name: Causality Ability Generation
overview: gain temporary abilities based on one's actions.
description: The user is able to get an ability based on their actions. This means they could do something and it can lead to an ability. There is a tradeoff. The action must have a meaning to it. An example wold be punching a man in a fight. Since that punch is an action, the ability would be something like enhanced strength. All ability last as long as the effect of the action.
pros: Gain abilities
Abilities are boosted by effect of action and decision that caused the action.
cons: Abilities last as long as the effects of actions.

name: Weaponverse
overview: Pull any imagined weapon from a separate personal dimension or armory.
description: Upon obtaining this ability, a personal dimension forms on the planes of your soul, housing any weapon that you have seen or imagined, even guns. You can configure the appearance of this separate plane and even pull it into this dimension allowing for a fortress-type armory. Upon summoning a weapon, a hole in space will form, linking local reality with your weaponverse, and any number of weapons that you have the energy to summon will appear.
pros: Can summon any weapon you have the capability to imagine or create within your mind.
Can potentially summon infinite numbers of weapons.
Summon weapons instantly.
cons: Can be extremely draining to summon large numbers, leading to death.
Can be harmed by summoned soul-rending weapons.
Some weapons lead to collateral damage.

name: Return To Self Genesis
overview: repair and heal any damage you cause
description: Simply put, the ability to return to normal any damage that you create. This ability applies to only your damage, however. You can choose which things to return and which things not to return.
pros: Helps out if a lot of collateral damage has been caused by you.
You can choose to heal your surroundings and not your enemy.
You can return the dead back to completely normal and healed. Said people will have no memory of what happened around their death..
cons: Can't heal damage caused by others.
Can be incredibly taxing.

name: Shattersoul
overview: cause any weapon you handle to remotely explode.
description: Upon activation of this ability, you can remotely detonate any weapon that you have touched. You can even cause weapons you are currently handling to shatter when swung.
pros: Powerful ability that usually serves as a trump card.
Can't be harmed by your own explosions.
Can be used on bullets.
cons: The collateral damage will be massive for some weapons.
The ability to be protected from weapon explosions does not extend to others.

name: Situational Adaptation
overview: have a superpower useful in a given situation
description: It is basically a highly limited "have every super power" power. Your power would be adapting, meaning your power randomly changes to a given situation. For example, if you need to save a person falling from a building, you'd have the power of flight. Need to get a bomb out of a crowded area? Teleportation.  As soon as the problem is solved, it goes away.
pros: Eliminates predictability when fighting foes.
Since you cannot choose your power, getting an unusual power for a given situation forces you to think outside the box.
Who knows. You might get omnipotence.
cons: You cannot choose the power you are given, so it may be challenging.
You are powerless outside of situation when you need to save someone or stop a bad guy(No donut summoning)

name: Perfect Sound Imitation
overview: imitate any sound with your voice.
description: The user can produce any sound or voice possible in any intensity or volume.  Gunshots to squeaks to celebrity impressions are just examples.  The intensity of the sound is even replicated.  For example, if the user imitates a loud explosion, a strong sound wave would follow as typically expected.  The user's vocal cords and neck muscles are powerful enough to withstand the strain from producing such sounds.  However, the user's ears are not protected from loud sounds, so caution is necessary.
pros: Useful for disguises or deception (i.e., pretending to have a gun)
An extant of unpredictability in combat
More durable neck
cons: Hearing protection needed for imitating loud sounds
May not work if enemy sees a pattern in your imitations
Useless if gagged or otherwise rendered mute

name: Power Bestowal
overview: bestow powers or jump-start latent powers.
description: You would be able to give powers to others or to increase the strength of their own powers.
pros: You would be able to selectively evolve existing genetic traits.
You would be able to see a person's genetic code.
You would be able to activate any latent powers in others.
cons: Once begun, the procedure is irreversible and can often result in unpredictable side effects.
You cannot use your powers on yourself.
Your power cannot be used offensively, unless you jump-start another's powers beyond their control.

name: Ghost Skin
overview: go through anything. You can turn into a ghost.
description: You will be able to go through anything, wood, steel, metal, almost anything. Can also become a ghost. You have all the strenghts of a ghost and all the weakness of a ghost. If you turn into a ghost you can only turn into it for one day.
pros: Go through anything.
Become a ghost.
Have ghost strenghts.
cons: Have ghost weakness.
Only become a ghost for a day.

name: Ability Reader
overview: See your  opponents/ally's powers and  skills.
description: Well to tell it simply you'll be able to see anyone's type of power and skill which gives you an edge but beyond that it's just more insight so you know what your up  against and the display is like pop up icons.
pros: Know what power/skill they have.
Works with a picture of person.
Helpful in need to know bases.
cons: Works only with sight.
Multiple  opponents might cause icon confusion.
Can't tell how powerful that power/skill is.

name: Probability Falsification
overview: hide or create false information, factor, or variables that affects probability..
description: The user will have the ability to manipulate probability by falsifying certain information. The user can shroud factors and variables that affect the likely end results of events in order to create a new probability. They can also use it make people miscalculate their plans and strategies. The user can create false factors and information in order to create an event that is not real. In short, the user can create an illusion through probability.
pros: Manipulate probability through removed or falsified factors
Create illusion
cons: Probability manipulators/ perceivers could be able to see through this ability.

name: Mythological Monster Morphing
overview: morph into any kinds of legendary beasts & monsters  from any kind of mythology.
description: Getting this superpower allows you to transform into various mythological creatures around the globe from the eight-headed sea dragon Yamato no Orochi of the Japanese mythology or Fenrir, the wolf-monster from Norse mythology. You can even "morph" into Medusa if you want! If you have extensive knowledge about mythological creatures, the sky's the limit!
pros: You can acquire the skills and abilities of the monsters you "morph" into.
Dragons and ghouls (not recommended) are counted.
No need for special requirements, only use your mind!
cons: Requires concentration and patience to "morph". Plus, you also acquire their weaknesses.
Changing to human form is initially a quick but painful process (like a werewolf). With enough practice (and patience), though, You can change back to human form faster without inducing pain.
If you had no idea about mythology, after all XD.

name: Weapon God's Blessing
overview: use weapons effectively
description: This blessing gives you skill to use any weapon of your choice effectively
pros: You can unlock every weapons true potential
you're undefeated  in armed combat
cons: The other powers still effect you
this requires great deal stamina and strength

name: Angels Power
overview: be half human half Archangel
description: Having massive wings and  creating any kind of angelic weapon that you can think of.  Having the strength of an archangel or in really tough times become the size of which a normal angel in real life in the bible are 35 feet so about 65 feet. You are the fast thing that flies by flying around the world in  30 seconds and can shift to the spiritual realm. Not allowed to satan your purpose is to obey God. This is the Angels power. You can only get it if you are born with it and you get it by God.
pros: Demons fear you.
You can shift to spiritual realm.
You can pull spirits right out of hell or out of body if granted by God.
cons: Darkness is weakness.
Magic is a weakness.
You can be summoned by God at any time and are ordered to do his works.

name: Probability Field Adaption
overview: adapt based on the likelihood of might happen to you
description: The user allows one to adapt. By tapping into the probability field, the user's body is able to adapt in order to defend themselves from unknown events. Since probability is unpredictable, the user is constantly adapting, increasing/ decreasing in strength. This ability works well against lucky individuals/probability manipulators. The user can adapt to  an individual's luck. Probability manipulators are changing probability, so the user will instantly adapt to those changes.
pros: Able to adapt based on things that might happen to you.
Adapt to a person's luck/ probability manipulator.
Could reach a new level of power when every single probable thing has been calculated.
cons: Adaption is usually unpredictable.

name: Memory Sword
overview: Wield a sword and access the tactical knowledge and sword skills of previous wielders.
description: With this ability you can access the tactical skills of anyone who previously wielded the sword.
pros: Access the skills of previous users.
Gain tactical skills and knowledge you might not possess.
Can instantianiously learn new skills.
cons: Is useless if you are the first user.
Only works with swords.
Can grant useless ineffective and outdated tactical knowledge.

name: Healing Stone
overview: Heal yourself by going into a stony  slumber.
description: When you become fataly injured you can go into a deep slumber. In that state your body will become stone-like. As you rest you will heal at a accelerated rate and within a 9 hour period you will be totally healed.
pros: Can recover from injury faster than normal
Can heal any physical injury no problem.
cons: Will be vunarable in your stone state.
Must complete your full hibernation to be fully healed.

name: Hero Choosing
overview: choose the choosen one.
description: User is capable of choosing main character of the story, granting him/her luck and (possibly) happyend. Usually, this ability also allows user to watch choosen one anytime, like person watching movie.
pros: Grants target luck.
You can use this ability on yourself too.
cons: Good character can become bad character. Then it's trouble.

name: Useless Invisibility
overview: be invisible when no one is watching you.
description:
User of this unfortunate ability can turn invisible when nobody is watching.
You can stay invisible as long as you want, but if you come to other person's field of view, you'll turn visible.
pros: At least you have superpower.
You'll turn back to visible state only if one who sees you is same species (you'll stay invisible if only animals are "watching" you).
cons: If you are in someone's field of view while invisible, you'll turn visible.

name: Instinctive Reality Warping
overview: warp reality based on one's instincts and reflexes.
description: This is pretty basic. The user can warp reality through reflex. When something is coming at the user, the user's reflexes will then warp up a wall or a shield or something to protect them. The user can also use this in combat, warping their body to become strong and fast. This ability only affects the user and the immediate area around them.
pros: Warp reality to protect yourself
Use it in fights
cons: Short range
Only works on user, no one else

name: Spectral Death Weapons
overview: summon any weapon from a plane of death.
description: With this power, you can summon any weapon. The weapons will be colored black and red, and will be made out of a unique material with the essence of death. You can also choose to imbue your weapons with the Death Mark. This means that the weapons have an aura of death - if they harm someone, the victim will have an essence of death that surrounds their soul.  This means that the victim cannot die, and will be locked permanently in a prison inside their mind, unable to perceive reality.
pros: You become a powerful warrior.
You instinctively have great skill with the weapons you summon.
cons: If you injure yourself with your weapons, you will bestowed with the Death Mark yourself.

name: Power Versatility
overview: make any ability apply to any situation.
description: This ability will allow the user to make their other abilities work in any situation even in a situation that would be highly illogical. An example would be if someone was injured,and the user only has fire manipulation. The user with this ability could change this ability to use it in way to heal them. It is still fire manipulation just used in odd way. That is how illogical this ability can make it. It can only do one situation at a time and one ability at a time.
pros: Make any ability become useful in any situation.
cons: One situation at a time.
One ability at a time

name: True Sword Mastery
overview: use anything as a sword including nothing
description: The user imagines themselves as holding a sword and focuses their resolve to cut something within the range of that "sword". The "sword" will cut what the user intends and other weapons can be parried with that "sword". "Sword" can be any length but posture will have to be adjusted. The user can also increase the "cutting range" of any object held in their hand and use it as a sword. Intangible objects like fire and abstracts can be wielded if user has required secondary abilities.
pros: Not handicapped by the lack of a weapon and no need to carry one
Can increase the cutting range of smaller objects--useful if that object is something's weakness
The "sword" is not solid and only what the user intends to cut will be cut
cons: Must be able to physically wield the sword(or wield it using other powers)
People with good instinct can sense the "sword" and avoid it
Requires ability to imagine the sword in your hands and decent swordsmanship

name: Waveform Manipulation
overview: convert one form of energy wave into another.
description: It is the ability to change the energy of a wave into another. Like sound into light, heat or gamma ray and vice versa. It is the ability to change any type of wave found on the electromagnetic spectrum to another and manipulate anything that follows a wave pattern.   Rule: New wave/energy will follow its inherent nature.
pros: Adaptable and versatile
Can intensify or weaken to power of other energy
cons: Must carry a source or create with your body.
Can only convert into 1 energy form at a time.
Controller can be overwhelmed by multiple energy/waveforms at once

name: Jumper
overview: teleport to any location on Earth.
description: This is a very rare form of teleportation. A person can create psionic 'jump-scars' by using their mind to bend space-time. They appear as clear 'cracks' in midair, that can lead to any location on Earth that a person chooses. Some jump-scars have a short or long delay period, depending on their size.
pros: This is a very versatile power to have!
Escape from enemies in mere seconds, or become a very tricky opponent!!
cons: Takes time to learn to control

name: Doubletime
overview: do something twice as fast as you last did it
description: This power allows you to do something twice as fast as you last did it, without exerting any more energy. This power even allows you to break normal biological limits, but you still can't break physical laws (unless you have other superpowers that break the law in some way.  This power is limited to speed in the lower levels, but with enough practice, can be extended to strength (because you are exerting twice the force).  However, this power cannot make you more accurate.
pros: Get chores and work done quickly
A little force times lots of repetition equals tons of force!
Normal biological and physical limits do not apply (exhaustion, muscle speed, energy, etc. )
cons: Physical laws and other fundamental limits still apply (e. G. No faster-than-light travel)
Unless extremely powerful, can only do something twice as fast (NCN)
If you stop or are disrupted, you have to build up speed again (NCN)

name: Superpower Manifestation
overview: create superhuman abilities in a externalized form.
description: This ability allows the user to make any physical power and manifest it into a physical form. These manifestations do not take the form of living creatures more like objects or supernatural forces, unless it was an animal transformation ability. This means the user doesn't possess these powers. Example, The user created heat vision. This ability makes it physical manifestation of heat vision like two red dots. The user can fire those dots as twin fiery beams of death.
pros: Manifest any physical ability
Control those powers
cons: Some manifestation can be unpredictable.

name: Imaginative Causality
overview: imagine any action in one's mind in order to create the effects in the real world.
description: The user is able imagine an action and this ability makes the effects happen in real life. For example, the user needs to karate chop a block of wood. The user first imagine chopping the wood in two(the cause), and his ability makes the wood in real life to be actually cut in half (the effect). The user and everything effected by this power is placed in the exact positions of how things would be like after the imagined action.
pros: Complete any action and subsequent effecst by thinking it.
If you imagine traveling to a different location, you will be teleported there.
Very effective in conjunction with strategies.
cons: If you imagine yourself being hurt, you will be. (If you don't master it. )
If the user imagines an action that seems impossible, the user will suffer.

name: Rapid Cell Regeneration
overview: heal from any wound instantaneously.
description: This ability doesn't just speed up healing, it allows you to pretty much never get sick at all, Slows down aging to the point that you pretty much live forever theoretically.
pros: Heal Instantaneously.
Never sick
Slowed or stopped aging when the power is active.
cons: You are everlasting thus everyone you know and love will pass, you won't.
You will have to bear the weight of forever for you may possibly live forever.

name: Electricity
overview: can shoot electricity bolls, give power to stuff that doesn't have power, you can take power and you can heal.
description: If you shoot electricity balls then it will just electrocute whatever it hits, if there is something that doesn't work then you can power it up so it works or you can heal people and can just electrocute stuff,if you run out of power then you can drain power from Machines and stuf.

You can heal people who are injured.
If there is something that doesn't work then you can power it up
cons: You can hurt citizens.
You can drain citizens power which will kill them
You could electricute citizens.

they need to be used for good not for bad.

name: Instant Learning
overview: instantly and perfectly learn any subject.
description: This power allows you to instantly and perfectly learn, and permanently retain, any knowledge and skills about any and all subject simply by thinking about them, all of which without any problem, difficulty or deformity.

name: Single Solution Causality

Example, I use this ability on a hammer. "A bomb is going to blow" I throw the hammer and it somehow defuses it. "Alien Invasion" Throw my hammer at them and they all perish. That is what this ability does.
pros: Make anything be the solution to any problem
Solve anything

name: Axiokinesis
overview: manipulate the value of things
description: With this power, you can manipulate how valuable something is to someone. This can apply to either everyone, or just a specific person/people. For instance, you could get things for super cheap from people by depreciating the value of those things in their eyes, or get people to want something by increasing its value. This works on people too; you can make yourself inexplicably valuable to your enemies, stopping them from harming you, or make someone value themselves less, leading to depression.

Protect yourself from people
Make people not care about themselves

name: Memory Tap
overview: travel back in time to the memory of another person.
description: Just by touching the target you can tap into every single moment of their life that they can remember.  You can travel back in time to a chosen moment.  You have a period of 6 hours to change whatever you want about that memory before you are transported back to the present day.  While you are in the memory, the reality that contains the memory's owner is frozen.  If the owner of the memory dies while you are in the memory, you will be transported back to the present day.

This power is easy to master.
cons: You could get stuck in a paradox if you mess with the space time continuum.
You can still die in the memory.

name: Advanced Regeneration
overview: regenerate bodily damage
description: Able to regenerate bodily damage, making the damaged area stronger each time it is healed. Broken bones become stronger each time they are healed, muscles and tendons become more resilient, etc. Fatigue is virtually eliminated, as lactic acid build up in the muscles is eliminated. Aging is slowed to the point where an individual doesn't appear to age at all, due to the body constantly regenerating the gradual decay of the aging process.

Come back stronger after each injury.

name: Imagination Manifestation
overview: manifest your imagination into a physical being only you can see.

overview: be extremely, superbly talented at everything.

You will gain a Grandmaster level for each of these skills, which would be anywhere between the 1st to 10th current best in the world. You can improve each skill even more with practice, but without practice it will eventually revert to the state when you first gained it.
pros: Your skills will never deteriorate beyond the level you gained them at.
Top-notch physical capabilities and obviously superhuman mental capacities.
Improved physical appearance. Hey, you can be at least the 10th best model in the world!

you have lots of applications

Do all that's not forced down (this is a proverb)

name: Tele Automation

description: This ability acts like a factory. The user wants something down and this ability automatically does the rest. Example, the user wants the house to be clean everyday before he gets home. Be your own factory. (High productivity)
Automatic ( No humans, No Machines)

description: The user will have great luck. This luck will appear in the form of a specific element like earth, fire, water, substance like acid, chlorine, or any other materials. name: Magic
overview: perform magic feats, cast spells, summon spirits, teleport, create things etc etc
description: With magic I can pretty much do anything. I think that anyone who is a Magician, Sorcerer, Sorceress, Witch, Warlock, Wizard and/or a Mysitc of any kind is only limited by their imagination and will so if I had a weakness it would be that. Though my potential is unlimited I do have a standard arsenal of offensive and defensive spells when in battle. I shoot mystical energy bolts from my hands and eyes, I fly, teleport, and I form a force field of mystical energy around myself when needed.

To be able to teleport from one place to another.
To be able to alter and/or change people, places and things into other forms.

Magic can be pretty unpredictable which is why it can be scary sometimes.

name: Bio Energy Communication
overview: communicate through one's bio-electrical field.
description: The user will have the ability to change their bio-energy into frequencies that they can us to communicate with other living things. Manipulate sounds
Create frequencies with different effects

Rip even the strongest of materials apart.

name: Reality Coder
overview: manipulate reality with a programming language
description: This ability allows the user to bring up a virtual keyboard and augmented reality display overlaying their vision. An empty prompt appears before them. They can summon objects and change the properties of things by typing code into the prompt. For example, "import Glock_17" would cause a Glock 17 pistol to appear. Anything can be done, but many functions and objects must be programmed before being used, otherwise the system doesn't know what you're trying to do. Comes with a virtual help file.
pros: Can summon virtually anything, and change the properties of objects
Can create programs for any situation and execute them at will
Cannot be seen using it (aside from the user typing at an invisble keyboard)
cons: Must create programs and define functions and objects
Have to memorize everything you've defined or be constantly refering to the help file
Must learn how to write code

name: Self Manipulation
overview: greatly change and control your body.
description: With this power, you can transform your body and manipulate its features. You can turn your body heat to a thousand degrees farenheit or more to be defended or turn yourself into fire and launch it. You can either use your bioelectricity as a weapon or turn into lightning and shoot it. You can also change your regular body and increase its strength and youth.
pros: You are extremely powerful.
cons: You must be creative.

name: Physical Understanding
overview: understand the inner workings, and physical aspects on any machine.
description: This contact based power will allow the user to understand the physical capabilities of any machine. It will understand how it works, how to use in perfectly, and all internal pieces within the machine.
pros: Allows the user to understand the use of any machinery like guns or vehicles
Can reconstruct past objects that he or she has touched.
Can physically take apart and rebuild any object
cons: No battle purpose other than creating weapons and using basic attacks

name: Energy Manipulation/Control
overview: control many forms of energy
description: Most Energywielders are separated into light and dark. LightWielders can naturaly flow energy through their bodies quickly and continuously but weak in power. DarkWielders can collect and focus energy and release it in precise and powerful blasts but cant be fired quickly. Their specializations do not make them good or evil. The 3 types of energy are Electricity(dark preference), Photons(light preference), and Plasma. Only EnergyWielders can control all types of energy.
pros: Power over many types of energy
Can be used in creative ways
Can be pulled from anywhere(no need of a source)
cons: Can only use one type at a time
Not all types of energy are effective against all enemies
Rigorous training is required to use higher level energies without a focus.

name: Clearance Schmearance
overview: have access to anything
description: With this power you can have access to any top secret file, facility or person. No need for a badge, password, ID or retina scanner just activate this power and go find what you're looking for. This power works with but is not limited too Governments, agencies, secret societies, secret clubs and satanic cults.
pros: You can have access to anything
cons: You still have to find where the information you're looking for is being held
^But you have access to that information too so...
Not much use in physical combat

name: Tactile Cryokinesis
overview: control ice while either in direct contact with it, or in close proximity
description: This ability is extremely powerful. A person can control ice in whatever way they desire. Ice shards and slabs can be formidable weapons. Advanced users can even overcome fire, heat, or even lava-based powers, provided they are in proximity of any ice or water source. This power allows regeneration at advanced levels.
pros: Be a near-invincible fighter!
Use ice trails to escape from enemies faster, and also slow them down.
Enemies will find you to be a VERY tricky opponent to fight!
cons: Takes time to learn to control.
This power requires either direct physical contact, or a proximity of no more than 200 feet to work

name: Power Automation
overview: greatly extend the capabilities of Power Programming to allow automation of your powers.
description: With this ability, one can program their abilities to act in a certain way in a given situation. Active powers can act without any intervention on your part. However, to use this power, one must have acquired Power Programming, though mimicry is permitted.
pros: Live a life with normal perception but still enjoy the benefits of enhanced perception of the world.
Activate or deactivate superpowers according to a given situation using Josh's Power Switchboard.
Use active powers while unconscious.
cons: You need to have Power Programming, but it may be mimicked.
Does not enhance the capabilities of your powers.
Useless without other powers; even if you also have Power Programming, you need powers to program.

name: Superhuman Energy
overview: have increased levels of mental and psysical energy when you activate this power.
description: Ever felt tired or lazy? With this superpower, you can have a lot of energy. Energy to do your homework, run across a bridge, dance. You can activate and deactivate this power at will. Don't overactivate this power, or you'll be hyper, paranoid, hypervigilant and will not sit still. You can stay up a few hours past bedtime. If you're extremely sleep deprived and forget to turn off this superpower, instead of staying awake, you'll fall asleep and awaken hours later temporarily confused and hyper.
pros: Have energy to do anything.
Activate and deactivate this power at will
Stay up for up to 4 hours past your bedtime.
cons: You WILL fall asleep if you're extremely sleep deprived.
Overactivating this superpower could lead to hypervigilance, hyperness, and paranoia for a while
If you sleep while this superpower is activated, you'll wake up temporarily confused and hyper.

name: Theory Of Relativity
overview: manipulate gravity and forces.
description: You are able to control gravity; you may increase it or decrease it. For example, you may pin targets to the ground, or levitate objects. Or else, you may create your own gravity, and make flying objects orbit around you. You may use this as a form of psychokinesis, pulling and pushing targets.
pros: There is no limit to the area that you cast your power upon.
If you try hard enough, you may lift extremely heavy objects such as cars with lack of gravity.
You can activate this power to you yourself, thus being able to fly.
cons: It requires a lot of skill to actually perform this skill. Even through practicing, you can mess up.
Your weakness is electricity or radar.
You may not increase gravity and decrease it at the same time, even if the targets are different.

name: Infinite  Weapon Arsenal
overview: carry an infinite amount of weapons
description: this ability allows you to carry infinite amount weapons with you
pros: you never run out of weapons
you're basically invincible in armed combat
the weapons are weightless when carried
cons: so many weapons to choose from may be hard for someone

name: Force Field Creation
overview: create an Impenitatible bubble around you.
description: You can create an impenitatible bubble around you as long as you are inside. Makes any shape at will. Incredibly strong. No limit on size.
pros: No Size Limit
Any Shape You Want
Completely Impenitatible
cons: Have to be inside of shield
Moves with you
Causes Exaustion

name: Omnipotent Power Mimicry
overview: have every power in the world
description: You can have every power in the world. You are also able to sense when a new power has been discovered, and you will know what it is. But you can only use one power a day, e.g. when someone needs to be saved from a moving train, you can choose to use super speed, but you are then stuck with that power until the end of the day (12:00 am).
pros: You have every power in the world
You can sense when a new power has been discovered
You can choose what power you want to use
cons: You can only have one power a day
You have to choose wisely

name: Shifting Elements
overview: change and control all know elements through hand controls
description: A advanced combination of telekinesis and alchemy. Through simple hand movements, you can lift something up, change their shape, size, properties and state of matter.
pros: Makes you very dangerous and powerful.
Because you can control yourself, you can enhance and rebuild yourself.
It enables flight and other powers derived of the main powers.
cons: If you don't understand physics/chemistry, you can't do that much.
The kryptonite of this power is fermium.

name: Ultimate Shapeshifting
overview: become anything.
description: You can shapeshift into any living, non-living (except corpses and such), or inanimate object you want, even something of different sex! If the thing you turn into has memories (such as elephants, humans, dolphins, or computers), you gain those memories in that form, but only while in that form. Also, when in a form that retains memories, the memories of that person or object (computer, etc. ) update psychically.
pros: Shapeshift into any living, non-living, or inanimate object you want.
Impersonate anyone you want :P You are indetectable and untrackable.
Disguise yourself as anything from a speck of dirt (not recommended) to a tree to hide from anyone!
cons: Heavy mental stress from memories and such can lead to mental problems. (In 30% of people)
Changing into inanimate objects can lead to temporary side effects, such as half-shifting.

name: Super Strength, Flight, Mental
overview: lift tremendous tons, fly unaided, read minds, project thoughts, control minds, project illusions.
description: With my super strength comes a  degree of invulnerability (endurance, stamina) as well. My body is completely resistant to bullets, arrows and other projectiles. My body is resistant to alot if not most energy attacks. My telepathic skills are proficient and continually improving. I can read minds, control minds, project thoughts and illusions, cause my soul to leave and re-enter my body (astral projection) and at times I see glimpses of the future. I have the ability to fly unaided.
pros: To honestly be able to help people whenever and however I can.
Being able to fly would be so fun and besides that, flying definitely has several advantages.
Not being hurt easily is definitely a pro.
cons: I could accidently hurt someone with my strength.
Because I'm so strong there would probably be people who conspired to try and find a way to kill me.
Being telepathic may have its advantages however you may see things that you'd probably rather not.

name: Psychic Powers
overview: have a different psychic power every day
description: Every day when you wake up, you'll have a psychic power. This psychic power will change every day. You can only have one psychic power each day. These psychic powers include but are not limited to: psychokinesis/telekinesis, telepathy, clairvoyance, levitation, astral projection, precognition, ect. because there are only so many psychic powers, the you will eventually re-attain psychic powers that you have already had before.
pros: New psychic power every day
cons: Allowed only one psychic power a day

name: Reality Effect Manipulation
overview: control or change how realities/dimensions affects people, objects, or etc. to give them effects.
description: This ability does not controls realities/dimensions just its effects on things within it. In some cartoon and anime shows when a character(s)enters a different dimension and they get stronger or weaker. This ability manipulate that those effects. The user can make himself stronger and other as well. He can be creative when dealing with enemies. The user can make their reality feel like poison or acid to them and no one else would suffer to the effects.
pros: Make you or other things stronger or weaker.
Give unique effects to targets or yourself.
Never be the victim of effects of alternate realities/dimensions
cons: The effects are only temporary if the user away from target.
Has a limit on targets when using this ability on multiple targets.
Does not controls realities/dimensions only its effects on things within it.

name: Molecular Machinery
overview: create tiny functional nanomachines out of loose particles floating in the air
description: A person with this power has the ability to create nanomachines out of particles in the air. Also known as Synthesis. This power allows the user to create many things that are only possible in a lab and some impossible. For example they could create machines that would improve the efficiency of their own body or create tiny energy generators that are highly efficient. The only limit to this power is the inability to manipulate after a certain size and the available resources in the air
pros: Can create any nanomachine as long as you have the necessary comp
Can become creative with this power
Also comes with the ability to sense microscopic things within surrounding air
cons: Machines only have a single purpose after being created and the creation must happen in your hands
Need to have some understanding of chemistry to avoid dangerous reactions
Can't create gigantic objects only nanomachines

name: Elemental Life Force
overview: be powered by a life-force of a specific element (natural or periodic).
description: This ability gives one a life force of an element. This is different from aura. Auras surrounds a person, while a life force is the spiritual energy of a person that keeps a human alive. The user will run on an element like fire, water,Copper, Helium,etc. If they are near an element of that matches to their life-force, then they get stronger. Of course, if you see fighting animation, the user can releases life-force to perform elemental attacks.
pros: Power up by element(natural or periodic)
Create Elemental life-force attacks
cons: If you use it up, you die

name: Self Existence Manipulation
overview: manipulate or recreate how you exist in this universe
description: Did you ever looked in the mirror & said "I wish was something else"? Then fret no more! With this ability you can recreate everything in your life from your body and your soul, to the very fabrics of your essence the made you real. Imagine the possibilities of being your own creator; now you can decide if you can die or not. Decide how you are seen, heard, or felt by others? Or not at all. Or remake from how your life began. This ability also enables the creation of new super abilities.
pros: The possibility of becoming one's own designer is limitless.
Death will be ultimately impossible for someone who can decide if he can die or not.
Can create new abilities for yourself
cons: Transformations are permanent
Requires so much imagination it is utterly useless to someone who thinks with his fist

name: Elemental Iris
overview: control elements
description: You can control elements such as fire, water, earth, air. And can change elements just by blinking and thinking of an element, which will change your iris color to that elements color. Power can be evolved to control more than the classical elements, for example lightning, metal etc.
pros: Can burn, freeze, or electrocute by blinking.
No side-effects
Powers won't work unless you want them to.
cons: Takes lots of practise to evolve to power

name: Infinite Supply
overview: give any item/container an infinite supply.
description: The ability to give an item or container an infinite supply.  I. E: An infinite amount of water in a bottle
pros: Limitless supply of ammunition in a magazine
Feed Africa
Unlimited McDonalds
cons: Concentration is needed for larger objects
Not all effects are permanent
Taxes

name: Function Mimicry
overview: mimic an object's primary function.
description: This ability can make someone the ideal carry-on tool. An example would be if the user mimicked the function of a hammer. Then they would be able to pound things like a hammer. You will have some of the strength and/or weakness of the tool that you mimicked. You won't actually turn into the object. You'll just be able to do what the object does. You can even absorb materials that one of the mimicked functions need like bullets if you had mimicked the function of a gun.
pros: Can mimic any object that has a function.
No more need for object.
Have some of the strengths of the object.
cons: Have some of the weakness of the object.
Only works on objects that have a function.
You need to understand the function and how it works.

name: Teleportation
overview: teleport yourself to any location.
description: With this ability, you can teleport yourself to anywhere in the world.  If you've seen the movie "Jumper", you teleport in a similar fashion.  That movie was horrible, by the way.  Anyways, you might be worried about teleporting while moving, or teleporting onto a moving vehicle.  That's all taken care of.  Your teleportation ability keeps you from teleporting into situations where you could get killed.
pros: Go anywhere, anytime, instantly
Never be late for work--as long as you can get your ass out of bed
You can totally mess with your friends
cons: Car rides seem slow as hell
You might be considered dangerous

name: Electric Powered Strength
overview: absorb electricity to heal and/or boost natural physical capabilities to superhuman levels
description: A person with this power can achieve many physical based powers including superstrength and speed by absorbing electricity. This also renders the user immune to any electrical attacks since all electric attacks only serve to strengthen/heal the user. The user can also absorb electricity actively through touching objects with electricity-later on they can do this from farther distances.
pros: Can eat electricity or absorb it through your skin with no problems-this includes draining batteries
Once you get a good charge going you can go on even footing with superstrength users
Can drain the power of machinery or batteries and even powe through touch to accelerate your healing
cons: No ranged attacks-can't shoot lightning etc, but can still throw objects
Need a source of electricity to get power from but you naturally have some degree of extra strength
Absorbing electricity is subconsious so you need to active control it to not drain your electronics

name: Hacking
overview: hack anything
description: This power enables the user to easily hack into any computer network, password or hand-held device, to access   information the user needs. This works on electrically activated doors and stuff like that.
pros: Can get any info from anywhere
Never forget your password
A job is ready set up at the F.B.I
cons: Doesn't help fight anything
Limited when accessing networks by computer capacity

name: Petrifactive Hibernation
overview: enter a dormant state as a statue, from which the user emerges fully rejuvenated.
description: The user can transform themselves into a statue in order to heal and be prevented from further harm, and returns to normal when they have fully healed.
pros: Cannot feel any pain when in statue form.
Advanced users may be able to become unbreakable stone (thus negating the first con).
cons: In statue form, the user may be chipped, damaged or completely fragmented.
If the user is not experienced, they may not be able to restore themselves.
Others may be able to restore the user before they have fully healed.

name: Luck Prioritization
overview: change and specify how one's luck operates to make it more effective.
description: This ability allows one to prioritize their own luck and how it works for them. The user is able to make their luck become more practical and controllable. An example would be to set your luck to "Attack Mode". Now, the user's luck will be more aggressive like their enemies would be hit by trucks and cars in the middle of the fight. They can change it to "Defense Mode" and random stuff will suddenly protect them. There are so many other modes to try.
pros: Change how your luck work.
Make your luck more effective and stronger
cons: Can only be on one mode at a time.

name: Portal Mastery
overview: open portals to anywhere you can see in your mind, for travel or isolation in suspended time.
description: Your body acts as a doorway to the inside of a worm-hole, except with total control. Portals to anywhere in the universe or simply a portal to keep people trapped in dead time (can be used to trap enemies or transport people as you can bring them out of it no matter where you are. ) When inside, time ceases to exist. There is no aging, no starving- time simply stands still.
pros: Easy access to place you can see in your mind.
You have an easy alternative to killing bad guys (if it's not your thing. )
Can carry an infinite number of people within yourself. Could one day save the entire planet.
cons: If you are knocked unconscious as you enter your portal, you'll be that way forever and never return
Know where you're opening a portal to. If you open one and step out onto the sun, you die.
Opening multiple portals puts an overwhelming amount of stress on your mind and could knock you out.

name: Ultimate Kinesis
overview: control any element known to man.
description: You can fully control any element or substance, such as fire, water, metal, space, time, blood, and many others.
pros: Can defeat anyone.
Controlling any power is easy.
Impressing your friends could never get any easier.
cons: You can only control five elements at a time.
Combining powers takes time.
You can be a threat to your loved ones.

name: Space/Time Manipulation
overview: manipulate space and time
description: Einstein once theorized that space and time were linked. He was right. A person with Space/Time Manipulation can slow, speed or stop time. They can also travel through time and teleport.
pros: See what really happened in all those battles
Go to all the great cities free of charge
No contest in fights
cons: Takes monumental effort to use
Cannot rewrite history, as the universe protects itself and sends you back
If you touch your past self, you will die in an explosion

name: Lexiconicy
overview: transform a written word into the actual object
description: How cool would it be to have any object you ever wanted? With the Lexiconicus power, that is possible! All you have to do is write the word out, and clap your hands together, and presto the written word actually becomes what it stands for. No pencil or paper necessary! You can write the word in mid-air with your finger! Need to escape a sticky situation? No problem, just "write" the word 'jetpack', clap your hands together and you instantly have a jetpack to blast out of the area with!
pros: You can have anything
Add on an adjective to enhance the word
cons: Must be able to spell, major backfire if spelled incorrectly
Only works with nouns (people, places, things)

name: Door To Anywhere
overview: use any door as a portal to any other door in the world.
description: With this ability you can turn any door into a portal that connect to any door of your choosing anywhere in the world. The portal closes as the door does and cannot be reopened except with this ability. This ability also applies to anything that acts like a door, including chest lids or cupboards.
pros: Go anywhere with a door
Evade enemies easily
cons: Others can follow you through your portals if the door does not close.

name: Answers
overview: cause people to truthfully answer any question you ask them while look at them
description: With this power whenever you ask someone a question while looking directly at them they will automatically give you a truthful answer. If you're looking at a person through a window, glasses, or a screen this power does not work.
pros: You can make people answer any question truthfully
cons: You have to be looking at them

name: Indestructability!
overview: be immune to kinetic attacks when you activate this power.
description: With this ability, you are immune to most kinetic damage. Your bones and blood become infused with a new element which is aware of you. Your teeth and skeleton become about 220 times stronger than steel. Your body mass stays the same. Your blood and organs become a "smart fluid" and will become 8 times tougher than steel when you scream "Indestructability! ", or when extreme danger is detected. You shut off the power mentally or by saying indestructability off.
pros: Bones become 220 times tougher than steel while maintaining a degree of flexibility.
You can make the rest of yourself indestructable by yelling "Indestructability! "
Can be turned off. Permanent indestructable bone and teeth!
cons: If someone else discovers the secret element/drinks your blood, they can turn durable/indestructable
Only stops kinetic force. Power is infused with bone(it has to in order to work).
Your bone and blood cells still depend on calcium for other things. Permanent indestructable bones!

name: Memory/Sight  Jump
overview: jump or teleport to places you have visited in the past
description: The person with this power is able to teleport to places which he or she has been too. The person cannot jump or teleport to places they have not seen or been to. There is no distance restriction for this power. If you have seen the place or been to the place you want to go, you can go there. When they jump, they leave no traces of smoke or light whatsoever
pros: Can travel to anywhere in the world as long as you have been there
Can stop enemies who are creatures of habit.
cons: Cannot go to places you have not seen or been to

name: Comic Word
overview: say comic words and make them happen
description: If you say boom looking at a car it explode. If you say whoosh looking at something that thing will fly. And so on.
pros: No physical exhaustion.
Can be done from a safe distance.
You get to read comics!!!!!
cons: If some one shuts your mouth it is useless.
Does not work with food in mouth.
Say it by mistake would activate it.

name: Great Good Videogames Orders
overview: have any terrific game that you want created
description: create any terrific game that the owner of this superpower wants, regardless of whether video games were lousy before using this superpower and regardless of whether video games were once so good that can not be further improved. You can create any game, whether for video game consoles or Internet.
pros: You can not make bad games
No need for lousy games since no effort is needed to create really good ones
No real limit on this super power's games
cons: You could get in trouble for copyright infringement
You can also create a very short game
If your games are terrible they will switch to something better

name: Desiderium
overview: know exactly what people desire, and make them come true
description: Desiderium is latin for "desire" . The user knows exactly what people desire, and can make those desires come true if they choose to do so. By focusing on a specific person, the user can know their every desire, from the smallest ones, to the greatest one of all. If the user wants to, they can make desires come true, except the desires to cause harm or death to others, or to take a persons free-will away. The user can use this power on themselves, which would be like granting their own wishes.
pros: Know exactly what other people desire
Make desires come true
User can use this power on themselves, which would be like granting their own wishes
cons: Can't make desires come true if they cause harm or death to others, or take a persons free-will away

name: Ultimate Technopath
overview: control any technology anywhere in the galaxy
description: With this power, you are basically a god. Since our society is so dependent on machines, any piece of technology anywhere is within your power. You can control a nigh limitless army of technology that can continue to grow if you set up a few factories and program them to mass produce. The only problem with this power, you need absolute focus. If you're surrounded and battling six war fronts at once, your brain will shut down as if a computer from too much lag.
pros: Godly in this time
Control all tech
Other technopaths can't touch this, you overpower them.
cons: Focus, you need lots of it.

name: Force Manipulation
overview: manipulate all forces
description: You can control gravity, electromagnetism and all types of force. You can control friction and slow things down, gravity to make things weightless. This is only limited by your imagination. Also, you have a more advanced control over these forces.
pros: Levitate your car in traffic
Make surfaces slippery
Pretty dangerous
cons: Too dangerous for supervillians

name: Perfect Self Control
overview: have perfect control over one's self.
description: With this power, you have complete and utter perfect, easy, and continuous control over yourself, thus preventing you from ever being controlled, manipulated, and corrupted by outside forces. As a side effect of having this power, you also have perfect, easy, and continuous control and use of any and all of your special, superhuman, and supernatural powers, abilities, skills, and talents too.
pros: Never be controlled, manipulated, or corrupted by anything ever again.
Never lose control of any of your powers.
Have extraordinary willpower that is beyond anyone or anything.
cons: Nothing bad whatsoever.

name: Natural Talent Power
overview: increase your natural talents
description: With this power you can increase your natural talents to the point where they become super powers. For instance if your natural talent is singing you will become the best singer ever and your singing will be hypnotic. If your natural talent is baking you will make the best breads and other baked goods ever and they will be able to cure diseases. If your natural talent is writing you will become the best writer ever and whatever you write will become true.
pros: You can increase your natural talents to the point where they become super powers
cons: You cannot increase the natural talents of others

name: Personal Realm
overview: create your own realm.
description: With this power, the user can create a world outside of this dimension. This world will have the user's own rules, laws of physics, look, etc. A portal must be made on a "marker" in this world that has a counterpart in the user's world. The marker can be either a tree, a rock, a doorway, etc., but there is only one marker. You can make as many realms as you want, but only one at a time.
pros: Cool place to hang out
In your realm, you are a god
If the real world is about to be destroyed, you can bring people to your world and save humanity
cons: Takes lots of practice, meditation, and work to make the world and portal stable
If the portal is destroyed, there is no way into or out of your personal realm
The only portal into the realm cannot be moved.

name: Body Reformation
overview: completely reform your body
description: When any of your body parts explode or get cut off,  they'll desintegrate into clouds.   Those clouds will then gather automatically to reform your body to it's original form.   Even if your whole body gets divided into countless pieces, you'll still reform.
pros: Killing you permanently will become difficult
You won't ever permanently loose any of your limbs, or head
cons: The pain before you would need this power
This power has no offensive purpose

name: Master Of Combat
overview: instantly learn any form of martial arts just by looking at its basic movements
description: The user is able to learn any form of martial arts that currently exist just by reading the martial arts or hand to hand combat moves from the respective manuals . However, the user is only able fully master a total of eight forms of martial arts
pros: Can combat any opponent hand to hand.
Dont need to spend hours on training.
Easily defeat weak opponents that are horrible at hand to hand combat
cons: The total of martial arts that can be mastered
Not strong enough to combat the major powerhouses

name: Shadow Walking
overview: teleport through shadows
description:
Basically, you could walk into a shadow of an alleyway by your house, and walk out of an alleyway in Paris or something. Zing! 

Or even walk into a shadow here, and come out of a shadow on the dark side of Mars! (or any planet)

The only downside is you might get lost in the 'Shadow Realm' you have to pass through.
pros: Shadows are basically everywhere
Super-easy to walk into people's houses
Cool party trick/ good for escaping
cons: You might get lost getting from place to place
If you fell into a shadow, you might end up on Mt. Everest.................
Probably not the easiest power to control

name: Psionic Energy Manipulation
overview: absorb and emit powerful psionic energy at will from both the mind AND the body
description: This ability is, basically, the psychic equivalent of induced radioactivity. A person can absorb limitless amounts of psionic energy without harm, and emit it at will in small amounts or in a huge blast similar to a shockwave from a supersonic jet. You can even control bursts of energy in your hands, similar to small atomic explosions, like what someone with induced radioactivity could do.
pros: No psychic could ever hope to read your mind or control you!
Your power is great in a fight!
You could eventually develop psychic powers with enough practice!
cons: Psionic energy bursts can be lethal to others
Extreme levels of power can fatigue you very quickly, and gradually weaken your power

name: Elemental Weapons
overview: form weapons out of the elements
description: With this power you can create weapons out of air, water, fire, and earth, along with variations of the elements like storm or ice. As long as you are near the element, you can create any type of melee weapon you want. You could make a whip out of storm clouds, a mace out of rock, a trident out of water, or a sword of fire. The weapons are solid, but they retain properties of the element you created it from. For example, fire weapons can burn, ice weapons freeze, and storm weapons can shock.

name: Superhuman Habit
overview: increase the effectiveness and efficiency of any one action you perform repeatedly
description: A person with this ability can specialize in any one action or a limited set of closely related actions and turn that habit into something supernatural in nature. For example a user can practice a single punch repeatedly such that using that punch will generate superhuman amount of force and the amount of force generated continues to grow with every repetition of the same action. Eventually the user may have to limit the times they perform that action because it may become too powerful.
pros: Can specialize in any one specific action turning that action superhuman in nature
Can be used to gain accuracy, speed, power, efficiency, and other attributes for any action
A customizable power able to adapt it to any one action you desire
cons: May becomes impractical to use overtime ie it becomes overkill
Only applies to one action or set of actions
Action may be useless for current situation

name: Ability Reality Application
overview: turns one's physical abilities/powers into reality warping ability.
description: The user has the ability to turn mundane and physical powers into cosmic phenomenons that have a place in reality. An example of this would be the user having the ability to possess a power punch. With this ability, he can now summon a fist made of metaphysical energies to strike his enemies. This can strain reality if used to many times at one, but give it time, and reality will adjust.
pros: Turn any physical power into a force of reality
Control the range of the effects
Reality will adjust to it
cons: No Reality themed abilities
Reality can be damaged if used too many times at once

name: Feather Weight Touch
overview: make anything as light as a feather by touching it.
description: A person with this power is able to make any object or item as light as a feather, regardless of how big or heavy it is. For example, someone with this power will be able to lift a car like it was only as light as a feather. If the item or object leaves the hand or hands of the user, the item or object will return to its normal weight. If the user were to use the item he or she is touching as a weapon, the enemy would feel the full weight of the object.
pros: Can easily carry heavy items or objects. Do no need to hire moving men if you were to move houses
Can combat crime
Can be a good first responded in the event of a collapsed building,
cons: None

name: Vision Of Fictional Situation
overview: see a fictional character in any situation you want
description: This superpower allows its owner to see how they behave and how they react fictional characters in the position you want, for example Mario departed too fat or Mickey this in a storm only indoors. The results of these situations can be seen.
pros: You can see a fictional character in any situation you want
This superpower only allows viewing and not make it happen, it can be as advantageous as awful
There are no limits to find out to see what would happen with any fictional character
cons: This superpower only allows viewing and not make it happen, it can be as advantageous as awful
You can see things that can only be seen by mature or adult.
This superpower no use to attack

name: Nuke Clap
overview: Clap with the force of a nuclear blast
description: The owner of this power wields the force of a nuke in his hands. When the owner claps hard enough, a huge blast wave shoots out with the power of a 5 megaton nuke. You don't want to be on the receiving end of this. But if your body can't handle the force of it, then it's a horrible idea to use it.
pros: It is very damaging to enemies
It's so much fun to use
cons: It destroys everything in a 20 mile radius
Unless your body can handle the force of it, it will kill you.

name: Dimension Manipulation
overview: enter, create, and control different dimensions.
description: With this power you could enter, control, and create any dimension. This includes hammerspace, the nightmare dimension, the dream dimension, a dimension of your very own etc. You can change your dimension into whatever you want. In there, you are god. There are also an infinite number of dimensions to explore and control. Ones such as the bacon, mime, maze and almost anything else you can think of. This is all yours to control.
pros: You have your own dimension.
There's not much you can't do.
You can create and distroy anything.
cons: You might get lost in some dimensions.
You might run out of ideas for new dimensions.
Different dimension,different scientific laws,and different reality.

name: Transmutation
overview: change ANYTHING into ANYTHING else one can clearly imagine
description: You could take a pencil and change it into a high tech rocket. As long as you can clearly imagine it you can change something into it. And it does not have to be realistic, so it could be a futuristic weapon or robot. It could even be nonreal things like monsters. Refrigerators to time machine. Cat to mutant saber tooth tiger. Anything means anything!
pros: Becoming the best saleman ever...endless inventory from junk!
Could have anything you want!
You can create and destroy anything.
cons: You must have something to change first.

name: Tactile Sensory Absorption
overview: gather all information of a surface from a single touch
description: By touching an object the user emits a field that gathers information based on the surface area. A whole newspaper can be read by one sustained touch by understanding the ridges of ink and indentations. People can be detected by touching the floor and emitting field, though if they are suspended in air they would be undetected.   at low levels works in pulses on small objects high levels capable of large areas, radar, vibro-analysis, stresspoint exposure
pros: High spatial awareness & 3d mind imaging
Able to identify weakspots on touch
cons: Sensory overload if untrained in use

name: Gravity Direction Manipulation
overview: manipulate the direction of gravity's pull by bending space.
description: This power bends space, but gravitational fields are unaffected. This will result in apparently changing the direction in which gravity pulls. To illustrate: imagine a civilization in a river. The current would be gravity. Now, the ability wielder would be able to rearrange everything, with the current going the same way, eg: they turn the civilization upside down so that the current appears to pull up, making everything fall into the sky. This power could be used for telekinesis and flying.
pros: Could be used for telekinesis, flying, projection into space.
Would be really cool to make gravity pull upwards so that everything falls into the sky.
Cause chaos easily.
cons: Difficult to use.
Could easily kill oneself, if say, made oneself fall three strories to the roof of a big building.
Limited use.

name: Will Materialization
overview: give form or materialize the willpower of the user
description: This ability utilizes the mind of the user to materialize his will in the physical world. This enables him to create a myriad of weapons in all forms and sizes he can think of with their own unique abilities. Anything formed by this ability is impervious to change; It will remain as it is in form, composition, ability, purpose, its place in the universe, and its existence in time and space as long as the person 'wills' it to be. The user also perceives everything in the midst of his creations.
pros: Materialize almost anything you can think of.
Your creations will retain their characteristics no matter what as long as you will it.
Because it originated from your willful mind your creations enable you to perceive your surrounding
cons: Entirely dependent on the willpower of the user making it hard to master.
The speed of materializing an object is dependent on the user's familliarity or knowledge
Imagination is your friend but it is also your limiting agent.

name: Kinesis Collection
overview: use all 'kinesis' powers
description: With this power you are able to manipulate just about all types of 'kinesis' powers from Telekinesis to Chronokinesis. Basically, you are able to use every legitimate kinesis power that is on this site
pros: You can use a lot of powerful powers.
You can use multiple at the same time.
cons: Doesn't grant you immunity to kinesis powers of others.

name: Obedience Manipulation
overview: make anything obey or disobey anything eles.
description: This ability can make anything obey to the user even non-living things. The user can make things obey to anything else if they want. This ability can make anything disobedient as well. This could cause anarchies in kingdoms. The effects only go away if the user is not mentally focusing on the victim.
pros: Absolute control
cons: Effects go away if the user is not mentally focusing on the victim.

name: Impenetrable Skin
overview: have impenetrable skin
description: Nothing can penetrate your skin, not bullets, blades, needles, ect. In addition, your skin is immune to pain and burn marks. Having this power does not make your skin stiff, your skin is as flexible as usual, it just cannot be penetrated (or burned). Also, if you possess this power, than your bones become unbreakable. This power makes you indestructible and immune to pain, but not immortal; you can still die by any means that isn't caused by physical injury.
pros: Skin is immune to penetration, burn marks, and physical pain
Unbreakable bones
cons: Not immortal; you can still die by any means that isn't caused by physical injury

name: Telekinesis Via Sight
overview: move thing with their mind as long as they can see it or have eye contact with it
description: Normal telekinesis can work eventhough you cannot see the object you want. For example, if you left you cup behind you you can use telekinesis to bring it to you. However, with this power you must be able to see you cup or the object you want, then only will the user be able to use this power. Anything in the user's field of vision can be moved telekinetically. If the user were to move, resulting in the object he or she is currently levitating to go out of sight, he or she will drop the object.
pros: Can move things with your mind
Dont need to get your hands dirty
Easily defeat opponents by just looking at them
cons: If you are blinded even temporarily your powers will stop working
Cant use this power in very dark places

name: Accelerated Probability
overview: predict every outcome.
description: Ever played soccer and wonder how to kick the ball into the goal? With this ability, you can slow things down, see the path before you, and move there with super speed. Once in probability mode, you can see every outcome and mathematically manipulate the odds in your favor!
pros: Slow down time
Foresee every outcome
Move at super speed to get things done
cons: The ability works consciously (f.y.i you do not predict things constantly)
Can only use super speed in probability mode
You can only physically change the odds (Jet Li using a human shield in The One)

name: Mimicry
overview: mimic the appearance or skill of any object, person or creature.
description: With this ability, you can mimic the appearance or abilities of any object, person or creature you can clearly imagine. However, you also take on the weaknesses of that object/person. One drawback of this ability is that it's much harder to mimic something you've never seen before, and you CANNOT mimic something which doesn't exist.
pros: You can transform, and/or gain the ability of any person/object/creature you can clearly imagine.
There is no time limit to how long you can stay in your mimic form.
You inherit all the strengths of your target.
cons: You can't mimic something which doesn't exist. (Ex: a wizard. )
You also inherit the weaknesses of the target.

name: Weapon Manipulation
overview: psychically manipulate anything that is intended to be a weapon
description: One with this ability can psychically manipulate anything that is intended as a weapon (to hurt, harm or injure). Axes, knives, spears, harpoons, swords, guns, shanks, clubs, whips, bombs, etc. Are all under the user's power, and can be moved around and controlled as though by normal Telekinesis. This can be used to wield the weapon for yourself, or relieve others of their weapons, or even cause a gun to jam up and backfire on its holder. Any weapon is under your complete and total control.
pros: Makes aim and dodging a breeze (bullets, arrows and crossbow bolts are also considered weapons)
Take weapons away from your foes, and call your weapon to you if you lose it
Do that cool "Matrix" thing where you make the bullets stop in mid-air and drop to the ground
cons: Will not work on any item unless it is intended to be a weapon at the time of its construction
Will not even work on a weapon if was made to be just a display or something
People with MythPower: Olympian Arsenal have weapons that are immune to this ability

name: Control Elements Of Nature
overview: control the wind, earth, fire, water, and lightning around you
description: With this ability, you can use fire, water, wind, earth, and lightning bolts to your advantage as long as that element was around you. For example, in a rainstorm, you could create water walls. If it's windy out, use the air to fly! Etc...
pros: These elements are almost ALWAYS available.
This power is great for revenge jokes, or just plain revenge.
cons: Have the potential to cause a tornado, hurricane, typhoon, etc..
Having this power comes with great responsibility.

name: Telepathic Suggestion
overview: make other humans or animals do what you want by thinking of it.
description: You can have anyone do whatever you want. Or anything, that is, which has life. You have to picture that person doing what you want them to do, which sends them a mental suggestion of the task to them in their mind. This has a 0. 03% chance of failing.
pros: Everyone is at your command.
Could suggest people into giving you what you desire.
Have animals accompany you, including dangerous predators.
cons: It fails 0. 03% of the time.. Could get hurt while trying to tame animals, etc.
You have to get a picture in your head of the suggestion's result for it to work.
Much more difficult if you do not have eye-contact with the person / target.

name: Physics Application
overview: create your own laws of physics to apply to yourself or others.
description: This power allows you to create your very own laws of physics and apply them to yourself or others. You can gain an edge in battle or make a law that gets more work done for less effort. These laws can replace existing ones or coexist with them and you can make as many as you want. You have a perfect memory of all the laws you created and once one law is made you can instantly recreate it at another time. However the laws can not interfere with the workings of superhuman abilities.
pros: Make up your own laws of physics.
Can make a law to boost your chancees of winning.
Have an exact memory of laws you created and can recreate them when you wish.
cons: At first you can only make laws similar to existing ones.
You cant do more powerful laws in the beginning.
Thinking of new physical laws could take a while.

name: Ancient Element Manipulation
overview: manipulate the ancient elements
description: The ancient elements go in categories starting with the main ones: 1)water, fire, earth, and wind. 2)ice, metal, and lightning. 3)pure light and pure darkness. 4)spirit and mind. This order is also the order of easiest elements to master to hardest elements to master and the order in which the user masters the elements.
pros: Water, fire, earth, wind, ice, metal, lightning, pure light, pure darkness, spirit, mind
cons: Order of elements: easiest to master to hardest to master

name: Book Of Everything
overview: have a pocket sized book with which you can research an topic that you will ever need to research
description: A person with this power has the complete encyclopedia. They can look up anything in the book. The information is constantly updated. Also you can rip out pages in the book. The ripped out pages will also be updated. Other than ripping the book is indestructible. This book does not tell you the future however it does tell you some secrets that are kept from the public. In addition this book is small enough to fit in a person's pocket, but can expand to fit the user's preference.
pros: Handy encyclopedia
The book cannot be destroyed though you can rip pages off and separate the book
The book updates itself over time so that the facts are accurate
cons: People can steal pages from the book and that page will be gone forever until they put it back
Some entries are blank because there is nothing that can be said about it

name: Lucky Strike
overview: manipulate probability, causing unlikely things to happen or likely things not to happen.
description: Alter probability to make the unexpected expected. With this ability, you can be almost certain the traffic light will turn green when you get there, that you will run into certain people under very unlikely circumstances, and that the lottery numbers you picked just might beat the odds. You can manipulate probability so that, if it's unlikely, it will suddenly become the next most likely thing to happen.  What are the odds you'll win that sweepstakes to live at the playboy mansion? You decide!
pros: Make amazing things very likely to happen to you
Alter the odds of someone sharting
Turn the odds in your favor
cons: With all this luck it might become boring
But, it probably won't!

name: Ghosting
overview: posses the perceived abilities of a ghost: phasing, invisibility, supersonic flight
description: At any time you can activate any combination of the powers of invisibility, phasing, and supersonic flight (though supersonic flight requires you to be in phasing mode). You can cause other objects to be affected as well, so you can fly at supersonic speeds in a car or make you and your friends invisible. The limit on your speed is only limited by how fast you recognize the landscape.
pros: Travel to any location as fast as you desire
Eavesdrop like a pro
Walls and doors: no longer a problem
cons: Affecting other objects requires physical contact
Won't work while asleep or unconscious

name: Power Writing
overview: change your nature by writing on your skin
description: When anything descriptive is written on your skin, you instantly become as the word describes. You can write the words on, or someone else could do it. As the ink fades the described effect weakens, and if the writing disappears it wears off. A tattoo would have a more permament effect. For example, if someone wrote 'drunk' on your arm, you'd instantly become drunk. If you wrote 'super-strong' on your body, you'd get super strength. Drawings have no effect
pros: Can give yourself virtually any superpower
Can make yourself 'good-looking', 'healthy', 'rich', 'immortal' etc.
There's a lot of space on your body to write
cons: Someone could write something really bad on you eg. 'dead'
Unless you re-write a description or go over the ink again, the effect will wear off
You'd have to be careful not to accidentally doodle on yourself, or write memos on your hand

name: Photographic Reflexes
overview: replicate any physical act after watching it once
description: Athletes have to train for years to throw a football perfectly, perform a championship gymnastic routine, or any other athletic skill. A person with Photographic Reflexes (also called Photographic Muscle Memory) can perfectly replicate any physical event after watching it only once. This means any martial art move, any Olympic dive, and every perfect free throw is totally inside their range. However, superhuman events are not.
pros: Become the star quarterback
Become an amazing gymnast
Be a martial artist extrordinare
cons: Cannot replicate superhuman feats (i.e. flight)
Can still be hurt
Cannot replicate what you haven't seen

name: Physics Distortion
overview: bend the laws of physics for a short while
description: Physics covers every physical event, so Physics Distortion is very powerful. Its users can bend natural laws to run up walls, make an object keep its energy and fly in a straight line, change the direction of flying objects, slow down time for objects, and even create a field of megaspace around themselves where space is so condensed traveling an inch in the field is like traveling a mile in our world. It is only distortion, so no natural laws may be broken. It also takes practice.
pros: Run up walls (mess with gravity)
Slow down time for objects (mess with time)
Create condensed megaspace fields (mess with space)
cons: Is only distortion, can't break any laws
Takes practice to consistently do the same thing
