Only for about 1 hour consistently

name: Body Snatch
overview: hijack and take someone's mind and body
description: This power allows you to "jump" into a person's body (taking your own with you) and you have full control over them. In addition, you have all their memories and once you leave they will have no recollection of what you've done. However, someone with strong will or psychic abilities can resist you from entering. Some psychics might even be able to fight you once you possess them. Otherwise this power works well on most people and if they die you just jump out unharmed.
pros: Full control of another person's body (including their powers)
Victims don't remember anything
Your body isn't left behind and you'll physically be safe
cons: Those with exceptionally strong will can resist you from entering
Some psychics can use their own powers against you

name: The Nexus Key
overview: use it to travel to countries, through realms, timelines, planets, and alternate dimensions.
description: The nexus key is made of a cosmic material, but you may control vast mystic forces, enabling you to create a keyhole shaped portal to travel to countries and through realms, timelines, planets, parallel universes, even to go inside a computer or human bodies and fire disruptive energy beams. The appearance of the nexus key changes depending on who wields it.
pros: Can change your size whenever you use this key to go inside human bodies and computers
Could go exploring in what it's like in alternate timelines.
cons: It can be use for extreme evil.

name: Self Attribution
overview: gain powers based on physiological, psychological, and other aspects of yourself.
description: This power means that whatever certain attributes you have can be turned into superpowers. Such as you are overweight so you gain a gravitational field or you are skinny enough to slip between atoms or dimensions. It even counts for geneological attributes such as making a slight resistance to disease into virus immunity. It can even give some powers from psychological or ancestry traits.
pros: There could be some good geneological powers.
Many powers.
cons: Immeasurably rare to have a immortality trait.
Some powers you just can't get.
Might not get good ones.

name: Satori
overview: heal wounds, memories, emotions, and give ineffable happiness to yourself and others.
description: This power is used by coming into contact or sending energy waves (radius of 10 Miles). It can heal physical wounds from the slightest scratch, to mutated or severed limbs, cancer, and cure 'in-curable' diseases. It also heals emotional wounds, and can grant ineffable and utter joy and happiness to yourself and others. It can change malign intents into benign intents. It also heals people from their anger, frustration, and any other negative emotions.
pros: Extremely Beneficial.
Make this world a better place.
Can cure any negative emotion or physical state.
cons: If your intention is to harm, this power is completely useless.
Hard to focus on other things when power is in use.
The farther away someone is, the less control you have.

name: Metal Kinesis
overview: control metal and turn any object into any metal.
description: You can control any metal by making it bend, twist, break, float, slide, etc without even touching it! You can also turn objects into metal, but this effect only lasts 24 hours.
pros: You can control any piece of metal with your mind.
Stop your enemies by turning them into metal.
You can stop metal bullets and secretly steal metal coins.
cons: When you turn something into metal, it lasts only 24 hours.

name: Lifeforce Mimicry
overview: transform into and generate lifeforce.
description: Lifeforce is the force existent in living beings that allows them to live. This power lets you turn into this force to manipulate it. You can bring life to inanimate things, heal, and much more. You can also resist death powers because of your abundant life force. If you wanted to, you could take the life from someone or infuse them with life to make them more powerful. In this form you regenerate from damage and can heal from previous injuries. You can also increase your lifespan.
pros: Heal and regenerate.
Unaffected by death powers or ones that manipulate your lifeforce.
Take life.
cons: Long lifespan does not mean immortality or invunerability.
A standoff with death or a reaper.
Cons cannot be negated.

name: Spacetime Indemnity
overview: be liberated from the physical constraints of time and space.
description: This ability renders a person unaffected by the constraints imposed by the forces that represent time/space. Action, perception, experience, when & where he exists in the universe is free to be controlled. This enables one to: move into any space in the known universe with just a single step, perform multiple tasks in different places simultaneously in no time at all, exist in past, present, future simultaneously, act freely even if time stops & exist even in the absence of space.
pros: Nothing or no one in the universe is far enough or fast enough to escape from you.
You are beyond any speed in the universe & everything you do is completed in the blink of an eye
Abilities that manipulate time and space does not affect you.
cons: This ability does not manipulate time and space around you.
You always change history over and over again and nothing really stays the same.
May drive someone to the edge of insanity due to the overwhelming experience.

name: Tychokinesis
overview: manipulate probability and chance
description: This ability is very powerful, because of all the applications. First off, it's more controlled by your subconscious mind then your conscious. It will affect things you're subconsciously thinking about, like paying the rent. But after you gain more control over it, you can become very powerful. Not only can you control chance short-term, but long-term as well. For example, you can warp chance so that everyone who lives in a certain house will constantly be losing their car keys.
pros: You can control probability and chance
You can be very powerful
Long-term warps are possible(without constantly focusing on them)
cons: At first, your subconscious mind is more in control then your conscious.
The larger the warp, the more it takes out of you

name: Umbrakinesis
overview: manipulate shadows.
description: The ability to shape shadows into a 3 dimensional form.  The shadow can only stretch so far.  Shadows can connect to other shadows.  You can only manipulate shadows within a certain range, about 10 feet without connecting to another shadow, but the shadows can stretch farther than that range.  The more light there is, the weaker the shadow is.
pros: Can suprise and kill an enemy before they even knew what was going on.
Can cut through steel with shadows
cons: Weakened shadows in the sun
Limited range

name: Full Heal
overview: heal any wound at the blink of an eye.
description: Like the description says, heal any wound at the blink of an eye.
pros: Heal wounds.
cons: Nothing.

name: Anabolic Power
overview: synthesise a new complex power from two or more simple powers.
description: This ability allows one to tamper with their own powers. They can take two or more simple powers (powers that have only one effect, like basic Pyrokinesis or Aerokinesis) and combine them together to form a more complex and powerful ability, i.e. Pyrokinesis + Aerokinesis gives you the ability to create flaming winds.
pros: Make more complex and powerful abilities.
Can combine multiple powers.
cons: Only works with simple powers.

name: Portal Cutter
overview: use sharp objects to create portals from one place to another by slashing
description: Someone with this power can use any sharp object such as knives, broken glass, barbed wire, etc to create portals from one area to another. The one making the cut has to concentrate on where they want the portal to go to or the destination will be raandom. The portal will automatically close after the one who made it goes through.
pros: Perfect escape route since the portal closes when you go through.
cons: Need defensive powers since you'll always be the last one to go through in a group.
Accidentally going into a war zone.

name: The Shield Of Time
overview: control time.
description: The shield of time is a mechanism that can control time. It takes concentration to control it, and mastery over it can make you nearly unstoppable.
pros: Never have to wait, you can speed forward to when it is your turn.
Never be late
Can be used as real shield
cons: You don't know what happened during the time you skip
It stops time only in this dimension
Freezing everything including yourself will result in a permanent stop in time

name: Phasing
overview: pass through solid objects
description: People with phasing don't respect doors. Or walls. Or floors, or ceilings, or cars, or buildings, because they don't have to. At the slightest thought, they become immaterial, and objects pass right through them without stopping. They keep from sinking into the ground by a type of electron repulsion.
pros: Ultimate thief
Can ignore hallways and go straight to your room
Freak people out
cons: No offensive powers
Unable to phase more than twice your own mass
EMPs can disrupt electron repulsion

name: Dream Realization
overview: gain any power that you exhibit in a dream
description: If you can DREAM it, you can DO it! UGH, so cheesy! But I digress. If you are dreaming and you find yourself doing something you can't normally do, if you remember it when you wake up, then you can do it. This can potentially make you very powerful. Your powers may be as useful as flight or as ridiculous as transforming into a Sailor Moon outfit. This does not apply to objects or events in your dreams, and you can only use powers that you exhibit. You are also incapable of lucid dreaming.
pros: Potentially quite powerful
Allows for a unique array of powers that reflect your personality
Much easier to explain your dreams to people
cons: Can only use abilities after you dream them
Does not apply to objects or events
If you only dream in third person you are outta luck

name: Metalkinesis
overview: create and control metal.
description: This power is NOT magnetic! The ability to manipulate, create and control metal is highly unique. With Metalkinesis, your thoughts control what you do with the metal. You can use a bullet to create a shield, adding metal seemingly by magic. Create full body armour or convert the metal to liquid form without heat. Extreme heat or cold weaken your abilities, yet you can use them in space. As you age, this power and the control over it grow. It is wise to combine this power with immortality.
pros: An armour is always available.
You can make any weapon with your thoughts.
You can absorb metal and save it for later.
cons: Planets or areas without metal weaken you.
Very big magnets or heroes with magnetic powers make using your power unwise.
You are vunerable to extreme heat or cold when in metal armour.

name: Metamorph
overview: alter your own molecular structure at will
description: A metamorph is anyone who can manipulate their own molecular structure. This lets you become anyone or anything as long as they have the same amount of mass. So they couldn't become something much larger than themselves but, by condensing their atoms, they could become smaller. Some metamorphs become immortal by morphing into a younger version of themselves. A word of caution is necessary here. The more they morph they harder it becomes to return to their true form.
pros: You can become anyone or anything as long as they have they same amount of mass.
Immortality
Other powers could be gained (turning into a winged demon capable of flight)
cons: The more you morph the harder it is to return to your true form.
When you condense yourself, you are just as heavy. This could give away a diguise (a 140lb vase)
Can only morph yourself not others

name: Lord Of Shadow: Shadow Traitor
overview: animate and command other people's shadows
description: With this power, you can bring other people's shadows to life and command them to fight for you. When you animate a person's shadow, it separates from his body and becomes 3-D. The shadow is intangible unless you will it to be solid, making it virtually invulnerable. You can animate multiple people's shadows, giving you command over a shadow army. As your power advances, the shadows will even have the powers their original owners have.
pros: Shadows have all the skills and, at higher levels, even the powers of their original owners
You can keep the shadows in a pocket dimension and summon them back at any time
Potential for a super-powered, near-invulnerable shadow army
cons: Giving shadows the powers of their original owners takes experience
Commanding large numbers of shadows can be difficult and takes great focus

name: Telepathy
overview: communicate mentally with other people
description: A person with telepathy can place his thoughts in the heads of others. They also have mind-reading talent and can attack others using only their thoughts.
pros: Can communicate without speaking
Can pick brains for information
Can fight without having to hit anyone
cons: Unable to affect physical world
Can be blocked by other telepaths
Often mistrusted and feared

name: Force Absorption
overview: absorb any physical force like momentum, gravity, kinetic energy, heat,... Etc.
description: Abiltiy to absorb and stockpile physical force/kinetic energy in any form, including gravity and telekinesis. Can stockpile this force to use in any way desired like transferring it to a mountain and making it shoot to the moon (depending on how much has been stored. Can use power to freeze things by absorbing the movement of the atoms. This relies on forces that potentially influence user, and user must be in direct contact with the force.
pros: 100% projectile and cut proof, basically impenetrable.
Can be used to fly
cons: Useless against energy attacks like fire or electricity

name: Chronos Blood
overview: create and control a liquid metal substance and then harden it and use it as a weapon or armor.
description: With this power you can create and control the Blood of Chronos, a liquid metal pearl-colored substance. You can make it appear from any part of your body. You can cover all your body with it, and then harden it and make a powerful armor, or you can make a melee weapon with it. The Chronos Blood metal is very strong, almost as strong as a diamond and its very light, so you can move freely while covered with it. It is also a non-magnetic metal, so magnetism wont affect it.
pros: A very powerful defensive and aggressive power.
The Blood of Chronos is almost as strong as a diamond and it's very light, perfect as armor.
Chronos Blood isn't a magnetic metal, so magnetism wont affect it.
cons: People with Liquid Control Powers will be able to manipulate it, even if its in solid form.
Blood of Chronos can be frozen in liquid form.

name: Imagination Creek
overview: create a personal realm of infinite space, accessible by entering your own thoughts.
description: Welcome to the Imagination Creek! You start off with a simple white plane of nothingness. Decide anything you want by imagining it. This is your personal realm and literally anything is possible. Anything. Create a universe, create gravity or others physical forces or not. It doesn't matter because this infinite realm is yours to imagine. This is different than your everyday brainstorming. When you enter the imagination creek, you are actually in it and you will feel and experience everything...
pros: Create anything you want and interact with it, without boundaries
When in the Creek, reality's time will not pass
Accessible anytime and again, anything is allowed
cons: Only you can enter the Creek (no actual people from reality, but you can make up people)
No one else can see it; no way of bringing it to reality

name: Personality Superpower
overview: gain a superpower based on your personality
description: A person with this power gains a superpower based on their personality. For example, if you have a magnetic personality, you gain Magnetism. If you are a flexible person personality-wise, you can gain an elastic body.  You can only have one power with this ability and your ability can be unique because it is rare that someone will have the exact same personality as you. However, a person with multiple personalities can have more than one power, but can only access one at a time.
pros: The power will always become natural to use since it is based on your personality
If you have a split personality, you can have multiple powers
Split personality can give you multiple powers
cons: It's based on your personality

name: Planetary Empowerment
overview: be empowered by the planets in our solar system.
description: The person with this power , by stating the name of a planet; will gain the different powers each planet has to offer. If you shout Mars (invulnerability), Earth (geokinesis), Jupiter (electrokinesis), Mercury (super speed), Venus (florakinesis), Saturn (psychokinetic powers), Ketu (Umbrakinesis), and finally Rahu (illusions). When the planets are alligned, the power and effectiveness of each power doubles
pros: Different sets of power to combat different situations
Huge arsenal to take down the powerhouses
cons: You only can use 9 sets in a day ( 1 set is equivalent to all 9 planets )
Magic is one of your biggest enemies

name: Extrasensory Teleportation
overview: teleport based on what your next course of action or decision.
description: This power will instantly sends you to a place based on what you decided to do. Example: A person decided to go to the movies, they'll teleport to the movie theater. A person may be able to teleport anywhere, but it means nothing if they don't where to go. That's what makes this teleportation unique.  With advanced training, the user can stop the teleportation at will.
pros: You won't be late.
With training, stop teleportation or teleport ahead of time
cons: Without training, teleport anytime.

name: Supertime
overview: move so fast that time seems to stop
description: With this power, your molecules vibrate so fast and you move so fast that everything around you seems to stop, even time. You can win a race or get revenge. If someone touches you while you're going into supertime, they move as fast as you. But once you turn it off, they return to reality too.
pros: Win races
Get revenge
Pull awesome pranks
cons: Tempted to evil
Well that's just about it

name: Dc Superpowers
overview: have the abilities of five DC characters of your choosing
description: You could have an amazing array of powers with this one. You would have the exact powers of five different DC characters, of your choice. Credit to Vault since this is just the DC-version, with pretty much the same wording, of his Marvel Superpowers.
pros: You could be like an amazing hero
cons: Might not be five DC characters you want powers from

name: Personal Quantum Calculation
overview: predict consequences for all possible courses of action for oneself
description: When faced with a personal choice, you are able to instantly calculate the consequences of all possible courses of action. The power is limited only to your own choices--you cannot predict the future for another's course of action. You can see the chain of consequences from the point you commit to the action to the point of your death--you can't see how your actions will affect the world after you die.
pros: You have the power to choose not to make any mistakes.
You know what personal choices can positively affect others.
You no longer have any need to worry.
cons: The power can easily lead to a life of no risk, which can lead to a life of deep boredom.
The power doesn't help the situation when all courses of action lead to negative consequences.
You can make decisions that benefit the world for the short term, but harm it after your death.

name: Vectors
overview: control invisible, telekinetic arms
description: The ability to control invisible and telekinetic arms capable of slicing human flesh, bone and even metal. They are also capable of deflecting projectiles, such as bullets. Vectors are incredibly strong, and can lift extremely heavy objects.
pros: Great way to go on a killing spree.
Only people who share this power can see these "vectors"
cons: Limited range.
Unable to stop certain projectile weapons.
Your vectors cannot stop another user's vectors

name: Physical Shape Shifting
overview: change only your physical apperance
description: Almost like Tonks in HP. You can change only the physical features of your body. (ex. Changing your hair color, length, type or doing your own nose job. ) It's probably good to keep a picture of the person you wish to look like. When you change yourself you must have the desired body part clearly in mind (ex. Hair or nose) before transforming. Remember- You can also change skin color too!
pros: Great for spy work! You can look like any person you wish to be.
Never get zits.
Never need a haircut (or a nose job. )
cons: The killer is in the details, so do a lot of research about your person!
Your voice remains the same.
You will not magically become the person you wish to be. You'll just look like them.

name: Blacksmith's Hands
overview: create heat and shape metal with just your hands
description: A master blacksmith uses the heat of a forge to form metal into any shape he wants. This power lets you do that with your bare hands. At will, your hands are covered in fire, allowing you to heat and then physically bend any metal you want. You are unaffected by the heat. As you grow stronger, you can shape metal with your mind; simply touch it and imagine what you want in to look like. You can bend metal, break it, stretch it, crumple it, the possibilities are only limited by your imagination
pros: You can bend, break, or reshape anything made of metal: weapons, locked doors, cars
At higher levels, users can develop pyrokinesis, allowing them to control the flames they create
At higher levels, you can simply touch metal and will it to assume whatever shape you want
cons: Requires physical contact with metal even at higher levels
You are only immune to the heat you create, not to other sources of heat
At lower levels you have to physically shape metal; you only gain mental control at higher levels

name: Artifical Intelligence Creator
overview: create artifical intelligence contructs and control them
description: With this power you can create your own AI. You can give the AI tasks and it will preform them with a level of speed and detail unseen in humans. They are able to learn and master skills extremely quickly. Task them to write books, make games,do your assignments for you, or play the stock market at a level of detail no human could match. They will always be loyal, unless your create one not to be. Also you cannot use your PC while they are performing a task, as they will be using it.
pros: Have your AI write books, make games, produce animations
Can learn process and master information and skills for optimum results
Live off their work
cons: You cannot use your PC while they work
In order to learn, they can chew though your bandwidth
The wrong people might get suspious

name: Electrophite
overview: control electricity and manipulate it.
description: As an electrophite, you will be able to harness the power of electricity. You will be able to direct it and manipulate it to your will. With time, as your powers develop, you will be able to create electricity from nothing and eventually travel as electricity. You can even travel through power lines and outlets. Unfortunately, this power takes a long time to control, but a relatively short time to develop
pros: You can harness and eventually create electricity
Lightning fast travel
Most of the world has electricity to harness
cons: The power is controlled by your emotions. If they are wild, so are your powers
Initially you will be overloaded with power, so you need to learn how to control it fast
Anything touched by your electricity will most likely die, even loved ones

name: Photographic Deduction
overview: figure out connections in whatever you seeing and process them in your head extremely fast
description: A person with this power does not have enhanced sight but instead has superhuman processing of anything seen visually. For example, if they see someone moving their hands to draw something you can create an image of what they are drawing in your head without even being able to see the canvas. This also allows the user to read lips. Continued usage can lead to nigh prerecognitive abilities.
pros: By looking at someone moving their pencil you can figure out what they are writing
You can read lips
cons: You will be tempted to cheat in tests because looking at people's movements give you the answers

name: Tactile Georegeneration
overview: use the Earth's energy to fully heal yourself or others
description: With this ability, a person can absorb the energy from the Earth through physical contact, turning it into a powerful form of healing. Everything, from the most minor of injuries to the deadliest of diseases, can be healed, or severed/malformed limbs totally regenerated, in a matter of minutes!! Advanced users of this power can even go as far as slowing down, stopping, or reversing every effect of aging, both internally and externally. You can, however, stop this power to let enemies suffer.
pros: You can be the world's greatest doctor!
This power always strengthens itself, even when not in use, as long as you are in contact with earth
No more aches & pains!!
cons: You need to have physical contact with natural ground for the power to work
You could accidentally heal an enemy if you aren't careful
This power starts off weak, only healing minor injuries at first

name: Materialization
overview: create matter from imagination alone.
description: The user is able to turn imaginary thoughts into real matter. Just from imagining them, a person would be able to create an infinite amount of swords, money, or even their own world.
pros: What you create is 100% just up to your imagination.
There is no limit as to what or how many of something you create.
Your wildest dreams may come true.
cons: Creating something from nothing goes against the laws of nature.
Due to the above, reality will begin destroying whatever you made as soon as it is made.
Even a tiny scratch can destroy your object if you did not imagine that scratch possible beforehand.

name: Psychic Strategy
overview: perceive all probable outcomes of a situation, and otherwise perceive probability
description: Also known as Quantum Precognition or Stochastic Precognition, this is the ability to perceive all the probable outcomes of a situation in hypertime. The user can also sense which outcome is more likely to come to pass. In addition, if the power develops, you can sense how to alter situations to affect the future, perceive the ultimate conclusion of a decision you make (called Butterfly Effect Observation), or avoid telepathy by pretending that the probabilities you perceive are your thoughts.
pros: Perceive all probable outcomes of a situation (and which one is most likely)
Perceive the ultimate conclusion of a decision (and how to alter situations to affect outcomes)
Probability/Chance/Luck-based MythPowers enhance this power greatly
cons: Unpredictability (unless you have a Probability/Chance/Luck-based MythPower)
The strongest sense manipulators can distort the psychic perception
Sometimes the perception isn't in hypertime (immoblilzing you like Precognition til the vision ends)

name: Claircognizance
overview: acquire knowledge without ever experiencing an event that could have given you that knowledge
description: Claircognizance is one of the most powerful abilities. With this ability, you can gain knowledge without ever experiencing an event that could have given you that knowledge. Interestingly, when actively using this ability, you also can find something that has not happened, and you can also get another evolved human's abilities. You can also get these abilities in a random way or passive way. You also can find about location, history, person's characteristic, and everything that you want to know.
pros: You can become a great people for country or world
You can be a psychic for the greater good
You can be the most powerful heroes in this universe
cons: You can be the most powerful villain in this universe
You can get information that you don't want to know in a passive way or random way
Many people who will come to you for bad or good reason cause they think you're dangerous

name: Stop Time
overview: stop the progress of time
description: You have the ability to stop time. What is meant by this is that any living thing will be frozen in time, excluding plant life, while you still move at normal time. There is a restriction, you cannot move any living thing except for plant life.
pros: Avert human and machine disasters
Make bank withdrawls and then go about your business
Do some fun time up-skirting
cons: Living things are frozen, so non living things are still in motion

name: Logic Defying
overview: defy any sort of logic as long as you don't believe that it applies to you
description: Unlike Physics Rejector, or Physics Distortion which allows you to only defy the laws of physics, a person with Logic Defying has the ability to defy any type of logic in existence. That means that you can defy the laws of chemistry and biology or any other science as long as you don't believe that the laws apply to you. However, even the user themselves doesn't have any way to explain what they can do- they can do anything they want as long as they don't believe otherwise.
pros: Nothing applies to you, or you choose what laws apply to you and what doesn't
You can do everything in Chuck Norris jokes just because you can
You can even skip any type of restrictions anyone put on you
cons: Limited by a person's logic

name: Cell Generation
overview: create biological cells for your own body
description: This power allows you to create cells in your body. You can even create new types of cells with unique properties. If you are injured create stem cells to turn into necessary ones or create the lost cells. If you are in a hostile environment you could create a cell type that heals you quickly or increases muscle power. If there is poison in your body you can make new immune system cells. Even make cells that take in oxygen more eficently.
pros: Works well with tissue generation and control.
Heal rapidly or go offensive.
Create new cell types to suit your needs.
cons: Cant make magical cells.
Must have a somewhat decent knowledge of cells.
These cons cant be negated.

name: Empathic Telekinesis
overview: gain powerful telekinetic abilities through empathic connections with others
description: With empathic telekinesis, a person can move things with their mind by creating links to others through empathy. The powers can then be used by that person to help and protect other people they choose. It has the same properties and versatility as vector telekinesis.
pros: Can only be used by good people
Is extremely powerful
Can be learned and controlled in a very short amount of time
cons: Confused or negative emotions negate the power

name: Transmechanization
overview: turn "scrap" into a machine or turn a machine into a different type of machine using your mind.
description: "Scrap" is another word for junk, though in this case it is useable and not useless. You can transmechanize an old car into a massive cannon or even a pile of wooden planks mixed with old engine parts into a speed boat. You can also turn a complex machine into another complex machine (example already used with the old car). However, there's no guarantee the machine will work properly (refrigerator to jetplane), and not EVERYTHING is "scrap".
pros: Can create cool machines from just about anything
Can transmechanize the machine, even if the machine is being used
No blueprints, which means no one can steal your creation.
cons: Must be formed from multiple objects, or one complex object (can't make cannon out of just one can)
Does not work on stones, bricks, or organic material (even if decayed or dead), except for wood.
No guarantee it will work right (example: turning a refrigerator into a jetplane)

name: Every Kinesis
overview: replicate any kinesis power.
description: The ability to replicate any kinesis power: All the known abilities and also any new ones. If someone adds one that you don't have (yet), you can use it through this power. This also improves every aspect of your other (hard copy) kinesis powers, but only if you have Stackable Abilities.
pros: Can have any kinetic power
Will be able any new kinesis of which you do not yet have a hard copy
cons: Anti Power Mimicry

name: Will Projection
overview: project your will onto anything or anywhere around you.
description: Most people can only will their own bodies. This ability allows you to will anything around you. But you must practice, because your will is just as strong as everyone elses at first. If you can build up your will, you'll be able to do more than move things. You can even will things to change into something else, as long as your not creating or destroying life. After mastering this, you could even will things into existince. But you still must follow the rule, no creating or destroying life.
pros: You can do almost anything if you can muster up the will
cons: No creating or destroying life.

name: Pure Energy
overview: blast pure energy from your eyes, hands, and/or entire body
description: With your hands, you have full control over direction. If you can't use your hands for some reason, then use your eyes. If you want to blast in all directions, use your entire body. You can use this energy as a shield or a platform of energy for transportation. How this energy is looks is pretty much your choice (transparant, translucent, solid, and color choice). But, to blast any energy at all, you must use 100% concentration.
pros: Can blast energy from hands, eyes, and/or entire body
Pure energy
cons: Requires 100% concentration, nothing less

name: Virtuoso Reaction
overview: respond to any situation with advanced skills and knowledge of an expert.
description: Say that you caused a fire and you don't know how to put it out. With this power, your brain will begin to calculate the thoughts and ideas on how to put out the fire. Then, your body will follow your brain's lead in which it would put out the fire skillfully. This ability doesn't last long; once the situation is over, you will lose the knowledge that you gained.
pros: Gain knowledge.
Be ready for anything.
cons: You will lose the knowledge after the situation is over.

name: Radiation Immunity
overview: be immune to any kind of harmful radiation
description: With this power you can be immune to any of the affects of any kind of harmful radiation. You will be able to function as if there is no harmful radiation at all. Even applies to UV light causing sunburns and melanomas
pros: You are immune to harmful radiation
You (unconsciously) decide which radiation is harmful
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Imaginary Energy Manipulation
overview: make energies that don't actually exist real and control it
description: What do I mean by "Imaginary Energy". Well, in one episode of "American Dad" a guy mention that he could manipulate his own "Sexual Energy". We all know there is no such thing. The guy just sang an moved his body in an erotic fashion. The point is this ability could make that energy real. That is one part of the fun. The user can make up energies as well with their own effects and powers.
pros: Bring fake energies real
Make up your energies
Control them
cons: Using two or more energies in the same area might cause an terrible explosion.
Can't create an energy that is actually real.

name: Probability Transportation
overview: make something happen to someone/thing by sending them to places where the likelihood is very high.
description: This ability works like this. The user wants someone to catch on fire. The ability allows him to send that person to a place were there is fire like a house on fire or the sun. This ability is not an exact science, because it sends the person to the place were likelihood of being on fire is high. It is good for sending people away and teleporting.
pros: Send people or themselves away to places that you something specific to happen to them.
Teleportation application
cons: Not specific on location most of the time
Might be affected by Probability Manipulation or luck based powers

name: Data Realization
overview: create objects/events from nothingness
description: Using the DNA of creation, you have the ability to create objects, feelings, people and many other things out of nothing. Also, it is possible to create and destroy the world in the blink of an eye. Most of the powers are being controlled by your own emotions, and mostly, the bearer is unaware of the power.
pros: Be able to have everything you want
Be able to recreate what you do not like
Be able to make your own world at your own liking
cons: When under emotional pressure, the power could get the better of you
You might be unaware of this power

name: Touch Of Knowledge
overview: gain knowledge by touching it
description: If you want to read a book but don't have the time, just simply touch the book and it will be as if you have read it. This also works on movies and if you touch someone you can pick and choose what you want to copy from them. Also, if you touch a computer and go on the internet, there is nothing you can't learn and it is untraceable.
pros: Can learn anything
Doesn't steal knowledge from people
You absorb in a millisecond
cons: Must touch the object
That's it

name: Nonlinear Time Perception
overview: see past, present and future at any given time.
description: You can see the past, events that have already happened, you could solve all history's unanswered questions or have the greatest history textbook memory there is! You can also see the present, no change there. But most of all you can see the future, and change or perform different actions to shape the future as you wish. With training and concentration you can look into a certain person's or object's past or future.
pros: See the past and everything in it.
Shape the future to your will with your actions.
Helpful for people with bad memories.
cons: You cannot change the past.
Shaping the future can have consequences. Some small, some dire.
You WILL see how your loved ones die.

name: Powermatrix
overview: have an indestructible gauntlet that provides you access to all your superhuman powers and abilities
description: This superpower provides you an extremely cool, awesome, original, indestructible, and comfortable gauntlet. Which grants you complete & utter access, use, and information of all your superhuman powers & abilities via hardlight holographic displays. That also allows you to organize all of the superhuman powers & abilities that you possess. The gauntlet itself can become invisible and intangible when every you want. And is powered by an infinite & unlimited clean, safe, and efficient power supply
pros: A gauntlet that allows you at access and utilize all of your superhuman powers and abilities.
Able to view information about your superhuman powers and abilities and organize them as well.
The Gauntlet is powered by an infinite & unlimited clean, safe, and efficient power supply.
cons: Does not provide you any superpowers, only the ability to access and utilize the ones you have.
The gauntlet can not be removed unless you are dead or your arm is removed.

name: Hypertime
overview: move so fast time "stands still"
description: Your molecules move so fast that you move at superhuman speeds. Enough that time "stands still". In REALITY the people around you are moving slower. If anything comes in contact with you during activation they are just as fast as you and they don't need to stay in contact.
pros: Perfect revenge
Cheat on tests and you can't get caught
Win races
cons: If someone else has this power and turns it on at the same time as yours, they are just as fast
Liquid nitrogen can knock you out of hypertime
You'll be tempted to commit crimes

name: Time Relativity
overview: control the passing of time for a person
description: With this power you can make any person experience time for a relatively shorter or longer time than everyone else. One can make good times last years and bad times last seconds, and appear to be super fast by time go faster relative to your opponent, and one can talk to people for hours and for them only think it has been couple seconds. Electronics and other living things fall under this power, as well. While making relativity shift your body's needs (food, water, ect)still go at normal speed.
pros: Always have enough time to do what you want.
Parties don't end until you want them to.
Finish work in last five seconds after procrastinating.
cons: Can't relive things you have made relatively shorter without another power.
Only you or the person you are affecting can notice the change in time relativity
Have to eat, drink, sleep eventually

name: Psionic Tactility
overview: read & control the minds of others you touch
description: This ability allows you to control others through physical contact, but unlike tactile hypnosis, you can use telepathy instead of your voice. You can also control someone's thoughts, memories, and emotions, read their minds and memories, and also control their physical actions.
pros: A very versatile form of mind control
Is strong enough to override most healing powers except for regeneration
Psychics will find this a very useful ability
cons: Someone with regenerative powers is immune to this ability
Cannot be used against empaths
May cause painful static feedback if someone is strong enough to resist telepathy

name: Beast Humanoid Shapeshifting
overview: shapeshift to become any animal-human crossbreed.
description: This ability allows you to become any existing animal, in a half-human form. This allows you to shift into forms such as half-tiger, half-lion, half-wolf, half-bull, etc. Makes for some interesting combinations.
pros: You sustain the intellect of man while having the strength, cunning and agility of your animal.
cons: You take on the mentality of the beast more and more the longer you stay in this form.

name: Resurrection Man
overview: resurrect each time you die with a new ability.
description: Death is the final obstacle and you've dodged it. When anyone with this ability dies, they resurrect shortly after, but changed. They will have a new superpower. The new ability is completely random, but sometimes it has something to do with how they die. For example, if you die in a fire, you might resurrect with the power to control fire. But if they were to die again, they would lose the fire power and resurrect with a new one. Also, the first time you die, you won't age past that point.
pros: Even in this strange form, it's immortality.
Gaining new powers after each resurrection.
Sometimes the power relates to the death.
cons: You must die to gain a new power
Losing a power you liked.
Immortality is a gift and a curse.

name: Infinite Energy Storage
overview: store an infinite amount of energy within yourself.
description: With this ability, you can store an infinite amount of energy inside of yourself. With practice, you can control how much of that energy you use. You can handle using a nearly infinite amount of energy without harm. Limited to the energy you have stored inside. You can still get hurt from energy based attacks.
pros: Store an infinite amount of energy inside of yourself.
Be able to safely use a nearly infinite amount of energy.
Control how much of your energy you use.
cons: Limited to the energy you have stored inside.
You can still get hurt from energy based attacks.
You need practice to control the amount of energy used.

name: Communication Scanner
overview: detect, scan and understand a flow of information.
description: Whenever an exchange of information is taking place through any form and method (speech, written paper, thought transfer, sign language, braille,... ), you can scan and understand the message. Knowledge of the language being used is not needed, though you won't necessarily get the subtexts when inside knowledge is required. It works on any type of communication means, including body language, electrical wires, fiber optics,... As long as the message is being transferred to a compatible receiver.
pros: You are undetectable to 'muggle' ways of detecting intrusions.
You can even read someone's thoughts when they are thinking to themselves.
You can get your hands on private information.
cons: A compatible intended receiver of the message is needed, that is one who can understand the message.
You won't get the subtext if some prior knowledge is needed to fully understand it.
You can't bypass any encryption algorithms, including the 'muggle' ones.

name: Soul Weapons
overview: have a particular melee weapon appear in your hand, based off of your soul
description: Everyone's soul is different. So, with this power, you will have the perfect personalized melee weapon based off of your soul. The weapon will reflect the soul of the person. If you are a good person, it will have a bright aura. If you are evil, it will pulse with darkness. The weapon will always feel balanced and right in the user's arms. The weapon is unbreakable and can be manifested and unmanifested whenever the user desires. These weapons will damage the foe physically.
pros: The weapon can only be used by the owner and the owner's lover
The weapon is perfectly balanced to the person and unbreakable
The weapon is created based off of the person's soul
cons: The weapon will always be the same. It will never change based on needs, lifestyle, etc.
Good people are damaged by evil weapons and evil people are more damaged by good weapons(also a pro)
You aren't instantly good with your weapon. You will still need to train to be good with it

name: Dragon Lord
overview: have the powers of a dragon and control dragons.
description: This power gives you the abilities of a dragon. Also, you can control dragons as well. You can breathe fire, create fire balls, and grow and retract wings.
pros: You can grow wings.
You can make instant toast.
Dragons will be at your command.
cons: You might accidently burn people or things.
The dragons might destroy people or places.
Your back will be sore after retracting your wings.

name: Morph
overview: change anything when touched
description: You have the ability to change any type of object into anything you want when touched. With this ability, you can't morph any living creature. This ability is difficult to master considering it is tied to your emotions and mind (you need to be at peace with yourself before truely mastering it).
pros: Once mastered, your power will become invincible
Can get you out of any situation or trap
Can disguise your physical appearances
cons: Has no effect on living things
Is difficult to master
Your emotions can ruin your powers

name: Superhuman Mimicry
overview: have the powers and appearance of any fictional character with superpowers
description: With this power, you can have the powers and appearance of any fictional character with superpowers. With their powers, you will have the same amount of control as them. If you are taking the appearance of an animated character, then you will look however you imagine that character looking if he/she was real. Once you have become a character, you are stuck with that character's powers and appearance forever.
pros: Have the same powers and appearance as any fictional character with superpowers
cons: Once you have become a character, you are stuck with that character's powers and appearance forever

name: Nature Manipulation
overview: manipulate the elements of nature
description: The basic elements of nature are earth, water, wind, and light. The user can manipulate or blend in with: stone, sand, dirt, most liquids, ice, snow, wind, weather, light, and natural disasters. Because this power is nature-based, insects and animals appeal to the user. Light is tricky, the user can generate and bend light to a certain extent. The user can survive in any natural environment on earth. This power also gives the user healing abilities.
pros: Manipulate earth, water, wind, light, and heal.
Appeal to insects and animals
Survive in any natural environment on earth and/or blend in with different environments
cons: You may be considered a Tree Hugger

name: Mind Writer
overview: alter, implant fake memories or erase someone's mind all together and reform it
description: With this power, you can see into the minds of those around you, alter their memories, erase or even wipe them clean and make your own in their head. It's not some silly 'they don't know ANYTHING' power, they still retain the basic functions, knowledge and human interaction, but their knowledge of who they are, who their family is, likes and dislike can be meddled with. Note it may take you some time to reform a person from scratch. You can also take their knowledge.
pros: Alter people to follow you fanatically, no special memory needed, it will simply be in their nature
Gain knowledge from your enemies and turn them into slobbering fools
Remove traumatizing memories from victims
cons: Must be within 50 meters of the person. Time stops as you use it. And you must see them
Might make a mistake. You can erase their memory multiple times, but might erase something important
Must plan ahead meticulously to know what will be in an altered memory

name: Phantasmic Mimicry
overview: use the ghost energy of any dead person to gain their knowledge, skill and physique.
description: You have a massive archive of passed people that you can choose anyone from to gain their knowledge, skills strength and also to mix their appearance with yours.
pros: Choose from any dead person.
You only take part of that persons apperance.
It is completely temporary.
cons: People will notice the appearance changes.
Concentrated spectrum waves will negate the power.

name: Bio Energetic Force Aura
overview: generate a localized force field around yourself
description: This power allows you to create a force field around your body that grants you flightand superhuman strength, as well as superhuman durability and can be used as a way to heal by manipulating your own bio-energy to speed up the healing process. You can also generate concussive bio-energy blasts, as well as being able to survive pressures of any type (water, atmospheric, etc. )
pros: Can protect
Used both offensively and defensively
Highly useful
cons: Can be affected by certain forms of energy

name: Reality Mimicry
overview: have the traits or become the reality in one's fantasies,
description: The user becomes a portal between the our normal reality and their reality. They can teleport things in and out of his reality including character in their reality. If anything from our reality stays in the user's reality for too long that thing will become part of that user's reality forever and if that thing is a super being, the user gains their powers. Reality warpers can really hurt the user. The user can be in portal form to absorb attacks safely.
pros: You can teleport anything in your reality through to our reality and vice versa.
Absorb attacks
Gain powers of victims
cons: You can still be physical harmed when you are not in portal form.
You are very susceptible and weak against Reality Warpers.

name: Reality Rift
overview: create portals in between locations
description: This could be either one of the most blatantly powerful abilities or a very understated power, all in how you use it. A person with Reality Rift can tear holes in the fabric of reality connecting two locations; these holes do not close until something passes through them. These can either be huge gaping portals to space or tiny tears only big enough for a hand. One of the most suble ways to use this power is to create a rift just behind one door, walk though it, and come out another door.
pros: Fast, effective teleportation
No distance limit
Can be huge and epic or tiny and understated
cons: Rifts don't close until something goes through
Must open first portal with hand
No physical powers

name: Temporal Rewind
overview: reverse time back to a specific point
description: Embarrassing moments--we all have one or two or ten in the course of our lives. Temporal Rewind can indirectly solve these. The user (through focused concentration) can reverse time and fix/avoid events. This means that you didn't break that glass, call her a man, or step in front of that taxi. The tricky thing about this power is that other people will cloudily remember the original event, not unlike deja vu. However, most people will pass it off as just that unless they know what to look for.
pros: Resetting recent events
Redoing a fight
Preventing a death, fixing a conversation
cons: Requires concentrated focus
30 minute maximum use at first
Headache can result from prolonged/intense use

name: Chronokinesis
overview: control the flow of time in various ways
description: Also called Time Manipulation or Time Control. As we all know, the power of controlling time is like having a remote control to the world. Pause it, slow it down, rewind, fast-forward and even travel through it. Not to mention, the ability to set time in a loop, in desired. Even control time around specific objects and areas. Accelerate time around objects to break them down; freeze time around enemies to immobilize them for allies; accelerate time around yourself for Superhuman Speed, and more.
pros: Going back in time, you can meet your past self, possibly creating an endless army of past selves.
Speed up or slow opponents down. Also freeze people (place them in a state of stasis)
Hopping through alternate timeline to alternate timeline to see how some things can play out.
cons: Be careful with that time travel. You might go too far and lose your place in time.
Careful. You might land in one timeline and think it's your own. Don't lose your grip on reality...
Enemies with Time Defiance, Hypertime Chronopathy and similar powers can serve as a foil

name: Outside Energy Manipulation
overview: control and use energy from other energy sources
description: The ability to construct shapes with solid energy, create energy blasts, and make force fields; the only hitch is that they cannot create energy on their own and must be near an energy source (A lighter, the sun, even the moon) in order for their power to be effective.
pros: The bigger the energy source, the greater the power
Almost anything around you can be used as energy
cons: The smaller the energy source, lesser the power
Energy cannot be created
Energy-Suppressing abilities

name: Omni Gas Manipulation
overview: manipulate any and all gases.
description: This is a deadly and powerful ability. With it, you can control ALL gases. Chlorine, oxygen, plain air, etc. You could bring down any manner of disaster by the air (tornadoes, air blasts, places without ANY gases at all, etc.), even rip out the air from someone's lungs. In addition' the user can solidify and compress gases into weapons, armor, etc., that can easily repair themselves. Even sound can be manipulated by manipulating the vibration of gases. Even some complicated things come easily.
pros: Have control of all the air in the atmosphere.
Cause huge disasters, bring or destroy clouds via air barriers, etc.
Form weapons or armor out of gasses and repair them instantly.
cons: You can only manipulate gases with this power.
It takes some concentration to manipulate whole atmospheres.
If you are in outer space with no gasses

name: Opportunity Repeat
overview: repeat any opportunity that you or others were given.
description: This ability allows the user to be able to get the same opportunity again, if he failed to take it the first time or if you want to do it again. If you missed a dead line for a paper, this ability will open up that opportunity again. If you were a assassin who missed the perfect shot, this ability will make it so your target will be in the perfect spot to make that shot again, etc.
pros: Never miss a opportunity again
If mastered, you can make the opportunity came back instantly.
cons: Without training, all the bad opportunities will keep showing up.
Without training, it will take time for an opportunity to return again.

name: Information Enchantment
overview: bestow supernatural properties on information itself.
description: With this power, one can give information supernatural properties, mainly effects on the reader/viewer/etc. The limitation, however, is giving new powers, although it can channel the effects of your other powers, such as using Friendly Power Gifting to give anyone who reads a particular sign one of your powers. Other examples include making something impossible to remember or impossible to learn to certain individuals.
pros: You can contain the effect to a particular medium, so it does not spread.
Advertise anything and have it granted to those who read it.
The only limit is your imagination.
cons: Effect may not last recreation by the human mind unless precautions are taken.
You cannot grant new superpowers with this, though you can simulate them.
This power cannot be modified by other powers, although you can use your powers through this.

name: All Good
overview: control reality unconsciously in accordance with your deepest desires.
description: All good is a passive, unconscious power that functions as a very specific manipulation of reality. Upon receiving this power, your entire future will be rewritten. You won't have direct control over how your life changes, but at the end of it, you are guaranteed to be able to look back on your life and say it was a good one.
pros: Your life will be good.
The reality alteration will come from your own mind, and will be tailored specifically to what you consider a good life.
cons: There's a side effect - you will forget receiving this power, and will never know you have it.
It resists all but the very strongest counters.

name: Memory Wipe
overview: take someone's worst memories from them to give peace.
description: You can help people be at peace by wiping their mind of their worst most horrific memories by letting those memories into your mind. You may even change villains into good people this way but you'll have their memories.
pros: Helping people be at peace
Potentially reforming criminals if their past horrors male them become criminals.
cons: You'll have to live memories of being, shot stabbed, raped, and any other number of horrible acts do
Pain from all these memories is real in your mind forever.
You'll spend most most you free time and money on Psychiatrists. Or kill yourself.

name: Moral  Based Ability Granting
overview: grant abilities to oneself or others based on life lessons or morals.
description: The user can give abilities to themselves or others based on lessons and morals that they learned. I don't mean like if you learn something from in school and now you have a power. I mean lessons about life like this for example. You fought someone bigger and stronger than you, and you figured out you need to out-think than out-muscle him. With that "Might is not always right" mentality, your ability kicks in and gives you enhanced intelligence to defeat your opponent's brawn.
pros: Gain new and unique abilities based on the morals that you learned.
As long as you hold those morals, the abilities are permanent
Read parables and stories that have morals
cons: Ignorance can prevent you from learning morals

name: Lightning Speed
overview: move superhumanly fast with Lightning Speed
description: The more you run the faster you become. You will generate enormous bio-electrical energy which gives you superhuman speed. 1. You run at subsonic speeds in a bio-electric cocoon. 2. You move at supersonic speeds emmitting a bio-electric trail. 3. You become imbued with massive bio-electrical energy and move with the speed of light. Linear flight is possible and doing damage is a must.
pros: With early use of your power you could run through a wall protected by your bio-electric cocoon
Stopping to punch something is no problem just keep punching and you will still build energy, speed
Lightning impact and invulnerability, punches, kicks, ramming does massive damage
cons: Magnets and must keep moving to keep your powers once you stop you return to normal human stage
At stage 1 hitting things that attract electricity will damage them but will slowly drain energy
Using powers for 51hrs straight causes you to permanently be energy go into space and dissipate

name: Reality Key
overview: own the key to reality that allows you to do nearly anything.
description: This power gives you the key to reality, a device so complex it doesnt have a shape but instead takes the form your mind imagines for it. The device is so complex that it will never be fully understood. The key becomes linked to the user's soul and commands are entered depending on what form the key takes, though it is unknown what the command may do. Since the key is linked to the user's soul, the key can respond to basic instructions, but stray thoughts can change the outcome.
pros: Nearly anything is possible.
May be able to cause things that break the laws of reality.
So complex that other powers cannot affect the key.
cons: Will never be able to fully understand how to use the key.
Random effects of the key may be undesirable.
May lose patience before learning a command you require.

name: Fictional Copy Cat
overview: use the powers, talents, and gadgets of fictional characters.
description: Use the abilities and technological advances of any fictional character!  Become as powerful as Superman, or a strategist like Batman.  Use Iron Man's armor, or have Spider-Man's reflexes and spider powers.  You could even use Thor's hammer, or adapt and evolve like Goku and Vegeta!
pros: Have Superman's powers!
Become smart and a martial arts guru like Batman
Have Darkseid's Omega Beams or Thanos' Infinity Gauntlet
cons: You will have their weaknesses
May become too powerful
Too many abilities to remember

name: Universe Adaption
overview: gain a certain ability(s) depending on what universe, reality, or dimension you are in.
description: This ability is good for those who travel across the omniverse. The user will be able to absorb a bit the universe(that they are in)'s essence/theme. This will cause the users body to adapt in gaining abilities based on those essences/themes. For example, if the user would be in a universe were people have superpowers, the user will gain ability(s) that allows him to manipulate those abilities or increases the chance of gaining an ability(s) through different causes.
pros: Gain ability(s)
This ability could also increase your chance in certain subject based on those worlds.
cons: It is an active ability, you will have to activate it.
You have to have some form of travel to go to new worlds
Abilities last as long as you stay in that world

name: Restoration Bubble
overview: form a bubble with healing energy
description: Forms a large circular bubble, which will restore anything inside it to its original state. Can be expanded to form a large sphere or can be thrown. Ecological disaster? Large site of destruction? Not anymore...
pros: Good for cleaning up after oil spills or war time destruction
Restores and repairs all forms of pollution, including radiation
Natural disasters are no problem
cons: Has random effects on people, if they're standing in the explosion

name: Superpower List Link
overview: gain the powers in your profile in real life.
description: Want your powers in real life? Then participate in this experiment. According to the parallel universe theory, there should be a universe in existence where powers acquired on the site in this reality are acquired in reality there. If this power works, the holder will grant their powers to any alternate reality counterpart who knows of this power and wants the powers.
pros: Gain the powers in your profile.
If this power is negated, it's effect remains the same.
Even if this doesn't work, it is still a groundbreaking experiment.
cons: No power of you own can affect this, not even Con Negation or Ability Cancellation.
Most likely won't work.
You have to acquire this power to use it -no power mimicry, reality manipulation, etc.

name: 100% Efficient Movement
overview: redirect the kinetic energy your body endures when it moves
description: When your body pushes against something, exactly half of the energy produced pushes against your body in an opposite direction. With this power, any punches, pushes and shoves are 100% efficient, as this waste energy is redirected into your target. You are now essentially twice as strong and as fast as any human your strength and build. You also now cannot damage your own tissue from over-exertion, e.g. you can't break your hand by punching a concrete wall. The wall will instead by more damaged.
pros: You are as fast and as strong as any other human
No danger of damaging yourself with your superstrength
No sore hands or broken hands after a fight, which happens more often than you think
cons: Attacks from others hurt you just as much
This isn't a particularly impressive power
You need to build up your strength by working out

name: Digital Conversion
overview: convert matter to and from digital data
description: Also called Digitization, Digitalization, Data Conversion or Cybernetic Conversion, one with this ability can psionically convert matter and energy into digital data. This allows one to travel through cyberspace via a technopathic version of Astral Projection, as well as use electronic devices for storage, shelter and travel (via electronic wires and Wi-Fi signal connections). Not to mention, digital data may also be psionically converted into physical matter and energy equivalents, at will.
pros: Convert self and others (including objects) into digital data, at will
Travel cyberspace via Technopathic Astral Projection (use electronics for storage/shelter/travel)
Convert digital data into physical matter/energy equivalents (bring cybernetic data to life)
cons: Technopathy can affect digitized matter (to manipulate it, damage it or even delete it)
At the lower levels, the ability affects ONLY you, ONLY others or ONLY objects
If an electronic device is destroyed while digitized matter is inside of it, the data is trapped

name: Arch Demon
overview: become a demon
description: Users with this ability either is or can transform into a demon. Most commonly user retains their general form but with some additions; horns, retractable claws, fangs, tail, wings, more muscular body and can have colour changes, mainly red, blue or black. You can also summon lesser demons, use demonic energy for spells or energy attacks.
pros: Vast energy powers
Summon other Hellish creatures
Fly
cons: Your'e not neccesarily evil, but the powers push you that way
Strong Angelic/Good beings can beat you

name: Vitakinesis
overview: heal oneself, other people and plants
description: A person with Vitakinesis can heal themselves when they have pains and cuts. You can also heal others that need it. Or heal plants. And for your information, this is actually a REAL ability. Anyone can use. But don't do it when emotional! ;)
pros: Heal yourself when hurt
Don't have to go to the doctor's! :D
Real fun!
cons: Can't use it when emotional!
Don't use it the opposite way (relates to #1)
Same thing as #1, because there are not a lot of cons for this ability

name: Unbreakable Spirit
overview: have such a strong will that your mind and emotions can never be broken or manipulated
description: While many seek to dominate and break the will of others through evil, unspeakable methods, they will find you undefeatable. With this power, all your emotions still exist but can never defeat you. Nothing can control your mind or drive you insane. You can hold the One Ring in your hand for years without budging a finger. You'd laugh at Ctulhu and poke his tentacles with a stick. And the cruellest, most vile forms of torture known to man wouldn't draw so much as a whisper from your lips.
pros: Ever heard of Batman? Pssh. Guy's a wuss.
Imagine the distilled blood of several hundred thousand Spartans flowing through your veins.
Best for last: Infinite stimulus threshold. The worst chemicals, pain, or pleasures can't break you.
cons: ABSOLUTELY NOTHING.

name: Blind Luck
overview: be extremely lucky when you can't see
description: Go on and try giving the dice a roll, just remember to close your eyes and you'll get any number you hope for every time. With this power you create your own luck. Getting shot at? No problem, just run forward with your eyes closed and you'll be unscathed every time. Nuclear bomb about to go off above you? Close your eyes and a satellite will knock it out of the air and into some remote location where it won't cause trouble. If your already blind, you won't even need to close your eyes.
pros: Ridiculously lucky
Need i say more?
cons: Need to have eyes closed for this power to work, or be blind

name: Electrical Storm
overview: absorb electricity from around you and use it to your will
description: Absorb electricity from around you, e.g. power lines or living creatures. You can use it to zap enemies or use its electrical vibrations to move objects around. You can also make your mind as fast as lightning. If you think hard enough, your body will become electrical, preventing bullets from hurting you.
pros: Slows down your mind to think of what to do next
As long as you absorb electricity, you're not tired
If enough is absorbed, you can take out a small city!
cons: Takes a long time to master your power
Cannot be constant

name: Summon
overview: summon creatures from your imagination
description: All you would have to do would be imagine the creature you want to summon and pick an area. In the area a magical sign(varies per creature)will appear and glow really bright than flash out. In its place would be the creature you imagined. The creature would be under your control and have one small magical power(you choose). You could make more than one of the same creature at one time depending on its size. The smallest it can be is 1cu foot and the largest is 10cu feet. You can also vanish them
pros: Can summon any magical creature you can imagine that is at your control
The summonings are fast and cool to watch
The smaller the creature the more you can make at once
cons: Summonings are hard to hide.
People will want magical pets
Can't summon objects

name: Superhuman Reflexes
overview: react almost instantly.
description: You can react to events nearly instantaneously.  "Think fast!" will be a slow and annoying practical joke.
pros: Dodge things
Impress your friends with your leet Whac-A-Mole skills
cons: Laughing early at people's jokes

name: Invisibility
overview: become invisible to the naked eye.
description: Everyone knows this one.  You can become transparent so that people see right through you.  Be careful though--people can still run into you and getting covered in flour or any other dust gives you away.
pros: Sneak into places
Locker rooms with hotties
Become a badass spy
cons: Getting run over by a truck
Locker rooms with old wrinkly people
Getting caught

name: Speed Absorption
overview: stop any motion coming at you with your mind and reverse it.
description: You can take a speeding bullet for example and turn it around and shoot it at your enemy.
pros: You can take away any speed of an object and turn it around
You can always hurt your enemy because you can backfire anything back at them
cons: NONE

name: Life Force Manipulation
overview: read organic substances and transfer life force by touch.
description: With this ability, you could easily analyze any organism's biological make-up simply by looking at it. You can read and interpret the health, special abilities, and personality of any entity, as well as manipulate the life force in it. You can pour your life energy into a living thing in order to heal it, or absorb another living thing's life energy simply by touching it, thereby gaining their memories, special abilities, and strength. This will weaken the target or even kill it.
pros: Quickly analyze something's health, personality, or any skills/superpowers they might have.
Heal any injury through physical contact.
Gain the health, memories, and skills of the target, weakening or killing them.
cons: Healing weakens you as much as it strengthens the target.
Life extraction may manifest in a lust for life force.
May have difficulty controlling the power, resulting in accidental damage upon physical contact.

name: Projective Teleportation
overview: move objects by bending space
description: This power is like telekinesis, but the objects that are moved disappear from their place and appear in another, without the user touching it and with just a mere point of a finger/hand and directing where the object will appear.
pros: When moving, the objects are more accurately to go to the user without physical interference
Unpredictable attacks, the user can teleport enemies and objects anywhere within their line of sight
No need to touch objects to teleport them.
cons: The range of the power is small in scale depending on how far the user's sight is
The user cannot projectively teleport the objects or humans to other places out of their sight
The power usually would not be effective that much to users with sight problems or in the dark

name: Intuitive Inventing
overview: be able to invent anything they can imagine
description: Someone with this superpower can create almost any device imaginable. This is the uncanny and almost empathic ability to understand machines and to perceive "mechanical energy. " One can create fantastic futuristic devices, including cybernetic systems, holograms, and elaborate computer and fiber-optic systems.
pros: Can replace limbs with robotic limbs
Can make a teleporting machine to travel
Able to make a machine to give or take powers away
cons: Takes time to make
Cost a lot of money to buy supplies

name: 100 Percent Brain Efficiency
overview: use your brain with 100 percent efficiency
description: Humans generally use only 10% brain capacity or maybe less, and within the 10 percent it is possible for errors to occur. With this power, the user can use the maximum amount of brain capacity allowed without intruding on the subconscious functions like breathing. The user also has no errors in thought, they will not freeze up when thinking about things. The user can exhibit near clairvoyance due to being able to perceive more things about their environment in shorter time. Does not grant ESP.
pros: Can process information faster and retain it
Immune to error in the mind-includes illusions and mind control can also tell if mind is being read
Quick prediction and analysis-also allows user to dodge bullets if the body is fast enough
cons: Contrary to popular belief, does not give you psychic powers
A great brain does not equal a great body
You will find regular things not challenging enough

name: Talent Of Healing
overview: have a natural ability to heal people and other things
description: By simply laying your hands on something, that animal, plants, fungi, or other entity will heal. You also gain a natural knowlege of medicine and can heal a persons auras and other energies. A bonus of this is that you can reverse the aging process and can unlock a persons potential or unlock their abilities.
pros: Description can't be shortened and pros can't be negated.
Knowledge of medicine
Reverse aging and unlocking potential
cons: None

name: Magical Door
overview: summon a door which can be used for teleportation
description: With this power, you are able to summon a magical door which leads to any place you want to go. Wanna see another country? Locked yourself inside the house? Do you need a certain object? Do you want to find somebody? Think about the door and it will appear out of nowhere. Go through it and you'll find the thing you seek. The door leads only to places on Earth, places that exist. You can make the door disappear too, and with practice, you can create multiple ones.
pros: Get anywhere, anytime.
Travel around the world, meet celebrities.
cons: Never open up a door that leads to the bottom of the ocean.
If there's no room for the door, it can't be summoned.

name: Ultimate Programmer
overview: program any piece of electronics/tech one wants in any way one wants
description: AI for games, robots, satellites, research, space station facilities, etc. Anything you want to program you can, even to the point in which the AI has human creativity and intelligence as well as morals. Even graphics can look so realistic you can't distinguish them from real scenes or people.
pros: Have a computer with which you can discuss philosophy.
People might pay loads of money for an AI you programmed.
cons: May become a reclusive or taciturn nerd.

name: Antibacterial Body
overview: kill germs & clean surfaces with your own body
description: Because your body is antibacterial, you can clean surfaces by touching them with your hands, feet, tongue, or any other part of your body! As a bonus, you are immune to almost any disease since harmful germs die as soon as they get on you!
pros: Clean surfaces with your own body parts.
Immunity to almost any disease!
You're like a living block of soap!
cons: It's not quite impossible for you to get sick...
You can still be stained by discoloring substances like paint. Rinse yourself to wash them off.

name: Stealth Mode
overview: become more stealthy in multiple ways
description: With this power, your aura dampens down and becomes harder to sense. Also, any sound you make is slightly muted and harder to detect. Your smell also becomes more similar to that of the environment's and your footsteps are lighter than normal, leaving footprints that are harder to see. Your mind also becomes less likely to be found by a mind reader/detector.
pros: Harder to detect.
Can be underestimated in a fight, due to the 'weak' aura.
cons: Doesn't do anything about visibility.
Just lowers the possible ways to detected, doesn't eliminate them.

name: Mending Minds
overview: make people do stuff without completely controlling them.
description: You can hack into people's mind and change their mind and tempt them to do other things while you're not completely controlling them.
pros: You can make your crush have a crush on you.
You can make your mom get you whatever you want!
You can make your enemies hurt themselves.
cons: No bad things

name: Codebreaker
overview: learn any secret.
description: This ability allows someone to break any code. With it one would be able to access any secret hidden from them, be they in a computer or elsewhere, by instinctively knowing how to break the "code" to get to it. The solution to the "code" could be anything from the correct computer password, to the exact things you need to say to get someone to tell you something.
pros: You will be able to hack into virtually anything.
If you suspect someone is keeping something from you, it would be a simple matter to find out what.
