The eventual ability to make codes and store secrets so that none could get at them.
cons: It could be emotionally damaging to know what others really think of you.
This ability would eventually cause the user to see the world in numbers and symbols.
It only works if you know something is hidden away.

name: Data Manipulation Entity
overview: manipulate the data of the universe
description: Anyone with this power has a near god-like power to manipulate the universe. However, it can only be used for an object or in a closed space. A closed space is created by creating a large program to create a realm outside of normal reality. This power is limited because it needs large setup time and it cannot create something out of nothing. Normal use without closed spaces can range from increasing your own strength values to giving properties to items, such as homing capabilities
pros: You have near god-like reality bending powers
You can change variables within objects or turn objects into other things
If you release your full power, you can also manipulate time
cons: You cannot create anything new, you must use already existing objects
You can only use this power to manipulate small variables, unless you prepare a closed space
In order to activate full power, you must have the permission of the integrated thought entity

name: Infinite Knowledge
overview: possess the full spectrum of human knowledge.
description: Simply means that you know everything. Anything anyone on Earth learns or discovers is instantly added to your knowledge bank. You leave no questions unanswered. The future and such are still a mystery to you and other people's histories and personalities are not necessarily included, but essentially, everything known by man is known by you.
pros: Know everything.
Ace tests like a madman
Never surprised by anything you learn
cons: No physical offense or defense.
Cannot read minds.
Doesn't look cool.

name: Fire And Ice
overview: simultaneously use the powers of fire and ice for various effects.
description: Not much to describe here; you use the power of fire AND ice simultaneously. It has unlimited uses and various effects. Sometimes, it will even summon the two dragons Ergolek and Kralissan. This power is more for show than for go, considering it is almost impossible to control. Fortunately, the worst backfire is cross-cancellation where one cancels the other effects, though you won't even get hurt by it, except by 2 degrees (inside a building, collapse the roof and get buried in debris)
pros: Occasionally summons the Great Dragon of Fire Ergolek and the Great Dragon of Ice Kralissan
Has various effects
Looks cool
cons: Difficult to control
Occasional cross-cancelation (fire melts ice but the ice freezes the fire at the same time)
Dragons may fight each other instead of an enemy

name: Cosmic Manipulation
overview: manipulate cosmic energy and space matter.
description: Sure, their are people who can bend space and rip through time, but true power is in the stars. This ability allows you to manipulate cosmic energy and space matter. Cosmic energy is orange and can be manipulated into shapes or used as raw power. The surface of shaped cosmic energy looks like the bottom of a still pool, with lines wavering all around it. Space matter is things like meteors, black holes, comets, and stars. You can also fly through space unharmed. However, you cannot move planets.
pros: Manipulating and shaping cosmic energy
Controling space matter and space travel
Very, very powerful
cons: Cannot move planets
Might accidently destroy a planet or star

name: Ultimate Authority
overview: order anything to do what you want.
description: With this ability anything you can order anything to do what you want. This includes inanimate objects. However, the longer the command the less the power your command has, so it's best to stick to a few words. This ability takes intense concentration to work. The level of concentration varies, depending on if the object could normally do this. Meaning that living objects are easier to control than inanimate objects, or space. Orders can also include effects such as, Burn, Freeze, or Age.
pros: Order anyone to do anything
Can also convey orders telepathically.
cons: Takes intense concentration.
Refrain from cursing at all times, they may be considered orders.

name: Digitalization
overview: digitalize yourself on a subatomic level.
description: The ability to turn your entire body into a digital holographic form. Users may be able to hack into any computer based objects (computers, cell phones, satellites, exc. ), become intangible, cover their body in a digital armor and project weapons from their body. Limited to users imagination and energy. Users can draw energy from any electrical device they touch. Experienced users can also regenerate when touching an electrical device.
pros: Users are immune from deseases.
Extreamely difficult to harm.
Users can shape digital vehicales around body(tanks, jets, cars exc. )
cons: Inexperienced users can get trapped in a single object(computer, cell phone, car exc. )
Users can be fatally wounded if infected with a virus
Users may have to reprogram theirselves if they get wet or catch a virus

name: Energy Morph
overview: change your body into an energy you can reshape at will.
description: You could morph any part of your body into an energy that you could will into any form you can imagine. The energy is transparent and can be any color you want. You can even separate the energy from your body in the form of objects and projectiles. For example, you could form a sword then reform your hand around the handle. Morphing your hands is the easiest but not your limit.
pros: Very useful power.
The energy is nearly indestructible.
cons: You can not morph all of your body at once.
Need to be creative to reach your full potential.

name: Fortune/Misfortune Smiles Upon
overview: make people go from rags to riches and vice versa
description: This is a test of one's greed or thankfulness. You are able to bestow upon a person either riches or "Help Me" cardboard signs. You smile at a person who is poor and they will immediately become rich. But you can take it away from them at any time if they choose to be selfish, ungrateful and use their newfound wealth unwisely. As for the upper class, you can frown upon a person of greed and snob, making them lose their money and power. If they prove they can change ways, smile at them :D
pros: Give someone a chance that they can give back to the world
cons: Can't make yourself richer or poorer with the power

name: Plasma Control
overview: control any form of plasma such as the sun, lightning, fire, and other objects that are plasma.
description: With the ability to control matter made up of a high amount of energy, or plasma, you would essentially become a very powerful being. Plasma is the least common form of matter on earth, but it is actually the most common of all the universe. Such examples are stars, auroras, and nebulas. So you would be able to not only control high amounts of energy, but also gather it. But it would take you a while to control such vast amounts of energy.
pros: Control an almost unlimited supply of energy.
Create high energy objects such as lightning.
cons: Time is needed to control that energy.

name: Psychometric Regeneration
overview: heal people by understanding the history of any injury or disease they had or do have
description: This healing ability is very powerful. You can use psychometrics to see when and how someone was injured, and heal them by taking control of their memories of the incident, and thus stimulating that person's natural healing process by triggering the brain's natural defenses against the threat they were exposed to.
pros: If the person has a healing power, this ability naturally stimulates it to start working
You can search through the person's memory if they cannot recall it, and find it for them
The healing process can fully regenerate severed or malformed limbs in as little as 30 hours
cons: A person with psychic or mnemonic powers could slow your power down, but not weaken it
If the person has powers similar to your psychometry, painful psychic static feedback could result

name: Blood Temperature Manipulation
overview: control the temperature of someones blood.
description: You can control the temperature of someone's blood making them hot or cold you can kill them by making them really hot and exploding them or really cold and freezing them. You can also use this power on yourself
pros: Can make yourself the tempature you want.
cons: Takes alot of concetration

name: Kinetic Speed
overview: absorb kinetic energy and release it at will
description: The ability to absorb kinetic energy (eg: from being punched, falling, voluntarily striking surface) and release it at will, usually in the form of superspeed. Can store the energy absorbed in body for later use. While storing and using energy the hero vibrates quiet rapidly, causing some discomfort.
pros: Opponent's energy can be used against them.
Energy from using superspeed causes more energy.
cons: Can cause some pain if too much energy is stored
Vibration while using the power can be uncomfortable

name: Indestructible!
overview: be indestructible and build up a pain tolerance
description: Heal ridiculously fast from any physical damage, burns, bullets, amputations, etc. If a generous portion of your body is destroyed & one cell remains, the cell will regrow your entire body. You will steadily build a tolerance to most conventional injuries. Reattach limbs or grow new ones; your will controls every cell. Your bones will become nigh unbreakable and your skin will toughen. You will double peak human physiology. You will even learn to block out pain completely at will.
pros: Be unstoppable. Walk thru lasers, razors, run thru infernos, shed frozen tissue
Eventually (+/- one jupiter year) you will freak enemies out by taking their worse and smiling
Grow rhino-like skin, lift a metric ton, bones will be like thick galvanized rubber.
cons: You are not invincible. Mentats hurt you & you could still be injured and even destroyed.
If your pain centers are off, touch will be off as well and it will take days to come back
Your body density & hair will grow. Eventually you will look like a pale Wolverine reject

name: Superiority
overview: surpass the powers and talents of others.
description: With this power, even the Hulk and Doomsday will have trouble! The moment you encounter someone with an ability that you can use, you will surpass all of their talents. "Anything you can do, I can do better" will no longer be a joke!
pros: Become stronger, faster, and smarter than anyone!
Win at everything forever!
cons: You will become a real world Mary-sue/Gary-stu
Nobody likes a Mr. /Ms. Perfect

name: Psychometric Muscle Memory
overview: gain skills by touching an object that someone used before
description: A person with this power has an unique form of psychometry that allows for the user to absorb skills from the objects they touch. They can use the object with the skill of a previous owner. In addition, they also can tell how the object was made by copying the skills of the person who made it. Once the user has absorbed all the skills they can use their acquired skills on similar objects. With practice, you can learn how to absorb someone's skills by touching them.
pros: You can gain skills very easily
You also know how to recreate any object you touched by copying the creator's skill
You can also absorb skills by touching people-if they somehow let you
cons: You now want to touch everything to gain more skills
It is pretty expensive to buy things that were previously used by pros
You can only absorb skills involving the object you touched

name: Elemental Influencers
overview: empower and weaken the natural elements
description: Fire, water, earth, air. In a way, these are the substances that make up our world. Anyone with this ability can empower and weaken the elements in their natural forms. Influencers could turn a ripple into a tsunami, build a spark into a roaring fire, or force a breeze to grow into hurricane level winds. The flip side to this gift is that the user can also dampen and weaken the elements, stopping choatic earthquakes, gusting tornadoes, and distructive fires in their tracks.
pros: Influencers can empower and weaken the elements to their advantage
Can create various effects
Unique power.
cons: Can only control the elements to a degree.

name: Elemental Transmogrification
overview: take on the form of the basic elements at will
description:
Ability to transform parts of your body or your entire body into any of the basic elements. You can use more than one ability at once, so long as they're not touching (ie. Fire on one arm, electricity on the other). 

Usable elements include: Fire, Water, Air, Electricity, Metal, Earth
pros: You are the master of the elements
Can adapt to many different scenarios
Be the life of all the parties
cons: Contradicting elements can harm you when used together
Certain elements are harder to control than others (ie. Rock slows you down)

name: Immortality Manipulation
overview: control immortality, in any of its forms.
description: Immortality can come in many forms. Lets see, anti-aging, resurrection, preservation and the weird one where you just don't die from wounds. Someone with this power can grant or remove any of these, and choose between which they grant. Physical contact is necessary and this ability can be used on yourself. You can even make up your own forms of immortality. Also you can change the kind of immortality someone has
pros: Can grant any form of immortality and it can't be removed from you.
Can choose what form you grant and can make up your own kinds
Can be used on yourself AND can take back immortality from others.
cons: Physical contact is necessary.

name: Mirror Teleport
overview: walk into any mirror and walk out of any other mirror you've seen
description: Imagine you are surrounded by hundreds of soldiers or a few other superheroes and you're about to get the beating of your lifetime. Just pull out a mirror and walk through it and you walk out of whatever other mirror you want. You are able to pull people through with you too, but it will drain your energy twice as much for everyone you pull in. Unfortunately, the first mirror will show what the mirror you come out of is facing.
pros: You can get anywhere with a mirror really fast
If your foe breaks your mirrors, they'll have really bad luck
You will dominate in the house of mirrors
cons: You'll appear in a lot of bathrooms
Foes can see where you teleport to
Big cost of buying a lot of personal mirrors

name: Weapon Evolution
overview: transform and supersize any small weapon into your weapon for combat.
description: Just think of it, you could even pick up a Knife/Dagger and morph it into a Sword/Saber, a Claw Hammer into a Warhammer, a Tomahawk into an Axe, and any small weapon you can think of transform and supersizing it into your very own weapon on your own brutal and fatal arsenal.
pros: Lots of different weapons
cons: Evolution has to resemble the original weapon, no forming a big gun out of a toothpick

name: Supernatural Sense
overview: be alerted when something Supernatural is where you are
description: You hear the sound of thunder in your head that alerts you something Supernatural is in the area of where you are or something Supernatural could happen.  This includes but not limited to Demons Vampires, Ghosts, Sorcerers, people using dark magic,demon possession of a human or animal, a person summoning a demon or decided to summon a demon.
pros: The Sound of the Supernatural Sense is Loud so hard not to hear it
Useful for fighting Supernatural Enemies
If loud noise or something else prevented you from hearing it, it will repeat until you hear it
cons: It doesn't tell you spefically what Supernatural it is in the area
Sorcerers and Others very Powerful Can Block It
Can disturb you when on vaction, sleeping, eating at a restaurant, seeing a movie, etc

name: Power Wash
overview: clense oneself of wounds, physical and mental.
description: The user is able to heal any damaged cells, broken tissues, stressed materials, and mental strain to which they have suffered by focusing a stream of energy to bathe over their body. They are "washing" away the harm.
pros: Can heal physical and mental obscurities.
Can be used on other people, if the user allows.
Can introduce a form of immortality.
cons: Telepathy can cause drawbacks, if not shut the ability off completely.
User can still be killed by any conventional weapon.
The ability doesn't make the user invincible.

name: Invisible Force Manipulation
overview: control any invisible forces of nature.
description: There are many invisble forces of nature. There is wind (or air), gravity, and even heat. This ability will allow you to control it.
pros: Able to control invisible forces.
cons: You won't control any invisible creatures, people, or spirits.

name: Knowledge Absorption
overview: drain or copy the knowledge of others
description: Knowledge is power. A Knowledge Absorber can take someone else's knowledge by physical contact. This lets them find information, use stolen scientific/math/physics knowledge, or even determine the location of people. This ability does not work well with applied skills. Just because the user knows how to do something does not mean that they can do it.
pros: Find information
Use stolen science/math/military info
Can merely copy info or rip it out of their head
cons: Requires touch
Requires more concentration the harder they resist
Does not work well with applied skills

name: 5th Dimension Notebook
overview: have a notebook that you can use to manipulate reality
description: A person with this power has a notebook that can manipulate reality. The notebook has power over reality in anything below the 5th dimension-that means it affects both space and time. The user can either create characters or weapons in their notebook and bring them to life or change aspects of the real world to the words/pictures written. Pictures drawn in the notebook have more power. The book comes with a pen that has powers itself. The book has 100 pages and things written are permanent.
pros: You can manipulate reality to a certain extent-creating heroes and weapons, etc.
It also comes with a pen to write with that can also function in the real world to draw doors
You can give the notebook a password so only you can use it
cons: You only have 100 pages and there is a limit to what you can create-no omnipotent characters
You can't use it when it closes to recharge
Anyone can use it as long as they know the password and have the pen

name: Matter Minions
overview: give matter life and control it
description: You can manipulate any form of matter into a living creature that you can choose to be under your control. You have a limitless amount of life energy that you use to animate matter and give it a living consciousness. If your matter creatures are damaged to the point of "death", the energy inside them is released and it sends out a shockwave, damaging nearby matter. You can use your life energy to heal yourself and other beings.
pros: You can have an army of random objects
You can also animate large forms of matter (buildings, mountains, planets)
You can heal yourself
cons: You can't control biological beings

name: Refresh
overview: renew or revitalize anyone and/or everything around you.
description: If there's any pollution anywhere on this planet, or some negative addictions inside of a person like drugs, alcohol, and even junk food, you have the power to erase it by releasing a glowing Refresh logo that spins around the user and then goes inside it, instantly wiping out all forms of pollution. You can also free anyone who's mind controlled by any villain.
pros: You can become a greater help to the environmental community.
Rid a person of various addictions that are inside of them.
Can choose what negative influence you want to get rid of
cons: Crooked goverment officals can come after you.

name: Comic Book Mimic
overview: replicate the superpowers of fictional characters
description: The name of this superpower has 'comic book' in it because the most common way to use this superpower is to copy, replicate, or mimic the superpowers of characters from comic books. Powers can also be copied from television, novels, etc. based on comics. The user must see an image of the superpower being used by a fictional character before he/she can replicate it. If the user acquires too many superpowers, they will all disappear and the user will have to acquire a whole new set of superpowers.
pros: Copy, replicate, or mimic the superpowers of characters from comic books
Powers can also be copied from television, novels, etc. based on comics
cons: The user must see an image of the superpower being used before he/she can replicate it
Aquires too many superpowers, they'll all disappear and you'll have to aquire another set of powers
How many you can acquire before you have to start over, is different for every user

name: Shape Metamorphosis
overview: change yourself into a different shape, person.
description: You can shapeshift into any living or non-living solid matter. However if you change into another person with a different power you won't be able to possess their specific power. Shapeshifting into any animal or mytholgical creature of any size. So you can change from a gigantic dinosaur into a microscopic bacteria. Cool!!
pros: You can be anything and/or anyone you want to be.
You can change into a microscopic bacteria so no-one can see you.
cons: Changing into another person doesn't make your voice sound like their's.
You can't change minor specifics. It's either everything or nothing.

name: Forcefield Body
overview: have a body that is made of force fields.
description: Your entire body is made of force fields from a visible level down to your DNA. You have any strengths and weaknesses that an actual forcefield would have. If you take too much damage at one time, you will overload and die. With time and practice, you can control your force field body to do other things. Fly, reshape your arms into force blades, extend short-ranged tractor beams,... Anything that would work with a force field.
pros: You're a solid energy being.
This power combines with other force field powers (i.e. Impenetrable Field).
With time and practice, you can fly or reshape your force field body.
cons: Energy draining powers will weaken or kill you.
The powers Barrier Melting and Wall Tearer will kill or hurt you.
As a force field, you'll have a finite damage limit.

name: Forcefield Projection
overview: project and manipulate fields of energy
description: Force without mass is the greatest weapon. A person with Forcefield Manipulation can project durable, translucent fields of energy that will naturally form into bubbles unless mentally directed to do otherwise. They can be used as a shield or an offensive weapon.
pros: Easy to win fights
Even easier to defend yourself
Very versatile
cons: Can be overloaded
Takes practice to use offensively
Takes focus

name: New Shift
overview: shape-shift & replicate into absolutely anything in the universe.
description:
From particle to stellar red giant, shift into anything in the universe. Split into endless copies of yourself. You could be your own armour, sword, gun. You could shift into becoming a star, replace our sun. Note: Making copies of yourself compromises your density & takes awhile to replenish. Transforming into something as massive as the sun or a blackhole would take hours to develop necessary energy to mimic a true one. You no longer require oxegen. 
You could shift into a whole new universe.
pros: You are the ultimate shape-shifter capable of shifting into any fluid, solid or energy
Mitotically create COPIES of yourself; you could carry weapon that are part of YOU
At rest your body is of amorphous consistency rendering you immune to sharp & blunt trauma
cons: Susceptible to absolute zero temperatures & you have no superhuman form of energy projection
Unless you touch the duplicates of yourself they are stuck in whatever form they've shifted into
When shifted immune to the fluid, solid or energy a duplicate has become not the true element

name: Ground Manipulation
overview: control the ground beneath your feet
description: Also called Ground Control, this is the power to manipulate the earth BENEATH ONE'S FEET. The user can't pull rocks up from the earth, and can't manipulate any AIRBORNE or HELD earthen objects. However, the user isn't at a disadvantage with this power; they can still cause monstrous tremors, make the ground ripple and cause constructs to be formed from the earth, as long as they remain in contact with the ground. You can even cause the earth to part, for easy tunneling.
pros: Make the ground shake, crumble and ripple at will
Displace ground for effective digging
Form constructs (spikes, walls, pillars, etc.) as long as they stay in contact with the ground
cons: Can't hurl rock through the air (or above ground AT ALL)
Can't manipulate rock that is hurling (or being hurled) at you
Power may be untamed at first, causing earthquakes, tremors, etc.

name: Reactive Knowledge Gain
overview: gain knowledge as you need it.
description: Tied up with very hard rope and there is a bomb in the room? This power helps you by allowing you to gain knowledge of how you could break the rope and disable the bomb. There are limits of this power though, this power only helps you escape not win battles, and you gain knowledge as you need it, not as you want it.
pros: Gain knowledge as you need it!
cons: Doesn't help you win battles.
Only when you need it, not wan't it.

name: Creation
overview: create any object microscopic to global in size and in complexity
description: The power of 'Creation' allows you to (once per day) create any object, creature, item, weapon, armor, vehicle (including spaceships), or place (like a house or city) that you can imagine. The object may be living or non-living, of nearly any size, of any complexity, and of any materials imaginable. The object will have all the abilities, attributes, traits, limitations and weaknesses that you 'assume it' to have. The object may be reality based: like a car, or fictional: a Star Ship Enterprise.
pros: Gives you 'Godlike' power.
cons: Before you can use 'Creation', you must have had the power 'object creation' for 2 years first.
You can only use this power once per day.
The created object may not be smaller than an atom, or larger than the planet earth.

name: Existence Manipulation
overview: manipulate existence
description: This is the fraternal twin of Self-Existence Manipulation. It allows you to control the existence of everything, but yourself. To put it more simply, you can control what things are. You are not the creator of all, but more like the molder. All of existence is yours to control.
pros: Near unlimited power.
Can control existence of all things.
cons: You cannot control your own existence
You have much power, but need even more control.

name: Hydrokinesis
overview: mentally manipulate liquids
description: Water is everywhere. Imagine being able to control it. Creating crushing geysers, floating streams, and even using water pressure to cut through things is in the range of a Hydrokinetic.
pros: Very versatile
Powerful and shocking to watch
Can be used to manipulate bodily fluids (to degree)
cons: Cannot create water
Cannot destroy water
Cannot manipulate more than 100,000 gallons effectively

name: Energy Form
overview: transform into a being of pure energy
description: Flesh & blood is weak as an energy form; you don't have those weaknesses. You can emit & control all types of energy & not be hurt by most attacks. Your energy form has no limits on your abilites. You can pass through anything that emits energy, even when you are destroyed. As long there is any part of you left, you can reform yourself. You don't age & can gain the properties of different energies. You can phase through objects at will, you can levitate or fly. You can stay transformed forever.
pros: You have no limits on your abilities
You can reform when destroyed
You can emit and control energy
cons: You can be trapped in places that are made to hold you
When you are in energy form you are vulnerable to energy absorption powers
You will be considered a freek

name: Scanning
overview: see any weakness, flaw, or mistake by simply looking at something.
description: With this power, you can make any plan foolproof. Find out what's wrong with any patient and be the world's best doctor. Or even fight super heroes/villains and use their weakness against them, winning the battle without even trying.
pros: Pin point weaknesses, flaws or mistakes
Ace quizzes
Ultimate doctor, never lose any fight, unless you don't feel like winning. (pfft)
cons: ..... Not really a power you can use without preparation

name: Top 10 Power Mimicry
overview: have the top 10 powers.
description: The holder of this ability could be a very powerful person, as they have the top ten most wanted powers on the Superpower List. Unfortunately, once the preferences change, you get a new ten powers. Remember, the top ten may not be your favorites. However, if you do not like an ability, you can suppress it. If this is one of the top ten, you get the other nine and the eleventh.
pros: Getting some really good powers.
Having ten at a time!
You can suppress powers you don't want.
cons: Not everyone has the same preferences.
Some powers are redundant -who wants Space/Time Manipulation and Teleportation?
The powers may change too fast for you to get experience.

name: Supreme Earth Elementalist
overview: rule over every aspect of Vegetation, Minerals and Soil
description: You can summon Earthquakes of any size. You can Geologically change the grounds and the mountains within minutes. You can make grounds fertile from years of famine. You can grow trees that are higher than redwoods. Your body can transform into trees, rocks, metals or into soil. You can grow very nasty thorns from your own body. You can mold any soil into any rock, stone, or gem.
pros: You can create seeds of new species of plants from your mind
You can easily make a path through a mountain
Making precious metals and stones are as easy as making pies
cons: Fire is deadly
You'll make dirty footprints on someone's clean carpet
Doing Geology manipulation can kill someone if you're not careful

name: Zero Point Energy Field
overview: create the effect of a gravity gun by blasting energy from your hands
description: If you've ever played Half-Life, or seen Syndrome's rays in the Incredibles, you will automatically know the practical uses for this power. A person with this power can shoot and "energy field" that can either blast things away or pick up and drag items closer to you. With this type of power you can turn things in your surroundings into deadly weapons as well as move heavy objects around your house.
pros: Pick up items to use as deadly weapons
Pick up heavy items from afar and carry them
Pick up people and prevent them from moving
cons: People can dodge your initial energy blast
Needs to be creative

name: Chronospheres
overview: create spheres in which the flow of time is different.
description: With this ability you gain the power to forms spheres in you hands. Inside these spheres time either moves faster, is slowed down, or completely stopped at your discretion. You may then fire the sphere, at which point it will expand to encompass whatever it hits. Spheres will remain until banished by the user.
pros: Stop time in a certain radius.
Speed up time in a certain radius.
Slow time in a certain radius.
cons: You are just as vulneable to the spheres as anyone else.
The spheres will encompass only what they hit.

name: Perfect Eyesight
overview: allow yourself and other to have perfect vision
description: With this power you can allow yourself and other to have 20/20 vision. However when this power is used on somebody it causes them to loose all eye/sight related super powers such as laser vision, video eyes, eye grenades, etc. Even when you use this power on yourself you loose all of your eye/sight related super powers except for this one. This power also make sure the person this power is used upon's eyesight never become less than perfect no matter what happens to his/her eyes.
pros: You can give yourself or other perfect vision
You can use it on enemies and cause them to lose their eye/sight related powers
The person this is used upon can never lose their perfect vision
cons: When this power is used the person it is used on loses all of their eye/sight based powers

name: Power Personification
overview: personify one of your powers into physical form.
description: With this power you can choose one of your powers and create a physical form for it. Once this is done you can only use that power through the new personification. Luckily it has no mind or thoughts of its own, instead acting as an extension of your own body and responding to your thoughts and feelings as though it were your own arm. The form the power takes when personified depends on both the power and the user, and it can be dematerialized and hidden within the users body at any time.
pros: Attack from two seperate directions.
Seperate a power that has a negative drawback from yourself while still getting the benefits.
It behaves exactly how the power it used to be did, but it can now punch people as well.
cons: Because you're connected you take any damage the personification does.
You can only ever have one power personified.

name: Transformers: Rapido
overview: outrank everybody
description: With this power you automatically hold a higher rank than everyone else in the room. If a person that ranks higher than you in your organization walks into the room your rank and clearance level automatically increase. So if you were to walk into a room with the President or some other head of state you would automatically have a higher rank than them and be able to command them.
pros: You outrank everybody
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Never Ending Shopping List
overview: order anything you could possible want, free of charge, just by writing it down
description: This power allows you to summon a small white roll of paper that will never run out. All you have to do is write the correct name of something you can buy and it will be delivered to your house, free of charge, the next day when no one is looking. Your purchase will always be left outside your house, as close to the doorstep as possible. If you tear part of the list off you will be expected to pay for everything written under the tear off point. If the list is destroyed, you pay for everything.
pros: Order anything you can buy and have it deliverd to your house, free.
cons: The list can not be unsummond once it appears, and will eventually get very long from use.
If the list is torn or destroyed, you "pay" for everything you wrote that is no longer on the list.
There are some things that are not for sale.

name: Physically Perfect
overview: be physically perfect
description: Physically, meaning your body. This qualifies as looks and strength. This power allows the user to be extremely good looking and have amazing strength. Also, although you don't need to, if you take care of your body, in return your body will become resistant to physical harm and your appearance will become so attractive that you'll be able to take control over the will power of others. You'll be physically perfect.
pros: Extremely good looking
Amazing strength, maybe resistant to physical harm
Control the will power of others
cons: Mental imperfections remain

name: Dimensions Of Fiction
overview: open portals into alternate realities that are based upon the works of fiction
description: In addition to our own home reality, an infinite number of alternate realities based upon the works of fiction exist. This power allows the user to open and close safe & stable interdimensional portals at will. These portals can be used to travel instantaneously to any point, place, & time within these alternate realities. They can take anyone & anything with them into and out of any of these alternate realities, and also back to one's home reality.
pros: Alternate realities includes all forms of fiction portrayed in all forms of medium.
All alternate realities appear portrayed in live action, just like our home reality.
Can change events within any alternate realities and have adventures alongside your favorite heroes.
cons: Might have bad experience in some dimensions.
Might change things for the worst within the dimensions, including our own.
Could bring evil villains or zombies home with you.

name: Inertia Manipulation
overview: control the inertia of any object.
description: Inertia is the resistance of any physical object to a change in its state of motion or rest when it is acted upon by an external force. Those who can control inertia are able to control the outside resistances and make the object immune to such things like wind resistance or gravity, allowing them to redirect, speed up, slow down, or even entirely halt an object in mid-air. This can be used to hit harder, run faster, and even curve the direction of things like bullets.
pros: Able to halt incoming attacks
Able to choose a destination an object is going
Able to increase the user's own physical speed and strength
cons: Without any resistance, the object will continue on forever
The user moving at superhuman speeds doesn't mean the user can perceive at a superhuman rate
An object must be in motion before it can be redirected, stopped, or sped up

name: Diamond Water
overview: transmute water into diamond, and manipulate the diamond you made from the water
description: With this power you can transmute water into diamonds at will. It doesn't matter what kind of water, it all becomes the same kind of diamond. Not ruby, not emerald, not amethyst or that topaz crap. Diamonds. Not gold, not silver, not any other metals. Not to mention, the diamonds generated from the water, you can manipulate to form constructs, shoot at foes, and other cool stuff. 'Nuff said.
pros: Um, hello...DIAMONDS!
Water is one of the most abundant elements on earth
Control the diamonds you form from water
cons: Only works with liquid water
Only makes diamonds (if you don't like diamonds, too bad)
Only manipulate diamond that is made from water

name: Words To Items
overview: change words into items as long as the sentence begins with I want.
description: A person with this power can turn their words into objects. They can get whatever they say out loud. For example if they say sword they can get a sword. If they are more specific they can get better items. For example if they wanted a gun but they wanted something that can shoot faster they can state Gun that shoots at lightspeed or is always faster than target. However the limitation of this power is that it cannot create people. The objects will disappear after a while.
pros: Get any weapon or device by saying it
Can get anything as long as it is not unique
It doesn't matter how fast you say it or what language you say it in
cons: If people stop you from talking
Having an item doesn't mean you are proficient with it
No surprise because they will expect whatever you pull out

name: Game World Reality
overview: create worlds in an alternate reality based on games.
description: The game must have a setting. Monopoly would just work. The game can be a board game, RPG, card, computer, online or miniatures. The nature laws of a game reality can be entirely based on the game rules or based on real world laws or somewhere in between. If you can die in the game you can die in the game world. Objects can't be taken from a game world. However you could bring 100 fire elemental miniatures to a D&D world and have a 100 elementals ready to serve you.
pros: A game where death never happens.
Actually live out your favorite game fantasies.
cons: Any dangerous game realities. Warhammer 40000, Rifts, horror games.
You can't leave with objects found in the game reality.

name: Change Manipulation
overview: control all aspects of physical change.
description: This ability allows the user to controls the an aspect of change. This involves shapeshifting, evolution, matter transmutation,invisibility etc. The user has absolute power over them. The user can't control the things that he changes except himself. He can also reverse the changes and make any changes positive or negative. he can make things consistent or inconsistent. This power is the master control of all changing powers. The user can even stop change as well.
pros: Change anything
Neutralize all changelings' powers
cons: Can't control things that change.
Unlike reality warping, the user can't change stuff from a planet to universal scale without...
... killing himself. It takes years of training.

name: Approvability
overview: be approved by everyone, even when you don't deserve it.
description: This ability allows people around the user to speak nothing but positive things about him. This also makes people approve on your action even when it is down right cruel or evil. This can allow you to do almost anything within your power.
pros: To be approved by all
All deeds will be accepted
cons: Limited range

name: The Watch Of Destiny
overview: control a being's fate.
description: The Watch of Destiny is a mystical object created by Father Time. If you obtain this you may see or control someone's age or fate. You can't lose this object because whoever possesses it will have it attached to their skin. The only ways to get rid of it is to die or cut your wrist off.
pros: Make it so a bully is two years old.
Make a supermodel make out with you.
Make your family discover a gold mine.
cons: It hurts a lot to get it removed.

name: Pyrokinesis
overview: start fires with your mind
description: A person with Pyrokinesis can ignite oxygen in the air, creating a fire sustained with willpower. These fires can be directed, manipulated, and generally had a lot of fun with.
pros: Revenge
Never need kerosene again
Win every fight
cons: Revenge
Still can be burned
Losing your temper can really have consequences

name: Freeze Time
overview: freeze time.
description: With this power, you can freeze time, except for yourself, for up to one hour.
pros: Freeze time.
Not be bothered by anyone.
Get places fast (but not to you).
cons: You can't drive anywhere.
Nothing will work. E.g. Your pages won't turn or the computer won't turn on.
It is only for an hour.

name: Castling
overview: teleport and exchange locations with another individual
description: Castling is a form of teleportation where you exchange your location with someone else's. You switch places. It gets its name from the Chess move where the Rook and King simultaneously - The King moves into a safer location, and the Rook moves into a more dangerous area where it can either defend the king or take a more active, aggressive role.
pros: If you are in danger, exchange places with your foe
If ally is in danger, exchange places with them to protect them
cons: Make sure you know where you are teleporting into or else there can be trouble
May exchange locations and one or both of you may not be able to deal with the new problems

name: Glossa
overview: speak any language without having to learn it.
description: Speak any language without having to learn it. For instance if you wanted to travel to France but can't speak it, with this power you'll be unstoppable.
pros: You can vist those places you've always wanted to go.
You'd get an A+ in Spanish, French, Chinese or whatever your taking.
Don't need years of training!
cons: You can't turn it off

name: Mind Creation
overview: create any weapon using your mind and hand motions.
description: When you're walking and someone is going to shoot you, you can create a shield of any kind and deflect it, or you can summon something else.
pros: It's easy to pull out a weapon without any struggles.
You can be prepared for any battle.
they can't steal your weapon.
cons: Your hands will get tired.
When shocked you won't think straight.
You won't know what will be the right weapon.

name: Magic Symbols
overview: use magical symbols to obtain other powers
description: Sorcery is the art of using magical symbols to gain control of other supernatural powers. This ability gives you knowledge of those same symbols. All you would have to do would be draw the symbol somewhere and then focus your energy on it. The symbol will then glow and give you the power the symbol represents. Depending on how much of your energy you direct at the symbol the longer your power will last.
pros: You know hundreds of magical symbols and what they represent
The symbols can be drawn anywhere. The floor, a piece of paper, your iPod, the wall, etc.
cons: While you are very powerful you can't do everything

name: Speed
overview: move at high speeds capable of passing through the barrier of light.
description: Speed will allow the user to run on water as his quick footwork avoids breaking apart the water's surface tension; run up walls before gravity takes its toll; vibrate molecules so fast that light fails to reflect them off, rendering him invisible. Further vibrations will allow your molecules to vibrate in their fixed positions above the speed of sound, allowing the body to move faster than Mach 4. Pushing the limits even further will cause the body to move at light speed, perhaps faster.
pros: Running around the world 7 times in a sec (light speed) to deliver a matter-shattering punch.
Enjoy the wind and freedom of speed.
Quick reactions to dodge allowing yourself no harm.
cons: Need to train the perception of speed to avoid splattering innocent bystanders
Requires high stamina to run long distances.
Try not to trip. XD
tags: Speed Jet Sonic Burst Pistol Gattling Gun

name: Distance Manipulation
overview: change the distances between any 2 points at will without creating perceptions of change
description: A person with this ability can manipulate the distances between any 2 points at will. However, space does not look warped at all. The only indication that change has been made is when people realize that they are going nowhere. I.e. if they try to move, they still feel like they are moving, until they realize that they only moved a few inches or not at all. The user can use this to "teleport" by shortening the distance between 2 points, allowing them to go miles with just a step.
pros: Similar to teleportation--literally walk miles with 1 step--watch out for walls though
"Stop Bullets" They are still moving but it looks like it is stopped in place
Create an area of infinite(near infinite) distance to trap people
cons: No spacial sense comes with it--you see exactly what other people see when you make changes
Does not grant superspeed--no matter what it looks like
Time and gravity flows normally in distorted space--could be a good or bad thing

name: Nature Hero
overview: evolve living creatures, tame them, and mimic their abilities.
description: When activated, you have access to every living species of animal on Earth. You can also draw strength from them and aquire their abilities. Since you are the Nature Hero, they obey your every command and operate on a "hive mind", meaning you can control an entire army of these beasties.
pros: Evolve a whale to an ocean fortress.
Mimic a tiger, bat, chameleon, wolf, and become a super predator.
See through the eyes of a hawk.
cons: You are only capable of mimicking four different animals at one time.
Operating a "hive mind" could be frustrating.

name: Overpower
overview: manipulate subatomic particles
description: Control Gravitation, Nuclear forces & Electromagnetism. You could manipulate every item in the known universe. Well, everything you can see at least. You sense, control & alter subatomic particles. Change the properties of matter. Convert energy into gravity or vice versa. Change ice to flame in a blink of an eye. If you are brave, you could even create subatomic particles. All this power will have dire consequences, like everyone thinking you are a god.
pros: Strip energy, gravity, matter, nuclear forces down to subatomic levels & change them into any form
See everything at a subatomic level, invisibility, diguises & shape-shifters cannot fool you
Separating subatomic particles will produce unlimited raw energy which, of course, you control
cons: You can not change yourself. You must physical see the object you are affecting.
Complex organisms (like humans) tend to die if shape-shifted incorrectly, you cannot create life
Creating new particles makes you feel like you are being ripped apart & burning alive simultaneously

name: Ultraviolet Pyrokinesis
overview: create and control flames that can only be seen in the ultraviolet spectrum
description: A person with this power can wield flames that can only be seen in the ultraviolet spectrum. This means that the flame is practically invisible except for the hint of distorted air currents. The flames are so hot and powerful that they can cause most things to sublime instead of melt. The user is aware of the location of their own flames and with practice can focus their flame so that it needn't be so destructive. The flame is fueled by user willpower as opposed to O2 and does not harm the user.
pros: Practically invisible to the naked eye except for distorted air patterns
Can sublime substances instantly---turn to gas
The user has required secondary powers
cons: Its very dangerous to use
Can't use it to light torches----it will burn it out

name: Time Travel
overview: move forward and backward in time
description: A Time Traveler doesn't need a DeLorean or special chair to navigate the timeline. The only thing they require is a bit of focus to travel through time. They have less restrictions on their power than a Space-Time Manipulator; time travel takes less out of them, they can interact with their past and future selves, and they can even influence present events by messing with the past. However, they cannot teleport.
pros: Requires moderate focus
Can interact with past and future selves
Can influence present events by going into the past
cons: Cannot teleport
Fighting your future self
May change future for worse

name: Body Supremacy
overview: have total awareness, familiarity and control of all the motions made by your body
description: Also called Body Mastery or Free Motion, this ability allows you a freedom of movement that is uninhibited by an unawareness of what your body can do. As such, you can use your body in various ways that would normally require practice first. Effortlessly do back flips, handstands, cartwheels, various fight moves, go from a supine position to upright in one move, and many other athletic feats. In addition, your motions cannot be dominated or otherwise controlled by anyone except you.
pros: Totally aware and familiar with every move you make (swim speed equals land speed, etc. )
Move by the most efficient means; get the most out of every move you make (conserve stamina)
Foes cannot take control of your motions by any means other than pure brute physical force
cons: Control of the body doesn't mean Shapeshifting, Rapid Regeneration or Longevity/Immortality
Resisting bodily domination isn't same as Immutability (can still be altered, etc. )
Resisting bodily domination isn't same as Psychic Immunity (mind can still be read)

name: Power Of The Hercules Beetle
overview: lift up objects 850 times than your body weight as well as fly
description: The user is able to lift up objects 850 times heavier that the user's body weight. For example, if your body weight is 60kg , you can lift up objects as heavy as 19,000 kg. This power also grants the user the ability to fly.
pros: Super Human Strength
Has the ability to fly
Can go head to head with powerhouses
cons: None so far has been observed

name: Shadow Kinetics
overview: indirectly vampirize the potential energy of any solid thing to boost the user's speed and agility.
description: The user can use anything solid to get potiental energy: rocks, objects, people. It only works if they stand still enough. Once the energy is absorbed, the user gains more kinetic energy which boosts their speed and agility. The reason why I called it "Shadow Kinetic" is because not only the victim of this ability can't move because there isn't enough potiential energy to turn into kinetic energy, but when they see the user moves, it'd be like they were a living shadow because they can't move.
pros: Boost speed and agility.
Immobilizes opponents.
cons: Works only when the solid isn't moving.

name: Earth Bender
overview: become a Earth bender from the Avatar the Last Air bender animated television series
description: (Earth is the element of substance) you can manipulate the earth. The source of your power  Is the earth. Water is your weakness. When you master earth bending you can metal bend.
pros: You can sand bend
You can metal bend at higher levels
You can earth bend
cons: You have a deep hatred and mistrust against fire benders
You like to eat bugs
You have a deep desire to kill fire benders

name: Digital Duplication
overview: scan an object, then perfectly duplicate it in reality.
description: Your eyes scan any object whether they are physical or a mere representation. You are then able to duplicate the item perfectly from material around them.
pros: Near endless possibilities
Able to adapt to certain situations
cons: Useless in pitch black situations
Material used must be of exact mass

name: Power Adaptation
overview: get a random power to help you in the specific moment
description: If you get thrown from a building, you are probably thinking ''oh crap'' right? Nope! With this power you'll probably get the power to fly or wall crawl or teleport to save yourself. If a car is falling on you, you'll probably get superstrength or time stop of superspeed to get out of the way.
pros: The powers you use in the moment you keep
They might be really good powers
cons: You only get to keep five powers so once you get power #5 you stop adapting

name: Precognitive Reflexes
overview: have one's reflexes facilitated through a subconscious perception of the future
description: With this ability, your mind is constantly in-tune to the forces of fate. As such, your body warns you of future events without being distracted by those pesky visions. In other words, if you need to do a certain movement (within your physical capability) in order to avoid danger, or otherwise help you out, then it will be done. This ability makes combat a breeze, because you don't even have to consciously think about it; your subconscious reflexes will kick in to do all the work for you.
pros: Your subconscious always perceives the immediate future, often bestowing Superhuman Reflexes
Once you develop your power, it can be used for more than just combat (tests, sports, etc. )
This is just as effective against probability manipulation as Unpredictability
cons: If you can't control it, may make social situations awkward or annoying
The strongest sense manipulators can distort the subconscious perception
If you decide to override your subconscious perception, may lead to disastrous conscequences

name: Psychic Static Telepathy
overview: control brainwaves to read the minds and memories of others
description: This is an extremely rare form of telepathy. A person can augment the electricity in other people's brains, thus creating 'psychic static', which thus augments their thoughts and memories. Psychic static is similar to ordinary static electricity, but is much stronger. Strenuous use of this form of telepathy can result in feedback, much like a microphone next to a speaker. This power is highly versatile in that a person can create illusions that distort other's physical and mental perceptions.
pros: One of the strongest forms of telepathy known to exist
Psychic static can augment received thoughts from others
They cannot feel the energy, and won't know you are looking into their mind
cons: This power is difficult to control at first
This power can cause migraines and/or nosebleeds if not consciously controlled
Trying to read other psychics is near impossible due to the nature of this ability

name: Technologically Endowed
overview: completely control and be with one with technology
description: You will completely understand everything that is remotely technology. You will also have a sense of feelings for it, and it will all be under your control. When your human body dies, you'll still be alive in everything that's electronical, so you'll never die. In our world, where technology is becoming more and more like us, adaptive and a force to be reckoned with,... I give you this.
pros: Control all technology and electrical machines and devices
Understand everything about it
Have knowledge of anything that is stored in a memory device or anything thats considered technology
cons: Might lose respect for life
You know almost everything in the world, now what?

name: Sinister Luck
overview: drain the luck from others to increase your own.
description: With this power, you can make yourself unnaturally lucky by stealing the luck from others. However, the luck that you drain from others will only last for 24 hours, so once your luck is back to normal, find someone nearby and suck out all of their luck.
pros: Win the lottery
Every gamble will work in your favor
Drain the luck from others like a parasite
cons: Without their luck, people will fall into despair
Bad things will happen to them more often
Casinos may accuse you of cheating

name: Supreme Fire Elementalist
overview: have supreme powers of Fire and extreme heat.
description:
You have control of anything hot and burning. From magma to lightning. You can manipulate fire, or you can generate fire from your own body. You can mold magma with your bear hands you can walk over magma with your bear feet. You also can turn your body into a mass made of Magma. You can redirect lightning, as well as become a body of lightning. 
you can breath fire, as well as throwing fire.
pros: Fire cannot burn you
You can control it
(If your powerful enough) you can master lightning
cons: It takes a while to master lightning
Objects and people around you are more likely to get burned
You have to have super reflexes in order to redirect lightning

name: Heat Manipulation
overview: manipulate heat.
description: Heat is one of the main forms of energy. This power allows you to manipulate it in almost any way you can think of, giving you tremendous power. You can shoot blasts or waves of pure heat. You can will heat into shapes or weapons  You could even freeze something by removing the heat from it. Naturally, you are also immune to the effects of heat, so you can never be burned again.
pros: You can completely control heat
You can create shapes and weapons out of heat
You can't be hurt by heat
cons: Heat shapes wont be totally soild
There is such a thing as too warm

name: Purpose Inducement
overview: create or change a purpose or function of person, object, or ability .
description: This ability allows the user to give a purpose to something or change its pervious purpose to something that fit the user or other's needs. This is done by warping the reality of that thing without changing much of it's physical existence.  For example, changing the purpose of a venus flytrap from catching insects into store energy. Another example would be to giving a person the purpose of being your minion. This effect only last for several hours or more.
pros: Give something a specific purpose no matter how strange it is.
Change the purpose of something
Affects powers
cons: Only last for a short while
Cannot change their physical appearance.

name: Bio Finite Control
overview: manipulate the biological aspects of oneself.
description: You can manipulate biological aspects of yourself e.g. manipulate biological clock (your age), control your mass and size, so you can control the amount of space you occupy by affecting your size. Electrical resistance etc. can also be controlled (the amount of current passing through your body if ever struck by lightning). This is a defensive power.
pros: Potential to live forever.
Can control all finite elements of one's own body.
cons: Can not affect others, it is a self-casting ability.
The uses of this ability are not limitless.
Can not time travel, teleport, conduct electricity e.g.

name: Water Control
overview: control all forms of water, i.e. mist, fog, ice, steam, etc.
description: You can control water sources and alter the physical state between its phases. You can bring it from air, ground, trees, plant and obvious areas. It can be used to walk on water, travel underwater, grab objects and control people.
pros: You control an element
Looks really cool if you have control
cons: Lack of water in area
Lack of control of larger attack

name: Primalism (Primal Lord)
overview: control and manipulate both the essence of life and evolution itself
description: This infinite ancient power has existed since the very beginning of life and time itself. No one, not even Gods knows where this unimaginable force came from. It is rumored to be the power core of the cosmic balance called 'The Balance of Creation'. Becoming a Primal-Lord. One who is bestowed with this great power can create new life in the universe, revive anyone who is dead and start off any species evolution. With this power, he/she is considered to have God status.
pros: Able to create any new life and give life to those that are deceased
Start off any species evolution
You'll be the deity of Life (also known as a Primal-Lord). So, you'll be very, very, very powerful.
cons: Causes great cosmic calamity to creation itself if the user is too power crazy of being like a God
Reviving those who are evil (like Hitler) or a species that died out naturally (like the dinosaurs)
If you change the natural laws of life for the wrong reason, you'll be stripped off of this power

name: Plasma Generation
overview: generate and manipulate plasma
description: You can generate plasma bolts, like in The Sorcerer's Apprentice, and other things with plasma. You can create a plasma, like electricity to power your house, create plasma shields to protect you from any kind of attack, etc. The uses are only limited by your imagination.
pros: Don't need to pay your electricity bills
Great for self-defense
Powerful ability
cons: Dangerous if you're a supervillain

name: Omnilingual Translator
overview: translate any language in the known universe
description: The user is able to translate any language in the known universe, no matter how obscure or ancient the language is. The user is able translate any language, however when the text is removed from the user, he has no recollection or any knowledge about the language he or she just translated. In a nutshell, the user cannot save the language and only can translate it.
pros: Good for archeologist on Earth
Good at determining alien languages
cons: Not combat oriented

name: Auto Dodge
overview: dodge anything and everything that can threaten you
description: This ability lets you dodge everything that is in motion towards you. For example, bullets and punches can be dodged. This ability is automatic so you must dodge no matter what. Even if you try really hard you must dodge. No one can ambush you since even if you don't see an object your body will dodge it subconsciously. This ability also means that you mostly can't be touched so you won't be able to hug anyone. This ability is active even when asleep.
pros: Can even dodge bullets and perform superhuman feats in order to dodge
No one can ambush you
Can also learn how to counter at the same time as dodging
cons: Can't be touched-You automatically dodge hugs and high fives
Your muscles still get tired if you dodge continuously

name: Solar Electrical Generation
overview: generate electricity while in sunlight.
description: With this ability, the user's skin generates electricity when exposed to the sun, effectively becoming a solar panel. One can use this energy with energy-based powers, fire it at people or simply charge electronics. The more sunlight they are exposed to, the stronger their ability. The more experienced the user becomes and the stronger their ability is, the better the conversion rate.
pros: Electrokinesis when in sunlight.
Go for a walk in the sun and charge your electronics.
Charge other powers.
cons: Only works when in the sun.
May not generate much power in cold climates.
Could be dangerous if you have not yet learned to control it.

name: Fly
overview: fly. (no arm flapping required)
description: The ability to fly, thats pretty much it.
pros: No need for a car or a plane.
cons: Airplanes
Hitchhikers
tags: now you don't need your dreams for this

name: Reactive Adaptation
overview: become immune to whatever you are exposed to
description: Reactive Adaptation allows the person using this power to "react" to their environment or other factors relativly quickly. In the same way that insects become immune to a pesticide over several generations, the user of Reactive Adaptation becomes immune to whatever they are exposed to. For example, if burned multiple times, the person may become fireproof...or they may develop the ability to expel water to put out the fire
pros: Hard to be hurt the same way more than a few times
Can easily develop superhuman atributes by need
cons: If killed, the power is useless

name: Molecule Manipulation
overview: control molecules and atoms
description: You can make things out of thin air. For example, to imprison anyone in a cage, etc. You can control molecules and atoms, meaning you can turn metal into gold, water to petroleum, carbon dioxide to oxygen, speed up and slow down their vibrations and anything you can think of.
pros: Make things out of thin air
Turn water to ice
Deadly
cons: Powered by emotion and concentration (mostly emotion)
Can't control energy particles

name: Energy Transfer
overview: transfer energy from one thing to another
description: This is a simple, complex, and powerful ability. It allows you to transfer energy of any kind to anything else. For example, if you had a lit candle and a ball. You could transfer the energy from the flame to the ball, causing it to burst into flames or move(you can also change the type of energy). Or you could use the energy to promote change around you. If you could generate enough energy, you could create a powerful storm, send yourself through time, or even create new life-forms.
pros: Very powerful and has almost limitless uses
Can do almost anything if you have the energy
Can heal yourself and others with the energy around you.
cons: The bigger the transfer of energy, the harder it is.
Can only do as much as the amount of energy you have allows

name: Nosokinesis
overview: manipulate disease-inducing pathogen (bacteria, viruses, etc. )
description: One with this ability can psychically control microscopic pathogens of any kind. This means the user can generate any kind of bacteria or virus at will, alter their numbers, their potency and their speed of production. The user can also intensify/suppress illness (in self and others) or intensify/suppress their symptoms. At the higher levels, one can even turn one kind of pathogen into another, make new ones, change how they are spread (airborne, contagious, etc) or kill them at will.
pros: Generate and manipulate any kind of microscopic pathogen (virus, bacteria, rogue protein, etc. )
Become immune to them (and have the ability to kill them at will)
Change their properties for one's own purposes
cons: Disease Immunity
Disease Absorption
At the lower levels, you'd better stick with lesser illnesses (no immunity)

name: Conduit
overview: channel energies or powers directed at you
description: When energies of other superpowers are directed at you, your body becomes a conduit for these powers. They pass through you and out again in your chosen direction. As certain powers pass through you, they may energise you. Users with high willpower are able to keep the power contained in themselfs for a short period of time instead of having to release them imediatly. (note: you do not keep the power only redirect it)
pros: Deflect energy blasts, elemental attacks and other powers back at their users
Immune to many powers
Channel energies such as electricty or magnetism if you can find a constant source
cons: Does not work on all superpowers (physical attacks for instance)

name: Superhuman Speed
overview: move at above-human speeds
description: Superhuman speedsters can run at speeds of up to Mach 1 for extended periods. Their thinking processes, hand movements, eye motion, and reaction times are similarily faster. These energies are fueled by either massive amounts of food or an absorption state during sleep.
pros: Never be late
Have fun in dodgeball
Thievery
cons: Need to eat all the time
Normal life seems slow
May be kidnapped by FBI and studied

name: Destiny Alteration
overview: change destiny
description: The person with this power can change the future. At any given time you can activate the power, see the future and change it however you like. You start off by being able to change small events or affect a few people, but with training, you could change global or even universal events.
pros: Can change any event.
Can stop some one from being destined to die.
cons: Takes up lots of strength to change events on a grand scale.
You might make the world worse, but usually, if you are careful, it'll turn out okay

name: Substance Transmutation
overview: change an article from one substance to another.
description: This ability allows you to change the substance material of anything you come in contact with. You could turn air into laughing gas, lead into glass, or water into soda. Imagine making gold nuggets out of gravel, or vanilla ice cream out of snow. You can turn foes into iron statues, mud into gasoline, carbon dioxide into helium, or ice into plutonium. The possibilities are endless!
pros: You can generate a lot of valuable material.
You would never run out of food.
cons: The object you transmute will still have the same size and shape as it did before.
The object you transmute will still be the same temperature it was before.

name: The Gambler
overview: win any agreed upon bet
description:
With this ability you can win any bet no matter how ridiculous as long as you can get someone to agree to bet you. For example if you bet someone that you can lift 500lbs, you can. But if they do not agree on the bet you are out of luck. 
Note that bets should be carefully worded as techicalities still count and the outcome is not always what you hope for
pros: Never lose a bet
Can igrnore laws of physics to win bets
As long a some one agrees to bet you, you can do anything
cons: You must have someone to accept the bet to suceed
Bets work to the letter, eg 'A bullet cannot kill me ' means that you could still be gravely injured
Winning the bet does not force the other party to pay up, they may try to stiff you

name: Awakened Mage
overview: cast your own personalized spells
description: After having your magic power awakened, you can cast spells personalized to you from your spellbook. The spellbook describes each spell in detail. As your magic power grows, so does the spellbook and the number of spells you cast. Which spells you get are determined by how you use the spells you already have.
pros: Can cast a wide range of spells
Spells are custom to your personality and habits
cons: Can't choose what spells you get

name: Reflexive Precognition
overview: see moments in time before they happen
description: A person with this power can see a moment in time or action before it actually happens, giving them more time to react, making it appear as if they have amazingly quick reflexes.
pros: Amaze people with your reaction time.
Never make a wrong move.
Never be caught off guard.
cons: You aren't surprised by anything anymore.

name: Mending
overview: repair and fix damaged inorganic matter, at will
description: Also called Reconstruction/Rebuilding/Repair or the Fix-It Effect, this is the psychic ability to fix broken/damaged inanimate objects, by touch, word, thought or gesture. One with this ability can fix bent/scratched/dented/warped/melted items back to perfect working condition, at will. In addition, one can undo cracking damage, or cause broken parts to pull back together. One can also undo water, burning or acid damage, at will. One can even repair complex systems (ie electronic devices).
pros: Repair any bent/dented/scratched/warped/melted item, at will (even uncrumples paper, ie dollars)
Repair cracked items; if broken, item's pieces can rejoin, or each piece regenerate a new copy
Undo water/fire/acid damage; replair complex systems like electronics
cons: Put other mechanics and repairmen out of business (awful for the economy)
Does not affect living/organic matter (to use on plant matter, must be processed wood/paper) (NCN)
Erases electronic information stored in the broken part, unless accompanied by Technopathy (NCN)

name: Power Ring Summon
overview: summon any color power ring
description: With this power you can summon any color power ring featured in DC comics (green, blue, indigo, orange, red, white, black, yellow, pink/violet) and use them to fight (or commit) crime. They work the same way they would in the comics. Once you summon them you cannot send them back and are forced to keep them.
pros: You can summon any power ring from DC comics
They can do anything they can do in the comics
cons: You cannot send them back once you summon them

name: Aura Claws
overview: create claws around one's hands or emitted from the tips of one's fingernails
description: The claws have a color that is the same as your aura because they are formed from your aura. The are sharper than the sharpest katana ever and will ignore the skin during attacks to deal internal damage to your enemies body.
pros: It's really hard for anyone to determine the extent of the damage that you have dealt.
Your enemy has to cut themself open in order to determine how much damage you've done.
cons: The claws can be blocked by anything that has been created from an aura.

name: The Ice Dragon
overview: shift into a powerful 'ice dragon' form with power over fire, ice, and water
description: The user has the power to transform at will into a huge ice blue dragon that can control ice, water, and high temperature blue fire at will, and also use these powers to heal both oneself and others, regardless of their ailment or injury. The user can also live forever if they desire. They also have extremely powerful telepathic and telekinetic abilities.
pros: Can control ice, water, and blue fire at will, and also be granted immunity to any lethal force
Can control every aspect of the human mind with their telepathy
Can move and control objects with their mind via telekinetic 'vectors', and also fly in human form
cons: The three elemental powers(ice, fire, and water) are all hard to manifest and control at first
Can be lethal to other people when used offensively
Healing of either oneself or others is slow to work at first

name: Earth Empathy
overview: draw power from standing on the ground
description: Like a tree with water, an Earth Empath sucks up raw energy from the planet's core. While standing on dirt, they can bench press 70 tons; on asphalt or something man-made, 30 tons; while wearing shoes, 10. They are also mildly invulnerable while exercising their power. However, prolonged seperation from the planet can kill them and soil pollution has an adverse affect on them.
pros: While standing barefoot on dirt, can bench 70 tons
Mildly invulnerable while standing on the ground
Become unmovable just by taking a strong stance
cons: Less strength/invulnerability while in the city, wearing shoes, etc.
Soil pollution has a physical affect on you
Prolonged seperation from the planet can kill you

name: Time Dilation
overview: make time go slower relative to the user
description: While the user is unable to stop time, they can make time go slower for themselves. When activated, everything else moves very, very slowly compared to the user. In effect, other people think you are moving at high speeds. You also avoid most problems of super speed, such as friction. You can move things in slowed time, but things you touch will react with the relative speed in real time. You can also make other people faster with this power if so desired.
pros: Great for daily life-do things at a leisurely pace
The next best thing to time stop
Make attacks too slow to matter
cons: The user cannot dilate time to get more sleep
The power only works on yourself and things you touch, but does not work on machines
If you get stabbed from behind while using this power, your death will be slow and painful

name: Transference
overview: transfer human neccesities to oneself and others
description: The wielder can transfer stamina, energy, strength and health to themselves or allies by draining it from opponents. This can physically wear out the opponent if a transference is made.
pros: Transfer peoples stamina, health, energy and strength to the wielder or allies
Transfer fatigue, wounds and damage to other people
Strong combatant at close range
cons: The transference can only take place through touch
The wielder can only transfer one thing at a time
Weak against long-ranged attacks

name: Aptitude Intensification
overview: increase all of ones innate or acquired skills and aspects.
description: The bearer of this power has all of their innate,natural, and acquired skills increased to inhuman levels. They are automatically gifted in all range of skills they possessed beforehand and will be able to do anything they had practiced perfectly and effortlessly. In addition ALL of ones natural aspects(Strength, sight, speed, etc) related to the bearers specific skills will be increased as well. When developed the user needs only to learn the basics of a skill and instantly become good at it.
pros: It requires relativity little effort to  learn and master new skills.
Most people have some skill in most anything, even simple things can lead to aspect enhancement.
Any skills will have their related aspects enhanced as well.
cons: Before your skills are increased you must actually HAVE skills to speak of. NCN
Those with one-upmanship abilities can still trump you.
Useless if one possesses no useful skills.

name: Mnemonic Reality Bending
overview: manipulate time based on your memories and your dreams
description: If you have memories of good times gone, this power lets you go back, and relive them, or you can switch time so the event is yet to come. You can also bend reality to make your wildest and best dreams come true!
pros: Relive good times in your past
Make impossible things that you want to experience, happen
This power is only limited to your imagination!
cons: If you're not creative, this power can be weakened
Sometimes it goes dormant if you can't remember good things that happened
This power is useless if you aren't the creative type

name: Cosmic String Manipulation
overview: bend reality by tugging on 'cosmic strings'
description: After getting this power, you can see the cosmic strings that form reality floating around everywhere.
