You cab change anything you want just by grabbing whatever the string is connected to and tugging it how you want it to be. However, you can only affect solid objects and liquids, and you have to be close enough to something to grab the string in order to affect it, and close enough to see it in order to pick something out in specific AND change it.
pros: Can make the world be the way you want it.
Travel through time, space, and dimension. Transmute junk into anything you want.
Shapeshift into your ideal form, and mess with your own string to give yourself other powers.
cons: Need to be close to the object; liquids are hard to manipulate and gasses are almost impossible.
While you will automatically get some proficiency with this, you can still mess things up.
Since you can not affect pure air, you need to make time/space/dimensional portals on a surface.

name: Shadow Portals
overview: not be seen when in shadows and to teleport to other shadows.
description: You can disappear into a shadow and move from one shadow to another while remaining unseen.
pros: No limit to how long you can use it
Can go from place to place as long as a shadow is there
cons: People will know that you're gone
Drains your energy

name: Object Summoning
overview: make an object appear by saying its name
description: You can make any object appear anywhere by saying a noun. Proper nouns are not allowed. As an example you could say "desk" and cause it to fall on your enemy. You could also say "fire" and set your enemy ablaze. Adjectives are allowed; for instance, "flaming desk". However, the object has to come from somewhere so it has to exist, and it also takes that object away from its owner. Also, anytime you say a noun without concentrating, it appears at a random location near you.
pros: Very low effort ability
Easy to use
Can also be used for teleportation
cons: Difficult to speak normally
Restricted to the boundaries of reality
Not allowed to summon Jessica Alba (hahahahahah)

name: Motion Termination
overview: cause objects or people that are in motion to cease moving
description: A person with motion termination is able to cause anything that is in motion to completely stop moving. For example if a ball is thrown and this power is used to stop the ball, it will freeze in mid air. Having the power is like having access to an on/off switch. The object remains stopped until the user decides to allow it to move again. More advanced users would be able stop every object or person within a certain area without having to think of every individual thing in that space.
pros: Stop harmful projectiles in mid air
Stop anything, including people, from moving
Can be used to kill people by stopping their hearts
cons: If you forget that you stopped something, it will remain stopped until you remember to allow movemnt

name: The Shadow Dragon
overview: have all the powers over shadows and darkness
description: A person can control physical darkness and shadows, but this power is not at all evil. The person simply uses their mind to control it, and can become a powerful Shadow Dragon, similar in appearance to a Night Fury, with powers over a black fire that only they, or whom they choose, is immune to, and they can also use the fire to fully heal themselves or others. They can use the black fire in human form, are immortal, and have invisibility just like Peter Petrelli, but it blocks sound and heat.
pros: The powers of the Shadow Dragon can be used in human form, and are augmented by moonlight
You have extremely powerful 'black pyrokinesis', regeneration, invisibility, and vector telekinesis
They can easily overpower even the strongest light, manmade or natural, except for the sun
cons: The sun is the only source they are powerless against
The shifting of human to dragon, and use of the powers, only works at night
Prolonged exposure to light stronger than the moon, if using the powers, weakens the user

name: Fate Change
overview: change the fate of you or others around you
description: Gives you the ability to see into the future ten days. Once you know what will happen to you or someone else, you can choose to change it. Ex: If you see you will die in the future, you can change that event. This power cannot be stolen. You would either see the event of the power getting stolen taking place and change it. If someone goes back in time, it cannot be stolen in the past, unless they are in a time period where you exist and had not changed that time even earlier in the past.
pros: Can live forever if you change your future so that you do not age, every ten days
Cannot be stolen.
Can make sure your enemy will die.
cons: Must change your time in advance. If you are already dead, it is to late.
Would make an unstoppable villan.
Can be replicated

name: Psychometric Telekinesis
overview: move things with your mind that you have seen or have used
description: With this power, a person can telekinetically control objects that they have previously seen or used, whether recently or in the distant past. It also works if the person relies on either their memory, or psychometry itself, to recognize an object. A secondary aspect of this ability is called telekinetic breakdown, where either one touch, or intense concentration without physical contact, can either partially or completely separate an object into it's individual parts(such as a handgun).
pros: One of the strongest forms of telekinesis known
People with telepathy or intuitive aptitude can learn to control this ability much faster
Is extremely versatile once the person learns to control it
cons: Confused or forgotten memories of objects you try to control will weaken this power
Memories of an object can be no older than one month

name: Mind Projection
overview: project yourself into another's mind and alter their decisions or choices without their awareness
description: You would be capable of projecting an astral version of yourself into another's mind. This ability would allow you to change and alter your opponent's choices and to explore their inner thoughts.
pros: Control another's mind
Explore to find your opponent's weaknesses
To be able to make others believe your every word
cons: Useless info
Family and friends might not trust you
You could possible become a control freak about everything around you

name: Conscience Manipulation
overview: manipulate another persons conscience.
description:
Right through history the several psychopathic killers have murdered, raped and hurt without guilt, without anything holding them back. Until now. 

Having this ability means a psychopath's mind can be altered in such a way that he/she is GIVEN a conscience. Furthermore the amount of guilt someone feels when doing a certain action can also be manipulated. Even a person's ethics can be given a healthy boost by making alterations or additions to his or her conscience.
pros: Guilt can be altered as to cause extreme psychological discomfort when performing certain actions
Even psychopaths now have chances to live normal lives.
cons: Your own conscience cannot be changed.
Short term alterations are temporary but do not cause any damage to your own conscience.
Changing a conscience forever chips away at your own and the lost piece cannot be recovered.

name: Perspective Manipulation
overview: manipulate the perspective of objects
description: Anything you see, no matter how near or far, you may pick up and place it anywhere else in view. To you, it will always be the size it looks when you viewed it from where you are standing, but in reality the further away you place it, the bigger it will become. Move closer to it to see its true size. Want to make a pencil massive? Pick it up and place it in the distance. Want to shrink a tree? Pick it up and move it closer to you.
pros: Can grow or shrink anything in view.
Can pick up anything from a distance.
cons: Only works on things in view.
May be hard to restore something to its original size.

name: Information Absorption
overview: absorb information from CDs, books, etc.
description: Everything is written down somewhere. An Information Absorber knows this for sure. By merely staring at a CD, encyclopedia, video cassette, or even a carved stone slab, they can memorize the information on it. This memory fades 100 times slower than a regular memory. Some users have allowed themselves to become overloaded, mostly by trying to absorb the Internet.
pros: Only need to stare at its surface
Fades 100 times slower than usual memories
Very large storage capacity
cons: Need to look at its surface for as long as it takes
Memory will fade eventually
Not infinite; can be overloaded

name: God Of Inventing
overview: be the world's greatest scientist, engineer, inventor, mathematician and a master strategist
description: With this power you can make ALL kinds of objects and advanced in the invention, improvement to old technology. You can use advanced strategy on how would your invention can be used. You are the worlds greatest Inventor and scientist, engineer, strategist.
pros: You can make almost anything.
You can improve old technology.
You might get rich by selling your inventions.
cons: People want to use for themselves.
You're not a real god, you're still just a man.
You can still be killed.

name: Surgical Precision
overview: be extremely precise in completing any action
description: A person with this power has superb hand-eye coordination undeterred by fear or nervousness. In addition this power gives the user the ability to be calm when performing any operation. For example they can perform surgical operations with the utmost precision. In addition this power also works for any action taken. For example you can also learn to throw objects with the utmost precision and learn to play instruments with precision.
pros: Perform surgeries that are considered impossible
Works even when nervous or in state of fear
Applies toward any action you do.
cons: Doesn't give you medical knowledge

name: Geokinesis
overview: manipulate rocks, soil, and earth
description: Geokinetics can turn the ground they stand on into a weapon. They can mentally cause rocks to levitate, cause shockwave damage with a seismic stomp, and even know where the fault lines in an area are.
pros: Looks awesome
Can bring down a building in all of two seconds
Become the best constructor ever
cons: Useless against metals
Useless against processed earth, i.e. bricks
Useless if seperated from ground

name: Light Jump
overview: jump in a flash of light and appear in another area.
description: With this power when you jump your body turns into light and you appear in another location of your choosing that is in a straight line from the direction that you jumped. This power can be activated while in midair just by moving your feet. You must know where you are jumping to before you can change into light and you can not jump to a solid area, such as jumping inside a wall. There is a three second cool down for this power between jumps.
pros: Jump to any location as long as you know where it is.
You move at the speed of light.
You can jump again in mid air just by moving your feet.
cons: Only works in a straing line in direction you jumped.
You must know where you are jumping too.
Has a three second cool down.

name: Pick A Power
overview: change the power you have.
description: You simply think of a power and it's yours. But you can change it into any other power you want. And you can only have one at a time. There is no power you can't have. From shape-shifting to acid snot, super hearing to super speed, it's yours. You can even have fun making some up!
pros: You can have any power you want.
You can have any power you want.
You can... oh forget it.
cons: Nothing, and even if you can think of something bad, there is a power to fix it!

name: Metal Materialization
overview: make any metal out of thin air and twist it into shape
description: You can pull metal out of thin air and bend it. Your hands must be free to use this power.
pros: Don't need any in the environment
Metal can capture enemies without you moving
cons: Must use hands

name: Nature Wrath
overview: control all natural things like plants, winds, and etc.
description: You may be able to fly because you can make the winds maintain your weight (just like Storm). You can wrap enimies with vines plus you can wrap trees around yourself to make yourself a monster!
pros: Animals love you!
You can fly!
You can give your enimies poison ivy!
cons: Your weakness is fire and acid rain so you can't fight weather manipulators.
You are green when power in progress.
You have to practice to level up.

name: Reality Changing
overview: change what could happen into what you want to happen, which is something someone least expects.
description: The ability to make what you want to happen from what really should happen. For example, if a bookcase fell over, before it hit the floor you could make it reappear in the same spot with a wave of a hand. Other things you could do are make a light explosion and control others' powers. For example, if someone can phase through objects, you could get them stuck in the object they're phasing through.
pros: Control power
Can fix anything
cons: Can never unwarp what you have already warped

name: Ultimate Version Telekinesis
overview: move anything in the universe as long as you know where it is
description: With this power, you have telekinesis that can affect any part of the universe or all of the universe at once. The strength of the TK is equal to your own physical strength and is applied over the affected area.
pros: You have infinite range telekinesis
Your telekinesis lets you move things around the universe proportionally to your strength
If you concentrate on one point, your telekinesis strength is multiplied.
cons: You can only focus on one part to do things, affecting the whole universe cancels itself
Does not come with omniscience or remote viewing and you must consciously control it
When concentrating on one object, you cannot defend yourself because you are too focused

name: Energy Leech
overview: live forever and heal your own wounds with energy outside your body
description: You can live forever or heal your wounds with energy outside your body. You can take energy from organisms or other energies, like fire, light or wind. This should only be done in great need as taking energy from organisms, no matter how small the amount of energy taken, kills any organism you use it on instantly. Needs physical contact to work. It takes years of practice to touch people without killing them.
pros: Can live forever through energy transfusions
Can kill enemies with a single touch
Can heal yourself and others
cons: Needs physical contact to work
Kills instantly
Needs years of practice to be able to touch people

name: Enchanted Elements
overview: produce the 4 Enchanted Elements
description: The 4 Enchanted Elements are as follows: Watch-Fire, a fireball that will find a target and attempt to kill them; Dancing-Seas, a hypnotizing water that will entrance a target and drown them; Vile-Vines, living plants; Anger-Winds, which will paralyze a victim entirely.
pros: Dancing-Seas is a good way to kill somebody
Anger-Winds will paralyze the victim and they can't fight back
All 4 Enchanted Elements obey their master/summoner and will not attack anyone on your side
cons: Watch-Fire can miss a target
Dancing-Seas will not work on people who are immune to hypnosis
Vile-Vines can't catch someone with super speed

name: Dragon Heart
overview: gain powerful supernatural abilities/immortality through bestowal and possession of a dragon's heart
description: If you are hurt, in distress, or simply want a better life, you can call upon one star of your choosing. It will come to you as a mythical dragon, who then will give half of it's own heart to you. As long as the dragon lives, so will you. You can heal from any wound or illness in a matter of minutes to hours, have greater strength, agility, and stamina, and also be much wiser than most people. You and your dragon can communicate telepathically, and have a powerful empathic connection.
pros: The dragon will only aid people who are good
You can have a great friend and ally
You are immortal as long as the dragon lives, and vice versa
cons: If either one is hurt, the other will feel the pain just as much
You are only partially immortal
If you both die, you will merge and transform back into the star from which the dragon came

name: Photographic Power Mimicry
overview: mimic powers when you see them in action.
description: Once you see a power being used, you mimic that power even if you don't know that it is an actual power. After this, you will completely understand the power that you wield. You can hold limitless powers.
pros: You can mimic powers that you see in action. (Even powers you can't actually see like telepathy)
Gain limitless abilities.
Have complete control over the power.
cons: You have to SEE it in action. (Your vision has to be CLEAR)
You gain the abilities weaknesses if they're vital to the ability being used.
Complete control doesn't effect some abilities. (Intuitive Aptitude, etc. )

name: Mind Control Via Sight
overview: control the willpower of people when they are within your sight
description: The person with this power is able to control the will power of people while they are within the user's sight. You can control as many people as there is within your sight if you want to.
pros: Can control over a large group of people by just looking at them
cons: If you turn away, then your control over them is cut
If you are blinded, this power will be negated

name: Energetic Hands
overview: project psychic energy into the hands
description: The user can will their psychic energy into their hands. When energized, they can block psychic attacks by parrying them with their hands. Any physical attacks like punching will also harm the opponent's mind. Energetic hands display the color of the user's psychic aura when in use.
pros: Block or deflect psychic attacks
Injure the opponent's mind and body simultaneously
No actual energy loss from use of this power
cons: Still need to get close to opponent to punch them
Very obvious when in use
Can't block some types of attacks

name: Volatile Construct
overview: generate bombs and explosives
description: The user can create and launch bombs, explosives and other volatile constructs that have various yields, ranging from small explosions to near-nuclear blasts. These bombs may be composed of energy, element, biological matter, or simply normal bombs.
pros: Create explosives from energy, element or users body
Control the fuse time, or detonate at will
User may have Selective Invulnerability to explosions
cons: User may limited on how many they can produce at a time
May not be immune to the effects
Un-exploded bombs may have to be defused

name: Change Circles
overview: place circles on things that change one aspect of the world within them.
description: With this power you can form a two dimensional circle in your hands, expanding it to any size you wish, before placing it on any large enough surface. You then state your desired change, such as "everything within the circle turns to gold" or "gravity within the circle is multiplied 100X. " This becomes true within the circle, and applies to everything encompassed by it. To destroy a circle, the user must take part of it and break it, causing the effect to cease. Only the user can do this.
pros: Rewrite any one aspect of the world within your circles.
cons: The circles interperate things literally, so watch how you word your changes.
A circle can only be placed on a surface big enough to hold it.
Everything within the circle is effected by the change in a column extending forever.

name: Potion Creation
overview: brew potions.
description: This power allows you to brew potions with many effects. You don't have to be magical to make them, it's just that magic-users are more adept at it. You can get lots of ingredients and brew an awesome potion. They can have many effects! You can also make splash potions (throwable potions held in bottles of non-damaging glass). Potions could be in the form of stew, soup, jelly, pills, candy, or just a basic drink like most. It all depends on how you want to make it!
pros: Get a boost in power with a potion.
Your combat is affected very positively so you can fight better.
You can even make a potion which gets you better grades!
cons: Sometimes potions have negative effects.
If you brew it wrong, it could backfire badly.
Not all potion effects last forever...

name: Finite Power Manipulation
overview: create, induce, or infuse power that is "just enough" for any situation.
description: The user has a power that is capable of tipping the scales of most situations. The user can give anything a limited power that can be enough to fulfill a task. Since, it is finite, the probability of it failing are still possible. The user in a fight can boost their power to almost match the opponent, but it is up to the user that will decide the winner. The user can power machines enough to almost run the time that they need.
pros: Power boost
Change the course of any situation to a bit of your favor
Power up other things with limited power
cons: It is limited power
You have to think wisely to utilize its "full" potential

name: Jet Propulsion
overview: produce an aura that allows high-speed flight, like a living rocket
description: Also called Propulsion, Rocket Flight, Jet Flight or Jetting, this is the ability to propel oneself into flight with a psychic energy aura. One with this ability projects an aura of psionic heat and force across their body, with propulsion focused through the hands and/or feet. In addition, this aura also protects the user from heat damage, friction damage, and sight impairment at high speeds. In essence, the user becomes a living missile, because they can crash into things and emerge unharmed.
pros: Aura allows user to fly at high speeds, and to blast/burn foes in close combat
Aura protects user from friction, heat, sight impairment and impact in flight
When developed, user gains a sense that lets them home in on targets
cons: Launch time is delayed by a few seconds, until developed
Launch path can be difficult to control, until developed
If you use your power to crash into things, people might make you pay for the damage

name: Closed System Generation
overview: create a "closed system" field
description: A closed system prevents transfer of mass or energy across it. The user of this ability prevents any mass or energy from moving across a field that they generate. In addition, a person in a closed field is unaffected by all forces exerted from objects outside the system including gravity. Closed system cannot be moved even by its user and can only be turned off. Since you cannot exert action on the field, the field itself cannot exert any reaction so all energy that comes in contact disappears
pros: Can be used as a force field--technically it's an "anti-force" field
Can be shaped like anything--and looks like generating darkness
Absorbs all impacts without exerting forces back (the energy just disappears into another dimension)
cons: Does not create structures of energy or armor--it is just like a stationary area of nothingness
Airtight barrier, also blocks light, and cell phone reception (don't surround yourself with it)
Because of con 1 you cannot walk on it(you can however use it to break your fall)

name: Time Jumper (Lineage)
overview: travel through time by way of ancestors and descendants
description: You can travel though time by riding the minds of you ancestors and you descendants. You cannot directly control the people jump into but you can communicate with them and influence their thoughts to some degree.
pros: Traveling through time. Get to know your Family before and after your life.
Keep and eye your Children long after you die
Gaining information by convincing your Ancestors to help you maybe even complete unfinished busines
cons: Limited by genetic family members.
Some of the people you maybe go insane.
You cannot completely control anyone you visit.

name: Mystical Zodiac Gauntlet
overview: bestowed the powers of the Chinese Zodiacs when in possession of this gauntlet
description: The person with this gauntlet is able to harness the power of the Chinese Zodiac. There are 12 Chinese Zodiacs and the user get one Zodiac power bestowed on them every month. It will change to another power when the month ends and when the new months begin. Dragon (pyrokinesis), rabbit (superspeed),ox (super strength), rooster(flight),monkey(super reflexes), dog(invulnerability), snake(invisibility), rat(size-alteration), horse(healing),pig(unbreakable skin), tiger(tiger traits), sheep (phasing)
pros: Can take on powerhouses on some scenarios
Hard for enemies to adapt with powers keep changing every month
cons: The user can be depowered if the gauntlet is removed from him or her
The user does not know what power he or she receives every new month until he or she uses it

name: Symptoms Reader
overview: instantly diagnose someone based on their symptoms
description: With this power all you have to do is see a person's symptoms and you'll instantly be able to diagnose them. Accurately and everything. Take that doctors!
pros: You can diagnose people instantly and accurately
cons: Doctors will probably hate you
Not much use in physical combat

name: Aversion Field
overview: avoid being directly hit by anything
description: An invisible field constantly rotates around your body, preventing anything that is aimed directly at you from hitting you. Bullets will just miss you, punches and kicks will never land, etc.
pros: Never lose a fist fight
Enjoy bank robberies without the worries of gunshots
cons: Indirect attacks like bombs, light flashes, etc cannot be avoided

name: Psammokinesis
overview: manipulate sand
description: Sand is just a material composed of small finely divided rock. Psammokinesis allows you to control it. You could cause sandstorms, create beaches at lake-fronts or use sand to grab your opponents. Surf the desert like it's the sea, create a giant sand castle or simply keep the stuff out of your shoes. This ability has limitless applications.
pros: Can manipulate sand
cons: Can't control glass or larger rocks

name: Unlimited Ammunition
overview: have unlimited ammunition for any weapon one fires
description: Any cannon, bow, gun, slingshot, etc will have more ammunition replace the fired ammunition the instant the used ammunition is fired.
pros: You can just keep firing at will and never need to buy more ammunition.
Saving lots of money.
cons: Your superiors might wonder why you never need to get more ammunition.

name: Psychic Energy Construct
overview: create and control characters and objects made of energy
description: With this power, you can build or create any animated character or object under your psychic control.  Energy-robots, energy-pliers, energy-motorcycle, energy-Santa....whatever!   You're limited by your imagination and will power, but everything else is fair game!
pros: Anything or anyone you want!
Anything or anyone you want under your control!
Anything or anyone with any ability you want under your control!
cons: Your fatigue affects your constructs' abilities.
You can only create as many as you can keep under control.
Your will power is the only limit to the constructs' strength.

name: Picture Extraction
overview: pull any object from within a picture out into our reality.
description: For the ability to work, one must have a picture of any size with them. Proceed to use your free hand to touch the picture. Your free hand will "go into the picture's dimension" where you can pull the object out into our reality. Once the object is pulled out, the picture surface will turn blank and the object will appear and interact in our reality. One example is, if you wanted to pull out a hot and attractive woman from a picture, this ability will allow you to bring her out into our reality.
pros: Any object or person pulled out will retain its original features, dimensions, and attributes.
The user can use any command phrases such as "open sesame" to pull the object out.
cons: If the picture surface is destroyed, the object extracted will permanently remain in our reality.
The user can use any command phrases such as "close sesame" to return the object into the picture.

name: Healing  Mist
overview: produce a mist that heals all those within it
description: The mist will slowly heal all wounds, ailments, diseases, curses, etc of everyone inside the mist.
pros: Heal everyone with a ravaging killer disease, it can't gain immunity to this power.
Bad cut from a rusty knife? No matter! Just produce this mist and everything will be fine.
The holder of this power is essentially immune to all diseases.
cons: It's a slow, slow, slow heal.
The people who want to take advantage of someone with this power for their own gain.

name: Mythical Weapon Summon
overview: summon any weapons use in any mythology
description: With this power you can summon and use any weapon used in any mythology, from Excalibur to Poseidon's trident and anything in between. When you get the weapon, you automatically know how to use it and when you're done with the weapon, you can send it back to wherever it came from.
pros: You can summon any mythological weapon
You automatically know how to use the weapon when you get it
cons: If you take the weapon of a God they might come for it and destroy you

name: Drawing The Future
overview: control the future by drawing it
description: You can cause future events to happen by drawing or painting scenarios. You cannot control the events that lead to the drawn situation, or the consequences, unless you draw those too. Your drawings can't violate the laws of physics, unless they involve superpowers that can do so. Anybody controlled by drawings do not realise they are being controlled until it is pointed out to them, believing all events are natural.
pros: You can control minds and reality far away and even in the future
As long as you hide your drawings, you could even hide your power from all
You can control your life so it turns out how you want
cons: It is impossible to draw and control all the consequences of events you draw
Your power is slightly limited by your artistic ability. Greater detail ensures more control.
You cannot completely warp reality

name: Instantaneous Evolution
overview: instantly adapt or evolve to survive in a current environment
description: The user of this power is able to instantly adapt or evolve to survive in the current environment that he or she is in. This power cant be used at the user's will. This power only becomes active when the user is in danger. For example, if the user if in a burning room , the user will gain fire proof skin to protect him or her from the flames
pros: Can survive in any environment
Great defense
cons: Can't call up power unless in mortal danger

name: God's Algorithm
overview: know the optimal way to solve a problem
description: You immediately know the shortest possible way to solve a problem.   For example:  * You are given a scrambled Rubik's cube and you would know the minimal moves needed to solve it.  * Someone asks you directions, and you'll know the shortest path to the location.
pros: Know the shortest solution to any problem
Solve puzzles faster
cons: Puzzles rarely pose an entertaining challenge
The shorted solution to a problem isn't always the best solution

name: Lygokinesis
overview: produce and control raw energy
description: Lygokinesis is the power to produce an energy that is completely in your control. You can make it into anything you want from swords to robotic suits its up to the limits of your mind. The energy will appear similar to the type that the green lanturn makes but with two differences. One it is not hard light its your own energy. Two it dosen't have to be green it can be any color you want.
pros: Very useful power
Can be any color you want
Can be anything you want
cons: The energy dosen't have much detail

name: Memory Manipulation
overview: erase or enhance the memories of others.
description: With this ability, you can erase other people's memories from any given time span, like in Men In Black.  You can also enhance memories they have, such as childhood memories or things they can't remember, and create false memories of things that never happened.
pros: "Undo" things that you've done by making people forget them
Make hookers think you've already paid them
Be the sneakiest lawyer or the best lover by manipulating people's memories
cons: There's a possibility you'll become a control freak

name: Phase Transformation
overview: undergo a transformation which makes all of your abilities stronger.
description: With this ability, you can undergo a transformation that makes all of your natural and supernatural abilities more powerful. The side effect of this ability is that it takes more energy than your normal form. You can also go through stronger levels of phases, but each one drains your energy more than the last.
pros: Great for a sort of 'last stand' situation.
You can go through multiple levels of phases.
cons: Requires more energy for each phase that you undergo.

name: Dream Walker
overview: move through and control the dreams of others.
description: You are able to control another's dream and cause physical harm and even death through this. This is essentially the conscious part of your brain talking to the sub-concious part so you do not actually get any real sleep through this so you cannot do this every single night. Your body is also still vulnerable. The person whose mind you're invading cannot wake up unless they are awoken violently.
pros: Control your own dreams
Cause physical harm to others using their dreams
Become a real Freddy Krueger
cons: Get very tired due to lack of real sleep
Body vulnerable

name: Quantum Leap
overview: use random powers everyday
description: Also called Ability Shifting, this is the ability to acquire different abilities every day. One with this ability cannot choose which abilities they acquire, as the abilities change either based on their emotions, or just randomly. One with this ability may, one day, have a deadly sonic scream, and the next day, have telepathy. This ability only lasts roughly 18-20 hours (at most a full 24-hour span).
pros: Start your day with Superstrength, end with Telepathy
Abilities MAY change based on emotions or situation (but only once)
Abilities range through the full spectrum (physical, mental, empathic, magical, etc)
cons: Can't control when power changes, or what power you get
Can't sense when power changes, or what power you get (unless you also have Chaos Sense)
Can't control intensity of power

name: Regulating Power Beam
overview: fire a beam that adjusts itself to the right amount of energy to either destroy , energize,or stun.
description: This power allows the user to release a beam that changes power levels to what the user wants to do: destroy, energize or stun. The beam must connect to the living creature or object to be able to regulate itself within a range of 1 to 10. 1 would stun a microorganism, 5 would energize any machine and 10 would destroy a planet in time.
pros: Powerful stunner or energizer.
Powerful energy beam.
Can be regulated.
cons: Must make contact with target to regulate the amount efficiently.

name: Power Multiplex
overview: replicate multiple abilities from others by physical contact
description: This form of ability replication is rare. Unlike normal ability replication, this version of the power allows a person to hold onto multiple abilities right from the start, thus making it very useful. However, despite having many powers, you can only access them in 'sets' at any given time.
pros: Hold onto more than one ability at a time, right from the start
You can switch between powers if you want, or even use them simultaneously!
Absorption takes no more than a few seconds
cons: You have to touch a person to gain their power
You can only hold up to a maximum of nineteen abilities
You cannot take abilities such as empathic mimicry or other forms of power replication

name: Musical And Sound Manipulation
overview: cause many different effects with music/sound.
description: Without doing anything, you can generate music and sound by wanting it. Your voice is perfect and you have an innate ability to sing. Using an instrument or singing greatly augments your power. You can cause people to sleep, wake, become confused, be calm, snap out of confusion, be attracted to or repelled from others, and shoot sonic blasts and waves with sounds and music. Even in space, the energy and aura of what sound or music you want will affect them.
pros: Can make a profit.
Make your enemies dance.
cons: Have to learn to play an instrument.

name: Trident Of Poseidon
overview: control water with Poseidon's trident
description: The Trident of Poseidon is a weapon with a mahogany handle infused with powdered diamond for strength, a solid gold base, and prongs of pure silver. When first summoned, it appears as a small pen, which then permanently links to it's first wielder, but only if they are good, with rightful and just intentions. The person can control water in any way they choose, and also use it to heal even the deadliest injuries or ailments in mere hours. The trident will always return to the user if misplaced.
pros: The trident permanently links with the first person who wields it, and only if they are good
It can make them near-immortal!!
Power limitation is only in the wielder's imagination, so enemies better watch out!!
cons: None

name: Electromaniacal Form
overview: change into a form which grows and gains power from electricity
description: With this ability, you switch into a form which grows and becomes stronger the more electricity you consume. You become an electric monster, and gain more abilities as you gain strength. These abilities include thunderbolts, sonic screeches, releasing electric surges, and having some control over magnetic fields. These abilties swell as you feed on electricity. However, if you're hit with enough water, you'll short out, and revert to normal. You have a mild immunity against physical attacks.
pros: Grow and gain strength from electricity.
You have a variety of abilities, from electrical surges to shock-screeching
Can easily find sources of power in a city.
cons: Water gives you a short-out, weakening you and possibly causing you to revert.
Once you revert, the electricity you consumed is lost
Transforming requires some concentration.

name: Psionic Blade
overview: create an invisible blade slicing through any objects by using the mind.
description: An energy invisible blade with a velocity of 50 meters per second of any size and number that cuts through the exterior part of any substance or things. A clear focus mind is vital to initially activate this ability which approximately takes 15 to 30 seconds and a reactivation gap of 4 seconds. This has known cutting limits to a maximum of 7 inches (17. 78 cm) thickness or diameter of iron steel and point of target of 20 meters.
pros: Element of surprise: unseen attack measure
Moderate to long distance target
No limits on size and number of psionic blades
cons: Time consuming mind unlocking process
Limitation on target's distance and thickness
Complete mind exhaustion after one hour battle

name: Elemental Forces
overview: summon the Elemental Forces.
description: With this power, you can summon, control, heal and dismiss the Elemental Forces at will, all of which are in your complete and utter control. They are all extremely powerful forces of good. The Elemental Forces happen to look like extremely cool, awesome, unique, and original versions the Summons from the various Final Fantasies. They include Odin, Alexander, Belias, Shiva, Bahamut, Hashmal, Fenrir, Ixion, Famfrit, Phoenix, Typhon, Ultima, and Ragnarok.
pros: All Elemental Forces have a wide variety of special powers, abilities, skills, and talents.
All Elemental Forces have the Ultimate Attacks that they have in the Final Fantasies.
All Elemental Forces have extremely awesome summoning sequences.
cons: Can only summon one Elemental Force at a time, though they can be instantly swapped out.
Can cause a lot of destruction if not careful.

name: Genesis Gem
overview: use it to create your own universes and restore all life.
description: It is the polar opposite to the Exodus Gem. It has the power to restore life and could create a universe in your image, but, whenever a timeline, a planet and/or a universe is destroyed, you can restore it to its natural state. Also, you can have a complete awareness and control over space, matter, energy, reality and time around you.
pros: Could become a god.
cons: None.

name: Telesynthesis
overview: create objects with your mind using raw materials
description: With this power, you can use raw materials to assemble and create objects with your mind. All you need to do is gather the ingredients, think of the item you'd like to synthesize, and the ingredients will be transformed into the object. The more complex the object, the more practice and concentration required. So when you need a toothbrush, grab a few plastic bags and you're all set. Sunny out? Make a ridiculously gigantic sombrero! Need a glass of water? Use rocks and the water in the air!
pros: Endless possibilities for synthesizing objects
Life threatening situations become walks in the park
Transforming your Ford Focus into a Ferrari
cons: All ingredients must be present, otherwise synthesis will be incomplete
Complex objects (like electronics) require great skill and concentration
Synthesizing life costs other lives

name: Creation Training
overview: use any power you create through training.
description: This power allows you to use any power that you create. However, before you train at it, your powers will be very weak. Training involves practicing with the power until it becomes more potent. The amount of training required for a power to reach its full potential varies, but is never more than three months worth.
pros: You can have a wide variety of powers.
Training at powers generally helps you to understand them better.
cons: If you have this power, the only way to get powers you create is by training.
Training tires you and it takes time.

name: Focus Manipulation
overview: control anything's accuracy including oneself.
description: This ability can make anyone gain or loss focus on what they want. This will help the user avoid attacks from their opponents. This ability can make anyone a powerful marksman or someone who really needs glasses.
pros: Gain Accuracy
Can avoid opponent's attacks
Can make people loss focus on their goals or pay attention to you.
cons: effects only lasts for 3 days

name: Planetary Avatar
overview: generate and control any natural phenomena from any planet
description: Control the acid rains of Venus, the volcanoes on Mars, the hurricanes on Jupiter, the storms of Neptune and all others.
pros: Can travel through and survive in outer space
Can control weather on earth
Can keep oneself comfortable
cons: Aliens are always trying to capture your powers.
When you die, your powers go to the closest person.

name: Arcana 11: Justice
overview: cause the most neutral possible outcome in any conflict.
description: In any conflict, be it physical or social, between two people or groups of people, you can cause the result of the conflict to always be a tie. A coin toss would end with the coin falling on it's edge, two sports teams would end up with exactly the same scores, no matter how long they played. This power ignores any differences in respective skill- A chess grand-master could be rendered unable to defeat a chess novice.
pros: You can determine the balanced outcome of almost any fight or conflict, including your own.
You can make certain that you never actually lose a fight.
cons: This power has no ability to actually make anyone succeed at anything.
This power doesn't work when a single person is involved, such as in solitare.

name: Enhanced Progression
overview: learn or adapt much faster than normal.
description: Everything takes time, they say. Not always true; a person with Enhanced Progression can adapt to a task much more rapidly than an average person. Martial arts training may take half the time, Newtonian calculus might become a weekend project, weightlifting gradients might pass by faster, and so on. This does not mean they are smarter or stronger. Rather, they must expend less time and effort to get the same results. There is a con--they cannot become superhuman in any area.
pros: Acquire new skills with prodigious speed
Lifelong commitments are no longer necessary
Become a master of karate, physics, weightlifting, etc.
cons: Not inherently smarter or stronger
Still must spend some time learning the task
Cannot become truly superhuman in any area

name: Transdimensional Architect
overview: temporarily change the inside of any building without making the outside bigger.
description: As soon you enter a building you can make any existing room or corridor bigger. You can add new rooms,corridors,staircases,stairways and floors. You can grow or shrink new rooms and corridors. You can give stairways and staircases as many steps as you want. You can rearrange any thing you added. You can't kill or trap anyone. Try and crush someone, he will reappear outside the building. When you leave the building,it reverts back to normal. Anyone who had been in a lost area will be outside.
pros: Make that economy hotel room bigger than a palace.
Lose anyone chasing you by making a broom closet near infinite in size.
Put a 5 mile long corridor between yourself and a foe.
cons: The wilderness.
People might start saying "Here comes Captain Building! "

name: Legend's Armory
overview: summon objects from myth and legend.
description: With this power, you can wield any weapon or magic object from myth and legend. You could summon Poseidon's trident to control water, or smite your enemies with Thor's hammer. You could summon a cloak of invisibility or a flying carpet. As you get more experienced with this power, the easier it is to control more powerful objects. With all the magical items in the myth of the world, the possibilities are virtually endless.
pros: Wield a variety of powers from different objects
No limit to amount of objects you can summon (even summon the Argo)
Could give allies objects that enhance their powers
cons: Have to be able to control objects you summon
Can't summon creatures
Can't summon buildings

name: Biokinesis
overview: control life, biology, and genetics.
description: Control living thing. Alter them in anyway you wish, on a macro, cellular, genetic, and even molecular,atomic, or subatomic level. Alter any traits they have. Grant them brand new abilities or traits. Create new living matter, using already existing lifeforms and matter. Destroy existing life as well. Even use his ability on yourself.
pros: Can remove any diseases or other biological problems.
Can control, change, enhance, and destroy anything biological.
GIve yourself other biologically based powers.
cons: Can't cotnrol anything that isn't biological.
If one doesn't know much about biology, its use can have unintended effects
You can't become instantly superintelligent, only gain the mental ability to be superintelligent

name: Complete Blood Control
overview: have complete control of blood
description: With this power, the subject can absorb and metabolize blood like a leech through physical contact. Transfusions are also possible. You will be immune to all other blood-based powers such as acid blood, explosive blood, vampirism, etc. You are able to control people like puppets with blood or just plain blow them up from the inside out. You may use your blood as a weapon by shooting it from a cut at high, concussive pressure.
pros: You will never be HIV positive.
Any destructive blood or blood-based power doesn't affect you.
You have a powerful, biological weapon.
cons: Blood doesn't nourish you.
A regular hemokinetic has more control of blood.
You can still die from blood loss, non-blood based damage/illnesses/toxins, etc.

name: Bodily Energy Unification
overview: combine all the energies in one's body to create a new energy and manipulate it.
description: Humans produce many kinds of energy. Heat energy, kinetic energy, the energy from food or cells, etc. This ability combines them into a unified force that still have the properties of the energies that formed it. The user can then manipulate the new energy as the user pleases. Any outside energy that makes contact with the user will be temporarily absorbed and added on to the new energy. The new energy will act out all the energy that formed it so the user can function normally.
pros: New form of energy.
Manipulate it.
Energy has all the properties of combined energies.
cons: Energies are combined forever, but you will still function like a normal human.

name: Shadow Seconds
overview: be in another plane of existence so that the user won't be detected for a certain amount of seconds.
description: This ability is for stealth or avoiding conflicts with enemies. The user makes themselves go to another plane of existence for a couple seconds. Like in Charmed, in that time, the user is in some kind of dimension where they can see and hear things but not interact with the normal world. Physics still applies (if you leave, go through a door), but while in non-existence, people (even psychics) and computers will not be able detect the user for those few seconds.
pros: Stealth.
Avoid trouble.
Psychics won't spot you.
cons: Physics still applies.
Lasts for a couple of seconds.

name: Shadow Clone Technique
overview: create clones of yourself by splitting your powers in two
description: Always wanted to watch movies and play video games at the same time? Well now you can! With this ability you can split yourself in two. If you possess more than one superpower they will be split amongst the clones and if you only have one, the power will get weaker as it's potency will be split into the clones. The power of this ability is based on the creativity of the user, example he can use a clone to throw him in the air.
pros: Can distract foes by attacking from all directions at once
Can be very useful for spying as when they are unsummoned all information comes back to the user
cons: Superpowers are split amongst the clones and/or are weakened by them
Takes a lot of willpower to make more clones
Clones can be destroyed with one good hit

name: Sight Jacking
overview: psychically see through the eyes of another, (human, animal, etc. )
description: See through the eyes of another organism via psychic connection. You don't need telepathy or empathy to use this power, however it does help to find a target to use it on. This power only works within a 2 mile radius. A very useful ability to have if you are blinded during a fight. Of course, this ability wont work on someone who is already blind and cannot be used on the dead. This power only works one way; therefore, while using sight-jack, your true body is left blind and open to attack.
pros: See through the eyes of enemies, allies and loved ones. Both animal and human alike.
Great for spying and gathering information.
If you are blinded or are already blind, seeing becomes possible!
cons: Cannot see through the eyes of those who are already blind or dead.
While using this power, it leaves your own body blind and open to attack.
Range, 2 mile radius. If your target moves out of range, you connection to your target will break.

name: See It Know It
overview: see things progress before your eyes
description: This power allows you to see things and their answer. For example, if you are stuck on a test, you can use this power and see the answers glow from your point of view. Like if the answer to the test is A, you would see the A bubble glow up. In the case of problems requiring steps to be performed, you will see them solve themselves right in front of your eyes, so you can repeat the steps.
pros: You will always get A
You can solve the hardest problem as it will solve right in front of your eye.
cons: People would dump all their work on you

name: Soundwave Control
overview: create and control soundwaves for various effects
description: A person with this powercan control all forms of pressure waves in the air. They can project sound as a weapon as well as change their voice. They can also use sound wave as a boost to reach near sonic levels of speed. Sonic boosted jumps are possible. Soundwaves can be amplified or distorted. They can even prevent sound from occuring for a 1 mile radius as well as produce wonderful music rivalling the best musicians. They also can sense any disturbances within soundwaves for a 5 mile radius.
pros: Sonic weapons
Find out where people are through soundwave disturbance (sort of like super-hearing)
Boost your own abilities by using sonic energy
cons: You can break the eardrums of bystanders
Doesn't work in space
Soundproof material

name: The Superpower List
overview: gain abilities posted on "The Superpower List"
description: Why have one when you can have them all? This ability allows you to gain every ability posted on superpowerlist.com . Every time a new one is added, that's yours now as well!
pros: You get every power posted on the superpower list!
Conflicting abilities can be swapped at will between themselves.
cons: A power must be added to the list before it is usable.
You don't know when you get a new power.
Powers you add don't count.

name: Seeding
overview: grow something from anything.
description: This power allows the user to grow anything. To use this power you must first acquire a piece of the thing you wish to grow, such as a chip off of a building, a spark plug, or a hair or fingernail clipping. Plant this object in the ground and treat it as you would a seedling. In a matter of weeks (or longer, depending on what you are trying to grow) you will have a fully formed replica of the thing you acquired the "seed" from. Living creatures grown this way will have no memories.
pros: Grow yourself a car, spacecraft, computer, or a whole building.
Bring extinct creatures and dead people back to life.
cons: Living beings grown this way will have no memories and behave on instinct
Grown humans will have to be taught.
You must care for what you are growing as if it is a plant.

name: Magnokinesis
overview: manipulate or even create and control magnetic waves and eventually, metal.
description:
Use your hands or even your thoughts to create and control metal, magnets, and magnetic waves. This is a very simple ability and can be very useful. Your able to easily hack into computers, screw with compasses etc. 

You have to learn to control metal, and work towards it. This ability doesn't come to you when you first have this power.
pros: You can hack into computers
You can control and mold metal at your will.
It is very useful if your evil!
cons: Hard to control.
You have to work to control metal.

name: Technomancy
overview: change technology to make it so advanced that it gets confused with magic
description: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic. This ability lets you make devices advance to that point. Your power is easly confused with magic, but is immune to all powers that affect it. Conversly, your power is still affected by technopathic powers. You create a machine that can do virtually anything a mage, wizard, witch, sorcerer, sorceress, seer, or other magic user could do.
pros: Magic-ish powers.
Immune to magic affecting powers.
cons: Technopaths will try to use your technology.
You have to have some device to advance.
Learning how to use the technologies and/or machines might be difficult.
tags: any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic

name: Controlled Time Manipulation
overview: control time in a given area
description: One with this ability can reverse, pause, or slow time in any given area. This ability could be used to heal fatal wounds, and repair bridges and buildings. The ability only affects the object or person of focus. One with this ability could accelerate the aging of an enemy, making them crumble to dust, or could freeze them where they stand, without affecting time as a whole.
pros: Excellent for combat and high risk scenarios
Healing teammates when they are injured by reversing the wound's timeline
Any obstacle can be easily dispatched
cons: Requires massive concentration for smaller scale use

name: Velocity
overview: control velocity
description: The ability to control velocity, pure and simple. Velocity is the speed and direction a object is moving. You can do many things with it. You could simply move things around, but the more creative the better. By controlling your own velocity, you could make yourself fly into the air. Or you could cancel somethings velocity, make it freeze where it is, even if it's in the air. You might even use velocity as a sort of force blast, blasting things away from you at high speeds.
pros: Controlling one of the most powerful forces in the world
Many uses
cons: Velocity control will leave you tired at first, but the more you use it, the less tired you will be.
Might accidently cancel your own velocity sometimes

name: Terra Forming
overview: manipulate the elements to create a perfect "world" of your desire
description: The ability to control any rock element (can raise or lower a solid landmass), any liquid element (can multiply liquid to create a lake or ocean), any wood element (can manipulate one plant root to stretch as far as you want to create an ecosystem). You can manipulate the weather and climate around an area to make it foggy, rainy, or hot.
pros: To create an entirely new world based on what you want it to be
Can upraise a landmass out of the ocean and create an island with any type of ecosystem
cons: Cannot create wildlife to roam free in your world

name: Vision Manipulation
overview: make your opponents see things that aren't there
description: To activate you have to make eye contact with your opponent, then concentrate on them, think of anything, your opponent will then find themselves seeing that thing. Great for: torture, interrogation, just plain having fun with it. You will also be able to make them see their WORST NIGHTMARES right in front of them. Can be turned off by will, or if someone else attacks you.
pros: Can trick your opponents
Makes them see things that aren't there
Can make them see their worst nightmare
cons: Tires your eyes
Must make eye-contact
Can be disrupted by someone else

name: Teleportation Imbuing
overview: make teleporting objects.
description: With this ability, the user can make an item, such as a watch, teleport the holder to your current location with a selected action, e.g. rubbing it. Alternately, you can make it teleport you to an object. The user can also control the objects and render them normal. The owner of the ability decides whether the object travels with the user. There are no energy or time requirements for the ability.
pros: Make infinite teleporters.
Never need public transport or a car again.
Can give a "Trojan Horse" gift to an enemy.
cons: Can't travel through time.
Have to be in a desired location.
Others can use the item (could be a pro).

name: Mastermind
overview: summon minions and upgrade them.
description: A person with this ability can choose one type of minion, such as ninjas, zombies, or robots, and summon them to follow his command. At first only a small amount of low ranking minions can be summoned but the more the power is used a larger number and higher ranked set of minions can be summoned. The mastermind can also cast upgrades onto weaker minions to make them more powerful as higher ranked minions are able to be summoned. The minions will follow the mastermind unquestioningly.
pros: Summon and train your favorite type of minion.
The minions will always follow your commands exactly as you want them too.
Can upgrade weaker minions so they do not become useless.
cons: Once a type of minion is chosen it cannot be changed.
The higher ranked a minion is, the less can be summoned.
Available minions start out weak, and higher ranks must be trained.

name: Crystal Kinesis
overview: shoot crystal bullets out of one's body and cover oneself in a retractable crystal armor.
description: If you need to smash through a wall, cover yourself in crystals and/or diamonds.
pros: Can be indestructible.
You never have to reload.
Can smash through walls.
cons: Easy to miss.
Crystals will break off.
You will look weird when covered in crystals.

name: Energizer Bunny
overview: manipulate kinetic and potential energy
description: The ability to convert kinetic energy into potential energy, and vice versa. Basically, with this power, you can stop two speeding cars from colliding by converting all their kinetic energy into potential energy. You can also pull the potential or kinetic energy out of anything and shoot it at people as energy beams.
pros: Shoot energy beams at your enemies! Mwahaha!!!
Turn kinetic energy into potential energy (i.e. stop things from moving)
cons: No power over human life force
Converting one type of energy into another takes a lot of strength, focus, and human energy
Can't affect yourself (you can't wave your arm and use that kinetic energy, for instance)

name: Creator
overview: destroy, create, and control your own world
description: When you make your world, you also make what's in it and control it. After you make your world and the things inside of it, you can use the objects as a weapon without harming it and also without killing it.
pros: It will protect the good
It helps with travel
It's very strong
cons: Sometimes unstoppable
Goes in a different way sometimes
Loses strengh sometimes

name: Unblockable
overview: never have the path of the road in front of you be impeded
description: A person with this power has his path always clear. Unlike unstoppability he cannot ram into objects. Instead the objects such as obstacles will be compelled to move out of your path or open so that you can enter. Even people cannot block your path unless they can resist this power. This power can be perfectly non-lethal in usage. However this only applies to things that can move out of your way or open for you. Unlike Path Maker,Things like walls and trees that are rooted will not move for you.
pros: Locks, drawbridges, and steel doors open before your presence and allow your passage
Cars cannot block your path---ie can't be hit in an accident--the cars will slide to the side
Football---no one can tackle you (from the front)
cons: Cannot be used to attack people since they become compelled to move away from your path
Conventionally immovable objects such as walls or trees

name: Spacial Beam Banish
overview: fire a beam of  space energy to to send things away to a different location
description: This is a space manipulation move where you put your trigger and middle finger together against your head, then concentrate on a location to send an a object or person to. Then you fire at the target with the tip of your fingers. The beams cause pain depending how long you charge it and with enough practice, you can use the beams to transport larger objects, like planets.
pros: Send things to another demension
Use it on yourself to go on trip free vactions
Send an enemy to the sun
cons: Need the space element to use it
Alot more consinstration on larger object
Hard to use on an large group of people

name: Requiem Drive
overview: render a person unconscious through touch
description:
Upon physical contact with another person, the user can put the target to sleep in mere seconds. When the victim re-awakens, they will feel extremely dizzy. 
In addition, if the user cannot physically touch the target, they can chant a small verse while focusing on said target to knock them out from afar.
pros: Tired of someone talking? - put them to sleep.
Want to sneak past a security guard or two? Problem solved
Suffering from insomnia? Use it on yourself!
cons: Not much use if multiple opponents come at you all at once
Cannot be used to kill. Which is bad if your opponent wants your head.
May not actually work on its owner, so insomniacs may need sleeping pills.

name: Divine Protection
overview: be protected by an unknown force
description:
The Universe basically wants to help you. You will be protected from anything and everything. 

Bullets will miss. Knives will bend. Anything that wants to do harm to you will be prevented. 

Will not work if you tempt the power. You will die if you try to commit suicide.
pros: Someone up there likes you
Will protect you from unknown threats
cons: Overprotection
No offensive ability
Will not protect you from yourself

name: Omnicheat
overview: cheat on anyone or anything in existence whether physical, spiritual, psychic etc.
description: Omnicheat is the ability to cheat anyone or anything in existense. This ability can cheat (but is not limited to) the following: games, rules, space/time, simensional separations, other abilities, logic, omniscience, omnipotence, mind body and spirit, magic, death, and your own limitations. This renders the totality of the universe's laws and other people's abilities virtually useless, void or unapplicable to the user.
pros: Cheat the rules of reality and all the forces in the universe
Cheat other abilities by simply changing how those abilities work on you or making them useless
You can even cheat death itself
cons: Everybody hates cheaters.
You can cheat only ten times per day
Takes the fun out of everything you do because you can simply "cheat your way" to victory

name: Aero Augmentation
overview: change how you interact with the forces of air
description: This power allows you to enhance how you interact with one force of air (lift, thrust, drag, weight), and devalue its counter force. Lift makes you lighter allowing levitation, thrust makes you faster, drag makes you slower (useful if you need to make an immediate stop), and weight (gravity) makes you heavier. This power is very useful for aerial combat.
pros: Combining thrust and lift allows you to fly (not levitate, actual flight)
You can achieve super speed and flight
cons: Not an ability meant for combat (doesn't mean you can't though)
No defensive abilities

name: Theatrical Instancy
overview: bring characters to life that you have seen in movies
description: With this power, when you watch a movie you have the ability to bring the characters to life to be your servants. If you want an army of 300 Spartan and the star wars republic army, and you watched there movie, you would be able to have them as your army. You can summon your favorite superheroes and villain to work together to do your bidding. You could watch the movie Superman with Superman. This power doesn't effect the movies from which you summoned the character.
pros: You can get more than one movie involved in your creation
You can combine different movie characters into a more powerful being than in the movie
You can have the power of one character put into your own body
cons: You can't use cartoons or animation in your creation
If you take the power of a character, you can't summon that character
You can't summon religious gods

name: Weather Manipulation
overview: manipulate the conditions of the current weather
description: If its raining, you can make it rain 10 times harder; if it's hot and sunny, you can make the rays of the sun more intene and thus raise the temperature. But you can also do the opposite, make it rain less hard or make the weather less summer-like
pros: You can get more of the current weather-type
You can get less of the current weather-type
cons: You can only increase the current weather
It can be dangerous

name: Chemical Necessity Generation
overview: create chemicals that act as necessities that any being needs to have to survive.
description: The user can create chemicals that act as some of the necessities that living creates need to survive. They can create a chemical that a become a food like substance. They can satisfy anyone. Water and oxygen can be other things that can be made when none of it isn't around. Their is one issue with it. When the effects start to dissipate, the chemicals become a poisonous. Non-lethal, of course, but it can leave the one to use these chemicals become ill for short moments in time.
pros: Create chemicals to use to survive
Eventually learn to manipulate
User will develop immunity to poison effects
cons: Products will become poisonous while used

name: Tactile Psammokinesis
overview: control sand when in contact or close proximity to it.
description: This power allows a person to control sand at close range. It is slightly stronger than the normal form of this ability due to psionic energy emanated from the individual when in concurrence with any sand source. A user of the power can even infuse their body with it to increase or decrease their mass, strength, and power. They can also create sandstorms, tornadoes, etc.
pros: You have near-limitless regenerative capability when in or near any form of sand.
You can be a formidable combatant to an enemy.
You cannot be destroyed.
cons: You can only control minute amounts of sand at first.
Water, heat, and wind can all weaken you.
If you are inexperienced, this power can fatigue you very quickly if amplified.

name: Super Time
overview: control the time vortex.
description: Able to control the time vortex and gives super speed and strength
pros: can go back in time
Super speed
Can go into the vortex of space
cons: Can disrupt the pfuture
Can change the past
Can kill you if used wrong

name: Sublimation
overview: change your body into mist
description: With this power, you can become a hazy mist that blinds anyone within range and gives you the power to phase through objects, intangibility, and of course, blinding.  With this power, you cannot feel pain, and it is very helpful in escaping dangerous situations. Unfortunately, you only have an hour before you MUST change back to your true form.
pros: You can blind opponents
You have the powers of phasing and intangibility
Easily escape dangerous situations
cons: You have an hour before you MUST change back to your true form.
You can accidentally blind allies.
Retreating is not always a good thing to do.

name: Chorokinesis
overview: control the dimension of space
description: The ability to affect the dimension of space on a physical object or person. Its effect on the subject is similar to teleportation, it moves from one space to another without using time. (All other dimensions on the object stay the same--length, width, depth, and time). In other words, this ability allows you to teleport yourself and other objects instantaneously.
pros: Go anywhere you want.
Move anything you want so you don't need to move.
cons: You cannot control any time aspects.
You could teleport into a solid object which would probably kill you.
Objects and people stay in the exact position they were in just a different place.

name: Strength In Numbers
overview: create up to 12 super strong clones of yourself
description: With this power you can create up to 12 clones of yourself and each of them have super strength. Note you yourself don't have super strength only your clones do but you have complete control over your clones. Also if one of the clones dies you can simply recreate it.
pros: You can have up to 12 super strong clones of yourself
There is no time limit on the clones
The clones are under you complete control
cons: You yourself don't have super strength
The clones are not invincible

name: Energy Converter
overview: absorb energy, change it, and redirect it.
description: With your left hand, you can absorb any kind of energy. Thermal, electrical, kinetic, light, sound, psychic, chi, you name it. You can absorb from the general area, or from something/someone in particular. Once absorbed, it can be converted into any other type of energy and fired from the right hand in the form of a powerful beam. You can choose how much energy to put into the beam, but it's max power depends on how much energy you've stored up.
pros: You can absorb any kind of energy from any source.
By absorbing all of somebody's body heat, you could effectively freeze them.
The beam can consist of any energy in existence (that you know of).
cons: Absorbed energy doesn't add to your physical strength.
You can't absorb kinetic energy from getting hit, unless you block with your left hand.
Lefties may have trouble aiming (but with enough practice, they could become ambidextrous).

name: A Dragon's Ring
overview: summon a special dragon ring as a supernatural aid
description: With this power, you can summon the silver dragon ring from 'The Sorcerer's Apprentice' to use as an extremely versatile source of power. It's main power is unlocking the mind's psychic power, thus granting the person access and control of it. Other secondary powers include pyrokinesis, phasing, enhanced speed and reflexes, regeneration, and super strength.
pros: Have nearly-limitless psychic power!
Be near-immortal
The ring binds with the first person who wields it, and only if they are good
cons: Unlocking the ring's full power takes time and practice
You can only remove the ring through willpower

name: Illusionary Fear
overview: make the user's enemies fear come through via illusions
description: The person with this power is able to make a person's fear come through via an illusion. The enemy becomes trapped in an illusion of the thing that fear the most. A person with a significant will power can overcome the illusions of fear.
pros: Illusions can be used to trap enemies in the worst fear
Can stall enemies
Can prevent enemies from stealing something
cons: A person with significant will power can escape this power

name: Cell Control
overview: control your own cells.
description: This is one of the most gruesome and bloody abilities. It allows the user to control their own cells like a metamorph can control their atoms. This allows you to make many genetic weapons. For example, you could change your arm into a fleshy spike tipped with a jagged head of bone. Or you could take your hand and turn it into a whip. You can even change your cells' form from animal to plant. So you could use photosynthesis and other plant-related powers. You can even increase cell generation.
pros: You can make tons of cell weapons (Bone spike shooter)
You can even change your cells' form and increase cell generation.
cons: It's a gruesome and bloody ability.

name: Xenoglossy
overview: understand and speak any human language.
description: This literally translates to "foreign tongue". You can understand and speak any human language, like Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, French or Cambodian. Any one of the over 1000 different languages found around the world. You cannot communicate with animals, plants, aliens, etc.
pros: Speak any human language.
Understand any human language.
cons: You can't speak to animals or plants.
You can't speak to aliens either.

name: Influence Adaption
overview: adapt and utilize any form of influence.
description: The user has the ability to withstand any influence and be able to pass it of to influence other things. This means the user can be immune from emotion manipulation to mind control. Then the user can use those abilities to control or free other people from another being's influence.
pros: Influence immunity
Gain influence-based abilities
cons: Influence abilities only last as long as one is near the source of the influence.

name: Phase Diver
overview: turn solids into liquids or liquids into solids by touch
description: A person with this power has the ability to turn any solid they touch into its liquid state or any liquid they touch into its solid state. Obviously this power can be used in many creative ways. Some examples include going through liquid walls. Trapping people by pulling them into cement and then hardening it.
pros: Solids into liquids - Swim on land, go through walls,
Liquids into solids - Trap people in swimming pools
Everything that changed state will start to revert to previous shapes and have the same temperature
cons: You still need to breath when swimming through any liquid

name: Energy Weapon Generation
overview: create any weapon made of pure energy.
description: This ability allows for the hero or villain to create a weapon made of energy, with the right amount of focus. The weapons appears in the hand, glowing in the color of the users choosing. The weapon may only be weilded by the user and has twice the lethality of normal weaponry. An energy sword would cut through more than a normal sword but not everything. The weapons are created by syphoning off the user's energy. So too many, too big or too powerful of a weapon causes the user to pass out
pros: Any weapon any time
Highly lethal weapons
cons: Drains own energy
Requires focus so faster generation is harder

name: Activation And Deactivation
overview: activate and deactivate various objects and systems
description: This is the ability to imbue objects and systems with the energy they need to perform their functions. For example, the function of a paper airplane is to glide through the air from one place to another. You can make that happen. There isn't any limit to the kinds of systems you can activate. Mechanical, electrical, biological. This means you can even activate abilities in another person. The flip side is that you can also deactivate systems around you.
pros: You can activate and deactivate objects and systems around you.
Tons of different uses
You can even activate and deactivate abilities in others
cons: This ability is heavily connected to emotion, and can be hard to control.
You can't force an object or system to go beyond it's capabilities.

name: Force Extension
overview: extend the force of an object that you are using.
description: Grab any item and smash an opponent with it from any range. This ability extends the force from the object you are wielding to the target point. However, there is a range limit of about 50 meters of extension from the tip of the object. More advanced users can create multiple extensions to create various effects, like a small wall of defence, and also the ability to slightly exaggerate the force, making it stronger than it would normally be. But you have to swing the object for this ability.
pros: Extend the force of any object that you use, including blunt, pierce and slash forces
More advanced users can make the forces stronger and make more extensions
Use both offensively and defensively
cons: Must be wielding an object.
Have to visualise where the extension comes from
Acts as a physical extension, so energy beings are immune.

name: Child Of The Night
overview: grow claws, be able to run at God-like speeds, and be almost invincible during the night
description: The ability to grow claws and be able to run at God-like speeds during the night. Once the sun rises, you become a regular person. This power is inherited through genetics. Running in the night is like a drug for the Children of the Night and produces extreme pleasure. Direct contact with the sunlight could cause slight discomfort. The Children of the Sun are your enemies.
pros: Become an insanely powerful creature of the night
