Feel the icy wind against your body as you run through the night
Be able to eliminate any enemies
cons: If you are in the middle of a battle and the sun comes up, you are screwed
The sun slightly causes you to be discomfortable
The Children of the Sun are powerful while you are a weak human

name: Wing Manifestation
overview: grow wings that can be used for flight
description: The user of this power is able to grow wings that can be used for flying. However, the wings that are grown is dependent on what animal or insect with wings which are near the user. For example, if there is a bald eagle near by, you would get a wing structure of a bald eagle. The wings that are manifested are proportianate to the user's size and will enable them to fly
pros: The user can with limits depending on the type of wing
Can defend against rear attack
cons: Not independent flight, air and thrust is still needed
Defect or injury to wing may cause flight to be erratic

name: Ambidextrous Elements
overview: control a different element with each hand.
description: This power is designed to combine the four traditional elements. Combining the elements can also enhance (Water and air become a hurricane) or decrease (Fire and water become steam) their combat effectiveness. With concentration, you can use two elements at the same time to defeat your opponents.
pros: Great for combat.
Control over Air, Water, Fire, and Earth.
Affecting air pressure can change the weather.
cons: Combining elements in one spray can disable their effect. (mainly water and fire)
Overuse can lead to fatigue.
You must always be within sight of the element you plan to use.

name: Mastery Of Explosions
overview: create and manipulate explosions
description: The ability to create, control, manipulate and absorb explosions. With this, you can: Fly- By creating small explosions at the base of your feet and stabilizing with other small explosions. Defend- By exploding any danger coming at you. Does not affect energies. Attack- Melee or energetic. By creating explosions from your fist to blow up someone's face or even just blow up their head from afar. It also allows you to stop explosions, including the explosions in guns, pistons in cars, etc.
pros: Can blow up anything and everything.
Can stop explosions, rendering cars, trucks, guns, anything with explosions useless.
Protection from physical harm.
cons: Useless when unconscious.
Property damage.
Energy exhaustion.

name: Concussive Force
overview: create strong force blasts.
description: A hand-to-hand power where one forces out a large amount of energy out of one's hands, or feet, creating a sonic boom-like thing. This will destroy most things in its way.
pros: Incredibly destructive.
Superior to Sonic Blasts.
cons: Can damage an unconditioned body.
Unstable.

name: Aura Bullet
overview: create and fire off bullets using one's own aura
description: The bullets are composed of condensed energy from your own aura and can travel at speeds of up to 1000 metres per second. You can fire them from either your mouth by making the actions of spitting something out or from your fingertips. Also, you have to fire the bullets right when you create them. The color of the bullets is the same as your aura's color.
pros: The bullets give off no telltale smoke when fired so no one can trace them back to your hiding spot.
The bullets dissolve after a few minutes so they can't be traced back to you.
cons: You can't store the bullets for later use.

name: Selective Temptation Immunity
overview: be immune to any unwanted temptation in any form.
description: This ability grants the user with an immunity to temptation in any form. To be tempted to do something, they must choose to do so. These temptations can be financial, superhuman, biological, mental or otherwise in nature.
pros: You will not go mad with power (unless you want to).
You are immune to unwanted seduction.
You are harder to manipulate.
cons: Does not help against most forms of mind control.
You must consciously choose to be susceptible to something.
If you remain immune to metabolic temptations, you still need to fulfill those needs.

name: Omnipresence
overview: see everything happening anywhere.
description: Like an omniscient god, you get to witnes events happening in other parts of the world, even across galaxies.
pros: Your enemies can run, but they can't hide.
cons: Information overload could give you severe mental strain.

name: Illusion Manipulation
overview: alter the perceptions of another
description: The term illusion refers to a specific form of sensory distortion. Unlike a hallucination, which is a distortion in the absence of a stimulus, an illusion describes a misinterpretation of a true sensation.
pros: Make people believe what you want them to believe
Can affect any of the senses; ie. Sight, sound, touch, taste, or smell
cons: You can only do this while you're within seeing distance of the person
It has to be a conscience action

name: Technopathy
overview: communicate mentally with electronics
description: A person with Technopathy can control any form of computer-based device. They can mentally write computer programs, manipulate data streams, and use their abilities to infulence real-world events.
pros: ATM machines are now the same thing as free money
Write e-mails with your mind
Make everyone's cell phone ring at once
cons: Powerless without technology
Computer viruses
Firewalls

name: Tactile Hypnosis
overview: make someone do what you want by touching him
description: This ability enables you to make someone do what you want by touching him and giving a verbal command. The person you touch will preform the command unless he is restrained somehow. This ability may not work on pepole who are superhumanly durable or have a healing factor.
pros: Make pepole do what you want
You can control the actions of others
You can make people obey the verbal commands you give
cons: Ability is limited by touch
May not work on pepole who are superhumanly durable or have a healing factor
You must use verbal commands to make this ability work

name: Pyromaniacal Form
overview: switch into a form where you grow and gain power from fire
description: With this abilty, you can switch into a pyromaniacal form, which allows you to grow and gain power from fire. Once in this state, your body represents a figure completely engulfed and shaped in flame. You gain more fire-like abilties as you feed off fire, and they also adapt as you feed. These abilities include fire breathing, fire balls, and surges of flame. You can revert to normal form at any time, however, if you're cooled down enough, you will automatically revert.
pros: You gain abilities such as fire-breathing, fire-balls, and releasing fire.
You are immune to most physical attacks
You can revert to your normal form at any time.
cons: At the beginning of your form, you will be vunerable to most harm, espescially water.
Once you revert to normal form, your pyromaniacal form resets in size.
Mental attacks can still easily damage this form.

name: Nature Zone
overview: create a zone that promotes the growth of nature.
description: Creates a zone that promotes the growth of nature. Plants and animals inside the zone will grow faster and healthier. If the area has been cleared of natural wildlife and vegetation, then both will be attracted to return to the area. While the zone is active technological creations will be less effective and man made objects will begin to degrade. Specific plants can even be manipulated to grow faster normal and in a specific way. Animals will also act friendlier to humans.
pros: Cause animals and plants to return to an area.
Manipulate plants to grow faster and in a specific way.
Animals will act friendlier to humans.
cons: Technological creations and man made objects begin to fail.
Others can manipulate plants against you.
Animals can still be dangerous even though they will normally act friendly.

name: Goal Achievement
overview: know exactly how to achieve your goals
description: This power allows the user to know every detail of every one of their own goals, as well as every detail of how to achieve specific goals. Example: a shapeshifters goal is to "upgrade" their appearance without making any huge changes, but still satisfying their needs. With this power, the shapeshifter would know exactly how to achieve this specific goal. Combining this power with other powers is an advantage, although this power still works on users without any other powers.
pros: Know every detail of every one of their own goals
Know every detail of how to achieve specific goals
Combining this power with other powers is an advantage
cons: Users without any other powers are more limited as to what goals can be achieved

name: Weakness Manipulation
overview: change someone's weakness and/or the severity of the weakness.
description: Someone's weakness(including any of your own)can be changed to something else. You can also alter the severity of a weakness. You can make the severity of the the weakness no worse than a bad skin rash to a almost instant death reaction. You can match a weakness with someone's powers or give someone a weakness that contradicts a power they have. A icy weakness for ice power user or a friction weakness for a super fast runner. Changes like these aren't permanent however.
pros: Change your or a friend's weakness at will.
Make a weakness you have you no worse than a allergic reaction.
Make a foe's weakness into a deadly one.
cons: Some weaknesses will only be temporary.
You can't negate a weakness with this power.
You have this power but so does your enemy.

name: Phoenix Ability
overview: use the abilities of a phoenix
description: The ability to use the abilities of a phoenix. You can create fire, lift 10x your own weight, your tears have healing powers, and when you die you will turn into ashes and be born again.
pros: Cook popcorn in your hands
No need to use stoves
You will always have a light
cons: Without practice you could burn someone else
Born again means that you turn into a baby

name: Accuracy
overview: hit something no matter where it is
description: The ability to take any object, like a dagger, a throwing star or even a ball, and hit your target no matter where you throw it. So, you could throw something right, but if your target's on the left, it turns left. Unfortunately, you have to be able to focus on the object and where it's going to hit.
pros: Will never miss a target
Bend laws of physics
Able to join a lot of sports and be the best
cons: Wouldn't use a gun; hard to focus on a bullet
Your emotions might distract you

name: Periodic
overview: control all the elements in the periodic table of elements with your mind
description: With this superpower, you can control all the elements in the periodic table of elements with your mind. Control gold, gallium, oxygen, iodine, lithium, uranium, neon, plutonium, and many many more. There are over 100 elements. Works best with a chemistry reference table or chemistry knowledge.
pros: Control every element on the periodic table of elements.
Control valuable metals and tough metals.
Works best with a knowledge of chemistry.
cons: Can not control energy of any kind.
Can not control plasma.
Can not control ghosts.

name: Darkness Manipulation
overview: manipulate darkness and shadows
description: A user of this superpower can do the exact opposite of someone with Photo-Kinesis; they can decrease the amount of light and create 'flashes' of total darkness. They can also cloak themselves to hide during the night and can become completely invisible when in shadows. An adept user would be able to 'melt' into the shadows and could travel between them easily. An extremely adept user would be able to create the illusion of the Sun dimming in the sky by creating a planet-wide veil of darkness.
pros: You can avoid detection by manipulating shadows.
It can be used without other weaponry.
You can play upon human's natural fear of the dark.
cons: This can be cancelled out by someone with Photo-Kinesis.
More advanced aspects require a large amount of mental strength.
Extreme aspects could lead to madness and insanity.

name: Future Sight
overview: see the result of any action performed by oneself in the close future
description: Every time you imagine yourself performing a certain action, you see its outcome. The vision is experienced through the POV of your future self with all of your 5 senses. You don't suffer from the physical pain experienced in the vision nor any other negative effects other than the reaction to the content of the future can harm you. You can analyze multiple scenarios simultaneously and branch them from each other. While being in a vision state you are fully aware of your surroundings.
pros: Get an answer to the every "What if..?" question that has been bugging you
You now live your life like a video game ("Oops, I died. Oh well, I'll try again")
Seeing in the darkness, light-speed reflex...- find new uses by stretching your imagination a little
cons: You may want to try out some scenarios that you wouldn't even consider doing in the real life.
If you know everybody's reaction, people will feel unrealistic to you.
If the unescapable death will come close, you'll know it.

name: Ultimate Upgrader
overview: evolve/devolve your own powers to/from its ultimate form
description: This ability lets the user access ultimate versions of their ability at will. Ultimate abilities are abilities that have been honed so much that their power is at max and their possibilities to do things increase. However, it comes at a price with having glaring weaknesses and chances to leave a trail of destruction. A person must know how to absolutely control their abilities to use ultimate abilities effectively. You can switch back to non-ultimate forms with the original level of power.
pros: You get to use an upgraded version of your own power
You can switch between the ultimate and non-ultimate form
cons: Ultimate abilities have glaring weaknesses such as indiscriminate paths of destruction
Ultimate abilities are harder to control than any other superpower and can be fatal to the user

name: Viral Regeneration
overview: heal small injuries by reprogramming bacteria to repair them.
description: The Viral Regeneration power allows for rapid repair of injuries. It works by absorbing microbes in the immediate vicinity. They are then reprogrammed by the immune system to repair cellular damage or bodily injuries.
pros: Almost invicible, as any damage will be repaired quickly.
Prevents you from getting sick.
cons: Germ-killing substances can counteract this power.
Can't repair fatal injuries.

name: Sports Week
overview: be extremely good at certain sports on certain days of the week.
description: On Monday, you are an excellent football (soccer) player. On Tuesday, you are an excellent basketball player. On Wednesday, you are an excellent roller skater. On Thursday, you are an excellent gymnast. On Friday, you are an excellent swimmer. On Saturday, you are an excellent golfer. And on Sunday, you are an excellent tennis player. However, you will only be good at these sports during the indicated day, your capacities will be back to normal on the other days.
pros: You will be excellent even if you don't have the right anatomy for it.
The date is the one of the time zone you're in.
Being excellent at a sport also means coming up with great strategies and being a good teacher.
cons: If a match you're playing on a good day is reported to the day after.
You will only be good at these seven sports. You can't change them.
You will only be good for one day per week.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Existence Affinity
overview: become stronger by something specifically that exists in their surrounding..
description: The user has the ability to be stronger, faster, and more durable by something specific that exists; the  only limits is how many of them do exist, how significant the thing, or both. Example: If a smoker truly loves or desires cigarettes, the user will become more powerful by the number of cigarettes that exist in their vicinity.
pros: Become stronger, faster, and more durable.
Numbers are the key.
cons: If that specific thing doesn't exist anymore, user is back to normal strength.

name: Energy Ball
overview: create and manipulate spheres of energy of varying kinds.
description: This ability allows the user to basicly create energy balls. The energy appear very similar to cosmic energy, but it comes in more than just orange. It comes in red, blue, orange, green, yellow, black, grey and others. Each color can do different things. After creating the sphere, if it comes into hard contact with something, it will burst. Lets say you made a red ball. If it bursts, whatever it hit will burst into flames.
pros: Tons of colors can be used.
Spheres can be made around your hands(Red sphere/human flamethrower)
cons: Stranger colors will be a surprise the first time you use them.

name: Weather Control
overview: have full control over weather.
description: With this ability, you can change the weather to be sunny, rainy, cloudy, snowy, icy--you name it.  Just as long as it isn't catastrophic.  None of this Noah business.
pros: Great weather when you want it
Be the best weather reporter in the world
cons: Causing draughts
Flooding if you let it rain too long
Crazy wedding planners

name: Dimensional Room Upgrade
overview: make an upgraded dimension inside an enclosed space that is an upgraded version of that space.
description: When you use this power on an enclosed space, the inside of the area becomes a new dimension that is larger on the inside than on the outside. The dimension inside will be an upgraded version of whatever was in the area previously. So, if you upgrade a kitchen, you could have a kitchen of any size with appliances and supplies, even if they were not in there originally. You can have multiple dimensions inside the created dimension, such as if you used it on a house and then on rooms in the house.
pros: As much space as you need.
Have a really awesome house.
Larger dimensions may have more interesting things inside them.
cons: People will want you to continuously make dimensions for them.
Cannot make dimensions smaller than the enclosed space.
Have to have some stuff in enclosed space or you'll just get a big empty box.

name: Accelerating Thinking Process
overview: think faster and faster as time goes by.
description: One with this ability has a thinking process that keeps accelerating, allowing them to think more and more in the same amount of time. As a side effect, their movements get faster -- as fast as humanly possible though, so do their reflexes and reactions, and they can readjust their movements in a split second, allowing them to have very precise movements. After a while, their thinking process gets so fast their perception of time is slowed down, allowing them even more time to think.
pros: You get more and more time to think thoroughly.
You could clearly see the speedsters' movements, allowing you to block and evade them.
You could do impressive acrobatic moves, as you can readjust your movements while in motion.
cons: Passive ability. You need active concentration to slow down your thinking process to a human level.
You consume more energy, so you need to eat and rest more.
Your body cannot get superhumanly fast,. So, after a while, your body will seem slow to you.

name: Visual Muscle Replication
overview: perform any feat you can imagine.
description: With this power, whatever you imagine you can do in your head. Your body will do it. For example: you see a Jackie Chan feat that you want to do plus a few more of your own added. Now you can do it. This power is limited to your flexibility and realisticness. So you can't fly.
pros: Your muscle will be A LOT stronger. You bone will be lighter too.
Got pushed of a building, you'll be fine. Just imagine how you will land, your body will do it.
Do cool stuff, like qua-tripple spin on a skateboard even though you nerver skateboard before
cons: You can't do superheroes feat. So if you want to jump like spider man, you''ll be like him for 2 sec

name: Fortune Cookie
overview: make a fortune cookie with anything written in it come true
description: Tired of having bad luck or not having any date? Well lucky you! With this power, you can create any fortune cookie with anything written and whoever reads it will be affected. For example: Mom reads a fortune cookie stating "You will become hot and sexy" and poof!! You got a hot and sexy mother. Be warned though, the effects are permanent.
pros: Be a wonderful match-maker
Have everyone's mother become hot and sexy
Be worshipped as the Fortune Cookie God
cons: Might want some "Unwanted Effects"
Can't use on yourself more than once a day
Might read the words "fat and ugly"

name: Overdrive
overview: change the cellular constitution of the body to function faster
description: The user of this ability can change the cellular constitution of their own body to function faster or better, for example, change muscle cells to red blood cells for faster circulation. Or to change white blood cells to muscle cells, effectively making themself stronger but prone to more diseases. Changing cell constitution burns energy. They can also transform into an Overdrive body, making themself 300% more efficient, stronger and faster.
pros: Can change cellular constitution to become faster or stronger.
Overdrive Mode can make your other powers 300% more efficient and powerful.
Cellular regeneration is possible for skilled users.
cons: Changing your cells burns energy so you have to eat a lot.
You can change too many of your cells, if unskilled, which is dangerous.
If you stay in Overdrive Mode too long, you will die from lack of energy.

name: Overclocking
overview: increase your own abilities beyond your normal scope for a period of time with side effects later
description: A person with this power can increase their own abilities both natural and or superpowers for a period of time in exchange for side effects later. For example using this power you can increase your strength past its limit or increase your stamina and concentration. You can also increase the computing power of your brain. If you have superpowers you can also increase their power using this ability. The user receives a backlash of fatigue and hunger after using this ability.
pros: Increase your abilities when you need it the most
Decrease time needed to train or study in exchange for fatigue later
You can control how much you are overclocking and can tell when the backlash occurs
cons: Backlash some time after use of this power
If you overuse this ability it is bad for your health

name: Utopian Hallucination
overview: cause someone to believe they are in their personal utopia
description: With this power you can cause someone to believe that they are in their personal utopia. As far as they are concerned, the world is their definition of perfect and nothing is bad or wrong. However in reality it is all in their head and the person's body remains in a coma like state until you free them. You cannot use this power against yourself and a person with this power cannot be subjected to it.
pros: You can cause a person to believe they are in utopia
Non-violent takedowns
cons: It is all in their head.
Victim is placed in a coma

name: Arceusforce: Sky
overview: channel the power of Arceus's Flying form.
description: The user of this ability can channel the power of the heavens of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Flying-type. The user's skin turns periwinkle, their irises turn white and pupils turn sky blue. Under their avian guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Flying-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Flying attacks such as Aerial Ace, Drill Peck, Brave Bird, Hurricane and more.
pros: The user can resist supernatural combat, insect and plant-based attacks. Immune to earth attacks.
Generation and manipulation of wind and avian aura to use Flying attacks.
The user gains feathered wings to fly like a bird.
cons: The user is weak to electric, mineral and ice-based attacks.
This power may be too powerful for the user. Might also require to be unlocked from the default form
If grounded, the user can be hit by earthen attacks.

name: Karma Manipulation
overview: manipulate other people's karma.
description: Now, this ability is the ability to manipulate others' karma, that means that you can make good things or bad things happen to someone, for example if someone is good to you, you can just concentrate on good things happening to them, and then they'll like win on dozens of scratch tickets, or if they are bad to you you can think bad things and their car will crash, but they never die, and there are some rules, bad things will only happen to them if they deserve it.
pros: You can control others karma.
You can reward or punish people who deserve it.
cons: You don't know how it will happen, you can only chose whether it is bad or good.
If they are not bad people, and you try to make bad things happen to them, it will go back onto you.
You cannot change your own karma only other people's.

name: Electrokinesis
overview: generate & manipulate electricity
description: With this power, you can create and command electricity in any form. You can hurl lightning bolts, recharge your appliances etc.
pros: Dead batteries? Not anymore.
If you generate your own electricity, power companies can't steal as much of your money.
Good in a fight. Especially if you can control the voltage well.
cons: I imagine swimming won't be fun.
Can be pretty deadly to those around if you lose control.
When you run out of power...

name: Resurrection
overview: come back to life after you die
description: Able to come back to life fully healed after you have died
pros: Can do whatever you want without fear of death
Live forever
cons: Have to see loved ones die

name: Transduction
overview: change one form of energy to another
description: The user is able to convert any form of energy in equal amount to any other form he pleases.  Using the power drains/depletes his surrounding of the energy he absorbs. The user needs a constant supply of energy and cannot store it. He also is helpless in a environment without energy. At the height of his ability, he is able to use atomic power. But overuse or a lack of energy in the envir causes a residual antimatter, a dangerous entity, unless the energy is replaced within 5 minutes.
pros: Use energy forms according to situation
Can use any form of a particular energy
Manipulate and discharge in any way he pleases
cons: Cannot function in energy depleted environment
Can use equal amount only
Can't create energy

name: Instant Hypnosis
overview: unleash ultrasonic waves from your eyes then to control people affected
description: You'll be able to stand and emit hypnotic waves from your eyes. If the waves hit the opponent then they shall start to walk up to you, then they let you command them to do whatever you want.
pros: You can tell them their most secrets.
cons: It'll wear off once they snapped out or splahed on with water.

name: Copy Cat
overview: copy any power you hear, or see.
description: Copy cat is exactly as it is titled. You can copy any power that you see, or hear about within a matter of seconds. However, you can only copy cat 25 powers before it disappears, and you are unable to copy any more powers, so you have to be careful about which powers you want to copy.
pros: Can have multiple powers
Can choose which powers you want to copy
cons: It takes you longer than most to master each power
You must HEAR or SEE this power in use
With each power you take in, this power itself gets weaker

name: Youth Manipulation
overview: change how old or young a person looks or acts
description: This power allows alteration of how old or young a person looks or acts. For example, you could make a ten year old suddenly have an aching back or make yourself 21 for the rest of eternity. You can also subtly change how they think. For example, you can make someone in their 90s slowly over the course of weeks or months think like they did as a toddler.
pros: You can live forever by making your body look the same age constantly.
Using this on an annoying classmate or teacher.
cons: If you can't undo the effects.
If you can't control the effects of this power for some reason.

name: Earth Bio Power
overview: have the abilities of every living species on earth-(all naturally occuring powers)
description: With this power you have the ability of every species on Earth and you also have powers of viruses as well. A person with this power has unlocked his own genetic code giving him every ability possible by genetic manipulation. They can access all biologically possible powers within nature including flight. However the user is blocked off from powers not observed in nature, such as telekinesis.
pros: You can access all the powers naturally occuring in nature
You will have immunity to diseases and viruses-since you have their powers as well
You still look human-but can shape shift to gain body parts like wings or extra arms
cons: Cannot use any other power-this one power is already too powerful
Can still be beaten by superpowered means or by technological means

name: Titanium Scale Skin
overview: have titanium skin covered with scales
description: Your skins changes to chrome Titanium and grows titanium scales all over the body except on the head, hands and feet. A tail with scales might also grow depending on the person but when changing back to human form, the tail disappears. The skin also provides great invunerability and durability. There are also 5 retractable claws on each hand.
pros: Enhanced invunerability and durability
Great agility and speed
Claws can slice through anything except for titanium armour
cons: Difficult to learn how to use a tail

name: Mechassimilation
overview: bond metal parts, or machines of any kind to your body in the form of armor or weapons
description: Bond with any metal or metallic object within 800 yards, pulling them to you from a distance. The metal parts will wrap around your body by themselves as they bond to you, attaching and arranging themselves according to your thoughts. You can also dismantle other machines for more parts, and not just metal itself. You can combine those machines to your body WITHOUT disassembling them, and become a Transformer! Physics still affects you however, so be careful how much metal you bond with!
pros: Bonding with machines is a better idea than just raw metal, as you can strengthen your body.
Metal bonded to your body becomes almost a second skin, and will not come off. Great for protection!
Iron Man made easy! Make yourself a battlesuit made entirely of android parts by mere thought!
cons: Intense psychic control and focus is needed to draw in metal from a distance.
Metal broken, or severed from your body in any way cannot be salvaged, and must be replaced.
Dismantling a working machine renders it useless, and after that, can only be used for parts.

name: External Duplication
overview: create a copy of almost anything you are in physical contact with.
description: Can copy anything you are in physical contact with that does not exceed 15ftx15ft(objects exceeding will be created incomplete). While in contact with object you perform a "psychic scan" which creates an identical copy that is stored within your subconscious, and can be recreated anytime you wish.
pros: Infinite resources (Water, Food, Money, Weapons, Fuel)
Recreate precious/rare items (Antimatter, Superpowered Items)
Never need to carry anything on you (Entire wardrobes, sheds full of items, etc.)
cons: Remembering everything you store! Be sure to write it all down just in case.
Copying a broken/potentially dangerous object ex. A leaking nuclear missle.
Can only create any item if there is enough space for it to appear in.

name: Elemental Plane
overview: have a connection to an elemental plane of your choice.
description: With this power you gain a connection with an elemental plane of your choice. You can enter and exit the elemental plane at will and create portals to bring objects across. The elementals inside the elemental plane will not try to harm you but you will have to tame them to get them to follow your commands. You can also craft elemental artifacts while within the elemental plane. Lastly you will be able to use elemental magic that is connected to your elemental plane.
pros: Able to open portals to enter and exit an elemental plane.
Have the ability to tame elementals and craft artifacts.
Can develope an ability to use elemental magic for the elemental plane.
cons: Can only connect to one type of elemental plane and cannot change.
Have to be able to tame elementals.
Takes time to develope powers and craft strong artifacts.

name: Mental Capacity
overview: surpass your mental capacity/limitations
description: By surpassing your mental capacity/limitations, you gain what some would call "psychic abilities" such as moving things with your mind (including yourself), mental communication/influence, telekinetic forcefield, and spiritual detection (dead or alive). The telekinesis has a weight/size limit of that equal to two large automobiles, but with practice, you can lift more weight/size. You must know the person you are mentally communicating with/influencing.
pros: Moving things with your mind (including yourself)
Mental communication/influence
Telekinetic forcefield, and spiritual detection (dead or alive)
cons: You must know the person you are mentally communicating with/influencing
Telekinesis has a weight/size limit (but with practice, you can lift more weight/size)

name: Calculated Moves
overview: make precise calculated moves in combat
description: When in danger or combat situation, your mind analyzes calculates the surrounding are in a nanosecond or less. You instantly scan the area & opponents & determine the best course of action. From punching physics like how much strength to put in & the damage it will do to throwing something or shooting. Its like you have Terminator eyes to some extent. You won't have different imaging settings like x-ray, night vision or thermal etc. Just split second decision making processor.
pros: You're a human strategic super computer
cons: Your mind is the only thing advanced really. No other superhuman attributes.

name: Psychic Seismic Shockwaves
overview: send invisble and destructive shockwaves with your mind
description: By hold one's index fingers to the temples, closing the eytes and focusing, you can unleash a powerful, devastating shockwave across the land and not be injuried by it. The shockwaves have a ripple effect an are similiar to earthquakes and tremors.
pros: Shockwaves are devastatingly powerful
Shockwaves can't physically injure you
You can control the power and distance of the wave
cons: Horrible headaches can come from doing it too much
Physical and mental energy will eventually drain if done too much, causing mental strain.
Being stressed and distressed helps with the power.

name: Kinesis Adaptation
overview: gain different "kinesis" powers based on the materials one touches
description: Kinesis Adaptation, also called Adaptive Kinesis is a variation of Reactive Adaptation in which the user's "kinesis" power changes, based on the materials he comes into contact with; if the user were to touch water, he would gain the power to manipulate water (the power to manipulate fire if he touched fire, and so on). However, if the user touched an obscure material, he could choose between just manipulating that substance/material/element and going back to normal Telekinesis
pros: Touch water, control water; touch fire, control fire, and so on
Touch the most prevalent element in one's environment (never at a total disadvantage in fights)
Also gain adaptations against that element (water: aquatic adaptation, fire: fire resistance, etc. )
cons: One element at a time
If an object has Telesthetic Immunity, you can't control it
No touching people to control them (unless the power is HIGHLY developed)

name: Children Of Absorption
overview: absorb the energy and/or power of someone/something
description: You can take someone's powers by touching them. You can also absorb energy like heat or light(ning). At most, you can absorb/hold two kinds of energy and one power at a time. By default, all people who have this power have deep purple eyes and purple colored blood.
pros: Absorb anyone's power just by touching them
Absorb energies like heat or light(ning) and mix them up to create deadly/original powers
Get cool purple eyes and purple blood by having this power
cons: Could be identified as a Child of Adaptation by your purple eyes and blood
Have to touch the material, person, or energy to get absorb other powers
Get purple eyes and purple blood by having this power (very noticeable)

name: Consequence Manipulation
overview: manipulate or negate the effects of your or anyone else's actions or decision.
description: What happens if you didn't study for a test and you  knew you are going to fail? This ability makes your cause "Not studying for a test", and changes the effect "getting an F" to "getting an A". If the consequence is negative like that, you or someone else will suffer another kind of way. This works on your decisions as well. This ability can even negate effects from anyone's actions or decisions. In short, nothing will happen no matter what anyone does.
pros: Able to make positive consequences more enjoyable.
Able to change the effect of your actions.
cons: Might suffer if you change a negative consequence to a positive consequence.
Only works if action or decision has been made.

name: Shadow Controlling
overview: control all shadows and make them have essence (they are able to hold stuff or crush people)
description: Control all shadows and make them have essence (they are able to hold stuff or crush people or move poeple if they have shadows on them). You can completely control them, making your range limitless. You are at your strongest at night and your weakest in the middle of the day. Your shadow DOES NOT have to be touching other shadows to control them.
pros: Can crush people.
Can pick stuff up with an extra set of extendable hands (shadows).
Nearly invincible if you wrap your shadow around yourself.
cons: Your shadow can never be an exact copy of you.
There has to be a little bit of light for anything to throw a shadow
Shadows can follow you around.

name: Power Of The Fruit
overview: have different powers depending on what fruit you eat at the beginning of the day
description: The user is able to gain different powers depending on what fruit he or she eats at the beginning of the day. Apples give superstrenght, oranges give invulnerability, bananas give elasticity, peaches give flight, pears give superspeed. Must be the real deal, no vitamin supplements or pills etc.
pros: Good because different type of powers
Good at preventing scurvy
cons: Might not have time to eat the fruits
Might not like the fruit

name: Body Armory
overview: transform any part of your body into a weapon.
description: Using this power you can make every part of your body turn into a different weapon. You can turn your arm into a sword, your leg into a AK-47, your tongue into a Colt... Any limb and any weapon! BUT, the bullets must be made of something, like your bones, and when you shoot a bone bullet on someone it will take time until this bone grows back again. This ability is very useful, but you might kill yourself if you turn your head into a bazooka, so be careful.
pros: Infinite weapon choices, mutiple weapons at the same time
You are never unarmed.
Reload very fast
cons: Some weapons are heavy.
You use part of your body as bullets (or arrows, or missiles... ) too.
You can kill yourself turning a specific part of your body into some weapons (like a bazooka).

name: Trait Replication
overview: replicate the traits of other people
description: Lets say you envy one persons looks, another persons personality, another persons talent, and another persons skills & abilities. With this power, you can replicate all of those traits from other people. Also, for physical traits, you could take one persons say, face and body structure and another persons eye, hair, and skin color/tone.
pros: Replicate peronality traits, physical traits, and more
cons: May end up looking or acting too similar to somebody else
Just traits, no superpowers

name: Realitive Alteration
overview: change attacks and actions into illusions, and thoughts into attacks
description: Your enemy's attacks are turned into illusion and your thoughts or tricks and illusions become real attacks. This means that, while affected by this, even death becomes an illusion. This also means that your own thoughts can become attacks of a certain power level. Some powers can evade this and this does not always allow you to evade attacks or make them.
pros: Specialized version of Power of Imagination
Win a fight unharmed by standing still
Mastery of this lets your chance of succes increase.
cons: Does not always work.
Some powers can evade you or attack beyond time.
No concentration/imagination

name: Sleep On It
overview: gain any knowledge and information a book can give by sleeping on it
description: You need to study for the big test tomorrow but you have to hit the hay? With this power, all you have to do is put the book you want to gain knowledge from under or on top of your pillow, even in your pillow case is fine, or by using the book as a pillow. If it is the kind of book you need to find the meaning of what the author is trying to say, you'll know it immediately. It'll practically be second nature.
pros: Be an amazing cook and make food just like in the pictures
Detailed understanding of history and various famous texts
Learn skills, like operating and repairing from entire medical textbooks
cons: Your head might get sore from sleeping on a book
Only works on books
Unlikely, but you might get a book with false information.

name: Martial Arts Master
overview: learn and master martial arts far quicker than a normal person
description: You have the power to have an intimate knowledge of the inner workings of fighting styles and as such, you can learn them at an incredible pace. At the higher levels, you can mesh fighting styles together to become nigh undefeatable.
pros: Don't need lots of time to learn fighting styles
Can combine fighting styles at higher levels
If getting beaten, you can change to a different fighting style
cons: Useless at long range
You have to fully concentrate to learn the martial arts
It is not instant mastery

name: Golden Feeling
overview: exude gold and jewels from your body whenever you're experiancing positive emotions..
description: Every time you're feeling happy, exited, love, or any old good feeling, jewels and sheets of gold will emerge from your body on your chest, back, legs, or along your arms. The process is painless, and your skin looks as though the wealth was never there at all once removed. The amount generated depends on the intensity of the positive feeling, and will be continual so long as you are experiencing it.
pros: A positive person will get almost constant money.
You're safe from kidnappers looking to use you because you only create goild when happy.
It extream cases, the wealth can act as natural armor.
cons: A negative person would not get much use out of this power.
A positive person will also have to scrape themselvs off regularly.

name: Super Contingency Effect
overview: generate a positive effect to make any failed action succeed.
description: This ability is great for those who are those classic bumbler or failures. This ability can turn there actions of disaster to actions of success. The user is able to create a supernatural effect that makes their failed actions succeed. For example,say the user throws an object at someone, but it failed. His ability will create an effect to make it work. The effect could be like a burst of energy that bounces the object back the target. I said it would be supernatural not subtle.
pros: Make any action succeed
Learn how to weaponize it
It could manifest in many ways, even in the form of a temporary ability
cons: Can be difficult to fail if you want to

name: Energy Blasts
overview: shoot energy from every part of your body
description: Energy Blasts power alows you to create energy, blast energy, and create weapons with energy. For example: if your dad's boat hit a rock, you can lift the boat off the rock, AND patch up the hole. Or say a giant robot is wrecking the city: you can trip it, pin it down, then slice it down with an energy sword. Some techniques take practice.
pros: You can make weapons.
You can make energy shields.
cons: You still need to train.
You can't always control it

name: Reflective Teleportation
overview: teleport from any reflective surface to another reflective surface.
description: With contact, the user can easily move from a mirror, a puddle of water, a tile or anything else that they can see themselves in to any other reflective surface in existence.
pros: Can easily be almost anywhere
Water can be enough of a reflective surface to teleport through
cons: Moving surfaces create problems
You may not know where you are
Some places lack reflective surfaces

name: Universal Bonding
overview: merge and de-merge anything and everything to ones self
description: The ability to merges with things such a animals, objects and elements, allowing wielder of power to enhance senses manipulate the elements and completely enhance body.
pros: Insane speed and strength
Near indestructible
Can control any thing around you
cons: Share the weaknesses of what you merged with
Body mutates to a hybrid of the merge
Uses allot of energy

name: Mitosis Manipulation
overview: control the process by which cells divide and replicate.
description: This power(also called Mitokinesis) gives the user total control over mitosis(the division and replication of cells). The user can speed up, slow down, concentrate, make efficient, halt, and even REVERSE mitosis in themselves or others. This allows the user to rapidly regenerate as well as harm others by undoing their mitosis or stop people who shapeshift by mitosis. You can even make mitosis more efficient to heal wounds in seconds or slow the aging process down.
pros: Heal AND slow the aging process in yourself and others.
Easily wound a foe by reversing the multiplication of their cells to create whole new wounds.
Concentrate mitosis in one place for quick healing or repair.
cons: If your foe has a biological manipulation power.
Most shapeshifters dont rely on mitosis.
In the beginning only basic manipulaation can be done.

name: Endermic Healing
overview: heal someone through contact with the skin
description: This ability can cure any disease, illness, or injury, but your skin must come into contact with the injured person's skin. Also, it is involutary until you learn to control it
pros: Others are healed to perfect health
cons: Does not work on self
Must be able to touch other person
Is involuntary at first

name: Shadow Speed
overview: able to move exceedingly fast within shadows
description: It is best used at night or in a forest where shadows or darkness are predominate. While in shadows/darkness you have the ability of super speed.
pros: If your wearing black you're almost invisible
Can attack without being seen due to the stealth of the shadows/darkness
Great move for ninjas (let's face it who doesn't like ninjas)
cons: Does not work in light, only in shadows

name: Omnistrength
overview: be the strongest person alive
description: You make the gods look like little girl guides. You'll be the strongest person alive and break the unbreakable. This power does not have any effects on how much damage you can withstand. So, if you try to flick steel, it will break, but you will break a nail and feel pain. To deal with your superior muscle, your skin is harder and is very difficult to pierce (you still feel pain). Your bones can also withstand the pressure of heavy lifting
pros: Stronger than an army of Kryptonians
A bullet to the face wouldn't kill you
You'll never break a bone
cons: If you get internal injuries, you can't go into surgery
You still feel pain
More with this power (evenly strong) or One Upmanship-esque abilities (they are stronger)

name: Card Stack Abilities: Queen
overview: completely control space
description: Access the power of the elemental spirit of space in order to completely control the third dimension. Create wormholes out of thin air and alter the space around an object to make it explode or compress into an atom. Create barriers out of space or warp to a different area to avoid an attack. Basically anything that involves space, you have control over it.
pros: The ability to warp anywhere you want.
Absolute control over space.
Make your enemies compress or explode with a single thought.
cons: Accidentally destroying everything around you because of a space distortion
People with the Card Stack Ability: Jester are not affected by your powers
Con 2 is only valid when they are of an equal of higher power level.

name: Kinetic Deflection
overview: create impenetrable force field that deflects any exerted kinetic force with greater power
description: Your body is surrounded with an impenetrable force field. When kinetic force is exerted onto you, say a bullet shot at you, the force field absorbs that exerted force energy & deflects it with a greater kinetic force. So that bullet shot at you bounces off you & shot another way with greater momentum. Making it a super bullet. This is also applied to attacks. Sending the assailant flying back.
pros: Nigh invunerable
cons: Your exerted force is not amplified

name: Energy Armor
overview: create armor, weapons, and other things out of pure energy around yourself
description: You can create a field of energy around yourself which forms into different kinds of armor, any kind of weapon, or an animal shape around you. If you make a bird shape, then you can fly, and if you're injured badly then the energy will form a shield around you that will heal you. The armor is almost completely invulnerable, and while you're in it then your mind will come out of your body and you will control the armor.
pros: You can heal while in the armor
The armor and weapons almost impenetrable/ unbreakable
You can gain the ability of whatever you are, so if you take a bird form you can fly.
cons: YOU get an out-of-body experience so when you go back it feels weird
THe problem is the one thing that can break it
Sometimes you can't control it from turning on

name: Starlight Hero
overview: produce luminous energy blasts of plasma and augment your strength by absorbing heat and radiation.
description: When activated, you acquire the abilities to travel at incredible speeds and blast enemies with rays of light. You can also intensify your strength by absorbing heat and various types of radiations, such as UV rays (ultraviolet rays), thermal, solar, etc. The more radiation you absorb the more you grow in strength, speed, power, and durability alike. Not only is this power offensive but also defensive; you can shield yourself and others with a starlight shield.
pros: Explode into a nova and quickly draw yourself back together.
Travel at lightspeed and send enemies packing with "nova punches"
Cannot gain cancer from radiation.
cons: Nova explosions around civilians. (need I say more? )

name: Persuasion
overview: persuade a living thing to believe whatever you tell them
description: You may make any living thing believe what you say. You may make them do what you tell them, however, you may not interfere with free will or true love.
pros: They'll believe anything you say!
cons: You must be either looking them in the eye or touching them to persuade them.

name: 10x Thinking Speed
overview: think 10 times faster than normal
description: You can think ten times faster than you do now. So, what takes you one minute to think about now will be thought through in six seconds. You will not necessarily reach better conclusions, but you'll get there faster.
pros: Outsmart your enemies!
Beat the calculator!
cons: You might come across as a besserwisser...

name: Mnemonic Telekinesis
overview: have telekinetic powers through memories of characters from tv, movies, and books who have it
description: This ability lets you gain the telekinetic powers of any fictional character who has it, from TV, books, and movies. You immediately gain their power when you think of them, and have it permanently, although it can be suppressed at will, but never lost. If you have a photographic memory, and thus recall the character and his/her abilities easily, you will gain the power more easily as a result. You can even create power combinations(Johnny Drake/Sylar, Jean Grey/Grant Borrows, etc.).
pros: Having a photographic memory allows easy access and use of this ability
Have the same level of control as the character(s) you think of
A user cannot be harmed by their own power, and can also choose to pass immunity to others
cons: A very dangerous power in the wrong hands
You cannot gain the powers of someone you don't remember clearly

name: Lawless
overview: break any law, free of consequences.
description: Laws are very pesky things. This power is like a law-begone. It allows you to break ANY law, without facing any consequences. Depending on what kind of law you're breaking, this power will act in different ways. Saying you are robbing a store. This might erase the memories of your face or simply blur your image while commiting the crime. But this doesn't stop there. You can also break physical laws, like gravity and friction. If you are daring, you might go as far as breaking the universal laws.
pros: Never, ever get in trouble.
Can consciously choose which law you want to break.
cons: You never know how exactly this power might save you from the consequences

name: Second Thoughts
overview: take back a previous action.
description: Let's say you were shot by a gun, still awake, and you just want to go back to that last moment and change it! It's sort of like time travel only more limited. You cannot go back thousands of years in the past to change some large event, only a minute is your limit. You will be able to do the same fight with someone countless times, memorizing their every move, feeling no pain after traveling back, eventually winning. A TV villain weakling did this on Batman and won, making a fool of him.
pros: Eventually win almost every fight.
Even the best fall eventually
You are the only one with knowledge of this displacement.
cons: You cannot perform this ability if you die, so avoid explosions.
If a fight is inevitable no matter what you do , you'll always lose.
The shame of having to do a fight hundreds of times to win it.

name: Superhuman Awareness
overview: be perfectly aware of your surroundings
description: Falling. Tripping. Missing the last step on the stairs. Missing the first step on the stairs. Superhuman Awareness ensures that its holder never has to worry about these things. A person with it can sense where everything around them is, and how far away it is. This grants them an amazing sense of balance, extraordinary accuracy (judging distances), and a good idea of all weapons and exits. With time, this ability can sense weaknesses. However, this ability needs at least a glance at the area.
pros: Enhanced accuracy (accurate distance judging)
Enhanced balance (know just how much to lean)
A good idea of where the exit is
cons: Requires at least a glance at the area
No other superhuman attributes
Might not be able to dodge in time still

name: Happenchance
overview: make the odds of something happening a lot greater.
description: This power increases the odds of something happening by 50%. With this power, you can have limited control over luck and chance. However, you can only use this power ONCE PER DAY. Using this power does not guarantee that the perceived event will happen, but increases the chance of it happening by a significant amount.
pros: Increases the chance that certain things will happen.
This is limited tychokinesis.
This power is very controllable and reversible.
cons: You can only use it once per day.
No guarantee that the perceived event will happen.
Results may vary*

name: Interruption Inducement
overview: induce, cause, or materialize anything with the purpose to interrupt anything.
description: This ability allows a user induce interruptions. Example, if you were about to be blasted by someone's energy attack, this ability can interrupt that by any means necessary before the attack is made, may it be a tree falling on the attacker or reality changing. The inducement can change into materializing when needed. This is a passive ability most of the time, but if you master it, you have a good chance to activate it when you focus.
pros: Interrupt any attack
Interrupt any process or progress
Interrupt any unwanted conversation
cons: Might be interrupted by your own ability at times, if you don't master it.

name: Mind Control Immunity
overview: be immune to all forms of non-mundane mind control.
description: With this power, you are immune to any and all forms of mind control, provided they are not mundane in nature. You are not, however, immune to hypnosis, persuasion or temptation, at least as long as they are not superhuman in nature (the power of persuasion, for instance, would count as mind control). However, mundane forms of mind control still work, so you must remain wary of such things.
pros: Immunity to mind control.
Complements Selective Temptation Immunity perfectly.
Passive.
cons: Only works against mind control.
Only works if the form of mind control is superpower or magic based.
Like all powers, this can be compromised in various ways, so do not rely on it entirely.

name: Likeness Control
overview: control your own likenesses.
description: This powers user is able to control any likenesses of themselves such as shadows, reflections, pictures, live video etc. Independently from their true body by locking "eyes" with it. These likenesses can interact fully with the likenesses of alike thing to affect them, such as the user's shadow strangling another man's shadow resulting in the other man's death. Only one likeness may be controlled like this at a time. After you give up control, the likenesses go back to their normal places.
pros: Attack from infinate range so long as you have something depicting your target and you.
Confuse people by making a picture move, or you in a video do something different.
Statues of yourself can be controled in this manner.
cons: You must lock eyes, or a rough approzimation of where they would be, with a likeness to control it.
Likenesses in picture and video will only be able to affect things that are on screen with them.
A likeness has to be recognizable you in order for you to take control of it. No stick figures.

name: Superhuman Ingenuity
overview: have superhuman skill in devising solutions to problems
description: What would you do if stuck in a kitchen with heat-seeking death robots? Well, if you had Superhuman Ingenuity, you would light some paper, stick it to the robots with fridge magnets, and leave. People with this ability can see the connections between objects in a subconscious way. So in a situation, they can combine an aerosol and a lighter(a torch), or a sock and bar of soap(a flail), or cayenne pepper, vinegar, and baking soda(some tear gas)without even thinking. MacGyver would be proud.
pros: Never be at a loss
Everything is a weapon
Impress people by fixing their car with a dozen eggs
cons: No other superhuman attributes
May be bugged by needy people
May be tempted to use abilities for mischief

name: Deus Ex Machina
overview: produce a "miracle" to get you out of an impossible situation
description: "God from the machine" is what it means. When you're trapped in an inescapable dangerous situation, you just yell out "Deus ex machina" & a person or thing will appear out of nowhere & help you out. In simple terms, its a "get out of jail free card"
pros: A reality bending power that gets you out of trouble
cons: Must yell out "Deus ex machina" to work

name: One Man Army
overview: preform many tasks and have the abilities, knowledge and the minds of army personnel
description: You'll have the mind of a hardened soldier, the brain of a army technician,the body of a perfect soldier. And with your vast combat skills and creativity you would be able to take down multiple opponents with your knowledge on fighting, creating weapons, defusing bombs, creating bombs and weapons out of simple materials, tactics, pyschology. The army always develops so anything new will instantly be yours. You also have a rank of 5 star general, so you will have the perks they get.
pros: Make weapons out of practically anything
Become a great ally
cons: Become a great foe

name: Ability Resistance Adaptation
overview: adapt to super-powers used against you.
description: With this ability, you adapt from superpowers used against you. For example, if someone with Pyrokinesis hit you with flame, it would increase your resistance to it. Being attacked again would make you invulnerable to that attack. If your foe decided to attack you a third time, your body would adapt to using it as a fuel, and instead absorb the attack, giving you power and energy. Using it against you again would allow you to harness that ability to an extent.
pros: Adapt to super-powers used against you.
For each time it is used against you, you adapt to that ability. The adaptations are below.
1. Resistance. 2. Invulnerability. 3. Absorption. 4. Ability to harness the superpower.
cons: No effect if the ability used on you is beneficial.
You only gain the adaptation after you've been struck.
You can still be harmed if knocked out in the first 2 strikes.

name: Shadowy Retreat
overview: jump into the shadows to completely restore your condition.
description: With this ability, when engulfed in darkness, you have the ability to vanish, and reappear nearby in perfect condition. This eliminates any harm you may have taken, or any illnesses you may have. It does not, however, have the ability to restore broken or lost bones.
pros: The shadows are now your friend. Hurray :)
cons: Being badly injured on a sunny day. :(

name: Mind Reader
overview: know what other people are thinking.
description: With this ability, you can read others' thoughts.  Anything the person is immediately thinking is accessible to you.
pros: Know what people's true intentions are
Raid the casinos!
Like Mel Gibson, you can potentially bang Helen Hunt
cons: Sometimes, ignorance is bliss
You might read someone's thoughts and ruin the plot to a good movie
Revealing secrets you didn't want to know about

name: Symbiotic Armor
overview: wear a symbiotic armor that gives the wearer information as well as suggestions
description: The symbiotic armor has the ability to give information as well as suggestions to the person who is wearing it. Another feature of this armor is that when the user of this armor is in danger, the armor will automatically form around the user in armor-mode. The armor also has the ability to self regenerate and repair itself.
pros: Symbiotic in nature
Can't die easily
Armor is self regenerating
cons: No superhuman capabilities

name: Energy Control
overview: turn energy around you into immense power
description: you can turn the slightest amount of energy around you into any force in any universe. You can use it to travel through time and space. You could transfer it through the elements. Tranfer energy into immense strength and/or agility and any other power you desire.
pros: you could control time and space
you could control the elements around you
you could turn it into any power you heart desires
cons: It weakens your body physically
With all that power you might go crazy
You could become evil and be hated by the world and the universe

name: Create Cosmic Gizmo
overview: create cosmic objects that only work for you and have certain powers.
description: With this power, you could hold together with rubber bands an egg beater and a box knife and control gravity. This power will give your gizmos control or manipulation powers. Gizmos can also have powers like time travel, force field, teleportation, quantum intangibility or any similar powers. Your gizmo must have one moving part and you must be turning this part to make the gizmo work. The Imagination Crusher power will stop this power. Technology control powers won't work on any gizmo you make.
pros: Gadgets that only work for you and are unaffected by technology control powers.
Control the forces of the universe with things found in your home.
cons: The Imagination Crusher power.
If you can't think like a child, this power may not work.
Someone who could paralyze you.

name: Orb
overview: teleport in a flash of blue sparkles. You can also teleport items toward you.
description: It is called orbing. You can orb out of the room or across the world. You can stand in front of a book, hold out your hand and say "book" and tada! It's in your hand.
pros: Go almost anywhere.
Get things that are out of reach.
Doesn't waste time with walking.
cons: Anti-Orb spell will cancel out the effect.
Needs time to master.

name: Speed Of Thought
overview: go as fast as you can process information
description: A person with this power can go at the speed of thought. The faster you think the faster you can go. If this is attempted you can go as fast and maybe even faster than baseballs and cars since you can process their speed in your head. Basically if you can see an object/know where it is you can go as fast or faster than it since your thoughts can process where it is meaning that your thoughts are faster than said object/person.
pros: The faster you think the faster you are
Even if you can't think very fast this still makes you faster than normal
You can practice mental training to increase your speed
cons: Not as fast as speed of light(unless you can think that fast)
If someone/thing moves faster than you can think such as a bullet

name: Aura Powers
overview: use your human aura as energy to attack and/or heal others.
description: Everybody has an aura surrounding them, this ability allows you to use it as a blast of energy and the ability to heal others, and to float/fly by repelling the aura around you (kinda like a magnet repels like poles). Also, you can use it as a form of a weak telekinetic attack by repelling the person's aura hard enough.
pros: The blast of energy can create heat or have charecteristics of fire.
The blast of energy can also freeze things or have characteristics of a freezing power.
You can heal people and yourself quickly by "healing the aura." Also, you can fly by repelling auras
cons: It's more for the "hero" type, so if you use your power for evil you might not like it.
You cannot instantly heal someone. It takes about a half hour to completely heal someone,

name: Mirror Portals
overview: use mirrors as portals to get to other mirrors
description:
In the same style as using Floo powder to get from fireplace to fireplace in Harry Potter, this power allows you to enter mirrors and teleport instantly into another mirror of your choice. 
Training would allow you to use less and less reflective surfaces; windows, puddles, TV screens, pianos, the possibilities are endless!
pros: You can easily get away from your foes, especially if you always carry a waist-size mirror with you.
If you only put your eye through the mirror, you can spy on others.
You can build a secret warehouse that is only accessible with a mirror.
cons: Mirrors are usually only found in bathrooms.
The mirror has to be big enough for you to fit through; it better not break!
For it to be really useful you'll have to carry a heavy mirror around with you.

name: Cold Absorption
overview: absorb cold from surroundings and unleash absorbed cold
description: Though previously thought to be a violation of the laws of physics, one with this ability can literally absorb cold. If the particles in the air move slow enough that they only produce a temperature less than 70 degrees Fahrenheit, they can be absorbed into the body with no harm to the user. This makes room for warmer particles in the air (thus raising the temperature). In addition, the cold may be released at will as blasts of frigid "cold energy".
pros: Violate one of the laws of physics!
Good to raise the temperature in a cold place.
Release absorbed cold (radiating it from the skin, through a touch, or through Freezing Breath)
cons: Violate one of the laws of physics (Poor eggheads will go crazy trying to figure out how it's done)
Absorb too much, and lower-leves users could freeze.
Temperature manipulators can limit how much cold you have to absorb

name: Conditional Ability Bestowal
overview: grant abilities, with the consequence that ability-granted individuals fall under your control
description: This ability is certainly a boon. By giving someone superhuman abilities with this power, they in turn give you their undying allegiance (whether they want to or not). This can be used to make your power-bestowing finally do some work for you, instead of just letting all the other superhumans have all the fun.
pros: People get powers
People who get their powers from you also become loyal to you
The effect can be reversed (and redone if you regret the reversal)
cons: Cannot work on already-superpowered beings
If untrained, can't decide what powers they get
Sometimes requires contact

name: Reflective Invisibility
overview: turn yourself invisible by touching a mirror
description: This is a very interesting power to have. A person can turn themselves invisible, either partially or completely, by touching a mirror. The light around the person will be absorbed into their reflection, turning it into a shadow, but their real body will disappear. The person can still interact normally with objects, but people won't know they are there until the power is deactivated. This form of invisibility is exactly like Peter Petrelli's, but sound and thermal detection are impossible.
pros: Sneak up on enemies totally undetected!!
Works both day and night!
Scare people with a sinister shadow reflection!
cons: Cannot work with broken mirrors or pocket mirrors.
Can be weakened by both sunlight, and by electricity over 200 volts.
You are not invisible to others who have this power, or any light-based power.

name: Willpower Strength
overview: summon enormous amounts of strength by will
description: With this ability, you can gain infinite amounts of strength by will. The only limit to this power is this user's willpower. You can slap over trucks, put craters in steel, and possibly even move buildings.
pros: There's no limit to your strength
Top scores in P. E.
Great if you are strong willed
cons: You may be dangerous in fights, could possibly kill someone
If your will isn't strong, the ability will be powerful, but won't reach full potential
People may wonder how you can lift objects hundreds of times your body weight

name: Memory Control
overview: steal and erase other people's memories
description: You can steal and erase other people's memories. You can also recall any memory perfectly and never misremember. It works to a range of 4 feet away. You can steal others' memories to get whatever information others have and review their memories instantly
pros: You can make people forget themselves and you
You can tell when people are trying to tell you bull**** stories to you or lie
If the other person has had sex, it's like free porn
cons: Cameras will still remember you
If your girlfriend forgets you, it'll be really hard to get her in the sack
You might find memories you wish you hadn't

name: Tactile Power Counteraction
overview: build immunity to an attack by absorbing the enemy's power through physical contact
description: This is an extremely powerful form of immunity. A person can match, and thus nullify, any offensive power an enemy uses against them, such as pyrokinesis. If the enemy uses it on you, the moment you touch them, you will absorb the part of that person's power which grants them immunity, and thus be immune yourself.
pros: Once you absorb a person's power immunity, it is permanent!
Catch a foe off guard by faking your injury or death!
They cannot feel the absorption, and skin-to-skin contact isn't always necessary.
cons: This is a 'tactile' ability: You ALWAYS need to physically touch your opponent to activate it

name: Metamorphic
overview: increase combat abilities through metamorphisis
description: When activated by will, the user becomes a 'pupa' but does not physically change. However they are restricted in movement and are extremely vulnerable before they enter the 'cocoon' stage. The user is completely immobile until they become an 'adult'. Adult stage brings a massive increase in agility and attack power, and a modest increase in defensive abilities. The user evolves faster when near enemies. The buffs last for two days. Metamorphing can take up to one full week at its slowest.
pros: Long wait, but has a massive payoff in the end
Buffs don't go away for two full days and the cycle can be repeated immediately
cons: Faster evolution requires some risk
Completely helpless until adult stage is reached

name: Ability Manifestation Control
overview: manipulate how one's abilities manifest.
description: This ability allows one to control their ability in the way of how it emerges. There are many methods and ways an ability could manifest itself like through physical mutation, magic, interaction with a object/technology, or even through in enhancements. This ability makes the user summon their power through any of those methods or others. Since there are many methods, many abilities will be different. There is a time limit since you can only use one manifested ability at a time.
pros: Access new abilities through different methods.
Having an adaption ability would be useful
cons: Limited time use for each abiltiy
If you use the same method to manifest an ability, you only get the same ability as before.

name: Intermolecular Force Control
overview: control the strength by which matter clings to matter.
description: You can control how strongly or weakly matter clings to other matter. This ability isn't the ability to rearrange, destroy or create atoms and molecules. This is the ability to change the adhesion between objects. You could use this power on a fast running villain and all they'll do is run in place. You could climb up a wall made of frictionless material. You can keep a machine gun from firing or 'glue' someone's hands together. This power only works on solid matter.
pros: Guns or any thrown weapons are rendered useless against you.
You can make the most uneven surface slicker than ice.
You can 'glue' any solid object to the ground or a wall.
cons: Foes not made of solid matter.
Energy weapons.

name: Black Hole Breath
overview: suck in any living matter and absorb its talent, ability, or power.
description: With this ability, you can suck in any living matter and absorb its talent, ability, or power.
pros: Any power you find!
cons: None

name: Potential Channeling
overview: channel one's full potential into anything else.
description: This ability allows one to turn one's full potential into a form of powerful energy and infuse it to one part of their body, items, other people,  and abilities. This will make them very powerful and even destructive.
pros: Make your physical form more powerful
Make items, other people, and abilities more powerful
cons: Usage can be draining.

name: Advanced Dimensional Control
overview: create, control and destroy parallel Dimensions
description: By absorbing energy from large temporal rifts, the user of universal dimensional control can create a dimension which he or she can control to an extent and when finished, destroy it. Also they have the Ability to move from any dimension at will. Unforutunaly; this leads to self-inflicted harm which can lead to fatal wounds and death due to the required energies to create a parallel dimension. Also the user cannot create life forms using this power or send items from one dimension to another.
pros: You can create your own Parallel dimension to control like a god.
You may change any aspect of it at will and move to different dimensions.
And then destroy any you have made, thus returning to the Main dimension.
cons: The user can die from creating Parallel dimensions.
Life or new elements or Compounds cannot be made using the Parallel dimensions
And Temporal energy is required for one to be created; something the user does not have.

name: Blue Pyrokinesis
overview: create and control blue flames
description: Blue flames are hotter than red flames. A person with this power can create and manipulate blue flames. Aside from the usual perks of pyrokinesis this ability also gives you the required secondary powers to not burn yourself with this ability.
pros: Much hotter than red flames
You have the required secondary powers
It looks way cooler than red or yellow flames(in my opinion)
cons: It is hotter so unless you are good at using it you might burn others

name: Optical Reality Negation
overview: destroy anything that is within your line of sight.
description: With this power, one has the ability to negate/destroy reality within their line of sight. This power can be used to destroy specific parts of an object or the entire structure in general. You can also bounce your power's optical aspect off of reflective surfaces.
pros: You can easily win staredowns.
You are dangerous around mirrors.
Anything you see is an easy target.
cons: You are limited by the range of your sight.
Any obscured object can not be destroyed.
You will become mentally exhausted after over use.

name: Fireproof Body
overview: be invulnerable to fire, heat and radiations.
description: Your body can't get burned, suffer damage or feel pain from fire, radiations and heat. Excessive heat and smoke don't bother you. You have the upper hand against most fire manipulators, since they tend to rely more on their abilities, neglecting physical training. This power can be used offensively by throwing burning objects and fire breathing (the art, not the power) since you don't have the limitations that every fire breather has. On the other hand, your clothes can still be damaged.
pros: You will survive in the near future when heatwaves will be commonplace.
You can easily escape a fire and protect people from severe harm.
You can also use fire to attack.
cons: Your clothes may be damaged or you may end up being naked after a fire.
Electricity can't burn you but you can get shocked.

name: Upgrader
overview: upgrade anything you touch.
description: Whatever you touch when saying "upgrade" (doesn't have to be loud) instantly advances the item to a more modern version as it would be 100 years in the future (doesn't include people or animals). Can work on people when they are using a superpower which upgrades the power.
pros: Futuristic
Impress your friends
Easy to control
cons: Have to say "upgrade"

name: Imperceptibility
overview: evade all of the five senses
