description: Also called Incorporeality, this is the ability to psychically avoid being detected by any of the five conventional senses (sight, touch, hearing, smell, taste). This allows the user to access Invisibility (inability to be seen), Intangibility (inability to be touched, also referred to as Phasing), Inaudibility (inability to be heard), Inodorosity (inability to be smelled) and Inodorosity (inability to be tasted). And usually, the user can choose whether to be partially or entirely undetected.
pros: Invisibility
Intangibility
Inaudibility and Inodorosity
cons: Insipidity (how often will a superhuman come along and try to taste you? )
Not imperceptible to those with ESP
If you have to choose between being entirely perceptible and entirely imperceptible

name: Lightning
overview: produce electricity
description:
A person with Lightning is a living dynamo. Their abilities include:
*Generating lightning bolts
*Recharging appliances
*Producing an EMP
*Releasing a massive electric shockwave
pros: Recharge your iPod whenever
Defy authority
Protect what you love with little effort
cons: Still affected by electricity
If you're wet, your bolts will shock you
Lightning is drawn to metal

name: Plasma Heart
overview: generate plasma shields, beams and orbs
description: Your heart has been replaced with an alien heart that pumps plasma-charged blood around your body. As a result of this, you can phase the plasma through your veins to create plasma blasts, beams or shields. It also allows the electric energy in the plasma to escape and let you glide when jumping, like an electromagnetic pulse.
pros: Plasma powers
Gliding when jumping from great height
Improved healing factor
cons: Dangerous when fired at people, it can cause burns or worse.
Time is needed to recharge after expelling large amounts of plasma
Alien hearts can cause side effects

name: Power Bestowed By Intelligence
overview: gain a power depending on what is your strongest intelligence. (Multiple Intelligence Theory)
description: The user will gain an ability depending on what their intelligence is. For example, spatial intelligence would give the user a spatial- based ability. Another example is if they had naturalist intelligence, they would be able to get a nature- based ability.
pros: Have a power that matches your intelligence.
cons: Any weakness that power has.

name: Firefox & Thunderbird
overview: use the fire spirit, Firefox and the thunder spirit, Thunderbird
description: The person with this power is able to call upon either the fire spirit Firefox or the thunder spirit Thunderbird. However, the user cannot use both spirits at the same time. The basic form of this power is that the user can use the powers associated with the spirit of fire or thunder. The ultimate form is that the user can transform into the element spirit themselves.
pros: Can transform into the animal spirit of fire or thunder
Can control fire
Can control thunder/ lightning
cons: Cannot use to power simultaneously
Powerful magic users can disable power with powerful spells

name: Viral Blast
overview: throw a viral energy blast that slowly kills
description: Power from the black arts. The user can throw viral energy blasts from his hands. When the blast touches a target, he becomes sick and dies within 3 hours if not healed by a healing power or magic. If the target has powers, he can resist up to 6 hours, but s/he also dies if not healed by healing powers or by magic.
pros: Kills pretty much everything in a sick way
User may choose the potency of the poison in his blasts
It could wear down/defeat stronger opponents
cons: You are not immune so if it's reflected, you die
May only fire up to 50 ft
Drains the user's life force if used too often in a short period

name: Arm Shield
overview: abiliy to create a shield from your arms
description: This power can help with defence and attack when it comes to battling other people as a extra ability the shield can't be destroyed.
pros: Improves defence
Can be used for attacking
Is indestructible
cons: Only used on your arms

name: Jack
overview: jack anyone for powers, position, IQ, skills or significant others.
description: Blatantly steal superpowers, positions of power, skills, items, significant others. Someone's got a better power than you? A better car? A better life? Jack'em. Look them in the eye and say Jack, tell them what you are taking and it can all be yours. You're not only rewriting history, you're remaking reality.
pros: Jack superpowers, IQ, skills, jobs instantly. IQ and skills are yours forever.
Possessions such as weapons, property, vehicles, armor, degrees, etc.
You can even Jack significant others, girlfriends, boyfriends, friends and family
cons: Powered abilities and jobs supplant each other. Must be sure you want to lose what you have.
IQ and skills are instantly learned giving you a killer headache each time you Jack someone
Each thing must belong to someone before you Jack it. Cannot jack human senses.

name: Solar Manipulation
overview: manipulate and use solar energy.
description: With this ability, you are able to manipulate and use solar energy, a common resource. You can store it for up to 24 hours, and unleash it in the form of a concentrated beam, or a blast around the radius of your body. Another use for this ability would be to supercharge solar-powered devices, for example, a solar panel. This solar energy can also be used as a source of heat in cold areas. Fortunately, you can determine the amount of solar power you can release, ranging from harmless to fatal.
pros: Supercharge solar-powered objects.
Release solar energy in concentrated beams, or blasts which are released in your radius.
You may use the solar power as a source of heat, and control the amount of solar energy you release.
cons: You may accidentally release a harmful amount of solar power.
All solar energy that you can't maintain/store is instantly released around you.

name: Warp Speed
overview: run with such great speed that one jumps from this dimension/time to another
description: One with this ability can run so fast, that they jump from this dimension or time, to another. You can jump from here to the past, to the future or to an alternate reality (and then jump back). Too bad, you can't use this power for regular superspeed (you automatically accelerate to warp speed).
pros: Run incredibly fast
Jump into different dimensions
Jumpt into different times
cons: Can only use this power for travel (unless you maybe smack your enemy on the way out)
Have to have enough room to move (if you don't, you'll bump into stuff before you can warp)
People who can travel to different dimensions can try to follow you

name: Super Dexterity
overview: increase your dexterity to superhuman levels.
description: Super Dexterity allows one to have dexterity at superhuman levels. This means they can hold up to 8 objects in just one hand, mimic anyone's handwriting, even write two different people's handwriting at the same time, even by using two pens with the same hand. It also allows pandexterity, which includes being able to write with not only your right and left hand but also your feet, your mouth, even between your eyelids and stomach area. Not to be confused with super strength.
pros: You can hold multiple objects in just one hand.
Pandexterity is just plain cool
You can mimic anyone's handwriting
cons: Not to be mistaken with super strength

name: Object Mimicry
overview: mimic the properties of any object the user touches
description: The user of this power is able to take on the properties of any object the touch and gain whatever abilities that come with the object they have touched. For example, if you touch a tyre you become rubbery and bouncy in nature due to the rubber. The user's ability to mimic the object is dependent on how much of the object is present.
pros: Objects around posses certain different qualities giving different types of power
There are always objects around that can be mimicked
cons: Cannot mimic two objects at the same time
How long and how good you can mimic abilities depends on how much of the object is present

name: Supreme Water Elementalist
overview: possess every aspect of water and liquid
description: You can manipulate water, or generate it from your body. You are always Hydrated, and can turn into a body of liquid to seep in through tiny cracks or holes in walls or floors. You can summon rogue waves with your mind. You can absorb water from anything wet. You can turn into ice, as well as into a Jelly consistency (however if you're in cold regions and turn into ice, it will take almost forever to move). You can surf with your bare feet and can also walk on water.
pros: No surfboards or wipeouts anymore
You can last 500 times in the desert than a camel.
You can sense vibrations miles away
cons: You might have overactive sweat glans
You have a hard time moving in cold regions if you choose to turn in water
The far away vibrations can disturb your sleeping at night

name: Electrical Mimicry
overview: turn your body into electricity
description: Your flesh and blood body is relatively limited. Electricity is much less so. Electrical Mimicry allows you to transform into a human-shaped lightning bolt that can travel through electrical wires, fly, emit bright light, and electrocute things.
pros: Fly
Able to go many places you normally couldn't
Able to use electricity to heal your lightning body
cons: Water causes unconsciousness or death
Magnetism is your new gravity
Unable to safely touch people in lightning form

name: Aerokinesis
overview: manipulate air and other gases
description: A person with Aerokinesis has control over the air in their immediate area. They can generate 200 mph gusts and make 50 yard air-boosted leaps. Even air pressure is not outside their range. They can make it greater and crush things, or decrease it so they can do things with less air resistance (i.e. run fast).
pros: Very versatile
Not easy to fight against
Allows user to go to many inaccessible places
cons: Cannot fly
Cannot create air/gases
Cannot destroy air/gases

name: Alchemy
overview: change matter into other forms of matter, such as sand into gold.
description: You can alter the natural elements, changing them from one substance into another.  Scientists have studied the science of "alchemy" for years, attempting to transmute iron into gold, or other elements into gold.  Now you can!  Remember chemistry?  You can change any element into another element with no thinking involved!
pros: Become rich by changing things into gold, silver, platinum, etc.
Pimp your ride--everything chrome!
cons: Too much gold in the world reduces its value.
If your power becomes public, you will probably need protection

name: Existence Displacement
overview: blink yourself or anything else solid in and out of existence.
description: The ability to cause your physical being or the physical being of anyone or anything else to be removed from the plane of existence, and then to be able to bring it back, at will.
pros: You can dodge ANYTHING
Ability to leave the room during awkward moments
cons: Can only keep them out of existence for a short time until the ability is developed
You can only remove a single thing at a time, any more and the other one is lost forever
Can only remove from existence if you know the exact location in the universe of where a thing is

name: Story Power
overview: recreate a power from any story you have ever read.
description: Great to use with story teller power. Basically if you read the story, and you have the general idea of how the power is used, you can copy it.
pros: Man that's alot of options!
Great for people who like to read
Having the book with the story increases the powers copied from that story
cons: Powers have their weaknesses.
Read, read, read

name: Concept Beam
overview: turn any concept or idea into an energy beam that applies that concept to a certain extent.
description: Here is an example. The user would like to use the concept of order. They will be able to turn that concept into energy and that energy is released into a beam. That beam then becomes an Order Beam. When it hits something, it makes it more predictable or organized. There are many other concepts and ideas that can be used as well.
pros: Powerful energy beam.
cons: The effects don't last long.

name: Telepsychic Wings
overview: sprout telekinetic razor-sharp wings of pure mental energy.
description: You can manifest telekinetic razor-sharp wings from your back composed of pure mental energy which spans about sixteen feet from wingtip to wingtip at its highest intensity. You can fly anywhere undetected too, very difficult to track, even by very powerful telepaths. Those wings can fire Psychic flechettes which are able to stun or kill.
pros: You might become a divine psychic.
cons: Those wings will eventually wear off in about 576 hours.

name: Tactile Vector Telekinesis
overview: create psychic energy appendages to control objects, by first touching that object
description: This form of telekinesis is extremely rare. You can control objects with telekinetic vectors that are first created by physical contact with the object. It's vastly useful in the hands of experts, and connections between the mind and a desired object take no more than three seconds. There's an unlimited time frame of control, and you can maintain or terminate it at will. A side effect is pale amber fire seen around objects moving at high speed due to molecular control, a basis for this power.
pros: Move huge objects of immense weight with ease, and fly by riding long projectiles like snowboards!!
You cannot be harmed by the psionic fire created at advanced control levels
Despite being a 'tactile' ability, this form is as powerful as Jean Grey's telekinesis!!
cons: Takes time to learn to control
A very dangerous power in the wrong hands!
Despite limitless power time, you always need to touch an object before it can be controlled

name: Upgrade
overview: make any item one step better than it is
description: This power can only be used once for every year you have been alive each day. I. E. If you are 15 you can use it 15 times each day until you turn 16. You can upgrade things together but not apart and not everything will come out cool if you do,like a pencil-fridge would not be very useful. Broken stuff will be fixed
pros: Can turn the "rest" into the "best"
Can upgrade things together
Could eventually become cyborg
cons: Can't split them back apart (might be a bad idea to combine people)
People will wonder how you traded your ps1 for a ps3
Limmited number of uses

name: Most Wanted Superpower
overview: always have the most wanted superpower on this website
description: The user always has the most wanted superpower on this website, no matter what it is. And if the most wanted superpower changes, then the user loses the previous one, and gains the current most wanted superpower. The amount of control depends on the user and the superpower.
pros: Most wanted superpowers are awesome
cons: User loses the previous power if the most wanted superpower changes

name: Animal Empathy
overview: use traits from animals
description: Think of it this way, you wanna be like spider-man without having to be bitten by a radioactive spider. Now you can by being empathic to spiders. But it get's better. You can combine species. Grow limbs with lizard power, have chameleon sight. Have radar sense of a dolphin. Almost anything is possible with this power. You just have to know about the animal and then bam! You can use its power.
pros: A lot of potential
Can use any animal. Even the extinct ones.
Combine powers (spider's eyes with chameleon sight), had one to sneak up on.
cons: You can't turn into the animal.
You can't use mythical creature's power because they don't exist.
You might have to do a lot of reseach before you go into battle with this power.

name: Author Power Mimicry
overview: use any power you created.
description: Many people create a power, but never acquire it. With this power, you don't need to -it does it automatically. However, it will get the powers you made whether you want them or not, so watch out if you made something like cracktart. On the other hand, if you made a really good power like Ability Sponge or The Power of Imagination, this is a very useful ability to have.
pros: Have all the powers you made.
Have multiple powers.
Really good if you made a lot of useful powers.
cons: Not very useful if you aren't creative.
Awful if you made a really bad power like cracktart.
Only acquires powers you made.

name: Symbolic Clothing
overview: have powers depending on the objects on your clothing
description: It as it says on the tin. You can acquire powers based on whats on your clothes. Doctor Who:Time Lord abilities, Cross: angelic abilities, Money: Currency Conjuring etc etc. Iron-ons also included.
pros: Shirt, Pants and Shoes can make powers
Clothes can be bought cheap
Iron-on's for pants and shoe decals even spray paint makes powers
cons: No Shirt Pants or Shoes No powers
No money for clothes No powers
If you like plain T-shirts

name: Depth Perspective Telekinesis
overview: psionically manipulate objects as if they were the size depth perception makes them look.
description: Makes depth perception your weapon. If a car is far enough away to look 2 inches long, you can reach out and manipulate the car as if it was shrunk to 2 inches. It extends to held objects, so if you hold a newspaper and make hitting motions at a person who looks one inch tall, the effects work accordingly.
pros: The farther away from the target, the more powerful it is.
Very destructive.
cons: VERY DESTRUCTIVE!

name: Sunlight Absorber
overview: absorb sunlight and use it for superpowers
description: With this superpower, you can absorb sunlight just like Superman and use it to fuel your energy and give yourself superpowers. You can think of any powers you want.
pros: Can have unlimited energy
Can have any powers you want
cons: Clouds and shade are your weakness

name: Metallokinesis
overview: manipulate metal mentally
description: You will mentally control all metal sources. You will be able to summon metal from the ground, shape and form metal into different constructs, like a suit of armor, shields or weapons. You can also repel metal projects from hitting you. You can even break and repair metal objects, or manipulate its properties (density, conductivity, color, etc.). This is not using Magnetism or Magnetokinesis.
pros: Control over metal
Can form it into armor and weapons
Can manipulate its properties
cons: May be affected by magnetic power
May be affected by electric power

name: Boomerang Touch
overview: cause any object to always return to you magically.
description: An object tagged with this ability will always return to you. The object will reappear in your possesion no matter where you leave it or place it. When it returns it may do so in several ways. It might reappear in your inventory or in your hands. If you own a house it may reappear there.
pros: Never lose important object.
Objects reappear quickly
cons: May be creepy to have an object constantly reappear near you.

name: Mental Escape
overview: escape from anything by imagining.
description: With this power, you can easily escape from any prison with only your imagination. If you are in handcuffs or trapped on an island surrounded by sharks, all you have to do is imagine yourself escaping and you will be free.
pros: Get out of jail everytime.
Bad guys can never capture you.
Get out of all boring conferences.
cons: Won't help you fight.
Won't work if you can't imagine escaping.

name: Psychometric Terrakinesis
overview: control earthen minerals you have had previous contact with
description: This form of terrakinesis is very rare. A person can control any form of earth that they have previously worked on, as when farming. They gain total control of that section of earth, and their psychic link to it can be maintained or terminated at will.
pros: Psychometric connections make this an extremely powerful form of terrakinesis!
You can extract minerals to use for healing, weaponry, and even artistry!
Is very easy to control once it is mastered
cons: Use for weapons and artistry take sufficient practice
If you can't recall memories, you could easily lose control

name: Messianic Aura
overview: cause good attributes to be dominant in your presence
description: A person with this power can cause people's good attributes to be dominant while people are in their presence. Even hardened criminals become repentant when under the affects of this power. Anything that has a conscience immediately tries to do good things or what they think is good. It can induce generosity and sharing as well. Even animals are affected by this power and will not attack you. Plants are also affected. Even bacteria and viruses are affected.
pros: Spread peace and win a Nobel Prize
Eventually you can use your reputation to do other things
Works on animals, plants, bacteria, fungi, and viruses--ie you can also stop any disease temporarily
cons: People might want to follow you around
You are also affected by your own power at all times--so no using powers for evil
Only directly affects things nearby you

name: Superhuman Agility
overview: change the body's position at superhuman levels
description: Agility is a mix of balance, coordination, speed, reflexes, and strength. A person with Superhuman Agility can leap off walls, backflip with ease, and perform with a gymnast's grace in any environment.
pros: Looks awesome
Very intimidating
Can be used without much suspicion
cons: You are not that strong
No resistance to injury
Can still make mistakes (header into wall)

name: Friction Manipulation
overview: control the friction of your own body and of objects you touch
description:
Friction is a force that stops the movement of two touching objects. These objects do not move because of electromagnetism. By controlling friction, you can make things "sticky" or "slippery", including yourself. 
You can do this to objects that you have touched as well. You need to be conscious to keep these things in the state you want them to be (although you don't need to think about it). They will revert to there normal states when you sleep or are knocked out.
pros: Stick to any surface, allowing you to climb up walls or walk on ceilings.
Move things more easily by making them slippery.
When you're frictionless, you are immune to all physial attacks unless they hit your center of mass.
cons: Unless you also have superstrength, climbing up walls will be difficult.
Still weak to fire, explosions, drowning, or any non-physical attack.
Actively changing which body part is sticky and which is slippery may get confusing.

name: Computer Interface
overview: control or transfer someone's conscious into computer.
description: You can control a computer to do anything you want, or transfer yours or someone else's conscious mind into any electrical device capable of containing it.
pros: See through any camera no matter the distance.
Trap enemies' minds in a storage device.
Put your own mind into a highly destructive robot.
cons: Accidentally losing the mind you are transfering.

name: Reanimation
overview: bring things back to their original state of animation
description: This ability allows one to undo any sort of effect as the ability Animation, Glaciation, Petrifaction, Vitrification or the like. Anything that makes inanimate objects ANIMATED, or makes living things INANIMATE will be negated. This also works to undo death-inducing abilities and paralyzing/immobilizing abilities (and return the dead back to living beings). In addition, it means Glaciation, Petrifaction, Vitrification, insta-kill, paralyzing and immobilizing abilities fail to work on the user.
pros: Reanimate the dead (as living people, not zombies), undo Petrifaction, Glaciation, Vitrification
Return animated objects back to normal (they can't attack you)
Immune to Petrifaction, Glaciation, Vitrification and Insta-Kill/immobilizing/paralyzing abilities
cons: Can't animate objects with this ability, unless they've been animated before
Some user DO reanimate the dead as zombies, but this power doesn't let you control them
Some with this ability aren't immune to Petrifaction, Glaciation, Vitrification, etc.

name: Calorie Power
overview: have each calorie you eat increase your muscle/body/bone mass.
description: Every 2000 calories you eat increases you body mass to to the equivalent of 1 pound of strength. You are able to lift 1 pound per 2000 calories. It is evenly distributed throughout your body. But you never lose strength or mass. Constantly gaining weight to the point you would not e allowed on elevators and certain roads.
pros: Gradually stronger and eventually indestructible from the out side.
Never lose strength.
More you eat, the better you are.
cons: Will become extremely heavy.
Skin wil become impenetrable good/bad--surgery.

name: Passive Superpower Aura
overview: give yourself and others nearby a passive ability of your choice.
description: This power enables one to bestow themselves with an incredible ability. This power must be passive, however and affects everyone within 10 meters. However, you can also apply it to certain groups, like all adolescents or all females. A "group" can also include just yourself or just others. You can only give one at a time, but it can be multifaceted and switched immediately. It can also grant negative powers as weaknesses, such as a poison or induced susceptibility to sunlight.
pros: Great team support ability.
Can be a specialist weapon.
Can target groups.
cons: Only one ability at a time, although it can be multifaceted.
No Con Negation or similar powers can be used on this.
Only passive abilities.

name: Mentally Triggered Explosions
overview: make explosions with your mind
description:
Fire is fun! But explosions are better. With this ability a person could concentrate on what it is they want to blow up, and then, depending on the strength of their focus, an explosion would rock the object.

Think about this ability, you could come across an impenetrable wall of stone keeping you out of the enemy's base. Boom! No more wall.
Peons are shooting at you! Boom! Disabled the guns.
Plus, the explosions don't harm you, but the shrapnel might...
pros: Revenge, blow up the neighbor's mailbox
The detonation can be anywhere
You control the size of the explosion
cons: The detonation can be anywhere
The first few tries might injure somebody. Bad.

name: Empathic Metamorphosis
overview: change your power or appearance by the emotions inside you
description: This ability allows the user to become a untouchable adversary due to the emotions inside them. The more emotion and/or the stronger the emotion the more powerful they will become(i.e. rage induces fires and or strength).
pros: Can become virtually anything
Any power is theirs for the taking
Adaptive in any battle
cons: Is emotionally based; no emotion or not getting the desired emotion will make you weak
Metamorph into something dangerous (i.e. cannot control emotion)
If you cannot control your emotion you can lose control of the power

name: Ghost Field
overview: make fields of intangibility
description: Make portable and movable fields that make things intangible for however long you want. Make a field around a bullet so it can go through walls or innocent people and become tangible right before hitting your opponent. Make a field around yourself in a sphere to protect you from any physical harm, or make a skin-tight field around yourself to phase through walls, people, weapons, or objects. When phasing objects become invisible, so you could phase into a tree and make a little peephole.
pros: Be immune to physical harm
Hide easily
Don't need to hurt innocents or go around walls
cons: Can't go through force fields
Energy weapons
Non-physical superpowers

name: Thief's Power
overview: become an expert thief.
description: This power makes you ambidexterous to steal or pick pockets in most positions. You gain an innate knowledge of parkour and karate to fight out of situations. To sneak in and out of art museums you gain invisibility that is voluntary and your sense of balance is doubled so that you can evade security cameras. This power also allows you to know what elements, such as gold, something is made of to tell how much it's worth. Finally, you have eternal youth to continue stealing valuable objects.
pros: Get rich easily.
Almost impossible to get caught.
You become excellent with knives and throwing stars.
cons: Eternal youth doesn't help against bullets.
People will hate you.

name: Magnetism
overview: manipulate magnetic fields
description: Magnetism is a universal force keyed to nickel, iron and cobalt. A person with Magnetism can repulse, levitate, attract, and manipulate these metals using only their mind. They can also repel their body iron from the Earth's core and float, although they cannot fly.
pros: Best bank robber ever
These metals are fairly common
Limited only by will
cons: Useless without metal
Weakened by EMPs
Limited control over less magnetic elements

name: Equilibrium   Healing
overview: restore biological lifeforms to their peak form
description: Equilibrium allows the user to restore and maintain balance in any given situation. This ability is dynamic, altering depending upon the current requirements to maintain balance. In the case of biological damage, it can be used to heal wounds. This ability will naturally try to return biological lifeforms to their peak state. This means it will force regeneration of all damage, no matter how long ago it occurred. Can also heal mental illness. Can be turned on and off.
pros: Can heal all damage done to self
Can heal any injury done to others
Can heal even mental illnesses
cons: Healing is involuntary once active
Will naturally heal everyone, even enemies
Extensive healing can leave the user drained

name: Monthly Wish
overview: get one wish at the beginning of every month
description: This lets you get 1 wish on the first week of every month that will come true. At midnight of the day a week after the start of the month the wish is gone... No stockpiling to have 2 in the next month... Also this wish can not harm the earth intentionally (no blowing up the planet) and can only affect one person directly (your wish is for someone to die this would only directly affect that person... But you couldnt do an earthquake cause would harm/affect several people)
pros: Every month you get one wish you want that will come true
You could do or get almost any one thing you want
Anything with lasting effects lasts until end of month
cons: It only lasts until the end of the month if it has a lasting effect
Cannot directly harm more than one person or the earth
Only get to choose a wish at the first week of the month (till midnight start of 8th day of month)

name: The Light Side Of The Force
overview: harness the natural energy of life for nearly infinite uses.
description: The Force is an energy field created by all living things, that surrounds and penetrates living beings and binds the galaxy together. Jedi can harness this energy for any purpose from telekinesis to mind control and beyond. The ability to connect to the Force is related to the concentration of Midi-chlorians in one's cells.
pros: You get an awesome lightsaber
You can lie during droid hunts
You can throw people with your mind
cons: Sith, stormtoopers, droids, bounty hunters, and giant worm-people try to kill you
You can never marry
The government expects you to do all of the front-line fighting in every conflict

name: Dark Lightning
overview: generate dark energy in the form of lightning
description: This ability allows you to generate dark energy in the form of black lightning or any color you wish as long as it is dark (no bright colors). You can shoot bolts of pure dark energy at anything, from your hands or eyes or even legs to either destroy or just shock the target depending how much you focus it and the power being used. With practice you could increase your speed using the dark energy. You won't be able to control electricity in any way, only counter it and can still be shocked.
pros: Become really scary (not sure if that is a good thing)
Never need a weapon again, at least not for fighting
Can increase speed but needs practice
cons: Running out of energy, thus forcing you to draw more power than you can handle wich could backfire
This is not electrokinesis so you won't be able to control electricity and are not immune to it

name: Data Beam
overview: create data beams that alter reality.
description: With this power you can create a beam of data that alters reality by changing the data of the objects it touches. Any type of data can be used to change objects, such as making things peaceful with peace data, setting things aflame with fire data, and changing to substance of something with a specific type of mineral data. The power can be trained to control range of beam and to control what the beam touches.
pros: Can use any type of data.
Strong ability that can rewrite the code of anything.
Can change data to gain advantages in situations.
cons: Removing the added data is difficult, without appropriate power.
Affects everything the beam touches.
Have to understand how the data will affect certain things.

name: Inthinkieous Createomious
overview: think things to reality
description:
You can think anything to happen and it does. You have an english paper to type up? Just think it. Dog has to go out, just think it and done. Its usefull in every situation. Have a few extra pounds? 
BOOM! 
not anymore!
pros: You can complete tedious tasks without moving
Create unworldly inventions
Be a hero
cons: You have to have logic behind the imagination(Like the english paper has to be written by you in
order for you to think it typed)
You learn no life values or skills

name: Head Rushed
overview: instantly learn everything about any one thing by simply wanting to learn about it.
description: You want to learn about something, you power activates and the information about it rushes into your head so fast you literal convulse. All information no matter how closely or vaguely connected it be to your targeted topic will be in your mind permanently.
pros: Learn about anything you need to know.
cons: The rush of information makes your entire body convulse uncontrolably until you've learned it
You could become addicted to learning, thus your mind will eventually rip itself apart.
You cant turn it off ever, no matter how many times you want to know how it works you wont learn it.

name: Induced Evolution
overview: evolve or "advance" one's self, people, animals, plants, and objects physically and mentally
description: With this power you can evolve or users of this power call; "advance"; things to you own desire by harvesting nearby resources. You can advance weapons to more powerful ones or when your driving a vehicle "advance" it into a airplane or evolve your self where you can breathe underwater. This power is interruptible. The more large and complex a target of "advancing" is, the more time it will take to advance and the more energy it will drain. When you advance something you cannot change it back.
pros: Advance a gun into a bazooka
Have flight, breathing and other powers.
Great when you have a getaway car; advance it into a plane
cons: Limited energy no matter what.
Cannot change targets back.
Longer time for more complex and larger targets

name: Metal Substance Manipulation
overview: suck up metal into one's skin and later use this metal by turning it into whatever you want.
description: Touch anything with metal in it (while thinking of wanting the metal) and the particles will separate and float into your pores. You can also suck metal out of the earth/dirt, since it possesses metal particles.
pros: You almost always have a source of power.
Can store metal in oneself instead of carrying it around.
Can make any metal object appear.
cons: Must flex part of body where you want metal to come out and then think of what you want it to become
Can only store certain amount of metal in your body at a time.
MIGHT run out of metal, but as you can take it from the ground, it is highly unlikely.

name: Light/Dark Energy
overview: manipulate light/dark energy
description: You can only use light energy when exposed to light and dark energy when exposed to the dark. Both energies can be used to blast energy and/or create force-fields of energy. Light energy can be used to travel as/with light, fuse with light, inflict positive emotions/thoughts, and generate heat. Dark energy can be used to travel as/with darkness, fuse with the dark, inflict negative emotions/thoughts, and generate cold. Both energies can be used as explosives. Power is greatest during eclipse.
pros: Manipulate light energy when exposed to light
Manipulate dark energy when exposed to the dark
Manipulate dark and light energy during eclipse
cons: Cannot manipulate dark energy unless exposed to the dark
Cannot manipulate light energy unless exposed to the light
Eclipse isn't very long

name: Temporal Sense Manipulation
overview: alter a biological objects sense of time
description: A person with this power can alter anyone's sense of time. For example, they can make it feel like an hour while it has only been a minute. In addition, you can temporarily freeze their sense of time, leaving them staring blankly still stuck at that moment. Conversely, you can also accelerate people's sense of time to give them sensory framerate acceleration - in fact, you can even make their sense of time go faster than their body can handle.
pros: Make it look like you can stop time
Can make plants blossom early - fool the biological clock
Can grant people sensory framerate acceleration
cons: Cannot stop a bullet or speed/inertia
Physics still applies
Mental strain in doing this - needs practice to alter for longer periods

name: Call Of The Olympians
overview: call upon the power of the Olympians in your time of need.
description: You have the incredible power to have the abilities of any Greek god. This includes the Twelve Olympians and the minor gods. You can only call upon one god's power at a time. You don't summon the god to you, just their power, such as the speed of Hermes, the intelligence of Athena, or the ability to control the skies like Zeus, you get the idea. Once you call upon one god's power, the one you are possessing goes away.
pros: You can have the power of the Greek gods.
You can have many powers.
You can call upon the major and minor Greek gods.
cons: You can only have one god's power at a time.

name: Sharingan
overview: copy and memorize anything that does not require another person's genetic structure
description: You don't need to worry about forgetting anything if you have your Sharingan on! Also known as the "Mirror Wheel Eye", the Sharingan can copy anything, as long as you don't need a specific genetic structure for it. You can also perform hypnosis. But be warned, your Sharingan is nearly useless under any condition that reduces visibility. Also, if you want the Mangekyou Sharingan, you must kill your best friend. And if you want the Eternal Mangekyou Sharingan, you must take the eyes of yo brother.
pros: Learn, and remember, anything you want!
Creep out your enemies!
cons: Anything that blinds you makes the Sharingan useless
To get the Mangekyou Sharingan, you must kill your best friend
To get the Eternal Mangekyou Sharingan, you must take the eyes of a brother w/ a Mangekyou Sharingan

name: True Sight
overview: see what is really there
description: True Sight is the ability that lets one see what is really there. Example: If the person who hones this power meets with a shapeshifter, he/she would see past the shapeshifter and see what the person is really like. Also, he/she can see how the person really is. The person who has this ability has eyes the color of gold.
pros: You can see past any charade.
Provides mental protection from demons and infernal beings.
You can see how someone really is, contrary to what they say or how they act.
cons: The powers are somewhat involuntary, to avoid this the bearer must wear sunglasses.
You can be affected indirectly.
To get the full extent of the power, eye-to-eye contact is necessary.

name: Source Inducement
overview: induce or create link between you and a person/object/power/etc. and make your source of power.
description: The user is allowed to create a link to any thing and make them an power source for the user can draw all his strength from. When away from the source, the user gains enchanced natural abilities, energy projection, and any properties or powers the source has. When the user is closer, they become stronger, but the source will become weak until it becomes inert or dead.
pros: Link with other things to make them your power source, and you can link up with multiple things
Power yourself up.
You can allow other to gain power from it
cons: Dangerous for the source if the user is to close
The source can be depleted.

name: Sage Power
overview: absorb chi from the surrounding and channeling it.
description: This power allows the user to absorb chi from the immediate surrounding and channeling it to produce energy constructs, blast or Buddhist themed defensive figures that will protect the user
pros: Chi is present anywhere
Can go head to head with most powerhouses.
cons: Body of the user is not made invulnerable.
Great control needed to absorb the energy
Will only last a little while, before needing replenishing

name: Seasonal Powers
overview: have different powers depending on the season
description: This power gives you different abilities for each season. In the spring, you can control plant life, talk to animals, and heal people. In the summer you can control light and summer storms (rain, wind, lightning, etc. ) In the fall you can wield red-gold flames and control darkness. In the winter you can control water, ice, and winter storms (snow, sleet, hail, wind, etc. ). It gives you a wide range of abilities that would be strong in each season.
pros: Stop hurricanes and blizzards
Hide in shadows and scare people for Halloween
Start awesome gardens in the spring
cons: Needing another season's powers
You might not want a garden

name: Intuitive Aptitude
overview: analyze and understand the workings of complex systems
description: Understanding is something that we all need more of. A person with Intuitive Aptitude can instinctively and subconsciously comprehend any kind of system---biological, mechanical, social, complicated or simple. However, the user is also driven to understand as much as possible.
pros: Be an amazing scientist
Understand why people do what they do
Understand how other superpowers work
cons: Desire to understand may make you a monster
No other superhuman attributes
May take time to understand massive systems (i.e. the universe)

name: Superhuman Intelligence
overview: have intelligence far above genius level.
description: With this ability, your intelligence, creativity and attention span are far above ordinary genius level.  You can assess, analyze, synthesize, deduce and solve nearly any problem with lightning speed, accuracy and objectivity. This extends into nearly any field of study one encounters, including social interaction (meaning you realize that people would find an arrogant, know-it-all brainiac to be annoying, and you'll know how to keep humble, despite your intelligence).
pros: Use your brainpower to change the world
Solve problems, like cancer or this morning's Sudoku
Write killer rap song lyrics
cons: The simple things in life may not feel fun or funny to you--you'll probably see them coming
People constantly hounding you for answers
People may get jealous of you and try to do you harm

name: Dream Recreation
overview: enter into a dream you have had before.
description: With this power you can enter into the world of a dream you previously had allowing you to re-experience the dream world with greater clarity. In addition to having greater clarity, you can stay in the dream longer than you did originally to experience new things. To activate this power simply think of its activation when you sleep and you will enter into a world with a menu of your dreams to choose from. To exist a dream simply wish yourself to wake up. Time in dreams is not equal to real time.
pros: Re-experience your favorite dreams.
Do not have to do the same thing you did the first time you dreamed.
Can stay in the dream for as long as you wish.
cons: May not want to exit the dream.
You may not have many good dreams.
Can not experience new dreams while in the world of your old dreams.

name: Jacket Of Wonders
overview: pull any object you want, from your inside jacket pocket.
description: You're wearing a jacket where you can pull, any item you think of out of the inside jacket pocket.  You can only pull the items out if you are wearing the jacket. So don't have to fear pick-pockets. But if some-one else gets their hands on the jacket, you lose this wonderous ability.
pros: Pull any item you want out of the jacket.
No-one else can pull items out of the jacket as long as you are wearing it.
Won't outgrow the jacket. It grows to the size of the wearer.
cons: Must be wearing the jacket to pull the item out.
The jacket has the power, so make sure no-one else wears it.
Anyone else can wear the jacket.

name: Portal Phasing
overview: phase into an object and out of any side of it or any other object touching it.
description: To portal phase you must touch the object you are phasing through. The object must be wider than the person, or else, the object phases through the person. When phasing out of an object, you can phase out of any side of that object or anything touching that object. Owners of this power can't phase through people.
pros: Getting to other places is faster
Thanks to gravity every inanimate object is touching the ground
There is no place you can escape from
cons: The power doesn't work if the owner is evil
The owner of this power shouldn't have other powers
If you have other powers, you age quicker

name: Think Fire
overview: set people on fire with your mind
description: With this power you can set people on fire with your mind just by thinking of the person on fire. You can even put the fires you create out with your mind. You could also change the colors of the fires you create for your own amusement.
pros: You can set enemies on fire with your mind
You can put the fires you create out with your mind
You can change the colors of the fire
cons: You can only use fire to set people on fire
You can only put out fires you created with this power
You can only change the colors of the fires you create with this power

name: A Z Powers
overview: have one power from each letter of the alphabet
description: With this power you can have a power from each letter of the alphabet. The power has to be on this site and if you decide to change one of your power for another of that letter (i. E. Switching Acid Pee for Ability Snatch) all of your powers are changed to a different one from their respective letters. You cannot have a power that starts with a number or symbol (! Or 5 Faces Of Darkness).
pros: You can get 26 powers one for each letter of the alphabet
cons: If you change one of your powers all of your powers are changed
The power has to be on this site
You can't get a power that starts with a symbol or number

name: Pantheon By Day
overview: mimic the powers and abilities of myth and legend
description: Read any myth or legend, touch the desired character's name & mimic their powers and abilities. For one day your former life will be forgotten by all and you will look exactly like the mythological or legendary figure. You could do this only once a day. There is no returning to your former self that day. You have the power until you sleep or 24 hours after you became Myth or Legend.
pros: Phenomenal amounts of possibilities, all powers and abilities of the mythical person
Includes gender changing, growing appendages (such as wings) and paraphernalia materializing
Works on historical figures also if they have become legend
cons: Story must be over 70 years old, widely told and known by at least one culture
Must be able to read, and touch the character's name
Everyone forgets you exist and knows you only by the character's name or names for the day
tags: Son of Re and Strange Visitor

name: Emotion Commotion
overview: create elemental attacks (depending on the current emotion).
description: It uses the emotion and converts it into any element blast by physical contact or you can throw it onto an enemy. Emotion - Element: Anger - Fire; Depression - Ice; Fear - Lightning; Love - Purity; Evil - Corruption; Courage - Earth. However, some emotions cancel each other out. Example, Depression and Anger, Love and Evil, Courage and Fear
pros: You can keep foes at bay.
Can help express emotions.
Help in serious situations (ex: Gang fight)
cons: Need to control emotions
Might hurt friends/family (if lost control)
In trouble, if one has emotion problems

name: Dark Matter
overview: create and control dark matter
description: Dark matter is a form of matter unlike any other. No light can pass through it at all. This ability allows you to create and control the dark stuff. When you make it,it will appear as a black cloud/smoke. You can then use it for a variety of effects. You could make a shield against light based powers. And by surrounding something with it you could move the target. Also with time you could surround your self with it(not your head)and fly. Dark matter also has many other unique properties.
pros: You can control one of the most dangerous forms of matter known to man
You can use it to move stuff, make a shield, fly,etc.
Dark matter has many unknown properties for you to discover and put to use
cons: Dark matter isn't totally solid so moving things will take practice.
You can't use it as a sheild for anything but light
You can control one of the most dangerous forms of matter known to man

name: Clean Up Power
overview: make something disappear and then appear where it is supposed to be.
description: Like cleaning up your room, you can zap something to make it appear were you want it or where it's supposed to be. Can also be used to clean something. Get rid of filth, get back something you have lost or clean up a big mess: this power does it all for you.
pros: Clean up faster
You can have more time to do things with your family and friends
If your brother or sister hides something of you, zap where it was at and it will appear
cons: People will start to notice that you are getting things done faster than you normally do.
You might zap something you don't intend to zap
You might zap something and use the wrong effect of this power.

name: Speed Reading
overview: memorize an entire book just by touching it
description: If you never have time to read, you can just touch a book and immediately know every word.
pros: You can read through an entire library in a half hour (instead of the normal year)
You'll be the smartest kid in your school
Never have to read at a normal pace again
cons: Yeah, right!

name: Spirit Magic
overview: employ spirit magic.
description: Spirit magic is also called divine magic, depending on who is talking. Whatever the name, it is the act of channeling the power of a spirit to do great tasks. Some even draw a spirit within themselves, as this sometimes works better(and the spirit can speak to you and give you advice and knowledge). To channel or absorb a spirit, you must focus on everything around you, then a spirit will come to you and you can channel its power.
pros: Can do almost anything, depending on the strength and power of the spirit.
Can even absorb a spirit (if they allow it) and gain their knowledge as well.
cons: Spirit magic is a very misunderstood branch of magic, and is slightly hard to explain scientifically

name: Chained Lightning
overview: fire lightning from one's hand that hits one target then others.
description: The lightning will hit the first target with several volts of electricity and each successive target after that will get half the voltage. The initial amount of electricity depends on the user and how well they have mastered this power. Using this power will drain large amounts of energy from the user.
pros: You can choose how many targets there are and in what order they are hit.
cons: Hitting multiple targets will decrease how harmful this power is on each successive target.

name: Danger Sense Fighter
overview: turn into an extreme fighter, when in danger
description: If you are in danger, you will be able to become an extreme fighter. When using this power, you have to think about a fighting style. You'll then become a master of the style that you have thought of. The downside is that it only lasts for a short period of time. You can merge two fighting styles.
pros: Amazing fighter
Can morph two fighting styles to make better
Be able to defend yourself
cons: Lasts for a short period of time
If you merged fighting styles, you have even less time to fight

name: Sun Angel
overview: become a sun angel
description: Sun angels can use pyrokinesis, able to fly,and anger inducement. Unlike moon angels they are strongest during the day.
pros: Pyrokinesis can control both blue and orange flames with enough practice
Powers are strongest during the day
Very likely to be worshipped
cons: Getting tired of worship
Moon angels could kill you in your sleep
You can only control one power in the night

name: Articulation Manipulation
overview: use words to perform physical action.
description: With this power, words take on physical actions. For example, saying "Strike" would produce a blast that strikes whatever's in front of you while. "Obey" would make anyone within the soun of your voice obey whatever you say. The problem, however, is that you bound by the rules of language. E.g. if you say "Strike" without thinking of the correct term of voice, you will be struck.
pros: Always win arguments
Never lose debates
cons: If you can't speak, your powers useless
Not using correct form will backfire
Your range is limited to the sound of your voice

name: Reality Cube
overview: create your own reality within a 1-mile radius and bring other people into it
description: Also known as Inconsequential Omnipotence or the Virtual Room, this power gives the user omnipotence, but the user is confined within a 1-mile radius when activated and any changes are always undone when the power is deactivated. Also, the power will deactivate anyway over time. The only thing that people can keep is personally gained knowledge or skills. Mainly uses for illusionary purposes or training. The cons cannot be negated by any power.
pros: Inside the other reality, you control everything. Also, the time is slower than outside time.
You can use it to simulate training for your other powers-nothing gets destroyed in real life.
Learn other people's powers and weaknesses by testing them and hide your real powers.
cons: The reality cube will crumble because of the surrounding reality.
After the reality cube crumbles, everything returns back to normal-like nothing ever happened.
Can't really kill anyone, heal anyone, etcetera-none of the real things that omnipotence gives you.

name: Vibration Control
overview: create vibrations by your body
description: With this power you can create vibration with you body,create vibrations,slicing(for example with a group of vibration you can slice in a half a piece of any metal,diamant and other materials). Also,with vibrations of sound you can nature sounds,melodies and other things. A big wall of vibrations of sound it's possible too if you need to slice a house or something bigger than you. The vibration you create may be detected by sensor enemies or other type of GPS. Maybe you could make an earthquake.
pros: Can slice or break anything,with any measure(of vibration) without hurting yourself.
Any favourite melody/sound could be listened any time without an mp3 or something.
An earthquake may be possible.
cons: The enemies could find you.
Needs concentrating and time for practicing.
You may slice something accidentaly whitout practicing enough.

name: Telelocation
overview: be able to find anything lost, missing, or hidden.
description: Essentially, the ability to answer any question that starts with the word "where." Once you have a concrete target - the criminal in hiding, the assailant waiting to ambush you, the kid on the milk carton, your TV remote - you can sense where it is. This is not 'tracking' that requires your quarry to have left a physical trail as it moves, but a psychic 'homing device' that tells you where it is right now. Advanced power levels may include the ability to see the location site (clairvoyance.)
pros: Track down any loved ones kidnapped or taken hostage.
Be hugely successful as a treasure hunter, or a private investigator
Never lose anything again, ever.
cons: By going straight to a target, you can miss a lot of valuable information about it.
Locate physical items only - you can't ask "Where is the best restaurant in town?"
Must be consciously activated - you don't get alerts that something of interest might be near.

name: Luck Enchantment
overview: enchant yourself and others with long lasting good luck
description: Every 24 hours you can enchant 1 person with good luck. Your power has an immediate effect, bringing something positive to that person's life within the minute. The duration of the enchantment is random, however, but lasts no less than one month. Each day, something positive is guaranteed to happen to the enchantee and no bad events relating to that person or their friends or relatives will occur. Of course, the definition of good luck is relative to the person being enchanted, so choose wisely.
pros: Bless others with good luck and fortune
You can bless yourself to protect you and your loved ones
You will be seen as holy by some
cons: Casinos won't be too happy to see you
You're not holy--it's just a sweet superpower
You'll never lose in a fight--luck will always be on your side

name: Conceptual Manifestation
overview: manifest the physical form of a conceptual entity.
description: This ability allows you to purify and manifest any conceptual entity into a physical form. For example you could purify awesomeness or create a bottle of liquid despair. This could possibly be used for any noun that does not describe a physical object.
pros: You could create grenades of pure pain or hate.
You could wake up to a nice warm cup of pure excitment.
You could get all the girls with a sip of pure charm or desire.
cons: If improperly used could cause depression, hate, etc

name: Godlike Craftsmanship
overview: skillfully make objects and bestow them with vast, otherworldly powers.
description: It is a Godlike power in which the user can skillfully make ALL kinds of objects by ALL forms of medium and bestow them with powers that are vast and other worldly. Example: One can make a pitcher that NEVER runs out of fresh water (ever). Or one can make a sword that can slice through anything. Or one can make a coat that is impervious to ALL harm.
pros: The user can make ordinary objects or supernatural objects entirely by his/her own will.
It is the user's wish to choose what power(s) to bestow upon the object.
They make priceless gifts to your most trusted friends.
cons: The user can not place a power that doesn't match the object. Example: a Pitcher that slices.
If the otherworldly weapons are at the wrong hands, they can cause chaos to the world.
Most corrupted people would be willing to kill you over these objects.

name: The Illusionist
overview: conjure illusions.
description: With this ability, you can conjure illusions that are visible to you and others.  Any illusion goes--a chair, a snowball, a car, a naked hobo, a swarm of bees--you're only limited by your imagination. You can control every aspect, from how they move to when they appear/disappear.  While other people won't be able to touch them, if you'd like, you can make certain illusions tangible to you.  That way, you can realistically manipulate them.  But for everyone's sake, no naked hobos please.
pros: Amaze your friends.
Mess with people who deserve it.
Impressive, and potentially lucrative.
cons: People may become afraid of you.
While the illusions look real, they are merely illusions.

name: Memoripath
overview: know and control a person's memories.
description: Similar to Telepathy. When a memoripath comes in contact with a person with a very strong or painful memory(ies), they will experience it mentally. Afterwards, it will feel like their own memory. The more powerful, the more painful for the Memoripath. Memoripaths tend to have great trouble controlling their power, and unless proper mental barriers are put in place, often go insane, not knowing which of their memories are theirs. In addition to this, Memoripaths can alter the memories of others.
pros: Talented at extracting valuable information from others without torture.
Can make entire armies forget why they were fighting, or create false memories.
If used correctly, a potent form of mind control.
cons: Identity confusion often leading to insanity.
Burdened by traumatizing memories that don't belong to them.
If they do go insane, they can create entire reality shifts by altering the memories around them.

name: Power Of The Star
overview: use starlight to gain superpowers
description: The person who has this power is able to use the power that is generated from the stars in the sky ( your own sun in the solar system does not count). The more stars in the sky the more powerful the user becomes. For example a starry night on Earth will result in the user having the ability to fly and shoot energy bolts. In space, the user will have the ability to fly, shoot energy bolts, super strength and invulnerability. The star light can be saved to be used in the day, but sparingly
pros: Stars are present almost frequently in the night sky
At night, dont need to worry about losing powers
cons: During the day you have limited star light reserve
Once reserve runs out, no powers

name: Mind Warp
overview: completely change others' minds.
description: You can completely change people's minds and make them think whatever you want.
pros: Get out of trouble.
Get better grades.
Get the boy/girl of your dreams.
cons: You may lose control over the power.
You may use the power to corrupt people.
If they find out, they may kill you.

name: Parakinesis
overview: move space.
description: The ability to move space around an object, or person, or whatever allows you to move the object without affecting it at all.  EXAMPLES: A section of water can be moved without warping the water. Fire can be moved without being affected by the air. An object in motion will stay in motion, but won't actually leave the manipulated space. Because of that, it overrides things like telekinesis.
pros: Overrides things like telekinesis.
Don't have to worry about spilling your drink.
Can fly and turn upside down without all the blood going to your head.
cons: Can't warp things around.
It's harder to separate apart solid objects than not solid objects. Like rock vs water.
Bigger objects use more energy.

name: Ultimate Healing Touch
overview: hyperaccelerate healing for any condition
description: A person with this power has the ultimate healing ability able to heal any biological disease by hyperaccelerating cells and replacing them and simultaneously getting rid of infected cells. However the healing is very potent and will heal any injury even ones that people do not want to heal. If you heal a person too much they will age. Then this power can heal the old age by changing the person's cells into immortal cancer cells that will continuously self replicate. You must take your hand off.
pros: You are the ultimate healer
Your healing is always treated as beneficial by any superpower sense so you can heal anyone
You will heal any injury when used even your own
cons: You cannot use this power for very long or else you will overheal yourself
Hyperaccelerated healing will also hasten the cellular regeneration rate thus causing cells to age
You might accidentally heal someone to the point that they turn into cancer cells

name: Radioactive Burn
overview: produce skin tissue, bone structure, and blood as weaponry.
description: As a result of being exposed to intense radiation, you have acquired a malevolent growth on your back that gives you superhuman abilities. When active, you can create biological weapons such as claws, arm/wrist blades, etc. You also have superhuman strength, speed, endurance, and other heightened senses. You are capable of crystallizing your blood and hardening your bones as both offense and defense. If you take too much damage, your growth will expand and transform you into a hulking creature.
pros: You are capable of producing five times the amount of blood of an average human.
Increase your mass and strength using synthetic fibers.
Immunity to the intensities of heat, cold, and various forms of radiation.
cons: Once you metamorphose into your second state, you rely only on instinct.
Be careful not to shoot bone/blood spikes around civilians.
Over using the "growth's" ability could be fatal.

name: Energy Redistribution
overview: redirect into or away from you, and change energy forms as they pass through you
description: If you put your hand into a socket, you can make fire shoot out your other hand. If you put your hand in a fire, you can shoot electricity out the other. If you walk into a room you can turn the lights off by absorbing their energy, or you can make the room go sub-zero (or hot if you've absorbed energy from someplace else), etc. However, if you absorb too much energy, you go supernova/nuclear, and there is a massive explosion that destroys everything around you for 1km radius, and you might die.
pros: Turning off lights REALLY scares people :P
Putting your hand in a socket and making a flamethrower come out of the other is awesome
You can freeze an entire room just by willing it
cons: Everywhere you go it fluctuates from hot-cold (but usually cold)
Lights sometimes inadvertantly turn off and on around you
Too much energy absorbtion leads to nuclear supernova explosion.

name: Healing Breath
overview: heal wounds by blowing on them.
description: With this ability, you can heal all wounds or cuts by blowing on them. They regenerate instantly. Your breath is also very pleasing, and has a cool temperature at all times. This, however, ONLY works on wounds, gashes, et cetera.
pros: Breath that heals all types of wounds.
Your breath is very cool and pleasing.
No one will need bandages while you're around.
cons: Cannot heal poison, age, or unexposed wounds.
Attracts the attention of the public.
If you lose your lungs, you will not be able to blow.

name: Animal Mimicry

description: With this power you can throw anybody you want down a bottomless pit where they will be in a constant state of falling until either they die of shock or starvation or something or you free them. You can also place the pit or move the pit wherever you want. If there is no once currently in the hole it disappears until you want to use it again. You can send multiple people down the hole at once.
pros: You can send anybody down a bottomless pit
Only you can free them
You can send multiple people down the pit
cons: If you forget about the person in the pit they could die of starvation

name: Animal Enchantment
overview: give an animal an elemental power.
description: Animal enchantment is a very rare power. An animal enchanter can combine an element with an animal. Ex: fire plus wolf equals a wolf with fire for fur who can breathe a jet of flames. The animal you enchant will be your protector and your friend. However you may only enchant 3 animals at a time. If you try to enchant a fourth animal the first will lose his/her power.
pros: Having pets with powers.
Having powerful guardians.
cons: You need to enchant the right animal with the right element.
The enchantment process can take up to 90 mins.
You can only enchant 3 animals at a time.

name: Positivity Construct
overview: create constructs out of one's positive attitude.
description: This ability allows one to create constructs withfrom their own positive attitude. The more positive, the better. When the user shows any sign of negative feelings, the constructs will fall apart.
pros: Create constructs
More positivity equals more powerful constructs.
cons: Negative attitudes will break apart your constructs.

name: Telekinetic Touch See
overview: telekinetically perceive your immediate surroundings
description: This is a version of TK with a very specific use, similar to echolocation but more effective in darkness. The user generates a 90 ft radius field of millions of semi-tangible touch sensors that allow him to perceive all physical objects in range. Unlike echolocation, however, it is silent and can navigate around objects; ergo, if the user is in a warehouse full of boxes and an attacker is hiding behind them, the user can navigate his TK field to search all available areas within range
pros: Can detect ambushes in close proximity without giving away his position
Can perfectly perceive environment in total darkness
Undetectable to anyone but the user
cons: Enclosures/containers can still evade the sensor field
Powerful telekinesis users and telepaths might sense the field
Only 90' range as a beginner - may be increased with practice/proficiency

name: Metaphysical Mutation
overview: mutate metaphysically.
description: The user is able to mutate their metaphysical side. So, their physical self won't experience the change. They will have all the power of a mutated monster but will look normal to the normal eyes. They will appear to have telekinetic abilities but it is just their metaphysical body doing the work. If mastered, the user will be able to evolve metaphysically.
pros: Have the power of a mutated monster
Look normal to most people
Learn to evolve your metaphysical side
cons: Hard to control mutated metaphysically side
Can be seen by people who can sense metaphysical or control metaphysical thing

name: Paralysis Touch
overview: stop parts or all of somebody just by touch alone
description: Just by touching a part of somebody you can stop them from using their body parts of which is touched. If need be the touched part can temporarily be or fully paralyzed. Can also heal someone of paralysis that you have paralyzed or was born that way
pros: Can stop someone in thier tracks
Can heal someone of paralysis
Can touch items that can pass on the effect
cons: Takes time for paralysis to start working
Can paralyze yourself if taking on to much of the paralysis when cureing

name: Quantum Procrastination
overview: procrastinate while simultaneously performing your intended task.
description: In quantum physics, a single particle, such as an electron, can follow all possible paths as long as it is not observed. You can apply this to a limited extend on a macro scale and avoid problems with observers. You follow two paths; if you did and did not procrastinate.
pros: Get work done no matter what.
Can be turned on and off at will.
Even achieve the physical effects of doing a task, such as losing weight or developing muscle.
cons: You cannot do anything with this power except avoid the effects of procrastination.
You are still limited to one non-procrastination task.
Not as useful for those who are self-motivated.

name: Bless This Mess
overview: make an area luckier the more dirty and decrepit it is.
description: With this power you can increase the amount of lucky chances, coincidences, and miracles that occur in an area by how decrepit, polluted, and filthy it is. These lucky chances directly benefit any person currently in that area. The area can be as small as a cabinet or as large as a city, provided the vast majority of the area is dirty. If the area is improved, the excess luck goes away and return to a normal amount of luck.
pros: Be really lucky in dirty places.
Bless whole negiborhoods, towns, or cities that have fallen on hard times.
cons: Blessing only works on dirty areas.
As such, your blessing will inevitable fade as the area is reinvigorated.

name: Ocean Lordship
overview: control the ocean and everything in it
description: This is the ability to control everything in the ocean and the ocean itself. This does not mean you can generate things like life. But you can mutate life in the ocean to match a different description. You can also make ocean plants grow at your will.
pros: You can go to the beach without fear of getting bitten by a shark.
When you go surfing, you can make big waves.
You can ride dolphins.
cons: If there is a tsunami you will be blamed if people know about your power.
When you hear about shark attacks you might fill guilt because you could have stopped it.
People could try to assasinate you because they are jealous of your awesome power.

name: Ability Compensation
overview: gain abilities for one's handicaps, what they lack, or when they feel inadequate.
description: This ability allows the user to gain superpowers based one's shortcomings, especially if it is an ability that is nothing like the user's desire, but works the same anyway. For example, if someone in a wheelchair had this power, they will gain the ability to levitate. It is not the ability to heal their legs, but hey, they can fly. That is much better than walking. The user can even gain a power boost just because they feel unable to do a task
pros: You will not be handicapped.
Gain abilities
cons: Abilities won't be what the user desires, but will be just as good.

name: Mass/Density Manipulation
overview: alter an object's mass and density to generate a large array of potential effects.
description: With this power, one can control both the mass and density of an object, including themselves. They may apply changes to the whole object or merely parts. Potential effects primarily include changing the size of an object, but one can just as easily make their bones super-dense to resist injury.
pros: Change an object's size via altering mass, density or both.
Alter durability of an object by manipulating density.
Make an object incredibly heavy or incredibly light.
cons: Powers such as Immutability offer defense.
While you can expand existing supplies, you cannot create or duplicate them.
The full potential of this power i difficult to realize without some creativity.

name: Darkness Empowerment
overview: be granted enhanced abilities during the night or when the user is in darkness
description: A person with this ability will be granted enhanced abilities during the night or when in total darkness. The user will be granted enhanced speed, reflexes, strength,the ability to see in the dark and the ability to blend into the darkness to escape
pros: Fighting crime at night is no problem at all
cons: No enhanced abilities during the day

name: Fire Proof Skin
overview: not be burned by mere fire
description: This is a type of immunity! Fire cannot burn your skin. However, extremely hot temperatures (hotter than 350 degrees Fahrenheit) can still hurt you! So Beware!
pros: Mere fire cannot burn your skin.
You can withstand temperatures up to 350 degrees Farenheit without taking damage.
cons: Temperatures hotter than 350 degrees Farenheit can still cook you.
You're more vulnerable to ice attacks.

name: Myth Power: Ananeosis' Amnesty
overview: channel Ananeosis' command over the essence of renewal and restoration
description: Ananeosis, in Greek myth, is the goddess of renewal and restoration. As such, channeling her allows one to access Rapid Regeneration. In addition, one can psychically heal others to an optimum default state, by touch, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically mend scratched/dented/bent/broken/damaged items, by touch, at will. One can also restore spoiled, rotten, stale or moldy food to a perfectly fresh state, at will. One can even psychically restore lost/repressed memories, by touch, at will.
pros: Access Rapid Regeneration and heal others to peak physical health, by touch, at will
Psychically mend broken/damaged items, and restore spoiled/rotten/moldy food to fresh state, at will
Psychically restore memories, by touch, at will
cons: Cannot psychically renew ammunition, food rations, etc into infinite supply until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically suppress/negate others' Healing and/or Rapid Regeneration, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically revive subjects from the dead (can only prevent/undo death's decay) (NCN)

name: Manakinesis
overview: manipulate magic, and mystical power, and those who possess magical based powers.
description: Manakinesis is the ability to manipulate and affect the force of magic, and also prevent those with the magic-based powers, like Sorcery, to not harm you with their powers, this includes Spell based powers. This does NOT include manipulation over physical (genetic) or mental powers. i.e. having wings are physical, or telekinesis (mental). Manakinesis is not a magical power, it is a "-kinetic" based of power, that controls the force that allows those with magical based powers to work their magic.
pros: You can lessen the effectiveness of a spell caster / mage's power by decreasing their access to the "mana force"
Manakinesis can allow you to tap into magical based powers, and use them.

If a magical powered person is prevented from using magic by another manakinetic, then you can counter that by giving that person the force that control magic, depending on how much stronger with the Manakinesis you are.
cons: Manakinesis not being a magical based power, means another manakinetic can't be stopped by your power alone.
This power defines magical based powers as being influenced by a singular, natural force, that connects it with the super-powered universe.
Doesn't protect against physical based or mental based powers.

name: Daily Reset
overview: fall asleep and wake up when you first woke that day.
description: With this power you are able to go to sleep at the end of the day (for example) and wake up when you first did that day and relive that day a second time. This power can only be used once per day, so therefore you only get two runs of that day, the first initial run and the second when you use the power. Your memory remains normal. In order for the power to work, you must fall asleep before the end of the day (midnight) if not the power does not work.
pros: Relive every day twice.
Win every race, bet and lottery, dominate the stock market.
Always have a second chance within the immediate future.
cons: Your ability to exploit this power is based on your memory.
You must fall sleep within 24 hours of waking up, if you doze off after midnight then you go to the next day, also not great if you have trouble getting to sleep.
You might get disorientated and lose track which run through you are on for that day.

name: Super Absorbency
overview: absorb ANYTHING
description: If you touch any object you can absorb it's essence into your being.  You can do this with any object, whether it be a sword or a chocolate-unicorn-baby.
pros: You can use any weapon that you can absorb
cons: There is a 50 - 50 chance that you will get injured by the object that you absorb

name: Empathy Weapon
overview: create a weapon from someone's personality.
