The armor also super charges the neural synapses. This means that the user can react faster to danger and push their body to their extreme limits, granting them extreme powers
pros: Transonic Speed
Electric-enhanced strength
Immune to electrokinetic users
cons: User may get the feeling nobody can beat them

name: Shield Of Light
overview: wield special powers from Lucian's silver pendant
description: This power allows a person to summon the silver pendant with the jade gemstone, that Lucian, leader of the Lycans, wore in 'Underworld'. It is completely indestructible, and can return only to its first wielder if ever misplaced. The source of its power lies in the gemstone at its center, which can be connected to the person's mind at will. They are granted self-regeneration, pyrokinesis, healing, telekinesis, flight and superb fighting skills.
pros: The pendant can only be worn, and its powers wielded, by a good person.
Some powers, such as pyrokinesis and telekinesis, are very good powers to fight with.
Have partial immortality in addition to superb fighting skills!
cons: Takes time to unlock the pendant's full power.
Some powers, such as pyrokinesis, might be dangerous.

name: Crystal Generation
overview: generate crystals of varying strengths from or around your body.
description: The crystals generated are clear in color, similar to a diamond, and can be as durable as the generator wishes. They can be formed into weapons or other objects or used to create a bridge etc. The generator may also create an armor around them.
pros: You can become pretty much invulnerable to most things if used correctly.
Useful for creating objects that aren't too complicated to use.
cons: Doesn't enhance your physical traits.
Although the crystals are light, they can increase your weight if used too much.

name: Bullet Time
overview: manipulate & slow time in combat
description: When fighting, you can slow down the perception of time making everything slow movement to sped up. You have from a micro-second to a minute of added reflex, agility, & speed as time slows. Countering an attack or dodging. As your time manipulation ends, everything starts to speed up till its normal. You don't have all the power like in the Matrix or 300 & the One, just half. Not super strength or fly. Just a little bending of physic laws.
pros: Slo-mo fighting
Added speed & agility of up to a minute
cons: Only have a short time frame of power
Not as powerful as seen in bullet time fighting movies

name: Chance Of Success
overview: increase probablity if you bet on the outcome with this lowest probability of happening.
description: Increases the probability of your bet successfully becoming true only if you bet on the outcome with the lowest probability of occurring. The outcome is not guaranteed to occur with this power but those with mastery of this power can cause the probability to increase to 50%. Works on any bet that is made with other people. Works on the lowest probability outcome out of a set of outcomes that you are aware of.
pros: Have a higher chance on winning bets that you would normally lose.
Can be used to make a lot of money.
Can have different effects depending on what is being bet on.
cons: If a bet has two outcomes with equal chance of happening then this power does nothing.
Can only raise probability to 50% so you can still lose.
Only works on the outcome with lowest probability.

name: Tissue Generation And Control.
overview: control and generate biological tissue.
description: With this power, you can create biological tissues that can give you new or stronger abilities. You can make more muscle tissue to be stronger or can create the tissue of an electric eel's electric organ for biological zapping powers. You can regenerate if you're hurt, but this will require many tissue regenerations. You do have to have bulky arms if you add more muscle tissue. You can however make the created tissues go away at will.
pros: Don't have to consume water or food.
Can get other creative powers like electric eel organ tissue or bone spikes.
Can be super strong in seconds.
cons: Must have imagination.
Have to be logical, tissues can make energy out of nothing but no super magic or other weird tissue.

name: Event Cloak
overview: create a time gap within light
description: Unlike classic invisibility cloaks, which bend light around an object, an event cloak would open up a time gap in the light by slowing its speed, and then sealing it again to hide all traces of activity within the gap. It works like crossing a special highway where some cars slow down, creating a jaywalker-friendly, vehicle-free gap, before speeding up again to re-establish the seamless flow of traffic. Event cloaking would allow you to do pretty much anything without anyone knowing.
pros: Rob a bank in broad daylight becaue no one can see you, or any of your actions for that matter
No one can prove you ate the last cookie
Security cameras are useless since you and anything you do is hidden within the light
cons: Motion sensors
You can still make noise, so it's best to do things quietly

name: Cheat Code
overview: use cheat codes in real life.
description: Cheat codes are no longer just for video games; with this power, you can use cheat codes for real life. Skip - Next significant stage in your life. Redo - Do over a stage in your life again. 2nd Chance - Like having many lives; basically, you cheat death.  You can do any cheat code that you can relate into your life. Cheat codes for life aren't actual codes--you just input the code into your mind.
pros: Can use cheat codes when playing sports, taking test examinations etc.
Skip boring moments of your life.
Redo your mistakes.
cons: Skipping stages in your life defeats the purpose of your life.
Cannot control what happens when skipping stages.

name: Gift Of Dionysus
overview: manipulate and enchant water, or any body of liquid with magical qualities
description: You can enchant any body of liquid (within a container, cup, etc., it cannot be directly from the tap). You can turn a regular glass of tap water into an elixir that heals all wounds, a love potion, an invisibility serum, or spike the drinks of others and have an army of slaves. You must be touching the object which contains the liquid, or the liquid itself. The maximum amount of liquid you may enchant is limited by your weight, e.g. if you weighed 100kg, then the limit you may enchant is 100L.
pros: Cure diseases. They can also be made to work for a limited time FYI
Make yourself and others smarter, younger, fitter, give them powers even!
An army of eternally loyal slaves to do your bidding
cons: Could get into the wrong hands,
If you give you friends powers, it could corrupt them and they might go on to tell others about you
Use it as many times as you like but the amount you can enchant is limited by your body weight

name: Shadow Kinetic Pulse
overview: indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to redirect it as a shockwave.
description: The user can steal the potiential energy then merge it into a grayish kinetic pulse. The objects and living things will be blown away especially those that can't move.
pros: Powerful shockwave attacks
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
cons: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Mobile Invisibility
overview: be invisible while you're moving around
description: Someone with this power can be invisible, but only while they are moving around. Until the higher levels of this power are reached the holder of this power cannot control whether they become invisible or not while moving around. Automatic functions of the body do not count as movement.
pros: Can sneak around, but only while moving around.
Makes the whole body invisible regardless of what is moved.
If you have Superhuman Stamina.
cons: Some users can only make the body part they're moving around invisible.
Forgetting that you have to move around for this power to work.

name: Willpower Mimicry
overview: transform into pure willpower.
description: The Will, is the most powerful primal inner force that can exist inside any conscious being. It is the power that drives our ability to choose & act. Even though it is unseen or unheard at most times, its manifestations in the physical realm is undeniable. A person with this ability is a very formidable opponent; being able to transform himself into pure willpower he has omnipotence over his own will & actions & can control the freewill or actions of others living and non-living alike.
pros: Time, Space, & anything in it is a slave to your freewill. Induce them to act according to your wish
When you are in this form you are intagible, indestructible, and unpercievable by the 5 senses.
You are immune to all types of control or attack that targets the mind.
cons: When in this form both body and soul is rendered nonexistent.
You cannot directly attack anything or anyone with this form, you can only control them.
People that possess strong willpower can resist you.

name: Peak Human Potential
overview: reach a level of physical fitness beyond that of a superb Olympian or fighter.
description: Also known as peak human physical condition, this is the ability to reach a level of physical fitness beyond that of a superb Olympian or fighter. This primarily involves the vastness of human feats such as athleticism or combat, with marksmanship included.
pros: Your strength would be at the pinnacle of human perfection.
You would be able to run and move at speeds superior to those of any Olympic athlete.
Your musculature would be considerably more efficient than that of an average human.
cons: Your strength would not be superhuman.
Your endurance and stamina would be limited.
You would still be susceptible to illness and injury as any normal human is.

name: Immunity
overview: be immune to all viruses and diseases.
description: You will never get sick ever again.  You will always be healthy in terms of viruses and diseases.
pros: Never have the flu, a cold, or get sick for that matter.
Immune to cancer
Less co-pays!
cons: You can still get injured (but with no infection!)

name: Fourth Dimensional Existence
overview: exist in the fourth spatial dimension
description: We live in a 3-D world. But there are more D's than meet the eye. A person with this ability exists in 4 dimensions. This allows them to do many feats, like stand outside the 3rd dimension and thus become invisible and intangible, knock people into the 4th dimension, see inside people's bodies, defy natural laws, and do many other impossible acts. If you need an analogy, think of a 3-D man interacting with a 2-D universe.
pros: Do the impossible
Multiple applications (invisibility, intangibility, etc.)
Can find many mysteries of the universe
cons: May alienate you from our dimension
May become cold and detached
Can lose some emotional capacity

name: Green Light
overview: generate a green aura that speeds your cognition and reflexes.
description: A green flashing aura that greatly heightens your speed, reflexes and intellect (all things that require neurotransmission).
pros: Think fast.
Worlds fastest reflexes.
Make complex plans instantly.
cons: Your perceptions make other things seem slow

name: Water Adaptation
overview: be able to breathe underwater and withstand any level of water pressure
description: Also, when you are in the water flaps of skin will come out from between each finger and toe in order to increase your swimming ability.
pros: You can swim better.
You can stay underwater as long as you need.
cons: The pressure part only applies to water.

name: Lightning Dragon Summon
overview: summon a dragon that shoots lightning bolts out of its mouth
description: With this power you can summon a large dragon with black scales and yellow eyes from an alternate dimension. The dragon along with being able to fly, being super strong and having sharp teeth, claws and a loud deafening roar, can also shoot lightning bolts out of its mouth. The dragon is under your complete control and you can send him back to its home dimension when you're done with him.
pros: You can summon a lightning shooting, super strong, sharp toothed, flying dragon
He's under your complete control
cons: If he's killed you loose this power

name: Money Tree V7
overview: make a tree that produces an infinite amount of money
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time but it produces as much money as you want it to produce in any type of currency. This money tree also cannot be destroyed by anyone other than yourself and the when you break the branches off they turn into swords.
pros: You can have as much money as you want
The tree cannot be destroyed by anyone other than yourself
The branches can turn into swords
cons: You can only have one at a time

name: Hydra Regeneration
overview: mimic the healing abilities of the mythological Hydra.
description: In Greek Mythology, the Lernean Hydra was a creature that would grow two heads whenever one was cut off. With this power, whenever a head, arm, or leg is severed from your body, two more will grow in its place. When you no longer desire the additional appendages, they will be absorbed into your body. Extra heads provide an increased field of vision, and extra arms have a number of functions. Additional heads do not think independently and are all controlled by a single consciousness.
pros: Immunity to decapitation and limb loss.
Increased field of vision from extra heads, as well as various applications for extra arms.
Extra heads and limbs are easily disposable if undesired.
cons: Any extra legs will only get in your way (but they can easily be absorbed back into your body).
Generally makes you look like a freak (but again, this can easily be fixed).

name: Special Energy Body Repair
overview: replace damaged body parts with energy-based ones while the real ones heal.
description: When a part of your body is damaged, you can create an energy-based version of it. While the original one is healing, you can do normal things again. The energy actually heals that part as long it is injured. This power can repair missing limbs as well. This ability can also do organs as well.
pros: It heals your body parts.
You can do normal things while you are still injured.
Does organs as well
cons: None.

name: Speed Of Light
overview: run incredibly fast
description: Smoke your frinds. Save the day.  Run at the speed of light!
pros: save the day
smoke your frinds
make new friends
cons: hurting people
creating wind storms

name: Invisibility Bestowal
overview: turn things invisible.
description: You can turn just about anything temporarily invisible by touching them and willing it. Of course, you can turn yourself invisible too by willing yourself invisible. You are able to see the things that are turned invisible; not only the things you turned invisible, but also those done by others.
pros: Practical jokes: "He touched my hair and now I'm bald!"
Turn foe's gadgets invisible. Especially effective against Batman.
Turn teammates invisible.
cons: You'd be the one suspected whenever something's missing.

name: Poison Immunity
overview: be immune to any poison
description: You are immune to all poisons with this power. This includes mental and physical poisons as well as moral ones.
pros: Immune to poisons without need to build up resistance.
You can eat fugu safely! It's a Japanese delicacy of pufferfish.
You'll never be greedy, angry, or ignorant (3 Buddhist Poisons).
cons: Won't have the thrill of not knowing whether the fugu was incorrectly prepared.
Might get the physical only version.
Can still get killed by a poisoned dagger slitting your throat.

name: Ecokinesis
overview: become one with nature and control it. "Force of Nature"
description: Anything that has to do with nature like "storms" or anything that relates to storms and their effects you can control with this power. You can become a "Force of Nature."
pros: You can control the weather
Dazzle your onlookers
cons: Can get out of control

name: Alter
overview: turn your body into different substances
description: With Alter, you can change into nearly any other substance. Don't like all the traffic? Become fire and melt everything in your way. Gone fishing and dropped your stuff in a lake? Become iron and sink to the bottom, then become air and float back up. Other forms include Ether, Sand, Light, Argon, and Electricity. You always retain your shape, however.
pros: Gain a variety of powers
Limited by your creativity
cons: You retain your human shape

name: Realizer
overview: make any game characters or creatures become real
description: You can take any living thing from a game and make it real.
pros: Can have an army of minions
Can meet your favorite character
cons: If you don't have control, they can run wild

name: The Human Element
overview: draw energy from people around you
description: Allows you to draw energy from groups of people around you and you can use that energy to heal yourself or others,give yourself a boost eg. If your feeling tired it will wake you up.
pros: Useful if you live in a big city.
People drinking coffee are almost unlimited power sources.
You can use it on your enemy to make them tired or have fatigue.
cons: If there is not a crowd or group of people near you you can't use this power.
It's hard to control and you might use it on yourself by accident.
ONLY humans.

name: Durable Life Span
overview: be resistant of ANY damage imaginable.
description: The person is indestructible to any damage.  He/She can never die from getting shot, stabbed, electrocuted, burned, or even get inflicted with ALL of the diseases in the world. Even when the person gets Radioactively vaporized, the person will rapidly regenerate.  However, there's a difference between being Immortal and having a Durable Life Span. Even though He/She is Indestructible, the person can still age and die from old age.
pros: You are Indestructible to any harm imaginable.
Since you have a longer life span, you age a lot slower. So you can live up from 150 to 310.
cons: You are still susceptible to old age.
Since you are still susceptible to old age, you die of old age.

name: Momentum Charge
overview: charge objects with momentum
description: Charge any object or person with "momentum energy" then release it forcing them forward at massive speeds.
pros: Works on any object you touch, including air.
Can charge yourself, increasing jump capacity
Turn objects or people into projectiles
cons: Only works on objects you touch
Must release a certain amount of energy every 24 hours to prevent discomfort

name: Ambient Empathy
overview: increase physical capabilities through interaction with ambient energies
description: Your physical attributes including strength, speed, durability, stamina, and healing will increase depending on how much ambient energy you absorb, e.g. photons, radioactivity, heat, magnetism etc. depending on the user and their experience and will power this ability can be limitless
pros: Easy energy source for enhanced stats
limitless potential even potentially surpassing supermans strength
cons: If not controlled properly, will short circuit electrical devices
Cannot redirect as beams or whatever
Requires a strong mind and training

name: Attunement To Time
overview: be totally attuned to time and temporal energy.
description: This power makes the user totally attuned to time and temporal energy, as well as time being attuned to them (consciously and unconsciously). This means that the user's thoughts are rapidly acted out by time, this even applies to subconscious thoughts. This means that not only will the time be like an extra limb to the user but it will change rapidly like they themself had been going to in the first place. In addition, the user can sense some of the nuances of time (being attuned to it).
pros: You can rapidly and easily change time.
Time has a tendency to protect you (due to a subconscious need to survive).
You can sense the nuances of time and how it flows.
cons: If the user's internal clock is messed up, then time will act differently for them.
Similarly, if the user has a different perception of time, then that will be what time is for them.
Time even acts to SUBCONSCIOUS thoughts.

name: Data Collect
overview: collect data and use the knowledge to your advantage
description: By looking at something, you are able to gain all the information regarding that object, person or element you've looked at. As long as it's a direct eye contact for 60 seconds
pros: You can use the information as intel for your bosses
You are able to find out the target's weaknesses
You can use the information to build something useful for you if it's a blueprint
cons: If it is covered by something like a cloth, then the power is negated
You can't use this power without glasses.
You have to have direct eye contact for 60 seconds, no glances or one second sight

name: Tele Grabbing
overview: grab anything out of the TV
description: What if you had the ability to grab food, clothes, even money out of the TV and make it reality? If you're hungry you can just walk up to the TV, grab a pizza and eat it right then and there in your own living room! Now THAT'S room service! And since whatever you grab will be duplicated, the object will be in your hand as well as the TV. And no one will notice
pros: You don't have to wait to get what you want
The bigger the TV, the bigger the object you can pull out
No one in the TV notices you grabbing objects
cons: You can't grab objects larger than your TV
When grabbing out of the TV, you may grab something you didn't want
You can't stick your entire body in the TV

name: Diamond Shards
overview: shoot diamond-hard bolts of energy.
description: Someone with this ability can impale several different people with the shards and puncture even the hardest metals on Earth. The power takes small portions of the carbon material already in your body and transmutes them into energy, so the more you use it, the less of your "self" you leave behind.
pros: Nearly unstoppable energy attack
Impossibly sharp
Can shoot up to 10 shards at one time
cons: The transmutation of the carbon atoms in your body leaves you weak
Takes several days to weeks to recover
Not effective against real diamonds

name: The Will: Tactile Terrakinesis
overview: control geological elements through both physical contact and willpower
description: This form of terrakinesis is extremely rare, but also highly versatile. Unlike other psychic powers, this one is controlled by your willpower. You can control the ground you stand on in any way imaginable, and create earthquakes, landslides, rifts, and many other natural phenomena directly related to the earth. You also have natural regeneration, and can heal others regardless of ailment or injury severity.
pros: Have extremely strong and precise control over geological elements
Be a formidable fighter!
Gain accelerated cellular regeneration with absorbed terrakinetic energy
cons: A very dangerous power in the wrong hands
Some people might find this power dangerous, and thus fear you
This is a 'tactile' ability: you ALWAYS need to have physical contact with the earth to control it

name: Target
overview: have perfect accuracy & marksmanship with almost any object.
description: Like Bullseye & Red Arrow, you'll have superb accuracy & marksmanship. Besides conventional weapons like guns, you'll also be able to use ordinary objects & turn it into a lethal projectile. Never mis your target & you can kill them with Post-It notes or staples.
pros: Never miss your target.
Greatest assassin in the world.
Turn any object into a lethal weapon.
cons: Have to be careful what you toss to a friend or you might kill them.
Become a Most Wanted because you are a super killer.

name: Hammerspace Manipulation
overview: completely control hammerspace.
description: Hammerspace is, in essence, a storehouse of a dimension. Thus, if you have absolute control of it, you are able to do things like produce things from thin air, make objects vanish, and even teleport by putting yourself into hammerspace.
pros: Teleporting is possible.
You can produce things from thin air.
You can create a void that sucks in things like bullets into hammerspace.
cons: You're not immortal.
You're easily susceptible to sniper rifles and the latter.
If you don't concentrate on what you're pulling out of hammerspace, you might not get what you need.

name: Dark Spawn
overview: use your dark energy to spawn absolutely anything
description: A dark spawner can generate dark energy and use it to spawn anything his mind can come up with. It could spawn weapons, different items and vehicles. The dark spawner could also spawn puppets to do his bidding. Puppets are creatures created by the spawner's imagination, with powers and sometimes minds of their own. The spawner can also spawn wings on his back to fly. Spawning money is also possible. Anything you spawn must stay within your vicinity to exist otherwise they wouldn't last for long.
pros: Could create anything your heart desires or needs to survive
Puppets are awesome and can be powerfull allies or just good to have around
Wings dude wings... Well you could spawn a hover-board too... Anyway you could fly
cons: Uses up a lot of energy and the bigger and more complicated you try to spawn the more energy you use
Forgetting you have wings attached to your back (what that could happen)
You will be counting a lot on your puppets and won't actually fight yourself

name: Age Transferral
overview: transfer the essence of age between yourself and the environment.
description: With this power, you can make yourself younger or older by transferring the essence of age to a living thing. Thus, if you touched someone and made yourself a year older, they would become a year younger. It does not need to be a human; it can be any living thing, so you can ripen fruit quickly. This power requires skin-to-skin contact.
pros: Keep yourself at the same age for as long as you like.
Help the elderly and those with ageing disorders, as long as you have a source of youth.
You can absorb youth in a harmless way, such as by ripening fruit.
cons: You need a source of youth to stay or become young.
Ageing is useless against immortals.
Requires touch.

name: Focus Sight Regeneration
overview: recover from wounds by simply looking at them.
description: With this ability, you can recover from cuts, bruises, or any other type of wound simply by looking at them. This, however, does not work on other people.
pros: Recover from any type of wound by looking at it.
cons: Does not work on other people.
If there's a wound on your back, you can't recover ( Except by using a mirror )

name: Mechanical Transmutation
overview: change one type of machine or piece of technology into another.
description: This is the psychic ability to change one machine or piece of technology into another. One with this ability can change a computer into a TV, or a cellphone into a flashdrive. The user can even psychically advance a machine or piece of tech into its more advanced version (turning your old cellphone into a copy of the newest model, or any other type you desire, or the like). This ability can also reverse that process.
pros: Have any type of technology you want (Need a cell phone? Get a much cheaper version and change it)
Have it be as advanced as you like (If you don't like the new version, change it back.)
Change other people's tech as well (make it more/less advanced or just make it dysfunctional).
cons: Often requires contact.
Must be of similar size (but this can be remedied by combining numerous pieces of tech).
If your power is undeveloped, you may not be able to control when tech changes, or what it becomes.

name: Momentum Killer
overview: stop movement of everything around you, including you.
description:
The ability to stop the movement of everything around you within a five-yard radius for a few seconds, including yourself. After the few seconds in which all movement is frozen, momentum is stopped and gravity takes effect. 

An example: a bullet is stopped in midair. After a few seconds in which everything is stopped, gravity kicks in and they fall to the ground. 

It can only be used for 10 seconds consecutively and then requires a 5 second cooldown.
pros: Can block bullets and drop them to the ground around you
Fire can be put out by stopping the vibration of molecules
Can be used to break a fall
cons: Only lasts for 10 seconds, and needs a cooldown
You can't move while you use it

name: Layer Reinforcement
overview: make anything harder up to the level of diamonds without losing mobility
description: With this power, you can make anything harder up to the level of diamonds. You can selectively make only some parts be hard as well. Hardened objects are the same weight as before, but are deceptively more durable. The hard properties are only on the surface. Hardened liquids/gases stay on the surface they were originally on so you can create non-moving barriers of air or water. Also you can throw hardened air as projectiles or trap people in a hardened bubble of water or a cube of air.
pros: Iron body that is not heavy
You can harden air to walk on or create a barrier
You can reinforce your blunt force weapons
cons: Hardened objects allow light and other particles to pass through(can be good or bad)
Can be mistaken as mimesis

name: Summon Transportation
overview: summon any form of transportation.
description: With this power you can summon any form of transportation such as vehicles and mounts. The transportation can be for land, air, water, or even space and does not have to exist normally such as a UFO or dragon. The rides can only be used for transportation purposes meaning that you can not make the dragons breath fire on people or run over things in your vehicle. You can unsummon the transportations at will as long as you can survive without them, so you can not unsummon UFO in Space.
pros: Always have a way to travel.
Have a better ride than your friends or enemies.
Create your own collection of vehicles.
cons: Have to know how to drive what you summon.
Can only be used for transportation purposes.
Larger forms of transportation are harder to summon.

name: 3 D Subconscious World Builder
overview: enter your subconcious and create you own world with anything you want
description: One can enter their own subconcious into a ''blueprint'' kind of world where they can make anything and control anything e. G. Time speed, oxygen levels e. T. C. They are basically god's in this world. More advanced users of this techniques can project aspects of their world onto the real life. But a special barrier prevents the projection of OP'ditems into the real world. It is also possible for one to suck another into this world. But it required a long time of charging up and an unwary enemy.
pros: You can do anything as long as your subconcious is up for it
You can project anything (except OP'd items) Into the real world
You can make wacky items to solve real world problems
cons: If you do manage to suck someone into this world they could run amok and destroy your mind
The more complex the item the more time it takes to build
The bigger the world the bigger the persons mental capacity needs to be to store it

name: Superhuman Durability
overview: possess a superhuman resistance to damage
description: People have dreamt of Superhuman Durability ever since the Grecian age. A person with Superhuman Durability can withstand an I-beam being dropped on them with minor bruises, a knife with superficial cuts, and a bullet will only penetrate their skin. They are not invunerable (they can still be hurt), and they possess no other superhuman attributes.
pros: Things hurt less
Take less physical damage
Resistant to corrosives, burning, etc.
cons: Not totally invunerable
No other superhuman attributes
Surgery

name: Hands Of Hephaestus
overview: melt and cool a metal surface with your hand.
description: Using your hand to grab, or hold, or to place it, the area underneath it will melt, and it will be able to hold to only you. Think of your hands as anvils to metal only, being able to shape small chunks of it and even add it together. Although if you attemp to touch/melt copper or iron your hands will burn up and have serious burns for 3 weeks. You can also cool the metal on demand.
pros: Create a weapon anytime.
Could stop bullets or any metal weapon by putting hands in the way.
Open doors and metal boxes by sticking hands through.
cons: Could try to do it without knowing it's copper or iron you'll burn up.
May not always have metal near you.
May be attacked by wooden or plastic weapons and rubber bullets.

name: Atomic Energy Manipulation
overview: manipulate atomic energy.
description: Atomic energy is what makes things what they are. Your control over this energy gives you great power. When you produce the energy it will appear as orange light and/or electicity. When you shoot it at something, your target's molecular structure will change in some way. For example, if you blast a chair, it might change into gold or some other material. Also it's atoms might rearrange themselves into something else, like a glass bowl. With practice, you might be able to control this change.
pros: Manipulating Matter
Very powerful
You might be able to rearrange atoms
cons: Very hard to control

name: Psychic Bursts
overview: make explosions of psychic powers with your hands.
description: The power to make psychic bursts with your hands, making things explode, implode or shatter.
pros: Great offensive power.
Great defensive power when in trouble.
Disappear with it.
cons: Big explosions could destroy the Earth.
Takes some concentration.

name: Inclusion
overview: include yourself in things.
description: This power is virtualy the polar opposite of exemptedness because instead of exemp yourself you can include yourself in things. For example if youre enemy is attacking you and theres protection near include yourself in it. This also allows you to include yourself in information, people using their beneficial powers on a group and more. You can even stop yourself from dying by including yourself in a persons youth or the fact that they are not dead.
pros: Include yourself to a group or certain access.
Many different uses.
Include yourself in a person's list of trusted people.
cons: If there is nothing to be included in.
Not much protection to be included in when confronted with high level powers.
Can't include yourself in a persons protection powers.

name: Psychic And Psionic Weapons
overview: create Psychic and Psionic weapons that attack the mental body instead of the physical one
description: This ability allows you to attack the mental body instead of the physical one. You can create daggers, swords, guns, hammers, any weapon you want. You can completely K.O. someone without touching the physical body.
pros: K.O. someone way easier
cons: If someone has the ability to block mental attacks, the weapons are useless.

name: Astro Spear
overview: convert cosmic energy into powerful blasts & can destroy evil ailens and beings of dark magic.
description: The Spear had many names (cosmic lance, galaxy pike, judas killer). It can give you the ability of flight & different variations have allowed different powers including; levitating objects, creating force fields for both offense and defense, manipulating energy, and creating simple energy constructs. The spear also will "attune itself" to the user allowing you to control the spear by thought. You can also use it to kill off dark magical demons & evil alien warlords.
pros: Can convert any cosmic energy into powerful blast to aim it at your opponent.
It can only be used by the forces of light.
cons: Nothing bad here.

name: Book Character Summon
overview: summon any fictional character from a book
description: With this power you can summon any character that's ever appeared in any fictional book (no biographies, encyclopedias etc. ) This power does not apply to comic books or graphic novels either. The characters are not under your control but depending on who you summon they might want to help you. When you're done with them you can just send them back to their home universe.
pros: You can summon any character from any fictional book ever written
cons: They are not under your control
They might want to kill you

name: Creature Cloner
overview: clone any mythical creature
description: With this power you can clone any mythical creature/monster/cryptid. The clone will look exactly like the real thing but be under your control and only have half the strength/power on the real thing. You can only clone monsters that you've either seen in real life or seen a picture of.
pros: You can clone any creature
The clone is under your control
You can summon and unsummon the clone whenever you want
cons: The clones have only half the strength/power of the real deal
You can only clone creatures that you've either seen ir real life or some sort of depiction of

name: Mind Bullets
overview: shoot psychokinetic energy blasts, causing mental, emotional or physical pain
description: Using the gun gesture with your hands and fingers, you can shoot psychic energy at a person. From powerful telekinetic energy bursts, which can bruise or puncture flesh like a bullet, to emotional empathic pain or mental pain that makes a person go catatonic. The downside is you can only shoot 15 times at once before having to rest and recharge, or you risk passing out from mental exhaustion or worse. You can recharge with quick meditation and focus.
pros: Shoot psychic energy at a person causing different kinds of pain
cons: You can only shoot 15 times, or else you will pass out if you don't rest and recharge real quick

name: Gift: Speed
overview: be gifted at high speed movement
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at moving at high speeds than other beings. Thus their speed-based powers are faster than most other being's powers and it is harder to slow them down. However, someone with this power can only recieve speed-based powers, nothing else.
pros: Almost no one is as fast as someone with this power.
Speed-based powers are boosted slightly.
cons: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only speed-based powers now.

name: Universal Armor
overview: use basic natural elements, minerals, fluids and energy as armor.
description: Iron Man? Not if you don't want to be. Make armor of elements (minerals), fluids (any for of water, acids, gases), base energy (sunlight, fire). Cover yourself with iron, diamond, ice, fire, the list is almost endless. You could increase your armor size if there is enough of the element around you. If someone counters your armor you could shed it and conjure up new armor. Do you like money? Your shed armor can be collected and sold.
pros: You can make armour of any single element, energy, fluid on earth
Gaseous armour give you the ability of flight, hard mineral superstrength, energy speed
Each element you use allows you immunity against that element while in armour
cons: One element at a time & the element must occur in nature. Alloys like steel are prohibited
You are taking the elements from the earth and your surroundings, be careful of what you deplete
Another element could counter your armour

name: Mind Hopping
overview: transfer your consciousness from one individual to another.
description:
Used as a reconnaissance ability, Mind hopping allows the user to transfer their mind to anyone within their line of sight. They essentially 'piggy back' on another's consciousness; they can see/hear/think what the host does, but the host is unaware. From this host, the user can 'hop' to another individual in line of sight, and so span great distances. 

To get back to their own mind, however, they need to 'hop' back via line of sight, and their body is left vulnerable while their mind is away.
pros: Gain information about people and places some distance away, even people's thoughts.
Suggestive influence whilst inhabiting a mind.
Be able to enter the deepest rings of an organisation completely undetected.
cons: Body left vulnerable by absence. Can be overcome by hiding, but...
Difficult to get back to body, as sight is needed. Could have a partner to 'bring mind' back to you.
If someone you are inhabiting dies, you die.

name: Spectre
overview: turn into a ghost along with anything else you touch.
description: With this power you can change to a ghost and back, it is instant. As a ghost you will appear translucent but you will keep your human shape, you will appear as if you are underwater. Anything you are touching will became ghostly too, including clothes & weapons. You can have weapons & bullets phase right through you, they will slow down slightly due to the fact you have slight mass. While in ghost form, you can phase through anything and breathe underwater. When changing back, wounds all heal.
pros: No prison can hold you.
Indestructable unless caught by suprise.
Never ever leaving the keys indoors again.
cons: Might make you a social outcast.
Won't shield you if sniped or caught by suprised.
Turning it off while in a wall will kill you.

name: Take Over
overview: take another persons power when you beat them
description: This power allows you to take a persons power when the person is beaten by you in any competition, allowing you to have multiple powers in your arsenal at the same time.
pros: Multiple powers at once
An edge of suprise for enemies in small competitions
cons: If your first competion is a fight, your power is useless
Your opponent will be pissed at you if you take his/her power
Accounts even for small competitions like rock, paper, scissors

name: Matter Motion Alteration
overview: increase or decrease the energy in atoms to alter any matter's structure and movement.
description: All matter is moving, even solid matter moving in a slow rate. With this ability, you can change the energy, that allows matter to move, at any speed you want. You can mostly use it on your body to make it as slow and solid as rock or as quick and unstable as liquid, gas, or plasma.
pros: Can change the speed of energy in matter.
Can make things sturdy or unstable.
cons: Can't think of one.

name: Life Energy Absorption Aura
overview: live longer when someone dies
description: Whenever someone dies within the radius of a kilometer of you (your aura), you feel their death and can choose to live x years longer, where x is the age of the person who died divided by ten. Every time you use this power, your aura decreases by 1 meter, so you can only use this 1000 times at max. This only expands your lifespan and does not prevent dying during your extended life.
pros: Good for soldiers.
Can live longer.
Can choose whenever you want to use your power.
cons: Does not prevent deaths.
Can only be used up to 1000 times.

name: Light Condense
overview: condense light into solid matter
description: Condense the surrounding light into a near indestructible object. You could create armour, sheilds and weapons. You can also use it to make walls, boxes and other helpful objects. Light objects can be warped to bend or twist. You can also condense the light in a room to a small object, effectively removing the light.
pros: Always have a weapon ready.
You can put your enemys into darkness.
cons: Would not be as effective at night.
If you tryed to condense light outside you could condense the sun creating a black hole

name: Electro Magnetic Spectrum
overview: control the wavelength of all possible frequencies of radiation.
description: You would be able to control the electromagnetic spectrum easily. Ranging from being able to pick up radio frequencies and manipulating them to attacking with high energy gamma waves. You dont even have to attack them because visible light is part of the spectrum so you could easily just blind them and leave.
pros: Amazing ranges of attacks
Offensive and defensive
cons: Can be very deadly if you dont know what you are capable of

name: Anywhere Flight
overview: fly at any speed, anywhere.
description: This power allows you to fly anywhere as fast as you want--even in space--by forming an air filled, pressurized force field around you. The force field needs at least minor concentration to maintain.
pros: Fly in water, space, anywhere!
Always have breathable air
Fly as fast as you want.
cons: Can get lost.
Force field won't work if you don't pay attention to it.
Force field can only stop minor physical damage.

name: Fracture
overview: use your telekinetic ability to make a straight, clean slice through any surface any length away.
description: With this power you can create a slice for up to a mile with a cut straight through, about 50 feet max. The cut that you produce will make a loud crack when you make it. To make your "slice of death," you need to clap your hands once together. The sound that you make is a crack as loud as a gunshot. You can also point with your index finger and make a sort of invisible micro light saber for up to a mile distance.
pros: With one clap, you can make a clean straight cut though anything, including foes or mountains.
With a point of your finger, you can draw a cut line for anything you need to do.
You can potentially end a fight with a great big applause. : )
cons: You also cut anything in the way to your target.
There isn't a cool loud crack when you use the index finger method.
You can't see the split go on its way since it happens just like that right when the hands meet.

name: An Old Soul
overview: gain all of the strength and wisdom of your dead ancestors!
description: This power lets you call upon and gain the strength and wisdom of all your ancestors when they were at their peak. You wouldn't even need to know about the ancestor, you can/will automatically get it..
pros: Super strength!
Super smart!
You get to know your ancestors
cons: You'll have the memories of your ancestors. (good and bad ones).
Your ancestors don't get to know you

name: Genre Mimicry
overview: become a different version of oneself based off a kind of genre.
description: Here is how this ability. The user watches a action movie. With this ability, the user becomes more a action hero. Depending on what genre they watch or read, the user can acquire powers that comes with the genre form. The person even changes clothes and personalities to fit the genre.
pros: Become a new you
Gain new powers
cons: Won't work if have not seen a certain genre before

name: Doppelganging
overview: generate copies of others for various purposes
description: Also called Doppelganger Generation or Doppelganger Summoning, this power can be used only to produce replicates of others. However, this is not a disadvantage; certain effects may be obtained by producing these replicates. Some can transfer their souls temporarily into the doppelgangers they generate, while others psychically command them. Some can even use the doppelganger to do damage too, which in turn harms the person the doppelganger resembles.
pros: Generate doppelgangers of others (three words: Angelina Jolie doppelganger) for your own purposes
If you psychically command the doppelganger, they can be directed telepathically/empathically
The doppelganger requires little effort to generate and/or disperse and last as long as desired
cons: Only one can be generated at a time (have as many as you like, but they must come one at a time)
They may be kinda dumb (unless you can mimic and/or imprint knowledge as well)
They can be dispersed by others psionically

name: Kinetic Amplification
overview: amplify your exerted kinetic force
description: The kinetic force you exert when punching will be greatly amplified to a superhuman punch with lightning speed. So your strength & speed are charged with amped up kinetic energy & increased to greater power. Your jumps will be almost boundless. But if you pick up something heavy, you better throw it quick, because stopping/slowing down will decrease your kinetic energy down to normal. Plus you have to be careful what you through to, because that object will have the force of a speeding train.
pros: Your exerted kinetic force will be amped
Increased strength & speed
cons: Cannot really stop or slow down for the power energy will be less
Have to be careful when using your power, because you'll have wrecking ball force

name: Projective Time Freezing
overview: astrally project while simultaneously freezing time until you return to your body
description: A person with this power has the ability to freeze time while astro projecting themselves. This makes them a great scout since they can see ahead while prevent anything from happening while they were out. You can go through all walls except for lead walls. You can also use subliminal messaging by whispering while in astral form. You can also hit normally intangible objects while in astal form. Their is no limit to your range, except you cannot enter/exit lead rooms and radiation still hurts you.
pros: Almost perfect ghost buster--ghos's are frozen in time while you are free to attack
Can't be attacked and you can scout ahead or think of a plan while time is frozen
No time limit and you do not age when astral projected.
cons: Can't attack other people unless they are a ghost/intangible
If you become distracted and time is forever stopped
Can't exit out of lead rooms

name: Super Power List Support
overview: summon a goblin that can teach how to use every power on this list.
description: Summons a intangible goblin that can only be seen by you. The goblin has every power on the list but is unable to use the powers to affect the real world. The goblin must also follow any instruction you give him. The goblin is an expert on every power he possess so he can teach you to master any power you gain from this site. It is impossible for the goblin to break free from your control and cause chaos in the real world.
pros: Teaches to become a master in any power.
Visual aid and training programs for powers.
Free invisible / intangible goblin.
cons: If you happen to get an annoying goblin.
Will look like youre talking to yourself. Can't have goblin train others.
May take long time to train to mastery.

name: Containment Field
overview: create a forcefield that lets nothing out
description: Got a highly flammable material or radioactive waste? Do you fear accidents happening? Fear no more! This power will create a forcefield that will not let anything out until the user decides the field is unneeded. Limits on field is it can be no bigger than a 1 kilometre radius and no smaller than a 3 centimetre radius.
pros: Anything can get in, nothing can get out (also a con).
Field stays up until user does not need the field.
Can move the field as needed.
cons: Have to be able to control objects you summon
Anything can get in, nothing can get out (also a pro).
Enemies with Barrier Defiance or Barrier Melting.

name: Emotions Are The Enemy
overview: overwhelm someone with their emotions.
description: The user of this ability is able to draw pure emotion from either their own or another's memories and manifest them into a physical form. That form can be anything from a statue, to a ball of light, to a puddle but the effect will always be the same: an aura of its patron emotion that overpowers a persons or group of people's rational selves.
pros: Instant distraction with an emotion "bomb" if you need to make a quick getaway.
Have the ability to keep yourself calm in stressful situations.
Alternatively; you can keep your enemies off balance by flooding them with anger.
cons: Memories used to get emotions could lose all meaning to the person they were gotten from.
If the emotions are gotten from the user they run the risk of losing them completely.
Prolonged exposure to an emotion construct could cause personalities to be permanently changed.

name: Pictomancy
overview: draw a picture and have it come to life/ happen
description: The ability to draw a picture and have it happen. Draw a scene, it happens. Draw a new creature, it now exists. Draw someone dead, then they're dead.
pros: Bend reality easily
Can redesign self to change look and give powers.
Can redesign others to change look and other things
cons: Need artist skill
Must draw an entire scene
Not meant for battle

name: Empathy
overview: sense and control the emotions of others.
description: Empathy, sometimes called Telempathy,is the ability to sense the emotions of those around you and influence those emotions. This power can be used to instill confidence, fear, anger or any other emotion in anyone you choose. Empathy can also be used to channel the emotions of a victim into the mind of their attacker and force them to relive what their victim felt until they fell guilt for what they did.
pros: Cannot be lied to because you would sense the lie.
Can make others feel what you are feeling or vice versa to improve interpersonal relationships.
Can incapacitate an opponent with a simple thought.
cons: If in a crowded room emotions can be overwhelming.
Opponent can use the ability against you to force you to feel their rage which can be painful you.

name: Alternate Self Summon
overview: summon alternate versions of yourself to aid you
description: This ability allows the summoner to summon alternate versions of themselves, the alternate versions have different powers due to the fact that their from different dimensions.
pros: You would be stonger in numbers
No one version has the same power, so variety
cons: You wouldn't know if the alternate version is good or evil
Some powers might be lame

name: Intellectual Surge
overview: obtain and instant intellectual surge/rush.
description: You gain an instant rush or surge of knowledge coursing through your brain, it happens at random and is involuntary. You don't have to be aware or be taught that knowledge. It's more an instant absorption of the knowledge possessed by others through a telepathic process.
pros: Gain an instant rush of knowledge.
Knowledge does not have to be taught or shown in any direct way.
cons: Is an involuntary ability; thererfore can not be controlled.
Ability happens at random.

name: Reality/Imagination Confusion
overview: make someone unable to distinguish between reality and their own imagination.
description: This power allows you to curse anyone to be unable to tell the difference between imagination and reality. They won't be able to tell if something or someone is real or imaginary. Imagined objects will appear as real to them, no matter how goofy it would seem to a normal person. Imagined situations can appear as real memories or seem to occur in front of them. If they are imagining a fictional world, they can become trapped in it, living inside as if it was real.
pros: This curse prevents them from realizing and believing anything imaginary is false.
As time goes on, they should eventually question the veracity of reality itself.
Great against people with Extraordinary Imagination.
cons: As most curse, this one can be removed if the user is killed.

name: Rune Master
overview: create a circle-like wall of light around you that has runes on it which give you powers
description: You are able to create a ring of runes around you which give you different powers. There is one for each elements, summoning, flying, destruction, creating, invisibility, strength, speed, and one for wishes. All you need to do to use a power is touch the rune and you are able to use that power for three and a half hours, except for the wish one which stays in effect for a year. While the powers are in effect, there is a rune on the back of your hand so you know you still have the power.
pros: You can have many powers
You are able to summon creatures to your aid
You can fly
cons: Might mix up the runes
Could forget which rune stands for which power
You can only use the wish rune three times a month

name: Mental Hands
overview: have transparent hands that can come out of your body and grab objects
description: The hands can pick things up and toss them, vibrate at a high velocity and cut through anything. You can also push them into the ground to jump high. Your hands have a limited range (in meters), the range varies from person to person, some have a two meter range, others have an eleven meter range. Your hands are also limited to a certain number. You can get more with practice. From time to time your hands may become uncontrollable and might kill someone or cut something you don't want to cut.
pros: Can amputate anything
Pick up anything
Can push into the ground to jump high
cons: Having a range
Having a certain number of hands
Can't control hands at times

name: Moderate Existent Manipulation
overview: control another's perception of your existence.
description: You have moderate control over how a person perceives your existence. You can exist to a person in a certain sense: a sound, a smell, a feeling, a picture, or a taste.
pros: Excellent for stealth; you can sneak past henchmen as a peculiar smell or taste.
Can be the best thing anyone has ever tasted, smelled, felt, heard, etc.
cons: You could unintentionally make multiple people perceive you as something.

name: Dna Modification
overview: fire a beam that causes anything in the receiving end to shapeshift
description: A person with this power has the ability to shoot a beam from their hands that changes other people by changing their DNA. At first the user can only change one variable such as height, strength, gender, hair color/length. However if used a lot the user can create variations in order to change someone to match someone else's appearance. When not used on an organic life form it takes the form of a stunning concussive blast. Once mastered this can be used to create or cure mutations to the DNA.
pros: Turn people stronger/weaker or change appearance
No time limit
Can fire indefinitely like a laser
cons: Has to learn how to control beams
Can't use on something without DNA or some sort of genetic code.
If you are firing a big beam you might hit some bacteria in the air

name: Selective Fusion
overview: fuse anything together.
description: This ability allows you to take the best of one thing, and fuse it with the best of something else. For example, you could fuse a lightbulb and gun to make a light ray. It even works on people and animals. Any creatures you create are under your limited control. When you fuse two people, one of them will have main control over the body, while the other will be a voice in their head. If the people have superpowers, those will fuse too. You can also fuse things with yourself.
pros: You can fuse together almost anything
You have limited control over any creatures you create
You can fuse things with yourself
cons: Some fusions might look disgusting
Some things can't be fused

name: Ultimate Reasoning
overview: litterally infer everything possible from what you already know.
description: Described in Sherlock Holmes as "The ultimate reasoner would be able to infer the existence of Niagara falls from seeing a raindrop on the other side of the world." It's like sudoku. Most people only know a few numbers and where they fit and so are occasionally able to deduce something, but the ultimate reasoner would be able to, using only a handful of numbers, figure out everything about everything in the universe. This person would then be able to predict the future, and calculate the past.
pros: Predict the future.
Know everything.
Know the consequences of all actions, so they can effectively do anything.
cons: Become alienated.
World may lose meaning.
Depends on deterministic universe for effectiveness.

name: Void Control
overview: enables one to control Void Power
description: This power is an ability that allows one to control the massive powers of the Void. This enables the person to disappear into Void regions,rendering him or her invisible to all, but the user can still see everything. This power also allows the use of making Void Skills such as: Shields, Barriers, Blasts, and other Void related power (This is usually placed in the Magic Category)
pros: This superpower enables one to escape from unwanted conflicts (Like your nagging siblings! )
Enables one to take out the opposition in a single shot
Can not be effected by any other superpowers, other than Power Canceling Abilities
cons: Takes a huge amount of energy to use (Magic in place of energy if magic applies to the world... )
Takes a darn long time to activate

name: Blade Of Life
overview: create a pure-energy sword that heal wounds or accelerate cellular decay.
description: The subject is able to materialize a 1,10 meter long sword, made of thermodynamic and luminous energy and containing ATP, growth hormones, platelets, peptides and other molecules involved in biological processes that regenerate body cells. Stroking with this weapon s. O. Wounded or mutilated, the subject can heal his wounds by encouraging cellular proliferation. Otherwise, this sword can "steal" regenerative molecules, in order to make s. O. Decompose and fade.
pros: The sword can be used as a normal sword, because it can instantaneously cut cells with enzymes;
Healing and fading caused by the sword are almost instantaneous.
cons: Tumors and viral illnesses can't be removed, only physical injuries;
Summoning the sword postulates a big metabolism from the subject.

name: Metalworks
overview: transform your body into solid or liquid metal.
description: You've probably seen the T-1000 in the Terminator movies--this ability is very similar.  You have the power to morph parts of your body into solid or liquid metal.  You can target specific areas of your body, or you can transform your entire body.  While you can always return to your normal self, the morphed parts of yourself will become a tough metallic substance. Because of the nature of this power, you will have rapid healing abilities in the event of cuts or puncture wounds.
pros: If you're ever shot or stabbed, you can just morph the wound closed
You're tough as hell, and people won't want to mess with you
Mophing into an air glider and jumping off a cliff
cons: Transformed parts of your body change to metal only
You can't alter your overall size
For guys, some of the ladies might be a little freaked out

name: Power Accessing
overview: able to access powers through a network of super-power energy
description: You have the ability to get any power that has ever been created. This works by accessing some 'overpower' that unites all superhumans.
pros: You get to have a few powers at the same time
It's quick and simple, just imagine the power, think about it, and you have it.
You can do it anywhere.
cons: Only three powers at a time
There's a limit to how long you can "hold" onto the powers.
The more powers you gain, the less you'll be able to do with them

name: The Will
overview: have control over everyone's free will.
description: This ability allows you have complete control over people's actions, movements, and anything else that is voluntary movement. You can't stop involuntary movements like heart beats and breathing, but you can to a small extent control their emotions and feelings, but it is very limited and can only increase through experience with this power. The Will is a cross between puppeteering and possessing, where they are aware of their actions, but can't control them, unless you let them.
pros: Complete control of people's free will
cons: Limited control of emotions, thoughts, and feelings
Can not control the involuntary movements of a person.

name: Ergo  Ecosynthesis
overview: absorb elemental energy and use it to enhance other energies.
description: Like photosynthesis, the user absorbs the elemental energies of nature around them. The  user's body is capable of combining the absorbed energies to enhance other forms of energy in the user, like their heat or kinetic energy. The user can also shoot the absorbed energy to enhance other external energies and those of other people's powers.
pros: Enhance the energies inside you
Enhance external energies
Enhance other people's power
cons: Can't absorb man-made energies.
Difficult to absorb elemental energies produced by another being.

name: Spectrumal Vision
overview: fire a laser of multicolored light-based energy from your eyes.
description: You can have the power to fire beams of colorful solid light beams that produce various effects through force of will. Here are the variety of effects: green -disintegration, black - corruption, pink - confusion, yellow - paralysis, red - burnt skeletons, orange - blindness, blue - freeze vision, white - healing, violet - seduction, and gray - petrification.
pros: The effect of the color brown can turn anyone into dust.
The effect of the color indigo can cause your opponents to dissapear.
cons: None.

name: Dream Tale
overview: bring your dreams to life.
description: Dream Tale allows you to bring your dreams to life. It also allows you to control your dream once you get in the middle of it.
pros: You may be able to make a 'crush' like you
You may be able to make fake creatures real
You may be able to bring a departed one back to life
cons: You can only control dreams once you get in the middle of them
Sometimes the power goes off randomly
You can only bring back the last dream you had

name: Kinetic Energy Redirection
overview: absorb/redirect kinetic energy from anything
description: You can take kinetic energy from any object and take it for your self or redirect it inti something else. Kinetic energy can be taken from physical movement of something, down to the molecular movements of particles(heat)
pros: You can become really fast, really quick
You can increase the heat or cool things quickly (combustion to absolute zero)
You can stop a fast object dead in it's tracks
cons: You may be propeled involuntarily
You may suddenly burst into flames or freeze
Contact is needed

name: Student Of Power
overview: learn the powers of others
description: Anyone who has a power must have a method to control it. If someone with this power learned what that method was they would be able to use that power. When a power is learned the users eyes flash orange.
pros: Knowledge to you would be power!
Gain multiple powers
cons: People might not tell you their methods
Involuntary powers like healing are out of reach
Some powers are harder to learn than others

name: Seismic Shockwave
overview: create seismic shockwaves that can travel through earth, sea, and air
description: A person with this power can create shockwaves that can travel through any medium including the earth, water, and air. At first the user can only disorient people but soon if they realize their destructive potential they can create shockwaves that are on par with grenades and soon shockwaves that can cause tsunamis and earthquakes.
pros: As long as you aren't in a vacuum this can be used
You control the epicenter of where the shockwave is
It is a AoE effect
cons: Another Pro: It's invisible unless you are making earthquakes or tsunamis
It is an AoE effect(you can hit your own teammates)

name: Hunger
overview: absorb the essense of any objects in your surrounding area.
description: A person with this power can absorb any properties of objects in their surrounding area. The user then stores what they absorbed inside a special organ in their body waiting for use. The absorption proses would look like a blur in the air coming from the drained object to the user. If the object is visible than you will see shards of the object instead of the blur. If the user absorbed too much then the excess will be ejected in bolts of plasma.
pros: You can use and control the absorbed essense like a kenisis power.
Absorbing is permenent.
It is lethal when used on another person.
cons: Can only absorb so much essence.
Can not only use on one thing in your surroundings.

name: First Rule Of Business
overview: turn every weakness into a strength
description: The first rule of business is to turn all weaknesses into strengths. Give that a twist and you've got this. This will be better explained through an example. Let's say you have radiation poisoning. This power will allow you to focus that radiation into an energy blast or something. Any weakness you have will become a strength, making you very hard to hurt or beat.
pros: No more weaknesses
A lot more strengths
Could gain great and vast powers
cons: Makes you almost inhuman

name: Adept Assassination
overview: be an expert of assassination techniques.
description: With this ability, you have the qualities of an adept assassin. You can easily murder any opponent, and when in need, you can cleverly use your surroundings to create weapons or traps. Before assassinating your victim, your stealth, agility and senses are greatly increased, and you have heightened knowledge of where to strike your opponent (his weak areas. ) However, these senses return to normal If you're not attempting an assassination.
pros: Easily assassinate any average human, knowing all of his weaknesses.
You can devise clever tactics to defeat your opponents, such as traps or set-ups.
Usually manage to kill your victim without any problems, taking him out in one strike of your weapon
cons: Your opponent, from prior knowledge, may still know you are attempting to assasinate him.
It may not instantly defeat others with Superpowers, depending on what power they have.
Does not give any effect whatsoever to you unless you are assasinating someone.

name: Paint Alive
overview: paint anything and make it come alive.
description: Paint anything like animals, people or objects and make them come alive within 5 seconds.
pros: Paint the person you love and make them come alive.
Paint money and you will be able to use it everyday.
Paint a house for you to live in.
cons: Can paint weapons to harm people.
Can paint wild animals to cause troubles.
Can paint disaster to kill people.

name: Multiverse Code Master
overview: manipulate codes allowing one to go into alternate universes
description: You can create a code that, when spoken aloud, allows one to go to a parallel universe. You can create as many codes as you want, and deactivate unwanted ones, though you don't have any special knowledge of what one is being used for. As for choosing the destination (both what universe to go to and where in the universe they appear), what the code allows through, what the portal/transportation/whatever looks like, etc. , you design that when you make the code.
pros: The power to travel through alternate realities, and you can give it to friends and revoke it
You could give everyone a unique code, so you can cut people off when you want
It can be very limited (one way to random universe), or extremely open (anywhere to anywhere)
cons: Someone evil could get a code, and you might never know about it
Someone can force you to make a code for them, and then kill you or take your power
Someone could force you to disable all the codes, and then kill you or take your power

name: Power Delegation
overview: assign power/energy to parts of one's body to give them abilities.
description: This ability is handy for those who have too much power. The user is able to give power or energy to parts of their body and give them special abilities. For example, giving your right hand the ability to shoot a small beam of light and giving your left hand the ability to release a small pulse. The main point is to help the user control their intense power by weakening it from the separation.
pros: Create powers for each part of the body
Control one's intense power
cons: The number of parts one can use at a time depends on how much power/energy they have.
Weak abilities

name: Clairvoyance
overview: find anyone, no matter their location
description: Thousands of people go missing every year. A person with Clairvoyance can find them. By simply concentrating for a short while, they can pinpoint their exact location: the city, building, floor, and even room number they're in at that moment. However, dead people cannot be found. And since this ability hones in on someone's mind, Telepaths and other Clairvoyants can tell when they're being found.
pros: Worldwide range
Very precise (city, building, floor, and room #)
Find friends in your area to hang out with
cons: One person at a time
Dead people cannot be found
Telepaths and other Clairvoyants know when they're being found

name: Unfettered
overview: reach any destination regardless of obstacles.
description: The unfettered ability is a form of probability manipulation and is emotionally activated. So long as the user perceives himself as free, there is no obstacle capable of hindering his progress. Shackles fall off, locked doors fail, paths are always open to the user, and foes fail to hinder or kill the user. Speed and constant motion enhance the effect; a full sprint will make an almost straight path to the destination, while walking makes a winding but inevitable path to the same destination.
pros: Cannot be detained or hindered, and can never get lost.
Can smuggle or carry a parcel with near complete certainty.
Paths can be made for allies who can keep up to pierce security or enemy lines.
cons: Feelings of abstract captivity (ultimatums, paradoxes, etc.) can dampen or nullify the effect.
The power only affects the journey. If the user is not in transit, he is not protected.
Paths can be followed by foes who can keep up.

name: Time    Bubbles
overview: stop, fast foword, rewind, ect in a certain radius or bubble
description: With this power you can make a bubble of time that you can control.
pros: Make plants grow faster
Make people run slower faster ect
You are not affected
cons: Time only affected in that bubble

name: Size Manipulation
overview: change the size of yourself and objects around you
description: This ability allows you to make things larger or smaller with your mind. You can shrink to fit into small spaces or grow to destroy things. You can make projectiles you throw large at the last second or shrink things thrown at you to make them insignificant. You can even make food larger to have giant feasts. Unfortunately, when you make things smaller (including yourself), they're quite vulnerable and are likely to be destroyed.
pros: Shrink to fit into small spaces
Make things bigger to make them more powerful
Shrink projectiles to make them insignificant
cons: Things are more vulnerable when small

name: Null Vision
overview: fire light purplish beams from your eyes that will disable your opponent's powers.
description: The null vision is capable of negating your foe's powers and abilities, whether they are good or evil, by firing put lavender beams from your eyes at them. Can be temporary or permanently.
pros: Whether your foes' powers are permanently or temporary disabled, you can devastate your opponent.
Can utterly take advantage of your foes.
cons: It does not work on ghosts
If the target has protection against negation

name: Fresh Breath
overview: breath a chilling cold air that will form ice whatever it touches.
description: Using your own powerful lungs you take in a mighty breath, and exhale it into a chilling wind. You form ice all over anything your chilling breath caresses. Though it will not automatically kill opponents.
pros: Freeze opponents.
Put out fires.
Let it snow!
cons: Can be used accidentally.
No effect on icy opponents.
In effective if you can't breath out of your mouth.

name: Mystic Language
overview: know the languages of all things.
description: Ancient mystics knew that all things have their own language and that if they could learn those languages, they could speak to and control them. This ability allows you to access some of the knoweldge of ancient mystics. Through mental exercises or even hypnosis you might be able to learn some of the languages of things around you. For example, you might learn the languages of trees,fire,rocks, or even time.
pros: You could converse with things around you
The more you learn the more powerful you will become
cons: It takes time to learn even the simplest languages.

name: Chameleonism
overview: copy a colour, picture or superpower onto/into your body.
description: You can change your colour, shape or power to the shape/colour/power of what you are touching when you activate your power.
pros: You can get the looks or power of anyone you touch.
You can disguise yourself.
You can make yourself so good-looking that girls/guys swoon for you.
cons: You have hardly any control over a power you copy.
You cannot change back after 24 hours.

name: Tactile Telekinesis
overview: move objects with your mind but you have to touch them first
description:
Tactile Telekinesis is the ability to move objects with your mind, but you have to touch them first.

Uses of this power would be firing projectiles from you hand without having to throw them. Rocketing people away with a hand to hand attack or if they hit/touch you. Jumping through a window and firing the shards of glass back at your pursuers. 

You can use this power for flight by riding an object you are controling. You can only control something for a limited time before needing to touch it
pros: Versatile
You can make anything into a weapon
Can be used defensively and offensivley
cons: Need to touch objects first
Limited time frame of control
Need objects at hand to have a ranged attack

name: Omnilingualism
overview: perceive and communicate in almost any and every language in existence, at will
description: One with this ability can automatically perceive, understand and communicate (speak, write, etc) in nearly any and every language, at will. English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese, Italian, German, Dutch, African, Greek, Latin, Aramaic, Animal, Plant, Kything, chemical message exchange, computer text, Klingon, Elfin, Gallifreyan, R'lyehian, Body Language, Sign Language, Morse Code, Bee Waggle Dance, etc. For those requiring certain organs one lacks, one can also access Vocal Mimicry.
pros: Understand any language (never caught off guard by a language barrier)
Communicate any language (never offend others by pronouncing words/phrases wrong)
Access Vocal Mimicry for any languages that require body parts one does not have
cons: Doesn't translate gibberish into comprehensible language
People always hounding you to translate for them
Communicate in 'nearly' any language (certain languages require alien body parts you don't have)

name: Keys Of Infinity: Space Key
overview: go anywhere using a magical key artifact
description: Take the key and twist it in the air of in a keyhole. If done in the air, a door will appear. Think of a place (not a time, not a dimension, it will only get confused and spit you out somewhere), and open the door. If you go through the door, you will be at the place you thought of. *Can be used with the Time Key and Dimension Key to create the Key of Infinity
pros: You can go anywhere!
Can be combined with Time Key and/or Dimension key to make the Key of Infinity
Mess with your freinds by apparing next to them!
cons: Can only go places, not times or dimensions
Might take a bit of time for the door to appear, so if you're in a fight, then you shouldn't use it

name: Weapons Eater
overview: gain a weapon's abilities by eating them
description: With this power you can gain a weapon's abilities by eating them. You will also not be hurt or adversely affected by devouring the weapon.
