When you eat a knife or sword you will be able to turn your arms into blades, if you eat a gun you will be able to shoot bullets from your mouth, if you eat shuriken you will be able to shoot shurikens from your hands etc.
pros: You can gain a weapons abilities by eating them
You will never lose the powers you gain
You will not be adversely affected by eating the weapons
cons: Nothing really

name: Pain Suppression
overview: inhibit pain at will or the inability to feel pain.
description: There are two form of this power: the first form is the superpower to suppress pain at will like Noh-Varr. The second variation is the inability to feel any pain at all like Darkman. Both deliver the same results which makes them two variations of one power and each counts as a superpower. Characters with this power have fortitude beyond even peak human levels that make them superhuman. Torture doesn't effect them, they can withstand attacks, keep fighting when pain would stop normals, and more.
pros: Freedom from pain.
Combat advantages.
Characters seem (but aren't) invulnerable
cons: Characters with the second form could be unaware of greivous injuries.
Characters could accidentally injure themselves.
Characters with the second variation might not be able to feel anything.

name: Devil's Cards
overview: control cards at your will, turning their edges into a razor-sharp blade
description: Show people you're not messing around. Any cards around you will come to your side. Their edges turn to razor blades that can cut through steel, but unless the person is evil, people will only feel a scratch. This power is awesome when fighting against tricky villains.
pros: Cards will always come to you, no matter what
Great power to kill tricky villains
Useful when cutting through villains' secret lairs
cons: None

name: Time Multiply/Divide
overview: manipulate time by multiplying or dividing.
description: You could manipulate the laws of time by multiplying or dividing to give youself more or less time to do whatever is possible. You can throw your glowing hourglass up to the heavens to multiply or divide time, multiplying time means to give you much more hours and dividing time means to give you less hours.
pros: You could make others early or late.
cons: You might waste your own time goofing off.

name: Energy Saver
overview: absorb energy to use as a concussive blast or store it to increase strength
description: You're able to absorb energy, either ambient or energy that's directed towards you, and use it in the form of a concussive blast. You're also able to store energy, increasing strength and recuperative ability as well as giving you a measure of invulnerability.
pros: Increases strength
cons: The energy will soon wear off

name: Universal Flow
overview: control the flow and partial effect of energy, matter and others.
description: With this you can redirect, bend, and sometimes create energy and other universal substances. You can cause a cataclysmic universal disruption as an attack or redirect a solar flare. You can even affect the universe's other features, like time and space to a certain amount.
pros: Be one of the most powerful beings ever!
cons: It might go to your head.
Have an immensely hard time with things people are controlling.

name: Apportation
overview: apport any object into your general location as long as the object is within 50 km from you
description: Similar to object teleportation this lets you bring objects to you but this is different in execution. For example you can apport an avalanche of concrete and road signs to rain down from the sky as long as these objects were withing 50 km from you and you have enough room to not get hit. If you wanted to you can also apport your enemies so they can't escape. In addition you can apport objects into your hand. However there is no distinction when apporting so you can't do precision apports.
pros: Rain debris on unsuspecting enemies.
Don't need to know the location of the items-just think what the general shape looks like
"You will not evade me"
cons: Can only bring objects to you--and cannot send them back to where they came from
Can't teleport organs--because you might get your own-but can apport people--but might get the twin

name: Needed Creation
overview: create things as long they are needed
description: The user can create any thing from ammo to the biggest building. However there is a catch, for the objects to keep existing the must be used. With more practice the user can "set" the rate of usage before the object fades away.
pros: Quick, disposable, untraceable weaponry and shelter
Anything, even people, can be created
Create your own world
cons: The people that you create do not count as "users" making your own world
Thing that you create then, forget they exist eventualy will cease existing
Enemys DO count as users

name: Physical Wealth Generation
overview: create an endless supply of valuable materials from ones body.
description: Upon the acquisition of this power the user becomes capable of transmuting any "Disposable"(Skin, hair, nails,tears, etc) part or product of their body into priceless materials such as gold , silver, or diamond. Once transmuted these materials will fall off and any the body regenerates. This shedding does not have to occur immediately and the user may keep the transmuted parts on the body while they retain their original properties. Once developed the shed materials may be concentrated mentally.
pros: Being your own personal goldmine is a good way to make money.
At higher levels you can "Shed" materials such as platinum, iridium, or pure oil.
Psychically concentrate the materials into a convenient form(e.g. shed gold skin into gold bars).
cons: No instantaneous regeneration until developed. NCN
There are relatively few direct combat applications.
The selection of materials is limited until further developed. NCN

name: Invisiwalls
overview: create invisible, impassable walls of any size
description: With this power, you can create invisible walls of any size that prevent the passage of any and all matter. Be it for comedic purposes at the mall, for stopping that machine gun in its tracks, or for fulfilling your lifelong goal of becoming a mime, your invisible walls will never fail to deliver! They can be horizontal, vertical, diagonal, you name it, and you can create or remove them at will. You're limited to 25 walls at a time, only YOU can to see them, and they're planar (2D) only.
pros: Hours of entertainment creating walls for people to run into
Giving the goalies of your favorite teams a hand
Endless ways to defend yourself
cons: Limit of 25 walls
2D only. That means no fancy curved walls.
If you build a house, privacy may be an issue

name: Shadow Automatism
overview: have an independently-acting shadow which can affect one's environment
description: This ability is quite the odd one; it is the presence of a shadow that can act independently of the user; this shadow can affect matter by affecting the matter's shadow. In fact, the shadow almost seems a separate entity; while it is still connected to the user, it can "speak" to the user, formulate thoughts of its own, and bond with the user, gifting him with night vision and enhanced attributes.
pros: Shadow affecting the shadows of other matter gives the appearance of telekinesis (shadow's strong)
Shadow can't be harmed by normal means (it's intangible AND fortified with psionic power)
Shadow can "speak" to user and merge with him to heighten stats (strength, etc. ) in darkness
cons: Enhanced attributes only work in darkness
Shadow can get bossy or it may be evil
Umbrakinesis or Psionic Energy Manipulation can harm the shadow

name: Gravity Mimicry
overview: transform into a form of pure gravity.
description: Other gravity power permit you to control it but this one allows you to transform your body into gravity. You can draw objects to yourself and control gravity in the area. You can also drastically increase the gravity near you to crush physical matter and people.
pros: Become gravity.
Crush foes.
cons: Powers that reduce gravity or make you immune to it.

name: Perfect Gifter
overview: know what people want and be able to get it for them
description: Your mom's birthday coming up? Your one year anniversary with your girlfriend? And you have no idea what to get them. Now you will, with this power you will know exactly what they want or need and you'll also have the means to get it. For instance your girlfriend want some tickets to a sold out concert for her birthday you will suddenly win a radio concert to get them. Or if your mom wants a new car for her birthday you will find out that you inherited one from your deceased second cousin in law
pros: You will always know what somebody wants for a special occasion and then be able to get it
cons: Nothing

name: Weapon Immunity
overview: be immune to all weapons
description: A weapon is any object used by a living thing with intent to cause harm to another living thing. With this power, you are intangible to all weapons. This means you can't be harmed by anyone unless they use their bare hands, but you can't use weapons either. This includes walls and floors if someone throws or drops you into them. You are still vulnerable to accidents and superpowered attacks as long as there isn't a gadget behind it, and you can still harm yourself.
pros: Basically turns every battle into a fistfight
Can pass through walls with some assistance
Seriously Frustrating
cons: Still vulnerable to superpowered attacks and accidents
Attacks pass right through you and may harm your allies
Can only hurt people with your hands, better learn some pressure points

name: Spontaneous Cryostasis
overview: freeze anything
description: This power is really "cool"! Hahaha! It's a joke, see? You know, freezing, "cool", it's funny right? No?  with this power, you can freeze absolutely anything within your line of sight, just by thinking about it. Of course, some people develop a flair while using it, such as pointing at the object to be frozen. This power can be used to freeze air as well, creating ice out of water vapor or changing the weather.
pros: Never have to actually fight
Never be too hot
Never have melty ice cream
cons: You don't inherently have immunity to cold
If you think about popsicles and look at your friend...

name: Eloscity
overview: stretch, deform, expand your limbs and body to super-human high speeds.
description: The odd defining quality however is that your body becomes a combination of elasticity and supersonic speed, you are adapted towards the rigors of flexibility, coordination and able to move at extremely fast speeds, much faster than any vehicle etc. , and you can even run on water or exceed the speed of sound, without getting injured when beyond the natural limits of the human body. You can also contort yourself into any shape you choose faster in a blink of an eye.
pros: Can stretch and run over vast distances, faster than the speed of sound (770 miles per hour).
You can deform yourself for offensive or defensive purposes.
cons: Can contort yourself into various positions and sizes, although this is painful and difficult.
Extremely odd and difficult for people to see.

name: Self Projection
overview: mold and project any force or energy in your body
description: This power lets you take a force or energy in your body such as bioelectricity or lifeforce and project it on to something else or mold it. If you generated magic energy you could use it. This power even allows you to project and shape emotions to use in combat even if you are not feeling them at the time. This power also allows you to take an energy that has gone into your body and project it out such as defending against magic attacks.
pros: Project out anger for a good offense.
Use lifeforce to heal.
Protect against attacks.
cons: Can only defend against so much energy directed at you.
Does not work on death or kinetic energy.
Cons unaffected by con negation.

name: Pseudo Supernatural Magic
overview: manipulate the forces of alternate or futuristic science.
description: Not all magical superpowers are actually supernatural, but are based on alternate or futuristic "science" which is unexplainable.
pros: You would be able to manipulate reality and the laws of a universe.
Your powers would be of infinite supply.
It would not be affected by true magic.
cons: You would have no full knowledge of your ability.
You would possibly unintentionally harm others.
If not experienced, you could be temporarily depowered.

name: Click Boom
overview: click your fingers and make stuff explode
description:
When you click your fingers in a direction, a little arc of electricity shoots forth from your fingers and whatever it touches explodes! 
You could clap as well, or stamp your feet for bigger explosions.
pros: It's easy to explode stuff
Some things explode in a fiery ball of, well, fire, while other stuff just shatters
It's cool!
cons: Might not explode what you want (a little inaccurate)
If you're listening to an especially catchy song, you might kill yourself or those around you
You can't turn it off

name: Blessed And Damned
overview: manipulate luck through the eyes
description: Blessed and Damned is when the user can control luck like a type of reality manipulation. The user can make luck go good or bad but this power doesn't hurt the user. Like if a killer was trying to kill the user and throws the user out of window the users eyes will turn white(good luck)and the wind current will get strong enough to blow the user somewhere safe. Or the users eyes will turn black(bad luck)and the attacker will be harmed by a random force. The user has no choice in how the luck work
pros: Anything the user wants
Lucky
Keeps the user or anybody the user wants to be safe
cons: No choice how the luck works
Tampering with reality
Make work in positive way or negative

name: Personifying
overview: turn into the personification of anything.
description: The ability to turn into the personification of anything like, death, probability, life, and hate. You've got to be creative.
pros: Get the powers of what you turn into.
this is one of the best super powers on this website
cons: You don't know what the personification of something might be

name: Light Bulb
overview: give others and yourself ideas
description: With a thought or a 'for flair' snap of your fingers, people suddenly get an idea. The idea can be about absolutely anything. This can very helpful or unhelpful. For instance, give someone a new astro-physics equation to test or give them the idea to think you're a monkey's uncle. With practice you can force the idea to focus on one central theme. This power encompasses epiphanies also. (Note: The ideas doesn't come from the user its random. )
pros: Help someone understand a subject... Sometimes
Give yourself ideas and eventually something worthwhile will appears that you can patent.
Be able to be completely original.
cons: Give someone the thought that if they kill you they'll be forever happy.
Bad Ideas
Overall having little control over your own powers.

name: Paradigm Shift
overview: introduce a new concept into the world, and control it
description: You design an entirely new concept for science (or what you want it to ultimately achieve), and introduce it into reality. For example, if you want giant robots or superpowers, your power designs an energy or particle that will eventually result in that dream, within a decade. You can only do this once. After you have changed the world, you gain a power to control that concept or its results, like a specific technopathy for giant robots or power manipulation/bestowal powers.
pros: The power to remake reality, and live like you're in fiction. It can be almost anything, even magic.
You then become a very powerful person in the new world. No one knows that this is unnatural.
You don't have to know how it would work, just the results you want.
cons: You can only shift reality in this major way once. And it may take some time to develop.
You do not control what powers you might get in the aftermath.
You're limited to basically deciding what GENRE of fiction you want the world to be like.

name: Cloner
overview: clone yourself and others
description: You can change and control the clones you create. Also, they have the superpowers of the people they're cloned from.
pros: Be any person you want
Clone yourself and change your physical or mental features
Embarrass someone by cloning them and making them fart, poot, etc.
cons: The other person is still there, so it might cause confusion

name: Energy Bender
overview: become a energy bender from avatar the last air bender the animated television series
description: (This power does not have an evolved level) we bent not the elements, but the energy within ourselves.  With this power you can transfer knowledge by physical contact, remove bending permanently by physical contact, restore bending by physical contact. This power easily corrupts its user. If the person is even slightly weak, or even bendable, then they will be infectedby by the one they are bending. Know your history
pros: You can remove bending permanently by physical contact
You restore bending by physical contact
You transfer knowledge by physical contact
cons: This power easily corrupts its user
You need physical contact at all times
This power does not have an evolved level

name: Excalibanana Summon
overview: summon a excalibanana
description: Ever got in a fight and wished you had a weapon? With excalibanana summon, you can summon excalibanana, a magic bannana that gives its user super strength to slap people with. You have super strength to, so you can knock someone out with the bannana. And you can summon it anywhere!
pros: Summon excalibanna anywhere
Slap people with a bannana
Use super strength slap
cons: It still is a bannana
People will laugh at you
Your enemy can eat excallibannana

name: Offensive Defense
overview: gain a random offensive superpower in an offensive situation.
description: With this ability, you gain an offensive superpower for an offensive situation. For example, if someone tried to attack you, you might gain Telekinetic Blasting, Pyrokinesis, Super-Strength, or any other power which could be used to harm the attacker. Once you gain this ability, you will know which ability you have gained. However, it only lasts until moments after the attack / offensive situation.
pros: Gain a superpower for every offensive problem.
You know which superpower you have gained automatically.
cons: The ability lasts until moments after the offensive situation.
You can only gain offensive abilities. (Super-strength, Pyrokinesis, etc. )

name: Pusher
overview: create and push thoughts into a person's mind.
description: Mind control is just like brainwashing. You could get somebody to do your dirty work while at the same time get another thing done. When you're using your power, your eyes turn black. You can control more than one person. You can create a lie and project it into the mind of another person.
pros: Make anybody believe anything
Have somebody do your dirty work
Control more than one person at a time
cons: Your eyes turn black

name: Metabolic Immortality
overview: be efectively immortal as long as your body takes in the neccesary nutrients it would normally need.
description: This power (also called Metabolic Continuation) makes the user's metabolism (as well as the user themselves due to it) immortal. As long as the nutrients that would normally be needed are gained the user is immortal(Recovers from all illness quickly, never ages, etc). In addition the users metabolism keeps them slim and healthy by utilizing any extra nutrients in the users body. In case the user would be going without nutrients for a time they can consume a large amount and it will be stored up.
pros: Gain immortality(as well as slimness and orther metabolic benefits.
Recover from ANY normal biological ailment quickly(as well as other abnormal biological ones).
You can consume huge amounts of food and water to continue the immortality for long periods of time.
cons: Recovering from abnormal biological ailments takes longer than normal ones.
Even if you consume lots of food and water you still need oxygen constantly.
If you don't gain nutrients regularly then the immortality fails(counteracted by third pro).

name: Security Zone
overview: create a zone that promotes protection.
description: Creates a zone that increases the protection of those inside. Security and protection systems of any type, including alarms, safes, armors, and prisons, become more effective the longer they are within the zone. Security officers and guards will also have their effectiveness increased, even to the point of having super powers, as long as they correctly do their job. Also, it becomes easier to create security and protection systems. Finally, laws are easier to enforce.
pros: Increase effectiveness of Security and Protection systems.
Security officers and guards are empowered and can enforce laws easier.
Easier to create security and protection systems.
cons: Others can create security systems to keep you out of areas within the zone.
Dangerous to break any laws.
Some security systems could break down once the zone is removed.

name: Power Control
overview: manipulate the strength of super-powers.
description: With this ability, you can manipulate the strength of super powers, including your own. You can dampen powers rendering them useless, or you can maximize powers to a point in which they cannot possibly become any stronger.
pros: Maximize the powers of anyone.
Dampen superpowers, rendering them useless and uneffective.
Give yourself a super-charge to your powers.
cons: Does not work on natural human abilities, unless they are boosted by superpowers. (ex: strength)
You may cause someone to lose their superpowers if you dampen them too much.
Maximizing someone's powers could make them more controllable, but they will still be dangerous.

name: Life Energy
overview: absorb and use life energy.
description: With this power you can absorb life energy from any living thing by touch or from a distance. Once you have the energy you can use it to heal yourself and others and shoot energy blasts.
pros: You can heal yourself and others from dire injuries.
Weaken people by will.
Become more energized with the more energy you absorb.
cons: Using to much of your own energy can cause you to fall weak.
Absorbing to much energy from a living thing can kill it.

name: Power Improvement
overview: turn a no-good power into something one would consider much more useful
description: One with this ability thinks of a superhuman power (or physical feature) that they currently possess, and in an instant, the ability upgrades/downgrades into something more fun, more desirable (more manageable, powerful or effective). Say, for example, one had the power CrackTart. Instead of making poptarts come out of their behind, their subconscious desire to have a cooler power would allow them to instead summon poptarts from anywhere, making them as hot or cold as desired in the process.
pros: Make useless powers more cool, fun, effective or powerful
Powers that have harmful side effects will be made more manageable
This power cannot be stolen, negated or mimicked (and prevents the same effects on the target power)
cons: Guided by the subconscious (even with Con Negation)
Only effects one power until developed
Will NEVER develop faster than normal, even with Power Negation

name: Sleep Manipulation
overview: control sleep
description: This is a neat little ability to have. With just a look or a touch, a Sleeper can put someone to sleep, controlling how long they sleep and how deep they sleep. With some practice, they might be able to cause someone to sleep-walk, totally controlling their actions while asleep. But there is a flipside. Sleepers can also control there own sleep, and will wake completely recharged no matter how long they've slept.
pros: You can totally control sleep
Always wake up recharged
cons: Without control, this ability could be dangerous

name: Mind Contraption
overview: enter your own mind, or trap someone inside of it.
description: With this ability, you can trap someone in your mind. Once you begin, your foe's mental self leaves his body and is placed into your mind. You can choose to enter your mind with him. Once inside, the foe can do only what you want him to do, and you can do anything you want to do. If you decide to destroy his mind, you can do that, and he will be killed in the real world. However, anything else that you do is simply imagination.
pros: Send yourself or anyone else into your mind.
You have full control over people while they are in your mind, you can destroy their mind.
Anything is possible in your mind. Whether everyone else can do anything in your mind is your choice
cons: People eventually become weary from staying inside of your mind.
Everything is only imagination.
Your bodies will stay left in the real world unless your experienced enough to make them disappear.

name: Skill Theft
overview: steal the applied skills of others by touch
description: Most people have to devote years of their lives to master a skill; a Skill Thief needs half a second. By touching a person, they can take one of their skills-cooking, plumbing, martial arts-and use it for themselves. The target no longer has that skill. This requires touch, an idea of what to steal, and does not work on superhuman skills.
pros: Become a plumber, neurosurgeon, black belt, etc.
Target no longer has skills
Given enough time, can become a master at everything
cons: Must touch
Must have an idea of what to steal
Doesn't work on superhuman skills

name: Form Replication
overview: copy a person entirely
description: Shapeshifting only allows for change in shape, but Form Replication allows for a total disguise. It is possible to change one aspect (e. g. Height) but not others. In a total disguise, you have the original's memories, powers, skills, appearance, etc., in addition to your own powers, skills and memories. You can the switch from your normal appearance and your stored disguise, which can be stored for any length of time.
pros: Perfect disguise
Get another power
Great for immortals
cons: Only one stored disguise at a time
Having the original show up
Requires touch

name: Unlocker
overview: unlock everything with just your mind, from locks to passwords.
description: With this ability, you can unlock everything you want just by concentrating. Doors, chests, combination locks, user accounts... Everything.
pros: Losing your keys or forgetting your password won't be a problem anymore.
Allows you to go everywhere, even where you're not supposed to.
Best. Hacker. Ever.
cons: You can still get caught while being in forbidden places.
You can still get caught while stealing accounts.
Not useful in a fight.

name: Magician's Power
overview: manipulate magical energy
description: The Magicians Power is the ability to manipulate magical energy. Magicians draw energy from force lines, streams of magical energy that run through the earth and sky. Once they have this energy, they can use it for magic or store it inside them for later use. Some of the basic ways they can use the energy is levitation, fire-starting,and dimension-hopping. But there are hundreds of other ways they can use it too. The best part is that magicians dont need anything but their minds to do magic.
pros: You can do magic
There are hundreds of different spells you can do, and you don't need anything but your mind
You might have the Magician's Touch.
cons: Hopping to a dimension with few force lines
You have to teach yourself magic through experiments

name: Energy Absorption
overview: absorb and expel energy
description: This is the ability to extract the energy in matter and store it in your body, in a similar way to how burning a fuel extracts its energy as heat. Simply by touching an object, you can remove all of its energy. Energy you absorb can be used to power your body, removing your need for food, air or water and preventing aging. The energy you absorb can be expelled as any form of energy (radiation, electricity, heat, light, kinetic force etc.) and in any form (beams, blasts etc.)
pros: Can absorb the energy from projectile attacks and enemy bodies
Can attack with any type of energy, making defense against you very tricky.
Can never starve if you can feed on the very air around you.
cons: Extremely unreactive materials (e.g. gold) cannot be absorbed
If you expel all your energy, you will have no energy to start reactions and you will starve.

name: Aura Control
overview: focus your aura into shapes,or weapon.
description: Every living thing has a aura which is a energy field surrounding it. Its similar to the glow around a neon sign. Someone with this power can focus it into energy constructs like objects,weapons,armor,or shapes. When your aura is activited(visible)a colored smoke will come off your skin. The smoke and your aura will be colored to your personality. All of your energy constructs will give off the smoke too. Also you can channel your aura into things to super charge them.
pros: You can have instant armor,weapons,and other stuff
You can channel your aura into stuff to super charge it
cons: Over using your aura will cause you to combust
Can't control the color

name: Fantasia
overview: see and manipulate the fantasies of others.
description: By looking at a person(s) directly or indirectly, (seeing their reflection in a mirror or their shadow), you can see what their fantasies are. Fantasies are often what people see themselves as or what they wish for the most. By knowing what their fantasies are, you can shatter them in order to make up a new fantasy in their minds. By creating a false fantasy for them, they may see themselves differently or change their goals in life. Their dreams may alter and may possibly gain more fears.
pros: Learn more about the person you see.
Can make your enemy fear something new that they may not have feared before.
Can turn those with evil fantasies good by destroying those fantasies and recreating good ones.
cons: Cannot see fantasies of others while they're asleep.
Changing certain fantasies of some individuals may have unintended consequences.
Changing others fantasies too often could damage their psychie.

name: Thread Manipulation
overview: manipulate any type of thread or string
description: A person with this power has the ability to manipulate any thread or string both physical and abstract. Although the user starts out only able to manipulate simple things like rope and clothes. With greater practice they can manipulate even abstract things like the red thread of fate. Also it may even be possible for the user to control all forms of matter using string theory.
pros: Can manipulate abstract strings as well
Strangle enemies, undo buttons, and manipulate string cheese!
Can't be tied up with rope
cons: Can only manipulate thread----which isn't a problem if string theory is true
Needs to have full control to use the more powerful aspects of this power

name: Instant Meal
overview: cause a meal to appear whenever you want
description: With this power you can have a meal to appear whenever you want. You can choose any one drink, one side, one main and a dessert at any time of the day you want wherever you are. You can use this power only once every five hours and you can only have one of the above mentioned things, no seconds, no refills on anything.
pros: You can have a hot meal whenever you want provided it's been at least 5 hours since you last used it
You get one drink, one main, one side and one dessert
cons: You can only use this power once every five hours
No seconds or refills on anything

name: Empathic Mimicry
overview: mimic other powers while you are near the users
description: Empathic Mimicry is one of the most powerful abilities. When other people with powers get near an Empathic Mimic, the Empathic Mimic can do what they can do: Technopathy, Super-Strength--even physical abilities like Shape-Shifting. There is no limit to the amount of abilities they can mimic, nor is there a limit on the types of abilities they can mimic. However, there is a range limit---2 football fields(200 yards), and the Empathic Mimic has to know about the ability.
pros: Using multiple abilities at once
Hitting someone with their own power
One of the more powerful abilities
cons: 200 yard range
Must know person has the ability
May mimic a uncontrollable ability

name: Spectral Chains
overview: create chains that you can control.
description: You can create chains with your soul. The chains are made of soulerite, a metal as hard as diamond. You can control the chains as if they were your own limbs, you can fire them at sound speed. Once outside your body, the chains move at a normal speed. When separated from your body, the chain will disappear in 2 hours.  You can also spin the chains arround your body to become a living chainsaw which is useful to travel, cut things, ect.
pros: Good in defensive and offensive.
Chains are released by thought.
Incredible strength
cons: Chains are affected by metal controlling skills and magnetism.
Cut chains only last for 2 hours

name: Doppelganger
overview: copy the form and talents of a target.
description: They say that a doppelganger is an evil twin. As a superpower, you can not only become a perfect version of that person, place, or thing, but you can copy their talents as well. Once you see someone or something you would like to copy, their appearance and talents become yours.
pros: Take the form of a brilliant scientist and have their brilliance
Become a sports expert or martial arts master
You can even copy fictional characters!
cons: Can only copy someone or something you have seen
Can only copy one form at a time

name: Flux
overview: induce the continual flow of any form of energy
description: This ability allows the user to continue any source of energy at maximum capacity until it taps out. With this, one could keep a fire going underwater, or keep a person moving until they can no longer muster up the energy even to breathe (or for their heart to beat). As one can imagine, this ability is especially effective against superhumans with energy abilities (as the use of energy abilities often exhausts the user after extensive use).
pros: Continue the flow of any kind of energy (heat, light, kinetic, metabolic, psionic,electrical, etc. )
Keeps the energy flow efficient (no disruptions of energy flow until no energy is LEFT)
Can be used positively (heightened stamina, cognition, etc.) or negative (forced energy discharge)
cons: Does not provide perpetual energy (just maximizes flow, and flow efficiency until source taps out)
Does not allows you to otherwise manipulate energy (cannot suppress or absorb energy, etc. )
Does not work if the system is already at peak operation capacity

name: Spectral Mimicry
overview: mimic the form and abilities of a ghost
description: All the fun of being a ghost, none of the pain of dying. At will, a Spectral Mimic's body can become weightless, translucent and immaterial. They can also become invisible, but this takes more active concentration. While in spectral form, they cannot be touched or touch anyone. They can't see or control the dead.
pros: Can float and fly
Automatically translucent, can become invisible
Immaterial
cons: Cannot touch anyone in spectral form
Invisibility takes more concentration
Cannot see or control dead

name: Vicarious Healing
overview: have an object take damage for you
description: A sinister variation on Accelerated Healing, Vicarious Healing still lets the user regenerate from most any wound. However, the damage that would have been yours becomes inflicted upon an object of your own. The healing is more efficient if the object is something close to you, or even better, a picture of yourself. While this may afford healing and nigh-immortality, if you view the object, all the damage it took for you will leave it and return to you.
pros: Recover from any wound
Maintain your youth
Jumping head-first into dangerous situations
cons: Works best if it is your own portrait
If you see the object, its damage will return to you
May become jaded and a bit bitter

name: Superhuman Visual Acuity
overview: distinguish fine detail at a higher level than regular humans
description: A person with this power has a higher visual acuity that normal letting them see everything in hi-definition. They can even sense some things that are nigh-invisible like spiderwebs due to increased resolving power of their eyes.
pros: See the world in HD
See and avoid spiderwebs
Sense how much dust is floating around in the air
cons: Sometimes you don't want to see certain things in high definition
Can be distracted by looking at weird looking spiderwebs

name: Miracle Worker
overview: preform 1 miracle or impossibility a day
description: This ability allows you to perform one miracle or impossibility a day. Your miracle is by definition bounds by no laws, so you can literally do anything, but only once a day. Any miracles affecting yourself will be undone by the activation of another miracle on yourself.
pros: Miracles can do anything
cons: 1 miracle a day
Only 1 miracles can affect you at a time

name: Construction Zone
overview: create a zone that prevents destruction and allows creation.
description: This power allows you to create a zone with special rules inside. Inanimate objects inside the zone are prevented from breaking and become more sturdy. People inside the zone will begin developing limited alchemic powers that will allow them to use the resources around them to construct objects. The alchemic powers can change a constructed object into another as long as it is not dismantling the constructed object. One's alchemic powers are lost if one leaves the zone.
pros: Objects become unbreakable. (armor, buildings, etc.)
People can develop limited alchemic powers.
Allows construction of any type of man-made objects.
cons: Rules apply to everyone until the zone is removed
Cannot break things even if you wanted to.
Living things are still breakable and alchemic powers cannot be used on living things.

name: Meridian Electrocution
overview: deliver massive natural energy to a person in their acupunture meridians by touching them anywhere.
description: Pressure point assault with the lightest touch anywhere on their body.
pros: Effortless martial art kills.
Heal, paralyze and cripple with complete Dim Mak power.
cons: Must touch the person.

name: Active Mutation
overview: mutate to a more powerful form
description: Active Mutation causes a chrysalis to form around the caster, causing a mutation to take place. The extent of the mutation is controlled by the caster, and can be stopped at any time.
pros: Can mutate back and forth between forms.
Can be stopped at any time
Alters appearence, physical and mental strength, and alters abilities
cons: Stopping mid-mutation causes horrid side effects
Alterations may degrade performance
You are powerless while mutating

name: Sticker Enhancement
overview: make someone take on the properties of any sticker you stick to them.
description: With this power the user may alter a persons mood or abilities by placing a sticker on their body. Different types of stickers cause different effects. Animal stickers convey animal traits to a person such as enhanced strength, gills, or a mucus membrane. Item sticker convey skill with that item, such as a race-car making them a good diver. Smiley faces and the like change a persons mood. Abstract shapes are a wild card and you will not be able to predict what they will do.
pros: Give away powers and skills.
cons: Only one stickers effect can be applyed at a time.
You must physically place the sticker on the person.
The effect only lasts until the sticker is removed.

name: Pluviokinesis
overview: control rain
description: You can make it rain any time of any day, even if it's sunny outside. You can also stop, start, increase, decrease, and manipulate rain. You can focus rain onto one person or the entire world if you wanted too. You can even change the molecular structure of rain, making it poison rain, or acid rain, or even electric rain.
pros: You can manipulate rain.
You can change the molecular structure of rain.
Put out fires, start rainstorms... The possibilities are endless.
cons: Unless I'm mistaken.... There isn't any bad side that I can see.

name: Ignorance Invulnerability
overview: be immune to anything you can't see with your own eyes.
description: This power makes you immune to any attack or deadly condition you can't see. Bullets, super fast punches, anything invisible, diseases, poisoned drinks, disguised explosive devices of any kind and other such assaults. What will hurt you is anything slow enough to see-an arrow,a throwing knife. A labeled canister of poison gas, a device that is clearly an bomb, or someone who is obviously contagious with a virus will nullify your invulnerability.
pros: If you had a power to replace regular eyesight nothing might affect you
The strongest invisible villain can punch you--you won't feel a thing.
You can find all the deadly traps for your friends
cons: A substitute vision power may not be good as regular vision.
If you couldn't move and a big strong and slow villain is about to punch you

name: Anti Theft
overview: never have anything taken from you without your permission
description: A person with this power cannot have anything taken from them unless it was allowed. Normally only a defensive type power that bends reality to make it impossible for anyone to steal from you, it can also be used offensively. For example, you are breathing my air. No one can take your life unless you willed it and your belongings are protected. This power can be used to protect other people-cannot take family away. However, you cannot bait people to steal your stuff-counts as permission.
pros: No one can steal from you, unless you let them steal it-protects your belongings
No one can take your life away unless you willed it. -works on concepts like freedom and life
Can expand to things that belong to everyone like air
cons: People can still give you things, like pain
You must have a clear concept of what is yours in order to make it work
People can destroy stuff you have instead of taking them

name: Obliteration
overview: delete matter from existence with a touch
description: Also called Decrescence (Inducing), Olivion (Inducing) or Existence Negation, this is the psychic ability to make foes literally fade away, with a touch. One on whome this ability has been used will slowly begin to fade away, until he exists outside of space-time, and thus cannot interact with this or any other reality (so he dies; he still has physiological needs, but can't meet them). This cannot be undone by anyone except the user or someone else with the same ability.
pros: Your touch is lethal (affect living, dead and inanimate matter)
Only activates with deep feelings of anger (no accidentally obliterating friends or loved ones)
When obliterated, everybody (but you) immediately forgets they ever existed
cons: Requires a touch (sometimes prolonged touch or numerous touches)
If it requires a prolonged touch contact and you lose contact, they fade back in
If your power is uncontrolled, you can cause matter to be obliterated unintentionally

name: Static Wind
overview: concentrate a huge wave of electromagnetic wind that lifts and shocks the opponent.
description: You are creative in control of all things related to wind and electricity, you can Fire a horizontal electrical cyclone of air which can strike enemies and annihilates everything in its path. The electrically-charged tornado is generated exactly at the point where you stand, while in you are in a long distance forward.
pros: Works well against water-type supervillains.
cons: Not effective on wood and steel.

name: Artistic Realization
overview: draw things to life.
description: You HAVE to include a name somewhere around your drawing or it wont come to life! And your creation only stays for 24 hours, then it turns into dust, unless you draw a certain time limit for it.
pros: You can bring your imagination to life, any time you wanted!
You don't need paper, pencils, paint, or anything to draw, just use your finger!
You can make your fav cartoon characters or make new friends!
cons: It takes time to draw.
If you can't draw that well this wouldn't really be a good power for you.
If a creation meant to live, falls in love, it automaticly desolves into dust.

name: Transfer Of Energy
overview: build up and transfer energy into actions.
description: Every action takes energy. Nothing can be done without it. With a little concentration, someone with this power can build up energy and direct it toward any action. They can spend energy all at once or over a period of time. However, Generators can't store this energy and save it or build up energy while using pre-generated energy. Like with most things, practice produces improvement. With more practice, users could generate more energy in sorter amount of time.
pros: Any action can be done if you can build up enough energy.
With practice comes improvement
cons: Not building up enough energy for something (when flying, levitating a car, being invisible, etc. )

name: Cold Matter Manipulation
overview: manipulate all matter, provided it has some degree of low temperature.
description: With this power, you can control anything! The catch: It needs to have no (or very little)heat in it for you to control it. You control matter with varied difficulty, but the more heat it has, the harder it is to control, until it's impossible. This means you can control anything that is cold easily, but beginners only start with atoms and not subatomic particles.
pros: Control things like liquid helium, liquid nitrogen, dry ice and things at absolute zero easily!
Control matter as cold as ice.
You can also control warmer matter, but it could be very difficult.
cons: Beginners can't control subatomic particles, but start at atomic level.
You can't make things cold with this power, only control them if they are there.
Useless in a really hot scenario, unless it has something cool in it.

name: Lightning Travel
overview: travel through electronics or lightning.
description: You can travel at light speed through electronics and lightning. You can also enter games.
pros: If you have somewhere to be during a lightning storm, you're in luck.
Entering video games would be fun.
cons: You may get shocked a little after using this power.

name: Shadow Mimicry
overview: become a shadow
description: A person with Shadow Mimicry has an amazing gift. They can turn their bodily tissues into a living shadow. This allows them to move swiftly and silently along walls and floors, become unable to be touched, and even detach themselves from the wall and stretch like a shadow. However, there are some issues. The user must remain attached to a wall or floor when detaching themselves, gets more obvious in the day, and when there is zero light dies. Every shadow needs light.
pros: Swift silent motion
Spy extraordinaire
Can stretch from wall and fight
cons: Can be noticed
Die in zero light (every shadow needs light)
Need a wall or floor

name: Instant Storage
overview: make anything disappear and reappear whenever wanted
description: This power enables you to make anything disappear into your own private pocket dimension by touching them and to make them reappear out of it whenever you want - this includes living beings. That dimension therefore becomes some sort of storage compartment. Moreover, time won't flow inside it, meaning things won't evolve, degrade, grow or die while in it. This power also helps you remember everything you are currently storing in that dimension.
pros: You can travel lightly while keeping everything you need with you.
There are no limits to what or how much you can store
cons: You can steal anything you want with this ability...
You can make your enemies disappear but they'll remain in your memory.

name: Automatic Thought Transference
overview: automatically be able to build or fix things
description: Using the power of your mind, whatever you would like to build or create or fix, you can. However you want it to look, wherever you want it to be at, however you want it to taste like. Rules: Have to use your right index finger to point where stuff goes at. Need to have a good clear picture of what you want and where you want it at. However, you can change your mind and switch things around to your liking.
pros: Always get to have the vehicle and residence you want to have.
Always get to eat or drink what you want to.
Always get have the clothing you want to have.
cons: Have to be careful not to point your right index finger all the time.
Might have to use pictures of what you want to get something right.

name: Object Duplication
overview: create copies of any object you are touching.
description: As opposed to External Duplication, this power only allows you to create duplicates of objects you are currently touching. However, you can create as many copies as you want of any non-living object of any size. The duplicates can appear anywhere in your vicinity or anywhere in your visual field. The bigger the object, the more energy you'll need to create even one copy of it. Also, they will only remain as long as you keep touching the original object.
pros: Create as many duplicates as you want of any object.
You can make the copies appear wherever you want in your vicinity, not just in your hand.
You can even duplicate just the parts of the object you want.
cons: You need to touch the object to duplicate it. If you stop touching, the copies will disappear.
You need a lot of energy to create a copy of a big object.
Doesn't work on living objects.

name: Speed Control
overview: effect the speed of other people.
description: Speed control allows you to speed people up to bullet time or down to a crawl. Though you can effect the speed of people, this does not apply to time itself so inanimate objects move in real time.
pros: Move faster than other people
Get things done faster
Speed up anything unpleasent
cons: Only effects living creatures
Time stays the same
Can make people power hungry

name: Bionic Skeleton
overview: have an indestructible skeleton.
description: With this power it means your skeleton can never be destroyed. So you'll never break a bone and you can bash your skull against enemies without hurting yourself.
pros: never break a bone.
impress your friends that you can smash your head against wall without being hurt
cons: you'll never get a cast when all your friends have one

name: Chaotic Clap
overview: gather an amount of powerful energy in your hands, and fire it at your foe in a force field clap.
description: You can gather massive amounts of energy in your palms and release a concussive blast by clapping. This power completely envelopes you in a force field to deflect projectiles, but could also knock your opponents off their feet if they were too close.
pros: Could also create some explosions by clapping.
cons: Might not work on gigantic adversaries.

name: Arithmancy
overview: see the numbers of the universe.
description: Arithmancers see the underlying numbers in everything. Velocity, Force, Length, Weight, Width- They see them all. They can easily divine where something will go, tracing the patterns of force and velocity. This makes them expert snipers, evaders and billiard ball players. Most of them are very good at higher mathematics, as well.
pros: Predict the end location of most moving objects.
Easily determine the force and speed needed to hit or reach something.
cons: Does not increase physical speed to allow you to dodge bullets.
Often leaves other people confused at the stream of mathamatics lingo they indulge in.

name: Equilibrium   Absorb And Repel
overview: generate a barrier that absorbs and repels attacks.
description: Equilibrium allows the user to restore and maintain balance in any given situation. This ability is dynamic, altering depending upon the current requirements to maintain balance. In the case of attacks, it can be used to form barriers that absorb attacks (thus preventing alterations in balance) as well as releasing that force as a powerful concussive blast, similar to a controlled shock wave. Can be used as a personal shield or extended to other people or objects.
pros: Personal Immunity to attacks
Able to sheild others from attacks
Manifests on its own
cons: Can absorb only a set amount of damage
Useless against mental attacks
Absorbed energy must be released to continue defence

name: Temperature Control
overview: control the temperature of anything including people, objects, surrounding air, etc.
description: The user of this ability has the power to control the temperature of anything. They could target a specific person or object, or target everything within a certain radius of them. The farther away they change the temperature from the objects normal temperature the more the user must exert themselves. This power could have many applications if the user knows what they are doing. They could lower the temperature of every object and person in the area to absolute zero, effectively freezing time.
pros: Other powers could stem from this one like freezing time(explained above), weather control, and more
It has a very versatile and powerful amount of applications
Always be at a comfortable temperature
cons: Hard to control
Must be able to see their target (unless targeting an area)

name: Energy Blade Hands
overview: turn your hands into blades of energy
description: You can turn your hand into a large energy sword. Stab, slice, and cut up your enemies. These blades can cut through anything.
pros: Can cut through anything
Kill enemies with one slice
cons: Takes a lot of power to use

name: Age Shifting
overview: alter one's age at will
description: This ability allows the user to shift from his current age to any age he desires at will. You could age (which is called Maturation if you can ONLY do this) or de-age (called Infantilization if you can ONLY do this) as much as you want. While age-shifted, you take on the characteristics of your assumed age group (energy of a kid, wisdom and patience of old age).
pros: Chuck E. Cheese ball pit in the afternoon, hit the club for vodka by 11pm
Nobody knows your true age (change it at will, live for a LONG time, maybe forever if not killed)
Get a woman pregnant, become an old guy/kid as a disguise
cons: Some people will hit you no matter what age you are
Chronokinetics/Age-Manipulators can trap you at a certain age
True Sight sees your true age and Reality Anchoring prevents you from Age Shifting

name: Newton's First Law
overview: make objects continuous or paused.
description: An object in motion stays in motion and an object in rest stays at rest unless acted upon by an outside force. This means you can either make an object continually repeat any action it has done or make it stop its actions completely for a moment with this power. When the object has a large force applied to it, the object will break out of being continuous or paused. Takes a larger force to get a person out of being paused than to get out of being continuous.
pros: Objects will repeat the last action they did continually.
Can pause an object to halt what it is doing for a moment and come to a rest.
Multiple objects can be made continuous or paused.
cons: If a person is paused too long they will die from their heart not moving.
Harder to break objects out of being continuous or paused the larger the object is.
Things can be removed from being paused or continuous by other people even if you dont want them to.

name: Shadow Reality
overview: bend reality while in the darkness
description: While in the darkness, you become unstoppable. You can do anything and everything while in the shadows, destroying the laws of physics and making anything possible. You can change all that is around you, and become invincible. This becomes easier the darker the area that you're in. The lighter the area that you are inside, or are trying to manipulate, the more difficult it becomes to do this.
pros: The potential is limitless for you while in the darkness
You still have a small flicker of power in the sunlight
You can draw shadows closer to you when you need them
cons: Everything that you create is dark and sinister
You have almost no power in the light
Shadows may occasionally twist or bend around you

name: Hypnotic Voice
overview: hypnotise a person or a group of people when you talk
description: With this power, you have the power of strong suggestion over a person or people. When you speak, they will instantly enter into a deep trance & you almost have complete control over them. Its only suggestive though & if the person has a strong will, they can resist & come out of the trance. Also it takes great focus to control a lot of people & you have to snap the person or crowd out of the trance when you are done unless you make them a sleeper. They will not remember anything afterwards.
pros: Great power of suggestion over a person or crowd
Can turn them into a sleeper agent & use them when you need to
cons: Need a  lot of concentration when controlling a crowd
If they have a strong will the can resist & reject being hypnotised
You have to bring them out of the trance once you're done

name: Tesseract
overview: access and control a pocket of fourth-dimensional space
description: By being able to control a way into the fourth dimension, and be able to control the environment there and the movement of all objects in it, you have a near-infinite space. To an observer, you can make anything simply disappear at will. You store it in your fourth-dimensional space, and can bring it back at will. Since the space available is virtually unlimited, you are limited only by how much mass you can shift in one use of the power.
pros: A safe way to move large numbers of people. Rescue whole crowds; turn attackers into prisoners.
Transport whole trainloads of goods by any means that can accomodate one passanger.
No more problems with airline luggage or moving companies anymore.
cons: It may take some effort to 'hold' items in the tesseract, putting a time limit on large holds.
The temptation to become a smuggler would be nigh-irresistible.
If you aren't the only one able to access this particular dimension, some of your goods could go mis

name: Electromagnetic Kinesis
overview: control the electromagnetic spectrum.
description: Can manipulate the electromagnetic spectrum, in all of it's intensity, from gamma rays to x-rays.
pros: Become Invisible with light spectrum manipulation.
Controlling Microwaves causes melting, boiling and burning.
Get a tan easily with UV rays
cons: May emit radiation, causing cancer
Very hard to control - would definitly draw attention.
Must study Physics closley to fully understand your power.

name: Reality Frequency Boost
overview: have supernatural physical attributes by being on a different frequency of reality.
description: With this ability, the user can be in the same reality as normal people but in a universal view, they are on a different frequency of reality. One example of this ability would be if the user ran, the user would think they are really running. When someone sees them running, to them, it appears that they are teleporting. Another example is the user's durability becomes invulnerability because their body is outside earthly boundaries.
pros: Supernatural physical attributes.
cons: Hard to live normally.

name: Ballistic Wind
overview: make bullets out of air
description: Ballistic Wind is the ability to make bullets out of air. For a volume of air to act like a rifle bullet in speed, accuracy, firing rate, and etc, it requires the ability user to concentrate. More practice, less time the ability users has to concentrate over time. Depending on what kind of bullet the user wants (from a pin to a cannon fire) ithe amount of concentration varies.
pros: No need for a weapon.
cons: Less practice, more time required to make a bullet to fire.

name: Adaptive Strength
overview: gain super strength
description: With this ability, the user will match the strength of whatever is being thrown the users way (the force of a grenade, the strength of a punch, ect) with the addition of the users current base strength, there would be a high resistance to all types of physical attacks.
pros: Once adapted, the user would be stronger than the opponent
The user would stay superhuman until they stopped and rested
Would have a choice of becoming good or evil
cons: This power is non passive (doesnt work unless the user is aware and makes the choice)
Could become to powerful for the users own good
Once the user stops and rests, they could pass out or slip into a coma

name: Ability Cloaking
overview: cause your abilities to be undetectable and invisible
description: With this power you can make your powers completely undetectable. You can also make your powers invisible. For example if you have laser vision the lasers are invisible. Or if you summon something the thing you summon is invisible and so on and so forth. You can turn this power on and off.
pros: You can make your powers undetectable
You can make your powers invisible
cons: If this is your only power this does absolutely nothing

name: Ultimatum Immunity
overview: unaffected by ultimatums, supernatural or otherwise.
description: This ability allows one to not be affected by ultimatums; he doesn't have to suffer the consequence of any difficult decision. This means that the user's luck increases so that he can survive the effects, but only temporary. The user is even immune to events that, in root, were caused by an ultimatum, even a nuclear blast.
pros: Never make any difficult choices again.
Protection against event and things caused by ultimatums.
Temporary luck boost until the negative events caused by a ultimatum has passed.
cons: Only works for ultimatums

name: Chemical Invulnerability
overview: be impervious to chemical damage of any kind.
description: With this power, you become invulnerable to chemical damage. Beneficial chemical reaction are unhindered, but negative ones are prevented. This effectively provides total immunity to poisons, any type of venom, acid burns, damage from a strong base and corrosion. It also cancels the negative effects of oxidants and provides immunity to most dangerous forms of radiation.
pros: Phenylketonuria is now irrelevant.
Dumped in a vat of acid? No problem.
No poison or venom in the world can affect you.
cons: Anesthetics and most medications no longer work on you.
Certain types of medical examinations cannot work on you.
Supernatural chemistry is unhindered; normalization fluid will still knock out your powers.

name: Arcana 16: The Tower
overview: destroy and reform skills or powers.
description: Select one power, skill or ability you possess (Such as skill at writing or ability to throw fireballs). Over the course of several days, you will slowly lose this power or skill. After a few days without it, you will slowly regain your lost ability or skill, except the potential strength or finesse of the ability will have increased. You will still need to practice in order to reach the new skill level.
pros: Able to slowly increase the power of any of your other abilities.
Works on mundane skills as well as superpowers.
cons: You lose access to the power for the duration.
This power requires a great deal of time to function.

name: Automatic Secondary Powers
overview: gain any secondary power necessary
description: This is needed for lots of reasons: If you had super strength then you would need anchoring powers to stop you from being pushed back while trying to push a large object or falling into the ground if you lift on up. If you had super speed you would need to be able to withstand the massive friction and the pressure of the wind stopping you. If you had the power of flight then you would need to be able to deal with the thinner atmosphere the higher up you go. Etcetera, etcetera.
pros: It can decrease the amount of cons
Very useful to have this power if you have a potentually self-harming power
cons: Enemies with these powers can become very hard to defeat
These would be bad if you wanted to commit suicide with your powers.

name: The Star Warrior
overview: create an armor of stars around the user
description: The user calls down a shower of stars to create an armor of astral energy around the user. When the armor is completed, the user can shoot star blasts from their hands and fly. Since it's made of star energy, the armor is very hot and will go out if the user enters (enough) water (long enough). The armor gives super strength and boosts speed. This must take place at night, though the armor can last in day time.
pros: Gives power over star energy
Flight
Strength and speed boost
cons: Goes out in water
Can only be used at night
Can burn people or things without wanting to

name: The Knower
overview: know anything that you're asked.
description: If anyone asks you something you automaticlly know the answer. You don't have temptation to answer them, but you will get the answer yourself. The power is only triggered if you are extremely upset or emotional.  If someone asked you when the world would end, you'd know.
pros: Never get bad grades on tests again!
Know anything that is asked.
Control over saying the answer to the asker.
cons: You can't ask yourself a question.
Sometimes the answer can change things for you.
You trigger the power with a certain emotion.

name: Assumption Reality
overview: change reality based on one's assumptions.
description: This ability allows the user warp the reality of people, things, and even concepts by assuming what they are to the user;literally or metaphorically. They can even use the ability on themselves to make them more powerful.
pros: Change Reality through your assumptions of it.
Can be literally or metaphorically.
Only use the assumptions that you want.
cons: The effects will wear off in time.

name: Shadow
overview: merge with Shadows
description: The ability to "disappear" into any shadow, and move about within the world as a shadow. Whilst inside shadows, you have the ability to reappear from any point within it, effectively teleporting, and becoming invisible whilst within the shadow. If the shadow is destroyed, by being washed out with a light source, you will be "forced" out of the shadow and re-enter the regular world.
pros: Fast movement through shadows.
Stealth movement abilities.
While in the shadows you cannot be hurt.
cons: If the shadow disappears, you will be forced to re-appear.
Can only move around within the shadows you entered as you cannot jump between shadows.
Without any shadows nearby, you are helpless. you cannot enter your own shadow.

name: Speed Serum
overview: create a speed serum
description: Have you ever wanted to temporarily have super speed or give others super speed? Well now you can with this power you always have a syringe that is full of speed serum, a red liquid that when injected into somebody gives them the power to move at incredible speeds for three days. There is no way to make the effects of the serum permanent and once it wears off you have to wait a period of three days before injecting yourself again. If you do not wait three days in between injections you will die.
pros: You can give yourself or anybody else super speed for three days
You can have super speed for three days
You can summon the syringe whenever you want and if you lose it you can just summon it again
cons: You only have it for three days
You have to wait three days after it wears off before you inject yourself again
If you don't wait the three days you die (so if you inject your enemies twice in one day they die)

name: Molecular Power
overview: freeze atoms and explode atoms.
description: With a wave of your hands, atoms of an object or person freeze (stop moving) for a limited time or explode.
pros: Powerful
Annoyances can be dealt with
Fun
cons: Strong Emotions can trigger power
Dangerous
Limit to area of power

name: Kinetic Dampener
overview: dampen kinetic force making you take no damage if a kinetic based attack is launched at you
description: The person with this power forms a small field around his or her body that will dampen kinetic energy. This is different from invulnerability because, with this power you are immune to bullets or punches by not concussive beams or radiation blast.
pros: Can stop bullets in its track
Good for fighting crimes
cons: Your powers does not work if confronted by someone using magic
Only can stop kinetic force

name: Immortal Life Span
overview: live forever without aging a day.
description: The person gets to live forever and never age.  However, there is a difference between  "Immortality" and "Immortal Life Span".  Your life span may be forever, but you are still able to be killed by fatal injury, gunshots, stabs, diseases and anything else that you can get killed by.
pros: You don't age once you reach to a good, healthy adult state.
There is NO time limit to your life span
cons: You can still be killed by fatal injury, gunshot, diseases and anything else you can get killed by.

name: Space Manipulation Knowledge
overview: know how to build devices to manipulate space
description: You gain the knowledge to build any sort of device that manipulates space. This isn't limited to teleporters, it can include (but again, is not limited to) warp drives (and as a bonus, the rest of the stuff surrounding it), cloaking devices (by bending light through altered space), shrinking/growth devices (altering the relationship with space something has), superspeed devices, bullet/attack dodgers/distorters, and weapons that kill by changing the location of various parts of the victim.
pros: Space manipulation is almost godly powerful if you know what you're doing
You can make any sort of variants or space-manipulating ideas you have. Want grenades? Storage?
You have one set of bonus, non-space related knowledge: all the other parts for spacecraft
cons: While space is pretty powerful, there are definitely powers that balk it, and you have to build
You have to have modern day technology around to build most of the stuff
Nothing prevents the tech from being stolen, analyzed, disabled, etc.

name: Psychometry
overview: relate details about the past or future condition of an object, by touching it.
description: When you touch an object or person, you know everything that has happened and that will happen to that person. The future is susceptible to change, since that person can make a decision later on that changes the future. This happens every time you touch something, no matter if you have touched it before. The time it takes for the visions to pass varies on how long the object or person has been in existence.
pros: Can save lives by knowing if they will be murdered
Can help people regain memory if they have been affected by a memory sapper
Can change an enemies' perceptions by bringing up something that happened to them in the past.
cons: Cannot relate details to your own future or past.
Learn unwanted details of someone's past or future.
Involuntary. Contact with anything will have to be limited.

name: Illusion Creation
overview: make illusions real
description: Depending on how strong the illusion is it usually will just go right through you. But with this ability simple focusing on an illusion causes it to become real. No matter what illusion it is you can make it real. You can not reverse this process.
pros: If you're an illusionist you'd be super powerful
This power works on all illusions
cons: Useless against a illusionist
Can't be reversed

name: Eternel (Undying)
overview: survive in any environment in addition to everything
description: Survive in any environment including space and the arctic, and high speed regeneration from any attack, even those that reduce you to nothing; however those kind of attacks cause regeneration to be longer. Only for roach hybrids.
pros: High speed regeneration
Nigh indestructable
Can survive anything
cons: Have to eat a huge amount of the closest edible source nearby
Regeneration is incredible painful
Still effected by weather; for example being frozen, but will still survive

name: Money Tree
overview: make tree that produces money
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time and it grows one hundred dollars (or the equivalent of one hundred US dollars depending on where you are) a day in one dollar bills (or the equivalent). If the money tree gets destroyed or you destroy it, you can create a new one somewhere else.
pros: You can have a money tree
You can get up to one hundred dollars a day
cons: You can only make one at a time
You can only get one hundred dollars a day and its in singles
People will always be trying to steal it from you

name: Altered Life Experience
overview: experience a part of another person's/animal's life in a slightly different way
description: This power allows to user to experience a part of any person's or animal's life. Say your a kid and don't know what you want to be when you grow up. You can experience the lives of people doing different kinds of jobs. If your wondering what your friend was doing you can get a idea of what they did. You can leave the life experience any time you want and you can't die in a experience you can only feel the pain. No time in the real world will go by while your in the experience.
pros: You can experience lives of your friends, family and people you don't know.
You can't die in a experience.
You can even have experiences of dead people and animals.
cons: You can feel pain in the experience.

name: Light Travel
overview: travel through light.
description: In essence, this is like teleportation, but more limited. Anywhere there is light, you can meld into it and emerge anywhere else there is light. You essentially move at the speed of light.
pros: You can travel quickly.
You can escape easily.
cons: It's more limited than teleportation.
It can be difficult to perform.

name: The Best Superpower Ever
overview: gain the best superpower ever according to your subconscious mind.
description:
You gain the best superpower ever according to what your subconscious mind thinks. If it was your conscious mind, you would have to actually decide what you think the best superpower ever is, and that would be annoying. 
All superpowers have their limits. This power won't give you any ultimate future deciding powers and you can only use it once a week.
pros: You choose it. (Kind of)
It's powerful.
It can be fun.
cons: It can't be everything.
It can only be used once a week.
It might not help with the situation.

name: Blood Master
overview: control living things with a drop of your blood
description: One drop of even a small portion of your blood on any living organism makes them your slave-drone. If your blood touches a living thing you know everything the organism knows, see whatever it sees and as a bonus you can access their abilities. They have an undying loyalty toward you and all things your blood has touched. Your blood can be washed off but the effects last forever. Have fun controlling the world.
pros: There is no limit to how many people, creatures, plants, viruses etc. you can control
Seeing through other people's, animals', insects' eyes and taking their skills and abilites
Spilling all of your blood onto the earth and becoming the planet
cons: Pricking your finger, cutting yourself, drawing blood constantly will eventually make you weak
Abilities do not include superhuman abilites, only athletic abilities, learned skills, IQ
People will find out who you are and a sniper's bullet will end your reign... or will it?

name: Celestial Light Pulse
overview: use the Divine Light pulse of every energy in the universe
description: Unlike Terrestrial Light Pulse, you can rejuvenate stars, create stars from a distance, and make vegetation become everlasting. Even when they are cut off, or are in the middle of a desert with no nutrients. Make them impervious to even atomic bombs. You can even revive anybody from death (even after severe deterioration). You can also grant mortal animals and humans different forms of mortality, even total immortality.
pros: You can make rejuvenate things permanently (at will).
You can create, regenerate, and replicate forms of any energy that gives off warmth and light.
You can bring people from the dead and grant them eternal youth, durable life span, or immortality.
cons: Most christian churches would cast you out.
Don't let pride go to your head
Be wise before using this.

name: Kinetic Absorption
overview: absorb and store kinetic energy
description: A person with Kinetic Absorption has one of the most useful abilities. They can selectively absorb kinetic energy--the energy that moving objects have--and use it for themselves. This means if they get hit with 500 pounds of force, not only will they be unharmed, but they can throw a punch with 500 pounds of force immediately afterwards. They can only use as much kinetic energy as they have stored, they can be overloaded (1,000,000,000 pounds), and they have to think about the ability to use it.
pros: Cannot be hurt when using
Able to use energy you've stored
Versatile
cons: Must think about ability to use
Cannot absorb other forms of energy
Can be overloaded

name: Weight In Gold
overview: turn items into their weight in gold
description: With this power, you can turn objects or people into their weight in gold.
pros: You'll be rich
cons: Once you turn something into its weight in gold, you can't turn it back

name: Bestial Seasonal Manifestation
overview: summon physical manifestations of each season.
description: This ability allows you to invoke the four seasons as bestial physical manifestations. Summer would manifest as a large big cat with a bizzare coat and long slender body. Autumn would take on the form of a large golden brown stag with menacing antlers. Winter would manifest as a large white owl with scalloped wings. Spring would manifest as a massive scarlet butterfly capable of draining its victims of their life force. You can acquire their attributes as well as strength.
pros: Capable of drawing strength and power from the seasons.
Each manifestation's power grows by tenfold in its orginal season.
Summoning one or all four seasons is optional.
cons: Must concentrate to control all four seasons.
Still vulnerable.

name: Telepathic Healing
overview: stimulate the brain's function to speed up healing.
description: By using telepathy, you are able to control the brain of others into stimulating the body systems into the healing process. Also, through such ability, you can control the hormones, chemical mediators and cells of organic beings as an offensive form of the power.
pros: Heal any form of injury.
You would be able to know which part of the body needs the most healing
Can heal multiple victims within psionic range
cons: Tends to shorten life span of patients because of increased cellular regeneration.
The more victims and injuries, the greater concentration is needed.
Creates great fatigue to the user of such power.

name: Vorpal Sharpness Control
overview: control sharpness in any object you touch, either imbuing or taking the quality of sharpness away.
