description: With a touch you can give vorpal qualities to anything, even non-edged surfaces. Sharp weapons cut better, while non edged weapons, objects, even your hands, can be imbued to cut through nearly anything. You can also imbue an item as a trap, such as making a doorknob cut anyone who tries to open it. You can also take sharpness away from things, turning knives and other edged weapons into awkward bludgeons against you.
pros: Can make anything a lethal weapon
Can set traps for enemies
Cannot be cut by anything if you do not wish to be
cons: Only lasts for an hour
May accidentally cut someone if careless

name: Accurate Fists
overview: have fists that cannot be dodged and will always hit the intended target
description: A person with this power has fists that literally cannot be dodged and is always accurate. This manifests as an extra insurance attack that always hits the target. Even if a person dodges the blow they will still get hit by the force of the blow. In addition the user does not need to aim punches. If it is thrown into a general direction the intended target will be hit. In addition if you aimed at the head and actually hit some other part both parts will have been hit.
pros: If people move out of the way they will still get hit by the force of your punch regardless
Instant accuracy--no need to aim punches only throw in a general direction
Can instantly flurry someone
cons: Punch can still be defended against with armor etc.
Is only strong as your actual strength
There are power that can dodge this

name: Temporal Snatch
overview: freeze someone in time for up to 3 days to the future to gain more time in the present.
description: This ability is mostly used to get more time. You need to touch a person and freeze them in place. During that time, you can either pause, increase or rewind time, depending on how long you froze someone to the future. You can only freeze them for up to 3 days (giving you a maximum of 72 extra hours). You "steal" their time, as it were, to gain more time yourself or manipulate time..
pros: Send someone to the future.
You can either pause, increase, or rewind time.
cons: Can only freeze them for up to 3 days.
Can only get the same amount of time as how long they remain frozen.

name: Electromagnetic Absorption
overview: absorb any frequency of light and convert it to energy.
description: Photosynthesis works on a very limited range of frequencies (and not the one for green light, hence the colour of plants). However, imagine if you could absorb *any* frequency of light, be it Radio waves, Microwaves, or even Gamma rays. A person with this ability would be living in the perfect era, as electromagnetic radiation is all around us, what with cellular and Wifi networks etc. This power can be activated at will, but if it is used for too long it could have disastrous consequences.
pros: Limitless source of energy that is abundant in today's society.
Can be drawn on as a source of energy for more tiring powers.
cons: If it is activate for too long you'll at best become really fat, or at worst die from the overload.
You would completely disrupt signal anywhere you were using it.
Doesn't protect you from the damaging consequences of high frequency radiation (Gamma rays).

name: Clear Flame
overview: create and control a flame that heals
description: The flame literally has no color and heals any living organic matter that it touches. The flame will heal anything up to near-fatal wounds and weak diseases.
pros: Heal your allies with something that looks like it would kill.
cons: Automatically heals living organic matter and cannot burn it.

name: Fissure Weak Point
overview: give someone/thing a weak point that is in a form of a crack or a fissure on them.
description: This ability applies to anything except God, water, or intangible things. The user gives anything a supernatural crack on them to point out their physical weakness. One hit will cause the entire thing to bust like a vase. For living things, the same thing happens to them, but, unlike objects, they can be restored. When a living thing gets a weak point, they will be stunned. Only the strong will not be stunned.
pros: Anything physical will have a weak point.
Invulnerability is useless to this power.
Stun weak enemies.
cons: Doesn't effect God, water, or intangible things.

name: Angelic Blessing
overview: have angelic powers
description: After being blessed by an angel, you have powers typically reserved for angels. As you were born human (or elf, alien, or whatever), you look completely normal, and you can activate your powers. You have command over holy light, celestial fire, etc. but they're all holy because it's angelic. You can create wings made out of light, fire, etc. You can manifest any weapon made out of holy fire.
pros: Any weapon you want made out of fire.
Wings for flight.
Can look completely normal if you want.
cons: The more evil you are, the weaker you are.

name: Time Breath
overview: stop time by holding your breath
description: From the second you stop breathing (unless dead) to the time you breath in or out time will stand still except for you.
pros: Play pranks
Steal stuff
Cheat
cons: Lung capasity is an issue
Kissing and swimming would be awkward
Most Machines don't work (bicycles would)

name: Techno Charisma
overview: talk to machines and control them via voice
description: A person with this power has the ability to talk to and communicate with any machine and can command machines with their voice.
pros: Control machines with your voice
The power works on any type of machine or computer no matter how sophisticated
cons: You also hear machines complaining about their jobs etc.
Only works on machines, cyborgs only have half the effect

name: Ambient Energy Conversion
overview: change (transform or convert) ambient energy into a different type of energy
description: This ability allows the user to change surrounding energies by influencing them. For example, the user can change the normal ambient energy around you into heat energy with your mind. Heat energy would surround you or the area you wanted. The user can also turn it into cosmic, negative, positive, or even cryo- energy. With training, the user would be able to create constructs.
pros: Change ambiant energies
Surround enemies and objects with this specified energy
With training, the user would be able to create constructs.
cons: Still affected by the changed energies
Can't actually manipulate.

name: Alter Ego Transformation
overview: transform into a super-powered alter ego.
description: With a phrase (or just a word), you can transform into a hero/heroine, complete with transformation sequence, change of costume (sometimes other changes in appearance may occur as well) and additional powers. Nobody will be able to recognize you unless you transform right in front of another person, in which case they will be able to tell it is you.
pros: Gain powers and costume
Cannot be attacked while transforming
Easy to keep secret identity
cons: Phrase, powers and appearance cannot be chosen
Cannot transform without the needed word or key-phrase
Power may be tied to an item which is then needed to transform as well

name: Statue Sentinels
overview: create statues to guard an area
description: Statue Sentinels are stone statues you can summon to protect a specific area. They can be people, animas, or mythical creatures. When an enemy or someone with bad intentions comes within 50 feet of a Sentinel, it will animate and attack that person. The Sentinel's are still made of stone, so they're very hard to destroy but can be a bit slow. They will continue to guard an area until you dismiss them or they're destroyed.
pros: Statue Sentinels offer strong protection for an area
They look like statues, so an enemy won't suspect anything until it's too late
You can guard as many areas as you want
cons: You can only have up to 10 Sentinels guard the same area
Sentinels won't attack anyone outside of their 50 foot radius
Because they're made of stone, Sentinels can have slower reactions

name: Photokinesis
overview: produce and control light.
description: With Photokinesis you can produce light at any time from your own body. With this light, you can shoot energy beams from any part of your body, but unless you were EXTREMELY adept you would not be able to produce the intensity to make harmful beams come from your whole body at once. Preferred method is to use your hands. You can also create illusions, or blind your enemies.
pros: You can see anywhere.
You don't need artificial weaponry.
You can make people believe almost anything through the use of illusions.
cons: It's difficult to control.
It can be hard to hide.
It's not too remarkable in the light.

name: Personalized Spellbook
overview: summon a spellbook to give you magic power
description: This power gives you a personal spellbook that can never be stolen or damaged, and can be summoned and desummoned at will. It can also shift size and appearance at your will, though it always looks like a very old, dusty, leatherbound tome. Every day, you get a new spell, based on your desires and what you would want to do. As you grow older, the spells are allowed to be more and more powerful, and earlier ones can be beefed up. The book has unlimited pages, and opens to where you need it.
pros: You cast spells with a symbol, a word or phrase, or gesture, depending on the spell
OR, if you summon the book, you can cast it at will.
Build up a wide variety of spells to do things that are always cool (as it's your preference)
cons: You aren't particularly potent at first
If you don't have a "gain permenant invulnerability spell", which would probably take YEARS to reach
Then you'll be at risk of being sniped or the like

name: Ability Absorber
overview: absorb an ability from anyone who has a special ability.
description: With this ability, you can absorb an ability from another person who has a special ability. So let's hope you meet a lot of superpowered people
pros: You can absorb someone's ability without him/her losing their ability .
You can try a new ability every time you come in contact with another super powered .
cons: Might end up with abilities that you hate.

name: Kinesis Manipulation
overview: control any -kinesis power.
description: You can weaken, strengthen, negate or cause temporary malfunctions in any power with -kinesis as part of its name, including this one. The range of this power is 500 feet. You have to see your target and know that he has a power that can be controlled.
pros: Strengthen the telekinesis of an ally.
Stop a pyrokinetic foe.
cons: This power stops working beyond 500 feet.
You have to know someone has a power you can affect with this power.

name: Memory Access
overview: access anyone's mind like a computer database.
description: Whenever a person is sleeping near you, an icon appears above their head. This icon is only visible to you, you can touch this icon as well. Once you touch it an entire organised database appears in front of you. You can look in it and access any file/memory you wish to see. You can even copy memories from the sleeping person. Permanently.
pros: Know things you would never know otherwise.
Your mind is immune to anyone with the same or likewise power.
If you remove the right data, you can take someone out forever.
cons: If the target awakes, you risk corrupting data and permanently damaging their mind.
You are left without defense while accessing a mind.
If you alter the wrong data, you might make someone blind or deaf.

name: Power Splitting
overview: multiply copies of yourself that each gains one of the powers from The Superpower List.
description: Say you're surrounded... well, just multiply twice and there's four of you that can multiply, plus the powers you gained off the list. During the multiplication process, your duplicate gets all of your powers PLUS a superpower from the list. So, basically, you can have an army of you with every superpower on this list. Yeah, good luck stopping you.  You can banish your duplicates whenever you want.
pros: You become a super army of you
Fun to watch an attractive female with this abilty multiply into many attractive women
cons: Your duplicates gain the powers, not you

name: Confuse Ray
overview: make people confused, resulting in them attacking their allies or even themselves
description: The person with this power is able to make a single person or a group of person confused. When his or her enemies are confused, they would either attack themselves or other people. However if the user is trying to confuse a large group, the probability that the enemies would attack themselves or each other is lower.
pros: Good at turning enemies against themselves or their allies
cons: Not that effective against large crowds
People with strong minds or mental powers can break away from it
Cannot directly control the person

name: Desire Detection
overview: understand a beings' desires.
description: With this ability, the user is able to detect a beings' desires, whether they be human, animal, machine, spirit or something else entirely. However, this only works if they want the user to understand what they desire.
pros: Pets are now much easier to care for.
Language barriers pose no issues.
You won't be the literal genie when trying to help someone.
cons: Useless to uncaring people.
Cannot detect secret desires.
Does not provide the means to fulfill detected desires.

name: Animal Morphing
overview: morph into any animal.
description: With this ability, you can morph into any living creature.  A cat, a bear, a cow, a giraffe.  You get the idea.
pros: Changing into a bird and flying
Changing into a lion and chasing people
cons: Try not to get captured

name: Endless Pockets
overview: store anything and everything in any container
description: You can store an infinite number of items of any size (elephants, TVs, people, games, etc. ). You are essentially Mary Poppins, except it works with anything you touch. You can store anything in your pockets, lunchbox, backpack, anything. This does not affect the size or shape of the object, or even the weight. You can change the weight, size or shape of the object at will as long as it remains a shape that it would be able to take normally.
pros: "Walk in" storage anywhere!!!
Store everything and anything (including you)
Bring everything everywhere without having to carry something
cons: When you let it get too messy and you can't find anything
Not extremely useful in a fight unless you put the person in your pocket...
In which case you have to either place them there or cover them with the container

name: Time Dilation Manipulation
overview: manipulate areas of altered time
description: You can create Time Dilation Fields. These are areas where time flows differently. You could create a room of extremely slowed time to go to the future, accelerate/pause time around you to go super-fast, make paused time to 'teleport', stopped time to prevent a bomb from going off, or create a non-mobile accelerated time field around someone to age them to death. Creating a field that goes in REVERSE may be possible, but it'll take years of practice to develop.
pros: Includes a lot of other powers. Super-speed, teleportation (in a way), aging.
You could also make "force fields" by creating an area of stopped time, where nothing could move.
There's also time travel to the future, though getting back is a pain, if possible at all.
cons: Momentum. You will hate this concept after you create thousands of dollars of collateral damage.
If you're not careful with your fields, parts of you (or your allies) might age differently...
Or even be seperated by moving in different timeframes. Oh, and you're going to age really fast.

name: Encompandentia Infinita
overview: create a giant barrier dimension that has infinite space.
description: When you say "Adeat", you and everyone else of your choosing will be transported to a barrier dimension that has infinite space. Basically, it's a room with no exits.
pros: No one can escape unless you say so.
Can control the laws of physics inside of the dimension (EX: gravity).
cons: Can be broken through if you're not calm.

name: Diamondification
overview: turn your body into stone, becoming inpenetrable.
description: This power lets you become completly industructable, becoming an unknown substance stronger than diamonds.
pros: When stone, you're indestructible
You have amazing strength
You're impervious to magic
cons: You're only indestructible when using your power

name: Life Force
overview: put yourself into any other persons/thing body
description: You can put your life force in people, literally.You can have their power and basiclly live forever by putting life force into little babies.You can live to be hundreds even a thousands-years-old.And you can put thier life force into something else.
pros: Be someone else (the girl you like)
"LOOK" at yourself in the mirror(a girl)
Have another power
cons: Poeple may mistake you for someone else

name: Double
overview: split into 2 of yourself with 2 distinct powers
description: This power allows you to split into 2 just like duplication, but would give each of the 2 a distinct power. To do your first split, you must think of a power you will give yourself. Your twin will receive a different power to complete your choice. The twins are mentally linked so can communicate from afar but share their pain. You can always become 1 again, but the powers will remain the same after the first split. With practice, you could split into more than 2 & reset the powers given.
pros: Instant twins
Will automatically know the weak point of the power you choose
Won't fear dating twins anymore, for a while
cons: You feel the pain being inflicted to your twin even though you won't be hurt physically
Choosing a power can be difficult
Splitting into more than 2 takes a lot of patience

name: Omni Forcefield
overview: create extremely large force fields.
description: Say there is an intergalactic problem and ships are shooting the Earth. If you have the power of Omni-Forcefield, you can shield the whole Earth.
pros: Spectacular defensive power.
cons: Not the best offensive power.

name: Dust Manipulation
overview: manipulate The Particles Of Dust
description: With this power you can control dust such as sand soil dirt natural dust of any other small particle that fits in that category this power can be used for many this such as taking the dust off of an object of cleaning the air it can also be used as offensive by making duststorms or sandstorms
pros: Can clean the air
Can blind people with dust
cons: Sometime dust goes evertywhere and can attack you

name: Ambiguous Power
overview: have all the abilities that have not been thought of by other people around them
description: A person with this power has access to all the powers that have not yet been considered by people. They can fly but only by using an alternative method to do so, because if anyone knew they were using flying they would instantly stop working and you would fall off the sky. Thus you need to think of powers that have the same function as flying such as telekinesis so that when you are flying they will not think that you are actually using telekinesis.
pros: You can do a lot of things with imagination.
Your powers always have a surprise factor.
cons: If someone figures out your ability the ability stops working
If you are going against a mind reader
Powers are limited because the user has no time to develop every single power.

name: Lightsaber Spawn
overview: make a lightsaber appear out of nowhere
description: With this power you can make a lightsaber of any color you want appear out of nowhere in order to fight (or commit) crime. The lightsaber works the same way a lightsaber in the Star Wars universe would making it extremely powerful and deadly. When you're done with the lighsaber you can make it disappear again
pros: You can have a lighsaber at any time
Lighsabers are very powerful weapons
It can be any color you want
cons: You can only summon one at a time

name: Light Regeneration
overview: turn into an entity of light and heal yourself completely
description: You can heal yourself and turn into the light version of you (like in Jak 3). This is possible because of light eco. You have to turn into the light you in order to heal.
pros: You can heal yourself.
Never go to the hospital again.
Can also heal bones and deseases.
cons: Have to collect light eco clusters or from an open unlimited light eco vent.
Once you run out of light eco, you can no longer heal yourself (unless you get light eco).
You can't have unlimited light eco inside you unless you unlock that cheat.

name: Copycatation
overview: copy all the abilities of one foe
description: If challenged by a foe, you can copy all their abilities, including fighting skills and superpowers, and fight them. It is usually still good to protect yourself with tech, but no one can beat you in a one-on-one fight. Combine this with additional abilities and you will always win.
pros: Always win in a one-on-one fight.
Effect is permanent until replaced by new abilities.
Superpowers can be copied.
cons: Cannot copy a gun, but can copy invulnerability.
Multiple enemies is a possible serious threat.
Accidentally copying a bad fighter will make you a bad fighter.

name: Dark Field
overview: create force fields and other things from dark energy
description: A person with this power is basically the dark Green Lantern. They can make bubbles of dark energy as well as fist, hammers, and so on. The user usually has an object that is the focal point of the power--a ring, necklace, or another object on their person. For more stuff that can be done with it, look up the things Green Lantern can do.
pros: Be a force of darkness
Force fields
The different things it can be used to make are nearly unlimited
cons: Limited by user's willpower
If the item is lost, so is the power
Does not give you the power to manipulate shadows or use them for travel

name: Free Space Manipulation
overview: manipulate Free Space
description: Free space is an abstraction from nature, a baseline or reference state, that is unattainable in practice, like the absolute zero of temperature. It is characterized by the parameter known as the permeability of free space or the magnetic constant, by the parameter, called the permittivity of free space or electric constant, and by the speed of light. With this one can manipulate electromagnetism and "Vacuum" or namely non-zero pressure.
pros: Manipulate free space
cons: Turns things into free space atomizes them, changing them into free floating particles, Empty space.

name: Mental Mechanic
overview: make mechanical items disassemble or assemble with your mind
description: This ability allows you to disassemble and reassemble mechanical objects with your mind. So, when one has a weapon pointed at you all you have to do is think and it shall fall apart in their hand. It can be influenced by emotion, so when the user has extreme anger they may cause a whole bunch of stuff to fall apart.
pros: Useful when faced with a weapon
You can take apart, fix, and reassemble mechanical items with no work
cons: Useless in battles with weaponless powers
Anger subconsciously activates the power

name: Stealth Rejuvenation
overview: heal all injuries and restore stamina by bio-thread aura cocoon.
description: A thin aura thread surrounds the body like a cocoon, giving a stealth or camouflage appearance which takes half an hour to revitalize and heal wounds by absorbing all elemental energy in the area.
pros: No physical or mental side effects upon completion of healing.
Can be use for others by laying hands on the head.
cons: High risk and vulnerability upon discovery by sensor types.
It takes longer time to heal if elemental energy is limited.

name: Atlantean Physiology
overview: have an atlantean physiology
description: The atlantean physiology is the physiology  that all Atlanteans have. On the land, the Atlanteans have superstregth as well as invulnerability due to the difference in the pressure between land and the sea. The higher pressure in the sea, makes all Atlanteans stronger on the surface due to the extreme pressure they face under the sea, making their body tougher to hurt on land . In the sea, Atlanteans have the ability to breath underwater. All Atlanteans can also breath on land
pros: Can breath underwater as well as on land
Superstregth
Invulnerability
cons: Under water, Atlanteans have normal strength and is as vulnerable as a normal human being

name: Quantum Intangibility
overview: not be affected by forces in this dimension
description: When using this power, one can become intangible to a number of specific things at once. The easiest being able to phase through matter, then levels of intangibility are possible: desities of matter, light, weak forces, gravity, strong forces, then even to the point of time. You remain intact by intrensic forces. There are levels of concentration to keep yourself solid at places and time, and intangeble at others.
pros: You can unmaterialize before getting hit
You can simulate flying and invisibility
You can share this power with those around you
cons: You sometimes have to concentrate to keep youself solid; shaking hands might be difficult at times
If you materialize in solid matter, you lose that part
When you become invisible, you can't see

name: Outnumbered Exponent
overview: have all your natural and supernatural abilities multiplied the more outnumbered you are
description: A person with this power will become stronger the more outnumbered they are. When a person senses hostile presence around them, they can multiply all of their abilities, both natural and supernatural, at a rate exponential to the amount of people facing them. This means that it is very likely that the person with this power can defeat an entire army. Unfortunately, this power requires knowledge of being outnumbered, so it does not work when the user is ambushed.
pros: Look badass by beating an army
A million people will have to fight you to the millionth power
You can also hide your strength and do not have to defeat everyone right away-holding fort, etc.
cons: Doesn't work on one on one
If you get ambushed, the power doesn't activate

name: Space Time Forcefield
overview: withstand physical attacks by sending the attack somewhere/some time else.
description: A space-time forcefield works by sending any physical attack-a bullet,a sword,someone punching you,a thrown chunk of building-to some other time and place in the space-time continuum. This other time and place is random every second and beyond your control. Thrown explosives that hit you will be affected if they don't go off on impact. Things like nanites are too small to be affected unless they form a solid mass. Water or air attacks even if shaped to look solid will still hurt you.
pros: Say goodbye to the Hulk.
Stand under an asteroid.
The look on your opponent's faces as his watches his demon sword vanish.
cons: There's always a chance a grenade could reappear right where it disappeared.
Everything sent to another other time or/and place could damage the continuum.
Energy attacks still hurt you.

name: Psychokinesis
overview: manipulate the attraction between atoms
description: A person with Psychokinesis can perform a variety of startling effects. They can soften objects, making titanium as soft as butter by touching it. They can also liquefy objects and disentegrate objects.
pros: Very versatile
Can liquefy cold butter for toast and save some time
Scare foes
cons: Unable to mentally move objects
Disintegration leaves a very distinctive powder,so they know it's you
Liquefication has its limits

name: Dafentesis
overview: think of any one power and attain it!
description: This is the ability to get what you want! What ever power you want! But once you've attained a power there is no giving it back or getting a different one! So be careful what you wish for.
pros: You get what you've always wanted.
cons: It's inexchangable

name: Clairsentience
overview: have visions of the past of an object by touching it
description: Every year, millions of pieces of police evidence are scrutinized so they can tell their stories. A Clairsentient has a shortcut. They can experience an object's past just by touching it, i.e. seeing the history of a gun or a suit, all its owners and what they did with them. With intensive practice, they can even tell what their past owners are doing now, and their state(dead, alive, etc.).
pros: Become a good policeman (never wrong)
Become an excellent forensic scientist
Know other's secrets (if these walls could talk...)
cons: Involuntary, takes work to master
Might not like the truth
Learn nasty, unwanted secrets (if these walls could talk...)

name: Capsule Transformation
overview: transform objects into capsules that can be transformed back
description: You have the ability to transform objects into small portable capsules.   Those capsules have a release trigger that will transform the capsule back to the object in it's original size.
pros: You can capsulate your weapon, car, house and carry it in your pocket
No matter the weight of the object, the weight of the capsule is always low
You can carry many capsules with you.
cons: You can't encapsulate living objects.
Capsules are easier to steal then the actual objects

name: Electronegative Pulse
overview: convert your own intense emotions into electronegative energy
description: Your able to take all your anger, aggression, rage, and hatred and transform it into an energy source of electrical and negative energy. This ability also increases your physical attributes to supernatural levels.
pros: You can summon this energy anytime you want to
It has a special healing quality
It's only given to individuals that have a pure heart and honest mind
cons: It's fueled by bad memories, anger, rage, hate, fustration, or depression
This power is a rare and unstable form of energy that has to be learned to be controlled
It's a very dangerous power source if in the wrong hands

name: Shadow Animation
overview: bring one's shadow to life for various purposes
description: This is the ability to animate one's shadow, allowing it to become a "living" three-dimensional being capable of flattening up against walls, impersonating the shadows of others, merging with the user (allowing him to become invisible in shadows and teleport through them) or aligning themselves to another person, allowing the user to see the target wherever he goes, through the shadow (like a scrying device)
pros: Finally your lazy shadow picks up some of the slack
Become invisible in shadows
Teleport through shadows
cons: Intense light
Umbrakinetic psychics can take control of your shadow, too
If your shadow has a mind of it's own (and isn't mentally connected to you) once you animate it

name: Super Fighting
overview: use various fighting skills to defend yourself and destroy your opponents
description: Powerful punches, destructive kicks, flip kicks, windmill kicks, use of the walls, ceiling and surroundings to jump from to get power, and super healing. You can turn it off and on at will. Have super karate moves and kung fu power. You're born with this power. It's a defense mechanism that can't be stolen or absorbed by opponents. You never get tired in "fight mode," and have super jumping power. Your weakness happens when sleeping.
pros: Controllable
Never allows you to be hurt
Never lose a battle awake
cons: Immortal
Weak when sleeping
Defeated when sleeping

name: Ctrl + Z
overview: un-do things.
description: With this power, you have the ability to un-do things when you screw them up. You can correct any mistake by traveling to the past up to 5 seconds. You can only do it once each time you screw up. It is similar to the computer, when you make a mistake, you hit CTRL + Z and everything is un-done.
pros: You never screw-up.
You can do things over again.
You have more control over your life.
cons: You can make terrible mistakes.
You don't live your life fully.
You can become very obsessive.

name: Tactile Illusion Projection
overview: project an illusion around objects you touch
description: When you touch an object, you can create an illusory field around it that makes it appear as whatever you want, as long as the image has similar dimensions as the actual object. You can create a very exact illusion, or one with vague details that an observer completes subconciously, all with little focus. These illusions deceive all 5 senses. If the object loses contact with your skin, or an object linked to your skin, the illusion will fade within 10 seconds. You can even hide an object.
pros: Can change your own appearance and your clothes easily
Can use a piece of laminated paper as any ID
This would be fantastic for magic tricks
cons: Can only create illusions around things you touch
If you lose contact, the illusion will fade fast
People may notice that they see an object slightly differently

name: Perfect Counter Ability
overview: always have a random ability to perfectly counter anyone's single ability
description: A person with this power has an everchanging ability that instantly becomes any ability that can counter another superpowered being's ability. For example, against a time manipulator, this power will prevent alterations in space-time or copy their alterations. Against a pyrokinetic, it will either become fireproof, fire control, cyrokinesis, or eating flames. The counter power you get is random. You can choose which ability you want to counter. Most of the time, the counter only stops the power.
pros: You can beat any superpowered being with a single power
You can beat a group of superpowered beings with the same single power
You can choose which ability this counter ability works on
cons: Can only work on one ability-less useful against someone with multiple powers
You can't get this power twice(unless you are WHD)-no offense just a joke
The counter ability is random and can be different every time you fight the same person

name: Memory Viewer
overview: see a person's memory
description: With this power you can see the memories of other people
pros: You can see what the person has done in his life
cons: You can only see things the person remembers not just anything that has happened to him/her

name: Trailshocker
overview: fly leaving a trail of a lightning bolt behind you.
description: You can turn yourself into a thunderbolt in the air, dashing through the sky at a very fast speed leaving behind a stream of electricity.
pros: You can fly while being a thunderbolt.
You can even shock and tackle your foe.
cons: Can't use it underwater.
You can't go through control electricity
You can't go through power lines

name: Cloud Hopper
overview: go to the clouds and jump on, walk on, sleep on them as though they were tangible.
description: With this ability, you can summon a cloud that reaches earth. You ride the cloud and it takes you to the clouds in the sky. You can actually touch the clouds. You can jump on the clouds in the sky and it acts like a trampoline. You can climb clouds to reach higher clouds. You can sleep on a cloud. The clouds always move and change shape. If you fall from the cloud, a cloud will go right under you and bring you back to the sky. You can ride the cloud to go back to earth. Time waster!
pros: You can jump on clouds.
You can sleep on a cloud.
No one knows where you are (except pilots and passengers).
cons: Time waster!
If it's a clear sky.
You can't change the shape of the clouds in the sky.

name: Force Construct
overview: create objects out of forces.
description: The user is able to make weapons, objects, and even toys out of forces. Unlike elemental or any other construct, the force construct applies the properties of the force. A gravity- based construct by my guess would be the heaviest thing on the planet, capable of cause the same amount in damage. The user is able to wield the construct of any kind without any difficulty. Look under the definition of forces or check the fundamental forces to get the idea.
pros: Different effects for different force construct
Create constructs out of forces
cons: May deplete source of the force (No Pun Intended! )

name: Inator Creator
overview: create any manner of beams, rays, waves, or blasts of energy.
description: All you would have to do would be say "(the thing you want to do)inator!", aim your hands at your target, and enjoy. For example, you could say "destructinator!", aim your hands at a bag of garbage, and *poof*, no more garbage! This ability can be used with all sorts of inators. Ones such as the shrinkinator, begoneinator, freezeinator, badbreathinator, and everyone's favorite, the chucknorriscomesandbeatsyoureneimiesheadsininator.
pros: You can make inator beams, rays, waves, or blasts
You can make different types of inators.
You don't have to say the name, just think it (but saying it looks a lot cooler)
cons: It can be hard to think of a name for your inators
Umm that's it, adios

name: Duplication Imagination
overview: create imaginary dopplegangers of yourself to confuse opponents
description: You can create exact duplicates of yourself, from anytime during your life. The duplicates cannot physically affect the outside world, but you can use them to confuse, manipulate, and distress opponents.
pros: More difficult for your opponent to target you
Drive your opponent mad by confusion
Clones are imaginary and can go through walls to spy on people
cons: Unable to use clones to attack
Clones can't touch anything
Limited by how far you can send them away

name: Pro Recall
overview: gain anything you've had in the past.
description: This power allows the holder to use any power, skill, memory, physique, etc. that they have used in the past. For example, if you had a long lost memory, you could recall it. You can even use it for abilities. If you lost an ability, you could recall it. In addition, you can recall physical features--youth can be recalled from any age or become any weight you have been. Injuries can be erased by recalling your body from a time you didn't have that injury. Even positions in work can be recalled.
pros: Train once and keep results for life
If you lose a power, you can recall it.
Heal injuries.
cons: If you don't accomplish anything in life.
If you lost a power, chances are you will lose this one.
Must be consciously recalled and returned.

name: Prototype Blacklight Virus
overview: consume people and steal their memories, powers, skills, and form.
description: With this power, you are infected by the Blacklight/Mercer Virus. Your main ability is to consume people (ripping them apart and combining their DNA with yours). After doing so, you can copy their powers, gain their memories, and shape-shift into them. You also have super strength, super speed, regeneration, and can turn your body into weapons.
pros: Have strength and speed. Can walk on walls, glide, and jump really high.
Can turn parts of your body into weapons, like swords, claws, shields, etc.
Can do everything Alex Mercer and James Heller can.
cons: You can still be killed if you sustain to much damage and don't replenish your health

name: Flamethrower Palms
overview: have a stream of fire come out of your palms
description: Be careful of what you're doing, so you don't accidently set anything on fire. Don't get too upset or mad and make sure you dont set yourself on fire, because you are not fireproof.
pros: Flying using the flames
Blowing stuff up
cons: Setting something on fire you didn't mean to (like yourself)
Blowing up buildings
Running out of flames

name: Life Saver
overview: save a person's life if they are dying.
description: If a person is dying, like truly dying, you can stop their death. Plus cure them of whatever was going to kill them. It works on yourself, but it takes longer. If you end up dying while that happens, you will end up as a ghost.
pros: Your loved ones would never die
You'd be a great cancer doctor
cons: You might wind up a ghost

name: Anything Magnet
overview: make anything you want be magnetically attracted or repelled by you
description: A person with this power has the ability to attract or repel anything they desire. They just need to know what their target is then their body will adjust so that it attracts only that/those object(s) or repel only that/those object(s). This works on any object the user thinks of even if they are not in the room at the time or are far distances away - the effect is weaker at futher distances.
pros: Grab items from great distances and push things away without even touching them
You can change the strength of the magnetic effect
Can switch instantly and can turn it off at any time and it works on ANY object
cons: You need to train to improve the power
Can only affect 1 item initially but can later be used on multiple objects or indiscriminately
Can be overcome with strength

name: Insta Weapon
overview: instantly create a weapon out of midair.
description: With this power, you can instantly create a weapon out of midair. You have to know or have seen the weapon to create it.
pros: BAZOOKA TIME
LASER TIME
SHOTGUN TIME
cons: You have to know or have seen the weapon to create it.

name: Invisibility Projection
overview: make objects you touch invisible
description: You can project an aura at will that bends light around objects, making them completely invisible. However, you cannot create this aura around yourself.
pros: Can hide objects you're holding
Would be great for magic tricks
Safes and walls can hide nothing from you
cons: Cannot hide yourself
Have to learn how to open safes if you want to open them using this power
If you lose contact with the object, it quickly fades into view

name: Gift: Lightning
overview: be gifted at the control of electricity
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling lightning and electricity than other beings. Thus their electrical and lightning-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of electricity and lightning from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve electrical powers, nothing else.
pros: Almost no one has as good control over lightning as someone with this power.
Lightning-based powers are boosted slightly.
cons: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only lightning-based powers now.

name: Chronos's Gift: Pool Of Youth
overview: create the fountain of youth in your hands
description: This power allows you to create the Fountain of Youth anywhere or anytime in the palms of your hands. With this power you can turn back the hands of time and cure any diseases that you or others might have. The amount of time you de-age is totally up to you.
pros: Never grow old
Immortal
Can share with other people
cons: Have to have hands
You have to decide how many years the water has to take off

name: Ability Theft
overview: steal other people's superpowers
description: If a superhero is a person in a Ferrari, a person with Ability Theft is a carjacker. By merely touching a powered individual, they can steal and use the powers for their own ends.
pros: Can obtain some amazing abilities
Can combine abilities (i.e. radioactive super-punch)
Be a hero/villian without equal
cons: Wary superheroes
Become hated and feared
Also absorb weaknesses (i.e. Kryptonite)

name: Sub Personality Creation
overview: create alternate personalities which can be controlled by maker
description: If you're attacked by a mind controller, you can create a copy of your mind to be attacked instead. You can then manipulate that alternate personality to do your bidding. Perfect for foiling evil plots under a supervillain's nose. Also, in a scenario where you need to hide, you can simply create a different person and hide. The original can prevent the copies from accessing other superpowers and retake control of his/her body at will.
pros: Can create a personality that can be an exact copy or different from the original.
Personalities can be reabsorbed and (optionally) share experiences with the original
The original can control copies
cons: May lead to confusion on who is the original
May be mistaken for MPD
Copies becoming aware of being copies could drive you insane

name: Enhanced Pack Invulnerability
overview: share invulnerability and more with other people.
description: This power is like Pack Invulnerability but has no limit on the number of people in your group. You use this power by having a shared vision of something (e.g. a utopian world or empire ruled by villains) with the other people. This power also gives the group a shared strength based on who's strongest, e.g. if in a group of three, one person can lift 250 lbs., all three of the group can each lift 750 lbs. If strength is equal (all three lift about 200 lbs. ), each will be able to lift 600 lbs.
pros: Invulnerability and a strength that grows with each new converted to your vision of the world.
cons: If you're not charismatic enough.

name: Iceworks
overview: generate plasmatic energy of the cold which you could fire your hands as any other shape.
description: Cryotechnis, freezing glory, cal them whatever you want, but these ice-cold energy globules that varied in degrees of power and intensity that'll obey you mentally, traveling whereever you direct them, arranging themselves in balls, streamers, and other shapes, and exploding whenever you wish for. These combinations could result in anything from a multitude of light colorful sparkles capable of freezing anything & anyone around you whenever you throw these things at them.
pros: You will be able to generate the largest amounts of ice and snow.
You can have the potential to detonate matter at a sub-zero-atomic level.
cons: Won't work in the summertime, but it can work indoors.

name: Reality's Language
overview: change reality useing foreign languages.
description:
When ever you you say something in any foreign language(any language other than your first)it will happen insantly.You can do anything as long as you now the words.The bad part is that you have to use a foreign language which can be hard to learn. But if you learn the words "teach me this language" it will help a lot. 
You can learn a lot of languages this way.
pros: Very powerful and useful.
You can learn a lot of languages.
Easy to control.
cons: The dictionary will be your favorite book.
Some people will be scared of you.
Not much else.

name: Universal Synesthesia
overview: control and sense sound and form it into different objects.
description: With this power you can control sound. You can also sense sound. Not only can you hear it, but you can also see, smell, feel, and taste sound (you can't eat sound since technically, it's not edible, but you can taste it on your tongue). Also, you can form sound into different objects. The sound becomes solid and takes the objects shape, so you can make weapons or walls and stuff. The louder the sound, the stronger the sound-shape-thing.
pros: Create weapons and shields.
Smell, see, feel, and taste (if you want), sound
cons: No sound equals no power

name: Reverse Psychology
overview: have people do certain things for you by reversing psychology
description: For example, if you asked someone not to get out of a car, they would get out instead. If you asked someone that you didn't need money, they would probabally ask you how much you needed. This effect is normally switched off, and you must 'will' it to be switched on.
pros: You have the power of reverse psychology.
Tell someone you don't need money, they probabally will give you money anyways.
Can be 'willed' off or on.
cons: Gets confusing when you talk while using reverse psychology.

name: Omni Liquid Manipulation
overview: control all liquids
description: You have complete control over all liquids: Water, tears, rain, battery acid, blood, tree sap, honey, milk, lava, petrol, you name it. You have the ability to pull blood out of a man's skull, stop volcanoes from erupting, force volcanoes to erupt, move the entire planet to avoid being hit by a comet, stop rain from falling, cause rain to fall. This power does require intense training before you can execute some of the more complicated feats, but when mastered you become a god... Or more.
pros: No more rain on your picnic or romantic date
You can control yourself and never have to bleed
Awesome party tricks
cons: People will begin to rely on you to fix world problems
You can still get charged for murder
Moving the entire planet could alter its solar path

name: Angel Eyes
overview: purify and heal a person while staring.
description: Whenever you see a person who is sick, corrupted, insane, cold-hearted or just plain diabolical, the beams of white light will come out of your eyes and they will be completely healed of wounds and/or lust for evil.
pros: Could even heal the blind, deaf, and mute.
cons: Must gaze at a person to work.

name: Time Floating Field
overview: create a cosmic energy sphere that completely freezes the time in its field of range.
description: This ability allows you to trap someone inside a sphere made of cosmic energy. The time is unable to move inside this sphere, making anyone inside it get unable to move, attack or even realize that got trapped. This effect lasts for at least 30 minutes. The problem is that enemies inside this sphere don't get hurt too. The energy sphere can trap an entire building, but you can create only one sphere per time. If the user has full control over this power he can bend the cosmic energy into a spear
pros: Enemies frozen in the sphere will have no idea of what happened.
The Cosmic Spear is the only thing that can kill someone inside the energy sphere.
You can use this power to protect someone while taking out baddies.
cons: Enemies inside the sphere can't get hurt too, unless if you can control the Cosmic Spear.
The Cosmic Spear requires a lot of energy and it can take years until the user is able to use it.
You can create only one sphere per time.

name: Toy To Real Life Equivalent
overview: turn toys into their real life equivalents
description: With this power you can turn toys into their real life equivalents. You can turn HotWheels cars into real full sized versions of the cars. Turn teddy bears into actual bear, monopoly money into real money, toy army men into actual soldiers, Nerf guns into real guns etc. You are unable to turn them back into toys with this power.
pros: You can toys into their real life equivalents
cons: You can't turn them back into toys
Some toys it doesn't work for such as marbles, Slinkies, dart boards etc.

name: Natural Talents
overview: make superpowers natural talents.
description: You can make superpowers natural abilities. For example, if have super strength, then you can make that a natural talent.
pros: Some powers only specifically affect other powers and not natural talents
cons: Some you may have a hard time explaining, like cooking poptarts from your behind.

name: Mnemonic Power Absorption
overview: absorb the powers of others through memories and/or psychometrics
description: This is possibly the most powerful form of ability mimicry in existence. You can absorb another person's power(s) through memories you have of them, and also through information you gather from objects that person has been in contact with.
pros: You can absorb someone's power by simply remembering them using it, similar to empathic mimicry
Psychometry is a natural part of this ability, and thus makes it easier to use
You can choose to absorb a power entirely, partially, or not at all
cons: Some people might fear you
This power can be countered by telepathy
Unless you can suppress and/or destroy a memory, you could be stuck with an undesired power

name: Comic Book Character Summon
overview: summon any fictional character from a comic book
description: With this power you can summon any character that has ever appeared in a comic book or graphic novel whenever you want. The characters are not under your control but depending on who you summon they may want to help you. When you're done with them you can just send them back to whatever universe they came from.
pros: You can summon any comic book or graphic novel character
cons: They are not under your control
They might try to kill you if its a villain

name: Timeless Lightning
overview: fire lightning that freezes time from one's fingertips
description: The lightning will cause whatever it hits to be frozen in time for half an hour. It will also be a bright pink in color. Using the lightning will also drain away your stamina.
pros: Keep enemies frozen to deal with them one by one.
cons: Bright pink lightning might look ridiculous.
Can't use the lightning rapidly.

name: Instant Secret Compartments
overview: create secret compartments on any vertical surface.
description: The vertical surface can be as thin as a 1/8th of a inch. The surface can be any material but must be opaque. You must press against the surface to open the secret compartment. The compartment itself exist in another dimension. The compartment is 36''high,24" wide and 6'' deep. It contains extras of any gear you have on you at the time or any signature gear that you might use.
pros: A good secondary power to The Door power or a power like The Door power.
Works on doors,one-way mirrors,a piece of cardboard held vertically. Use your imagination.
Have extras of any equipment(small enough to fit in a space 36"x24"x6"
cons: Equipment you need might not fit in a space 36"x24"x6".
A secret compartment requires a surface area at least 36" x24".

name: Colossus Creation
overview: make colossus out of any material
description: The ability to make a colossus and control it to what ever you want. But if you lose control it will go on a rampage, then explode which can only be prevented by destroying the colossus within 15 minutes from when control is lost
pros: Can help with giant monsters
Can be made to adapt to any enviroment
Will follow order to the letter
cons: The mini nuke if control is lost for 15 minutes
Rampage if control is lost
If creator is evil so is the colossus

name: Momentum Alteration
overview: charge the angular momentum of objects!
description: Discover that you can bend the laws of nature in a spectacular way; take for instance the ability to redefine the details of conservation of angular momentum. Magnifying the spin applied by any amount of force to make objects turn with incredible speed, then add to that by translating the angular momentum into energy of a more useful kind, transforming it into an effective weapon.
pros: Spinning a coin can blow up a room.
The game of Frisbee takes on a whole new level of pain.
The slightest modification to a car's wheel can result in devastation of whole city blocks.
cons: Could result in user's own demise.
Could destroy more than anticipated.
Can't affect organic materials, such as humans, animals or trees.

name: Transitive Property Execution
overview: imply the rules of transitive property into reality.
description: Also known as "Transitive Property Enforcement", the user is able to use transitive property in supernatural ways. In a real life example, if the user has to fight a guy who lost to another guy that the user actually defeated. That means the user automatically wins without moving a muscle, because transitive means he is stronger than that guy without implying both fighter's skills and abilities. The user can also become stronger because of the effects of transitive property.
pros: Use transitive property effect reality around you.
Gain strength and abilities by adding up the effects of transitive property that you use own others.
cons: Have to be greater than a thing that is greater to another thing to work.

name: Elemental Genetics Swap
overview: exchange one's own genetic/ natural ability/ functions for an elemental equivalent.
description: The user has the ability to switch any of their abilities that they are naturally capable of with any element to gain an elemental ability similar to it. Example: the user swap his natural ability of turning food into energy, then swap that with gold, and now all the food turns into gold. This ability also works genetic disabilities. You could make them better. The effects are not permanent.
pros: Gain new and unique abilities
Make disorders or other bad genetic traits into elemental abilities.
Also works on brain functions
cons: Effects are not permanent
Might be horrible side effects of changing genes.

name: The Aura Of Dracula.
overview: hypnotize Anyone and Make Them Your Minions
description: This power is the ability to hypnotize anyone with your aura and drain them of their energy, will-power and powers like how a vampire drinks blood. This enables the user to control their subjects and corrupt them, making them their minions.   The subject must be a human or superhuman being in order for this to work and they must be easy to manipulate, it does not work on demons, timelords, demigods or robots but works fine with superhero/superheroine types.
pros: Can be used on superheroes or superheroines.
You can drain them of their powers.
You can corrupt them and make them your minions.
cons: Doesn't work on demons or robots.
Characters with higher resistance levels are more difficult to hypnotize.
Doesn't work on timelords or demi-gods.

name: Marionette Quartz
overview: implant small amounts of quartz in living beings that allow you to control their actions remotely
description: This ability allows it's user to inject small quantities of quartz, through touch, in living organisms. The implanted quartz reacts and responds to the user's thoughts, allowing the user to remotely control the actions of infected organisms. The quartz dissolves in the blood after a few days, ending the user's control.
pros: Control enemies and allies from afar
cons: Wears off after a few days
Requires skin contact to implant quartz

name: Polymorph
overview: change people into animals
description: With this ability a person can forcibly change another person into any animal of their choosing. Such a change is always unpleasant for the person changed. Strangely this power only works on things that can think making animals, plants, and objects immune. This power generally last for a day or two for a normal person, but for exceptional people it lasts hours. A person with a power will still have that power, though on a slightly reduced scale. This power is useless against shapeshifters.
pros: Good for non-lethally disabling people
You can choose the animal they turn into
Fun.
cons: Temporary
People still have powers, so beware that super-strong mouse!
Can't work on animals or objects, or yourself

name: Flight Manipulation
overview: control your own and others' flight patterns
description: With this ability, you can access the power of flight in its entirety. That means that the user is able to direct his flight in any direction (forward, backward, side to side, and at whatever velocity the user desires); in addition, the user can also control the flight patterns of OTHER flying things. Fortunately, when the user flies, his mind subliminally keeps him from going any faster than his body would be able to handle. UNfortunately, this same limit does not apply to others.
pros: Access the power of (wingless) flight, and control the motion of other flying subjects
Your body will never let you go faster than you can handle
Others can be made to fly as fast as you want them to go (or to stop midair, etc. )
cons: Can't control things incapable of flight (unless they are already in the air)
Can't send a subject INTO flight (can't MAKE people capable of flight)
No "terminal-velocity detection" is present in certain people (go faster than you can handle)

name: Quietus Jump
overview: teleport into living things for possession, damage, or the kill-jump
description: Teleport directly into any living organism around you. The effects of jumping into the living depends on the proximity at which you teleport & the size of the thing you jump from. Things smaller than what you jump from are instantly decimated. The closer a living thing is to you the more damage you do. If at arms length you kill-jump. Farther away you may initially stun, if you finally learn to jump into bodies without killing you possess them, gaining knowledge, abilities etc.
pros: You can teleport into any living thing in your area. (32 kilometer radius)
May steal bodies when you jump into them. All their knowledge, talents and abilities are yours.
Highly effective: At the least you render victims comatose, deaths are more likely
cons: If you stay in a body too long it will begin to deteriorate and you will be forced to jump
Once you activate this power you will have no body of your own, jump 'til you die
If bodiless, jump into a body into a body in 60 sec or you are an ethereal afterthought

name: Mirror World
overview: use mirrors as traveling dimensions
description: You can just simply walk into a mirror, preferably your height & you'll enter the Mirror World. A dimension of traveling mirrors you can cross through. Though if you have words on your clothes, when you exit, they will appear reversed. Also small mirrors like compact are not really usable accept maybe spying through & using cracked/broken mirrors will could shatter & destroy you into a million pieces.
pros: Use mirrors as a instant transporter
Use mirrors as spy devices
cons: Words on your clothing will be backwards when you exit mirrors
Small mirrors are just really used for spying
Traveling through cracked/broken mirrors will kill you

name: Firestorm Matrix
overview: have an access to the Firestorm Matrix, transforming him or her into Firestorm
description: The firestorm matrix enables whoever has it to transform into Firestorm, a person who is both man and nuclear energy. When the user is in Firestorm form they can shoot nuclear energy blast, transmute objects, loosen up molecules that are binding a object together and fly.
pros: Can combat crime ranging from small to large crimes.
Can fly around.
Can go head to head with certain powerhouses.
cons: Lead might hinder your powers.
Certain powerhouses might be too strong for you.
Hard to master powers, especially transmutation.

name: Psionic Spheres
overview: generate spheres of intense psionic energy.
description: These spheres can be thrown like projectiles; sometimes these sphere detonate like time bombs, hid underneath the surface of the ground like mines, can be rolled like balls and then explode and many other uses. One with this ability is immune to the psionic energy.
pros: One can detonate these spheres at any time.
Your foes wont suspect the "mines".
With time one can change the size of the spheres, adding more psionic energy to them.
cons: Another person that has an ability such as, Energy Absorption, is immune to the psionic as well.
Can take time to learn how to make them explode at will.
When this ability is undeveloped, the users sphere will explode on contact and will send one flying.

name: Summoner
overview: summon any person or group of people just by snapping your finger.
description: With the snap of a finger, you can summon any person or group of people to your location.  Just think of the person and snap your fingers.  Don't worry, you won't summon someone every time you snap your fingers--only when you want to use the ability.  And hey, if you don't know how to snap your fingers, then you'll suddenly know how!
pros: When someone wants to hang out, just summon them
Summoning the police or Jackie Chan if you're in trouble
Even better, summoning Chuck Norris if you're in trouble
cons: You might find it funny when you're drunk to summon a crowd of angry arabs, which would be bad.

name: Octopus Mimicry
overview: take on the traits of an octopus.
description: You have a flexible, elastic body that can squeeze through tight spaces or expand to a great size. You can breathe underwater, and can sprout eight tentacles with little suction cups to grip and manipulate multiple items at once. You also have the gift of camouflage, and can change your skin tone to blend in with your surroundings by will. Not only this, but you can expel a jet-black ink to form instant darkness, and a quick getaway.
pros: Eight handy tentacles.
Excellent flexibility.
Camouflage and ink blast.
cons: You're born with a pinkish purple skin tone.
You'd be kinda freaky.
Might be heavier than you are now

name: Timebombing
overview: create bombs that freeze time
description: This power grants the user the ability to create bombs that can freeze time for a preset amount
pros: Can freeze time
Good for escaping tight situations
Keeps everything outside the field frozen
cons: Can only freeze time
Must be specific about amount of time you want to be frozen

name: Instilled Perception
overview: cause others to believe something no matter how illogical or ridiculous it may seem.
description: You can tell anyone that 2 plus 2 is 5 and they believe you! You could steal money without a mask and say you didn't steal the money and everyone would believe you. Or say you're in love with someone and tell them they love you, they will be convinced they are in love with you.
pros: Can get out of anything.
Can get the girl of your dreams.
Can make lots of money.
cons: Some villains may be extremely intelligent and can not be controlled.
You can only control 25 people at a time.
You can't undo it after 5 hours.

name: Delete This Now Ok
overview: be ambiguous and a duplicate
description: ambiguous and a duplicate
pros: Very useful power
cons: Nothin

name: Visible Imagination
overview: experience imagination all around you and other people
description: This power allows you to see your own imagination before you, like it's really there. You'd have an amazing memory, this power is great for creative people. These illusions affect all 5 senses. You can see what others imagine about too.
pros: Have an amazing memory
Useful when you're an artist
Be a superhero, meet celebrities, do everything you ever wanted
cons: It's a beautiful show only you can see
It's not always great to see what people create in their head
Some people will never turn this power off and will finally lose their senses.

name: Aura Of The Phoenix
overview: use the phoenix's aura
description: You unleash the Aura of the Phoenix. Giant wings of pure flame come out of your back, and you gain incredible regeneration abilities. While in use, most injuries you obtain heal within minutes. It has no real fighting abilities by itself.
pros: Can fly
Regenerate at an incredible pace
cons: No fighting abilites by itself

name: Fabric Metamorphosis
overview: transform your clothes in armors or weapons.
description: The person who possesses this power can melt your skin with the clothes she wears. These dresses can be modified so as to turn into organic weapons and armors: a bracelet of wood can be transformed into a chakram, a gown can become a tangle of controllable lianas, a belt could become a whip, and so on. The power will only work with anything is intended solely as "wearable" (a bucket on your head can not be used in this way).
pros: The wounds that would normally hurt your body will be "absorbed " by clothing.
Patterns, designs and pictures on clothing will undergo amazing changes.
cons: The power has no effect on synthetic fibers (acrylic, nylon);
Whatever is launched, thrown or bolted retains its mutated form only for a while.

name: Shadow Kinetic Strengthening
overview: indirectly vampirize the potiential energy of any solid thing to boost your strength and durability.
description: The opposite to the original ability, this gives the user a boost the strength and durability of the user. The amount of the strength and durability boost depends on how many potiential energy they absorbed.
pros: Physical strength and durability is increased.
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
cons: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Shadow Obliteration
overview: delete a person from existence by deleting their shadow
description: One with this ability is powerful to say the least. In most cases, a shadow disappears when there is no way for the shadow to be made; however, one with this ability reverses this relation on a quantum level. They psychically cause matter to disappear whenever the matter's shadow disappears. However, this isn't always active. The user psychically deletes the shadow (or makes it invisible) which in turn makes the object that makes the shadow disappear.
pros: Works on anything, living, dead or inanimate (as long as it casts a shadow)
Doesn't activate automatically (no accidental obliteration)
Doesn't require much concentration
cons: May require touch
Umbrakinetics can secure their shadows
If your powers are uncontrolled, they might delete people or things accidentally

name: Acquired Total Immunity
overview: become immune or to be completely unaffected by any other ability through its acquisition.
description: With this ability, a multi-powered superbeing is unaffected or granted total immunity against all superpower they are in possession of, e.g. if you have telekinesis, flight, reality manipulation, immunity, and immortality, all these superpowers will have no effect against you or your abilities. Telekinesis will be unable to move you or anything near you, flight is nullified. Reality manipulation? Immunity and immortality? Forget it! As long as you have the ability, it will not affect you.
pros: If you have access to multiple superpowers. (Yey superpowerlist! )
If you are a power copier, stealer, or absorber.
If a superpower is a threat to you, all you have to do is acquire it. It's just a click away.
cons: If your enemy possesses deadly abilities different from what you have.
If you are not a power copier, stealer, or absorber and you have no access to the superpowerlist.
This doesn't work against the ability 'Author's Immunity'.

name: Flaming Spikes
overview: shoot fiery spikes that will burn & impale the opponent.
description: You can snap in a fit of rage and start firing long, sharp, burning spikes that will scorch and impale the opponent. The spikes are capable of igniting anything in their path, including burning up walls and ceilings when it sticks to them. Sometimes, the spikes are emitted from your body smeared with a toxic matter in order to spread infection throughout the wound.
pros: Effective against plant and bug type foes.
cons: None

name: Old People Are The Best
overview: become more powerful as you become older
description: With this power you get a new power every year on your birthday and all the powers you had before become more powerful. This power starts the first birthday you have after obtaining this power it does not work retroactively so if you're 75 when you get this power you do not get 75 powers but you get one new power when you turn 76 and so on and so forth.
pros: You get a new power every year on your birthday
When you get a new power all your other powers become stronger
cons: This power does not work retroactively
If your birthday is February 29 you are not going to get a lot of powers from this power

name: Hydromaniacal Form
overview: transform into a state where you grow and gain power from water.
description: With this ability, you transform into a form which grows and gains power from water. You become a monstrous elemental formed out of water. As you absorb water (by bathing in it, or touching it), you grow, and gain abilities such as blasting water, water-breathing, and controlling water. You are susceptible to freezing temperatures, however, and must revert if you begin to freeze.
pros: Absorb water, which increases your size and power.
You gain abilities such as water-breathing, water-blasts, and manipulating water.
Bathing in the ocean would give you an unlimited amount of power.
cons: Freezing cause you to revert to normal form.
If you revert, you lose all of the abilities and size that you gained while in this form.
Absorbing the ocean could become dangerous

name: Latent Power Absorption
overview: absorb the latent abilities of others
description: This ability allows you to absorb the latent abilities of others for your own. This means that if a normal person is about to manifest a superpower, you can take that power from them, preventing it from even manifesting. I addition, if a super already possesses one or a few powers, and is about to manifest another (or his power is about to develop), the user can absorb that power, or the boosted version that's about to manifest. As such, this may be accompanied by Power Sensing.
pros: When you absorb powers before they manifest, you can automatically use them
Normal people with unmanifested powers often have no way to defend themselves
A person who already HAS a power, and is about to receive a power boost
cons: People who can't have their powers absorbed
If you try to absorb already-manifested abilities, you'll overload, pass out and lose the power
Sometimes you don't get the Power Sensing, so you can't sense if someone has unmanifested powers

name: Five Senses Manifestation
overview: release your five senses as physical forms.
description: With this ability active, you are able to release your five senses as five different forms of yourself. Touch would take on the form of a human-sized spider with enhanced strength, smell would manifest as large wolf without eyes and a muzzle, hearing would take on the form of a large bat, taste would manifest as a large chameleon with a prehensile tongue capable of inducing paralysis, and sight would manifest as a giant crimson eagle with scalloped wings. The sixth sense is a chimera of all.
pros: When in trouble, invoke your five senses for back up.
Communicate with your fives senses using telepathy.
Utilize all five senses at once to call upon the "sixth sense" (precognitive).
cons: Learn to control all five senses.

name: Deconstructive Energy
overview: send waves of deconstructive energy.
description: With this power, you can send out waves of energy that can deconstructe anything they come into contact with. This extends to the ability to break down other objects like concrete and steel to elements such as breaking the bonds of water molecules to make gas. You can even negate gravity by breaking down gravitons.
pros: Deconstruct objects
Bust down any door
cons: Range is limited to 320 meters
Power is useless if hit by a reserved force
Elemental break downs require energy and control

name: Dire Situation Adaptation
overview: adapt to any dire situation.
description: One with this ability can adapt to any dire situation. Similar to Reality Warping or Wishing, this can help one gain abilites if almost dead, if one was having trouble finding a partner, one would gain the necessary qualities to find one, or if one was poor and collected money from others, one would gain more and more til whenever one desires. This ability kicks in when one is under-average to get to an average or higher status than what one has currently and when one is in dire need
pros: If you're homeless, you gain qualities and endeavorment or the opportunity to gain a place to live.
Money when poor.
Gain a suitable life partner
cons: Doesn't work if one isn't in a dire need of something.

name: Matter Absorption
overview: absorb the structure of different materials.
description: With this ability, you are able to absorb the physical structure of any material at will. If you touch flame, you become living and burning flame. If you touch metal, you can become dense, organic metal. Your cells absorb the structure of matter but remain connected, so if you absorb water, your cells won't drift apart.
pros: You can become metal from a bullet.
Turning into air provides transportation.
Your body becomes your weapon.
cons: You can become combustible.
You can be lost in the ocean or the atmosphere as a liquid or gas.
You could cause damage as certain substances ie. Fire, acid, etc.

name: Transparency
overview: control an object's opacity from opaque to translucent to transparent
description: The power transparency, also known as Opacity Control, gives the user the ability to control any objects or person's opacity. They can make things opaque, translucent, and transparent at will. With this power it is very easy to fool other people and hide your true power. For example you can fake hammerspace, forcefields, flying, and super human speed, just to name a few. In addition, the user ,through training, can make anything invisible once shown--such as hiding blood from opened wounds.
pros: Can make anything invisibile including yourself
Immunity to lasers and light based attacks--light passes through you or said transparent object
Excellent for magician, mimes, and illusionists and assassins
cons: You need to train in order to control how opaque you want something to be
Once someone finds out your trick it is a lot easier to beat you
Things that you don't know the location of cannot be made transparent

name: Optimism
overview: shape reality depending on your optimism
description: Optimism allows the users to shape reality to his will, restrained only by his/her negative thoughts. Examples would include changing the share market, or never-ending "luck" (as long as you're still optimistic). If user is pessimistic, this ability does nothing.
pros: Unlimited "luck"
No "bad" luck
Worryfree
cons: Sometimes it may be hard to be optimistic
It may also be hard to know you have this ability
Hard to control & use

name: Impenetrable Cocoon
overview: create a cocoon around oneself for various effects
description: The user of this power can create a cocoon around themself that is impenetrable. While in the cocoon you can do up to 3 things: 1) heal all wounds on the body, 2) gain one other power, or 3) increase all physical attributes used in fighting by 150%. Options 2&3 have a limited number of uses. #2 can only be used once and #3 up to three times. You cannot gain godlike powers from #2. Also, the better the power/the worse the wound, lenghtens the time you need to be in the cocoon.
pros: Can heal any wound while in the cocoon.
Can gain one power while in the cocoon.
Cocoon cannot be opened or damaged except by you.
cons: Can't do anything while in the cocoon.
The worse the wound, the longer the time in the cocoon.
Allies can't wake you up even if you want them to.

name: Arctic Touch
overview: freeze someone solid with just one touch.
description: With this power, you can flash freeze someone by just slapping them. When you rub your hands together, they start to glow a frost blue. Then, the next thing you touch will freeze instantly. The more force applied, the better the effect. If you slap someone with the power in effect, the person will be frozen solid, and is given the appearance of being slapped. Do not confuse slapping with punching. If you punch someone with the power in effect, they won't freeze. They will transform into ice!
pros: Stops enemies instantly.
Great for rigging floors.
They can never thaw unless the person who froze them says "Unfreeze. "
cons: Can be lethal if used out of anger.

name: Attractivness
overview: be immensely attractive and charming.
description: The moment you gain this power all blemishes, scars, and integumentary flaws are erased. Your pheromones change to make you more appealing. Your skin can change to tan or pale to attract others. Your Adam's apple shrinks to be less noticeable. Your voice turns melodic and lighter.
