description: You run as fast as darkness, and everyone knows darkness is faster than light, thats why theres a void of darkness.   You ignore collision because your body, clothes and equipment will become a shadow who can penetrate anything while running.  While running everything becomes slow motion for you.
pros: Ignore collision
Faster than light
Get to places in a blink of an eye
cons: You may run too fast and fall down a cliff or any high places by accident

name: Time Recycling
overview: erase moments of one's past in order to convert into add extra time in one's present moment.
description: This ability allows the user to "recycle" the time he used in the past in order to pause or fast forward time. This means erasing past events in the user's life. The erased time is then converted into extra time for the user. Then he can add it to his time in the form of time frees or an "event replay". A event replay is when the user can replay the event that happen to him in the past but in the present. It may be different though since the user is in a diferent time or place.
pros: Have extra time
Replay certain moments
The user can chose what moment he wants to erase.
cons: Classic Time Warning: Change the past, change the future

name: The Earth Power
overview: absorb and channel energy from the earth
description: As long as you're touching the ground you can absorb energy from it. This energy can be used to recharge yourself, gain strength, heal, shoot energy blasts, and other such things. Also, you can store this energy in yourself so that you don't need to absorb it from the ground. This is good because if you're seperated from the ground you can't use your powers. To use this power you must imagine energy flowing from the ground, through your legs, and into your body.
pros: You can gain energy rapidly and use it in different ways
You can store the energy in yourself
There are other ways you can channel the earth's power
cons: You must be touching the ground to absorb the power.
It takes concentration to absorb energy

name: Laser Emission
overview: generate powerful lasers from your fingers.
description: Laser is an acronym for Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation. It's really an extremely powerful ray of light. A Laser Emitter can produce a laser from their fingertip that can pierce a 2 foot block of steel--or generally anything else.
pros: Can pierce most anything
Looks very cool
Powerful offensive skill
cons: Almost no worth as a defense
Takes concentration
Maximum range 70 yards

name: Person Creator
overview: create people
description: With this power you can create people, or recreate existing/fictional people, and alter their/give them personalties in any way you wish. You can also alter their looks according to your liking and they're also completely under your control. You can make as many as you want, but only a hundred of them can exist at once.
pros: Make an army of people that will do whatever you say.
Hang out with friends.
cons: A hundred people can be (re)created and exist at once.

name: Vicarious Reality
overview: trade places with fictional characters.
description: A vicarious reality is where people prefer Star Wars over everyday life, or someone who plays World of Warcraft once too often. As a superpower, you can trade places with these fictional characters, such as Dante from Devil May Cry, or Neo from the Matrix. Plus, you will have the powers, skills, and memories of the fictional character you trade places with.
pros: Become your favorite fictional character
Escape reality for a while
cons: You may not want to come back to the real world
You may have to fight Freddy Krueger or Lex Luthor

name: Ice Blasts
overview: shoot blasts of ice from your hands
description: Freeze your enemies in their tracks with ice from your hands.
pros: Stop enemies,
Make icicles to stab your enemies,
Make awesome ice sculptures,
cons: Licking the ice would be a bad idea,
Doesn't work well against fire,
Ice will eventually thaw,

name: Percussive Maintenance
overview: fix anything by hitting them
description: A person with this power can fix anything by hitting them. TV broken--just give it a light tap and it will be fixed. Rogue robots---punching them will also fix them. Person being mind controlled--punching them reverts them back to their original self. Someone has a headache punching them also fixes the person up. However even if the object is fixed they still receive damage from your punch so if you overdo it, it will still break.
pros: Fix things---a universal interpretation of the word fix
Excuse to hit things
Can be used on anything and everything including people
cons: If a part is missing this will not regenerate the lost part
If the thing that needs fixing is on fire or is otherwise unhittable---or unadvisable to hit
Cannot change the inherent properties of an object--no upgrades or modifications

name: Multi Jump
overview: jump and then jump again and again in the air.
description: Double jumps have nothing on you. With this superpower, you can jump and then jump again in the air. You can jump again and again in the air. You have to practice and time your jumps. You get higher with each jump in the air. You need to develop your jump stamina or you will only jump a few times.
pros: Jump, then jump again and again in the air.
With every jump in the air, you get higher and higher.
If you time your jumps, you get the most out of this power.
cons: If you don't time your jumps, it's harder to get higher.
If you don't practice, you will not be used to jumping or get too high in the air.
If you don't jump while in the air, it will not work.

name: Energy Bow
overview: create a ball of energy out of which you can shoot arrows
description: When activated, you can create a ball of energy. Then, you can pull on the ball to create an arrow. Finally, release it to fire an energy arrow.
pros: Fire pure energy arrows
cons: If you're facing a fast opponent

name: Healthy Hands
overview: reach into someone's body and pull out anything that ails them.
description: You now have the power to physically reach into someone's body and pull out anything keeping them sick, be it a tumor or something bacterial or viral. People will start to come to you with their problems and maybe even pay you!
pros: Need an organ transplant for one of your family members? Now it's free.
Become a world famous doctor.
People you save may owe you favors or reward you.
cons: You have to find something to do with whatever you pulled out.
You have to build up a great immune system to be able to withstand diseases.
Doesn't work on yourself.

name: Object Displacement
overview: shift objects into a parallel dimension
description: Now you see it, now you don't. A person with Object Displacement can 'drop' nearby objects out of our reality with a wave of the hand, making them totally nonexistent. When they bring displaced objects back, they reappear in exactly the same location moving at the exact same speed in the exact same state as it left. The more heavy an object is, the harder it is to shift; speed is less of a factor but still influences the difficulty of the displacement.
pros: Killer magic tricks
Displaced objects return in the exact same state they left
Can be used at a reasonable distance (10 yds)
cons: Must get a clear thought in at the object, nothing rushed
Displaced objects return at the same velocity
Speed and weight affect the difficulty of the displacement

name: Water Combustion
overview: cause water to combust
description: You can cause nearby bodies of water to combust, making the water burn similarly to oil. Larger masses of water require greater focus. You can ignite the amount of water in an Olympic-sized swimming pool with difficulty and extreme focus.
pros: The human body is about 57% water. What would happen if you combusted all of that.
Droplets of water suspended in air will create an explosion when combusted
Can turn any stream of water into a flamethrower, so carry around a super-soaker for self-defence
cons: You can't ignite very large bodies of water eg. Lakes
Having the power to kill others at will could make people fear you

name: Music Manipulation
overview: manipulate music
description: You can control & manipulate music with this power. Change the volume of the music. Change the way it sounds. You can make a guitar sound like a trumpet, for a limited time. Change the pitch of voices; a soprano can be deepened to a mezzo-soprano! A bass can be raised to a tenor! You can even create synth sounds! Ever heard of Sound Forge?
pros: Control the volume of music, make it quiet so you don't disturb pesky music-haters!
Change the way musical instruments sound, like a synthesizer!
Make it louder & easier to hear.
cons: You can't manipulate music that is too far away, such as a distance of 3 miles.
Don't make the music too loud or you could go deaf!
Not everyone loves music.

name: Super Physique
overview: keep running and moving without ever getting tired.
description: You can train and have good physique and get more muscle but never lose the old you have. Even when you get old, the powers stay. You never get tired and you do not need to sleep. However, you need to recharge your body with water and food at some point after the human limits. But the great thing is, you stay fit all the time, never needing to train. This is not like the power Contained Metabolism, because there you don't need to eat.
pros: Never get tired
No need to train your body
No need to sleep
cons: Need to eat and drink
You can get injured
You can die when the internal organs stop of old age

name: Money Magnet
overview: attract currency (money) like a magnet, or repel it
description: You can activate this power and control the strength of the magnetism; you must have some of the type of currency you mean to attract or repel. By type I mean American money, Monopoly money,etc.
pros: You can atract all american currency with a penny.
Throw people by repeling the money in their pocket
cons: If you have no money of the desired type.
If enemies are broke
You might get pummeled by large amounts of change

name: Ultimate Tk(Space Time)
overview: have tactile kinesis over time and space
description: With this power, you can use your hands to grab space-time. You can use space as a shield and you can create slides and other things out of space. When you touch someone else, you can rip apart their bodies via "space cutting. " You can even grab time frames where an attack exists and crush it. You can rip open a portal then rip open time/space for your exit. You can create artificial gravity by creating a funnel toward an object. Be creative and you could do more things
pros: Your hands are the ultimate weapon
You can do virtually anything with your hands
cons: You are only limited by your creativity and your willingness to mess around with the universe
If you do not immediately undo what you have done, it could lead to consequences
You can only bend what you can see

name: Super Human
overview: lift objects, jump great distances, run extremely fast and be supremely tough
description: A super human is able to go far beyond the limitations of their mind and body to be able to perform all manner of actions. This power gives its holder super enhanced versions of the following: strength, speed, reflexes, agility, acrobatics, endurance, toughness, senses and mind. This allows the holder to lift extremely heavy objects, leap huge distances, run at high speeds and withstand all forms of physical and mental attacks to a certain extent.
pros: Strong, fast, agile and tough
Enhanced intelligence
Prepared for all manner of situations
cons: Takes a long time to learn how to control
Can only improve with training, but con 3 is still valid
Very strong and fast but those with just super strength are a little stronger and likewise for speed

name: Monospecies Omnipotence
overview: completely control one animal species
description: When you get this power, you think of a single species of animal. You have complete control over this species. You could gain its attributes, turn into it, turn individuals of it into humans or human/animal hybrids, turn humans into individuals of it, give others its attributes, mind control it, spawn/summon it, destroy it, give people were-it powers or curses, edit attributes of individuals (only within the bounds of the species, though). Any animal-related power you can think of.
pros: Get a large variety of powers AND the ability to grant powers to others
Of course, the animals (of this species... ) absolutely love you and follow your orders
So you can keep them as pets, too, and impress people
cons: One species. You can't change the basic form of the species, either, you're stuck with it.
Thinking of a relatively useless species
You still can't, say, travel through space, teleport around, reshape matter, etc.

name: Biological Absorption
overview: absorb the complete biological structure of another being
description: Through this power, you are able to absorb the powers of another being. As well as powers, you absorb their energy and DNA, enabling shapeshifting and healing.
pros: Gain many powers
Enables healing
Shapeshift to max 1 other form to evade pursuers
cons: The process of absorption almost always kills the person being absorbed
Due to the volatile nature of the users DNA, their DNA degrades hundreds of times faster than normal
Because of this, they need to take at least one person a week to stay in top shape.

name: Vector Terrakinesis
overview: use telekinetic vectors, or energy appendages, to control geological elements
description: This ability lets a person control earth, like normal terrakinesis, but with a big difference: "vectors", or invisible telekinetic appendages, allow the user far more dexterity and control than the normal form of this ability, letting them control rocks or earth far too heavy for a normal terrakinetic to handle. The vectors also allow you to effortlessly slice rocks, even granite, in seconds!! This ability can even still work if a person using it is physically separated from earth.
pros: Have extremely strong and precise control over geological elements!
You can use the vectors to channel earth energy into others, to heal them
You can be an extremely skilled and deadly fighter to any enemy!!
cons: Using more than 4 vectors at once causes both physical and mental strain
Evil people with this ability are extremely dangerous!
Your power is weakened sufficiently if you are in an urban environment

name: Power Duplication
overview: duplicate with super powered clones
description: You can duplicate giving the clones a random superpower
pros: An army of superhumans at your disposal
Can get rid of clones at any time
cons: Clones might get to powerful

name: Aura Shield
overview: create a shield out of your aura
description: If done properly, this can protect you from any attack; physically or mentally.
pros: Protection from anything
cons: Can only protect you if used properly
Cant deflect arrows yeah it sucks

name: Time Code Mastery
overview: control the two codes allowing time travel
description: In any universe you are inside of, there are two 'time codes'. One allowing travel to the future, and one allowing travel to the past, which are used by reciting the code out loud, and then stating the destination time. You know what the two codes are, and can change them at will, along with how time travel via the codes works (for example, what happens if you create a paradox while traveling by using the code). Anyone who knows a code can use it, but they'll be stuck unless they have both.
pros: Not only time travel, but time travel you can allow your friends to use, and revoke it, too
You know what happens if you create a paradox, since you can change that aspect, so no worries
If anyone gets the code and you do not want them to, you can just change it, and it'll be useless
cons: Someone can use the code before you can change it (particularly if you don't know about them)
They could even erase your existence, preventing the code from being changed
If you don't give someone both codes, they'll be stuck without either help or another way to travel

name: Silvertongue
overview: read people and characters into and out of books
description: Using this power while you are reading out loud you would be able to read characters and objects out of books. People can even change the events of reality using this power. You can read yourself into and out of books too, along with others. I do not own Inkheart, and to be honest this is where the idea came from.
pros: You can read your favorite character out of books.
No more paying for items, read aloud a grocery list or catelog and you're set!
You can read youre enemy into a book with a terrible ending.
cons: When you read yourself or someone else in or out of a book, someone has to take your place.
You have limited control over which character or object comes from the book.
You can easily accidentally read someone into a book.

name: Marked Omnipresence
overview: be omnipresent in any area you have visited.
description: With this power, you are omnipresent in any area you have been at will. This avoids the problem of seeing things you do not want to and reduces the risk of an Omni Vampire. Unfortunately, you cannot interact with the viewed area.
pros: View any area you have visited since acquiring this power.
You can choose what areas you view.
Useful for manipulation; get someone into a place you have been and you can watch them.
cons: If you view an area with an Omni Vampire present, you suffer the consequences.
You must have been there already and some powers can hide what you see, such as Unpredictability.
This power cannot be modified in any way, including Con Negation or an Enhancement power.

name: Eternal Eclipse
overview: govern the powers of dark energy and gravity
description: With this ability, the user can generate high amounts of dark energy and gravity. Dark energy (at Full Body Transform) allows the user to do nearly anything, from complete destruction, to time/space travel, to infinite knowledge. Gravity allows the user to create things like black holes, or the user could even collapse a star to create a supernova. There are three forms to this ability: Human Form, Angelic Form (comes with two black wings and an exploding darkness spear) and Full Body Transform.
pros: Not just for bad guys
Power to become an energy being
In Full Body Transform you gain the ability to regenerate as long as there is a particle of you left
cons: Angelic Form and especially Full Body Transform are hard to master
If you stay in Full Body Transform for too long, you will be stuck that way permanently
Tread CAUTIOUSLY around energy absorbers (don't forget you have gravitational powers, so use them! )

name: In My Pocket
overview: have any item or object in close proximity upon request by another person
description: For all those times people ask you for an odd item when you're stuck in a jiffy, such as needing superglue, a pen, a calculator - or to be more creative, a lightsaber, the first issue of X-Men Giant Size to credit cards, etc. ANYTHING that's requested basically.  Also, the probability of you being able to possess the object through natural means is inverse to the object's potential to malfunction, i.e. it may be likely to have a pen handy, but not a Harrier Jump Jet - so expect malfunctions.
pros: You are always equiped
You would become the most useful guy/gal in the world
The more people you know, the more items it's reasonable for you to have access to
cons: Someone else MUST request the item before you can materialize it
The probability that you could possess the object is inverse to the usefulness of the object

name: Ability Replication
overview: copy the superpowers of others by touch
description: An Ability Replicator is a highly adaptable and unpredictable foe. By touching another superhuman, they can copy their abilities: Telepathy, Super-Strength, even Flight is not beyond them. The downside is that they can only hold on to one power at a time; with extensive time and practice it might be able to be expanded to 2 or 3.
pros: Can copy foe's superpowers
Surprise factor
No superpower beyond you (Telepathy to Super-Strength)
cons: Can only hold on to one power at a time
Must touch target
Getting stuck with an awful power

name: Big Brother
overview: know when you're being watched
description: With this power you automatically know when somebody is watching you. Makes it perfect to know when you can't/should use your powers. Also gives you the location of the watcher (deities and higher beings not included).
pros: You know when you're being watched
You know when you shouldn't use your powers
cons: Doesn't include deities and higher/celestial beings

name: Total Remote Viewing
overview: use remote viewing in its strongest form.
description: You can see past and present activities anywhere on Earth and other planets. You can even find planets with other humanoid life.  You can also view three things, in three places, at once.
pros: You can find anybody, and anything.
You can see past and present things.
cons: You can only see either past or present things.
Some things are better left unseen.

name: Contemporary Magic
overview: use magic to create any effect as long as it is possible with current technology
description: A person with this power has the ability to do magic to create any effect that is currently possible with current technology. For example they can shoot fire in an arc that looks like a flamethrower and can blow dry their hair using magic.. Anything that you can do with current technology is possible for you to do. The user is limited by current technology because although you can mow your lawn with magic it is only just as fast as the highest technology lawnmower that there currently is.
pros: Easy to hide your powers--people probably think you are some sort of Batman
Your power is only limited by current technology
You can use the effects of the best technology for free
cons: Kinda useless since you can't really do anything technology can't already do
Don't really know what current technology can do so you have to read magazines to learn new "spells"

name: Void Lightning
overview: fire lightning from one's hands that creates a void when it hits something
description: The lightning will create empty space when it hits something, but air is unaffected by the lightning. You still need a medium for the lightning to travel through.
pros: This lightning doesn't cauterize wounds. Good if you want to kill.
cons: Creates an opening for someone to use 'Lightning Void'.

name: Transfearmation
overview: transform into any person, creature, animal, or a thing that your enemies fear most.
description: Sure the Scarecrow has developed a fear inducing gas that he uses on his victims. He can induce specific fears or cause his victim to experience their own worst fears. What if you have this power to shapeshift into the worst horrifying monster, demon, alien, mutant, a person, or anything else that most evildoers fear most.
pros: might be a good use against bullies.
cons: you could give some elders heart attacks

name: Remote Viewing
overview: see any past or present event through your own eyes.
description: By closing your eyes and concentrating, you can revisit any past event and witness it exactly as it happened.  You can see what is CURRENTLY happening anywhere in the world (and universe) as well.  Watch any game, concert, or event as if you were actually there!  Unravel mysteries that have been lost in time!  What really happened to the dinosaurs?  What really happens at strip clubs??  The possibilities are endless!
pros: See anything that happened or is happening
Revisit moments you were too drunk to remember
cons: Some things are better left unseen
You might potentially spend a lot of time remote viewing

name: Particle Accelerator
overview: increase the speed of molecules and atoms and other subatomic particles
description:
With this power you can speed up the molecules to produce various effects. 
For, example you can create heat by speeding molecules in the air or you can make things explode by speeding up their molecules. 

You can also create a vibrating saw by making the molecules around your hand speed up so you can plow through anything, and as the name implies you can create a particle gun to shoot particles by speeding up particles that are already slowly moving toward the target
pros: Explosions and Fire(Heat)
Particle gun and saw
Alchemy, by particle acceleration
cons: You can only speed up particles but you cannot change the direction
If you creates an explosive element with the particle gun you could very well blow off the earth

name: Multiverse Travel Knowledge
overview: know how to build machines to travel the multiverse
description: You know how travel to parallel universes works, and how to do it. You will be able to build, with parts from just about anywhere (at least with fairly modern technology), any sort of machine you can imagine that allows one to travel to an alternate universe/reality/timeline. It could be handheld, a vehicle, cybernetic (only if that tech is available, though). It can vary from creating a one-way portal once to one world, to jumping to anywhere inside of any universe you choose.
pros: You can travel to any alternate universe, and be able to give others machines to do it
Or teach worlds how to do it
You can go meet fictional characters, get fictional weapons, whatever you can think of
cons: If your machine breaks somewhere with little or no technology, or with a hostile populace
Someone can steal your machines, or figure out how they work
Or stick bamboo under your nails until you tell them how it all works

name: Cryptid Caller
overview: call upon the creatures of myth to do your bidding
description: You get to call upon the creatures mankind believes does not exist, like the Loch Ness monster, Sasquatch, etc.
pros: Can call upon some really powerful allies
They never turn their back on you
Can become unstoppable
cons: Some people may try to expliot you
Must be a strong believer
Must know exact name of cryptid you try to call upon

name: Character Creator
overview: replicate characters from movies/books or to create your own.
description: The ultimate power for aspiring authors or crazy fangirls. A person with this ability can recreate fictional characters or create their own as long as they have enough information.
pros: You're own Edward Cullen.
A bunch of hot guys.
A bunch of hot girls.
cons: You can't return them.
The questions that people will ask you.

name: Shadow Manipulation
overview: control and manipulate shadow energy
description: Shadow Manipulation is a rare ability not to be confused with Shadow or Shadow clones. Shadow energy is a power source that can only be past from 1 shadow caster to another. Once obtained the user can travel through shadows at the speed of light. They can also fire blasts of the dark energy in the forms of black/gray fire,lightening bolts,or raw energy.(Raw energy may back fire and cause serious damage to the user.) The user can also summon Shadow weapons.
pros: Great for Escapes
Power not limited to day or night
Shadow Energy is almost unstoppable
cons: A back fire may kill the user
Hard to control where you'll end up when using shadow travel
Power may start to take control of the user

name: Rules Of The Room
overview: set up an area where your rules must be followed
description: With this power, you can make rules that must be followed by anyone who enters the room. You write the rules within a rulebook that you must read to people after they enter the room. You must clearly state the rules before they are in effect. If someone disobeys the rules, they will die. The rules must be able to affect everyone. For example you cannot write "Only I can attack", but you can write "No violence" or "A punch for a punch". Also, you can ban superpowers, except this one.
pros: "No violence" is good for protecting you, "A punch for a punch" is good if you have superstrength
The rulebook can regenerate
You can also create a game with the rules
cons: You must follow your own rules and they must be able to affect everyone
You cannot make exceptions, unless they can be utilized by everyone
You have to be very specific to cover loopholes

name: Urban Empathy
overview: become superhumanly strong, agile, and intelligent while within a city's limits
description: The city: full of artists, businessmen, and culture. For an Urban Empath, it's the home of something else as well--their abilities. While in a city, they gain strength, agility, and intelligence relative to its inhabitants. If they live in a major city they can stop a semi, freerun through the urban jungle with reckless abandon, and outwit anyone who crosses their path. However, they are uneasy around large amounts of plant life, cannot grasp simple technologies, and get ill when in pure air.
pros: Strong enough to bench a firetruck
Agile enough to freerun on the tallest buildings
Canny enough to outwit any normal person
cons: Powers quickly dissipate as user leaves a city
Strength of powers relative to inhabitants of the city
Adversely affected by the presence of plant life and pure air

name: Avatar Of The Universe
overview: link together with the universe.
description: You will age but only if the universe will be someday die;otherwise your immortal. Your immune to anything that the universe is immune to. Reality altering powers will affect you. Antimatter doesn't affect you. Black holes can affect you.
pros: Immune to everything but reality alteration.
cons: Destroyed by reality alteration,but who wouldn't be?

name: Impenetrable Field
overview: have absolutely nothing happen to you.
description: This power is the ultimate gift, and the ultimate CURSE! You are surrounded by a permanent shield that is impenetrable. No power can get through it. It takes care of all your needs like air, food, water, warmth, keeping you cool, bathroom, etc. But nothing can get in, and you can't get out. That means you can't enjoy much anything. No sex, no kissing, no wine, nothing. Not even snacks. Your clothes are always different when you wake up.
pros: The ULITMATE SHIELD
Nothing can get through it
Can't die by trauma
cons: The ULTIMATE SHIELD
Nothing can get through it
Can't kill yourself.

name: Fear Inducing
overview: induce fear in any living thing.
description: With this ability, you can induce fear in any living thing with emotions. You can choose the intensity of the fear, which can also determine how long the being is in the state of fear. This is done mentally, and you can use it on large areas. You can induce fear without visual contact. However, it requires more concentration.
pros: You can get anyone frightened.
cons: Has no offensive use on its own.

name: Telekinetic Storm
overview: create a telekinetic storm
description: If this power is activated, the user will begin to levitate, along with all objects within the user's vicinity. These objects will suddenly start moving at high speeds around the user in a large cylinder shape. Telekinetic waves will start to blast outwards from the user, which resemble powerful gusts of wind, but affect others internally, as well as externally, and can cause a number of affects on the human body, varying from telekinetic force, to cuts, to disintegration of the body.
pros: Levitation (of user and other objects)
Telekinetic waves/blasts
Can cause telekinetic force, cuts, disintegration (on others)
cons: Can be destructive to suroundings

name: Newton's Third Law
overview: control kinetic reactions.
description: For every action there is an equal and opposite reaction unless this power is involved. Normally when a force is applied to an object and equal force is applied to what caused the force. With this power you can strengthen, weaken, or negate either the original or the reactive force.
pros: Negate the force applied to you when you use force on something.
Double the force of a blow to your opponent if they hit you.
Break through a wall because it wont react to your force to stop you.
cons: Would fall through floor if the floor didnt supply a reactive force to hold you up.
Would easily break objects accidentally if power was not controlled.
People could be easily hurt just by touching you and having their force multiplied.

name: Infinity Sneakers
overview: use them with great speed and defy gravity.
description: The infinity sneakers are a pair of shoes that allows you to move with greater super speed & defy gravity, this can include walking on walls, flying, floating, and being able to move with blinding speeds appearing as a blur. I can also you of impending danger.
pros: You are immune to earthquakes while wearing them.
Move faster than a speed of light & sound.
cons: Could trip on evil-made obstacles.
Only immune to the shaking of the earth, not to the destruction and parting of the earth
Can be stolen

name: Power Cards
overview: put powers into cards
description: You can put any chosen powers into cards but there are four conditions. 1. The being who has the power(s) involved has to allow you to put them into the card(s). 2. The power is removed from the person (not copied) and is then pasted. 3. 1 power per card. 4. Anyone can then use the power the card contains ONLY while they own the card. FYI this power can NOT be altered at all.
pros: Can help people who don't want to have powers anymore.
You can use the power the card contains.
You can use this on all your horrible powers and give their cards away.
cons: Person has to be willing.
Power is permanently removed.
Anyone can use the cards.

name: Energy Void
overview: absorb forms of energy
description:
Rules:
1. You do not get the energy it is gone.... Forever
2. You must come into contact with said energy or the energy's source, however you are not damaged by the energy... Example: put you hand into a fire you will not get burned. 
3. Energies include: magic, elemental, life, so on so forth. 

 This power is not something you can turn on or off once your body comes into contact with the energy or it's source it will be absorbed. This can be canceled by clothing
pros: Immune to being hurt by said energy
Automatic cannot be switched off : considered both
cons: Cannot cast magic or use any magical powerful items
Automatic cannot be switched off : considered both

name: Reaper's Scythe
overview: use a scythe as a supernatural tool for killing and travel
description: If you want someone dead, then all you have to do is slice. You can also use your scythe to slice into midair, and open a rift to anywhere in the world.
pros: You can be at home and kill someone anywhere in the world.
You can go on a vacation without having to pay.
cons: You need a scythe.
You need to know where you want to go before you slice.

name: Telepathy Via Sight
overview: read people's mind or send people information whenever they are in your sight.
description: The person with this power is able to read minds as well as send people information mentally whenever a person or a group of people is within their sight. If the person they are mind reading or sending information goes out of the user's sight, then he losses the mind reading and information link.
pros: Can read minds
Good for getting information as well as sending information
cons: Cannot use this power against someone with Mental Shielding
A power that only can be used primarily surveillance, not combat effective.

name: Neutral Matter Manipulation
overview: summon and control neutral matter.
description: What is "Neutral Matter"? It is matter that is found between the Matter/Anti-Matter worlds. It is immune to the effects of both of two matters. The user can summon it from its own reality to control it. This matter is only good for defense, because Neutral Matter will repel itself and any other matter. It cannot touch Matter/Anti-Matter nor they cannot touch it. The user can touch.(Warning: This is Babeltalk's version of what neutral matter is?)
pros: Control a new kind of matter and you can summon the energy of that world as well.
Have a powerful defense
It is immune to the effects of both Matter and Anti-Matter
cons: Maybe something outside the realm of science like magic can defeat it.

name: Card Powers
overview: channel the powers of card suits.
description: With this power you can use the power of card suits. Clubs gives you increased luck. Spades allow you to turn your hand into melee weapons. Hearts makes people fall in love with you at first sight. Diamonds grant you an indestructible skeleton made of diamond. You can only channel one card power at a time.
pros: Have incredible luck in a fight.
Your melee weapons or indestructible skeleton may come in handy.
Always get the girl.
cons: Can only channel one power at a time.
Diamond skeleton may increase your weight, giving you incorrect readings from a scale.
When you activate the hearts power, fangirls/fanboys will crowd around you.

name: Avatar Creation
overview: create a warrior made of aura to cloak the body
description: This ability grants the user the ability to manipulate his aura and make a warrior 5x bigger than the person to cloak him/her. The avatar is powered by the persons aura/desire to win which can be good or bad. One can also generate weapons with aura as well, to be wielded by the avatar. The user can actually model how the avatar looks by manipulating his/her aura.
pros: You have a portable arsenal that you can summon at will
You gain a physical advantage when outnumbered
You can generate any weapon to suit your situation
cons: The avatar is fueled by the user and he/she aura.
If the user becomes badly injured or loses the will to win the avatar will disintegrate into nothing
The avatar is particularly weak against aura or magic based attacks.

name: Circlism
overview: make circles of anything
description: By drawing a circle in the air with your fingers and imagining it to be whatever it will form, it is only limited by your imagination.
pros: Can create circle weapons of any type
Can create circle anything from what ever substance
Can create multiple circles at any one time
cons: Size is restricted to the ability to draw with fingers
You have to think about what it is going to be made from
You need to have a clear picture inside your head in order for the circle to form

name: Psychometric Power Absorption
overview: emulate the powers of others by touching an object they had previously been exposed to.
description: This very rare ability is a curious mix of empathic mimicry and psychometrics. A person can mimic and later absorb abilities of people who have touched and/or used objects that the person with this power comes into contact with. There is no limit as to the number of powers that can be absorbed, nor is there a limit on the types of powers that can be absorbed.
pros: A very useful power for an empath.
Is extremely powerful.
Can be harnessed and controlled in a very short amount of time.
cons: Is useless if the memories you collect do not involve people using abilities.

name: Starlight Camouflage
overview: be invisible at night
description: At night when the stars are shining, whether there is cloud cover or not, you gain complete invisibility. Your senses are heightened and you gain increased athletic abilities.
pros: Invisible if the stars are shining
Can be a ninja
Get extra sensory powers
cons: Uncontrolable
Cannot be seen even indoors
Cannot see yourself

name: Power Of The Bat
overview: have abilities of a bat
description: Aster being bitten by a radioactive fruit bat, the hero or heroine or villain develops abilities of a bat. Abilities include echolocation, enhanced agility, enhanced balance, enhanced hearing, enhanced smell. The person bitten does not take any physical characteristic of a bat and would stilt look like a normal human being. Therefore, no big bat wings or any bat physiology
pros: Powers very good for crimefighting or to commit crime
Good for fighting at night as the user does not need eyes to 'see'
cons: Cannot take down powerhouses one on one

name: Staff Of Montezuma
overview: possess a staff that can turn things into gold
description: This staff is made from coconut timber. This staff is bathed in gold and is covered in jewels. This staff can turn things into gold.
pros: You have more gold than Midas
You can feed a nation by turning a mountain into gold
You'll never be poor
cons: This staff cant torn living things into gold
You are a gold maniac
Everyone will want this staff

name: Celestial Consciousness
overview: transfer your consciousness to celestial bodies.
description: A telepathic branch of power that allows you to transfer your consciousness to celestial bodies including, but not limited to stars, planets, moons, even nebula.  Requiring immense energy and focus, once your consciousness has transferred you can move through space, as a conscious star, and can exert control over your gravitational influences.
pros: Control the power of the sun with your mind.
Control the celestial properties, and forces that the body you transfer into can control.
cons: Leave your body defenceless, and unconscious during the period of transference.
Further the celestial body, the more focus required.

name: Ventriloquism
overview: project your voice.
description: With this ability you are able to project your voice from any living creature that is within visual range. When doing so the person or living creature is completely unaware of what is taking place.
pros: Create a diversion...
cons: Making non-human creatures talk can be unnerving to others
If a person is asked what they said, they are unable to repeat it as they were unaware of what they had said while under control

name: Compassionate Gaze
overview: gaze upon a soul who has committed a heinous act, and fill their heart with compassion.
description: When someone commits such an atrocious and vile and corrupt deed, that many could consider unworthy of forgiveness, and they show no sign of remorse, guilt, or any attempt towards redemption. You can gaze upon their soul and fill their hatred, and loathing with true compassion for their victims and the crimes they committed against them.
pros: Bring out a redeeming quality in some of the most heinous villains, for the atrocities they've committed.
You would instinctually know when someone holds no remorse for an ill-deed committed, so this power can't be misdirected.
cons: This power is very specific, and purposeful, and would hold no value in a majority of super-powered contexts.

name: Kinetic Charging
overview: charge matter with explosive kinetic energy
description: Kinetic energy: the energy of motion. A Kinetic Charger can increase an object's kinetic energy by touch. The next time the object touches another, it will explode. This makes everything and anything a dangerous weapon. You must touch the object to make it charged.
pros: Totally voluntary
Next time charged object touches another, it will explode
Everything is a weapon
cons: Must touch to charge
Takes more energy to charge larger objects
Cannot uncharge objects

name: Repetitive Damage
overview: make any damage you deal repeat itself indefinitely.
description: Whenever you cause a damage to something or someone, the same amount of damage will keep being dealt again and again. For example, if you cut something with a knife, new cuts will keep opening afterwards. If you punch someone, they will keep being struck again and again. The new damages are exactly the same as the original one and appear around the same area and outward. The frequency of appearance is linked to both the violence of the damage and your experience with this power.
pros: You can deal great damage with a single hit.
Continuous damages can be increased. For example, the effects of poison can increase dramatically.
The effect continues even if you deal a new damage. So, you can overload regenerators and healers.
cons: Useless if the original damage has no effect in the first place.
You need to be present, or else the damages stop appearing.

name: Electrical Absorption
overview: absorb electrical energy harmlessly
description: The most electricity a human can take is 400,000 Watts. A person with Electrical Absorption can store up to ten times that without harm. In addition, they can later release that energy at will.
pros: Become the best electrician ever
Give Taser freaks a taste of their own medicine
Can store huge voltage indefinitely
cons: Can run out of juice without much warning
Is possible to absorb too much power and hurt yourself
Emotional outbursts may activate a discharge

name: Aspect Humanization
overview: give different aspects of your personality human form to fight for you
description: A few examples of different aspects: anger, fear, happiness, jealousy, heroism, insanity, intelligence, ignorance, religion, future predictions and past self. The more diversified you are, the more you get.
pros: They can have different abilities depending on how you see your emotions.
There can be a lot of them
The more you know yourself the more powerful you become
cons: You can't be confused about who you are or they may attack you
You may only have one loyal aspect
If you ignore who you are it is useless

name: Pan Dimensional Teamwork
overview: summon up to 5 of your other dimensional selves.
description: If you have the Pan-dimensional Existence power, then this power will let you call up to five of your other dimensional selves to work together as a team with you. This power will make them work together, no angelic version of you fighting a demonic version of you. This power will keep your team in this dimension for as long as you like. You can swap out team members at any time. A kystian version of you for a sharke version of you. A sharke version for an infinity dimension version of you.
pros: So many dimensions, so many possible team combos.
cons: It will take time to learn which team combos work and which don't.
An amoral way of thinking may be the only one to have the best team combos.

name: Animate Inanimator
overview: change anything living to anything non-living thing and back
description: A person with this power can change any living thing within sight into a non-living thing as long as the non-living object has roughly the same mass. That means you can change your enemies into chairs or even turn them into weapons that you can throw. You can also turn one animate object into multiple objects that are lighter. If you throw one, the other objects will follow the first object till the 5-foot limit and the creature will reform and hit the intended target-you can throw giants!!!
pros: Change your enemies into chairs or multiple footballs and then kick them
Change animals into swords, clubs, guns, etc. To use against people further away
As long as the mass is the same, you can also change the person into multiple objects
cons: If you throw the object farther than 5 feet, the object(s) will bunch together and reform
The power wears off if the object is 5 feet from you
As an inanimate object, the creature/person becomes indestructible

name: Ancient Beast: Phoenix
overview: have the powers of a phoenix.
description: The power is split into three types; Phoenix-form, Human-form and Hybrid-form.   The Phoenix-form allows flight, control over fire and reincarnation.   The Human-form allows control over fire and reincarnation.   The Hybrid-form allows control over fire, flight and reincarnation but the powers are much more powerful than in Human- or Phoenix-form.
pros: Unkillable.
If someone disagrees, burn them to ashes!
You can FLY!
cons: Eternal life isn't very fun after a couple of thousand years.
The burns on your clothes aren't very funny.
Watch out for heavy rain fall.

name: Intraceability
overview: leave nothing behind that would allow anyone or anything to follow you.
description: When you walk, you leave no footprints. Items left behind are free of scent or identification (such as a name or address); it is much like invisibility where a person cannot be seen, but in this case the person cannot be followed by the use of evidence left behind. However, they still can be recognized by a witness and found by what the witness said. The intraceability doesn't activate until the person leaves the scene (or as long as they are standing in one spot they have a footprint).
pros: Cannot be followed via tracking (prints, markings, scents, IDs)
Throw a party and trash the place, then leave and it's like you were never there.
As long as you keep distance, your enemies will never catch you
cons: Cannot use markings to find your way back
Still visible and thus can be recognized by witnesses
No one can find you by tracking, including those who can help you.

name: Terrestrial Light Pulse
overview: use the light pulse of the planet to rejuvenate almost Anything
description: There is a light pulse that flows through planets. With your hands and your mind, you can summon up this earthly light pulse to grow the tallest and freshest vegetation on even the most Barren lands. You can clean the lakes and rivers from any pollution. You can even bring back animals and humans back from the dead (as long as they were recently dead).
pros: You are the replenisher of the Earth and other planets.
You can turn moldy food back into their freshest state.
You can also use it to heal wounds on your self, or others. And bring back people from death.
cons: You can't create a made up plant. Plus a planet has to have some remote sign to sustain some life.
Revive the dead as soon as possible. Because when it completely deteriorates, it's harder to do so.

name: X Men
overview: possess/control up to 3 superpowers that any mutant from the x-men movies, comics, and series have.
description: The overview pretty much explains it all. Even if the mutant is dead. Also you get complete control over their powers. But there's only one problem: The user can only use up to 3 powers at a time.
pros: Everything!
cons: Limited power usage at one time, but no biggie!

name: Enemy Skill
overview: learn and successfully manipulate the skills and abilities of your enemies.
description:
The person with this ability is like a copycat or a mimic, but with a difference. They can use the skills and abilities of their enemies, when their enemy uses that particular skill on them. You can only use the last ability used on yourself. 
E. G. A fire breather uses their ability on you so you can breather fire until someone shoots lightning at you, then you can shoot lightning. 
This power isn't just limited to your enemies, your allies could heal you, giving you healing powers.
pros: Copy the previous power used on oneself, to its full potential.
Can copy any ability used on yourself, as long as it doesn't kill you in the process.
cons: Can only use the most recent ability, used on oneself.
Can only copy up to one skill at a time, they change each time a new ability is used on you.

name: Cold Current
overview: fire bolts of ice that freeze and electrocute your enemies.
description: You can do everything like firing out cryobolts. It shocks and freezes the opponent solid at full force. Also, you can create large frostbolts that will sweep across everywhere, damaging your opponents and leaving them paralyzed and frozen.
pros: You can give your enemies the shocking chills.
cons: None.

name: Time Manipulation Knowledge
overview: know how to build time machines
description: You know how manipulating time works. This includes, but is not limited to, speeding up time, slowing it down, rewinding it, traveling through it, seeing the future, the past, jumping to other timelines, etc. You have a complete knowledge of how to build things to do this, and what materials you'll need/when they're available. Finally, if someone has an innate ability to interact with time, you will know how to awaken it, control it, how to train them, and how to disable them.
pros: A plethora of time powers are available to you
You can also make them availble to others, and look like a genius while you do it
Comes with an understanding of temporal mechanics- helps you with paradoxes
cons: Of course, someone can steal the machines
Or analyze them
Or beat you with a pipe wrench until you explain it

name: Beat Resoundance
overview: project any sound heard into a solid form
description: When this power is used every sound wave that your ears process with become a potential weapon. All you have to do is focus on the soundwave and it will be at your disposal.    You can make them into any shape or form such as orbs shields disks or just simple raw waves. You can adjust their density to be non damaging to extremely lethal.   If your deaf then this power is of no use to you. Plus anything that can diffuse sound can diffuse your constructs.
pros: Have the power of soundwaves at your fingertips
Even use your voice as a weapon
Always be prepared for any defense situation
cons: No use if deaf
Doesn't work on sound diffusing surfaces

name: Avatar
overview: create your own avatar
description: It is like a secondary body for your brain. The avatar is usually a more advanced humanoid. It gives the user access to siddhis, a form of psychic magic. It lets the avatar use levitation, creation of physical constructs, use of the original five elements, see into the past, present and future, bilocation (split body), make the body impervious to harm for a short time, attain a higher level of consciousness. If the avatar is killed, the human body sustains a similar wound.
pros: The avatar is stronger and more powerful than the human
They can learn to access siddhis after a long use of the avatar
Constant use of the avatar will let the human gain use of both sides of the brain
cons: If the avatar is killed, it cannot be recovered
If the avatar is killed, similar wounds will happen to the human
The human may not want to go back to its human body

name: Puppet Mastery
overview: control other people's motor functions
description: Controlling other people is something we all like to do, whether we want to admit it or not. A person with Puppet Mastery can manipulate the movements of other people as they please-- making them jump, run, dance, freeze in place or even hurt and kill themselves is only a gesture away.
pros: Controlling others
Stopping small groups of assailants
Saying, "Stop hitting yourself!" over and over again
cons: Not something you can use covertly
Larger groups require more mental strength
Can become vengeful and wrathful

name: Tele Builder
overview: build something fool-proof and reliable with just your mind
description: You can look at something, pick it up using your mind, and turn it into something different that works and is reliable. To do this, you can close your eyes, or hum, or whatever it takes to make you concentrate. The new device you have created can be whatever colour you like. This ability is sometimes called telekinetics, but that is only the ability to move things with your mind, not build them. Good luck!
pros: You can make a device in the space of five minutes
You can turn even a crumb into a complete suit of armour, for example
The devices work smoothly and without problems
cons: The devices disappear after an hour
The devices may fall apart if not put together properly (it takes practice!!! )

name: Elaborate Planning
overview: make unnecessarily elaborate plans that have a 99.9% success rate
description: A person with this power has the ability to make the most convoluted schemes ever and have them succeed. They MAY take many years and may involve time travel, messing with the continuum, meating alternate versions of yourself, ruining the lives of countless others all in the name of doing one simple action. But they don't have to, they can also be short, concise plans executable for someone without any further powers. However, mind readers etc. will not even be able to understand your plans.
pros: Your plans always work (99.9%)
Your plans can never be understood until you reveal it
People will underestimate you, giving you the win
cons: Sometimes your plans involve doing stupid things
Your plans may take many years to accomplish versus making a regular plan
Could put a lot of planning into a few simple tasks

name: Ageless
overview: live indefinitely, unaging, with some regenerative capabilities.
description: With this power, you will never look a day over 30, but your lifespan is indefinite. So long as no outside forces kill you, you can live for thousands of years. Also, you heal 50% faster than normal people, and naturally regrow lost limbs. It takes about a month to regrow a lost finger, and almost a year to get back a lost arm. But that's just a drop in the ocean to you. You may not look so healthy all the time, though. Also, you will be inexplicably fated to meet any others with this power.
pros: Live indefinitely
Immune to death by "natural causes"
Enhanced regeneration (Note: Other regenerative powers will override this one, though)
cons: Not indestructible
Danger and the paranormal seems to be drawn to you
May develop depression and a cynical attitude from living so long

name: Unlocking Fingersnap
overview: unlock doors and objects by snapping your fingers
description: By clicking your fingers, you unlock any door or lock that you are focusing on. If you focus to a greater degree, the handle will turn and the door or lid will open as well.  This power works on electronic locks and systems as well, allowing you to bypass locked car doors, etc. However, the doors must have a mechanical element to unlock.
pros: No jail cell can hold you ever
Could become a master thief without any tools
You're a really useful guy to have around
cons: Locks that use magnets are resistant to your power
Can't unlock pin-encrypted devices, like phones or computers
Not a tremendously impressive ability

name: Vive Chacun
overview: control how long people live
description: With this power you can control how long people live. From only 1-year-old to 1000+ years-old. As long as they die sometime. You can also control how they die. By "they" I mean anyone or everybody or someone or him or her, etc.
pros: Controling death
cons: Cannot control how they die

name: Paralysis Point
overview: cause people to become paralyzed when you point at them
description: With this power you can paralyze people by pointing at them. The victim will be unable to move as long as you are pointing at them. It doesn't matter how far away you are from them or which finger you use to point at them. You also can't turn this power off so whenever you point at anybody they become paralyzed. You can also point at multiple people at once and they will all become paralyzed.
pros: You can paralyze people by pointing at them
You can do it with any finger and from as far away from the person as you want
You paralyze multiple people by pointing at multiple people at the same time
cons: You cannot turn this power off
Once you stop pointing they unfreeze

name: Synapse Manipulation
overview: control neurons and command them to do your bidding
description: In the nervous system, a synapse is a structure that permits a neuron to pass an electrical or chemical signal to another cell. Basically, the user can manipulate the electrical or chemical functions between neurons. For example; electrical synapses conduct nerve impulses faster such as defence reflexes. Chemical synapses are crucial to the biological computations that underlie perception and thought. They allow the nervous system to connect to and control other systems of the body.
pros: Control a human body from within
Have the great advantage in battle
cons: Negative emotions trigger this if unexperienced

name: Psychic Bubbles
overview: wrap spheres of psychic power around portions of the atmosphere and control everything within.
description: A film of psychic power wraps around the air and forms a sphere, in the same way that soap creates bubbles. Any number or sizes of bubbles can be made, but they are all perfect spheres. Change the size of the bubble to create a super-dense marble, or a low-pressure atmospheric bubble that will create a gust of wind when popped. Or just make a large one around yourself for a quick, 1HP forcefield. The possibilities are endless.
pros: Very versatile - only your imagination limits what you can do with the bubbles, really
Perfectly transparent - only you or other psychics will know what's going on
Quick shield - doubles as a weak forcefield, dust screen, underwater air bubble, whatever!
cons: You can't control what it is you capture in the bubble - whatever's in the air, is in there
The bubbles are flimsy against other psychic power, and another psychokinetic can pop them with ease
Who would be intimidated by invisible bubbles, really?

name: Technointegration
overview: merge your biology with a technological device
description: Resistance is futile: best line ever. And a Technointegrator can pull it off. By touching a piece of technology (telephone, computer, chainsaw, nanites, etc.) they can merge their best qualities with the machine's best qualities, making a 'cyborg-esque' being. They can also use the abilities of the technology they used: making calls, computing quickly, having a deadly chainsaw for a hand, etc. They can only absorb 3 technologies at a time and are still vunerable to disease.

overview: turn your body into the body of one your other-dimensional selves.
description: With this power you change your body into the version of your body from a different parallel dimension. You gain the abilities, skills, and weaknesses of the other version of yourself that you are turning into. When you change bodies you will have the clothes and personal items of the other version you are turning into. (If they have a sword with them normally you would gain their sword while changed into that version). You will not gain their personality however.
pros: Infinite dimensions to choose from.
Will have all the training of the version you are turning into.
If the version you are changing into uses any special items you gain those items.
cons: Have to wait a short period of time to recharge before you can change again.
Skills get lost and replaced when you change into a different version of yourself
Will have to handle any weaknesses of the version you change into.

name: Symbiotic Suits: The First
overview: have every natural skill enhanced.
description: The First is a symbiotic suit that enhances your strength, your healing time, your reflexes, your speed, your vision, your sense of smell, everything, to that of a superhero's. You basically become super you. If you have any natural powers, they become amplified. By the way, The First replicated (had kids) some of whom were different, and some of whom were the same.
pros: Super Everything
Amplified super powers
cons: Weakness: Sonic Vibrations & others with a version of The First
Only applies to natural skills
Symbiote will probably try to take over every once in a while

name: Ice Walking
overview: freeze anything that touches your feet
description: Ever wanted to be like Ice Man and make a path of ice to skate on in mid air? Well, now you can. Freeze the ground under your feet and build it up so you can make a path above the ground. Slide/skate around, cross a lake in the middle of summer and never fall into water. It can be turned on and off at will.
pros: Instant skate ring
Make a path of ice in the air (transportation/hard to reach places)
cons: Only works with feet
Intense heat/fire

name: Current Situation Intuition
overview: know everything about any situation one is in, be it anything.
description: This power is very useful and it can get one through nearly anything one encounters. Be it financial problems or life-death situations, and many other things, one knows exactly what to do. One with this ability has a greater mind, thinking of the consequences for a certain decision to get out of that certain situation. This power is always on.
pros: Know exactly what to do.
cons: Suffer the consequences of the decison one takes to get out of the situation.

name: Custom Organism Creation
overview: create new species of organisms
description: With Custom Organism Creation, you have the power to create your own species of organisms which could eventualy evolve into your allies, viruses, or whatever you want. You control the shape, size, abilities, and features of your organism.
pros: Create allies to help you in battle.
Create viruses to destroy your enemies.
Use them to accomplish your goals.
cons: Evolution could lead to unintended traits.
Others could raise your organisms under their command.

name: Possibility Manipulation
overview: take skills from parallel yous.
description:
You can look at yourself in parallel universes and imitate your parallel self's skills/abilities/powers for a limited amount of time. This means that it's possible to become the very best you could possibly be for a short time, although doing something like that would take more energy than taking something minor (like the skill to cook teriyaki as opposed to the power to stop time).
Only one ability/skill/power can be taken at any given time, although with enough skill you can switch quickly.
pros: Become the best you could possibly be
Have a wide variety of powers on call
Be good at almost anything
cons: You can only take one skill at a time
There's a limit to how long you can keep a skill

name: Strong Force Manipulation
overview: tinker with the interaction that holds protons to neutrons
description: No exaggeration, this ability may be the most powerful physics-based skill. It allows the user to attempt to influence the strong force--which holds together atomic nuclei. A person with this power could make objects disintegrate into thin air or make protons/neutrons from the environment incorporate into chemical elements and vice versa. Due to the power in the strong force, users can usually only influence objects through direct contact, with immense focus, and only temporarily.
pros: Hold the key to a fundamental force of physics
Make objects float apart into airborne atomic dust
Make atomic elements exchange protons/neutrons with the air, transmuting them into other elements
cons: Takes immense focus, much energy or effort, and direct contact
Usually ages user prematurely due what it takes out of you
Disintegrated objects snap back into shape immediately afterward

name: Rapport Inducing
overview: be able to get along with anyone at will and build trust easily
description: A person with this power can get along with anyone by being in sync with them and become able to see how they view the world as well as developing mannerisms to complement the mannerisms of anyone they like thus inducing the other person to like them. This can be used as precognition in fighting since you can simply move along with their movements a la dancing. This power can induce trust very quickly and it can be used to gain friends and customers as well.
pros: Can see the worldview of anyone and be able to show them your worldview
Can become anyone's dance partner including the ability to dance to dodge people's attacks
Can get you into any group of friends you want
cons: Just because you can get along with everyone doesn't mean you will want to
Harder to get along with multiple people at the same time
Cannot be in sync with two parties that have opposite viewpoints at the same time

name: Axis Access
overview: psychically move oneself along the spatial axes of existence
description: This ability allows you to move along the spatial axes of existence, like a point on a coordinate plane. X-Axis Travel would let you distort space to move horizontally (side-side). Y-Axis Travel would let you distort space to move vertically (up-down). Z-Axis Travel would let you distort space to move forward or backward. And Coordinate Travel would allow you to combine any two of these effects at a time, for more dexterous maneuvering. This ability is often accompanied by a Geometric Sense.
pros: Relocate yourself easily along the spatial axes of existence, like a point on a coordinate plane
Relocation is fairly quick; it looks like teleportation (and Y-Axis Travel allows levitation)
Often accompanied by the power to perceive space geometrically (makes using this power efficient)
cons: Not as efficient as true teleportation
Not as efficient as normal Spatial Manipulation (can't distort space to avoid bullets or the like)
Spatial Manipulation can make this power act erratically

name: Fire Empathy
overview: draw energy from sources of heat
description: Warming up used to be something reserved for athletes. A Fire Empath gains power from large sources of heat--a bonfire, a space heater, the blazing sun--and channels that energy into enhanced strength, speed, durability, senses, and reflexes. As a side effect, the user is totally fireproof. Of course, if there is insufficient heat no enhancements will be available, and cold will affect them more than most people.
pros: When sufficiently warm, develop enhanced strength, speed, etc.
Can draw power from space heater, sweltering day, cigarette lighter
Fireproof
cons: If there isn't enough heat, no powers
Cold affects you more
Might not know how much strength you have

name: Multiple Changeable Vision
overview: change the way your eyes see.
description:
This ability you can see normally and just blink and you can see in x-ray vision, heat vision, microscopic vision, zoom-magnification vision. You can switch between your visual sight by blinking and focusing on which vision you would like to access at that point.
You can not use two different visions at once. E.g X-ray vision and night vision.
pros: Look at the world in multiple ways.
cons: Can't access more than one vision at once.

name: Unpredictability
overview: resist the forces of fate and probability
description: The user is unaffected by Tychokinesis (when touching a luck-manipulator, their powers short-circuit), and their moves cannot be predicted by Danger Sense, Precognition, Divination or Telepathy (even Combat Telepathy). The user is excluded from prophecies; his moves are hard to determine by Psychic Strategy, Imaginative Deduction, Quantum Deduction or other psychic means, except Omniscience. By simply existing, the user may change things that have been predicted/prophesied
pros: Probability manipulation can't affect you directly
Moves can't be predicted (a good foil for those with Superhuman Reflexes and the like)
Mess up prophecies and premonitions of the future
cons: Probability manipulation can still affect you INDIRECTLY
Sometimes your unpredicted presence makes no difference in prophecies
Omniscience still 'sees' you

name: Necromancer
overview: control the dead, death, ghosts, ect.
description: Necromancy is the magical art of rasing the dead. With this ability you can animate corpses and skeletons, see and talk to ghosts, and use your power over death in many ways. All corpses and skeletons you animate are under your control. And while they do have their own will, ghosts will usally do as you say. They can move things, phase, turn invisible, and use other ghostly powers. You can also sense when people you know die by reading their life forces.
pros: Can control corpses, skeletons, and ghosts
Ghosts have many powers and are usally obedient
Already being dead, corpses and skeletons can't die
cons: Kinda a freaky power
Knowing when a friend or family member will die just sucks
You will be naturally feared

name: Power Safety
overview: have your powers immune to harming effects.
description: When you get this power, all your powers including this one become immune to negation, draining, mimicking, stealing, trapping you if you have them, inhibitation, sealing, being taken away or destroyed, being targeted by harming effects specific to your powers, being eaten, deactivated, made useless and many other protections. Your aura cannot be stolen or destroyed or sealed away.
pros: Do not fear myth eater or killer.
Virtually invincible with strong abilities.
cons: None, unless you don't want powers.

name: Espermaniacal Form
overview: grow and gain power from consuming psychic energy.
description: With this power, you grow and gain power by consuming psychic energy. This includes gaining power from mental activity in your area. You take the form of a creature spiraling with energy. As you grow, you gain more psychic abilties, such as telepathy, telekinesis, and eventually powers such as mind control. These powers adapt and become greater as you consume psychic energy, making them much more effective. You have an immunity (and need) for psychic energy, but susceptibility to physical harm.
pros: Become immune to, and absorb psychic energy. (This includes mental activity in your area. )
Increase in size and power as you absorb the psychic energy around you.
Gain abilities (Telepathy, Telekinesis, Mind Control, Telekinetic Blasts, etc) from psychic energy.
cons: Susceptible to physical damage.
Once you revert to normal form, you lose all the size and abilities that you gained.
If you're not constantly fueled with psychic energy, you revert to normal form.

name: Word Of Power
overview: obtain a superhuman strength everytime someone says a specific word.
description: The subject becomes stronger and more resistant than normally possible everytime he/she hears a specific word said by someone else. This word could be every word spoken in any language or dialect. The subject can chose the word that activate his/her power, but only after a deep self-persuasion and autogenic training. The duration of the power is three or four hours.
pros: The word chosen by the subject could be ANY spoken word all over the world;
The word can be changed anytime.
cons: The duration of the power is limitated;
The power doesn't work if the subject him/herself pronounces the word;
The effect of the word is not combined.

name: A Friend To All Non Humans
overview: be such that no non-human will ever attack one.
description: Non-human beings will always like you and never attack you, and they will always want to help you at any time. Must have had 'Animal Attraction' for 2 years to gain this.
pros: You will have friends everywhere you go.
cons: Humans might wonder why you are surrounded by animals and other creatures.

name: Perceptible Stress
overview: see the mechanical stress in an object as colour gradients.
description: Just as infra-red vision displays hot areas as red and cool areas as blue, someone with this power would literally be able to see areas of high and low stress concentration in an object. With this ability, you could tell when and where something was about to fracture (such as a platform or bridge), and assess the safety of a range of things before you used them. An intensely practical power.
pros: Very practical, could be life-saving in a number of situations.
Relatively voluntary, as you need to focus to truly see the stress.
An engineer's dream power. Well, this and anything with steel and explosions.
cons: Watching the inevitable as you see a bridge about to collapse wouldn't be fun...
Not too useful in combat, although spotting stress concentrations in armour could show weaknesses.

name: Shadow Kinetic Change
overview: indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to cause a biological change of the user's body.
description: The user can absorb potiential energy around them and direct the energy into the user's genetic code. This causes the DNA to kinetically move to the user's will. The changes only last on the amount of potiential energy is absorbed.
pros: Change your DNA
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
cons: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Strategy Affinity
overview: become stronger when one thought up or hears a strategy.
description: This ability is very good for thinking- types. The user is capable of becoming stronger, faster, and more destructive when he thinks or hears a strategy or plan. The more complex it is and likelihood of that plan to work, the stronger the user become. The user will know how strong he got as well.
pros: Become stronger, faster, and more destructive.
Know that your or other's plan will work.
cons: Complexity is Key to power up.

name: Conflict Style Manipulation
overview: change and control one or all aspects of conflict styles.
description: There are five known styles of conflict. They are Avoidance, Accommodation,Competing, Compromise, and Collaboration. This ability allows the user to control one or all of them. They can change people's conflict styles into anything else. They can make a competitive jerk into shy guy who avoids conflict. With more experience, the user could acquire new abilities based on the styles he changed to or on others.
pros: Control aspects of conflict styles
Change others' conflict styles
With experience, gain abilities based on those conflict styles.
cons: Beware the competing conflict style, it could be the most uncontrollable

name: 0 G Stomp
overview: create a small field around you that suspends gravity's hold
description: Stomping creates a Zero-Gravity field around you, which causes all objects within the field to become weightless, allowing you or anyone else to pick the, up and use them with ease. After creating the field, you do not have to continue stomping, as objects which leave the field continue to be unaffected by gravity for a while. Maintaining the Zero-Gravity field requires concentration and after a long period of use you may become exhausted.
pros: This ability allows you to act as though you were extremely strong.
Other people within the field are affected by it.
You can pick up anything as long as it's loose.
cons: You are more open to attacks while maintaining the field.
It is only useful in short range fights unless you have lots of throwable objects near you.
Other people can use objects which have been affected by the field.

name: Fictional Character Chatter
overview: converse with any fictional character
description: The user can talk with any fictional character that is willing to talk to you. You picture the character in your mind and you can try to talk to them; it's up to them to allow this and talk back.
pros: Infinite ways to know your characters, you can know the way you want.
This superpower can make you feel very accompanied
This superpower lets you know things that only fictional characters know
cons: Limited to fictional characters and their knowledge

name: Bibliokenesis
overview: manipulate books, manuscript pages, and text paper
description: Also called: Literacy Manipulation  The user has the ability to manipulate all forms of physical literary objects that are printed, written or drawn (books, comics, magazines etc. ), including their physical forms/materials and anything written, printed, illustrated, or drawn in them.   In extreme cases the user may have access even to the media that doesn't truly exist, but is only mentioned in other media or imagined to exist.
pros: Transform a written word into the actual object
Trap people/objects in the books
Break the fourth wall and rewrite your own story!
cons: User who doesn't have a book handy is helpless
Books aren't the most portable or compact objects.
Usefulness depends of the quality (fashion magazine vs RPG Bestiary) and quantity (single book vs li

name: Sympathetic Vision
overview: see through the eyes of someone else's.
description: To use this power, you need to close your eyes and concentrate on a precise person or animal, it doesn't need to be someone or an animal you're familiar with.
