When you open your eyes again, you'll be able see exactly what that person or animal is seeing. Their eyesight won't be affected and they shouldn't notice anything. Obviously, if that person or animal is blind, not gifted with eyes, sleeping, unconscious or just dead, you won't see anything until you cancel the effect of your power.
pros: Peek into anyone's private life without being noticed.
Works wherever the other person or animal is.
cons: You can't see what's in front of you, so don't move while you use this power!
When the target blinks, you'll see a flash of black which can feel odd at first.

name: Internal Solar Fusion
overview: manipulate solar fusion and its effects.
description: Your body houses an ultra-bright star, and can utilize the fusion taking place to draw on limitless energy reserves. You are also able to project various solar energies, such as magnetic bursts, heat waves or streams of supercharged ions. This is an incredibly destructive power. The user can also utilize all of that moments solar potential to create a devastating supernova pulse. The solar energy can be utilized to make light, heat, to heal the user, or even to fly.
pros: Limitless energy means that you never need to sleep.
A most destructive superpower. It can quite possibly destroy planets.
cons: This power makes the user physically and mentally unstable.
The user can "Overheat". This causes them to disintegrate to dust after going nuclear.

name: Hypnotism
overview: put people into a trance of extreme suggestibility
description: No watch-and-chain necessary, a Hypnotizer can put a target into a trance by staring into their eyes. This state also leaves the target highly susceptible to suggestions, like "Kill your boss", "You are now a Democrat", or "Every time you hear James Brown's music, you will start to sing along at the top of your lungs." This is limited to 1 hypnosis at a time.
pros: Amass a hypnotized following
Get someone to fight for you
Convince someone to do something humiliating in public
cons: 1 hypnosis session at a time
Cannot make anyone do something they really don't want to
Must establish eye contact

name: Submit Gain
overview: instantly and permanently gain any powers you submit to the Superpowerlist website.
description: With this ability, any and all normal/special/supernatural/superhuman powers, abilities, skills, talents, items, objects and weapons that you submit to the superpowerlist website, you instantly, perfectly, and permanently gain it at any point in time that you want. All of which without any problem, difficulty, or trouble of any kind, and also regardless of any powers, abilities, skills, talents, items, objects, or weapons that are added to the superpowerlist.
pros: Instantly and permanently gain any powers you want no matter what they maybe.
Instantly and permanently gain any powers even if they don't get added to the superpowerlist.
The creator of Submit Gain automatically gains this power no matter what, because of its nature.
cons: Does not work on powers submitted before Submit Gain was created.
The Get This Power button will never appear for anyone who has this power.

name: Mirror Image
overview: leave a mirror image of yourself at your location.
description: You can leave a mirror image of yourself at your current location that will perform only the last action that you were doing. The mirror image will look exactly like you, including having a copy of any item you had, and will be near impossible to tell apart from you. You can have as many mirror images as you have energy for and can dismiss the mirror images at any time. If you are doing a chore the mirror image will continue until it is done, or if using a weapon it will continue to do the same.
pros: Leave a mirror image to continue doing an action for you.
Can have several mirror images all copying you using your powers at a foe.
Can leave a mirror image as a decoy.
cons: The mirror images can only do one action or command.
Have to be at the location that you want to leave your mirror image.
The mirror images can be destroyed easily.

name: Supernatural Magical Powers
overview: use magical forces to varying degrees.
description: It is the ability to use magical forces to varying degrees. Often used to simulate other powers, such as mind control and elemental attacks.
pros: You would be one of the most powerful beings in the universe.
You could read minds.
You would have shape shifting.
cons: If you were to have severe hand injuries, you would be unable to control your magic properly.
You would be weakened by mortal wounds.
Without experience, your spells would be as powerful as intended.

name: Fear Illusion
overview: make people see you as what they fear the most.
description:
You don't change shape only illude people to see you as what they fear the most.
Example: If someone is afraid of spider you can make that person see you as a spider.
If someone is a afraid of heights you can illude their surroundings by make it seem as if they're at the ledge of a cliff.
pros: You can scare the living daylight out of everyone.
Nobody can scare you.
cons: You can't use your power on yourself.

name: Bookend
overview: summon characters and plot devices from books.
description: By touching a book you may summon characters and plot important objects to assist you. If what you summoned is destroyed it returns to the book, but you are unable to summon it again. You must be touching the book to summon from it. Summoning last up to 24 hours and can be dismissed at any time. Pervious summons remember you. Anything or anyone summoned retains all traits that it had in the book so it would help to have read the book before summoning from it.
pros: Access to powerful allies and weapons
cons: Must convince character to assist you
Might summon something hostile
Must be touching the book to summon from it

name: Under Blades
overview: extend large blades protruding from your wrists.
description: You can, at will, release these retractable two-foot long metallic blades from under your wrists. The skin between your wrists tears and bleeds, but the blood loss is quickly halted by your healing factor. You can unsheathe blades at once, although you must keep your wrists straight at the moment your blades pass from under your arms. When unsheathed, the blades are entirely within your wrists, allowing you to bend them when they are extended. The blades are made of metal and can slice anything.
pros: By grinding your blades against each other, you can fire sparks of energy towards your enemies.
Can use your wrists for swords.
cons: None actually.

name: Psychic Map
overview: house a psychic "map" within your mind
description: This ability comes in two manifestations. The first is perhaps most beneficial, and it implies that the user possesses a map of the whole universe in his mind. However, the second manifestation is not without its benefits; it implies that the user has a map of the location they are in when the power manifests, and the map expands as they travel from that point. This manifestation also allows one to scan any location on his mental map, to observe anything that is currently in that area.
pros: (First manifestation) have a map of the entire UNIVERSE in your mind (know how to get ANYWHERE)
(Second manifestation) have a mental map that builds from the point your ability manifests
(Second manifestation) locate anything in the areas you've registered in your mental map
cons: (First Manifestation) only extends to your current dimension
(Second Manifestation) only extends to places where you've been
(Both) Can't be used to find someone/something that's been cloaked

name: Shadow Watch
overview: use shadows as windows to look through
description: Any shadow that is cast you will be able to spy through from shadow you are near. Eavesdrop on people from the shadows. You do have to picture either the person or area you want to look at & the closest shadow maybe to small to view through.
pros: Shadows are your windows
cons: You have to imagine what person or area you want to view
The shadows may not have a great view

name: Vector Control
overview: control anything's direction
description: With this power, you can change the direction of anything under the laws of physics. For example, you can change the vectors of bullets and forces like lightning. You can also change the direction of natural forces, such as gravity and air resistance, to make yourself a little faster as well as increase your own power by directing all the force of your punch into one concentrated point.  However, you cannot change the direction of aging since that falls under biology.
pros: Takes 0 energy to activate this power and you can set to default to reflect back
Reflect enemy attacks
Concentrate you own power
cons: You need to be good at math/physics to use this power at its fullest
If you are physically unfit, this power cannot really augment your strength at all
If you do not know where something is, you cannot manipulate its direction

name: Problem Solver
overview: find a solution to any problem without failure.
description:
Can solve any problem, puzzle, equation. Absolutely anything without flaw.
In order to solve the problem you must first analyze the situation and go through a sometimes time consuming thought process.
pros: Can find the solution to any problem
cons: Can be time-consuming
Doesn't make you a genius or smartest in the world.

name: Elemental Reconfiguration
overview: change the elemental attribute of a superpower, a spell or even a magical artifact.
description: You're at a disadvantage in an elemental battle? Simply change your or your opponent's elemental type to get the upper hand. However, the changes follow a very precise order. Every possible element is arranged in an immutable cycle, which can be followed in either direction. For example, if you want to change a fire mimic into a water mimic, you can see them progressively change to a wood mimic, then a smoke mimic, a plasma mimic, a tornado mimic and a sound mimic before becoming a water mimic.
pros: Combine this power with an elemental one, and you can have many elemental version of that power.
Change a defensive fog-type power to the offensive lava-type or poison-type version.
Choose any element from a wide variety, such as darkness, shadow, radiation, sand, stone, mud,...
cons: There's no logic behind the cycle, so it can take some time to get a desired element.
Some "elements" aren't counted, and you must be in the vicinity to keep the changes active.
You could give your opponent a very strong element before reaching the desired weaker one.

name: Limited Reality Warping
overview: warp reality, but never warp in that way again
description: You can warp reality, but once you have performed an act, you can never use your power in that way again. For example, if you turn something to gold, you can never turn something else to gold again. Your power is not endless, as you cannot destroy the universe or affect an entire planet, etc. You can warp reality in different ways for similar effect, such as turning one enemy into smoke, then turning another one into water vapour. You do not have to speak for your power to work.
pros: Can do basically anything you want
It will be rare that you will want to use your power in a way you have previously used
The ways your power can be used in combat, transport, etc. are endless
cons: Must make sure you do not carelessly use up a useful warp
May not be able to reverse an unwise warp
Have to remember how you have used your power before

name: Control Shadow
overview: call shadows with your ring of darkness
description: The shadow ring has the ability to call shadow beasts by saying :Let there be darkness, with the ring you can control shadow beasts and help you in your combats.
pros: You don't need to be in a shadow
The opponent can't cut it nor shoot it
It can only be attacked with psychic powers or the ring of light
cons: You can only call two-three beasts at a time
It can beaten with the ring of light or with a magical attack
You need to be in darkness to operate it

name: Sonographic Deduction
overview: process sounds in your mind in a superhuman fashion allowing you to figure out people's actions
description: A person with this power is able to process sounds that they hear in their brain, allowing them to decipher the exact action that causes the sound. This could allwo them to reproduce it. Also known as perfect or absolute pitch. Not only can you use this to learn how to play instruments quickly, you can also tell what people are typing just by listening to it. You can also use this to change dialects quickly by understanding the necessary movements ofyour speech organs.
pros: If you hear someone typing, you can tell what they are typing
You have perfect pitch with this ability, letting you play instruments by ear
cons: This only works if there is a set pattern of sounds for a certain action
If there are many sounds at the same time this ability might fail
You have to hear a sound at least once in order to use it as a reference

name: Vacuum Simulation
overview: create a mist-like void that imitates the effects of space and manipulate it.
description: This ability can be deadly for the user can make space come to Earth. They will be able to suffocate any living creature with power. The mist will cover everything in a blanket of darkness and airlessness. The user, of course, can survive this, training his lungs up to the point that they will gain "Vacuum Adaptation" so they can live in real space. The user can manipulate it and make it solid.
pros: Suffocate or knock people out.
Manipulate it.
Eventually gain "Vacuum Adaptation".
cons: Doesn't effect those who have "Vacuum Adaptation".

name: Disaster Manipulation
overview: control any type of disaster.
description: You can stop a storm, control earthquakes, and change tsunamis into tiny waves. You can control any natural disaster and also cause them.
pros: You can make a storm so you don't have school
Save millions of lives
cons: Might accidentally create one
This is powered by 30% concentration and emotion for the rest

name: Passion Eye
overview: hypnotize and have complete control over the one you use passion eyes on.
description: Passion Eyes allow you to have complete and utter control of the victim you use it on. In order for passion eyes to work, your eyes must meet theirs; then they become servant-like and do as you say. Passion eyes wears off based on the victim's mentality. The stronger the mind, the quicker it wears off.
pros: You have servant like people that cater to you
They actually fall in love with you, which means they are willing to risk their lives for you
cons: If someone's blind, it won't work
If you dont care about the one you used passion eyes on, you will see them as annoying and obsessive

name: Power Of Hard Work
overview: gain superpowers naturally through training and improve training speed
description: Anyone with this power has the ability to gain simple abilities that can transcend peak human potential naturally through hard work. For example, through training, you can gain the ability to shatter mountains and run on water or jump on air. You can even gain superpowered intelligence by studying hard. There is no limit to how much you can train your acquired power, though it gets increasingly harder. Also, if you have existing superpowers, you can train them faster when you have this power.
pros: You can gain superpowers naturally
You learn faster depending on the amount of effort you put in
Normalization fluid does not negate acquired superpowers since they were your own training
cons: You have to gain superpowers through your own hard work, sweat, and tears
If you are lazy, then this ability is pointless

name: The Opportunity To Learn
overview: learn anything that is possible
description: Once you get the power, your mind erases everything that you learn socially, but not at school. As you grow stronger everyday, things will be easier and come more naturally to you.
pros: Awesome education
Smart creations
cons: Need to sleep to rest the mind

name: Tactile Deduction
overview: recognize patterns in whatever you are touching revealing aspects not seen with the visible eye
description: A person with this power is able to tell a lot about anything by feeling it. For example, it is possible to find a lot of secret messages on the wall comprised of words that have been previously erased, you can feel the indentations caused by the writing. I if the person is adept, they can use this ability to figure out the composition of the top layer of any object. In addition they can feel cracks on the wall to find an object's weak point.
pros: Can find secret messages on walls-even those that may have been "erased"
By touching some materials you can figure out what it is made of - including type of wood
Figure out weaknesses in a wall then attack those spots to break it
cons: You need to have a reference to figure out what material it is made of
Even if you figure out the weakest part of the wall you need to have strength to break it

name: Psionium (Destructive Metal)
overview: create and control a metal that is immune to all psionic powers and effects
description: This metal can be turned into any form the user wants it to be in and is fully immune to all psionic effects and powers. However, at lower levels the user can only make the metal resistant to psionic effects and powers and can only have it be partially be in the shape they want it to be in.
pros: Covering yourself with the metal will protect you from all psionic effects and powers.
cons: The metal can still be affected by magic.

name: Fusion
overview: fuse anything or any two people with anything within 5 feet
description: Tired of having to go to the bathroom every ten minutes? Tired of having to leave the tv during commercials to go into the kitchen to get a snack? Well say no more, because with this power, you can fuse the toilet with a lay z boy chair and your remote with the fridge. It even works on people. Make your brother a sandwich. Literally! The possibilities are endless. The only way to change 'em back is by concentration on the two separate targets. No one will be able to change them back otherwise.
pros: Fuse a cat and a dog for twice the fun and ignorance.
Fuse a gun with a sword in case the zombie apocalypse starts.
No one can reverse it but you.
cons: Concentration to defuse things
Could fuse the wrong things, like a tank and an air bus
Takes about five seconds to charge for each use.

name: Energy Spike
overview: create spikes of energy from the energy that lies within one's body.
description: This ability gives the user control over the energy that lies dormant in the body. By concentrating, the user can create spikes of energy throughout the body. If you can't fight, then you can use this power to strengthen your body by hiding the energy spikes under your skin. If you want to kill someone, then this is your power. And if you want to reach high places, then draw the energy to either one of your hands and place your hand on the ground or a wall and a spike or spikes will come forth.
pros: If someone had a gun to your head, you can kill that person or guard yourself.
Using the energy in your body, you are able to make the spikes appear anywhere on your body.
You can create a body armor from the energy spikes.
cons: Using the energy spikes can take a major toll on your body, unless you train yourself.
If you didn't want to kill the person trying to rob you, then it was a mistake using your power.

name: Petrifaction
overview: turn matter into stone.
description: One with this power can transmute a subject into solid stone with a look, touch or some other method. If a subject is turned into stone, the affect can usually be reversed by the user as long as the subject remains intact, i. E. Not broken, smashed, weathered, etc.
pros: An effective way to get rid of an enemy or nuisance
The 'statue' might go nice with the garden
To be rid of someone for good, just get a sledgehammer
cons: If the 'statue' is destroyed the effect cannot be reversed
May be triggered subconsciously (acidental petrifaction)
Would be difficult to move or destroy

name: Tangibility
overview: make intangible things tangible/solid
description: A person with this power can make things that are intangible become tangible/solid just by touching it. Make ghosts tangible and attack them as if they were real persons, learn how to shape tangible/solid balls of air and use them as weapons; the possibilites are endless...
pros: Literally grab/touch air - use it as monkey bars, platforms or as offensive balls of air
Intangibility is useless against you
Make ghosts real, never fall in a pit etc.
cons: Only make things tangible - can't make things intangible

name: Weakening
overview: weaken whatever you touch
description: This ability i got from a reminder of Wabisuke from bleach... Whatever you hit/touch you can make it weaker by an amount that varies based on your choice. The stronger your power, though, the more you can weaken something.
pros: You always win physical fights
Can destroy almost anything in an instant with a touch
You would always be stronger than your opponent (weight lifting, hand wrestling, etc. )
cons: Can cause deaths from making them so weak their body cant support themselves
Have to actually touch the thing you want to weaken (can't be something intangible)
Doesn't increase your own strength so you would have a false sense of massive power

name: Surface Grinding
overview: grind, or generally "ride", on any surface at extreme speeds
description: This ability allows you to grind, or generally slide on any surface. Think of it as riding a skateboard without the skateboard. Any solid surface can be used to ride. Your body basically propels sideways in a skating position. Your feet will automatically follow the surface until it ends or you jump off. You can also follow any distinct line, such as a road lane. So if you use a spray paint can to create your own path, the speed is determined by the length; the longer you go, the faster you get.
pros: It is a cool way to travel and can make for some cool trick grinds
You can get up to 100-200 mph while grinding and stopping can be instant
You can also grind as an attack, either by using the momentum to attack or by "hand grinding" them
cons: You can't grind on water or air
Very durable shoes, one with metal bottoms, are needed to withstand the friction caused by grinding
Surface grinding at extreme speeds can cause damage to the surface

name: Weapons Master
overview: know everything about any weapon and how to use anything as a weapon
description: With this power you can know how to use any type of Weapon both magical and normal. You can also know how to use anything as a Weapon. You'll be a a master of the Sword,Spear and all Weapons and know how to use them. You can also know their strengths, weaknesses.
pros: How to use any type of weapon, both magical and normal.
Know how to use anything as a weapon
cons: You can still be killed
You can still be killed

name: I Want...
overview: get what you want
description: If you say,"I want _____", then clearly state what you want, then you'll get it. Just make sure that you really mean what your saying before saying it. At first, you'll only be able to ask for things that you NEED. Then you'll be able to ask for things that you WANT (has to be something that already exist). If you get really good at using this power, then you can ask for things that you want, but don't exist. Remember, word choice is key!
pros: Now you can have whatever you want
cons: At first, you only get what you need
Be careful what you wish for
Karma

name: Physical Overdrive
overview: put the user's body into a temporary state that breaks all the limiters in the human body.
description: This gives you the ability to temporarily turn off all the limiters in the human body. This means any and all physical limiters are gone meaning you have an insurmountable amount of strength and speed. This ability also takes of the limiters on the brain, allowing 100% of to be used witch in turn gives you superhuman level smarts and senses.
pros: Remarkable amount of strength
Unsurpassable speed
Beyond this world IQ and superhuman senses
cons: Limit of use: 10 minutes
Going beyond limit will damage body. After 30 minutes there will be damage that can not be fixed.
Beyond an hour means certain death after leaving overdrive mode.

name: Immortality
overview: be unable to age or die
description: Immortality is a gift and a curse. An Immortal is unable to die or even age--when the ability is first manifested, the holder stays that age forever. Their hair and nails continue to grow. Though they cannot die, they are not invunerable nor do they heal faster: if they are hit by a train or decapitated, they must wait for recovery. Users may also develop an aloof mindset or even become despairing.
pros: Live forever
Do everything you want to do in life
Ultimate adversary
cons: No healing factor
May develop a distant, arrogant mindset
Still feel pain

name: Gust
overview: project powerful gusts of air in any direction.
description: With a flick of your hand, you can ride the wind to your wildest destinations, blow all the leaves from your lawn, or blast away the bad guys in your way.
pros: Easy outdoor travel.
cons: Limited control of element.

name: True Nature
overview: unlock people's true nature and release their true form. Read full description.
description: This power transforms people into their true forms.  True forms are beings greater than humans that exist solely for their true natures. All of their attributes are enhanced, and human parts are more attractive. Each has multiple distinct abilities, and other general powers. Most appear half-human, but they can also appear nonhuman or human. Their bodies and powers are manifestations of their true natures, and no two forms are the same. Feel free to post a comment if you are at all confused.
pros: Enhanced attributes and tons of power for you or anyone else
Can use on anyone and still keep ability - even if you use on yourself
Transformations are awesome to watch!
cons: True forms can be very dangerous
Never know what form they will take
TRUE NATURE CAN NOT BE REVERSED!

name: Tactile Florakinesis
overview: control plants by touching them
description: Florakinesis is the ability to control and manipulate plants. With this power, all you have to do to obtain florakinesis is to touch a plant of your choice and concentrate. You can control any plants that you have touched. Also, if you concentrate as you touch soil, you can cause a plant of your choosing to grow. Unfortunately, this power can only be used once per day, until it develops.
pros: You can obtain florakinesis by touching plants
Any plants that you have touched can be controlled
Touching soil can cause a plant to grow
cons: It can only be used once per day, until it develops.
You HAVE to touch a plant to control it
Touching poisonous plants is not a good idea!

name: Telepathic Alarm
overview: know when anyone wants to do you harm
description: A passive form of telepathic power, that alarms you when anybody on Earth plans to do you harm. If one of your enemies is thinking about hurting you, your telephatic sense will give you a signal.
pros: You have more time to get ready to any attack against you.
cons: If you have too many enemies, you may get a headache because of the "voices".

name: Empathic Hydrokinesis
overview: manipulate water through strong emotions
description: This power works by creating powerful psionic energy when a person feels strong emotions such as fear, anger, elation, etc. That energy can then be channelled into any desired source of water, thus granting the person total control of it, so as long as they remain in their heightened emotional state. They can create tsunamis, waterspouts, floods, and anything else desired with water.
pros: Use water as an extremely versatile weapon!
Can overpower fire if used with strong enough emotions
You can protect people without fear of them ever being harmed by your enemy!
cons: Is extremely dangerous unless consciously controlled

name: Wait For It...
overview: freeze time until you finish your current sentence.
description: First, you must start saying something. Then, before you finish, you say, "wait for it. " Time will stand still. Nothing will age, including you. Nothing will move except you and things moved by you. However, frozen objects are harder to move, being unaffected by gravity or wind resistance, but being heavily affected by static friction with the fabric of time. The only way to unfreeze time is to speak or to die. The first thing you say will unfreeze time by finishing your sentence.
pros: Can keep yourself from aging.
No aging means no need for sleep or food.
Can do all sorts of things with frozen people and things.
cons: Must remain completely silent (vocally) while using this power.
Moving objects is roughly five times harder than usual.
Accidentally tripping and shouting out in pain while trespassing, unfreezing and alerting everyone.

name: Master Locksmith
overview: make or pick locks at will
description: This ability allows you to create a lock anywhere you can imagine one or, if there is already one there, pick it with your mind.
pros: Never blocked out of anywhere
Keep posessions safe by making really complex locks
Never get locked out of anything again because no need for a key
cons: If they use bars to hold the doors you cant pick it
You can still lose the object you lock
You could still get caught breaking in

name: Synthetics
overview: create synthetic things for many purposes.
description: With this, you can make synthetic things for various purposes without using any tools whatsoever. You can make artificial food by assembling together made-out-of-nothing proteins or generating meat from quickly created cells. You can change your DNA by inserting new proteins into it. You can extend or make permanent your youth and life. You can make primitive things as a whole, like a small piezoelectric stick as a weapon or contact lenses.
pros: Can make materials out of nothing or isolate them.
Very versatile, such as genetic modification, artificial diamonds and spray on tan and pale parlor.
Can change appearances with organic or synthetic plastic surgery, also eternal youth.
cons: Be creative or it will not be very effective.
People who like naturally-made things may hate you.

name: Sanctum Sanctorum
overview: become one of the Sorcerers Supreme
description: You become the mightiest magician in the cosmos, a Sorcerer Supreme, just like Stephen Strange/Doctor Strange, and thus on level with cosmic entities. You gain mastery of magic and genius-level intellect.
pros: Become one of the mightiest magicians in the cosmos
Mastery of magic and genius-level intellect.
On level with cosmic entities
cons: Dependent on magic, sucks if foes are immune to it
Have to find ways to indirectly affect magic-immune foes
Not being able to handle so much power

name: Shadow Damage
overview: damage an object through its shadow
description: With this power you damage objects by damaging their shadows. This does not amplify force. Hitting the shadow of a building will produce the same amount of damage as hitting the building normally. Stomping on the shadow of a human, however, will have stunning effect. This makes it easy to fight people from a distance. You can also shoot someone without leaving the bullet inside of them. However, your best times are dawn and dusk. Midnight and high noon do not work well for you.
pros: Fight from a distance
Shoot without a trace
Stomp on heads with minimal effort
cons: Doesn't amplify force
Only good at certain times of the day
May have to appoint a sidekick to hold a flashlight

name: Mirror Moving
overview: control your parallel universe
description: They say mirrors contain the exact opposite of your life in our "world". And that what you do here is the exact opposite of the mirror world. By using this power you change the outcomes of what ever mistakes you do here in our "world" or completely change the events that may have caused you distress and problems. It's sort of reality warping but with the limits of a parallel universe being affected.
pros: You can change the result of any thing like getting a low scores in test then use
The power to switch the "universes" and get a high score. You could also change the outcomes of
Wars,fights and even gambling bets in which if you lose here you can win if you switch the universes
cons: Can alter the death of others but cannot alter your own death
Positive results for you may cause negative outcomes for others
Can destroy the veil of the two universes with constant use and can cause great strain to the user

name: Superweapon Creation Knowledge
overview: know how to create WMDs and superweapons with common resources
description: With things easily available to you in your hometown, this power allows you to build: thermonuclear weapons, suitcase thermonuclear weapons, "salted" thermonuclear weapons, neutron bombs, EMP weapons, chimera viruses, recreations of any natural pathogen, chemical weapons, super-tanks that hurl nuclear bombs like firecrackers, super-cannons, missiles which can be loaded with any of the above, and just about any sort of bomb or weapon of immense power you can imagine.
pros: If you're a super villain, or want to have your own nation.
Or, if you like your government, you could claim to be a scientist and sell the designs
You could probably figure out a heroic use for a thirty-foot tall Hunter-Killer robot
cons: The sort of power that even if you're a hero, you'll want to hide
Not only can your stuff be stolen, but it can do A LOT of damage, and you're not protected from it
You'll either be terrified 24/7 of your stockpile going off, or terrified of a slip mid-manufacture

name: Wind Absorption
overview: absorb wind from the surrounding
description: The user is able to absorb the wind in his or her surrounding and release it upon the enemy. The power of the wind released is dependent on how strong the wind is. If it is a mild breeze than the user can only release a jet of compressed air, if the wind is gale and strong, the user can release a human sized tornado.
pros: Wind is ever present
Eco friendly
cons: Weak against fire
Not very powerful if there is no powerful wind

name: Olive Green Power Ring
overview: use the mysterious olive green energy of peace
description: The user is able to form constructs, force fields, shoot beams or bolts of energy that comes from the mysterious energy of peace. The ring only chooses people who are peaceful in nature or strive for peace and at the same time having a distaste for war or any senseless violence. The only weakness of the ring comes from the energy of senseless violence. The ring's symbol is an olive branch. The Olive Green Peace corps sign central battery is located on peaceful planet where nature is abundant.
pros: Can make construct out of pure energy of peace
Can make other be calmer in situations, making them more peaceful in nature
cons: Must recharge the ring
Weak against the power of senseless violence ( the color blood red )

name: Twist
overview: twist the space around you.
description: Basically, by twisting the space around you, any attack will slide off you, making you impossible to hit. It does not work on attacks aimed at the mind, such as mind control, mind reading etc.
pros: Can't be hit by any physical attack.
cons: Can be hit by attacks aimed at the mind.
Only works when you want it to.

name: Property Imbuing
overview: design chemical elements with desired properties.
description: With this power, you can "program" an element with a particular property, within limits. There are restrictions on properties, but you still have a lot of freedom. You could make an element turn movement into electricity, a lightweight but superdense material or a material which could withstand the temperatures and pressures of the inside of the sun. You can also change one element into another. The time it takes depends on what you are converting. It takes a lot of concentration to perform.
pros: Make armor nearly indestructible.
Turn trash into gold.
Have lots of freedom.
cons: Requires a lot of concentration.
It isn't ability imbuing -you are giving objects properties, not powers.
Some properties cannot coexist -its best to just give each object one property.

name: Emotion Based Weapons Creator
overview: create weapons based on the feelings of oneself or others
description: The weapons look different based on the emotions that are being used as a base but all the weapons have 3 things in common: a power core, restraints, and being extremely powerful. The power core provides power to the weapon (like electricity to a computer) and if broken the weapon is destroyed and rendered unusable. The restraint prevents the weapon from being at full power and going on a rampage in its true form. Each weapon is powerful enough to destroy a city.
pros: The weapon could be anything from a spear to a laser gun.
The weapon chooses its wielder. May be a con.
cons: You might not be able to use the weapon even though you made it.
Never ever let a restraint be destroyed or everyone around the weapon will be killed.

name: Human Puppetry
overview: create psychic invisible threads that attach to a organism and manipulate it's movements.
description: A maximum range of 85 feet is the length of the threads. These threads can be made visible for the user's amusement. Each finger releases one thread and controls entire limbs or, for more advanced user's, entire sections of the nervous system. Each movement of the fingers is a movement of the body. These threads can only be severed through loss of concentration.
pros: The maximum amount of 'puppets' is 500
It is not limited to humans. It controls all living bodies
No being can resist these psychic bonds
cons: They are severable
The power exhaust the user and can even induce a coma
At some point the people you manipulate become emotionless and soon just empty shells of themselves

name: Energy Solidification
overview: turn energy into solid matter.
description: This ability isn't right for those who are really attached to their electronics, but if you are not, then you can use it in many ways. You can use energy to create a solid construct, like turning off a nuclear bomb by changing it's core into a solid rock.
pros: Make the energy into a solid weapon.
Able to expand the energy before it becomes solid.
This ability affects all sources of energy.
cons: If not trained, it could destroy or shut down electronics.

name: Skin Produced Diamond
overview: produce diamond from your skin
description: With this power, you gain diamond's most well-known characteristic which is to be unbreakable. Your muscles become used to diamond's weight and gain superhuman strength.
pros: Your defence is flawless against any kind of attack
Superhuman strength
You can get richer by selling your home-made diamond
cons: Your weight becomes astronomical!
You can't swim in water
And you're very very visible

name: Vehicle Shapeshifting
overview: change to any vehicle you want
description: From flesh to metal, you can be any vehicle on land, sea and in the air.
pros: Go anywhere you want
cons: Last one hour a day

name: Situational Defenses
overview: gain natural defenses based on offensive situations
description: With this ability, your body will defend itself against anyone or anything that attempts to harm you. For instance, if someone were to throw a fist at you, your skin may become razor-sharp. If someone tried to slice off one of your arms, for example, you skin would become extremely dense and simply ruin the blade. If you obtained any disease, your body would be able to easily defeat it.
pros: This power protects your body physically, and mentally
You can take almost any type of punishment, and still be left without a scratch
No average being can cause any sort of harm to you
cons: This only triggers when you're attacked, or your body is in danger
You can still be harmed if your body is attacked extremely quickly, or is extremely damaged
If anything can seriously injure you, you will be unaware

name: Carbon Manipulation
overview: control carbon atoms
description: Can control only carbon atoms, however in order to control the atoms you must direct them with your hands. Takes a lot of concentration the bigger the object or the denser you are making the object.
pros: can kill in an instant
can turn skin into diamonds
control over most objects in the universe
cons: overpowered
can't be used if you have no arms

name: Oblivious
overview: not be affected by charm spells, hypnotism, brain washing, etc.
description: You are unaffected by things that would change your feelings or thoughts toward something (girlfriend, TV show, etc. ) You cannot be brainwashed because it affects your thinking. You are unaffected by love potions because they affect your heart. Others scenarios are included.
pros: You cannot be manipulated by someone else.
You cannot be hypnotized or charmed.
cons: Can still have thoughts read, just not manipulated
You may not understand other people's feelings; Cold hearted or stone heart.
You might be also seem to be absent minded, dumb,or very mean. Not that you are.

name: Camouflage
overview: make anything imperceptible
description: You can change the coloration of objects to make them harder to see. For example: change the color of your skin and clothing to blend into the forest. You can change the coloration/texture of any surface, by either touching or looking at it, with the application of the camouflage in mind. If you wanted to hide in the forest, think "forest", and the object you are touching/concentrating on will change color and/or texture instantly. This also allows you to create fake models of things to hide in.
pros: Can mock up hollow rocks or dead tree stumps to hide in
Can hide anywhere at any time
Works on other people, and happens naturally when sleeping
cons: Can't hurt enemies with it
Doesn't make you invisible, just really hard to see
Won't work if you don't know what environment you're in, or if you are in an empty room/box

name: Book Synchronization
overview: do anything associated with books and written stories
description: This ability allows you to copy the abilities and skills of characters of books. These include short stories, manga, novels, etc. As long as it has been officially been published, you can use it. Also, you don't have to read the entire book to use it as a power, but it might be a good idea to do so.
pros: Use the powers of characters from your favorite books
Bring characters from books to life and have them fight for you
If you own the book, you grow stronger
cons: You MUST know the name of the book
You can't do anything extreme (like being God)
If an enemy knows more about the book, you might lose

name: Dna Equivalence
overview: turn into your own equivalent of whatever creature you want, providing it bites you first.
description: When you can turn into any creature that bites you, Mosquitos are way less irritating! Once something bites you, you can turn into it at will, anytime you want. You are still susceptible to anything venomous, but surviving it would have extreme benefits.
pros: Sneak around, go werever you want, get bitten by other supers and absorb a fraction of their powers.
Really, who hasn't regretted being human at least once?
cons: You can still get infections. Invest in polysporin and band-aids.
If it can't bite you, you can't morph into it. That lifelong dream of becoming a moth? Not likely.
Anything too powerful that's biting you will probably kill you before you can morph.

name: Morality Meter
overview: see every moral choice you can possibly do in a situation.
description: Infamous,Fable,MassEffect. The list goes on with moral decisions in games, But what about seeing them in life. Most people are irrational in certain areas and don't think with their brain. With Morality Meter your perception of time stops and you will be able to see a good neutral and bad choice you can possibly do. Friend being a royal pain? Don't know what to say to someone to not hurt feelings? Not with Morality Meter. It happens automatically and gives you the most appropriate response
pros: Can choose what moral choices to make.
Can be the most rational person in a situation.
Never say something you would take back ever again.
cons: Time stops and moral conundrums might get annoying after a bit.
If you feel angry you can choose bad choices
You can be too much of a goody two-shoes

name: Expression Realization
overview: manifest a literal version of any expression.
description: With this power, one can induce a literal version of any expression. The expression "use it or lose it", for example, could be exploited to lose weight or strip an enemy's powers. The only restriction is the target performing the required action (in the case of depowering an enemy, not using the targeted power).
pros: Creativity can give this power a lot of uses.
The more expressions you know, the more powerful you are.
Unusual; harder for an opponent to predict and therefore counter your attacks.
cons: The target must complete a certain condition.
The expression cannot be made up.
The strength is the weakness.

name: Tailor Maker
overview: make the most efficient, practical and stylish costume for anyone who has a power.
description: You can design the most  practical and stylish costume for anyone with a power. The costumes you make, conjures itself around the person you are tailoring for. The costume you design works practically for the kind of power they have for example someone who generates flame and hot fire, their costume will be heat-resistant. With time your costumes can enhance and boost the power of the individual you are tailoring for. You can also control whether the person can no longer wear your costume.
pros: Costumes tailored are practical, and can be as stylish as you choose to design.
With enough practice the costume can enhance or boost the power of the individual you make the costume for.
You can also 'turn off' this power on the individuals you tailor for. Example: If you can boost the power of the individual, you can also stop that enhancement.
cons: A background power for someone on a super hero team. No real, personal, combative capabilities.
If you enhance a person's power with the costume they design, they could turn against you, if they went rogue.

name: Repair Fire
overview: summon golden flames that fix broken things.
description: This power allows the user to summon golden flames that revert broken objects to their 'repaired' state. For example, using them on a broken window will repair the window. The power allows for a fairly arbitrary definition of 'repaired' - if the flames are used on ordinary glass, it is possible to revert it to its 'unprocessed' state of sand and assorted chemicals as long as the user decides that they're applying the flames to 'broken' sand, rather than fixed glass.
pros: Fix broken objects with ease.
Heal peoples injuries.
cons: If the flames are used on computers or other electronics, it will wipe the data on them.
Excessive use of the flames will tire the user out.

name: Lie Detector
overview: know for certain whether someone is telling the truth or lying.
description: With this ability, you will always know whether someone is being genuinely honest with you or just giving you a line of bull.  You'll also be able to detect which parts of a story are stretches of the truth or near-truths, although you won't automatically know the actual truth unless the person tells you.
pros: Have a much easier time trusting people who consistently tell the truth
Accusing people of thinking you're hot, then catching them in a lie when they say no
You have the ultimate upper hand when playing poker and negotiating with salespeople
cons: Sometimes not knowing the truth is better

name: Superhuman Leaping
overview: jump great heights and distances
description: A person with Superhuman Leaping has a sort of specialized Super Strength. Instead of the strength being in the upper body, a Superhuman Leaper has enhanced leg muscles and bones. They can jump up to seventy-five feet straight up, 150 feet in a long jump, and they can survive most falls. They have no enhanced arm strength and no other superhuman attributes.
pros: 75 feet straight up, 150 foot long jump
Can survive most falls
Good for escapes
cons: No enhanced upper body strength
No other superhuman attributes
Confined spaces

name: Super Person Copy
overview: possess the superpowers of a super-person
description: Any super-person from a TV show, movie, book, comic, etc. , the user can pick one, and have all their powers. The super-person can be anything/anyone that has superpowers (alien, mutant, magician, creature, hero, villain, etc. ) But, the user can only pick one super-person, that's it. But the good part is the user get's ALL of that super-person's superpowers.
pros: Have all the powers of any super-person
Super-person can be an alien, mutant, magician, creature, hero, villain, etc. (superpowers required)
cons: User can only pick one super-person.

name: Selective Intangibility
overview: make only certain parts of your body intangible at will
description: A person with this power can make selective parts of their body intangible at a time. For example, they can make only their head intangible to dodge a punch to the head. When a person phases through someone and becomes tangible again, their body parts will fuse temporarily through space-time until the person becomes intangible again. Objects grabbed by the user can become intangible as long as the hands are intangible as well.
pros: Hostages can be punched through
You can make things you touch fully intangible
You can immediately make any part intangible, including the head, without any consequences
cons: You cannot make your whole body intangible at once
You need to concentrate on which body part to make intangible

name: Metaphysical Change
overview: force an ability user's ability to distort and become another random ability.
description: This ability allows the user to twist another's ability upon physical contact of the person. The change is not harmful nor disastrous upon change. However, the ability will no longer be the same as the ability the other user had before. It will most likely be the opposite. The target user does not keep their old power but is bestowed with a new one. However, it is different from Power Bestowal (or anything similar) in the sense that a new power is not added to the user, only changed.
pros: Change a potentially annoying power to something else.
Change an unwanted power to something perhaps useful.
cons: The target's power may be... Even more annoying afterward
Need to develop new strategy to face new power.

name: Insomniac Strength
overview: become stronger and tougher by staying awake
description: The longer you stay awake, the more your strength and invulnerability increase. When you are asleep or have just woken up, you are baseline human, but two hours after waking up you will be impervious to small arms fire, and able to throw people around one-handed. You become tired as fast as normal people, but stimulants can help keep you awake. At full power you could withstand a tank shell or a napalm attack, and benchpress a commercial jet.
pros: For most of the day you have considerable powers, and by night you're a serious force
Can take stimulants such as caffeine if you really need to use your full power
When you're so tired you can't focus in a fight, your invulnerability will still protect you
cons: You need to shave etc in the first half-hour you're awake, before your hair becomes indestructible
You could be fairly easily killed early in the morning
You find it difficult to use your full strength, as you'll be very tired by then

name: Incognito
overview: become completely anonymous--nobody will recognize you and you'll leave no tracks.
description: With this power, at will you can go completely incognito in an instant.  In a mirror you might look the same, but in incognito mode, nobody will recognize you, and they won't be able to recall what you looked like.  You won't leave fingerprints, hair, or any incriminating evidence for that matter. And, to make things better, you won't appear at all on cameras or in photos.  So go ahead, go incognito and rob the bank!  But just make sure you've hired a good getaway driver.
pros: Easily get away with certain things
Become a kickass spy
Avoid annyoing ex-girlfriends (or ex-boyfriends)
cons: You might be tempted to break the law, and often
You can still get caught (however, they won't know who you are)

name: Uncontrollable Energy
overview: harness anger, hope or determination into energy
description: Harness anger, hope or even determination into energy. This energy can sometimes be uncontrollable.
pros: You can have lots of power
Enables you to do more inhuman things
cons: Sometimes uncontrollable

name: 0 G: Zero Gravity Reduction
overview: reduce gravity to zero for various effects
description: This ability can be used for many things. It obviously allows the user to reduce gravity, however, it is not only use to levitate oneself. You are also capable of making others float, and objects. However, at the higher bands, you can reduce the gravity within structures to the point that bonds are loosened and they are effectively vaporized
pros: Float/"fly"/levitate, and reduction in gravity helps in jumping and agility
Levitate other things
Reduce gravitational attraction to the point people fly away or objects are vaporized
cons: Can't control your levitation path until you develop your ability
Can't control object's levitation path until you develop your ability
Can't vaporize objects until you develop your ability

name: Gliding
overview: fly smoothly and continuously along with minimal effort or resistance
description: You could be able to harness the power of flight with minimal effort and minimal resistance
pros: It is practicly effortless (you don't need to flap your arms or anything)
No machinery is needed
You can go as far as you want to
cons: You will need a running start
This ability takes time to fully master
People will be able to see you from the ground or otherwise

name: Half Succubus/Incubus
overview: be half-human, half-succubus/incubus
description: Someone with this power will have boosted strength, speed, and magical power though mostly for illusions. They will also have fangs, claws, a pointed tail, and wings as well as a beautiful/handsome appearance (no zits, smooth skin, slender, well-built, etc). They will also give off pheromones that attract the sex that they are interested in.
pros: You will always look good and never have to work on your appearance.
You can attract anyone you want for a mate
You always have claws to fight with if something goes wrong.
cons: If you for some reason have this power but don't like people, everyone will be attracted to you.
Note: It would be half-succubus for females, half-incubus for males.
Someone who has no feelings or is immune to pheromones.

name: Manual Adaptation
overview: choose your physical and mental weaknesses.
description: Reactive Adaptation allows you to become immune to something after being exposed to it a few times. With Manual Adaptation, why wait? You can willingly become immune to threats as soon as they attack you! You can make yourself immune to high voltage attacks, bullets, and nuclear blasts as soon as you wish it. Also, your body and mind will become stronger as a result.
pros: Be invincible!
Choose what can harm you
cons: It's a Mary Sue ability
You must be aware of the threat

name: Matter Conversion
overview: change the state of matter with any object.
description:
The ability to change the state of matter of any living or non-living matter.
Example: You can cause people to melt or you can turn steam into ice.
You can even change objects to their plasma state.
pros: You can melt people you hate.
You can make ice cubes instantly on a hot day.
cons: Might by accident melt someone you like.

name: Talent Thief
overview: steal any abilities of the victim.
description: If the victim has the ability to pilot a plane, when you use this power, you will immediately receive that power as well. Steal any abilities a person has (superpowers don't count).
pros: Jack of All Trades, Master of All
Never lose the victim's powers!
Become amazingly powerful.
cons: Choose a bad person? You're stuck with his talents forever.
Ego.
Choose a person with piloting skill, cannot steal someone else's piloting skills.

name: Painting Master.
overview: control reality with your paintings
description: With this ability you can paint a scene of a certain person thing or place, and whatever you painted will happen. If it a time is not specified with the painting it will occur before Twelve a. M. If you think of a person and randomly paint something you will paint a picture of what that person is doing at that exact moment, a later moment, or an earlier moment in time.
pros: Make anyone do whatever you want by painting them in a picture.
See what other people are doing whenever you want.
You can paint anything you want with perfect clarity.
cons: Never draw cartoons. Ever.
How the scene occurs, and what happens afterward is not controlled by the first drawing.
You have to complete the drawing for it to take affect.

name: True Luck
overview: exist in a perpetual state of good luck.  Sort of.
description: Someone with True Luck was born under the watch of fate, God, or some other power that keeps them safe.  They never get hurt, or sick, or cheated when it can possibly avoided.  It seems as though the laws of causality and probability will bend (if not break) to give them a shot.  However, it's also not under that person's control; and the powers that be are notoriously fickle.  They don't like it when someone tries to exploit them, meaning you can't try to win at blackjack with this.  Good Luck.
pros: Nothing bad really ever happens to you, it's avoided in some way or another.
You will always be provided for, i.e. you'll aquire money, food, shelter... whatever you may need.
Various perks gained from 'good' outcomes that occur to you, as long as it was unintentional.
cons: Nothing particularly 'good' can happen to you, especially if you try to plan for it.
Your definition of positive, and fate's definition, may not always match.
Since you're not in control, you may wind up being confused about what's happening and why.

name: Endless Blood
overview: have a endless supply of blood.
description: With this power the user will never run out of blood within his bodily system. Any lost blood is immediately replaced without needing any energy from the user. The blood will be the same blood type as the persons normal blood. Open wounds will continually bleed until the wound is closed. This power is normally always on, so the supply of blood can not be turned off. The blood can be used to fuel other blood related powers.
pros: Never fear blood loss.
Can donate an infinite supply of blood.
Always have a supply of blood for other blood related powers.
cons: Can not be directly controlled by the user through this power.
If wounds do not close the bleeding would never stop.
The blood will be the same as your normal blood.

name: Power Crystals
overview: create and manipulate power crystals.
description: Power crystals are crystals of great power. They can be (if done properly) used as energy sources, but can also give great powers to humans. With simple exposure, you could gain any sort of power. But depending on how someone is exposed to them, they can have different effects. You can also manipulate them, so you could use them as weapons or structures. You can even control when they are activated (glowing), meaning when they can grant abilities.
pros: You can control and shape power-granting crystals
Studying different kinds of exposure could allow you to control what they do to people
cons: Sometimes the crystals can have bad effects

name: Unstoppability
overview: charge straight through any subject
description: With this power you can charge through anything, be it a dense wall, or a living foe. A person with this has inertia to keep going for however long the user likes (although they can get tired and stop of the their own will, and can sometimes be moved by outside forces), and though any obstacle, to reach any target, or just to tackle a foe with phenomenal force.
pros: Can go through anything.
Can stop whenever one chooses too.
When charging through living foes, their bodies and left in shreds, bits, pieces, etc.
cons: Can still tire.
Can still be stopped my outside forces ( psychics, a person with persuasion, etc)
The damage of Unstoppability

name: Weekly Wonder
overview: have a different power depending on the day of the week
description: With this power, every new day means a new power for you. Each day of the week brings you a specific new power untill the day ends.  Monday - Increase Gravity on others, making them slow and sluggish.  Tuesday - Control wind.  Wednesday - Aquakinesis, control water.  Thursday - Geokinesis, ability to control earth.  Friday - Laser Vision.  Saturday - Electricy Generation, generate and control electricity.  Sunday - Pyrokinesis, ability to control fire. Power wanes with the setting sun.
pros: Each day is a new power
Control over multiple elements and powers (over different days)
cons: You have to plan based on what power you'll have the next day
Somtimes hard to remember what power you have.

name: Phasing Extension
overview: phase yourself and objects while out of your hand
description: The ability to go through solid matter without any harm. This ability also extends to other items, even when they are out of your hands for a short period of time. If you threw a baseball across a 20 yard field, within 15 yards it would uncontrollably phase back into solid matter. It depends on how strong or weak your ability is: If you are focused and have much, then the object will be phasing for a longer period of time.
pros: You can phase
Other objects can be out of your hand and still be phase
The stronger the person, the longer the phasing effect lasts
cons: The phasing of other objects only last for a short period of time
It takes concentration to phase an object while out of your hand
You cannot un-phase the object once it is out of your hands

name: The Door
overview: spawn a door to a supply room wherever and whenever you want
description: Just think of the door and it will come down anywhere and anytime. Through the door you will find weapons, cars, food, meds, and tech. Only you can enter though. Anything and everything is in there and you can sort it like in "The Matrix." The downfall is that you can't spawn other superpowers.
pros: Any weapon you want, including guns, ammo and melee wepons
Any car you want plus you can put guns on the cars too
You can hide in there if needed
cons: Only you can enter
Can't get other superpowers

name: Superhuman Perception Zone
overview: become totally omniscient on a small specific area.
description: Using this power makes you omniscient on a certain area of range. When using this ability you can see every single detail of every single thing around you. You know what is everyone thinking, what everything is made of, everything in this small zone. Although its really powerful, this ability makes you really tired and while using it, you fall in a deep sleeping state.  The initial range of the power is a small living room, but it can be increased. The sleeping state lasts at least 30 minutes
pros: If you are in a criminal scene, you can solve the crime in seconds using this power.
You can locate a hidden person or a lost object.
Using this power you can solve the Da Vinci's code easily!
cons: While using this you become really vulnerable, so you might need to have someone to protect you.
This ability makes you exhausted and using it too much could ruin your mind.
Increasing range is very dangerous; 30 minutes can't be shortened.

name: Lie Realization
overview: turn other people's lies into truth
description: A person with this power can turn other people's lies into truth. As such reality bends to make it true. If history has to be rewritten then an alternate universe is created where the lie is true. Only the lying person is aware of the change. If the person that told the lie admits what he said was a lie, either in person or in a journal after death etc, there will be a backlash that reverses the effects of this power and goes back to the moment that lie happened.
pros: No one can lie to you if you don't want them to
Make things you want to hear true
If people flatter you, you can make what they say true
cons: Does not come with lie detection ability
Does not work on your own lies
If someone starts telling the truth this power gets reversed

name: Infinite Stamina
overview: never get tired
description: You can exercise all day long and never get tired. You can run a long distance race at your fastest sprinting pace. If you can do something once you can do it millions of times. Unfortunately you can't ever sleep. Also, you have to actually work for a while to be strong and you still won't be super strong. If you're slow you'll still be slow you just won't ever get tired. But if you put in some work you'll be like a batman who doesn't ever have to take a break.
pros: You can exercise for hours without fatigue standing in your way
People who stand in your way will eventually get tired and give up
You are always energized and alert
cons: You can't sleep
Requires work to become useful

name: Tactile Thought Projection
overview: project aspects of your mind.
description: This is a Twilight power. Tactile thought projection is the ability to place the user's thoughts and memories  into another person's mind. This power allows the user to project his or her thoughts into  another person's mind in the form of vivid pictures, thoughts and feelings, and requires  physical contact. It works best in communicating with others when words are not  suited to the purpose. One can hijack the user's power to access his/her dreams by  placing their hand on their faces.
pros: Showing people your life story.
Non verbal communication.
cons: Mind invasion while you sleep.
Physical contact needed.

name: Immune System Enhancement
overview: have your immune system increased with other aspects.
description: With this power, your immune system, along with other aspects, is immensely increased to keep you safe. Your white blood cell count skyrockets along with other things and you are immune to AIDS, and poisons. You can breathe out or excrete a poison to kill "germs" and other things, and your body heat can go up to three hundred degrees fahrenheit without harm. You heal quickly and have one hundred times as strong connective tissue.
pros: Virtually invulnerable to disease.
Heal quickly.
Versatile.
cons: No sick days.

name: It's The Thought That Counts
overview: become stronger whenever someone thinks of you
description: With this power whenever someone thinks of you you become stronger
pros: Whenever someone thinks of you you get stronger even if they're thinking of you badly
cons: The extra strength wears off as soon as nobody is thinking about you anymore

name: Shadow Combination
overview: combine yourself with your own shadow
description: To attatch yourself with your own shadow, making yourself light, 2D, and invisible in other shadows.
pros: Can fly
Easily looked past
Can escape through cracks between doors
cons: Cold - if done for too long will result in hypothermia
If you don't concentrate you will float away
Everything looks blurry and unfocused - hard to concentrate

name: Dragon Morph
overview: morph into a dragon creature.
description: When you morph into a dragon, you possess every characteristic of the mythological creature. You can fly at super speeds, breathe fire, super sight and hearing, and the super strength of a dragon. You just have to concentrate in order to morph into the dragon creature.
pros: Possess many separate abilities at once.
Ability to breathe fire, fly, strength, super senses.
cons: Can only use dragon powers in dragon form.
Can not stay in dragon form forever.

name: Reaper's Light
overview: generate a bright light that paralyzes anyone caught in its glow
description: This ability allows you to create a bright light that paralyzes anyone caught in its glow. Paralyzed victims become frozen in whatever position they were in when the light appeared. When the light is has waned, victims do not rember it happened and continue as if it never happened. You can enter the light after it has been activated and not be affected. Killing the user of this ability while it is active will kill all caught in it.
pros: Freeze victims for a clean getaway or a clean kill
cons: Some can avoid being frozen by blocking the light when it is first deployed.
Dying while it is active kills all affected by it.

name: Musical Influence
overview: gain a superpower by listening to a specific song.
description: The subject who owns this power has a deep affiliation with music, so deep that he/she can acquire a superpower every time he/she listen to a specific song. The power he/she obtains depends from: 1. The meaning of the song; 2. The text, the melody and the rythm of the song; 3. The subjective emotions inspired by that song to the owner.
pros: A very wide range of acquirable powers, as various as the existing songs;
The most appreciated is the song, the most powerful will be the received power.
cons: A silly song will give a useless power;
The song must be listened entirely.

name: Aura Communication
overview: communicate with others by way of contact with auras
description: You can send messages to and recieve messages from anyone who is either at least one centimetre in your aura or has you at least one centimetre in their aura. Noone can stop the messages from being sent or recieved.
pros: Instant uninterceptible communication during combat!
cons: Messages will go in a straight line and will be recieved by anyone who is in between you (to con 2)
(from con 1) and the intended reciever as long as they are also within your aura.

name: Photoshop
overview: modify just about anything
description: A Photoshopper can copy, paste, add effects, merge, change colors, and otherwise edit people and objects.
pros: Retouch your face
Erase your annoying sibling's mouth
Select all the water in a flooding area and delete!
cons: People expect you to fix their flaws
You can't copy and edit the power.
If you have no artistic talent, you might mess things up badly and not be able to fix it.

name: Magical Weapon Creation
overview: create magical weapons of any kind.
description: This ability works by creating a weapon of your choice and adding a single magic type. For example, you can choose a sword and fire magic. You can choose even modern weapons such as a pistol or machine guns, or even futuristic weapons, but those will take a lot more concentration. Also, when you choose a weapon, you can only add one magic type to it. For example, if you chose a spear, you can't add both ice and lightning to it. You can, however, change the magic a weapon has.
pros: Can create any weapon and add any magic to it, healing, fire, ice, etc.
Can change the magic on a weapon, whether immediately or later.
Can activate magic powers upon will, and manipulate them to your will.
cons: Magic works better with melee weapons and does not work as well with futuristic weapons.
You cannot add more than one magic per weapon.
You have to direct the magic through your weapon.

name: Weapon Draw
overview: take a weapon from any computer game
description: Just put your hand on the screen and think about the weapon. And you have the weapon you want.
pros: Any weapon you want in your hand
You can have a car if you have a car game
cons: The computer might be too far to touch it

name: Ability Snatch
overview: temprarily steal the abilities of others.
description: This only works if you are within, at least, ten-feet away from your "victim." Once you're near, your "victim" will lose their ability and you will be able to use it.
pros: You can negate an opponent's ability, without any physical contact.
You can snatch more than one ability.
You'll be immune to physical-contact powers (ex. super strength)
cons: There's a limit to the amount of abilities that can be snatched (just like a normal thief).
Powers, other than physical-contact powers, will be difficult to snatch.
You'll lose your obtained ability(s) when you're at a certain distance away from your "victim."

name: Rod Cell Mimicry
overview: see better in the dark, convert darkness into electricity and allow people to see what you see.
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. It is more effective at very low light intensity. With it, you have an enhanced night vision, but you can't see if there's no light at all. It also allows you to convert darkness into electricity. The darker it is, the more voltage you produce. Alternatively, you can convert darkness into special signals. By sending them to someone's visual cortex (the back of the head in humans), you'll make them see what you see. This power can be disrupted by flashes of light.
pros: You can see in the dark better than a normal human being, provided there's enough light.
You can electrocute someone if it's dark enough.
By touching the back of the head of a human person, you can show them what you see.
cons: It can work at high light intensity, but there'll be a cooldown period before it works in the dark.
Because of con 1, this power can be disrupted by flashes of light.
In bright light, you can only create very low-voltage electrical impulses.

name: Mirage Inducing
overview: conjure illusions that are real as long as people think they are
description: Mirage Inducing is a version of Illusion in which the user can generate illusions which last, and are completely real, as long as targets don't know that they are illusions. One with this ability could cause any type of illusion they desire, but the second someone calls out "it's not real! " or shakes subjects out of their deluded state or subjects see the illusionist working his power, the illusions wear off entirely (until they can go unnoticed again).
pros: Cast powerful, convincing illusions
They can affect and interact with the environment as though they were real
Requires little concentration, and the power gets much stronger over time
cons: Partly requires others' mental power (belief, fear, etc) or one's own self-delusion to work
If subjects are shaken out of their deluded state or catch the user casting the illusion
Perspicuity (Mental Immunity), Anti-Telepathy and similar abilities provide immunity

name: Vicarious Superman
overview: transfer your mortality into an object and become a demigod.
description: This is a sinister version of the Superman Spell. You transfer your mortal limits into any person, place, or thing you desire. By getting as far away from them as possible, you become a powerful demigod, but you will start to lose your powers in their presence. If the vessel is damaged, you will be as well.
pros: Be a god among men
Any limits you have will be transferred to the vessel
cons: Your vessel is your kryptonite
If it is damaged, you will be as well

name: Spirit Shifting
overview: become a ghost at will
description: The ability to become a ghost at will. When user becomes a ghost, their body turns into an object (example: necklace. ) When they want to be a mortal again, the just have to touch the object. Spirit-shifters can become ghosts at any time, but they can only stay ghosts for short periods of time (about 30 minutes. ) If they stay longer, they be taken to the spirit world.
pros: Can go through objects
Can communicate with ghosts (to get information)
Can easily spy on people
cons: Shifting forms requires lots of concentration
If their object is lost, so is their human body
If they stay a ghost too long, they get taken to the spirit world

name: The Power Of Random
overview: change your power randomly whenever.
description: You can change your power whenever you want but you can't control what power you get. With some training and practice you might be to control what type of power it is. You know,mental,biological,supernatural,ect. But without you could get any no matter what.
pros: Many uses.
Unique power!
Can control what type of power you get with practice.
cons: Get a stupid power.

name: Typhoon Master
overview: call a typhoon whenever, wherever.
description: This ability is about calling a typhoon whenever or wherever you want it. You can tell where the storm will be but you can control where the lightnings will strike, the direction of the wind blow and the hardness of the rain. Well you can call a storm far away from you, where you know your enemy is. Useful when it's hot outside, LOL! Every minute that the typhoon is summoned will decrease your strength as a human being. When the typhoon you created is so strong, you can't control it anymore.
pros: It's useful when it's hot outside.
Can use it far away from you.
You can feel so powerful with this!
cons: You can also be hurt when not properly controlled.
You can kill a person or thousands of them.
You can destroy a whole nation!

name: Mark Of Hati
overview: become a lunar lycan
description: In Norse mythology, hati was one of the wolf brothers (the other being skoll) who chased after the sun and moon god. During the day of Ragnarok, hati devoured the moon God and gain his power. With this power, you have the ability to turn into a werewolf or gaint one with immense strength, speed, healing factor, immoratality. You also have power of a Moon God and can use elements like water, dark, and gravity and can become more powerful at night.
pros: Super strength and speed of a werewolf
Power of a moon god
Stand up against gods and devour them
cons: Other gods might want hunt you down
Might be hard to control at first
Not as strong during the day

name: Complete Physical Mastery
overview: be aware of and manipulate all of the processes of one's body.
description: Someone possessing this power can alter and regulate their bodily functions at any time. Increase your metabolism to prevent gaining weight. Turn off your body's ability to register pain. Increase your body's production of lactic acid to prevent fatigue. Increase production of bodily cells for accelerated healing. Be aware of the position of the body, any diseases or foreign materials in it, their center of gravity and tissues.
pros: Enhanced balance, healing, reflexes, and instincts
Immunity to poison and being controlled
Total control over bodily processes (heartbeat, breathing, etc.)
cons: Using this power to its full potential requires intricate knowledge of how your anatomy works.

name: Temporal Communication
overview: communicate with the past or the future through electronics(email, phone, text, etc. )
description: A person with this power can talk with the past or the future by connecting with and electronic device. They will send the electronic waves backward or forward in time to call people. For example, you can call your future self to ask for the answers to homework or where a bomb is or how they defeated someone. You can also call the past and risk creating a temporal paradox.
