However if a paradox is created the user of this power is unaffected by the paradox and retains their memory and their body.
pros: Calling the future is similar to prerecognition
Calling the past to fix temporal paradoxes or create them
Even if a paradox is created you will not be affected and retain all memories
cons: You need to have a communication device
If phones don't work in the future
You don't know what phone number to call in the past or future

name: Elemental Wolves
overview: create and control wolves of any one element
description: The wolves will be composed completely out of the element of your choice and have sharp fangs and claws. Choosable elements are Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Wood, Ice Lightning, Metal, Sand, and any element on the Periodic Table. You only get to choose one element for ALL the wolves you make. Once the choice is made it cannot be changed. The wolves can go for a range of up to 50 metres from your position.
pros: You can choose your wolves' element.
The wolves can be powerful soldiers.
The wolves have all the strengths of their element.
cons: The wolves have all the weaknesses of their element. Alteration powers have no effect on this power.
Element chosen cannot be changed even with other powers nor can the number of elements be increased.
Your wolves can be hijacked by someone who can control the wolves' element.

name: Draconic Fire
overview: create and control a fire that can only be put out by other fires
description: The fire of an extremely powerful dragon is such that only regular fire can put it out. The holder of this power can use this extremely powerful flame for any cause that they may desire.
pros: Enemies have to literally fight fire with fire.
Water just makes this fire stronger.
cons: The weakest flame from Pyrokinesis can put out your fires.

name: Modern Science
overview: manipulate the forces of modern day science.
description: Science has many great powers. It has carried us through many problems. You can control and invoke the forces of any modern day science. This includes physics, biology, chemistry, astronomy, psychology, and geology.
pros: Very powerful
As science evolves, so does this power.
cons: May not understand your power at first

name: Blade Manipulation
overview: control bladed objects and protrude blades from body parts
description: The power to control bladed objects around you including knives, swords, axes, spears, anything with a blade. The power also includes having the ability to protrude blades out of your body (like wolverine on a bigger scale). Can create armor out of the blades protruding. Becoming unconscious can cause an uncontrollable flurry of bladed objects which would have to be controlled by your mental will. This can also be cause by high amounts of bodily harm or trauma.
pros: Can deflect and create a shield of blades
Surprise attacks
cons: Losing control can create an uncontrollable flurry of blades
Unconsciousness causes bad 1
Can sometimes control body

name: Soundwave Skin
overview: protect oneself with soundwaves that are right on top of one's skin
description: You create the soundwaves by screaming which will cover and protect you. The soundwaves will cause anything that touches them except for you to be blasted backwards by a shockwave from the sound. While the sound is protecting you, you are immune to any loud noises that would hurt your ears to the point of nearly deafening you.
pros: Sound-damage immunity combined with a barrier.
cons: Powers that annihilate other powers. Ex: Power Burning or Negation.
Your throat will hurt while using this power.

name: Delete This Shadow Flight
overview: fly across the air anywhere at a steady speed, you would move faster, and leave a black trail.
description: It'll be a lot cooler if you were like Johnny Cage from Mortal Kombat, but not only not like he does his famous Shadow Kick you would fly into the skies leaving a black or green trail behind you.
pros: No one will be able to catch you.
cons: Same as a regular flying power

name: Dislikes Disappear
overview: rid any person, place, or thing of all the things you dislike about it
description: Anything that you dislike about a person, place, or thing, you can get rid of. This power also works on yourself. Also, let's say you don't like your voice. It wont just disappear, but instead it will change according to your preference (in this case, whatever voice you would prefer or want/like best).
pros: Get rid of anything you dislike like about a person, place, or thing
Things you dislike change according to your preference (whichever alternative you would like best)
cons: Nothing

name: Exterior Materialization
overview: change your exterior to any material you touch.
description: You could change your skin (exterior) into any material you touch.
pros: You could change your skin
You will never be naked
You couldn't be hurt
cons: Careful what you touch
Can't really feel anything

name: Thought Breaker
overview: break things with a simple thought in mind.
description: If you want to break something such as someone's bones or breaking a light, all you have to is think about it and will it to happen.
pros: You can break an enemy's bones with a simple thought
You can not be accused of something that you didn't touch
It's the thought that counts
cons: If you think of something and will it to happen it will happen.
You have to control your thoughts a little more when you are angry

name: Elemental Arms
overview: turn your arms into some of the elements
description: You are able to turn your arms into rocks or tornadoes. You can also have arms of water. You can't have elements on your arms for a long time, and there's a 1-hour cooldown when you're done. It can become dangerous if you put 3 elements together.
pros: Can have two different elements like one fire arm and one stone arm
Can combine two elements
Can use both arms as an element
cons: 1-hour cooldown
If you put more than two powers together, chances are it would amputate your arm

name: Master Storyteller
overview: entrance and entertain people by crafting amazing stories
description: You have the ability to craft amazing stories, most ideas you have you can flesh out into full stories. Be a best selling novelist or screenwriter, be able to think up the best alibi or excuse.
pros: Be a best selling Novelist, Screenwriter or Director
Entertain millions with your work
Live in luxury thanks to your works
cons: You might prefer being in the limelight rather than a behind the scenes person
Fame might not be for you
While many will adore your works, there will always be critics

name: Psi Armor
overview: create armor that protects from some kinds of psychic attack.
description: When activated, this power covers you in a layer of psionic energy that negates physically based psychic attacks, such as telekinesis or pyrokinesis. Any attempt at using such powers on you fails, with the attack just bouncing off or sliding past. However, this does not prevent indirect attacks, such as throwing a car with your mind. It also is ineffective against any kind of mental attack, such as telepathic mind control.
pros: Protection from pesty kinetic powers.
Allows you to fight psychics more easily.
cons: Doesn't protect from indirect attacks
Or from telepathy.

name: Man
overview: control every aspect of humanity
description: Control movement, mind and bodily elements of humanity, as well as augment any natural feature of a human being including yourself, as long as you sit on throne.
pros: You have all humanity as an army, as long you had contact with them
You reduce backstabbers by controlling their minds so that they have undying loyalty to you
You can enhance any part of a normal human into a deadly weapon.
cons: Does not work on animals, human hybrids or non humans.
You sit on a throne at all times in order to keep the humans you've met under your control
You will have to met them first

name: Hormone Manipulation
overview: manipulate hormones.
description: With this power, one can control hormone production. Production levels return to normal over time, but can be restored at will, provided they have not yet returned to normal levels; otherwise it needs to be applied again. In yourself, however, levels are constantly maintained. As bonuses, one can sense hormone levels and diseases related to them such as type 1 diabetes as well as cure said hormone disorders, even when the levels must adjust for specific conditions.
pros: Cure hormone-related disorders, such as diabetes type 1.
Alter hormone levels to control factors as you desire, such as quantities of fat and muscle.
You can instantly reverse any changes you have done to a person's hormone production.
cons: Effects wear off over time unless maintained.
You cannot cure a hormone-based disease if the individual has no allele for it.
You can only control hormones, not other proteins such as enzymes.

name: Triumvirate
overview: fly at extreme speeds, be super durable, and fire energy blasts, but not at the same time.
description: You have the ability of flight, durability, and energy projection, but there is a catch. You cannot use all 3 abilities at full strength once. You can use one ability at full strength, two abilities at medium strength, or three at a relatively weak strength. Flight at its strongest allows Mach 2 speeds. Your durability at its strongest allows you to block virtually all physical attacks and most high energy attacks. Your energy blast at its most potent could level a city block.
pros: You can fulfill several rolls on a battlefield that you can change as the situation calls for it.
Using all 3 you could still fly faster than most, withstand low caliber fire, and shoot lasers!
You can be a Lightning Bruiser, Mighty Glacier, Glass Canon, Fragile Speedster, Stone Wall, and etc.
cons: If somebody uses rock when you're using scissors.

name: True Intentions
overview: see if someone is good or evil
description: Using this ability you can see the true intentions of someone. You can tell if someone is good or evil, but you can't tell the 'level' of good or evil someone is on. You will unconsciencly judge yourself. Also, there is no 'in the middle' because people who are like that are either good or evil and it is being hidden by other actions. (hoped that answered some questions)
pros: It's impossible to have bad friends, you could see if they were evil.
Comes in handy in political situations.
You see someones true nature and intentions.
cons: People who know of your powers will most likely try to exploit you. (not always)
You become very self-conscious, due to the fact that this power makes you judge yourself.
Knowing that people you love are evil can be a big burden.

name: Intelligence Mimicry
overview: analyze and mimic by touch any creature's strongest form of intelligence.
description: There are different types of intelligence. For example, there is Naturalist Intelligence or "Nature Smart". This ability lets the user mimic and add on to his amount of that intelligence for ten hours. This can allow the user to mimic the instincts of animals, the powers of those who can read minds or see the future.
pros: Gain more intelligence.
Gain animal instinct.
Gain some psychic powers.
cons: Each mimicked intelligence, instinct, or psychic power lasts for ten hours.

name: Elemental Seance
overview: commune with and control the elemental spirits of nature, and allow them to manifest physically.
description: Spirits of the four elements exist all throughout nature, protecting and preserving pieces of their respective elements. Those who wield this power, called Druidic Elementalists or DEs, have the ability to commune with these spirits. In return for helping them to preserve and heal nature, they will assist you. They each posses properties of their elements. A special ability DEs posses is to manifest them physically so that they may assist you. They may also merge with them, but this is a rarity.
pros: You can heal and protect nature.
You have elemental spirits that can aid you in many things, both physical and mental.
You may always have a friend in nature.
cons: You have to make a deal with them to be able to gain their trust and help.
Manifesting them physically takes a lot of energy and may make you tired.
They may turn on you if you go back on your word.

name: Muscular Enhancement
overview: have increased muscular power.
description: With this power, all your muscles gain a much greater degree of strength without being bigger. A child with this could easily lift two hundred pounds. You can also run, jump and climb faster and longer because your muscles won't tire out as easily. You can rip sheet metal. You also live longer because your smooth muscles work better and your respiratory and cardiovascular muscles keep you going longer. Your muscles are also immune to tranquilizers.
pros: Live for hundreds of years.
Almost no effort needed for physical hard work.
Take longer to tire out.
cons: Not a long-range attack power.
Immune to muscle relaxants at doctors.

name: Psionic Blast
overview: blast powerful psychic energy.
description: Using this power, you can blast psychic energy at a person or group of people. This energy psychically attacks the mind causing either pain, memory loss, unconsciousness to even brain death if you use that much power. The downside is it takes great mental concentration and it is possible to easily exhaust yourself. Also, you cannot read or communicate psychically, its just used for offensive and defensive attacks.
pros: Attack people's minds.
cons: Takes great  focus.
Easily become fatigued and weak if you used too much power.
Not telepathic.

name: Psychic Aim
overview: have have psychic premonition of your targets in order to perfectly strike them
description: It's almost like "spider-sense" or the movie Next with a twist. You get a glimpse of the future of your target and where they will be. So you already know where to shoot or kick or punch, hitting them perfectly. It mostly just works in danger-type situations, like combat. The vision, which seems long, is really a micro-blink. You also just have normal reflex so you barley miss getting hit cause of your power. The ability works up to a mile radius all around.
pros: Can predict where to shoot
Fight your intended target perfectly
cons: Only works in combat
Psychic vision up to mile radius
Normal reflexes. You only dodge attacks because of premeditated knowledge

name: Location Memory
overview: learn what had happened in the past at any location.
description: Just by being in an area, you instantly learn everything that had happened in that square mile in the past year. You can dim it down so it does not distract you but you can not turn it off.
pros: Be an awsome detective.
Learn what you forgot about the party last night.
Find out who stole your car and where they went.
cons: No physical ability.
Going to public restrooms.
Still having to go find your stolen car.

name: Significance Manipulation
overview: change the amount of importance or desirability of anything.
description: This ability can rearrange the importance or desirability any living thing, any object, any concept, and anything else including the user. The user could make make the ugliest of men the most desirable or the president to be as important as a bug that was squash. This ability can get specific in what thing is important to certain group. In a fight, the user can make their attack so significant in an universal prospective that it causes more damage than it should.
pros: Make anything important or desirable
Make anything unimportant or undesirable
Can increase damage of one's attack by making it significant.
cons: Changing the desirability of anything too high will result in magnetic-like attraction.
Changing the significance of anything too low will result in fading from existence.

name: Myth Power: Kronos' Craft
overview: channel Kronos' command over the essence of the passage of time
description: Kronos (Cronos, Cronus, Khronos, Chronos, Chronus), in Greek myth, was the Titan god of time. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically manipulate the flow of time, and psychically travel through time, at will. One can also psychically perform feats of Telepathy and Telekinesis across time, at will. One can even psychically project temporal energy blasts, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically access Chronokinesis and Time Travel, at will
Psychically access Temporal Telepathy and Telekinesis, project Temporal Blasts, at will
cons: Temporal anomalies and paradoxes are likely to ensue, if timeline not altered carefully (NCN)
Anachronism, Unpredictability and Attunement to Time provide resistance (NCN)
Time Defiance, MythPowers based on Kronos' parents, siblings and offspring provide immunity (NCN)

name: Essence Conduit
overview: connect to anything that has an essence and create and manipulate a duplicate with your essence.
description: The user can create a telepathic link to all things that have an essence. With the connection, they will be able to create a duplicate of the thing they are connected to with their own essence. Depending on the thing they are copying, the user will lose a certain amount of themselves but will control the duplicate. If the duplicate is destroyed, the original will not die for it is the users essence. You will be restored in the process.
pros: Be connected to all things that have an essense.
Create a duplicate to control.
Can make more than one duplicate as well as have different duplicates at the same time.
cons: Uses a certain amount of essence to create a duplicate.
Beware of using all of your essence.

name: Wormhole Color
overview: create wormholes with paint.
description: It's as simple as taking a can of paint and splashing it on the wall! If you make a similar painting somewhere else, you have a wormhole connecting the two markings. The colors have to match to each other, meaning you can have 2 wormholes per color shade. If you paint more,it cancels the first one you made. You can determine it the paint should be a wormhole or not.
pros: Teleport to places you've already been.
Other people can't go through unless you're touching them.
Get away from situations with a splash of color.
cons: You need paint.
You also need to paint in the location you're heading to.
People grabbing onto you can use the portal.

name: Shadow Wrap
overview: have the shadows wrap around one's forearms in order to protect oneself
description: With this power shadows wrap around your forearms and will harm anything that comes near you with hostile intent. You cannot control the shadows in any way as they are automatically controlled by your mind's desire to protect itself.
pros: A good defensive power.
Don't need to concentrate to use this power.
cons: Can't control the shadows protecting you.
The shadows automatically attack anyone with hostile intent nearby even if it is not towards you.

name: Nonexistence
overview: move outside of space-time, giving the impression of not existing.
description: This is the temporal ability to erase oneself from the time-space continuum, and thus not be bound to the "boundaries" of what is physically possible in the material realm (it would only allow defiance of space and time, and the like, not things like Summoning or Reality Bending). Not to mention, all memory of the user will be erased (they will not appear in pictures or prophecies, and there will be no evidence of their existence other than their presence), until they phase back into space-time.
pros: Immunity to time manipulation, bodily alteration, reality bending and recording devices (no traces).
Loss of bodily needs to eat, drink, sleep and breathe.
Defy space-time (walk up walls, teleport, leave people's memories when you leave their presence).
cons: People with Chronokinesis can make this permanent.
Might get annoying if people forget who you are as soon as you leave their presence.
Makes robberies and such too easy (MIGHT get boring).

name: Force Of Balance
overview: balance and unbalance various things
description: Balance is a force to be reckoned with. When a part of our world is unbalanced, it has a certain effect. For example, when you unbalance the energy in the air, it will re-balance itself, and doing so, will discharge energy, in the form of heat or, if enough energy is disturbed, lightning. Or you could unbalance the land and cause earthquakes, or unbalance the functions of the body, and cause disease and sickness.
pros: Can control a force of nature
Very powerful and has many uses
cons: If you can't control your powers, you could destroy everything

name: Mystical Hourglass
overview: become a paragon until the sand in the hourglass finishes
description: The user with this special hourglass pendant, that can be rotated for the sands of time to count down, can be a paragon until the time runs out. After that, the user must turn back the hourglass in the other direction and wait until the sands of time count downs again before using it again. Usually the power would last for an hour, and the time taken to recharge the power will also take an hour
pros: You are a paragon.
Can go head to head with most powerhouses.
cons: When the time runs out, you are in deep trouble
Takes the same to restore the user's power

name: Sound Displacement
overview: take away sound produced by anything and place that sound anywhere
description: A person with this power can remove the sound produced by any action including speaking. They can remove the sound of their footsteps and even the sound of an explosion. In addition they can then place the sound that they captured in a new location. They do not need to place the sound immediately somewhere else and can store the sound for prolonged periods of time.
pros: Completely silent movement--useful for sneaking around
Can later place that sound anywhere--misdirection
Protection against sonic based attacks
cons: Needs practice to use effectively

name: Choshech (Darkness)
overview: do everything a thousand times better.
description: Black smoke clouds cover your body filling your lungs and everything you do is done a thousand times faster, stronger, and more powerful. For example, you can run 1000 mph, your skin can become as tough as concrete, you can also jump a thousand miles farther. Those are just some of the things this power has to offer.
pros: Can run at 1000 mph
Skin is as tough as concrete
Are 1000 times stronger than you already are
cons: You might hurt someone by accident with this power

name: Digital Power Acquisition
overview: digitally acquire superpowers via a neural implant.
description: By implanting a wireless neural implant in the brain, the user can 'program' their body (with a computer) to acquire superpowers. Based on this code, the implant constructs synthetic viruses to take the modified genes to the body, thereby imbuing the power. Any mistakes in the code could be fatal, but the implant can also convert from power to code, thus creating a central database of working abilities. The imbuing process is long and painful, though, 11+ hours and a lot of pain. Is it worth it?
pros: No limit to the amount of powers you can obtain.
The type of power limited only by your programming knowledge.
If a partner has this you can share abilities.
cons: Imbuing process is long and painful.
Quite easy to make mistakes in the coding, so must be heavily debugged.
Technopaths. This power can be Self-Negated to defend against this though.

name: Full Frequency Hearing
overview: hear anything being broadcast on any frequency with your own ears.
description: You can tune your ears sort of like a radio. You can have normal hearing or change your ears to a different frequency to pick up police radio and even cell phone conversations. You need to develop the skill to be able to use it correctly. You cannot broadcast yourself, you can only listen to what others are broadcasting.
pros: You will never need a radio again.
You can listen to people's cell phone conversations.
You can hear what police are doing.
cons: Takes a few weeks to learn how to tune out some broadcasts.
People might be afraid to talk on a cell phone if they know you are nearby.
You cannot broadcast yourself.

name: Gravitational Attraction
overview: create gravitational attraction between yourself and anything you want.
description: This ability allows you to create a gravitational attraction between yourself and anything you want to attract. The attracted object will rotate around you no matter how heavy it is.
pros: You can make anything rotate around you and use it as a protection against incoming attacks.
cons: You can't really manipulate the speed of the objects circling around you.

name: Luck Steal
overview: steal people's luck through touch and give luck to other people
description: A person with this power has the ability to steal people's good luck and fortune and give it to other people. Their right hand steals luck while their left hand gives luck. Thus the user needs to wear gloves all the time to prevent accidentally transferring luck around.
pros: Perfect assasin-people die by natural causes/accidents
Can use stolen luck to give yourself luck or give others luck
cons: You have wear gloves on your hands
You need to touch people to use this power

name: Reforming Psionic Entity
overview: create a body from the surrounding environment
description: When this power activated, your human body was disintegrated and you became an incorporeal psionic entity as your true form. You automatically telekinetically draw in and hold together objects from nearby surroundings to form a new humanoid body, such as sand, water, earth, plants and masonry.  When this body is destroyed, you automatically begin to make another one. Your appearance stays very similar, you just appear to be made of a mix of debris. When angry, you create a larger, stronger form.
pros: You are now immortal. If you are destroyed physically, you rebuild yourself
Your environmental forms have advantages, e.g. steel muscles, rock skin
Cannot tire as you have no actual muscles, and cannot get ill or age
cons: You will no longer be able to pass as a human
Cannot commit suicide if immortality becomes too much
Cannot taste food, experience touch, etc.

name: Toonforce
overview: warp reality to create comedic effects
description: With this power, you can warp reality for comedic effects, defying every law in existence for the sake of laughter. You can do anything as long as it is funny. Thus, the only limit to this power is if the action is funny. You can also interrupt fights with funny intermonologue and you can break the 4th wall. You also get a hammerspace full of objects to induce laughter. You can also survive getting flattened like a pancake. This power can only be used when someone else is present.
pros: Be like Bugs Bunny
Virtually unstoppable unless facing a superior toonforcer
cons: You can only use this power in the presence of others
You need to be partially insane to use this power correctly
Sometimes you will look ridiculous, but you are supposed to be

name: Alert Spheres
overview: generate stationary energy orbs that will strike any moving object.
description: There is not much to say about this ability. The user produces the orbs that stay where the user places them mentally. When any moving object comes near it, they will be triggered and attack the object. They also make a thunderous sound to warn the user.
pros: Good guards
Warns you
cons: Will not move when placed
Cannot make exceptions, also strikes allies

name: Shadowveil
overview: create an area made of complete darkness
description: This is like Tosen's bankai from Bleach. This lets the person create a black dome or sphere around them and makes everyone not touching the user of this power lose 4 of their 5 senses (only one you keep is touch)... It is a repeating dome so you cant just keep running in a line to escape it
pros: They lose almost all of their senses unless they can find you and keep hold of you
You can make everyone trapped in it practically useless while you and anyone touching you are fine
Can make your opponents fear you (especially when scared of the dark) and gain great advantage
cons: A big shadow dome thing is rather obvious that something is happening there
Its around yourself and made of darkness so you cant see out until you end it
Anybody that goes in cant leave till its dropped and lose senses unless touching you

name: Static Strength
overview: gain power and strength from feeding off electricity
description: With this ability, by touching electricity, you can consume it and gain strength. Your body also thrives with electricity, giving you a chance that you may shock someone. Feeding off large amounts of electricity will allow you to perform extremely powerful and electrical attacks. If you feed on too much electricity, you may hunger more and more for electricity until the hunger becomes unstoppable.
pros: Electricity gives you a boost in physical strength, and also gives you a lot of static.
It sometimes has a nice taste to it.
cons: Feeding off electricity is addictive.
You could accidentally give someone a shock, even while not fully-powered.

name: Empathic Self Healing
overview: heal yourself by transfering the wound or illness to another person.
description: By using this ability, the person can transfer any wound or illness they have to another person as long as they are near them.
pros: Can hurt anyone you don't like by harming yourself.
cons: Have to transfer it onto another person.
The person using this ability still feels pain.

name: Genetic Break Through
overview: change one part of your genetic code forever.
description: This ability allows the person to see their genetic code and change one part of it permanently. Like, for example, someone could change their code to keep on growing the rest of their life. Another example is that a person could change their code to continually raise the percentage of their brainpower. This ability is so life changing that you can do it only once.
pros: You can unlock a hidden power within your genetic code.
You can change any part of your genetic code.
cons: It is permanent
You can do it only once.

name: Newton's Second Law
overview: control mass and acceleration to create a force.
description: Force is equal to mass times acceleration. With this power you can change the mass or acceleration of an object to change the net force applied to the object. The direction of acceleration can also be controlled in the X Y or Z planes. Mass is harder to change in the object than the acceleration of the object is.
pros: Mass can be increased or decreased in any object without changing volume.
Acceleration can be applied in any direction to move an object
Acceleration can be used to cancel out forces like gravity.
cons: Mass is more difficult to change.
Large changes in mass may hurt the object you are changing.
Will have to take into account the forces already acting on the object.

name: Ambush Detector V2
overview: instantly know if someone is planning on ambushing you
description: With this power you will instantly know if somebody is planning on ambushing you. You don't have to be near the person or even know who the person is but if they want to ambush you a faint beeping will go off in your head and you will know wear the ambush is set up, who planned the ambush and who is part of it.
pros: You will know if someone want to ambush you
cons: Not much use if nobody wants to ambush you

name: Temporary Total Mimicry
overview: take on the form, skills, and powers of another person for an hour
description: A person with Temporary Total Mimicry is to be watched at all costs. They can totally mimic another person: appearance, any skills they may have, and even their superhuman abilities. As such, they are one of the biggest threats to any organization. However, the ability takes some concentration to activate, has a time limit of an hour, and a range of a football field.
pros: Mimic the strongest person there
Absorb all the skills they might have
Even lets you use any powers they may have
cons: Concentration to activate
Time limit of an hour
Range of a football field

name: Forced Choice
overview: force someone's choice.
description: You are able to sense when someone in your vicinity has to make a decision, as well as the choices they have if there are any. You can then force them to select any choice you want. Unless they can detect mental intrusions, the victim will be left with the feeling that they made a free selection, whether it turns out to be a good or a bad one. Even if someone made up their mind about something, the slightest hesitation is an opening to make them change their decision.
pros: Your victim will have the feeling that they made their choice on their own.
You can affect any choice, whether it's talking to a girl, choosing a card, commiting a suicide,...
You can use this power on yourself. It reinforces your determination to do whatever you want to do.
cons: A weak form of persuasion. You can only affect someone if they have a decision to make.
Even if you made up their mind for them, they can still hesitate and change their choice.

name: Hell Jump
overview: jump high and quickly, tearing through any obstacles.
description: This ability allows the user to jump extremely far, extremely quick. Not only that but the user can "rebound" in mid-air to redirect his/herself. Another, and key element of this ability, is that while in use, the person becomes "supercharged", where their atoms spin in place, causing them to "push" away anything in their path, with enough force to rip a man in half, or turn a tank inside out. At the highest level of mastery, the user can wrap through objects/beings, and continue the jump.
pros: Similar to and faster than the Flight ability
Highly offensive ability
Multiple uses.
cons: Extremely hard to control at first.
Hazard to allies unless user is an experianced user. (15 years +)
Uses the users energy.

name: Plasma Knives
overview: use them to stab and shock your enemies.
description: The Plasma Knives are similar to butterfly and automatic knives, but you can shock your opponetns with them. You coluld also charge them up and fire plasma-bolts with them.
pros: Can use them like a combination of taser and knives.
cons: Not a good thing against water-type foes.

name: Entity Inability
overview: freeze a living person/entity into a state where they can't do anything.
description: With this ability, you can freeze a living person or entity, disabling their ability to act in any way. All of their senses will be turned off - basically it's as if they're not alive. Once in this state, it cannot be reversed unless the user reverses the effect, or the state wears off. (Depending on skill level, it can take 5 hours to a month for it to wear off. )
pros: Freeze someone in motion to make an escape.
They can be moved. You could think of them as either 'dead' or paralyzed. It's a mix of the two.
You can do whatever you choose to them while they're in this state. *Eheheheh*
cons: Effect wears off either when the user chooses it to, or when it wears off. (Varies by skill level)
Not one of the most 'moral' powers in the world. (Lol)

name: Appearance Alteration
overview: physically alter the appearance of other individuals
description: An Appearance Alterer is a government coup waiting to happen. They can reshape skin, hair, and vocal cords any way they want to; no color is beyond them. They literally smooth out someone's face, making it blank, then rebuild it in whatever pattern they please. They can also affect other parts of the body too, adding tattoos, adding or taking away hair, or even adding animal parts (claws, fur, etc.). The effect lasts for 48 hours, can be removed by extreme trauma, and cannot be used on yourself.
pros: Creating spies that look like people in the establishment
Making women hotter
Able to add claws, spines, etc. as weapons
cons: Lasts for 48 hours
Can be removed by extreme trauma
Cannot be used on yourself

name: Arcana: 1 The Magician
overview: learn how to manipulate energy.
description: With this ability, you have the capacity to manipulate any kind of energy after you figure how. This means repeated observation of the energy. Watching it naturally (a fire or lighting) could take weeks. A faster method is observing someone manipulating it. Once the power is learned, you don't gain the control most get. You have to learn how to control it. The upside is that there is virtually no limit to how strong the manipulation can get. You can go from lighting matches to burning cities.
pros: Learn any kind of energy manipulation.
Use kinetic energy to use super-strength, Biological Energy for healing, even Psionic Energy.
cons: Can't directly manipulate matter.
Can't learn all kinds of super powers.
Can take a while to learn the ones you want to learn.

name: Pack Invulnerability
overview: be part of a group and only being able to be hurt or killed as a group.
description: This is the power the flickerspawn have. This power requires at least one other person you trust and has trust in you. This power will work for up to five other people. This power won't work if you or a member of your group already has an invulnerability. This power works by touching each member of your group. All of you now are invulnerable. For someone to kill one of you or hurt one of you, your entire group has to be hurt or killed at the same time.
pros: Great for a team of heroes.
Great if one of your team can turn invisible or teleport.
Great if everyone on the team has super speed.
cons: Bad for a team of villains.
Bad if your team is fighting in close quarters.

name: Eco Grow
overview: touch any plant and have it come to life
description: Make flowers bloom and trees grow big and strong. With this power with the touch of your hand any dead flower or plant and watch it come to life at an alarming rate.
pros: Help grow a garden
Help stop global warming
Grow your pumpkin REALLY BIG for the pumpkin contest :)
cons: Requires touch

name: Love Manipulation
overview: manipulate love and hypnotize people with your beauty.
description: Love is one of the most powerful powers because it can destroy people and make them only focused on love. You can make yourself and others attractive and you can make people fall in love. You can also sense when people are in love and when they are not. See, love is like a magnet; with this power you can have an army of people willing to do anything for you even if it kills them.
pros: Can get anything you want
Can get hot guys or girls
Can be really attractive
cons: You have to face havings thousands of people coming up to you a day
Your beauty can make people do anything for you

name: Music Induced Abilities
overview: gain different abilities by listening to different types of music
description: Music holds power over all of us. A person with Music-Induced Abilities takes that to the next level. When they listen to music, they develop an ability that varies with the genre of music. Translation? Classical music lets them create Force-Fields, dance music grants them Luminescence, rock lets them Induce Explosions, blues lets them Phase, metal gives them Super-Strength, etc. The ability ends as soon as the song ends, and it takes a while to kick in at first.
pros: Put your iPod to good use
Different genres grant different abilities
Surprise factor
cons: Ends with the song
Takes a few seconds to kick in
Loving the ability the genre gives you but hating the music

name: Were Anything
overview: change into anything you desire under a full moon
description: You can be anything or anyone ... if there is a full moon. You could change into a werewolf, but why stop there? Why not change into a super(hu)man? a super werewolf with wings and a suit of armor? Don't get carried away, because you could end up being an Abomination for the night.
pros: Be anything
You could be super strong
It doesn't even have to exist
cons: The transformations hurt the first few times
You may not always be in control
You will fell exhausted in the morning.

name: Velocity Displacement
overview: transfer the speed and direction of one object to another object
description: The user is able to transfer and/or manipulate the speed and direction of any moving object. This ability has two specific targets, the initial object and the target object. The initial object must be moving for this ability to take effect, whereas the target may or may not be moving. The magnitude of this ability lies solely upon the initial objects velocity. The user can change the direction, but not how fast. This also negates the target's previous velocity, allowing complete control.
pros: Can move with unbeliveable speed
Can force objects to be repelled, shifted, or become stationary at a moment's notice
The user can combine multiple velocities into a single velocity
cons: The initial object MUST be moving
Cannot change the speed, only its direction and the object it affects
Stopping a jet in mid-flight isn't the best idea

name: Electron Kinesis
overview: control electrons for various effects
description: A person with this power has the ability to control electrons. They can utilize electrons from any element. However, it is more difficult to remove electrons from noble gasses. They cannot control elements themselves, only electrons. However, even with that limitation, they can still do many things. They can create static electricity by transferring electric charges. They can also induce chemical reactions. Also, they can bend electrons to create an electron cannon.
pros: Can make static electricity by transferring charges between atoms
Cause reactions to occur
Can bend electrons to create an electron cannon
cons: Not immune to own shocks
Cannot control electric charge, only direct it
Needs a calm mind to control electrons correctly

name: Fractal Crystalline Body
overview: become a crystalline form with fractal abilities.
description: You have all the strengths and weakness of a living crystalline being plus fractal abilities. You regrow any lost body mass and any lost body mass grows into another you. Your new selves have your intelligence but are your slaves and share your fractal abilities. Shattered into 500 pieces you grow a new body and you have 499 new allies. If for some reason you switch back to human form or have this power negated, your crystal clones vanish.
pros: You become an army if someone inflicts damage on you or you jump off a tall building.
It requires total destruction or your existence being erased to kill you.
cons: A power that can freeze, banish or trap you without damaging you.
Someone who could control or manipulate your crystalline body.
Any power that can stop you from damaging yourself.

name: Fractal Shard Burst
overview: shoot a burst of fractal crystalline shards from your hand.
description: With this power, besides the initial cutting damage, any shards that pierce flesh will grow inward into the flesh of an opponent as daggers. These daggers shatter if touched or moved or if the victim moves around causing each shard to grow into a new dagger. The only way to safely remove a dagger is by teleporting it from the victim or targeting the dagger with a pinpoint attack that will destroy it in one piece. This power has an effective range of 300 ft. You are immune to this power.
pros: Effectively paralyse a foe you hit with this attack.
One dagger can grow into 50 or 60 daggers.
Regeneration may work in a way to cause daggers to grow in an opponent.
cons: Regeneration might work to eject a dagger from an opponent.
Opponents immune to an attack of this nature.

name: Movement Stopping
overview: prevent someone from completing a movement.
description: With this power, you can prevent someone from flexing specific muscles, causing them to stop dead in their track when they attempt to move these muscles. You can even disable complex actions, such as snapping one's fingers, opening a bottle or flipping the finger. You can only prevent voluntary movements, so you can't stop someone's heart, involuntary breathing or reflexes. However, you need to actively keep the effect going, or else, it will wear off.
pros: You can even affect the muscles involved in the voice, to impede their speech.
Many powers require you to do certain gestures or actions, which you can easily prevent.
cons: You can only affect voluntary movements.
You need to actively concentrate to stop your target's movements.

name: Quick Fix
overview: correct a mistake if you realize it soon enough.
description: Have you ever accidentally knocked over something fragile, or blurted out something you did not mean to, and then instantly realize the mistake you made? With this power you can correct the mistake you made without any consequences. As long as you realize the mistake within a couple seconds of it occurring you can warp reality to make the right outcome occur. If you do not realize your mistake soon enough then this power has no effect.
pros: Fix your accidents.
Never blurt out the wrong things.
Warp reality to create the correct outcome.
cons: Have to realize the mistake you made.
If you do not realize soon enough then this power has no effect.
If you think that you could never make a mistake then this power is useless.

name: Hallucagenic Lygotation
overview: create an overwhelming darkness that brings out a person's worst fear, making them hallucinate.
description: Creates darkness around a person, making the world seem "pitch black." They then are haunted by their worst fears. The caster may use it on more then one person if they have enough training using it. The victim will die if killed by a hallucination. (They will die in the way the hallucination kills the victim. Only way to stop this power is by having Telekenetic powers, or to reverse the casting.)
pros: Easily trainable.
Manipulative.
Great for super villans
cons: Unstable at times.
The power can be reversed.
You cannot move while casting.

name: Arachnomancy
overview: control arachnids for attack, perception and seeing through time.
description: You have three benefits with this ability. One. You can study the web patterns of the spiders and see a short distance into the future/past. Two. You can summon and control the actions of a horde of spiders. The horde can be a mixed bag of different species and genders. Your power stops any natural behavior that would prevent a mixed horde of spiders from working with each other. Thirdly, you can share the senses of and communicate psychically/empathically with any spider.
pros: Command massive hordes of arachnids (not just spiders, if you develop your ability).
You can look at a web and see a brief distance into the future or the past.
Sense what arachnids sense, communicate with them psychically and empathically
cons: Spiders are easily squished.
All spiders don't have deadly poison.
You'll need to find a free or cheap source of insects to feed your spider horde.

name: Soul Invasion
overview: exist as a soul that can invade and control other bodies.
description: With this power, you can inhabit any soul-carrying vessel (body) and passively share its experiences or take direct control. Upon transfer, your memories and knowledge are carried with you, and you can acquire the knowledge and memories of your host. You can choose to passively join the other soul in its vessel, temporarily take control, or forcibly eject (and therefore kill) the other soul. You can exist outside of a vessel until you find one to inhabit.
pros: Immortality
Possibility of complete domination over others
Ability to be whoever you want
cons: No body of your own
Limited by the physique of your host
No personal identity unless you live as someone long enough

name: Shadow Guardian
overview: use Darkforce energy through your Shadow Guardian
description: You unconsciously give life to a Shadow Guardian as a result of your mental energy being uncapped. This Guardian will protect you by any means necessary so Guardian control via thought command is a must if you didn't want it to kill. You can merge with your Guardian and share its darkforce energy which allows for numerous shadow-based abilities, such as shadow slipping. A byproduct of this power is a passive mind over matter ability which gives you an extremely high pain threshold.
pros: A Guardian that protects you at all times
Use of darkforce
cons: Difficulty in controlling an angry Guardian
Your Guardian can influence your personality
Your Guardian isn't bound by morality

name: Astral Shape Shifting
overview: transform into ALL forms of spirits
description: The person changes into ALL supernatural forms of life. The user can turn into a ghost or spirit (without experiencing death) to explore the Spirit World and come back to the normal world at will. The user can also transform into the spirits of the Elements. The user can also become an angel, a demon, a grey spirit and (temporarily) an Immortal being that can shake hands with Deities. Commonly the ones who practice "Spiritual Converse" (strongly enough) are more likely to receive this gift.
pros: The user can be a source of vast energy to living things and the Elements.
The user can receive knowledge and more powers from these realms.
If the person is powerful enough, He/She can take a spirit of the deceased back to the normal world.
cons: It drains the user's energy (temporarily). And they lose more body mass.
The realm of Elemental spirits and nature spirits is very hard to get the hang of.
If the user dwells too long as a spirit, the physical aspect fades away and will never come back.

name: Sugar Rush
overview: gain heightened strength, speed, stamina, reflexes and agility with the consumption of sugar
description: One with this ability is often considered quite the lucky dog. With every bit of sugar they intake, they will only get stronger, faster and more durable. And if they take in enough, they will go into a berserker rage that tears through most foes with relative ease. Not to mention, they can intake sugar to regenerate, and no sugar they ingest will affect the body negatively (no diabetes, no tooth decay).
pros: Sugar you intake increases your strength, speed, durability, stamina and reflexes
Ingesting sugar heals you (and you can never get any disease/condition from high sugar intake)
If you intake enough sugar, it sends you into a berserker rage that can take out really strong foes
cons: Berserker rage is just like ANY berserker rage (dangerous for friend AND foe)
After the berserker rage, you crash HARD
You can still be in trouble if your sugar is too LOW

name: Writers Faith
overview: make anything that is written come true and happen with your faith.
description: This power gives you the ability to make anything and everything that is written or that you wrote come true and happen no matter what, whenever you want, after you write down the words "For With God All Things Are Possible! " Note: in order to be able to use this power, you have to have faith in God, the Father who gave his one and only son to save us from the wages of sin, thus the reason for the words.
pros: This power will work on any medium, whether it is paper and pen, a computer, a wall, etc.
Need faith in God, the Father, to make this power work.
Can make anything that is written or you wrote come true and happen.
cons: Atheists are never able to use this power.
Have to be careful what you write for it will come true.
Words "For With God All Things Are Possible! " have to be exact. Including the " ".

name: Aerial Combustion
overview: make air explode.
description:
You aim, you focus(think the air explodes) and it explodes! 
Although you can only do this once every 289 minutes, it is possible to destroy anything as long as you have a visual feed of the location, for example camera feed is sufficient. WARNING : The explosion reaches as far as your sight so if you trigger the explosion from your own eyes, you might want to be behind a shield.
pros: You can make air just go boom!
Perfect for hitting people who have shields, as long as there is air behind that shield.
Air is everywhere so you can pretty much make any location go kabooom!
cons: Selfdamage is possible.
Useless in space.
Does not pentrate shields but explodes from within the shield so don't aim next to your victim.

name: Memory Force
overview: generate memories and emotions into force.
description: Using all your memories and emotions, you can send all of it to your palm and send out a blast of energy.
pros: You can use good memories and happiness as a shield.
You can also use a memory and emotion to increase your agility.
You can also use a memory and or emotion to increase your speed.
cons: Using too much force and memories can make you tired for a few minutes.
Using it on machines can malfunction a machine and may even destroy it.

name: Elemental Shield
overview: create a shield of natural elements
description: With this ability, you are able to create a shield of nateral elements. Don't be upset if you're thinking that all you can do is create a shield, because you can take chunks of your shield and toss them like missles at your opponent. You can also create shields for things other than yourself. Wind can be created at your feet to make you fly. Don't forget that you can mix elements like water and earth to create mud.
pros: You can block almost anything
You can escape attacks
cons: You can only use elements that you are around.
Each shield has a weakness

name: Bullet Of Compression
overview: store compressed things in your hands and shoot them
description: You can absorb anything into your hands (five objects each) that gets stored in each of your fingers (thumb included). Then, at will, you can open up the "cap" on the end of your finger and either fire the compressed object like a bullet, of just let it fall out. With the latter, you can then return to normal size the object you compressed without having any harm be done to it.
pros: Shoot bullets from your fingers: "finger gun"
Can store anything in a compressed space
Can absorb any solid (including bullets that somebody else shot or somrthing they threw)
cons: Can only store 5 things
If you get your finger cut off, it won't work for that finger (you lose storage space permanately)
It has to be absorbed through your hans, so don't get those cut off...

name: Sensikinesis
overview: control the senses of other people.
description: Sensikinesis is the ability to control the physical and mental senses of other people. This comes in very handy when fighting a superhero, or villain, that relies on his/her senses for their abilities. Superstreght, for example uses the sense of touch. Say you where to take away their sense of touch, their powers would be rendered useless. It would be considered "Unfair" if you where dueling someone with hand-to-hand combat, it would be cheating to make your senses unparalell.
pros: You could blind a whole room to escape a sticky situation.
You could paralise a person set on destroying you.
You could greatly increase your senses so you would be a unparalell fighter.
cons: It takes a little to work, and do again. Much like you have to wait for it to recharge
If you increase your senses too much you could be too confident and misjudge your opponent.
Your powers ware off if you leave them for too long. About 6-7 hours they will last.

name: Missiles
overview: cause missiles of any size to hit wherever you want
description: With this power you can cause missiles of any size or power to hit anything or anyone you want. You are immune to the effects of the missiles you create; this includes the explosion and, if there is any, nuclear radiation.
pros: You can make missiles of any size or power level to hit whatever you want
You are immune to the effects of your missiles
cons: You can still be hurt by other missiles
You might accidentally hurt innocent people with your missiles

name: Phenomena Rejection
overview: reverse time and space anywhere with in 5 km radius.
description: One night, you are walking late after a midnight party with your friends. You talk about the future and all that stuff. Suddenly, a mugger comes and tries to mug you. Your best friend fights him and he gets shot. Wouldn't it be great to have this power. It consists of rejecting any events by warping time with in a barrier. Its combined with memory reversal, time reverstion, barrier, and erasure of matter.
pros: You can avoid death
protect your feveryone you love
Save humanity.
cons: Be death
Be excluded by family and friends
Eradicate humanity.

name: Age Control
overview: age or de-age a person by touch
description: This power through touch allows you to age a person till they are dead & dust or de-age to genetic ooze & anywhere in between. Either way, you absorb & extend your lifespan & minorly de-age yourself.
pros: Control over age in another person
Extend your lifespan
Minor de-age in yourself
cons: Has to touch & hold a person for the power to work

name: Stasis Field Projection
overview: project stasis fields and control them
description: A person with this power can be the best neutralizer. While this power can be used offensively to create swords and other weapons, the main function is to trap and capture targets. You can use the field as a forcefield or you can wrap it around a target to freeze them in time. When frozen, they will not age and you can maneuver the bubble of frozen time. The stasis field also acts similar to an EMP which prevents nearby electronics from functioning. People in stasis can be revived later.
pros: Stasis fields have near infinite durability and you can use it as a weapon
Can neutralize anything surrounded by stasis field-they are frozen in time
Can act as an EMP
cons: If you put yourself in full stasis, it will be very hard to get you back
The stasis field requires concentration from the user
You cannot attack people in stasis fields, they are protected by your barrier

name: Psychic Photography
overview: capture people's secrets on photographs.
description: When you take pictures of someone, their deepest secrets show up on the photographs as a colorful cloud twirling around them with relevant pictures and words in it. The cloud reflects the nature of the secrets and the person's feelings. A thin part represents doubts or suspicions. A massive part represents a heavy or important secret. Dark colors are for shame, guilt or sick intentions. Light colors are for lightheartedness or innocent secrets. Bright colors are for important promises or vows.
pros: Every paparazzi and tabloid's dream.
Discover anyone's secrets.
Works with any type of camera.
cons: The results are not always explicit and are open to interpretations.
The target has to be isolated in the picture or there will be clusters of secrets.

name: Negative Energy Absorption
overview: absorb and/or generate negative energy.
description: This ability allows one to absorb negative energy and redirect it if chosen.
pros: You can absorb other's negative emotions
You can purge others from negative energy and thoughts
You can redirect the absorbed energy as an energy blast
cons: If used too much, one can become overhelmed by negative energy and become evil

name: Splicer
overview: splice anything together.
description: The Splicer ability allows you to splice any thing living or non-living together. You can choose the new species' traits, defects and abilities.
pros: You can make new species.
You can make the species' traits the way you want.
The species doesn't have to be all alive.
cons: It could be uncontrollable.
It may not survive.

name: Gift: Summons
overview: be gifted at summoning powers
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at using summoning powers than other beings. Thus their summoning powers are better than most other being's powers and it is harder to unsummon their summoned beings. However, someone with this power can only recieve summoning powers, nothing else.
pros: Almost no one is as good at summoning as someone with this power.
Summons are harder to undo.
cons: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the unsummoning aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only summoning powers now.

name: Librarian
overview: instantly summon any known book to hand
description: Can summon any book to hand that person is aware of- has either seen it, knows specifically what it's called or what it is. Can also choose to return or keep the specific book after summoned.
pros: Instant source of information
More robust books can be utilised as a weapon in a pinch
cons: Limited to the books the person is aware of
Limited help in dealing directly with villans

name: System Manipulation
overview: manipulate and control any and all systems.
description: A system is a set of interacting or interdependent entities forming an integrated whole. Put simply, this means different things working together for a purpose. Many, many things fall under this, if not all things. Now, all power must have boundaries and limits. The limits of this power is that the user must have a basic understanding of the system to be able to control it. For example, you could control your genetics because biology is a system.
pros: A lot of power
Can do almost anything
cons: You must have a basic understanding of the system you' want to control.

name: Immutability
overview: resist all unnatural physical change
description: One with this ability cannot be transformed into another form, genetically altered, shrunk, expanded, weighed down or affected by Obliteration or Reality Bending. All attempts to do so are null and void. In addition, he cannot be vaporized, liquefied or the like. His body is entirely resistant to unnatural change (even magical body alteration). However, he can still age, and is still vulnerable to conventional harm (guns, knives, bad comedy).
pros: Your body is immune to powers like Biokinesis, vampiric or therianthropic conversion, etc.
Cannot be aged, de-aged or reduced in intelligence, looks, or size
Cannot be vaporized, liquefied or affected by Reality Bending directly
cons: Still vulnerable to normal harm
Still age
Still feel pain

name: Aura Wolves
overview: create wolves from one's own aura
description: The wolves look as though they are not fully solid, but they are fully capable of ripping an enemy apart tooth and nail. Their coloring differs dependent on what one's aura is like and they have their own personalities. Also the wolves cannot go outside the radius of where one's aura can be felt.
pros: A giant aura radius.
The wolves can be great allies and companions.
cons: Having the power No Aura.

name: Georegeneration
overview: be a huminoid rock hero who can heal using surrounding minerals
description: A hero who is constructed out of rock or some other mineral can heal oneself using nearby minerals. Its appearance would then be changed depending on the mineral used. As an example, if asphalt is used in the healing process, a stronger, black body would be constructed. After a certain amount of time, the new body would shed away, leaving the default rock body underneath.
pros: Potential immortality
cons: Finding yourself broken without any nearby minerals

name: Master Of The Will
overview: survive through will
description: A more accurate way of describing this is the ability to not only continue to live but fight, exercise,think and so on through sheer will power. These people could be completely burned, frozen paralyzed, on deathbed, smashed, virtually anything and still have the strength to get up. Mental attacks are difficult, if not impossible due to this willpower. These people will never stop till their goal is complete.
pros: Form of immortality
Dangerous even with body in pieces
Looks at the worst situation without fear
cons: Won't look to good missing an arm and your legs
Give up and you die
May be covered with stitches

name: Shadow Shield
overview: wield a shield which can control shadows/darkness
description: You are able to call forth a shield which can control the shadows and darkness. You can teleport through shadows and make them come to life. You also get night vision in dark places. You can only do this when you wield the shield. Your powers are stronger at night.
pros: You can teleport through shadows
You can control shadows
You get night vision in dark places
cons: You need to wield the shield to have the powers
You are only stronger at night
Your weakness is Light

name: Amalgamative Touch
overview: combine many different entities or objects into one.
description: Whenever you touch something, be it a person or an object that entity will pulse with a green surge of electricity every few seconds until you come into contact with another entity. An ominous green light will fade in and out from the two points of contact until you bring your hands together, at which point the two chosen objects will float towards each other and either fuse completely making something new or fuse partially so both functions may still be used.
pros: Make new animals or objects from already existing stuff.
No need for glue.
Make everything better and more efficient.
cons: When you disassemble or destroy something you have fused, you experience some backlash.
Puts some strain on your mind.
Other people can use the things you fuse.

name: Singularity Beam
overview: generate a beam from your hand that duplicates the effects of a black hole core.
description: The beam will destroy anything made of normal matter or energy. It won't affect anything that is immune to changes in the laws of physics or things that defy the laws of physics. Hence, immutability and physics rejector will protect the user from this beam. Invulnerability would also stop this power. Someone who is intangible in some way would also be unaffected. The beam will destroy a foe made of air or energy and keep going until it hits something solid or liquid which will stop the beam.
pros: Destroy anything made of normal matter or energy.
The beam only stops when it hits something solid or liquid.
cons: Someone with immutability, quantum intangibility, space-time indemnity, physics rejector,
Invulnerability or any powers that are similar to these powers.
Any foe who isn't made of normal matter or energy.

name: Surpass Strength
overview: gain more strength when confronting an enemy or object.
description: This is an ability that will even give Superman a hard time. This ability allows the user to gain strength to when fighting an opponent or obstacle and continue to gain more until they gain enough to crush them  You'll be able to take down any strong guys, even if those guys were actually stronger than you.
pros: Able to defeat strong opponents.
Able to crush objects.
cons: The only way to gain more strength is to go hand-to-hand with the enemy or object.
Trying to handle mind-blowing weight could result in a full body strain.

name: Light/Darkness Expansion
overview: feel the faint amount of goodness/evilness in someone's heart and expand it
description: This power only works if you have a considerably good or bad alignment. In that case, you can scan any individual's heart to look for a small amount of goodness (if they are not on the good side) or evilness (if they are not on the dark side). If there is some, you can amplify it a lot so that person gets a total change of alignment. You can even use this power to know which alignment someone really is and if someone is a traitor.
pros: Works on neutral individuals too.
Easily recruit people to the good/dark side.
cons: Only works if you have a huge amount of goodness/evilness in your heart.
The effects are cancelled if you die or if you lose your power.

name: Heat Absorption
overview: absorb heat from surroundings and unleash absorbed heat
description: A person with this power has a power similar to Heat Eater but is more advanced. Instead of taking in heat energy for food, the user uses up stored heat energy for the use of releasing it at a later time. The user can control both how much heat they can absorb and how much heat they give off with practice. Also, with practice, the user can manipulate pressure and wind to a certain degree by heating and cooling air.
pros: You can absorb heat from surroundings-causes temperature to be cool or freeze things
Can release stored heat either slowly like a hairdryer or quickly like a heat ray
Can also manipulate pressure/wind with practice
cons: You have to absorb heat first in order to release heat-set pattern in using power
Less useful in cold climates for obvious reasons
Stored heat slowly dissipates from the body when not using the heat for other purposes

name: Universe Control
overview: create black holes and control the universe's celestial objects.
description: You will be able to make black holes, more stars, control where stars and planets are, and if it's too hot outside, you can cool the sun down.
pros: Cool down a sunny day
Make your own constellations
Make your own new inhabitable planets
cons: You might accidentaly destroy the earth if you're not careful!

name: Create Time Loop
overview: put someone or something in an endless and repeating period of time.
description: You can create a personal temporal prison for someone or something. The person or object vanishes and repeats an amount of time chosen by you endlessly... Until the end of time itself.
pros: Enemies gone forever.
End nuclear war.
Eliminate toxic waste.
cons: You have to plan ahead to use this power.
Enemies will try to kill you from a distance.

name: Bending Shield
overview: make attacks go around you instead of through you
description: When activated this power makes long-range physically-based attacks go in a semicircle around you. This prevents the damage from actually affecting you in the first place. This power CANNOT be made to affect mental attacks instead of physical ones and is not passive.
pros: Attacks won't hurt you.
cons: Only affects distance-based attacks.
Does not affect telepathic attacks.
Unaffected by Con Negation and similar powers.

name: Prescience
overview: knowledge of future events before they exist
description: This power enables one knowledge of future events before they even exist. This isn't like your ordinary future-seeing power. No. This specifically says "Knowledge". You are seeing the future. You simply know. You can use this power to tap into any timeline that isn't present or past.
pros: Knowledge of the future
Gain advance technology via recreating them
Be the cool prophet
cons: Like the present. The future always changes
No lamscience or sufsience, future only
Might freak knowing when and how you die

name: The King's Champion
overview: compel a single being to protect and serve you untill killed, in turn, compelling whoever killed it
description: The King's Champion power compells a single individual to become devoted to serving and protecting you permanently. This compulsion lasts untill the champion dies. In the case of the champion being killed, the champion's killer becomes the next individual compelled to be champion. If the champion dies in any other way, or if you kill the champion yourself, you may then compel another individual to become your champion. You may have no more than one champion at any given time.
pros: Always have a champion to protect and serve you.
Each time your champion is killed, you gain a more powerful champion.
Free butler, maid, jester and bodyguard.
cons: This power involves lots of slavery and death.
This power permanently ruins the lives of others.
Champions can be needy with thier compulsion to serve and make sure that you're O. K.

name: View Grower
overview: enlarge or shrink anything in sight
description: When viewing a watermelon you can grow it without the danger of explosion. Or shrink it until you can no longer view it. Using an magnifying glass or microscope enhances powers. You can only grow people evenly. You cannot just increase someone's height, but you can grow a body part such as each leg individually to increase height.
pros: More food for less
Grow peoples body parts; cheap plastic surgery
Enemies can be shrunk to action figure size
cons: Controlling it---overly sensitive power
People wanting you to grow there wifes breast's secretly
Trying to help starving people. Just can't get to them all.

name: Dragon Master
overview: control dragons.
description: With this power you can control the mighty dragons even summon them from anywhere you want. If there a dragon you can control them but only if your stronger than them. If they are stronger than you they can break free and attack you. One who has this power after a time can fashion himself a dragon form with powers that any dragon they have encountered has even modify there own form to there liking in essence they become a dragon with a human form as well.
pros: Can control dragons
Can become a dragon
Can summon dragons
cons: Dragon stronger than you can break free and kill you
May end up hated and or feared by those you care for
Might end up hunted by dragon slayers.

name: Ultimate Armor
overview: materialize an unbreakable armor that provides ultimate protection
description: With the ultimate armor you are invincible to anything and everything. However you can still be moved. No special powers go past the armor, not even spacial or time powers and it negates abilities that travel through a medium such as shock waves. Telepathy is also useless and objects on the other side of the armor cannot be controlled. The user can also go without necessities indefinitely. The user cannot move at all when the ability is activated nor activate any other abilities.
pros: You are invincible to everything but only when your power is activated
You are very heavy so not many people can lift you.
You can "live" indefinitely as long as your ability is active and you can still talk
cons: You cannot use your other powers when activated and you cannot move
If you deactivate it you can get hit, such as throwing them into a lake
If you stay in the armor form too long you will eventually lose your ability to think

name: Cyber World Traveller
overview: travel into the cybernetic, internet world.
description:
This ability you can travel inside the internet via a computer terminal with internet connection. Instead of viewing a monitor screen; when accessing the world wide web. 
You can literally visit those web pages. Online video games only seem more real (just don't run out of lives). 
The rules of the cyber world apply to you too. 
With this power you can leave from any terminal that has internet access. So in theory can be used to teleport.
pros: Have access to every website in the world.
Has teleportation potential. (Like into top secret military bases, area 51).
Obtain valueable bank account detail from everyone across the globe.
cons: Cyber world rules apply to you.
Can only go into the cyber world via a computer terminal with internet access.
Security programs may find you as a threatining computer virus.

name: Shadow Absorption
overview: absorb shadows (and abilities)
description: Able to absorb someones shadow at will.  This renders the person who's shadow was absorbed dead.  A person's ability will automatically be gained when their shadow is absorbed.  People who possess this power are a threat to people who can mimic shadows.
pros: Grow stronger with every shadow you absorb
Gain multiple abilities
cons: You can kill people close to you

name: Mind Melding
overview: change or trade another's thoughts
description: You can link any two minds together to have them think exactly the same, or alter a chain of thoughts the other person thinks. Much like regular thinking, except thinking for someone else.
pros: You could help a friend cheat on a test, or give their thoughts to yourself
You can make two people angry at one another, or the exact opposite
You can play with your rivals', and friends', minds by sending weird messages
cons: If you link to someone else's mind, they can hear you also
Tuning into another person's mind shuts out all hearing except for their mind

name: Super Cryptography
overview: decode any code and find any pattern
description: This power allows you to decode any code, mostly by patterns you do not even need the cypher to decode it. Also, you can find patterns in anything whether it is by looking at someone's past actions or numbers or anything. This power is useful to a detective or private investigator or anyone needing to decode anything. This power also makes you bilingual in a way, considering you do not need to understand the language of the code to understand it. You can also create amazing codes.
pros: You can decode any code even if it is in a language you do not understand and create the best codes
You can find patterns in anything
You would be an amazing detective and amazing at predicting people's actions
cons: You can see patterns where they do not exist
If you do not wanna be an investigator/ cryptographer, this power is kinda useless
People will get annoyed when you call them predictable

name: High Hopes
overview: make the things that you get your hopes up for happen for real
description: Make the things that you get your hopes up for happen for real
pros: You don't need to worry about getting your hopes up
cons: What you get might not be as good as what you would have gotten

name: Deepest Desire
overview: make anyone's deepest desire come true.
description: This power grants you the ability to cause anyone's deepest desire to come true. This is very similar to granting wishes, but some rules apply: you can only use this power once per person, you cannot use this on yourself, and the person may have no control over what their deepest desire is (they might not even know what it is). When using this power, you'll hear a badass sound so you know it worked. But choose wisely, though. If their deepest desire is for you to be dead... Well, you'll be dead.
pros: Bring people's deepest desires into reality
Your powers aren't merely an illusion; they're real
You will garner respect and reverence!
cons: Someone's deepest desire might change physics or disrupt the natural order of things
Using this on depressed people. They might not be desiring the happiest things.
You can't use this on yourself. The only way it affects you is if someone else desires it.

name: Fallproofing
overview: be totally invulnerable to tripping or falling damage
description: Also called Fall Protection or Fall-Induced Invulnerability, this is a specified form of invulnerability in which one cannot take damage from any fall, no matter how high up, or what you land on. When the user's mind subliminally perceives that they are falling, the user's invulnerability is triggered to keep the user from dying from the impact of the fall. After the user perceives that they are no longer falling, their vulnerability goes back to normal.
pros: Makes skateboarding, bike-riding and rock-climbing way more fun
Makes skydiving A LOT more fun--no more need for that pesky parachute
If you trip or fall off of something, you can just get back up, no matter HOW far you fall
cons: If you ever try to commit suicide by hanging yourself or jumping off a building, good luck
Landing from a fall or being tripped still hurts, even if you don't get a bruise or scratch
Bottomless pits REALLY suck

name: Crystallization
