overview: make and control a variety of crystals and crystal structures.
description: With this ability, a person is able to make crystals from any substance that is physically attached to the physical world (like leaves, rocks, skin, and even blood). The crystal material is like steel on the outside. If the user traps a person with this ability, they can decide whether or not the object will be crystallized or it being a hollow crystal and just trapping that person. The crystals can also vary in size and shapes. The crystal itself is very durable from the inside and out.
pros: Crystalize anything
Almost unbreakable to any attack
Can win a fight without actually hurting anybody
cons: May lose control and crystal anything in a 5-mile radius
If not in control, anything the user touches will crystalize and disintegrate with it
Very weak to ultrasonic waves, and light, if pointed to the user, will cause temporary blindness

name: Sliders
overview: open portals to other dimensions
description: With a special remote control you can go to other worlds that are based on your world's time just not actually yours.
pros: See new/other places on other worlds
cons: If you change the time limit you could be lost in other dimensions

name: Demonic Immunity
overview: be immune to that which is demonic or infernal.
description: This power grants you total immunity and protection from that which is demonic or infernal. They cannot directly affect you in any manner. When they try to use their powers on you it does no damage. This also allows you to ignore the affects of any demonic weapon or magic that is used against you. You can defy demonic or infernal contracts and protections that you come by and can easily harm the strongest of demons. Even if your life depended on them you could continue to live.
pros: You do not have to fear harm from demons or infernal creatures.
Provides mental protection from demons and infernal beings.
Your soul cannot be taken by them.
cons: They can harm you with regular weapons like guns.
You can be affected indirectly.
No protection against that which is not demonic or infernal.

name: The Midas Touch
overview: turn any object into any mineral of your choosing
description: Just imagine it. You could turn anything you want into gold, silver, platinum, diamond, pearl, white gold and so much more. You could turn a plain old stick into a gloden scepter just by the wave of your hand. You could have untold riches.
pros: You will become rich
When you touch an object it only changes if you want it to
You could turn your house to gold
cons: There aren't any

name: Hollowing Essence
overview: steal and absorb the essence of anything, leaving behind a hollow shell.
description: This ability allows you to steal and store the essence of anyone or anything. This process leaves behind nothing but a hollow shell of the absorbed object. The stolen essence is stored in your body, but this ability does not give you contol of that essence.
pros: Steal essence
Kill any living thing
Get to keep the stolen essence
cons: Hollow shell is left behind
Ability does not give you control of the stolen essence
Can be countered/resisted by certain abilities

name: Alternate Temporal Bridging
overview: create connections between this timeline and others.
description: This power is a complex and dangerous one. It gives the user the power to connect the different timelines for storage, travel, etc. When the user creates a connection, it forms a link between the two timelines with portals at the ends. Going into one of these portals will take you to the other timeline. However, you have no control about what comes through the portal (it could be a very dangerous other timeline). At the more advanced levels, you can connect many timelines at once.
pros: Connect timelines together for a variety of uses.
You could gain advanced technology from a timeline ahead of ours.
You can send enemies to a dangerous timeline.
cons: You have no way of knowing what is in an alternate timeline.
Things can come through the timelines at the other side.
Only at ADVANCED levels can you connect multiple timelines at once.

name: Raikatana
overview: create a sword made entirely out of lightning.
description: The Raikatana is a legendary move that is very strong. The user's inner energy is transformed into lightning that is condensed and transformed into a glowing yellow blade that sprouts from the user's hand. Anything that gets hit by the blade is electrified. This technique is strong enough to slice metal. The Raikatana makes a very distinct noise of chirping electricity and roaring thunder whilst attacking.
pros: It is strong enough to slice through metal.
Good for close range combat.
If you cut your opponent, even slightly, they will be electrified and probably unable to move.
cons: This power fails against earth based techniques, being lightning.
The faster you move the louder the sword gets.
You can not use other techniques while you have the sword activated.

name: Electro Shielding
overview: create a shield of Electric charge and power.
description: Create a field of Electricity to cover your body and others. Very few things can phase through it without being destroyed or in pain. Does not hurt the weilder of the shield nor the people inside it. The shield may expand to massive size depending on the wielder's strength. No one can stop the shield unless inside the shield or The weilder gives up.
pros: Protect your self
protect others around you and love ones
stop bullets from hitting you
cons: may hurt others
Dont use in rain. may electricute yourshelf
massive strength in a persons hands

name: On The Bright Side
overview: control light
description: You can control the energy of light. Turn it into balls of energy and toss it at people, or just use it as your own personal flashlight!
pros: Light is usually around most of the time
When it's bright, it's powerful!
cons: Whenever you take the light from somewhere, it doesn't come back for awhile after use
The weaker the light, the weaker your powers.
It drains your energy when there is no light around.

name: Countdown
overview: cause whatever you're touching to explode when you count down from 10 to 0
description: Whenever you count down from 10 to 0 whatever you were touching when you reached 0 explodes. You are immune to the effects of the explosion though everyone else around you can be injured or even killed. You can blow up enemy bases by touching one of the walls of the base and counting down from 10 to 0. It even works on humans, animals and other living things. It only works if you star counting down from so if you start from 11 nothing happens also if you go past 0 to -1 noting happens.
pros: You can cause things to explode by counting down from 10 to 0 and you're immune to the efffects
It even works on living things
If you change your mind midway you can either stop or just keep going past 0 to -1
cons: It happens whenever you count down from 10 to 0 unless you're not touching anything

name: Power Filter
overview: absorb and use any ability you encounter, and then place it in an object.
description: This power allows you to obtain a temporary copy of any power you encounter, simply by touching the person who has it. You can only hold one power at a time, and the power only lasts 24 hours. The best part of this power is that if you currently hold a copied power and you wish to keep it, you can permanently place it into an object, such as a weapon or clothing. So long as you have the object, you have the power. The more powerful the power, the bigger the object needs to be.
pros: Use any power you find.
Keep the ones you want by putting them into objects.
Objects work with only the people you want them to work with.
cons: Can't hold more then one power at a time.
Carrying around lots of objects can get tiresome.
You don't really have a power of your own.

name: Machine Body
overview: turn individual parts or all of ones body into a machine.
description: With this power you can make any part of your body into a machine at will. Flesh becomes metal, veins become wires, bones become cables and any number of combinations, then back to normal. Like this, you can interact and manipulate electronics directly. It can be used to turn even a simple cell phone into a super computer.
pros: Any body part can be used.
Direct interface with electronics.
No security system can stop you.
cons: VERY freaky to watch.
Can't be used on the run.
Does not make you invulnerable.

name: Light Mimicry
overview: turn your body into light
description: The speed of light is 299,792,458 meters a second. A Light Mimic can become light and travel this quickly at will. When they travel, they have some control over their direction. Being sent through a prism splits them up into six different people with one mind. However, they can be washed out by a stronger source of light, can never completely stop, and are subject to all of light's natural laws (i.e. mirrors)
pros: Can travel at 299,792,458 meters a second
Have some control over their direction
Going through a prism splits you up into 6 bodies
cons: Can be washed out by stronger light
Can never totally stop/slow down
Subject to natural laws (i.e. mirrors)

name: Digital Manipulation
overview: control digital information.
description: This is nothing like Technopathy. Technopathy controls machines, Digital Manipulation controls the data. You can extract data from computers and place it in the real world. You can even create vortexes to the cyber world, transform real-world objects to data, access the Internet and software without computers, transform into data, control computer viruses, viral immunity, and even shoot and create data without any technological assistance. Another term for this power is Cyber Manipulation.
pros: Never use a computer to go to Facebook, YouTube, etc.
Best way to cheat on a test
You're deadly in a computer store
cons: You always start with control over data
You only shoot 0's and 1's at beginner's level
The virus in the cyber world might harm you in the real world

name: Gun Manipulation
overview: create and control any gun
description: For this power a gun is any weapon that has a trigger, fires bullets, and uses gunpowder or gas as a propellant. Thus an AK47 can be used but not a lasergun or crossbow. A low-level user of this power can create one gun at a time and is unable to control the gun while a high level user can create 1000 guns at a time and control each individually. This power can only be gained by hitting 1000 cans that are thrown into the air without missing a single can using a pistol. You are allowed to reload.
pros: Can be very powerful at higher levels.
cons: Very weak at first and this power does not give any boost to your aiming capabilities.

name: Postscience
overview: have knowledge of the past
description: You can have knowledge of the past. You instantly learn how, when, where, who, why and what of the things that happen in the past. Want to know the answers to a test? Wait until the test is passed out, and you'll know. This power however cannot tap into the present or future.
pros: Know history.
Solve crimes and mysteries.
See who was right in an argument.
cons: Past only. No futuristic equipment? LAME!!
Involuntary
Don't see the past, just know it.

name: Un Foreign
overview: hear all languages as if they were your native language
description: By having this power you can hear all languages as if they were your native language, never again will you be frustrated with not understanding an others language, cant say the same for them though ^_^
pros: Never be confused by another language.
Useful in foreign countries. (Kinda)
All around better comprehension skills.
cons: They may not understand you.
Learning a foreign language will be near impossible.
Not really a battle notable power.

name: Subconsciencial Form Shifting
overview: turn yourself into things from subconsciences. Please read full description.
description: When this power is activated you lose your body and just have a body of no distinct appearance.  This ability has two modes.  1) You can pick something to look like (e. G. Hottest female) and you will look like that to everyone. It will be different for everyone, and it works even if the person doesn't concisely know what it looks like.  2) You pick a specific body from someone and become it physically, with all of it's attributes.  You can look at someone and know their version in either mode.
pros: Immortality - Don't have to age or get sick or have normal needs in a specific body
Gain powers
Be the hottest person on the planet or your enemy's worst nightmare
cons: Lose your body
Cannot merge or modify forms

name: Hyper Strike
overview: accelerate parts of your body for devastating blows.
description: With this ability, your attacks can be sped up to past the speed of sound. At that velocity, a hit with your fist could shatter any bone in your opponent's body or break through stone. Slashing with the blade of your hand or foot could slice through someone like a knife.
pros: Deliver powerful attacks with any weapon that involves physical contact
High speed could also be used to block
Your body is extra durable so as to prevent you from shattering your hand when you punch
cons: Can't be used for super-speed movement, as it lasts only a fraction of a second
Doesn't increase your reflexes

name: Reality Reincarnation
overview: be reincarnated in a different universe.
description: This ability allows a user to be reincarnate in different universal version of yourself. Most of the time you will look like yourself and sometimes you look different. You could wind up being a slave or a conquer, a animal man or an advance human. You won't know.
pros: Be recarnated in a new world.
Gain experience
cons: Unless you are immortal or have some special condition you can only do it once.

name: Implosion
overview: destroy things by making them collaspe on themselves
description: With a hand gesture of crushing, you make objects fall onto/into themselves into nothingness. A building, car or person will start to cave in from the inside out till there's nothing left of it. Where it goes from there is a mystery--like the other side of a black hole. All you know is: it was there, you imploded it, now it disappeared.
pros: Make things suck into themselves till gone
You can clear an obstacle blocking you from your destination by imploding it
cons: You have no clue where your imploded things go to

name: Weaponize
overview: agitate the molecules of any object and cause them to explode in a desired direction
description: With this ability, you can effectivly turn anything into a "gun." By agitating the molecules in an object and causing them to explode in controlled, directed bursts. Bigger objects need more control to keep them from just exploding out in all directions.
pros: Anything is a gun for you.
Never be unarmed
Two words: Building Gun
cons: Might turn a necessary object into a gun
Hard to control with larger objects

name: 9 Lives
overview: have 9 lives & luck of a cat
description: You have the power of the urban myth of a cat having nine lives. You get nine chances to live if anything should happen to you. If you die, depending on how severe the injury was, it could take from 9 seconds to 9 hours for you to revive completely healed. You also have some luck to spare your life. If in a death situation, depending on your will to live, you can get out of it without dying, but it's pushing luck & not always reliable. You still age normally and eventually will die permanently.
pros: Can die 8 times & live before dying one last time forever
Will be healed instantly after coming back to life
Have a bit of get out of death luck
cons: Age normally
May take some time to revive after death
Your luck factor is random & may not work all the time

name: Shatter
overview: break things
description: People with this ability, called "Shatterers," can break anything by touching it with their right hand and saying "Shatter. "
pros: Fights are relatively easy
It is an impressive ability
Everyone wants a "right hand of death"
cons: DON'T sleeptalk
You always need to watch what you say... "Oh, crap, I shattered a glass... " this just won't do
Many will fear you

name: Panmnesia (Total Recall)
overview: remember everything that one has ever experienced in one's lifetime
description: Interchangeably called Panmnesia, Hypermnesia, Total Recall or Perfect Memory, this is the ability to easily remember (and recall) everything that one has ever experienced, learned or encountered in one's lifetime, regardless of how you acquire the information (visually, verbally, via smells, etc. ). This includes everything from the time the user's power manifests (and the power may be present from birth).
pros: Remember important facts, figures, dates, times, events, etc. (and recall them at will)
Even if you get distracted from doing a task, you don't forget important things you have to do
Memory cannot be manipulated externally (but is also not consciously present all the time)
cons: If power is weak, all of one's memories WILL always be consciously present (mental bombardment)
Your memories CAN be manipulated (fairly rare, but it happens)
Doesn't mean you automatically understand info (remedied by memorizing definitions/formulas, etc.)

name: Idiosyncratic Theft
overview: obtain a another person's most prized possession (power, person, or object) and control it.
description: This ability will strike people were it hurts, their hearts. What is tucked inside their heart, their prized possession. This ability takes it away so that the user can control it. Basically, the user has a partial mind reading ability that only allows them to know what is their target's most prized thing nothing more. This ability can be dangerous, because the user can develope a coveting problem if not stopped.
pros: Take a person's most prized possession
Use it as a shield against the victim
Use it to bargain with your victim
cons: Might develope a coveting disorder

name: Evolver
overview: randomly evolve and mutate.
description: Evolution is a very powerful tool of life. With this ability, your genetic structure is programmed to continue to evolve and mutate in positive ways. This means every once in a while, you'll develop a random genetic based ability. You will know when this happens because every time it happens you'll feel flashes of hot and cold. These mutations are uncontrollable and are almost always positive. So you'll never know when or how you will evolve.
pros: You might develop an anti-aging mutation.
Could become very powerful
Almost any ability is geneticly possible
cons: Some mutations are just plain useless

name: Geometric Perfection
overview: have a perfect understanding of physics and geometry.
description: Although one might think this is useless, if it were to be applied to a user of projectiles, this person would become godly. Perfect Geometric recognition would allow someone to bounce bullets off of almost any solid object. Like Cyclops from Marvel, he could almost be the perfect sniper, as now wind, drag, objects, and any physical thing is now instantly added into his or her immmediate thought process. Basically, it almost ensures never missing a target, without really needing to concentrate.
pros: Become a scientist/scholar/researcher
Can easily predict where projectiles are going
Instantaneous reactions since thought process is no longer a variable
cons: Based on number of projectiles
Still not the most amazing power

name: Music Generation
overview: make any song start playing randomly
description: With this power you can cause any song to start playing out of nowhere. Everybody around you will hear the song until you either change decide to change it or stop the music completely.
pros: You can cause any song or musical composition to start playing out of nowhere
Everyone around you will hear the song but they will have no idea where it's coming from
You can change the songs or stop the music completely whenever you want
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Seismokinesis
overview: create and manipulate earthquakes
description: You can create and manipulate earthquakes. No one can come close! You can make quakes anywhere and can even creake sinkholes. Your shockwaves will scare your enemies.
pros: Amazingly powerfull
Destructive prowess with little effort
cons: Could kill everyone
Overuse results in lack of control

name: Zonifying
overview: zone out in class, but somehow remember all of the important points
description: Teacher: Blah blah blah blar blah blah. Lily:(zoned out). Teacher: Lily, when did Marco Polo travel to China from Italy? Lily: Why, 1217, ofcourse (smiles sweetly). Teacher: (scowls)
pros: Help with school!
You will become smart
cons: You're bored.

name: Bioelectricity Absorption
overview: absorb others' bioelectricity
description: This ability allows you to absorb others' bioelectricity, making the brain unable to send charges to your limbs and organs so they can do what you want and what they're suppose to. For example, when you want your arm to move or when your heart beats. You can also absorb others' bioelectricity to make your limbs and organs move and work faster.
pros: You can cause an enemy to be immobilized
You and your body can work faster
cons: If no one's around you, you are powerless (unless you have other abilities)

name: God Of Words
overview: always be right.
description: Tired of being wrong all the time?  Well, with this power, anything and everything you say will automatically come true!  Simply say "I know the answers to this test" and the answers will flow into your mind!  Also use this ability to get back at people who hurt you or improve your bank account with a whisper!
pros: Always be right
Your word is law
Make yourself into a super being with a word
cons: Must watch what you say
May affect reality in unwanted ways
Don't be like Timmy Turner

name: Power Ritual
overview: give people powers by performing rituals on them
description: Basically, you can create rituals that can give people powers. One ritual can only ever give one specific power. Ex. One ritual could give Telepathy while another ritual gives Immortality. The better the power is the more complicated or physically-damaging the ritual is. Also, only someone with this power can perform or initiate the rituals on others. 'Omni' powers are beyond what any ritual can give and thus cannot be gained.
pros: People will probably pay to gain powers.
cons: You have to think up multiple rituals if you want to help others gain multiple different powers.
Strong powers are harder to gain.
This power will not do anything for powers that can only be gained one way.

name: Powerful Breath
overview: blow different types of breath, such as fire, ice, gas, wind, etc.
description: You can blow fire, ice, gas, or wind at any pressure or force. Fire can range from melting ice to evaporating water, ice can range from freezing solids to freezing gasses, gas can poison your target in seconds, and wind can range from bending trees to causing storms. The effect of your breath is actually almost infinite, since you have large lungs and you can suck in large amounts of air to charge up the pressure/force at one time. Can also increase the maximum volume of your voice.
pros: Cool down your dinner instantly.
Warm up the cold weather
Blow sulfur on some jack.
cons: Easily noticed

name: Heat Strength
overview: become stronger depending on how hot it is in your location
description: With this power your strength level rises with the temperature in your present location. If you turn up the heat in your house you become stronger or if you travel to a hot place you become stronger. You also become weaker in the cold so if you're fighting a villain in the winter or in Canada or something you'll probably lose if this is your only power.
pros: You become stronger depending on how hot it is in your present location
cons: You become weaker if it's cold

name: Yin And Yang Manipulation
overview: alter the elements of yin and yang
description: Yin, the passive, healing element. Yang, the aggressive, harming element. With this ability, you have a mastery of both. This means that you can impart yin energy into subjects to heal them, to heighten their defenses against illness and harm, or even deflect yang attacks. With yang, you can do just the opposite. Hurt foes with a blast or beam, weaken foes physically and deflect the effects of yin. The two naturally cancel one another out, and thus are useless being used against each other.
pros: Yin energy can be used to heal (yourself and others), raise defenses and deflect yang
Yang energy can be used to harm (blasts, beams, enhanced strikes), lower defenses and deflect yin
Yin energy can induce good bahvior, Yang energy can induce bad behavior
cons: Yin is harmless, so it can't be used to harm AT ALL (in case you're more skilled at Yin)
Yang is harmful, so it can't be used to heal AT ALL (in case you're more skilled at Yang)
Yin and Yang used together is a null attack (no harm is taken, no damage is healed)

name: Dream Invader
overview: invade another's dream.
description:
This ability allows you to invade another person's dream. You can only use this ability while asleep and your victim must be asleep too.
While in their dreams you can cause a person to have unbearable nightmares or you can lock a person inside their dream.
pros: Make people you hate have nightmares.
cons: You have to be asleep to use your ability.

name: Invictus
overview: be powered by your own confidence and ego
description: This power is based on your growing inner energy. Belief in yourself, confidence and ego power you to great extremes. You are as strong and indomitable as you believe. Immunity to fire, cold and disease if you believe you are. If you boost your confidence enough, you will be able to defy gravity, physics, logic. No one can tell you what you can and cannot do.
pros: Initially you will be as strong, as fast, and as tough as you believe
Boost your ego enough and you will be able to fly, walk up walls, crap gold, drink lightning
Enemies and projectiles will bounce off you when they feel your awesome aura
cons: Doubt is your greatest weakness
Beings with Telepathic, Superiority, Surpass or Evolutionary powers give you problems
Aging will slowly cause your confidence to wane no matter how powerful you become

name: Elemental Fist
overview: transform your fist into whatever element you want
description: The user, with the aid of a special gauntlet, is able to form an elemental fist using an element that is nearest to him. The elements are fire, earth, wind & water.
pros: Able to counter almost element
cons: Easily defeated if up against the wrong element

name: Wish Magnetism
overview: attract or redirect the benefits of any person's wish or desire.
description: The user will be able to attract the benefits of any one who made a wish that's coming true, or a reality warper who is warping reality. This ability has a near universal range. Any wish can become the user's and he can take all the benefits leaving the wisher or reality warper with the consequences. The user can redirect the wish if he doesn't want it. The effects of warped reality and certain wishes will were off.
pros: Take a person's wish or desired reality.
Redirect wish
cons: The effects of warped reality and certain wishes will were off.

name: Florakinesis
overview: control plant life.
description: This is a very simple psionic ability. It allows the user to manipulate plants around him as an extension of their own body. However, this ability doesn't allow the user to create plant-life, but does allows you to accelerate plant-growth. You can even promote plant life in an area, as long as their was some there before, creating a sort of super-garden.
pros: Controlling plant life.
Tons of interesting plants
Trees are included here
cons: Cannot create plant life from nothing

name: Statue Animation
overview: bring statues to life under your control.
description: This power allows you to channel your own life energy into statues. The abilities of the statues are dependent upon what they depict: a horse will not be sentient but a human will, a gargoyle or bird will be able to fly, and statues of gods or superhumans will retain their powers. The statues can be made of anything from stone to ice.
pros: Army of statues for you to command
Statues can appear inanimate and ambush enemies
Statues are stronger and more durable than real-life counterparts if made of rock or metal
cons: Only works on statues of animals, not abstract sculptures or other inanimate objects
If broken once, statues cannot be reanimated
Statues are fragile if made of ice or glass

name: Weapons From The Dark
overview: turn shadows into weapons
description: You can turn your own shadow into weapons, both melee and long-ranged, such as swords or sniper rifles.
pros: Variety of weapons depending on the imagination of the user
Strongest during the night
Nearly invincible in well shaded areas
cons: Weapon may shatter depending on surrounding light
Weapon mass depends on shadow size
Weak against flashlights

name: Life And Death Control
overview: bring back the dead and control them, and control people that are alive too.
description: You might not be able to control your powers sometimes unless you practice a lot. When you are using this power, you might feel rage or love. The undead might attack the living people you are controlling.
pros: You could bring back the people you love.
Control anybody, even animals.
Be able to make your enemies do whatever you like.
cons: You might feel rage and maybe go too far because of it.
The undead might try to attack you for waking them up from their deep sleep.
You might not be able to control your powers most of the time.

name: Mark Of Shock
overview: electrocute people from distance
description: The user plants a mark in the target that allows him to electrify him from any distance. They can control the intensity of the shock and as an added bonus, the target attracts other electric-based attacks.
pros: Good to inmobilize
Easy kill
cons: Needs physical contact to place the mark
The mark can be removed
Emotions might affect the discharge

name: New Reality Vortex
overview: create vortices that lead to another dimension that is either good or bad
description: You can create vortices that take you to a new reality that is either much better than this world, or horrible. Are you alone, without a family, and want a new start? Cornered by bullies or thugs? This power lets you escape. But you can also pull in enemies, sending them into a barren, desert-like place similar to Erebus, the dark netherworld crossed over when going into Hades, from which there is no escape. You, on the other hand, can always end up in a better place if you choose it!
pros: Getting rid of enemies? No problem!!
Live a better life in a happier place if this one doesn't suit you!
You can choose, and therefore control, whether the endpoint is in a good or bad place
cons: Vortices are weak when you first acquire the power
They will open unintentionally if you don't control the power
You need to consciously focus on either the good or bad destination

name: Atomic Bond Manipulation
overview: manipulate molecules and atoms at will
description: With this ability one could do pretty much anything one chooses. Want to use it for good? Make weapons cease to be... then turn them into bonds for the bad guys. Evil's your style? Rip people apart just by looking at them, or torture them one atom at a time.
pros: Manipulate matter
Free Energy!!!
Weapons are worthless
cons: Can't create things, atoms and molecule have to be formed already

name: Blessing Of Morpheus
overview: have the Blessing of Morpheus
description: Morpheus is the Greek god of dreams and sleep. His blessing allows you to have various effects over his realm. You can control your own and others' dreams, and mentally enter another's dreams. Also, you can force people and things to sleep and control for how long they do.
pros: Controlling dreams
"Sleeping" people and things(turning off a TV, shutting down a car, etc. )
cons: Until you can control your power, everything around you will sleep.

name: Transcendent Dominator
overview: manipulate, take possession of, and use a super powered being as an acquired ability.
description:
With a simple grabbing gesture of the hand this power enables you to instantly snatch a super powered target and use him as an acquired ability. 

This removes the target from this realm, sending him into a non dimensional pocket within your existence where he will remain in a mindless/non-sentient and will-broken state as a superpower for you to use for all of eternity.
pros: Gives access to all abilities the target has acquired.
This ability ignores space/distance between you & the target. In effect it also disregards barriers.
Ideally useful against targets with 'Power Hold' because of their existence as one with superpowers.
cons: Can only be used against super powered beings.
Effects cannot be undone. Targets with powers like Craktart or suicidal abilities are threats.
Range: 10 miles around the user. Beyond that this power is useless.

name: Ability Countermeasures
overview: produce a superpower for every superpowered problem
description: If a person with Ability Countermeasures were facing a Pyrokinetic, they would develop Cryokinesis. If they squared off against a Speedster, they would be able to Slow Time. Ability Countermeasures is the ultimate nemesis: it finds a way to nullify any ability's advantage.
pros: Become the weapon of last resort
The more powerful they are, the more powerful you are
Could potentially beat down the Hulk
cons: Only lasts as long as the threat lasts
If faced with many powered foes, get the ability to Teleport
Only works with powered foes

name: Neuron Revival
overview: make every neuron in your brain that ever died to reform and revive.
description: With this ability, you can make every neuron that ever died in your head to reform and revive. Neurons are not immune to poison damage.
pros: Bring dead and destroyed neurons back to life.
cons: Neurons are not immune to poison damage.

name: Duplicity
overview: have the power of Loki and harness the forces of deception and trickery
description: By simply tapping into the power of Loki, one would have the ability to harness any capability that helps to deceive or trick people, and start chaos; the primary ones being the power of shapeshifting, illusion, lying with a straight face (and no bodily changes) and the power to subliminally compel people to believe one's lies in the same way a person with psychic persuasion (mind control) subliminally compels you to follow their orders.
pros: Pwn lie detectors (the machines and people with the power)
Never get caught doing mischief
Make enemies turn against each other
cons: Sometimes you have to worship Loki to get these powers
Um, nothing else, it's like a god power.

name: Lung Adaptation
overview: hold one's breath indefinitely and to breathe anything safely
description: Carbon monoxide poisoning, nerve gas, even drowning have claimed thousands, if not milions of lives. A Lung Adaptor never has to worry about that. Without even thinking about it, they can automatically breathe any gas or liquid safely: tear gas, water, etc. They can also hold their breath for hours--days--at a time. Unfortunately, this offers no resistance to ingested or skin-absorbed poisons.
pros: Breathe tear gas, carbon monoxide, etc. without harm
Use nerve gas as a weapon with no fear of death
Win every breath-holding contest
cons: No resistance against ingested poisons
No resistance against skin-absorbed poisons
Still as vunerable as a normal person to damage

name: Fictional World Interblending
overview: fuse the real world with fiction
description: With this power, the user can fuse the real world with the world of fiction. You can fuse the world with any type of fiction: video games, etc. The new world will contain elements of both worlds, so it is possible to meet fictional characters. Nobody will die but they may be different in the new world. For example your best friend can now be your worst enemy. Everyone will eventually forget the previous world. If multiple fictions are fused, the world will be divided into different parts.
pros: Create a world with superpowers/magic
If the fictional world has something that you excel at
You can meet fictional characters
cons: Making superheroes also makes supevillains and can cause monsters to form and kill people
Can cause chaos because everybody becomes different and some things are altered
You can't control elements of the new world and you cannot use fiction made by yourself

name: Super Athlete
overview: be unbeatable at any sport
description: With this power you can be unbeatable at any sport; from baseball to race car driving to laser tag.
pros: You can't be beaten in any sport
cons: You can't use your sports skills in battle, such as paintball sharpshooting with a real gun

name: String Manipulation
overview: manipulate physical strings
description: You can control any physical string. The string can be of any material, whether it is cotton, cow hide, steel, diamond, etc. You can only manipulate strings within a radius of 1000 metres.
pros: All strings of all materials are under your control.
If you can make fire strings they are under your control.
cons: Effective range of 1 kilometre.

name: Power Mix
overview: mix different superpowers.
description: Because of this power, the greatest powers could be combined. But, contrasting powers may take more than just power, one must have creativity and imagination. An example is fire plus water. A liquid which burns is acid. Also, combining great powers may drain out a person's energy. Using combined powers may also take time and energy. It is also forbidden to combine powers not of one's level and combine power plus a combined power.
pros: One could use a very powerful combo of attacks based on opponent's weakness.
Powers around may be sources of ideas.
Defense can be combined with offense.
cons: Drains energy.
Time-consuming.
Many rules to follow.

name: Super Soldier Serum
overview: have all your normal attributes increased
description: Makes you stronger, faster, smarter, enhances your senses. Makes you an enhanced human, not superhuman (not smart enough to read or control minds, as fast as the Flash or as strong as the Hulk).
pros: Makes you way stronger than an average human.
Senses are way more alert you can almost never get caught off guard.
Makes you way more durable.
cons: All traits are increased, even anger. It increases irritability.
Cannot control powers, serum is part of you forever.
The super soldier serum shortens life, at most you can an average age of 35.

name: Vicarious Impulse
overview: manipulate thought processing
description: Impulses: bio-electric energy produced by the brain as to allow movement and thought. The user is able to speed up, slow down, completely stop, and even steal impulses from others in order to cause the target's brain and body functions to cease just by thinking so. Seizing impulses, the user can store knowledge of the target alongside their own, be it special abilities or memories.
pros: Sever a target's motor functions
Send a target into a vegetative state
User learns by taking skills
cons: User might be the victim of their own attack against a target who has reversal talents

name: Matter Into Armor
overview: touch matter and turn it into armor.
description: The ability to touch any solid matter and it covers your body, turning it into armor
pros: Can absorb anything solid like stone, metal, rubber and anything else that is solid.
You could absorb mostly stone if you were in a fight
Metal is useful for strong attacks
cons: You can't absorb liquid or gas

name: Artifact: Imperium Graphices
overview: bring your drawings to life.
description: When you say "Adeat", a drawing pad and a magical feather pen appears. Whatever you draw instantly comes to life (such as birds, pillows, people, televisions, etc. ). The more detailed your drawings, the better they will be.
pros: Can use your drawings as shields or decoys.
Can summon weapons or shields.
Can summon things to fight for you.
cons: 1% of the damage your drawing takes goes to you.

name: Glaciation
overview: turn matter into ice
description: This is not the power to freeze; the user actually psychically transmutes matter into ice. One with this ability may do it by touch, look or just mental power (depending on the user's genetics). It affects the subject in the same way one is affected by the power Petrifaction, but, instead of stone, the subject turns into ice. In addition, if a subject is turned into ice, they can be returned to normal at will, as long as the ice hasn't melted or been shattered.
pros: If you don't want a person to be turned into ice, you can use the power to just freezer-burn them
May be accompanied by an immunity (or at least high resistance) to cold
User may sometimes be able to also affect non-living matter
cons: You can't return a person to normal if they shatter or break
Sometimes only affects living matter (or only non-living matter)
It can also be triggered subconsciously (accidental glaciation)

name: Animal Matter
overview: become any animal you see or think of.
description: If you think about a snake, you become a snake. If you think about a wolf, you become a wolf. This is a cool superpower to have!
pros: You can communicate with other animals.
You have the same abilities the animal you have chosen has.
You can use animals to attack your foes.
cons: If your head hurts, the power doesn't work.
You can only become an animal for a limited time, otherwise you stay the animal you are forever.
It hurts while you transform.

name: Bio Enhancing Technopathy
overview: alter yourself via technopathy and nanobots or bionics
description: A technopath has a great understanding of machines which would lead to huge advances in technology. By injecting millions of nanobots into yourself and/or giving yourself bionics, you can use your technopathy to constantly alter your body and powers. Get the nanobots to rapidly build jet boosters into your feet or lasers into your eyes, or "repair" you. They could harvest metal from nearby or it could be stored within your body. Rapidly adapt to each situation and become a tactical war machine.
pros: Easily enhance and repair yourself
Internal communications, internet, data storage etc
Many super-powers at your fingertips
cons: May take concentration to organize large numbers of the nanobots
Requires an initial flair of invention and willingness to use self as a human guinea-pig
May feel extremely strange having add-ons built internally.

name: Equilibrium
overview: be the physical equal of whatever force you're fighting
description: You have the combined physical prowess of whatever you're fighting. Up against 100 men? You'll have their combined strength, speed, stamina, agility, etc. However, with every enemy you take out, you're abilities decrease in response to the decreased enemy force. No matter what, your mental abilities remain the same.
pros: You'll always be just as physically powerful as your enemy.
You can respond to a large variety of threats.
cons: Your abilities constantly fluctuate.
Long, drawn out fights due to equal abilities.
If you're up against a physically weak super-genius, you'll most likely lose.

name: Cartoon Physics (Toon Physics)
overview: adhere to absurdly more lenient laws of physics
description: We've all seen cartoons defy human physics for the sake of comedy. Well, imagine if you had the same powers. To defy gravity until you notice so. To access hammerspace (to produce objects from seemingly out of nowhere). To slow one's fall for a safe landing. To travel into drawings, cartoons, TV, movies and cyberspace at will. To pick up and use holes like tangible objects. And most important, the user can't die, since that isn't funny. Though, he can still feel pain, only not that much.
pros: Be a human cartoon by defying the laws of human physics
Inability to die, aging and injury are impermanent, and feel less pain than normal
Sense of humor automatically improves
cons: Can only be used in comedic situations (until developed)
Still feel pain
You'll be the laughing stock of the superhero community

name: Position Switching
overview: exchange your position with anything or anyone you want
description: This power enables you to instantly exchange your physical location with anything or anyone you are pointing at and concentrating on. It is not possible to only affect a part of an object, a person or a group of objects which are tightly fixed to each other, they will be moved as a whole. It works on any thing, except if it is bound to the Earth, i.e. if it is so heavy it cannot be humanly possible to move or if it is interlinked with the ground or something also bound to the Earth.
pros: Like teleportation, except you have a finer and safer control on your moves.
Escape any situation AND put something or someone else in your place.
cons: You must have a direct visual contact with whatever you want to switch with.
You can only teleport within your visual field.

name: Sentience Granter
overview: give sentience to inanimate objects
description: This ability gives objects the ability to be self-aware, talk, and move(either levitation or rolling/walking).  You can also take away their sentience.  All objects have a predisposition to their owner, they will attempt to return to their owner.  You can use this power to have money continuously come back to you.
pros: If there are no witnesses you can question the evidence itself
You can convince objects to work for you. And, if you lose them, they will come back to you
You can have the book teach you by talking to it
cons: Some objects will have annoying personalities or destructive tendencies
It's weird to talk to objects and will freak other people out
If all the objects joined to take over the world.

name: Water Works
overview: merge with water at any of its phases
description: With this power you are able touch and join with water at its various phases: Liquid, Solid or Vapor, changing your body into water. You control each and every water molecule you bond with. You could easily control your body at varying temperatures. You are able to combine with other water molecules and become stronger. You could become tsunami sized tidal waves, artic glaciers, a giant iceberg or pounding rain, or an avalanche.
pros: Touch a form of water and become that form of water, controlling its strength and motion
Merge with various sizes of water becoming enormous tidal waves, jagged icebergs or storm systems
Virtually invulnerable as a polymorphic liquid, a super-heated vapor or any size or form of iceberg
cons: In fluid forms you could be contained
Unwillingly be changed to different states by one with temperature manipulating abilities
If submerged or buried in a form of water you subconsciously merge with that form of water

name: Omnidirectional Blast
overview: selectively attack everything up to a 5 mile radius all at once
description: Tired of fighting against someone who just dodges your every move. Well, now with the omnidirectional blast you can hit everything up to a 5 mile radius all at once. The blast is concussive and can hit multiple times if the target is close by you. This power can also be used like a forcefield blasting everything around you away. The user can make the blast intangible at certain areas in order to protect things they don't want to hit. After use the user has to recharge.
pros: No dodging your attack
You can choose what does not get affected by your attack if mastered
Blast is near instantaneous
cons: You have to know what you don't want to hit
People will now want to stay clear of you-not really good if you want to be a hero
The blast is weaker the farther from the center.

name: Mastery Of The Great Ice Aura
overview: completely control ice as a weapon
description: This superpower allows you to become a master of the art of using ice as a power. This ability is acknowledged by a glowing aura of faint ice around the possessor. This superpower is extremely hard to master and therefore only the best can use it. Upon mastering it, go to the Temple of the Ice Being. There, you will be granted by the Ice Being the legendary Frostmane. This icy cloak gives the wearer invincibility to frost, water and fire. It also designates them as a master of ice.
pros: The ability to use ice as a combat tool
The ability to forge weapons and armor out of ice, as well as variants of ice walls.
The Cloak of the Ice Being, Frostmane
cons: Extremely hard to master
Fire is a sworn enemy of Ice

name: Vacuum Control
overview: create and manipulate vacuums
description: You can create spaces devoid of any air in any shape or size you want.
pros: You could put out any fire instantly
The human body doesn't do well in vacuums, so you could fight with that
Using your control over vacuums, you could propel yourself in any direction
cons: Hopefully, there weren't any people in that burning building you just sealed inside a vacuum
You, unfortunately, are human as well
You had better pack an airbag and parachute, you aren't impervious to falling damage

name: Neuro Kinesis
overview: alter physical feeling.
description: Pain, touch, perception of cold, all of it can be administered or removed using Neuro-kinesis. A telepathic ability, the user can force enemies into submission through intense pain, sexually stimulate a person to get them into a comedic mishap or even just lessen the effects of cold or heat on another person mildly. This power has several different uses and can be used primarily to cause or ease pain, making it suitable for good or bad people.
pros: Can change your or others' perceptions of the immediate environment.
Never have to worry about feeling hot, cold or in pain ever again.
Can make death less painful for others or yourself (or more, if that's cool with you).
cons: Can form an addiction to numbness.
Pain is natural and needed for a healthy body. Being always numb could lead to potential death.
If someone else has this power, they are immune to its effects.

name: Enhanced Effect
overview: increase and apply the affect of all your actions to matter or energy.
description: The user of this power is capable of achieving more effect from any action than the effort they put into it. In addition any effect achieved through the users actions may apply to realms beyond those it characteristically impacts. Touch, language, and action may bypass the material realm, affecting beings on other planes or merely being increased to heightened levels(e.g. whispering could become as loud as shouting, tapping to striking, etc). The influence of this power is determined by intent.
pros: Tactile Manipulation of matter and energy( Tearing through steel can be as easy as tearing paper).
At higher levels influence the astral, and divine realms as easily as you could the physical.
Extends to communication, allowing the user to converse with anything that communicates.
cons: Applies only to touch until higher levels. NCN
Despite the power to communicate with almost anything it does not give omnilinguism. NCN
Some effort IS required to actually trigger the effects of the power.

name: Mirroring
overview: alter the appearance of others by changing their reflection
description: Mirroring is the ability to change somebody's reflection in a reflective surface; when you change their reflection, their body changes to match the reflection. You can use this to turn people into almost anything; other people, animals, plants, objects, etc. You can make them stay that way as long as you want, but can also change them back.
pros: Reflective surfaces are now useful in combat (puddles, windows, mirrors, etc.)
Turn people into whatever you want
Can reverse the effects if you want
cons: Can only affect your OWN appearance if your power develops
Can't manipulate glass or reflective surfaces other than changing what they reflect
Some CAN'T reverse the effects of their power

name: Key Of Infinity: Dimension Key
overview: use a key to go to a different dimension
description: Turn the key in midair or in a keyhole, and a door will appear. Think of a dimension (This counts alternate universes, like if you would have worn red socks instead of blue ones) and go through the door. You'll appear there! But without the Key of Space or Key of Time, you'll appear randomly in the past/future and/or in some random place
pros: Going to alternate dimensions
Having fun in them
cons: Might appear randomly without other keys
Might die when appearing randomly

name: Snap You're Gone V2
overview: teleport people to other planets by snapping
description: With this power you can send people to other planets by snapping saying their name and the name of the planet you want them sent to. This power does not allow them to breathe in space so if they can't they'll probably die when you send them to a different planet. The planet does not have to be in your solar system or galaxy but is has to be in your universe. You can bring them back by saying their name and the name of the planet they came from. This power works on corpses and animals as well.
pros: You can send people to other planets
Get paid by NASA to send astronauts to Mars
cons: This power does not allow people to breathe in space

name: Mystic Eyes Of Death Sight
overview: destroy anything by perceiving and cutting its mystic weak points.
description: Full title: Mystic Eyes of Death Perception. Upon activation, their owner may "perceive death" in the form of red lines and dots. The user in question is the only one who can see, touch or use these lines and dots. Lines be traced with any held blade which cuts the line and inflicts damage which cannot be healed or repaired. Dots can also be pierced by sharp weapons, which effectively erases that object or creature from existence. The user's irises will glow blue when these eyes activate.
pros: These eyes allow their users to destroy nearly anything that has a concrete, physical existence.
Users will have 100% accuracy and superhuman speed when attempting to cut or pierce a line or dot.
The depth of a cut is always magnified. Ex: Users can easily slice through boulders thrown at them.
cons: A user must fight with a held blade to use this ability. There is no benefit for ranged weapons.
Using blunter objects to sever or pierce, such as fingers, will require much more effort.
Size is the only limit: extremely colossal targets, such as planets and moons, cannot be destroyed.

name: Holey Man
overview: create tactile holes and portals.
description: With this power, you can create holes that lead nowhere, or portals that can lead to wherever you want.
pros: It's very easy to kill a person with this power.
Your portals can lead anywhere you want.
cons: It's very draining to create a long-distance portal.
You need a very clear mental image of the place your portal leads.
Don't send two people in at a time, a 'la The Fly.

name: Pyropathy
overview: stimulate anything fire related into the mind of someone else
description: Pyropathy is a specialized form of telepathy which only circles around fire. With this power you would be able to start fires in someones mind which can cause mental explosions or sweating because you are heating the hypothalamus. This is definetely not to be confused with pyrokinesis. You could also burn someone's memory away, create illusions of fire, and in some cases see the future through fire(Pyromancy).
pros: It can be very useful against those wo are afraid of fire
Can erase people's memories
You could heat an ally if there are close to hypothermia
cons: Can cause severe headaches
May accidently erase too much of a persons memory
Can be activated by extreme anger so you might harm others unintentionally

name: Solar Electricty Ball
overview: generate a ball of intense electrical and solar energy by absorbing sunlight
description: By absorbing an unlimited amount of sunlight one can produce immense amounts of electrical power. One can also fuse the energies of solar and electricity to increase the power, but this takes time and practice. The power has less limited energy during the day when the sun is out but the energy is more limited at night.
pros: Immense electrical reserves
Super powerful technique
Can fuse energies of solar and electricty
cons: Ball is unstable and could explode before use
Radiation exposure
Uncontrolable electrical discharge

name: Superhuman Disability Bestowal
overview: make yourself or other willing individuals incapable of something.
description: With this power, you can make yourself unable to do something, such as die or lose your powers. The user can apply these to willing individuals. An individual is capable of the desired action as long as they want to be. However, this power cannot compromise someone ability to choose what they want, such as making them incapable of existing. In addition, one can forcibly enable others to do things normally blocked by this power.
pros: This power has as many uses as you imagination can come up with.
Become immune to many things.
You can apply the benefits to others.
cons: You cannot defend yourself from other enabling you to do certain things.
This power cannot be modified by your other powers.
You cannot use this on someone who does not want to be affected.

name: Control Brightness
overview: call light with your light ring
description: The Light ring has the ability to call light beasts by saying :Let there be lightness, with the ring you can control light beasts and help you in your combats.
pros: The light beasts are stronger than the shadow beasts
The opponent cannot shoot it or cut it
It can only be attacked with psychic abilities
cons: You can only call two-three beasts at a time
It can beaten with the ring of darkness or with a magical attack
You need to be in partial light or complete light to operate

name: Arceusforce: Fist
overview: channel the power of Arceus's Fighting form.
description: The user of this ability can channel the fighting spirit of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Fighting-type. The user's skin turns mahogany, their irises turn tan. Under their brawny guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Fighting-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Fighting attacks such as Mach Punch, Hi Jump Kick, Aura Sphere, Close Combat and more.
pros: The user can resist insect, darkness and mineral-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of chi and aura for Fighting attacks.
The user gains knowledge of combat as well as a more advanced physical condition for combat.
cons: The user is weak to fairy magic, psychic and wind-based attacks.
This power may be too powerful for the user. Might also require to be unlocked from the default form

name: Randomize Door
overview: randomize the output location of any door.
description: This power allows the user to, upon opening a door, randomize the out location to any other door in the universe. For example, you could open your front door and come out of the closet of a French mansion. The output location is random and the connection between door A and door B only exists for as long as the door is open, becoming normal once the door is closed. If one is displeased by whats on the other side of the door, one need only close it and reopen it to try for somewhere else.
pros: Make a quick escape to anywhere, from anywhere.
Create a stable portal to some place amazing by keeping the door open.
cons: It's random where it puts you out.
It only works on doors.
Things can get strange when it connects two doors of different sizes.

name: Arceusforce: Judgment
overview: channel the power of Arceus, creator of the Pokemon universe.
description: The user holds a mighty force with this power. Their hair becomes white, skin becomes golden and eyes become green with burning red pupils. They have all of the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Normal-type. They gain supernatural condition as well as the ability to generate raw energy for attacks such as Hyper Beam and Giga Impact. With intense training, the user can transform into other elemental types and summon Arceus' almighty Judgment, a powerful light shower of the elements.
pros: The user is immune to spectral attacks in default form.
Generation of raw energy for various attacks.
BOW TO THE SHEER FORCE OF JUDGMENT!!!!
cons: The user is weak to supernatural physical combat in default form.
This power may be too powerful for the user. (Especially Judgment)
Intense training is required to access the other elemental forms of Arceus as well as Judgment.

name: Arcana 18: The Moon
overview: enhance mental powers and creativity.
description: You possess an aura that enhances mental powers, imagination and creativity within in. The longer a person remains within the aura, the strength of the enhancement increases, however, prolonged exposure to the aura can have negative effects. This can include dream-like states, hallucinations, poor emotional control, odd delusions and eventual psychological meltdowns. This can be prevented by taking a break from the aura. You may allow the aura to affect or not affect you as you desire.
pros: You may enhance your or allies creativity, imagination or mental powers.
You can cause people to dissolve into insanity just by being around them.
Your aura expands when you are exposed to its effects.
cons: You are not immune to the negatives of prolonged exposure.
Insanity caused by this power can cause random outburst of telepathic noise or illusions.

name: Derailment
overview: pull others into your own train of thought for 10 seconds
description: A person with this power has the ability to get others to think the same thing as them for 10 seconds. For example, you can derail a serious conversation by talking about getting burgers, then the other party will start discussing about burgers until they realize that you just tricked them again with this power. The power lasts for 10 seconds, but the other party might continue to be in the same train of thought after 10 seconds is up. They might actually want burgers now that you suggested it.
pros: Derail conversations and get people to help you
Its hilarious to use just like a comedy gag---try not to laugh at the stuff you get to happen
Can work on groups of people
cons: If not trained this power might happen subconsciously(which can be terrible)
After 10 seconds, the other person(s) realizes what they are doing
If the user's thoughts are too complicated this power will not work

name: Lawman
overview: establish and enforce supernatural laws
description: As a Law-maker, the user can create a condition/consequence system, and bind it to a chosen area. When the condition is met, the consequences follow. These systems can be used to varying ends, either passively or actively. In this example, "All those who display aggression will be restrained", the active condition "aggression" leads to the consequence "be restrained". A passive condition, "Any over the age of 25", can have the consequence of "cannot exit the building".
pros: Grants a great deal of influence over your surroundings; creativity is key
Multiple laws can be enacted in a single area, and consequences are supernaturally enforced
Time restraints can be added ("Between the hours of noon and 5pm... ")
cons: This ability takes time and effort to use; the more influence the law has, the more difficult it is.
Areas in which this ability is used are static; once activated, they cannot be moved by choice
Loopholes and anti-law abilities can disrupt law systems.

name: Program Creation
overview: create any type of program.
description: With this power, you can create any type of program that can do anything. I do not mean you can create a program that can manipulate reality or something. I mean you can create a program that can hack systems or manipulate systems. When I say, you can create any program I mean you think of it and it is created.
pros: You can hack any type of system.
You can give a virus to someone's network if you don't like them.
You can make easy money by creating apps.
cons: People might kidnap you to exploit your power.
People might become jealous of your awesome programs and kill you.
You might create a program so advanced the government might see it as a national threat.

name: Epigenetic Manipulation
overview: sense and manipulate gene expression.
description: With this power, one can detect and control gene expression. Potential applications include deactivating genes for dominant traits, deactivating unwanted traits and capabilities, such as weight gain and much more. If a power is genetic, it too may be deactivated. This power also bestows the ability to sense activity of a gene and what a gene does.
pros: Deactivate unwanted traits.
Works on both the user and others.
Prevent disease.
cons: Cannot alter most existing physiology, except in specific situations.
This power offers no knowledge or understanding of genetics.
It could very easily kill the target.

name: Mechanic Kinesis
overview: control cars in a multitude of ways.
description: Ability to mental control and augment cars, augmentation would take a period of time depending on how the car is changed. The ability to change the form of their cars from guns to robots. The form appearance and abilities would be dependent on car. A mental connection with his would allow his body to be augmented by the abilities of one car at a time, but to a smaller degree. However, the number of cars he could control at one time would be limited. And his cars being damaged would reduce power
pros: Not needing a to refuel
Different car for different situations
Can use the cars for combat
cons: Powers rely on users cars being around
Whatever weakness the car has is the users weakness as well
Number of cars able to be controlled at once is limited

name: Causality Interception
overview: change, or nullify the effect of any cause by placing an outside object to intercept the process
description: The user has the ability to stop or alter the effect of any action by putting something literally in the middle of it. An example would be the user saw someone about to be punched in the face and he just so happen to see a teddy bear in the corner. The user can use this power to make the teddy bear take the punch. Thus altering the end result of the action.
pros: Alter or stop any effect to any action.
Send things in between the action maker and action receiver
Teleportation application
cons: Could make a bad effect become worse

name: Book Nitro
overview: Transport yourself into a book
description: This power allows you to go into the world of a book. You could end up changing the whole story line and if someone reads it, YOU will be in the book. There are no loop holes. You can't get stuck. BUT you can die or be discovered. You can take as many people as you want with you and bring people back with you.
pros: You can be IN a book.
You can become a main character
You can bring the characters back if you persuade them.
cons: You might ruin the whole plot.
You could die.
You could be discovered.

name: Text Commands
overview: write and type commands that people will perform upon reading them.
description: With this power, you are able to write and type hypnotic commands that people will automatically obey upon reading them.  Whether something you write is actually a command is entirely up to your intent while you write it.   You can be as vague or specific as you want with your commands.  Upon completing their tasks, people will not remember reading your commands and will have thought they acted on their own unless you specify otherwise in their command.
pros: People will follow your written commands automatically.
You can determine whether something your write is a command or not.
By default, people will not remember being controlled upon completing their tasks.
cons: Will not work if the target does not have the required knowledge to perform the task.
Will not work if the command is physically impossible for the target to perform.
May result in controlling people you never intended on controlling if the wrong people read your commands.

name: Geological Empathy
overview: connect to, feel, and control earthly materials
description: Geopathy is the ability to connect ones self with earth materials. The person can feel the earth and everthing that is happening to a specific area. The ability can also change geological objects and materials by projecting the landscape as a hologram, which then can be used to change it.
pros: You can see and feel the earth.
You can talk to the earth.
cons: Sometimes you may hear many voices if you are near a lot of geological materials.

name: Time Pass
overview: "pass" in and out of time
description: When activated, you will turn transparent and you cannot be harmed by physical mean, but you can be hurt by magic or mystical means. It only lasts five minutes and needs one minute cooldown.
pros: "Pass" out of time itself
Cannot be harmed by physical means
Turn almost invisible
cons: Can be harmed by magic and mystic means
Only lasts five minutes
One minute cooldown

name: Delete This Cryptokinesis
overview: render objects unseen.
description: combo of powers.
pros: Invisiblity
Can make other things invisble too.
cons: requires touch

name: Irony: Relaxed Super Humanism
overview: gain unparalleled strength, speed, concentration, etc. the lesser the effort put into the act.
description: A person with this ability will literally try to just relax and slack off when in a fight. This is because the lesser the effort he puts into the act the more it becomes more powerful, faster, or effective. For example if he is fighting someone as strong as Superman he will need only 0.000001 percent of his total strength in order to deliver his killing blow. Another good example is when he wants to move fast all he's got to do is go extremely slow to the point where he's almost not moving all.
pros: Do nothing and you become so strong to the point where you become immovable and invulnerable.
Its so fun to use only little to almost no power at all against your enemies when they're using 100%
Being relaxed has a lot of health benefits.
cons: You look like you're not doing your best at all.
Your friends think you're just being lazy.
You are only at your most powerful when you're not doing anything at all.

name: Icy Crysmal Detonation
overview: discharge an explosive corrosive mass of ice.
description: This ability allows you to detonate an explosion of ice around your target. You can also channel a small portion of the explosion to your fists for minimal damage. When the torrents of ice hit your target, it will consume them and spread all over them, devouring them like tar. You are also capable of projecting the ice in missile-like constructs.
pros: Detonate yourself like an "icy nuke".
Consume the target with ice.
The ice is incapable of harming you, so no worries.
cons: The explosion technique is dangerous to use around civilians.

name: Temperature Manipulation
overview: absorb and release excess heat from yourself
description: The more heat you absorb, the more you can release from yourself. However, if you do not have any excess heat absorbed, you cannot use this ability. Unless you have mastered this skill, you cannot really absorb a significant amount of heat from objects below room temperature. You can also freeze things so cold that they can snap as a result. Heightened adrenaline levels may also result in inadvertent heat bursts
pros: You can cool down a hot object without any problems
The excess heat you gain from the above can be stored for later uses
You are immune to excess or deficient body heat-related problems
cons: If you absorb too much heat, you begin to burn up inside
To fully heat up or cool down an object, you must be touching it
If you get too hot, you start to glow red, and this is not good for subtlety

name: Human Floppy Disk Drive
overview: read data contained in a floppy disk, format the floppy disk or save data on it.
description: It's extremely rare to find a computer with a floppy disk drive nowadays. Mainly because we stopped using them. So, this power changes you into a human floppy disk drive. Just insert a floppy disk in your mouth. It allows to read the data contained in it. You can also format the disk, an important step for those data containers. And you can also save data on it, such as memories, thoughts, information, etc.
pros: You can save datas on floppy disks in case you're the victim of a memory wipe.
If you find a floppy disk but don't have an adequate computer to use it.
cons: Floppy disks have a very, very small memory capacity.
Floppy disk are hardly found anywhere, except in attics, labs with obsolete equipments, etc.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Altor's Shield
overview: shield yourself from any other super power or anything physical.
description: You can be safe from any illusions, mental manipulation, telekinesis, any time control, any sort of powers as long as you're inside the shield. Kind of like nullification, but that'ss only while youre inside the shield. The shield is also physical, so if someone tries to hit you while you're in the shield, they'd be repelled. It takes little time to erect the shield, like 30 seconds. The shield will stay as long as you are conscious and you will it to.
pros: You are safe from any attacks
You can protect others with this
You won't be defeated
cons: If you're taken by surprise, then you will most likely lose
You can only protect those standing close to you
You have to erect your shield

name: Outta Sight, Outta Mind
overview: make anything invisible for as long as you want.
description: Outta Sight, Outta mind, right? This lets you make anything you want, *Poof* Disappear. No matter the size, or what its made of, You can make it invisible for as long as you want. No restrictions, just don't forget to make the object visible again. It doesn't have to be the whole object, it can be just a finger or toe or hair. It can even be something or someone on TV.
pros: Rob banks without getting caught on camera.
Make Secret item (Cherished or handed down) Invisible so no one will steal it.
Make anyone or anything you see on TV disappear.
cons: Can Still be seen on thermal detectors, or heartbeat sensors.
Can still be Injured while invisible.
May accidently make National monuments disappear.

name: Common Knowledge
overview: gain access to any information that is common knowledge.
description: This power allows you to learn about anything you want as long as it is common knowledge of the population around you. Common knowledge being things that are generally known or could be easily researched, things that have already been discovered or learned by other individuals. This power does not give knowledge of secrets or personal lives as that is not common knowledge. If the info is not part of the common knowledge of people around you anymore, then you have to relearn it a different way.
pros: Will already know anything that an university would be able to teach.
Masters of this power can access the common knowledge of an entire planet.
Will eventually become an expert at every new discovery
cons: Have to choose what you will learn.
Cannot learn secrets, personal events, or new discoveries, unless many people know around you.
If the common knowledge of the population around you changes, your knowledge changes too.

name: Juggernaut
overview: become an almost unstoppable force when running
description: To use your power, you have to run. Once in a speeding motion, you build up a kinetic energy force. the force of a charging rhino, bulldozer, train, & wrecking ball combined. You'll have that increased strength & speed. A force to be reckoned with. Demolishing almost anything & everything in your path. Though it is hard to stop, almost exhausting.
pros: Increased strength & speed
Demolish anything in your path
cons: Hard to stop

name: Cartoon Powers: Captain Marvel
overview: have the powers of SHAZAM
description: With this power you have the wisdom of Solomon, the strength of Hercules, the stamina of Atlas, the power of Zeus, the courage of Achilles and the speed of mercury
pros: You have all of the powers of Captain Marvel and the rest of the marvel family
You have super speed, super smartness, super strength, super stamina, super courage + lots of power
You don't have to say SHAZAM to access these powers
cons: You don't have all of Shazam's powers

name: Dead Aim
overview: have perfect aim, with all guns, bows, spears, and other projectile weapons, if one eye is dead.
description: If you have an eye thats dead, (right or left) doesnt matter which one. Then you could end up with this power. It's a mystery how you get it though. Anyway, that dead eye is regenated and from that point on your aim is perfect every time. If it is possible, you'll hit your target;  no matter how far or unlikely.Pefectly every time.
pros: Hit targets perfectly every single time, with any waepon you can shoot or throw
Your range is greater than the even the best Military training can provide.
No limit for the kind of weapon of your choice.
cons: You are blind in that eye, Unless you're aiming at something. No if you're completely blind.
Does nothing for handheld close range weapons. Your depth perception doesnt change.
You do suffer entense headaches in the beginning. Takes lots of getting used to.

name: The Musician
overview: convert sound into any type of solid sound & energy construct(s)
description: Pick up any musical instrument or sing any song and it becomes a solid sound-energy construct, anything your mind can conceive of for offense or defense. A concussive blast, blades, loyal soldier(s), a hammer the size of a building, vice grips, steps so you can walk on air. The constructs are only visible if you want them to be or if your opponent has some type of above normal senses. All you need is one note. Assassin, Hero, or incredibly rich entertainer. You choose.
pros: You can create constructs of any size or shape. Most effective with lots of ambient noise and energy
Sing and play simultaneously & continually for your strongest weapons, shields, etc.
Intuitively play any musical intrument & sing any song perfectly
cons: Ability must begin as music, you need air & surrounding energy to create constructs
Useless in a vacuum (outer space). Weak effectiveness vs the deaf or vs the blind
Can never play or sing for fun. Again, it will always become a construct capable of hurting someone

name: Quick Change
overview: become invisible and copy what you see through you
description: This power allows the person to copy any patterns or clothes on them or somewhere else. The power simply works by turning yourself invisible and becoming what is seen through you. Example: By becoming invisible and standing in front of a brick wall your skin and clothes become a brick pattern. This also work for clothes and accessories. Simply stand in front of what you want to where and use the power to wear it.
pros: Wear anything or be anything at anytime.
Change skin,hair,eyes,nose etc.
Awesome camouflage
cons: May stay permanant
Can only copy certain things

name: Computation
