overview: do anything a computer can do. Only better!
description:
People with computation could be the most accomplished people on the planet. They can solve complex equations and scenarios in their head, mimic movements with perfect precision, and have amazing memories.

Don't be misled. You cannot interact, merge, or control technologies, let alone surf the net.

Your body would be the hardware your brain's software commands. Vocal cords as speakers for example.

This is a great power that unleashes human potential.
pros: Smart Beyond Belief
Make a lot of money (game theory, probability, etc)
The body can function as computer hardware
cons: No additional hardware. Your chest isn't going to be a printer.
Lame nicknames like Data and Hal.
Some social awkwardness

name: Walking Panacea
overview: develop a cure for any affliction.
description: With this power, you can transform water into a drinkable cure for any affliction. For all intents and purposes, it's still water, but it also contains the cure. To use this power, you need to be touching someone or something with the affliction. The water can only "hold" one cure at a time, and the afflicted person must drink one cup of your cure for it to work. You can make unlimited quantities.
pros: Cure the world's diseases
You may be seen as holy
Your presence isn't required after the cure has been made
cons: One cure at a time
Requires you to be touching someone with the affliction
You need water to start with

name: Antimatter Gauntlets
overview: use them to create and manipulate antimatter
description: With these black gauntlets you can harness the explosive power of antimatter within the palms of your hands. They can be used to create  And manipulate antimatter into any form shape or size.If you wear the gauntlets long enough you could absorb the certain energies within them to gain immunity to antimatter explosions
pros: Can gain immunity from antimatter explosions
Destroy anything in your path
cons: People will label you as a terrorist
the miltiary will hunt you down for them
blowing up your planet

name: Gift: Flames
overview: be gifted at the control of flame and fire
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling fires and flames than other beings. Thus their fire- or flame-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of fire from them. However, someone with this power can only receive fire-based powers, nothing else.
pros: Almost no one has as good control over fire as someone with this power.
Fire-based powers are boosted slightly.
cons: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only fire-based powers now.

name: Molecule Separation
overview: separate your molecules so you become invisible.
description: You can separate your molecules so that you can become invisible and things can pass through you, but you can't go through walls or anything like that. With your molecules separated, you become light and can somewhat fly or float, too. If you become too emotional, your molecules could separate without you wanting them to and if you are invisible and you become shocked or become emotional, they can come back together.
pros: Become invisible
Can fly somewhat
cons: Could become invisible without you wanting to.
Could become visible again without wanting to.

name: Breathe Underwater
overview: breathe underwater.
description: You are able to go underwater forever and actualy breathe as if you had gills.
pros: You can stay Underwater for as long as you like.
You can search for Sunken Treasure off the Florida coast.
You can visit the Nude Beaches for a close-up view
cons: You might forget that you're Underwater
You can get overloaded with Treasure.
You might get caught Peeping at the Nude Beach and have to Register as a Sex Offender

name: Contagion
overview: pass on and receive conditions by touch
description: Also called Contagious Contact, one with this ability can project and receive numerous mental and bodily conditions simply by touching subjects. One with this ability can project or receive thoughts, emotions, behaviors, psychic imprints, compulsions or the like. In addition, they could also project or receive illnesses.
pros: Project thoughts, emotions, behaviors and psychic imprints onto others by touch
Receive (hear or sense) thoughts, emotions, behaviors and psychic imprints of others by touch
Pass on (or receive) illnesses, skills and superpowers
cons: At the lower levels, conditions passed on involuntarily (accidentally sicken others, etc. )
At the lower levels, conditions received involuntarily (accidentally take on sickness, etc. )
At the lower levels, being compelled is much easier (they just have to touch you)

name: Nanotech Armor
overview: produce cyber nanotech armor suit.
description: You can produce a suit of cyber armor made of sentient nanobytes that covers your body. Its nearly indestructible yet you're still very agile. It also increases your strength & speed.
pros: Nearly indestructible yet still agile
Increased strength
Increased speed
cons: Affected by EMP
Sentient nanobytes might become to self aware & turn against you

name: Flesh Manipulation
overview: control flesh and muscles
description: As opposed to controlling blood or the brain this ability lets a person take full control of a person's flesh(or soft tissue). In addition flesh that is dead can also be manipulated. Flesh can be ripped from the body and be transplanted in other parts of the body-- for example manipulating flesh to cover someone's mouth or eyelids. Your own flesh can be manipulated as well to create more muscles or weapons.
pros: Control anything biological and some undead as well
Make your muscles bigger by manipulating them
cons: Does not grant full control over a person's body
People can still think while manipulated

name: Energy Imbuing
overview: store your own energy in objects
description: An Energy Imbuer could be wearing a WMD and you would never know it. Their ability enables them to 'charge' any object with raw energy. Once the energy is in the object, the way it is first released will determine the way the remainder will be released. The result? Rods that release electricity on impact, rings that pack a kinetic punch, and so on. Now while anyone can use these objects, only the user reverse the process--deenergizing the objects to revitalize themselves.
pros: Energy can be released (radiation, kinetic, heat, etc. )
You can reabsorb energy you have stored to revitalize yourself
Personal effects become weapons
cons: Anyone can use an energized object
May not have enough energy to charge anything
Only one type of energy an object

name: Elemental Opposites
overview: change an element into its elemental opposite.
description: With this power you can send out an aura that can turn anything you wish into its elemental opposite. An elemental opposite would be things like Light to Dark, Fire to Ice, and Wood to Metal. The object that is changed will still function like it originally was but will be made out of a new substance. A tree will still grow like a tree but would be made of metal. Changes can be reversed with aura as well. Changes are permanent unless affected by another power.
pros: Can change anything into its elemental opposite.
Change things into the opposite of what people can control.
Changes are permanent unless you or another person uses powers to change substances back.
cons: Can only change a substance into its opposite, nothing else.
Changing substances of attachs does not necessarily mean you will not get hurt.
The opposite of a substance might be no more help to you than the origenal.

name: Super Perception
overview: notice instantly suspicious or out-of-place things
description: One can instantly see out of place things that one would have to either be alert for or trained to find.  Behaviors like tics, nervous habits, and even faked emotion stand out to the user.  Even things like a missing or unusual objects and a different physical atmosphere becomes apparant.  This power is almost completely visual, in that the user must be able to see to perceive through his/her other senses.
pros: You can tell when people are acting suspiciously
You instantly recognize hidden messages
Easily win at Where's Waldo and Eye-Spy
cons: Not all perceptions necessarily indicate danger
Sometimes you wish you didn't notice some guy picking his nose
It helps if you're not blind.

name: Emotional Aura
overview: produce an aura which varies based on your current emotions
description: With this ability, you produce an aura that effects those around you based on your mood. If you're in a joyful state, it increases the energy of you and those near you, and gives them a good mood. If you're disappointed or sad, it will cause others to feel sad. While angered, the aura becomes strong, and instead of sharing your emotions, it puts others into state of fear. A strong negative aura can cause others to be put into a state of shock.
pros: Joy increases the mood around you, and boosts the energy of you and others
Anger will create an aura that increases your strength, but will make others fear you greatly
All emotions effect those around you, and usually positively after both you and them
cons: Great negative emotions can cause chaos around you, such as shaking of the ground, etc.
Friends may favor you for your ability, and not you as a person
Difficult to control, just as regular emotions are

name: Transforming Touch
overview: transform into anything you touch
description: You can transform into anything by just touching it but it might have some side effects like when you touch a piece of paper your body is pure paper.
pros: When You touch your enemy you have all his powers and looks
When You touch a metal fragment you'll become that certain metal
When you touch an animal you'll turn part human part that animal
cons: only half of your body transforms
everything you touch you turn into
whatever weakness you touch has that is your weakness

name: Residual Energy Manipulation
overview: sense and control faint energies/radiation.
description: This ability allows the user to control energy and radition that remains in one place when its main source is no longer there. The user can see the residual energy and then able to make them more visible.  The energy/radiation won't have the effects that it had when it was whole. No radiation poisoning, No heat from energy.
pros: Control energy/radiation that is faint to the human eye.
Use psionic ghosts to talk about what the people they belong to said in that moment
cons: The reactivation of multiple residual energies/radiations at once could cause a massive explosion.
Residual energies/radiations don't have the effects of its former sources.

name: Aura Ball
overview: launch a ball of your aura

pros: May send opponents flying backwards
Hurts real bad(not you)
Powerful
cons: Only damages human/creatures
Can only hurt if praciced (but will freak people out)
People will want to hang around you (may include stalkers)

name: Magic Mimicry
overview: transform into magical energy
description: When you transform into your magic form, you are still human shaped but you will glow a different color, be slighty transparent, and crackle with energy. You can focus this energy into bolts, blasts, shockwaves, ect. It will have a different effect everytime you hit something with your energy. It could change it, bring it to life, destroy it, make it vanish, or something completely random. With time and practice you could probably contol the effect as long as it's within your limits.
pros: Your magic form looks cool
You can focus your energy with varying effects
It's mimicry, with more
cons: Controlling the effects is very hard
Must be in magic form to use your powers
You have a limited amount of energy before you revert to human form.

name: Contortion Inducing
overview: psychically induce involuntary contortion of foes into awkward and odd positions
description: One with this ability causes subjects to not only become flexible, but to actually contort. That means that the subject's body will begin to twist against his will, into strange, perhaps yoga-like, positions; they will twist, turn, bend and contort until they are completely immobilized. Obviously, aside from entertainment purposes, this is rather useful for both combat and defense.
pros: Make enemies twist into strange positions

Their body won't contort past its bodily capability, so they can't die from this power being used
cons: Their body won't contort past its bodily capability, so they can't die from this power being used
If this power is uncontrolled, it'll activate on EVERYONE around, including the user and loved ones
This doesn't just make you flexible, it contorts you, so using this on yourself is a bad idea

name: Last Stand
overview: suddenly turn invincible when you are about to die.
description: When you are about to die, the Last Stand ability converts all your damage into strength, energy and determination, making you invincible when you are in great danger. The more wounded you are, the more power you will have.

overview: pull out a hair before you die and then get reborn at that age from the hair.

pros: Pretty much never die!
Can do pretty cool stunts!
Can stick hair through keyhole, die, then be on other side!
cons: Easy access for villains.
Every 50 times you do this, fate takes a random person.
For every soul fate had to take because of you, you spend that many years in hell.

name: Lightning God
overview: travel and move as fast as a speed of light.
description: A blinding speed that makes you the master of gravitational space. You can see nano light particles, hyper movement and sound vibrations in slow motion.
pros: Multi-task.
Excellent offensive and defensive measure.
cons: For each use, you loose 1 minute of your lifespan.

name: Eschaception
overview: sense the end.
description: The ability to sense/know the end of something. This includes (but is not limited to): the end of a statement, conversation, era, storm, and war. It also allows the user to sense death (the end of a life). It is a specialized form of claircognizance and does not involve any visual aspects.
pros: Useful for road trips and removes the necessity to harass the driver by stating "are we there yet"?
PROFIT from telling people when they will die.
Know when a war will end.
cons: The end of something is never a surprise.
Fatalistic in nature.
Be aware of when the world will come to an end, but not HOW.

name: Tactile Pyrokinesis
overview: mentally control fire by touching objects associated with it and focusing on fire
description: A person can control fire by touching something associated with it (a lighter, paper, wood, etc.), and mentally focusing on the fire it could fuel, thus absorbing the object's power. The air around their free hand will start heating, eventually igniting. They can create fire over one or both hands, without touching the object, and create floating fireballs to launch, alongside blazing jets!! Orange fire is the most common created, and creating rarer high-temperature blue fire takes time.
pros: Generate fire by absorbing the power of anything that is flammable, with no need for outside sources
Play with blazing fireballs, and launch jets of searing flame at enemies!
A user cannot in any way be harmed by their own fire, and can also choose to pass immunity to others
cons: A very dangerous power in the wrong hands
The person has to touch an object, and mentally focus on the source of their power
Can manifest unintentionally under stress(anger, fear, etc. ), but only with a fire-related object

name: Void Weaponry
overview: create indestuctible weapons, armor, and many objects to do your bidding. MUHAHAHAH
description: Summons an indestructible and unlimited substance that can be crafted into anything you can imagine! This can also be an extension of yourself, i.e. tentacles, spikes, bullets,wings. The more concentration you have the more powerful the objects are. At maximum concentration you will have the power to make this indestructible material into powerful minions with thoughts and powers of your choosing! The material can also be converted into a gas, solid, & liquid. Gives strength, flight & durability
pros: Indestuctible weapons and armor
Flight and overtime durability, strength, flight, and mind
Using your mind as an unlimited source of power to create powerful minions
cons: Concentration may be straining
So much power leads to a big ego
Creating minions with powers other than yours may be threatening

name: Soundwave
overview: make sonic sound blasts
description: You could make their heads explode, you could make their ears bleed. You could cancel out sounds and make sounds.
pros: You can fly
You can block
You can kill
cons: None
None
None

name: Kill Shift
overview: turn into anybody who you've killed
description: With this power you can turn into anybody that you've killed. You can imitate their voice and mannerisms perfectly and you have access to all of their memories and knowledge along with your memories and knowledge.
pros: You can turn into anybody that you've killed
You have all of their memories and knowledge
cons: If you never kill anybody this power is useless

name: Fictional Factories
overview: recreate fictional products made by fictional businesses.
description: This power allows you to produce items made by fictional businesses in books,movies,tv shows, etc. There are limits though, you can only obtain 5 fictional factories at any given time.
pros: Have awesome things from books and movies.
cons: Only 5 factories at a time (but an unlimited amount)

name: Emp Control
overview: have control of an EMP
description: EMP control is a deadly ability, seeing that the world is overrun with technology. With this ablity one takes control over an EMP or Electromagnetic Pulse. This ability renders technogology useless. Knocks out street lights, sets off alarms, causing overloads at power plants, damages all electronic communication even to the point of creating a geomagnetic storm.
pros: Knocks out electronics
Can be concentrated to be in a certain area.
cons: Deadly ability
Only effects electronics

name: Death Control
overview: make you or someone else live forever or die
description: Make you or someone else live forever or die instantly or age.
pros: Your can be immortal
cons: You can be dead

name: Was Scepter
overview: acquire an Egyptian scepter and utilize its mystical properties.
description: The Was Scepter bestows upon the user immortality, godly strength, speed, and experience with magic. The scepter can also raise the dead and create portals to the underworld (netherworld).
pros: Immortal.
Revive those who have fallen.
The scepter is attuned to the user, so it is accessible by mind.
cons: Raising decayed individuals would frighten people.
The underworld is dangerous.

name: Super Adaptive Tissue
overview: be able to take in any sort of implant into your body
description: A person with this power can take anything and make it part of their body. In addition no undesired side effects, like rejection, will occur and they are in full control of implanted part. This power also works on internal organs. The implant must be a "part" if it is still attached to the whole it cannot be attached. You can also hide objects within your own tissue to use later. D
pros: Can implant robotic arms, arms of magic beings, hawk eyes, etc.
You can absorb anything as a part as long as it is not already a part of something else
cons: You get more monstrous the more implants you make on yourself
Can only implant if sufficient area is provided
Some implants like arms bigger than your body are impractical

name: Lucid Dreaming
overview: always have lucid dreams
description: A person with this power always has lucid dreams. This lets them control every aspect of their dream. In addition they can use this power even when they are pulled into someone else's dream in ways such as mind contraption. When two lucid dreamers exist in the same dream the person with the stronger mind and willpower becomes dominant. In a lucid dream you are invincible because your thoughts become reality. As long as you believe what you are doing you can do anything.
pros: Take that Freddy Krueger--you can beat him at his own game
Be the hero even in your nightmares
No dream manipulator can beat you and you can shut off the dream at will
cons: Only works in dreams
Sleepwalking--if you first gain this power
Once you learn to control it you can do anything within your dreamworld

name: Lord Of Oblivion
overview: alter reality by controlling the void of non-existence
description: By deleting a piece of reality and then controlling the void that replaces it, you alter reality. You can only have three changes retained at once, plus however many you can focus on. If you lose focus on one that isn't 'saved,' the piece of reality and everything connected to it disappears (death with no afterlife). If you SUDDENLY lose focus, not only does it disappear, but it is replaced by a chaos demon with similar powers that will attempt to destroy reality. Changes must be in line-of-site
pros: Create something you want by deleting some air and then writing what you want over it
After you're done with a creation, just let it turn into nothing again, can control minor demons
With training and practice, you can increase range and even get a few semi-saves ('while awake')
cons: Can not give yourself powers (as you're 'connected' to whatever you change) without a 'change save'
Friends and family lost to the void can be brought back, but will use up a 'change save' to keep
If someone with this power is lost to the void, the resulting demon can slay gods with a blink

name: Perfect Person Perspective
overview: become your own perspective of the perfect person
description: What is your opinion of the perfect person? Whatever it is, with this power, you can become that person. You'll have your "imaginary perfect person's" looks, talents, and everything else.
pros: Become your own perspective of the perfect person
Have your "imaginary perfect person's" looks, talents, and everything else
Be happy
cons: Your perspective of the perfect person might be another's perspective of a horrible person

name: Latent Power Activator
overview: psychically activate powers that haven't revealed themselves
description: Can 'reach' in to a person's mind and 'turn on' their powers. This results with them gaining powers and you becoming a little tired. You can only use this power on those with no powers.
pros: Could get rich selling your services.
Everyone has a latent power even if it is just better memory.
Good counter to Latent Power Absorption
cons: Can't use this power on yourself.
Not much battle use.
No peace and quiet from those who want their powers activated.

name: Falling Potential
overview: suddenly use stored kinetic energy and unleash it as if it had fallen from 2000 feet
description: If you concentrate on any object, you can cause it to react as if it had suddenly stopped at the end of a 2000-foot fall.
pros: Anyone would be foolish to mess with you, lest they become hard to recognize
I can open that safe for you
Three words, superbouncy bouncy balls
cons: You would create a mess wherever you went
Not all things react the same to crashing into the Earth at terminal velocity
You don't actually make anything fly into the air, just react as if it had fallen from that height

name: Teleanima
overview: determine someone's greatest prides, fears, humiliations, etc.
description: Everyone has a deep sadness and everyone has a deep joy. Teleanimists can stand near a person and determine their extremes: the thing that they are most proud of, the thing they are most hopeful for, their faults, fears, and failures. This is automatic and passive, but can be suppressed.
pros: Can find friendly strangers in a crowd
Win someone over by complimenting their biggest pride
Cut someone deep with an incisive insult
cons: No influence on the outside world
Might not be able to resist the perfect diss
Knowing society's deepest darkest secrets is not good for your sleep

name: Genie Summon
overview: summon a genie
description: With this power you can summon a genie. The genie is under your complete control until it grants you three wishes after it does that the genie disappears and you have to wait a period of 365 days until you can use this power again. There are a few restrictions regarding what you can wish for, you can't wish to have super powers, for more wishes, for somebody to fall in love with you, to become a god, to become a genie or for somebody to die.
pros: You can summon a genie.
It will grant you any three wishes.
cons: Once it grants you three wishes the genie disappears and you can't summon a new one for a whole year
You can't wish for more wishes.

name: Alter Angel
overview: shift into angel form at will
description: Each & every living being has 2 images of himself: his physical image & his alternative image. This ability allows you to shift into your alternative image or angel form. Angel forms are naturally empowered: flight, phasing, weapon projection, enhanced physical abilities & limited elemental control. Wings are optional. Angel forms always have platinum hair so you can't go unnoticed anywhere at all, so for your own safety you can't stay in angel form forever & normal weapons can still hurt you.
pros: Be a hero... Or not
Ultimate seducer
Unstoppable
cons: Super strong but not invincible
Always draws attention... Being too perfect has its downsides
Uhm... Being an angel doesn't mean you will go to paradise (if that place really exists)

name: Merlin's Apprentice
overview: have all the powers of the wizard, Merlin
description: Merlin was the greatest wizard ever to live, with vast powers beyond imagination. He mastered the Seven Songs of Wizardry, Changing, Binding, Protecting, Naming, Leaping, Eliminating, and Seeing. He could also command things with his mind, and see without his eyes. He knew the language of trees, and could heal any wound. This ability allows you to control and channel all of these powers. You may not understand this gift at first, but when you do, you will grow even more powerful than Merlin.
pros: Mastery over the Seven Songs of Wizardry
Commanding things around you and using the second sight.
The art of healing and speaking to trees
cons: You may not understand your powers at first.

name: Time Cut
overview: cut up portals in time.
description: With this ability, you are able to go to the future and the past.
pros: Go to any time period
Meet famous people in History
cons: Messing up with time is dangerous

name: Alien Equipment
overview: summon stereotypical alien equpiment.
description: With this power you can summon stereotypical alien equipment such as a UFO, ray gun, and cloaking device. While you may not know how the equipment works you have perfect knowledge of how to use the equipment. The alien equipment only works for the owner of this power. The type of equipment is not fixed, meaning you can change your UFO into a different type of UFO. When the object is summoned a green crop circle symbol appears in the air in the area where you are summon the item.
pros: Have many different stereotypical pieces of alien technology.
Have your own personal, customizable UFO.
Alien technology is considered to be far more advanced than Earth's.
cons: You do not know how to make the equipment, only use it.
The government will want to expirement on you.
Only get one of each piece of equipment.

name: Personal Demon Inducement
overview: induce psychological issues in the form of demons onto people
description: This ability is a mental power. This ability allows one to induce other people's hidden mental problems in the form of pesky demons. They will taunt and torment them until their eventual self- destruction. The user can induce new issues to their victims as well. For example, if a victim suffer a major failure, the user can create mental demons to poke fun at that failure. The demons are mental, they can only seen by the victim.
pros: Torture victims
The demons are invisible to other people
cons: Victims can overcome them if they beat their problems

name: Enchanting Flavor
overview: imbue any food with any taste or flavor you desire
description: The summary says it all. You can eat the healthiest food on the planet and absolutely LOVE it. Make your Brussels sprouts taste like mint chocolate chip ice cream, make liver and onions taste like filet mignon, even make quinoa palatable! Can also transmute rancid and out of date food into healthy, sanitary, and delicious sustenance.
pros: Eating healthy never tasted so good
Never have a meal you don't thoroughly enjoy
Did I mention the thing about quinoa?
cons: There's something to be said about developing character by having to eat stuff you don't like
That's it

name: Via Curious Control
overview: control someone remotely and expirence what they do
description: Through a pyschic link, your mind takes over someone else's. You yourself are still in your body, but you're remotely controlling whoever you want. Every experience is experienced by both persons. Only emotions and death are not experienced by you.
pros: You can experience multiple lives in one lifetime.
You can fulfill desires of all kinds. Wether good or bad
Your able to go, do, learn, and experience things you never could before.
cons: If you try to completely changing someone else's life it can either turn against you or stop working
The link can only work for a day up to a year then this person is no longer accesible to you.
You can have multiple links but only one person can be controlled at a time.

name: Astral Projection
overview: mentally have an out of body experience
description:
Using this power allows you to go into a trance & astral project yourself to a psychic dimensional plane. You can communicate with spirits & you can astrally appear & communicate to people & enter their dreams. You can also astrally trap another person in the psychic plane so they can't go back to their body. But using this power, you only have a 24 hr. period or your body will fall into a catatonic state. Also while in
trance, you are left defenseless.
pros: Spiritually appear anywhere
Communicate with the dead
Astral trap another astral projected person
cons: You only have 24 hr out of body before your body goes into a coma or catatonic state
Your body is left defenseless

name: Gift Of Apollo
overview: have perfect aim with a bow, be good with any instrument, never get sun burned
description: With the Gift of Apollo you'll have perfect aim with a bow and arrow so you could be a pro hunter and get lots of money! Also, you could show off your perfect body without having to worry about getting burned! And finally, you can impress anyone with your amazing talent with any instrument you want to play!
pros: Fire a bow with perfect accuracy
Play any instrument like a pro
Never get sun burned!
cons: Not as cool as the other gifts of the gods.
Not really any bad after that

name: Light Absorption
overview: absorb light energy harmlessly
description: Sight is a person's strongest sense and without it, they are severely disabled. A Light Absorber knows this better than anyone. They drain all light from a 50-foot radius, making it totally pitch black. But, even though this power may blind others, the user can still see in the darkness.  Yet, this may come with a cost. Sometimes, the user absorbs ALL light--even background radiation. If so, then unless he learns to absorb the less harmful part of the spectrum, using this power poisons the user.
pros: Minimum concentration needed to generate a 50-foot radius of total darkness
Light Absorbers can still see in the dark (they also have either Night Vision or Lightless Vision)
Light Absorption can also be used to absorb light attacks with little to no harm
cons: Cannot generate light, or manipulate the darkness they generate
Also pick up background radiation, thus poisoning self (unless you have adaptations to prevent it)
Letting absorbed light build without releasing some, often results in the user overheating

name: Media Manipulation
overview: create, change, or control all form of media.
description: This ability will allow the user to take control of all things that are considered media: newspaper, televisions, magazines, etc. The user can actually alter newspaper or magazines to say or have what he wants on it. He can appear on tv or the media aspect of the internet without living his home. If played right, this ability can influence people to do what ever the user wants them to do.
pros: Manipulate all media
Can create media
cons: Can't control electronic media if out of power
Can't contol paper based media if they are physically destroyed

name: Alarm Clock
overview: sleep for a specific amount of time and always wake up completely refreshed.
description: With this power, you never need to hit the snooze button again. Using your mind alone, you can set an internal alarm clock that wakes you up at a specific time or after a specific length of time. But here's the best part: Be it 5 minutes or 5 hours, you always feel COMPLETELY refreshed when you wake up. You can also purposely knock yourself out for things like surgery, MRIs, class, and that strange curiosity you have about what it's like to fall asleep at the wheel.
pros: Always wake up feeling refreshed no matter how little you sleep.
Stay up all night or go to bed with the rest of the world (heyooo)--your choice.
Nyquil's got nothin' on you
cons: You might miss that exhausting, tired dragging you get after sleepless nights. Wait... No you won't!
You won't be able to relate with people who feel tired in the morning
You might get carried away with those wild dreams you keep having

name: Structure
overview: change the structure of any object.
description: The user can change the structure of an object, making it softer or harder, lighter or heavier, and so on. This ability is only active when you want to.
pros: Break through anything.
Dampen hits by making yourself softer.
cons: You need to touch the object you want to re-structurize

name: Lightning Vision
overview: electrocute enemies with your eyes
description: This power is like laser or heat vision, except that instead of lasers or heat coming out of your eyes, lightning bolts do
pros: Can electrocute your enemies
cons: Your eyes turn yellow after using this to much (this might not be a bad thing if you like yellow)

name: Decimation
overview: destroy anything with a simple thought
description: Devistating if used by the wrong people because it can be used to destroy continents.
pros: Destroys anything easily
Can be used to get to what you're headed for quickly
cons: If in the wrong hands it could be used to destroy continents
Too destructive to be used by the inexperienced

name: People Person
overview: create an infinite amount of people in any image, physical attributes, personality you want
description: With you mind you put every trait that you would want that person to have and in a matter of moments they will appear
pros: You can "play" God
You can make the perfect person
You can make super soldiers
cons: You "play" God
The creations might rebel like Frankenstein
You might miss some details

name: Firearm Precision
overview: fire guns with 100% accuracy.
description: With this ability, you always accurately fire guns. There are two limitations to this ability: 1. You must be able to see the target. 2. Your weapon isn't always as accurate as you are. If you're firing a pistol at a target a mile away, you're most likely not going to hit it. This ability applies to any firearm, Including flamethrowers, snipers, machineguns, bazookas, etc.
pros: Fire any gun with 100% accuracy.
This includes flamethrowers, bazookas, everything that goes bang with a trigger bro.
cons: Your weapon may not be as accurate as you are.
You must be able to see your target.

name: Moon Blade10th Timeless Silver
overview: summon the blade of time.
description: The 10th MB, has a large hand guard, with 2 silver clock-hands meeting at an angle to form a triangular blade. The blade can cut portals into any time and dimension, and well as bypass any time paradoxes (ex. Going back in time to kill someone, will only make the person disappear in current time, w/o affecting any people they interacted with). The blade also allows to absorb an attack into a timeless dimension, and then spill it out from portals around the target (ex. In comments)
pros: Controls time
Disables time paradoxes
cons: Difficult to comprehend time change

name: The Eye Of The Destroyer
overview: charge up and fire a huge devastating beam from your eyes straight forward.
description: You can even risk using it, but it does a lot of insane damage by firing a concentrated light beam of energy to disintegrate everyone and everything in your path until it dissolves into nothingness. In my idiom "Pain is in the eye of the destroyer".
pros: Can have a potential desire to burn all who oppose you.
cons: It'll take a lot of hours to charge up.

name: Heat Lightning
overview: turn heat into lightning
description: The user is able to turn heat from the surrounding into lightning that can be discharged from the body. The intensity and voltage of the lightning is dependent on the heat from the surrounding. The hotter the surrounding, the more powerful the lightning.
pros: Heat is almost always present throughout the year
Any source of heat can be used
Can shoot bolts or streams of lightning
cons: Can't use the power during winter
Can't use the power if you have a cold

name: Time Hollow
overview: create time-space portals in a small area.
description: Can be used by Demon Transformation #3 Black Demon. You take out an hourglass, throw it in the air and destroy it (gun, slashing with sword, etc. ) The sand flies in all direction and each grain turns into a portal. By going through one portal, you can exit in any other. Therefore, you can be jumping in between the portals, and while you are doing so, you can slash your enemies to pieces because your movement is so fast they will no be able to block your attacks.
pros: By repeatedly going in and out, you build up great speed.
Great way to finish a fight fast.
cons: If you go too fast, you will have trouble seeing your targets, thus risking to hurt your friends.
Foes, can move out of the portals area, and since the portals do not move, this will...
... render the attack useless.

name: Empathic Blast
overview: fire a blast of emotional energy as an attack
description: Empathic Blast is the ability to generate a blast out of pure emotions (perhaps a specific emotion or numerous combined) which imposes said emotions on whoever is hit; OR it may vary in intensity based on the emotions of the user; OR effects may vary based on emotions (happy means a good effect, etc. )
pros: Finally, a truly offensive use for empathy
It's actually a concussive attack
Blast is also potentially helpful, if used on a friend/loved one (boost confidence, numb pain)
cons: Aniothability
Perspicuity
Empathic Backlash

name: Oxykinesis
overview: control the element of oxygen, including creating reactions and changing its phases
description: A person with this power has the ability to manipulate the element of oxygen with their mind. Not only can the user use it to take oxygen from someone's lungs, they can also create carbon dioxide by having it react with a person's insides as well as induce oxygen poisoning. They can also start many oxidation reactions. Also, pure oxygen can be use to start a path of flame, which you can then direct by manipulating the oxygen in the room.
pros: Can create oxidation reactions
Steal oxygen from people's lungs or induce oxygen poisoning
Can redirect the flow of oxygen in the air so you can start a path of flame
cons: Need to rip out oxygen to use it
Less usable when trapped in a burning building, since the flames keep on taking your oxygen away

name: Holographic Computer Display
overview: control a computer that is holographic anytime one wants
description: The user of this power is able to access a holographic computer. The only parts that are visible are the screen, the keyboard, and touch sensitive pads. Anyone can see the computer but only someone who has this power can touch the computer. The computer acts like a high-tech model and can access the internet. The computer will always update to be the same as the best model possible.
pros: Free high-tech computer with internet access.
Takes up virtually no space and it can't be hacked or traced.
Parents can't put Parental Controls on the computer.
cons: Don't even try using this power in combat.
Can't save files on to the computer.
Flash drives cannot access into the computer as there is no physical aspect to it.

name: Super Skidding
overview: slide across surfaces in any direction at high speeds
description: This power allows the user to slide across surfaces at high speeds. They can do this using any part of their body and they are immune to friction burn. Though this power can be used similar to superspeed, they lack the ability to use this ability for purposes other than movement. However this ability is useful because the user doesn't have to be able to physically move limbs thus they can bypass people who look at your body to predict movements.
pros: Like super speed but no need to actually move your limbs thus making you unpredictable
Can even build up speed to slide up buildings or even skid across water
Immunity to friction burn and no skid marks
cons: Can't use this unless you are on a surface
Tunnel vision
Need to train reaction time and balance

name: Limitless Weapons
overview: summon a limitless amount of any type of weapon.
description: When you say "Adeat", a weapon of your choosing appears. It can be any weapon and you can summon as many as you want.
pros: You can attack multiple enemies at once.
You will never run out of weapons to use.
Can also summon shields and armors.
cons: Enemies can use the weapons you summon.

name: Fire Eater
overview: eat fire and gain all the nutrients a person need for a year
description: With this power a person has a heat resistant mout and heat resistant innards so that he can eat fire. The fire has to be on something though (a stick, a cookie etc. ) and when you ingest it you gain all the nutrients you need for the next 365 days.
pros: You have a heat resistant mouth and heat resistant innards
When you eat fire you gain all the nutrients you need for the next 365 days
cons: Not much use in physical combat
Only your mouth and innards are heat resistant not the rest of your body

name: Paradis Terrestre (Eden)
overview: release a toxin that confuses all five senses
description: By fanning your wings, you can place your victim in an illusion by utilizing pollen. Now you evade all their normal senses, so you can assassinate him quickly.
pros: Produce madness inducing illusions
Kill your enemy while he/she's in a daze
Enemy has no way of counterattacking unless he's a wind user.
cons: Have to be a Butterfly hybrid
Have to sleep for 24 hours after use
Can be blown away by a strong wind

name: Water Empathy
overview: gain various enhancements by being in contact with water
description: 'Swims like a fish' barely covers the extent of a Water Empath's abilities. When they are covered in water, their healing, strength, speed, and reflexes are doubled. They also: know their exact location (latitude/longitude) while on water, have a natural "Waterproofing" that keeps them and anything they are touching warm and dry and oxygenated underwater, and can even find underwater people. Also, they swim like a fish. However, they do not have hydrokinesis and are powerless without water.
pros: Doubled strength, speed, and healing
Know where they and other people are while at sea
Have a "waterproofing" that keeps them dry and breathing
cons: No hydrokinesis
Powerless when out of water
Physically hurt by water pollution

name: Primordial Sense
overview: sense near-future danger in time to flee.
description: The Primordial sense is a sixth sense possessed by animals in nature that alerts them of dangerous weather like hurricanes. It's not a premonition or predicition it's more of a feeling or sense that alerts you of near future danger or when danger is lurking around you.
pros: You are able to flee from the danger in time.
You can save other people from the danger.
cons: People might not believe in the danger you sense.

name: Telesympathy
overview: tell and understand others' motivations, emotions, and values
description: A person with this power does not have telepathy. They have no power over a person's thoughts based on reason. Instead, they have the ability to read people's emotions, motivations, and values. The person immediately knows what kind of person they are talking to and whether they are inherently good or bad in nature. In addition, they can send their emotions to others, so that others can understand their own emotions.
pros: You will be an excellent psychologist and can persuade people to turn good/evil
You understand people-something that millions, maybe billions of people can't do
This works in any language, since emotions and goals are universal
cons: Another Pro: You can convey your own emotions back to others, similar to giving a speech
Doesn't work on machines and is less effective on completely rational people
You might be swayed to your opponents side, unless you have a strong will

name: Tachyon Force
overview: control tachyon particles
description: Being imbued with Tachyon particles enables you to control tachyonic energy. Move, react and see faster than the speed of light. Become invisible to anyone who cannot stop time even when you are not moving. Dodge lightning and lasers. You can nullify teleporters. If something makes contact with you, solid, fluid or energy, it will either be metabolized, disintegrate or explode. Time travel may be possible.
pros: Move faster than the speed of light
Become invisible, impalpable and invulnerable at the same time
Cause things to disintegrate or explode
cons: You are not able to move at less than lightspeed unless you revert to normal
Reverting to normal takes a monumentous amount of concentration
No control over what happens when you make contact with something in your tachyonic form

name: Egyptian Gods: Monthu
overview: have superhuman reflexes and fight well.
description: Monthu is the Egyptian falcon god of war. He is usually depicted as a falcon-headed man, but turns into a bull-headed man when angered. Users will be able to fight with speed, precision, and strength, as well as have superhuman reflexes. Users will also have the ability to morph into either a bull or a falcon, which are both powerful and deadly creatures.
pros: Be extremely fast and accurate while fighting.
Have superhuman reflexes.
Transform into two awesome animals.
cons: Animal transformations are very draining in energy.

name: Emotion Negation
overview: negate people's emotions
description: With this power you can negate people's emotions. You can make it so that a person will never be angry or sad or happy or scared etc. You can give people back their emotions whenever you want.
pros: You can negate people's emotions
You can negate villain's emotions for anger making them good
cons: You can't negate your own emotions

name: Planet Energy Absorbsion
overview: absorb enegy from planets
description: The ability to absorb energy from plantets. The kind of energy you absorb depends on what planet it comes from. Example: Neptune: Water, Mars:Rock, Earth:Life, Venus:Plants. You can project the energy at foes, surround yourself with energy,or make a sheild with the energy. When you are finished with the energy, you must return it to the planet in which it came, or else the planet will die. With Earth's life energy, you may heal people to a certain extent.
pros: Absorbtion time is really fast
The more planets you know, the more types of energy you can use
Heal people to a certain extent
cons: You must return the energy
After keeping the energy for a long period of time, it grows weaker
You may not use more than one planet's energy at a time

name: Air Cannon
overview: compress air to get a very dense sphere of compressed air
description: Capability to compress air around the user to create a dense sphere of compressed air. The sphere will explode when touched, releasing an energy equal to 10 High Explosive Grenades.
pros: Very powerful ability to cause a wide area damage
Become hell pitcher (throw the sphere and see what remains from your enemies)
Become an untrackable terrorist
cons: The sphere is unstable, could explode even with a light touch
Unusable when the air is not present (in space or underwater)
Require a very intense concentration to maintain the stability of the sphere

name: Healing Bomb
overview: turn a ball of mud into a instantaneous healing explosive
description: You could heal anyone, one bomb at a time. Take a second to infuse mud with your healing energy. Your healing bomb explodes on contact with any living thing. You could heal injuries, sickness, replace limbs. You can heal your teammates and repel enemies away from them. You will be an irreplaceable ally.
pros: Completely heal anyone in an instant
Anyone caught in the blast radius will be instantly healed of their injury, illness.
You get to throw mud and make pretty sizeable explosion
cons: Could accidentally heal enemies
Need to treat mud with your healing energies to make the bomb work
Bombs don't damage people but does throw them off their feet & does property damage

name: Movie Synchronization
overview: do anything associated with movies.
description: With this power you can do anything that you see in movies. You can also make the characters that are in the movie, appear and fight for you.
pros: Copy the powers and abilities of characters in movies.
If your a movie addict, then this is the perfect power for you.
Summon characters that appear in the movie to fight for you.
cons: You can't do anything too extreme (like being God).
You have to have seen the movie and to summon a character you must know their first name at least.
If someone else knows more about a movie than you do, they can find your weaknesses.

name: Emotion Absorption
overview: absorb the emotions of those around you and turn them into superpowers.
description: By using eye contact, you can absorb the emotions of those around you and turn it into a variety of powers. Superstrength for anger, water manipulation for depression, invisibility for fear, superspeed for happiness or nervousness, etc.
pros: The more people around, the better
The innocent people are your power source
Even your enemies give you a power
cons: Depressed people will become suicidal
Many people become emotionless
Those close to you are affected

name: Angelic Presence
overview: have a presence that is angelic
description: Anyone you encounter will be calmed/fascinated by you and believe that you are an angel. Also they will welcome you into their homes as they will believe that it will bring them good luck.
pros: You may not have any enemies, just people who want to gain your favor.
People may think you're good, even when you're not.
cons: Someone has to know you really well in order for this power to not affect them.

name: Flash Mnemonics
overview: recall people and/or powers through memories when in a dangerous situation
description: This ability is extremely rare, and very powerful. You can recall people you've met or thought of before, and also recall any kind of power or ability that someone had. It works through 'flashes' of someone you've seen or met, or of someone using an ability, such as regeneration or telekinesis. The user can then rely on the memory they have of someone to activate the same ability that that person displayed. It is different from empathic mimicry in that you rely on memory instead of empathy.
pros: Flashbacks of abilities allow split-second replication of a power
Can be used in any dire situation
Once a person recalls someone, they get their ability permanently
cons: Does not work if you aren't in a dire situation
You might remember someone with a dangerous ability

name: Call Of The Guardian
overview: call upon your guardian spirit.
description: A spirit, usually a type of demon, when called upon takes a physical form and aids you in battle. The spirit can have two physical forms. For example, a wolf demon will have the form of a majestic powerful wolf, and a cute cuddly puppy form.
pros: Aids you in battle
Is bound to you for life
If your reincarnated, it will take a new form too
cons: You to are bound to it, therefore you feel its pain if its hurt
Only have one guardian

name: X Men Powers
overview: have the powers of one X-Men every day
description: With this power you can gain all of the powers of any superhero who was or is an X-Men. However you can only use the powers of one hero a day. Once you choose the hero you are stuck with his or her powers for a full 24 hours.
pros: You can gain the powers of any X-Men
cons: You can only use one a day

name: The Butterfly Effect
overview: go back into specific places in your life through the memory of that moment
description: Just like in the movie you could go back in your life and choose to fix things in your past, see what really happened during certain moments, play out different scenarios, etc.
pros: Fix mistakes that you or others have made
Have fun with the question"what could have happened"
cons: Can only  go as far back as your first memory
If you die in a memory, you will be completely erased from the world

name: Autopyro
overview: light things on fire (including yourself) without physically harming them/you
description: By thinking of something on fire, it will light on fire for real. That something will not burn, but the fire can burn other people or things.
pros: You can light yourself on fire to fight, a la Human Torch
You will be fine afterwards
The fire is still real and can burn other people
cons: The fire can still burn other people
It can cause immense panic
It can expose you

name: Rpg Stats Holograph
overview: see holographs with people's stats as roleplaying characters
description: Anytime you see someone you can also see a holographic display of the stats the person would have as an RPG character. The display shows the level, HP, strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, and charisma of the person. It will also show what class they would be as a roleplaying character. The holograph will last for as long as you want it to.
pros: You know who is more powerful than you and can avoid fights with them.
You're the only one who can see the holographs.
cons: Having this power on auto will fill your vision with the holographs and make you go crazy.
Can be resisted

name: The Lycan Within
overview: shift into a powerful werewolf form
description: You can become the 'second-generation' werewolf from 'Underworld', called a Lycan, and have superbly enhanced senses, strength, stamina, and reflexes. Wolfsbane vastly enhances regeneration if used on wounds, and also augments your senses and strength if directly consumed, or the aroma inhaled briefly. You are immune to normal silver, and can extract bullets by consciously focusing on them, but the liquid silver nitrate is very dangerous, working by destroying the brain's regenerative power.
pros: People can have senses and reflexes far beyond any human or animal
You retain some human thought and reasoning
Your werewolf form makes you the perfect crime-fighter!
cons: Some people might fear you as a werewolf (Lycan)
Normal silver is harmless, but the chemical silver nitrate, in doses over 200 mg(2 ml), is lethal
Smaller doses of silver nitrate(from 20-199 mg) hinders regeneration and shifting, and dulls senses

name: Shadow Blade(S)
overview: summon up blades of different size, shape, and style for the shadows around and inside of you
description: This is a very useful ability that may require practice to master.   What it does is that you focus the shadow energy around you and fashion it into a blade or two. These blades can take any shape or size.
pros: Helps in bad situations
Gives you a good weapon to fight with
Can be any size of style of any sword, even fictional
cons: Could summon the blade inside of you, if your inside shadows are the only ones available
These blades could act on their own

name: Biological Immortality
overview: be unfazed by any physical trauma
description: An individual with Biological Immortality is unique in many ways. First, they stop aging after their first child is born. Second, they are undistracted by any trauma directed against them--a Biological Immortal can lose limbs, vital organs, and parts of their head and continue to function. Third is that they will not naturally heal; gaping wounds will remain for months. Even simple paper cuts must be bandaged.
pros: Effectively immortal
Can lose important pieces (chunks of head, etc. ) and still function
You are no longer very stoppable
cons: Effectively immortal
Will not naturally heal
May become egotistical and maniacal

name: Air Travel
overview: turn into air to travel extremely fast
description: You turn into air and can ride air currents or create your own to travel on. It can be difficult to turn back to your original form again the first time. It takes practice to create your own air currents.
pros: Can escape dangerous situations.
Can't fall to your death.
cons: Is difficult to revert to your original form the first time you change
Takes practice to create air currents

name: Chaos Manipulation
overview: see the possibiltiy of chaos and cause it or force chaos in a non-chaotic situation.
description: You can suddenly see and manipulate the negative energy that causes chaos. You manifest the negative energy in your hands, so in order to cause chaos, you must touch the target or expel the negative energy in the form of a "chaos bolt" This ability only affects people or objects in negative ways. People and animals could experience weakness, aging, random cuts and bruises, sickness, and/or death. Objects will become broken, rust or weakened. Plants will wilt. Nothing is safe from your abilities.
pros: Nothing and no-one is safe from your powers.
The chaos can get worse the longer you touch someone with negative energy
Great for Revenge in any way. Have someone trip on the floor or fall through it.
cons: No choice to see chaos probability, can cause you to become insane
temptation to cause chaos, it builds if you don't use your abilities
needs hands to manipulate the negative energy and eyes to see chaos possibility

name: Lightning Vortex
overview: charge up electricity then fire it off in a blast
description: One hand becomes positive, the other negative. Electricity will start to flow between both hands and your body. The longer you can keep the circuit going the stronger the final blast will be. Ex: 1 minute can destroy a house while 1 hour can destroy a town. Maximum destructive power is a full city which takes five hours. All that will be left of whatever is hit will be a crater. While charging the user's body will be immune to all harmful electrical effects.
pros: You can destroy enemy bases from a long distance away.
cons: If your circuit is broken by an someone else your body will get huge amounts of electricity running
(cont) rampant through it and you will most likely die.
It takes a long time to get to maximum charge.

name: Magic Garnet Summon
overview: summon a garnet necklace that gives the wearer magical powers.
description: This ability allows you to summon an ancient magical garnet necklace, that gives powerful magical abilities to the wearer. The garnet gives the wearer the ability to summon crimson energies that can be formed into different constructs. It also gives you the ability to transmute anything into garnet, or to summon large amounts of non-magical garnet out of nowhere. Only the pure of heart can use the magic. You can make the necklace disappear at any time.
pros: Summon a powerful magical artifact.
It grants the user many powers.
Only the pure of heart can use it.
cons: You could lose it.
Only one garnet necklace at a time.

name: Terra Sapiens
overview: transfer your conscience, intelligence and personallity into the Earth or any planet you are on
description: With this power, you can transfer your intelligence, personality and conscience into the Earth, or any other planet you are standing on. You can see everything that happens on the planet, feel everything, smell everything, etc. You can see what happens on one side of the world, and use the Earth to talk to people there. You can then go back to your old body.
pros: Talk to relatives or friends on the other side of the world to your physical body.
See if anything is happening dangerously.
cons: You'd be in pain if people are currently mining out of you, an things like that.

name: Omni Substitution
overview: become a substitute of anything.
description: The user can act as a substitute for anything another person needs him to be, a power source, transportation, e food or a person of a certain profession. At first, this ability only activates when the need for a substitution is issued. The user can master it so that they do not need another person to issue the need for substitution.
pros: Become a substitute for anything else.
Have all the abilities of the thing you are substituting for.
cons: Without training, the ability does not activate until substitution is needed.
The abilities of the thing you are substituting for are temporary.

name: Cardboard Enhancement
overview: have cardboard act as the thing you're pretending it is.
description: Have you ever pretended that a cardboard tube was a sword, or spyglass? Have you ever gone on an imaginary flight in a cardboard box rocket ship, or used one as a time machine?   This power makes it so that cardboard takes on the properties of what you imagine it to be. A tube really is a spyglass, a cardboard sword will really cut, a cardboard box "drives" along the ground like a race-car, and the walls of a cardboard box fort really will stave off attack.
pros: If you can imagine something that cardboard can imitate, it acts as that thing.
Operatinbg a cardboard box is as easy as it was when you were a kid.
As in, you don't need to know how to fly a real rocket ship to fly a cardboard box imitating one.
cons: Cardboard reverts back to normal if it gets wet.

name: Temporal Restoration Field
overview: manipulate "Temporal Restoration Fields"
description: TRFs allow you to reload points of time. By creating a TRF and restoring it, you will be taken backwards in time to that point. Minor restoration fields can be used to repair objects or heal people by restoring it to an earlier state, without the need to create a TRF for them. You can duplicate things by reloading their TRF too. Also comes with an innate understanding of TRFs, enough so that someone with sufficient engineering skills might be able to make a TRF Machine with your knowledge/help.
pros: Load a gun with one clip, then just reload the TRF from its loaded state when it runs out.
Hopeless situation? Want to time travel? Load a TRF. Someone injured? Reload the state of their body
See a nice car/weapon/whatever? Reload its TRF and have it.
cons: Loading a TRF made in the future takes you back to that future, regardless of changes to the past
Can't go back further than when you got the power, you go back to the place you made the TRF
You must have encountered an object to duplicate it, it must have been functioning once to repair

name: Temporal Artifact: Matchbook
overview: spawn time-pausing matchbooks at will
description: The matchbook contains any number of matches you choose. You can make as many of the books as you want, and anyone can use them and the matches within. You must use up or destroy a book to be rid of it though. When a match is lit, time pauses for everything save the holder, anyone touching them, anything they're carrying, and the air around them. You can move objects, but you can't bring new things into paused time. When the *FLAME* goes out, time is restored, but a match can only be used once.
pros: True time pausing, in a convenient gift form. You can have unlimited matches in a book.
The flame carries the power, so you can have a lot of extra time if you can get a candle.
You can steal, kill, work, etc. in zero seconds. Or, even better... You can light a dark area!
cons: The summoned books can be stolen, watch out in particular for books with unlimited matches.
Water doesn't flow. If you start a fire, it can take a while to put out and get people killed.
If you're not careful when moving things/people, they'll go flying/break bones.

name: Death Transfer
overview: transfer a lethal blow onto somebody else.
description: When you are dying because of a bullet wound, sword stab or any other reason, you can spare your life at the expense of another life by just thinking of the unlucky victim. Your injury is instantly healed and the victim takes the hit for you. If you do not think of someone while you are dying from a lethal blow, a random person will be chosen for you.
pros: Never die from physical attacks
Injury is instantly healed: you can be healed from cancer by transferring it.
Can do life-risking stunts without fear of dying
cons: If you do not think of someone when dying, a random civilian dies. A friend or family member can die
Can still die from age or disease
Does not transfer pain or damage if not lethal.

name: Retrocognitive Projection
overview: produce images of the past of an area
description: One with this ability needs only to be in an area for an instant, and they can pick up on psychic vibrations left behind by others who have been there. This psychic-vibration channeling allows the projections of a 3-D holographic image of the area's past. This can be used on any are previously visited by sentient/animated/living beings (people, ghosts and undead, plants, robots, aliens ALL count)
pros: Project the past of an area (who committed a crime, who took the cookie from the cookie jar, etc. )
Looks like the event is really happening (great form of illusion that few are immune to)
Psychic imprints are left in areas all the time
cons: If a place has never been visited before, you could only project the scene of you visiting
If power is undeveloped, can't control how far back into the past to project (Stone Age, 1850's etc)
True Sight is able to see through this projection (the only powerc that CAN)

name: Strike Delay
overview: delay the impact of your attacks.
description: With this power you can delay the strikes of your attacks until you choose to trigger them. Your initial attack dose no damage, but you can then choose to trigger the strike whenever you want. Say you punch someone 3 times in the face with this power. It would be as if they had not even gotten punched. But, you could then trigger those punches at a later date. This power also works with objects and space. You can leave an attack hanging in the air to catch someone off guard.
pros: Control when your attack connects.
Works with any type of damage from physical or weapon strikes to energy blasts.
Set traps by leaving attacks hanging in space until called upon.
cons: You can not trigger individual attacks. When you trigger they all strike at once.

name: Bookworm Immunity
overview: be unaffected by anything you can understand.
description: Matter of any form, energy of any form, psionic or magical damage, if you can understand how an attack might work you're immune to it. Viruses, poisons, venoms and also bacteria. This power will protect you from deadly gases, but not let you survive vacuum. However, it would let you survive extreme cold or heat. If you can grasp how reality altering works, then no one could erase you from reality. Know how telepathy works and no one could erase any knowledge from your mind.
pros: Most non-psionic or non-magical things will be easy to learn about.
The easiest immunities just require Internet access.
cons: Reality alteration could require a genius level IQ.
Knowledge about something esoteric, like magic, could be hard to find.

name: Short Term Memory Eraser
overview: erase someone's short-term memory.
description: It allows you to wipe out someone's short-term memory before the information has a chance to be consolidated in the long-term memory. You do not have to touch your target; you just need to be in their vicinity, allowing you to erase many people's short-term memory at the same time. Be aware that if some information had time to form enough connections with the long-term memory, the person will experience a sense of presque vu, as the information has disappeared but the connections still remain.
pros: You can erase anyone's memory of the last seconds or minute.
You JUST did something wrong? Quick! Wipe out everyone's memory!
You know how frustrating it is to feel you just forgot something but can't remember it at all?
cons: There's a short time frame before a recent memory is either forgotten or remembered for a long time.
You can't select which information to erase. There's not much information to choose from anyway.
It's much less effective on people with Enhanced Memory, Infinite Memory Palace or Digital Mind.

name: Life Absorption
overview: steal life from living animals or other forms of life
description: With this ability, you can steal life from any living organism, giving you it's life, and leaving you more powerful than before. For example, you could steal life from a wolf, or even from a tree. It increases your physical performance every time you use this ability, making you potentially very powerful. Life that you steal from slowly withers away as you become stronger.
pros: Take the life of any living organism and steal it for yourself, such as animals, plants, even grass
Increases your life and physical performance, making you potentially extremely powerful
If you're still in your growing stage, it will increase the rate of your growth if you use it often
cons: The life which you steal it from slowly withers away as you become stronger
You could accidentally use this ability on someone that you know (though it can be switched off)
Leaves you with a lust to absorb more life

name: Heaven's Light
overview: make a divine light explosion.
description: You raise your hands towards the sky and say the following words: Heaven release thy wrath!  And as the last word leaves your mouth the sky unleashes a beam of pure light on the chosen location you had in mind, making an explosion when it hits something within the radius of the blast (100 feet).
pros: Great to send those who form a treat against you on a holiday.
You can blast anything at any time at any location.
Light also blinds those who prefer darker locations.
cons: If they interrupt you when you are saying the words, the attack is canceled.
You can't hit your target if there is no sky.
If you think about yourself while saying those words you WILL kill yourself.

name: Nanotechnosis
overview: control tiny robots
description: The tiny robots that you control can be programmed to build, destroy and cover yourself with metal
pros: Can change anything metallic into something different, e.g. a car into a cannon.
Can have artifical abilities, e.g. super strong and fast
Can't get hurt by a high fall or a big explosion
cons: Have to keep your memories in a computer
Can be hacked
Becomes weak when wet

name: Controle De Les Spirte
overview: control someone's mind, body, soul, heart, and thoughts.
description: You can stop everything that is going on in this person's body and mind, including the heart. They're your own personal puppet. You can control up to 1000 people doing this. In battle, it'll be easy to kill your opponent. You can go into their mind and see their memories. You can't control them for more then 5 minutes though. Not even a mental shield can break this. It is strong and will cause awful pain to the victim once it is over. You will receive a headache after though.
pros: You can control anyone
You can control as much as 1000 people at once
You can kill them by just stopping their heart
cons: You lose your common sense and mercy when you are doing this
You get a headache after
You lose at least 100 brain cells.

name: Induced Explosion
overview: make objects explode
description: A person with Induced Explosion has one of the more dangerous abilities. By mentally damaging the atomic structure of an object, they make it so unstable it has to blow up. This ability is not limited to combustibles--wood, plastic, even metal can be made to blow up. However, it is limited to solids and takes active concentration to use.
pros: Blowing up cars
Can explode any solid object
Intimidation factor
cons: No real peaceful use
Cannot make liquids/gases explode
Getting angry

name: Rare
overview: manipulate the aspects and attributes of rare things in yourself.
description: Being rare is useful and enjoyable. You can be immune to mimickers because you can have the trait of being one of a kind. You can be protected like rare things so you can have wards etc. You can also use the rare things general attribute of being loved so that people are kind to you and will like you. You can also increase your value to people so many more positions are now available to you. Other attributes of rare things can also be valid for you
pros: Pros cant be negated.
It is good to be valuable.
cons: Can be affected by power sacrifice.

name: Internet Celebrity
overview: control, summon, and manipulate the Internet.
description: You can control, summon, and manipulate the Internet/Internet-related things. You can go inside the Internet into a Tron-type world of websites, summon Internet memes, and other stuff. For example, you could summon the 'Stop the rock' meme and cause a huge boulder to chase your enemies.
pros: Nearly limitless due to the Internet's expanse
This website is included, so you can grab any power off of here!
Transportation into other computers
cons: Your strength depends on the connection in the area.
Must have a browser installed, working, and open to move around computers
Some memes would be extremely chaotic to bring into the real world.

name: Atomicity
overview: resist being forcibly divided
description: Also called Indivisibility, one with this ability has a powerful defense. The user's body cannot be divided by any means. This means that his body cannot lose limbs, cannot be dismembered, cannot be vaporized, cannot have its soul forcibly removed, cannot have powers forcibly stolen and cannot have positive psychic links broken. In fact, it even prevents inconvenience with joint conditions, because the joints are designed to keep the body perfectly together, for the rest of the user's life.
pros: Prevents dismemberment, power theft and Astral Eviction (makes psychic links unbreakable)
Never worry about joint problems
Doesn't disallow Anatomical Automatism, Astral Projection or other voluntary separation powers
cons: Doesn't prevent ALL types of damage (acid, fire, electricity, psychic attacks, etc. )
Sometimes, the indivisibility only works on a physical level
Sometimes, the indivisibility only works on a mental level

name: Sonic Bomb
overview: blow up an area with sound waves
description: You take a deep breath and blast the sound from your body. Your body will amplify the resulting sound in the area, making the blast bigger. The bigger the sound you make, the stronger the reaction.
pros: people can never touch you as use it
in a life or death situation you can stop the bad guys
the military can't touch you
cons: you can't use a big wave in big public areas
you have to watch your tone at people
you can't be too loud or you could destroy a big area

name: Power Source
overview: take power from the source of anyone's power.
description: This power is sort of a telepathy/empathy-based power. The user can create a mental link with any superpowered being. Now, the user can tap into that power and store it somewhere in their mind. Now, the user can use that power whenever they want. The amount of powers the user can hold in their mind depends on their mental strength. If the user were to store too much power in their mind, it would most likely cause permanent brain damage, and judging on the amount, can possibly destroy the user.
pros: Tap into other superpowered beings powers.
cons: Limits to amount of power being stored in the mind.

name: Entropy Manipulation
overview: make energy more usable or more dispersed
description: A person with Entropy Manipulation can control how focused the energy of an object is. If they decrease the amount of concentrated energy avaliable the remainder bleeds off as heat and the object can thus do less work; in simple terms, packs less of a punch. Bullets become hard blows, hard blows become light powderpuffs. While dispersal takes less energy/focus, concentrating energy requires much focus. The effects, however, are amazing; thrown pins can pierce a human head. Effects are temporary.
pros: User gains command over integral natural force
Can disperse work energy into heat (punches into powderpuffs)
Can concentrate heat into work energy (powderpuffs into punches)
cons: Requires basic grasp of Second Law of Thermodynamics for full potential
Much harder to coalesce energy than to disperse it
Objects that undergo dispersion warmer; objects that undergo concentration colder

name: Tornado Teleport
overview: spin & disappear in front or behind your opponent.
description: You are in a praying position spinning like a tornado, literally drills yourself into the floor & reappear in front or behind of your foe. You can even spin and vanish to another location.
pros: It can be of great use to confuse and surprise your enemies.
cons: None

name: Hole Creation
overview: open holes through any layers of material and to manipulate them
description: This power enables you to open a hole on any surface you're concentrating on, through a process of displacing its material away. Any hole you created stays open if you stop concentrating on them. You can expand the hole or deepen it, move it around or even close it by reversing the process and allowing the material to move back into place. Any object caught in the hole while it's closing can either stop the process if the material is too soft or friable, or be crushed if the material is harder.
pros: Reach whatever is inside a closed container or behind a wall.
Go through any wall by creating a passage through it.
Trap anything or anyone by opening a hole beneath them.
cons: Don't forget about your holes on the ground. You could fall accidently!
Only works on inorganic matter.

name: Electrostatic Charge
overview: charge metal with electricity by touch
description: Electrostatic Charge is a unique ability. The user can produce massive amounts of electricity from their body--up to 300,000 volts, which is enough to kill 10 men. But, they can only put this into metal. Therefore, if they have no metal, they cannot release any electricity.
pros: Up to 300,000 volts
Electrified swords, iron pipes, etc.
Can recharge batteries
cons: Can only release electricity into metal
Can only absorb half of what you generate
Must touch metal

name: Dimensional Teleportation
overview: teleport to other Dimensions
