description: You can go straight to where you would be in the exact same spot in another dimensions.
pros: You can go to a different dimension before you are killed
You can get tons of friends all over the dimensions
You might end in a girls' locker room
cons: You might go into space
You need to wait 1 hour until you can go to another dimension
Something bad happens to what dimension you leave

name: Accelerated Test Taking
overview: take tests or quizes at an advanced speed
description: With this power you can take any test, quiz or questioner at an accelerated pace. You still get all the answers you would've gotten had you took more time to think about the questions and then go over your work. It take you about three and a half seconds to complete each multiple choice question. Ten seconds for short answer and about a minute to do essay questions.
pros: You can take tests at an accelerated pace
You get the same answers
cons: Not much use in physical combat
It still take some time just not as much

name: Master Of Inventions
overview: invent something unique
description: The user is able to invent something that is unique that can be either used for offensive or defensive purposes. This power also covers the planning phase. The user cannot build inventions of other people at a 100%
pros: Good at inventing gadgets
Unique inventions, only you can use it or only allies
cons: Can't reverse engineer enemy gadgets perfectly

name: Big Bang
overview: obliterate one or many objects in one area and fill it in with your own creation
description: With this power all you would have to do is point at an object and yell BANG! the object would create an explosion that damages all matter in a three yard vicinity of that spot leaving a black hole leading to oblivion or command the hole to suck in all matter and stop after the things you don't want are gone. Then all you would have to do is concentrate on what you want in place of the hole and you just and you just created a whole object out of nothing.
pros: You could destroy an entire evil fortress or superhero headquarters in a mere moment
You could create impossible things
You can start the world anew and rule it
cons: The more mass you destroy and create the more of your energy you waste
You can't use this ability to recreate yourself in total perfection because you will be destroyed
You can't use it on the time space continum or everything will fall apart

name: Decentralization
overview: split your existence between multiple realities.
description: Decentralization allows the user to voluntarily expand himself across several parallel realities or dimensions. When split, damage is only applied to "slices" directly affected. If you were to split many times immediately before a blast, for example, you could let only 1/1000'th of you take the damage, and re-merge essentially unharmed. At least one "slice" must remain in the reality of origin, and the thinner spread the user is, the less he is affected by, or can affect, his surroundings.
pros: Quick reflexes can make for effective invulnerability.
Can be used to make one less noticable, which is perfect for stealth.
Can be used to make decoys.
cons: The thinner a user is spread, the less he can sense and interact with any given reality.
The thiner a slice is, the easier it is to destroy; even weak attacks can be lethal if synchronized.
If one slice is obstructed, all slices are obsructed. Obstructions may exist in other realities.

name: Darksiders: Serpent Road
overview: travel miles within seconds.
description: The Serpent Road is a sub-space where you must walk along a stone path in an empty void. Just pick the location you wish to travel to, and you will be taken into the Serpent Road. Once you make it to the portal at the end of the road, you will be at your destination.
pros: Travel from Seattle to New York City in one minute!
Never have to pay for plane tickets ever
cons: This is not teleportation; you still have to do some form of travel

name: Answer Me
overview: make anyone answer your question truthfully
description: With this power, everyone has to answer a question you impose and cannot attack you while they are answering questions since their mind is preoccupied.   After the question is answered the person forgets that he/she answered the question.  If the other person does not know the answer then the other person will go into a trance and will move to find the answer.  If it is a math problem the other person will go into "calculator mode" and attempt to calculate the answer
pros: Get info on people and person forgets that he/she answered
Forced calculation-make anyone into a human calculator
Can be used to blackmail or prevent blackmail
cons: You can only get what people think is the right answer
If the answer cannot be answered then other person's mind becomes entranced
If you ask a rhetorical question this ability activates even on yourself

name: Electrified Fire
overview: create and control fire that has lightning surrounding it
description: Anyone it touches will be electrified and burned simultaneously. The fire is of a medium temperature, closer to normal fire than the blue of stars. The temperature differs for each person.
pros: Getting burned/electrocuted is bad enough separately but simultaneously has to be 100 times worse.
cons: You can never separate the lightning from the fire (may be a pro).

name: Selective Invulnerability
overview: be invulnerable to a specific thing only
description: The user of this power can be only invulnerable to one specific threat to his or her life. For example, if a user of this power chooses to be invulnerable to being injured by physical contact, then powers like super strength has no effect on them. But if the get hit by a concussive beam then they will become vulnerable and get injured
pros: Invulnerability
cons: Only invulnerable to one certain power
Easily defeated if weakness is known

name: Matrix
overview: step into and out of a virtual world
description: With it you can collect as much information about something as you want. You can also train or relax as long as you want. You don't physically go there as only your mind taken. You even remote control your body! It is in essence a computer / virtual world on demand.
pros: Unlimited access to information
Play games in "reality"
Do whatever you want on the computer.
cons: Your body is left in the real world
You die if your body does

name: Moreaumancy
overview: turn animals into humans or humans into animals.
description: You can exactly fuse together between man and beast by turning any animal into a human being and/or human being into any animal species with glowing gestures of your hands.
pros: It might be kind of cool to some.
cons: It might be kind of gross at some times.
Some might never accept transformations.
You'll be forever branded as an outcast.

name: Shadow Stealing
overview: steal the shadows of others, gaining total control over them
description: You can steal people's shadows with this power, and when you do, they not only lose their shadow, but they lose their reflection, their voice, their emotions and their opinions (as well as their need to blink, eat, sleep, rest or breathe). It's like they don't exist (and nobody can perceive them except you). And that's perfect, because during this time of "nonexistence", they become entirely loyal to you, and do whatever you want.
pros: Steal a person's shadow, and they become totally-loyal servants
They lose their emotions, their opinions and their need to eat, sleep or breathe
Only you can perceive them (and you can control them mentally)
cons: Some users can't communicate mentally with their minions (looks like you're talking to yourself)
Umbrakinetics, Immutables and people with Fixed Forms can keep their shadows
The subjects that become your minions aren't mindless, but they try to follow you everywhere

name: Dark Wing
overview: fly, defend yourself, counterattack the enemy and enter a "rage" mode
description: You can fly. Your wings can't be hurt but can be injured. In rage mode, your true wings would show up (from 2 pairs of black angel wings to 6 of them), and if you're fat, ugly or short haired, when in normal wing mode, your body will change, but it could hurt a lot!
pros: You can fly.
Your wing can defend you.
When your wing is injured, the blood that flows out burns everything it touches.
cons: When in rage, you can't choose whom to attack, even if friend or foe.
When in normal mode, you get a little bit tired.
When the wings get in/out of your body, it's so painful.

name: Gift: Shadows
overview: be gifted at the control of shadows and darkness
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling shadows and darkness than other beings. Thus their shadow- or darkness-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of darkness from them. However, someone with this power can only receive shadow-based powers, nothing else.
pros: Almost no one has as good control over the shadows as someone with this power.
Shadow-based powers are boosted slightly.
cons: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only shadow-based powers now.

name: Laser Vision
overview: shoot lasers from your eyes
description: One with Laser Vision can shoot lasers out of their eyes. There are seven different colors of lasers you could shoot. Red, blue, yellow, pink, white, black and green.  Red lasers burn things with extreme heat. Blue lasers vaporize things. Yellow shocks things. Pink kills things. White heals things. Black kills things. Green makes nature-like things appear.  There is a firing limit of 10 lasers a day.
pros: You can finally be FIRING YOUR LAZOR!
You can heal your friends.
You can burn/shock/vaporize/lill the Villain.
cons: Your lasers bounce off mirrors and other things that reflect light.
Accidently healing the Villain/Bully/BadGuy you're fighting. Accidently killing people you like.
Limit of amount per day fired.

name: Nephilim
overview: inherit the powers of your angelic relatives or bloodline.
description: The Nephilim, also known as the "fallen ones", were the offspring of fallen angels and humans. You are capable of utilizing any powers or abilities your ancestors may have had. These abilities may refer to the natural elements, spirituality, and magic. Although you are not a full-blooded angel, you are still quite powerful.
pros: Easily vanquish foes with rays of light.
A fearsome warrior in strength, speed, intelligence, and endurance alike.
Wield enchanted swords imbued with light or darkness.
cons: You are only half-angel.
You do not possess wings, your flight is limited and is considered a glide.

name: Tolerance
overview: build up a tolerance to most things.
description: This power lets you build up a tolerance to most things, even negation of powers. You have to endure the thing to tolerate it and this power can't be negated for obvious reasons. You can build up a tolerance to damage or poison, and tolerances last forever.
pros: Tolerance to negation.
Tolerances last forever.
cons: Tolerance does not mean immunity.
Just a small tolerance.

name: Size Shifting
overview: grow or shrink at will
description: Having this power, you will be able to increase  or decrease your size. To being as tall as a 100 story building down to the size of a molecule. The drawback is that you can't grow & shrink rapidly or your body structure will become unstable.
pros: Become a giant
Shrink to the size of an ant
cons: can't size shift rapidly or body structure will become unstable
1,000 ft. is the max limit you can grow to
Cannot shrink past the size of a molecule

name: Auto Locking
overview: lock anything automatically.
description: This is a mental power that allows you to lock things by just thinking about them. For example, say you forgot to lock your house. Poof!... The door automatically locks. Even better, this isn't confined to doors and other things with locks on them. Anything that can be opened can be auto-locked. Only you can open something that's auto-locked. This power is very useful for protecting valuable objects.
pros: Automatically lock anything by thinking about it.
Only you can unlock the locked item
Useful for protecting valuable items
cons: Unlocker, Janus' Key etc.

name: Fairy Maker
overview: make a fairy for any task
description: People often refer to a "(something) fairy" as a joke or expression to say something is almost magical. For example, upon learning that junk mail was very flammable, someone joked "it's like a combustible fairy visits my mailbox and gives me gifts". You just think of a description for a fairy (and any other details you want, but they have to be tiny female humanoids with brightly colored insect wings), its typical task, and snap! The fairy will soon visit you in the night to bestow its benefits.
pros: Can get anything you can make a fairy for, and you can befriend them/have them serve other tasks
Have lots of little friends to call upon, if you befriend all the ones you make
You can steal their wands for magical effects, or eat them to regain health (they'll ALL hate you)
cons: You can call upon fairies as you want, but their first post-creation visit is always in the night,
While you're in bed (though not necessarily when you're sleeping).
If you don't make it specific, they'll also delever gifts to other people, based on some criteria
tags: kind of creepy sneaking in like that

name: Steam Blaster
overview: send out waves of steam to damage foes.
description: You could send out a flow of radiating steam to damage opponents. Can be used both in the air & on the ground. It is extremely effective against water and ice type adversaries. Against fire, not so much...
pros: Extremely useful for melting frozen obstacles.
cons: It does not affect fire type foes.

name: Gifting Or Giving A Gift
overview: bless or gift anyone with any gift he or she desires
description:
The limits of this ability are not known. With this ability you can give any man woman or living creature any thing they desire from immorality to flight. 
in order to gift or bless someone a payment must be made to you. Payment can be what ever you choose such as a piece of paper. Or money. Or even the individuals soul
pros: You will be loved by everyone you bless or gift
cons: You can not give yourself a gift.
All though. You can requre as payment the individual to give the gift back to you at anytime you
Choose allowing you to aquire said gift

name: Legendary Pokemon Summon
overview: summon any of the 47 legendary pokemon
description: With this power you can summon any of the 47 legendary pokemon from any generation of the series. They are under your complete control and removing them from their universe will not cause their universe to go into a state of chaos as the capture of legends usually does. You can only summon up to four legendary pokemon at a time and when you're done you can just send them back.
pros: You can summon any legendary pokemon
You want cause the Pokemon universe to fall into a state of chaos
You can unsummon them when you're done
cons: You can only summon up to four at a time

name: Light Immunity
overview: be immune to the harmful effects of light
description: Light-based powers and techniques can't harm you but they can still help you.
pros: Eliminates a weakness if you are a vampire.
Eliminates a good number of MythPowers from affecting you.
cons: No, this power will not make you invisible (No Con Negation).
Darkness and shadow-based powers are not considered light-based by this power(No Con Negation).

name: The Chamber Of Understanding
overview: make a chamber drop out of nowhere that allows you to understand things better.
description: With this ability, all you have to do is state the words "I'll be in The Chamber of Understanding! " like professor Farnsworth fro Futurama. The chamber has a disco ball inside and different types of music that plays inside of it. The chamber has an endless supply of oxygen, the perfect temperature/humidity level, and blocks out distractions. The chamber is made out of a transparant, durable material that's harder than glass. Understand chemistry, the cure for cancer, world peace, and the truth.
pros: Understand things you never thought possible.
Be at peace within the chamber. No distractions!
You can understand very helpful and abstract subjects more.
cons: Although it takes less time, it may still take a really long time to understand something.
You still need to study or you might not have enough information to understand.
Secret societies run by insane people might stop you from thinking and understanding. Thought police

name: Natural Probability Replay
overview: make things that do not occur naturally become common place and control it.
description: This ability allows one make something that does not appear normally and makes it become more naturally. Here is a perfect example. Lightning strikes near you and then you use this ability. Now, you can summon lightning as reoccurring thing. As in, It will happen more often and probability will accept it as the norm, and the user can have control over that as well.
pros: Make things that do not usually occur in nature or probabilty become common place.
Have full control over these new natural phenomenons.
Make something that happen only once become a natural occurrence.
cons: You can only control new occurrences not nature or probability itself.

name: Vacuum Seal
overview: seal objects in a vacuum, preserving them and insulating them from the air
description: With a touch, you can seal/unseal an object in a vacuum. When used on food, it can keep it fresh and bacteria-free. Vacuum-sealed objects are also completely insulated, and as such are incapable of being affected by wind, sound, fire, or any other thing that is dependent on air to exist or move. When used on living beings, it suffocates them, and causes various other disturbances to their biological systems. You, however, are immune to the effects of vacuums (although you still need to breath).
pros: Can keep food fresh simply by touching it
Can make objects insulated against air-related things
Can incapacitate most enemies with a touch
cons: If sealing yourself, you better take a big breath first
Needless to say, enemies who can survive vacuums are unaffected by this power
If you seal yourself, you won't be able to hear anything, since sound is reliant on air

name: Temporary Weapons Knowledge
overview: have complete knowledge of any weapon that you are holding while you are in danger
description: With this power you have complete knowledge on a weapon and how to use a weapon, assuming a couple of conditions are met. One if that you have to be holding the weapon and the second is that you only have this knowledge while you're in danger. As soon as the danger is gone or you let go of the weapon you lose the knowledge.
pros: Knowledge of weapons
cons: Only works while you're holding the weapon
Only works while you're in danger

name: Mental Route Navigation
overview: think of a location and find a suitable path to that point.
description: This power allows an individual to instantly find a path to or from any point instantly, either between that point and their current location or between two other locations. This factors in not only mundane routes such as driving or walking, but also factors in things like public transportation and allows for the supernatural, such as finding a path to a different time or reality. It even factors in side benefits, such as support of local business or exercise.
pros: Factors in cost (monetary and otherwise) as well as timetables.
You can find any possible route, unless actively hidden, almost certainly through non-mundane means.
You immediately know of a short list of the best options, rather than having to do it manually.
cons: Almost entirely useless if you have other travel-related powers, such as teleportation.
Only useful for travel; no point if you are not travelling or are satisfied with your current route.
Does not warn you of most dangers along the route.

name: Lord Of Shadow: Shadow Double
overview: turn your shadow into a duplicate of yourself
description: With this power, you can separate from your shadow, turning your shadow into a duplicate of yourself. This shadow duplicate has your exact appearance, knowledge, skills, and powers. It can function by itself exactly like you would, but it is also completely obedient to you. You can use the shadow duplicate to be in two places at once, or you can double your chances of winning a fight. If the shadow duplicate dies, you are left unharmed
pros: Two of you is better than one, be it for difficult fights or conflicting obligations
The shadow can do everything you can do, and it will do whatever you tell it to do
You are unharmed if the shadow duplicate is harmed
cons: Neither you nor the duplicate will cast a shadow while this power is in use
You can only summon one duplicate at a time
If your shadow duplicate dies, you must wait half an hour to summon a new one

name: Diamond Mimicry
overview: turn your tissues into solid diamond
description: Diamonds are forged in the depths of the earth and are the hardest substances known to man. A Diamond Mimic can convert their body into solid diamond at will. They become extremely hard to injure, tireless, able to support great weights, and resistant to temperature changes. However, this diamond body has no super-strength of its own, only being able to support weight. Also, it has a flaw. Striking this flaw will cause them to shatter.
pros: Become nigh-invunerable + tireless
Able to support great weight
Impervious to temperature change
cons: No super-strength; only able to support weight
Diamond body has a flaw; will shatter if struck
Unable to swim

name: Dark Flame
overview: generate dark energy in the form of fire
description: This ability allows you to generate dark energy in the form of black fire or any dark colors (again nothing bright). You can project dark flames from your entire body and even cause objects to melt. You can also shoot dark fireballs of course. With practice you could fly by channeling the dark energy through your body. You won't be able to control fire in any way, so you will still get burned.
pros: Do like the human torch, "Flame on! "
Can intimidate your foes
Can fly but needs practice
cons: Lose control of your power
Running out of energy to burn
This is not pyrokinesis so you won't control fire and are not immune to it

name: Inanimate Intangibility
overview: make any non-living thing intangilble
description: This can only be used on non-living things. In other words, you can't use it on humans, animals, or plants unless their already dead. You can make walls, floors, clothes, or anything else non-living intangible. The intangibility is activated by what you touch, regardless of what you touch it with. You can touch something with your hand, foot, head, and any other part of your body to make it intangible.
pros: Make any non-living thing pass through anything else
Pass through walls and floors
Protect or take away anything non-living
cons: May get killed or have things fused in you if you make things tangible while passing through you
May have other objects fall through to where you don't want it or break
Can't make living things intangible

name: Intuitive Comprehension
overview: immediately understand any list of symbols
description: Knowledge is power, and understanding is the key to knowledge. An Intuitive Comprehender needs to only look at a serial number, acronym, or abbreviation and the facts will come to their mind. When they see it, they must stare at it for a moment; in a flash they will know what it means. This ability does not work on the spoken word or drawings.
pros: Know the difference between M80 and E80
Looking at a serial code lets you know what it is and where it was made
Learn if you should visit the CMF or not
cons: Must get a good look at the number string
Does not work on the spoken word
Does not work on drawings

name: Periscopic Vision
overview: see around objects without moving.
description: A periscope is a device with a mirror in it. The mirror reflects light so that you can see around corners and other objects. With this ability, you are able to utilize the power of the periscope with your eyes to look around corners and other obstacles without revealing yourself or your location. You would be the ultimate spy.
pros: See around objects without being seen.
You would become a great spy.
cons: Prolonged use may cause eye damage....
...  Speak to your eye doctor to see if this power is right for you

name: Ice Lightning
overview: make ice cold lighting
description: The lighting is so cold that the bolts may freeze. It's light blue in color.
pros: Freezes
cons: May kill!

name: Dryad Or Death
overview: transform into a dryad or tree spirit when you're about to die.
description: Use this power if you know you are about to die to become a dryad, or if someone else is about to die then you can make them a dryad at the cost of your own health. A dryad is a tree spirit that is assigned to one species of tree and if someone on earth harms that species of tree, then getting revenge on them will make you stronger.
pros: You don't die.
You get protection from your tree species.
cons: You're not there because you're a spirit
If someone harms your tree species and
you don't get revenge within a month you go into a killing frenzy.

name: Diamond Tail
overview: grow a tail made out of diamond
description: With this power you can grow a tail made out of diamonds. You can use the tail as weapon or to trip people. The tail can also be detached to be used as a melee weapon or to sell to make some extra money. Once you detach it you can instantly grow another one so you can have multiple weapons or make lots of money by selling several of them or you can do both and still have a tail growing out of your back.
pros: You can grow a tail made out of diamond which you can use to trip people or hit people
You can detach the tail to use it as a sword or sell it for money
Once you detach it you can still grow a new one
cons: Growing the tail is painful (but detaching it is not)

name: Fungus Mastery
overview: control any type of fungus
description: This power gives the user the power to control any type of mycelium which means that they control fungus. In addition this also lets the user sense where fungus are since the fungus would be in their field of control. They can also cause mold to grow faster.
pros: Can summon tons of underground mycelium to attack opponents
Find truffles easily
Cause your enemies houses to be filled with mold
cons: If you are allergic to mushrooms or other fungi
Cannot control spores after release-only lets you control mycelium

name: Friendship Powered Abilities
overview: gain an ability every time you make a friend as well as make friends more easily
description: A person with this power has the ability to gain powers everytime they make a friend. Also they start with the ability to make people more likely to be friendly towards you after talking to them. You can get good powers by meeting great friends. Caring personality equals healing, aggressive personality equals pyrokinesis, cold personality is ice. Shocking personality is electricity. The list goes on and on and no two powers are completely identical. You can only use one ability at a time.
pros: You start with heightened charisma when you have this power.
You get more powers everytime you make a friend
Powers reflect your friends' personality
cons: If your new friend has a disgusting personality, the power you gain will be disgusting too
You can't change people's personalities but all the powers are expected to be positive effects
Some people just won't become your friend and losing friends or your memories means loss of power

name: Teleport To Friend(S)
overview: teleport to where one's friend(s) are/is located at
description: With this power you can teleport straight to wherever your friend(s) are/is whether it is 100 yards away or on the other side of the universe.
pros: You can help your friends whenever they need help.
cons: You are unable to teleport back home.
You cannot teleport to other dimensions until the higher levels.
If you only have imaginary friends then this power is useless.

name: Pursuit
overview: make things come true by continuously pursuing them
description: With this ability, anything is possible. If you pursuit it, you can do it. If you constantly pursue thoughts and concepts, they will become a reality. For instance, if you always want to fly, you may gain the ability to float, or grow wings. If something is troubling you, pursuiting thoughts of it ending may make the problem go away. There is no end to what your mind can pursue. However, more specific abilities or concepts take more concentration, and everything takes time to become a reality.
pros: Pursuit your dreams, your goals, and they will come true
cons: Nothing can happen instantly, it takes a real want for something to come true
Things can be awkward without being specific, and pursuing more specifically takes more effort

name: The Paths Of Magic: The Wizard
overview: have special talent for wizardry.
description: The Path of the Wizard, or the Path of Will, is the first of the five paths of magic. Wizards are mages that use nothing but will to do magic. Naturaly, wizards are the most powerful of mages, due to the fact that they are almost all-powerful and are only limited by imagination. Very few have the power or the talent necessary for wizardry. This ability grants you a special talent for wizardry.
pros: Wizardry will come easily to you.
Almost no limits.
cons: Cannot break the universal laws

name: Jail Immunity
overview: never go to jail for a crime
description: With this power you will never be sent to jail for any crime from loitering to murder. You won't even be taken to court or be put on trial. Additionally you cannot get a speeding or parking ticket and are more or less immune to the laws of any country.
pros: You will never be arrested, take to court, put on trial or receive parking tickets, speeding tickets
Or fines
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Ice Mimicry
overview: convert your body into freezing ice
description: You're like Iceman but you don't have cryokinesis, you just turn into freezing ice. Everything you touch will be frozen. The colder it gets, the more strength & mass you gain. You can even protrude spikes from your body bad of icicles & you can heal instantly from injuries like knife & bullet wounds. Of course, heat will be your downfall & if you gets to hot, you turn back to normal, weak & exhausted.
pros: Turn into walking super snowman
Produce icicle spikes on your body
Freeze injuries & heal instantly
cons: Heat
Too much heat & you turn back to normal, weak & exhausted

name: Solaris
overview: harvest the power of the sun.
description: With this power, you are able to be in superheat form, which is when you are completely blazing and you can super-melt anything you touch. You can also control what temperatures you would like to use.
pros: Can cook your own food without oven.
cons: Can't control the sun.
Works with your emotions.

name: Price Label Substitution
overview: move the decimal point on price tags
description: With this superpower, you can move the decimal point on any price tag. For example, something costs $250, but you change it to $2. 50 and BAM! It's yours for the new price! The best thing is, shop owners feel compelled to sell it to you at your price. They can't claim it was a miss-print. The only limitation to this power is that you must leave at least one digit before the decimal point. The lowest you can go is, say $2. 70. You can't change it to $0. 27.
pros: Buy anything you want at a reduced price
Shop owners can't refuse to sell you the reduced item
You can buy a $5m mansion for $5. 00
cons: Might become a shopoholic
You'll have heaps of useless stuff
You might get greedy/corrupted by this power

name: Psychic Sound
overview: create sound waves made out of psychic energy.
description: A person with Psychic Sound can create sound waves made out of pure psychic energy. The psychic sound waves can affect the world like normal sound waves but are unaffected by Sonokinesis. The psychic sound waves can also be used to affect other things using psychic energy. The psychic sound waves can also be used to talk to others in a sort of false telepathy. Can also choose which individuals can hear or are affected by your psychic sound waves.
pros: Use sound waves that are unaffected by sonokinesis.
Use sound waves to also affect psychic related objects.
Can use the sound waves to create a sort of false telepathy.
cons: Affected by other psychic powers.
If your focus is lessened then your power weakens.
Works similiar to sonokinesis.

name: Inundation
overview: overload a foe's mind and senses
description: This ability is QUITE unpleasant for the person on whom it is used. It causes an overload of every sense the user has. One with this ability causes the foe to lose control over his senses and train of thought, so that every sensory stimulus in range is constantly in his mind. Combine that with the fact that his thoughts no longer form coherently into cognition he can understand (thoughts and memories emerge/disappear randomly, emotions constantly changing) and the foe is left a mind-numbed mess.
pros: Overload a foe with his own thoughts, memories and emotions (can't focus them into coherent thought)
His senses go haywire and everything he picks up on is very strongly present in his mind
Often knocks the foe unconscious within a few seconds
cons: If one's power is too strong, it causes coma or even death
If the power can't be undone at will, you might feel bad using your power (MIGHT)
If the power is uncontrolled, it can go off randomly

name: Synergy
overview: add the sense capacity of others onto oneself
description: Also called Synergistic Perception, this is the psychic ability to add the sense capacity of others onto oneself. The user (usually) starts off with normal senses, but when around others with normal or superhuman perception (like Telescopic Vision), THEIR senses can increase to superhuman levels. If they were around five people with normal perception, for example, the user could increase his perception five times. However, the user does this AT WILL, so as to prevent sensory inundation.
pros: Friends with Precognition, Telescopic Vision, X-Ray Vision, Superhuman Senses, etc.
Even the senses of normal people can increase your senses
Even borrow the senses of MACHINES design to "sense" things (radar, sonar, GPS, etc)
cons: If you can't control the sensory magnification, you'll be overloaded
If your sensory magnification occurs randomly (can't choose the person whose senses you use)
Doesn't take the subject's senses away

name: Quetzalcoatl
overview: bestow upon yourself the abilities of the Aztec god Quetzalcoatl.
description: When activating this ability, you gain the following: superhuman strength, speed, near invulnerability, acute olfactory receptors, and keen sight. You can also metamorphose into a feathered serpent or a humanoid feathered reptile. Your claws are nigh indestructible and skewer through targets with ease. As a result of acquiring Quetzalcoatl's powers, your life prolonged a hundred years (possibly more). Your feathers can also be utilized as razor-sharp flechettes.
pros: Virtually immortal.
Change into a feathered serpent for possible flight.
Serpentine anatomy/physiology offers higher elasticity and a tougher skeleton.
cons: Still susceptible to attack. (still vulnerable to stronger enemies)
Limited shapeshifting.
Your feathers are dangerous to use around civilians.

name: Electronic Fog
overview: create and control the fog that makes up the Bermuda Triangle
description: A person with this power can create the effect of the Bermuda Triangle anywhere by creating electronic fog. Within the fog electronics don't work and people caught in the radius will be blinded and their sense of space and time is distorted. Compasses are broken too. After a while things will deteriorate. You are immune to any and all negative effects of your own power.
pros: Disrupts electronics
People can't see through the fog and will suffer spacial and temporal disorientation
You are immune to the effects of your own power
cons: Only useful for killing or sneaking

name: Reflecting Shield
overview: make long-range attacks return to their users
description: Basically, what happens is long-range attacks go in an almost full circle around you. Just enough so that they get returned back to the same place they were launched from. This works on all long-range attacks whether natural, supernatural, etc.
pros: Eliminates one field of combat for the enemy. Fields of combat: long-, medium-, and close-range.
All long-range attacks natural, supernatural, etc.
Returns the attack back to the enemy.
cons: Only helps in long-range fighting.

name: The Animal Glyphs
overview: draw two glyphs each representing an animal then you transform into a combination of the animals.
description: The day you were born and the position of the stars determine the twelve animals that not only describe you but reside within. Twelve Glyphs beamed into your brain represent the twelve animals. Then all you do is draw the glyphs wherever even in midair with your finger. However depending on the quality and work put into the glyphs determines the power and duration of the transformation.
pros: Possibility of having twelve awesome animals at your disposal.
If you can draw well then the power of the transformation is doubled
The combined animals becomes stonger then just one alone
cons: Possibility of having twelve bad animals at your disposal.
Takes time to do not good in a sneak attack
If you cant draw then the power will be halved.

name: Guardian Powers
overview: have certain powers only when guarding things
description: While guarding things you will have superhuman strength, speed, senses, and invulnerability to make you into the best possible guard. It doesn't matter what you protect so long as you know what you are guarding.
pros: If you already have the powers in the description, you will still have them when not guarding.
cons: Most likely going to end up guarding things for others.
If you don't know what it is you are guarding.

name: Eye Of Awakening
overview: repel the even the most powerful mind controls and illusions
description: You are impervious to mind tricks, controls, and any illusion. You even repel the Shadow Of Mara.
pros: You are Impervious to any mind control, and illusion.
You can duplicate this power and bestow it on others.
You can even use it as a shield on thousands of people.
cons: If you use your other powers for evil, this power is temporally disabled.
Be wise before bestowing on this to someone else.

name: Own The Spear Of Destiny
overview: control the fate of the world
description: He who holds the spear of destiny holds the fate of the world in his hands. Owning the spear causes you to fall into positions of high power, and have fate make you incredibly lucky and immortal for the duration of your ownership. Notable users include: Longinus - a roman soldier who used it to pierce Jesus and caused him to die; Peter Bartholomew - used it to summon an army of angels and won a battle in the 1st crusade; Hitler - used it to gain political power and nearly conquered the world.
pros: You gain positions of power very quickly, most of your goals succeed
Fate will protect you, assassinations will fail, you will escape danger, you won't ever get sick
Anyone you impale with the spear will surely die, it pierces all forms of armor and metal.
cons: If you lose the spear, you die.
The spear chooses its owner. The spear can choose another and leave you any time
You will be long remembered, for good or bad.

name: Vending
overview: create vending machines for anything.
description: With this ability, you will be able to create vending machines out of thin air, for literally any item.
pros: Vending machines for anything.
Literally.
They are created out of thin air.
cons: Need exact change
1 cent per trade (money for object).
Need enough room.

name: Acid Spark
overview: fire green electrical bolts that will burn through anything.
description: It may sound bizarre, but you can fire light-green corrosionic bolts of energy from your fingertips or the palm of your hands which could dissolve through anything and even melt off a person.
pros: Weird new electrical power to have.
cons: Doesn't work in water.

name: Blessing Of Gaea
overview: have the blessing of Gaea
description: Gaea is the oldest goddess there is. She is the earth goddess and her blessing allows you to gain powers over the earth as well. Besides basically controling it, you can use the earth to heal. Whenever you are wounded, instead of blood, sand will pour out. That sand will then collect over the wound, heal it, and fall away. You can also turn things into any material from the earth and sense things using vibrations from the ground.
pros: You can control the earth and anything from it
You can change anything into any material from the earth
You can heal and sense things through the earth
cons: It looks weird whenever you get hurt

name: Healing Aura
overview: unconsciously heal things around you
description: You can emit an invisible aura that heals all organic beings around you. No effort is needed, but things heal faster if they are close to you, e.g. a broken limb will fuse completely in 4 hours if the sufferer stays in the same house as you, but you can only just suppress any viruses someone down the road has. You benefit from the aura as well, staying in perfect health at all time, never feeling ill and healing even from life-threatening injuries in 2 hours.
pros: Can keep self, roommates and nearby loved ones in great health
Very difficult to be killed
Could stay overnight in hospitals and heal most of the ward by morning

Can't cure genetic diseases
Can still be killed quickly, e.g. shot in the head

name: Ability Commutation
overview: instantly switch a power you're using to another one, bypassing the condition to activate the latter
description: You're using a power but then realize you need to change it for another one. You would normally need to stop using the current one and then activate the one you want, possibly becoming open to attack. With this power, you can instantly switch from one power to another, without needing to fulfil the conditions to stop the current one and to start the new one, if conditions are required. However, the switch will be broken if the next power has effects that entirely depend on those conditions.
pros: You won't lose time switching between superpowers the normal way.
You won't need to fulfil the conditions to activate the next one.
Rapidly switching from an offensive power to a defensive power.
cons: The switch will break if the next power has effects that depend on the conditions of activation.
To use this power, a superpower must already be activated, which can be short in time.
Switching a superpower for this one or this one for another doesn't count.

name: Gaia's Blessing: Translator
overview: talk to all things in nature
description: This power allows you to talk to anything organic or on the periodic table only rule is that you must always watch what you say because this power is always active and all metals must listen to you animals, plants,and non metals have a choice

Always have a pencil
You can have a pet panther

If you insult any animal or tree the may hurt you
If you wish someone dead and an animal hears you that person may die

name: Lullatrick
overview: sing a lullaby able to put someone to sleep
description: With this power, if you sing any lullaby, you will put anyone (except those with a power that prevents then from sleeping) to sleep immediately. You can only sing at "full power" to one target at once, but the others will feel a little drowsy. It affects anyone in the immediate surrounding, even those with you.
pros: Put (almost) anyone to sleep easily
Good to soothe a crying sibling/baby in the middle of the night
Also good if you are cornered.

name: Game God: Card
overview: summon monsters from card games.
description: With this ability the user can become basicly omnipotent with card games.  This allows Summoning beings/objects from cards, into the real world to serve you you can summon six thousand copies of each card. You can also designate one copy as a leader, and dominate its mind, making a copy of your mind, you can act through it.  Beings cannot battle each other, you can dismiss them at will, they do not require food, water, and you can revive the dead beings.

Mind copies.
Normal armies will wet their pants.

You will look childish.
Good cards cost money.

name: Bio  Overshadow Proximity
overview: turn everything around you into the organic equvalant of oneself and manipulate it.
description: This ability allows the user to make anything physical into an organic version of the user. Intelligent beings, air, energy, spirits, and God are not affected by this. The things that changed will bare similarities to the user like color of his skin or have his face, etc. The user is also able to telepathically control them and capable of giving them feelings. The things will stay that way as long as the user is near them. There is a certain amount of space that this ability affects.
pros: Make things be more like you
Control over them
cons: You will have certain amount of space that this ability affects.
Intelligent beings, air, energy, spirits, and God are not affected by this.

name: Negativity Deconstruct
overview: deconstruct things with one's negative attitude.
description: The user is capable of destroying things with their negative attitude. The more negative the user is, the more destructive he/she becomes. Positive attitudes will diminish its power. It will look like Phoenix's disintegration attack from The Last Stand and it breaks down all forms of matter.
pros: Destroy things with your negative attitude
cons: Positivity weakens it

name: Connection Of The Animals
overview: calm down, speak to animals, and summon them
description: If you're found caught with an aggressive dog, talk calmly. If you have the power, the dog will calm down and listen to you, although you cannot actually understand what it says in its language. But you can understand through seeing its actions and situation. Upon a word or signal, you may summon an animal to your aid.
pros: Summon animals to your aid
Animals will not hurt you
You are able to understand them

Cannnot understand their language
Summoning happens rarely

name: Matter Trait Inducement
overview: give one form of matter the traits of a different form of matter.
description: This ability will allow you to create new breeds of matter with their own special characteristics. Take a glass of water; just by touching it, think of the flammability of gaseous matter and it will become flammable, but still be drinkable.

cons: The effects might last forever.

name: Underwater Exploration
overview: become a mermaid/merman or turn invisible once you hit the water.

Perfect for sneaking up on your friends in the pool
You can talk to fish

name: Bronze Skin Transformation
overview: convert the tissue of your entire body into an organic bronze substance.
description: In bronze armored form, you have the strength, which enables you to lift at least 160 tons under extreme conditions. You have the stamina, which means that you will tire much, much slower than regular human beings and can continue exerting yourself for hours without tiring. While in this state, you also do not require food, water or air to sustain yourself and can withstand high impact assaults as well as extreme temperatures. You can even use your fingers to pick locks or safes.

name: Sleep Control
overview: put people to sleep on command.
description: Having trouble getting to sleep? Don't want to deal with some annoying person? Want to stop bad guys before they even do anything? Then this power is right for you! Just think about making someone fall asleep, and they will! No matter their current circumstances, and they'll stay asleep for as long as you please.

You can stop your foe by making them take a permanent nap.
Get for revenge.
cons: They can still hurt you if you don't use your power first.

name: Fall
overview: make people fall
description: With this power you can make someone collapse on the ground just by saying "Fall" and then pointing at the person or saying the person's name. The person can get up whenever they like and you can use this power on as many people as you like as many times as you want.

cons: The person can just get back up

name: Pressure Vision
overview: produce large amounts of pressure from your eyes.
description: You are able to produce large amounts of pressure from your eyes. This allows you to crack slabs of cement, warp metal, turn lumps of coal into diamonds and even break people's bones. You can shoot it in bursts or a long powerful beam to hit from a distance.

name: Planar Intangability

This allows the user to travel time, space, and evade attacks on different planes. Because space and time function differently based on the plane you can traverse these in a limited manner. Also because most actions exist on only one plane you can evade ALL actions on a plane you're intangible on.

Attacks that are multi-plane.

name: Lateral Repulsion

Like lateral magnetizer, heat has no effect on the repulsion. You can fly with this power by charging your hands to push the ground/air or alternatively use this to blast away people. Newton's 3rd law applies when using this power so you need to be careful to prevent backlash. You can selectively change the amount of repulsion possible.

name: Blood Puppetry
overview: control blood inside people and make them your puppet slaves
description: If it has blood, it's yours to command. Like a puppet master, you can use your mind and hands to contol people or animals. You can also make blood come out of them, causing death, or make the blood move so fast it burns. Even if the thing whose blood you are controlling dies, as long as it has blood in it, it's your minion. name: Abjuration
overview: create wards of any shape or size, that can slow, stop, or repel anything.
description: Abjuration gives you a whole heap of useful abilities. Yes, you can do basic wards which can stop bullets, or repel the ground so you can fly. But your imagination is the limit. Imagine the ability to look cool, by creating a ward that drives off all un-cool attributes. Non-detection wards that repel people's vision so they can't see you, and stop sound from leaving. Catch bad guys with ease by slowing down their getaway car to a crawl. This ability gives a massive amount of power.

name: Undersea Adaptation

They can distend their body as though it was rubber, allowing them to stretch over 1 and a half football fields in length and remold themselves into any number of shapes. They also have an extreme resistance to injury---explosives, corrosives, and even bullets cannot penetrate their rubbery form. So, if you got bitten by a werewolf, you would gain its strength, agility, fangs, etc. But you wouldn't become a werewolf. If you got bitten by a venomous snake, you would gain its flexibility and poisonous bite, but you yourself wouldn't get poisoned. Once you've been bitten, you retain those powers forever.

When the power is used the objects move back to previous positions similar to a rewinded video. When moved back to original location, the objects inertia becomes equal to the inertia it had at the time. With practice you can reverse objects indefinitely to "immobilize" objects.

CSI purposes

And it's simply a physical illusion like those in the card games in TV whre the terrains change.

Skydiving without the parachute!
