overview: perceive information from shadows
description: This power is great for umbrakinetics. It allows the user to perceive anything located within darkness. This ability is the projection of one's sight to any area submerged in darkness (project your sight all around a dark room to look for people without moving and tripping over things, or the like), the perception of the presence and activity of things as long as they aren't touched by light, and the discernment of the past or future condition of an object by touching its shadow.
pros: Project your sight to any location shrouded in darkness
Perceive the presence/activity of things (living or inanimate) that aren't touched by light
Perceive the past or future condition of a subject by touching its shadow
cons: No night vision, so your sight is still impaired in darkness (though this is compensated for)
This doesn't allow you to see past camouflage, even in darkness
Perceiving the past/future condition of something may be draining if your powers are weak

name: Godslayer
overview: kill gods and take their powers.
description: A godslayer is usually a mortal man or woman who is granted the power to kill gods. However, the godslayer needs a source of power to draw from (Xena's daughter, Eve; Desak's amulet from Marvel comics) and they need a weapon in their possession. For every god, demon, or other mystic creature you slay, their power becomes yours!
pros: Destroy the petty gods and make their power your own!
A mortal with an immortal life span.
I am Kratos, God of War!
cons: You may be tempted to slay good gods as well (Thor, Amaterasu).
You may develop Kratos style bloodlust.

name: 1000 Shotguns
overview: fire 1000 energy blasts from one's sleeve
description: In order to use this power, you need to have a long-sleeved shirt or coat and yell out, "Fire" each time you want to utilize the power. The larger the sleeve's size the larger and more powerful the blasts coming out of it will be.
pros: Can blast enemies into submission with a barrage of blasts.
cons: Smaller sleeves might as well not even be used.
Will always be in sets of 1000.
Yelling out 'Fire' will get repetitive.

name: Thermokinetic Bombs
overview: explode things up through thermokinesis
description: Thermokinesis can increase and decrease temperature that results in combustion, melting or freezing. However, this might take long to do because the user has to concentrate until they can reach the boiling or freezing point of the objects, but with Thermokinetic Bomb, the user simultaneously HEATS AND FREEZES THE MOLECULES resulting in a clash of energies ending with a big explosion that can destroy almost ANYTHING!!!
pros: Awesome offensive power
Even if the enemy has a shield or armor, they can be attacked on the inside by...
...manipulating the body's thermal energy
cons: Harder to mix opposing HOT AND COLD temperatures in extreme...
...environments, like volcanic areas or in the North and South pole
If emotionally frustrated, a large area can be destroyed, so use with extreme caution

name: Mana Manipulation
overview: generate and manipulate mana or force-like energy
description: You can create energy constructs for nearly any purpose, usually creating platforms to levitate yourselg and others, beams to grab enemies, and circular blasts to knock enemies back.
pros: create shapes and sizes
make platforms like stairs or elevators
make slides
cons: you missed the opponents

name: Curse
overview: lay a negative effect upon whatever you desire.
description:
You can place a curse on whatever you wish (people, places, objects, etc. ). How you do it (eye contact, rhyme, etc. ) and what the curse can do is up to you as long as it is not benevolent in nature (like giving people good luck) and brings harm to others. 

While your curses will not end with your demise, you do need to include a way for people to break it. Just as you decide the effects of your curses, you can also decide how they can be broken.
pros: Versatile
Coming up with a good curse can be an art itself
Curse people who slighted you
cons: Limited by your own imagination
People will probably hate you when they find out you cursed them

name: Hormokinesis
overview: control hormones and pheromones.
description: For those who don't know this, hormones are chemicals that are released in the body with different effects. Pheromones are chemicals that are giving off from the body as a warning sign or an atempet to attract a mate. This ability gives many gifts. First you could control the hormones in your own body. Releasing more testoserone to build more muscles is one example. Or you could pheromones to attract a date, or making your enemies wary of you.
pros: Very useful
Can decrease hormones to cause unconciousness or even death
cons: Its hard to reverse any changes you've done to yourself

name: Regenerative Duplication
overview: hack off pieces of your body which become superpowered copies of you
description: Every bloody piece of you has the ability to quickly regenerate into a fully grown superpowered you once it is seperated from your body. The level of power the new versions of you will have depends on how much you cut off. A slice of your skin will give you a sidekick power like Pie or Forced Standing. Teleportation, Invulnerability or Telekinesis will cost you an arm and a leg. They are all you, you are central point watching & guiding their every move.
pros: Create a superpowered army of yourself that you control.
You will be able to experience every superpowered adventure without being in harm's way.
The more important the body part the more powerful a copy you make
cons: You have a fast healing factor but it will be painful & it will be messy
You will feel all the pain your copies feel in the part they originated from
The death of one of your copies will always haunt you. You will always feel like they are here.

name: Cartoon Affect
overview: survive disasters like in cartoons
description: Survive any disaster that might come across like cartoon chacters do. Recover life threatening injuries.
pros: Almost invulnerable
Super recovery
cons: May have your physical shape altered in order to survive.

name: Animating Inanimate Objects
overview: bring objects to life.
description: Where you ever too lazy to get ready for school in the morning?Well that is all in the past with this power. All you have to do is snap your fingers, and your toothbrush, clothes, and bed will do everything by themselves.
pros: Can be lazy all you want
If you are too drunk to drive, your car will drive for you
If n battle, you can bring to life any weapon to assist you in battle
cons: Each object has a mind of it's own

name: Monster Creator
overview: create an army of monsters with your mind.
description: With this power, you can make any monster from movies, books, etc, but it must be on a paper or TV. You can't just have it in your mind. To get rid of them, you can just poof them away.
pros: Make "the super devil", "dementors, "B.O.B.," etc.
They're on your side and they obey you
Have a lot of fun scaring people
cons: You might go crazy with so much power

name: Object Independence
overview: take the powers from your object-powers and make them YOUR abilities
description: This works in several ways. If it's just a power based in an object, you can just use that power at will. If the power really needs to manifest in an object (like infinite ammo guns), or if you want to, you can summon/disappear the object (if someone steals it, disappear it), or imbue any object of that type you handle with those properties. The final bonus is that you can summon many copies of the objects, with a limit you choose (usually, either time before it disintegrates or number of uses).
pros: This happens automatically, so new objects are never at risk of being stolen before being transfered
Can still have neat tools by summoning them, but don't have to worry about theft
And you can still use those powers even if you don't want to have to lug around the object
cons: This only works if it's an object with a power- not if it's a power to make an object
If this power gets perma-negated/stolen, all your objects suddenly spawn in the air around you
(Good because you don't lose them, bad because suddenly there's a bunch of weapons everywhere)

name: Slow Motion Vision
overview: make you perceive time slower than normal people, allowing you to react faster
description:
Heart beats 6000 times per minute, allowing you to not only see things slower but also gain a little "zoom in zoom out" vision, thus allowing you to react faster.
The only con is that there is that good chance that your heart may explode
pros: Could react to things faster
Notice little things
cons: Heart may explode
Could cause dizziness

name: Cocoon Flight
overview: fly extremely fast, without the wind holding you back.
description: This power gives you the ability to fly very fast. The more air resistance you build up the stronger the cocoon gets. The cocoon is big enough for you to be able to fly in whatever position you'd like.   The ability to simply fly would be worthless you want to fly faster than 200mph since the wind resistance would rip your clothes apart and you would go deaf from all the air passing by your ears. A cocoon solves that problem.
pros: The ability to fly, safe and secure against wind resistance, in a cocoon of air.
You can travel wherever you want
The cocoon is always strong enough as long as you don't hit any big or heavy objects.
cons: You are not invisible. People can spot you flying.
You are not invincible. You can still crash into something and die.
Don't fly in to space; there is no resistance out there and the cocoon would go away.

name: Plasma Energy Fists
overview: clench your fists into a plasma energy
description:
This ability you must clench your fist and focus for them to be trans-fused in plasma energy.
You can shoot plasma energy at opponents and punch opponents with fists severely damaging them with the plasma energy surrounding fists.
pros: Shoot out the plasma energy
Touching opponents will burn them with the plasma energy.
cons: Touching yourself with plasma fists will burn you.
Don't want to touch someone you care about with this ability active.

name: Blood Tentacles
overview: turn your exposed blood into vicious black tentacles
description: This ability would be very handy in a fight. If you get hit or stabbed and you bleed, you can turn your blood into horrible violent tentacles to take down your opponent. And once the fight is over they recede back into your body and heal the wound they protruded from.
pros: Healing factor
Intimdation
Grabbing opponents out of normal reach
cons: Hard to control at first
People may think you're scary
May cause villanous personality

name: Blazing Energy Morphing
overview: generate and morph fierce energy into any shape desired.
description: When you generate a raw, damaging form of energy, you can mold it into a staff and use it like a double-sided light saber. You can form it as a ball and throw it like a dangerous grenade, or form it into a disc and throw it like a large, fast & dangerous frisbee
pros: The energy you form cannot harm you.
You can use it as a light saber, a bomb, or a flinging disc.
cons: Watch where you are using this power. Objects, friends and family could get burned.
Since this energy comes out of you, you would get temporally exhausted from this.

name: Hall Of Armor
overview: use any armor in iron mans vault or in the universe.
description: The ability to use any armor in iron mans vault or in the universe.
pros: Its limitless
You have the weapons
cons: One at a time
Its hard to master

name: Hand Weapon
overview: morph your hands into weapons.
description: With this power, you can turn your hand into any weapon you want: shotgun, pocket knife, RPG, anything. But, it has to be a weapon, and if you have a gun, you don't have to put ammo in it!
pros: No ammo needed
Just imagine all the weapons you can make
cons: Can only make weapons
Some might look weird, like pocket knife, pistol, etc.

name: Molecular Orbing
overview: create elements using your molecular orbs
description: The user has blank molecules (that vary in size) floating around them. When the user conjures them up, they are able to make any element on the periodic table and then mnipulate them. However, with this form of orbing, you must have knowledge about elements.
pros: Make a toxic gas to kill a group of people
Make a steel shield or sword
Create oxygen while underwater
cons: No knowledge, no power
Can only make elements that exist
The elements you create lose their molecular bond, so be wary

name: Mini Energy Monster Creation
overview: create tiny monsters made out of pure energy that can absorb energy from their surroundings
description: With this power you can create tiny monsters made out of energy that can absorb energy from their surroundings (such as electricity, nuclear power, and even stars if they get close enough) they also get larger as they absorb more energy and they are completely under your control
pros: You have tiny energy monster minions
If you're a villain you can have your monsters destroy the sun
Energy cannot be destroyed
cons: Your minions might get on your nerves due to them not being able to be destroyed

name: Plans Within Plans
overview: come up with a clever plan which contains another clever plan.
description: With this power, the user can make a plan that will out trick, out think, and out plan the enemy.
pros: Great for traps, and back up plans. (if you need them)
cons: If you're enemy can read minds, you're screwed.

name: Spiked Wings
overview: fire small nail-like spikes from the back of the metallic wings.
description: You can project some razor-sharp lead-like quills from the back of the metallic feathery wings which can puncture foes and anything that is in your way.
pros: Could look cool and scary.
cons: Beware of the ones who can manipulate metal.

name: Affinity Change
overview: change one's affinity at will.
description: Affinities are the things that, in the superpower world, makes someone stronger. A normal user usually has one or two, but this ability can allow the user to change his affinity. This makes him able to be powered- up anything he wants.
pros: Change your affinity
Gain strength, speed, and possibly other abilities
cons: Can only have one affinity at a time.
Can only gain a certain amount of power

name: 3 To Get Ready
overview: get ready for any occasion just by snapping
description: With this power you can be ready for anything just by snapping and saying the event you need to be ready for. Snapping and saying "Friend's wedding" will cause you to appear in a new tuxedo and a gift for your friend. Saying "Bear Attack" will cause you to know what to do if a bear attacks you and give you a weapon just in case. Saying "Science Fair" will give you a science project worthy of an A+/first place/blue ribbon. Saying "Math Test" will cause you to know all the answers to the test etc.
pros: You can be ready for anything
cons: You can't use this power to get other super powers of any kind

name: Immunity Mimicry
overview: mimic other things' immunities or selective invulnerabilities.
description: This ability makes the user to copy what anyone or anything else is immune too. This also works on what they are selectively invulnerable too. With this, a user change from survivor to immortal if they find the things to copy. Find out what selective invulnerability on http://powerlisting.wikia.com/wiki/Selective_Invulnerability.
pros: Gain different Immunities
Gain different invulnerabilities
Pass on some immunities to something else.
cons: There are some immunities that you mightnot want

name: Fist Scanner V3
overview: know what an object is made of just by pointing your fist at it
description: With this power you will be able to know what an object is made up of just by pointing your fist at it. You can turn this power on and off.
pros: You can know what an object is made up of just by pointing your fist at it
You can discover the secret formula of the krabby patty
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Elemental Dragon
overview: create a dragon from various natural elements
description: This ability allows a person to create and control dragons from the natural elements of rock, fire, wind, water, lightning, or metal. Each dragon created has control over the element they are made from, but are primarily in the control of the user. Empathic connections with each dragon allow the user to merge with the dragon, thus granting such abilities as flight, hydrokinesis, telekinesis, etc.
pros: Have control over your desired element.
If your dragons are destroyed, their merging to you will grant you near-immortality!
You can use a dragon's power on your own if you desire.
cons: Each dragon can be destroyed by the polar opposite of their element.
You are vulnerable to counteractive forces (magnetism to metal, heat to water, etc. )
If all your dragons are destroyed, they will merge back into you.

name: Healer 9: Deformity Correction
overview: remove demormities and gain superhuman attractiveness.
description: With this ability, you project a field with a radius of 25 kilometers, which can be turned off at will and expands by one meter each year. Anybody in the field has unwanted deformities removed and as you remove more deformities in people you grow more attractive. In this case, attractiveness is based on your opinion. This power works both before and after birth.
pros: Remove possibly crippling deformities.
Range starts at 25 kilometers and increases by one meter each year. Can be turned off at will.
Become more attractive.
cons: After people leave the field, they can become deformed once more.
You still age and this power cannot reverse anything but physical symptoms.
Unlike other healing powers, this cannot heal wounds or other ailments.

name: Experience Pull
overview: sense the type and strength of an experience around you.
description: The user feels any experience coming at them. They would know potentially bad experiences even when they aren't obvious. By reading the experience, one could gain knowledge about something, like watching a video and learning about something.
pros: Could "go through" a role like being a celebrity, writer, athlete, etc.
Could learn information by reading the knowledge tied to an experience.
Could possibly sense any bad experiences that are near the user.
cons: One might start to feel overwhelmed by the experiences around the user.
A fear of bad experiences could develop.

name: Involvement Manipulation
overview: control one's or other's involvement in any situation.
description: The user has the power to change, create, or neutralize any form of involvement. The user can be or not be apart of any event. They can avoid events that could harm them. They can do the same for other people as well. The user can make other things involved or not like objects, materials, or super/natural phenomenon. The can manipulate the levels of involvement: physical, mental, spiritual,etc. By making one not involve with something in a spatial level, the user can teleport.
pros: Be a part or not a part of event, people, and things.
if you make yourself not involved in a spatial level, you can teleport.
Manipulate other's involvement
cons: You will miss out on something great
You could get involved in something way over your head

name: Chaos Reincarnation
overview: summon one of the mythical King Solomon's 72 Demons under your command.
description: Legend has it that King Solomon sealed up 72 powerful demons so their strengths cannot be put to misuse. These demons has a strict ranking and almost all has a small army collected from hell. These demons will obey your orders, although some of them may be very unwilling. To learn more about these demons, consult this link: http://en. M. Wikipedia. Org/wiki/Lesser_Key_of_Solomon
pros: These demons each has magical powers and unique personalities.
Better yet, you have 72 to choose from.
You may summon up more than a single demon at once.
cons: Some of these demons can get a bit out of hand. Try not to make them mad.
Manipulating these demons require some mental and physical energy. Overuse may cause extreme strain.
To use efficiently, you need to learn and remember all 72 demons.

name: Sorted
overview: instantly organize things into categories or patterns
description: With this power you can organize a group of objects or names or words or people or anything into neat categories or patters. This power also provides you with multiple suggestions for categorization and whatnot.
pros: You instantly know how to sort things.
cons: Not much use in physical combat.

name: Master Mime
overview: mime objects that become real.
description: Whatever you want to mime will become real, but invisible to other people.  They will not be able to see the mimed objects, but they will still be able to feel and be affected by them.
pros: Miming a box around your stuff
Mime a gun and shoot someone
Mime money to trick vending machines
cons: Walking into invisible walls
You couldn't actually be a mime
Your superhero name would suck

name: Element Matter Asorber
overview: touch any matter and absorb it.
description: This ability allows you to touch any type of element or matter and absorb and you gain its properites. It could then be made into body armor. It only comes out as a thin coating of the material you touch.
pros: You could turn into any type of material you want.
You could have any properites of the material you touch.
cons: It only comes out as a thin coating of the material you touch.
It can only protect you for a little while, unless you are weakened.

name: Shamanic Mind
overview: commune with your surroundings
description: Man has always felt a connection to his home (my tree, my horse, my TV). A Shaman can communicate with their claimed home, influencing events diverse as weather patterns, wildlife, and even stochastic fields--that is, luck. However, it takes time for them to be able to influence an area; until they feel comfortable, nothing will happen. Shamanism is also a two-way street--the environment holds a great deal of sway over them as well, compelling them to aid it in any way it requires.
pros: Influence weather patterns, luck, wildlife, etc.
Works anywhere you feel is your home
May become very influential over environment
cons: Will not work unless you are comfortable with surroundings
Takes time to fully master
Environment influences user as well

name: Monster Shifting
overview: transfrom into any monster
description: Shapeshift into dracula,frankenstein,werewolves but you can not turn into a hero only villains so no superman but you can turn into lex luthor
pros: Great Halloween Costume
Turn into your favorite monsters
Get the powers of the monster when you turn into them
cons: Could get arrested
Heroes attacking you
Policemen after you

name: Digital Mind
overview: psychically mimic the "thought" processes of a machine, most commonly a computer CPU
description: Also called Digital Mimicry or Mechanical Mind, this is the psychic mimicry of the electronic "thought" processes of a computer hard drive, allowing memory and data gathering, analysis and processing on par with, or beyond a supercomputer; can also be used to read bar codes/binary code like an actual language and to "borrow the senses" of machines designed to detect things (radar, GPS tracking, etc. ); in addition, the user's mind may be blocked from mental access by a password.
pros: Human sonar, radar, GPS, motion detector, radio, iPod, audio recorder, surveillance camera,...
Very intelligent (analyze, process and remember information on par with a supercomputer)
Mind often protected by a password
cons: If someone discovers your password (or you don't have one)
You are susceptible to normal viruses and diseases, but also computer viruses and worms
If your mind tries to process too much at once, you freeze like a computer

name: Blade Creation
overview: use any material you touch to make blades on handles
description: If you have a broken blade and if you touch steel, the steel will travel from where you touch to the handle and rebuild the blade. If you touch magma, you will be burned, but you will have a magma blade. Any material will work, even water or any liquids will solidify into sharp solids.
pros: No broken swords and Gatorade blade XD
Magma Blade!!!
If you have pain immunity or healing powers, you're set
cons: When you dont have healing or pain immunity
Will have scars from harmful materials

name: Celestial Creation
overview: create celestial phenomena
description: The ability to create, control and negate all celestial phenomena that occurs outside of our atmosphere. The creation of certain phenomena may affect the earths unique stability
pros: You could create an alternate world
Could advance the knowledge about all celestial phenomenon
The body adapts to the rigours of space
cons: Negating certain celestial phenomena may take its toll on the body
The use of certain celestial phenomena may affect the unique stability of the world
The body adapting may have bad side-effects from the changes to cope with space

name: Vital Amplification
overview: enhance multiple physical and mental attributes through consumption of vitamins and minerals
description: With the consumption of different vitamins and minerals, you have the ability to attain enhancement through the nature of the source of nutrient consumed. The enhancement may extend beyond measures depending on the amount of serving the user consume. Examples of the  enhancements consist of Vitamin A improving sight, and accelerate healing process as well as internal infections due to the antioxidants. Minerals like Iron, and Zinc will enhance endurance and durability. The list goes on...
pros: 1-Can of a Monster Energy can dramatically enhance a user's abilities to the limits.
Become Superhuman on every level to having Super; Strength, Durability, Reflexes, and Intelligence
Immune to Vitamin Poisoning
cons: Enhancements only last for up to 12 hours from the time consumed

name: Empathic Amplification
overview: amplify emotions
description: Also called Emotion Amplification, Emotion Amplifying or Emotion Heightening, this ability allows you to make a subject's current emotions stronger. With this power, you can make angry people irrationally irate, make fearful people hysterical and paranoid, or even make sad foes depressed enough to want to commit suicide. You can even heighten their emotions to the point that they're incapable of functioning AT ALL.
pros: Heighten positive emotions in allies; Heighten negative emotions in foes
If a person thinks you're cute, turn it into full-out undying love; if people are mad, make 'em riot
Heighten emotions even to the point of immobilizing them or sending them into shock
cons: Can't otherwise manipulate emotions
Can't compel anyone whose emotions you manipulate (make them REALLY mad, and then what? )
Can't perceive emotions like TRUE Empathy

name: Targeted Lightning Strike
overview: make lightning strike where you want it to
description: They say "lightning never strikes twice in the same place." But with this power, you prove them wrong. All you have to do is point to & focus where you want lightning to strike. The cons of this power is it has to be natural lightning, not man-made & you can't create a lightning storm, one most already be naturally forming. So you would have live in an area where storms occur frequently & also watch the weather news. Also not immune to lightning strikes yourself.
pros: Make someone or thing a lightning rod by pointing at them
cons: Not immune to lightning, so don't be to close to where ever you target
Have to be in a stormy area with lightning

name: Human Inertia
overview: be very difficult to move and very difficult to stop or change direction when moving.
description: A compromise between immovability and unstoppability. When activated, your body's inertia will dramatically increase, but not to infinity, making it very difficult to change its speed, its direction of movement and its rotation, even for you. Only strong enough forces, especially if they are continuous, can significantly affect you. This ability works down to the molecular level, making you near invulnerable to sudden and brief external forces. It doesn't affect bodily functions
pros: You're nearly as unstoppable as the Juggernaut and nearly as immovable as the Blob.
Your body gains a lot of inertia, including rotational inertia, without gaining any mass.
You also have some form of invulnerability.
cons: You're not completely unstoppable, nor completely immovable.
Continuous external forces can affect you and cause damage to your body.

name: Comic Book Physics
overview: gain powers through ridiculous and sometimes fatal methods
description: Think about it. How do most superheroes get their powers? Radioactive spider? Gamma bomb? Lab accident? These methods are ridiculous by our standards, but with this ability that is no longer the case. Become a nuclear man by exposing yourself to dangerous amounts of radiation, or develop psychic powers the next time you wake up!
pros: Become a super soldier through little exercise
Spinach will actually give you strength and stamina
Lab chemicals will give you super speed or molecular control
cons: Your powers depend on what is around you
If you lose this ability, these methods may kill you

name: Item Merging
overview: merge objects with yourself.
description: Like by merging guns with your arm, your arm can then become multiple guns in one. This can be used with anything.
pros: Pretty good combinations.
cons: Guns can run out of ammo.
There are some bad combinations out there.

name: Superman Spell
overview: cast a spell to give yourself or others Superman's powers.
description: With this ability, you can give yourself or others Superman's powers. The difference is that you get to vary up the source of power. If it's a rock, you'll be at 20% strength; if it's a nuclear reactor in New Mexico, you'll be at 120% strength. This allows you to bestow and remove the powers at will, and if someone abuses the power you give them, you can reduce it or take it away!
pros: Become a different version of the man of steel (Sentry, Hancock, etc. )
Give yourself and others superpowers!
cons: Some of the empowered may not be so noble
Power supply may become obvious
Making disposable items a power source

name: Pattern Sense
overview: analyze, and later pick up on, patterns in one's environment
description: This ability comes in two parts: the analysis and the perception. First, the user looks at a subject, or otherwise, comes into contact with it, which triggers the willful psionic analysis of a subject's properties and features (shape, density, texture, etc. ). After the analysis, the second part comes into play, allowing the user to pick up on any subject of the same molecular/chemical/genetic, or otherwise, structural makeup, and track them accordingly.
pros: Become an awesome analyst (analyze chemical components, texture, beneficial/harmful effects, etc. )
Sense a subject's true nature (age, gender, race, any diseases) to "out" shapeshifters, or the like
Track down any specimen similar to one you've previously analyzed
cons: Analysis, if undeveloped, can be triggered randomly
Analysis can be used to analyze language patterns, fighting styles, etc. But this can take a while
At higher levels, even analyze the space-time continuum, but this takes a while to obtain

name: Weredragon
overview: transform into a strong, fire-breathing humanoid beast.
description: Whenever you are scratch or bitten by a baby dragon that hatches out of its egg, you are able to transform youself into a humanoid dragon which includes a serpentine body with large arms, can have fire-breathing capabilities, superhuman strength, able to resist penetration by small caliber bullets, and able to breathe fire onto your enemies.
pros: Can also fly.
May attack your foe with a long tail.
cons: Can get killed by a sword to the heart.

name: Nano Re Animator
overview: re-animate newly dead people using nanites.
description: Your body makes re-animation nanites. You touch someone to inject them. Nano-reanimates retain full IQ and can heal and stop decay and aging. Limb reattachment is possible. Those who use technology powers can affect nano-reanimates. If a nano-reanimate has technology powers of his own, then this is no problem. Nano-reanimates do occasionally need to ingest the raw material their nanites are made of to stay nano-reanimated.
pros: Better re-animation through nanotechnology.
You can't nano-reanimate yourself, but someone else could.
cons: A nano-reanimate lacks technology-control powers.

name: Avatar Condition
overview: be the physical representation of an idea or concept
description: An avatar is a higher force, like a god or idea, in human form. They can be strength incarnate, evil incarnate, Vishnu incarnate, the fighting spirit of their homeland incarnate, or any one of a hundred different descents. Those that do discover the truth about themselves can command all of their idea's power. For example, a Strength Avatar could be as strong as all humanity. These Avatars may have specific weaknesses; damaging their souces usually weakens them personally.
pros: Can be one of a thousand descents (Vishnu, evil, intelligence)
Commands all of their given idea's force
One in a long chain of similar avatars
cons: May not discover the truth about self
Idea has a huge command over your personality
Have a specific weakness, usually the source of your powers

name: Cosmic Seeker
overview: absorb cosmic rays and turn it into an energy orb weapon.
description: This is like a heat seeking rocket but it's in a form of an orb that tracks and destroy. First, you must absorb a great amount of cosmic rays to use this. It's a guaranteed hit, even if someone will evade it with superhuman reflexes or superspeed.
pros: A sure hit of the target no matter what.
cons: Cannot use if no cosmic rays to absorb and.
Orb can be destroyed/absorbed

name: Blademancy
overview: produce swords and daggers from your hands.
description: Produce blades of any size from your palms, such as daggers, throwing knives, katanas, hook swords, dual swords, and broad swords.
pros: Can break out of a trap.
Swords are indestructible.
cons: When you first get the power, it is unpredictable.

name: Binary Vascular System
overview: have two hearts working together
description: You possess two hearts, each even stronger than that of a long-distance Olympic runner, which work in conjunction to pump blood around the body. Your heartbeat is therefore as low as 10 beats a minute, and your circulation is far better than normal humans. When under extreme stress or during an adrenaline burst, your hearts combined beat far faster than any human's could, and safely as well.
pros: You are far stronger, fitter and faster than normal humans
Attacks to the heart (e.g. being stabbed) will miss, as their locations are off
If one heart stops beating, you can survive without difficulty with the other, until you restart it
cons: If both hearts go into cardiac arrest, they must both be restarted
Doctors unaware of your condition could easily kill you when performing surgery
Your speed and strength has limits, and is not a lot above top human levels

name: Half Dragon (European)
overview: be half-human, half-dragon
description: 'Half Dragon' is similar to but different than this power. First,you can only spit fire from your mouth instead of ignite it anywhere on your body. Also,your skin is covered with scales except for your face,you have claws and fangs instead of nails and canines,you have horns coming out from the sides of your head,and you have wings that are proportional to your body. Not only that but your intelligence,strength,speed and magical power are all well beyond that of an ordinary human's.
pros: You have higher physical and magical attributes than most humans.
You could do well as a blacksmith considering that the fire you spit out is at a high tempurature.
cons: A full dragon can still defeat you in all-out physical combat with no allies and no weapons.
Due to the horns and wings, you definitely do not look human and may be mistaken for a demon.

name: Two Wings
overview: have any two wings you want grow on your back
description: (This power is very easy to understand) with this power you can choose any two wings and they will grow on your back. For Example Griffin wings and Phoenix wings.
pros: You can choose any two wings to grow on your back
The wings are your choose
They look good
cons: You have to hide your wings
You will be hunted
People will be afraid of you

name: One Size Fits All
overview: make any article of clothing fit you perfectly
description: With this power you can make any article of clothing fit you just by putting it on (or trying to put it on). The article of clothing remains your size until you take it off then it reverts to its original size until you put it on again.
pros: You can make any article of clothing fit you
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Ultimate Charisma
overview: make people like/dislike you/others
description: The ability to boost/decline yours or others charisma. Boosting it to the extreme will make people do what you want to,listen to you,trust you or make you unbelivable,untrusted,do the exact opposite to what you say
pros: People will do what you want
You are a magnet to people
If you say something people will listen intently
cons: You may get to have a big ego
People may not like that they cant help but listen to you
You might permanently un-charismize someone

name: Myth Sense
overview: sense where mythological are located
description: You know where all the mythological creatures in the area are. You can sense them up to a hundred miles.
pros: Prove or unprove hypotheses about mythological beings.
Capture and sells the animals.
cons: Jurassic Park like situations.

name: Psychic Absorption
overview: absorb psychic energy aimed at you.
description: With this ability, you can absorb psychic energy. You can choose to build up the energy you store, and release it in a concentrated blast. This includes Mind Control, Telekinesis, and other psychic attacks. Telepathy can still be used on you. However, you can choose to absorb it as well.
pros: Immune to psychic energy.
Can fire back the psychic energy in a concentrated blast of energy.
Can store this energy for as long as you want.
cons: Not many have abilities which use psychic energy.
No resistance to physical or emotional damage comes from this ability.

name: Wayne Enterprises
overview: get products from Wayne Enterprises.
description: With this power you are able to get products directly made from any Wayne Enterprise section. You will receive free shipping from your products. This company excels in stealth, hand-to-hand combat, and aero-transportation.
pros: You get excellent products for free.
cons: It is bad in certain areas compared to Lexcorp/Stark Industries.

name: Wind Walk
overview: walk in air.
description: You are able to walk in the air without falling.  This is not an ILLUSION!  It's not flying, either.  You walk through the air!!!
pros: Can escape from bad guy/good guy
You can avoid traffic
Good way to impress friends
cons: Umm... none

name: Intuitive Weakness Sensing
overview: detect weak points in objects and people
description: A person who has this ability would be able to size up an opponents and objects in a quick glance, allowing them to know immediately their pressure points, soft spots, and generally all the places where they would rather not be hit and/or where the most damage can be done..
pros: Able to sense any skeletal damage
Able to detect a bad leg or such
Able to efficiently deal with such a person
cons: No superhuman strength
Cannot work on non-biologicals
No special fighting prowess

name: Time Traveler Possession
overview: have mind & soul time travel possessing someone in the past for 6 hours
description: Sort of like Quantum Leap, you go into a deep trance & have an outer body experience. Your spirit travels back in time & inhabits a living person in the past that's the same gender as you & approximately the same age. You can't change or make big influences the past for it might throw the cosmic universe off balance, even if it seems for the better. You can't also inhabit your past self. Your spirit will meld with the past people so you have their knowledge & memory experience.
pros: Possess someone in the past for 6hrs
Your spirit will intertwine with the spirit of the person you inhabit, so you have their knowledge
You also gain their memory experience & skills
cons: Cannot change the past majorly
Cannot possess your past self for risk of cosmic rifts. Your present body is in catatonic state
You possess random past people unless truly focused on a person & die if they die

name: Fear
overview: know what people fear and bring it to life
description: Everyone has a fear, which means everyone can fall victim to this power. The person will see what they fear, like a giant spider, but the spider can't actually hurt them. It's all just one big illusion.  Must have physical contact with the victim.
pros: No one is immune
cons: Must have physical contact of some type
The created illusion can not physically hurt the other person

name: Remote Contact
overview: make physical contact with a distant object or person no matter the distance
description: If you want to touch a person or an object but they are out of reach, you just have to reach in front of you and you will feel them and act on them like they are right here. So, you can effectively push, punch, grab, kick, and all from a distance. Furthermore, you can extend this ability to any object you're holding. So, you can stab with a knife, burn with a flame, knock with a blunt object from very far away! It works no matter the distance, but only if your target is within your visual field.
pros: Turn close-range attacks into long-range attacks
You can attack people without them knowing from where the attacks came from
No need to precisely aim since faraway targets are much "closer than they appear"
cons: Your enemies could try to hide or get in your blind spot
You can still get hurt by the object or the person the moment you make contact with it

name: Matter Redirection
overview: absorb matter through one limb and dispel it from another
description: If you place your hand near something and concentrate, you can dispel it through your other hand or your feet. This is easier to do with objects smaller than your palm or your sole, any larger items take more concentration and may come out completely shredded. You can shoot matter at your enemy, and redirect projectiles to a degree. You can absorb dirt through your feet and dispel it through your hands, allowing for easy underground travel, a process that also can be applied for limited flight.
pros: Really Versatile
Underground travel and flight, kinda
Become a wood chipper!
cons: Cannot store matter
Fast projectiles need a mostly straight line between the limbs, so redirecting bullets is dangerous
Difficult to redirect large solids

name: Zodiacal Amalgamation
overview: grant new powers just by combining the western and chinese zodiacs.
description: You can grant yourself new abilites by combining two different zodiac signs (Western & Chinese), but for example if you try to merge Gemini with the Rat - you may bring thins to life and have them split up. Capricorn with the Monkey equals to become a Dolphin, Virgo with the Snake equals Instant Regeneration.
pros: Can do almost everything.
cons: You can only combine two.

name: Barrier Defiance
overview: pass through forcefields and barriers no harm and no difficulty
description: Also called Forcefield Defiance, this ability allows the user to bypass any forcefield that he comes into contact with; telekinetic forcefields, barriers of psychic/psionic energy, light screens, electrical barriers, barriers made of heat energy or sound energy or magnetic energy or gravitational energy, Impact Shield, "mimed barriers" or the like, can all be bypassed as though they weren't there. The user can pass through any barrier that is intended to defend, so long as it isn't solid.
pros: Bypass any forcefield or barrier (touching something that generates barriers cancels their power)
No effort required and no harm occurs (even resist Repulsion Field and similar defensive powers)
Doesn't matter what type of energy the barrier or forcefield is made up of
cons: Cannot be a solid (no walls, doors, etc. )
Only works if the energy is used to keep others out (as a blast, bolt, etc. You can still be hurt)
Some can only pass through a certain TYPE of barrier (psychic, psionic, light, etc. )

name: Money Maker
overview: make any kind of money, from different countries or different worlds
description: This is very similar to "Money Controller", except with this you can go anywhere and make as much of their currency as you want or need. Unlike counterfeit, you just have to touch the actual currency and your skin will analyze everything about it and copy it 100%.
pros: You will be rich anywhere
Buy anything you want
Use your money to help the world, like poverty
cons: Massive inflation within the economy
A lot of people might try to rob you
It will be hard to trust anyone or have a person who likes you for you

name: Natural Environment Link
overview: make your surroundings become a part of you.
description: With this ability, you can make natural surroundings become a part of you by linking your arms with them. You then have control of some extent to manipulate them. This will not work on animated forms of life, however it does work on plants. For example, you could shake a tree while linked with it, cause vines to wrap around objects or other people, or re-shape the ground while in contact with it. The objects become movable by thinking about moving them, just like your arms and legs.
pros: The objects stay in contact with you as long as you wish to maintain the link.
Experienced users will no longer need to have contact with what they want to manipulate
A lot of natural environment would greatly increase your abilities.
cons: Has little effect if you live in the city.
Cannot manipulate man-made objects.
Extreme emotions could cause you to shatter the environment.

name: Cellular Conversion
overview: change anything into the appropriate cells
description: A person with this power can change anything non biological within a biological creature into body cells. In practice, this can remove bombs within people's bodies by turning it into blood/organs. The user can also transform bullets that entered the body back to the tissues that they destroyed. If the user is missing a body part, attaching something else with the same amount of mass will convert it into cells. The user can also reverse the transformation and can detect transformed cells.
pros: Can heal people as long as they are alive
Healed objects become similar to tracking devices for the user
The user can reverse the transformation if desired
cons: Must have matter to convert
Cannot heal dead people this way
Cannot make different tissue-no turning fat into muscle. (All of the cells must be the same)

name: Enhanced Magnetism
overview: be magnetic
description: This ability allows the user to become magnetic in more ways than one. Not only can they attract objects and people toward themselves, they can attract things in other ways too. They can attract people mentally so that they are liked, so much so that people will obey them. Or they could even draw the energy right out of someone. They can be magnetic in any way they can think of, and even control how they're magnetic.
pros: Very useful
Can control how you're magnetic
cons: At first, you can't control your power.

name: Energy Disc
overview: fire energy based discs
description: The disc are formed and controlled by your thoughts. They can be held like a shield deflecting projectiles, or used as a projectile. You can levitate on them and you are immune to your own disc.
pros: Immune to your own discs
Fire energy based disc...'nuff siad
cons: Not immune to discs of others

name: Ranged Kinetic Bolts
overview: project energy bolts that amass kinetic energy as they travel
description: A person with this ability can produce balls of energy from their hands. However, these balls amass kinetic energy as they travel, becoming more powerful with distance.
pros: Hit distant targets with great force
Almost better than a handgun
Protect an establishment easily
cons: Closer targets get hit with less power
Overuse can be physically draining
Bolts are affected by gravity

name: Summon Ninjas
overview: summon ninjas to do your bidding
description: A person with this power has the ability to summon generic superninjas. The ninjas are at your beck and call. The ninjas have the typical ninja moveset of generic ninjas in fiction. They can teleport, hide in small places, have limited superstrength, and can literally walk on air. They also have ninja weapons. They will do whatever the summoner asks them to do. You can use them as messengers, foot soldiers, as well as send them to buy your groceries. They can communicate with you telepathically.
pros: You can summon as many as you want and you can also unsummon them
They are all skilled and have the typical ninja moveset
You control them and they understand what you say(no communication error)
cons: They will tend to kill people in the way of your orders
They will also attack pirates or people with eyepatches for no particular reason
They can't communicate with other people unless you give them a note

name: Ultraviolet Vision
overview: perceive the ultraviolet light spectrum
description: One with this ability can easily shift their vision to see the ultraviolet part of the spectrum. This means that your visual capacity is greatly enhanced; you can see traces of bodily fluids on surfaces as though an ultraviolet blacklight is shining on them; you can see through water (no matter how murky) with no problem; you can even look directly into sunlight with no risk of optic damage; what's better, the color quality of your vision is greatly enhanced.
pros: Enhance the range of what you consider visible light (see in greater detail)
Pick up on traces of body fluids left behind (solve crimes, track down subjects, etc)
See through murky water, and intense sunlight glare with no optical strain or damage
cons: Optikinesis can impair this power
If one's power is TOO sensitive, it could blind you when you look directly at the sun
Visual Illusions still work (except they're vibrant and colorful, making them even more realistic)

name: Chi
overview: gain superhuman capabilities by learning to harness chi.
description: Martial artists gain superhuman capabilities by learning to harness chi. This type of method generally provides extraordinary strength, speed, durability, and reflexes. Also often used for superhuman awareness, energy blasts, elemental powers, and sometimes invulnerability.
pros: You could enhance your abilities to extraordinary levels.
You would be able to increase your strength.
You would be capable of running and moving at speeds greater than even the finest Olympic sprinter.
cons: You would have to learn martial arts.
Your stamina would be limited.
You would still be vulnerable to injury

name: Karma Incarnate
overview: deliver karmic retribution or salvation to anyone by altering reality
description: With this power, you have the ability to manipulate reality, but only to serve karma. You have the ability to punish the wicked with an appropriate punishment and help the innocent by giving advice or items. However you feel compelled to use your powers every time you see something wrong instead of letting things resolve by themselves. Since the user is karma incarnate, they are also immune to their own karma so punishing the wicked or assisting the innocent does not help or hurt their karma.
pros: You can punish those that deserve it
You can help those that need it the most
You are immune to other karmic powers or karma
cons: You have to serve karma- you feel compelled to use your power whenever you see something wrong
You sometimes come off as a jerk since you can not show any sort of mercy to the wicked
You can only use your power if you witness a person's own cruelty or kindness

name: The Superpower List Choice
overview: pick any ONE power from the "Superpower List" and attain it
description: Pick any power from the "superpower list" and you can have it! But you only get one, so choose wisely. Luckily for you, the "superpower list" is full of awesome superpowers! Also, let me note that if the user got to have more than one superpower, his or her strength would have to be divided into the superpowers, making them weaker, but because the user only gets one superpower, that power is at its greatest strength!
pros: Pick any power from the "superpower list" and you can have it
Because the user only gets one superpower, that power is at its greatest strength!
The "superpower list" is full of awesome superpowers
cons: You only get one, so choose wisely

name: Magma Ring
overview: call forth a ring that can manipulate and control the element of Molten lava.
description: With this power you call forth a ring to manipulate and control Molten lava. While you have the ring on you are immune to the effects of Molten lava and the ring will not come off. You make things out of lava. You can walk right through a river of Molten lava without getting hurt but, anyone else will get hurt.
pros: With the ring on you are immune to the effects of Molten lava
Ring will not come off.
You can walk right through river of Molten lava with getting hurt
cons: Ring will not come off.
The ring has the power not you
People may fear you

name: Kinetic Projection
overview: create and control kinetic energy
description: This allows you to instantly project kinetic energy, and control it. It can be used to create force fields, kinetic blasts, and change the force of your own movements, like making a punch harder, or a fall lighter. You can also project kinetic energy around an object to move the space around it (parakinesis). It can also create kinetic friction which can turn kinetic energy into fire, then control the fire through its kinetic energy.
pros: Lots of possibilities
Fire is fun
cons: Can't do telekinesis. Only parakinesis.

name: Genetic Reader
overview: read one's genes and bibliography by touch.
description: Touch someone to know one's genetic history. Learn the origin, trails of heredities, talents, and abilities possessed.
pros: Become a human blueprint reader.
Know one's strengths and weaknesses.
cons: Excessive use develop mood swings.

name: Artifact Projection
overview: recreate with your mind any held objects.
description:
A form of mental sorcery forming a copy of any held object. Power is drawn from the collective thoughts humans have about the target object. The power of the item made depends on its original abilities and the current number of people who think about the item. 

Common items will be almost identical to their real counterparts (ie a generic sword), artifacts known to some countries will suffer moderate ability reduction (ie Excalibur), while obscure relics suffer large penalties (ie Fragarach).
pros: Any held object can be recreated. Try the One Ring, Hermes' sandals, or the Lasso of Truth!
Abilities bestowed by a copy of a highly popular object will be virtually identical.
If more people see the copy and/or its effects, it will gain power as more people think of it.
cons: Only items that have truly existed in real life or in literature can be copied.
Using this power will induce physical strain proportional to the strength of the artifact recreated.
Copies will always shatter and disappear within fifteen seconds of summoning.

name: Stardust Transformation
overview: transform yourself into stardust
description: The user is able to transform his or her form into stardust. The stardust form is purely for transportation and distraction purposes only. The stardust hole does not have any offensive abilities
pros: Can distract enemies
Can fly around
cons: Cannot attack enemies

name: Viscosity Control
overview: change the rate of flow of any liquid
description: With this power you can change the viscosity of any liquid, meaning you can make it flow slower or faster. You can throw enemies in bodies of water and then speed up the current in order to injure them, you can cause honey to come out of the dang bottle faster or you can cause a bleeding person's blood to flow very fast so that they bleed to death before their platelets can react.
pros: You can control the rate of speed at which a liquid flows
cons: You can only make liquids move faster

name: Extraordinary Imagination
overview: have an imagination much greater than that of a normal being's.
description: With this ability, you have an extraoridinary imagination. You can imagine concepts that could not be imagined by the normal human mind, such as different dimensions, advanced technology, and other abnormal phenomena which, again, can't be grasped by the human mind. This also gives you a much wider imagination, making you extremely creative.
pros: You would be amazing at developing art concepts.
Imagine ideas and concepts that are superior of a normal human's.
Invent new things with your imagination.
cons: Others may not understand your imagination if you explain it to them.
A lot of your imagination may not be particularly realistic.
May have daydreams at the wrong moments.

name: Solar Fueled
overview: become potentially superhuman varying on the weather.
description: With this ability, you become more powerful by the amount of sun rays you're exposed to. On a mild day, as long as the sun is out, it would allow you to knock over a truck, run the speed of a car, have extremely quick reflexes, and superhuman stamina. In the summer, you become fully-charged, and these abilities can multiply by 5. However, cloudy and rainy days leave you at normal human ability. This also supercharges any superpowers you have, if you happen to have any.
pros: Become supercharged in the sun, gaining super strength, speed, stamina, and reflexes.
A hot, summer day could increase thes abilities by a maximum of 5.
Also supercharges any superpowers that you may have.
cons: Cloudy, rainy days leave you at normal power.
You're most likely not going to have much power during the winter, or in cloudy areas.
An overload of power could cause you to become dangerous, destroying things by accident.

name: Charisma
overview: make people feel good toward you
description: Being liked is something that we all want. A person with Charisma can make people to feel friendly toward them for no apparent reason. This can range to anyone they choose to extend it to, even sworn enemies. Perhaps more sinisterly, this can be forced, making your target hang on their every word and thus be willing to do anything for them. Skilled telepaths might be able to detect the ability when it's being used, but only the strong-willed can resist it.
pros: No shortage of friends
Can even be extended to sworn enemies
Anything from warm fuzzy feeling to slavish devotion
cons: May be tempted to use for evil
Can be detected by Telepaths
Can be resisted by the strong-willed

name: Power Malfunction
overview: make superpowers malfunction temporarily
description: Any superpowered being that goes against you will have to do so at their own risk since they do not know the results of their own abilities. For example, a person with pyrokinesis may accidentally create an explosive flame in front of themself. Also, this may cause people to use another power by accident. When using superstrength, they may accidentally use healing touch or alternatively fire breath.
pros: When someone with superpowers goes against you, their powers are out of their control
Some of the results may be funny, such as creating a stuffed bear when they wanted to make a monster
You may not need to fight at all, letting the other person blow themself up.
cons: The results are out of your control and people can improvise
The person may find a new use for their powers afterward, i.e. ice making from water manipulation
This can happen to your own powers as well

name: Ultimate Weapon(Shield)
overview: have a giant unbreakable and unstoppable shield floating in front of you
description: A person with this power has the ability to create an unbreakable and unstoppable physical shield that floats in the air in front of their field of vision. The shield negates any type of superpower used against it. It moves with the user and can be used as a battering ram. Besides the shield in the front, the user can also create additional shields in any direction. Shields are unmovable after creation but can disappear at will. The shield can be any design the user wants, except being small.
pros: You can make multiple shields
A good offense and defence
It negates any superpowers that try to pass to the other side
cons: You can't see past the shield (it also negates your x-ray vision)
You might hit allies-see con 1
If you don't like having a big thing blocking your way

name: Opposite Power Absorption
overview: absorb the opposite of other people's powers
description: When you touch someone with a super power, you will absorb their power but it is inverted, e.g. fire balls would equal snow balls, and vice versa. If the power does not have an opposite, you will not absorb it and you can only hold one power at a time.
pros: You get superpowers
They can be really powerful
cons: If there is no opposite, you will not get one.
You can only hold onto one at a time.

name: Shockwave Transfer
overview: damage organic and inorganic things internally
description: This ability allows the user to transfer energy out of his or her body into another person or object, internally damaging the person's bones and organs, or destroying the objects inside. At higher mastery levels, the user can liquefy organs or shatter bones, or cause inorganic things to explode or even implode. At the highest level, the user can use the kinetic energy around them to generate the shockwave, instead of their own energy. Must come into physical contact to use.
pros: Pierces all defenses.
Can use energy in environment for shockwave at higher level of mastery.
Extremely powerful.
cons: Must come into physical contact with object/creature.
Need to use your own energy at lower-mid levels of mastery.

name: Rpg Class
overview: level up as a fantasy Role Playing Game class character.
description: With this power you are able to take on the aspects of any fantasy RPG class such as those found in World of Warcraft and Diablo. You do not have to acquire the same abilities and can learn your own unique powers as long as you stay within the theme of the class. You are allowed to have multiple "accounts" of classes which you are allowed to switch between, but you must level each separately. Class armor can also be obtained as you level up a class.
pros: Many Classes to choose from, and many abilities to be learned.
Can have multiple "accounts" to switch between many classes.
Can obtain class armor to increase your powers if you level up high enough.
cons: Limited to staying within the theme of each class.
Each RPG class "account" has to be leveled separately.
Level Cap is 100.

name: Name Strength V2
overview: give other people strength by saying their name
description: With this power whenever you say a person's first and last name they will gain superhuman strength and invulnerability for 24 hours. You don't have to be near the person or even ever have met the person.
pros: You can give people super strength by saying their name
cons: You cannot use this power on yourself

name: Range Analysis
overview: detect the area of effect of a power user.
description: This power can only be used on a power user. When you use it, you can sense the maximum range they can reach with their superpowers. Maximum range, meaning the range they can reach at their full potential. You'll know the shape and dimensions of that area of effect and sense where it is relative to your position. At the beginning, the power will only return the information about all powers combined. With experience, you'll be able to discriminate the area of effect of a specific power.
pros: Obstacles can create safe spots within the area of effect.
Know exactly where you have to go to be out of reach from a dangerous user.
Use it on yourself to discover your potential.
cons: At the beginning, you won't know with which powers they can strike your location.
You won't know whether the effect will be dangerous, benefic or completely harmless.
Powers that enhance one's capacity will be ranged 0, but what they can do will far outreach it.

name: Mad Genius
overview: let your anger fuel your brain, intellect and intelligence
description: With this power the angrier you are the more intelligent you will become. Frustration and anger will make you a master strategist, scientist, engineer, inventor, mathematician & musician. Your IQ will be immeasurable.
pros: Anger increases your brainpower, let your ire grow until you have no intellectual rival
Their will be no code, crime or strategy you couldn't unravel
If angered enough you could outmatch any intellect, machine
cons: Only happens when you are angry
Unangered you are prone to absent-mindedness
Brain matter may constantly grow to grotesque proportions

name: Dermal Microspines
overview: create near microscopic spines on your skin
description: This ability allows you to form small (nearly microscopic) spines anywhere on your skin. The spines are nearly indestructible and sharp. These small spines can produce a multitude of effects. They can allow you to cling to walls, use your skin like sandpaper to harm your opponents by tearing skin, or even allow them to break off in your opponent causing intense pain.
pros: Wall Climbing
Your skin is now a weapon
No hugs from people you don't like
cons: Hard to get close to people
Hand to hand combat required
Sometimes you can't suppress it...

name: Lodekrio
overview: become anything you touch, organic or inorganic
description: Anything you touch, you may become. You may become a car, or a building. If you wish, you may even be your cousin, the guy down the street, the president, even.
pros: Become anyone, anything
Master of disguise
If you're touching two things at once, you may choose which to be
cons: No body of your own
Kill innocent people, if you becomes too big of an item/animal

name: Titan's Grip
overview: have increased hand strength and brawling abilities.
description: With this power you can focus your energy in your hands creating a dark red energy that lets you crush or hold things in your hand without losing your grip. The focused energy increases the strength of your punches causing them to hit with the force of a large meteor. The force can also be focused into a melee weapon, such as a sword, to greatly increase its destructive force. The melee weapon would become indestructible, weightless to the user, and would also glow with same energy.
pros: Power of a titan.
Increased strength with fists and melee weapons.
Never lose your grip on your weapon.
cons: Only increases strength in hands.

name: Reverse Aging
overview: reverse your age at will.
description: This ability allows you to reverse your age at any time, while still retaining the knowledge and experience you have now. However, if your illness is due to natural causes from old age, you can reverse the process.  Any age goes, be it 20, 15, 10, even the age you were born. name: Angelic Hierarchy: Powers
overview: become a celestial keeper of history.
description: The Powers, also known as the Authorities, are the bearers of conscience and keepers of history. They are also warrior angels who remain loyal to the superior. As a Power, you oversee the distribution of power among mankind, hence the name. Powers appear as beautiful humans clad in gold sapphire-studded armor, they also have incredibly long hair which sparkles and glistens like a river in the summer. The Powers carry two beautifully crafted longswords which are hidden in their red velvet wings.

name: Moon Angel

name: Healer 8: Enzyme Addition

As a bonus, if any of them have other enzymes in their body which are blocked, this power will restore them too. You can also mimic enzymes found in other species or from any superhuman who enters your field, allowing you to survive a greater range of internal pH and resist changes in temperature. The field expands a meter each year and can be switched off at will.

Useless without some form of weapon

Great magic trick

description: You can create bowling ball sized exposed singularities. You can guide up to two towards a single target or hit two targets that are close together. Any armor or forcefield will be destroyed first. Powers that defy the laws of physics or give protection from changes to the laws of physics give someone immunity to this attack. Powers of invulnerability or intangibility also give immunity. Otherwise, this attack destroys any target made of energy or matter.
