cons: Subjects can become drowsy, so they can't reveal secrets
Subjects may appear intoxicated, so the police may question you
Excessive use may disrupt a subjects sleeping pattern

name: Capability Possession
overview: physical possess another thing's capability(s).
description: This ability allows the user to physically fuse with someone else's body in order to take control of the capabilities they possess. They cannot take control the person who has the capabilities. The user can activate, negate, increase, or decrease the capabilities of the other person.  It could natural talents, skills,  functions, or powers. The user can possess the matter or energy that a person produces as long as it is still in use. The user can move out of the person anytime they want.
pros: Activate, negate, increase, or decrease the capabilities of the another person or thing.
Magic and technology is also affected by this ability.
The can take over multiple abilities or abilities user at once with more time.
cons: If the ability of the other person is removed while the user is still within it, they will be removed.

name: Mark Of Skoll
overview: become a solar lycan
description: In Norse mythology, Skoll was one of the wolf brothers (the other being Hati) who chased after the sun and moon god. During the day of Ragnarok, Skoll devoured the Sun God and gain his power. With this power, you have the ability to turn into a werewolf or gaint one with immense strength, speed, healing factor, immoratality. You also have power of a Sun God and can use elements like fire, light, and gravity and can become more powerful with sunlight.
pros: Super strength and speed of a werewolf
Have the power of the sun god
Can stand up against a god and devour them
cons: Other gods might want hunt you down
Might be hard to control at first
Not as strong at night

name: Move Swipe
overview: use a move that was just used on you.
description: You will be able to use a move that your enemy used on you. You absorb the aftermath of a move, say laser fragments or a dust cloud, and you can use that move
pros: You can use a cool move
You can mimic abilities that your enemy holds
cons: It has to hit you first
You can only use it once (If it hit you again, you can use it again)

name: Pagokinesis
overview: control the Cold Air.
description: Unlike Cryokinesis which controls ice, Pagokinesis controls the Cold Air that turns water into ice. It grows stronger with the natural cold air around you. Also, the more you use the ability in a specific area, the colder your environment gets.
pros: It's like manipulating water and air
The colder it is, the stronger it is
Can be used for flight and speed as well
cons: Cannot manipulate water, only the ice
Grows weaker in warmer temperatures

name: Nightmare Dimension
overview: teleport people to a dimension of all of humanity's darkest nightmares
description: All of humanity's nightmares go to one place: the nightmare dimension. Your power allows you to transport anyone to and from this place. All the fear and terror possibly dreamed lives here and is made into phyisical forms to inflict horror, terror, fear and harm to any visitors. This dark realm has no escape unless you wish it.
pros: Cause victims terror
Be a living Freddy Krueger
cons: ...if sending people to a terrible dimesion and causing insanity is wrong, I don't wanna be right
Can only stay inside dimension for 24 hours, then the target is teleported back to our dimension

name: Psychic Network
overview: create a network of esper whose power increases due to the network sharing
description: A person with this ability has the power to grant anyone psychic abilities as long as they consent to listening to an mp3. Once the other person, becomes an esper, you also gain the same abilities as the other person. The more people that are in your network, the stronger everyone in the network will be. Only the moderator/proxy/owner has multiple abilities and they can kick out anyone from the network at will as long as they are in a lower rank. The owner can use the group as a calculator.
pros: Create an army
Get everyone's powers if you are the owner
Have the calculating powers of your entire network
cons: You can still be defeated by someone outside your network
Sometimes kicking out someone does not remove their psychic powers
If someone finds your identity as the owner they can plot to kill you so they become the new owner

name: Blessing Of Poseidon
overview: have the gift of the sea god, Poseidon.
description: Poseidon is the Greek god of the sea. His gift allows you to channel the power of the sea in different ways. You can manipulate sea water and even breath underwater. You can also speak to sea creatures, gain strengh when in sea water, and know your position when at sea. Another thing, when you come in contact with water it will crawl along your skin and heal any wounds you have. And you only get wet when you want. The power of the sea is in your hands.
pros: You can control sea water and breath .
You can speak to sea creatures, and know your position at sea.
You can heal and gain strengh from the sea.
cons: You are drawn to the sea
You can only use your powers with sea water

name: Plant Manipulation
overview: control and produce plant life
description: A person with Plant Manipulation (also called Agrokinesis) has an amazing gift. They can induce plant growth and cause large shrubs, grasses, vines, trees and other vegetation to move with their mind; this requires very little concentration. Even more spectacular, their anatomy is more plant-like than animal. This lets them photosynthesize, produce vegetation, and regenerate at twice normal speed.
pros: Takes little concentration
Can take on many foes at once
Increased resistance to animal-targeted poisons
cons: Herbicides
Fire
Pollution

name: Homing Propulsion
overview: throw any object which will home in on any target
description: This power enables you to give any object, that you are throwing, the property to aim at any target you want and to move towards it. Unless an external force acts upon the object, the latter remains at the same speed it was thrown at. The target must be in your line of sight when you throw your object, but once the target is locked on, the object will keep homing in on it until either one of them is destroyed, the object is stopped or you decide to cancel your action.
pros: You don't need to guide your object yourself. It will aim on its own.
Increase your chances of hitting your target. You will rarely miss.
Keep track of your target's movements.
cons: The more inertia the object has, the less maneuverable it is.
Can be avoided if the target is faster or more maneuverable.

name: Genetic Memory Lineage
overview: pass memories via genes
description: Memories are passed via genes from parent to child at the moment of conception.   The children will also inheret all memories of those that lived before the parent and who had this ability.
pros: You remember multiple lifetimes.
You know your mom or dad very well because you share a lot of memories.
You don't have to instruct your children about your families history.
cons: Your children will know many of your secrets.
Memories are only one point of view on what actually happened.

name: Reed In The Wind
overview: be unaffected by a superpowered attack by acting as though one has no need to defend oneself
description: There is a short story about trees and reeds in a storm and the tree is knocked over because it won't bend to the might of the storm but the reeds are absolutely fine because they bent when they needed to. The user (a reed) of this power applies the lesson taught by the reeds in the story to superpowered attacks(storms). Basically the user has to act as if there is no need to defend in mind and body causing the attack to go through them without causing any harm.
pros: Can be used against any attack caused with a superpower.
Good example of this is in the manga Shaman King.
cons: Won't help with getting past defensive powers.
Can't remember if it was willows or reeds in the story. Please change name and text if I'm wrong.
Really hard to act as if there is no need to defend.

name: Tale Manipulation
overview: manipulate stories, fiction, and mediums
description: At first, you can manipulate a single 'instance' of a story, such as changing the way a book goes for a single copy of that book; turning that copy into an adaption (movie, videogame, anything) of that book; or changing the way one person perceives that story. Also, you can 'create' stories- you just need to think of a few details, then you can will a copy in whatever medium to appear. At higher levels, you could change it worldwide without anyone noticing, or auto-publish your stories.
pros: Want to use a TV-based power on a comic? No problem! Turn a copy of that comic into a set of DVDs
Works for any medium and any type of story. The adaptions are faithful and entertaining.
Using this power to create stories makes them the highest quality possible with the details you give
cons: While this power is great for entertainment and making money, it is worthless in combat on its own
Can't automatically publish works, make worldwide changes, or guarantee people love them at first

name: Successor Of The Dragon
overview: serve as an avatar for a cosmic dragon.
description: When this ability is active, you acquire superhuman abilities, such as enhanced strength, endurance, energy projection, speed of light, and flight. You are able to undergo a state rendering you invulnerable to all incoming damage; you metamorphose into a human/dragon hybrid with razor sharp claws that can distort space.
pros: A fearsome warrior who can easily strike fear into people with a single gaze.
Use your "thousand claw method" to annihilate armies of enemies.
cons: Intense "dragon beams" could wipe out innocent bystanders.

name: Magma Kinesis
overview: create and control magma
description: A person with this power has the ability to create and control magma. The user does not have a magma body. In addition they are immune to the heat and effects of their own magma. Using magma they can burn things and if they let it cool it can also petrify things. The user with practice can even create magma constructs and force the magma to cool faster to form mineral constructs.
pros: Burn things
Petrify things
You are immune to the heat
cons: Might destroy the things you want to petrify---ie heat damage
Only you are immune to the heat and damage so you might leave a trail of collateral damage

name: Wave Control
overview: have complete control over all waves, from water waves to brainwaves and every other ones.
description: The power to control and manipulate all waves in the universe. You can control a person's brainwaves. Send sound waves back or even negate them. Control heat waves and bend them to your whim. All things that are waves are yours to control in any way you see fit.
pros: The power to manipulate forces to your will
The power to control energy and electromagnetic waves
The power to manipulate the waves on the sea
cons: Is not an automatic ability and requires one to be awake.

name: Hydro Monster
overview: create monsters made of water
description: With this power, you can create monsters out of water. You can also create a monster around you and control it. Being able to control the monsters, you can turn them into ice. You can also breathe under water. You can use anything that has water. A juice monster would be kind of funny
pros: You do not need to use the water around you
You can turn the water into ice
cons: The ice can shatter

name: Super Edge
overview: cut through anything.
description: With a blade, you can cut through the toughest of armors as though it was butter.
pros: Can cut through pretty much anything
cons: Must have a blade in hand
You'll be feared even if you only have a cutlery or a pocket knife

name: Energy Teleportation
overview: teleport energy to different location.
description: The user will be able to teleport any energy from one point to another. Able to teleport their energy attack directly at the target without them knowing. The can teleport the energy they or others have like kinetic, heat, bio, etc. Even energy beings can be teleported away from or at the the user.
pros: Make instant energy attacks
Safety from energy attacks.
Get more energy for yourself.
cons: Beware of taking your own energy away.

name: Exp Collector
overview: gain experience points and level up from simple (or complicated) daily activities
description: You play your life like a video game and earn Exp from everything that you do. When you reach a certain amount of Exp for an activity, you level up and have a chance to get an ability related to that activity. There is a higher chance to both get an ability and get a more useful ability the higher your level is. (Other powers can make you lose your skills but not permanently).
pros: You can't lose Exp permanently. (once you are able to do something you can always do it)
Can gain superhuman abilities at high levels.
Can train (gain Exp) in as many activities that you can imagine / do.
cons: You are terrible at anything new you try until you train.
Takes a while to be able to get useful abilities to make this power worth it.
You can become bored with no competition after training so much in something you like.

name: Summon Perfect Contract
overview: summon a contract for any situation.
description: With this power you can summon a contract for any situation that will not have any loopholes unless you want them to exist. The contract will cover all possible outcomes, even those that you could not think of yourself, to ensure that you get exactly what you want when the contract is signed. When a person signs the contract they must follow the contract exactly and will forced to obey the contract through multiple means. The contract can not be changed at a later date.
pros: The contract automatically covers any loopholes the person signing could use.
The contract is perfect and automatically has sections for every possible outcome.
Once signed the contract must be obeyed by the signer.
cons: The contract can not be changed at a later date.
The contract could possible affect you as well depending on the deal.
Must get person to understand and sign the contract out of free will (no telepathy etc.)

name: Chaos Absorption
overview: gain power from destruction
description: While chaos control allows you to give others bad luck, chaos absorption allows you to gain strength through the aggression and rage of others, whether they attack you or whether they attack other people.  War, greed, and sickness are your power source, allowing you to do whatever you want!
pros: Tempt others
Can become nigh invincible
Unlimited power supply
cons: Peaceful resistance will weaken you
Will turn you into the bad guy

name: Power Sharing
overview: share the powers possessed by your group between every member.
description: Every time you accept someone as a fellow member, any power they possess, except for this very power, is added to the group's collective powers and is now possessed by every one of its members until they die or leave the group. In other words, every member of a group share the same powers. You can belong to more than one group. In that case, you have access to all the powers of your fellow members, but your fellow members only have access to the collective powers of the group they belong to.
pros: You have the potential to form the most powerful team of superhumans.
Give powers to someone who doesn't have any and give a useful power to someone who has a crappy one.
You can belong to more than one group and become even more powerful than your fellow members.
cons: A passive power remains passive until the original owner of the power has a better control over it.
The power 'Power Sharing' and any similar power cannot be shared.

name: Natural Ability Balancer
overview: balance between strength, speed, and smarts
description: Imagine that everyone on the planet has 30 points devoted to their natural abilities: strength, speed, and smarts. 10 being the average for each ability. Well, with this power, you can add and subtract points to and from each ability. This can be done on a whim. Anything is possible if you balance perfectly for the situation. The only catches are that you can't add any points to the total of 30, and you can't do anything completely superhuman. So no light speed or telepathic stuff.
pros: Become immediately suited for any challenge
Illiteration ROCKS!
Imagine a scrawny nerd turning into a giant ogre and crushing your head. Yeah. Suck it.
cons: Cannot add points to the total
Balancing to far in one direction leaves you open to certain attacks
Nothing Completely Superhuman

name: Virus Mimicry
overview: hi-jack materialization powers to duplicate yourself.
description: A Virus Mimic can reprogram someone else's power to create something, giving them the power to create an identical copy of the Virus Mimic themselves. Their new power is also reprogrammed to always be active, forcing them to create a copy whenever possible. Materialization powers are any power that allows the user to create something physical by bypassing laws of conservation. They don't include summoning powers, as they involve calling/teleporting already-existing things.
pros: Duplicate yourself by using other people's power to create something.
Duplication and self-duplication powers are included in the materialization powers.
Some transformation powers are included if they imply creation of new material to increase the mass.
cons: This power is NOT a duplication power as the user doesn't create anything with it.
Transformation powers that respect the laws of conservation cannot be reprogrammed.
Powers that only create mental objects or intangible energy (light, heat, force) are immune to it.

name: Destructive Force Blast
overview: create an explosive destructive force blast around you
description: You'll have the power of an A or H bomb. Fueled by emotion & adrenaline, you can create an explosive destructive force blast around your area without any harm to you.
pros: Have the power of a nuclear bomb
Harmless to you
cons: You'll be a WMD
Hard to control
Powered by your emotions & adrenaline

name: Form Shifting
overview: break yourself into pieces and scatter
description:
Able to break yourself into anything you want, as long as it's a smaller thing than yourself (eg: a thousand butterflies, leaves, knives, dust... whatever)
Different from shapeshifting, because you shatter when you use it. It has a rule, though. When your small forms scatter, there is one form that is the original you. When the original you is destroyed, the rest of your scattered forms disappear and you die.
pros: This ability is very elegant (when you scatter to a flock of doves, for example)
Amaze everyone and make them think you do magic
You can evade lots of attack
cons: Can't beat forcefields or anything that can contain you
Can't phase, you're still a breakable matter
When you (as a particular form) are damaged, you get damaged as well

name: Aura Attune: Fire
overview: attune your aura with the element of Fire.
description: With this power, you may attune your aura with Fire. While active, all mystical and spiritual abilities related to fire or heat are greatly empowered, but all water related ones are weakened. You also become more resistant to Fire powers, but weaker to Water-related powers. This power also makes your aura like that of a powerful Fire Elemental, causing fire-aligned beings to treat you with respect. Water-aligned beings, however, fear or hate you. Luckily, this power can be turned on and off.
pros: Empower your spiritual or magical fire powers.
Have fire-aligned creatures treat you with respect or friendliness.
Become more resistant to harmful fire powers.
cons: Weakens magical and spiritual water powers.
Water-aligned creatures hate or fear you.
Weaker to harmful water powers.

name: Soul Warrior
overview: collect the souls of the dead and use them as weapons and the like.
description: Collect souls that have recently become souls and use them as any weapon, armor, shield, or skill that your imagination can come up with. You also obtain 3 forms. The first being an aura that flares when contact is made with others. The second, you obtain the skill called soul tempest. The third, you now have the Blade Of Oblivion which may be used once per fight.
pros: The more souls, the more powerful you become.
The more souls, the more effective your weapons, shield, armor, etc.
The more souls, the more powerful your forms become as well.
cons: The less souls, the weaker you are.
If your imagination is weak, so are your weapons, shields, armor, skills, and forms.
After the first slash with the Blade Of Oblivion it dissapears until you are in a deadly situation.

name: The Dragon Creator
overview: create dragon out of anything
description: This ability is that the user can create dragons out of anything the harder the materiel the tougher the dragon. The dragons gain abilities on what they are made of like a rock dragon gains geokinesis or a sapphire dragon can create sapphires
pros: Dragons!!
Get rich quick
Everyone wants one
cons: Can't control it
Only one ability per dragon
Dont make the dragons too big!

name: Irresistible Love
overview: make anyone or anything love you.
description: It's a good thing to have anything and anyone love you, but things, like a side effect that makes it permanent, could make it worse. There'll always be someone out there you can make fall for you, but the fact that it's not a true deserving love might guilt you. If you hate causing others pain, this isn't a power for you, because you could easily break someone's heart by gently telling them it's not real love. One great thing is that the person will love you without argument and normal problems.
pros: You can make the evil not want to hurt you
It can make you emotionally happier
Someone will always love you, even if you did something you regret
cons: Sometimes permanent
If you have an alternate normal identity, they'll only fall in love with the super version of you
It could end up like how you love your friends, or the feeling in your heart of needing someone love

name: Matter Mimicry
overview: turn yourself into any state of matter.
description: With this power you can turn into a gas, liquid or solid. So, now you can turn in to a puddle of water and go into the girl's locker room!
pros: Go into the girls locker room as a puddle of orange crush
cons: Can only liquefy of turn yourself into a gas. Can't shapeshift.

name: Animal To Mythical Creature
overview: turn ordinary animals into mythical creatures
description: The animal being transformed can only be turned into a mythical creature that is similar to it in some way. Ex: wolves become Lycanthropes or Raiju, foxes become Nekomata, birds become Harpies, Rocs or Griffin, horses and rhinos become Unicorn, Kirin or Centaur, etc. The creature gains all the powers and intelligence of the mythical creature they have become.
pros: You can predict what animal will become which mythical creature(s).
cons: You can't cause an animal to transform into something completely different.
The mythical creatures might not want to listen to you.

name: Purifying Blood
overview: purify anything by touching it with one's blood
description: Your blood can purify whatever it touches whether it is a demon, fallen angel, weapons, etc. It will purify both physically and spiritually.
pros: Churches would love to have you join for purification rites.
Always have clean water.
cons: Churches could reject you and call you blasphemous.

name: Fear Powered
overview: gain power from others when they are scared
description: This power is a variant from pain powered. The up side to this is no one has to feel pain. They just have to be scared. You can gain untold amounts of power from just the slightest hint of fear. Since most of your enemies will be fearless it might be wise to get someone who is scared to come with you. Gain Olympic strength and speed. You never get tired, heal any injury and even come back from the dead. You can gain power empathy with enough terrified victims. You even gain precognitive vision.
pros: With one scared victim you gain untold power
Faster and stronger
Seeing things way before they happen and knowing when and where they happen
cons: Someone always has to be scared
Hearing screaming all the time is really annoying
"Are you afriad? "

name: Invidia
overview: copy another's powers or abilities to a certain degree
description: This is a power that allows the user to imitate another person's powers or abilities. The powers copied however are at a lesser degree to the the original. For example, if copying a fire user's power, one may not be able to use it as effectively as the original person copied from. However, the user may be able to use the power more effectively if their envy takes over. The more envious of the original the more powerful it becomes. The power is timed however and the effect won't last forever.
pros: Can copy any power or ability no matter what it is
Gets stronger as one's envy of the original increases
cons: Is only temporary and the copied power will wear out eventually
Usually always inferior to the original
Can't copy more than one power at a time due to the strain put on the user

name: Techno Teleport
overview: transport yourself through electronics
description: When you are a "Technoport", you will be able to instantly teleport between electronics. Anything that is considered technology, you can teleport to. And anything you hold with you can also be brought through the teleporting process. But you can only teleport to a technology in a 1 mile radius.
pros: Fighting someone in an electronics store
Be the best shoplifter
cons: Only a 1 mile radius
No technology, no teleport

name: Ultimate Vacation
overview: be extremely lucky to receive an all-expenses paid vacation.
description: This power gives you the luck to get an all-expenses paid vacation to any destination you wish. Vacation lasts aas long as you want.
pros: Free vacation
Anywhere you want
As long as you want
cons: None

name: Sk: Transferal Telekinesis
overview: indirectly vampirize and tranfser potential energy in order to move another thing.
description: This is the rise of the "Shadow Kinetic" series. The user ,like the original ability, will secretly steal the potiential energy of solid objects or living things. Then they transfer it to another stationary solid object or living thing. Then that thing can be temporarily controlled as if the user had telekinesis. In short, they steal potiential energy adds it another object so that the user can control the object.
pros: Steal potiential energy from anything solid(very effective on living things that are about to move)
Make anything levitate
cons: Control over a thing only last for a short time.
The solid things must not move in order to steal potiential energy.

name: Spirit Manifestation
overview: bring forth your spiritual embodiment.
description: This ability grants the user control over their soul to bring forth their spiritual self as if it was their clone. Everything you can't do, your spiritual self can. And with proper training, the user will become able to create more, at least 2 clones, 3 max.
pros: Can create spirit clones of yourself. (Maximum limit is 3. )
Everything you can't do, your spirit can, such as fighting, cleaning, cooking, etc.
You'll never get beat up. (lol. )
cons: You have to train yourself to create more clones and to give them your features and qualities.
(Some may think of this as bad. ) You'll hardly ever have to do anything.
If your spirit self gets killed, then so do you because it's a copy of your soul. So your soul dies.

name: Power Mall
overview: buy powers on this website
description: Go to this website, explore the superpowers then click on one, look at what percent like the power and put that many currency into the screen (80% is 80 dollars). The money will melt into the screen, and you now have that power, both on this site and IRL!
pros: You get superpowers
cons: It cost money.

name: Minion Army
overview: control an army of minions to do your bidding and transfer your mind into one of them if you die
description: You can hypnotize/brainwash people and make them your servants. They are completely devoted to you and are willing to die to protect you or to do your bidding. You can completely take over a person or more, and use them as a puppet, though you might lose focus if you control too many at the same time. If you do die, you can transfer your mind and power to someone else's body, but do it quickly or you'll completely die and lose all your army. Either way, you do lose some control over your people.
pros: Endless supply of controlled people
You are their master overlord
Can take over one or more of them and permanently control one if you die
cons: Complete control takes focus and controlling too many is hard
If you die, you lose some of your subjects

name: 7 Swords
overview: summon seven swords, that each has its own unique power
description: The person with this power is able to summon 7 different swords that each has a special property. The first sword is the fire sword , the second sword is the lightning sword, the third sword is the adamant sword, the fourth sword is the sword of invisibility, the fifth sword is the sword of speed, the six sword a sword that can change its length and finally the seventh sword is a sword that can open portals.
pros: Different swords to combat different situations
Swords are mystical and cannot be destroyed by conventional means
cons: Some swords are still made up of metal and although mystical, magnetism users can still disarm them
The user of the swords have to train for years to master them

name: Revenge
overview: change pain and physical damages into muscle mass.
description: Whenever you get hurt, you can convert the pain/damage into muscle mass. Therefore, if you have been damaged really badly or have been tortured you can become extremely big and strong!
pros: Revenge is yours!
Don't ever be afraid of thugs, if they attack and harm you, pay it back to them double time!
You can easily win a body builder contest, just by slapping yourself before start!
cons: The power isn't permanent.
Pain will make you stronger, too much pain will kill you!
Muscles aren't everything, good to have some brains too!

name: Creature Call
overview: summon mystical creatures to do your bidding.
description:
This ability you can summon powerful creatures to take down your enemies, take you long distances in short times and anything else wanted done.
The creatures can possess varying powers from creature to creature. Creatures from summoning go from a Minotaur, Medusa, Dragon to even a tiny little Imp.
pros: Can summon any mythological creature from choosing.
Can dismiss creature any time to back wherever they came from.
cons: Summoned creatures can lose or die in a battle.
Do not possess a direct power to oneself.

name: Many Arms
overview: grow different kinds of arms and hands.
description: With this power the user can grow up to 6 additional arms of any kind. This includes things like normal human arms, arms made of stone or fire, pincers, robot arms, animal claws, skeletal arms, and tentacles. When you are done with them, they slide back into your bod and vanish.
pros: Have up to 6 extra arms of any kind.
Do many things at once.
Grow arms to fit any situation.
cons: You should be shirtless when you use this power if you don't want to ruin your shirt.
You will look grotesque with 6 extra shoulder blades.

name: Speed Reading (Speedreading)
overview: read at superhuman speeds
description: One with this ability has a sort of superspeed ability that is limited to one's reading and comprehension of words on a page. In essence, the user can read written or typed material at an incredibly fast pace, and retain the entirety of the information for as long as he would remember information read at a NORMAL pace. The user could read an entire manual within seconds, and a whole book in mere minutes.
pros: No more wasted hours reading boring books and manuals; still boring, just take less time
Word searches are a breeze
The enhanced reading speed may result in enhancement of one's VISION in general
cons: Doesn't NECESSARILY result in (or result from) superhuman sight
Doesn't help your comprehension of words you don't know
Doesn't make reading any more interesting, aside from getting done with it faster

name: Water Jets
overview: shoot out high pressurized water from your pores
description: A person with this power does not have hydrokinesis, instead they have the ability to shoot water from their pores like a water gun. However, not just any water gun-you can control the pressure of the water shot by your pores from being a simple water gun to the point that it can shatter stone and kill people. The user can fire water out indefinitely. In addition the user can use the jets as a means of propulsion if mastered, though you will likely hit bystanders on the ground-try jumps instead.
pros: You can shoot the water out of any of your pores and from your retina as well.
You can control the pressure from being a water gun to being able to shatter stone and kill
You can "fly" with this ability, except it is very easy to hit bystanders and kill them
cons: This doesn't come with hydrokinesis, so it's only a shot of water (albeit strong)
It conducts electricity so-just a warning
You might accidentally flood the town while trying to save it (very likely for beginners)

name: Forced Sight
overview: force others to see the spirits of those that they have killed
description: You can force other people to see the spirits of those that they have killed. The person can also feel anything that the spirits do to them, but they cannot do anything to the spirits themselves. You can also see and communicate with spirits who really want you to help them get revenge on the one who killed them.
pros: Hurt other people with this power by using the spirits of those they killed.
Can possibly always have someone to talk to.
cons: If the other person hasn't killed anyone.
Can only communicate with spirits who really want your help.

name: Phagomorphosis
overview: gain biological attributes from what you eat.
description: You are what you eat. Actually what you eat becomes part of you. Want gills? Just eat some fish and now you can grow yourself gills. How about something like spitting poison? Then just eat a cobra and it can be done. You eat it and you can grow or have any of its biological attributes, and eating it won't ever kill you. It won't work for plants, and if you vomit you lose all those extra acquired attributes. Thanks to cannibalism you can even regrow limbs--they're still lost from vomiting.
pros: Just eat an animal and you can have any attribute it has.
You can't die from eating any animal (even a poison dart frog)
You can heal yourself thanks to cannabalism
cons: Only works by eating meat (useless if you're vegan or vegetarian)
You vomit then you lose all the extra parts you acquired
Once you decide to grow a part you cannot simply just "ungrow" it.

name: Summon Intangibles
overview: create spirits, ghosts, ghouls, wraiths, and intangibles for many uses.
description: This power lets you make orange, green, purple, or white spirits. They can vary in apperance from cute chibi ghosts to menacing spirits. They can have a variety of abilities from consuming negative emotion to haunting people. You can make a large number at a time and they can change in size and shape.
pros: Summoning intangible beings
They have abilities.
cons: Can still be defeated.
They have a free will (although they will listen to you)

name: Freezing Fire
overview: shoot fire that turns into ice.
description: This gives you the ability to shoot fire that freezes on contact. It is useless against some abilities.
pros: Works underwater.
You can burn then freeze opponents.
cons: Is useless against magic.
Cannot work against people with the abilities of pyrokinesis and cryokinesis

name: Piezoelectric Crystal Form
overview: become an electrified crystal elemental.
description: You are a walking electrified crystal being with the strengths and weaknesses of crystalline material and the ability to stun or kill someone with your touch. Your body without a source of electricity to recharge with has enough energy for 300 stun touches. A kill touch uses up 3 stun touches. You could function as a defibrillator and save the life of someone who's having a heart attack.
pros: You can choose stun setting if a bad guy really doesn't need to die.
Or kill setting if he's a cutthroat, then fry him as if you were the electric chair.
Electricity doesn't harm you.
cons: Someone who controls electricity or is immune to it.
A long drawn out fight in the great outdoors.
This power requires touch-unless you have some way to conduct your electrical charge.

name: Master Oh Disaster
overview: control your favorite type of animal through some spiritual connection.
description: Let's say your favorite animal was a bat. Imagine controlling hordes of them to create terror, steal valuable objects, and many others. This power will work with whatever animal is your favorite animal, it is some sort of spiritual connection mixed with a specific type of telepathy. Yes, no voice commands; you think it, they do it.
pros: The unconscious mind can use the animal to defend you, hence sleeping is fine.
Training is unnecessary.
Can be a good or bad guy power.
cons: No powers when your animals are very far away.
If your favorite animal is something like a firefly, your power is somewhat limited.
Humans are immune to control, even though they are animals, because of a more powerful brain.

name: Searchlight Eyes
overview: see through things, to look for something from very far, far, far away, and to see invisible things.
description: If you have this kind of power it means you never have to move to find anything because you can just use your powers to see where what you're looking for is and to see if it is inside your stuff. When you're robbing stuff, you don't have to worry about things you can't see because of your power.
pros: Easy to look out for invisible fighters, warriors, or cops
You can see what's far, far, far away and can see if something or somebody is looking for you
You can hide while looking where somebody is going at the same time
cons: Well that's all you can do... that's it.
After five hours from using it, you'll get a major headache.

name: Identity Switch
overview: switch your identity, body and mind with someone else
description: One can just switch his identity with anyone else by knocking into that person. Their souls will switch. The switcher will get his powers (if he has any), knowledge and skills he possessed, as well as those he originally had. However, the victim will not remember anything and will automatically think that he is the switcher himself, but he will not be able to switch identity as the real switcher is already in his body.
pros: Can understand or learn something easily from another person
Can get the taste of others' powers
Can use others' identities to complete tasks
cons: If you lost your original body, you will not be able to switch your identity back.

name: Stunt Double
overview: replicate yourself when in inevitable death's way
description: It's like Hugh Jackman's character in The Prestige. The machine replicated him, and as one drowned the other was teleported at a safe distance. That's this power; whenever in deadly harm's way, you automatically make & teleport a duplicate to a safe area. But the original must die. Once dead, they vanish into atoms & their engery transfers into the duplicate. Also, you still age normally & are subject to illness.
pros: Auto make a duplicate of yourself when in peril
Duplicate will be exactly like you with all memories up to point of death of original
Any illness or injuries that inflict the original will not transfer to copy. A new, healthy you.
cons: Original must die. After death, they vanish.
Still age normally, so when down to old age, natural cause will most likely make you vanish.

name: Heat Shock
overview: turn heat into electricity
description: With this ability, you can create powerful electrical blasts on a sweltering hot day. You are immune to heat with this power. Say if someone lit you on fire, you'd absorb all those flames and channel it into killer electrical shocks at your foe. A master could walk into lava and turn all that heat into electrical attacks. This power is fueled by heat, so one would be at a disadvantage in the extreme cold.
pros: Never get burned again!
Power up your cellphone just by putting on hand on the stove and the other on your phone.
cons: Powerless if in extreme cold.
Not immune to acid or lightning.
Can be a bit draining.

name: Railroad Track Generation
overview: shoot steel railway tracks out of your long sleeves.
description: This power can only be activated if you are wearing long sleeves and holding your arms parallel to each other and directed toward the ground. When activated, you will generate any length of rails you want. As soon as they are shot out of your sleeves, the rails will slither along the ground to create a railroad. When you're done, the tracks will attach themselves to the ground and there you are, a brand-new railway track!
pros: If you are a Train Mimic.
If you have train-related powers.
You can generate steel in the form of rails.
cons: You can't generate bridges to cross over chasms.
You can't generate trains to use the railroad.
You must be wearing long sleeves.
tags: was edited as it was just a unimaginative combination of two unrelated powers

name: Temporal Spike
overview: generate spikes of temporal energy to affect one's surroundings
description: One with this ability is a dangerous foe; this power allows the user to generate shards of tangible time, and fire them at foes for various effects. They may inflict wounds that don't heal, stop the foe in time, speed him up, slow him down, or reverse him in time. The shards could even age the foe, de-age him or blink him from the space-time continuum. The user can only control the effect as he gains more control over the power.
pros: Release painful shards or spikes of solid temporal energy, which even affects non-living matter
Inflict wounds that don't heal, or produce numerous other time-based effects
Not many people in the world are time-defiant
cons: Time Defiance can be used to resist this power
Cannot be used to travel through time, and cannot effect others with this ability
Can inflict wounds on the user if he is stabbed with his own spikes/shards (but they heal)

name: Historical Help
overview: call on people from history to help you
description: This power allows you to summon historical figures and groups to help you. You can call on people like Attila the Hun, George Washington, Napoleon, and their soldiers to fight your foes. But you aren't limited to summoning an army. The people you summon can also teach you. Learn magic from Houdini or strategy from Alexander the Great. Be taught by ninjas, knights, Roman legionaries, and more to master combat, stealth, survival, and countless other skills.
pros: Summon a small army to overwhelm opponents
Receive training from history's best
Get answers to history's mysteries
cons: Ancient weapons not always a match for modern ones
Might not be real effective against some super-powered opponents
Have to know your history

name: Dead Power
overview: use any power that a dead superhero had
description: With this power you can use the power of any currently dead superhero such as Elongated Man, Superman-2, Abin Sur, Al Pratt (Golden Age Atom) etc.
pros: You can have a vast array of super powers
cons: Once the character comes back to life his or her powers are no longer available to you to

name: Organic Metal Muscles
overview: permanently possess organic titanium muscles
description: Every muscle in your body is organic metal muscles, with hardness, flexibility and weight similar to titanium. You can still move as normal, but are now far heavier. Your bones are also just tough enough to be able to cope with the extra stress. Your strength has increased accordingly. Your muscles secrete far less of their equivalent of lactic acid, so your stamina is increased. As your legs are super-strong, you also have slight superhuman speed.
pros: Most of your body is now basically indestructible
You are now stronger, tougher, faster and have greater stamina
Your abs are now actually rock-hard
cons: You are now far heavier, so you could easily break things with your weight, e.g. chairs
Your bones aren't as indestructible; you could still be killed by a high-calibre bullet to the head
You have to get used to your new strength and weight, which could be dangerous

name: Hide In Anything
overview: hide inside anything regardless of volume capacity or living/non-living status
description: A person with this power can hide in anything. This is not an overstatement. You can hide in anything be it a tiny spec of dust or something that doesnt even have volume to hide in. In addition you can "see" when you are hiding so you can tell where you are and where you are going. However you take the damage that the object/person you are hiding in would have received when hit so you can be defeated even when hiding unless you hide in something unbreakable by the people after you.
pros: They don't notice when you slip in
Always win hide and seek
The volume does not matter
cons: Can only be used to hide
You take the damage of the object/person you hid in
You still need to do things like eat and go to the bathroom, you can sleep though

name: Superhero 2: Wolverine
overview: have the powers of the clawed berserker, Wolverine.
description: He's the best there is at what he does. Who is he? Wolverine! With his razor-sharp Adamantium claws, you can slash anything in your path. You also have his regenerative healing factor, and his heightened senses of smell and hearing.
pros: You have metal bones, which gives you metal claws.
You can regenerate any part of your body.
Ain't a good tracker? Say no more because you can smell anybody's scent.
cons: You'll lose control using your animal instincts.
At first, your hands will bleed once you sheath your claws.
Makes holes in your gloves.

name: Mental Solitude
overview: be unaffected by mind-affecting powers
description: Someone with this power will never be affected by other mind-affecting powers. The reason? No-one else can find or even touch their mind on the astral or mental planes. This results in the mind of the holder of this power being fully isolated in its own little world that it completely controls. The alterations to this world affect nothing on the outside world.
pros: Perfect for completely and totally uninterrupted meditation.
Impossible to be mind controlled.
Get a mental world all to yourself.
cons: Too bad this doesn't affect the physical body.
People can still yell into your ear to pull you out of meditation.
Your mind can't find other minds either, unless it is physically or electronically meeting them.

name: Cartoon Powers: Team Rocket
overview: be able to survive any fall from any height and be relatively unharmed
description: With this power you can fall from any height and survive with only a few minor scratches and bruises. This is useful if you need ever need to fake your death, or escape from pursuers and have to jump off of a cliff. Or if you're parachute doesn't open while sky diving. Of if you're frequently launched into the sky by a ten year old and his pet mouse.
pros: You can survive any fall from any height
cons: You still get some minor cuts and bruises

name: Blast Vision
overview: fire a massive red-violet energy projectile from your eyes.
description: You can fire a strong, red-violet, star-like projectile from your eyes at the opponent. The projectile will vibrate at such high speeds that it will make the projectile larger in size, increasing the damage it causes. The projectile explodes when it comes in contact with anyone.
pros: Not like any eye laser powers.
cons: Could have a minor headache while using it.

name: Avatar: The Swordmaster
overview: be the physical embodiment of swordfighting.
description: You embody the art of swordfighting itself. On attaining this state, you gain the skills, knowledge, and physical limits of any sword user that has existed or will exist in the universe. As such, you can defeat all opponents who face you with a sword. Against other foes, you are still a power to be reckoned with.   As a universal force, you do not age unless you give your power to a worthy successor, or are slain. You may appear wherever a sword battle occurs and fight for the side you favor.
pros: A limited form of immortality. You also get the physical limits of any other being that uses swords.
You may pass on your abilities to any other intelligent being of your choice.
You are the best swordfighter in the universe.
cons: On gaining this power, you are only allowed to fight with swords.
You hold the form you had when you gained this power and can still be crippled or killed.
If you die without passing on your power, it instead travels to the nearest intelligent being.

name: 100 Obsidian Shards
overview: create and fire off 100 shards of obsidian
description: Obsidian is one of the sharpest or the sharpest material on Earth known to mankind. It can hold a perfect-looking edge as small as a few nanometres. While using this power you can create shards of obsidian with edges of 1 nanometre in sets of 100 and fire them in any direction you choose.
pros: The shards will be around 1 metre long.
cons: It has to be in sets of 100 shards.
Obsidian is very brittle.

name: Subconscious Hemokenisis
overview: subconciously morph blood with the mind
description: A person with this power can subconciously control blood at a sub molecular level. This ability is good since normal Hemokenisis takes an awful lot of concentration. One unique ability of this is that, when the body is injured the midn will subconciously drain blood from nearby people and morph it into carbohydrates & proteins giving energy & repairing body cells in little inder 5 minutes. But this can have a bad side too. People with subconscious hemokenisis can't actually control it.
pros: One can pull of harder hemokinetic based moves at ease.
One has greater control over blood and even some control over water.
One can focus on one thing while his subconscious focuses on another
cons: One can't control it. One can only impose their will on it. One with a weak will will be overcome.
If one depends on it too much for regeneration, they will only be able to live by absorbing blood.
It feeds away at the blood like a leech slowly.

name: Turning
overview: turn enemies to your side.
description: You have the advantage of making foe into friend for 3 days. You can turn up to 100 foe at a time.
pros: You can make enemies kill their friends.
Having a spy comes in handy.
You have a ramie of enimies killing each other.
cons: You can only keep them friends for 3 days.
None.
None.

name: Self Infusion
overview: infuse part or all of one's very being into a person, item, etc.
description: This ability allows one to infuse one's self into other things. It makes them more cooperative with the user. They will become more like you... Personality-wise. No actual transformation. People will be more open to you, but they won't be under your control. You will have to persuade them, with which the ability helps. Items will obey since they are more like you.
pros: Make new friends and allies
Manipulate items
cons: Sentient being that you infuse, can become destructively obsessive with the user

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message8
overview: channel the Muses' command over the essence of knowledge, inspiration and art
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration. As such, channeling Thalia (Thaleia- Comedy, Rustic Poetry) allows one to psychically access knowledge of all comedic and rustic works, at will. In addition, one can psychically travel into any comedy story world, at will. One can also psychically summon objects and characters from comedy story worlds, at will. One can even psychically attune oneself to Cartoon Physics, at will.
pros: Psychically access knowledge of comedic and country/rustic/bucolic works, at will
Psychically travel into (and summon objects/characters from) comedic story worlds, at will
Psychically attune oneself to the absurdly-lenient laws of Cartoon Physics, at will
cons: Cannot psychically disrupt creativity (or negate ideas), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive subject's ideas until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift may cause bossy attitude toward the user (NCN)

name: Stacking
overview: safely stack anything on top of anything else.
description: With this power you can create perfectly stable stacks of anything, regardless of weight or shape differences. For example, you could stack a couple of cinder-blocks on top of a baby and, not only would you be able to climb it safely, the baby would be perfectly fine. Anything added to the stack will be able to support the weight of everything above it and the items will stick together as though magnetized.
pros: Make huge towers of random junk.
Carry literally everything you own on your back, or things you don't own.
Stack things on people to make moving around awkward and hard, or put them in a stack.
cons: The base of the stack can still be moved, and could up end the entire stack.
You can not attach things to the side of the stack and have them stick, the height must increase.
Someone can become the base part of a stack by getting underneath the bottom item in the stack.

name: Arceusforce: Meadow
overview: channel the power of Arceus's Grass form.
description: The user of this ability can channel the harmony of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Grass-type. The user's skin turns green and their irises turn yellow. Under their plant guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Grass-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Grass attacks such as Razor Leaf, Vine Whip, Leaf Storm, Solarbeam and more.
pros: The user is resistant to electrical, water, earth and other plant-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of plants for Grass attacks.
The user can feed through photosynthesis in this form.
cons: The user is weak to fire, wind, insect, poison and ice-based attacks.
The power might be too powerful for the user and may even need to unlock it from the default form.

name: Task Clones
overview: produce duplicates of yourself to perform specific tasks.
description: With this power, you can create clones specially designed to complete a specific task. For example, you could produce a clone to do work while you enjoy your leisure time. The clones will most enjoy whichever task you assigned them to do. They can be reabsorbed at will and if they die or are reabsorbed, you acquire all of their acquired knowledge, skills, memories, powers (if applicable), etc.
pros: Get a clone to do work more than willingly, while you relax.
The clones thoroughly enjoy whatever task you assign them to.
The clones can be used to acquire powers, knowledge and skills.
cons: Each must represent a different aspect or activity, limiting their numbers.
If the clones die, your clones acquire the experiences as well. If reabsorbed, only you do.
You do not command the clones..

name: Wound Change
overview: change one type of injury into another.
description: This power allows the user to change any injury into a different injury of the same severity. For example, a huge bleeding gash across someones leg could be changed into a broken leg, or a burn spread across the leg. You can also move the injury when you change it, like turning a bloody nose into a nasty bruise on someones arm. You can also change old injuries, such as scars and amputations, into something else so long as they are visible.
pros: Change injuries that you don'y know how to, or are difficult to, treat into simpler ones.
Broken leg? Bleeding badly? Change them and get moving.
If something gets choped off, just swap around which body part you're missing.
cons: It does nothing to diminish the pain, and in some cases may make it worse.
You can't save anyones life with this power alone.
If a wound was fatal before you changed it you'll only be able to change it to other fatal wounds.

name: Ankh Of Ascendance
overview: be granted magical and mystical powers by the mystical ankh of power
description: A person who is in possession of this mystical Ankh of Ascendance will be granted a myriad of magical and mythical abilities to be used. When combined with the scepter of knowledge, the user's power is doubled as well the user inheriting all the knowledge of all the scepter's previous users
pros: You are one of the most powerful magical users on Earth.
cons: If the Ankh is separated from the user, the user will gradually lose their power.
Certain mystical artifacts can block the user's connection to the Ankh's mystical energies

name: Heart Manipulation
overview: control the Heart, physically or metaphorically.
description: This power allows you to control another persons' heart. This means you can speed up/slow down their heart rate, make it stop, or even control where it pumps blood. It also applies to mental aspects which are associated with the heart, such as fear, courage, love, empathy and any other emotion that can be justified as being controlled by the heart.
pros: Stopping someones heart is easy to do, even from a distance.
Can be used to make an ally braver before going into battle.
You can control your own emotions and heart.
cons: This is NOT blood-bending, you can NOT control someones' body using this power.
Changing emotions is based entirely on the users willpower vs the affecteds' willpower.

name: Lightning Run
overview: run as fast as lightning, but for as long as a lightning strike
description: When activated, in a flash, you will run as fast as lightning, but, as said before, only for as long as a typical lightning strike lasts. The user feels like time has stopped.
pros: Run as fast as lightning.
cons: But only for as long as a lightning strike.

name: Virus Master
overview: create and program both biological and data viruses
description: You are the ultimate virus creator capable of creating and controlling any virus
pros: Infect other people and control their minds
Cure people by infecting them with a counter disease
Be the best hacker
cons: Evil tendencies
Does not work on people who have an immunity
Must infect people to have any power

name: Fisher King
overview: shape your environment according to your emotions and status
description: You uncontrollably shape your surrounding environment in a 3-mile radius according to your emotions. If you feel happy, there will be clear skies and warm weather. If you're upset, then there will be rain. If you're seriously ill, then buildings around you will slowly crumble, cracks will appear in the ground and rivers will become poisoned. Areas where you spend large amounts of regular time will slowly and permanently shift to reflect your personality.
pros: When you're in a good mood, everyone nearby gets sunny warm weather
If you learn how to control your emotions, you can control this to an extent
Can form an area that suits you perfectly
cons: People may get pissed at constant rain if you're an emo
No one wants devastating tornadoes and thunderstorms if you're in a murderous rage
Weather forecasts are pretty much useless for you

name: Sp: Healing Presence
overview: heal others in your presence, and be healed back by the amount healed to others.
description: 'SP' stands for 'Sharing Presence'. With this ability, you heal other people/creatures in your area. You are also healed by the amount healed with this ability. For example, if five people are in your area, they are healed, and you are healed for the total amount recovered by the five people. This ability can be turned off.
pros: Basically, you are healed for healing other people.
Can be turned off.
cons: Forgetting to turn it off in the wrong situations.

name: Lifeforce Drain
overview: suck the ability and life out of a person
description: We speak of someone like, "Oh, he/she just sucks the life out of me." It's not a joke anymore. A Lifeforce Drainer can absorb the vitality of a person just by touching them. This prolongs their lifespan, but kills the person. As if this were not enough, they also absorb the person's special ability (Flight, Superhuman Speed, etc.).
pros: Potentially live forever
Get some amazing superhuman powers
Kill swiftly and silently
cons: Kills the target
Must touch to drain
May lead to people organizing to take you down

name: Awesome
overview: be extremely awesome
description: You are incredibly awesome. This is a subconscious reality warping ability. Normally, probability is altered so things just go really great for you, though physics can also be distorted so things like action-movie cliches are possible. Your intelligence is enhanced, and you can gain general knowledge or a rare specific detail (disguised as a hidden moment of inspiration) for fighting and any skills (such as musical instruments or games), and one-liners. You will be in peak physical condition.
pros: Never need to buy weapons, sunglasses, or cool-looking clothes
You can live like an action movie star, or just be awesome at anything
cons: Sound like you're really stuck up describing your power ("My power is that I am amazingly awesome...
... No, like, its actually a power.  ")
Not extremely powerful

name: Life Touch
overview: , when you touch someone, live their life in a split second.
description: The ability to, when you touch someone, live their entire life in a split second. But, while living their, life you are able to alter their thoughts, changing somewhat part of their life.
pros: Learn new things
Somewhat be able to change their life.
cons: To many lives.

name: Human Sword
overview: produce swords and other blades from ordinary materials or your own body
description: The user of this power can turn any part of his body into a sword-like object, in addition to turning other objects--like a ceramic vase--into sword-like objects.  The swords can be broken, however, which leads so cuts, bruises, or even broken bones in the swordified extremity. Fortunately, you can also repair and maintain swords of all kinds.
pros: Aid other heroes by turning yourself into an adaptable blade
Easy and fast way to produce weaponry
Turn yourself into a sword to hide
cons: Does not ensure sword skill.
Turning into a complete sword renders all your clothes torn and useless

name: Physical Karmic Increase
overview: gain power, strength, stamina and endurance based on positive actions
description: One with this ability gains a physical boost from their positive actions. This includes strength, endurance, stamina, and it also powers your other superpowers (if you have any). The effects of this ability are unlimited, so if you're a complete saint, this ability would probably make you unstoppable. However, a negative action causes you to lose some of your karmic bonus.
pros: Gain a physical boost from all of your positive deeds.
If you're a complete saint, it could potentially make you unstoppable.
Negative actions only weaken your bonus, and not your overall physical ability.
cons: Negative actions still weaken your karmic bonus.
If you're always doing negative things, you may never experience the effect of this ability.
Does not increase your luck.

name: Prop Realism
overview: make props for a movie that actually work.
description: Say you have to work on a Harry Potter movie. You can make wands for the characters that actually fire off spells. It doesn't just stop there though. Think of the possibilities. The Dagger from Prince of Persia; The Car from Back to the Future; The whole of Hogwarts! You can even make sets that are real, or, as long as the person in question agrees, you can make anyone crumble to dust, burn to ashes or age to a skeleton. There are no limits. Forget the sky: Your imagination is the true limit!
pros: Make anything you could possibly imagine.
You can recall anything that you don't like.
If you don't have good imagination, just copy from movies.
cons: Still causes, even if only a little, pain to the people you fake kill

name: Fate & Free Will
overview: accurately determine the consequence of all choices.
description: Fate is what will happen. Free Will is your choice. I believe both are connected. With this power, before you make a decision, you will accurately know the consequence of the chosen decision. It allows the user to wisely make the right choice.
pros: Know what will happen, depending on the choice you make.
Makes decision making a whole lot easier.
cons: There is a possibility that only a negative will result in either choice.
Only applies to the choices you will make. (Doesn't work with other people).

name: Sensual Focuser
overview: cause a person's senses to focus on one aspect
description: A person with this power can "hack" any person's senses causing them to only focus on one thing. For example you can cause it to only focus on pain so that anything that they sense will cause them pain and the pain felt will be magnified. You can also use this to focus on pleasure letting them be in a sense of ecstacy from just a simple touch. You can even make it do both at the same time---but that might drive them insane.
pros: Increases enemies sensitivity so that they feel more pain when hit
Increase their sense of pleasure so they want to get hit
Can also work on things that aren't the regular 5 senses
cons: Can't think of any morally righteous uses of this power

name: Botanist
overview: create special plants using only sunlight.
description: With this power you become a master Botanist, gaining the power to create sentient plants out of sunlight. You can naturally store sunlight within your body but can not use it for anything else except creating plants. Once you have collected enough sunlight you just point at a substance that the plant you are thinking of can grow in and it will appear. Each sentient plant can have special characteristics such as being able to shoot freezing seeds or explode.
pros: The plants are sentient and will defend you and obey your commands.
Can grow Sunflowers which have the ability to produce extra sunlight to use.
Plants are extra effective against the undead.
cons: Need to have sunlight or this power is useless.
Stronger plants require larger amounts of sunlight.
Nearly all of the plants are fixed to the spot that you summon them.

name: Negate
overview: neutralize any superpowers
description: You're surrounded by an invisible force that causes the powers of others to disappear as long as they're near you. With enough concentration, you can materialize this invisible force and use it as a dagger. Any superpowered beings who are wounded by this dagger will permanently lose their powers. Any ordinary people wounded by the materialized neutralizing force will bleed non-stop.
pros: Secured while surrounded by supernatural beings
Disables your enemy's superpowers
cons: You might wound yourself

name: Gamer's Touch
overview: bring your favorite characters to life or use their powers for yourself
description: The ability to bring any gaming character to your side whether it be for good or bad. The way to summon them is to focus on that specific person or thing and it shall appear before you. You can also determine how tall or small you want them to be. And as an added bonus, once you begin to perfect your powers, you will be able to obtain a chosen character's power.
pros: Your favorite hero or villian is by your side to defend you
You won't be lonely
If you pick the right person you will be unstoppable! Like DeadPool!!!!
cons: If that character doesn't agree to help you then you have a big problem on your hands.

name: Solar Projection
overview: control and make stars.
description: With this power one can control the stars they make and also release coronal mass ejections (C.M.E's), solar flare, super novas etc. And a master would also be given slight control over gravity. For the best use of the power one would have to fight alone. If these powers are not released the user would get body trembles and eventually  emit a devastatingly massive C.M.E that could kill everybody within a 15 mile radius.
pros: Personal heat source
Unlimited power supply
cons: Must use powers constantly.
Must fight alone all the time for best results

name: Piezoelectric Crystal Darts
overview: shoot a steady bursts of electrified darts from your hand.
description: These crystal darts not only do impaling damage but will also deliver electrical damage to a target or targets. The range is 300 feet. Darts that fail to hit a target will retain a charge. You can't be hurt by any damage this power does, so you have invulnerability to electricity, impaling and crystal-based damage.
pros: A rapid-fire burst attack with decent range.
Impaling and electrical damage at the same time.
Three invulnerabilities.
cons: If you're a hero, you have to watch for out for civilians or teammates when you shoot.
Powers that render your attack meaningless somehow.
Teammates may matter if you're a villain.

name: Injury Absorbing
overview: absorb injuries.
description: This ability heals the owner and any others within range. The injuries are turned into enhanced strength, powers, speed, etc. Things like ageing are also absorbed. So, if an ageing person walks nearby, they rapidly age back to the prime of their lives. The owner does not need to eat, but only if they have stored injury and they weaken to a normal human if they do. This cannot be turned off and it only works on living people.
pros: Live forever.
Torture people.
Doctor by day, superhero by night!
cons: Can't permanently hurt enemies without killing them.
Can't be turned off.
Cannot resurrect the dead.

name: Tele Clone
overview: teleport while leaving a clone behind
description: When the user activates his teleporting abilities there will be a puff of smoke and it looks like they haven't left yet. However, the person that is left behind is actually a clone of the original. The clone is in all ways the same as the original and can only be told apart by superhuman intuition or omniscience. The clones can learn and can become independent after they recover from their creation. Killing the user does not kill the clones and vice versa. There can only be 99 clones at a time.
pros: Fake your death then plan for another ambush
Teleport many times in the same location to create a 100 strong army
The clones are undistinguishable by the common supersenses
cons: The clones all have the same condition as you so they will not be healed
You must kill the clones after you are done using them
This power does not come with the ability to telepathically talk to your clones

name: Death Restriction
overview: make yourself or others around you die by only one thing.
description: Used on others, this power would basically allow you to beat someone to death and they would still be alive thanks to your ability. Used on yourself, as long as you have this ability, no force can kill you or others around you. You will live the longest, and most natural life as you or other people can. You can change what could kill you or others.
pros: Longevity of life, and minor accelerated healing factor.
You can change what can kill you or others
Takes away mostly all possible death factors, but one
cons: Only one thing will kill you instantly.

name: Forced Drunkness
overview: instantly make someone drunk or sober
description: Able to make someone drunk instantly. This also can make someone sober as well.
pros: Makes foe sluggish
Can cause someone to get arrested for public intoxication
cons: Some people like to be drunk
Irish plus drunk equels better fighting and more anger

name: Injury Transplantation
overview: shift injuries and afflictions from another to yourself, and vice versa.
description: You transfer physical injuries and diseases from yourself to another person and/or back again. If someone is dying of multiple injuries, split the load among many people who can cope with minor pains. If an enemy stabs you in a fight, grab hold of them and transfer the wound to them. You have to be touching the person for it to work. Can be passed along a chain of touching people if need be. Symptoms are identical but smaller/weaker people may be actually harmed more than you by some injuries.
pros: Able to 'heal' yourself or others.
Everything you get hit with in a fight, they get hit with.
Practical everyday use if you run out of plasters.
cons: You must be touching or connected to the person via other people's nervous systems.
If you heal yourself, you harm others.
May unintentionally overload another weaker person and kill them.

name: Talisman
overview: have the twelve powers of the talismans from the animated series Jackie Chan
description: Remember that show "Jackie Chan the Animated Series?" It was on almost every Saturday. Well, this power will give you the power of each of the twelve talismans. If you end up using the tiger talisman power, you could have to chase yourself all over the planet. You can only use two talismans at once.
pros: Can do nearly anything
Have power that some people would call god power
cons: Can only use two powers simultaneously. One for each hand.
Tiger power could use up a lot of time.
Takes concentration to switch between powers.

name: Teleplosion
overview: explode and teleport at the same time
description: Teleplosion is a rapid increase in volume and release of energy in an extreme manner, and it also allows the transfer of matter from one point to another, more or less instantaneously. You can even transport yourself and others to a safe place and blow-up an enemy's hideout. It allows you to create an explosive wormhole to get away, but if your opponent is following you they won't bother doing it cause it blows up after you leave.
pros: You can transport yourself and others out to a safe distance and blow up a lot of enemies.
cons: You might not know what destruction you've caused after you explosively transported anywhere.

name: Human Battery
overview: create electrical currents
description: The wielder of this ability is able to psychically transfer a large body of electrons from one part of their body to another, thus creating a positive charge in one part and a negative charge in another. They could then create an electrical circuit by indirectly connecting the two charged points. For example, negatively charging the thumb, and positively charging the forefinger could allow the user to switch on an unconnected lightbulb by holding it.
pros: Power electric circuits
Use lightbulbs anywhere
Supply power for a long period of time.
cons: Not hugely powerful.
Could potentially shock the user.

name: Charge!
overview: store energy into your body and charge at speeds up to 300 mph
description: With this power, you can literally charge the enemy with a force that's not humanly possible. If you learn to only use so much stored energy, you can also start throwing kicks and punches or throw with superhuman speed, but that takes practice, experience and control.
pros: You can move at superhuman speeds
With training, you can do normal strikes at superhuman speeds by successfully distributing energy
You are basically unbeatable in a fist fight
cons: If you don't distribute your stored energy, you'll get tired really fast
If you charge into a hard surface, it'll hurt a lot
If you trip while charging into the enemy, it'll hurt a lot

name: Microconcussion Inducing Eyes
overview: instantly cause a microconcussion on the conscious parts of the brain through eye contact
description: A person with this power has the ability to emit a wave from their eyes that can travel like light and can be reflected off reflective surfaces. When seen, the target receives a selective microconcussion in their brain. The microconcussion can range from loss of motor functions to loss of superpowers to disabling of senses. All effects are temporary.
pros: Disable motor functions
Disable superpowers
Disable pain receptors etc.
cons: Does not work on subconscious-no killing with this power
Is only a microconcussion, not an instant knock out
Eye contact needs to be made

name: Ultima X Power: Portal
overview: create a rift to the japanese anime world of your choosing.
description: With the proper controlled use of Ultima-X forces, you're able to tear space time asunder and create dimensional gateways to any anime universe you wish. However, as with every great power, there are always catches, so be extremely careful. Equip yourself well, and have an awesome adventure!  This also applies to anime based games and other associated media.
pros: Enjoy adventuring in your own episode of any anime you choose with your favorite characters!
You become an anime version of your real self upon entering the portal.
Enjoy the comical physics of the aniverse! They all apply to you as needed.
cons: To open a new portal you must close the first, wait for 3 months, and a new moon.
Leaving portals open is BAD. To say the least, space time is fragile!
Portals are one way, and you cannot return until you've progessed the main story far enough.

name: Whistling The Wind
overview: call up wind via a noise.
description: Anyone who has this power may be able to conjure up a wind from the direction their facing by making a noise. Commonly this is done by whistling,but can also be done by clapping, singing, playing a musical instrument or even clicking your tongue. The more intense the noise, and the more intense the effort, the stronger the wind summoned.
pros: With practice, the user may even be able to cause winds to blow weather towards or away them.
Always have a cool breeze in summer.
Will always win in sailing competitions.
cons: The user can only summon the wind, not control it.
The user can't summon a southern wind if they're facing north.
If you're unable to make a noise, or are not outside.

name: Fetish Manipulation
overview: create,control, or change anything that has to do with your interests.
description: This ability allows the user to control what would be considered his fetish. For example, I like this symbol I made. With this ability I can be able to do stuff with fetish of mine. I could create this symbol out of thin air, make weapons that look like it and shoot energy blast in the shape of it. You can even warp reality to match your fetish and etc. If you have a fetish, this can make it into a power. If the Joker or Riddler had this ability, they would really dangerous.
