If your feet are facing two different directions a weaker gravity will take place between them. This offers a wide range of uses with barely any concentration, just a little bit of forethought. You will always land right side up, but its up to you to not die.
pros: Always land right side up
Deliver punishing kicks
If you do the splits you achieve anti-gravity
cons: Will probably be exiled to the countryside where you won't topple any buildings
Even walking causes a little wobble
Very Disorienting

name: Scapegoat Effect
overview: have other people take the damage you get
description: With this power, the person chooses another person to receive the damage they get. However, they must have a strand of that person's hair or some part with their DNA, like blood or sweat, in order to transfer the effect. You can even transfer death. If you pulled out your heart, the scapegoat's heart will fail while you are perfectly safe until the other person's body is cremated or destroyed completely.
pros: You can use other people as shields, or you can transfer the damage to the enemy
Attacking yourself hurts others while you receive no pain or injury
Killing yourself only transfers damage to others
cons: Does not protect against age or indirect effects, such as shrinking
Must need the person's DNA to work-not really that hard, unless you're up against a masked person

name: Lion's Roar
overview: release soundwaves around you with your vocal cords at super high volume.
description: The origin of the name "Lion's Roar" comes from a Chinese idiom which translates in the English language as "the lion east of the river", but it is a roar-like yell powerful enough to shatter wood and glass, tear the plaster off walls, and lift anyone off the ground like ragdolls. An innocuous side effect of your training is your ability to raise your voice loud enough to overpower a group of a hundred or so people speaking loudly in unison.
pros: You can stun the opponent, giving you a free hit.
cons: Using it too much can give you a sore thorat.
You'll lose your voice.

name: Surgical Blade
overview: create scalpels made out of energy.
description: This power allows you to create surgical scalpels out of energy from your body that have the ability to cut or separate objects from the inside. The surgical blade can pass through any object, cutting it from the inside. The blade can also separate two objects without damaging either object. A second personality or types of mental control can be separated out of a body. The blade can even touch the intangible. Masters can even separate certain powers out of a super-powered person.
pros: Cut objects from the inside.
Separate objects without hurting them.
Remove second personalities or types of mental control from a body.
cons: This power can not put objects back together.
Need knowledge of objects you are cutting so that you do not cut the wrong parts.
Powers that can block or disrupt the energy that makes the blade.

name: Unstable Molecular Sythesizing
overview: manipulate your entire molecular structure, causing it to become unstable.
description: By focusing your entire force of Will into your body all at once, this Synthesis ablilty allows it's user to manipulate their entire molecular makeup. This would allow you to shift your body through solid materials, float through the air, breath underwater, purge yourself of poisons, and the like. While you can shift the molecules, you can't change what they are, only move them around, i. E. Forcing your molecules between the gaps in stone molecules to pass through a wall.
pros: Able to heal instantaneously
Able to shift through any material
Able to survive in any atmosphere
cons: Molecules cannot be changed, just rearranged
If you don't have an intimate knowledge of molecular structures, you could accidentaly kill yourself
Cannot exert any other powers that you may possess while using Unstable Molecular Sythesizing

name: Ordinary Attack Immunity
overview: reflect physical attacks from inanimate objects and non superpowered humans.
description: With this ability, you can reflect physical attacks from inanimate objects and people without superpowers. When someone attacks you, you don't get hurt and the impact will hurt where they hit twice as much. If someone punches you, they will feel like their fist got hit with a fist. If a car hits you, the impact will not push you away. The force of the impact gets reflected. The limit of this ability is 100,000 pounds per square meter. Animals and superpowered beings can still hurt you normally.
pros: Reflect impacts from inanimate objects and people without superpowers.
As long as the attack is not concentrated in a small area, you don't get hurt.
Any person or anything attacking you will get twice as hurt where it hit.
cons: Animals and superpowered beings can still hurt you normally.
Poisons and desease can still hurt you.
Limit of 100,000 pounds per square meter of force.

name: Aura Synchronization
overview: synchronize one's aura with another's and enhance both side's battle capabilities
description: Basically your aura synchronizes in such a way that you and one other ally can fight without impeding each other. That is you won't get in the way of your ally's attacks and neither will they. Everything the two of you do will be in perfect concert with the other person.
pros: Don't impede allies in combat
cons: Can't synchronize with more than one person until higher levels. Maximum is three other people.

name: Mental Shielding
overview: shield your thoughts from mind readers
description: The user is able to shield his or her mind from telepaths, effectively blocking them out of their minds. This power is only as powerful as the consciousness of the user. This power is fully active when the user is conscious. Sleep does not affect the power, only being knocked out unconscious will render the power useless
pros: Able to shield your thoughts from enemy telepaths
Good secret keeper
cons: Allies cant relay messages telepathically

name: Death Note
overview: kill by writing someone's full name in a deathgod's note book
description: When someone's name is written in a deathgod's (shinigami) note book that person will die.  The owner of the note book needs to imagine the face of the victim while writing the name.  By default the victim dies from a hearth attack 40 seconds after writing the name. But the time & cause of death can be defined by writing them next to the name.
pros: You posses the perfect homicide tool
Certain death of your targets, and no obvious way to trace you caused it
You can do something about the human over population by killing the bad guys
cons: You're followed by a creepy deathgod as long you're the owner of the note book
Genius level investigators will be trying to find out who you are
Killing many people can't be good for your karma

name: Vista Orbing
overview: create orbs that allow you to see in 360 degrees w/o blind spots.
description: With this type of orbing, one can create orbs of sight. These orbs are connected to the users mind allowing them to see in 360 degrees all at once w/o blind spots. These orbs can also me made and then set in a stationary place or be movable.
pros: Make an orb above your head that follows so you can see all around yourself
Make a small orb and leave it in someones house for survailince.
Make an orb and send it out so you can see into the next room w/o having to enter
cons: Limited orbs, due to the brains inability to focus, becomes over whelming
. Orbs replace normal vision. E. M. F(s) cause distruption
No special sight. No night vision or heat vision.

name: Pixelation
overview: create anything out of pixels.
description: Any size object can be created with the Pixel Staff, the item that creates it. Or, you can use what is called 'magic' on the hero's home planet, and create smaller objects if with out the staff. Mostly used as an assistance power, this power defeats and kills indirectly any foe of the hero. This can be stopped if the staff is broken and the hero's magic disabled, however is somewhat rare.
pros: Can create ANYTHING
User can not lose potential to use staff, they can create a new one or fix the old one
cons: Requires intense focus on Earth because atoms must be turned into pixels.
If copied by a villain or hero, it becomes a very difficult battle to win.

name: Arcana 17: The Star
overview: bend probability and logic to your aid - for a price.
description: You may use this power to perform some action. That action, no matter how impossible or improbable, will succeed. This will result in the best possible outcome for that action. (Such as not merely winning the lottery, but winning the million dollar prize)However, for every time you use this ability, you will fail horribly some action you take in the future, and even this power can not aid you.
pros: Guarantied assurance at success.
Works even when the action would be logically impossible.
cons: Something terrible will happen to you sometime in the future after using this ability.
Creatures or being that dislike probability and reality bending may take offense.

name: Book Alive
overview: bring fantasy characters to life
description: Suppose you like a particular character from a sci fi movie. So bring it to life. Just speak its name and say 'arise" after it.
pros: You can rest while your warriors fight
You get to do fun stuff like read, watch movies and then read again!!!!
They cannot harm you.
cons: They can be mind controlled.
They do not last after one fight
Drains your energy

name: Kything
overview: communicate non-verbally and non-psychically
description: Also called "Speaking Optic", this is the psychic ability to discern what someone wants to say simply by looking into their eyes or reading body language. One with this power can pass it on to others, so they have no need to speak aloud and their thoughts cannot be read, as the thoughts empathically resonate, but only between beings involved in the kything-link. This ability even allows communication through time and across dimensions, as long as kything-link is strong enough.
pros: Never need to talk again
Kything link transcends space and time
Kything link is easy to maintain
cons: Annoying people outside of the kything link
Creeps people out when others agree with you and you haven't said anything
Kything link can only be established between willing partners

name: Mind Pain
overview: make someone feel extreme pain by looking and concentrating
description: When you concentrate on someone, you can make them experience different types of pain by concentrating, from headaches to burning.
pros: Easy to get back at people
Don't have to protect yourself through physical violence
cons: May become an evil pain inducing villain
May become sadistic

name: Natural Leader
overview: have the best solutions to problems and make people listen to you
description: You always come up with good ideas depending on the situation. People tend to want to befriend you. People tend to listen to you.
pros: You are always given important roles or jobs
You are great at solving problems
cons: Not for you if you"re not a people person
Have a lot of weight put on your shoulders

name: Bullet
overview: rapidly speed up any or all parts of your body
description: This power also grants you a way of flight. If you jump in the air and speed up your entire body. If you jump up and speed up your legs so they hit the ground harder when you jump, you can jump very high. This power also grants you a version of super strength. If you speed up your fist as you punch, it will cause a very powerful blow. One can pretty much use this power for half of the superpowers in the world. You can also rapidly speed up your growth, making oneself a giant, along with others.!
pros: Fly / jump high and far
Superstrength
Superspeed
cons: Becomeing too big

name: Specialization
overview: place restrictions on what a power can affect or what a power is able to do.
description: WIth this power you can turn a broad power into a more specialized one such as changing levitation to only levitate firetrucks and flame users only able to use blue flames. The specialized power has increased power equal to how narrow the range of what it can affect has become. It can be used on your own and others powers. The specialization can be changed or removed after which this power has time to recharge. Recharge time varies between users.
pros: Broad powers can be focused on specific things.
Specialized powers have increased power.
Can be used on opponents to make their powers only affect odd things.
cons: Has a recharge time.
To increase your own power you have to narrow your own powers.
Your opponents can still use their powers if they follow the restrictions.

name: Atp Manipulation
overview: generate and manipulate adenosine triphosphate, the chemical fuel of the body
description: Adenosine triphosphate, also known as ATP, is the chemical energy source of all living animals. With this ability, you can produce it within yourself, induce its production in others, and control how much is produced. That means you can control how strong any metabolic process is (breathing, digestion, motion, thought, superpowers, etc. ), making them stronger or weaker. At the higher levels, you can even cause mitochondria to stop producing it altogether, slowly shutting down the body.
pros: Enhance metabolic processes of yourself and allies
Hinder metabolic processes of foes
Induce death at will, or prevent it
cons: Does not work on organisms whose bodies don't operate on ATP to survive
Cannot CONTROL thoughts, motions, etc. Other than strengthening them, weakening them or the like
Cannot reverse death of living things, or bestow life on inanimate objects

name: Attribute Reversal
overview: reverse any characteristic of anything into its opposite.
description: With this power, you can reverse anything or anyone's characteristics. For example, if someone shot a fire blast at you, you could reverse the direction of the attack, sending it back to them, reverse its effect, making it a freezing blast or reverse the direction of the time flow of the blast, cancelling it. Any reversal is possible except reversing something to nothing or nothing to something, for example, movement/immobility, flowing time/stopped time, existing/not existing or living/dead.
pros: Reverse a strengthening power into a weakening one.
Reverse a damaging attack into a healing one.
Reverse your "opponent" into your "ally".
cons: You can't attack by yourself, your opponent has to make the first move.
Reversals are local. You can't reverse the worldwide meaning of an F grade.
An exception is if your own power is reversed, you'll lose it.

name: Magic Lamp
overview: have a magic lamp with a genie inside it who can grant you 3 wishes.
description: What more is there to say? You can ask any wishes you want, except having more wishes, being omnipotent, stuff like that.
pros: We're not in Disney Land, you can also kill people, resurrect them, or make someone love you.
Even if you can't ask to be onmipotent, you can ask to have one specific power.
cons: You have only 3 wishes...
And you can't ask to have as many wishes as you want.

name: The Paths Of Magic
overview: generate and manipulate mana
description: There are many forms of energy in our world, such as heat, kinetic energy, and electricity. Another, less publicly known energy, is mana. Mana is a term used for magical energy. Magic is the science of using mana to promote change in one's surroundings. Mana has many properties, one of which is that it can be controlled by certain beings, called mages. There are five kinds of mages, also called the five paths of magic, or the five paths of the mage. Simply, this turns you into a mage.
pros: You can control mana.
You might learn some of the other paths of magic.
cons: Your cells(almost all forms)generate mana, so you'll have to eat a lot or get energy some other way.
Losing control of your powers.

name: Object Absorption
overview: absorb objects into the body.
description: It is possible to absorb any object into the body, and expel it at the speed it entered.   Only 5 objects may be absorbed at once. The weight of the object is negated, almost as if it no longer existed. The effect of the object is also negated whilst inside the body (for example a magnet no longer attracts).   If something living is absorbed, it does not age and has has no memory (if not a plant) since the absorption. You cannot absorb yourself, or the Earth.
pros: Pass through airport security with illegal objects
Cannot be knowingly shot (as you can just absorb the bullet and shoot it back at them)
cons: Can only hold 5 objects at once

name: Electronic Machine Possession
overview: astrally project oneself to possess electronics & machinery
description: On the verge of technopathic, you project your psychic spirit into electronics & machines & control them. You can even create & transform them into a humanoid creature. Your body will be left defenseless though & if an EMP struck while you possessed something, it could leave you in a coma.
pros: Possess & control electronic machinery
Combine & transform them into a humanoid
cons: Body is defenseless
EMP could leave you in a coma

name: Mangekyoyomi
overview: see a power and completely understand strengths, weaknesses, applications, and counters.
description: An eye ability, the Mangekyoyomi allows the user to fully understand the workings of a power, skill, or ability by seeing it. By understanding the ability, the user sometimes learns how to use it. Also through understanding, the Mangekyoyomi user can know all the weaknesses, strengths, applications, and counters of the seen ability. When reading an ability, the irises flash different colors and spin, hence the name: Kaleidoscope Reader.
pros: Understand enemy powers, thus knowing weaknesses.
Ranged (Only have to see, not touch the power or person)
Can be used on powers and skills (such as karate techniques).
cons: Basically useless to a non-strategist.
Usually does not grant the scanned power.
The opposing user must perform the skill correctly for a complete scan.

name: Stereotype Manipulation
overview: change, create, or eliminate stereotypes at will
description: With this ability, you can create, eliminate, or change any stereotype at will. You can make people with no confidence get all the girls. You could eliminate thugs. You could make nerds dress like winners. Make geeks stupid and poor. Turn the bum stereotype into a rich bum stereotype. Make up a stereotype that is superfun. Doesn't work on superpowered beings.
pros: Make nerds dress like winners. People will now see nerd as a synonym for winner.
Eliminate thugs and bullies. Eliminate all stereotypes.
Make up your own, superfun stereotype.
cons: Can be used for evil.
Make jerks even worse.
Someone could use this to make brothers more annoying.

name: Altdimension Creature Summon V2
overview: summon creatures from alternate dimensions
description: With this power you can summon creatures from alternate dimensions. When you activate this power you receive knowledge of all of the alternate dimensions and the names, powers and descriptions of all the creatures residing in all of those dimensions. All you have to do then is say the name of the creature and the dimension the creature is from and it will appear. It won't however be under your control. When you're done you can send it back by saying the name of the creature and the dimension.
pros: You can summon creatures from different dimensions
cons: The creatures are not under your control

name: Ring Of Solomon
overview: summon and enslave demons
description: (This ring is most prized among rings) the wearer of the ring has the power to summon any demon and enslaves them. You have an unlimited supply of demons to summon and enslave
pros: Army of demons
Build and destroy cites
Command demons to submit to you
cons: Every demon hates you
You will lose the ring eventually
People will kill you for the ring

name: Vitamaniacal Form
overview: change into a state which grows and gains power from absorbing life.
description: With this ability, you can transform into a monstrous-like creature which grows and gains power from life. You absorb life with tentacles, and you also have the ability to ingrain yourself with the ground to absorb it. As you grow, you even gain the abilities to suck in life, heal living things around you, and become more regenerative. Once you revert to normal, however, you lose the effects of this ability.
pros: Grow and gain abilities, such as draining tentacles, draining breath, ingrain, and healing.
You become more regenerative the more life you absorb.
It's difficult to take damage while in this form.
cons: Once you revert to normal, you lose the effects of this ability.
You have no defense towards emotional damage.
This form is extremely reckless.

name: Instant Atomization
overview: make things explode through touch.
description: This ability allows you to make anything break apart into atoms. People, cars, air, anything. This power is one of the more dangerous ones because all it takes is one touch and its all over. It work by giving the protons a negative charge then pushing the electrons away and then breaking the matter down into atoms. The power is surprising easy to control, but the only draw back is that it actually takes energy from the user.
pros: Extremely powerful
Easy control, you can select what is atomized in less then i milisecond.
All it takes is one touch
cons: Takes energy from the user
Can't be reversed

name: Keys Of Infinity: Time Key
overview: use a magical artifact that allows you to move around time.
description: This artifact just requires you to turn the key into air or a door. If it's in the air, a door will appear. Then, as you open it, think of a time. You will appear at the same place you were, but at whatever time you thought of. *can be combined with the Space Key and Dimension Key to make the Infikey.
pros: Go to the past, future, anything
Portable key
Can be combined with the other Keys of Infinity
cons: Might reappear someplace where a wall was/is now, so you could die
Cannot control where you go without the Space Key

name: Induced Psychomagnetism
overview: generate a powerful destructive psychic wave.
description: A wave that exists outside the electromagnetic spectrum which is completely destructive and generates in the form of a white light, usually associated with the energy given off during a precognitive state. The energy can be concentrated into orbs, beams etc.  The power requires incredible concentration.
pros: Incredibly powerful with nothing that is immune to it.
Allows psychometric abilities.
Can't be controlled with magnekinesis.
cons: Gives you a really bad headache.
Practically impossible to control and use at will.
Easy to overextend yourself and possibly end up in a coma as a result.

name: Consciousness Transfer
overview: transfer one's consciousness into another unconscious person.
description: At will, you can remove your consciousness and transfer it to an unconscious person, e.g. someone asleep or in a coma. The moment you touch them, their memories, skills, and personality is then merged with yours and their body is now yours, while your old body is left in a coma. You must physically touch this person for it to take effect and the merging of their personality with yours is permanent, in effect you kill them. You can however return to your old body at any time.
pros: If you have access to an unlimited amount of unconscious clones, you have practically immortality.
You can take on the role of anyone, providing you are there when they are unconscious.
You have their memories and personality. If you pretend to be them, no one will ever find out.
cons: You will die if you are hurt away from your clones or other unconscious people.
After collecting so many personalities and memories, you may forget which ones were originally yours
Insanity and depression is a high risk. Suicide may be inevitable after many years.

name: Immovability
overview: make anything around you immovable
description: The ability to make anything around you immovable or unstoppable.
pros: You can make yourself immovable.
You can make yourself unstoppable.
cons: No superstrength.
No unstoppable force.
Non invulnerability.

name: Perception Compulsion Immunity
overview: see through alterations and not be compelled.
description: This power allows you to see what's really there. You can see through all illusions, see shape shifters in their true form or anything else that alters perception etc. For compulsion immunity, you can't be controlled through persuasion, telepathy, puppet mastery, or anything that removes your free will.
pros: You know you have free will
Never be tricked
cons: Not the most dynamic power
The person may kill you after they find out you can't be tricked/compelled

name: Sense Steal
overview: steal someone's sight, hearing or voice.
description: Quite like the proverb "see no evil, hear no evil, speak no evil". You can take people's senses by holding your hands over someone's ears to steal their hearing, over their eyes for sight and cover their mouth for voice.
pros: Defeat enemies.
Funny
cons: Can be taken back with a simple spell.

name: P.O.W.E.R.S Power
overview: manipulate any object,action or describing words that start with letter
description: This ability will work if it is an object(noun),action (verb),and a describing words (adjective). If it is an object, you should see that object before manipulating it. If it is a verb, you should choose a specific person that will do that action. If it is an adjective, you should choose a specific person to possess that adjective that you ascribe to him or her.
pros: You can make enemies PERISH
You can make other people SLOW
You can make a person or an object SOFT
cons: You are not able to use other letters except p,o,w,e,r,s
If you have a bad vocabulary
Powers that keep you from speaking or thinking clearly

name: Robotic Spider Summon
overview: summon thousands of robot spiders
description: With this power you can summon thousands of small robot spiders that are under your complete control. Each spider is equipped with a laser, can walk on walls, and has super strength. When one is destroyed you can just summon another one to take its place.
pros: You can summon hordes of robot spiders
They're under your complete control
cons: They can be destroyed
They can be reprogrammed

name: Thirteen Treasures: The Ring
overview: use the stone and ring of Eluned the Fortunate
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. When the stone on this ring is turned inwards to face the palm, and the hand of the bearer is closed into a fist, the wearer will be rendered invisible from whoever he or she so chooses.
pros: Become invisible to everybody but one person. Have fun making them think they've gone mad!
cons: People might think you're married if you wear it on the wrong finger.

name: Human Transformation
overview: change people into whatever you want
description: With this ability you can change anyone into anything and they will remain alive in whatever form the thing you changed them into is in (as long as there are still some of the particles the item is made of in something they will be alive in it. For example: some idiot annoying you? Change him into a burrito and eat him. He will then be digested and excreted. He will be alive for all of the process because there is still some of the particles that the burrito was made of in the feces.
pros: You can have anything you want--made right from a person
cons: It is permanent
If you havn't activated it for awhile it will activate randomly

name: Parting
overview: part anything. You can separate any conceptual mass into two.
description: This ability allows you to "part" anything. From mountains to oceans to your morning bagel, you can separate any conceptual mass into two. To perform this feat, you must raise your hands, place them together and move them outward. If there is resistance (i.e. a liquid trying to fill back in), the target will stay parted for roughly a day. Navigate through deadly swamplands with ease! Looking to shove some people around? Visit Times Square and have at it! Moses will be asking for pointers.
pros: Create paths through mountains, oceans or busy shopping centers for travel
If there's resistance (such as water that tries to fill back in), it will stay parted for a day.
Easily win massive applause and rounds at the bars by parting mugs of beer.
cons: Exhausting. The more mass involved, the more taxing.
Parting only lasts for a day if the parted target doesn't naturally stay parted (i.e. liquid).

name: Omnipotent Ganger
overview: use double ganger in it's most godlike form.
description: You can create up to millions and millions of your self at once. You can make your replicates either holographic illusions, temporal clones, or actual real people of your self in full flesh, blood, and bone. You can also rejoin the clones back to you and you can gain multiple memories from their experience.
pros: You can make as much clones as you can think of. With no end.
You can gain memories of any of their experience when you rejoin (at will).
It is your choice whether or not you make a real clone to live by his, or her own life.
cons: Your clones won't have superpowers, unless if you (the source) have another superpower to begin with
Some of your clones would miss behave (depending on your personality).

name: Myth Power: Gaia's Gift
overview: channel Gaia's command over the essence of earth, the ground and earthly phenomena
description: Gaia (Gaea, Ge), in Greek myth, was the goddess of earth (land; the ground). As such, channeling her allows one to perceive and manipulate all naturally-occurring earthly phenomena (earthquakes, quicksand, sinkholes, mudslides, avalanches, volcanic eruptions, geysers, oil spouts, etc), at will. In addition, one can perceive and manipulate plants and earth at will. One can even attune oneself to the earth/ground of one's current planet/location to become familiar with one's surrounding, and more.
pros: Perceive, induce, amplify, reduce and negate earthly phenomena at will
Perceive and manipulate plants and earth (dirt/soil, rock/stone, metal, sand, etc) at will
Attune oneself to earth from one's current planet/location (learn land's layout, be healed, etc)
cons: At the lower levels, earth and plant manipulation are triggered by emotions (NCN)
Cannot take on a form composed of plant matter or earth until developed (NCN)
Cannot open the earth to reveal portals to the underworld, until developed (NCN)

name: X Treasure Chests
overview: cause a chest full of treasure to appear whenever you draw a white x on the ground
description: With this power you can cause a treasure chest to appear whenever you draw the letter x in white on the ground. You can repeat the process as many times as you want and you get to keep all the treasure and the chest even if the x is erased.
pros: You can get tons of money
You can sell the chests for even more money
It works whenever you draw the letter x in white on the ground
cons: Only works on the ground
Only works if the x is white
Does not work on white surfaces

name: Tactical Cards
overview: create cards that have data on people
description: The cards are created by waving your hand in front of their face at which point a card with their stats will appear in front of you. The card will have their current power levels, strength, speed, agility, dexterity, intelligence, health, and class (RPG-type closest match possible) level at the point the card was created. Also, the card will have at most two of their powers identified on it. The card will not update itself when the person becomes stronger or weaker.
pros: You can have information on people at the start of any battle.
The cards could be used to know how much power you need to use to heal someone or a group of people.
Con: The cards can be stolen. Pro if used in conjunction with the next con.
cons: Between battles people can become stronger thus making the previous data obsolete.
Enemies with more than 2 powers will need multiple cards to know all their powers.
Ex: Vespert will take at least 350 cards possibly more.

name: Avenger Summon V2
overview: summon any Avenger
description: With this power you can summon any Avenger. The Avenger doesn't have to be currently an active member of the team they don't even have to be living in the current comic book timeline. Also when you summon when of them they under your complete control. Unfortunately if you want to use the mind control function you can only summon one of them. If you summon two or more you lose control over them.
pros: You can summon any of the Avengers
You can mind control up to one of them at a time
cons: If you want to summon more than one you lose the mind control function

name: Technique Based Power Creator
overview: be so proficient with a superpower technique that it becomes a superpower of its own.
description: A power technique is any way you use your powers to perform certain tasks. With this, whenever you master a technique, it can become an ability of its own. For example, with Telekinesis, you can train to get the power to propel anything. If you only lose Telekinesis, you'll still retain the power to propel things, but you won't be able to freely move them. If you only lose the propelling power, you can still propel things with Telekinesis but you'll be less proficient. This power is automatic.
pros: The actual number of superpowers you have is higher than the ones you acquired.
There's no limit to how many techniques you can develop from a "root" superpower.
If you lose the "root" power, you'll still be able to use the techniques turned into superpowers.
cons: You can't decide when a technique becomes a superpower and not all techniques can become one.
Some conditions to become an ability are the complexity, the proficiency and the originality.
Some other conditions are the specificity of the task and the combination of abilities.

name: Spheres Of Nothingness
overview: create spheres that obliterate everything inside them.
description: You can create a 3cm solid marble that you can throw (or rather should throw). 3s after its creation, the marble immobilizes itself and expands into a 3m ethereal sphere, lasting for 3s before disappearing. Any matter that was inside or enters that sphere disappears forever. The sphere doesn't have a gravity of its own and therefore doesn't suck in matter like black holes do but air or water rushing in can provide mild or excellent suction. You can create up to 3 spheres within a 3min period.
pros: Anything can be totally or partially destroyed.
Waste regulation problems now have a solution.
Kill or incapacitate anyone you want. Even makes you intimidating or fearful.
cons: You are not immune to your own spheres, so be VERY careful!
With 3 spheres max within a 3min period, you better be strategic.
If you use this power too much, fatally the planet's air supply will be depleted.

name: Aquaria Spinning
overview: spin and manipulate Aquaria, the lifeforce of the waters
description: Aquaria is what keeps oceans, rivers, seas, etc healthy, vibrant and strong. By spinning Aquaria, you can draw raw life energy from the water. You don't actually need to be near water to spin Aquaria, but water does make it a whole lot more powerful. With this power, you can do a lot, from healing to destructive force blasts, just like how the ocean can be a great healer as well as a great killer.
pros: Can spin unlimited amounts of raw life force energy
Can do magic, heal, fly, shoot energy blasts and have psychic abilities
Raw power of the sea in it's purest form
cons: All this power may go to your head
It reflects your emotions, if your not in a good mood, it becomes weak
Can't acutally control water, just it's lifeforce

name: Myth Power: Prowess Of Proioxis
overview: channel Proioxis' command over the essence of pursuit and onrush
description: Proioxis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of pursuit and giving chase. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive the location, number and identity of any target one pursues, and hunt them with predatory instinct. In addition, one may surpass the speed of any target one pursues. At the higher levels, one may even cause one's target to slow down, as well as communicate with, and transform into, any animal considered a predatory animal.
pros: Perceive the location, identity and number of pursued targets
Gain predatory instinct (even when the power is otherwise not in use)
Slow down targets and transform into a predatory animal at the higher bands
cons: Some predatory animals are also considered predators (may get confusing)
Cannot COMPEL predatory animals until the higher bands
People with MythPower: Teumessian Fox-Trot are immune to this ability

name: Training Space
overview: teleport into and out of a space that is only for training
description: The training space will have what you need in order to train your natural and supernatural abilities in an environment where no one, except someone training, will get hurt. If a mountain is needed the space will have a mountain, if a bunch of holograms are needed to fight against, then there will be holograms. The only thing it won't have though, is food. Time in the training space runs the same as the dimension you came from.
pros: Always has what you need to train.
No chance of harming anyone except yourself while perfecting a dangerous technique.
It's a place outside of any dimension so only you or dimensional travelers can enter it.
cons: You can starve if you forget to leave for food.
When you teleport out you will be at the same spot you were at when you teleported in.

name: Reploid Power
overview: transform into a reploid.
description: Transform into a reploid like Zero or Megaman, complete with weapons and other equipment and abilities. Use everything as if it was your own. However, you are stuck with the transformation for a day before choosing another. If you die, you explode just like any other reploid.
pros: Power of the reploids!
Increased skill in accordance to transformation.
cons: If you die, you explode.
You're stuck in that transformation for a day.

name: Contained Metabolism
overview: sustain yourself without eating, breathing, etc.
description: Most metabolisms are pretty high-maintenance. A person with a Contained Metabolism does not fall into this category; their body recycles all its nutrients, hormones, and energy. Thus, they do not need food, water, nutrients, or even as much sleep. However, if the system loses nutrients (i.e. wounds), they will have to be put back in by eating. Also, the user is not resistant to injury in any way, though they will tend to have more endurance than usual.
pros: Body recycles nutrients, so you never have to take care of it
Tire less quickly
No more bathroom breaks
cons: If your body loses nutrients, they will have to be replaced
Not resistant to injury
Poison stays with you twice as long

name: Scavenger Sight
overview: see the worth of objects.
description: Scavenger Sight allows you to see the worth of any object. This could mean either how much money you could get for the object, or how to the object can be used beneficially for you. Objects that are useful to you will glow to attract your attention, but the glow can only be seen by you. Objects inside containers will still glow to show you there is something useful but you will not know what it is until you open the container.
pros: See the value of any object.
See how an object would be useful to you.
Find useful objects by their "glow" before you even know they are there.
cons: Always seeing the "glow" of objects.
Just seeing useful objects doesn't mean that you will be able to get the objects to use them.
Can not tell what an object inside a container is by its glow until you see it.

name: Death Reversal
overview: gain power based on whatever kills you.
description: When killed by anything besides old age, your body transforms into a creature that is half human and half of whatever killed you. For example, if you're killed by a gun, you would have a metal body and could shoot projectiles. The transformed state only lasts for a period of time, you stay transformed longer from a more painful death.
pros: Don't have to fear about getting killed.
Can gain nearly any power for a limited time with creative deaths.
After transformation wears off, you are fully healed.
cons: Have to die to use power.
Must get killed to activate this power.
If you're accidentally killed, everyone would see you transform.

name: Enhanced Synesthesia
overview: see and control sound
description: This ability not only allows you to see sound but control it in different ways. First of all, you see sound as colored wisps of light coming from the source. You can move them around without the sound dying out. You can intensify and weaken them. Sadly you can not create sound with this ability. Other than basically controlling sound you can do two more things. You can make sound visible to others. And you can make people come to you by focusing on them and making a constant stream of sound.
pros: You can see and control sound
You can intensify sound enough to break stuff and weaken it enough to hide it
You can make sound visible and call people to you
cons: To turn off your "sound vision" you need to concentrate constantly
You still can be hurt by sound
You can't create sound with this ability

name: Hyper Metabolism
overview: possess a faster metabolism than normal.
description: With a Hyper Metabolism, one can heal from injury or disease faster than regular humans. They will still be subject to all human vulnerabilities, although his immunity to diseases, toxins, or even alcohol poisoning is extraordinary. It can burn off a large amount of calories, forcing the subject's body into a better shape and keeping on going.
pros: Becomes morbidly obese to perfect fitness in seconds
Having lots of energy coursing through body
Having enhanced physical prowess when needed
cons: Most subjects with this power cannot turn it off
Still have to eat

name: Matter Dissolution
overview: pass through solid matter, crumbling it afterwards
description: Matter Dissolution is a more dangerous version of Phasing. The user passes through solid objects, just like a Phaser. But as soon as they have gone through it, it breaks down and crumbles. This is because they break down binding forces as they pass through it. So, while they can walk through walls, they leave a big gaping hole afterwards.
pros: Can walk through walls
Break down what you have gone through
Very good for combat
cons: Leave crumbling holes in the walls you have passed through
Must be careful what you pass through
Rather obvious

name: Empowered Naming
overview: increase the power of your actions by giving it a name
description:
This ability lets you amplify any attack by declaring it before performing it or increase the effect by declaring it afterward. Attacks can also be weakened by giving it a funny or weak sounding name. 

Even normal non-superpowered attacks can be amplified this way and can obtain characteristics similar to the name

For example if you yell "Flaming Punch" you punching attack will be slightly hotter than usual but not as hot as it would be if you actually punched with real fire
pros: Make anything you do more powerful
cons: You have to declare your attacks to make this work

name: Mirror Veil
overview: conjure reflective surfaces of glass in a radius depending on your power.
description: Using this power, you can create mirrors whose perimeter and area are dependent on your skill and general power. Most people can manage a four or five foot mirror. These mirrors are easily enchanted - more so than normal mirrors - and reflect light and most magic perfectly.
pros: Mirrors confuse people, especially in the dark.
A light manipulator may get toasted by his own beam if you 'outdraw' him.
The mirrors are permanent, and could be a source of income.
cons: The mirrors are fragile and melt from enough non-magical heat.
You have no control over them once you create them.
Someone whose power includes them could use them against you.

name: Mega Fists
overview: create giant energy hands as extensions of your hands
description: With this power, you can create energy hands that act as extensions of your hands. They can be the same size as your normal hands or giant. You can use them to deliver devastating blows or to lift extremely heavy things. You can contend with super strong opponents or shield yourself from attacks. With enough creativity, it can be an incredibly versatile power.
pros: Engage in hand to hand combat while a safe distance away
Mimic super strength
Easy to catch falling objects or reach things
cons: Hands can only reach 100 feet away from you
Have to be able to move your hands to move energy hands
Can still get tired using energy hands

name: Subatomic Pulse Generation
overview: amplify the energy given off by the movement of subatomic particles to fire off pulses of energy
description: The user of this power can then direct the amplified energy in one direction in order to hit the intended target. This power will take up a lot of the user's stamina and energy for each use. Maximum range is 10 metres for the pulse and 100 metres for use on any object or being.
pros: Good for extending the maximum range of a weapon (10 metres is nothing to laugh at).
cons: Energy-consuming
Long battles

name: Danger's Light
overview: see bright white light where it is dangerous to be
description: Say someone's going to attack you with say a bazooka and you don't know they're around. Normally you would die, but with this power the path that the ammunition from the bazooka would shine with a bright white light that only you can see. This effect applies to any possible danger regardless of how much damage it would do to you. The light shows up 10 sec before the dangerous event happens.
pros: You know exactly where to stand in order to avoid a danger.
You have enough time to react after the light apears.
cons: If you have invulnerability, even stuff that would normally kill you, but is now harmless shows up.
Thousands of bullets will hurt your eyes.
Be sure not to move into an attack that is already occuring while trying to avoid a future attack...

name: Instant Blueprints
overview: create blueprints of anything on any paper held up to the subject
description: By holding up a piece of paper you can use this power to copy a blueprint of whatever the paper covers in your line of sight. The blueprints you create can be of anything, including people. The blueprints include notes of important information about the subject. For people this includes weaknesses and powers.
pros: Let's you create a blueprint of anything.
Shows weaknesses of people
Blueprints contain notes of the subject.
cons: Must have a piece of paper to use this power

name: Super Awake
overview: live your life without ever having to sleep
description: You never ever need to sleep.   While others get tired after being awake for to long, being awake simply doesn't affect you that way.   This also makes you immune to powers that induce sleep.   You are still able to sleep if you'd like.  But it would just be your choice.
pros: More time to spend
You can do things while others need to sleep
Sleep deprivation has no effect on you
cons: To much time to spend
Some could expect you to do things while others are asleep
Long lonely hours during the night

name: Myth Power: Triton's Triumph
overview: channel Triton's command over the essence of the surging waves of the sea
description: Triton, in Greek myth, was the god of the surging waves of the sea, as well as Messenger of the Seas. As such, channeling him naturally allows one to survive underwater and swim well. In addition, one can summon a conch (like Triton's) to churn any sufficient body of water into a tidal wave, and calm rough waves, at will. Furthermore, one can turn one's legs to/from a mermaid tail at will. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with fish and other aquatic species.
pros: Swim well, survive underwater; summon a conch that, when blown, can stir up or calm rough waves
Turn one's legs to/from a mermaid tail at will (when developed, share by touch)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with fish and other aquatic species
cons: Cannot use one's Triton Conch to teleport to any body of water until the higher level (NCN)
Cannot compel mermaids and tritons until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige provides immunity and allows disruption/negation/compulsion (NCN)

name: Starships
overview: summon a fleet of artificially intelligent starships
description: With this power you can summon up to fifteen artificially intelligent starships. The starships have tons of weapons and defense mechanisms and can pilot themselves. They are also under your complete control and will do anything in their power to protect you from harm. If one of them gets destroyed you can summon a new one to take its place. You can also unsummon them and resummon them whenever you want.
pros: You can summon a fleet of starships
They have tons of weapons
They're under your control
cons: They're big so they can't help you if you're in an enclosed area
They can be destroyed

name: Carbon Sequestration
overview: remove carbon from any source, especially a gas such as carbon dioxide.
description: With this ability, you can remove carbon from any source and use it. However, this is easiest to do with carbon dioxide. Once you have it, you can use it for many purposes, such as emulation of photosynthesis (requires water) and making various constructs with it, such as solar panels, diamonds and structures.
pros: Helps to save the planet though simple use.
Has a variety of purposes, only limited to the user's imagination.
Plentiful source material.
cons: To make full use of this power, you may need knowledge in areas such as chemistry.
Requires a fair bit of concentration for some tasks.
Heavily dependent on imagination.

name: Physical Ricochet
overview: make who ever touches you to rebound off
description: While this power is active whenever anyone touches you, they rebound forcefully off. This also applies to any other object that hits you (bullets, shrapnel, people with Super Strength) with ten-times the force it hit you. This power does not apply to Non-physical forces or attacks (lasers, things like wind, that psychic dude's mental blast). If you jump off a cliff and hit the ground, YOU will bounce.
pros: You are a Super-Strength-ed hero's nightmare
Can be used for transportation via bouncing
You can ammuse yourself by giving hi-5s
cons: Forgetting to turn it off and...say jumping in a pool
Can't stop Non-physical attacks or energy
You have to read the big paragraph up there to understand this power

name: Japanese Virtues
overview: control the Japanese virtues and the elements associated with them
description: There are five ancient Japanese virtues and each has an element associated with them. Benevolence makes people willingly give you free gifts and control the element of wood. Courtesy makes people treat you as though you have higher rank and control fire. Sincerity makes people tell the truth and allows control of earth. Justice causes people to believe that you have the side of right and allows control of metal. Wisdom makes people listen to what you say and allows control of water.
pros: Can control five virtues and elements.
This power has many different uses.
cons: Can only use one virtue at a time.
Each element is beaten by another element.
Con Negation has no effect on this power and alteration powers have no effect on the cons.

name: Vampirism: Phobic
overview: gain sustenance and power from the fear of others
description: Also called Fear Vampirism, Phobic Absorption or Fear Absorption, this is the ability to absorb the fear of others and turn it into sustenance and energy for one's own use (it also works on doubt, nervousness, anxiety, dread and uncertainty); though some with this power leave subjects temporarily numb emotionally, it is most common that the subject remains conscious, and thus still afraid (this power works especially well on those with fear-based powers, or on neurotic, paranoid, phobic people)
pros: Feed off the fear of others, which SOMETIMES leaves them emotionally numb (but usually doesn't)
Taking their fear delays your need to eat or rest
Foes with fear-type abilities or with fearful/fear-inducing personalities
cons: Best if you can also sense fear (but Fear Sense does not ALWAYS accompany this power)
Sometimes it requires an actual bite like a true vampire
If you can't control it, friends and family won't want to be around you

name: Mythical Creature Taming
overview: tame up to 5 mythical creatures
description: Dragons, chimera, unicorn, hydra, etc. Any mythical beast is possible. When the mythical creature is tamed he/she will be completely loyal to you and follow all reasonable orders. Ex: the creature won't kill itself but it will give up scales, fangs, etc. This power is completely voluntary in use due to the 5 creature limit. Once 5 mythical creatures are tamed, you cannot tame any more even if one of the mythical creatures you have tamed dies. Can only be gained by mastering Animal Trainer.
pros: You can have 5 powerful creatures at what is pretty much your beck and call.
Some rare versions of this power allow you total control of the creatures but that is rare.
cons: You still cannot ride a unicorn if you are not a pure-hearted virgin. No making this power stronger.
Mythical creatures are intelligent and may ask the reason behind your orders from time to time.
Angels, demons, and a few others are beyond this power's strength to control. No Con Negation.

name: Dream Eater
overview: eat people's dreams and gain different powers
description: With this power, you can eat people's dreams. You can do this by turning into a small spirit at night and going into people's minds. Once in their mind, you can access their dreams and eat them. The powers you get are based on what's going on in the dream you're eating. You have those powers until the next night when you become a spirit again.
pros: You can gain powers by eating people's dreams.
cons: You lose the powers the next night.
You automatically become a spirit at night.
The only thing you can do as a spirit is fly and go into people's minds to eat their dreams.

name: Teleport Then Explode
overview: teleport then cause the place that you used to be standing to explode
description: With this power you can teleport and then cause the place you were standing to explode and wipe out everything in a ten mile radius. This is useful if you're standing next to an enemy you can simply teleport more than ten miles away and cause the place you were standing to explode to wipe out your enemy.
pros: You can teleport
You can turn the explosions on and off
cons: If the explosions are on you have to teleport at least ten miles away from where you were standing

name: Induced Entropic Destruction
overview: cause things to break down
description: The ability to separate anything into a closed system and increase entropy in that system therefore causing that system to break down. For example, walls crumble, metal rusts, bones break. Eventually if the system is exposed to further entropy, it is broken down into an atomic dust.
pros: Escape from any place
You are difficult to stop
cons: Could destroy the world if left unchecked

name: Symbiotic Suits: The Energizer
overview: change any and all inertia, energy, momentum, or force into an energy beam, weapon, etc
description: This suit grants you the ability to change all momentum (from running) into energy, allowing you to make sudden stops and releasing a blast of energy. Similar to Iron Man's Shockwave attack, you can gather energy by inertia, momentum, or even from a fall. You will not only survive but have an awesome explosion of energy released from it. The amount of energy, and the range is dependent upon how fast, how long, or how hard you hit.
pros: Can't get hurt from a trip, fall, or running into something.
The suit's ability affects cars,vehicles, or things that you are using or have on you.
To fight someone, all you have to do is have them punch you.
cons: Can't ever turn it off.
Could hurt someone.
Small things (minor trips, getting smacked) can sometimes not be converted.

name: All Your Base Are Belong To Us
overview: dominate any operational system, electronic or biotic
description: This ability is a truly hated one among those it affects. It allows one to entirely take control over nearly any system and make it YOURS. Literally. You can make it move, make it talk, access its information (thoughts and memories for living things, data for electronic devices) and command it verbally; and once you've dominated the system, you can assume control of it again, regardless of obstacles and distance.
pros: Total body/system control (control almost any machine or creature)
Total body/system access (access any memories/thoughts/skills subjects possess)
Can borrow subjects' senses and abilities
cons: Mind-control resistance prevents use of this power
Beginners in the use of this power have to actually SAY "All your base are belong to us"
Foes can keep from being controlled by saying "All my base are belong to me! "

name: Plant Humanoid Evolution
overview: cause plants to evolve into bipedal humanoids
description: You basically cause plants to become bipedal humanoids. They can talk in human languages as well as think for themselves. They will retain whatever abilities they had as plants such getting nutrients from the ground, making food from sunlight. The appearance of the humanoid plant differs based on what they looked like as a plant. If their lifespan as a plant was shorter than that of a human's it will expand to be at least that of the average human's, longer if it was originally longer.
pros: If you prefer plants more than people, now they can talk and play with you.
If you tried to take care of plants they will honor you.
cons: People will gawk as the humanoid plant might still have things such as petals or leaves.
Not having been nice to plants.
They might decide to conquer the world as they can reproduce faster.

name: Swallowing
overview: interact your cells with anything.
description: You can make your cells "swallow" anything, making it a part of your body. This power activates only at will. If you interact with an other human being, that person becomes a part of you. The person's body mass makes you bigger, increasing your muscle and body mass. If the interacted person has a power, you get that power.
pros: You're invincible, basically.
Absorb many human beings and grow big muscles.
The absorption is unlimited, absorb all you want.
cons: The absorbed person's feelings are given to you.
You can be defeated, but the chances aren't very high.

name: God Of Cooking
overview: create any type of food out of thin air
description: With this power, you can make any meal appear in front of you as long as you visualize it.   The food can be eaten or thrown. You can change what ingredients are in there.   By any ingredient, I mean that, besides extra salt/pepper or other spices, you can also add more things such as laxatives, poisons, and even explosives.  As long as it can be feasibly put into the human body, it can be made.
pros: You can create any type of food that ever existed
You can add any ingredients you want
You can make it look like anything you want
cons: You have to visualize the dish to make it

name: Xiaolin Showdown Throw Down
overview: summon and properly use all of the Shen Gong Wu from the TV series, Xiaolin Showdown
description: The ability to summon various objects is no joke. Especially THESE objects. One with this ability has the power to summon any of the Shen Gong Wu from the series Xiaolin Showdown. In addition, you have perfect knowledge of their names and their functions, so you never summon the wrong one. You effectively have the potential to be a very powerful warrior, for either the side of good or for the side of evil.
pros: Perceive the name, appearance and use of all the Shen Gong Wu
Summon any of them, and have heightened skill in using them
At the higher bands, replicate the objects and construct new Shen Gong Wu of your own
cons: At the lower levels, you can't summon more than one at a time
At the lower levels, have a harder time perceiving and recalling the Shen Gong Wu
Shen Gong Wu can be broken (you can only fix that at the higher levels)

name: Invisible Body Guards
overview: summon two invisible bodyguards
description: With this power you can summon two body guards that only you can see. The body guards will do anything in their power to protect you and are super strong, agile, know how to use any weapon and can shoot lasers from their eyes. If both of the bodyguards die you cannot summon new one and you lose this power.
pros: You can summon invisible super powered body guards
cons: They can die

name: Magician's Touch
overview: possess the Magicain's Touch
description: Some people have a gift called the Magicain's Touch. Locks will open at your touch, guns will never run out of bullets, and broken-down cars will run again with a brush of your hands. Your can even use your touch to persuade people and tame animals.
pros: Very useful power.
You can persuade people.
cons: Not much use in a fight.

name: Object Shooter
overview: have objects you just touched shoot at anything you are pointing at.
description: You must first touch the objects you want to affect with your power. You can place them wherever you want, even leave them where you found them, and you can touch as many as you like. Then, just point at something with your hand shaped like a gun. Every time you do the finger-gun gesture, one of the objects you touched will be propelled towards your target, the first one you touched being the first one to be shot. Also, the smaller an object is, the faster it will be propelled.
pros: You can shoot as many ammunitions as you can.
Projectiles are shot from where they are placed, so they can hit from any direction.
Since the target can be hit from any direction, there's a good surprise factor to your attacks.
cons: You are limited by the number of objects you can touch. (I'd recommend Remote Contact to reuse them)
The ammos are shot in the order you touched them. So, anyone can dodge if they remember the order.
Only non-living objects can be used as projectiles, and the bigger they are, the slower they are.

name: Innate Language
overview: access innate knowledge of language
description: If you have this ability, you automatically possess knowledge of a certain language or set of language. You may be fluent in the Romantic languages, German, Japanese, Computer-encrypted code or any other language that would not be innately possessed by people of your particular race (if you were Hispanic for example, you might possess innate knowledge of English or French); this usually implies any places that you'll visit in your life (when the situation arises, you'll be ready).
pros: Foreign language class anyone? (You can both understand and communicate the language)
Get around in the country that speaks that language
Good for disguises and espionage (and understanding foreign instruction manuals)
cons: If your language is a dead language (like Latin)
If you're stuck in a situation or place where no one speaks that language
You may only have knowledge of that language in a certain time period (like OLD Latin or OLD Greek)

name: Protective Blessing
overview: bless people with protection from harm.
description: With this superpower, you can bless others with protection from one harmful event of your choosing. The blessing lasts indefinitely and the event can be anything from being shot, a car accident, or getting sick. It's important to note that the blessing acts as a preventative measure. Being blessed AFTER the fact won't help any current situation. Also, only the latest blessing is active. Blessing against being cut is allowed, but that would prevent helpful surgical procedures, so bless wisely!
pros: Protect your loved ones (and yourself)
No fear of skydiving--just bless yourself from falling injuries
cons: One blessing at a time
Choosing the wrong blessing

name: Me, Myself And I
overview: have two extra minds in your head.
description: This power gives you great mental coordination, so great in effect you've developed two extra minds. Each functions separately and independently. Your minds are identical but hypnotism, mind control and telepathic powers affect them separately. This power could let you use three mental skills at once or three mental powers at once or one mind could use your senses while the other two focus on an opponent.
pros: Use three mental powers at the same time.
Telepathic powers only have 33 percent chance of success against you.
Think of the most powerful mental abilities and reread #1.
cons: Unless you're the Man-Thing and you have no mind.

name: Catch Master
overview: catch anything that is thrown to you
description: With this power you will automatically be able to catch anything that is thrown to you. You will never drop the ball in a sport game or anything else ever again. You can turn this power on and off so you aren't constantly catching grenades or bombs that are thrown at you by enemies.
pros: You can catch anything that is thrown to you
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Reality Flux
overview: cause reality to change randomly after only activating the power once
description: After an often random interval of time, reality would simply change to cause some new occurrence (normally in favor of the user of the ability), or until the power is deactivated.
pros: Gain the upper hand of foe
Get out of a situation
cons: Now telling what would happen, the flux may not even apply to the user.
Useless occurrences

name: Mental Ignition
overview: channel electricity through another person's brain, causing lethal damage.
description: Mental ignition requires one to put their hands on either side of another person's skull and charge their cranium with power. The electricity courses through the brain and effectively "fries" it, killing the victim with enough power. If the attack is not lethal, even a second of forcing electricity to directly enter the brain is enough to cause often-permanent damage.
pros: Have the ability to kill anyone at anytime from behind without a weapon. The attack cannot be seen.
Have the ability to impair an enemy mentally with a quick charge
Have the ability to mercilessly torture or threaten anyone with death and intense pain
cons: Very difficult to control the amount of electricity
Very risky to use on a person you do not wish to kill
Unusable if the attacker's hands are damaged or lost

name: Tactile Combustion
overview: set objects you touch alight
description: Your body is covered in a thin, invisible energy field which can spontaneously ignite any combustible material within it. If an object is touched, the field extends along it in a limited way, covering the object if possible, and linking to others to a degree. For example, if touching a person's hand, using the power on them would set their entire body alight, but using this on a table inside a house would only set the table alight. You are fireproof.
pros: Easily win any close combat fight
You're invulnerable to all flames
You can ignite the air around your hands, creating flaming auras for them
cons: Limited range
You're at a severe disadvantage against foes with guns, long range powers, etc.
Your tactile field cannot strech particularly far -- it can cover about two people

name: Dark Flare
overview: cast dark explosions
description: Dark power spheres are shot from the palm of the hand exploding on contact causing an explode radius of 5m.
pros: Good for breaching
Good for fighting groups of enemies
Good against anything that is elemental
cons: If used in close range it could end up harming yourself or others
Needs precise aim for maximum affect
Light elements are not affected by dark flare

name: Barrier Melting
overview: melt barriers one touches physically
description: Can melt any type of barrier by touching it. Forcefields,walls, shields, etc. Can be magical, physical, psychic, etc so long as it can be physically touched.
pros: No barrier can stop one's physical attacks.
Doesn't matter if the barrier is natural or supernatural.
cons: Have to touch the barrier.
Can't melt barries protecting the mind.
Doesn't extend to projectile attacks.

name: Einstein
overview: access Albert Einstein's intelligence
description: The ability to access Albert Einstein's intellect is a very help full gift, especially during a science pop quiz. You automatically know everything that he knew in life.
pros: Inventing weapons, armor and gadgets on the go
Quizzes and tests are a breeze
Automatically proficient in German
cons: Sometimes getting flashes of his thoughts
Feeling the need to do some thing great, this can be good or bad
People always bothering you to know what Einstein knew

name: Liquid Teleportation
overview: teleport liquids around you
description: You can teleport nearby bodies of liquid, up to the size of an swimming pool, to other locations that you can see. You have to point an index finger at the liquid to teleport it. The liquid will be teleported out of its container, leaving the container behind empty
pros: Teleport drinks out of cups or kegs into your glass
Teleporting the blood out of a foe. Bit messy, but it's quick
Get rid of puddles in your way
cons: Can only teleport liquids

name: Existence Blink
overview: change the dimension that a subject currently occupies
description: The ability to cause a subject's physical being to be removed from this plane of existence, and then relocated back to another dimension of the user's choosing. This can be used to send people back in time, to the future, to alternate dimensions, and the like. However, you can't relocate yourself. And if you can't decide where to send the foe, you have a short time before they return.
pros: You can transport anything (oncoming bullets, etc.)
They can be transported anywhere
They can also be brought back
cons: Can only keep them out of existence for a short time before they have to go SOMEWHERE
Can only transport them to existing dimensions (no making up NEW dimensions)
Can't transport yourself

name: Power Of The Chimera
overview: transform two different animals into a single new one, a chimera.
description: With this power you can transform two different animals into a single new one, this new animal specie will be called a Chimera. You can create the most powerful predator to ever existed by transforming great predators into one, like a Rhino and a Lion (weird one). But, if you make something too aggressive or too smart it might turn against you. You can't use this power on humans because they are too smart, and you must be careful while creating a Chimera, its a complicated process.
pros: You can create a powerful and unstoppable predator with the right animals.
You can create a powerful virus or bacteria too, since they are simple organisms.
Chimeras created by you will be always under your control, as long as you be careful with them.
cons: This power doesn't work on humans, they are too complex and smart.
You can't create something too aggressive or smart, it would turn against you.
Creating a chimera is a complicated process, if you forget to create a single artery it will die.

name: Total Self Bio Control
overview: control every non-element that has ever been part of your body
description: This ability lets you control anything that was ever a part of your biological body remotely. You can control dust that has been a part of your body and you can automatically summon them from any part of the world or universe. Biological implants that have synchronized with your own body can also be controlled. You cannot control things that have been turned into base elements like oxygen however. Carbon dioxide can also be controlled.
pros: Every time you spit saliva or pick booger or scratch yourself you add more particles to control
You can control your own blood and body as well as dust, sweat, filth, and dirt
If you have lived a long time this power is very very strong
cons: You cannot control diatomic particles or particles that have been converted into base elements
Controlled things have a tendency to mix when manipulating more than one object
Your controlled objects are highly combustable

name: Antinomian Persuasion
overview: persuade people to do the opposite of what you say
description: While this may seem more of a curse to some, it requires a bit of thought to see the true gift behind it. This ability is often called "Psychic Reverse Psychology", and for good reason. By telling anyone to do something, you subliminally compel them to do the opposite. So, in order to compel someone with this power, tell them what you don't want them to do.
pros: Works just as well as a normal psychic persuasion
Can make a person do anything within their power (even if they would find it morally questionable)
Compulsion is activated at will
cons: If it can't be suppressed
If it actually makes them do the things you reverse-compel them to do
People avoid conversations with you

name: Telepathic Prison
overview: trap people that use telepathy on you in your mind
description: With this power, the user has the ability to trap the consciousness of anyone who uses telepathy on them in a prison within their own mind. The user can then either talk to them from outside the prison and let them out or keep them trapped forever. When trapped, the person with telepathy cannot move their actual body. You can choose to ignore the person and go throughout your daily life, and the telepath will still be stuck in you. You can also "borrow" the telepathic abilities of the trapped.
pros: People with mind power have to go through a clearance check in order to enter your mind
You can either decide to let them out or keep them trapped
Within your mind, their telepathy only makes you stronger. So, they can't break out with their power
cons: Not useful, unless someone with telepathy uses it against you
They can still trick you into opening the telepathic door if they are good at being persuasive ...
... without telepathy

name: Thunder Ignitement
overview: unleash a long electrical flame in all directions.
description: Because of it, Thunder Ignitement is considered the most undisputed super-ability for anyone to use. It does damage and has a 100.0% chance of electrocuting and burning the target. It's also a long-range attack that fires in a straight line of up to 90 miles, and may cause a burn and shock.
pros: It's totally effective against Pod People.
cons: May cause maximum harm to someone you love most.

name: Full Sleep
overview: get a full night sleep in only 1 minute!
description: Ever had to wake up early for a job? For school? Ever get in a bet where, if you fall asleep first, you would lose? Well, you won't lose because you won't sleep for very long!
pros: Only takes one minute to sleep!
Go to sleep faster!
1 minute of sleep equals 12 hours of sleep!
cons: Your last time you'll ever sleep, you'll sleep for about a month and die in your sleep.
Snore horribly loud!

name: Myth Power: Aeon's Essence
overview: channel Aeon's command over the essence of eternal time, eternity and infinity
description: Aeon (Aion, Chronus, Chronos, Khronos), in Greek myth, was the god of eternal time, eternity or infinity. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the passage of time, and withstand age and temporal manipulation. In addition, by touch, one can psychically induce a trance, in which subjects try to count to infinity. Furthermore, one becomes effectively immortal; if ever fatally wounded, the soul leaves the body and solidifies into a new body, complete with a new soul of its own.
pros: Perceive the passage of time (Chronopathy); Withstand temporal manipulation (Time Defiance) and age
Psychically induce dazed Aeon Infinity Trance, by touch, in which subject tries to count to infinity
If ever killed, soul is released, and turns into a new body with its own soul (Aeon Immortality)
cons: Can't be used to manipulate/travel through time; still can die when power is NOT in use (NCN)
Pro #2 prevents foe from eating/drinking/sleeping (maybe bad for your conscience...)
Pro #2 is permanent until developed; cannot share Aeon Immortality by touch until developed (NCN)

name: Purifying Blasts
overview: fire blasts of energy that purify whatever evil they touch
description: The blasts are colored golden-white and anything they touch is purified of evil influence whether it is living or nonliving.
pros: You can purify anything of evil influence.
cons: Purifying humans might not change their habits or attitudes.
Purifying magical artifacts won't get lose powers but will lose curses.

name: Infinite Teeth Healing
overview: have your teeth heal completely even if it's broken in half or chipped.
description: With this superpower, your teeth will always heal. They will heal cavities and always be strong healthy and white. If your tooth breaks in half, it will heal itself in a matter of seconds. It heals using seemingly magical particles and the teeth enamel comes from a parallel universe. You will never have to worry about broken teeth or cavities ever again. It might be a highly advanced form of science that seems like magic that allows the teeth to instantly heal.
pros: Never worry about broken teeth again.
Never worry about cavities again.
Your teeth are always strong, white and healthy.
cons: Your teeth aren't any stronger than metal.
Your teeth can be knocked off whole out of your human gums.
Your teeth aren't perfect.

name: Geometry
overview: manipulate reality in immediate area
description: this allows you to project a 3-D graph of the immediate area. you can then manually change the graph, which reality then reflects. also acts as a map.
pros: change reality
cons: takes time

name: Idea Spheres
overview: hold ideas as a physical thing.
description: A noun is a person, place, thing or idea. An idea is the only one of those that you can't touch. Until now. This ability allows you to create glass spheres out of ideas. Images of that idea will be floating within the sphere. If the sphere breaks, the idea it contains will enforce itself on its surroundings. Create a Sphere of Freedom when you're in a jail cell. Create a Sphere of Destruction in the middle of a fight. Create a Sphere of Power to power your house.
pros: You can create idea spheres
There are hundreds of different spheres you can create
When the sphere breaks, its idea is enforced on its surroundings
cons: Your house will be covered in shelves of spheres
A sphere's surroundings almost always includes you
Some spheres are dangerous

name: Wish Granting Sword
overview: wield a sword that will grant your wishes (eventually depending on need)
description: A person wielding the Wish Granting Sword and selected people are given the ability to make their wishes come true. The wish granting sword does not give power right away but makes it possible and highly likely to happen. For example if one wished for power, the sword will turn heavy so the user can train.
