Stones will roll away, branches will bend to free the path, people or vehicles will move aside,... Anything that can be moved away will move. With some experience and a lot of energy, you could smash through unmovable objects, such as walls, trees or giant rocks, to clear a way through them. Movable things could even be violently thrown out of the way.
pros: Create a safe path through which you can venture.
Everything will be prevented from obstructing the way until whoever who had to cross crossed.
With enough energy, you could cause serious damage when you want things out of the way.
cons: Things can only be moved away, so holes which are uncovered won't be covered.

name: Compressure
overview: control air pressure
description: A person with this power can control air pressure. They can affect a whole vicinity with pressurized air and shoot cannons of pressurized air. The normal effects of increased pressure does not affect the user. Other people will get headaches by the changes in pressure.
pros: Give enemies headaches by quickly changing the air pressure
Can create pressurized air cannons
Immune to changes in pressure
cons: Tricky to use

name: Illusion Of Light
overview: create the illusion that your body is shining light
description: You can create the illusion that your entire body is shining a bright, white, light. This illusion will cause others to think you are a being of good, and will induce hope into them. With practice, you can cause an illusion of warmth.
pros: Create the illusion that your entire body is shining a bright, white, light
Induce hope into others
Takes practise to create an illusion of warmth
cons: It's just an illusion

name: Sensejack
overview: perceive the world using the senses of others.
description: This power lets you tap into the sensory input of another person, allowing you to see, hear, taste, feel, and smell as they do. You can ride around in their head as a spy, receiving information unnoticed, but you can't control their senses or actions - you can only observe. Line of sight is needed to tap into a target, but duration is unlimited. Skilled telepaths can detect and evict a sensejacker from a host mind.
pros: Real-time information flow.
Safe and anonymous observation from a distance.
On higher levels, you hear the person's thought what what they perceive
cons: Might have to jump from person to person until you get the right position and perspective.
You can't use your own senses.
You're subject to the limitations of their senses (poor eyesight, hearing, etc.)

name: Pencil Of Freedom
overview: write the world's best excuse for whatever situation you are in.
description: Be free from any restraint! In court? Grab a pencil, use the power, and write down what comes to mind. Simply read it off, and you'll have teary eyes and heads nodding that it was necessary. Ram someone's new Porsche? Start scribbling! The Pencil of Freedom is incredibly powerful, and is used almost universally for evil. Can be resisted by people who can shield their mind with superpowers.
pros: Never let it be your fault again.
Get out without blame.
Be truly free of all morality (unless you have a conscience. )
cons: You're a liar.
There may still be consequences from your actions that can't be controlled.
Have to have a pencil nearby to use it, and you have to get that idea to them.

name: Sociological Aptitude
overview: have an innate understanding of society.
description: With this ability you understand not only all slang terms, but also sarcasm, tone, body language and context, which you can interpret flawlessly. With this power, you will never accidently offend someone and always know exactly how to speak in a way which will not be taken the wrong way. Also offers advanced insight into the human psyche and other sociolgical processes. Perfect for all with Asperger's Syndrome.
pros: Perfect for those with Asperger's Syndrome.
Perfect for travelling.
Never accidently offend anyone again.
cons: Not useful in combat.
Less useful with Telepathy, Humanity One! , etc.
Useless if you don't speak to relative strangers much.

name: Zygote Mimicry
overview: be the omnipotent/totipotent, most powerful Cellular Mimic of all Cellular Mimics.
description: Zygote Mimics have two abilities. The first one is mitosis, the ability to duplicate oneself. The second one is to change this power into any Cellular Mimicry power you want. Beware as the second ability is irreversible, so make sure you have at least one clone left with Zygote Mimicry. Search the site with the keywords "cellular series" to get the list of available powers you can get.
pros: You can get any power in the Cellular Mimicry series.
You can clone yourself to outnumber a foe.
You can create an entire army of Cellular Mimics with various powers.
cons: If you change this power, you can't have it back.
If you change this power before creating any clone, you've just ruined this power's full potential.
Some Cellular Mimicry powers are arguably more useless than others.

name: Negating Energy Beam
overview: shoot a ray of energy that eliminates any source of heat, light, or sound energy.
description: This power is really effective if you're a firefighter. It is the type of power to put out suns because it is heat and light together. This power can be used in battles, because what would be the point if you would be killed by some thug. It only has one weakness: you must be close to the source of energy to perform this power.
pros: Good for battle.
Very powerful.
Effective against heat, light, or sound energy.
cons: Must be close to the source of energy.

name: Get This Power Button
overview: have the Get This Power button constantly active for you and you alone.
description: With this power, the Get This Power button on the Superpowerlist website is continuously and permanently active 24/7 for you and you alone. After you push the button, you will instantly and physically gain the power that the button appeared next to. It shall be permanently active and you can use this power to gain any powers that you have submitted to the superpowerlist website too.
pros: Gain any power on the Superpowerlist website you want.
Also works for your own submitted powers
cons: Still have to train to improve your control over the powers
Can still only get one power per day, despite the button being active all day

name: Reflexive Super Strength
overview: gain superhuman strength through one's own physical pain.
description: One with this ability gains superhuman strength from one's own physical pain (getting punched, stabbed, etc). The body of the user of this ability is more sensitive to pain than the average person. When the user's body's pain receptors react, it fuels their adrenaline and physical strength. The more one receives pain, the more strength the user gains.
pros: Gain super strength from an abundant source.
More sensitive to pain, means more strength.
cons: No pain no gain.
You can still feel pain and with this ability one is more sensitive to it which can cause blackouts

name: Chaotikinesis
overview: mentally create chaos and panic.
description: When you use this ability, you send out brainwaves that do two things. One, it causes everyone around to start panicing for no reason. And two, they create chaos around them. It could be anything, from a car crash to animals rampaging on the loose. This could be very powerful, even if you have no control of what sort of chaos it generates. You could even focus the chaos and panic into a certian target.
pros: You could create some chaos as a distraction.
You can focus your power on a certian target
cons: You or someone else could get hurt in the chaos

name: Lycanthropy
overview: shape-shift into a wolf-like form
description: Our word lycanthropy comes from an old story about a king who was turned into a wolf. The ability itself isn't so extreme. The user merely becomes a bipedal humanoid with a muzzle, fur coat, claws, and enhanced physical attributes. They are twice as strong, twice as fast, and their hearing and smell are 10 times as acute. Yeah. Merely.
pros: Scary
Lots of power
Great combat ability
cons: Can be overwhelmed by intense smells
Activates under extreme duress
Can fall into bezerker rages

name: Reality Breaker
overview: break reality
description: Breakers can control reality, though they must pay a price each time they do so (like give up your sight, or your left toenail); but each time you break reality, you have to give up a bigger price than the last one; they also have a certain type of intuition that allows them to sense reality, including the presence of others with superpowers and impending danger.
pros: You can bend and break reality however you want to
You can sense danger in others, even when they are not human
Your mind is the key to breaking reality
cons: You must pay a price for breaking reality
Each time you do so, the price only gets bigger
You must use it wisely or not at all; it could kill you if not careful

name: Celestial Flames
overview: create and control flames that burn evil
description: The flames will literally burn all evil from a person. All evil thoughts, habits, etc after being burned by these flames a person will have a clean mind and soul if not a clean body. You can only gain this power by mastering Golden Flames and by having a pure heart.
pros: The flames won't hurt anyone physically.
You can make the world a better place.
cons: Might feel a little mean to force people to become good.

name: Red Sun Rebirth
overview: manifest ultimate power during sunrise.
description: Ah, sunrise. The birth of the new day. But for you, the real beauty of it comes from the power you can harness from it! Upon witnessing sunrise, your body flows with energy that allows you to be virtually indestructible. Effects only last 1-3 hours, and it gives you a good reason to wake up early.
pros: Gives you ultimat power and control over the elements.
Sure beats coffee.
cons: You must be exposed to the sunrise's rays to activate it.
You also have to wait 1-3 minutes for it to work.

name: Myth Power: Zeus' Zenith
overview: channel Zeus' command over the essence of the sky, weather, fate and sovereignty
description: Zeus, in Greek myth, was god of the sky, weather, fate and kings; he himself was King of the Gods. As such, channeling him allows one to alter the very sky itself to pour forth its blessings or its wrath. One can call forth any aerial phenomena, from lovely rainbows and gentle rain to drought, flash floods, blizzards and thunderstorms. The user can even call forth fiery meteors, and wield lightning like a weapon. In addition, one can mentally perceive, communicate with and compel sovereigns.
pros: Call forth the phenomena of the sky (control the clouds, the air, the atmosphere, etc. )
Perceive, communicate with and compel anyone with an authoritative status
Immunity to probability manipulation or perception (Unpredictability)
cons: People with MythPower: Kronos' Craft often dislike you
People with MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige and MythPower: Hades' Haunt often envy you
At the lower levels, may become afflicted with an overwhelming sex drive

name: Anamnesis Embezzlement
overview: steal the memories of another by touch
description: Ever had an embarrassing moment in front of your crush? Well, all you have to do is "accidentally" bump into (or just touch) him/her and immediately be able to "pick-and-choose" which memory you want to steal, being your embarrassing moment. Basically, through touch you can see the memories of the person you are touching, and then steal and erase the memory from the person. The possibilities are endless!
pros: You can view the memories of others without having to experience them yourself.
You can steal and "erase" a certain memory that you don't want the person to have.
It's awesome!
cons: You have to be able to touch the person, or it won't work.
They have to have their mental barriers down in order for you to access their memories.
Once you "steal" the memory, the person will not remember the moment.

name: Reaper's Essence Absorption
overview: gain new abilities, properties, and powers for each creature you kill.
description: With this power, you absorb the essence of whatever you kill. It could be anything related to the creature, such as enhanced physical attributes (sight, speed, etc. ), skills, and even superpowers. However, the version of the ability you acquire is only about 5% as strong as that which belonged to the original creature. You can compound it with more killings, but only up to 50%. You also gain any associated weaknesses. You keep the new abilities forever, unless something supernatural interferes.
pros: Can collect many powers
Powers can be used to compliment one another
You'll have an edge against anything you've faced before, which grows greater with each success
cons: Each power will never be as powerful as the original
You must kill to gain powers
May not know what to do with all your powers (if you kill a lot)

name: Bursts Of Invincibility
overview: be invincible for short bursts of 5 seconds
description: A person with this power has invincibility but only in short burst at a time. For 5 seconds the person is invulnerable, unstoppable, and cannot be moved by anyone else. When invincible, any and all powers that target the user directly are negated. All weapons and bullets bounce off. The user becomes shiny when they are in an invincible state.
pros: You are invulnerable during 5 seconds
You will be unstoppable and unmovable by anyone else for 5 seconds
Through training, the user can use this power at crucial moments
cons: There is a 10 second period between bursts
You cannot extend invincibility to others but you can shield people
Can still be distracted during the 5 seconds

name: Weakness Mimicry
overview: morph your body into your opponent's weakness, according to their abilities
description: If you're fighting against Superman, you will grow Kryptonite armor and be able to shoot Kryptonite quills. If you're fighting Flash, you will be able to vibrate the ground under your feet to trip him up or at least make him lose traction. Fighting against Aquaman, you emit a drought-like heat that evaporates water quickly. All of these come from this one power, if it's for one specific weakness like Superman/Kryptonite or power-based weakness like Aquaman/No water to use.
pros: There is a high chance that you could win every fight.
Multiple opponents means mutiple adaptions
Their weaknesses never hurt you.
cons: If you're not facing that one person, you lose that adaptation.
If they have no weakness, which is highly unlikely, you will not be able to adapt.

name: Utopia
overview: rid the entire planet of all things harmful, dangerous, ugly, and undesired
description: Once you activate this reality bending power, anything and everything that is harmful, dangerous, ugly, and undesired will disappear forever, such as: pollution, war, homicide & suicide, physical & psychological disabilities, inner & outer ugliness, illness & disease.
pros: No more harm, danger, ugliness, or anything undesirable
cons: Too perfect?

name: Supersonic Soundwave
overview: ride soundwaves.
description: One rule to this power is, it can't be your soundwaves, it has to be the voice of someone else to be activated.
pros: Travels fast
Even works for whispers
Can go through walls
cons: Loud screech when riding
It can't be your voice you ride
It may get caught in tornadoes

name: Summoning: Elemental
overview: summon elementals.
description: You have the power to summon Elementals, beings of immense power. They serve you until you dismiss them back to their own plane. You are able to summon Elementals of Air, Earth, Fire, Water, Darkness, Light, and the minor Elementals such as Sand, Metal, and Lightning.
pros: Beings that defend and attack for you.
cons: Will attack you if you can't control them.

name: Redrum
overview: kill people by saying their name and raise them from the dead by saying their name backwards.
description: If you say anyone's name, he or she will die. If you say anyone's name backwards, they will come back to life. You can only use this power on people you have already met personally. If more than one person has the name you're saying, it will kill the person you met last.
pros: Kill your enemies
Resurrect your friends
cons: You can't say anyone's name unless you want to kill them

name: Personality Phrases
overview: change one's personality with phrases
description: You can change one's personality. For example, you can give somebody "Heart of an eagle". This is life-changing.
pros: Change personality with phrases
Improve one's life
cons: Saying a phrase into the mirror will backfire it upon yourself. (good or bad? )

name: Nuke
overview: make anything get hit with a nuclear explosion.
description: Become the ultimate weapon of mass destruction! With this ability, all you have to do is point at an object and say 'boom'. Whatever you just pointed at will explode as if a hydrogen bomb hit.
pros: Become the ultimate weapon of mass destruction
Destroy your enemy's hometown or fortress in an instant.
No one can stop you! Muhawhawhawhaw!
cons: Can accidentally hut allies
Won't work on roaches
Need to point at an object far away.

name: Sound Conversion
overview: turn sound into a concussive blast that depends on how loud the sound is
description: The person with this ability is able to turn sound in their surrounding into a concussive blast. The strength of the blast is dependent on how loud the sound is in the first place
pros: Sound is everywhere
Can be used to fight evil
cons: If you are rendered deaf you cant use this power

name: Power Induce
overview: induce the powers of someone with superpowers
description: You can force someone with superpowers to activate any of the superpowers he/she possesses.   You can do this by looking at that person or a picture of him/her, and then calling out the name(s) of the superpower(s) while you have 1 finger in your nose and 1 finger in your right ear.
pros: You can defeat a superpowered foe by inducing conflicting powers at the same time
You can help out your superpowered friend who has problems activating his superpowers.
cons: Have to resist the urge to play pranks on your superpowered friends.

name: Do I Exist?
overview: exist outside of everything.
description: With this power you exist outside of everything; this isn't exactly omnilock, as it has a few more limitations. You exists outside of time, allowing others not to affect time while you are around. You exist outside of space, allowing others not to send you through space/teleport you etc. You exist outside of probabilities, allowing you to resist luck changing, etc. You cannot be erased from existence and have knowledge of knowledge of the effects of Reality Warping happening.
pros: Exist outside of some (not all) things.
You resist some things.
cons: Not the true omnilock power.
Still not immune to most things.

name: Break
overview: break into shards that reform
description: You're about to get hit, what do you do?... Break! You will shatter upon contact, then reform. You can reform behind your opponent for a sneak attack or propel the shards at him. If some of the shards get stuck, your body won't reform completely and will bleed from where the shards were.
pros: Bullets won't go through you
Hits can't touch you
Cut somebody using your body shards
cons: If some body shard get stuck, you will get a a wound when you reform

name: Substitute
overview: replace yourself with a dummy to take damage
description: On a whim, you can disappear and be replaced by a life-sized cloth doll that will take damage for you. Great for pretty much any occasion. Naturally, you can still be caught by surprise. Any objects stuck in the dummy (bullets, axes, etc) will appear in your hand when you come back. You can also summon your dummy to anywhere around you for use as a shield or a diversion. If the dummy becomes completely shredded, you may have to make repairs to it before you can use the power again.
pros: Invulnerability
Looks both immensely cool and immensely goofy
Take weapons that are stuck in your dummy
cons: Requires maintenance
Can't do anything while in dummy form
Can still be taken by surprise and all that jazz

name: Regeneration Block
overview: prevent a person from healing until chosen
description: A person with this power has the ability to prevent a person's natural healing ability to heal from cuts or bruises or any type of damage. This also applies to regeneration. This may not seem like a great power at first but it is. Anyone hit by this ability will eventually be unable to fight due to the staggering amount of injuries and the pain from torn out muscles. Unless the original user deactivates it, the person remains affected. Death does not deactivate the power.
pros: Once you hit someone with this power it will only be a matter of time
Death by a thousand cuts--you would be a master of torture with this ability
Outlast other people in sporting events if you are evil with this ability
cons: People can still sew themselves up or make external repairs (still not as good as regular healing)
Only works on organic tissue

name: Aura Dissipation
overview: make other people's aura vanish.
description: Aura is a subtle force outside our bodies. Most of the time, it is described as an external 'energy-like' colored presence, though auras vary in many characteristics most of them have very amazing abilities. A person with this ability has the power to make such auras vanish or be destroyed; thus eliminating all potential threat from abilities emanating from these auras.
pros: Instantly destroys the presence of other people's aura.
Your own aura is immune to this ability.
cons: Has no other offensive use other than eliminating auras.
Will cause a bit of pain if reflected back to you.

name: Counterfeit Doppleganger
overview: create a "double" of yourself, except he/she doesn't resemble you at all.
description: This power is just like any cloning power out there. Except you can only create one clone. And the clone doesn't look like you, act like you, think like you or even dress like you. At. All! Well, they still are the same gender as you. When you're done, you can unsummon your "clone". You cannot change how he/she looks like, the same one will always appear.
pros: The avantage compared to other cloning powers is you don't have to explain why there are two of you.
The clone will generally be on your side since you can unsummon them whenever you want.
cons: You can only create one clone and he/she won't even look like you.
Your clone may look more handsome/beautiful than you.
tags: was edited as it was just a unimaginative combination of two unrelated powers

name: Fear Of Thought
overview: touch someone and see their greatest fear.
description: The power to touch someone and see their greatest fear. When you touch them, they will see their greatest fear for a couple of minutes, even though it is an illusion.
pros: You can place an illusion of fear on a person.
You can control your powers.
cons: You may see YOUR greatest fear if you touch the person for too long.
Animals are immune to it.

name: Pyrotechnics
overview: generate bright bursts of multi-colored energy plasmoids from fingertips
description: Ability to generate plasmoids (fireworks)from fingertips
pros: You can control where the fireworks go
You can increase or decrease their size
You can create the shape of the fireworks nd explode them when u wished
cons: They can blind someone

name: Empathic Replication
overview: create replicates that represent each of one's emotions
description: One with this ability can summon replicates of oneself to assist, defend or do other tasks, but each replicate is only produced by releasing that emotion template from one's psyche and solidifying it as though it were a separate entity. This ability is often accompanied by Empathy or an empathic rapport with one's replicates (this allows the user to keep track of the replicates at all times)
pros: As many emotions as you are capable of experiencing, you can project as replicates
They're connected to your psyche, so they don't go rogue (and you can read their thoughts/emotions)
They may manifest abilities of their own based on the emotions they represent
cons: Exaggerated personalities based on the feeling they represent
This form of replication may trap you in the emotional state you were in when you replicated
This form of replication may devoid you of emotion completely until you recall the duplicates

name: Mirror's Edge
overview: create bizarre spaces interwined with each other.
description: This allows the user to separate light and dark matter. The user is then free to form the dark components into any scenery which will then affect the light components, and vice versa. Destroying one half of the space will affect the other half.
pros: Can easily travel through impossible areas.
Dissappearing ground can be a nasty surprise.
Fun to watch.
cons: Won't distinguish friend from foe.
Could wreck home by mistake.
Heavily damages spacial stability.

name: Research Zone
overview: create a zone that promotes intelligence and new discovery.
description: Creates a zone that increases the intelligence of those inside. Those inside will not be able to suffer from anything that causes a decrease in their mental powers. Objects inside the zone can be turned holographic with a computer screen appearing in front of them that contains information about the object. Experiments can be performed on the holographic items and then returned to their original state if desired. Living things will not be turned holographic but will have a double of themselves.
pros: Mental protection.
Increased intelligence.
Ability to study and experiment on objects.
cons: Your enemies will become smarter as well.
People may perform experiments on things you do not want them too.
Can only study what is in the zone.

name: Power Resonance
overview: fire a wave that resonates with another being and causes them to explode
description: The blast will resonate at the other being's resonation levels causing them to be energized to a point they can't contain. Thus they explode.
pros: Kills an enemy which means you don't have to worry about them.
cons: They can still resurrect.
You can only kill with this power.

name: Unfriendly Fire
overview: never damage your friends or allies with your powers
description: This power avoids all friendly fire. Some examples. You cast a huge meteor to drop in an area with both foes and friends and only the foes would get squashed. Your allies and friends would just stand unharmed in the crater. When you shoot randomly with automatic gun at a group of people, then only the foes get hit.
pros: No more risk hurting any your friends.
You could use some brutal methods to separate friends from foes.
You can go all out even when your friends haven't been brought to a safe place.
cons: If you don't have any friends, this power would be rather pointless.

name: Name Changer
overview: change the name of anything/anyone for a while.
description: With this superpower, you can change the name of anything and anyone for a while. The effect last anywhere from 5 hours to 10 days. If people object to you changing the name of something to something else before you use this power, the effect last 3 hours or less. Imagine people calling flowers "aliens" or calling dogs "hats". Calling souls "soles", or changing the cat's name from whiskers to "tom". People won't notice the difference. You can only affect 3 to 10 depending on practice.
pros: Change the name of anything or anyone. Even change someone's very name.
Call a box a rollercoaster.
You'll have fun when people call school "pooper".
cons: Last a short while.
Changing the name of something will not affect how it works.
Typically not very powerful at all.

name: Your Super Smash Bros. Powers
overview: use your movements as you would if you were part of the videogame called Super Smash Brothers
description: Use your moves and powers you would have if you were part of the videogame called Super Smash Brothers. The videogame called Super Smash Brothers is a videogaeme about combat in which they compete and fight the characters of Nintendo, all the powers and abilities of the characters in the videogame called Super Smash Brothers are based on the skills and powers used in his previous Nintendo videogames. This super power is just like that. This super power is inspired of Super Smash Brothers games.
pros: You can find out how they could be your movements, abilities and powers in Nintendo's videogames
You probably also have a lot of abilities and powers that you used in your current life
You can also use the shield using the characters in the videogame called Super Smash Brothers
cons: This ensures superpower not know what your life as a series of Nintendo
You can only use certain abilities and super powers about yourself
Your shield is not eternally invulnerable to all

name: Reaper Shadow
overview: transform your shadow into a reaper
description: With this power you can transform your shadow into a real reaper to do your bidding and as your shadow it will be entirely loyal to you. Since reapers are invisible to normal people you can kill invisibly, only you and others with this power can see it. They are not affected by light but also not invincible, so can be defeated by other reaper shadows. The reaper will express your personality so will be unique but maybe won't wield a scythe, also as long as it is summoned you won't have a shadow.
pros: Get revenge on anyone
Become a great assassin
Always have a friend by your side
cons: Will have no shadow while summoned so can be spotted by someone aware
Your reaper might not wield a scythe instead wielding another weapon like a dagger

name: Lavakinesis
overview: create and control lava and magma
description: The user can create lava and magma as energy blasts, create lava hammers, lava tigers, lava tornadoes, or anything else the person can think of. Similar to a green lantern power ring, it's limited only the person's imagination.
pros: You can use your imagination
You can absorb lava from volcanoes that gives you energy
cons: If a character s can absorb energies or is immune to hot energies
Not immune to others with the same power, or that can use fire, heat, or any other hot energy

name: Living Memory
overview: be a living memory
description: A person with this power becomes a living memory. As long as somebody in the world remembers you, you will continue to exist. You have enhanced strength as a memory since you are not bound by physical constraints and you do not age. You also regenerate. However, you can only appear to people who know you and can only be introduced to people by people who know you. You are not visible to cameras or other things that don't have sentience. You can also appear in people's dreams.
pros: It's very hard to kill you since you are a memory
You are not bound by physical limits or the constraints of a physical body
You can automatically appear in front of anybody who knows you
cons: People with memory wiping powers can wipe you from everyone's memory
If you are hit with power negation, you will cease to exist.
You will not be visible to a camera, so you won't leave a visual image for people to remember

name: Pokemon Summoning
overview: summon any Pokemon
description: With this power you can summon any non-legendary Pokemon. The Pokemon are under your control. When you summon a Pokemon for the first time they are at level five but the more you summon it and train it the stronger it gets.
pros: You can summon any Pokemon
cons: They start at level five
You can't summon legendary Pokemon

name: Second Time Around
overview: never lose to an opponent you've already faced once before.
description: You've got a strange sort of aura always hanging over you. Whenever you face a person in combat, regardless of whether you win or lose, their every movement, habit and ability is recorded in your mind. If you survive the first encounter and by chance, you ever battle that person again, your body automatically responds, dodges and perfectly counters any ability they throw at you.
pros: After facing anybody once, you can never lose to them again.
There's nothing cooler than a guy that CAN'T be hit.
cons: If you die during your first encounter, you're pretty much screwed.
No practical use whatsoever outside of combat.

name: Life Force Block
overview: use one's inner energy to temporarily stop the flow of life energy of another being.
description: The ability allows the user to temporarily immobilize any other being. The effect ceases after a few hours. This also gives the victim an appearance of death. It can also act as a minor energy blast that damage solid objects.
pros: Immobilizes living beings or spirits.
Long time until the effect wears off.
cons: Doesn't affect any other form of energy.

name: Explosion Stare
overview: stare at something and it will explode.
description: If you look at something for more then 3 seconds, the object you are looking at will explode. The only exception is for liquids and non-inflammable gases. It will work on solids, energy (energy blasts, lightning, forcefields), or inflammable gases. Just don't stare at something or someone you don't want to SEE die. If your mind goes out of focus and you're just looking at something, then that doesn't count. Your mind actually has to be staring at it, not just blankly looking at it.
pros: Solids, energy, and special gases will explode if you stare at them for too long.
You can blast through anything, even forcefields.
You will scare people away, so you can win almost any fight.
cons: You could destroy stuff that you don't want to destroy.
If you stare at a girl's butt too long, the girl will explode and you will never have sex with her.

name: Akasha Viewing
overview: mentally connect to the realm that keeps ALL records of ALL things.
description: It is a rare and an extremely powerful Godlike psychic ability that enables the user to connect one's mind with the Akasha realm. A realm that keeps infinite records of everything that has been done then, now and will be in the existence of infinity. The user not only sees things that happened, but sees the facts in their purest and truest form in reality.
pros: If the user has enough energy, control and power, the user CAN summon this at will.
This power never deceives the user.
The user has a Godlike knowledge of almost everything that has been and will be.
cons: The effect lasts for a short time. Even a God is not able to have a FULL connection with it.
Things that are frightening or bad can come unexpected and may terrify even the toughest user.
It drains the user's energy. If the user dwells within this state for too long, the user dies.

name: Aura Wolf
overview: be an aura-wolf
description:
You will be able to change between a human and a wolf! 
You can manipulate aura in either form and sense the aura in all things living. You can live forever, simply by changing your form at least once a day! 
Aura wolves also can use their aura to heal exponentially faster than regular medicine. Plus, you have all the regular abilities of a wolf such as enhanced smelling, strength and reflexes!!!
pros: You can change your form whenever you want to and live forever
Be a wolf!
Manipulate Aura(make aura-weapons, fly, heal, use as projectiles, etc... )
cons: Aura exhaustion can occur
Don't change daily, don't live forever

name: Universal Time Stop
overview: prevent a day from ending
description: A person with this power has the ability to freeze time for everyone. The clocks will not turn at all. There are no ill effects such as Earth's rotation stopping, etc. Time has just stopped until the user says it should go on. When this power is activated, no one will notice until they check their watches/clocks.
pros: No one will age or die unless killed directly
People can still act during this time
Lots of free time
cons: You will have to be on the job longer-Employers would give you more to do.
Someone will try to find out who stopped time
If you die, time will forever be stopped

name: Emotional Gas Emission
overview: emit different gasses depending on your mood.
description: The gases you emit have different effects depending on how you feel. If you feel happy or joyful, you might emit laughing gas. If you want someone to go to sleep or die, you might emit sleeping gas or poisonous gas. Some gases can cause diseases or create hallucinations. Some of them even have the power to heal.
pros: You can activate this power by simply blowing the gas out of your mouth.
You aren't affected by the gases if you don't want to be.
The gases are invisible so no one can see them and run away from them
cons: Sometimes, this power activates automatically by coming out from your pores.
It can also activate when you fart, but not all the time.
Could affect yourself

name: Electronic Communication
overview: intercept and generate electronic or digital transmissions
description: A person with Electronic Communication is a recieving station for all manner of digital transmission--every IM, e-mail, and satellite transmission in the area is theirs to 'see' or 'hear'. They can also send out IMs or e-mails, like a human cell phone. However, while they are able to read unencrypted messages easily, encrypted messages take a while to understand.
pros: No need for a cell phone for IMs
Can send IMs or e-mails
Spy on governments or people
cons: Takes a while to decrypt encryptions
Intelligible range depends on strength of mind
May be overloaded by massive amounts of digital information

name: Doxiakinesis
overview: be able to answer any question directly put to you.
description: Any question anyone directly asks you i. E what is the meaning of life, you would be able to answer, you don't know everything, but you will remember what the answers were. The questions would have to be directed towards you. You aren't forced to answer the question, you can keep it to yourself or lie.
pros: Become an expert with quizzes.
Can gain any knowledge you want.
Can easily learn the truth.
cons: Information could confuse or contradict your beliefs.
Some things you are better off not knowing.
Has to be asked to you directly

name: Dust
overview: turn your body into a living sandstorm powerful enough to flay the flesh off your enemies
description: You're able to turn your body into a living sandstorm, blinding enemies or attacking them with slashing dust, which can get so severe as to flay the flesh off your victims. However, in order to turn back into your normal self, you need to go back into the clothes you came out of.
pros: Leave your enemies with scars
Blind your enemies
cons: Must get back into previous clothes

name: Forced Reversion
overview: undo changes done by superpowers.
description: Sick of Perfect Immortality and other powers which change the body of the user? Then this is the perfect power for you - you can undo any change done by superpowers, even if they can't do so themselves. With practice, you can prevent such powers (e.g. Reality Warping) from working when around you. Needless to say, this power is best used as part of a team. If a foe is adaptive, he or she will have all adaptations stripped until they are re-adapted away from you.
pros: Excellent defense against Perfect Immortality
Great against a power mimic.
You can free people of changes done by another's powers.
cons: This power can only be used in certain situations
Don't use this on an ally with Immortality who is hundreds of years old.
If you undo something beneficial, this power cannot restore it.

name: Absolute Zero Temperature
overview: bring objects to and from absolute zero without damaging them.
description: Bring an object to absolute zero temperature, which is 0 degrees Kelvin. The object isn't damaged by the rapid loss or gain of heat. While at absolute zero, not even the smallest parts of the object will be able to move, such as its electrons. Since the object will have no heat energy while at absolute zero, it will have no energy to move, and will remain unmovable while you keep it at absolute zero. The object won't absorb heat from objects around it because you are keeping it at the same temp.
pros: Freeze foes.
Objects become immovable.
Objects are unbreakable and unchangeable while at absolute zero.
cons: Objects will become stuck in space as the Earth moves away from them.
Do not use on yourself or you will become a statue in space.
Frozen objects will dig straight through a planet if the planet moves across where the object is.

name: Offense Shield
overview: be protected from the kinetic force you cause to other things. Read Description.
description: This power is kind of like invulnerability, but it works only one way. If you punch a wall, the wall gets damage, but not you. If you body slam someone, they recieve damage, but not you. You are not protected from kinetic damage directed toward you. If a car hits you, you receive damage. If someone punces you or you get hit by bullets, you receive that kinetic damage and get hurt. It only protects from the kinetic damage you attack with, not the kinetic damage coming towards you.
pros: Be protected from damage your attacks cause.
Protection against any kinetic damage you direct towards other things.
You can finally punch the wall without getting hurt.
cons: Does not protect you from kinetic force directed towards you.
If someone punches you of you get hit by a car, you recieve that kinetic damage.
Only useful if you attack.

name: Circadian Control
overview: change the flow of the day, changing night to day or vice versa
description: The user is able to change the flow of the day. The movement of time is still the same, but the Earth is just rotated rapidly. The user can change night into day and day into night.
pros: Good against opponents who rely on the sun
Good against opponents who rely on the moon
cons: A very hard power to master

name: Dark Fire
overview: control the ancient forces of fiery passion and darkest sin.
description: In return for becoming a guardian of the legendary dark fire lord, your blood is infused with the poison of the black phoenix. Control the shadows and create flame. Coat yourself in shadows to create a twenty second unbreakable shield. Mix the flame with the shadow to summon forth the mighty dragon ras'khan.
pros: Create things out of shadow.
Ride on a dragon.
Become invincible.
cons: The poison will eventually take over your body and turn you into a monster.
A slave for the dark fire lord until the poison takes over you.
A long scar must be etched into your arm for the poison to be injected by the phoenix.

name: Mathematical Intuition
overview: instantly know the solution to any mathematical problem.
description: With Mathematical Intuition you can solve anything from 3489x243+21 to a rubiks cube in seconds flat. This can also have amazing accuracy by applying geometry to the situation.
pros: Can solve the most difficult puzzles quickly.
Be an amazing marksman
cons: This power only applies to mathematics

name: Hermes' Helmet
overview: run fast whenever the user wears Hermes's Helmet
description: The person who posses Hermes' Helmet will be able to run very fast, approximately the speed of lightning. The helmet will stay on the user as long as he or she wills it. If the user is knocked out, the helmet has a small chance to get dislodged from their head. Another person can't use this helmet unless the current user gives it to the other person for them to use
pros: Can run really fast
Can deliver a barrage of fast punches
Can be the first on the scene of the crime.
cons: Has a chance to get dislodged from the user's head if they are knocked out
Might phase out of the physical realm if they run to fast

name: Unerring Aim
overview: have an unerring aim when the user has a bow and arrow
description: The person with this power has an unerring aim whenever they use a bow or arrow. People with this power do not make any mistakes when they fire an arrow from their bow. Not even a strong wind will veer it off its course
pros: An arrow will always hit its target
You will never hurt a person you don't plan to hurt.
cons: Only can be used on a bow and arrow

name: Wards
overview: create magical energy wards
description: Energy wards are magical constructs set up by someone as a warning/defensive system. To create a ward you must first mentally visualize the area you place the ward in. Next you must focus your own magical energy into one marble sized energy ball. Then mentally move the ball in the shape of the ward you want. The ball will etch a energy trail behind it until you cease to direct it. How much energy you put into determines the strength of the ward.
pros: You can create magical energy wards of varying strengths
You can control the power level
The wards become invisible when you stop focusing on them and only you can see them with your mind
cons: Forgetting to take down a high-power ward
Though you can't be affected by wards your friends can

name: Flow Disruption
overview: disrupt the flow of power
description: Power naturally gathers in an area of the body, generally the heart. When using a power, some of that power flows from the gathering place to where it is needed. With this power, you can "disrupt" or block the flow. This in turn stops the use of powers on certain parts of the body for a shot period of time. This powers requires the target to be physically touched. This power does not stop energy needed to keep an area alive from getting to the area.
pros: Enemy can't use any power on part of their body for a short while.
Stops the power currently being used from getting more power.
The flow of power will slowly return to the affected area.
cons: Have to touch the target.
The blockage only stops power for a short while.
Con Negation and similar powers do not work on this power, Power Safety etc. do

name: Human Interface
overview: control what you do, when, where and how long for.
description: You are able to bring up your own interface, with it you can decide how long you want to sleep, exercise etc for example you can set your self to skip till after work entirely, you still hold the memories of work but didn't drag yourself through it. You just bring up the interface and set yourself to work for the whole day and your body takes over, you just skip ahead to when the task you have set is over.
pros: A days work over in a flash
The tiring hours at the gym over in seconds
Be able to study and remember perfectly, AND be your own alarm clock
cons: Can throw you off as 8 hours can pass in seconds
You are brought out of your "sleep" to make any major decision
You might miss out on experiencing something great

name: Blackstars
overview: throw black ninja stars that explode on contact.
description: When the power is used, you can take a stack of black shurikens and throw them at the opponent. Then, it all disappears. It will appear on the first object, enemy, wall, etc. straight in front of where you threw it. It will flash red and then explode. All this happens in one or two seconds, depending on the distance. You can throw a deadly multitude of shurikens at the foe, covering their entire body before throwing the last one into the head, causing the opponent to fall and explode.
pros: Could even make doors explode when in contact.
cons: In water, the entire process slows down the speed, including the period of time.

name: Heart Of Light
overview: be instantly resurrected and erase person's evil influence.
description: The Heart of Light is a pendant radiating a mysterious aura, capable of resurrecting just about any/everyone. You can even resurrect yourself, heal someone who's sick or injured, and erase a person's evil curse.
pros: It can also resurrect a hero.
cons: None.

name: Super Followthrough
overview: increase the impact of any object you throw
description: A person with this power can create a super-localized time stop which also removes the touched object from current timeline to increased their follow through without decreasing their force allowing them to make big impacts without Newton's third law being in the way--ie you use a small force but you apply it over a long time making a big impact. Naturally this can be used to send things flying with huge momentum.
pros: All you need is to be good at throwing and everything becomes a deadly weapon
Newton's third law does not get in they way--your applied force is small
Effects are only active in real time so no one knows that time was stopped
cons: No superstrength---its all about the time

name: Serpentry
overview: transform into, and control any type of serpent.
description: With this ability, you can transform into any serpent / snake at will. This includes Pythons, King Cobras, Anacondas, etc. You also gain all of their characteristics, including scales, venom, etcetera etcetera. You also have the ability to control them, and speak to them, giving them orders.
pros: You can shock people by turning into different types of snakes.
Even when you're not in snake form, you can control snakes.
cons: It might not be a good idea to bring snakes around other people, just a thought.

name: Chirality Reflection
overview: change any object into its mirror image based on a point of chirality
description: A chiral object is an object that is not equal to its mirror image. A person with this power has the ability to turn any object or part of an object into its mirror image. In addition this power can be used selectively to target only a single chirality center or point of difference. This power can work on a molecular level to synthesize compounds or prevent someone's body from working correctly.
pros: Give your enemies two left feet--to trip them up
Can make it easy to synthesize hard to make compounds
Can switch which arm someone hits you with or simply just make their body not function properly
cons: Less useful, if the user is not skilled enough to affect molecules
Useless against something that is symmetrical

name: Incandescence
overview: increase body temperature and emit a bodily glowing light
description:
The Incandescence ability has two facets: the ability to increase the body's rate of metabolism, leading to an increased body temperature and surge of physical stamina, and the ability to emit a glowing light through bioluminescent molecules in the skin, triggered by the aforementioned high levels of body heat.

This power is activated by stimulating the brain tissue which causes religious experiences.  This stimulation can be prompted by meditation, prayer, etc. Suits holy men or paladin types.
pros: Resistance to cold
Constant access to light, and a counter against darkness-based superpowers
Increased physical stamina and alertness
cons: Increased use of calories, leading to more rapid exhaustion.
Lack of stealth while using ability.
Requires self-confidence and a state of calmness.

name: Money Multiplier
overview: double the amount of cash you have.
description: You can only use it 10 times a day on cold hard cash, if you want to double your money. Example: If you have 1 dollar, double it once to get $2, double again for $4 and again for $8.   It won't last more than 24 hours, so you need to spend immediately!
pros: Double your money!
cons: Only works on cash.
You can't save the money. You need to spend it within that day.

name: Trivia Finder
overview: tell what someone else has in common with you.
description: Having a hard time finding the words? Possessing the Trivia Finder ability allows you to instinctively tell when someone has something in common with you. Impress the people around you with your knowledge, and never worry about party lines again.
pros: Helps you talk to members of the opposite sex.
Its much easier to find people with the same hobbies as you.
It makes it easier to make friends.
cons: No real combat ability.
It only works if you both know the same thing.

name: Living Nightmares
overview: bring others nightmares to life.
description: Lets just say your enemy's worst nightmare is being kissed by his grandma in public...ha ha... you could make it happen! To use this power you need lots of concentration, enough to bring it to life.
pros: It scares the enemy half to death.
cons: It could attack you.

name: Creature Bonding
overview: merge two or more creatures together into one
description: First you think of the animals, plants etc. Then, put your hand in a stop position and point it somewhere. That is the place the thing will go.
pros: No matter the distance between the animals you can merge them.
It doesn't matter if they aren't animals; they can be plants, fungi, bacteria, spirits & prehisoric
cons: They always come out different when you merge the same animals
You can't take the animals back out after you join them
You can't bond non-living things.

name: Death Existence
overview: unconditionally exist as long as death exists.
description: A person with this ability has the power to remain in existence as long as there is death (or the absence of life) in the universe. When this ability is active the user's state of mind (meaning its condition, freedom and abilities) is safeguarded by the ever existing death. This ability also safeguards itself and other 'death-powered' abilities like necromancy, death manipulation, and other death dealing abilities ever created from being nullied, manipulated, or dampened.
pros: Be the ultimate being of death.
This ability and other's that induce, or manipulate death are totally immune from nullifications etc
You, your mind and your soul will forever be free from destruction & manipulation.
cons: You are not alive and somehow not dead.
Your pain and suffering will eternally haunt you.
In the end you will wish you were dead.

name: Geothermal Energy
overview: attract geothermal energy within the Earth's core and use it.
description: Using this power you can attract geothermal energy within the Earth's core and use it. Whether it be to power your house or use it in battle such as attracting the actual magma.
pros: Multiple uses, it can power your house.
You can summon magma from the Earth's core in battle.
The Earth's core does not 'open' just because you are attracting energy.
cons: If you use the magma for more than an hour at a time it will become dangerous.
You have to use magma only twice a day. (though the energy is unlimited)

name: Blessing Of Hekate
overview: have the blessing Of Hekate
description: Hekate is the Greek god of magic. Her blessing gives you the ability to use Greek magic. You can control magical fire amd turn people into animals. Also, you'd be able to use words and symbols from Ancient Greek for various effects. For example, saying the Greek word for "lift" might allow you to levitate things or people. Or if you draw the Greek symbol for "serve" on a rock it might transform into a rock creature bound to your will.
pros: You can use Greek magic
You're very powerful
You know Ancient Greek.
cons: Using symbols and words in Greek might be tricky unless you practice.

name: Dream Consumption
overview: mentally consume dreams and gain strength and other heightened senses.
description: Simply one with this ability mentally consumes the dreams of others, thus gaining strength and other heightened senses from doing so. Consuming nightmares does not affect one in anyway, one may even gain more strength from these nightmares. One can can also eat day dreams and you can't starve to death from not eating dreams that often.
pros: Gain power from eating dreams.
Certain dreams dont hurt you.
Nightmares or extremely good dreams give you even more power.
cons: Must eat dreams to gain power.
Almost useless for combat, but nevertheless can be used in these situations

name: Monster Creation
overview: change objects into monsters with a random power
description: The rules include: that the monsters do what you want them to do and they have to be inanimate objects to begin with.
pros: Getting rid of bullies
Doing things without getting blamed
Get what you want
cons: No one gives you the credit you deserve
The creatures attack you when you are knocked out
Creatures disintegrate once defeated

name: Atom Construction
overview: create atoms from particals in the earth's soil and in the atmosphere.
description: Creates atoms using particals from the atmosphere and the earth. If used correctly, the caster can create items out of it. However, forming and combining atoms takes time unless the ability is mastered.
pros: Good for a sheild
Good for an explosive if used correctly
Can be used as a source for items or an offense.
cons: Takes a long time to master.
Can be very unstable.
If used incorrectly, it can kill the caster

name: Mood Stone Jewelry
overview: wear a necklace, two bracelets and a ring which change the power they give depending on your mood.
description: With these "Moon and Star" themed artifacts, you can use almost any power depending on the color. If you're happy, you gain the ability to cause powerful euphoria to the saddest person alive. If you're excited, you get the power of electricity. If you're angry, you gain the power of fire. It all depends on your mood. There are thousands of moods. If you wear all three artifacts at the same time, you will glow the same color as the artifacts's mood stone, and your power multiplies by 900!
pros: Use almost any power.
Be all-powerful and well-rounded.
Have all 3 artifacts, and you can GO OVER 9000!!!!
cons: Don't use drugs while you're wearing one of them.

name: Confessions
overview: make any person fall under a hypnosis for the user to do whatever (like a slave)
description: The user puts a person under there control for the rest of there life (no undoes). The user stares into the subjects eyes and readjusts his/her mind to follow and obey. People aren't sure how this is possible but it is sure it is a family trait.
pros: This can make peace with people
Perfect lie detector
Makes criminals good
cons: Slaves
People can die easier at a sound of a vocal box
Heroes can turn bad

name: Sleep Benefits
overview: gain superhuman strength and durability from sleeping
description: The duration of your rest corresponds to your power level; a cat nap is much less beneficial than a full-night's sleep. You could lift a maximum of a couple tons and survive a large explosion. As you spend time awake, your powers decrease until you have been awake longer than you have been asleep.
pros: Various levels of superstrength and durability
Incentive and excuse to sleep more
cons: Your powers will begin to lessen as you spend time awake
If you cannot obtain sleep you are powerless

name: Drug Touch
overview: cause someone to feel the effects of any drug by touching them
description: If you have heard of the name of a drug and its effects, you can cause a person to feel their effects by touching them, only when you have skin to skin contact. The drug will actually manifest in the subject's system. You can replicate recreational and medicinal drugs, and control the dosage created. The subject's body will burn through the drug at the normal rate, and you have to touch them again to remedicate.
pros: You can treat the ill and needy by giving them expensive medicines for free
You could make a lot of money giving people the effects of recreational drugs
If in great danger, you could sedate an attacker, or give them a lethal overdose
cons: Your power doesn't work on yourself
You need to research drugs and medicines to use your power to its full potential
Drugs you create still have their full side-effects

name: Canine Mimicry
overview: take on characteristics and abilities of canines, such as wolves, coyotes, foxes and other species
description: Canines are one of the dog family on Earth. A canine mimic has a power that allows the person to take on or duplicate on the natural abilities of canine species, such as superhuman senses, physical attributes of strength, speed and agility. They can also track down preys.
pros: Keen sense of smell, hearing, and eyesight
Extreme physical strength, speed and agility
Easily provoked and quick to anger
cons: If you cannot smell
You are very sensitive to loud music and vibrations, etc.

name: Blessing Of Helios
overview: be blessed by the greek God of Sun, Helios
description: The user is blessed by the Greek Sun Titan, Helios. After the user is blessed, he or she will be able to shoot bolts or beams of fire and command fire.
pros: A good offensive power
Can put out fires with the control over fire
cons: Vulnerable to water

name: Sorcerium (Liquid Metal)
overview: create and control a liquid metal that is immune to magic of any kind
description: This metal is immune to magic and can be fully manipulated into any shape at higher levels. At lower levels it is only resistant to magic and can only be in the rough shape of weapons or armors. Note: the metal is NOT Mercury aka Quicksiler or Hydrargyrum.
pros: Protect yourself from magic by covering youself with the metal.
cons: People who can control magentism can take control of this metal.

name: Astral : Mantra Plane.
overview: access the mantra plane
description: This power allows the user to access the Mantra Plane. If the user meditates in the Mantra Plane one can highten their senses and physical prowess to the zenith of human potential. It also powers up any other powers the user has. It also allows the user to gather mantra energy which powers up. It also allows the user to make contracts and summon the several beings living on the Mantra Plane.
pros: One can attack with a mantra energy which can be used in different ways out the body.
One can summon beings for help
One can train themself to the zenith of human potential
cons: The beings can choose to break their contract if the user is either weak or evil
The mantra energy varies in power depending on the way it's used so it's not very reliable
The mantra energy could overload if not balanced

name: Half Dragon (Eastern)
overview: be half-human, half-dragon
description: Someone with this power has higher strength, speed, and magical power than ordinary humans. They can cause the weather to become rain, shapeshift, and fly without wings. They will also have claws and fangs.
pros: You have a more altrustic personality than western half-dragons.
You can always have rain when it is needed while growing food.
You are also far wiser than most beings most of the time.
cons: Beware of using your rain power when the gods want a drought.
The 3rd pro also comes with the con of sometimes being more stupid than most beings.

name: Valuable Excrement
overview: you excrete valubles from your rear.
description: Instead of producing waste, you excrete valuables depending on the day of the week. Monday it's gold. Tuesday it's diamonds. Wednesday it's Silver. Thursday it's Emeralds. Friday it's Platinum. Saturday it's Rubies. Sunday it is random.
pros: Eating more the richer you become
Fun suprise Sunday's
cons: Possible damage to intestines or hind quarters.
Accidently flush toilet.
Need special toilet.

name: Robot Clone Army
overview: summon robot's that look exactly like yourself.
description: Once every 24 hours you can summon a robot that looks exactly like you. Has skin, and human eyes and hair. But inside is a titanium skeleton and cybernetics. The robots run on solar power, or can be charged through an outlet. They obey all commands with out question. Think Terminator 2 but looks like you.
pros: Build an army of robots who will do as you command.
Nearly indestructable.
So many good looking robots =D
cons: Vulnerable to emp
May get sick of looking at yourself.
You are the obvious culprit behind the army.

name: Transformation Mimicry
overview: mimic another person or thing's transformation.
description: This ability can allow the user to get as strong as the person that transformed. Example, say the user was fighting Goku until Goku transforms into a Super Saiyan. The user can use this ability to transform into a Super Saiyan too. The user gets all the powers and perks that the transformation gives. This ability's effects wear off as soon as the opponent turns back to normal. If the user stays in a form too long, they will burn themselves out.
pros: Transform into what your opponent (or ally) transformed into.
Counter their new form
All of the perks, none of the weaknesses
cons: Wears off when turned back to normal
Stay in a form too long, then you will burn yourself out.

name: Life Charges
overview: kill people to steal their life energy
description: You can use this to get any powers they had which were magical and thus bound to their soul you can also put the soul into another body or trade it to get another soul which you could resurrect but you need a empty body that is not too badly damaged you only keep their powers while you have their soul stored inside you and transmitting a soul into another body may cause a change their personality due the host bodies different brain chemistry and metal aptitude. Ability needs line of sight
pros: Kill your foes by ripping out their souls
Gain your enemies magical powers
Resurrect your allies
cons: Your friends may change in personality and intelligence
Power corrupts
People may sense a great evil from you

name: Dream Library
overview: enter a library which possesses millions of different books
description: When you fall asleep, you have the choice of entering the library or not. If you choose not to, you will sleep like usual. If you choose to enter the library, then you will find yourself at the entrance of a huge building. You walk inside and see huge bookcases containing every book you ever read and every moment you ever lived. You have the ability to take down any book, and the library's appearance changes upon many aspects of you, such as your past experiences, dreams, etc.
pros: You only need to read a book once before it will show up at this library.
You don't need to read the whole book for it to appear, but only the parts you read will show up.
You can write books here, and it won't keep your body from resting.
cons: You can only enter the library when you're asleep.
You must have either read part of the book, or lived the moment already.
Any other superpowers you have aren't effective in the library.

name: Soulstorm
overview: transform your soul into a lethal weapon
description: An array of powers that allow the user to manipulate their soul into living energy. They may bend this energy to their will whether it be a concussive beam, a force field, energy weaponry,or unleashing a soul storm. Every attack tears at the victim's mental and emotional state, piercing the fabrics of their soul. Though powerful and difficult to receive, the power is extremely taxing on the user's mental focus and strength
pros: Power increases as focus increases
Limited only by imagination and willpower
Attacks can't be physically blocked
cons: Taxing on the mental and emotional state
Can be corrupted or weakened by telekinetic attacks

name: Combining Robot Physiology
overview: separate yourself into individual creatures and reform.
description: This power allows you separate and recombine like a combining robot. Your head, legs, arms, and torso are capable of separating, either all at once or individually, and becoming individual creatures capable of locomotion and under your control. They are organic, and are in all ways like normal living creatures except in that they combine to form you. You are aware of everything the see, hear, smell, feel, or taste.
pros: Send a body part to scout the an area, and seperate to get through places you're too big to.
Seperate to avoid attacks, surround the enemy, or stealthily change position.
Keep from bleeding to death by seperating from your injuerd limb.
cons: The independant pieces of you can get hurt and die on their own, costing you limbs.
Make sure one body part brings your cloths with you.
They're freaky little critters.

name: Being A Clayfighter
overview: fight and being are like the characters in the video game series called ClayFighter
description: Clayfighter is a series of video games from the official brand called Interplay is about a special meteorite that made the characters and particular things become versions of dough with super powers and related to what are features. This superpower allows its owner to become a wrestler typical dough about it with super powers related to the typical it. A detail not mentioned is that like the human body could not be molded or mixed nor typical melted as you represent.
pros: Like the human body could not be molded or mixed nor typical melted as you represent.
You have super powers real good about yourself
cons: Can die as humans die

overview: bestow fortune or ill-fortune on others, only if they ask.
description:
If a person asks you to bestow them with wealth beyond measure. You can do so, or you could choose to give them poverty beyond measure. Playing with extreme wealth, or extreme poor. If the latter is given, all their assets are reduced to a net worth of zero, or go into a considerable debt.
This power can only be applied if the person asks you to bestow riches on them. You have the choice of wealth, or poverty, however once asked of you, you must make an immediate decision.
pros: Decide on whether the person becomes wealthy or poor.
Hopefully this will get me top spot alphabetically on the list.
cons: Power is only active when someone asks it of you.
You must make the decision when asked of you immediately, instinctively you won't become indecisive.
You won't be sure whether this person deserves ultimate riches or to suffer unbearably in complete poverty.

name: Politician's Answer
overview: always be able to come up with an answer that will please whoever is asking the question.
description: With this power you will always be able to come up with an answer that will satisfy whoever it was that asked the question. Disclaimer: You may be caught contradicting yourself.
pros: You will always have a satisfactory answer.
cons: There was a disclaimer and everything.

name: Card Stack Abilities: Jester
overview: create ripples in existence.
description: Your very existence creates ripples in existence which allow you to be unaffected by any reality manipulating powers as well as break the laws of physics by manipulating reality. You are the jack of all trades but master of none when concerning the powers of the Card Stack spirits. You can use all of their abilites but not to the same extent. As in a the king can always make himself move faster than you by speeding up his own time. You can also create or destroy rocks that can change reality.
pros: Break the laws of physics with your will.
Completely unnafected by changes in the time stream, even if they would undo your birth.
Seer type ability users cannot detect you because of ripples in reality.
cons: Takes a huge amount of power to use to any large extent
Only provides immunity to other Card Stack abilities if you are of an equal or higher level

name: Ability Immunity
overview: not be affected by any super power.
description: Someone with this power would be completely normal, only they are immune to all superpower effects. Memory removers, illusionists, suggestionists, pain inflictors, psychics are all rendered useless when confronted with a possessor of this power. However, indirect assaults from powers do inflict damage, such as telekinetic knife attacks or teleporting a heavy weight to above your head.
pros: This, if combined with another power, would be the perfect superhero assassin ability.
Ability stealers can't take this (because of immunity), so the wielder of this ability is unique.
Superpowers don't seem so ominous now.
cons: Positive powers have no effect either (such as telepathic relayal of information. )
Still have regular human weaknesses.
Not immune to indirect power effects.

name: Substitute Kryptonite
overview: make any object someone's weakness
description: With this power, you can make any object anybody's kryptonite.   The target person will react the same way Superman reacts when he is exposed to kryptonite-all their powers will be gone and they will cringe in pain, prolonged exposure leads to death.  The effects only work on one person at a time, so if you are fighting a team, then tough luck.   This weakness however works on all clones and alternate reality versions of the same person.
pros: In a one-on-one fight, you always have the advantage
You can turn anything into a person's weakness, even people
cons: Lead suits block weakness effects from afar
You can only target one person's weakness at a time
People will call you cheap

name: Injectiplode
overview: inject an energy into any object that causes the object to explode when a physical contact occurs
description: This ability gives you the power to inject a portion of your own energy into any object that causes the object to explode when a physical contact occurs with it. The force of the explosion is determined by how much energy you injected into the object.
pros: You can set up traps
You can inject your energy into any object and throw it at your enemies
cons: If you make a physical contact with the object you injected your energy into, it will explode

name: The Promise
overview: make any promise held against you come true, or not.
description: Allows you to make sure anybody's promise to you come true. Useful if someone promises money or anything valuable, but deadly if the promise is of death or defeat.
pros: You can instantly gain anything from promises.
You can finally get that promotion your boss promised you.
cons: Sadly, you can't promise to yourself.
Death and injury is always a bad thing, right?

name: Iron Cloth
overview: enforce the tensile strength and cutting edge of fabrics
description: This technique can cut through almost anything depending on how much Ki you infused with it. You can also throw it depending on how much Ki you put in is how long it will last when not in contact.
pros: Make cloth material as sword, whip, makeshift flails.
cons: Using Ki tires you

name: Monetary Telekinesis
overview: instantly have your money come to you in the exact amount needed
description: Tired of rummaging through your wallet for the exact amount of change because the cashier doesn't have it? Then your worries are over with Monetary Telekinesis! If you have the money, but can't seem to find it normally, then the money will be attracted to you like a magnet! Works on bills and coins!
pros: Makes it easier to buy things
Makes time at the counter less aggravating
Saves time!
cons: If you have a large bill and no coins, all you can do is use that bill
This does not break up your money for you
If you lose the wallet, this power will not bring it back

name: Magic Snap
overview: cause random events to happen by snapping your fingers.
description: All you need to do to activate this power is snap your fingers. Suddenly, a random, silly event happens within your sight, from a random gong sounding, to jello raining from the sky. However, it is completely random, and if you don't know how to snap your fingers, you can't use this power.
pros: Make comedic things happen by snapping your fingers.
Make people die laughing at the effects that will happen.
cons: No REAL combat uses.
If you don't know how to snap your fingers.
It is completely random.

name: Spirit Animals
overview: change into different animals from touching them, and be able to summon up spirit animals.
description: A mystical power to be able to change into an animal or conjure up spirit forms of the animals. This gives you many possibilities to change into almost any creature.
pros: Can change into different animals.
Can make ghost animals of different colors.
You gain some powers of the animals, like the strength or speed of something.
cons: You get a bloodlust when you're a meat eater.

name: Planar Repulsion
overview: prevent the planes of reality from connecting.
description: This power, also called plane connection elimination, is the power to repulse the different planes of reality. This allows the user to release merged planes as well as force anything on another plane away by repulsing the plane it dwells in. This provides protection against interplanar attack. The users very presence causes a large separation between planes which can disrupt any portal between planes as well as insulate against any action in other planes of reality.
pros: Protection against extra-planear entities and inter-planear attack.
Can undo the mergings of the different planes.
Can prevent portals that connect the planes.
cons: Reality bending.
Things that exist on many planes.
If an extra-planar entity is already on your plane.

name: Future Trails
overview: see where a person or object will go.
description: Focusing on a person or object will allow you to see a ghostly imprint of where they or it will be further along in their timeline. For example, focus on a dog and you will see not only that dog, but a trail of the dog shades showing where it will be and what it will be doing in the future.
pros: Easy way to keep tabs on people.
Save people who would be hurt in the future from their fate.
Know what someone will be doing in the future.
cons: You must physically follow the trail of shades to see what happens in that person's timeline.
You can only focus on one person or object at a time.
You can only see the shade, with no other context other than what you can infer from their actions.

name: Video Eyes
overview: record videos with your eyes
description: With this power you can record anything you see into a video that you watch later all you have to do to watch it is stand in front of a TV or DVD player and think about the video's name for a while and it will eventually appear on the screen
pros: Can take videos without a video camera
This camera's water proof
cons: It might take a while for the video to appear on the TV
You have to remember the name to the video

name: Forced Time Travel
overview: punch people into next week.
description: On a touch you can force someone into the future or past. The distance of the time travel depends on how skilled you are with the power and obviously it would be a terrible idea to send someone to the past. Cannot send self.
pros: Get someone out of your hair for a while.
Make someone miss their appointments.
Hide people in the future.
cons: Cannot travel in time personally.

name: Premonitious Touch
overview: glance into the future, past or present at random, but it also occurs when you touch something.
description: You can look into the future, past or present. This happens usually at random, but also when you touch something, like if you touched an old gun from a war, you would suddenly see a scene with someone holding it.
pros: See trouble.
Find people.
Unaffected by time freezing.
cons: Hurts.
Don't know what you'll see.
Uncontrollable.

name: Orbital Pull
overview: have any object orbit your being
description: The wielder can force any object with solid matter to orbit around their being creating a near impenetrable armour and shield. They can also release the control of an object and direct into any direction with accuracy and destructive force
pros: Can make any object orbit you to create a near impenetrable armour and shield
Can direct objects with accuracy and destructive force
Can attract any object into his orbital pull
cons: Can only attract solid objects with physical matter
Is extremely vulnerable to mental and illusion attacks
After a maximum usage of 4 hours the wielder is drained of energy
