cons: You only get new powers based on the wording of your old ones
Your old powers have to be off this site or somewhere where they have a worded description
Immortality- you can't die, so you can at will get the ability to die. Kind of pointless.

name: Emotion Manipulation
overview: change  a person's emotions
description: A person with this ability can amplify a subject's current emotions (e.g. happy to ecstatic, sad to suicidal), even to the point of overloading them so they can't think (e.g. sexual pleasure so powerful they are immobilized); they can change one emotion into another (e.g. happy to sad, sad to angry, sad to fear, etc.), or once it is developed, suppress emotions completely. You can also induce or negate Empathy and other powers based on sensing, manipulating or using emotions.
pros: Can change a person's emotion to your advantage
Turn your enemies against each other
Make your enemies suicidal, or extremely scared
cons: Cannot change your own emotions
May cause you to change someone's emotion unwillingly at first
If you don't practice, emotion changes can be permanent

name: Finger Tracker
overview: have your finger point you in the right direction of what you want or need
description: With this power, when you really want to find something. All you have to do is use this power and your finger will automatically point to you where to find what you need. This is helpful for finding lost objects as well as tracking people or information. The tracker cannot be fooled by any external force however illusions can hide the true answer. Also this does not tell you the distance of people and will only display the fastest route or the route that you specificate
pros: You will never get lost
You can always find out where your belongings are
You can find other people or information
cons: If what you are looking for does not exist
Sometimes the power is deceptive if something happens to be in front of your finger for example

name: Pain Charge
overview: increase the efficiency of one's abilities and skills with every injury suffered
description: This power allows the user to enhance his abilities/strength/speed/skills and other powers (if he/she has others) by 50% for every injury such as wounds,contusions and even internal body damage suffered by the one gifted with this superpower. Amputations or loss of body parts,except the head, will instead give a 500% increase in efficiency of all the user's skills and capabilities. Sickness or ailments,on the other hand,will yield a 1000% efficiency in your powers.
pros: Wounds and other injuries will no longer hinder you from your tasks
Amputations and other fatal injuries will turn you into a superhuman
Your enemies will become hesitant to attack you
cons: You can still die from suffering too much injuries and bodily damage
You will be restored back to normal once your injuries are healed
You must still possess enough strength to move or do stuff upon suffering injury

name: Truth Serum
overview: induce a truth telling chemical into a person
description: This power makes a person tell the honest truth. You touch the person & a psychoactive drug is injected into their blood stream that makes them lose some inhibitions, mostly the part of lying & being silent. So they start rambling on about everything they know & believe is true. It's a fast acting chemical that wears off after a day. Plus, it makes them dehydrated from non-stop talking & hyperactive & restless, so they'll crash after the drug is out of their system.
pros: You'll hear the truth, the whole, truth & nothing but the truth
cons: They endlessly babble on
What they believe is true could be false information
Wears off after a day & they become dehydrated & lethargic

name: Alternate Synchronization
overview: have the knowledge of every alternate reality version of yourself on demand
description:
With this power you have an ability very close to omniscience but only in the present. You get to know all the knowledge in all the alternate universes and apply them to another universe. 

For example, if a vaccine was developed in one continuity, you can reproduce the vaccine in another continuity.
pros: You know a lot of people before they meet you as well as their weaknesses
You can take over the world with your knowledge
Access to a lot of technology
cons: If the main one is destroyed all the other ones will disapear too
You have to collectively thwart all the enemies within each universe
Does not see the future or the past (weak against time travelling)

name: Beast Boy
overview: turn into any animal for at most 30 minutes
description: You can turn into any animal, even mythical creatures, but only for at most 30 minutes at a time. If you are an animal for 14 minutes, then there is a 14 min. wait. So, if you're an animal for the whole 30 minutes, you would have to wait the whole 30 min. You can switch animals on the move.
pros: You can turn into any animal
Helpful in combat
You are able to switch animals on the move
cons: There can be a long wait
Max time is 30 min.

name: Speech Empowerment
overview: gain powers from someone's speech
description: When someone with this power hears a speech or debate, he/she will be able to do what is said in that speech. You have to listen to the whole speech, understand it and the received powers vanish after a day. You can get multiple powers.
pros: Get powers from speeches and debates
Can get multiple powers
cons: Need to hear the speech/debate from beginning to end
Need to understand the speech/debate
Powers will last for a day

name: Aversion Change
overview: change one's aversion at will.
description: Aversion are the things that, in the superpower world, makes someone weaker. A normal person would usually have one or two, but this ability can allow the user to change his aversion. This makes him able change their weakness to something that no one could find out.
pros: Change your aversion
Remain strong
cons: Can only have one aversion at a time.

name: Sense Eliminator
overview: eliminate four of a person's five senses
description: With this power you can eliminate any four of a person's five senses (taste, sight, smell, touch, hearing). You can change which four you want to delete every time you use the power and you can restore the person's senses whenever you want.
pros: You can delete any four of a person's five senses
You can restore the person's senses whenever you want
cons: You cannot delete all five of a person's senses

name: Time Replacement
overview: replace events that have happened with different ones.
description: You can replace any event that has happened with a new one of your choosing. An example of this could be changing what you had for breakfast this morning. Rule of what you cannot do: you cannot remove someone from existence. You cannot undo your own death, but you can change non-fatal things. You cannot tamper with peoples lives directly. The new events that you used to replace the old ones will not change the past or the future in a significant way. THIS POWER DOES NOT LET YOU TRAVEL IN TIME.
pros: You can do whatever you want to, then go back and change what you did.
You can relive certain events.
You can look forward or back in time.
cons: You can only use this power on something that happened recently.
You cannot bring things into existence, merely suggest that it comes into existence.
You cannot travel in time, you can only change certain events

name: Criminal Mastermind
overview: be the ultimate criminal mastermind
description: With this power you are a natural master criminal, you know what to steal, how to get it, who to sell it to, and how to launder the money, it's in your nature. Whether it is being a con artist, a drug dealer or a master thief you'll know how to work your operation, best of all you cannot be caught by any law enforcement at all, even if you admit to your crimes they won't believe you, however this does not stop other criminals from trying to take you down.
pros: Make a lot of money and retire early
You'll always know how to operate or pull of a job
You can never be caught by any law enforment
cons: You could hurt innocent people, depending upon what you do
Other criminals might try to take you out to take your place, but it is easy to stay hidden
One way or another you might be hurting someone

name: Book Of Cards
overview: create a book to fill with useable cards.
description: This power allows one to summon a book with 300 card slots inside of it. The slots are divided into categories, 100 each for Living, Non-living, and Events. So long as you have the book in your hand you can point to something and recite "Gain," whereupon the thing you pointed at becomes a card and is added to the book. To use a card, take it out of the book and say "Gain" with it in your hand. Whatever was in the card will be summoned out of it at any point you can see, destroying the card.
pros: Store things as cards for easy transport.
Change your enemies or life threatening events into cards.
Anything can be "Gained" if you focus on what you want to Gain from something.
cons: You have a limited number of slots, and can not place a card in an inappropriate slot
The power does not make something summoned from a card loyal to you.
Once something has been summoned from a card it can not be made into a card again.

name: Final Fantasy Weaponry
overview: summon any weapon from any Final Fantasy Series.
description: You can summon any weapon from Final Fantasy series to your aid and you can have only four weapons at time, but you can change the weapons any time. And you can also lend the weapons with your friends or teammates.
pros: Weapons variables are great.
You can lend the weapons.
You can dual-wield weapons.
cons: It has to be from Final Fantasy Series (Kingdom Hearts are included! )
It has to be different weapon (no duplicates! )
Dual-wielding makes you bit slow

name: Self Hypnosis
overview: give commands to yourself in order to perform feats to your full potential
description: A person with this power can command their body to act in anyway physically possible. They can access 100% body strength and all their composite skills. They are immune to mind control since they command themselves. They can also give themselves special skills, such as hypnotizing themselves to be expert gunmen or hypnotizing themselves to play the piano extemely well. The user must first will himself in order to activate his power; if they are not motivated it will not work.
pros: You can access your full potential at will
You can access skills that you normally wouldn't have
cons: You will be very tired after using this ability for a long time
Cannot transcend own physical limits without consequences
You must be motivated in order to activate your power

name: Flight
overview: fly.  Arm flapping is required.
description:
The classic ability to fly.  No running start required.  You DO need to flap your arms to stay aloft, though.  You can travel at up to 60 MPH (or 100 KPH for you metric people), and you have heightened reflexes when traveling fast (or else you'd run into a lot of things).  

You CAN get hurt if you crash into something.
pros: Travel anywhere pretty quickly - no car needed
Fame and probably fortune
Get out of dangerous situations easily
cons: Getting sucked into a plane turbine
Running into power lines
You might become famous, which would mean you get a lot of attention

name: Super Power List Leech
overview: use almost any power obtained by another member of your choosing.
description: When you gain this ability you choose any member of the Superpowerlist and gain access to any power that person has gained. The problem though is that if you gain a power and the person you leech of gains the same power, your version of that power is cancelled and you can not use the power anymore. Once you choose a person to leech off of you can not change your decision.
pros: Use any power the person you choose has that you do not have.
Can use on a person with a lot of powers to quickly gain many powers.
Has no effect on the person you are leeching off of.
cons: Can not change which member you leech off of once you pick.
If the member you leech off of stops using site you stop gaining powers.
If they gain the same powers you gain then that power cancells out for you.

name: Holy Power: Avenging Thunder
overview: shoot a powerful laser from your fist, or Avenger Shield, with the same energy of a small star.
description: With this power you can shoot a powerful laser from your fist, or shield. This laser has the same amount of energy as a small star and destroys everything on its path. You can shoot this laser many times in great speed, but it attacks only forward, making you vulnerable.
pros: You can shoot a powerful laser in great speed from both hands.
This power has an accurate targeting, and a great field of range.
cons: Attacks only forward, making you vulnerable from other directions.
Energy Absorption or Suppression powers

name: Night Vision

If you live in the country, you can see deer.
cons: Haunted houses might bore you
If you like to sleep in the dark, you'll still see everything

name: Curse Of Epic Failing

description: You can become an alternate form of the Pokemon Charizard, with dark roan red skin, an orange chest, silver-black claws, glowing amber eyes, and a tail-flame of black fire. You can sense anyone both psychically and physically. You also have extremely powerful 'black fire' pyrokinesis, telepathy, and regeneration. You can read the minds as well as memories of any person or animal within a twenty-mile-radius.

An extremely dangerous ability in the wrong hands!

name: Chromakinesis
overview: manipulate colors.
description: The ability to change any color to any other color, not having to know names or computer values for the colors.
pros: Change your shirt design or your hair/eye color
Change the lens of a camera (or the enemy's eyes) to black to avoid detection.
Have lots of fun with this power

name: Iron Arms
overview: line your arms in metal.
description: Lining your arms with metal can be really helpful. One can mold the iron into a weapon of choice and the weapon would be of the strongest material. Use them to touch some of the hottest objects, the most powerful of acid, and the toughest walls. The power can be activated on and off whenever you choose for as long as you want.
pros: Shape into any tools, keys, weapons,etc.
Touch just about anything
Powerful and tough
cons: Can be a bit stiff
No feeling, so you don't feel texture

name: Lavapit
overview: make a pit full of lava to appear on any flat surface
description: With this power you can cause lavapits to appear on any flat surface and then make it disappear later. You can make the lavapit any size you want and keep it in existence for as long as you want.

You can make them any size you want
You can keep them in existence for as long as you want

name: Serpent Staff
overview: transform in to a 6o ft winged serpent or a sword made of refracted light
description: This staff was made by aztec gods. It looks like a golden wing serpent with a ruby eyes and a sapphire gem in its mouth. When thorwned on the ground it turns into a 60 ft flying serpent which can be used to travel on and when hold the sapphire gem it turns the staff into a a rainbow blade.

Turn the staff into a combat light sword

Staff can be stolen

name: Delete This Selfless
overview: utterly multiply and pummel your opponent.
description: First, you do your victory pose. Then, you start multiplying quickly. Moments later, your multiple duplicates rise right beside you and they begin to pummel the enemy from side to side in a blur as the opponent is beaten before a splat and a scream is heard.
pros: Could be a good thing when you are outnumbered.

name: Emotional Bomb
overview: create a shock wave with the strength of one's anger.
description: If someone is calm, the shock wave will be as if you are half way in the water at the ocean and the waves hit you. The strongest shock wave is like someone dropped an atomic bomb.

People will not mess with you
You have a lot of power
cons: People will fear you
You will be alone all the time
People will never want to be around you

name: Ability Information Library
overview: store information from powers in a special format.
description: Are your information powers causing mental overload? With this power, you problem will be solved. You can set your other powers to send their information into a mental bank, instead of your mind. You can then review your information in your own time, already sorted into the categories you need. Alternately, the information can simply appear as knowledge as it is needed (i. E. When speaking about world history, information from Psychometry may spontaneously surface.
pros: No more mental overload.
Presorted information.
Can look through stored information in your own time.
cons: Still limited to your own memory; you just access it as needed/wanted.
If you don't review your stored information, you may lose track of what you know.
Still takes up space in your memory, so you may need a memory-enhancing power.

name: Psychic Distraction
overview: dramatically decrease a person's attention span
description: Focus in anything is key. A person with Psychic Distraction can consciously infulence another person's brain so that it loses some ability to sort information. The result? Small noises, motion, an itch that would normally be ignored suddenly merit full and automatic attention. This ability takes little energy to activate and can be left on for a radius-effect of squirrely people.

Can be used to sneak past unfocused people
Devastating in hand-to-hand combat
cons: Weakens with range
Must be careful to not be noticed yourself
Can be accidentally left on, crippling allies

name: Precognitive Dreamer
overview: have precognitive dreams.
description: With this power, you will have precognitive dreams about things that will happen in the near future (a few days). Most of the time, it will be an event that concerns you or your friends directly, but it can also be a very important world event, like the 9/11 attacks.

Become the best medium ever.
Prevent disasters.
cons: You don't always remember your dreams
It's random: you might end up not having precognitive dreams for more than a month.

name: Sentient Superpower
overview: have each of your abilities have a personality of their own, including this one.
description: More noticeable if you have multiple superpowers. Each and every one of your powers acquires a personality. They are capable of acting on their own and taking over your body. Unlike DID, you are conscious of your condition and can discuss with your abilities. You have still access to all your powers, but using one may cause the power you're using to take over your body. Moreover, a certain power doesn't mean a defined personality. There are a lot of possible personalities that could fit.
pros: Your superpowers can perceive the world through you. So, they may notice something you don't.
If you can't stand up to someone, maybe one of your abilities will.
Each personality has access to the superpower they represent.

There may be conflicts between your personalities.

name: Animated Arms
overview: create a pair 3D animated arms and move them.
description: With this ability, you can create a pair of animated 3D hands and control them. You can use them to long-distance slap someone and never get caught. Can make them disappear too
pros: Have an extra arm under your control

overview: take anyone's power by a single strike.
description: This power will allow you to take there ability and store it in the sword. But sadly only one ability will be stored inside the sword. Once more the ability has a cost each blade must take at least a finger but it would be weak. If you cut off say the arm t will be fully stored and fully at its full potential. Going with any weapon. You can use bladed cards basically anything can be turn into a weapon:D. Others wont be able to use the weapon.

Can work with any weapon.
Limitless

name: Sonar
overview: know your surroundings by hearing reflected sound waves.
description: Like bats or dolphins, you too can use the power of sonar to know your surroundings.  Never stuble in the dark again!  You only need to listen to the ambient noise around you and you will instantly have a 3D image in your mind of what your environment looks like.
pros: Knowing what's behind you
See in the dark--save on energy bills
cons: You might freak people out if you leave your house lights off all the time

name: Necroplasmic Summoning

Creep out your enemies

Some summons may take on a mind of their own

name: Human Damper
overview: dissipate the kinetic energy stored in your body as heat.
description: When you activate this power, it progressively converts your kinetic energy into heat, effectively dampening your movement. It only applies to the kinetic energy stored in your motion, so bodily functions aren't affected. Your body also becomes highly resistant to heat, but if the heat is too high, you will burn. You can only transform your own energy. If you want to affect someone or something else's energy, you need to be solidly connected to them so their kinetic energy is shared with you.
pros: You can slow down more easily.
You can even decrease your terminal velocity if you are falling.
You have some form of heat resistance.
cons: If the heat you produce is extremely high, you will burn. Also, you are not fire resistant.
If you want to dampen something else's speed, you need to be attached to them.

name: Plasma Vision
overview: fire bolts of plasma from one's eyes
description: Plasma is a state of matter where the molecules have extremely high levels of energy. Good examples of plasma are fire and lightning. This power allows the user to fire bolts of plasma from their eyes to hurt enemies, burn down doors, etc.
pros: Can utilize something highly dangerous with your eyes.
Can turn this power off to minimze accidents.
cons: Will still hurt you if you fire it at yourself.
Destroying a nice pair of sunglasses.

name: Flow Reversal
overview: redirect energy
description: The reversal of Energy, as in Heat, Kinetic, and so on. This also means mild manipulation of movement in objects and so on.
pros: Ability to redirect several types of energy.
Stem the flow of small rivers.
Negate effect of mild radiation.
cons: Cannot redirect Lightning or stop objects more than twice own mass.
Requires a degree of knowledge of Energy Types.

name: Atomic Filtering
overview: separate substances on an atomic level.
description: When you touch something, you have tiny, atomic-sized pores on your skin that have vacuum-like properties. This vacuum pulls substances into it, and with a bioelectric charge, separates it into groups of like atoms. When the substances exit your pores, regroup and rebuild, you are left with basic elements. You can also reverse the process.
pros: You could separate deadly chemicals from the air to kill victims.
You could separate pollution from oxygen and breathe better air.
You could reverse the vacuum and launch out a glob of iron. Heh, face-breakin time!
cons: You have to be in contact with the substance.
You have to know what you could use offensively and defensively.
You have to be pretty smooth, and quick-witted.

name: Euphoric Aura
overview: make a person become entranced with joy
description: You can really cheer someone up when your aura of complete blissful happiness spreads to them. They will become entranced & feel complete enlightened aligned centered zen. A nirvana state of euphoria. Without worry, fear, sad gloominess. Just happy thoughts. Though the down side to this happy power is it doesn't affect you, you have normal feelings & the people could become addicted to your heavenly aura & want you around forever.
pros: You bring happiness to everyone around you
cons: You can't use your happy power on yourself
The euphoria could become addictive for the people
People might withdraw & become depressed when you're not there

name: You're A Fictional Character

description: With this power you can turn anybody you want into a fictional character by saying their full name, the name of the character and then say "Poof! ". EX: "John Doe, Bugs Bunny, Poof! " To turn them back you say the name of the character, the persons name and then poof. EX: "Bugs Bunny, John Doe, Poof! "
pros: You can turn people into fictional character
You don't even have to snap (snap didn't fit in the title so oh well)
cons: Nothing really

description: With this power, you can leave to physical plane and become an illusion in someone else's mind. You then become intangible to everyone but them. Mind Reading
Drive people crazy

If they stop believing that you exist, then you stop existing

description: You can turn into a vaguely humanoid exposed core of a black hole. You don't affect gravity, but gravity control has no effect on you. Any matter touching you will have its atoms ripped apart. Any energy beam striking you will be harmlessly scattered. You are a walking somewhat man-shaped breakdown of reality, so reality bending powers can't affect you directly. A probability controlling power could affect the world around you, hindering you, but not you.
pros: Immune to direct attack.
Villains will leave their best gear at home if they're facing you.

cons: You can't save people or important objects using physical contact. No hostage rescue.
You have the potential to be worse than a bull in a china shop.
Destruction is your first, middle and last name.

name: Blessing Of Zeus
overview: have the Blessing of Zeus
description: Zeus is the greek god of the skies. His blessing allows you to gain powers over his realm. You can create bolts of lightning strong enough to destroy a car or topple a small building. You can even call down lightning from the sky to charge you or your weapon. Also, Zeus's symbol is the eagle, so controlling eagles is now a simple extension of your will. You power is driven mainly by emotion, so watch out for lightning when you get upset.
pros: You have powers over the skies
Eagles are your servants
Lightning is incredibly powerful

Your emotions have more control over your powers than you do

name: Anger Control
overview: completely control the anger in people.
description: Also called Four Humors: Yellow Bile. With this ability you are able to raise or lower the anger inside of people. You can strike the anger of a completely calm person and make them go into an unstoppable rage or make a completely angry person relax or sleep. Your anger levels can not be affected by Agitator Pulse, etc. At higher levels, Berserker Rage and Hatred could possibly be more powerful.
pros: You can make people not hate you.

But be warned he who enters has no guarantee that he will be able to leave the zone again.  You can only leave the zone if you know an exit and posses the power to open these portals.  Those who lack the power are stuck in this zone forever. Unless you know how to teleport.
pros: You can hide in a place where almost nobody is able to get.
Send enemies into an nigh-unescapeable prison.
Reflections are everywhere so there are many place in wich you can hide.

If you forget how to leave the zone you risk getting stuck forever.

description: With this power you can turn all ten of your fingers into lock picks, which can open any lock ever made, except for those that are sealed by magic. When you've finished all your lock picking antics, you can turn your lock picks back into fingers.

You can open any lock except for those sealed with magic

overview: know the murderer of a man or an animal by touching its cadaver.

Exhume the body of JFK, and finally have the answer.
cons: If you don't want to solve crimes, the this power is of no use to you.
You only have a vague idea to where the murderer is.

name: Spec Swap
overview: change the specialty of a power.
description: A person with spec swap can change the specialty of any other power they posses. An power can be changed to an Offensive Spec or a Defensive spec or to any number of different specialties. Heal Spec or Damage Spec could make a power heal or hurt rather than what it was normally intended to do. Specs could include ranged, accuracy, area of effect, or speed. A poison spec would not work unless poison was a part of the power originally.

Make a power heal or damage instead of what it normally does.
Have multiple specs to switch between.
cons: Using a spec, such as Offensive, would make the Defensive side of the power weaker.
Takes time to change specs, but training can reduce the time.

name: Emf Manipulation

Manipulating EMF will make a change in voltaic cells, thermoelectric devices, solar cells, electrical generators, transformers, and even Van de Graaff generators, ceasing them or overloading them. Electromotive Force is smiliar to a magnetic field. In other words, one can use this to manipulate batteries, making them dead or to overloading them.

A very unique power.

name: Hyper Move

name: Auto Negate
overview: automatically negate the effects of any power that directly affects you
description: A person with this power has the ability to negate everything that directly affects them. This means that they cannot be the direct targets of any superpower. This obviously means no instant kill powers work on them. They also cannot be lifted up by telekinesis. Indirect attacks still work. For example the telekinetic can still throw boxes at said person. This power also negates the positive effects of your own powers that affect you directly.

No type of power theft at all
Another Con or Pro: You cannot be teleported
cons: Can still be hurt by indirect attacks
Also negates any positive effects of any power that directly affects you

name: Ultimate Pyrokinesis
overview: create a flame down to the very concept that is also unextinguishable
description: A person with this power can create a flame of any size and the flame has the the property of being able to burn anything even abstract concepts like souls and time. The flame is unextinguishable and cannot be moved from the place where it was made. The flames can spread if it catches onto another burnable fuel(which can be anything). It does not require oxygen to burn but it can be spread through sparks catching on to other objects. Flames also burn any incoming controller force.
pros: Your flames are unstoppable
Once someone gets burned they will stay on fire until burned completely or until eternity
If you time it right you can stop your own flames by burning it with another flame-very hard to do
cons: Your flames are permanent and stay stuck so you will have to prevent it from spreading
You cannot control your own flames except control where they start
Since it burns time anything around the flame will be distorted so you cannot even see your flames

name: Black  Out
overview: emit a cloud of darkness around you like a smoke bomb
description: Whenever this power is activated you release a cloud of black smoke around you that is like a dark fog. Your eyes eventually evolve to see through this giving you an added bonus of night vision, but only after being exposed to it for a while. However that being the case your eyes will become extremely sensitive to light in general.
pros: Ninja vanish
Can see in the dark
cons: Light
Equals
Bad

name: Paradise Planner
overview: plan, create, and live in your idea of a perfect world.
description: God saw how you're dissapointed with the world he's made, so he gave you a chance at creating a universe to see if you can do better. You must plan this universe precisely, from every event(assuming you want time to exist), to the nature of life in that world, to the location of every object(assuming this universe is physical). Every soul that has ever lived in the old universe must be included in your new universe somehow, and after it has ended they will judge it and compare it to the old one.
pros: You are given a room with a computer for notes and every form of comfort that you could ever want
You will live forever in any form you choose, and you will never forget anything.
You can try as many times as you want, and, if you give up, you can return back to the old world.
cons: People might not like any of your ideas of paradise.

Highly unlikely that you will ever create something better than someone who is already omnipotent.

name: Desert Control
overview: create and control sand and heat
description: Deserts are harsh environments that very few can survive in. This power allows you to control the sand and heat that make up deserts. Summon scorching sandstorms to blind and burn opponents, use blasts of sand to wear down and cut things, or create sand constructs. You can even create a small desert to fight in, ideal for you but horrible for opponents. You can also use heat for many things. Just be careful not to let your power get out of control and end up creating a new Sahara.
pros: Create harsh desert conditions that only you can really fight it
Lots of uses for heat and sand

name: Good Intent Resistance
overview: resist anything if your intentions are pure.
description: This ability allows you to resist any physical attack, illness, superpower, spell, reality change or any other action that would have an effect on you. You have complete control over what you have resistance to. This power will only work if your intentions in life are pure and good. Your power of resistance will increase depending on how pure your intentions are.
pros: You can resist ageing to prolong life.
You will have a huge advantage in fights if your intentions are good.
cons: If your intentions are bad, the power works against you, making you weaker.

name: Hobby Powers

description: With this ability, you'll have powers related to your hobbies and will make them more productive, easier, and more fun. If your into pottery, you can dry your items without the need of a kiln. If your an author for fun, you can write on a surface without a pen or pencil or type with your mind, etc.
pros: Hobby is a lot more fun
Can impress your friends with stuff you can make

name: Green Guardsmen Power Ring
overview: use the mysterious green  power of justice
description: The user is able to form constructs made up of pure energy from a green power ring using the power of justice. These rings choose people on their ability to have great virtue , is just and have no mood for injustice. The ring's only weakness is the negative energy used by the grey power rings which is injustice and evil. The symbol of the ring is a shield. The battery source is stored in a giant scale of justice placed in the Green Guardsmen Corps homeworld
pros: Can make constructs made out of pure of energy fueled by justice
Can shoot bolts and beams of pure energy

name: Flying Cars
overview: give any vehicle the ability to fly
description: With this power you can give any vehicle the ability to fly and you will instantly know how to fly it. You can make cars, boats, submarines, bikes, scooters, wingless planes, rotorless helicopters etc. The ability to soar through the skies at whatever speed they were able to go one the ground/water/space.
pros: You can give vehicles the ability to fly
You will know how to fly them
cons: Not much use in physical combat
You only know how to fly vehicles you've already used this power on

name: Just In Time
overview: be just on time
description: With this power whenever you have to be at an event or a show or anything you'll always be exactly on time not a second before not a second later. You can turn this power off so you can be early to things or fashionably late for things if you want.

name: Myth Power: Fertility Force3

description: The phallic companions of Priapus, in Greek myth, were the gods of fertility. As such, channeling Orthanes (Orthannes, Orthages, Orthagenes- sexual arousal), one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel subjects who are attracted to oneself, and/or to whom one is attracted, at will. In addition, one psychically withstand being knocked off of one's feet (ie remain standing 'erect'), at will. One can even gain physical power in the presence of large phallic objects (skyscrapers etc).

Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Power Fusion
overview: fuse any power with another
description: This gives the user the ability to fuse someone elses power with another and make it one. In order for this to work, the two subjects must be in physical contact with each other at all times for the user to fuse their powers. For example, if the user combines the powers of invisibility and super strength, both targets will be invisible and super strong as long as they remain physically contacted with each other. Once contact is seperated, the fusion is canceled. Some powers may not be fusible.

No time limit
cons: Targets have to have phyical contact with each other until the fusion is canceled
Some powers may not be fusible

name: Attack Replicating Ground
overview: let the ground below you absorb your attack and release it over a big surface.
description: You need to direct one of your attacks toward the ground which will absorb it. Then, the same attack will be released from the ground in one of three ways. First, the attack can be released all around you, save for a tight spot where you stand. Second, it can be released out of a remote area. Third, it can progressively be released toward a target, following them if they move. The attack released is the same as the one dealt to the ground, but replicated to cover a bigger surface.
pros: You can greatly increase the power of an attack and its range.
Just stick a sword in the ground and create hundreds of blades.
Shoot fire toward the ground and create fields of fire.
cons: It only works on the ground and you could attack yourself in the process if you're not careful.
It only lasts as long as you keep attacking the ground with your attack.
The attacks can only be released from the ground in your vicinity and your visual field.

name: Curse Of Life

description: The Curse of Life, a powerful curse that affects the user instead of someone else. Once used, the person who uses it can't die, from disease, old age, or any form of attacks. The head can be severed from the body, and it will still live. Injuries will heal at a supernatural pace also. However, it is a curse because it allows the user to never die.
pros: Can't die ever.
cons: You have to live forever.
The people you love will continue to die around you.
Can still feel pain.

name: Combustion Projection
overview: generate an explosive beam from the forehead
description: This is one of the most dangerous abilities. A Combustion Projector can generate a powerful ray that super-heats the air around the first object it contacts. The oxygen explodes, destroying the target. This ability is very powerful, but it has its drawbacks. The ray can only be projected by the forehead, and a direct blow to its middle will block the ability for a while. It is also hard to control at first; the beginner must be careful to not maim or kill himself.
pros: Extremely dangerous
Good for combat
Nigh-unstoppable
cons: Can only be projected from the forehead
Direct blow to the forehead's middle temporarily paralyzes the ability
Hard to control at first

name: Star Sight
overview: predict future events by watching the stars
description: The ability to predict future events on earth by watching the stars and planets.
pros: Being able to predict natural disasters
cons: Some times you will feel separated from reality.
You have to see the stars.

name: The Write Stuff
overview: perfectly forge anyone's handwriting.
description: When you forge a signature, you actually channel the person, perfectly replicating their writing style.
pros: Never have to bring home a permission slip again.
Get all the prescription drugs you want.
Get bills passed.
cons: Prepare for possible incarceration for fraud.
People will be asking you for celebrity autographs.

name: Insomnia
overview: go with out sleep and heighten your senses.
description: Have you ever been in a heated battle with an arch foe and you grow overwhelmingly tired? With Insomnia, you're able to put yourself into a trance and stay awake as your senses and strength heighten. But if you stay in the trance too long, you'll turn into a brainless zombie for eternity. Or until a slayer kills you.
pros: Able to stay awake to fight.
Grow stronger.
Senses heighten.
cons: Stay in trance too long & you'll turn into a zombie.
A slayer may kill you.

name: Timeline Protector
overview: protect the integrity and existence of your timeline.
description: The timeline from the moment you acquired this ability to the moment you lose it cannot be altered or prevented from flowing. In other words, any power that manipulate time won't work. There may be moments when your ability is cancelled, but, once it's reactivated, the timeline will snap back to what it should be, voiding any modification. Also, if someone travels through time during a period when your ability is cancelled, they can't go outside this period, as your ability acts as a time wall.
pros: Always active. As long as you have this power, time can't be slowed down, sped up or stopped.
Any power that affects reality or allows time travel won't work.
The periods when this power is active can neither be changed nor travelled through with time travel.
cons: Can be cancelled. Though any modification is voided when your ability is reactivated.
If you're discovered, time manipulators may try to kill you to use their abilities.
You can't alter time either.

name: Grey Matter
overview: see, hear and realize what a villain knows just by touching them.
description: You might get a strange feeling if you try to walk past and touch an unknown person who turns out to be a criminal. You are then able to witness, listen, and know what the evildoer is up to.
pros: You might inform the Police, the FBI or the CIA to let them know what the villain is planning next.
cons: You'll have bad dreams.
The criminals might know you too.

name: Sleep Absorption
overview: absorb the energy anyone gained during their sleep.
description: This allows you to suck the energy anyone gained from their sleep through touch. You can take as much energy as you want but no more than what they gained during their lifetime. If you take too much, the victim will get symptoms of sleep deprivation, but you will be able to stay awake, heal faster, enhance your memory and have an energy boost among other things. Symptoms include dizziness, hallucinations, increased blood pressure, immunity deficiency, loss of memory, dementia and even death.
pros: Gain all the benefits of sleeping without losing your time.
You will never feel the need to sleep again. You could do so much more and gain so much time.
You have control over the activation of this ability.
cons: You could severely incapacitate or even kill someone with this ability.
You will never have dreams or nightmares. Daydreams will never beat that feeling of unconsciousness.
It will take a lot of sleep before that person recovers what they lost.

name: Crystal Growth
overview: cause crystals to grow by touching the crystals
description: The crystal can be any kind of crystal. It will grow from any size to however large and any shape you want it to be at a rate of 27 cubic centimetres per second.
pros: Can always have weapons with you.
Crystals won't set off metal detectors.
cons: It will take some time to get weapons and items of the needed size.
Always need to have some kind of cryystal around for this power to be effective.
Can't change the properties of the crystals except for size and shape with this power.

name: Target Eye
overview: cause projectiles to home in at what you are seeing and if mastered a black hole
description: Also known as Eyehole Effect. This power causes objects to be attracted toward what the person see similar to a blackhole. Also the user can distort light in front of their eye so that they can see things that are farther away up to 2500 meters. Eye gets stronger the more it is used-the retina gets bigger and the eye veins grow. When at its peak, the user can create a black hole where they are seeing thus being extremely strong but the user becomes effectively blind. Best used for sniping.
pros: As long as you are looking at it, nearby projectiles will be attacted to it like a blackhole
Target Eye also give the user vision up to 2500 meters-the range for this ability
Can deactivate the power at will in early stages or by closing your eyes
cons: Another Pro: You can just train one eye to have the black hole
Dangerous to user when up close(Blast Radius-and sucked into own hole)
Continued use causes lack of control and leads to Blackhole Vision

name: Persistent Revival
overview: revive oneself when put out of commission
description: A person with this power refuses to give up. When they are knocked out or if their heart stops, the body sends an electrical signal that either restarts the heart or wakes up the person, regardless of their physical condition. Also, the body will be able to perform CPR on itself to resuscitate the user. However, this does not fully revive the person's strength.
pros: The toughest wrestler-Who can pin you down unconscious?
Can't be knocked out by sucker punches. Will get back up.
You can be revived indefinitely as long as you have the will to fight
cons: You can still die
People will think that you are a glutton for punishment
You can still feel pain

name: Anesthetize
overview: remove senses.
description: You could stop feeling pain. Blind, deafen, numb people.  You may make someone not sense anything but pain. Like a numbing medicine, only all-around. Cut off a hindering sense, too.
pros: Can fight without the trouble of pain.
Make your enemies senseless and kill them with ease.
Make people know only pain.
cons: When you anesthetize yourself, you won't know if a vital part has been hit.

name: Torrental Darkness Rain
overview: release a torent of destructive darkness at the target.
description: The user first presses his or her palms together which will collect all the darkness in the vincity of the user. It is compressed into the form of a sphere and, depending on how long the users palms remain together, the more darkness will be collected and, in effect, the more powerful the attack is. The user can then release the darkness by unlocking his or her palms in a forcefull motion. The darkness cannot be redirected back to the users palms once released.
pros: The darkness will pursue the target until it is either dead or destroyed.
The darkness cannot be dodged, blocked, redirected or stopped in any way.
The dark force can be adjusted according to the forcefullness of the movement needed to release it.
cons: The darkness is extremely destructive and can branch out in all directions if not controlled.
The darkness will permanently destroy all life from organisms that it comes into contact with.
The darkness cannot be redirected once it has been released.

name: Distance Locker
overview: lock your distance with something/someone, so neither of you can get near or away from the other.
description: When you activate this power, your current distance with your target will be locked. So, if one of you tries to get near or away, it would push away or drag the other to keep the distance between you constant. And if the latter tries to resist, the former will feel the resistance. Used effectively, you could prevent anyone from getting close or away, keep a safe distance from something or someone, or avoid being flown or teleported far away by locking your distance with the ground.
pros: You can severely impede someone else's movements.
Coupled with Superhuman Speed, you can drag someone to death.
Coupled with Superstrength, you can push/drag anything or anyone without touching them.
cons: You can severely impede your own movements.
If your opponent has Superhuman Speed, they can drag you to death.
If your opponent has Superstrength, they can push/drag you without touching you.

name: Illusory Wishes
overview: grant anyone's wishes with an illusion
description: A person with this power can grant anyone's wishes through illusions. For example, if someone wished for a hamburger, they would instantly see a hamburger and start to eat it despite it being a tree branch or etc. If someone wishes for someone back from the dead, then you can create an illusory duplicate of the same person, but they cannot be grabbed, etc. or if you are evil, you can replace it with a sword, so the person hugs the sword and dies by bleeding.
pros: You can grant any wish (except it is an illusion)
You can grant your own wishes (but you know it isn't real)
Can be used as pranks or kill people deceptively
cons: It's not real
Someone has to actively wish for something for you to grant it

name: Warp Spasm
overview: distort your body in a spasm of rage
description: Warp Spasmers are dangerous to see, mainly because that means the Spasmer can see you. A person with Warp Spasm involuntarily goes into one when they have become enraged to the point of no return. Their bones and flesh twist in their skin, their features distort like wax, and they go mad. In this state, they cannot feel pain and have enhanced speed, strength, and endurance. They are very difficult to stop and will kill anyone on sight, usually starting with the source of their anger.
pros: Happens whenever you are absolutely furious
Unable to feel pain
Enhanced strength, speed, and endurance
cons: Involuntary
Hard to keep yourself from spasming
May kill friends, family, etc.

name: Photoshop Reality
overview: alter reality by using Photoshop
description: This applies to Photoshop and all similar programs. You will be able to alter reality by using the program on an image or photograph. The only limits are your imagination and skill with the program. Once you become very skilled with this, you will be able to create objects or even living things.
pros: Alter anything that you have an image of
Skilled users will be able to create objects and living things
cons: You need a computer and the program to use it
Can take some time to do it right

name: The Four Swords Of Power
overview: summon and wield all four ancient swords of power at the same time.
description: The four swords of power are four stone swords that have been influential throughout history. They are Excalibur the sword of Ice, Clarent the sword of Fire, Durendal the sword of Air and Joyeuse the sword of Earth. With this power you can summon all four at the same time and fuse them into one weapon. Together they give you each of their individual powers along with the power to summon Coatlicue, The Mother of All Gods, who will devour your enemies.
pros: Use all four sword's power at once.
Summon Coatlicue
cons: You get all the negative effects of weilding all four swords
Coatlicue will eat you if you summon her and there is no other food.

name: Fisticuff
overview: deliver an endless amount of high speed punches to an enemy
description: With this power, the user breaks both speed and stamina barriers allowing them to punch their enemy for hours or even days without the enemy being able to escape the blows or dodge them. Fisticuff can even "speed match" to keep superspeed or teleporting opponents from escaping. Unfortunately, the move is strictly punches and so the chain can be broken by an accidental alternative blow such as a kick, throw, headbutt, or even open hand blow. This would allow an escape for the enemy.
pros: You can never get tired of punching and so can deliver blows for hours or even days
"Speed match" keeps even quick-moving enemies unable to escape.
cons: All blows have to be punches in order to work
The chain can be broken if a blow is delivered that is not a punch, such as a kick or a throw

name: Vanishing Act
overview: vanish off the face of the planet.
description: You can vanish for up to a millenium and you can choose when and where to reappear. However, it has too be on the same continent you vanished from. You would essentially be non-existant during that time, so you have no information of what happens during your absence. To you, your absence seems like a second. The only way it can be undone is by yourself or by time travel.
pros: Vanish for any amount of time up to a millenium.
Excellent evasion and mystery.
Great teleportation: you can reappear anywhere on the continent you vanished from.
cons: Irreversible (except for time travel).

name: Technological Clock
overview: control the level of technology
description: It basically means that you could go to a tiny tribe, jump the technology forward and make them superior to modern US. Basically, make any technology more or less advanced. It can be very useful.
pros: Mess with people you don't like
Jump humanity forward (cool!)
Make your stuff better than anyone else's
cons: It only works as long as you're thinking it

name: Willpower: Will Of Corruption
overview: corrupt the freewill of other people.
description: A person with this ability has the power to corrupt the freewill of other people by forcing his willpower upon them. The willpower of the user dwells within the mind of his victim; it acts like a poison that merges with the victim's mind and freewill in order to 'rewrite' them. In effect those who were corrupted no longer possess the ability to choose for themselves; instead they act or think in submission to the willpower that took hold of their very existence.
pros: Concentration is not necessary. You just need to poison them with your willpower.
Victims think and act just like you. The need to control them is no longer needed
No conscious being that possess freewill is immune to this ability.
cons: The act of projecting your willpower to corrupt others require absolute mastery.
Corruption may take time depending on the willpower utilized.
Victims eventually die.

name: Under Mass
overview: control anything with less mass than yourself
description: Anything with less mass than you is now a simple extension of your will. I'm fond of example, so let's say you have an apple. You can move the apple, teleport it, send it through time, change it into an orange, disintegrate it, clone it, change its DNA structure, or do anything else with it you can imagine. But there are rules. You can't convert something into something living unless it was alive to begin with. And you can't control anything that has more mass than yourself.
pros: Very powerful
The more you can imagine, the more you can do.
cons: No creating life
You can only control things that have less mass than you

name: Godparent Intuition
overview: bestow any superpower on any infant
description: With this power, you can bestow superpowers on any infant. The power/s will slowly develop as the child grows up and they will become aware of their abilities when they are ready to handle them. You are free to choose who gets what superpower and you can put limitations on any of them. However, this is the only power you can possess and it doesn't work on yourself. You can bestow a superpower on an infant only before they reach the age of 1. They can have multiple powers as well.
pros: Help kids out by giving them superpowers
Be a sort of fairy-godmother/father
You are extremely powerful in your own way
cons: You don't know if the child will grow up to use the power for evil
Might ruin a kid's life
You might give them the wrong power for their personality

name: Jelly Stingers
overview: have cnidocyte cells(stinging cells)
description: A person with this power has developed cnidocyte cells. In other words they can sting people like jellyfish. They can decide the lethality of their sting from simply stunning to putting people into a coma or straight up killing.
pros: Can sting people
It can be volunary but being surprised causes you to accidentally use it
Can decide the lethality from stun to coma to kill
cons: Being surprised causes you to use it-----(though nonlethally)
No aqautic adaptation (no breathing underwater, or otherwise mimicking a jellyfish)

name: Danger Cloaking
overview: hide threats and dangers in a pocket dimension (dim.).
description: This ability really uses the term "Hidden Dangers" to a new extreme. This ability affects anything that the user conceives as a threat or danger like a volcano about to erupt, lion ready to pounce, or even a new disease. Then they will place it into a pocket dimension. The user can use this pocket dim. In 2 ways. It could store the threat until the user escapes or use that threat as a trap for others. The second option shows that these dim. Have time stopping effects on things inside them.
pros: Put anything you think is a threat in a pocket dim.
Use that chance to escape the threat or use the threat as a trap for others
The trap activates as soon as the victim steps in to the area where the threat was sealed.
cons: When not used as a trap, the threat will come out within an hour or so.

name: Abomination Materialization
overview: create horrific creature that do not fit in the natural order.
description: This ability allows the user create animals and beast that beyond the laws of nature. They are freaks, but they are powerful. The user doesn't get full control at first, but eventually they will.
pros: Make abominations
Eventually Control them
cons: They will kill if you cannot control them.

name: Phobomaniacal Form
overview: transform into a state which grows and gains power from fear.
description: With this ability, you can transform into a state which grows and gains power from the fears of others. You become a dark, horrifying beast. Not only do you also become larger and more powerful, but as you grow, you become increasingly terrifying, and you may strike people with claws which put them into a state of shock and fear. You can also let off a horrendous roar, which causes emotional trauma, and can potentially kill people, depending on how strong you have become.
pros: Strike people with claws, or let off a horrendous roar which can cause emotional trauma or kill.
You become more invulnerable to physical, emotional, and mental damage the larger you become.
Growing larger will probably strike additional fear into people.
cons: Resistance to fear will cause you to lose power, and revert if you become weak enough.
People with less fear towards you can cause more damage.
Once you revert, you lose the effects gained while in this form.
tags: Paul McCartney's wife (Vespert: lol How dare you!)

name: Condensation
overview: condense material with your mind.
description: With this power, you can condense anything you can see into any size smaller than it was originally. For example, you can condense a cloud to flood the area below it. You can condense your enemy into a pile of flesh and bone. Even make a black hole out of the Earth by condensing it. You just need to be able to see the object. You cannot expand an object though.
pros: Flood an area with a cloud.
Kill that guy with a gun.
cons: Diabolical people will destroy the Earth.
You cannot put something back to the way it was.
What will you do with that pile of flesh?

name: Nightfall
overview: produce an aura that produces various night/dark related effects
description: This is the ability to generate an aura of psionic darkness around oneself. This aura of darkness makes the area around it look like it would at night (hence the name), and psionically blinds everybody in the field, along with making anyone within the aura/field appear invisible to anyone outside of the aura/field. Not to mention, this aura also protects the user and anyone else within the field from intense light, as the field absorbs all ambient light within a certain radius.
pros: You can see within the aura
Foes can't see within the aura
If you have another power like lycanthropy or invisibility in darkness, it's activated
cons: If you suck and can't see in your own aura
If your loved ones can't see in the aura
People can see you coming (a big radius of darkness surrounds you)

name: Bone Breaker
overview: break bones with a snap of your fingers
description: With this power you can break any person's bones with a snap of your fingers. You need to have that person in front of you. Concentrate on the bone to break, and then snap your fingers. Also, you can fix bones with the same procedure. It is better if you have an extensive knowledge of human anatomy.
pros: Break the bones of your enemies in any dangerous situation.
Repair bone in any accident
You will never have a broken bone
cons: Needs full concentration in the beginning
If you aren't careful, can cause serious damage to yourself or others.
People will suffer in pain if you don't use it wisely

name: Holy Power: Prismatic Volley
overview: shoot a volley of shots from all existing elements in the universe, destroying the target completely
description: Using the Gunslinger Pistols, you absorb a small amount of the universe tissue, focusing and comprising it inside the Pistols, and then releasing it against your enemy, attacking him with every element of the universe and destroying your target completely. This power wastes a regular amount of energy, and its range is safe and precise.
pros: Powerful, Safe and Precise, this ability is the perfect elemental power.
Doesn't wastes too much energy.
With all elements in the universe, its nearly impossible to survive this power.
cons: Takes a few seconds to get all the elemental energy.
Using this power too much can cause damages to the universe tissue and cause weird things to happen.

name: Heavy Rain Glasses
overview: use a pair of glasses that can gather enormous amounts of information.
description: These glasses are wirelessly connected to the internet, satellites, and various other things that can be used to find out what you need to know. Here's how it works: A person leaves their wallet on the ground. Activate the scanner on the glasses and it can identify it's owner using any DNA and fingerprints left on it. It can then find their address, phone number, etc.
pros: Find all sorts of information about friends and enemies
Can be used for blackmail
cons: They can break
No real combat purposes

name: Scarecrow (Scare Crow)
overview: make inanimate humanoid likenesses become very creepy, and use their creepiness to animate them
description: This ability is really good if you prefer to scare than attack. This causes any humanoid likeness (ventriloquist's dummies, mannequins, dolls and, of course, scarecrows) to become more and more creepy until it's creepy enough to bring to life. When they've reached their "peak creepiness", and enough fear has been imparted into the desired effigies, they can be animated; they will be able to exert greater strength and speed than any being that fears them.
pros: Creep enemies out
The creeping discomfort that they generate allows them to come to life temporarily
They can exert greater strength or speed than (and track) any being that finds them scary
cons: Only works on inanimate humanoid likenesses (dummies, dolls, mannequins, etc.)
If they creep YOU out, too, then they can overpower YOU, as well
Animation is only temporary

name: Hades
overview: gain the powers of the god of the underworld.
description: Hades the god of the underworld, also referred to as Hades the god of riches and the dead. This power not only gives you the power to manifest vast amounts of riches to your disposal whenever you wish, but it also allows you to control the dead. You also have Cerberus as your partner, but all dogs big or small have needs. It's very unwise to ignore the needs of this 30 story puppy. You'll reek of corpses most of the time and have pale skin.
pros: Untold riches
Control of the dead. (souls and zombies)
Giant three headed dog at your disposal
cons: Giant dog droppings. (grab the pooper scooper)
Reek of corpses
Pale skin

name: Lucky Last Shot
overview: good for last ditch efforts
description: Whenever you fire a gun, your accuracy is increased in proportion with the amount of bullets left. This way your last few shots will almost always hit where you want them to and be incredibly deadly.
pros: You will always succeed at something the first time you try it
Accuracy doesn't decrease proportionally, just increase
cons: No accuracy increase with machine guns
Only works for firearms (no longbows or bazookas).

name: Werepire
overview: become and posses the powers of both Werewolves and Vampires.
description: It can only work when you are bitten by a werewolf and a vampire, and you'll become a werepire (often referred to some as werevamp and vampwolf). Your strength and speed increase significantly, allowing you to move several meters and down a story in less than a second, as well as the ability to change partially, such as your eyes and teeth and even turn your fingers into claws.
pros: Can't be affected by sunlight.
Could turn others into Werepires.
cons: It'll work when you are bitten by a werewolf and a vampire.

name: Positive Power Charge
overview: gain strength based on positive feelings and emotions.
description:
This ability your strength, speed, accuracy, hand-eye coordination, logic and strategy skills increase greatly when in a vicinity of people feeling positive.
E.g Happy, cheerful, joyous, excited.
However you are weakened by people with negative feeling. Ths power opposes Negative Power Charge.
pros: You feeling positve, doubles the extent of your power.
cons: Must rely on people having positive feelings.
Negative feelings weaken you.

name: Luxuria
overview: cast an Illusion to another based on their most intimate desires
description: This ability allows the user to cast an illusion(s) to another person based on their most intimate desires. For example the person may see the one they love confessing to them, or perhaps see a harem of women(or men) relinquishing themselves. The illusion is very powerful and cannot be broken easily. Even if the person realizes that its an illusion that alone will not break it.
pros: Can work on just about everybody
Can't be broken by mere recognization of the illusion
cons: Though powerful and realistic it's a mere illusion
The length of the illusion is affected by the users own energy and power

name: Photon Repressed Superstrength
overview: have superhuman strength determined by how dark it is
description: Photon-Repressed Superstrength is generated by specialized cells all over the body. However, light causes these cells to become inoperative. So, at 12 midnight under a cloudy sky, you could bench 100 tons. At noon under the sun, you could bench 100 pounds.
pros: Become an awesome night watchman
Impress people at night concerts
Beat people up in the night and leave
cons: Little to no superhuman endurance
Little to no superhuman durability
Light, day, night in New York, floodlights, etc.

name: Animal Empathic Communication
overview: speak to & understand all animals & vice versa
description: Like Wild Thornberries, you will be able to talk to animals & have them understand you. Animals will also be able to talk to you & you will understand them. Even though you understand each other, it doesn't mean that dangerous, hungry animals won't attack you.
pros: Talk with animals & have an understanding of each other
Animals will help you if you need assistance
cons: Dangerous animals might still attack you
Some animals might not shut up

name: Arcana: 8 Strength
overview: get stronger, faster, and more durable the calmer and more serene you are.
description: You are strong, fast, invulnerable to harm! As long as you stay calm and centered. As opposed to getting stronger from fury, this power makes you grow in strength from calmness. The angrier and more emotional you get, the weaker you get. Showing extreme rage or sorrow will make you weaker than a normal person. A totally centered and calm person with this power would be able to tip over skyscrapers, run faster than the wind, and survive being hit by a bullet train.
pros: Strong, Fast, and Hard to hurt.
Harder to mentally dominate.
cons: Showing emotions makes you weak. Literally.

name: Nine Dragons
overview: fire 9 flaming dragons that'll swirl & engulf your opponent.
description: You could conjure up to nine blazing dragon spirits which fly towards, elevates & coils around your foes and then whips and damages them. Your foe is left burned in yellow-orange flames.
pros: It is super effective against plant type foes.
Melts off Ice type objects and opponents.
cons: None

name: Obsession Generation
overview: make a message of your choosing repeat itself over and over again in someone's mind.
description: The length of the message and the number of times it will be repeated depend on the energy you will spend to create it. Your target can also reduce the number of repetitions if they perform certain actions related to the message. For example, for "dirty", they can wash themselves or clean their house; for "the door's not locked", they can go all the way to their house and check their door; for "red is death", they can avoid touching red things or saying words with the sound "red".
pros: You can easily drive someone to madness, paranoia, suicide or murder.
It can be an effective way to brainwash someone.
A little energy is needed to use this power, so a message can be repeated for hours.
cons: The victim reduce the number of repetitions. But, they need to perform certain actions to do so.

name: Mercury Mimicry
overview: turn into a mercury based form which can change its phase or shape at will
description: A person with this power can turn into a mercury based form that can alter its phase and body physiology at will. In the mercury form, they have all the properties of mercury in the given form, as well as resistance to heat and a sort of heat detection capability. However, all the properties of mercury are copied, including toxicity and diamagnetism. I.e. can not touch people without poisoning them and is repelled by strong magnets. You can regenerate or grow larger by consuming mercury.
pros: Gives you heat detection capability----think thermometers
Alterable form--Liquid, solid, and gas and alterable body physiology
You are dangerous to touch and bulletproof and heatproof and can regenerate by absorbing mercury
cons: Too dangerous in mercury form ie can't grab someone to safety because of mercury poisoning
Can be called thermometer man as an insult
Affected by magnets

name: Harry Potter Magic
overview: use spells, techniques from the Harry Potter Brand.
description: With this ability the owner of it can use spells to accomplish a variety of things, lighting fires, instant killing, torture, mind control, teleporting. You need to know the incantation, or atleast the spell name, you also do not require a wand.
pros: Occlumency (Prevents mind control).
Legilimency (Mind Reading).
Instant killing.
cons: You may need to be a Harry Potter fan boy/girl.
Anti Magic Abilities.

name: Half Wyvern
overview: be half-human, half-wyvern
description: Someone who has this power has wings proportional to their body, fangs, and a long tail with an arrow-shaped barb. Anyone who they bite with their fangs will contract a deadly but noncontagious disease. Also, someone with this power will have boosted strength.
pros: If you bite your enemies, they will die in pain.
cons: Long-range fighters prevent the use of the bite.

name: King's Cross
overview: fire a huge light blue cross from your chest.
description: You can send a glowing turquoise cross from your chest in front of you directly towards the opponent or float in mid-air having several crosses kinetically imbued within spinning, swirling & surrounding around you, these follow as you fly damaging or killing every villain on sight. As it hits the enemy he/she will be quickly disintegrated.
pros: It protects you from the Dark Arts.
cons: They will fade as it lasts for eight turns.

name: Perceptible Magnetism
overview: see the magnetic field lines around you as colour gradients.
description: Magnetic fields are all around us, whether in the earth's magnetic field, around electrical objects, even very small ones in the brain. This power allows you to see those fields visually as colours, and so be able to tell things like the strength and direction. Always know exactly where North is. Be able to sense electrical equipment. Know in advance if an enemy is going to use a magnetic manipulation attack. The possibilities are endless!
pros: Always navigate perfectly with no need for a compass. Could be helpful with Flight.
Sense where and how powerful electrical equipment is.
Preempt magnetic superpowers by sensing disturbances in local magnetic fields.
cons: No control over magnetic fields, just perception.
Could be distracting, but focus is needed to use it so you probably wouldn't notice it normally.

name: Song Of Healing
overview: heal tormented souls and turn them into masks.
description: With this power, you have the ability to heal tormented souls with a song. Upon being healed and departing from this world, the soul leaves behind a mask. These masks allow you to transform into the mask's owner as they were just before death, granting you access to all of their abilities. People will recognize you as that person, but you will not have their memories or personality, so be careful. The masks can be taken off at any time and can be worn by anyone.
pros: Potentially unlimited mask transformations.
Perfect disguises.
Masks can be removed at any time or even given to other people.
cons: You do not have memory of the mask owner's life.
People will believe that owner of the mask is dead, so be careful.
This power does not allow you to see, locate, or communicate with tortured souls.

name: Library Of Dreams
overview: have access to all books that were erased from history or never published when dreaming
description: A person can access this library when they fall asleep. This will be akin to a lucid dream where they enter a library. In the library are all the books erased from history ie burned destroyed etc and books that were thought up but never published. Unfortunately you can only access these books for the duration of your sleeping time. You get kicked out when you wake up in real life. Also you cannot recall enough to write the books down when you wake up, although you remember the details perfectly.
pros: Can have access to all the books that you wanted to read
Can dream up furniture in the library to sit on while reading
These books cannot be accessed by anyone else

Will be tired when you wake up unless you sleep inside the library

name: Match Speed
overview: match the speed of anything you are chasing
description: With this power you can add the speed any object you are pursuing is moving at to your maximum speed while chasing it. In other words if you are chasing a car that is moving at 25 miles per hour and your top speed is ten miles per hour, you are able to move at thirty five miles per hour as long as you are chasing that car. Once you catch up whatever you are pursuing your extra speed goes away.
pros: You can match the speed of anything you are chasing
cons: The extra speed goes away once you catch the object

name: Literally Literally
overview: make a statement literal when "literally" is said but figuratively was meant.
description: When someone says "literally" and they meant figuratively you are able to activate this power and make their statement actually literal. The power is activated by saying "Literally?" when a figurative statement is said with the word literally. Example: statement said "I'm so hungry I could literally eat a horse." "Literally?" effect - the person who said the statement begins to devour a horse.
pros: People will learn real quick to use the word literally properly.
Power can be used on self to make something true. ex: I'm literally dating "celebrity name here".
cons: There is no way to undo the effect once this power is activated.

name: Spark Manipulation
overview: create an aura of extremely bright light around yourself.
description: Spark manipulation is similar to lumokinesis, but is not that at all. It is when you can stun your enemies using the sparks, making them blind or unconscious. You can also make yourself into a beam of sparks, and can shift your size and shape at will. You can also sting opponents when your sparks hit them
pros: You cannot be harmed while in spark form
Your enemies will not be able to see you after your attack
The stings can cause extreme pain to opponents
cons: Spark form only lasts for about 5 minutes
When in spark form, you cannot fly
Enimies can still defeat you if not fompletely blinded

name: Human Mood Ring
overview: read people's emotions.
description: When you read someone's emotions you know what they're feeling and your body turns into the color of their emotion. For example, If you sense that someone is feeling very happy your body turns into a dark blue color. It's all based off the mood ring colors.

Use it on your BF or GF if you are not sure that they love you
Use it on your boss if you think he or she is mad at you

Does not help with reading your own moods

name: Human Gun
overview: shoot any type of bullets from your body
description:
From bazooka to pistol. From sniper rifle to double barrel shotgun. You can shoot any kind of gun from anywhere on your body. But there are 3 rules that follows it. 
1. For every gunshot there is a price of energy so shoot wisely. 
2. You can not make up a gun, the gun must exist. 
3. You can not shoot for nothing, there must be a reason for every shot you make.

You can make your own gun and it counts as existing
You can regain energy by any means
cons: If you lose all your energy you fall alseep untill you gained all you energy back
If there is no such thing you can't shoot it
You can't shoot because you feel like it, you need a better reason

name: Whitelighting
overview: slowly heal anyone or anything that isn't dead. This does not apply to broken bones.
description: You can heal a cut, a bruise, a rash, anything except broken bones and if the person you're healing isn't already dead. This of course applies to yourself also. You're not immortal, you can just heal slowly.
pros: Heal fallen friends
Heal yourself.
Regain strength quicker when hurt.
cons: It's slow.
Doesn't work on the dead.
Doesn't work on broken bones.

name: Blessing Of Hephaestus
overview: have the blessing of Hephaestus
description: Hephaestus is the Greek god of fire and blacksmiths. His blessing gives you skills and powers unlike any other. You can craft magical weapons, armors, or items of any kind. Also, you can create anything OUT of anything else. A sword of fire. A chariot of lightning. A house of leaves. Another thing, you can control fire.
pros: You can create wonders
You can control fire
cons: Some of your creations might go haywire

name: Swarm Transformation
overview: fragment into a swarm of insects
description: At will, you can transform yourself into a swarm of flying, sting insects. You now control them all completely as a hive mind. You can reform only when the majority of the swarm is gathered together and shapes a humanoid form. If any insects are killed, then upon reforming the corresponding mass will be missing from your body, such as nails and hair, though you will quickly regenerate. If too many bugs are killed, you are killed too. A few bugs can be released at will to spy.
pros: You can easily spy on others
It is pretty difficult to kill a massive swarm of flying insects
In a dense humanoid form of flies, you can lift and move objects
