Experiencing dying as a bug could traumatise you

name: External Power Evolution
overview: improve another's power by stealing them.
description: With this power, you can touch a person and evolve it. This works by making the power one step better and then removing the old copy. This also refreshes it from any side effects not related to the power itself and restores it to it's normal condition, including cleansing it of the Condition Change powers. For example, if you used this on Regeneration, the subject may experience a faster healing factor and removal of pain. Unfortunately, this only works for normally acquired powers.

Gain as many powers as you want.
Help an ally who is struggling under the effects of a Condition Change power.

Each user can only use this once on each of a target's powers.
Con Negation does not work for this.

name: Origamimancy
overview: transforms origami objects into life.
description: An artistic ability transforms paper origami to life. It can provide entertainment, attack your enemies and uch more. You control the former origami figures and they will do your bidding without question.
pros: Spy agents.
Artistry
cons: Short paper supplies.

name: 2 Door Destiny
overview: have two doors show you your destinies.
description: You are able to make two doors pop out of nowhere and show you which destiny you should follow if you do this thing. If you are deciding over a girl or to kill somebody, it shows you what to do.

Know what you should do and shouldn't do
cons: Can't always control your own destiny
Sometimes you have to let go of some things

name: Vampirism Immunity
overview: be immune to powers that take from one directly
description: That is, any power that takes or drains energy, blood, etc will have no effect on one.
pros: Shadowulf1's Vampirism series will not affect you (not even Vampirism: Superpowers).
cons: This power makes you immune to even allies draining power from you.
You can't even use a power to drain yourself to boost an ally.

name: Cerebropathy
overview: detect and communicate with super-powered mutants with X-genes or Genetic Engineering
description: This ability amplifies the brainwaves of the user. It is not clear whether it finds mutants by the power signature they send out when they use their powers or by the presence of the of the X-gene in their body; both methods have been used throughout the comics.
pros: Detect mutants worldwide
Find mutated aliens outside of the planet
cons: How your power works is mysterious to you, but at least it works.

name: Resurrection (Half Demon)
overview: come back to life after you die, gain demonic powers
description: When you die, you come back from the dead with one or more powers from the demon who sent you back to the world of the living. You may end up looking like the demon but your actions are your own. It's possible to be a hero with demonic powers, just not easy to convince anyone of it.
pros: Coming back from the dead.
Gain really strong powers.
You have free will while in the living world.
cons: You may look like the demon who granted you another life, as a reminder of who you're endebted to.
You might constantly be trying to prove that you are not evil.
Coming back is more painful each time you die.

name: Electrifying Fire
overview: create and control a flame that shocks instead of burns
description: You can create a yellow flame that electrifies what it touches instead of burning things.

cons: The flame is a bright yellow which makes it easier to see.

name: Electroreception, Passive
overview: sense the weak bioelectic fields generated by other beings and locate them
description: All living beings generate a weak bioelectric field. In a method similar to how some sharks, fish, and even the platypus hunts for food, the possessor of this ability can sense the weak bioelectic field generated by the muscles, nerves, and in some cases, the gills, of other living beings. This sense is generally tuned to low frequency signals. A close-range ability, usually good within a few feet unless the it puts out a powerful bioelectric field. Also may be used to sense non-living things.

This can be used to supplement or replace your other senses
May even be able to find your lost cell phone

name: Miniature Army
overview: materialize a miniature army that can fire modern weapons and obeys your orders
description: If you've seen the movie Small Soldiers, then you will immediately recognize this power. However, the user materializes soldiers instead of making them. You are the general and you give them missions. Your army is made up of soldiers, navy, air force, and special ops. The army has tanks, copters and other military vehicles. Soldiers are armed with all modern weapons the user can think of and each have radios to communicate their findings to you. The army's numbers regenerate over time.
pros: You can command an entire army of soldiers/marines/air force whose numbers also regenerate over time
Find where your missing socks are
You can have your army surround your enemies and fire at will

Your army can be stepped on by anyone
The size of weapons does make a difference. However, the sheer number of attacks more than makes up

name: Enlargement

When the user punches somebody while their fist is enlarged, it can send the victim across a football pitch.

Gives superstrenght
Feel no pain

name: Quadarmy
overview: summon four soldiers
description: With this power you can summon four bodyguard/soldiers. They are all under your control and they are trained in all kind of fighting and know how to use any type of weapons. If one of them dies you can only summon tree and so on and so forth once all four die you lose this power.

They are under your complete control

Makes you look cool
Can change form

Enhances your weakness
Fire and super sound are your weaknesses

name: Alternate Reality:Heroes Vault
overview: use any weapon or tool that was used by a hero or antihero with 90% the efficiency of the original
description: With this power, you can access any weapon that was used by any hero or antihero in any timeline, by creating a downgraded copy from an alternate reality that gives you the same skills to wield it as the original user.  Also, you can transport people to your alternate reality to fight until someone dies. Weapons have all the effects given in myths and legends and also gives you access to the original user's memories.   Even modern heroes' weapons and tools can be copied.

In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and gain enhanced physical stats in the presence of subjects that wish for his success. One can even adapt their body, gaining superhuman abilities/features, to enter a competition wherever it is being held (in space, at the bottom of the sea, etc).

Alter reality in a set area.

Create more people

Naturally, it can also be used as an offensive weapon (slicing or stabbing) or as a defensive tool (super-dense body armor or a levitating shield). However, they cannot create glass. Example; you can say "massive" and "sword" to summon a huge sword to use. You can also link adverbs with verbs to enhance them as well. Example; you can say "run" and "quickly" to run at supersonic speeds.

description: The user is able to harness as well as use the powers that are embedded within the five mystical zeo crystals. The Red Zeo crystal has the ability of flight, the green zeo crystal has the ability of superstrength, the blue crystal is super speed, the yellow crystal is invulnerability and finally the pink crystal is healing.
pros: Different sets of power to combat different situations
Only gives power to the person that is good in nature
Cannot be stolen
cons: Cannot combine two crystals together to get two powers

name: Black Hole Immunity
overview: be immune to the attraction of black holes.
description: The summary says it all. With this ability, you can never get sucked into black holes. It also has the added bonus of letting you actually go through white holes, so you can see what's on the other side. So it also means you can escape black holes. However, you can still be sucked in if you touch the black hole (but who would actually do that? )
pros: Be immune to the gravity of black holes without being immune to any other gravity.
Escape black holes with ease.
Go through white holes and find out the truth of black holes.
cons: Where are you going to find a black hole?
You can still get sucked in by touching it.

name: Myth Power: Aegle's Aesthetic
overview: channel Aegle's command over the essence of the radiance of good health
description: Aegle (Aigle), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the radiance of good health, and the honor paid to people in the medical/healing profession. As such, channeling her allows one to be instantly snapped into peak physical condition, and always look healthy. In addition, one can withstand any injury, as they ruin/damage one's physical appearance. Furthermore, one can resist any disease that ruins/damages one's physical appearance. One even gains enhancement to any other healing/restorative powers.
pros: Always look healthy; snapped into peak physical condition, even when power's use is up
Immune to any injury, spot, blot, blemish, wrinkle or ailment that ruins one's physical appearance
Any medical/healing/restorative powers one has are enhanced; insured to NEVER die ugly
cons: Cannot enhance or disrupt/negate medical/healing/restorative abilities until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically steal beauty, by touch until developed (NCN)
Medical/healing/restorative MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Elemental Weapon: Wind Spear
overview: wield a spear that manipulates the wind element.
description: This ability you can call forth a spear to control and manipulate the wind element, you can create tornadoes, hurricanes, and wind blasts strong enough to rip off human flesh, and blow cars, trucks, even houses away. Or you can simply strike or thrust your spear piercing the flesh of your foes.  While wielding this weapon you are immune to the effects of the wind.
pros: Control and manipulate the wind (this includes any atmosphere you are present at)
Can lunge and pierce enemies with the spear
Create devasting natural disasters
cons: The spear controls the wind, not you
Only immune to the effects of wind when wielding the spear
Your elemental weakness is earth

name: Backwards Reality
overview: manipulate/change reality by saying sentences backwards.
description: The ability to manipulate or change reality by saying sentences backwards.  For instance, to stop someone in their tracks you say, "tracks in your stop."
pros: You can do anything you can put into words.
cons: If you are gaged you have no powers.
Got to turn sentences backwards.

name: Tattoo Power
overview: get a power based on your tattoos
description: If you have a Superman logo tattoo, you're Superman. A flame tattoo? You get flame powers. Any tattoo is possible, but you can only have up to three Tattoo Powers. Any extra and a random tattoo is burned off. And it hurts when it gets burned off!
pros: Three Tattoo Powers.
A cross tattoo could equal Jesus.
Mario or Bowser tattoo... Well, figure it out.
cons: Only three powers.
More than three makes a random tattoo burn off.
And it burns!

name: Human Vault
overview: take on the properties of a vault.
description: With this power you take on the properties of a vault. Your skin becomes impregnable and you gain the ability to open your chest and store items within yourself. You have infinite storage space, and the items you store will remain as they were when you stored them.
pros: Impregnable skin.
Infinate storage.
cons: You may be targeted by people who want to get inside your vault.
You can not eat by storing food in your chest.

name: Presence Projection
overview: alert others of your presence.
description: Annoyed that your friends and allies cannot see you while invisible? This is the power for you. You can project knowledge of your presence to targeted individuals, selected groups or those with a particular trait (e. G. A particular power).
pros: Eliminate a problem with invisibility and other concealment powers.
Prevent others from being surprised by your presence on arrival.
Can be controlled easily and turned off at will.
cons: Very limited usefulness, especially by itself.
While you may control this power, you may not control the powers it supports.
Immunity to telepathy will necessitate another mental communication power for this to function.

name: Chaos Sense
overview: perceive chaos and discord
description: One with this ability has a great gift on his side. It allows the user to sense current chaos as well as impending chaos. In other words, the user can tell when people are about to fight as well as sensing when a fight is about to take place, or the presence and movements of beings already in an altercation. This can even be used to discern if two beings dislike each other (and to what degree) or if they have conflicting beliefs.
pros: Tell when a fight is about to start
Tell when a fight is already occurring in one's immediate vicity (if you can't physically see it)
Sense if two people have conflicting beliefs (good at avoiding trouble)
cons: Doesn't tell you how to RESOLVE conflict
Not good for offense
May sense that a bigger, stronger, meaner foe dislikes YOU

name: Equalizer
overview: make a fight fair
description: If you fight someone stronger than you, you will get more powerful and glean some of their skills and, in some extreme cases, their powers, so that you are equal to them. Unfortunately,it has the same effect if you fight someone weaker than you.
pros: It is hard to beat you
You always have a chance
If your enemy has a superpower, you will gain it just because it is the only way to beat them
cons: It is hard to beat anyone as you will be equal to them
Your enemy always has a chance
Not ideal for fighting a group of enemies

name: Dinosaur Summon
overview: summon dinosaurs from the past
description: With this power you can summon dinosaurs to help you fight (or commit) crime. You can summon any species and as many dinosaurs as you want and they are under your complete control. When you're done with them you can just send them back in time.
pros: You can summon any amount of any species of dinosaur.
They are under your complete control.
When you're done with them you can just send them back in time.
cons: They might accidentally harm innocent people.

name: Importance Aura
overview: sense how important a object is or will be to you
description: With this power you will be able to see an aura around every object that tells you how important an object is to your current situation, or how important it will be to future situations. Different colors of the aura would tell you how important the object is or will be, and the strength of the glow (very dim to very bright) would tell you the amount of time you have left until the object will become important. If the object is important more than once the glow will reflect the more important tim
pros: Know what objects will be of vital importance to you
You would know what objects could save your life based on the color of the aura
cons: The aura does not indicate when or how the object will be of importance

name: Deep Thought
overview: trap a subject in such deep concentration that they become immobilized
description: One with this ability first conjurs up a thought. This thought is then implanted or psychically communicated to a foe; the foe starts to contemplate on the thought so hard, that as they try to make sense of it, all motor functions cease, and the subject has no other desire except to contemplate the meaning of the thought that has been implanted in their mind.
pros: The implanted thought can be the simplest thing, and they will contemplate it endlessly
Immobilizes the subjects (he won't even try to retaliate against attacks)
Requires little to no concentration to return the subject to normal
cons: Intense emotion triggers this ability (may make the foe contemplate the emotion that caused it)
If the power can't be turned off at will (or at all) it kills the foe (no desire to eat, drink, etc)
Makes the foe look stupid (trapped in a state of stupefied contemplation)

name: Reoccurence Eliminator
overview: prevent something from happening again
description: A person with this power has the ability to prevent anything from occuring exactly the same again. By exactly this means that something has to be different by a certain amount. Ie if a person tries to hit you with a cross hook and you use this they can never use a cross hook in the same arc ever again if you decide to do so. Try as they might they can never do that thing again. This power is permanent so it will force the other person to adapt and do things in new ways.
pros: No one can ever beat you in the exact same way
Enemies can't make the same exact move every time thus limiting choices
Is self controlled ie you don't suffer the same handicaps
cons: One Hit KO's
People that have lots of imagination--to come up with new ways to do stuff
Permanent power--if that person becomes your ally they will be crippled

name: Thoughtermination
overview: kill by thought
description: The ability to kill someone simply by thinking about their death and the conditions thereof. Death is immediate, and is caused by the conditions you select in your thoughts. The power is cut off when you fall asleep.
pros: You can destroy evil people in the world
You can remove all of those that get in your way
cons: You can easily and accidentally kill yourself
You can accidentally kill others
You may become too powerful and corrupted.

name: Necroplasmic Matter Manipulati
overview: manipulate and mold dead matter
description: With this ability, you can control any kind of matter that is dead (ie. Was previously alive). Whether it be human, animal, plant, or anything else in between, you can use said matter and mold it together into different shapes and forms to your will. Think the Green Lantern, but with dead matter.
pros: A virtually endless supply of matter to mold
Limited only by your imagination
cons: Matter will rot and deteriorate at varying degrees
May not smell so great sometimes, either

name: Fire Whirl
overview: send out a firey tornado that creeps above the ground.
description: It's been said in Wikipedia that a fire whirl, is a rare phenomenon in which a fire, under certain conditions (depending on air temperature and currents), acquires a vertical vorticity and forms a whirl, or a tornado-like effect of a vertically oriented rotating column of air. Fire whirls may be whirlwinds separated from the flames, either within the burn area or outside it, or a vortex of flame, itself. Fire Whirl does double duty--it sucks, spins and burns enemies inside of it.
pros: Evildoers are even sent flying up and burning into the air if caught in it.
You could summon a firenado or spin yourself in anger to become one.
cons: This power might be uncontrolled when it sucks and burns everything in sight period!

name: Quantum Mind
overview: perceive your life as all happening at once
description: This is a difficult ability to describe. A person with a Quantum Mind does not see their life as a series of events (I went to work, then I came home, then I went to bed). Instead, their mind is in their future and past even as they are in the present. This means that they know what is in store for them, and can never be surprised. However, they may also develop a fatalistic personality.
pros: Know what is in your future
Can mentally revisit your past
Never be surprised
cons: Can be disrupted by large nuclear blasts or tachyons
May develop a fatalistic point of view
Might not be understood by other people

name: Cheshire Smile
overview: harness the mad charm of the Cheshire Cat
description: First exhibited by the legendary Cheshire Cat, this ability allows the user to use his smile as a mode of defense or just amusement. In fact, the second the user cracks a smile, he can elect to become entirely intangible and/or entirely invisible (or mostly invisible, save one's eyes and smile); when the ability is in use, the user may also levitate and move through the air silently
pros: Disappear, turn intangible and turn inaudible at will
Levitate at will
Your smile finally has a use in a fight
cons: Your smile may become a bit larger than normal when power first manifests
People think you're creepy if you keep popping up in strange places all the time
You may go a bit mad after too many uses of the power

name: Letter Of The Day
overview: gain control of anything starting with the letter of the day.
description: The letter of the day starts with A on the day you get this power and changes each day, cycling through Z until you lose this power. You gain control over anything starting with the letter that is the letter of the day. Also works on people if the first letter of their name is the letter of the day. This power can be resisted by strong-willed people.
pros: Control over anything starting with the chosen letter.
Wide range of power.
Works on people's names.
cons: Cannot control which letter is the letter of the day.
Need large vocabulary to use more effectively.
Strong-willed people can resist this power.

name: Cuetzpalin, The Resilience
overview: have the means and strength to overcome nearly all obstacles and reinforce other people's courage.
description: You embody the Aztecs' representation of resilience, symbolized by lizards. When activated, you'll change into a human-lizard hybrid. The physical manifestation of this power allows you to be very nimble and reactive, climb up walls, have a detachable tail and a high tolerance to pain. The spiritual part of this power gives you more courage and resourcefulness to overcome emotional and psychological ordeal. You can also strengthen other people's courage and inspiration to overcome any obstacle.
pros: You're gifted with physical, emotional and psychological resilience.
Your powers can be used not just to flee, but also to dodge and to resist against damage.
You can breathe courage and resourcefulness into people's heart.
cons: Don't be too reckless as this power doesn't give you the means to surpass every obstacle.
While this makes you strong enough to overcome things like grief, others may see you as insensitive.
While you can take damage and still stand up, you are not invulnerable.

name: Skeleton Form
overview: become a powerful, animated skeleton at will.
description: At the user's command, they will become an animated, fleshless, hairless form of their own skeleton. This skeleton form will be indestructible, and whenever someone is killed by this skeleton, the mass of their bones will be added to it. This carries over to the user's human form, and the rest of the body will adapt to the new size.
pros: Indestructible skeleton form.
Can change form at will.
Can become larger.
cons: May eventually become strangely large in human form.
The weight of your bones alone is light initially.

name: Claymore : Dark Parasite
overview: posses a claymore that feeds on other powers
description: This Claymore feeds on other powers to the point where it becomes worthless. It is immune from detection. The blade is made from black obsidian. The hilt is made from iron. It is the oldest claymore( 4. 5 billion years)
pros: Detection immunity
You have the oldest claymore
Feeds on other powers
cons: Other claymores are immune ( no con negation )
This claymore looses its power during night time
you can only have one claymore ( no con negation )

name: Trackway Perception
overview: see the traces left by any animal, object or human on any surface
description: This power enables you to visually see what has been touched by anything or anyone in the form of glowing traces (footprints, handprints, pawprints,...) on any solid surface they made contact with. The more recent the trace is, the clearer it is. The user of this ability knows instinctively which traces belong to the same entity, effectively distinguishing all the trackways, but one won't know exactly who or what left them and has to discover it oneself.
pros: You can easily trace anyone or anything by following.
Discover what has been manipulated and find the culprit.
cons: Nope, gases or liquids are not solid surfaces.

name: Myth Power: Ode To The Oneiroi
overview: channel the Oneiroi and their command over the essence of dreams and nightmares
description: The Oneiroi, in Greek myth, were the gods of dreams.  As such, channeling Morpheus (Morpheos), one may psychically induce and manipulate dreams about people. Channeling Phantasos (Phantasus), one may psychically induce and manipulate dreams about inanimate objects. Channeling Icelos (Ikelos, Epiales, Phobetor), one may psychically induce and manipulate nightmares. One may even psychically receive or bestow dreams of past/present/future, and consciously control and remember one's own dreams.
pros: Psychically induce and manipulate dreams and nightmares (Oneirokinesis) at will
Psychically manipulate one's own dreams (Lucid Dreaming) and recall them (Dream Recall) at will
Withstand others' Dream Manipulation (Oneirokinetic Immunity)
cons: No Dream Travel/Teleportation, Dream Trapping or Dream Summoning until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot use dream energy (Dreamforce) to inflict hallucinations on waking foes until developed (NCN)
Sleeplessness, Dreamlessness, Perspicuity, MythPower: Hypnos' Lullaby, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Yclepsis
overview: use names for various effects
description: Also called Naming, this the ability to psychically cause subjects to react a certain way when their name is called followed by a command or a special phrase. After the user calls the subject's true name, they need only to call out a command (within the subject's power) or a predetermined phrase, and the command will carry out. This ability can even form a telepathic/empathic link with any other being of the same name or a similar name
pros: Afflicting the subject with any virus, disease or sickness the user knows the true name of
Causing the user to forget his own name/identity or the name/identity of loved ones
Causing the subject to think he or the user is someone else
cons: No Nicknames
The user must know the name of the subject that he wishes to affect
If the subject can resist Mind Control, Hypnotism or Psychic Persuasion, he can resist this ability

name: Reality Drawing: Spacial Block
overview: absorb and hold the reality of one's space to form a force field.
description: This ability will allow the user to have a powerful defense. This defense ability does have the price of taking away the unoccupied space depending on how big it is. Once the force field has disappeared, all space will return to its rightful place. All things that occupies space will start moving towards the user without any physical damage. This ability is the brother of the ability Reality Drawing: Temporal Blast.
pros: Will have a powerful defense
cons: Causes space to come closer

name: Chromaturgy
overview: harness light and create a substance from it, called Luxin.
description: Luxin can take on many different shades from the electromagnetic spectrum, and each color has its own unique properties. People who use Luxin are called Drafters, and most Drafters can only cast a single color of Luxin. More powerful Drafters known as Bichromes can use two colors of Luxin, and people who can use three or more colors are known as Polychromes. Superchromats have extremely acute vision when it come to colors. The inverse of those who are colorblind, they can see minute differences.
pros: Luxin can be used to create literally anything, from swords, to shields, to fireballs.
Limitless amounts of Luxin, as it comes from colored light.
You get cool colored shapes in your iris.
cons: Can only draft more than 1 color if you're a bi or polychrome
Can only draft a limited number of times in your life.
If you draft too much in your lifetime, you'll go insane.

name: Tea Master
overview: brew the perfect soothing tea.
description: You need to have access to the necessary materials to brew tea. You don't even need to know how to brew tea, this power will guide you. While you make some tea, this power's effect will infuse the tea with soul-soothing properties, making you the perfect tea master. Even if someone else tries to copy your preparation method, they won't be able to make a tea as good as yours. Drinking the tea, or even just smelling the tea, will appease even the most raging minds.
pros: Make peace, not war.
You don't need to know how to make tea.
This power is required to make this perfect tea.
cons: You are vulnerable while the tea is being prepared.
You need to have the materials to make tea, such as the tea leaves, a pot and some water.

name: Password
overview: have control over passwords.
description: A person with this power has the ability to control his own passwords as well as that of others. Passwords can instantly be discovered and even changed to whatever the user wishes. Passwords can even be protected so that others, even someone with this power, can not affect them. Passwords can even be placed on objects you own so that they can not be used without having the password.
pros: Discover and change passwords.
Protect your own passwords.
Place passwords on objects.
cons: Can't discover passwords of other people who have this power.
Only works on passwords and not other security items like fingerprint scanner.
Having to use passwords to activate all your items.

name: Shock Blades
overview: throw electrical, circular saw blades.
description: It's a weaponry superpower that takes the form of a razor-edged circular saw blade that's covered in dangerous electricity. The shock blades can be generated and thrown in any direction. The blades swirl around the opponent, slicing and shocking them.
pros: Can be hazardous to bird and water-type enemies.
cons: Will not work against metal manipulators.

name: Bat Mimicry
overview: take on the traits of a bat.
description: You have the ability to emit a high-pitched scream, which can be used in a concussive manner, to shatter objects, or via echolocation. You have two very large, sensitive, ears which are used for superhuman hearing and aid in echolocation. Your thumb ends in a long claw, while the rest of your fingers are elongated and form two large bat wings used for flight.
pros: You have a superhuman screeching ability.
You can fly.
You have superhuman hearing.
cons: This power is highly noticeable.

name: Tv Character Summon
overview: summon any fictional character from a television series
description: With this power you can summon any fictional character from any television series ever made. The characters are not under your control but depending on which characters you summon they may want to help you. When you're done with them you can send them back to whatever universe they came from.
pros: You can summon any character from any Television Show ever created
cons: They are not under your control

name: Hive Of Consciousness
overview: use the Conscious Hive.
description: Your brain is split into several independently functioning organs. You can multi-task at an incredible rate, focusing on several things at once. Your intelligence and ability to analyze things are unsurpassed.
pros: Multi-task.
Analyse things at incredible rates.
High intelligence.
cons: Might have a multiple personality.

name: Animalizing
overview: change people into animal/human hybrids
description: This ability allows you to change other people into animal/human hybrids. You get to choose what animal the hybrid will be and if it will have two or four legs. When you activate this power, the person grows fur or scales just like the animal they are turning into, then (if you chose four legs) extra legs and animal body parts (snout, claws, etc.) that are the right size for the body. The change will always be uncomfortable for the person undergoing it, and the change is permanent.
pros: Superheroes keep their powers when you use it on them
Turn supervillains into little mice
Mess with people
cons: It's permanent and you might regret it.
If you use it on yourself, you lose the power
Supervillains keep their powers when you use it on them

name: Egyptian Magic
overview: use Egyptian magic
description: Egyptian magic is the use of ancient Egyptian words and symbols to affect your surroundings. For example, if you want to unlock a door, you would focus on the door and say the ancient Egyptian word for open(sahad). The Egyptian symbol for open will appear on the door as a glowing colored hieroglyphics. The color depends on your personality and how powerful you are. Or you could just use the symbols, writing them somewhere, as a trap or something. Almost anything is possible with this magic.
pros: You could be a very powerful Egyptian magician
Not much is impossible to you
cons: Must learn ancient Egyptian language and writing

name: Lethal Ability Amplification
overview: increase others' abilities until it kills them
description: You amplify the abilities of another superhuman until it kills them, normally by exceeding their necessary secondary powers. For example, you could make a pyrokinetic literally explode incinerating himself, force a speedster to run so fast that the air friction liquefies him, make a telepath's mind shut down from the stress of reading so many minds. With some powers, increasing them could endanger or kill others , such as a pyrokinetic releasing a massive explosion, potentially killing you too.
pros: Can take out any dangerous supervillain
Become a specialised superhuman hitman
If a villain, no metahuman hero could defeat you
cons: If your enemy's power comes from technology, your power is useless
You could be killed by your foe's loss of control
This power only really works for amoral people or villains

name: Tornado Of The Elements
overview: create tornadoes (and tornado-like forms)
description: This ability allows one to create tornadoes. However, the tornadoes created are not limited to tornadoes of gale-force WINDS; you could use this power to create a fire tornado, a water tornado, a rock tornado, a sand tornado, as well as many other kinds; the limit is really just your imagination. This ability even allows you to combine tornado effects...like maybe water plus fire equals a steam tornado, and fire plus rock equals a lava tornado.
pros: Create tornadoes at will (for both defense and offense) and guide their movement
Select the element that is converted into tornado form (fire, water, ice, earth tornado, etc.)
Mixing elements to create numerous creative effects
cons: Can't STOP tornadoes (created or natural) and cannot otherwise manipulate weather
If not guided well it could be deadly
Limited by your imagination

name: Thuper Lithp
overview: gain superpowers from speaking the name of the power in a lisp
description: With this power, anyone criticizes your speech at their own risk. You can gain nearly any power by saying its name, but only by saying it in a lisp. So, instead of saying "super strength", you'd need to say "Thuper Thrength". For "size manipulation", you'd need to say "Thize Manipulathion". And while the power may be used for nearly any desired length of time, the cool-off time is just as long as power use. Otherwise, you need to say it again if you want to have that particular power again.
pros: Just say the name of nearly any power to get that power.
Could briefly confuse enemies.
Lithpth are AWETHOME
cons: People could make fun of you; Might get the wrong power by saying the name wrong.
Level of powers that can be used must develop as this power develops
Power not permanent; to use it again, you must say it again (after the cool-off time).

name: Ophiomancy
overview: control and summon snakes
description: With this power, you are the best snake charmer ever. To summon the snakes, focus on the word "snake" and all the snakes within a 5-mile radius will slither to you and be at your command. You can control these snakes to fight and bite your opponents. In addition, all the snakes you've summoned will have a venom boost, and you will be immune to snake venom. However, this isn't the best power if you live in a place where there are few snakes.
pros: You can summon and command snakes to attack your enemies
All these snakes (even nonvenomous ones) have a vemon boost
You will be immune to snake venom
cons: This isn't a good power if there are few snakes where you live
Summoning can sometimes drain your energy

name: Quiz Genius
overview: know the answer to every question on every test you take.
description: With this ability, you will know the answer to every question on any test you take. You might not understand the answer, but you will definitely know it. You can only use this ability to answer questions that have solvable answers. By the way, if someone asks you a question, that's considered a sort of test, so you'll know the answer! You can't test yourself.
pros: Always be right.
You can solve people's problems.
cons: You might need bodyguards.
You might not learn anything in school.

name: Cross Telephone Persuasion
overview: control anyone through their phone
description: A person with this power has the ability to control anyone that is answering a phone call. This power is akin to charisma or hypnotic voice but it only works through the electronic interface of phones. You can use any type of phone to call and the receiver comes under your control as long as they don't hang up. The affected person is unaware of the call and will forget everything once they or you hang up.
pros: One phone call while in prison
You can control important leaders by calling them
People put on hold are still under your control awaiting orders unless they hang up
cons: People have to be listening to the phone (Bluetooth works though)
You have to tell people not to hang up the phone or else they might hang up first
You have to know the person's number and the power can run out mid-conversation

name: Sun Ray Nutrition
overview: gain energy from the sun.
description: You wouldn't need to eat because you would get all the energy you need from the sun. You could live without food as long as there is light.
pros: Never need to eat again.
Can get energy anywhere.
cons: You can't stay indoors too long.
Cloudy days leave you with less energy.

name: Type Resonance Energy
overview: produce energy unique to that individual
description: Energy that is generated by the organism that is unique to that individual (usually expressed through varying colors). Emitted through the hands, once released the energy can be manipulated into different shapes and projected at high speeds. A more unstable form of this energy can be released causing an exploding effect, this is usually only obtained after training and practice. This ability is often accompanied with self propelled flying.
pros: a more common superpower
cons: This power requires a substantitive ammount of chemical reactions to take place.
As a result the person possesing this power often becomes tired easily

name: Wall Tearer
overview: rip walls open, including magical barriers, forcefields,...
description: When you are facing any kind of wall, you can plunge your hands into it and tear it open. You can only use your hands to do it, and these and your arms are the only parts of your body that are immune to whatever effect the wall can have. The rip will stay open indefinitely until it is repaired or closed in a way.
pros: Great against barrier-type powers.
Your hands are immune to the effects you should get when touching the wall.
No wall is strong enough to block you.
cons: In case of a normal wall, parts of the building or structure may collapse as the wall is weakened.
The rest of your body is vulnerable to magical effects.

name: Ultimate Tk(Light Speed)
overview: throw lasers or grab light
description: A person with this power can send objects they touch to any direction at lightspeed. In effect it looks like the person is throwing lasers. Since the user can accelerate objects to lightspeed, the reverse is also true. They can slow down light enough to grab it with no ill effects when in contact. With practice(hopefully), you can also accelerate yourself to lightspeed.
pros: Throw lasers(actually objects at lightspeed)
Can deccelerate light enough to grab it/touch it.
You can accelerate yourself to light speed
cons: Needs aim even with lasers
Needs projectiles to make lasers(but can use air)

name: Heavy Powers
overview: give someone's powers weight and increase that person's density.
description: Each power actually possessed,stolen,mimicked,duplicated or copied with power backup ability adds together and multiples the person's density by that number. Author power mimicry adds all the powers created by that person. Shadowulf1 tamer add all powers created by Shadowulf1. It takes 50 copies(the power backup ability) to equal one power. Top 10 power mimicry adds up to 10 powers,depending on how many of them the person actually possesses. Omni power mimicry counts as one power.
pros: Make a power duplicator to heavy to move his own body.
Slow or stop power thieves.
Another way to stop someone using author power mimicry.
cons: Someone with super strength.
You give someone invulnerability with this power.

name: Childish Wishes
overview: grant the wish of a child
description: With this power, you may grant the wishes of anyone under the age of thirteen. All the child must do is say "I Wish... " and you are able to grant the request that follows. Be the kind Fairy Godparent who makes all their dreams come true or the cruel Jinn who twists the words of their wish to harm them and everyone around them.
pros: Grant children's wishes.
Sell wishes and make oodles of money.
cons: You may only grant the wishes of children,
The wish must begin with "I Wish... "
People may think you're a creep for hanging around children.

name: Exact Condition
overview: always be exact
description:
When using this power the person always does things exact no more no less and reality warps subconsciously to make a person "exact"

Slight reality manipulation always have the exact amount in your wallet, when in the lab all measurements are exact and reactions perform exactly as calculated with very precise equipment
pros: Always take exact measurement
You are always "exact"ly right in calculations
You will always have "exact"ly what you need
cons: You can never be better than "exact"
If someone asks you for the exact value of pi and you try to explain, same with meaning of life

name: Cyperiokinesis
overview: give the sensation of being burned and frozen simultaneously.
description: Through the hand of the caster, a sensation of intense burning and zero-degree freezing is felt within the target, giving both a mental and physical disability.
pros: Heavy wounding if inflicted properly
Can leave the enemy mentally defeated if nothing else
cons: Depending on the strength of the opponent, it may not be as effective as on a weaker one
Through total mental control, it can be overcome

name: Which Blade
overview: wield a sword that changes each time you unsheathe it.
description: Every time you take out this weapon, it is different. From the lameness of a pencil to the power of Excalibur, this weapon is totally unpredictable. You can get any weapon with a blade or point, so no spoons or guns, unless they have a machete on them. If your sword breaks, you can put the handle in the sheath and it will come out as a new sword, one that hasn't been broken. If your sheath breaks, then it is stuck as is. If you make a new one, it won't change the blade.
pros: Any sharp weapon
Chance of mythical/legendary swords
If your sword breaks, you can put the handle in the sheath and it will come out as a new sword.
cons: No way to predict or control what sword you get
Chance of pencils, pens, arrowheads or other useless ones
If your sheath breaks, then it is stuck as is. If you make a new one, it won't change the blade.

name: Instant Replay
overview: instantly replay a scene, moment, or a recurring image in public
description: Perhaps you get yourself in a debate and you'd like to repeat certain points that the opposition pointed out earlier. Instant Replay is just the thing for the job!  Forgot where you put the keys? Don't know what you ate for breakfast? Instantly Replay it in real space that you can project anywhere, anytime! What better way than to say "I told you so!" when you can just show it?
pros: Can repeat important information required during missions
No need for electricity or gadgets
Can replace TV
cons: Will only replay whatever you have seen and heard
Must have surface to project onto
Will only play reruns (hence replays) of shows (if used as replacement for TV)

name: Daily Powers
overview: powers change daily
description: Your powers change every day. There's no limit to the powers that you'll have!
pros: There's not limit to your powers.
New powers everyday.
cons: Once you used that power for a day, it will never come back.

name: Chainokinesis
overview: control and manipulate chains.
description: With this ability, you can control chains with your hands as well as release them from your hands. It is a lot more draining to release chains. If you are more adept, you can even release chains from walls and the ground.
pros: Never run out of chains.
Lock people down.
Beat people with it.
cons: Very draining
Useless if you have Intangiblity
Can be melted with fire

name: Haha! Burn, Baby, Burn!
overview: control and create minions out of fire, water, air, etc.
description: You can actually control the elements. Good thing is you can create your own minions from your element, such as, let's say, you can control fire, you can create minions who are your element (fire) and they follow your commands. Bad thing is, you CAN be defeated by your opposite element, such as water beats fire, earth beats wind, energy beats ice and so on. The examples below are the characters created from my own imagination.
pros: Kyanos (ice)
Tremblor (earth)
Groglurk (fire)
cons: Drakonnan (fire)
Haeos (energy)
Heatblast (fire)

name: Delete This Life Crusher
overview: completely drain the very life of your foe to death, then stomp on their back.
description: You can grab your opponent by the neck, filling your fists with dark energy, and start consuming their life force. Then, you even punch your enemy in the stomach and allow the charged dark indigo firey energy to burst through them before throwing their body to the ground, and then stomp on their back that breaks their spine.
pros: Could steal a person's life to gain a new one.
cons: Can't give back a life that you stole from a person.

name: Costume Power
overview: gain powers depending on what costume you wear.
description: You are able to change into the things you wear. For example, you are able to have the powers of a sorcerer if you dress like one, or you are able to have the powers of a superhero if you dress like one. If you need to learn about people from the past, you can put on those types of clothes and see what it was like. That also includes if you want to learn about a famous person, you could dress like them and then know what they know. But you can always go back to just being you if you want.
pros: Can be different persons
Can totally freak people out during Halloween
Fun
cons: You might not have the costume you want
People might think you're weird if you always wear a costume
Can't merge two costumes, e.g. you can't add angel wings to an alien costume

name: Power Reverse
overview: cause anyone's power to become its polar opposite.
description: With this strange power you can cause a Pyrokinetic to become a Hydrokinetic, a Flyer to become a Tunneler, a Mind Reader to a Mind Controller. With one touch you could cause anyone's power to completely reverse. All powers have an opposite and this power also tells you what the reversed power will be. Some powers on the other hand might have more than one reversed form. For example, an Ability Amplifier might become either an Ability Thief or an Ability Dampener. With practice you could choose.
pros: You can reverse people's powers (and change them back).
If someone you know hates their power.
You know what the reversed power will be.
cons: Most won't know how to control their new ability.
You must touch them to reverse them.
Reversing your own power could be bad.

name: Aphrodite
overview: have hypnotizing beauty
description: This power enables the user to be as beautiful as Aphrodite herself. But Aphrodite has a temper. So the user can also make sure that any victim can never be loved.
pros: Beauty
More than just looks
cons: Kinda boring

name: Saboteur
overview: become a superpowered expert in the art of sabotaging.
description: The Saboteur is capable of disturbing the peace among individuals, small cliques, communities, and with enough willpower, towns or countries. The Saboteur's greatest tool is chaos and utilizing this element augments your strength drastically. The Saboteur also draws power from civil disputes, anger, shouting, and other forms of rage. When the Saboteur is fueled by chaos, he or she will emanate a burgundy aura. The aura can discharge in several forms of offense and defense.
pros: Riots will transform you into a virtually invincible being of unmeasurable power.
Blast targets with beams of raw chaos.
Expanded knowledge of sabotage; possibly unlimited solutions.
cons: Pacifists and monks are your worst enemies.
May be portrayed as a sociopath.

name: Negative Power Charge
overview: gain strength based on negative feelings and emotions.
description:
This ability your strength, speed, accuracy, hand-eye coordination, logic and strategy skills increase greatly when in a vicinity of people feeling negative.
E.g Angry, upset, frustrated, moody.
However you are weakened by people with positive feeling. Ths power opposes Positve Power Charge.
pros: You feeling negative, doubles the extent of your power.
cons: Must rely on people having negative feelings.
Negative feelings weaken you.

name: Vision Drain
overview: drain a person of their memories and add them to yours.
description: This power lets you steal a persons very memories, any they have from now to the day they were born, simply by touching their head. This move can be useful if you need to learn a secret your friend is keeping from you, find out where they hid the diamonds, or discover any other information the target could possibly know.
pros: Find out any bit of information you need.
Good for police investigations.
Find out the answers for that big important test you have on Friday.
cons: You could see some disturbing things.
Mind learn some hurtful things if the target knows you.
Could get cought by someone else if you don't use this power in private.

name: Polymerkinesis
overview: control and reshape plastic objects
description: You can be capable of manipulating and channelling various kinds of plastic. You can even manipulate polyesters and silicone-based nylons to your whim. This newly developed technique allows you to form organic bioplastics with the earth, water, and air.
pros: You can be a Plastic Magnet
Plastic is a relatively common substance
cons: Fire will melt anything you can control
Rural areas typically do not have many plastics

name: Demolition Zone
overview: create a zone that allows the destruction of anything.
description: This power creates a zone that changes things that are inside. Things inside the zone lose their invulnerability and immortality for as long as they are inside the zone. Objects become more brittle the longer they are inside the zone. People also begin to develop the power the create controlled explosions on inanimate objects to demolish them. The effects of the zone fade though when the zone is left.
pros: Enemies lose their invulnerability and immortality.
Objects become weaker.
Ability to cause controlled explosions on inanimate objects.
cons: You lose invulnerability and immortality too.
May start breaking things you do not want.
Foes can cause explosions as well.

name: Point Defense
overview: defend oneself with offensive powers
description: Basically, point defense is the practice of defending a single object or small area using things that are normally offensive. Ex: Using Surface-to-Air missiles to destroy Intercontinental Ballistic missiles, however realistic that may seem. This power just applies the practice of point defense to offensive superpowers. For example, this power will use Pyrokinesis, but not PB: Ignition. You could do point defense without this power, but it is harder to do without this power.
pros: If all your other powers are offensive, then this power will really help.
You can still use your powers normally even if they're being used by Point Defense.
This power calcutes out all the mathematics involved for the user.
cons: Has no effect on normally defensive powers.
Will not affect friends' powers.
Con Negation and similar alteration powers do not affect this power.

name: Magic Effect Transfer
overview: transfer the effects of magic from one being to another
description: Curses and enchantments are long-lasting magics that affect objects and people and are sometimes permanent. Someone with this power can change the one who is affected by those types of spells. Each spell whose target is changed will drain energy from the user of this power and require a large amount of concentration. The stronger the spell, the higher the energy drain.
pros: Take curses off allies and put them on enemies.
Concentration needed remains the same regardless of spell strength.
cons: Some high-level curses and enchantments (especially divine ones) cannot be affected by this power.
Pretty much impossible to use while fighting.

name: Golden Flames
overview: create and control flames that are anti-evil
description: These flames have the color of gold and can hurt beings like ordinary fire but deal more damage to anything that is evil and less to anything that is on the side of good. Those who are extremely virtuous will most likely not be harmed by these flames.
pros: Cool golden flames that have the purpose of taking down demons.
cons: Not meant to be used against the virtuous.

name: Perfect Power Detection
overview: detect what power would be perfect for someone
description: This power will look at everything about a person- from their passions, dislikes, and personality to what other people think about them, and will tell you what the perfect power for them would be. You can also limit what it's based off (for example, just based off of their desires and nothing else, or just what power would make them happiest), and limit what powers there are to choose from (for example, "of the powers off of the super power list... ").
pros: A must have for power-granters! You also get to know *why* it's perfect.
Also does the reverse, you can look at some of the powers that they'd hate the most
Will manage your own powers too if you have Josh's Power Switchboard (see very first comment).
cons: Without power-gifting powers, completely useless
No more asking people "what power(s) would you want, if you could have superpowers"
(since you'll already know the answer)

name: Emotional Submission Chamber
overview: create a barrier that traps your opponent for free hits.
description: With a gesture you can encase your opponent in a grey barrier from head to toe concentrating based on your emotions, he or she get a panicked look on their faces and the barrier closes in an orb around them and lifts them above the ground. Massive color balls of willpower, fear, rage, love, hope, compassion, justice, sorrow, peace, joy, greed & wisdom forming orbiting and spiraling inwards towards the barrier and it powerfully explodes with the foe that's in it dealing a huge amount of damage.
pros: You could out-trap your foe with this move.
cons: None

name: Aura Attune: Air
overview: attune your aura with the element of Air.
description: With this power, you may attune your aura with Air. While active, all mystical and spiritual abilities related to air or wind are greatly empowered, but all earth related ones are weakened. You also become more resistant to air powers, but weaker to earth related powers. This power also makes your aura like that of a powerful Air Elemental, causing Air-aligned beings to treat you with respect. Earth-aligned beings, however, fear or hate you. Luckily, this power can be turned on and off.
pros: Empower your spiritual or magical air powers.
Have air-aligned creatures treat you with respect or friendliness.
Become more resistant to harmful air powers.
cons: Weakens magical and spiritual earth powers.
Earth-aligned creatures hate or fear you.
Weaker to harmful earth powers.

name: The Guardian Of Eden
overview: protect and use the Garden of Eden
description: The power to protect and use the Garden of Eden. The Garden can give you powers or let you see into the future, each gift is different for each individual, however, the Garden can make it's own choices and if you prove unworthy, it will kill you or banish you to the darkest regions of Hell.
pros: The Garden gives you a gift it see's you need. (weaponry/powers)
You have the ability to protect Eden and use the wisdom and powers of the Tree.
You are viewed as a high ranking Angel which can move in an out of Eden at whim
cons: If proven unworthy to the Garden it will either kill or banish you to the darkest regions of Hell.
You cannot change the future.
You cannot use the Garden for revenge or murder.

name: Vampiric Matter Manipulation
overview: create and control a form of matter that feeds on other matter's motion energy.
description: This ability allows the user to generate a sinister material that is design to feed on the energy that other matter to move. This makes the other matter inert and maybe even worse. The vampiric matter can absorb the matter's basic properties.
pros: Create a dangerous matter that feeds on other matter to be more powerful.
Make all matter useless
Affects living creatures as well.
cons: Does not possess special properties of other matter just how the matter moves.

name: Lord Of Shadow: Shadow State
overview: steal people's shadows, allowing you to gain their powers by entering the Shadow State
description: With this power you can steal a person's shadow by touching it. You gain the person's powers, but you can only use them in the Shadow State. When you enter the Shadow State, your eyes turn black and you are surrounded by a dark aura. You can use the powers of all the people whose shadows you have stolen. But using the Shadow State has a cost. The darkness fills you with rage, and the shadows carry the memories of their original owners. Without practice, the rage and memories could consume you.
pros: In the Shadow State you have complete mastery over the powers you have gained
You can enter the Shadow State at will
Can be used with Shadow Traitor: you can steal a shadow for your army and gain its powers too
cons: The rage and memories make it hard to control youself (think Avatar State)
Even with experience, prolonged time in the Shadow State can drive you insane

name: Meteoric Metamorphosis
overview: convert your body into stone and propel yourself like a meteor
description: This power allows you to turn yourself into a stone-like material and launch you in the air like a real meteor. You can fly in that form and, in addition, your body will be unbreakable, destroying every terrestrial stuff in your way.
pros: You can fly really fast both on earth and in the space
If you land in somewhere with enough force, you'll make a real disaster
In your Meteoric form, you're completely invincible, even if you don't have oxygen
cons: It's really hard to control the flight distances
Your force will be very difficult to tame if you aren't very careful
Your power can be a danger to others in a very enclosed places

name: Correlation Inducement
overview: make any one factor influence any other.
description: With this ability, you can make any one factor influence another, with a positive or negative correlation. You can make any one factor influence any other, such as making the amount of toast consumed positively correlate with longevity; the more toast a person eats, the longer they live.
pros: Achieve a huge variety of effects.
Universal.
Fits several specialized purposes.
cons: Universal.
It lasts until death or intentional reversal, so you could forget it is in action.
Be careful not to make one factor influence another when the opposite is already in play.

name: Transformutation
overview: turn any mechanical or electrical device into a Transformer.
description: Basically, this power lets you give life and transforming ability to any mechanical or electrical device. You are essentially a selective "All Spark". The transformers you create are at your command, becoming your trained pets. Like pets, however, they must be cared for and taught how to behave, otherwise they revert to their natural "good" or "evil" base.
pros: You can have your own personal robotic bodyguard anytime you want.
Turn your car into battle-ready warrior - who can then turn into a better car!
You can have many smaller pets that will do your mischievious bidding.
cons: Bigger transformers tend to be accidentally destructive. Your car might sit on your house!
Un-cared for transformers could turn against you.
Too many transformers might be hard to manage.

name: Alti Power
overview: make people experience something from their past or future.
description: I didn't make this. It's a power that someone named Alti has on Xena: Warrior Princess. When she touches people she can make them go through something in their past or future in the present. Once she touched Xena and made her experience being crucified from the future, and Xena's hands and feet got nail holes in them. She also made her legs feel broken another time, but didn't actually break them because she wasn't touching her.
pros: Its a friggin awesome power
You can see a person's future or past with it
It makes super PWNage
cons: You have to touch a person to do it fully.

name: Death's Scythe
overview: summon Death's Scythe
description: The ability to summon death's scythe which can slice and dice anything no matter how strong. The scythe can also grab people and send them for judgement which will either send them for eternal punishment in hell or eternal happiness in heaven.
pros: Can cut through anything.
Send enemies to hell.
Can summon it wherever you are.
cons: Anyone can use it while you're unconcious if you had it in you're hand.
Enemies may go to heaven or choose to to come back to life.
Can be used on you.

name: Book Of......
overview: summon a book on any topic
description: Say you wanted to know to bake a cake. All you would have to do would be think or say "Book of Baking" and it would appear wherever you want. It would contain all the information known on baking but still be normal size. To make it vanish say or think "Book of Baking" and it would vanish. You could do the same thing for any topic. Book of Magic, Book of History, or even Book of Books. Can have as many books as you want at one time. But you may want to always have the Book of Books as a guide.
pros: Have the ultimate source of information on anything at anytime
The books are normal sized and can be vanished whenever
Could get more power from books like Book of Magic
cons: May not know what book you might need.
May lose track of some books

name: Existential Frequency Shifting
overview: target someone so that person is the only one who can interact with you.
description: This power allows you to tune into someone's existential frequency. By doing so, that person becomes the only one who can see, hear, or touch you, or more generally interact with you -- anybody else who doesn't match that frequency will just phase through you, won't even notice you and won't have any effect on you. That person is also the only one you can interact with. So, from your point of view, you are in a copy of the real world but devoid of population, except for you and that person.
pros: Your frequency can be changed randomly. It'll have a slight chance to match someone's in the world.
Anyone who doesn't match your frequency can't do anything to you, since you don't "exist" to them.
They can't even detect you or cancel your power.
cons: You can only interact with the person (or people, in rare cases) who matches your new frequency.
You can feel very lonely, seeing the world as an empty place.
To cancel it, you must match the universal frequency. If you don't realize it, it can mean trouble.

name: Adventure Time!
overview: make crazy, funny and cool things happen by saying out loud "Adventure Time"
description: Your life is boring? Problem solved! When you say the magical words "Adventure Time", you will be treated to an awesome, dangerous and funny adventure. This way you will never get bored, and you can go on all crazy adventures that you always wanted. The adventure usually starts when something weird happens exactly after you say "Adventure Time", so have fun!
pros: You will never get bored (saying Adventure Time causes SOMETHING randomly cool to happen)
Adventures are dangerous, but you will never die in them, and they are always awesome.
cons: Has no battle purposes, except maybe escape

name: Weight Shift
overview: shift your center of gravity to anywhere in your body
description: Your center of gravity is the point in your body through which you find it easiest to balance. With this power you can shift your weight to move it about your body at will with no visible effects. This concept was briefly explored in Futurama where it grants Hermes mad limbo skills. However, there are many other uses. If you place it in your head it can make you very difficult to knock down. Placed in your feet it makes it easier to get up. A variety of ninja-like skills are at your disposal.
pros: Very Versatile
Ninjaesque
No visible changes
cons: Difficult to get the hang of
Feels slightly uncomfortable
Placing weight in your head only works if you are hit in the head

name: The Giving Tree
overview: create seeds for any sort of tree
description: When you use this power, a seed or seeds will appear in your hands. The seeds will have a small image of what it will make. When you plant the seeds they will grow unnaturaly fast, fully grown in less the five minutes. You can even control what its full size is. You can choose what they bear. It can be anything from oranges to money to machine guns.
pros: Can create almost anything
Trees are cool
cons: Trees can be chopped down
Can create ALMOST anything

name: Rotating Shield
overview: create a shield that rotates and spins areas of itself
description: The forcefield created has a maximum radius of 100 metres. The shield is constantly and automatically rotating. The effect of the rotation is to decrease the damage inflicted to the shield itself. This allows the shield to last against more attacks in the long-run but takes up more power than your average force field.
pros: Can take more hits in a longer battle.
75% less concentration needed to have the field spin than with a normal forcefield.
cons: Takes up more power in the long run that could be used for other powers during the fight.
Normal nonspinning shield takes 20% less concentration to keep going than this shield.

name: Calcium Manipulation
overview: control and create calcium, and objects made out of Calcium.
description: With this power you are able to control not only calcium, but objects that have a large amount of calcium in them. This means that the user is able to create and control things such as milk, bones, and shells. It is even possible to change an object with calcium into a different object with a large amount of Calcium, such as turning Milk into Bones. Calcium is the most abundant metal by mass in many animals.
pros: Control and create Calcium and objects with large amounts of Calcium.
Control objects such as Milk, Bones, and Shells.
Animals have a large amount of Calcium in them, making this power useful against them.
cons: Objects need a large amount of Calcium in them to be controlled.
Creating objects that have Calcium in them is harder than creating pure Calcium.
People with stronger metal manipulating powers.

name: Psychopompism
overview: lure souls out of their bodies, resulting in death
description: This ability is not one to be toyed with. It allows the user to lure a person's soul out of its body by imitating the experience of near-death. This may mean causing the subject to see "The Light", or causing their life to flash before their eyes. Either supernatural method makes the soul feel like it's time to leave and go on to the afterlife, effectively killing the person in whom the soul resided.
pros: Kill foes with no trace
Their spirit won't even haunt you
If used on discarnate spirits, it sends them to the afterlife as well
cons: Can't be undone
Once the process starts, it can't be stopped
Immortals, time-defiers, astral projectors, animals and plants are all immune to this power

name: Weight Mimicry
overview: become the same weight as anything you touch
description: With this power, you just touch an object, concentrate on it, and Boom. You now weigh as much as that object. This process does not change your mass or density, and you do not require extra muscle to support extra weight. You can imitate the weight of anything, from the air around you to the whole earth, though doing the latter will likely cause you to fall to the center of said earth and die. There are really only two applications for this power: flight and demolition.
pros: Float and/or Fly if you have some helium with you
Tackle with the weight of a house
No need for extra muscle
cons: If you can think of more than two effin' uses then you're effin' brilliant
Falling through the earth might hurt a bit
Must touch another human to return to a reasonable weight

name: The Paths Of Magic:The Warlock
overview: have special talent as a warlock.
description: The Path of Warlock, or the Path of Thought, is the second Path of Magic. Warlocks use nothing but their minds and visualization to do magic. Because humans have very powerful minds, they are extremely good at following this path. It is also said that warlocks and witches are the best at controlling mana in it's rawest form, or in other words, mana weaving. This gives you a special talent for the Path of Thought.
pros: As a human, you're already gifted at this path.
cons: Takes great concentration

name: Drain Vision
overview: fire rays from your eyes that will drain someone's life force.
description: With this power, you can fire pink-colored rays from your eyes at the opponent. These rays drain their life entirely to replenish your health with frightening results – the enemy will spend the rest of their life living as a shriveld up old coot.
pros: Could look young and healthy again.
cons: Draining your opponent can take up to 20 minutes

name: Anger Vision
overview: shoot anger from your eyes
description: With this power, your anger turns into radiation that your body stores. You can project it from your eyes at will. The angrier you get, the stronger it is. And if it reaches the maximum zone--or "M-Zone"--it will be uncontrollable, shooting a huge beam out of your eyes. The only thing that blocks it is titanium. The only way to know people have this power is a red glint in their eye (which turns bluish when they're happy).
pros: Shoot anger out of your eyes.
Give bullies a run for their money.
Finally get the treatment you deserve.
cons: Uncontrollable powers.
People with titanium armor.
People can tell you have this power from a red/blue glint in their eyes.

name: Enhanced Senses
overview: have better senses
description: With this power, you would see, hear, smell, taste, and touch with more clarity, accuracy, and detail than usual.
pros: Better senses
cons: Bad smells and tastes, bright lights, loud noises

name: Goldworks:The Box Of Power
overview: wield the Box of Power
description: The Box of Power has been known by many names over time. The Diabolical box, Pandora's box, The Box of Fate, and others. Within this golden box, an incredible, unimaginable power dwells, the power to grant near godhood. All who open this box are granted god-like powers and a realm. They will know what their realm is, because they will find a scroll stating what it is within the box. The box will endow you with godly energy, with which you can do as you wish.
pros: Near god-hood(because you were once mortal, you can still be killed but it's very hard to do)
Powers over your realm
Other godly powers
cons: Can still be killed
Not a true god
Too much power is bad for everyone

name: Altered Ego Cloning
overview: create different version of yourself.
description: Everyone has an alter ego. They could be superheroes, villains, even a successful businessman, I don't know. Those are the people we dream of being, just like you and me but only better. They could also have powers but it is a one-time chance to create your altered ego. For me, I would have my altered ego be like me, but only stronger, faster, and more impervious to physical damage.
pros: Your altered ego can be anything you want.
There are no limits on how many abilities or skills it would gain.
You can make it disappear or reappear whenever you want.
cons: You can only make one.
Once you create your altered ego, you can't change it.

name: Musical Master
overview: create any music you want with a certain instrument just by thinking it.
description: Take any instrument, such as a piano. Think out the music as you go along and it will seem like you are playing the piano along to your mental composition. No musical training necessary. This will work for any instrument but will only make music from that instrument, i.e. you can't take a flute and make it sound like a trumpet, etc. Have a rock song stuck in your head and want to play it masterfully for the next school talent show? You can, without any experience. Just play!
pros: Play any song or piece on any instrument just by thinking it out
No experience required; you can be a master at any musical instrument
Make money by landing gigs as a musical genius
cons: The sound must be playable by the actual instrument
Only play one instrument at a time (unless you can play two at a time in real life)
Be cautious when playing out your thoughts: volume, quality, etc.

name: Voodoo Power
overview: make anything a Voodoo doll of any thing
description: With this power if wanted to make a building get destroyed you could make a Lego structure then nock it down, or use at chess board to control a real war. When your done you can gust undo the voodoo spell.
pros: You are the controller
cons: Don't make an mistake

name: Akasha Mastery
overview: alter the collective unconscious to suit one's desires
description: Also called Akasha Manipulation, one with this ability has an immensely powerful one at his disposal. The user is capable of psychically tapping into and altering the collective unconscious (which the mystics call the Akashic Records); this can be used to alter what people remember (including restoring memories, or changing what they know to be history), what people perceive to be true, and even change what psychics pick up on from the astral realms. This can't be telepathically resisted.
pros: Change what people remember and perceive as truth (distort/hide memories, fool lie detectors)
Change what psychics perceive (make a precog see the wrong future, or the like)
Perceive the true Akashic Records, and undo any changes to it at will
cons: Some people don't have the "PERCEIVE the Akasha" part, and they forget what they changed
Might be tempted to use this for evil
Divine beings, ghosts, extradimensional entities and those with True Sight, etc. Sense the truth

name: Inconvenience Destroyer
overview: eliminate minor inconveniences.
description: Whether it's comfort or the situation where you owe a friend $1 and you only have 99 cents, this power will eliminate inconveniences, generating that extra cent. This power works on minor inconveniences, not major.
pros: None really, it's not that useful.
cons: Only minor. Not major.
Not really useful, as it's only minor inconveniences.

name: Water Absorption
overview: absorb any water or ice without being harmed
description: Absorb water and ice with out harm. You can either release the water when you absorb it or save it in your body. Can only hold the water in for an hour.
pros: Water or ice will never hurt you
If your a firefighter you will never need a hose again
Good for in the summer and the pool is crowded
cons: If held in for to long you will blow up
Does not work at all in dry areas
If you go into a desert all the water will immediatly evaporate

name: Chaos Incarnate
overview: defy expectations. Or fulfill them. Or something...
description:
The essence of Chaos flows through you. 
Schrodinger's cat is every outcome between death and life until it is observed, right? This power is something along those lines. 
Essentially, your body exists in a never-ending state of flux. All of your qualities are constantly subject to change. 
Experience extreme mood swings; levels of intelligence, strength, reaction speed, etc. Unexpectedly change; shapeshift (although retaining a basically human form); use magic, see things, die, be water.
pros: Possibilities are endless.
Dying occurs, but not permanently.
Make your enemies tremble in fear.
cons: Uncontrollable state of being.
Probably not rational more than half the time.
Make your friends flee in terror.

name: Office Assassin
overview: kill someone with everyday objects
description: You know a multitude of ways to use any everyday objects to kill someone. Anything you can hold in your hand you know over 50 ways to kill someone with it. You know just where to staple someone in the neck to paralyze them; you can make a bomb out of a microwave, a radio clock, a water jug, and rubbing alcohol; you can make poison out of coffee, hand sanitizer, and a bag of jellybeans; you can crawl through air ducks, jump from roof to roof, and climb from window to window with ease; etc.
pros: You know over 100 ways to kill someone instantly with just a paper clip
You can hide any evidence and never get caught, they'll never know it was you or how you did it
You know every form of self defence and martial arts there is.
cons: You may have random impulses to kill the nearest person.
Does not affect your skills at normal weapons, e.g. guns, knifes, etc.
If someone taps your shoulder, or does anything to startle you, you go into killing mode.

name: Jadeite
overview: generate, manipulate and mimic the mineral jadeite
description: Jadeite is a form of jade and is currently the most expensive gemstone in the world. With this power, you have full control over jadeite having the power to create it, shape it, alter it's weight and density, perceive it and turn into a form composed of it. Even large amounts of Jadeite can be levitated and reshaped with little effort. However, you can only control the solid form of jadeite.
pros: Jadeite is the most expensive gemstone in the world.
Can turn yourself into a jadeite golem.
Can have full control over jadeite, creating and reshaping it.
cons: If you create to much jadeite the price will go down.
If jadeite is changed chemically you lose control over it.
Geokinetic powers may override this power (and can manipulate YOU in Jadeite form)

name: Power Programming
