pros: Useful for finding... Anything
Could be used to read minds, but not alter them.
See "Laplace's Demon", a mathematical theory.
cons: Not very useful for combat
You don't know what is going to happen.

name: Masochism
overview: take pain as a positive effect instead of a negative one
description: While the name does arouse a connotation that's more kinky than capable, this ability is a very useful, helpful one to have. It allows the user to perceive pain as pleasurable (as implied by the name), and to gain power from anything people would normally consider painful. Any attack short of instantaneous lethal damage will only EMPOWER the user, bouncing off of him like he has Superhuman Durability/Invulnerability, instead of doing harm.
pros: Normally-painful stimuli are now pleasurable
Empowered by normally painful things
Any damage short of instantaneous lethal damage (beheading, Death Touch, etc. ) only HELPS you
cons: Death Touch, Lifeforce Drain, Necrokinesis, Necromantic effects still can kill user
Suicide attempts can still kill the user
People think you're weird when they ask about your powers

name: Intelligence Shield
overview: use your comparative intelligence as a shield
description: You are not hurt by the attacks of those less intelligent than yourself. This applies to any attack they might make, including nuclear strikes.
pros: Invincible if you are the smartest in a fight.
You can increase your defence by learning more.
Passive: requires no effort.
cons: Smarter people can still hurt you.
May need a lot time to study
You can still hurt yourself (falling off a cliff, running into stuff, etc).

name: Liquid Quartz
overview: generate and control a liquid that can harden into quartz
description: With this ability you can generate and control a crystal clear liquid. You can manipulate the liquid with your mind. This liquid will harden into quartz crystal when it is no linger in cotact with you. It will stay liquid as long as you keep a connection to it.
pros: Unlimited supply of quartz
Can control the liquid
cons: Cannot control the hardened quartz
Must stay in contact with the liquid to control it

name: Transformation To Summoning
overview: change a transforming power into a summoning one.
description: You will be able to turn a power in which you transform into something, into a power where you summon it. Like if you are able to shapeshift into a vehicle, you would be able to summon a vehicle. This effect can be reversed.
pros: If you are able to transform into many things.
cons: They may not listen.
You may want to transform into them.

name: Vita Visum
overview: see and control the life span of others.
description: With this power, you can activate a 'mode' of vision that enables you to see a human being's current life span. You can increase or decrease this number, as if setting a clock. You cannot drop the number precisely to zero. You are able to detect any alterations to the number. The countdown falls by its own unit of time, and can vary from person to person. The number of changes you can make is limited for a period of time due to potential strain.
pros: Control over how long a person has to live
Easier personal time management with those who matter.
cons: Cannot determine the exact method by which someone is destined to die.
No control over the lifespan if simply looking at a photograph - the image must be fresh.
Not immune to effects; still vulnerable to attack and eye strain/damage when activated.

name: Twilight
overview: become the embodiment of fear and hope
description: The ability allows you to change from your normal state into a twilight state, giving you the powers to step in ultra speed to shoot pure light out of your hands and eyes if you are in the light.  If you are in the dark, you become it, having the powers of the darkness. You will be able to move throughout shadows, open doors into the void and emit beams and shockwaves of darkness from your hands and body. Plus, you can control the enemies' fear.
pros: Able to surprise the enemy
The look of you can scare the enemies
Plus the look of you can give hope when in the light
cons: You have a weakness: the time it takes for the sun to rise and set, you have no powers
The state you are in in the dark can be terrifying to the people you are protecting
This power is so cool that noone will want the other powers

name: Myth Power: Hades' Haunt
overview: channel Hades' command over the essence of the dead, the underworld and underground treasures
description: Hades (Haides, Aides), in Greek myth, was the god of funerals, the dead, the Underworld and subterranean treasures (oil, precious stones/metals, etc). As such, channeling him allows one to perceive, communicate with and compel undead (ghosts, zombies, liches, vampires, etc) at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and manipulate earth (including oil, metals--precious or not-- minerals and precious stones). One can even withstand and negate death/underworld/afterlife-based effects.
pros: Summon, perceive, communicate with, share senses with and command undead (ghosts, zombies, etc)
Control earth and its subterranean treasures (precious metals, precious stones, oil, etc)
Withstand and negate death/necromantic/underworld-based or infernal effects (Death Inducing, etc)
cons: Ghosts and other undead like, no, LOVE you
Cannot open up the earth to banish foes to the Underworld until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot release infernal creatures/monsters/demons from the Underworld until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Pheromone Production
overview: produce state-changing pheromones
description: A pheromone is a chemical that produces a physiological response when smelled. A person with Pheromone Production can pump out huge amounts of state-influencing pheromones, making anyone who sniffs them miserable, delirious with happiness, enraged, alert, drowsy, or any other powerful emotion or state. This ability's strength depends on the user's nutrition and the recipient's sense of smell.
pros: Can be used on a massive scale
Make an entire room fall asleep and then leave
Make anyone feel sad, happy, sleepy, in love etc.
cons: Can run out of pheromone
Strong winds can blow the pheromone away
People with colds

name: Schrodinger's Cat Infliction
overview: freeze a frame of time for a sentient being
description: The person affected by this ability is forced to replay a certain time frame between 5 minutes-1 week that may have different consequences each time depending on the person's actions. The affected person will repeat the scenario a set number of years(max 10) at the user's discretion. The scenario will restart if the person affected dies. All changes will be reversed when the scenario replays. Once the effect has worn off the person affected will regain all memories of the scenarios.
pros: You can inflict on your enemies a fate worse than death(until the time limit)
You can freeze yourself in a frame of time to predict the consequences of your actions
cons: There is a time limit of 10 years that you can freeze a sentient being in
The results can be unintended, for example: personality change

name: Magic Consumption
overview: destroy and absorb magic, magical constructs, and magic-users.
description: With this power a person can undo powerful enchantments with a touch and then absorb all the energy of the spell, further fueling their magic eating rampage. The user is immune to all forms of magic, any spell aimed at them is absorbed upon contact. This person functions as a sort of "Magic Vampire" absorbing a mage's magic and leaving them drained shells.
pros: Immune to magic.
If you eat enough magic, it suspends all biological requirements and functions.
Some magic is tasty.
cons: Rather destructive.
Can't be turned off.
You often kill mages accidentally.

name: Bubble Manipulation
overview: manipulate any bubble including shape, velocity ,and durability
description: A person with this power has the ability to manipulate bubbles. Not just soap bubbles they can manipulate any bubble. Of course there are many applications for this power, this includes but is not limited to parties, office work, combat, and medical work. The only limit is your imagination and your willpower.
pros: Make different shaped bubbles ie bubble structures-----just because you can
Can increase the durability making it useful as a concussive weapon--they'll never expect it
Can also make bubbles violenty explode releasing air pressure as a weapon
cons: Need to have a source of bubbles---can't create bubbles
Manipulation relies on mental power and concentration
Need to understand the physics behind bubbles to make them explode

name: Induced Digression
overview: control the direction of a speech/conversation.
description: The flow of ideas being expressed is like a flow of water. And just as you can divert water to make it go wherever you want, you can divert a speech/conversation to make it go to whatever subject you want. Since the direction is taken naturally, it can be difficult for the speaker(s) to notice they are digressing, but, if they do, they can change the subject or come back to the original one.
pros: You do not have to be one of the speakers to use this power.
You can bring anyone into a delicate, embarrassing or confidential topic.
You can get information out of anyone.
cons: If they realize they are digressing, they can break your control.
The further the distance toward the topic you want, the longer it may take to get there.

name: Triple Being
overview: be three beings in one body
description: Some'one' with this power is really three different beings who are all living in the same body. 1 of the beings is the opposite gender of the other 2 beings. Their body changes to reflect who is in control of the body at the time and only one can control the body at a time while the other two advise. Each of the beings have their own random power that can be used only when they are in control of the body.
pros: Can utilize three different, albeit, random powers.
Three cooperative minds can think faster than one.
cons: The three beings may not agree with each other at times.
Multiple sets of clothing for each being need to be bought and will drain their collective wallet.
Fights over who gets to control the body.

name: Runescape Magic
overview: use Runescape spells.
description: With this ability the user can use ANY spell that exists in the existing spellbooks, without having to pray at special alters or use elemental Rune stones. They can also conjure copies of any known staffs, they do not require levels, with this ability the user is treated as a Master Of Magic.
pros: Magic
Awesome powers.
Self defence for Runescape fans.
cons: You'll scare people.
Certain people will hate you for doing magic.
You may try to attain god-hood.

name: Quartz Graveyard
overview: cause large spikes of quartz to erupt from the ground in a large area
description: This abilty give you the ability to preform The Quartz Graveyard move. By slamming your hand on the ground you can cause hundreds of Quartz spikes to erupt from the ground around you. The spikes rise in a wave eminating from you and devastate the area around you.
pros: Cause lots of damage
Large area of effect
cons: Does not discriminate victims (You can harm allies by accident)
Requires nearly all your energy to use.

name: Acausality Curse
overview: scramble and rearrange the moments of a person's life
description: This power turns the causal timeline of someone's life into an acausal one, meaning A to B to C... Y to Z can become Z to L to G to A... This power has limits. When your victim is unrecognizable at some point in the past, your power cuts off. Shape shifters are unaffected. Time travelers can just travel to the past before you affected them. Reality changers can ignore this power. However, those who can be affected by this power will be continually confused and helpless.
pros: Immortals who can't time travel, shape shift or change reality. Good Luck to them.
Make an immortal wish he were dead.
cons: Any power that can restore causal existence to your victim.
May drive a victim crazy.
You don't know how many years back in the past you can affect a mortal victim.

name: Admiral Awesome
overview: dazzle anyone into forgetting what you were doing.
description: Rob a bank and don't get caught when you dazzle everyone in the room by doing anything. Chewing gum, yawning, even breathing. This power is also refereed to as Fonz-ekenisis. Look at a mirror and you're trapped, staring at yourself until someone breaks the mirror.
pros: Do anything and not get in trouble
Never wait in line for rides
Get rich quick for doing nothing.
cons: Look out for mirrors.

name: Vibrate
overview: make powerful vibrations
description: You will be able to make powerful vibrations like a jack hammer. Either make soft vibrations till you wear an object down or make it soft or powerful ones that turn an object to dust or even explode it.
pros: Go into roadside construction or demolish a building
cons: You'll be considered an earthquake

name: Chemical Factory
overview: produce chemicals within your own body and spray them from your pores
description:
With this ability you can create any chemical in your body as long as you know the formula and have the base elements within your body. 

Your body's digestive system is replace with a chemical plant in a dimensional pocket where chemicals can be stored

This makes you immune to the effects of any chemical swallowed. 

Nutrients are made from the chemical factory to be place within your body

Your body's pores are also immune to chemicals
pros: Produce acids, adhesives, slicks and other stuff if you know the formula
You can give yourself a diet by selectively choosing what type of nutrients go to your body
You are immune to chemical damage
cons: Must know chemistry
Must eat several chemicals to use power effectively

name: The Death Flower
overview: use any kind of flowers and turn them into weapons.
description: The power of The Death Flower is basically flowers that can turn into any weapon you can think out of your imagination. It may be weak when beginners use it but once you have mastered it, the stronger it will be.
pros: It can cut through anything once you have mastered it.
The flowers is your medium and you are the master.
It becomes handy when the user is fighting an enemy. It doesn't matter if he/she is weak or strong
cons: For beginners, it's harder to control and it would take up most of your energy.
And that's mostly all of the bad things that could affect the user of this power.

name: Shadow Of The Wolf
overview: use the Shadow of the Wolf.
description: Shadowulf's name inspired this, so give him some credit. Using this you can use the Shadow of the Wolf. Doing so gives you a wolf's speed, strength and ferocity. Some side effects include your hair growing at a faster rate, eating raw meat, and wanting people to scratch your stomach.
pros: Boost of speed.
Ferocious strength.
cons: Craving for raw meat.
Hair grows at a faster rate.

name: Metal Detection
overview: perceive metals
description: One with this power can sense metals with ease; not always is the metal apparent to one's perception, though; you must consciously try to tune into the location of the metal; although, if you are standing directly above it (or in close enough distance to it), you'll receive a painless, but shocking jolt that automatically alerts you of its presence; in addition, your power allows you to automatically tell what KIND of metal you've come across.
pros: Find any source of metal with ease
Your detection of metal doesn't overwhelm your senses
Detect what type of metal it is
cons: People will bother you all the time to find gold or silver, etc.
SOME have too great a sensitivity to metals (it overwhelms their senses)
Sometimes the detection of the metals is accompanied by a bleeping sound

name: Quadruped
overview: get on all fours and run at high speeds.
description: Tired of walking on two feet? Of course you are. With this ability, you can get on all fours and sprint at high speeds like a cheetah.
pros: Faster than running.
cons: May be somewhat shocking to most people seeing you run on all-fours.

name: Preferential Politeness
overview: have people be accommodating to you as long as you are polite
description: Our ability to be civil with one another is the backbone of our society, but this power can take it much farther. As long as you are polite to someone they will cheerfully follow most requests. They will only realize something was fishy if it is pointed out to them later that maybe they shouldn't have given that nice man the secret plans, or stopped to have a chat with the polite young lady when they were supposed to be cleaning out the vault. But if you are ever rude, the spell is broken.
pros: Everyone will always treat you with respect if you do the same.
You can talk your way into any building and talk down any criminal.
People will comply with most "favors" that you ask for.
cons: If you are impolite to the person your spell is broken and they will probably be angry.
Asking someone straight out for something is incredibly impolite.
What counts as polite can vary from person to person.

name: Magic Absorption
overview: absorb magic that has been used on one and use the power from that magic to boost physical abilities
description: Someone with this power will temporarily boost their strength, speed, and endurance every time magic is used directly on them. The boosts are equal to half the power of the spells themselves. This power cannot turn off but magical artifacts can be used so long as they do not affect the wielder.
pros: No enemy spells can harm or weaken you.
cons: Your allies cannot strengthen or boost your powers with their spells.
You can still be affected indirectly by spells.

name: Myth Power: Phorcys' Ferocity
overview: channel Phorcys command over the essence of the dangers of the sea
description: Phorcys (or Phorkys), in Greek myth, was the god of the dangers of the sea. As such, channeling him allows one to manipulate water at will, as well as surviving underwater and swimming well. In addition, one can perceive dangerous waterways (rocky waters, rough or stormy waters, toxic waters, flooding rivers, waters infested with sea monsters, rapids, whirlpools or water spouts, at a waterfall's edge, etc) at will. One may even teleport subjects to locations laden with said dangerous by touch.
pros: Gain the ability to manipulate water, bending it to one's will (regardless of its physical state)
Perceive dangerous waterways at will (rocky/stormy/toxic/monster-infested, waterfall's edge, etc)
Teleport subjects to dangerous waterways by touch; sea monsters will NEVER attack you
cons: People with Teleportation Immunity or the like are immune to Pro #3
People with aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers are immune to this ability
At higher levels, people with MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige can disrupt/negate this ability (NCN)

name: Panontic Bracelet
overview: gain powers by using a panontic bracelet.
description: The panontic bracelets are made of the same material as the archs. The bracelets only give one power and only work for three dimensions. Ergi-lets you radiate the heat of that dimension from your body. Ithuri-lets you travel to Ithuri. Nameless-you can temporarily summon a minion of one of the inmates trapped there. The heat of Ergi only has a range of five inches. You can't control what minion you get and the minion only stays thirty minutes. Bracelets and arches work together.
pros: Summon a horrible creature to help you.
Travel to a dimension where you can go to any other dimension.
Radiate ultra hot heat from your body
cons: The creature only stays thirty minutes.
The ultra hot heat only goes five inches from your body.

name: Constellation Rearrangement
overview: change the "position" of stars in the sky
description: A person with this power can change the position of stars in the night sky by diffracting the light from the stars to change the position of stars when viewed.
pros: Can rearrange constellations at will
Can use for advertising and message relaying
Since its actually diffracted light no damage to the cosmos occurs(directly at least)
cons: Not useful in combat(or at least I can't come up with anything)
Could cause mass panic

name: Runic Wall
overview: create a invisible wall which blocks everything unless the specified condition is met
description: The user of this ability is capable of creating an invisible wall, which is integrated with certain rules to pass through it. Only when the rules are met, the wall will let you through
pros: You can make up your won rules inside the rune wall
Can be used to play some games
You can be a trap master
cons: Takes time to create the wall
Consumes a fair amount of energy

name: Elemental Weapon:Water Trident
overview: wield a trident that can control and manipulate water
description: You can call forth a trident that can control and manipulate the properties of water. Not only water, but steam and ice, and everything that is primarily H2O. You can thrust the trident at foes and strike them down, or you can flush them away with a tsunam or tidal wave.  You are immune to the effects of water, while wielding the trident, and can breathe underwater.
pros: Control and manipulate all forms of water (steam, ice, and water)
Can strike enemies down, by thrust a powerful trident at them
Not only control water, but can generate it too
cons: Can only control water when wielding the trident.
Are only immune to the effects of water, when wielding the trident
Your elemental weakness is fire

name: Anachronism
overview: exist outside of one's natural timeline as though one belonged there
description: One with this ability is actually born into the wrong timeline, and thus being from a time before or after their current timeline, they gain certain powers. You may be faster than normal, and age slower than normal (though this is not always the case); you may even have random or intuitive knowledge about your own timeline.
pros: If you're from the future, you may psychically get information (or visions) about the future
If you're from the past, you may psychically get information (or visions) about the past
The fact that your temporal presence is distorted may result in you being faster than normal
cons: If you're born in the past, and you're from the future, people MIGHT think you're a witch.
Being a temporal anomaly sometimes results in you moving slower, or aging faster than normal
Coming into contact with anything from your true timeline, while still in the wrong one, kills you

name: Luck Reversal
overview: reverse stochastic effects
description: This ability is not to be taken lightly. It does not allow direct manipulation of luck and probability, but rather reverses whatever stochastic effect is currently at work. In other words, if the user sees a subject is experiencing bad luck, he can reverse this, so that subject will instead experience good luck. In the same way, he can reverse a foe's good luck to bad luck. The user, if his power is strong enough, can even affect himself.
pros: Change allies' bad luck to good luck
Change enemies' good luck to bad luck
Influence situations (without directly affecting PEOPLE)
cons: If you can't control this power, you can also change your own good luck to bad luck
If you can't control this power, you can also change a foe's bad luck to good luck
If you are really lucky in your life, people may get suspicious

name: Empathic Storm Cloud
overview: produce a storm cloud above your head that interacts with your surroundings based on your emotion
description: An Empathic Storm Cloud has many uses, in both combat and defense. It hovers over head at all times, only dissipating when the user consciously wills it to; its effect varies based on the user's emotions (thunder and/or lightning when angry, furiously blowing winds when afraid/nervous, rain when sad or a combination of these and orher effects at will). The user can often also make the cloud FOLLOW the foe with its effects, or even coalesce the cloud's molecules so one can stand on and ride it.
pros: Cloud produces effects based on one's emotions
Make the cloud follow the foe around, raining/hailing on him, striking him with lightning, etc.
Can even be used to ride/fly on
cons: Cloud produces effects based on one's emotions (emotional stress may even harm loved ones)
If you have no control over this power, it may even hurt you
Cloud is almost ALWAYS overhead, even if you develop this power

name: Subliminal Sexuality
overview: psychically project sexual thoughts into the minds of others, and otherwise seduce subjects
description: Also called Subliminal Seduction, Psychic Seduction or just Seduction, one with this ability can project sexual thoughts to the minds of others, can speak with subliminal seductive power behind each word, and stimulate the brain's pleasure centers by touch, voice or thought. This can be used to attract and seduce any subject one desires, because the subject receiving the thoughts would believe THEY were the ones thinking them.
pros: Seduce anyone you find attractive (regardless of gender, as long as they are at least humanoid)
Your touch and voice are sexually pleasing
May be accompanied by the ability to psychically perceive how to sexually please others
cons: If it only works on the gender you're not attracted to (rare, but it happens)
If it's permanently active (EVERYBODY falling in love with you would suck)
If your every touch stimulates pleasure (you could never have a normal conversation again)

name: Vortex Punch
overview: make quarter sized balls of up to 250,000 lbs.
description: Make a fist and directly in front of the fist all surrounding matter (except user) is sucked violently toward that specific point till user stops or till 250,000 lbs. Is reached within the ball that is compressed to a quarter's size. This can be kept for as long as the user has his hand in a fist, once released the matter violently returned to it's former density in an explosion (that is directed away from user by controled release. All living things contained within are reduced to meat soup.
pros: Can take many opponents at once
Can use with both hands
Can be used as defence against bullets, missiles,... Etc.
cons: Can only use as many as user has hands at a given time
Hands become basically useless except for punching since already In a fist.
May be harmful to other members in party

name: Paper Falsification
overview: make anyone believe some written material is genuine.
description: To use this power, you just have to write down on a sheet of paper, a card, a badge or any writable support the heading of the forgery, such as "Passport", "Police" or "Contract". Anyone who reads it will believe it to be genuine. Additional contents, such as the object of a "contract" or the identity of a person on a "passport", are optional but adds to the realism of the forgery. Furthermore, the effect is carried on if the inscription is scanned, photographed, filmed or photocopied.
pros: You can easily falsify any official paper.
You can make people believe someone else is the writer or the owner of a paper.
You can make anyone believe false facts about you, such as your identity, your job, your side,...
cons: People have to at least read the heading of a paper for your power to affect them.

name: Blessing Of Hercules
overview: be blessed by the divine hero Hercules
description: The user of this power is blessed by the divine Greek hero Hercules. This blessing is only given to males. When the user is blessed by this divine Greek hero, he would be given Hercules' strength as well as armor, sword and shield. His greatest weakness is powerful magic or sorcery.
pros: Has the strength of Hercules
Has the equipments of the divine hero
cons: Weak against sorcery and strong magic

name: Flinching Invulnerability
overview: be invulnerable and semi-intangible for a few seconds after you flinch
description: In old platformers, you sometimes turn invincible when you get hit. A person with this power basically has this power in real life. When they flinch, they become invulnerable for a few seconds and attacks will go through them. While not as useful as true invulnerability, this power is nevertheless useful in increasing its users survivability. In addition, this power works the instant you flinch, and you can move while invulnerable allowing you to learn how to flinch at specific triggers.
pros: Two for flinching--fails to affect you
Immune to multiple hits--since you would flinch then get out of the way while invincible
Can be bulletproof if you flinch the moment you hear the gunshot
cons: Invulnerability only happens for a few seconds and you blink at those times
Simple to use but hard to master---who can teach you how to flinch correctly?

name: Transferable Eyesight
overview: transfer all your modes of vision to another set of eyes.
description: Your normal sight and any other vision modes can see through another set of eyes. These eyes can be a doodle of disembodied eyes to the eyes of a living creature. The highest levels of this power let use vision-based powers(i. E. Laser eye beams) through a set of other eyes. If the other eyes you're looking through are damaged in any way you instantly see through your own eyes again.
pros: See through anything that is or has a set of eyes. Paintings,toys,photos,etc.
The highest level of this power works other powers like heat vision.
cons: Total mastery of this power is needed make it work with powers like laser eye beams.

name: Healer 3: Strength Restoration
overview: restore the lost strength of others and gain strength for yourself.
description: When this power affects someone with muscular deterioration, their strength is restored to it's former level instantly and permanently. This does not recover muscle lost to lack of activity. As a benefit for you, you gain the same amount of strength.
pros: Range of 25 kilometers, increasing a meter each year of possession. Can be turned of at will.
Instant and permanent.
You gain the strength too.
cons: You cannot restore muscle lost to lack of physical activity, unless extreme.
Limited range.
Unlike other healing powers, it cannot heal wounds or other ailments.

name: T Vportation
overview: pull anything or anyone out of a TV show
description: With this power you can pull any object or person out of a TV program at will!  Great tools and experts are available with a click of your remote and your TVportation power!  Once you have the object, it's yours to do with what you want.  The person or character is at your service and must do as you wish.  You're limited only by your imagination and channel selection.  The objects and characters go back when your show is over.....
pros: Just about anything is available - even fantasy objects and characters
Unique power!
Recorded shows work, too!
cons: Limited only by the length of the show:  30 min or 60 mins, etc.
People might not understand your choices

name: Total Bs
overview: bS your way into or out of any situation
description: You can tell exactly what individuals want to hear in order to get what you want. It's not telepathy so much as it is an empathetic connection and the careful observation of your target's actions.
pros: You see that girl over there, want her number? You got it.
Your boss gave you that raise and promotion, what was it your company does again? Aww who cares!
"Thanks again for not giving me that ticket, officer! I will tell my sick grandmother you said 'hi'"
cons: Just because you fool everyone into thinking you know what you are doing, odds are you have no clue.
Extreme ego boost, you might con yourself into believing the things you tell people.
God forbid you don't get a chance to talk to that mugger before he knifes you

name: Artistic Replication
overview: recreate what you see / have seen through artistic medium
description: You can draw, paint, sculpt, whittle, etc. anything you see or have seen. Includes signatures and such.
pros: If you get mugged, you can draw an accurate picture of him.
Become a famous artist.
Forge anything from the Mona Lisa to your boss' signature.
cons: Won't help in a fight.
Can't recreate original fantasy art since it applies only to things you've seen.
If you don't remember what it looked like well enough, you can't recreate it.

name: Blindsight (Blind Sight)
overview: use numerous methods to see without truly seeing
description: Also called Blind Sight, Blind Sense or Sightless Sight, this is the power to see without truly seeing. One can do this one of three ways. 1) the user can see the shapes of objects and subjects as a psionic outline rather than the true shape; 2)the user's eyes simply acts as a mode of awareness and points subconsciously in the direction of obstacles, so the user looks like he can see; 3) the user's sight capacity is inverted (when his eyes are closed he can see, but when they're open he's blind)
pros: Weird ways of being able to see catch people off guard
Still see perfectly
May be accompanied by some other visual aspect (telescopic, infrared, lightless, ultraviolet, etc. )
cons: Immature people might mess with you, cause they think you're blind (which you technically are)
The second variation requires some getting used to
The third variation may get confusing IF you can't turn it off (sleeping would be hard)

name: Ultimate Vaccination
overview: be immune to the effects of something if you inject yourself with it
description: With this power you can gain immunity to anything if you inject some of it into you. So if you inject yourself with alcohol you will never be able to get drunk again. If you inject yourself with a virus you will immune to that virus. If you inject yourself with coffee, it will never be able to keep you awake and active again.
pros: You can be immune to anything
cons: Once you inject yourself you will always be immune to that thing

name: Border Patrol
overview: have perfect control over borders and boundaries
description: This does not just include physical borders, but also conceptual barriers, like those between Truth and Lies, Criminal and Citizen, Death and Life, Past and Present, Present and Future, etc. You can manipulate them in any way you want once the power is fully developed. For example, conceptually blur citizen and criminal to destroy a city (citizens get arrested, criminals everywhere), or open a physical portal between the Truth- a place, and the Lie- an image of that place, to travel instantly.
pros: Extremely powerful reality manipulation
Can also manipulate any physical boundaries or borders, or things trying to block you
cons: Some boundaries will take time to fully control the energy of (example: Reality and Imagination)
You must be able to figure out what boundaries to manipulate in order to actually do something

name: Duo Tacto Mimicry
overview: copy the powers of two metahumans by touch
description: This ability allows you to replicate the abilities of any two superhumans! However, keep in mind that when you attempt to copy the abilities of a third meta human, you lose the first ability that you copied, with your second at risk should you copy a fourth mutant's power! You also keep whatever side effects their powers may come with (i.e. the super human's power -- effect on appearance, angel wings, blue fur etc. ) until you copy "over" the power and push it out of its "slot"
pros: The abilities of any two meta humans
cons: You have to make contact with them
You gain any features their powers gave them
When you copy a third person's abilties, you lose the first person's abilities

name: Encouraging Voice
overview: encourage any whom needs it.
description: Have your voice be the most inspiring and encouraging yet with this power. Perhaps your mother is depressed over her divorce; with this power the user can encourage her and she will be filled with joy. If you use this power used wrongly, she may be depressed even more.
pros: Be like Martin Luther King Jr. , inspire anyone!
cons: If used wrongly, the power will backfire, discouraging anyone.

name: Cargo Cult Deity
overview: have technology that makes you seem like a god
description: 'Cargo cult' is the term for a primitive group worshiping outsiders with more advanced technology, believing the technology to be magic. With this power, any technology you have/are using (note that even clothes count) is increased to the point that most of the people around you would consider it 'god-like. ' The technology retains, for the most part, its original function, just greatly extended in capability (a flashlight might turn night to day, but it won't shoot lightning or make bread).
pros: Have advanced technology- powerful enough to look like a god (or at least a powerful magic user)
The more advanced the people around you, the more advanced you get
Most city-dwellers have fairly high standards, and everything in a city is technology.
cons: You have to be in contact with whatever you're upgrading
Your power is entirely dependant on other people to make it, and their standards of what a 'god' is
The new technology won't be able to do random/new things, it has to be an extension of its old self

name: Social Engineering
overview: influence social behaviors and attitudes
description: With this power you can manipulate large number of people through verbal persuasion and deception without a failure.
pros: Can make people believe in the unbelievable
Can establish relationships with an ease
Can rule the world and beyond
cons: Can't use when your mouth is shut
Is immoral!

name: Face Reality
overview: help those with delusions of grandeur realize how the world perceives them.
description: A hero that just knows he's the greatest. The guy who directed The Happening. This ability is to make individuals like them become non-delusional and realize they're not a good as they think they are. A short period of depression may happen to someone after you use this power on him. After this his behavior will become normal and tolerable. The effect of this power is permanent. Sadly anti-telepathy or similar powers will block it.
pros: No more movies like The Happening.
No egotistical heroes.
This power may make some villains realize they'll never win and give up villainy.
cons: The guy who directed The Happening has anti-telepathy.

name: Unimaginable Existence
overview: exist as an unimaginable being relative to the existence of people who thinks of them.
description: An existential state wherein the affected person cannot be brought up in other people's mind to be pictured, thought of, or even imagined. Meaning anyone with this ability suddenly becomes an absolute enigma completely alien & unthinkable to anyone who tries to imagine or picture them in mind. In effect, a person with this ability (& with practice even their surrounding) is rendered unaffected by anyone or anything that has something to do with Telepathy, Mind Reading, & Power of Imagination.
pros: Nobody, not even telepaths, can think of you.
Renders your existence and at a certain extent your surrounding unaffected by power of imagination.
Also makes you a hard target. How can you attack someone you can't even think of?
cons: You can still be attacked if you can be seen
No one thinks of you. Not even your love one's. (yup, no more birthday parties and the like).
Not suitable for team work.

name: Drizzle
overview: make it rain.
description: You can now make it rain from the sky anywhere at any time, indoors and out. You control how long and how hard it rains as well as the temperature of the rain that falls, from boiling heat to as cold as the arctic sea. Since the rain is supernatural it vanishes at the point when it would normally evaporate and contains none of the nutrients needed from water to survive.
pros: Make it rain anytime. By extention you can also make it cloudy.
Rain out your opponent with a boiling or icy shower.
Flood whole areas.
cons: Nothing can make use of the rain water.

name: Weakness Inducing
overview: give the target a weakness.
description: With this power, you can give your target a weakness. It works on everything: humans, animals, plants, objects etc. They can be as complex or simple as you want, but one at a time. You can change the weakness and give multiple things/persons the same weakness. The effects will wear off when they leave your range (10 miles).
pros: Give anything a weakness
you can change the weakness
You can give multiple things/persons the same weakness
cons: Can only give someone/something one weakness
Weakness will fade when you're out of range

name: Zzzzzzz Point
overview: make people fall asleep and start snoring by pointing at them
description: With this power whenever you point at someone they will instantly fall asleep (and probably fall to the ground) and start snoring extremely loudly. This is useful to disrupt class or get people in trouble in class by making them fall asleep and start snoring in class or you can make your enemies or criminals fall asleep long enough for you to defeat them or for the cops to come and arrest them. The person wakes up and stops snoring as soon as you stop pointing at them.
pros: You can make people fall asleep and start snoring loudly
You can disrupt class
You can cause enemies to fall asleep
cons: You have to be pointing at them or they'll wake up
You can't make them fall asleep without snoring

name: Bullets Of Un Adaptability
overview: materialize meta-existential bullets that counter-adapt to anything the target is adapted to.
description: The power of defensive adaptation is an effective way of protecting oneself from defeat. For some, it is a cheap and annoying ability that doesn't require mastery, skill, or any tactical method to overcome a difficult situation. With this ability however, a person can now materialize a bullet (wired to defeat the target) that can counter-adapt any immunity or protection gained from adaptation. It will continously evolve and transform itself whenever the target has adapted from a previous attack.
pros: Infinitely creates new ways to harm, torture, counter abilities to defeat your target.
All Meta-bullets fired transcend all existential limitations and stay within the target.
The Meta-bullet will continously adapt to cause harm, even if it is inside the target.
cons: The bullet is perfectly unique and no two bullets are the same so you don't know what they do.
Can 'only' I repeat ONLY be used against annoying super beings capable of adaptation.
Has no effect whatsoever on non-adaptative targets.

name: Emotional Imprint (Non Living)
overview: embed imprint emotions onto non-living objects which "infect" those who touch it.
description:
While touching any non-living object you can imprint it with any single emotion you have personally experienced, and also multiply that emotion to extreme levels. 
Ex. While holding a public phone you can imprint anger onto it, and then multiply the emotion. Whoever touches that phone will be overcome with the emotion regardless of logic.
pros: Can use it for personal gain ex. wearing a ring that emits love so those who shake your hand...
Very powerful "behind the scenes" ability. Lust, Fear, Gulit, etc.
Can create projectile manipulation weapons ex. Airsoft guns...pellets embedded.
cons: Cannot use directly on yourself.
Cannot use emotions you've never experinced.
Effects wear off of person after 12 hrs, and off of object after 3 days.

name: Spell Burn Aura
overview: burn away the existence of divine magic, sorcery, necromancy, curses, hexes, blessings, etc.
description: A person with this ability has the power to burn up the power of existence of anything which is mystical or magical in nature; this involves (but is not limited to) any paranormal phenomena like magic, sorcery, divination, necromancy, curses, and blessings which endow characteristics that are clearly mystical. Indirectly, this ability also burns away mana and soul together with its vessel. This ability is passive and is only activated in the presence of such mystical energies.
pros: Be the ultimate mage hunter!
No mortal, immortal, unholy or divine power can touch you!
Even mystical weapon and armors will burn into crispy black or molten substance.
cons: Healing power or the like will not work on you.
All unholy or divine forces will ultimately want to destroy you.
This is not magic and it is not an ideal substitute.

name: Myth Power: Bia's Benefit
overview: channel Bia's command over the essence of force, might, power and compulsion
description: Bia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of force, might, power and compulsion. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically manipulate the force behind a projectile (such as giving a paper ball the force of a wrecking ball, giving a Mack truck the force of a tricycle, etc) at will. In addition, one can speak nearly irresistible compulsions, as well as psychically manipulate the power behind others' compulsions, at will. One can even psychically manipulate the power of superhuman abilities.
pros: Psychically manipulate the force a projectile exerts, at will
Psychically compel others, and manipulate and withstand others' compulsions, at will
Heighten or lessen the force behind any superhuman ability
cons: MythPower: Ananke's Answer provides immunity to direct effects of Pro #2 (NCN)
MythPowers based on Styx and Styx's Children (Cratos, Bia, Nike, Zelos) provide immunity (NCN)
Power/strength/toughness-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Humanity Separation
overview: split oneself or others into their mind, body, and spirit.
description: This ability was actually made to prevent near-death situations, but now, with the proper training, it can be used in more ways than one. When you separate, your body will be in atomized pieces, your spirit will travel as a ball of light, and your mind will travel in brain-waves. Eventually, you'll have to come back together, so before you split up, think of a location. Then, all your pieces will return at that spot. You can do this to anyone else as well.
pros: Good escape plan.
Different form of transportation.
cons: I don't know if this ability is good for fighting yet.

name: Evil Eye
overview: see what sinful person has done in the past, present, and/or future.
description: To know what true intentions of your enemies your eyes glow Dark Red, this ability allows you to see if a person's a cheater, swindler, rapist, or some other vile fiend.
pros: Criminals might fear you.
cons: Never try to use your power on National TV.

name: Mental Communication
overview: communicate with anyone else with this power.
description: Tired of phone credit running out? Well, then this is a great power to have. It enables any two users in the universe to communicate mentally. It can be turned off at will and you can choose if you want to be able to communicate with others. If you think a stray thought, don't worry, you can choose whether to send it or not.
pros: No need for credit.
Message is always perfectly clear.
Can communicate over any distance.
cons: If you are the only one with this power.
Same problems with language barriers.
No other uses common to telepathy.

name: Power Encryption
overview: encrypt your powers so they can't be copied or altered.
description: With this power, you can think of any power you have (including this one) and a series of letters and/or numbers. Once this "encryption" is done to a power, it can't be copied or altered. Powers can be stolen, but unless the power thief knows the access code, they can't use it. Not easy to master.

name: 4 Kings

description: The Four Kings are the opposite of the Four Horsemen; you can summon them to bring light & hope all over the universe. For example: Blessing (Health) is the opposite of Pestilence: can cure anyone of diseases, Peace the opposite of War: become blessed & stop ongoing conflicts, Bounty is the opposite of Famine - can have the power to create crops & stop anyone from starving, and Life the opposite of Death: allows you become merciful and to bring back the innocent from the dead.
pros: Can bring about the goodness everywhere.
cons: None actually.

name: Muscle Programming
overview: program your muscle to perform certain actions.
description: Normally, we control our muscles using our subconscious mind. This ability forges a sort of connection between the conscious and subconscious mind. By using visualization, programmers can set a series of action for their muscles to do. After doing this, and then activating their ability, the user's body will go into a sort of auto-pilot,like trance. They will carry out whatever actions they programmed in before.
pros: During auto-pilot, you will move with more balance and agility than moving normaly.
You'd have more control over your body than others
cons: At first, breaking out of your trance before it's finished will be nearly impossible.
But with practice, you will be able to do this easily.

name: Zero Tact
overview: reduce any object to absolute zero with a touch
description: Remove all heat from anything with a touch. The side effect being you will also cause someone or something of equal size and weight to be consumed by flame. Shatter walls, people, buildings etc.

Irreversible. Works on any size, shape or person as long as you make skin contact
Side effect could eliminate two problems

Side effect is someone or something will be instantly be consumed by intense heat
Losing precious items while learning how to use your ability

name: Rock Cycle

description: With this power in one hand you have the power to control heat and in the other hand you have the power to control pressure. You can only control the heat and pressure on rocks and minerals though. Pressure can be used to compact or expand the minerals or be applied in a certain direction to levitate minerals. Heat can create magma or freeze the minerals so that they become harder. By using heat and pressure you can turn one type of rock into another metamorphic rock.

The beams can melt through even the toughest materials
You can shoot the beams out of both of your hands
cons: You might melt your own skin

name: Soul Hacker
overview: bind another's soul to yours.
description:
You can bind another's soul to your own by a certain mean determined by yourself. Once they are bound to you, they cannot be unbound unless they die. 
You are also dead when you recieve this power and can do many supernatural things.

You have yellow eyes which mark you as a soul hacker to the world.

name: Hgc Correlation

description: Imagine if you control and manipulate what's happening right now. You could control your friends and it would be like a some sort of video game (kind of like the movie Surf Ninjas). You might even look into the past, presant, and future on your Gameboy Advance.

name: Electrical Perception
overview: perceive any electrical current from up to 50 meters away
description: With this power, you will know the exact location of any electrical current from up to 50 meters away. Power lines, cars, lightbulbs, etc, anything that has an active electrical current.

Always know where your cellphone is or where a phone booth can be found.

name: 1st Key Of Life

description: With this power the first key of life is yours to summon. Mankind has two kinds of Death resulting in two keys. This one is for the Underworld. By dropping/throwing this key on the ground, an earthquake occurs, and within the cracks, the people you wanted to release come up within the cracks, releasing them from the underworld.

It is a small key you may lose.

name: Myth Power: Asteria's Esteem

As such, channeling her allows one to psychically receive visions of past, present of future nights, at will (or induce them, by touch). In addition, one can psychically perceive subjects' zodiac signs and horoscopes, at will. Furthermore, one can ask spirits of the dead anything, and they must answer. One can even gain physical power in the presence of his zodiac sign.

name: Eternal Existence

description: The concept of non-existence, as opposed to existence, is fully and utterly removed from you. This guarantees that the true 'you' can never be destroyed. Your consciousness or soul (whichever you prefer) will go on forever. As a side effect, you are also immune from unnatural permanent changes (such as mind control) to your mind/personality. The range for 'temporary' changes is infinite, though, as long as there is an eventual revert.

name: Defenders Call

A lightning bolt will crash from the skies and reveal a hero that is perfectly suited to take down whatever danger is about to harm you.  An evil scientist trying to kill you with a freeze ray? The reinforcements power will summon a fire manipulating hero.  A hero for every situation.

You are prepared for every situation.

This power only works if you get attacked, NOT if you attack.
Power not available on a holiday, everyone deserves to be with their family on a holiday.

name: Samson's Strength
overview: draw incredible strength and power from your hair.
description: Samson was a sort of biblical superhero who could basically call down the powers of the Lord to turn himself into a hurricane of ass kicking. At one time, he used the jawbone of an ass to kill 1,000 Philistines who had been sent to capture him. The weakness of his ability, however, was that it came from his hair. Become nigh-invincible in combat

An example would be if the user saw one man about to fall and saw crate of poisonous scorpions about to be opened in a different location. The user can make it that both these events happen all together in the same spot in a perfect, synchronized fashion. Now the man falls in an opened crate of scorpions. With slightly more effort, he or she can remove an unwanted image from the consciousness of another person. Unfortunately, the target of the ability must describe the unwanted image as completely as possible to the user of the power in order for him or her to focus upon it. A person with Induced Mutation can create mutations in people that they can see: blindness, skin disease, mental damage, or even cancer. However, it could equally be stuff like better blood pressure, increased endurance, extra muscles, or even (1 in a million) the activation of abilities. And if you start to lose you can't even the odds again, so don't get overconfident. An evenly matched fight can still be rough, but it's better than a hopeless one.

The target will not only be charged with electrons, but their molecules will vibrate even faster than usual. Producing sound fuels the target's energy field. It's temporary.

Top speed of the carpet is Mach 2, but you may have trouble traveling at such speed while clinging to a carpet.
