Different grenades have different uses
No cooldown time between summons
cons: Only can summon one type of grenade at a time
Maximum of five mini capsules per summon of one type

name: Dark Angel Summon
overview: summon an angel of darkness
description: With this power you can summon an angel of darkness. The angel is not under your control and is completely evil. It will probably try to take over your mind and use you for its own agenda so you should probably get some kind of anti mind control powers before using this. The angel is extremely powerful with flight, super strength, immense knowledge of black magic and shapeshifting abilities. You can unsummon it later.
pros: You can summon an extremely powerful dark angel
It can be mind controlled
You can send it back whenever you want
cons: It might try to mind control you or kill you

name: Cone Cell Mimicry
overview: better see movements, convert darkness into electricity and allow people to see what you see.
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. It gives you a better perception of movements. It also allows you to convert darkness into electricity. The darker it is, the more voltage you produce, but you can still shoot a fair amount of electricity in dim light. Alternatively, you can convert darkness into signals. By sending them to someone's visual cortex (the back of the head in humans), you'll make them see what you see. When this power is activated, you will only see in one of three colors: red, blue or green.
pros: You can perceive movements better than a normal human being.
You can electrocute someone if the light is dim enough.
By touching the back of the head of a human person, you can show them what you see.
cons: You will only see in one color, and that color remains the same and can't be changed.
To see in all three colors while using this power, you need to acquire it multiple times.
You can't shoot electricity at all in very bright light.

name: Identity Assumption
overview: copy the appearance and memories of a person
description: By touching a person or a recently deceased corpse, you assume their appearance, knowledge, and identity. In this state, your mind operates on two levels: one duplicates the thoughts and mannerisms of the person whose identity you have assumed, the other is your rational mind which retains ultimate control. You can cancel this power at any time, however you cannot assume that identity again without again having physical contact with the person. Any powers that read minds only see the first mind.
pros: Perfect for disguise and infiltration
Knowledge gained remains permanently
Can duplicate minor power
cons: Unless the subject is dead or restrained, there will be trouble
Cannot duplicate major supernatural abilities

name: Action Inalterable
overview: insure anything you do remains done.
description: Every action you complete can only be undone by you or someone else with this power. In other words, if you break something, only you can fix it. If you make something, no damage can be done to it other than damage inflicted by you. In addition, this ability also allows you to reverse your actions and re do them up to thirty seconds after said action. Time for reversal doubles itself after each use.
pros: No one can break anything that you make.
No one can duplicate an object you've broken within a certain limit.
Nothing you break can ever be fixed by anyone else.
cons: If you accidentally break something, without realizing it.
If you destroy something needed to society.
Cons cannot be negated.

name: Tactic Swap
overview: switch any ability or personality from offensive to defensive or the other way.
description: This is the brother of my previous ability, Mode Swap, but this is a different version. Instead of switching any ability from physical to mental, it switches something different. A good example is if an army were to attack you; just switch them into a defensive phase and escape. Another good one: if you have the ability to release an energy blast, you can switch it into an energy barrier.
pros: Changes your or your opponent's abilities from offensive to defensive or the other way.
If you have a lot of abilities, you'll be able to open a whole new world of abilities.
cons: You'll never know what will come out when switch the nature of your abilites.

name: King (Or Queen) Of Balance
overview: alter people's sense of balance
description: Ever had the feeling where you lose your balance for no reason? Well, this power allows you to cause that exact feeling on others. With a flick of your hand, enemies will topple like dominoes and have no clue why they suddenly lost their balance. At the beginning, it is difficult to control.
pros: If an enemy has a gun or something else, they need to concentrate to use. You can cause them to miss
It's good fun to use on friends
cons: You are still human and can still get hurt if things don't work out.
It is difficult to control to begin with and you may find it happens more to you than others

name: Swiss Army Gun
overview: use it to switch to different guns within it.
description: The Swiss Army Gun is a multi-function pocket Gun-handle; it has an amount of various projectile weapons such as a pistle, normal/ sniper rifle,grenade/missile launcher, water/ray gun, and Gatling gun. Each weapon comes with a full clip of ammo when it is summoned but you must switch weapons when it runs out of ammo to get ammo back. Based on Amalgamer's Swiss Army Saber.
pros: Can switch between weapons instantly and store as just the handle when not in use.
Has large variety of projectile weapons including fictional ones.
Useful for changing strategies and confusing opponents.
cons: Has limited ammo but ammo can be reloaded when weapon is switched.
Need good aim and practice with each weapon.
Projectile weapons for this power does not include things such as bow and arrows.

name: Queen Of Hearts Impossibilty
overview: alter up to six laws of physics and logic between 6am and 9am
description: The Queen of Hearts told Alice that she believed "as many as six impossible things before breakfast. " This power allows you to to turn belief into power! Starting at 6am in whatever time zone you are in at that time, you can alter up to six laws of physics and/or logic for up to three hours. You can determine upside-down gravity, 2 and 2 are 5, on and on. Power can only be used whilst on Earth. Laws return to normal at 9am. You cannot alter the speed or flow of time of that three-hour interval.
pros: You can fulfill your wildest fantasies once a day, every day
You can continually experiment with the universe
You can make things so you don't have to go to work/school before 9am
cons: You have to be awake during those three hours
No matter how you alter reality, it will return to normal, and quickly
You can develop a God complex

name: Vorpal Strike
overview: take a person's head clean off with one blow
description: With this power, you are able to cleanly decapitate someone with one blow from your hand. The would resembles a cut from a blade. While a basic punch to the head or face would work, a karate-like chop to the neck is the most efficient means of using this ability. The power is activated by focusing your chi, or life energy, into your hand, creating a cutting field around it. Advanced practitioners of this technique are able to perform this feat with thier feet or even other parts of their body.
pros: You knocked his block off
Devastating attack
cons: You are required to concentrate and keep focus to use this ability.
Distractions disrupt power

name: Third Eye: Truth Seeing
overview: see the truth and past with your third eye
description: This power is gained by never using the Third Eye powers, but having the third eye open. The Third Eye power slowly turns into this power. The third eye can see through illusions, the true form of a shapeshifter, the general truth, and what happened in the past. The eye can still be decieved with past events. The further back in time the harder it is to see what happened.
pros: An evolved form of Third Eye.
Can see the the truth and past.
Can still use Third Eye powers.
cons: Must have Third Eye power and never use it but have the third eye open.
Only the third eye can see anything and it is still decievable.
Cannot get other formerly possible Third Eye evolutions.

name: 100x Big Bang Kamehameha!
overview: expel the most powerful attack in the Dragonball Franchise.
description: Literally meaning "Hundredfold Big Bang Turtle Destructive Wave;" it is an energy wave technique used by Super Saiyan 4 Gogeta against Omega Shenron. It is a fully-powered, synchronized combination of two ultimate attacks simultaneously harnessed by a separated Goku and Vegeta. The user does not genuinely provide the attack with their own energy, in fact, they gather it from their environment - broadening its force to any extent. Hence, nothing can survive it.
pros: Destroy anyone and anything.
cons: None known.

name: Egyptian Shazam
overview: blessed by the Egyptian Gods, thus becoming their champion.
description: The person with this power has been chosen by the Egyptian Gods Shu, Heru, Amon, Zehuti, Aton and Mehen. Different Gods give their champion different powers Shu (super endurance) , Heru ( superhuman speed and flight), Amon ( super strength) , Zehuti ( superhuman knowledge), Aton ( Magic ) , Mehen ( invulnerability ). When the person shouts SHAZAM!!! They will gain the powers of all the Egyptian Gods and become their champion.
pros: Can take down power houses
Can combat crime no matter how big or small
Magic has little or no effect to the person in champion form
cons: Cannot remain in champion form forever,or risk accelerated aging when you tuen back to human form
Some powerhouses can take you down

name: Chameleon Mimicry
overview: take on the traits of a chameleon.
description: This includes (a more gecko-like trait) climbing up walls or sticking to ceilings, having eyes that rotate independently of one another, being able to alter your skin tone so that you blend in with your natural surroundings, (frog-like) natural hopping ability, and having a sticky, prehensile, extensible tongue used for snatching objects from across the room.
pros: Climb up walls and stick to ceilings.
Automatic camouflage; partial invisibility.
Sticky snatching tongue.
cons: You're born with a greenish skin tone, but you may be able to alter it using your powers.
Your tongue is sorta gross.

name: Central Air Conditioning/Heat
overview: be constantly cool/warm
description: With this power you will always be cool or warm; you will never become too hot or too cold, but you'll always be somewhere in the middle. If it is very cold in your location you automatically become warm, if it is very hot in your location you will automatically become cool. This power basically makes you comfortable, temperature-wise. It is automatic and it cannot be turned off.
pros: You will never be too hot or too cold
cons: Not much use in physical combat
It cannot be turned off

name: Missile Launcher Arms
overview: turn your arms into small missile launchers
description: With this power you can turn both of your arms into small missile launchers. You can launch an unlimited amount of missiles from both of your arms.
pros: You can turn your arms into missile launchers
You have an unlimited amount of missiles
cons: Any damage sustained in missile launcher mode is transferred over to arm mode

name: Golden Apples
overview: generate the enchanted food of the Norse Gods.
description: In Norse mythology, Idun was the goddess who safeguarded the Golden Apples.  One bite from this fruit and the gods would maintain their immortality and power.  If a mere mortal ate this, they would become a god.  The trade-off is that it must be eaten once a year, otherwise you will grow old and die!
pros: Generate the ultimate elixir
Become superstrong, invulnerable, and eternally young!
Can give this power to others
cons: Must eat once a year
The wrong person may eat the apple
Can start Armageddon or make people fear you (or both)

name: Power Uneffectiveness
overview: take away others' powers
description: The ability to take away others' superpowers with your mind.
pros: No Superpowers can hurt you.
You can decide which power to take away
You can kill someone by taking away his/her power (sometimes)
cons: You're actually not that powerful
You can take away your own power if you're not carefull!
You need to have a weapon with you to hurt someone

name: Vitrification
overview: turn matter into glass
description: Similar to the superhuman power Glaciation, this is the power to psychically transmute matter into glass. One with this ability may do it by touch, look or just mental power (depending on the user's genetics). It affects the subject in the same way one is affected by the power Petrifaction, but, instead of stone, the subject turns into glass. In addition, if a subject is turned into glass, they can *sometimes* be returned to normal at will, as long as the glass isn't shattered.
pros: Glass is very fragile
May be accompanied by the ability to assume a form composed of glass (or to control glass)
User is often able to affect living and inanimate matter
cons: You can't return a person to normal if they get shattered
Sometimes only affects living matter (or only non-living matter)
It can also be triggered subconsciously (accidental vitrification)

name: Pacifism
overview: stop violence anywhere, anytime
description: This ability acts as a "physical" force that prevents any violence between any two parties. This ability cannot change a person or party's beliefs however.
pros: World peace
Galactic peace
Universal peace
cons: Peace dependent on you
Once you're gone, all hell will probably be let loose
People may want to kill you

name: Ultimate Pwn!!!!!!!
overview: destroy any opponent with one punch
description: With this power you can completly destroy your enemy with one punch.
pros: Awesomeness
Auto victory
Coolness
cons: Nothing bad about this power

name: Creator Of Worlds
overview: create planets.
description: This power allows you to create planets. Of course they are not created from scratch, but using the cosmic material already present in sorrounding space. The person who creates the planet can give it any desired characteristic (making it habitable, giving it a breathable atmosphere, etc. ), "hearing" at a distance every change he affixes.
pros: The planet is perfectly autonomous (if you want so);
You can "feel" anything is going on your planet in a detailed way.
cons: It could be affected cosmic balance;
You have no way to go to your creation, if not in classical ways (space travelling).
You only can create good life conditions, NOT life itself.

name: Broken Explosion
overview: cause things to explode if you're holding a piece of it in your hand
description: With this power you can cause things to explode as long as you're holding a piece of it in your hand. The explosion can hurt you so be careful not to stand too close to the object you are blowing up. You can steal a tire of an enemy's car then cause it to explode sometime later or cut of somebody's hair and then cause them to explode once you get far enough away from them.
pros: You can cause things to explode as long as you are holding a piece of it in your hand
You can do it as many times as you want
cons: The explosions can hurt you
You have to be holding something for this power to work

name: Moisture To Ice
overview: turn the moisture in the air into ice
description: The user of this power is able to turn the moisture in the air into ice. The ability to turn the moisture in the air into ice, is dependent on how humid the air is. If the air has a high humidity then this power is very effective, in a low humidity environment, this power is almost useless
pros: Air is pretty much humid in most parts of the world
Good at stopping bad guys
cons: Low humidity or no humid air will render this power useless

name: Fireflies
overview: summon ten million fireflies and have them under your complete control
description: With this power you can summon up to ten million fireflies and have them under your complete control. You use a bunch of them to lift you up and fly you around, or have a giant flashlight that follows you around, or you can make them attack your enemies. You can unsummon them whenever you want.
pros: You can have up to ten million fireflies
Never need a flashlight again
They can fly you around
cons: They're not very strong so making them fight off bad guys might not be so effective

name: Green Arrow's Quiver
overview: have Green Arrow's quiver
description: With this power you can summon Green Arrow's quiver. You have every trick arrow he's ever used and once you fire them they automatically teleport back into the quiver after an hour. You're also an expert archer but only when you're using Green Arrow's quiver.
pros: You have all of Green Arrow's trick arrows
The arrows automatically teleport back to you after an hour
cons: You're only an expert archer when you have the quiver
If you use all of your arrows in under an hour you're screwed for a bit

name: Delete This Bone Clawduplicate
overview: make claws retract out of your knuckles
description: With this power you can have retractible claws in your knuckles. Your claws come out without hurting yourself. Is the same as Bone Claws, which is older.
pros: It doesn't hurt
More stronger than a punch
cons: May ruin your gloves

name: Gold Manipulation
overview: manipulate gold
description: Gold is one of the most valuable substances in the world. This ability allows you to manipulate it in quite a few ways. You can move it, of course, but its more than that. You can reshape it on the molecular level. Also, with practice, you would be able to convert matter into gold. This ability also grants a "gold sense". Whenever gold is near you, you will know its location, amount, and density.
pros: Manipulating gold
Gold is very valuable
Having a gold sense
cons: Too much gold will decrease it's value.
Gold is also a very soft material

name: Cutting Remarks
overview: insult to opponents and affect them as if you had cut them open.
description: With this power as long as you can speak and your foe can hear and understand you any insults you give him will affect him as if you had cut him with a sword. If you have telepathy you can affect a deaf foe or one who couldn't fully understand your spoken language. This damage is neither invisible matter or a form of energy,unless you have telepathy then it is psionic damage. Invulnerabilities and damage resistance are no protection against verbal insults. Insults can't be repeated.
pros: Ignore invulnerability or damage resistance of any foe.
This power+Invisibility+Telepathy
Every foe doesn't have resistance to psionic damage.
cons: You need new insults for every fight.
A deaf foe with psionic resistance.
Losing your voice.

name: Bone Launcher
overview: fire bullet-like bones shards from the body
description: Bone fragments from the skeleton are launched at high speed through fingers or any other part of the body, the bone tissue lost needs to be regrown to launch more. The bone can not go through materials that a regular bullet from a gun can go through. This is the perfect gun, because no one would no when you shoot.
pros: Never need to buy a gun
Easier to go through metal detector at airport with weapon
Makes almost no sound
cons: Would need to have accelerated healing for better use
Loss of bone the more you use it, unless you can regenerate
Could misfire anytime if you don't have control over it

name: Injury Illusion
overview: fake any type of injury or accident to yourself, someone, or something else
description: This power allows you to fake or create a fake scenario of you, someone else or something else getting injured in anyway. When you perform this power on yourself, you'll never feel the actual pain of the injury but it'll look 100% real. When using this on others you can choose to make them feel the actual pain or not. Say your driving, you can simulate a random car crash or explosion and it'll be a hologram illusion to everyone. Touch it & it becomes real (it has life-like properties)
pros: You're immune to your own simulation, though you can choose to feel a bit of pain for realism.
You can get out of an situation you want by faking the right injury, and you always come out alive.
You can guilt people into feeling sorry for you and doing whatever you want
cons: People will hate you for making sick jokes
You can't really kill anybody or yourself
Can't protect yourself while your asleep

name: Dense Air
overview: mess with air molecule concentration in an area
description: This power allows you to make air thinner or denser. You can make it so thin that people find it freakishly hard to breathe, or so dense and heavy that people can barely walk through it.
pros: Lower your enemies' oxygen supply, thus reducing their brains' capabilities.
You are immune to the effects, so you'll be running around while others are gasping for air.
cons: I'm pretty sure there is none. I could be wrong, but I don't think so.

name: Spirit Mastery
overview: call upon spirits and control them
description: The ability to call upon spirits through the use of summoning them. They are bound to their summoner and will do their bidding . They can be used as both an offensive and defensive power.
pros: Awesome defensive powers since they cannot be dispelled
Their loyalty to the summoner is unwavering
They can be summoned from anywhere
cons: It takes great concentration to summon them
If concentration is broken during summoning, they disappear
They are not as strong in daylight.

name: Spider Silk Skin
overview: have soft, flexible skin that's stronger than nylon
description: With this ability, you can have smooth skin that's stronger than nylon. The skin is harder to break apart or get injured. The smoothness of the skin helps you give the perfect massage.
pros: Have skin that's stronger than nylon.
Bruise less easily.
The skin is soft, so you can give the perfect massage.
cons: Flesh and internal organs can still be damaged.
Might not know how to give a massage.
You are seemingly normal.

name: Godly Hand
overview: have a godly right/left hand.
description: To acquire this hand you must have lost a hand, then a god(dess) "donates" their hand to you. Granting you, a godly hand. All hands have the ability of superhuman strength, and durability.
pros: Have a godly hand!
cons: The god(dess) is chosen randomly.
You have to lose a hand.
Only having superhuman strength in one hand kinda stinks

name: Demonic Weaponry: Scar
overview: use the demonic weapon Scar.
description: Scar is one of the more destructive Demonic Weapons. It resembles a butchers knife, but with no hilt. It is pure metal, with silk wrapped around where the hilt should be. It is said anything it touches will stop growing, and die. If you were to cut a man's wrist with it, even just a shallow cut, where it cut would become nothing but dead cells. There are few who meet this blade and live to spread the tales of it.
pros: Powerful knife.
Works on plants, animals, and humans: anything that lives.
Appears like a normal butcher's knife
cons: Useless on nonliving things, such as puppets or powers.
Corrupts the soul; need a power to become aware of this.

name: Singularity
overview: resist being mimicked, copied or replicated
description: This ability makes you absolutely one of a kind. It prevents you from being forcibly replicated/cloned, having powers mimicked, and being mimicked by Shapeshifters or Illusionists. In addition, no one can ever mimic your voice, your hand writing or your skills/movements. You possess a physical, psychic, and empathic trait marks you as special, so even if someone tried to disguise themselves as you, people who know you would notice the ruse. There aren't even other you's in alternate realities.
pros: Being truly one of a kind
Cannot ever be mimicked successfully; anyone who tries to will go back to normal in seconds
Does not prevent you from mimicking others (or replicating yourself if you have the power to)
cons: People who know you will also know when YOU are in disguise (may not always be bad)
Can't help friends if they need to mimic your powers
No other you's in alternate realities... (sad face, only one of me to go around... )

name: Cat's Grace
overview: land safely on your feet like a cat
description: To have to reflexes of a cat. You'll land safely on your feet from high buildings, but not to high. This power doesn't come with 9 lives.
pros: The reflexes of a cat
Can land safely from tall buildings
cons: Can't be to tall of a building
Don't get 9 lives

name: Magnetic Resonance Vision
overview: be able to see things as if they were in an MRI scan
description: Simply what the description says, it doesn't get any simpler than that. You can get an MRI of anything instantly. That's it, just a slight modification of an age old superpower.
pros: Similar to X-Ray vision
Has most of X-Rays Pros
cons: To see the bad just contrast it with x-rays

name: Ira
overview: increase strength and speed to monumental levels
description: A transformation-like ability that allows the user to go into a state of rage. Under this state the user has increased speed, strength and even endurance. The senses are all heightened greatly as well. For example the user can perceive bullets as going really slow thus giving him the ability to dodge them effectively.
pros: Can go beyond the limits of the body
The longer the user remains in the form the more power is obtained.
cons: The body is severely weakened once said state is over
The longer the user remains in said state the more detrimental the aftereffects will be.

name: Body Link
overview: deal damage that was dealt to you to the one who did it
description: This ability does damage to your enemies body as they deal damage to you. This only effects the one who caused you damage so you cannot self inflict injuries to your enemy. The damage does not have to be from a physical attack to be dealt back to your enemy; it just has to do physical damage. Also cannot be used on attacks to the mind. The transfer does not heal you in the process. All damage is dealt at the exact same time so if you are killed the enemy dies with you. This is always active.
pros: Enemy won't want to hurt you usually unless they have issues
If your enemy cuts your arm off, theirs gets cut off also
Works even if you're unconscious
cons: Does not give you any resistance to attacks or prevent death and does not heal you
Must be physical damage to your body to work
Cannot be turned off, so if you are hit by an ally, they would still be hurt

name: Superhero 1: Spider Man
overview: have the powers of your friendly neighbourhood web-slinger, Spider-Man.
description: He's red, he's blue, and his webs are just like glue! Who is he? Spider-Man! With this, you can shoot spider webs from your wrists and swing from place to place. That's not all, you can stick to walls and sense danger with Spidey's "Spider-Sense". You also have superhuman strength (10 tons), incredible speed, and you can do amazing front flips, back flips, somersaults, and more acrobatic feats.
pros: Shoot webs, swing from place to place, slingshot yourself, and make various weapons out of them.
Stick to any surface and use your Spider-Sense to sense danger or track down anyone and anything.
Lift a car with your bare hands, run and jump from building to building, fight like a Karate master.
cons: Your Spider-Sense can't detect any symbiotes (e. g. Venom or Carnage)
Someone who has superhuman strength can pull you out of a wall.
If you're web swinging, you might accidently hit a building.

name: Villain Verbosity
overview: make opponents say what they are going to do before they do it.
description: This power is aura. When at a distance of at most 40 feet and in your line of sight, opponents will feel compelled to describe as proudly as possible every action they are going to do before they carry it out, no matter how trivial ("scratching an itch") or not trivial as an opponent telling you the combination to a secret vault you didn't know they had, or a nasty superpower you didn't know they had. The "spell" of your power is broken if you are no longer visible or if you act aggressively.
pros: No sneak attacks on you.
Opponents will reveal any tactics they are going to use against you.
Opponents may reveal they are bluffing.
cons: You might be forced to dodge attacks without fighting back.
It is better not to know that an opponent has five different powers to kill you with.

name: Mutation: Claws
overview: mutate your fingernails into razor-sharp claws
description: This mutation causes your fingernails to turn into ultra-strong claws capable of rending flesh and bones.
pros: The claws can easily kill any lifeforms you encounter
Additional mutations increase claw strength
cons: Does not increase muscle power, you must be strong to compensate
Mutation time increases with the number of mutations

name: Greatest American Hero
overview: possess a red alien suit with various powers.
description: "Believe it or not, I'm walking on air. I never thought I would feel so free eee eee. Flying away on a wing and a prayer. Who could it be? Believe it or not, it's just me. " Yes, with this power, you will have the red alien suit of Ralph Hinkley. The suit comes with an instruction manual to show you how to use it, so hero up!
pros: Invulnerability, super strength, psychometry, invisibility
Walk on air
Cool 80's theme song
cons: Losing the instruction manual
Learning how to use the suit (and sucking at it) if you lose the manual
Flying and falling (make sure you fly low)

name: Self Insertion
overview: insert yourself into anyone's memories.
description: With this power, you can look into the memories of others and insert yourself therein. It will seem to them as if they had known you forever and, assuming that you insert yourself into happy and good memories, they will trust you implicitly. Be careful, however, for if a true friend points out that you were not really there, then the spell is broken. So be sure to get everyone connected to that person as well.
pros: Make people love you by inserting yourself into the happy memories of their life.
Make people fear you by putting yourself in their bad ones.
Become old friends with the rich and powerful.
cons: If you insert yourself into many people's lives you must make sure that the memories are consistent.
If you try with someone who has a big social circle, expect a lot of work.
You cannot change the memories, only put yourself in them.

name: Electricity Immunity
overview: be immune to harm from electricity
description: Electrical components, wires, cables, and anything else that holds or contains electricity will never shock a holder of this power.
pros: Can repair damaged wiring without worry of death by electrocution.
Lightning is a form of electricity.
Electrokinetics might fear you, if you have other powers.
cons: I can't think of anything that's bad about this power, but there might be.

name: Camera Power: Freeze Frame
overview: render anything you see that would be visible in a standard camera immobile
description: A person with this power can turn anything they see immobile at will. There are two limits on this power. The first limit is that you have to close one of your eyes every time you use this power. Opening it will release the immobility effect. The second limit is that it can only immobilize what you see. If someone is hiding behind a rock or is invisible, they won't be immobilized. Otherwise, this is a very versatile power, even allowing you to make water solid or even freeze fire or explosions.
pros: Can immobilize enemies
Non-lethal in normal situations -- air still moves and people's internal organs are hidden from view
Can even freeze explosions so you can pose in front of it
cons: People can hide behind objects or within objects to avoid power
Must close an eye to keep things immobilized
Con 2 ruins the picture of yourself in front of the explosion

name: Fire Walk
overview: cause the areas one's feet touch to burst into flames
description: The flames created by this power will only last for 10 minutes before they disappear. Your speed is also boosted while using this power.
pros: Surround enemies with a ring of flames.
You can choose when to use this power so that there are as few accidents as possible.
cons: Can accidentally hurt friends if you're not careful.

name: Fear Sight
overview: change into a person's biggest fear by looking into their eyes.
description: With this superpower, you can shift into a persons biggest fear. You don't get any abilities of the person's biggest fear, and you can only look like the persons fear for an hour. If you look into multiple people's eyes, they will each see you as there own greatest fear.
pros: The person you use this on could become scared and flee.
You can use this on multiple people.
cons: You can only look like a person's fear for an hour at a time.
You do not gain any abilities of that person's fear.
If the person has no fear, there will be no affect.

name: Murphy's Law
overview: make anything that can go wrong go wrong
description:
When a person is using this power, they can make anything go wrong by thinking about it as long as they can determine a fatal flaw in something's design. 

This can work on any design from robots to someone's plan
pros: You can make things malfunction by analyzation-pointing out flaws make things malfunction
Very few designs can be without flaws or possible mistakes.

If someone was able to cover all the flaws you can think of
If you can't find a visible flaw in a person's plan or design

name: Talent Of Killing
overview: have natural talent of killing.
description: This is a fearsome ability. One who has this can kill a person with one blow at age six. Later on they can fight many strong opponents at once. Their speed and strength become greater and they become slim. This person can kill upfront or sneakily and is proficent in accuracy and weapons. They can also attack without an enemy having time to react. They are skilled enough to catch arrows out of midair.
pros: Description cant be shortened and pros cant be negated.
Taking out villans.
cons: Power sacrifice works on this.
People wont like you.
Taking out villans,

name: Appearance Switcher
overview: change the article of clothing you have on.
description: You may change the piece(s) of clothing you have on at the time to anything you have seen or heard about.
pros: Never have to buy clothes.
FREE CLOTHES!
cons: You can only change the clothes you are wearing.
Have to have seen or heard about them.

name: Atomic Fission
overview: split biological molecules apart through heat displacement
description:
Ability to control the molecules of living things by using heat transfer from the source to the destination in an extremely high-level radiation emission stream. It will penetrate any substance at a molecular level and transform the object into any other object through the power of suggestion from the source. 

The negative side-effect is the energy level must be replenished with the heat of the sun over a period of 15 minutes to full strength.
pros: Molecular transformation
Heat transfer from object to object
Super strength with the power of the sun
cons: Depletion of energy when used over an extensive amount of time
Unable to use to full strength in temperatures below freezing
Can produce unstable amounts of radiation harmful to others

name: Mind Control Through Hugs
overview: control a persons mind through hugs
description: You are able to control a persons mind when you hug them, however this can only be achieved via hugging them, and you can only control them if you will it. If a persons mind or will is strong enough, they can break from your hold on them, however if they are controlled via your hugging ability, they can do anything you ask, except killing themselves. So basically you have little minions that follow you.
pros: You can control a specific person of your choice
The person you hug is under your command
You do not have to keep hugging the person, to have control of the mind
cons: They can break free of your control
You cannot command them to kill themselves
You have to hug them to control them

name: Pain Transferring
overview: transfer pain or discomfort from yourself to another sentient lifeform
description: Pain transferring allows the user to get rid of their pain or discomfort by giving it to someone else or any other sentient being. This does not allow them to transfer their actual injuries, just the pain and discomfort side effects from it. More advanced users of this power would be able to transfer only a portion of their pain, still allowing themselves to feel some of it.
pros: Get rid of your pain and discomfort
Potentialy never feel pain or be uncomfortable again
cons: If you can't feel pain you dont know when you have been seriously injured (so be careful)
You must inflict pain upon another being in order to use this power

name: Autotune
overview: autotune your own voice or other people's voices
description: With this power you can Autotune your own voice and other people's voices to make them sound good when they sing. You can use the power on anybody and it makes them sound good, even when they're singing live.
pros: You can make people sound good when they sing.
It works even when they're singing live.
cons: No use in combat.

name: Book Lover
overview: look at the cover of a book and be done reading it already.
description: Whenever you look at the cover of a book you instantly are done reading this book no matter how long it actually is!!!!!
pros: Could be the fastest reader in the world
If you read non-fiction books you will get smarter
cons: You could be done reading all of the books in your school's library in 1 day or less
You would have read a lot of books!

name: Absorption On Death
overview: absorb the memories and abilities of the deceased.
description: With a touch the user of this ability absorbs DNA, knowledge/skills and powers of the recently deceased, ranging from years to days depending on the freshness of the corpse. Death up to a day old allows the user to gain information/skills about things/procedures as if they've done/known it for years. A corpse from a day to a week old deteriorates this from years of knowledge to about a week. A month's old corpse (and older) yields you info/skills up to about 24 hours before death (and sooner).
pros: Gains knowledge of how to perform advanced complicated tasks
Can obtain multiple powers
The DNA absorption allows you to shapeshift in the other's appearance
cons: This ability is never deactivated
Cannot absorb from the living
You absorb the good with the bad: ability weaknesses, emotional traumas etc.

name: Time Spaced
overview: invert someone's space-time dimensions.
description: You can invert someone's 3 spacial dimensions and 1 time dimension so he lives in 1 spacial dimension and 3 time dimensions. The effect is, if a victim moves or is moved forward, they will age, and if they move or are moved backwards, they will get younger. A victim will age either way one day for every foot they move. Time traveling victims will teleport. Teleporters will time travel in the spot they stand. This power will affect someone who can live in more then three spacial dimensions.
pros: Cripple super fast opponents and teleporters.
Mess with someone's existence.
Move a foe into old age or turn him into a baby.
cons: Immortals.
Once time travelers learn how to teleport, they could come after you.

name: Buffication
overview: pack on hundreds of pounds of musclemass instantly
description: When your heart rate increases rapidly your body undergoes rapid muscle hypertrophy and ossification. In this process you will grow 10 feet tall and pack on 900 pounds of pure super strong musclemass.
pros: No one will be able to beat you up
You will be by far the strongest man in the world
You could make lots of money in strongman and bodybuilding competitions
cons: Your clothes will be ripped apart
You will be scary looking

name: Eyes Of Perception
overview: use the Eyes of Perception.
description: The Eyes Of Perception is an odd ability, but incredibly useful for tacticians and such. People are born with this, and it's easy to tell at times. More than a hundred eyes are hidden on the user's body, covered by skin. When all of these eyes are opened, the user gains amazing powers of perception, allowing him to see the weaknesses of opponents, and even what attacks they'll use seconds before they use them.
pros: Perception.
Can see the moves of enemies.
cons: Hard to control.
Hard to master.

name: Reactive Copies
overview: make an equal amount of superpowered copies of yourself that protect you when outnumbered.
description: With this ability, you make superpowered copies of yourself when outnumbered. The copies are almost as durable as steel and although seemingly normal, can lift 250 lbs. This is a passive ability which only works when you're outnumbered. For example, if 20 enemies face you. You'll make 19 copies. The copies can't copy your superpowers. If it's one on one, you don't make copies, period. Their main goal is to protect you. It's too perfect. You can't control your copies minds.
pros: Make superpowered copies when outnumbered.
Never be outnumbered again.
The copies are there mostly to protect you.
cons: It's too perfect.
You can't control your copies minds.
If it's one on one, you might die.

name: Evt Teleportation
overview: equal volume transfer teleportation
description: Based on sight, thought, and knowledge, this teleportation transfers the volume of yourself to your target location and sends the target volume to where you stood.
pros: Effective weapon
Silent teleportation
Inconspicuos
cons: Exhausting overuse

name: Detrital Affinity
overview: advance and command decayed or decaying materials and dust.
description:
You have moderate kinetic control over decaying leaves, animals, wood, feces, rusted metals, and the like, and dust; more indistinguishable from original form for more precise control. Dust from asphalt, concrete, or other inviolable materials is out of the scope of control. Although, you can advance deterioration visibly in any non-living or dead objects with concentration and time. 
You also have a form of touch-initiated claircognizance with waste. (eg Dried blood is good for tracking. )
pros: Drive away unwanted people with waves of trash, corpses, and whatnots.
Be a forensic expert.
Clean your house instantly in all those hard-to-reach places!
cons: It's hard to avoid becoming terribly filthy.
Dust can't hurt your enemies.
Groping gross things might be too much to get what you want to know.

name: Absorbing Matter At Will
overview: absorb almost anything
description: Whoever has this power can absorb almost any type of matter. Though it'll make you stronger, it'll also make you slower.

Gain Super Strength
Really durable against bullets

You can't always control it
Very slow

and can also be the very mighty

cons: You might summon a weak creature
You might summon a powerful creature that wants to attack you

name: Psionic Restraints
overview: keep a psychic from using their full power
description: Someone using this power can prevent a psychic from using their full power by limiting how much power the psychic can access. The psychic can only be restricted down to 50%. The user of this power can decide how many people to use it on at the same time. WARNING: The more people this power is used on the easier it is for them to shed their restraints and use their full power.
pros: Don't have to fight psychics at their full power.
Don't have to concentrate once target(s) are determined.
cons: Only affects psychics.
Con Negation and similar powers do not affect this power.

name: Seventh Amendment
overview: sue anyone for anything for over $20 and win
description: No matter how trivial it is, you can sue anyone for over $20 no matter what it is and WIN.
pros: Get rich quickly
cons: If you sue for under $20, you always lose

name: Induced Excitement
overview: make anything sound exciting to you and others!
description: With this superpower, you can make anything (or any subject) sound exciting to you and others. You can make history sound exciting to you. You can get someone excited about watching paint dry. Only you can see the exclamation points. This is also useful in combat. You can make your enemies excited about the good side. It's these invisible exclamation points you summon that makes things exciting. Effects last 24 hours or less. Exclamation points become more and more visible after the first hour.
pros: Make anything sound exciting to you and others!
Make your enemies excited about joining the good side!
Make people excited about making a better future!
cons: Making people excited about bad things.

Effects wear off in 24 hours or less.

name: Metabolism Control
overview: control metabolism.
description: With this power, you can increase or decrease the metabolism of anyone you choose. If you decrease their metabolism... then they will get fatter. If you increase it... then they will be skinnier. Warning: If you decrease or increase their metabolism too much, they will die.
pros: You can control metabolism
You can make people skinnier or fatter
cons: You may accidentally kill someone....

name: Blunt/Slashing Conversion
overview: convert slashing force into blunt force and vice versa.
description: With this power, you can change the damaging effect of any thing. Things that normally deal blunt damages, such as punches, kicks, hammers or falling on the ground, will slash. Things that normally deal slashing damages, such as knives, swords, axes or shards of glass, will deal a blow.
pros: When dealing with slashing weapons, it's better to get bruises rather than lose an arm.
Deal serious damages with a single punch or the edge of your hand.
cons: Doesn't protect you from harm.

name: Twilight Power: Illusion Of Pain
overview: creates the illusion of intense pain.
description: The user projects the illusion of being in extremely intense physical pain into others  minds, thus incapacitating them. Can cause people to experience excruciating pain that  instantly incapacitates them. Can inflict this pain on only one target at a time, must be able to see your target to use this ability on him or her.

Useful for torture.
Instant.

Purple lightning is so cool

But there are conditions: a person at peak & ripe age is the best soul to take, very young or old grants little power & it depends on if the person was good or bad. Good souls are well good, but a bad evil soul causes pain, madness & rage.

Gain great power
Near immortality

You can also survive in water for long hours and swim with ease. Your physiology allows you to store water in your bones and discharge water in jets of aqueous blasts.

Extinguish fires with ease.
Produce "bone pincers" to easily snap and crush your enemies.

Can't stay in water forever.

By ripping muscle, skin and bone from as many mammals as you can, you can become immeasurably and increasingly stronger. The process adds to your density, durability and lifespan. If someone is stronger than you, just find a few more victims and return to the fight tougher and stronger.
pros: Incredible strength, pack it in add muscle tissue, the stronger the mammal you steal from the better

In addition, one can absorb natural sunlight to gain physical power (and sustenance) at will. Furthermore, one can psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can also psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions). One can even psychically turn into an entity of sunlight, at will.

Transform into an entity of pure sunlight, at will; psychically perceive lies, at will

Multitude if possible effects

Must have stored up essence to use.

You can't be hurt by your own grenades

This means they can create blasting jets of sand from their own body mass, fly by directing their sandy form, allow objects to go through them, and even take on extra sand to become larger. However, they are subject to parts of themselves being seperated (like in a jar), being transformed into glass, or even being washed away.

Can drift on wind currents as sand
Can take on extra sand to become larger

Never totally flesh-and-blood

It's one of the most gruesome of torture

Use it as you wish

You can do it anytime, but can only have one song before halting it. To make the music, you have to think about the song and scale (B flat) and then snap your fingers. Snap again to halt.

Entertain your school and friends.
Make everyone applaud you.

Cannot merge songs.

name: Burrower Dart Thrower

You can shoot one dart at a time or up to five every second. If armor is penetrated but not flesh, the darts can sense flesh and start digging into flesh. If a dart misses a target and someone picks it up barehanded, the dart will start digging into flesh. Your own darts know not to hurt you. The range is 300 ft.

Decent range.
An attack that may cause pain to someone who regenerates.

name: Bottomless Pit
overview: open a bottomless pit at will under someone.
description: Disclaimer. Bottomless pit is actually a dimension and it's only 1 billion miles deep. You can open a pit under someone who up to 200 feet away from you. The pit opening can be 20 feet wide. Inside the pit it's five miles in diameter. The pit will collapse on itself if a victim dies,lands on bottom or escapes. You can collapse your own pits but not pits of others.

As long as a foe lacks certain powers he's gone.

Any other powers that would counter the effect of this power.
A foe with this power.

name: Normalization Immunity

It does not matter if the fluid, power, or chemical would normally be ignored by or bypass the normal defensive powers and/or immune system, this power will turn those normalization fluids and chemicals into useful nutrients and negate the powers.

This is not powered by mitochondria, but by directly ripping apart glucose molecules.
cons: This power can still be individually removed.

name: Egyptian Gods: Meskhenet
overview: create life and spirits.
description: The Egyptian goddess Meskhenet was said to be the creator of life. She was able to breathe "Ka" (life spirit) into a human's soul as they are born. Users will be able to ccreate life and spirits, breathe life spirit into nonliving objects, and resurrect dead organisms for a short period of time. As Meskhenet was also associated with fate, users will be able to manipulate and sometimes foretell the future.

Manipulate and see the future.

Resurrected things are short-lived.

name: Singer + Song Writer

An infinite amount of wealth from the music that you create.

name: Plot The Plot

No flaws
Look smart

Their whole structure will change to resemble a human's except their genetics will stay the same. Though they might try to take over, fight & enslave man for domination & their primitive instincts could surface like killing to eat.

Who knows what secrets we could learn from the animal kingdom

name: Catalysis
overview: speed up chemical processes using your mind

With the power of catalysis, you can speed up any chemical process. This is actually a warping of space/time, but targeted to specific chemical processes only. For instance, you can make someone's car rust instantly, or age the cheddar in your fridge. Or, disable your enemies by speeding up their cell division rate, causing them to age!
pros: Speed up decay processes to render almost anything unusable
Cause wounds to heal quickly

name: Nudality
overview: make all of your opponent's clothes vanish completely.

name: Dungeon Summon
overview: summon a portal that leads to a dungeon.
description: A person with this power can summon a portal that leads to a video game style dungeon. The dungeon has monsters, bosses, and treasures, and has different floors that act as levels. If a person can make it to the harder levels of the dungeon they can find rarer and more powerful artifacts, but they have to be able to beat stronger bosses to obtain them. The dungeon is infinite and maze-like. A person with this power can create a portal to leave at any time. Only artifacts can leave the dungeon.
pros: Obtain rare and powerful treasures within the dungeon.
Open up portals to go on adventures or train with friends.

There are random traps hidden in the walls.

No other use

The brain gives off a magnetic field of its own and thus can be sensed.

name: Spawn

description: In order for this power to work, you must shed at least one drop of blood. From that blood, an exact copy of you is made. Same age, intelligence etc. You can multiply infinitely. No one is for for sure who is the original. You can drain yourself of blood & from that can spawn who knows how many of yourself. The negative is you can't re-absorb your copies, meaning whatever skills they learned you won't have.

cons: Must shed blood to make a copy
Can't absorb your copies

name: Old One Power: Necronomicon
overview: have the forbidden knowledge of the mythos
description: Old Ones: things of science and magic from other realities merged in hyperdimensional forms that bring insanity to all who merely think about them. Malevolent or uncaring, the human race is beneath the notice of their infinite might. You get an encyclopedic knowledge of these beings: the names, histories, abilities, politics, philosophical insight into their existence, the ways to summon them, and call upon their power for your own use. You are forced to write as much of it as you can in a book.
pros: Not even the Old Ones have all this knowledge. If you're noticed, they might find it useful.

name: Combined Defenses

Forcefields become melded together and stronger, point defenses more coordinated together, etc. If the one with this power is knocked out or killed, the whole net of defenses falls apart and reverts to normal separate defenses. Note: 'Net of Defenses' refers to the combined defenses.
pros: Defenses for the group are linked together and coordinated.
The point of this power is to prevent any damage whatsoever to any member of the group.
cons: The holder of this power must be awake, conscious, and alive for this power to work.
The net of defenses is linked to the holder of this power.

name: Calcium Increase
overview: put more calcium in your bones.
description: Calcium strengthens bones, right? So, add more calcium to your bones, and your body will be more durable.  As this power advances you are able to go to higher levels of endurance, but with this ability will not give invulnerability.
pros: More bone.
cons: You may seem heavier.

name: Enhanced Character
overview: have a series of greatly enhanced positive character traits.
description: You gain all of the following: Great & tremendous willpower far beyond anyone or anything imaginable. Complete & utter immunity to the influences of all evil, temptation, & corruption. A strong unwavering sense of justice, morality, & righteousness that never fails nor falters. A strict moral code often attributed to midwestern values which you feel strongly compelled to adhere to. And strong feelings of wanting to protect life, people other, & to never give up, even when things look bad.
pros: Your basically the ultimate good guy and hero.
Your fully capable of inspiring and uplifting people to be better, act better, and do better.
Provides you the capacity to stay calm, cool, & collected in any situation you find yourself in.
cons: Finding yourself at odds with people who don't share your point of view.
Most corrupt or evil individuals definitely hating your because of this superpower.
Doesn't provide you any other superhuman powers or abilities.

name: Myth Weapon: Grimpage Eclair
overview: summon the Grimpage Eclair, a weapon said to cut the very bonds of life.
description: The user gains the power to summon the Grimpage Eclair, a weapon formed into the shape of a rod. The small rod doesn't seem like much, but it does pack quite a punch, able to break holes in solid stone, but when the user is in danger, it transforms, this weapon grows another four feet, the tip becoming jagged before a blade rips from the sides of the top, a double bladed dark pink Scythe, truly a wicked weapon to demolish one's foes with. It has a ''sister'' weapon, but that's another story.
pros: Despite the small, two feet size of it in the weapon's first form, it still packs a wallop.
In it's transformed state, it is more than capable of cleaving though foes like butter.
With it's bloody and almost magical roots, it is able to cut the flesh, with the soul.
cons: With it's two foot range, unless the user moves in close, it's not going to be able to hit.
The second form only comes out when the user is in real danger, the user can't fake it.
In it's second form, the blades are extremely sharp, the user must be careful not to harm themself.

name: Coreation
overview: suck the heat from the center of  the Earth and use it for superstrength.
description: The power to drain heat from the center of the Earth and use it for superstrength. The power also makes you immune to fire.
pros: You get unbelievable superstrength.
You get superhuman durability.
cons: You can get too much heat in your body and die.

name: Vampiric Aura
overview: have an aura that steals life
description: You have an aura that steals life-force from other living beings. You can then use that stuff to reverse age, heal, stop aging, etc. Anything that has to do with life can be done. Restoring life to others takes tremendous amounts of stolen life however even with a body to put the life into.
pros: You can live as long as there are other life forms.
You can be whatever age you want.
You can restore life to others
cons: You must have other life forms near you.
No one will want to approach you (but Immortals don't mind; they have infinite life-force to give)
If you can't turn this power off for some reason when you need to.

name: Leidenfrost Effect
overview: temporarily be protected from extreme heat
description: With this superpower, you are protected from hot liquids and solids that are 122 degrees fahrenheit or hotter for a short time. There's an invisible layer of insulation. The layer works for five minutes at 122 F. The hotter it gets, the longer the insulation last. Every degree hotter it gets, that is the number of additional minutes it last. Can only work against heat 122 F of hotter. 222 F will have this power work for 105 minutes. Anything colder than 122F can still burn you.
pros: Be insulated from temperatures 122 degrees fahrenheit and above.
The hotter it is, the longer this power stays activated.
No more third degree burns.
cons: Doesn't protect you from heat colder than 122 degrees fahrenheit.
Can still get a mild first degree burn sometimes.
Insulating layer is visible underwater.

name: Entropic Immunity
overview: resist the negative effects of entropy
description: Also called entropic resilience this power grants the user the power to completely resist the adverse effects of entropy. The user of this power cannot have their energy chaotically spread out beyond use on a microscopic,macroscopic or any other scale. This means that the user can attack without having their blows reduced in power by entropy or suffer any disadvantage by an entropic attack. This power even eliminates NATURAL entropy's negative effects upon the user.
pros: Resist entropic influence inflicted upon you.
Don't fear the dampenning of your attacks or harm to your body through entropy.
You are still free to use your own entropic based powers.
cons: You can still be INDIRECTELY affected by entropy.
Not all that useful in most situations.
The enemy can still INCREASE the energy in their attacks.

name: Unforgettable
overview: remember all your past lifes.
description: Once you turn 16 you'll enter a 16 hour coma and when you wake up you'll remember all your past lives.
pros: You'll get knowledge that most people can't even dream of.
The things you were good at in your previous lives will bond once again with your body.
cons: Every single bad thing that has ever happened to you or that you have done will return to hunt you.

name: Space Hero
overview: have various superpowers while being in space.
description: When you are in space, you can survive the cold (even the absolute zero), the radiation, you don't need to breathe and you are able to float or fly in space. But you need to be in a vacuum: in the atmosphere, you are just a normal human being.
pros: You survive extreme cold and radiation in space.
You don't need to breathe in space.
You're able to float and fly in space.
cons: In the atmosphere, you are just a normal human being.

name: Secret
overview: manipulate the attributes of secrets in yourself.
description: The attributes of secrets can be very useful indeed. You can hide in plain sight or in shadows and other thiings with the effectivness of invisibility. You can be well protected from danger by barriers and other things. You can also be exempt from people scanning you to find things out about you and this includes intuitive aptitude. You can also gain a secret's trait of being important to be an automatic V. I. P.
pros: This power cannot be shortened to its breif description at the top.
This is good for being evasive.
A wide plethora of uses and pros cant be negated.
cons: Can be blocked by power sacrifice.

name: Haberdashery Mimicry
overview: gain powers from hats.
description: With this power, you gain all the typical abilities associated with any hat you wear. A hard hat will turn you into an peerless construction worker, a coonskin hat purveys the firearm skills of Davey Crockett, and a Deerstalker will give you unparallelled powers of deduction.
pros: Hats give you the abilities of the most famous person to wear them (Such as Mario's cap)
In cases where the hat isn't associated with someone, they give the most appropriate skills for it.
cons: If the hat is knocked off your head, you lose all your power.

name: Suspended Division
overview: postpone the breaking up of an object
description: When you knock over a glass, it hits the ground and shatters, right? Not any more! With this power, you can postpone when an object will break. You may knock over a glass, but when it lands it will be intact. You can then decide when it will shatter. When you stab or injure someone, it leave no initial mark or wound, but when you decide the wound will appear, the breaking action will occur. This happens to anything that breaks, tears, evaporates, breaks up etc, any action that divides an object
pros: Postpone accidental and deliberate breakages caused by you.
Stab someone, then use your power as blackmail.
Object remains intact until you so desire.
cons: It only works with things you break, not anyone else.
Some get suspicious when water won't evaporate, cheese is uncuttable and food is indigestible.
You don't need to say anything, so just thinking about an object breaking might be enough.

name: Superpower Charge
overview: charge your power by being struck by superpowers.
description: With this ability, by being struck by any superpower, you gain power and energy, depending on how strong the power that struck you was. You can store this energy for as long as you want, and release it in a powerful blast of energy, or choose to save it, which will increase your mental and physical strength.
pros: Every superpower used against you will benefit you
Save the energy of the powers you are struck by, or release them in a powerful, energetic blast
Being struck by powers makes you feel great, and has a nice taste
cons: No additional benefit if someone is healing you, or shielding you, etc.
If you're never struck by a super-powered being
This is a passive ability (it's always active)

name: Farsight
overview: see things from far away
description: Did you ever want to see what your best friend is doing? With this power you can!
pros: See what other people are doing
Spy on your crush
See where your foes are
cons: None

name: Creature Attractor
overview: attract creatures from species other than yours.
description: Unless it is controlled, you always give off a signal that indiscriminately tell any living creature in a large vicinity to come to you, except those from the same species as you. When sufficiently mastered, you can choose to attract only the species you want or only one specific creature, control the radius of your power, and even turn this power off. This power only draws the creatures' attention to you. They won't find you attractive; their feelings towards you are left to their nature.
pros: You are the perfect bait! Just attract any creature into a trap.
Works on any creature. Plants and fungi (though they will rarely move), lost animals, cryptids,...
You could have a Snow White moment with forest animals.
cons: You are the perfect bait! You can draw the attention of any creature away from your allies.
Works on any creature. Kystians, bacterias, ferocious animals,...
If you haven't mastered it, this power will always be on.

name: Color Change
overview: change the color of any item or person to any other color
description: With this power you can change the color of anything you want. The change is permanent if what the change is done on is wanted by the person or the item's owner.
pros: You can be any color you want.
You can make others any color they want to be.
cons: No true combative use.
Only affects colors, nothing else.
Color changes are only superfluous at worst.

name: Coin Flip Of Truth
overview: know the answer to any yes or no question by fliipping a coin.
description: With this power you can ask any true or false, yes or no question and flip a coin to know the answer. Heads is true or yes and tails is no or false.
pros: Pass test with little to no studying
Know if someone is lying to you
Always win the coin toss by asking an easy question
cons: Need a coin
Only yes or no questions

name: Moon Fire
overview: wield the moon fire
description: Gives the wielder control of moon fire. Moon fire is the essence of the night, so it lets you control darkness, shadows, moonshine, the evil inside people, the public conciousness and protection at night. Each use of the moon fire will make the wielder more attune to the darkness. If the moon fire is left uncontrolled, the wielder will eventuall turn into a mooncalf, a creature of the moon.
pros: Gives you control over the evil in others
Shadows can be used to hide from enemies
Gives you protection when it's night
cons: If left unattended, it will take over the wielder
It will make the wielder a magnet for creatures of the night
It is very addictive

name: Waterisation
overview: turn everything around you into water
description: You can use this power to make anything within a 5 mile radius into water but you won't be turned into water , although if you learn to control it you can turn youself into water. When you lose concentration everything will go back to its origional form unless its water.
pros: Water!
Never be thirsty
Really win a fight with this
cons: Its just water
As soon as you lose concentration everything turns back
If you can't swim then learn. Now!

name: Immortal Slayer
overview: kill immortals
description: Basically you can kill anything that has eternal life, or general invincibility, simply by touching it, and it stays dead.
pros: Defeat any super powerfull characters that try to play the "invincibility" card. "
Kill vampires, werewolves, zombies, ghosts, etc. Simply by touching them
cons: Does not work on anything mortal.
You have to come into physical contact with the immortal.

name: Four Eyes: Torture
overview: make people see and feel elaborate illusions by staring into your eyes
description: This power is gained by using the long distance part of the Four Eyes power. The Four Eyes power slowly turns into this power. When someone stares into all of your eyes simultaneously, they suddenly see and feel the worst torture they can think of for themselves.
pros: Do torture without any hard work.
Can still use Four Eyes powers.
This is a Four Eyes evolution.
cons: Must have the Four Eyes power and use the long distance power.
Target must stare into all your eyes at the same time.
Cannot get other Four Eyes evolutions.

name: Myth Power: Nectar And Ambrosia
overview: channel Nectar and Ambrosia's command over the essence of the food and drink of the gods
description: Nectar (Nektar) and Ambrosia, in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the respective Food and Drink of the Gods, of the same names. As such, channeling them allows one to turn normal food into delicious Ambrosia (which heals, cleans wounds and has all vital nutrients needed for any species--mortal or immortal--to survive), by touch. In addition, one can turn normal drink into succulent Nectar (which preserves age and enhances physical beauty), by touch. One can even negate said effects at will.
pros: Eat the divine delicacies of the Olympians, which taste heavenly (and have rejuvenating properties)
Eaten together, they can bestow temporary immortality (preventing aging, permanent injury and death)
One can turn off the immortalizing effects at will (if a foe gets his hands on it)
cons: Nectar and Ambrosia must BOTH be ingested to achieve the effect of immortality (NCN)
Nectar-and-Ambrosia-Bestowed Immortality only lasts for as long as the power is active (NCN)
MythPower: Hebe's Blessing and MythPower: Ganymede's Gain allow negation of this ability (NCN)

name: Triforce Of Wisdom
overview: use the triforce of wisdom
description: You have the triforce of wisdom and this gives you several powers. First, you know everything that is happening around you. Second, you have vast magical powers including healing, magic or even mind control. Third, you mostly make good choices.
pros: Magic, healing and mind control
Vast wisdom
Make good choices
cons: when you heal you give up your own life
People with the triforce of power may try to take the triforce of wisdom from you

name: Myth Power: Mnemosyne's Memory
overview: channel Mnemosyne's command over the essence of memory, remembrance, recollection and language
description: Mnemosyne, in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of memory, remembrance, recollection and language. As such, channeling her allows one to manipulate memory (implanting memories, enhancing memory, distorting memories, erasing them, etc) at will. In addition, the user has total memory of every experience or bit of knowledge he encounters (except anything he WANTS to forget). One can even understand and communicate in all languages (even those of animals, insects, aliens, spirits, machines, etc).
pros: Psychically manipulate memories of self and others (implant, enhance, distort, erase, etc) at will
Panmnesia (total recall of every experience one encounters); repress traumatic memories at will
Omnilingualism (ability to understand and communicate in any and all languages)
cons: Cannot survive death as a Living Memory until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provides immunity (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Cellular Regain
overview: not lose your other abilities if someone or something drains it.
description: If there is one thing I learned about superpowered heroes (and villains) is that, without their powers, they are almost nothing. So, that is why I made this ability so that, if that actually happens, Cellular Regain would kick in and will return that person's ability to fight once again.
pros: You'll never lose your powers.
If the opponent who is draining you holds on, they will either explode or burn out.
This ability works  with inner energy, blood,and genes as well.
cons: You'll never lose all your dangerous powers.
Your opponent could be more powerful if they hold on.
Your opponent could mutate into the form of your powers forever by 20% chance.

name: State Of Zero
overview: reset anything to a point of zero
description: Attacks, willpower, strength, ability, thoughts, anything can be reset to a point of zero with this power. Enough said.
pros: No one can take action against you since all their actions return to a point of zero
If you kill someone, their death state is also turned to zero, causing an infinite death loop
This power is very broken
cons: You cannot prevent aging since it will reset your age to zero(You die)

name: Ultimate Tk (Acceleration)
overview: make time go faster and be unaffected by this power
description: A person with this power does not have Time Skip. Instead of erasing time frames, the user merely has the power to make time go faster. The user is unaffected by their own power, they go as fast as time is accelerated. This means that they can move normally while everyone else's reaction time is slow, so people can get run over by cars that are a distance away. Also, the user only ages normally while everyone else ages faster. Also, if the user wanted, they could speed up time till doomsday.
pros: People don't notice that time has gone faster-their reaction is the same as when time is normal
You can be unaffected by this power-you move as fast as the time you speed up
Extremely powerful if placed in the right hands
cons: People don't notice that time sped up until you tell them
Mess with the world time and annoy physicists
A person who wants to destroy the world can simply speed everything up to doomsday

name: Artistic Precognition
overview: predict the future through artistic media
description: People have always needed to know what will happen next. A Precognitive can induce visions of the future, which they will experience as if they were watching it themselves. However, many users find it difficult to remember all or part of these visions. So once they enter the trance, they will usually pick up their most familiar art tool available and will begin recording the vision while still in the state. This might be a painting, a sketch, a literary work, a whittling or even a musical piece.
pros: Get hired as a consultant for almost any company
Totally voluntary
The phrase "I whittles the future" never gets old
cons: Might see a very unpleasant future
May become a bit of a control freak
If you predict the future on a musical instrument

name: Bone Claws
overview: make unbreakable bone claws come out of your saces between your knuckles
description: The bone claws are unbreakable and they can cut through anything. So if you are a good guy you can tear someone's face up. If you are a bad guy you can cut into a bank vault. But there is a catch. if you don't have a healing ability you will have a lot of scars. Also, it will hurt really really badly (you'll get used to it).
pros: Looks wicked cool
They are unbreakable
Can cut through anything
cons: It hurts
Takes a while for skin to heal

name: Perspectivation
overview: make people understand things the way you see it.
description: You can make people see the cause for revenge against someone, or make the reason clear why you like something, or someone. Basically people would know how you feel about a situation.
pros: Could gain allies from people who understand.
Assure someone of something you're gonna do.
Make someone know a decision's reason, but not when you change your mind.
cons: People will know exactly what you feel, so you can't lie.
May make people hate you for the way you see something.
Hard to control and may allow people to predict your decisions.

name: Love Nerd
overview: know what attracts anyone
description: This ability know what turns on anyone. This ability will make you never fail with the ladies or men. You just think of someone in an affectionate way and you'll know exactly what attracts them. Although that's all it does, it only makes people attracted to you when your doing the things they like.
pros: Never fail with a lover.
Always know what people like in other people.
cons: Doesn't really help you with bad guys
There not really attracted with the real you.

name: Spirit Helper
overview: have a spirit helper/sidekick
description: With this power you get a spirit helper. A spirit helper is a ghost like thing that can go inside of you and sort of possess you though you both can control your body. While the spirit is in you, you are stronger, fast and can fly. You are also immune to mind control, telepathic and psychic based attacks and powers due to you having multiple personalities in your body. You also cannot be possessed by an evil spirt even if your spirit is not inside of you. Your spirit can also only possess you.
pros: You have a spirit helper
You are stronger, faster, can fly and are immune to psychic, telepathic and mind control attacks
You cannot be possess by another spirit even if your spirit helper is not inside of you
cons: Your spirit helper can take full control of your body but only in extreme cases
If you die your spirit helper can take control of your body (not necessarily a bad thing)

name: Allpower Time
overview: sense when all powers are available on the superpower list.
description: Ever wanted a particular power, but could never find it? You knew there was a time when all were available, but it was just as elusive. Well, with this power, you will sense when the time is active.
pros: Always gain a power you want.
Help your friends on the site too.
Harmless, so nobody will fear you.
cons: You may not have site access at the time.
You need to acquire this power first, which puts you in a Catch-22 position.
People may nag you for the time.

name: On A Dimensional Scale
overview: alter a power so it is on a dimensional scale.
description: This ability changes a power so it is on a dimensional scale. Ex. Telepathy on a dimensional scale.
pros: Larger area to use a power.
cons: Only one power.
Can only be used once (Cannot be reversed)

name: Gravity Perception
overview: perceive the effects of gravity in one's immediate area
description: Also called Gravitational Energy Perception, Gravity Sense, Gravity Perception, Gravimetry, Baroception or Barognosis, this is the ability to perceive the flux, intensity and flow of gravity, and alterations to such. This perception lets the user sense disturbances in gravitational fields made by movement, as well as sensing the size, shape, weight and density of objects without having to see them; the user can even sense how to maneuver to effectively DEFY gravity, to mimic Superhuman Agility.
pros: Sense movements by perceiving disturbances in gravitational fields
Sense the presence, shape, weight and density of objects around you without having to see them
Sense how to effectively maneuver to appear to have Superhuman Agility
cons: Doesn't work in low/no-gravity situations
Especially sensitive to when people alter gravity (may be disorienting)
Maneuvering to defy gravity only comes at the higher bands of ability development

name: Wolf Hybrid
overview: be part wolf and gain part (or all) of a wolf's abilities
description: If you are a wolf hybrid you would be part human, part wolf. You would have mostly the bone structure of a human, but your skull might be shaped more after a wolf's. You would have most (or all) of a wolfs abilities.
pros: You would have a much farther developed sense of smell
You could jump far and run at great speeds
You would have the nails (and the teeth if your face is like a wolfs) of a wolf.
cons: Your ability can't 'turn off' it would be a perminent part of your chemical make-up
You would be furry and have a tail. (though in some cases considered adorable)
