You would have a much higher temper, it would be easy to anger you

name: Card Stack Abilities: Ace
overview: have complete control over the spiritual realm
description: Access the powers of the elemental spirit of consciousness and control the spiritual realm. You can turn your physical body into an astral one and possess creatures. Break through the toughest mental bariers and rewrite the memories and personalities of your enemies. If your feeling particularly nasty, rip out the spirit of a creature and decide whether or not you want to give it back its body. Summon spirits of the dead back into their former bodies and control them.
pros: Saying hello to your great great great grandfather whenever you want.
Possess people and make them do whatever you want
Avoid physical injury by switching into an astral form.
cons: A spirit binder or ghost hunters
People with the Card Stack Ability: Jester are not affected by your powers
Con 2 is only valid when they are of an equal of higher power level.

name: Collective Noun Creation
overview: bring the collective noun for a creature into existence.
description: A herd of elephants,a troop of gorillas or a howling of werewolves. If you can find the collective noun for a creature somewhere(the internet,a book)you can bring a average-sized group of that creature into existence. The group of creatures obeys you. You can only have one group at a time. What you create still has any traditional weaknesses. Your coven of vampires is still affected by sunlight and also affected by undead control powers.
pros: There are many useful animals that have collective nouns.
There are collective nouns for mythical creatures... A dignity of dragons.
Yes,you can create a crowd of people.
cons: There's more collective nouns for natural animals than mythical ones.

name: Animal Merging
overview: merge with any animal
description: You can merge your biology with any one animal & become an animal/humanoid hybrid. You will take on the animal's characteristics. It only lasts for an hour & your animal side might start to take over.
pros: Merge with any animal
Take on their characteristics
cons: Only lasts for a hour
Animal side might take over

name: The Maze
overview: create a magical maze to trap anyone you want to trap
description: Creates a magical maze that traps anyone you want to trap. Cheating is impossible because the maze's walls can detect any thoughts of cheating. The only way to get out is to find the exit, which is almost too impossible to find. The maze is not visible in the naked eyes of people outside the maze.
pros: Can save you from killing the people you hate the most.
cons: You cannot disperse the maze.

name: Decision Redirection
overview: change whatever a subject's current decison to the opposite
description: One with this ability can change the current decision(s) of others to the opposite. For example, a foe is deciding if he should stay and face one in combat, one simply changes his mind to run away from the user. The major flaw of this ability is that one cannot know what decisons another object is going over or cannot change "spur of the moment" decisons.
pros: Can stop someone from fighting you.
Stop others from thinking the wrong thing.
cons: Can stop possibly good decisons
Cannot read minds
"Spur of the Moment" decisions, decision without thinking.

name: Time To Die
overview: see exactly when and how someone or something will die.
description: With this ability you can look at any living organism and see it's life span. You will be able to see exactly when, where, and how someone or something will die.
pros: You will know when anything will die
You will know how long you have to prevent the death, if you want too
You will know what you should do to prevent the death, if you want too
cons: You cannot know learn your own fate
You might upset the natural balance sooner or later
If you did look at your own timeline somehow, you'd die right after you're done looking

name: Pencil Based Powers.
overview: have a metal/wood body and have powers based on creation and deletion.
description: This power allows you to turn your entire body into a mixture of metal and wood for defense and still have the same freedom of movement you had before. For creation you can produce diamond-hard lead spikes and projectiles out of your body and you can create black shapes of objects as if they had been drawn. For deletion you can create a pink rubber material that absorbs forces or energy (which you can reshape) or create a pink energy that breaks apart atoms.
pros: Have a metal / wood body.
Can produce lead weapons and black drawings that act like the real thing.
Can make rubber barriers and pink energy that deletes objects.
cons: Takes more power and control to use black drawings and pink energy.
The black drawings are not as strong as the real things.
The pink energy works slowly unless you concentrate a lot of power in one area.

name: Lydian Tunic
overview: use it to have defensive invulnerable protection.
description: When activated, the Lydian Tunic can glow light green & illuminated, can use it to put a force field around yourself which causes projectiles to be redirectly move back at your opponent, can block all kinds of attacks, but it can be extremely light and/or very heavy for someone else to use. Pretty effective against weapons of any kind.
pros: It could grant you extreme durability & enhanced strength.
cons: It can be harmed by dark magic or even psychic attacks.

name: Frieza Forms
overview: be able to become a different form as your power grows.
description: With this power, as your power grows, you are able to turn into different forms, created by your imagination.
pros: Create different forms.
cons: Other than a different look, it is nothing different.
No real combat use.......

name: Dimension Destination Control
overview: control where someone goes when they dimension travel.
description: Within 100 feet of you someone dimension traveling will go to a dimension of your choice. You can mentally preset this dimension or change it at will. This power also effects those traveling to other planes or alternate universes. Anyone who possesses the power PA:Ithuari is immune to this power. A few dimensions are off limits for this power (No con negation).
pros: Decide where (universe, plane, dimension) dimension traveler goes.
Ergi, the dimension where it's 11 billion degrees.
cons: You can't send anyone to Nameless(i.e. the power PA:Nameless).

name: Soul Animorphic Hidden Power
overview: unleash your inner soul's animal abilities
description: This ability unlocks the seal that keeps your soul from unleashing those unknown abilities you have been holding onto and have been unable to use. These abilities are limited and based off of your personality and feelings.
pros: Have the enhanced abilities of the animal you resemble the most
Ability to heal over time
Allows your stamina to be so enhanced you can fight for a week
cons: Activates only when in a desperate situation
May have unknown side effects such as memory loss
May become uncontrollable and those around that you care for may get hurt

name: Angel Power: Angel's Sword
overview: channel the sword of an angel
description: This power allows you to channel the mighty sword that every angel wields. At will, you can call to your possession a mighty, three-and-a-half-foot-long sword. This sword can not only cut through anything, but it can change into any type of bladed weapon: two-handed broadsword, longsword, shortsword, dagger, throwing knife, hunting knife, shuriken, butter knife, whatever. In fact, if you need it to, it can even turn into a shield of the desired size, to protect as well as attack.
pros: Sword can cut through nearly anything (and can be recalled to your possession at will)
Can change to a sword or bladed weapon of any size (to fit one's personal strength, or preference)
Can also change into a shield of any size, and (when developed) even armor
cons: Can't cut through divine materials (can't pierce the robe of an angel, or similar materials)
If you try to use it to harm an innocent, it'll phase through them (then teleport away from you)
If you try to use it against an angel, the sword will teleport from your possession to the angel's

name: Animal Splicer
overview: take two or more animals and combine them into one organism, giving you control over it.
description: This ability takes two or more animals and combine their DNA to make a new organism. Anything is possible, just be creative. Once this creature is created, it listens to any command you say.
pros: Transportation is easy
It requires no tools in doing this, just your hands
You have an army of creatures to do your bidding
cons: If no animal is in sight then this power is not activated

name: Gaze Of The Mischief
overview: make anyone within your sight misbehave and be naughty.
description: The toughest warriors, the coldest women, none are left behind by the gaze. All and truly all within the gaze commence to misbehave as soon as you activate your gaze. Thieving, fighting, childish behaviour and naughty actions will be unavoidable. Be warned the effects are temporary and if you use it to much on someone, they will become devious forever.
pros: No need to fight, just look at some people and flee while your enemy is destracted.
All are effected so don't be surprised if one who is normally far to serious becomes a grown child.
The gaze is only temporary, when used in moderation the subjects are returned to their normal state.
cons: People might want to kill you while under the gaze.
People who are recovered could hold you responsible for their deeds.
People who are hit by the gaze multiple times a day will experience side effects.

name: Holy Power: God Of Speed
overview: become faster than the light for 3 seconds.
description: With this power you can become faster than light for 3 seconds, making you fast enough to kill entire armies before your time runs out. When you are faster than the light, 3 seconds is enough to do a lot of things, like killing an entire army, then take a shower, eat some cake and write a book with 500 pages before the 3 seconds time end.
pros: You become really, really, really fast.
With this power, you have enough time for putting your superhero clothes on before saving the day.
cons: This power makes you tired, and you can only use it 2 times a day.
Only Tormentors can use this power.

name: Gaze Of Contempt
overview: ignore any superpower you personally deem to be stupid.
description: A sort of reality warping that allows you to project your willing suspension of disbelief onto the world. While it will not depower anyone, it will prevent powers you find to be ludicrous or logically incoherent from affecting you directly. You may still be harmed by secondary affects (e. G. A building falling over, etc)
pros: Humiliating defeats will be a thing of the past.
Power through annoying novelty midbosses like a hot knife through butter.
cons: Silver age superheroes will think you're a jerk.

name: Exemptedness
overview: be exempted from many things.
description: This power causes you to be exempted from a plethora of things. You could be exempted from laws and be a villain or be exempted from movement and literaly be unmovable. You can also make yourself exempted from fire or other elements. A bad feature is that you can make yourself exempted from types of damage, but not from damage itself, and powers like regeneration block can still get to you if you are not careful. You can declare yourself exempted from the laws of physics.
pros: Be exempted from space to travel quickly.
If you turn evil and become exempted from perception, specific powers can still find you.
Youre levelheaded friends with anti telepathy or such still know when you do bad.
cons: Not exempted from most superpowers, mostly just from what they can do.
Not exempted from natural stupidity, also takes practice to master.
These three cons can't be fixed by con negator or flaw removal.

name: Tactile Career Match
overview: instantly match any person to their perfect career
description: With this superpower, you instantly know what the perfect job is for any person you meet just by shaking their hand. You don't need to know anything about them, not even their name. Just by shaking their hand you instatly match their skills to the perfect occupation or career. However, it doesn't work on yourself.
pros: You'd make a great career advisor
You're always 100% correct
You could make a lot of money with this power
cons: It doesn't work on yourself
You can't switch it off
Some people might not be happy to hear they're in the wrong job

name: Displaced Existence In Time
overview: 'skip' certain periods of time, and relive them later.
description: Ever been on something like a long car trip and wish you could skip straight to the destination? With this power, you can! Activating this power will displace your soul from your present body and into your future body. You can choose the time your soul re-inhabits your body, and the time passes in the blink of an eye. And whenever you go to sleep next, your soul will travel back to the time of activation and relive the lost time as a dream. No one will notice a thing!
pros: Skip long, boring events
While reliving the events as a dream, you act exactly as you would've normally
No one notices, and the time passes instantly for you
cons: The length of your time-skip will reflect exactly how long you sleep.
You will not be able to wake up until you have completed your lost hours of time.

name: Tag
overview: make a person loved or despised by touching them
description: There are some people who are so charismatic that they are universally loved. And then there's that one guy who everone hates. Tag excites these general feelings around a person you designate, amping them up to the point where they either beat him mercessily or they deify him.
pros: Help someone out who deserves it
Beat someone down who deserves it
Cause a distraction
cons: Temporary
Cannot be used on yourself
Person who is touched feels a small shock

name: Icicle Control
overview: create and control icicles
description: You can create and control icicles out of the water floating in the air(humidity). The icicles will last as long as you want them too and will melt when you don't care about whether they are there or not. The icicles will be as hard as normal icicles are.
pros: Untraceable kills because the icicle melts.
Last as long as you need them.
cons: Only icicles.

name: Elemental Weapon: Fire Sword
overview: wield a sword that controls the fire element
description: With this ability, you can call to you a sword engulfed in flame. With it you can slash away foes and increase heat. It can also manipulate and control fire; you can shoot fire blasts and beams with the sword. Also you are immune to the effects of fire while wielding the sword.
pros: Control and manipulate all fire (ones you generate, and already lit fires)
Can slash away at enemies with an awesome sword engulfed in flames
cons: The sword controls fire, not you
Only immune to effects of fire, while wielding the sword
Your elemental weakness is water

name: Intimidation
overview: cause feelings of fear and discomfort
description: Rodney Dangerfield once said, 'I don't get no respect.' A person with Intimidation never has that problem. No matter their age, weight, or gender, they can consciously intimidate the people around them. The user can only affect people who see them, and it is more powerful the fewer people there are.
pros: Get some respect
Work your way to the top more easily
Completely voluntary, can 'flip the switch'
cons: Cannot affect a crowd efficiently
Can be resisted
Can be blocked by closing your eyes

name: Numbing Point
overview: cause a person's entire body to become numb as long as you're pointing at them
description: With this power you can cause a person's entire body to become numb just by pointing at them. You can not limit the numbing effect to certain parts of the body and the victim only stays numb while you're pointing at them.
pros: You can make people numb by pointing at them
cons: You can not limit the effect to certain parts of the victim's body
They only remain numb while you're pointing at them
It happens whenever you point at someone

name: Meteorbolt
overview: summon a huge lightning covered meteorite.
description: The enemy doesn't stand a chance when you summon a meteor that is covered in thunderbolts. It comes down on him/her really fast and hard, and will fry them.
pros: Brutal power to have.
Massive damage
cons: Strange and brutal power to have.
Difficult to control & Collateral damge
Enemy might push you in its path

name: Abacomancy
overview: divine the future through sand, dust, and ash.
description: Abacomancy is a method of divination using small particles (Sand, Dust, Ash, Etc.) An Abacomancer merely waves a hand over some dust/sand and it rearranges itself into a pattern that tells the future. More sand/dust means "seeing" further into the future. This power is very unspecific in what information it gives you; you may get anything from useless to bizarre. The better you are at Abacomancy, the more useful the information you get. For obvious reasons, this power works well in deserts.
pros: Can get information about the future.
Can work on dusty things, sand, or even the remains of campfires.
The patterns are unique to each person, like a fingerprint.
cons: May give you really weird things like, "There are 3 millon grasshoppers on the continent".
Can't be used without small particles.
Takes time and effort to decipher the patterns.

name: Think Wings
overview: give people or animals wings with your mind
description: With this power you can give people or animals wings with your mind all you have to do is think of the desired person or animal with wings
pros: You can give your friends the ability to fly
cons: You can't take away their wings once you give it to them
Does not work on birds
You can't give yourself wings

name: Synesthetic Inundation
overview: induce a synesthetic overload of the senses
description: One with this ability should use it carefully. Also called Synesthetic Overload, it allows the listener to hear the sound the user produces, but also makes them perceive it as visible light. In effect, when the user screams, he not only produces loud (not sonic, but loud) sound, he also produces blindingly-bright light in the foe's sight range. This effect can often be turned off at will.
pros: Your scream can be a weapon without it being sonic in capacity
Induce synesthesia in others, ONLY for the purpose of them being blinded by your voice
Can be turned off at will
cons: If the power CAN'T be turned off at will, makes conversation VERY awkward
Only affects beings that can hear
Covering the ears protects one from this ability, but also blinds them until power is turned off

name: Catharsis
overview: breathe out impurities
description: Also called Purgation or Purging, this is the ability to purge the body of all ills at will. All the user needs to do is inhale deeply, and when he breathes out, any bodily impurities are sublimated (changed into a gas) and released from the body. One with this ability can breathe out viruses, bacteria, stresses (stress-inducing hormones) or the like. This improves the speed of recovery from sickness, or even inflict said impurity on others.
pros: Breathe out all your stresses, diseases and viruses at will
Helps speed up healing process
Inflict the exhaled impurities on others
cons: Cannot breathe out stresses until they build up immensely
Aniothability can allow user to resist being afflicted with exhaled stresses
Immunity can allow user to resist being allficted with exhaled diseases/viruses

name: Temporal Transformation
overview: freeze or slow down time during a transformation
description: When the user transforms time will either stop or will be slowed down. It's basically like how the characters from Sailor Moon or Winx Club do transformations and the enemy seems not to move at all until their finished transforming.
pros: Time slows or stops during transformation
cons: Time Defiance or other time powers can interfere with this

name: Antithesis Mimic
overview: become the antithesis of any person or being you know
description: With this power, you can become the antithesis of anyone you meet. For example, if you meet a super lazy person, you can use this power and become a super smart and organized version of the same person and vice-versa. If you copied someone while they were weak but they later became strong, you can access both versions of the same person. You have limited control over the copied person's personality. Copying a hero will turn you into an anti-hero, and if not careful, a villain.
pros: This power can show people their possibilities
Limited disguise since you look the same (most of the time) but have different strength/control
cons: You also have the good attributes reversed too-if you copy a good person you will become evil/darker
The antithesis can only copy powers that a person had at the time that you met them

name: Myth Power: Oreithyia's Order
overview: channel Oreithyia's command over the essence of mountain winds
description: Oreithyia (Orithyia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of sharp, cold mountain winds. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate and manipulate cold winds at will. In addition, one may induce the feeling of frostbite in living things by a touch. Furthermore, one gains adaptation to survive on any mountain (enhanced toughness, cold immunity, adapted respiration, etc), which may be shared by touch. One can even teleport self and others to or from any mountain in the Cosmos at will.
pros: Generate and manipulate cold winds at will; induce frostbite in living creatures by a touch
Teleport to/survive on mountains (enhanced toughness and respiration, cold/wind immunity, etc)
Share Montane Adaptation (adaptation to survive mountain conditions) by a touch
cons: Cannot teleport foes to mountaintops and immobilize them there until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Way of the Winds and MythPower: Horae (Seasons) provide immunity
Cold Immunity provides immunity

name: The Strength Of Goodwill
overview: be more powerful through the goodwill of those who believe in you.
description: The more goodwill people feel towards you, the stronger, tougher and faster you become. Distance is not a factor. There is no limit to how many people or to whether or not they are human. Billions of intelligent beings in the universe means a billion times amplification for your powers.
pros: Near infinite speed, toughness and strength.
cons: Mr. Lonely. No time off. Billions of people who want help.
Must maintain a perfect public image at all times.

name: Punch Invulnerability
overview: be invulnerability to punches
description: Whenever you get punched, it leaves no damage or pain.
pros: Great in fight
cons: Doesn't help if you get kicked
Bad wrestler
Mostly useless

name: Focus Attraction
overview: attract all focus on to something.
description: Focus Attraction is the ability to select someone and centre their focus on yourself or an object, causing them to be obsessed with the object as long as you hold concentration.
pros: Can stop someone from attacking by changing their focus.
Cause someone to be obsessed with you or someone else.
While they're focused you can attack them and they will not respond as long as you hold it.
cons: Not offensive.
Only affects one person at a time.

name: Solitary Sphere
overview: trap a person in his consinse
description: Sphere is formed by hands and is made up of dark energy. A person hit by the sphere enters a deep coma and catatonic state. Once in coma the person is trapped in darkness and while a hour passes it wouls seem like one year.
pros: Perfect defense
Sphere absorbs other powers
Also used as explosive
cons: Uses lots of energy
Effects are not permanent
Does not work on people that also use darness as a power ect. Cloak

name: Myth Power: Galene's Grace
overview: channel Galene's command over the essence of calm seas
description: Galene, in Greek myth, was the goddess of calm seas, and calm weather at sea. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically still any body of water (keep water from being manipulated by hydrokinesis, etc) at will. Furthermore, one can psychically calm storms at sea (and on other bodies of water), at will. One can even psychically perceive and teleport self/others to anywhere where the sea is calm, at will.
pros: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically still any body of water at will; psychically calm storms on any body of water, at will
Psychically perceive and teleport self/others to anywhere the water is calm
cons: Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and command sea creatures, until developed (NCN)
Cannot calm the 'sea' of 'stormy' emotions, by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige provides immunity and allows disruption/negation (NCN)

name: Warning Label Maker
overview: create a warning label on an inanimate object, affecting it by what's written on the label.
description: Think of a object within visual range. Image a warning label on it. A warning appears on it and affects the object according to what you imagined on the label. Ex. You could put on a enemy's city-destroying laser that was just finished "must be on without firing for 3 months or laser will explode. " This power can make harmless things harmful(i. E. A cylinder of nitrogen gas with the right warning into something like nerve gas). Any label is made out of normal material.
pros: With the right warning label you could change something.
Sabotage.
Superpowers could make a warning label unremovable and nearly indestructible.
cons: Only affects inanimate objects.
Without superpower protection a warning label is easily removed or destroyed.

name: Transformation: Sticky Thing
overview: change his or her whole body into a sticky substance
description: The user is able to transform his or her form into a translucent , liquid sticky substance that can stop any projectile, like bullets or medium velocity projectiles that are thrown by enemies.
pros: A good defensive power
The sticky substance can be used to ensnare enemies
cons: Might get ridiculed by the public

name: Pandoran Nightmare
overview: have a prophetic dream every night of the most terrible thing that will happen the following day.
description: Every night when you sleep, you have a vivid, detailed nightmare depicting the worst even that will occur in the world the following day. This will continue to happen every night until the day you die. The dream will be detailed enough to accurately figure out what exactly will happen, where it will happen and when.
pros: You can prevent major loss of life through early warnings.
You could change the course of history for the better.
cons: Sleep will become an inescapable hell.
The establishment might just write you off as some kind of loony street preacher.
No matter how hard you work to prevent the distaster it will only have been one out of many.

name: Gorgon's Touch
overview: turn anything into stone that you physically touch.
description: This power allows you to turn anything you touch into a brittle stone that can break if hit. It is possible to turn something you turned to stone back to its previous form, but it causes immense drain on your own energy.   You can also control how fast the thing transforms, allowing for instant transformation or incredibly slow.
pros: Can break through anything.
Can turn even living things to stone
Can control what is turned to stone (so you don't accidentally turn your friend to a statue)
cons: Can't undo power if the item that was transformed was broken.

name: Zodiac: Scorpio
overview: poison your enemy's mind(s) with doubts
description: By drawing the sign of Scorpio in the air, you can fire off telepathic blasts that poison your enemy's mind with doubts as to why they are fighting. They will question what it is they fight for and whether or not your side would be better. This can lead to a massive loss in morale for ordinary troops. This effect lasts for two minutes and blasts are fired in sets of one per second.
pros: Get rid of enemies fast.
Can gain alies from enemy side.
cons: Can accidentally reinforce an enemy's resolve.
Are required to draw the sign of Scorpio.
Con Negation and similar powers don't work on this power.

name: Wind Perception
overview: perceive the flow and intensity of the wind
description: Wind Energy Perception or Wind Perception is the ability to perceive the flow and flux of the wind, and its direction; it also allows one to perceive things being carried by the wind, or that affect the flow of wind; it may even allow one to eavesdrop on conversations by listening to voices being carried by the wind (and otherwise mimic Superhuman Hearing), or allow one to mimic Superhuman Smell by honing in on scents carried by wind
pros: Sense the flow, direction and intensity of the wind
Sense things being carried by the wind (including the approach of storm clouds)
Mimic Superhuman Smell and Superhuman Hearing by honing in on the wind
cons: Sometimes you see only see the wind as color (and can't hone in on scents or sounds)
Sometimes your power to smell the wind is really strong (honing in on scents is disorienting)
Sometimes your power to hear the wind is really strong (honing in on sounds is disorienting)

name: Children Of The Virus
overview: infect people by scratching them or cutting them with a whip-like tongue, and control the infected
description: You are Child of the Virus. You have a razor sharp tongue. You also have sharp claws that are coated with the virus. You don't get nutrition from regular food, but you feed off people. Every person you infect you feed off of their life force psychically until it runs out. There is no limit to people you can infect. The more people you infect the stronger you get. Also those that are infected have to do whatever you say. If you get hurt you can heal by eating your infected's life force.
pros: Be invincible by infecting many
Slice enemies in half with your long toungue
Heal yourself by eating a large amount of your infected's life force
cons: Basically you have to slowly kill people to live and become strong
You have to come into contact with someone to infect them

name: Animal Shift
overview: turn animals into other animals
description: With this power you can turn one animals into another one, you can turn cows into zebras, dogs into cats etc. You can change the species of a single animal as many times as you want. You cannot use this power on humans - super or not - or aliens.
pros: You can change the species of animals
cons: This power has no effect on humans, aliens or superhumans

name: Rise Of The Two Headed Dragon
overview: turn into a two headed dragon
description: With this power you can turn into a dragon with two heads. One of your dragon heads breathes fire while the other one breathes ice. In addition to that you are super strong, can fly and have sharp teeth in both of your mouths. You cannot speak English in this form only the language of the dragons.
pros: You can turn into a two headed dragon.
You can fly.
You can breathe fire and ice.
cons: You can only speak the language of the dragons in this form.

name: Living Toys
overview: bring your toys to life
description: With this power, you can bring any of your toys to life (including ones that don't have faces or human/animal characteristics, such as Slinkys, toy cars, stuffed animal hot dogs etc. ) Once alive, however, the toys are not under your control but you can turn them back to normal toys when you're done with them. This power only affects toys that are owned by you, not just any toy you see.
pros: You can bring your toys to life.
cons: They are not under your control.
The toy has to be owned by you.

name: Absolute Perspective
overview: perfectly put situations into a global perspective.
description: You've had the worst day ever. You feel like you're starving. You're the luckiest man alive. Are you though? When faced with situations where you feel like this, this power allows you to gain a global perspective, flashing up thoughts, images and emotions of people who are *really* happy, *really* lucky, or *really* hurting. Allows for completely realistic rationality, but will likely leave you emotionally shell shocked.
pros: Be completely realistic and rational in your thinking.
Rejoice with those people who are *truly* happy.
Could spur you on to help people who are actually starving etc.
cons: Would drain you to keep seeing *really* bad situations.
Anything you achieve would be put into perspective, likely showing how meaningless it is.
Could find it hard to empathise with people complaining about how bad their lives are.

name: Aqua Cage
overview: create a sphere of water to trap your opponent
description: This ability allows you to create a water sphere to entrap your enemy. Once the opponent is trapped, the water sphere will solidify and shatter into millions of shards along with the trapped opponent. The Water Sphere originates from your hands as a small sphere at first. You have to throw the sphere at your opponent and it will turn big.
pros: Can trap multiple opponents at once
cons: Can be dodged
Requires your hands in order to form

name: Fighting Words
overview: use your words to fight
description: Any combat-related word that you use (like punch, kick, jump, etc.) will affect your foe in the way that you speak ('kicked' people will feel as though they were kicked, etc.); this is awesome, but can also be a downer; you can't control it, or turn it off or on; so you are stuck with it for life. ANY combat word you say will affect people (unless you direct it at a certain person, it'll affect everyone in radius).
pros: Doesnt take a lot of energy
Only have to say words
Good to have big mouth
cons: If you go hoarse it doesnt work
Cant turn it off
Doesn't work if you cant pronounce the word

name: Hacker's Touch
overview: have the Hacker's Touch.
description: Hackers are people who are extremely curious, sneaking into people's lives and learning everything they can, but they never use this information to their advantage. You have the Hacker's Touch. Whenever you touch someone with your bare hands (only works with your hands), you can learn everything about them besides their future. The limitation is, if you use this to your advantage, you will lose the ability and the information. However, you can use this ability to help the person you learn about.
pros: Learn things easily.
Satisfy curiosity.
Can help others.
cons: Can't take advantage of the information.
Have to wear gloves to avoid accidental contact.

name: Sacrificial Superiority
overview: enhance your speed, strength, and dexterity at the cost of physical strain
description: At will the user's speed, strength, and dexterity multiply. It can be done only a little (x2) or a lot (x10). However much the user powers up, though, is the level of strain on their bodies. Unless they are very seasoned in this ability then the higher levels, such as x10 or higher, can kill them if they use it for too long. The most famous user of this ability was none other than King Arthur, who, according to legend, once successfully used x20 in combat.
pros: The user's overall performance can multiply well beyond normal measures.
cons: A strain on the body; lower levels barely wind the user, though higher levels may cause injury.

name: Non Fractal Invulnerability
overview: be immune to any non-fractal kinetic damage.
description: Kinetic damage from non-fractal matter has no effect on you.
pros: Nigh invulnerability to most kinetic attacks.
cons: Fractal damage could still cut you to ribbons.

name: Human Hurricane
overview: create a potent orbital field of varying size and rotational speed around the user
description: This power requires a great deal of focus and energy to be used. When activated, a gravitation field surrounds the user, the radius of which is adjustable. Any objects pulled into the field will begin to spin around the user while remaining a set distance away. It takes more focus to rotate the objects faster, and even the best of users would only be able to maintain the field for about a minute before collapsing. Once the field is down, all objects will keep their speed, and are sent flying.
pros: Can easily destroy just about any interior locations.
With very precise focus, different objects can be rotated at different speeds within the field.
While in use, the user is protected by a kinetic barrier a few inches from their body.
cons: Takes a lot of energy to use.
User becomes very drained for a time after use (about ten times the total time the power is active).
Limited functionality.

name: Double Helix
overview: take one or two elements and create a a rotating double helix with them
description: The elements can be from the periodic table (oxygen, helium, hydrogen, plutonium, etc) and/or the traditional elements (fire, water, wind, ice, etc). The elements can be changed as needed. Either way, they will rotate around like a double helix. Radius for the helix is half a metre.
pros: The two elements can also be used to augment other powers.
Ex: Oxygen can make fires larger.
cons: Some might think it looks weird.

name: Blade Edge Rotating
overview: cause the edge of a blade to spin like a chainsaw
description: The result of rotating the edge of the blade is that it can cut through objects more easily than a normal blade. A side effect is that the rotating edge also gains molecular teeth like what is on a saw. The rotation goes around the sharp edge then before it reaches the hilt at the handguard it completes the circuit so that no molecules or atoms are lost from the blade.
pros: Makes it several times easier to cut through things.
cons: Noone can see or hear anything different so it appears as if nothing is happening until you cut.

name: Delta Darts
overview: fire darts at a speed of light to your foes.
description: You can throw darts that are charged with powder blue energy at your opponent that'll leave them temporarily paralyzed.
pros: Can even humiliate and/or beat your foe while they are stunned.
cons: Won't work when they have their force fields or armor on.

name: Continue
overview: cause things to continue through this power.
description: This power requires something to happen first, but once it has it can be continued. Submisiveness or ignorance broadcasted over video can be continued. Other "Continues" are damage, healing, change, replication. You can continue a state of something, emotions, thoughts, actions, and forces such as change, damage and traumas
pros: Prolong an existing effect.
Creative people love this.
Continue pumpkin pie for years or damage for hours.
cons: Self protection & reality changing powers (Unbendable will, Power of Imagination) break Continues.
Cons can't be negated
The harder Continues are, the shorter it can be continued

name: Syringe Manifestation
overview: create syringes filled with magical reality-bending viruses.
description: With this ability, you can materialize a syringe filled with a virus. The virus responds to your will and can be easily programmed to cause any effect simply by thinking it. Once injected into a person, the effect begins to take place in the time designated by how you imagined it. Any physical effect can be caused by the virus, including but not limited to illness/curing cancer/transformation/brain washing. The effects do not wear off and are not affected by immune systems.
pros: Control people's bodies entirely through injections.
Cure cancer.
Use it on yourself to give yourself physical-based superpowers like super strength.
cons: Once the virus manifests itself for one use, the needle can be used against you.
Once injected, you will have to administer another dose if you wish to change the transformation.
Some transformations may turn out wrong and you may be overcome with guilt.

name: Emotional Ego Trip
overview: possess different powers and personalities inspired by your emotions.
description: With the power of each personality, you could control different powers with vast emotions. However, due to your multiple personalities and potential, you can possess different powers and some of your abilites and personalities are as follows: fiery rage - zorn, cold cruelty - gene fezirk, waterly joy - acre, electric awe - tonnerre, god mode - victory, psychic lust - adan, optimismistic terrakinesis - manearth, envious toxics - eve, and enthrallment of light and dark - libra.
pros: Your enemies will get confused.
cons: It can only last up to 144 hours.
Your condition will grow bad to worse when you grow older.

name: Alphabetical Name Based Powers
overview: get the superpower that's alphabetically closest to your name on the superpowerlist.com
description: If you had this power, and went to the superpowerlist.com, and clicked the "explore" button, and clicked "A-Z", and found the superpower that's alphabetically closest to your name, then you would have thet power. For example, my name is "Niko", so I would get "Nightmare Manipulator" because that's the closest superpower to my name alphabetically.
pros: Might get an awesome power
cons: Might get a stupid power

name: Measure Control
overview: when you hold a measuring tool, control what it measures
description: If you were to hold a clock then you can control time. Holding a thermometer gives you control of hot and cold and a ruler the ability to control size.
pros: You can control many types of measurements
cons: You must hold measuring tools

name: Soulerite (Diamond Metal)
overview: create and control a metal that has the hardness of diamond
description: Pure Soulerite is as hard as diamond and also boosts the power of soul-based powers. Alloys that are at least 50% Soulerite have the hardness and the effectiveness of the boost is at least one-fourth that of pure Soulerite. In an alloy with less than 50% Soulerite, the alloy will retain the hardness but lose the boost to soul-based powers. If the percentage of Soulerite becomes less than 40% though the alloy's toughness will start to drop fast.
pros: Soulerite is really hard to break and can be turned into weapons.
cons: Making alloys of Soulerite can be ineffective.
10% Soulerite in an alloy is not much better than steel.

name: Alien Language Translator
overview: translate any alien language
description: With this power you can translate any alien language. This is useful is you're trying to talk to aliens in order to make peace or just to make conversation.
pros: You can talk to any aliens
cons: Only works with aliens you don't necessarily know all the languages of your planet
Doesn't work with animals

name: Lateral Line System
overview: detect movement and vibrations in the water
description: Similar to the lateral organs possessed by most fish and some amphibians, this adaptation is a must for all aquatic beings.  Being able to detect the movement and vibrations of the water around you allows you to orientate yourself in relation to water currents, avoid collisions, detect predators and prey (or the positions of friend or foes), and, if applicable, assist in schooling behavior.
pros: Detect approaching foes (or prankish friends) trying to surprise you in the water
Avoid bumping into things while swimming. Especially helpful in the dark.
Orient and position yourself in a group in the water
cons: Only effective in the water (or other liquid environments). Useless in the air.

name: Life Unmaking
overview: turn the living or once living into inert matter.
description: This power lets turn a man into a puddle of mostly water. Victims can be solid,liquid,gas or energy. Turn a man of living rock into a lifeless statue. Use this power on someone made of fire and he'll become a blazing camp fire. An air elemental will disperse into the atmosphere. Any solid (un)dead will crumble to dust. Ghosts will break apart into ectoplasm. The only ways to undo this power are through time reversal or reality alteration. You only need to think to use this power.
pros: Deal with living,dead or undead foes.
All you do is think to this power.
Only reversed with time or reality powers.
cons: This power won't on anything that was never fully alive.
Someone with immutability or fixed form.

name: Plant Speak
overview: communicate with plants.
description: You can communicate with plants with this powers. That includes bushes, trees etc. You can find out what happened somewhere of which only the plants were witness.
pros: Talk to plants.
cons: They might talk too much and affect your sanity

name: The Perfect Werewolf
overview: be the perfect version of a werewolf.
description:
You transform into a werewolf at night but you can use some of your abilities as a human. 

- As a human: Strength, Speed, Senses, Agility, Faster Healing, Sensing Danger
- As a werewolf: Strength, Speed, Senses, Agility, Faster Healing, Claws, Fangs, Sensing Danger, Resistance to Injury

Since you have the body of an animal, pretty much anything can kill you, but it takes a while for someone to do so because of your resistance to injury
pros: Can turn into a werewolf on any night (not just a full moon).
cons: Anything can kill you (swords, guns, etc. ).

name: Breakdown
overview: break down organic material
description: When touching organic material with skin-to-skin contact, the area being touched will start to break down on the cellular level, eventually turning the object or area into a puddle of ooze. Contact must be maintained the entire time. It only affects the area being touched extending out at all angles within a six-inch radius. The ability is always on, and the user is not immune to their own abilities. If applied to a normal human at the shoulder, the arm would break down and drop off in 2 min.
pros: Breakdown starts on contact
Most wounds are fatal if contact is maintained
Can cause aggravated damage
cons: Must maintain skin-to-skin contact to work
Can damage yourself
Hands must always have some kind of synthetic covering on them

name: Mediumism (Mediumship)
overview: perceive, communicate with and channel spirits of the dead
description: Also called Spirit Channeling, one with this ability (called a medium) has a fine tuned connection to the spirit world. They can see and sense the spirits of the deceased, understand their speech, communicate with them (regardless of language barriers) and even channel them into one's body; channeling spirits allows them to express themselves through the user, including speaking/writing, as well as using any superhuman powers they may have had in life (this is called Mediumistic Automatism)
pros: Perceive, and communicate with the spirits of the deceased (and perhaps other spirits over time)
Channel spirits of the dead (give them a chance to communicate with loved ones)
Allow them to work through you, to use any superpowers they may have had in life
cons: Does not prevent the possibility of being possessed
Does not ensure a spirit you channel is a good one (once they take control, they leave on their own)
Does not let you compel spirits (only perceive, communicate with and channel them)

name: Stupify
overview: make people babble, mutter or stumble over their own words, on command and for any duration.
description: With this power, you hold the ultimate trump card in any social situation. With the blink of an eye, you can reduce any person to a bumbling, mumbling, stuttering fool for any duration. You must be within a 1 mile radius and either see or hear your target. Great applications of this power include: speeding tickets, classrooms, arguments, courtrooms, presidential speeches, karaoke night, first dates, job interviews, and of course, reading a nuclear bomb deactivation code.
pros: Trump card in any social situation
Stop arguments in their tracks
You're the ultimate smooth operator when everyone around you is stuttering and mumbling
cons: Can't exactly use this to defend yourself in a physical altercation
Your stuttering, mumbling targets will be pretty annoying
Sometimes it's better to just give them a good old fashioned biotch slap

name: Ability Linking
overview: link together two or more of one's own superpowers.
description: The powers are not fused together. They are just "tied" together, so if one is copied, stolen, cancelled, removed or deleted, the other will be as well. You can only link your own powers together, including those which didn't originally belong to you. Curses can also be linked with another curse or ability. Objects with abilities cannot be, except if they are part of an ability the user has, like the ability to own or summon the object. If a power is immune to an effect, the other will be too.
pros: Link a curse to one of your superpowers and tempt someone else into stealing or copying it.
Link Ability Cancellation or Superpower Dispersal to a superpower someone wants to steal from you.
Positive effects are shared too, such as power augmentation.
cons: You need to come up with a good strategy if you want to make this power useful.
The superpowers are not fused together and can still be used separately.

name: Calorie Burn
overview: turn fat and calories into manipulatable energy.
description: This ability allows the hero to convert his fat and immediate energy into energy. This can be used to warm object, it can be fired, it can be thrown, it can form a force field, or it can explode from ones body. The power makes you body convert energy and nutrients more efficient so you can go without food for days if you don't fire the energy to much.
pros: Maintain excellent body shape.
Improved overall body function.
Energy attacks.
cons: You have to eat pretty constantly if you plan on a lot of energy discharge.
Keep candy with you on missions.
If you use too much energy you risk losing conciousness.

name: Gasoline Alchemy
overview: change a liquid into gasoline.
description: Change water, beverages and any other liquid into gasoline.
pros: Never go to the gas station.
cons: You need to put some kind of liquid in your car and change that into gas.

name: Artifact Mastery
overview: use the ancient mystical artifacts that are stored in Warehouse 13
description: The person with this power is able to use majority if not all the artifacts in Warehouse 13. The only exception are the artifacts in the Dark Vault. Besides that, the person with this power is able to transport the artifact he or she want to their position. The person who has this power also has a psychic link to the warehouse, making them know exactly what is it in the warehouse
pros: Huge assortment of artifacts for different situation
Easily defeat enemies due to huge array of artifacts
cons: Great concentration is needed to summon the artifacts from long distances
Concentration is needed if the user wants to summon multiple artifacts at one go
If the user is knocked unconscious, the artifacts can be stolen

name: Pharmacy!
overview: make any medication appear in your hands.
description: Have you ever had a problem where the insurance doesn't cover medication cost? Worry no more! With this power, you can make any medicine appear instantly! Limited to three types of medication at a time. Side effects may include hypervigillance and paranoia. These side effects are only temporary. Talk to see if pharmacy is right for you.
pros: Make medicine appear in your hands.
Side effects are temporary.
Can't summon medicine that makes you high.
cons: You will be hypervigillant.
You'll have paranoia.
Can't summon medicine that makes you high.

name: Amber Breath
overview: breath out a gas that quickly coalesces into amber
description: With this ability you will be able to exhale a cloud of gas that activates with the air to form an amber like substance to trap your enemies in. Anyone trapped in the amber remain in a state of suspended animation until they are freed. The gas has a delayed activation so you don't have amber form in your esophagus.
pros: Trap enemies
Victims remain alive (good if you're a hero)
Gas has delayed activation to prevent suffacation
cons: Gas does not travel very far
Victims remain alive (bad if you're evil)
Hard to control

name: Nth Metal
overview: create Nth metal
description: Nth metal is one of the magical metals. Nth metal appears very similar to gold but is infinitely more valuable. That means it can be manipulated through thought-waves. So after creating it you can will it into armor, weapons, cloths with enth thread,or almost anything else you can imagine. You can fly with Nth metal boots. Also it can absorb magical energy. The metal will only respond to its owner so unless you give or sell it the metal will only serve you.
pros: You can create one of the magical metals
The metal is nearly indestructable and extremely valuable
You can move and reshape it with your will
cons: Creating Nth metal is very hard and tiring
It can only absorb magical energy not expel it
You can't create the other magical metals

name: Power Backup Ability
overview: make copies of your own powers so you can't lose them.
description: If you have this power, every 24 hours this power will make a backup of itself and any other powers you have. These backups will remain dormant until you permanently lose a power through some sort of power negation or some sort of power theft. As soon as that happens, a dormant backup will awaken and your lost power will be restored. Dormant backups are undetectable and can't be stolen or negated or altered due to an active version working.
pros: No fear of power thieves or power nullifying if you plan things right.
It works with any number of powers.
cons: It takes time to build up a good number of backups.
This power can be altered or controlled without triggering a backup to awaken.
Power thieves and power nullifiers will join together to get you.

name: Quick Bridge
overview: make a bridge appear over any gap
description: With this power whenever there is a gap that you can't cross (or you can cross it doesn't really make a difference) you can make a bridge appear that is the exact length of the bridge and that is strong enough to hold any amount of people/vehicles/animals/other stuff. After you and your party cross the bridge you can make it disappear again.
pros: You can make bridges appear
The bridges can hold an infinite amount
You can make the bridges disappear when you're done
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Pyrokenesis Limited
overview: create small amounts of fire
description: Instantly lighting candles can be done with the snap of your fingers, but you cannot control fires larger than a radius of 26 feet.
pros: Ability to start fires instantly
Control small fire sources
cons: Cannot control large amounts of fire such as a forest fire

name: Biome
overview: create a Biome sphere that changes the ecosystem within.
description: With this power you can create a sphere of any size that changes the ecosystem within to match a Biome of your choosing. You can change the area to that of a tundra, desert, rain forest, etc. The change is instant and all Earth plants and animals except humans get changed to match the Biome you create. Masters of this power could create a sphere in space that creates a planet with Earth plants and animals inside of it based on a Biome.
pros: Change your area to the Biome of your choosing.
Make your enemies live in artic or desert areas.
Create planets at master level.
cons: Permanent unless you create a different Biome to replace to existing Biome.
Limited to the size of sphere you are able to create.
Does not give any sort of weather control after sphere is made.

name: Magic Immunity
overview: not be affected by magic, in any manifestation
description: One with this ability has a natural capability to resist and shake off all magical effects; this means that no magic can affect you at all. Magic energy directed at you will bounce off of you; magic items will malfunction; magic bindings and magic traps will be treated as intangible around the user, and he can simply walk through them. Magic cannot be directly used on the user in any way, shape, form or fashion
pros: No magical attacks, entrapment, banishment or curses/hexes/jinxes
No being altered magically
Makes the battle an even playing field when up against mages
cons: Mages REALLY don't like you
Can't be magically ENHANCED either
Can't be magically HELPED OUT either

name: Social Theft
overview: steal emotions, thoughts, memories and dreams
description: Stealing all information about someone just by touching them. All of their thoughts will forever are locked inside your mind. You can take away emotions too
pros: Learn what people think about you
Know when someone lies
Learn all about someone just by touching them
cons: If you store to many memories, you might forget things
Other people are aware when their thoughts are being stolen
Stealing to many emotions or whatever can cause brain damage.

name: Zone Zero
overview: send someone to another dimension.
description:
Do you have enemies who are just a pain in the behind? 
Immortal, overpowered or just really annoying? 
Well we, the employees of Diviousness. Inc have developed the Zone Zero Power. 
As soon as the threat is in your sight just clap your hands and wamm bamm they have been relocated into Zone Zero, a soothing place filled with nothing but air.
pros: Nobody is safe from your almighty hands.
You don't kill someone so your karma isn't harmed.
It never fails, as long as you clap your hands.
cons: Useless for people who lack hands.
Enemies who are able to teleport are still able to return.
If someone glues your hands to a rock or something else you are left defenceless.

name: Odd Evening
overview: make all outcomes of an event equally likely to occur
description: Not only does this ability allow you to compute probability to a certain degree, it gives you some power over it. If you fall from a great height and there is a chance that you will live, no matter how small, you can even the chances between life and death, making it 50/50. Further probabilities, such as breaking bones vs. not breaking bones, require further concentration. You can seriously improve your chances in any situation, but it will always come down to a toss-up.
pros: Can even all possible outcomes instantly
Can even influence people's thoughts by evening their likelihood to make a certain decision
Make bullets more likely to misfire
cons: No guarantees that it will work in your favor
Some outcomes must be broken down further

name: Thunder Clapper
overview: make thunder by clapping
description: With this power you can make deafening thunder whenever you clap your hands. You cannot turn this power off so it happens every time you clap your hands. The thunder can be heard by everybody in a hundred mile radius.
pros: You can cause deafening thunder to sound whenever you clap your hands
The thunder can be heard by everybody in a hundred mile radius
cons: You cannot turn this power off
If you don't have hands this power is useless

name: Fingerprint Database
overview: know the owner of a fingerprint when you see one
description: With this power, you are a human fingerprint database. Whenever you see a fingerprint, you will instantly know who it belongs to, and you can even sketch a copy of any person's fingerprint.
pros: You are a walking, talking fingerprint database.
You can sketch exact copies of human fingerprints.
cons: Not much use in physical combat.

name: Goldworks: Army Of Gold
overview: wield the Crown of the Golden Dead
description: Long ago, there was a ancient civilization whose name was lost to time. They had knowledge & technology far beyond other empires. After 700 years of peace, that civilization was torn apart by a civil war that killed hundreds of thousands of citizens. In the end, the emperor used what was left of their technology to create a golden crown. This crown had the incredible power to control the skeletons of the falling citizens, which had also turned to gold. The skeletons are under the wielder's power
pros: Controlling an army of golden undying skeletons with a golden crown.
When you need them, the skeletons will rise from the ground to help and serve you
The skeletons can repair themselves when needed
cons: The crown can be lost and used by others.
The skeletons are no stronger or faster than other beings

name: Siren's Signal
overview: call any person to your location by emmiting a sound only they can hear
description: This ability allows you to emit a sound that can only be heard by a person of your choosing. This sound sounds like a siren song and calls the person to your location. No matter where in the world the person is, they will be inexplicably drawn to you.
pros: Find anyone world-wide
cons: Might take awhile for the person to reach you
Might take a dangerous route to reach you
Doesn't hypnotize people, just attracts them

name: Past Revival.
overview: reincarnate in the past.
description: With this power you will reincarnate in the past anytime that you die. You will reincarnate a certain number of days in the past that is equal to the number of days that you lived. You would be born to a random family that is having a baby at that time. You keep your same appearance even if the family you are born too has a different appearance. Upon turning five all your memories come back from your future lives. You could meet yourself if you lived longer than previous life.
pros: Can live major moments in history.
Could change the future since you know future events.
Wont die until you get back to the time of the first humans.
cons: Everyone you know would eventually not be born yet.
Most modern day things would not be invented yet if you go back far enough.
You wont have your memories first five years of life, if thats a problem.

name: Crown Of Ice
overview: have an ice crown that allows you to shoot ice beams out of your head and control snow animals
description: With this power you can summon a crown made out of ice and it will apear on your head. Though it is made out of ice your head will not become cold from it. Embedded in the crown is a large blue jewel that can either shoot beams of ice that can freeze people or objects or shoot super sharp icicles that can impale people. The crown also allows you to control snow animals such as yetis, polar bears, snow owls etc. When you're done with it you can just unsummon by taking it off your head.
pros: You have an ice crown that shoot ice beams/icicles and controls snow animals
If anybody ever tries to steal it by removing it from your head it disappears
It doesn't cause your head to become cold
cons: It's not very fashionable

name: Stimuli Inducement
overview: inflict different stimuli towards anything.
description: Heat, Gravity, smells, etc. The user can induce the feelings of any stimulus towards anyone or anything. If a stimulus that is external like a reaction to fire is induced to a victim, the victim will be engulf by that stimulus spontaneously.
pros: Make feel any kind of stimulus: external or internal.
External stimuli will result in exposure to actual stimuli.
cons: Can be very dangerous.

name: Peace Manipulation
overview: manipulate the level of peace between one or more people.
description: With this power, you can be the ultimate peace keeper or peace breaker. You can alter how one person or group of people feels about another person or group of people with no restrictions on group size. If you strive for world peace, you can have it. If you're a psycho and strive for world destruction, well, go for it you crazy bastard. One restriction--you can only use this power once every 24 hours, so choose your sides wisely. Works great when you need a good cat fight to cheer you up!
pros: Pit the world against your greatest enemies
You can implant motivations for being on your side
The ultimate war: Bitches vs. hoes
cons: One use per day
A world of peace might be boring and predictable
If the hoes lose the war, all you have left are bitches  :(

name: Rebirth
overview: be reborn into a new body any time after the age of 13.
description: With this ability you can start life over anytime in a new body & family. On 2 conditions: you can't use the power before the age of 13 & your body turns to ash as your soul remains in the state he is until a new baby body is available. Also, you keep memories of your ancient life and that you have the power. On your 13th birthday, you will receive a notebook reminding you fully of your old life and the reason you used the power.
pros: Can start life over
Practically immortal
cons: You can possibly wait a long time before your rebirth
Can't use your power before the age of 13
Sudden memory of past life can cause trauma and nightmares

name: Super Mario
overview: have all the abilities that mario and bros. Would have
description: With this power you will be able to fly,become invisible,become pure steel,phase through objects,run on water,become faster,be abnormally strong for size,jump incredibly high for size,intense acrobatic skills,be smarter than you would normally be,be good at sports,and have a chick with tons of money :D
pros: Amazing range of different powers
Be incredibly good at almost anything
cons: You have to save your girl like alot

name: Eternal Nourishment
overview: never go hungry or thirsty.
description: With this ability you will never be hungry or thirsty again.  You will always feel satisfied (not full).  If you want to feel full, you still have the option of eating something. Also, you will always have the perfect level of nutrients, fats, carbs, etc. in your diet.  So, if you start working out, your protein levels will automatically increase. As a result, your health will probably be top notch. Eating foods that are unhealthy, like the glorious twinkie, is still bad.
pros: Never have to pay for food again
Have a perfect food intake as long as you don't eat junk food
Never feel hungry
cons: Never have the satisfaction of quenching thirst of relieving hunger
You might not enjoy food as much
You might start eating more junk food

name: Magma Current
overview: send a wave of lava along the ground.
description: With this power you are capable of sending waves of magma across the ground at your opponents. Regardless of how strong you are the waves only go as far as you raise them.
pros: Very easy to clear away your opponents.
cons: Doesn't mix well with water because lava and water mix into stone.

name: Dance Of The Dead Marionette
overview: control the actions of others.
description: Ability to control the actions of others. Can force others to use their superpower. Can control the whole body. The body (part) of a live target will start to die if spell left on for longer then 1 minute. Complete death of a live target in 5 min.
pros: Works incredibly well on undead/dead.
Allows for full control.
Can control just body parts if you want (ex. Only an arm)
cons: The body (part) of a live target will start to die if spell left on for longer then 1 minute.
Complete death of a live target in 5 min.

name: Soul Exchange
overview: make soul-exchanges
description: This is a slighty dark power, but ultimatly not an evil one. It allows the user to give someone almost anything they want, in exchange for their soul. After they die, they will become your servant for as long as you have their soul. So, if they died a year after you made the deal, then they must serve you for a year after they die. You will have total power over them, even controlling their shape. After their service is paid, they will go on to the afterlife.
pros: Granting the wishes of many people, for a fair price.
This power won't affect the target's judgement in the afterlife.
cons: It seems like an unholy power
Contact is necessary to make the deal

name: Organic Deconstruction
overview: break down living things
description: One can reduce living cells into nothing, and when developed can, in theory, destroy a person, people or any living things. Eventually, and with the will, one can develop the ability to raze entire areas of everything living. If the individual had an emotional bond with someone, had touched them or had a good look at them, then he/she could break them down if they were, for example in a mile range depending on that persons strength. Emotions can effect the strength and range of this ability too.
pros: Can potentially destroy numerous dangerous people or animals in an instant
Useful in war and law enforcement
Practically invulnerable
cons: Vulnerable while sleeping or unconscious
Would have committed a sin and a crime, and would become an enemy of your country
Will and state of mind affects range and power, could be taken down with long range gunshot

name: Magic Tricks
overview: gain powers through magic tricks
description: Stage magic and true magic are two different things. This is the bridge between the two. After creating a magic trick, and performing  it successfully, the user will be able to do it for real. Let's say you figure out how to make objects vanish and reappear. After you perform it, you will be able to make objects vanish and appear at will. You must create the trick yourself for this power to kick in.
pros: Gain great powers of deception
Become one of the greatest performers of all time
cons: Must create the trick for this to work.
Must perform the trick successfully (without anyone seeing how you did it)

name: Vampirism: Neuronal
overview: gain sustenance and power from the nerve impulses of others
description: Also called Neuronal Absorption, this is the ability to absorb the nerve impulses of others and convert it into sustenance and physical power; this may be used to facilitate an increase in speed, reflexes, agility, dexterity and cognition (anything requiring neuron activity). This absorption of neuron impulses leaves the foe temporarily paralyzed.
pros: Take away the neuron impulses of foes, leaving them paralyzed in the process
Taking their nerve impulses also heightens your own nerve firing (speed, reflexes, agility, etc. )
Foes with Superhuman Speed, Superhuman Reflexes, Superhuman Agility, etc,
cons: The paralysis is sometimes permanent
Sometimes it requires an actual bite like a true vampire
If you can't control it, family and friends won't want to be around you

name: Stackable Abilities
overview: increase power and control of any existing ability when you gain a similar ability
description: Let's say that you have 2 powers that both give you the side-effect of superstrength. Now you may think that will be useless but with this power it will not be. Now any power that you gain that is similar to an existing power will increase the power and efficiency of both powers and any power related. This power can not be negated or tampered with.
pros: Stack all your speed and strength and durability powers to have better power and control
This power can not be negated or tampered with---but your other powers can
Any ability that overlaps with another will increase the overall effectiveness of all connected
cons: Need to have similar abilities first

name: Collective Noun Morph
overview: literally become a collective noun for anything alive or that can move itself.
description: You can become a warfare of hydra,a culture of bacteria,a swarm of nanites,a skynet of cyborgs or a nucleus of physicists. Any collective noun form that exist in a book or on website. When reduced to your last body,you revert to normal,and can't use that lost form for a day. Your collective noun form is average size. Any skills given by it are good but not the best. Some forms aren't allowed. Con negation won't let you use those forms.
pros: There are collective nouns to give you mythic,undead,jedi,angelic or other kinds of powers.
You can add your own collective nouns to a website or self-publish a book.
Collective forms can give you new skills
cons: You revert to normal if reduced to one body,and can't use that particular form for a day.

name: Empathy: Emotional Resonance
overview: completely understand others and be understood by them.
description: Words and even actions are an inadequate ways to express oneself.  Now, you simply can have your thoughts, feelings, emotions, motivations, and values conveyed perfectly by simply willing it.  You also will automatically understand other's thought and emotions perfectly. There will be no doubts about intentions, good or bad.
pros: You will likely grow to be a very emotionally mature person.
Most relationships may become stronger than ever!
Less worry over what was said or done.
cons: No matter how hard, you will simply have to grow up.
Some relationships you enjoyed may reveal themselves to be a facade.
You may know what should be done or said even when you can't actually do or say it.

name: Living Insect Repellant
overview: repel all insects (even supersized ones).
description: With this ability, you can repel all insects (even if they're supersized). You repel blood sucking insects especially well. Insects hate the way you smell, but no human or animal can perceive the smell. You can repel fleas. You can not repel arachnids or leeches unless you practice a lot. Mosquitos will stay away from you.
pros: You can repel all insects, even supersized ones.
You don't smell any different to people or animals.
You will never have an insect bite again.
cons: Might take decades of practice before you repel arachnids and/or leeches.

name: Mental Destitution
overview: cancel out thought or higher thought and some of it's products.
description: This power(also called mental destruction or mental degrading)is the ability to damage or cancel the higher thought processes of others. Simply put it allows the user to render an opponent incapable of any higher thought causing unconsciousness or worse. As a side effect the user can also stop mental abilities(telepathy, telekinesis,etc) from affecting them due to their usual requirement of high mental power. The user can project this effect in fields or by their sheer presence.
pros: Can easily incapacitate foes AND stop their offensive telepathy or telekinesis.
You can do this in varying degrees(disorientation,delusion,incompetence,death).
You are immune to the effects of this power.
cons: Enemies such as golems or robots.
The effects are never permanent.
Foes who possess backlash powers.

name: Quartz Portal
overview: use quartz crystal as a portal linked to any other piece of quartz
description: This ability allows you to use any piece of quartz as a portal to any other piece of quartz. You can travel through these portals or use them to spy on an area. The size of the quartz does not matter.
pros: Size of quartz doesn't matter
Teleport to any other piece of quartz
cons: Quartz must be in the location you want to travel to.

name: Touch & Go
overview: obtain the maximum speed that a vehicle can travel at by touching that said vehicle.
description: The user once he or she has touched a vehicle of his or her choice is able to travel at the maximum speed that vehicle can travel at. However, this power is only applicable to be used on land vehicles such like cars, motorcycles, trucks and trains. The user is able to start out at the vehicles' maximum speed, after time the speed will start to decrease depending on use.
pros: Cars are ever present in cities
Can move really fast
Cant be hit easily and can easily hit people
cons: No cars in jungles or desserts if power wears out and need to acquire new speed
Cant fly

name: Singing Perfection
overview: have a perfect singing voice
description: An individual with this ability has a perfect, beautiful, & unbelievable singing voice.
pros: Fame
Fortune
Admiration
cons: Fans Constantly Chasing you
Paparazzi

name: Tattoo Power Seal
overview: seal a person's powers within your own body upon touch by turning it into a tattoo
description: A person with this power can seal another superhuman's power upon touch by absorbing it into their body. This process creates a tattoo on their body that represents the sealed power. The touching part means either touching the person using the power or having the power come in contact with your skin. Once one of these conditions is satisfied, the user can then take away that power and turn it into a tattoo on their body. The user can also give back the power thus causing the tattoo to disappear.
pros: Combined with Tattoo Power, this means power stealing
As a bonus, this comes with power negation--if the power is directly used on the user
Can also give back powers to original owners
cons: Will be heavily tattooed if you use this too much
If the other person's power is so powerful that the tatoo can't fit on your body

name: Ninja Spawn
overview: spawn ninjas
description: With this power you can spawn an infinite amount of ninjas and they're all completely under your control
pros: You have an army of ninjas under your control
cons: Ninjas aren't the strongest people in the world and can be killed by powerful enemies

name: Delete This A Infinity Turbine
overview: charge your fists with cosmic energy while flying spinning towards your opponent.
description: You can use it to escape situations by charging your fists connected with cosmic power, surrounding yourself with an aura, while flying spinning towards your opponents to send them flying. You can also spin in place and suck in nearby enemies and/or projectiles. Opponents are thrown to the opposite side of the M. I. T. , while projectiles are neutralized.
pros: Can do a great deal of damage.
Fly through projectiles.
cons: None.

name: Remnant Affliction
overview: cause previous injuries to resurface in one's presence
description: Also called Residual Affliction or Recurring Affliction is the responsiveness of an injury to the presence of the inflictor of said injury. Simply put, whenever one goes near a foe, whatever injury the user has caused to that particular foe (physical or psychological) will either resurface entirely, re-bruising and re-scratching up foes, or the area where the subject was wounded will begin hurting again; psychological damage will arise again.
pros: The more you hurt them one time, the more they hurt next time
You will never leave your enemies' memories
You always get the advantage in a fight (wounds heal at a normal rate, even with a healing factor)
cons: May also work on loved ones
Injuries (sometimes) must have been induced by the user
Makes befriending a former enemy very hard

name: Epic Absorbsion
overview: absorb "Eparticals"
description: "Eparticals" or epic particals are the substance that makes things epic. You will have the ability to absorb these particals from people or things. The more eparticals you have the more epic your actions become. Turn a punch in to a "EPIC PAWNCH". Or a kick into a "EPIC KICKUH". Bewarned if you absorb eparticals from people they will become less epic. Or if you absorb too many eparticals you will turn into Chuck norris (wait i dont think thats bad).
pros: Become more epic
Make a epic PAWNCH
Become chuck norris
cons: If you dont like becoming chuck norris

name: Nuclear Reaction
overview: create nuclear explosion, by splitting the atom with your mind,
description: With this ability you can create nuclear explosions and reactions, by having the mental capacity to split any atom with your mind. Once an atom is split a nuclear explosion happens. Also atoms are everywhere in all matter.
