pros: Create nuclear explosions anywhere.
Your nuclear explosions won't harm you in any way.
cons: Effect of nuclear explosion is devastating long-term.

name: Money Tree V2
overview: make a tree that produces more money
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time and it grows one thousand dollars (or the equivalent of one thousand US dollars depending on where you are) a day in five dollar bills (or the equivalent). If the money tree gets destroyed or you destroy it, you can create a new one somewhere else.
pros: You can cause a money tree to sprout out of the ground
You can get up to one thousand dollars a day
cons: You only get up to one thousand dollars a day
You can only have one tree at a time
People will always be trying to steal it from you

name: Ghost Force
overview: be able to attack a ghost as though it were solid and return them to normal form
description: This power let's you see ghosts and attack them. Instead of going through the ghost it is like a solid to you.  When in use the body glows a faint greenish-blue. Also allows you to turn a spectre or poltergeist back to visible form.
pros: You can attack ghosts as though normal solid creature
Allows you to turn poltergeists visible
Blocks most ghost powers that are sent as an attack at you
cons: Only applicable to ghosts

name: Unpredictable Time  Boost
overview: power up your body, mind, or spirit in different sets of time.
description: This ability, if you know the time when the boost will hit you, can be useful in almost any situation. The way this work is that it works for different people. When the ability boosts your body it will give you energy, and a boost of speed, strength, and agility. This ability boosts your mind's percentage by 50% and gives a basic telekinetic ability when the time comes. When the ability boosts your spiritual side, you'll be more at peace with yourself and able to dodge most hits.
pros: Very powerful.
Multiple ways to attack or defend yourself.
cons: You might get a different boost than the one you need.
Your boosts will come at different and unpredictable times.

name: Blessing Of Pan
overview: have the Blessing of Pan
description: Pan is the God of Wild Places. His blessing allows you to be one with the Wild, meaning you can control everything natural in nature. Rivers, trees, rocks, wind, if it's naturally there, you can control it. You cannot control animals; however, you can speak to them and they always love you. You can also use nature magic. It involves playing a certain tune on a wooden instrument for a certain effect. It could be almost anything, from finding a path to putting someone to sleep.
pros: Controlling nature
Speaking to animals, who always love you
Nature magic
cons: Losing your instrument
If you hurt nature, nature will hurt you back
Nature magic has its limits

name: Human Maraca
overview: make a sound similar to maracas when you shake your body.
description: It won't activate if you move your body in a normal way, unless it is natural for you to rapidly shake your body of parts of your body. So, just like a maraca, you will make similar shifting and shuffling sounds when you shake any part of your body. It can also activate when you halt fast movements of your body, because your body vibrates shortly before coming to a stop. Running also activates this power because your body is actually shaken up and down.
pros: If you forgot to bring your maracas.
It only activates if you shake your body, which you don't usually do if you need to be quiet.
cons: The sound just ruins the mood of oriental booty shakes. Seriously.
You need to analyze in which situations your body shakes. For example, shivering is a body shake.

name: Power Vampire
overview: become a power vampire.
description: With this power you become a power vampire. You can absorb the life force and energy of any living being gaining vampire like powers including superhuman strength, speed, staminia, durability, healing and senses, immortality, minor shapeshifting, flight, and any traditional vampire powers, abilities, and knowledge. The more life force you absorb the more you crave and eventual with constant absorbtion you will be unable to go without draining someone and go gradualy insane.
pros: Gain Vampire Powers
Gain minor control over the people you drain
Gain any powers, abilities, or knowledge the person had.
cons: The power weakens the victem(s) and can kill with repeated absorbtion(Bad for a hero)
May be hunted by vampire hunters
Draining the life force from sentiant beings(anything but plants) causing gradual insanity

name: Myth Power: Siren's Song
overview: channel the deadly seductive powers of the Sirens
description: The Sirens were known in Greek Myth as beautiful sea nymphs whose song lured many sailors to their death, crashing on the rocks of their island home. Channeling them gifts you with the same seductive power. You can entrance others of the opposite sex with your voice, and it has more than one effect. If you are up close, the subject will follow any command given. If you are far away, the subject will try to reach you at all costs to follow your orders. You can also communicate with/command birds.
pros: Entrance subjects of the opposite sex with an otherworldly singing voice
If they hear your voice close-up, they follow any command issued (whether you sing it or not)
If far away, your voice lures them to you (by safest or most dangerous route possible; you choose)
cons: People with MythPower: Aphrodisia or MythPower: Arrows of Eros are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Muse Influence are immune to this ability
You can also communicate with, control and share the senses of birds (may make you seem wimpy)

name: Souls
overview: control souls.
description: "Souls" is the ability to make dolls come to life and obey your every command (stage 1). Once the power advances, you are able to transfer your soul into any doll (stage 2). The next stage is that you are able to transfer your soul into someone else's body and when you get killed your soul will be set free so you can take control of a new body as your own (stage 3). You can have other people's souls go into other bodies (stage 4).
pros: Control dolls
Transfer your soul into dolls
Controlling someone
cons: Your energy is drained
You get tired when your doll is destroyed
You see all the dead souls

name: Thriller Dance
overview: compel zombies to do the Thriller dance
description: Everyone knows the iconic Thriller from Michael Jackson. With this power, you can compel zombies within a 60 feet radius and/or within your line of sight to do the Thriller dance. They automatically know the dance and so do you. They recognize you as the main dancer, if you opt to join in. Even works on zombies that are under somebosdy else's control, but does not workon superhumans that used a power to become a zombie.
pros: Thriller.
Dancing zombies.
Prevent from being eaten till help arrives
cons: When the dance has ended, you have to 5 minutes to use this power again.

name: Electrical Tentacles
overview: have tentacles that can electrocute what they touch
description: The tentacles will reach from the user's head to their ankles and can generate electrical energy. The amount of energy differs for each user differs. The tentacles are black and the user can control the movement at will. The user of this power is the only one immune to the electricity.
pros: The tentacles are part of your body.
cons: Entering water is not a good idea.

name: Precognitive Extrapolations
overview: non-psychically predict the future
description: Everyone extrapolates, They all think about what might happen. People with this power take it out to the far end. They can accurately predict what will happen minutes, hours, or even days into the future. However, this power requires vast amounts of information in order for you to make accurate predictions, its also burns alot of energy limiting the number of predictions you can make. The farther the prediction is into the future the less accurate it gets, and the more energy it burns.
pros: Lets you "see" the future
Is not a psychic talent, and is unaffected by powers that mess with psychics
You can choose what to extrapolate about.
cons: Requires TONS of information
Burns alot of energy
Less accurate the farther it goes into the future

name: Living Powers
overview: have your other powers come alive.
description: With this power you cause all of your other powers to come alive and gain a spirit body and personality. The personalities will always have your same goals. The living powers can even teach you how to use the powers better. You can even let a living power take over your body so that it can use the power to its fullest. If the power is negated it will appear as if the spirit is repelled from your body. When the spirit returns so does your power. Affected by all power affecting powers.
pros: The Spirits can aid you to use your powers more effectively.
Mimicry mimics the spirits also but the spirit remains loyal to you.
The spirits can be suppressed when not needed.
cons: Does not work on this power.
You may not like the personality of your power.
Having many powers will cause them all to come alive.

name: Touch Of Pain
overview: poke/touch/push/etc someone anywhere - even internally.
description: This sounds lame at first, but you can poke the exact place in the brain that kills.  You can temporarily stop people's hearts.  You can cause headaches, or pains anywhere.
pros: You can cause pain anywhere in your oponent.
You can kill your oponent instantly.
You can neutralise your oponent.
cons: One poke per person per day.
More than one poke and the energy drain is too much.

name: Sp: Defensive Presence
overview: give people around you more defense, and in return you gain the amount of defense given.
description: SP stands for 'Sharing Presence'. With this ability, people in your area are given extra defense against all forms of harm. (Physical, mental, etc. ) In return, you gain the amount of defense given to people by this bonus. For example, if 5 people are in you're area, they gain defense, and you gain their totalled defense. Can be turned off.
pros: Extremely helpful in fights of all sorts.
Can be turned off.
cons: You may occasionally forget to turn this ability off.

name: Ability Skill: Mimicry Wisdom
overview: gain innate intelligence, to those with mimicry powers, of the thing being mimicked.
description: Let's say the user, a Fire Mimic, has this Ability Skill. Once they mimic the fire, they will gain the wisdom of this element. They will know how to use it, to actually think like it. That goes to all different types of mimicry-based powers--electricity, sound, etc.
pros: Know how to use the thing you mimicked.
No need to practice.
cons: Must be a mimicry-based powers.

name: Stockpile
overview: become more powerful by not using your strength / abilities.
description: With this ability, you gain more and more strength over time. By simply not exerting your physical strength, it can stockpile to become dozens of times stronger than usual. This also applies to not using your superpowers. For example, if you don't exert Telekinesis for long enough, you'll be able to move larger things, such as tall buildings.
pros: Patience is the key.
Doesn't have any negative effect on your strengths.
cons: Patience is the key.

name: Blood Weaponry
overview: create weapons made of your own blood.
description:
By creating a small cut on your body, you can control your blood to create weapons like shuriken and swords to fight with. Depending on the attack used, and whether it is held or not, very little or a lot of blood is used.

However, there is a catch. You can possibly kill yourself by expending too much blood too fast. Draining more then 75% of your blood in an hour will likely pass out unconscious, and your injury will continue to bleed, possibly leading to death by blood loss.
pros: Always have a readily available weapon on hand
Weapons are sharp as titanium
Blood can be reabsorbed into body if still in contact with skin
cons: Can lead to death due to too much blood loss
Requires some focus to retain control over blood
Uneffective against vampires and other creatures that feed on blood

name: Psychic Vampire
overview: drain a human's life energy.
description: You can enter someone's mind and drain their life energy straight from their body.
pros: You can have a stable telepathic link if you have five people in it.
You can talk to people if you dont want to anyone else to hear.
People will not want to mess with you.
cons: If you have less than five people in the link, it kills the other person.
Once five people are in the link, there's no reversing it.
Once you start a stable telepathic link, your power is useless with anyone not in the link.

name: Napalm Dominance
overview: create and manipulate military-grade napalm.
description: This power allows the user to create and freely control high-grade napalm, a gelatin substance that not only persistently adheres to surfaces it comes in contact with, but that burns with such an intense heat that being anywhere within several hundred feet of a source of napalm can cause third degree burns. Larger quantities of napalm can cause the air temperature to dramatically spike, causing water to boil rapidly and burning skin and muscle with 2,200 degree Fahrenheit winds and flames.
pros: It's great for mass combat; the intense heat drives away most low to mid level baddies.
It's absolutely wonderful to be paired up with any wind-oriented powers (except for vacuum control).
The intensity of heat makes it useful even in small quantities and vs. Water/ice powers.
cons: You're human, too, so you better be wearing some anti-thermal gear or something.
It's an indiscriminate power; watch out for civilians and allies.
Be careful of potential collateral damage, like buildings catching fire.

name: Blue Ray
overview: give recovery sight for the blind.
description: Heal any blind person by emitting blue rays from your eyes. This blue rays restores one's sight without any complications or side effects.
pros: Heal the blind and be the greatest eye doctor.
Your eyesight are immune to any known radiations!
cons: None.

name: Divine Dimensional Travel
overview: create amazing portals to the Afterlife (Heaven), and/or the underworld (Hell).
description: This does not include the ability to Astral Project, but to create a portal as what it looks like a Dreamcatcher, if you travel to Heaven, you might be able to see your greatest grandparents, & see what's going on in the afterlife, but if you travel to Hell you'll see Extremely what's going on when dead evildoers have suffered.
pros: You might be able to ask someone in the afterlife who the perpetrator is that caused a hero's death.
cons: Better be careful of not let any demons from the underworld follow you back home.

name: Equal Speed
overview: stop resistance on a moving object.
description: The user just has to throw an object, e.g. a marble, pencil, table , etc. The object will move in a straight line not slowing down, allowing the object to move through walls, vehicles, or even people. The object will travel in the same direction at the same speed until it is destroyed or commanded to stop by the user.
pros: Sturdy objects will last in this state for a while.
The user can often use this on more than one object at once.
Not affected by gravity.
cons: Foes can avoid slower objects.
Object can be worn down or destroyed if it is not sturdy enough.
Objects lose this effect if the person is unconscious or dead.

name: Jeweled Tears
overview: create rare jewels by crying
description: Your tears will literally turn into jewels when you cry. They can be sapphires, rubies, diamonds, emeralds, etc. The size of the jewels are the same as the tears.
pros: You can get lots of money by crying a lot.
cons: Tears are generally really small.

name: Frost Shell
overview: create a frozen area around a object that prevents energy exchange.
description: A frozen shell is created two inches above and around any object of your choosing. The shell is light blue and can allow a small amount of light to pass through or none at all as well as air to breathe. The shell keeps strong amounts of energy from passing through so that it keeps power out or power trapped inside. It is near impossible to break the shell through non-physical means but can be shattered from a strong physical hit. Only lasts while caster is around. Shell is not fixed to one spot.
pros: Can be used as a defensive barrier.
Or as a prison for energy.
Takes little effort to make.
cons: Can be broken physically.
Manipulated by cold-related powers.
May not put shell up until after the energy hits you and then you trap the energy inside with you.

name: Ultimate Comeback
overview: create the ultimate comeback to any burn instantly
description: This power is perfect when you're getting burned constantly and can't figure out a good comeback in time. Now you can! Someone hurting your feelings, then absolutely destroy them mentally with the ultimate comeback when they feebly try to tell you off. However, this only works on after burns, it doesn't help with physical bulllying. And the ultimate comeback works automatically.
pros: Ultimate comeback to any burn
Possibly blow someone's mind out of their head
cons: Only works on burns
Happens automatically

name: Sleeper Agent
overview: plant a modifying program in the minds of others
description: A sleeper agent is someone who has a predetermined program written inside of them. With this ability, you can reprogram someone without them knowing about it. Once you activate the program, they will follow your commands. If you want, you can turn them into super-soldiers.
pros: Amass an army
Tell people what to do
Reprogram their minds and make them soldiers of fortune
cons: Every program has a kill code
A person of strong will might resist the program

name: Death Hallucination
overview: trap people in a hallucination that ends with their death.
description: Basically, you trap someone in a hallucination that ends with their death. The time spent in the hallucination can't be longer than a day, which means their death is guaranteed. The hallucination is instantaneous in real time, so no matter how long they spend in the hallucination, no time will pass outside. The hallucination can be anything from the world exploding, to a zombie apocalypse, to just getting hit by a car.
pros: Pretty fun.
Can be used on yourself
Experience the world blowing up, if you're bored
cons: May drive people insane if you aren't careful.

name: Aut   Phone
overview: travel to any paralell universe with the use of an alternate iPhone.
description: The AUT - phone is a handheld device that resembles an iPhone, the time on the phone is unlimited. A whitish silver portal is opened by pressing a button on the phone that sets it to open a wormhole to a new dimension, and with this phone, it can instantly gain knowledge from any universe you travelled in.
pros: You might find interesting cultures in many alternate universes.
cons: If you don't like this universe, you'll leave.

name: Forced Superpower Activation
overview: activate someone else's power by fulfilling all the conditions needed to use it.
description: A lot of powers require you to do something or fulfil certain conditions in order to activate them and use them. It may be concentration, certain emotions, saying something, drawing something, being exposed to sunlight, certain gestures or actions, etc. If someone with this ability does exactly what's needed to activate someone else's power, they will activate it without that person's consent. They're NOT copying that ability, nor do they channel it; they just force that person to use it.
pros: Some powers can be used as you please, as if you copied them, like Telekinesis or Geokinesis.
If an ally is put in a position where they can't activate their power, you can activate it for them.
You can use it on a power which is already activated but isn't used to its full capacity.
cons: Unless there's a specific conditions to fulfil, you can't deactivate a power if they are using it.
In most cases, activating a power doesn't mean you can use it on yourself, like Teleportation.
They can be immune to their own power, but not you. So, be careful when you activate a power.

name: Kryptopain
overview: send pain by thought to another person.
description: With this power, you can send pain by thought to another person. The rules: Be careful--even if it's a little bit of pain, it could be tons of pain to that person. Don't imagine it too much.
pros: Can torture siblings and bullies
Can send pain through your body to get out of class
Can save people while the bad guy is in pain and can't concentrate
cons: Killing people
Killing family members by accident
Not controlling it

name: Omni Vampire
overview: drain life from omni-powered beings.
description: Are you getting sick and tired of people with omnipotence? Worried about being spied on with omnipresence? Can't catch someone with omniscience? Well, if you get this power you will continuously drain the life out of them. Their powers are blocked. This power can affect the whole universe.
pros: Get many powers.
Omnipotence is no longer invincibility!
No more omni powers!
cons: Warning: Ownership of omni powers in conjunction with this is suicide.
Whatever you do, don't choose omnipotence.
Can't use this power against someone else with this power.

name: When You're Hot, You're Hot.
overview: munipulate the molecules of the users own body in order to create intense heat.
description: One can control molecules and generate a coating of heat. The user can coat their body in thermal energies and create an aura of heat around themeselves, from extremely hot to mild. It can also be controlled on just certain body parts or around them. Blasts can be shot from the body, but the farther the distance the weaker the effect.
pros: A shield of heat for protection.
Creates a light when needed.
Cook anthying with your hands.
cons: Can only be generated off their body.
Blasts weaken with distance.
Lack of control can melt your surrondings.

name: Under Pressure
overview: manipulate pressures, and send pressure waves at people.
description: This power is both a blessing and a curse. Whilst it allows you to send pressure shockwaves and implode/explode enemies, it comes with a price. You will forever have the song "Under Pressure" by David Bowie and Queen blaring at you and all those in your vicinity at 80db. A small price to pay? Perhaps. But remember.  "It's the terror of knowing What this world is about Watching some good friends Screaming 'Let me out' Pray tomorrow - gets me higher Pressure on people - people on streets"
pros: Awesomely powerful ability with the power to kill.
cons: You have to listen to "Under Pressure" forever.

name: Dagger Strike
overview: shoot daggers out of the palms of your hands
description: With this power you can shoot daggers out of the palms of your hands. You have an unlimited amount of dagger and the daggers are sharper than normal daggers, even being able to cut through metal.
pros: You can shoot daggers out of the palms of your hands
You have an unlimited supply of daggers
The daggers are sharper than normal daggers they can even cut through metal
cons: You might accidentally stab yourself

name: Mjollnir
overview: carry the mighty hammer of a thunder god
description: Use Mjollnir to break mountains or crack some skulls. You have the ultimate weapon. No godling, alien, man or beast can withstand a blow from it. If you throw it Mjollnir will always hit its mark and always return to you. You can make enemies think you are weaponless by hiding it in your tighty whiteys. Then whip it out (the hammer) and beat the snot out of them. You are almost immortal while Mjollnir is yours.
pros: Sword in the stone rule: only you can lift Mjollnir
Eventually control lightning, fly, teleport thru an astral realm and ride giant goats, yeah goats
You'll be 7 ft tall with long curly red hair, massive muscles, superstrength and a love of violence
cons: Dragons, cross-dressing murderous trickster half-brother/sister, frost-giants, and dark elves
You'll have to die a warrior's death or no burning boat funeral or Valhalla for you
Ragnarok will happen on Earth as long as you possess the hammer and you will not survive

name: Positive Reincarnation
overview: project one's positive energy into a human like-being.
description: Project positive energy with one's mind in it. The positive being is a bright white color. When the positive being is out, one is protected by an impenetrable force-field and one's eyes turn the same color as the positive being. Since it is energy, it can fly and phase through objects. The positive being can't stay out of one's body too long or it'll dissolve into nano-particles and be reincarnated by a negative being. However, if the two merge together, they become unstable and will explode.
pros: Can fly
Can phase through objects
cons: Can't stay in positive being for a long time
Merging with negative equals explosion.

name: Dagger Wrist
overview: summon a dagger chain out of your wrist
description: When used it will make a slit in your wrist (it wont hurt). And a dagger chain will come out. It can hurt you but it is indestructible,And can support any weight so you can swing on it.
pros: Have a weapon in any situation
Swing off the dagger-tail
Completly concealable
cons: The slit wont hurt but the dagger will
If you bring it to a gun fight
You have to practice

name: Magma Mimicry
overview: become living molten rock
description: This power combines rock & fire mimicry. The Thing & Human Torch fused together. Your body will convert itself into burning lava creating obsidian body armor. You'll have increased strength & durability. You can secrete & spew lava & make volcanic blasts. The negative side to this power is your speed is slow & water can harden you till your frozen solid.
pros: Increased Strength
Molten lava powers
cons: Hindered speed
Water equals enemy
Burn everything you touch

name: Twisted Liquid Reflection
overview: change what someone sees on the surface of a liquid to whatever you imagine.
description: This power gives you full control over what is reflected on the surface of any liquid. You can even make moving objects, or as if there was not even any liquid at all. To use it, you must touch the liquid while imagining an image or a scene and it will appear on the surface as if it was a movie or a picture.
pros: You can hide people/items beneath the surface of lakes or pools.
Or you can make sure no one takes water from your secret oasis.
This ability works on any liquid. Just to be clear, pudding is not a liquid.
cons: You can only change the parts of the liquid you can see.

name: Myth Power: Hebe's Hedge
overview: channel Hebe's command over the essence of youth, the young and youthful vigor
description: Hebe, in Greek myth, was the goddess of youth, youthful vigor and the young, as well as Cupbearer of the Gods. As such, channeling her allows one to only age to one's physical prime, thus gaining eternal youth. In addition, one can psychically de-age subjects (physically and/or mentally), at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with anyone younger than middle age (young adults, teens, kids, etc). One can even psychically generate a forcefield that works on the young.
pros: Gain Eternal Youth (remain in the physical prime of youth)
Psychically de-age subjects (mentally and/or physically), at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and generate a forcefield against the young, at will
cons: Cannot psychically trade bodies/minds with the young, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically convert one's youth into physical power, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Geras' Guard and other time/age-based powers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Wanted
overview: make someone have the least wanted powers while you gain most wanted
description: You can strip someone of all their powers & replace them with the least wanted power on This List. Depending on how many powers they have is the factor of how many most wanted powers you gain.
pros: Give someone the crappiest powers created
Gain the MVPs (Most Valuable Powers)
cons: Can only gain has many most wanted powers as the # of powers the other person has
Least wanted could become more popular each day

name: The Dorian Gray Complex.
overview: cast one's own soul into objects.
description: Not to be confused with the Dorian Gray Syndrome, the user of -this- ability can place their soul into an object and therefore become immortal, so long as that object is not harmed and/or destroyed. The user thus retains their prime appearance and is enhanced to peak human conditioning. The user can also separate their soul into multiple objects, making their destruction incredibly difficult -- the user is still unaffected even when many portions of their soul has been dissipated.
pros: The user is immortal.
The user is enhanced.
cons: If the object is damaged or destroyed, the user suffers the same fate.

name: Clothing Kinesis
overview: control all the clothes you wear
description: With this ability, you can control any piece of clothing you wear. You can even fly with this power by making your clothes fly. You can use your clothing to boost your own power and you can use a cape/scarf as an extra limb(s) You can throw your hat and have it come back at you. This power works on any clothing that you wear regardless of the material. Touch other people's clothes directly also give you control over them. Your power overrides other forms of cloth control since it is specialized.
pros: If you made clothes with titanium/kevlar or some durable material
You can change very fast.
You can simulate strength/flight with a full body suit or a cape and gloves
cons: If people destroy your clothes
If you are captured they will throw you in a cell naked
If you wear a cape you can get sucked into a turbine

name: Witch Time
overview: slow down time after dodging at the last second.
description: This power is more like a magic spell. Whenever you dodge an attack (or anything that's going to hurt you) at the last second, time automatically slows down.
pros: Enemies would be moving in slow motion to you.
Enemies would think you have super speed.
cons: You can't control it. The time slow-down happens automatically as soon as you dodge.
Dodging at the exact last second isn't easy.

name: Call Of The Wild
overview: call for help to every single animal in the surrounding area
description: When the chips are down, you can use this power to call every single animal in a 10-mile radius to aid you in combat, as long as the animal wouldn't die leaving its habitat, for example a fish, it would come to you as quickly as possible. You would also be able to give them commands and they will understand you.
pros: Get help from a lot of animals
Animals are strong
cons: Maybe there isn't a lot of animals nearby
Maybe they're all weak

name: Myth Power: Ocean/Tethys Power
overview: channel Ocean and Tethys' command over the essence of freshwater and the ocean
description: Ocean (Oceanos, Oceanus, Ogenos) in Greek myth, was the Titan god of ocean's expanses; his wife Tethys was the Titan goddess of freshwater, as a source of nourishment. As such, channeling Ocean, one can perceive and manipulate water, turn into a form composed of water, and project one's sight to anywhere submerged in water. Channeling Tethys, one can perceive, communicate with and share the senses of any being submerged in water (not just aquatic species), and generate drinkable water at will.
pros: Perceive, manipulate, and mimic water at will (in water form, breathe underwater
Project your sight to anywhere submerged in water; generate potable water at will
Perceive, communicate with and share senses with any creature submerged in water (even non-aquatics)
cons: Cannot become physically stronger underwater until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot become invisible underwater until the higher levels (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: New Emotional Spectrums
overview: have new different wavelengths of light based on thoughts and feelings.
description: It can grant you the ability to create solid-light constructs, wild animals, and weapons; whatever only you imagine. Here are the new inversions. Pink - Kindness, Magenta - Temperance, Brown - Sloth (Laziness), Teal - Wisdom, Tan/Beige - Humility, White - Life, Grey - Immortality, Scarlet - Chaos, Crimson - Vampirism, Bistre - Obedience, Gold - Pride/Vanity, Silver - Diligence Bronze - Cruelty.
pros: Might be use for a greater good.
cons: Might be use for Extraordinary Evil.

name: Myth Power: Phobos' Fear
overview: channel Phobos command over the essence of fear and phobia
description: Phobos (Phobus), in Greek myth, was the god of fear and phobia. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive fear (the feeling itself, and what fear in particular), induce fear, amplify fear (even to the point of overwhelming, paralyzing phobia) and negate fear by touch, word or thought. In addition, one gains physical power in the presence of (non-induced) fear. One can even totally withstand the effects of fear (whether natural or induced) and share this immunity by touch.
pros: Perceive, identify, induce, amplify and reduce fear in others at will (really easy to scare others)
Gain physical power from the (natural, non-induced) fear and phobia of others
Immunity to irrational fear (natural or induced); share Fear Immunity (Fearlessness) by touch
cons: Cannot cast phobic illusions (illusions of what scares a foe) until the higher levels
Cannot be used to induce or manipulate nightmares (NCN)
MythPower: Ares' Wrath, MythPower: Enyo's Laugh, Fearlessness, etc provide immunity

name: Auto Desk
overview: make a levatating touchscreen smart computer pop up
description: When you are having trouble you can pull up this smart computer and ask for a resolution. This power really helps with problem solving and you can even ask it to create an acual object of your design.
pros: Have infinite info at your fingertips
Can cheat on any test
Can show up on your eyes instead of in front of you
cons: Can attract viruses
Can crash
Can't use without special fingertips (need to do ritual)

name: Mechanical Imperceptibility
overview: be undetectable to machines
description: A person with Mechanical Imperceptibility has a strange gift. No machine can register their presence--radar, infra-red detectors, even household cameras. They simply do not show up on film. This aura can be extended to up to twice your body mass. However, it cannot be turned off and secondary effects still show up (doors opening, footprints, etc.).
pros: Unable to show up on cameras
Unable to be heard on recordings
Can be extended to twice your body mass
cons: Secondary effects still show up (doors opening or closing)
Not invisible to people
Cannot be turned off

name: Existence Nullification
overview: cause someone to never have existed just by saying so.
description: Saying someone does not exist causes them to disappear and it's as if they never began existence. When this happens, everyone's memories of that person are erased (including yours) and anything they ever did will be gone as well, such as children, bank accounts, jobs, records, if they murdered, those people return with a present life. The time between them dead and coming back alive, false memories are implanted in people's minds, as if they were still alive, even to the reanimated.
pros: Very effective.
Practically unbeatable.
Can null more than one at a time. ("You all don't exist")
cons: Dire consequences.
Can still be attacked by surprise. Therefore, do not have time to nullify the existence.
If you null yourself or someone else with this power nulls you, the same effect happens. See desc.

name: Bio Metallic Parasite
overview: manipulate a small piece of metal that lives on  your body
description: You can manipulate the (beneficial)parasite's size to make an near-indestructible metal shield or create a slide to prevent a hazardous fall. The parasite will react instinctly when your in harm. Example, someone is about to punch you from behind and the parasite will coil around your enemies arm preventing the punch. The parasite responds to your mental commands so if you think it, you get it.
pros: You will rarely get hurt
Traveling isn't much of a problem
You can make it small enough to prevent you from feeling it
cons: It will tire you easily if you don't  build your endurance
A reflex time may not be quick enough to prevent some attacks
Sometimes the parasite will have a mind of its owns

name: Transparency Curse
overview: curse anyone into being a "thought transparent".
description: This power allows you to put a particular curse on anyone you want. The curse is that their thoughts are no longer confined in their own mind and can therefore be perceived by anyone in their vicinity. How big that vicinity is depends on the emotional state of the accursed, ranging from tens of meters to tens of kilometers. The victim usually won't realize they've been cursed until they've been told so or they notice people's reaction. Only the person who put that curse can lift it.
pros: You can make the most intimate secrets of anyone public.
In a combat situation, you AND your allies can anticipate your opponent's moves.
You can drive anyone to suicide, isolation or craziness, as it is unbearable to have that curse.
cons: The curse can also be lifted if you die. If your victims realize this, you're in big trouble.

name: Movie Madness   Hero Syndrome!
overview: become a hero as if the protagonist of an action movie!
description: This what enables an Action Star to overcome any boundaries within a movie, and most often than not succeed at whatever situation calls for his expertise. Expertise can be anything from complete control and accuracy of any weapon, leaping from high places and landing without suffering harm, to being a formidable hand-to-hand combatant, surviving on sheer force of impulse, and disarming an atomic warhead with only a few seconds to spare. Among other possibilities imaginative!
pros: Basically, the talents are seemingly in the Hero's favor.
Limited only to the Hero's personal existence.
Is also a probable answer to wearing the same clothing one had worn the other day.
cons: Nothing bad previously known.
Nothing bad currently known.
Nothing bad futurely known.

name: Magi (Magus)
overview: call forth a sword and become a superhuman.
description: When you are a magi you gain the ability to call forth a mystical sword that represents your essence. You also gain acrobatic skills, stronger endurance, and the ability to discharge energy from your body. The "magi blade" is indestructible and can either slice through any object or deflect it. Your sword is easy to call forth although if separated from it you must concentrate to call it back. A magi can also sense the presence of other magi.
pros: You may have abilities that other Magi don't have.
Your endurance is extremely high so you can take a lot of punishment.
An energy discharge is much more lethal than a firearm.
cons: You are not the only Magi so there will be rivalry.
Must concentrate to call back sword.
Other Magi can sense when you are near.

name: Spiritual Purification
overview: purify anyone's spirit
description: We all know that there are some real creeps out there: rapists, pedophiles, criminals, devil worshippers, etc. This power enables the user to purify a person's spirit. Turn some child molester into a dedicated catholic or something. Or even something small, like turning a bully into a "sweetie." But maybe, if someone was pure evil, this power would either purify them--or destroy them.
pros: Lower population of creeps, criminals, and bullies
If anyone tries to do anything bad to you, just purify them and they'll stop
cons: Can't attack, just defend

name: Kigen Arts
overview: borrow and reshape the spirit of nature
description: This ability allows one to borrow and reshape the spirit of nature. The spirit can take any form, offensive and/or defensive means, under your command. Using this ability may corrupt your spirit and cause you to lose control over your ability.
pros: Can resurrect the dead by transferring the borrowed spirit from nature.
You can create a barrier or pure blast of spiritual energy.
cons: May corrupt your spirit and cause you to lose control over your powers
Overuse of this ability may anger nature, resulting in violent weather

name: Awakened Power
overview: max out all of one's stats and powers for a cost.
description: A person who has the Awakened Power has the ability to max out all of one's abilities to the maximum level the dimension can handle. Such as strength, speed or other super powers to their most powerful, making the person more powerful than even most gods for a short period of time. To use the Awakened Power, one must know the name of their soul, not the name given to them by their parents at birth.
pros: You can become stronger than anyone to the point the Hulk looks as weak as a kitten
Your senses will also be maxed out, such as sight and sound and even touch.
All other powers will also be maxed out such as semi fire control into universal fire control
cons: Must know the name of your soul.
Best used by immortals as it can shorten a mortal's life span by 10 years each time they use it.
Maxed out senses mean maxed out sensitivity

name: Ultimate Physical Strength
overview: have unmatched physical strength without the required secondary powers
description: The person that wants this power is either very powerful or a fool. This power grants the user unmatched physical strength but does not grant any of the necessary powers to make it useful. The user is not able to even move without causing a disaster, except by blowing through their mouth. The user remains as brittle as ever, thus their arms can break if not actively repelling anything. Please do not choose this power if you don't have the required secondary powers or it will be your own undoing.
pros: No one can beat you in a head-on fight (except yourself)
Your very movements can cause natural disasters
cons: Super Strength does not give you super speed or endurance
You cannot move or else the ground you walk on will become a crater and your foot will be stuck
You cannot even use this power without the required secondary powers

name: Sorcery
overview: Have A Darker Version of Magic
description: Darker Version of Magic
pros: Creates Dark Spells
Replicates Superpowers
Absorpts Superpowers
cons: Takes People's Soul & Becoming Them
Dark Empire Thoughtout the Entire Universe
Controls Humanity

name: Instinct Negation
overview: cancel out the innate behaviors and responses of living things
description: Also called Instinct Termination, Instinct Suppression or Instinct Blocking. This is the ability to psychically cancel out the subjects' instincts and innate behaviors. One with this ability could cause a person to not get off the train tracks, even though they see the train coming, or cause a person not to move their hand off the stove, even though the temperature is very high and everything in their mind tells them that harm is coming to them.
pros: Even pwn people with Superhuman Reflexes (they react faster, but that's if they react AT ALL)
Hurt enemies, and then negate their innate instinct to retaliate or get help
Foes won't move when the train is coming, or get out of the crossfire in a gunfight, etc.
cons: The number of people that can be affected depends on how developed your power is
Effects may be permanent
If powerful, also cancels autonomic body responses (now you're going to superhuman jail for murder)

name: The Perfect Vampire
overview: be the perfect version of a vampire.
description: A perfect vampire is basically a vampire without all of the stupid weaknesses. Powers: Strength, Speed, Agility, Senses, Healing, and Hypnotism. You have fangs that can be used to pierce the skin of humans to suck blood. The only things that can kill you are getting your head cut off and being set on fire and burning to death.
pros: You can actually walk in the sun.
Crosses, holy water, wooden stakes, and silver DON'T hurt or kill you.
cons: Decapitation (getting your head cut off) kills you.
Incineration (being set on fire and burned) kills you.
Lack of blood will make you tired and dizzy.

name: Polymer Reformation
overview: break up synthetic and natural polymers (and reform them)
description: A person with this power has a power similar to Polymerkinesis, but can only break up polymers (and selectively reform them), not control them like a magnet. A person with polymer manipulation can break up any type of polymer within a 7 ft. range and can also selectively reform polymers within a 1 ft. range. Besides manipulating plastics and nylon, the user can also break up the proteins in muscles and reform them, giving them either tougher or more elastic muscles.
pros: You can instantly "recycle" any plastic and change its properties to a certain extent
You can control your own muscles to make it either more elastic or tougher
You can break up muscles or plant tissues at will
cons: Can only reform polymers when less than 1 ft. away
Accidental Clothing Damage if not mastered, also this does not work on metals

name: Transforming Dragon Master #2
overview: transform yourself into many forms of elements through martial arts
description: As Master of Martial Arts, styles & ways you are gifted with the ability to transform into forms of base elements through fighting styles. Earth, wind, fire & water. Continuous movement in a style grants more bodily changes. Fight long enough & you morph into a full form of an element, able to use incredible durability, endurance & strength. You could even lend your powers to others if you are fighting in tandem. You innately know each fight style when you begin practice or battle.
pros: Transform into any form of fire for burning offense
Transform into any form of earth or water for defense
Mix elements to form fighting clay, lava, dust storm, geysers, hail etc.
cons: Complete devotion to movements & absolute focus is needed to maintain element fighting forms
You cannot force your element form, each style dictates what form you must take
You can lend your powers only to people who can mimic the fighting style (preferably another master)

name: Weather Fusion
overview: fuse with the weather
description: This ability allows the user to fuse with any weather condition. When the person is fused, they are the weather and can control it. For example, being rainy lets them control all the rain drops like bullets and attacking the rain does nothing, being sunny lets them control the heat, etc. However, the limit is the time the weather condition is active. If the user does not unfuse before the weather condition ends, they will forever be stuck as that weather condition.
pros: You are invincible as long as it is the same type of weather
You can control the weather to attack
You can create a pattern that looks like you, similar to a mirage to speak
cons: You must unfuse before the weather ends every time you use this or you will be stuck as the weather
If you are stuck, you will be "immortal" but you can only appear if the same weather occurs again
You cannot activate any other powers when you are the weather

name: Human Imprintation
overview: take the soul of a person and put it in an inanimate object
description: You can take the soul of any human and put it in something or someone else. If you put the soul in an inanimate object they will feel the thing as their body and be able to comuniicate through limited telepathy. If you put the soul in someone else, the person will either develop split personality disorder and the other personality will be the souls, or the soul will just be a voice in their head, depending on the willpower of the person
pros: Mess with people.
Put bad guys literally, and permanently in jail
You could rule the world
cons: It's permanant and you could regret doing it
It takes time
VERY hard to control

name: Blessing Of Erebus
overview: have the blessing of Erebus
description: Erebus, the Greek god of shadows and darkness, is one of the minor and less known gods. His blessing gives you powers over the dark. For one, you can control shadows as living things. They are your faithful servants. You can make them do whatever you want. They can reshape themselves and store things within themselves. However, you cannot become a shadow or shadow travel.
pros: Control shadows
The shadows can reshape and store things within themselves.
Shadows can spy on things for you and can "communicate" with you
cons: Can only summon so many shadows to help you at once
No shadow mimicry or travel

name: Lightning Familiar
overview: throw a lightning bolt to summon a familiar
description: When you use this ability you can create a lightning bolt that you throw into the ground it'll summon any creature in lightning form to protect you. However, you can't touch them or you'll get shocked and they only last 5 minutes only allowed 3 at a time.
pros: Summon a familiar to protect you
Shock and destroy your enemies
You can trick people into believing that your lighting bolt is a weapon
cons: Can't touch your pets
Only lasts 5 minutes
Three at a time

name: Blackened Bone Manipulation
overview: grow bones in any area of your body, the bone hardens on contact with the air.
description: If parts of the bone grows outside of the body, the outer area in contact with the air becomes black and near indestructible. The bone feeds of the blood of its enemies, and will become stronger the more blood it absorbs. Another point is that the bone that has been grown outside of the body can be snapped off without pain and used as a weapon. However, this bone becomes weaker than it would normally be. Small shards of bone can be fired from the under side of the wrist.
pros: Any normal broken bone can be replaced by this untill the original has repaired itself.
Almost no limit to the amount of bone than can be grown.
If developed properly, the bone can also be used as a form of armour.
cons: Because of the thirst of blood that the bones have, the owner can become driven crazy by the thirst.
The uncontrollable thirst can sometimes leave the owner open to attacks.
They need blood to survive. If they do not get enough, then they will feed upon the owner's blood.

name: Composing
overview: hear the name of a song and immediately know every word and note
description: Once this ability is first gained, the user can memorize a song completely the first time the song is heard all the way through. Once this ability has been trained halfway to full strength, hearing the name of a song causes them to memorize every word and note of the song. Once the ability has hit full power (or once the user turns 21, whichever comes first), they've memorized every song in the world and gain a new ability every time a new song is sung all the way through.
pros: Be a great singer
Never forget words to any song
Become stronger based on other people's songwriting talent
cons: Cannot gain new abilities based on your own songs
Takes years to master this power, even if you are born with it
Really hard power to gain (like one in a million)

name: Curse Eater
overview: devour curses for their magical power and use it as a spell.
description: A demon, human, or other entity with the Curse Eater power would be able to absorb any harmful magic that is fixed to a location, phrase, event, or otherwise tied down to a condition. The entity would then be able to use the power they gained from their meal for magic.
pros: Most people avoid curses, so you live without that hanging over your head.
Magic not specifically directed can be devoured to fuel your own spells.
Even a normal person with the Curse Eater power could be an extraordinary sorcerer.
cons: You would gain enemies - enemies that are probably sorcerers or divine beings.
A sorcerer with Curse Eater would find that it stunt their magic growth.
People might think you're weird if you stalk around asking for rumors about the local haunted house.

name: Literally Literal
overview: force someone to enact their idiomatic expression.
description: You are able to pick out an idiomatic expression from someone and force them to reenact it, e.g. if someone were to say "pinch me, I'm dreaming", you could pinch them and they would disappear from this world and wake up in another world; if someone said "this bites", an animal will appear out of nowhere and bite them; if someone said "when pigs fly", a random pig with wings/jetpacks will appear in the sky; etc.
pros: Great for a good prank, or getting rid of enemies, e.g. if an enemy said "I'd rather die"
You can control how an idiom is enacted, from funny to deadly (if that idiom is possibly lethal)
cons: Cannot use it on yourself. Is also permanent
Can only use it once a day per person
Can only use it on one idiomatic sentence per person

name: Ebony Whip
overview: morph it and use it to punish your foes from upclose or afar.
description: It may look like a regular whip, except for the tones of nanoliquid. Whenever you use it, it assumes features which seem to be revolving around both shadow and phantom. With the phantom powers, you are able to remove and control an opponent's powers using a ghastly force by wrapping them around it, and in shadow form, you are able to change her size and shape at will, forming tentacles, and hardening it to punish foes and break through anything.
pros: Can fire medium-sized black spikes from the whip.
Could wrap your enemy around your whip, then spin until the victim's bones fly out of their body.
cons: It will not work against water/ice-type opponents.

name: Walls Of Jericho
overview: create barriers that can absorb projectiles and can hurt and trap opponents that run into it.
description: It is designed to block and trap foes that are in contact with the barriers. They can be stunned, or even zapped if they run into it. It is also intended to stop the spread of zombies, werewolves and vampires, and instantly absorb projectiles.
pros: Nothing can stop it, except magic.
cons: Only those with light or dark magic can destroy the walls.

name: Brush Of Truepaint
overview: make portals into paintings and paint
description: The Brush Of Truepaint is a brush that allows you to create a portal on a canvas that lets you go inside. Once inside, you can imagine something and the brush will auto-paint it for you. This also works on creatures. Everything in the painting is real and real time...The trees will move, wind will blow, creatures will move... When you paint the portal back out, the canvas will contain the things you painted.
pros: A safe haven for easy hidden escape that no one would think to look
Painting appears normal from the outside, nobody can see the brush
Can create things in the canvas world, like toys and animals to play with
cons: If someone destroys the painting, then you are stuck till you paint the scene on another canvas
Could get cluttered if you don't realize how much your painting
Painted items could turn against you.

name: Evolution Of Pokemon
overview: evolve in a similar way to the way a Pokemon does.
description: With this power you can pick a combination of two Pokemon types and evolve up to two times to gain powers based on which combination you choose and how you use your powers while you are evolving. As you evolve you become more Pokemon like. Which types you pick as your primary and secondary types changes how you will become. You will learn four skills as you evolve based on how you train power. You can change out of Pokemon form at will. Can change types but will have to retrain powers.
pros: Become any combination of Pokemon types.
Learn up to four special skills to use while in Pokemon form.
Can change type choices and can change out of Pokemon form to normal at will.
cons: Can not use learned skills if not in Pokemon form.
Have to retrain if you want to add the ability to change into a different type combo.
Watch out for MasterBalls.

name: Parody Power
overview: temporarily change someone's power into a parody version of itself.
description: This power requires a good imagination and a good sense of humor. You have to observe what someone's power does. You have to be a 100 feet or closer. You have to think of a parody of the power you're observing. The parody effect last for a hour. Joke powers and cartoon-based powers are immune to this power as is this power itself.
pros: Alter a foe's power and have a laugh at the same time.
A good power if your funny and imaginative.
cons: You are dull-witted.
You choose to read a quantum physics book rather than watch a funny movie.

name: Zodiac: Gemini
overview: create a psionic clone of yourself
description: With this power you can do what Al Bester in Babylon 5 did, just on someone else. You can make someone else's psychic signature appear to be yours for 2 hours by drawing the sign of Gemini above their head.
pros: Make enemies confused as to who is truly you.
cons: If the person decides to commit a crime.
Only lasts for 2 hours.
Unaffected by Con Negation.

name: Apocalypse
overview: control the end of the world as we know it
description: Nuclear War, pandemic, alien invasion, robot uprising, economic collapse, environmental collapse, EMP strikes. These are among threats that could end civilization as we know it. You can select and shift details of any sort of apocalypse you choose, and travel to alternate timelines where it has occurred or where it will occur. Your power will eventually choose a time in the main timeline-and slowly torture you if you refuse to end the world. This is open to modification by other powers, however.
pros: Have private access to alternate timelines of your choosing/control, along with privacy in them
If the time isn't 'right,' you can reverse the damage of other potential apocalypses
You can also start the apocalypse at will, but then reverse it or dampen its effects
cons: Unless you are VERY careful with the real time-line effects, people will try to kill you
If you choose to enter one of the timelines and be able to take things out of it, you can die in it
The glorious post-apocalyptic genre of fiction might get to be pretty boring for you

name: 3rd Person Vision
overview: view yourself from a 3rd person point of view
description: With this ability you can view yourself as if from a third person perspective. You will still be able to move normally, but see everything from a different perspective. You will see yourself as if from a bystanders point of view and can change where you are looking from (i. E. Height, angle, zoom).
pros: Be able to see everything around you
Can still move normally
cons: Coordination is slightly impaired, until your vision return's to normal

name: Myth Exchange
overview: switch the attributes and aspects of mythological and fictional creatures.
description: With this power you have the ability to change the attributes or aspects of any mythological or fictional creature with that of another mythological or fictional creature. Such as making zombies only be hurt by silver while werewolfs will hunger for brains. Also Zeus could be made master of the seas while Hades could be made to suck blood like a vampire. You can change one creature without having to affect any similar creature or creature you got the attribute from.
pros: Swap attributes of mythological creatures to ones that you can more easily handle.
Create new mythological creatures by mixing attributes.
If you become a mythological creature (zombie, etc. ) you can use this on yourself.
cons: Can only swap the attributes of two species (e.g. werewolf), or Gods etc. at a time.
Angering an Olympian by changing its power.
The attribute or aspect you switch to may not be any better for you than the one you switched from.

name: Madness Into Matter
overview: turn any psychotic person's delusion into reality
description: By touching a psychotic person's head, you can turn his delusions into reality. If he believed he was Napoleon, he really becomes an awesome strategist who speaks French. If the person believes he's monitored by aliens, little green man really show up. WARNING: a psychotic delusion is rarely stable, so this power can become extremely uncontrollable.

The user has the ability to witstand pain.
Due to the fact that the user is able to control pain receptors they can also suppress pain.
cons: The user can be drained of energy if this power is abused.
This ability cannot work on anything inorganic.

name: Weapon Legacy
overview: strengthen and empower your weapon through continued use over time by yourself and your descendants.
description: With this ability you are linked to your chosen weapon. Over time and use as you grow stronger and more powerful so does your weapon as it tailors its self to you wielding the same strength and power as you do. And over time and continued use by your descendants it shares your strength and power with them and adds their strength and power to itself growing stronger and more powerful as time passes.
pros: Wield the perfect weapon for you.
An heirloom to be passed down to descendants.
Creates a family legacy.
cons: Can lead its wielder to overconfidence.
Is limited to bloodline.
Is worthless if not constantly used.

name: Fearsome Projection
overview: Project your fear on to others.
description: With this ability you can project your own fears on to others thus momentarily becoming fearless while rendering them cowering in fear.
pros: Become Fearless for a time.
Cause others to be fearful.
Face challenges you normally couldn't.
cons: Can backfire if over used.
Only works for a short time.
Can drive those whom you have projected onto your fear to make unlikely choices.

name: Stone Body
overview: be a living stone creature
description: Your body is literally composed of stone, with only the skin and hair still being organic. If you're cut, you'll bleed, but your blood will turn to bloodstones and pearls. Your tears become opals. Your heart is a large gem that's the same as your birthstone. When you take lethal damage, you scatter into stones that will then regroup around your birthstone and recreate your body.
pros: Can't be killed by violent means.
Gifts are a lot easier.
Diseases are no danger to you anymore.
cons: You're much heavier than before.
Can't get hurt or cry in public or everyone will know.

name: Power Hacker
overview: to hack into anyone's power.
description: This person can hack into anyone's power (via telepathy) similar to that of a computer. Once this person has hacked into a power they can do almost anything to it. They can copy, steal, deactivate, activate, alter, erase, transfer, and swap any power they are hacked into.
pros: You can acquire multiple powers.
You can turn your enemies power off.
You can hack into one of your own powers.
cons: You need to be within sight of the person being hacked.
Each hack takes 1 minute to hack into a power.
You are vulnerable to attack while hacked into a power.

name: Really Comfy Sweater
overview: have an extremely comfortable sweater.
description: You own what is possibly the most comfortable sweater ever. You can choose whether or not to wear it, though I don't see why you wouldn't want to ever stop wearing it, since it's so comfortable. It's very cool looking, interpret that as you may. It's also super soft.
pros: Stay warm, potentially share warmth with others.
Look awesomely comfortable while simultaneously BEING awesomely comfortable.
Distracts most villains.
cons: May not provide the greatest protection ever
You need to wash it.
Overheating

name: Revan's Mask
overview: wield the power granted when you wear Revan's Mask.
description: Wearing the mask of the Dark Lord of the Sith Revan will grant the warer his knowledge and Force talents and abilities, but at the cost of being enslaved to the mask because you're not Revan. You will be influenced by it and mentally dominated by it over time and constant use.
pros: Become as knowledgable and powerful as Revan.
Gain Revan's force talents, abilities and powers.
Become unbeatable by most force wielders.
cons: Lose yourself becoming enslaved to the mask every time you use it.
The mask is still a mask it can be stolen or destroyed by enemies.

name: Shrapnel
overview: cover the body in a metallic substance, & then explode without harm, projecting shrapnel in the area
description: Your body can secrete a metallic substance that covers the body & hardens into a durable armor. In that stage, your strength & stamina are increased. This only lasts for an hour. If you take too much damage, it will cause an explosion as powerful as an RPG. This will blast the metal covering in many directions as shrapnel. You will be intact & unharmed in the end.
pros: Have a strong metal covering
Increased strength & stamina
Can explode without harm
cons: Cannot control the explosion or shrapnel
Only last for a hour or depending on how much damage is taken

name: The Perfect Comeback
overview: instantly think up the perfect comeback to a taunt, diss, etc.
description: If someone is dissin' you or your girl, you'll think of the perfect comeback to make them back off your grille.
pros: You'll never again get served.
You'll amaze people with your wit.
cons: Requires you to deliver the comeback after thinking of it.
May cause other people to unexpectedly yell "oh snap!" or "snap tizzle!"

name: Mental Compass
overview: turn your own or another person's mind into an all-knowing compass.
description: This ability will allow the user to know the direction of anything, represented by a compass. Sure, there are those powers that would give the user the exact location of what they want, but its other function is the real reason I made this ability. When the user gives another this ability, their brain will make them go blind and they will follow where the user wants them to go.
pros: Good tracking ability.
Able to redirect people's movements or attacks.
cons: Sometimes magnetizes wandering brainwaves.

name: De Bone
overview: rip someone's skeleton out of their body
description: You can phase your hand into someone's body & pull out their entire skeleton, probably killing them instantly. You can also just pull out individual bones. Their deboned body will just be really a hollowed carcass. All organs & muscles will be intact though in their body.
pros: Skeleton ripping
Can take all or just one or two or more bones out of a body
cons: You leave them a dead deboned corpse

name: Powerdox
overview: gain physical and mental strength through the occurrence of a paradox
description: With this ability, the user is granted a boost in power from the activation of a paradox, the amount of strength gained equal to the intensity of the consequence the paradox imposes. e.g. the grandfather paradox would grant much more power than a paradox that arises from a contradictory word phrase. Once the power is gained, the paradox loses power.   The user gains no power from a paradox if he/she is the one who causes it. Once a paradox has been resolved, the power nullifies.
pros: A paradox strong enough, and you'd have power to rival that of a God.
With enhanced mental power, you'd develop the mental ability to create other paradoxes.
If combined with someone who could time travel, the power created would be unfathomable.
cons: Pretty useless when it comes to facing other abilities in battle.
Paradoxes are dangerous things- activating one can result in death.
It can be hard to activate a good paradox- the word-contradictory ones won't wield as much power.

name: Myth Power: Erebus' Errand
overview: channel Erebus' command over the essence of darkness and shadow
description: Erebus (Erebos), in Greek myth, was the god of darkness and shadow (including that of the Underworld). As such, channeling him allows one to generate and manipulate darkness, as well as see in the dark (ie Night Vision) at will. In addition, one can form deactivated photons (solid darkness) into constructs like weapons and armor. One can also use darkness to become invisible, and teleport through. One even gains physical power (strength, speed, durability, stamina, etc) in the absence of light.
pros: Generate and manipulate darkness (even to the point of animating/commanding foes' shadows)
Gain physical power in darkness; Night Vision; use shadows to teleport and turn invisible
Withstand all death-based, underworld-based or infernal powers (including MythPowers)
cons: Only gain psychic insight about an object/subject by touching its shadow at the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot sense, absorb or disrupt/negate umbrakinetic powers until the higher levels (NCN)
Light/dark/shadow-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Sand Conversion
overview: turn matter into sand
description: Similar to the superhuman power Glaciation, this is the power to psychically transmute matter into sand. One with this ability may do it by touch, look or just mental power (depending on the user's genetics). It affects the subject in the same way one is affected by the power Petrifaction, but, instead of stone, the subject turns into sand. In addition, if a subject is turned into sand, they can *sometimes* be returned to normal at will, as long as the sand doesn't get blown away.
pros: If you feel threatened, then any incoming impact automatically turn into sand (bullets, knives, etc)
May be accompanied by the ability to assume a form composed of sand (or the power to control sand)
User is often able to affect living and inanimate matter
cons: You can't return a person to normal if they got blown away
Sometimes only affects living matter (or only non-living matter)
It can also be triggered subconsciously (accidental sand conversion)

name: Myth Power: Athena's Ethic
overview: channel Athena's command over the essence of wisdom, war, civilization and crafts
description: Athena (Athene), in Greek myth, was the goddess of wisdom, war, civilization and arts and crafts. As such, channeling her allows one to gain Superhuman Intelligence and Wisdom. In addition, one gains skill in various arts and crafts (weaving/sewing, pottery, martial arts, etc), as well as inventing, using and improving technology. Furthermore, one can psychically change one's clothes into armor, and belongings into tools/weapons, at will. One can even gain physical power to help others in need.
pros: Gain Superhuman Intelligence and Superhuman Wisdom; gain skill in various arts and crafts
Psychically change one's clothes and belongings into indestructible weapons/armor
Gain physical power to help others in need; gain fighting/weapon skill
cons: Part 1 of Pro #3 requires that others be in need; no Hero Sense until developed (NCN)
Tend not to get along with people with MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige
Spiders don't act favorably toward you (NCN)

name: Black Breath
overview: breathe out a deadly black mist
description: One with this ability breathes out a deadly black cloud of an unknown substance, which can be concentrated to three levels; stun, knock-out or kill. The first level "stun" is a thin cloud of the substance which only dazes targets; the second level "knock-out" does just that, knocking foes unconscious; the third setting, however, is much more potent. It is capable of killing plant and animal life, as well as corroding matter to an extent (rusting metals, rotting wood, tainting water, etc. )
pros: Three levels: stun, incapacitate, kill
Can usually be turned on and off at will
Sometimes effect is empathic and only effects those you don't like or those who threaten you
cons: If the power can't be suppressed (sometimes it does happen)
If the power is always at a weak level
If the power is always at a strong level

name: Name Claircognizance
overview: know everyone's name
description: You know all of everyone's names from first, middle and, last to online names, aliases, and nicknames. You know the pronunciation and spelling, as well.
pros: Never awkward if you don't remember someone--all you need is the name to make it look like you do
Can pretend like you know the bouncer to a club and convince him to let you in
Rumpelstiltskin has nothing on you
cons: People may think you are a stalker
Kids may think you are Santa Claus
You don't know if the nickname was nice or mean

name: Supernatural Virus
overview: make a virus out of supernatural elements like magic that is incurable by regular methods
description: With this power, you can create a disease or affliction that is non-biological in nature. As such, powers such as regeneration will not work against this power. The only way the affliction can be cured is through magic or other supernatural types of healing.
pros: You can design the effects of the virus
No doctor can cure the disease, except non-mainstream doctors
cons: You are susceptible to your own virus, so it might spread to yourself over time
You need time to create a new virus and time to modify existing viruses
Viruses can be resisted by magical immunity

name: Cosmic Lost And Found
overview: undo the negation of things and superpowers and bring them near you.
description: With this power any object that was totally destroyed or negated from reality in a 5-mile radius of you will appear in your immediate vicinity. A nullified superpower will move to your body then back to the person who lost it. The bigger the object, the further it will be away from you-Giganto the 50-foot-tall hero won't appear in your house, he'll appear in your street. Objects small enough to fit in your shirt pocket will appear there. This power will bring objects that could hurt or kill you.
pros: Stop a fellow hero from suffering an ultimate death and losing his powers.
Help a fellow hero recover priceless equipment.
cons: The super villain who just was erased from reality appears before you.
This power doesn't filter out the harmful things from harmless things.

name: Adhesive Hold
overview: hold on to anything by will.
description: With this ability, nothing can be removed from your hold unless by will. However, one should note that sometimes it's best to let go. This ability works only if the object specifically is in your palm.
pros: You can hold on to important objects, or slippery substances.
Can be used to keep someone from leaving your grip for whatever reason.
Can be turned off at will.
cons: Sometimes best to let go (ex: If the object is too heavy for you. )
Activates only if the object is specifically in your palms.

name: Mind Exploder
overview: blow up a person's mind on touch
description: The user drains said enemy's experiences, memories, knowledge and wisdom, and even points of view or personality (optional), leaving their ming reduced to yogurt.
pros: you wont have to stay at school that long
nobody will want to mess with you
could be smartest person on the planet
cons: can't work if there's no physical contact
might not be cool at parties
almost no one will want you on their team

name: Superhuman Optimism
overview: be able to make anyone happy.
description:
With this power you can make anyone happy independent of its physical or mental state. Even if a person lost her arms and is bleeding a lot, yes, you can make her happy! 
This power affects your way of speaking, not the mind of your target, thats why everything you say seems really impressive and motivating. With this power you also uses 25% more of your brain smartness and deductibility, thats why you always know what to say.

You will have a lot of friends and your presence will take away your allies fears.
You will be able to influence an entire army of allies.

name: Quickfloor
overview: give an area of ground the properties of quicksand.
description: With this power, you can turn the floor into a deadly trap. An affected area remains somewhat solid and looks normal until something with a mass stands on it, at which point the ground suddenly liquefies. Even the user can't tell the difference, so be careful. As real quicksands, it takes a lot of effort to extract oneself out of it, and the more someone struggles, the more they will sink. The worst thing is the quickfloor is bottomless, though it's limited by the depth of the floor.
pros: A very effective booby-trap as noone should be able to see the difference with normal ground.
Even if someone doesn't sink entirely, they are completely exposed.
If the floor is not deep, someone who is trapped can fall all the way through the floor.
cons: You could fall into your own trap. So be careful.
If you're dealing with flying enemies or someone who knows how to react in this kind of situation.

name: Mind Cloth Imprinting
overview: make people's thoughts appear on their clothes or skin
description: A person with this power has the ability to make anyone's thoughts appear on their clothes. You can also choose to stop the thought pictures on the clothes. Now, you can not only read thoughts but you can prove them because, they are worn on their shirt/clothes. If they take off the shirt, it will be on the next shirt and on their skin. You can also stop this power at any time to force the words to be imprinted in their shirt.

If they try to take off their shirt, it will appear on the next shirt
Only you can choose when the words go away or when their thoughts stop showing up

It is in the language they are thinking in

name: Vampirism: Memory
overview: gain sustenance and power from the memories of others
description: Also called Mnemonic Vampirism or Memory Absorption, this is the ability to absorb memories from the thoughts of others and convert it into sustenance and energy for one's own personal use; this makes the subject temporarily forget weaker memories, and particularly strong or deeply-embedded memories provide an especially powerful boost (this power is especially helpful on those with traumatic memories, those with repressed memories, or those with memory based abilities)
pros: Take away their memories of the foe, temporarily making them forgetful
Taking their memories also delays having to eat or rest (and bestows the foe's memories)
Foes with Panmnesia, Photographic Memory, Memory Manipulation

name: Human Snow Globe
overview: make fallen and falling snowflakes fly everywhere when you shake your body.
description: This power only works where it snowed or where it's snowing. By shaking your body, you can make every snowflake in a 7-meter radius separate and fly all over the place while remaining in the same radius. When you stop shaking, the snowflakes will fall naturally.
pros: Through training, you can increase the radius to 10 meters.
If it stopped snowing, you can make the fallen snow fall again.
Perfect for Christmas

It's limited in radius.

name: Living Laser

You can be any color and you can direct yourself at any surface. Things that you are carrying become part of the laser beam as well, so you can take things (or people) with you.
pros: You can bounce yourself off of mirrors.
You are hot, so you can burn through things
It's good for combat

name: Ectoplasm Manipulation

Control ectoplasmic energy
