name: Optic Chromamorphism
overview: change one's eye color.
description: While more or less completely useless, this power does have a very impressive name. This ability comes in several variations. Some wielders of this ability may only be able to change their eyes between two colors. Some may be able to change either eye to a different color. Some may be able to go mirror. Some may only be able to change their iris colour, others may be able to change their whites or pupils. And so on.

Scare the hell out of people by turning your eye's blood red.
Be the life of parties!

name: Big
overview: manipulate being large yourself without any bodily change.
description: This power let's you control the general aspects of largeness in yourself. You can see from high up and view a wide area without being in the air. You can deliver blows as if they were done by a giant. You also can be noticable to anyone you want within limits as a large thing would be. You could give yourself the inertia of large things to be near-unstopable or use large things general property of traveling extremely far so you could cross miles in one step.

Powerful.
Useful.

name: Phytokinesis
overview: control and manipulate leaves
description: Also called Leaf Manipulation. Using this power, you can control leaves. Not whole trees, not flowers, leaves. You can pull them off of trees and stir them into a flurry to distract foes, or make them paper-thin and razor-sharp to use as throwing blades. You can even stop them mid-fall, fuse them together into rudimentary tools and weapons (like joining five at the stem to make a leaf ninja star) and the like
pros: Leaves can be moved to your will
They can also be made razor-sharp and paper-thin, to be used as little blades

name: Inner Darkness
overview: transform into your inner demon.
description: This power is rare to find, because there are a few conditions that must be met, at least one. (Either one: A person must have been possessed by a demon and survive, two: the person must confront with his/her inner demon through insanity, or three: the devil gives the person this power before the day they were born.) Once you activate it, you will transform into the demon made by your own darkness, depending your personality. The demon will destroy what causes you misery and woe.

name: Snake Mastery

pros: You can talk to snakes just like Harry Potter does!
They will always obey you

Your were-snake form will take some getting used to

name: Four Eyes: Mesmerize
overview: hypnotize anyone who looks into your eyes
description: This power is gained by using the long distance and aura seeing parts of the Four Eyes power equally. The Four Eyes power will slowly turn into this power. Whenever anyone stares into all four of your eyes simultaneously, they become hypnotized and act like a statue for one hour unless you tell them otherwise. This does not work on the strongwilled.
pros: You can beat up an enemy for an hour then freeze him again and repeat.
You can still use the other Four Eyes powers.
This is an evolved form of Four Eyes.
cons: Must have Four Eyes power and use all parts equally.

You cannot get the other Four Eyes evolutions anymore.

name: Halloween Costumes
overview: turn people into the costume they are wearing on Halloween.
description: With this power you have the ability to turn people permanently into the real version of the costume they are wearing on Halloween night. They will have all the powers and/or skills that come with the costume they are wearing. If you focus this power on somebody you can make the costume take the person over so that their personality is replaced based on what they are dressing up as. Need a different power to reverse the affects of this power.

Make their costumes control them.

Zombies, Ghosts, ect. On the rampage.
People using their new powers to get revenge on you for changing them.

name: Animal Spirit Discovery
overview: discover your unique animal spirit.
description: Do your friends describe you as proud? Brave? Loyal? Then this journey of self-discovery may end with your gaining a beastly lion animal spirit. Perhaps your persuasive, charismatic demeanor will produce a long, exotic python. Whatever form your animal spirit takes, your mind will be forever linked to it. It could become your best companion or your most powerful weapon...
pros: Spirit could take the form of a powerful animal.
You and the spirit share each other's thoughts.

You feel the spirit's physical and mental pain.

name: Touch Of Death
overview: cause the sudden death of any living organism at will.
description: With this ability, you can cause any organism to suddenly die by touching it. This includes all carbon-based organisms, such as the organisms here on Earth, and even viruses. Of course, you have full control over this ability, meaning you can't accidentally kill something or someone. No pain is inflicted, nor is there any symptom before death--the organism just ceases to live. Just in case, you have a 10 second window in which you can reverse the death, but touch is still required.

Killing off harmful viruses in your body (or others')
I suppose this would be useful if you were a butcher

name: Bleeding Time

Your heart is a pathway to temporal awareness (you can feel time & space within your heart). Oxygenating your blood causes you to slip from one place in time to another. You can direct your path by tasting your blood & thinking of where to go. You can take a friend with you by cutting them & mixing blood. If your heart is pierced, you will not die but you will exist forever, nowhere.

Kill people in agonising pain, who actually deserve it.

name: Power Bypass

description: With this ability, one can bypass any protective measures of a foe, but only one power at a time. For instance, you can use it to burn someone with Fireproof Body. name: Human Atom

The rotating objects must all have relatively the same mass. With practice the user can also create different rings of rotation like an atom. name: Manchurian Candidate
overview: turn anyone into a secret assassin.
description: With this power, you can speak someone's name to any other person. The next time these two people meet, the person you spoke to will be compelled to kill the one you named. They will go about the assassination as if they had just decided to kill their victim themselves. The assassin has no idea that they will try to kill their target until they meet them.

Change the tide of battle by shouting the name of the enemy commander.
cons: You may not be trusted by people who know you can do this.
You do not control how your assassin will kill the target.

name: Rise Of The Leviathan

description: With this power you can turn into the Leviathan, a mythical sea serpent that has extremely tough armor like skin, can breathe fire and is about thirty football fields long.

Anyone who is not the sender or the intended recipients won't understand the message at all. For example, a visual message will appear as a blur to them, an auditory one as static noise, or a tactile one as a rough surface. The intended receivers don't have to be aware a message is being sent to them.

The user can drastically reduce the amount of randomness of objects by touch--block towers reassemble, scattered cards come together in the correct order, crumbled walls become pristine. The downside is you can only imprint what you already know.

overview: possess the amazing magical powers of The Monkey King.
description: You can really go ape with this ability, but you may be able to possess his signature weapon "will-following golden-banded staff" which you can shrink down to the size of a needle and keep behind you ear, as well as expand to gigantic proportions. You also can become immortal, transform into 72 different images, employ clouds as vehicles, turn clumps of your hair into any object you desire, see through most illusions and can even multiply yourself.
pros: Many interesting powers to channel
cons: May be too clever for your own good

name: Spontaneous Combustion
overview: spontaneously burst into flames at a moment's glance
description: Ever needed to cut a path through the woods on a hiking trip? Why not start a forest fire and eliminate all your wooded competition? Ever been in a fight you knew you couldn't win? I doubt you've ever met someone who could punch a campfire without crying like a pansy. When the going gets tough, combust!
pros: You decide when to explode
You cannot be contained, walls won't stop you
The best thing that could happen to you is being doused in gasoline
cons: Severe dehydration results from never being able to take a drink

name: Biopotence
overview: know everything about biology.
description: One who has this power knows everything about biology, even how to change it.
pros: Instant degree in biology-related subjects
Knows how to change one's biology to gain abilities
cons: Needs labrotory equipment to change one's biology

name: The Bizarro Effect
overview: create short-lived opposite versions of people.
description: Just like Superman and Bizarro but your bizarro versions only exist for a hour. Behavior and powers get flipped around. IQ does also unless IQ of the subject was average. You have to focus on a subject for a 30 seconds and then you've got a opposite of that person. Not all powers are made opposite(e. G. Superman and Bizarro). One or more might stay the same.
pros: Temporary allies with counter powers to foes you're facing.
A opposite version of a insane foe to help you fight the insane foe.
A villainous version of the most law-abiding foe you have.
cons: Someone uses this power on use you.
There are powers that stop cloning or duplication.
If you're a villain you know that villains can turn on each other.

name: Solar Arm Cannon
overview: have a cannon arm that runs on solar energy
description: Your right arm turns into a cannon that fire solar energy. Anything caught in the blast is burned or turned to ashes.
pros: Arm cannon is indestructible
Fires solar energy like a beam
burns things
cons: Runs on solar energy

name: Death Eater's Aura
overview: receive life, power and strength directly from someone's death.
description: He who possesses this ability has the unholy power to wield death and decay in order to empower his life. He becomes stronger, more powerful, and vigorously more alive whenever someone else in his presence becomes subjected to death's cold embrace. Ironic as it may seem, any method of harm that is supposed to kill him empowers and strengthens him instead.
pros: You reap life and power from the deaths of those you kill or whenever someone dies in your presence.
You do not fear death instead you embrace it and draw life and power from it.
Better than being immortal.
cons: You are not immune to aging, you are not invulnerable, and you cannot regenerate wounds/scars.
Your body looks and feels like hell due to your gaping wounds. Becoming a skeleton is a good idea.

name: Wish Granting Rituals
overview: know how to create wish-granting objects
description: You know a variety of magical/mystical (or sufficiently advanced, if you're a science type) rituals which you can use to imbue objects with wish-granting power or spirits. Oil lamps, monkey paws, and wells are the most common, but you can do it with just about anything. However, the rules and potency varies on the object and ritual: Lamps might have faithful and nigh-omnipotent spirits, but an unbreakable limit on the number of wishes. Paws have a malleable number, but the wishes are corrupt.
pros: You can vary up the rules a bit (but there is almost always a limit on the wish number)
Wells/fountains can grant infinite wishes (with a coin, at least), but they need to be REAL ones
You can make wish-corrupting curse objects and give them away
cons: The ritual must be perfect- any slip will cause a demon that auto-corrupts all wishes
Can not re-use an object that is used up. If you use a lamp, after three, you need a new one
Your creations, and even you, will be the most coveted things on the face of the earth

name: Necro Possesion
overview: control the undead.
description: With Necro Possesion you can take any deceased corpse and make them do anything. This ability is not only limited to humans but animals as well. This power can work on skeletons as well.
pros: Undefeatable army
Revive friends
Manipulate the undead
cons: Does not work on cremated bodies
Takes time to master

name: Split Persona
overview: let out your light side and your dark side
description: This uniqe ability allows the user to let out two sides of his/her personality, each with powers of their own that represent that side of the personality. For example, the dark side could have powers like super strength or super senses.
pros: Your light side makes a great companion and friend
Each side has its own powers
cons: Your dark side might be hard to control
You can only let them out and back in or in other words no powers for you

name: Artifactof Light:Eternal Grimore
overview: use the grimore of the wold.
description: The grimore is able to scan any object it comes in contact with, and endlessly replicate the object of some part of it. If scanning another book for example it is posssible to get another copy of the book, or anything described in the book.
pros: Can replicate any weapon, real or from any story.
Same goes for any power.
Wrighting in the book, allows the user to change composition of the world.
cons: Using the book tires the user, requiring regular resting times.
Can only have so many replicas at once.

name: Contract Nullification
overview: nullify any contract, promise, or obligation
description: With this power, you can break any sort of obligation. If your true love was bitten by a vampire, you can sever his/her blood contract and they don't have to obey whoever bit them. Contracted demons are sent back to the demon realm. Not usable against Mythpower: Styx Bond since that will undoubtedly destroy every promises that ever existed, so to prevent that it will not work. Things that have already been done because of the contract are not negated.
pros: Take out huge loans then nullify the contract
Severe magical contracts
Save people from fulfilling undesired conditions
cons: People will still go after you for not keeping "promises"

name: Sonic Power
overview: use the powers of Sonic The Hedgehog
description: With this (much needed) power u can use Sonic the hedgehog's power. This includes: Chaos control, Superspeed, Ultimate wind resistance, Super and Hyper form, And Head invulnerability
pros: Become a human super hedgehog
All these powers in 1 package
cons: If you hate speed
Need 7 different colored gems to turn hyper and super
Only invulnerability to the head area nowhere else

name: Mental Freefall
overview: generate the feeling of freefall in another
description: Cause others to feel as though they are in total free-fall, disorienting them, making them sick or even stopping their heart from fear. Advanced users of this ability complete the illusion by fooling the victim's mind into "seeing" that they are falling, doubling or even tripling the effect.
pros: Disorient Victims
Good for clean getaways
People who fear heights
cons: Less effective on Brave, Psychic, or Mental Powered people

name: Myth Power: Hyperion's Watch
overview: channel Hyperion's command over the essence of light, watching and observation
description: Hyperion, in Greek myth, was the Titan god of light, watching and observation. As such, channeling him allows one to generate and manipulate all spectra of light; this includes forming it into rays, lasers, flashes and bolts; bending it to turn invisible (self and others), cast illusions and project one's sight to other locations; or repelling it to generate darkness. In addition, one can perceive light on all bands, to spot invisible subjects, camouflagers, light-based illusions and the like.
pros: Control light (blast it, repulse it, change its temperature, make yourself glow, etc)
Turn invisible, cast light-based illusions; when developed, turn temporarily into an entity of light
Perceive all bands of light at will (detecting light-based illusion, camouflage/invisibility, etc)
cons: Cannot sense, absorb or disrupt/negate photokinetic powers until the higher levels (no Con Negation)
Light Absorption or Light Repulsion provide immunity (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Aura Manipulation
overview: generate and manipulate the auras emanated from all living things.
description: One with this ability can change auras, causing them to give off the indication that a threat is really harmless, or they can cause an aura to show a certain emotion while they really feel another. One with this power could even use their aura to appear different without actually shapeshifting, or induce certain affects within the auras of others, including inducing Pacifism, aging or even repulsing or restricting movement.
pros: making meditation
sensing auras of all living things
cons: sensing dangerous aura

name: Shadow Kinetic Beam
overview: indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to redirect it as a piercing beam.
description: The user can absorb potiential energy around them in order to turn it into a grayish beam that can pierce almost anything especially anything that can't move.
pros: Powerful energy beam
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
cons: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Bullets To Paintballs
overview: turn bullets into paintballs
description: With this power you can turn any kind of bullets into any color paintball. This is useful if your are being chased by someone with a gun you can just turn all their bullets into paintballs. Or if you're already being shot at you can just turn the oncoming bullets into paintballs. You are unable to turn paintballs into bullets with this power.
pros: You can turn bullets into paintballs
cons: You are unable to turn the paintballs back into bullets

name: Dovahkiin
overview: be the dragonborn of legend
description: With this power you can absorb dragon's souls to make your self more powerful. You can learn dragon words of power to unleash a mighty thu'um or dragon shout. Each shout has 3 words of power to it
pros: Great at slaying dragons
Can unleash massive power
No telling how powerful you might become
cons: Dragons try to kill you alot
Might hurt friends and or family with some of your thu'um's
Some people will fear you for your power others may abuse you for it if your not careful

name: Star O Kinesis
overview: take stars out of the sky and use them as weapons
description: Star-o-kinesis allows you to take stars from the sky and turn them into 5-pointed blades that you can throw at your enemies with your mind.
pros: The star-blades can be fatal if they cut open any major arteries
You can throw them with your mind and avoid cutting yourself with one of the blades
They go too fast to be dodged by anyone who does not have super speed
cons: You can only use this power at night
Accuracy cannot be guaranteed during a full moon
You cannot use this power on cloudy nights

name: Word Injection
overview: insert a word into anyone's thoughts
description: According to many theories, people tend to think in words. A person with this power has the ability to insert a word into other people's thoughts. The word will immediately pop up in their head and they will think that they thought of the word. The word can be any length and can be a made-up word. If used when someone is speaking, they have a 90% chance of accidentally speaking whatever word you inserted. This can also be used to invoke fear by inserting the word fear into their mind.
pros: You can make them think that they think you sound good by inserting good in their minds
Make people mess up their lines by inserting a random word into their thoughts
cons: Does not come with telepathy
If the person does not understand the word
It must be in a language the person understands

name: Poppins Bag
overview: place inside another bag and it becomes bottomless
description: Using the Poppins bag you can line your back pack, purse or other handbag, making it bottomless. Anything big or small will then fit in your bag, weight not being an issue.
pros: Easy to move items
Will work with any type of bag/pack
Won't forget things or not bring them due to heavyness
cons: Lose it or someone steals it and that would suck, they'd have everything

name: Insatiable
overview: eat as much as you want without getting full or gaining weight.
description: With this power, you can never be full. You either have a bottomless stomach or an insane metabolism: Possibly both. And since it is impossible for you to eat enough, you can never gain weight or suffer from overeating.  You probably also have such an efficient digestive system that you never have to use the bathroom.
pros: You never feel the pain of being way too full.
You always have room to finish eating your food and/or anyone else's.
You can never get fat from eating too much.
cons: Never being full means that you are ALWAYS hungry.
You have a monstrous appetite, which can use up all your money if you are the one feeding yourself.
People are reluctant to feed you because you will eat all their food if given the chance.

name: Surprise Box
overview: get an object you didn't expect out of this box.
description: The Surprise Box works on surprise value. When you open it, it will give you an item which is always useful to you in the current situation if used correctly, but it will always be something noone could expect. So, it's up to you to discover how to use it. It can be something which seems useless, like a whistle, a bouquet or a bicycle pump. It can be a magical object with powers. The box can even surprise you by giving you what you wanted but thought you wouldn't get because you expected it.
pros: If your opponent is a precog, the box will overload their visions with all the possibilities.
There is always a way to make use of whatever you obtain to get you out of the situation.
If someone knows the future, the box will change it.
cons: You have to learn to improvise and the box can be stolen.
It can happen that you never discover how to use the object.
If there's a way you could succeed on your own, the box may give you nothing.

name: The Scepter
overview: cause anyone physical damage by gesturing with one's hand
description: With this power alone you can cause anyone to suddenly get 100 cuts all over their body without actually being cut by making a slashing motion. The depth of each cut is random and can be from. 002 millimetres to 4 centimetres. If you have the powers, 'The Throne' and 'The Crown' as well then you can cause the damage without gesturing.
pros: You can make anyone go nuts trying to figure out why they're hurt if you have all three powers.
This will seriously hurt anyone it affects.
cons: You can get caught if you don't have the other two powers as well.

name: Potential Unlocking Blood
overview: unlock hidden potential power of others with one's blood
description: Anyone who drinks your blood will be able to use the full powers that they were born with (but can't use yet) along with all powers of higher leveled beings of their race. Ex: an ordinary vampire could become a daywalker or a kitsune could gain tails to become a nine-tailed fox. Also, if the being has no potential for ESP or magic your blood cannot give them those abilities.
pros: Allies can now fight at full power.
Works even with a drop of blood. May be a con.
cons: Letting enemies get ahold of vials of your blood.
Will not give powers that a being does not have the potential for.

name: End Of The Line
overview: foreknow how any object will end its life just by touching it.
description: Everything that exists today, living and non-living, will one day cease to be. This power allows you to know when and how an object will end its life just by touching it. Some examples: for a table, this would be when it ceases to be a table (eg. it is irreparably broken or burned), for a car, this could be a crash, but for a living creature this would be it's death. When an object ceases to be what it is at the moment (a shoe, a couch, a living being) - that's what you'll see.
pros: Know in advance when catastrophes are going to occur.
Have some knowledge of future events, allowing you to plan accordingly.
cons: Cannot be switched off; every human touch will become horrific.
The event is inevitable, but you may be able to save people involved (eg. a bridge collapse).
Buying a new car would be quite a scary experience...

name: Your Killer Is...
overview: determine who killed a person
description: With this power whenever you stand within ten feet of a dead body you will instantly know who the killer was (if there was one). If the person died of natural means this power will do absolutely nothing.
pros: You are able to determine who a person's killer is
cons: Not much use in physical combat
If the person died of natural means this power does nothing

name: Anamnesis
overview: resist all manipulation or alteration of memory
description: This ability is not as powerful as many other memory-based abilities, but it does help. This power keeps the user's memory from being absorbed, stolen, erased, distorted or otherwise manipulated. If the user takes drugs, drinks alcohol, is possessed, is mentally dominated, or the like, he will not lose memory of the event. Blackouts don't incur memory loss, the user is incapable of geting amnesia and the only way to impair memory is to remove parts of the brain.
pros: Memory can't be distorted, manipulate, absorbed, blocked, etc. (power often accompanies Panmnesia)
You can actually REMEMBER the good time you had when you got drunk or high
Immunity to blackouts and amnesia (and you can remember if you are mentally possessed or dominated)
cons: Doesn't imply total recall
Drugs still loosen your inhibitions (this may not be a bad thing)
You can still go unconscious (but you remember the time during which the body is inert)

name: Passover Power
overview: turn into a mist and put almost every one to sleep
description: Wherever and whenever danger occurs, you change into a large mist that'll not kill, but  to make everyone dose off.
pros: You might only use this power outside.
cons: Whenever you use this power, you can slip inside building of enemy bases.

name: Pain Transference
overview: transfer all pain and injuries to the next person you touch.
description: Passive ability. All pain and injuries that are dealt to you (self inflicted or otherwise) will be transferred to the next person you touch. This ability only works with injuries that will not kill you. It unfortunately works with the sense of pleasure, so apathy is sure to follow.
pros: All fights end with you leaving without a scratch and your opponent bloodied
Feel wronged? Break your arm and shake your enemy's hand.
You feel no pain
cons: You feel no pain, so you might think you're invincible.
Might hurt loved ones. Sorry mom!
Also feel no pleasure. Sucks for you!

name: 0 Blood
overview: instantly destroy all blood in a person's body by touching them and saying, "Die"
description: Every single speck of blood will from the person's body in an instant. Thus they will die of no oxygen after a few minutes.
pros: Near instant kill unless target has Bloodless.
10 minutes or so is not enough to replace 50% of the blood in a person's body.
cons: Blood Manipulation can negate the effect. Infinite Blood prevents this power from working at all.
Ability Reflection or Immunity can be annoying.

name: Summoning To Powers
overview: change a person-summoning power into a ability-gifting power
description: You will be able to turn powers that allow you to summon persons, into powers where you gain their abilities instead. This effect can be reversed.
pros: Gain the abilities of the beings you wanna summon.
cons: Cannot acquire powers of summoned objects.

name: Atomic Knowledge
overview: know atomic makeup of everything in sight.
description: With this power, you know the elements that make up every molecule of every substance you can see. You can inspect anything in sight, and remember everything. You can choose to forget things you've seen, unless it comes back in sight. You can't turn off this power, and it might overwhelm you if you aren't careful.
pros: Be the ultimate scientist.
Figure out the truth of the world.
Forget unwanted elemental compounds.
cons: No combat uses. (Except for knowing your opponent's atomic makeup, if it is confusing. )
You cant control this power, and you may get overwhelmed.
Sometimes, the dark secrets of the universe overwhelm you before you can forget about them.

name: Water Nymph
overview: be a water nymph and control water
description: You just become a water nymph which is similar to a mermaid but not quite. A water nymph doe not have a tail like a mermaid does; therefore this is more common.
pros: You only have webbed toes (less conspicuous)
You can control water
You can breathe and talk underwater
cons: You can't control it for the first few weeks

name: Emotion Swap
overview: change emotions.
description: Either change others emotions or your own, or swap them. You may get unwanted emotions.
pros: Change emotions of others
Change your emotions
Swap emotions with others.
cons: May get unwanted emotions

name: Gift: Weather.
overview: be gifted at the control of the weather
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling the weather than other beings. Thus their weather-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of the weather from them. However, someone with this power can only receive weather-based powers, nothing else.
pros: Almost no one has as good control over the weather as someone with this power.
Weather-based powers are boosted slightly.
cons: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only weather-based powers now.

name: Celtic Invocation: Brigid
overview: invoke to power of Brigid, the Irish goddess of the three flames.
description: An invoker of this power has power of the three types of flame: the flame of inspiration, the flame of health, and the flame of crafting. By channelling the flame of inspiration, the invoker may inspire artists around them, to create fantastic arts. By channelling the flame of health, the invoker may burn out disease and infection from people's bodies, as well as increase the targets healing factor. By channelling the flame of crafting, the invoker may increase and control normal fire and heat.
pros: The flame of inspiration makes you many friends among the artistic types.
The flame of health ensures that you will never fall sick, cold, or become injured for too long.
The flame of crafting makes sure that all flames will do as what you want.
cons: Too much use of the flame of inspiration will drive the targets insane.
The flame of health does not instantly heal flesh wounds -- it only increases the healing rate.
The flame of crafting can not create flame from nothing. It can only control already existing fire.

name: Broken Summoning
overview: cause any object appear right next to you as long as you have a piece of it in your hand
description: With this power you can cause anything to appear right next to you as long as you are already holding a piece of it. So you can cut a part of off somebody's wallet and then make it appear right next to you and take their money. Or you can cut off a part of your enemy (a nail or a hair, or a hand or something) and stand next to a jail cell so the enemy will appear in it.
pros: You can cause anything to appear right next to you as long as you are already holding a piece of it
You can do it as many times as you want
cons: You have to be holding a piece of something for this power to work

name: Thorn Strike
overview: shoot thorns from your hand
description: With this power you can shoot an unlimited amount of thorns from the palms of both of your hands. The thorns can penetrate even some of the strongest materials such as stone and metal.
pros: You can shoot thorns out of your hand
The thorns can pierce even some of the toughest materials
cons: You might accidentally shoot yourself with a thorn

name: Robot Parts
overview: turn your body into robotic parts
description: Different parts of your body can be turned into robotic parts. You will look like a cyborg, but it can be switched off anytime so you can become fully human again. You can be power by electricity (which you can absorb) or by a battery of some sorts (internal/external). You are able to from a part of your body into a powerfull battery.
pros: You can transform into robotic parts.
You can become electronic devices.
absorb electricity to power yourself
cons: You can rust.
You're susceptible to EMPs and magnetic powers
You'll need a power source for the devices

name: Insect Controller
overview: control insects to do whatever you want, and have insects come to your aid.
description: With this ability, you can control bugs to do as you wish. No matter what kind of insect or how far it is, and yes, it must be an ACTUAL insect, they will come at the snap of your finger.
pros: You can play some pretty good pranks.
Helpful at the toughest physical situations.
You'll be a whiz in entomology class.
cons: Bugs will worship you, meaning finding you at the worst of times.
Pranks could backfire.
They may use your ear as a nest.

name: Dream Leeching
overview: put anyone to sleep and gain strength through their dreams
description: By touching someone's forehead, you can put them to sleep where they start to dream. Then, you can drain energy, absorbing and gaining strength from their positive happy dreams. They only sleep from 2 to 9 hours, depending on how well they sleep and can be awoken at anytime. Also, you become weak if they have a nightmare, or if they become lucid, meaning they control their dreams and sever your psychic link with them.
pros: Put anyone to sleep where they start to dream
Draw strength from their happy dreams
cons: They sleep for up to 9 hours or less depending on how well a sleeper they are
They can awake at any time
Nightmares and lucid dreamers can weaken you

name: Indignation
overview: call down the lightning of the gods.
description: "I, who stand in the full light of the Heavens, command thee, who opens the Gates of Hell. Come forth, divine lightning! This ends now. Indignation." - Jade Curtis. Divine lightning that obliterates almost any opponent. The only thing able to to stand up against Dhaos, the Time Traveler from Derris Khar'lan! Can be light, lightning, or wind elemental. Many ways to obtain, may need to contact the Summon Spirit Luna, or learn it yourself by studying magic.
pros: Jade Curtis the Fonologist - Most famous user of Indignation
Genis Sage the Genius Mage - First to upgrade Indignation to the powerful Indignation Judgement
Rita Mordio the Blastia Weirdo - Most recent user of Indignation
cons: Mithos Yggdrasil - Evil angel, instigator of a gynocidal hallocaust. Also uses Indignation Judgement
Neblim the Teacher - Replica of the powerful fonologist Neblim, user of every form of Fonology.
Dhoas - Can only be killed with Indignation. He fights with DHOAS LASER.

name: Depth Perception
overview: control people's depth perception
description: A person with this power has the ability to control a person's sense of depth perception. This can be used in many ways. For example, you can make yourself seem farther or closer. In battle, you can attack people who are unprepared for your attacks, thinking that you are farther away. Also, it is very hard to hit you since they have a higher chance to miss you or not get a direct hit.
pros: Make other people unable to predict where you are
cons: This power does not fool radars or other senses

name: Love Seat
overview: cast a spell on any chair/couch/bench so that when somebody sits in it they fall in love with you
description: With this power you can cast a spell on any chair/couch/bench/stool so that when somebody of the opposite gender as yourself sits in it they instantly fall in love you even if they've never met you before. It only works on people of the opposite gender as yourself and you can only make them fall in love with you.
pros: You can make anybody of the opposite gender fall in love you
cons: Only works on chairs/benches/couches/stools
Only works on people of the opposite gender
You can only make them fall in love with you

name: M Part
overview: use any metahuman's superpowered body part
description: You could transfer any superpowered part to any part of your body. Infuse yourself with Cyclop's eyes, Batman's brain, the Thing's fists, the Flash's legs, the Hulk's arms, or block bullets with Power Girl's chest. Close your eyes, focus and empower yourself.
pros: Invision any super-part, touch that part of your body & you will have that part with their power
M-Part looks like the part of the person you borrowed it from
Interchange abilities, ex. Firestorm's hand & Mr. Fantastic's brain would make you formidable
cons: Borrow only two parts at a time for 12 hours or until you return the use to the owner
Takes a lot of focus to return the power to owner before expiration time
The part is useless and numb to the owner while you are powered

name: Timely Appearance
overview: appear at the most unexpected time in a fight
description: Are your friends surrounded by a bounch of enemies, a deadly creature or a very difficult to kill bad guy that only you could beat, but you are too far away to arrive in time? No problem, with this ability it's sure that you will arrive just in time to block that deadly blast directed to your friend, beat the bad guy(s) and save the day. Does not matter if you are a hole continent away from that place, a bunch of lucky circunstances will get you there just in time.
pros: You will be the hero of the day
Your friends will not die
Always arrive at scene in the best dramatic entry
cons: The fact that you arrive does not mean that you can beat the bad guy
You will not have any advantages in battle
That people depend on you is not always good

name: Arrow Strike
overview: shoot arrows from your hand
description: With this power you can shoot arrows (as in bow and arrows) from either of your hands. The arrows work like normal arrows but they are twice as durable and twice as fast.
pros: You can pierce people's chests or heads with arrows
You have an unlimited supply of arrows
They are twice as strong and fast as normal arrows so they can cause more damage
cons: They can't pierce very powerful armor or helmets

name: Solitaire
overview: throw out light filled energy cards that stuns enemies
description: It's an ability that can shoot out kinetic flash of light cards that stuns enemies and even damages some. You can even hit your opponents that are out of reach, whether too high, too far away, or too dangerous to reach for. It can be directed upwards, as well.
pros: You could be even powerful as Gambit
cons: Nothing worse really

name: Blurbed
overview: have popup balloons of information appear over a foe's head.
description: This power will let you know things about a foe. Useful, useless and dull or useless and funny and/or humiliating. There's a 33. 3333333% chance each could appear. The factoids are 2-D balloons that you will always be able to see and read. These factoids will stay for three seconds. What you find out could be his weaknesses, his favorite color or things that a tabloid would pay good money to know.
pros: 33% chance of a fact popping up to help you win a fight.
33% chance of a fact popping up that a tabloid pay good money to know.
Telling a foe about a weird secret they're keeping could distract them in a fight.
cons: 33% chance to learn when he learned to walk.

name: Liquid Storage
overview: absorb all large liquids into the body
description: Absorb liquids no matter how large into the body, then become able to use hydrokinesis.
pros: Good for making a country turn against its leader due to drought problems.
Be able to use water attacks
Good for when you're thirsty.
cons: You can't drain liquid from living things.
You have to resupply every time you use a huge amount of water.
If liquid amount is large enough, it can leak from the body.

name: Myth Power: Deimos' Dread
overview: channel Deimos' command over the essence of dread, panic and cowardice
description: Deimos (Deimus), in Greek myth, was the god of dread, panic, alarm and cowardice. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive panic and timidity, at will. In addition, one can psychically induce and negate panic and timidity, by touch, word or thought. Furthermore, one gains physical power by scaring, startling or alarming (making them nervous, or making them outright panic). One can even withstand irrational nervousness, timidity, dread or panic, which may be shared, by touch.
pros: Psychically perceive panic and timidity, at will; psychically induce and negate panic, by touch
Gain physical power by naturally scaring or startling others (making them nervous, etc)
Withstand nervousness, timidity, dread and panic (may be shared by touch)
cons: Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel natural cowards, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically cast frightening illusions, to pop out and frighten foes, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Ares' Wrath, MythPower: Enyo's Laugh, Fearlessness, etc provide immunity

name: Temporal Destination Control
overview: control when in time a time traveler goes when they time travel.
description: Within a 100 feet of you, time travelers go to a past or future time of your choice. Mentally preset this time or change it whenever you want. The time you choose can't exceed the temporal limits of the time travel power of anyone affected by this power.
pros: Send foes to a dark, dead and cold future universe.
A good combo with a teleportation control power.
cons: Time defiance or powers like it provide immunity to this power (NCN).
Someone's time travel ability may be limited.

name: Hydra Morph
overview: transform into the Hydra, a creature with nine heads and a poisonous breath.
description: With this ability, you can transform into a Hydra, a creature with nine heads and a poisonous breath. Every time a Hydra's head is sliced off, it is replaced with two additional heads. A Hydra's breath is so virulent that it kills nearly everything it touches, and is breathed as a dark, purple cloud of poison.
pros: Grow back two heads every time one is cut off.
Your breath can kill anything; it can easily kill any average human.
You can revert to your normal form at any given time.
cons: Your heads cannot grow back if they are singed while regenerating.
Your form resets itself once you revert to normal.

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Thrones
overview: become a bizarre-looking angel of justice and authority.
description: The Thrones, also known as the Ophanim, are the manifestations of justice and righteous authority. Their appearances were rather strange and otherworldly, unlike the other angels. They appear as beryl-colored wheel-within-a-wheel, their rims covered and speckled with hundreds of eyes.
pros: Harness the power of justice and authority to your own extent.
Utilize rays of light and purification to instill justice
As any angel, you are capable of taking on the form of a human or a beast.
cons: None really.

name: Hosting Game
overview: capture people and place them in your mind, forcing them to play a game of survival.
description: You can capture people and place them in your mind, where you can control a game of survival.  You can see if the people care about each other or not. If they don't make it out, you can take their special ability.  They won't be able to come out unless you kill them, in which case they will come out. The people that survive will come out.
pros: You can control the game
cons: They might get out

name: Figure Bluffing
overview: be able to turn into a figure of your imagination if others believe you are really that.
description: If you say your a doctor that can heal all cases and at least 1,000 people believe that, then you are able to become that figure you made up.
pros: If you can convince others easily.
cons: It would be kinda hard convincing others that you are a godly figure.
You can only create 3 figures a day.

name: Cursing
overview: create the worst case scenario for any person of your choosing.
description: When you use this power, the target's worst case scenario will happen.  The result varies between people depending on what their worst case scenario is.
pros: Revenge
cons: Absolute power may corrupt you

name: Miracle: Water Walk
overview: increase the power of surface tension
description: With this abiliy you can "walk" on water like a water strider by increasing the surface tension of the water. You can apply this to other fluids besides water as well.
pros: Walk on water
Prevent spills by making the water stick together in one glob which you can then pick up
Water bed
cons: You must have great control in order to do this
You can't control the water only increase its tension

name: Universal Solvent
overview: create and control alkahest
description: The first thing most people think about when hearing the term alchemy is the so called "Philosopher's Stone", but a lesser known substance sought by alchemists was something called alkahest-a substance that can dissolve anything. A person with this power can create alkahest and use it to dissolve anything they want. Also they control the alkahest so they don't need a container. Once made alkahest will absorb anything and everything that it comes in contact. Alkahest cannot become saturated.
pros: Alkahest dissolves anything-- even photons or energy
You can undissolve elements from the alkahest--great for stealing gold, silver, etc.
You can control it so you don't need a container
cons: If it gets on you and you don't know how to control it
Once you make some you can't contain it unless you have a vacuum
You need to have control in order selectively dissolve things such as poison from your blood

name: Railway Teleportation
overview: teleport by touching a railway a one location and reappearing at another.
description: As long as two locations share a railroad track connection you can teleport between the two locations. You must touch a length of railway at one location to teleport. You also must know the second location. As a side benefit you're invulnerable to any damage a on coming train could do to you. This invulnerability extends to any parts of a train thrown at you.
pros: Teleport anywhere were train tracks exist.
When teleporting trains can't hurt you.
cons: You'll have to memorize or keep a book of of teleport locations.
You must make contact with a railway track to teleport.

name: Alligator Mimicry
overview: mimic the skills of an alligator
description: With this power you can mimic the skills of an alligator. You can open your jaw very widely, you have very sharp teeth, you can jump long distances, you have almost impenetrable skin and claws.
pros: You can mimic the skills of an alligator
cons: You can't mimic the skills of a crocodile

name: Phantom Anatomy
overview: utilize organs which are phantasmal (ghostly) in nature, that can interact with other phantom things
description: Also called Phantom Body or Phantom Body Parts, this ability implies the presence of organs which are invisible and intangible to the naked eye. However, this doesn't mean the whole BODY is invisible or intangible; the user may have a Phantom Eye that allows him to see the invisible, Phantom Arms that allow him to touch the intangible; a Phantom Brain that allows the user to perceive the presence of ghosts, Phantom Bones or the like.
pros: Phantom body parts or body systems are immune normal harm (and still function normally)
Interact with similarly-imperceptible things (Phantom Ears hear ghostly noises, etc. )
Make phantom body parts visible with light concentration (or in sunlight)
cons: If powers aren't strong enough, phantom body parts make the user look like an amputee
If adaptation goes wrong, phantom body parts phase out of the body (you DIE)
Phantom things are exposed to phantom danger (phantom ears sensitive to white noise, etc. )

name: Montage
overview: target something or someone and speed them up in montage fashion
description: A montage is a rapid succession of abruptly altering scenes that change the outcome of or the situation once returning to the problem. Basically you can choose a person, a thing or many different targets and selectively speed them up at different intervals or even the same interval. What you will hear in the montage is your own personal theme music instead of actual sounds.
pros: Learn new skills in 5 or 10 seconds
Travel great distances in same amount of time
Theme music can be which ever song you choose
cons: Targets have their own free will, so they can do anything they want and you can't stop them.

name: Lava Secretion
overview: fire volcanic lava from your hands
description: Lava secretion lets you spew lava from your hands as a projectile. Not much else to say about that.
pros: Doesn't harm you when power is used
Causes a painful melting death for your enemies
cons: You might surround yourself with lava accidently
Once the lava is there, it stays there
Causes massive fires.

name: Kolasi Generation
overview: generate the flames of hell.
description: This power allows you generate the flames of kolasi, the flames of hell, damnation, and inferno. By using this ability, these flames are not ordinary; they do not extinguish easily. They are also way more intense than normal flames. If something is even capable of extinguishing these flames, it leaves behind nothing, not even ashes.
pros: Powerful fire.
cons: If it gets out of control...

name: Siri Mind Link
overview: have a helper voice similar to Siri in your brain
description: Once a person gains this power a "helper voice" similar to the Iphone's Siri will activate inside your brain. The voice can help you with all sorts of things it can give you directions, record things, predict the weather for you and it is hooked up to the internet so you can ask it to search something for you and it will tell you what it finds. You can name the voice whatever you want and make it sound like whatever you want. To activate the voice you simply say it's name then ask it something.
pros: You have a helper mind voice
cons: If you forget what you named it you're screwed

name: Division Of Power
overview: divide one whole power into separate forms.
description: With this, the wielder is able to split one's own power, allowing multiple uses for a single power, resulting in new forms of power not usually available to them. A hydrokinetic could be able to actually generate water and in massive quantities, while having cryogenic abilities from the division. All "new" powers are still a sub-category of the existing power.
pros: Bodies could attack independently or together.
Serve as lethal distractions.
Bodies never wear out or tire.
cons: YOUR power will be reduced depending on how many bodies you create.
You're not immortal.
Best used as a last resort.

name: Disk Generating
overview: create anything as long as it's round and flat
description: With this superpower you can create anything out of thin air. But it has to be flat and circular; approximately disk shaped.
pros: Cookies! Pizza! Frisbees! You could throw the perfect picnic
Circular saw blades could be used as weapons
Psh, COOKIES!
cons: Must be round and flat

name: Bling Bling
overview: summon, manipulate, and turn into any precious material.
description: The user is able to summon and control any valuable mineral, like diamonds, gold, silver, platinum, pearls, rubies, sapphires, emeralds, etc. They can also fuse the jewels with their body, enabling them to withstand any attack or environment (they don't need to breathe, eat or sleep) and reform if they are damaged. Creativity with this power allows the user to make any weapon out of these minerals, which can be just as indestructible. However, the minerals are going to stay for only two hours.
pros: Absorb the minerals and become virtually indestructible and strong.
Create weapons out of the minerals, which become just as durable.
Money problems are a thing of the past.
cons: The minerals disappear after two hours, so be careful when fighting or bribing/buying.
People will annoy the user by constantly asking for jewelery.
Although durable and able to reform, the minerals will break permanently if hit by others you made.

name: Timed Teleportation
overview: teleport at set intervals of time.
description: A sub-power. With this power, a user can teleport at set intervals of time. This time can vary from user to user. For eample, one with this power may be able to teleport every 5 minutes or in an extreme case, once a year. If a user can teleport every second, this power has developed into normal teleportation or what some timed teleporters call Hyper Teleportation.
pros: You can teleport anywhere.
cons: Its timed.
Teleporting to other countries or bad situations
Having the most extreme case, teleporting every so much number of years.

name: Helmet Of Nabu
overview: become the powerful magician Dr Fate the keeper of order.
description: The person who has in their possession the Helmet Of Nabu is able to transform themselves into the powerful magician Dr Fate. Amongst the power that Dr Fate has, is great magical ability both defensively and offensively (flight, teleportation, super strength, magical blast, mind reading and transfiguration) as well as a great knowledge of the arcane. Dr Fate works normally to keep the world in order and to keep disorder at bay. The helmet cannot be destroyed by conventional means.
pros: Good against opponents who are weak to magic
Powerful magical spells to take enemies down
Can go head to head with powerhouses as well as magicians
cons: Helmet can be destroyed by strong magic users
Weak against very strong magic that draws power from discord

name: The Emperor's Code
overview: gain control of people who are socially under you
description: This power let's you influence and control people below you in social status. To influence people, simply shake their hand, and they will agree with your ideals. To control people, simply make eye contact and they are under your control. You can still lose minions by being humiliated in front of them
pros: If you are king, you can control everyone in your kingdom
Your controlled minions don't care about their needs
Even being middle-class grants you minions
cons: If you are in poverty, this does nothing
If you are humbled, degraded, or fired, you lose control
Raising your class is difficult work

name: Killing Jar
overview: have a jar with a deadly warrior inside of it
description: With this power you have a small pocket sized magic jar. When you open the jar a six foot three strong and deadly warrior appears in front of you. The warrior is under your complete control and is skilled in all forms of fighting and can use any kind of weapon. The warrior disappears as soon as you close the jar. If you lose the jar or it gets stolen from you it will automatically teleport back into your pocket.
pros: You have a jar warrior
The warrior is under your complete control
He is skilled in all forms of fighting and can use any weapon
cons: If the warrior is somehow killed in battle you lose the jar as well

name: Broken Time Travel
overview: send things through time as long as you're holding a piece of it
description: With this power you can send things through time as long as you're holding a piece of it in your hand. The piece does not have to still be attached to the object but if it is the entire object will be sent through time except for the piece you were holding which will remain in your hand.
pros: You can send objects through time
cons: You have to be holding a piece of something for this power to work

name: Military Vehicles V2
overview: summon any military vehicles
description: With this power you can summon any vehicles used by an military. You are also give the knowledge on how to operate the vehicles. You can unsummon them when you're done with them.
pros: You can summon any vehicle used by any military
You know how to operate the vehicle
You can unsummon them when you're done
cons: The vehicles can be destroyed or stolen from you

name: Myth Power: Heroism
overview: channel the Greek protagonists and their command over the essence of human heroism
description: Greek mythology had no shortage of heroes. As such, channeling them, one can gain Odysseus' cunning and wit; Autolycus' theft/disguise abilities; Amazon Queen Hippolyta's fighting/tactical prowess; Achilles' weapon/fighting skill; Daedalus' ingenious invention skill; Orpheus' musical skill; Bootes' keen hearing; Lynceus' keen sight; Atalanta's speed and athletic prowess; even, at the higher levels, Heracles' level of physical strength (before deification), King Midas' Golden Touch and the like.
pros: Best abilities/traits of the most powerful/famous Greek heroes, to the degree the hero had them
Autolycus could turn invisible, shapeshift, turn his loot invisible and change its appearance
Heracles was the strongest man ever to live; Everything King Midas touched turned to gold
cons: You have it to the degree they had it, no more, no less (be careful when channeling Midas) (NCN)
Also gain their vices (Achilles' heel, Daedalus' flighty mind, etc) (NCN)
You may be unaware of some of the heroes you can channel (better study up)

name: Myth Power: Chaos' Cataclysm
overview: channel Chaos' command over the essence of emptiness, the lower atmosphere and cosmic discord
description: Chaos (Khaos, Aer, Air), in Greek myth, was the god of emptiness, lower air and the unordered cosmic discord of outer space. As such, channeling it allows one to psychically disperse one's molecules into a nearly invisible cloud, or to turn intangible. In addition, one can psychically manipulate space, at will (even generating vacuums of airless space; within structures, they implode). One can even send back matter to a state similar to original chaos, effectively obliterating matter, by touch.
pros: Spatial Manipulation (Vacuum Generation, Phasing, entropy/disintegration/vaporization immunity, etc)
Send matter back to its original chaotic state (obliterating matter)
Withstand being directly perceived or affected by any other MythPower
cons: Cannot travel to/survive unaided in space (Vacuum Adaptation) until developed (NCN)
No Dimensional Energy Manipulation (Dimensional Travel, etc) until developed (NCN)
No Entropy Manipulation, Molecular Manipulation or Aerokinesis until developed (NCN)

name: Water Purification
overview: purify bodies of water
description: Oceans, seas, lakes, rivers, swamps, and ponds: the user can purify all of these waters. Approximately 75% of earth is water, but only 2% of that water is clean. With this power, all of the planet's water can be cleaner than clean.
pros: Clean water
cons: Kinda sucks

name: Implant Growth
overview: grow implants into your body over the span of your life.
description: With this power you can mentally trigger a change in your body that causes a mechanical implant to be painlessly grown. You can mentally track the percentage of growth of the implant until it is finished. Each implant fits perfectly inside your body so that you can look normal on the outside. An implant could take several years to grow to peak performance. Possible implants include: Reflex Booster, Optics Enhancer, Logic Co-Processor, Sub Dermal Armor, and Phoenix Monocyte Breeder.
pros: Grow any type of implant you can imagine.
The implants, when fully grown, are very strong.
Can even grow an implant to make the implants immune to technomancy.
cons: Takes a long time to grow the implant to its full potential.
Can not decide to stop growing implants.
Stuck with the negative aspects of implants unless it is surgically removed.

name: Musical Reality Bending
overview: warp reality in a way similiar to music videos
description: Do you see those music videos like "Cooler than me" by mike posner? Where he gets to stop time while he sings, or Rihana being able to sing while she's on fire? Well guess what, now you can too!!! Using these songs, you can bend reality to suit your needs. You can start off mimicking those music videos which were already created, but it's much better if you make your own.
pros: Make dancing zombies shuffle.
Teleport from one place to another with different clothes as well.
cons: Those who do not know songs.
Mimicking from music videos lack originality.

name: Snap No Sense Of Direction
overview: make people have no sense of direction by snapping
description: With this power you can make people lose their sense of direction by snapping at them and saying "No direction for you! " The person will then be unable to tell where they are going and unable to get to where they want to go until you snap at them and say "Direction for you! " You can only give people a sense of direction after you've taken it away from them already so you can't use this on people who already have no sense of direction.
pros: Make people lose their sense of direction
cons: This power has no effect on people who already have no sense of direction

name: Broken Enlargement
overview: make something bigger as long as you're holding a piece of it
description: With this power you can make any object bigger as long as you're holding a piece of it. The piece does not have to be attached and you can make the object as big as you want. You cannot make the object smaller with this power.
pros: You can make objects bigger
The piece you're holding does not have to still be attached but it had to at one point be attached
cons: You can't make things smaller again
You have to be holding something for this power to work

name: Agitator Pulse
overview: make people fight to the death
description: A person with this power has the ability to send a weak electric pulse, either through touch or through a medium, that upon contact with the brain stimulates the limbic system to focus on aggression. This will cause the person to view anything it sees as a possible enemy and give them a desire to fight to the death. It also increases the person's strength and skills and gives them the ability to predict other people's moves through observation.
pros: Makes other people kill each other
Enhances people's strength and skills, though they become a homicidal maniac
There is a delay time for the ability in which you can run or hide from the affected people
cons: Cannot deactivate the power without other abilities
You have to hide so that people can't see you

name: Ability Skill: Ripple Sense
overview: sense vibrations, sounds or movements if one has water-based abilities.
description: This provides support for water user. It adds a kind of sensor to your water abilities that allow you to sense vibrations, sounds or movements in water and, to some extent, air.
pros: Helpful in hunting and tracking.
Good detection system.
cons: Must have a water- or liquid-based ability.

name: Tangled Web
overview: tangle the foe up in every lie he has ever told
description: With this ability, you make lies a very deadly thing. Every lie the foe has ever told will be strewn together into a physically tangible supernatural web that binds the foe. This web will continue to gradually get tighter and tighter until the foe can no longer breathe and is suffocated (or it releases tiny Styx Spiders with an anti-lie venom); if he compensates every lie he's ever told with a TRUTH he'll be released; if he keeps lying, the web tightens even faster (or the poison gets stronger).
pros: Most people have told A LOT of lies  (hard to get free without revealing the truth)
Web is impenetrable by anything except the user, the truth, others with this power, and divinity
Foes who keep lying (or don't reveal ENOUGH truth in time) are either poisoned or squeezed to death
cons: Panmnesiacs can remember every lie they've ever told, so they'll make short work of the web
Sometimes the web ONLY constricts or ONLY releases the Styx Spiders
Immortals, people with Poison Immunity and Invulnerables/Impenetrables

name: Aura Of Incompetence
overview: make everyone around you incompetent
description: A person with this power has the power to make everyone around him incompetent. This does not increase or decrease anyone's powers but makes them unable to use their powers effectively. Also known as plot induced stupidity the people affected will not use their abilities to their fullest potential and will make critical mistakes when around you. Because of this the user seems better in comparison to the people around them. This power can not be turned off.
pros: You will beat everyone else---since they become incompetent
It doesn't matter how smart or strong they are---they will fail to use their skills effectively
Can use this to get promotions---by making everyone else incompetent
cons: You have to do all the work since everyone around you is incompetent
This power can not be turned off---so it will ruin any chances of you having decent teammates

name: Physical Harm Virus
overview: pass on physical harm by touch like a virus
description: This power allows you to infect people you touch with a virus that makes any wounds they have pass onto people they touch. These infected people will pass on the virus and their injuries to others they touch as well. People with this power are immune to the virus until they lose the power, have the ability to pass the virus on completely, or can cure it. The virus can be cured magically. Virus can pass through gloves, safety suits, and other clothes.
pros: Infect people at will.
Cure infected people.
Become immune to virus if you have this power
cons: May infect people you do not wish to have infected.
Virus may grow out of your control. More people infected than you can cure.
Virus remains in dead bodies so fatal wounds can be passed on.

name: Shrink Belt
overview: shrink to become small or microscopic size
description: The user of this belt is able to shrink to become smaller or even to microscopic size. A person with this belt also can shrink objects or people that are currently in the shrinking field that is emanated by the belt
pros: Good for getting into small places as well as well as fixing objects that requires a small person
Good at spying and getting information without anyone knowing
Good at escaping from enemies
cons: Not really combat oriented

name: Electric Collar
overview: zap someone at will.
description:
With a single thought, you can emit a signal which will send a pain message to your victim's brain. You will not actually harm the person but they will feel like they are being hurt. The intensity of the pain varies depending on your emotions. If you are feeling strong emotions (like anger, sadness or fear), it will hurt the person much more. 

Example: A gym teacher tells you not to stick your butt in the air when you are doing push-ups. "You were looking at my BUTT?!" ZAP!
pros: VENGENCE!!!
You can blackmail people by telling them its you and threatening not to stop.
It is oddly satisfying to cause someone pain and confusion.
cons: You can end up regreting your actions. This power is very sensitive, so be careful.
If applied in excess, it may cause nerve damage. To the person, that is, not to you.
If you do not use your power, pressure builds up inside you and you may explode.

name: Sound Mimicry
overview: turn your body into sound
description: Sound is defined as "a vibration carried through matter". A Sound Mimic can turn their tissues into a hissing, squalling, person-shaped vibration in the air. This lets them fly at speeds up to the speed of sound--causing more damage the faster they go-- generate high-pitched sound, and a limited ability to pass through solid objects. However, they cannot travel through a vacuum, they cannot pass through soundproofing, and their sound body can be 'washed out' by louder sounds.
pros: Super-fast flight
Sound body's presence causes pain
Saying, "Sonic BOOM!"
cons: Flight causes sonic booms
Being washed out by louder sounds
Flying in a vacuum will kill you

name: Frost Breath
overview: breathe out frost
description: You can breathe out frost at will.  Using this ability allows you to breathe frosty air on enemies, freeze stuff or you can just have fun!!
pros: No need for a freezer
cons: May accidentily freeze friends

name: Master Of Karma
overview: decide in what form other people will reincarnate.
description: You just have to look into a person's eye and you can decide what kind of fate they will have in their next life. You can decide if they deserve to be a human at all, you can put your enemies into an extremely unfortunate life, and you can reward your friends with making them powerful and happy people.
pros: You have the control over other people's fate.
It's not scenic when you use your power, so nobody will know what you have done to them.
It's fun to talk about your power without having anybody around who thinks it's serious.
cons: There's no visible effect of using this superpower, so most people won't believe you.
Even you can't be sure that your power truly exists or you are just a bit psychotic.
You can't have an effect on your own Karma.

name: Necrotic Physiology
overview: acquire superhuman abilities through the utilization of dead skin cells.
description: This ability is from the result of intense UV rays. When this ability is active, your entire biological make-up is virtually "dead". Your pain tolerance is incredibly high so you can take amples of punishment without shedding a single tear. You can also utilize ten 6" long claws. You are also prone to blacking out and assuming a bestial form when taking damage.
pros: You are still in control of your muscles and other bodily functions.
Never have to worry about rigor mortis or other skin conditions.
Harden your skin like diamond.
cons: Your skin will develop a grey-coloured appearance.

name: Think Cold
overview: cause frost bite with your mind
description: With this power you can cause frost bite just by thinking of the desired person having frost bite
pros: Can give enemies who are holding weapons frost bite so that they'll drop their weapons
cons: The frost bite wears off after a couple of hours

name: Myth Power: Astraia's Innocence
overview: channel Astraia's command over the essence of purity and innocence
description: Astraia (Astraea), in Greek myth, was the goddess of purity and innocence. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically purge impurities from water, air, earth and the like, by touch. In addition, one can purge one's own mind of impure thoughts at will, and others' minds by touch. Furthermore, one can purge one's own body of harmful pathogens/toxins at will, and others' bodies by touch. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel virgins, drug-free people, etc at will.
pros: Psychically purge impurities from water, air, soil, etc, by touch
Psychically purge one's own body/mind at will (others, by touch)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel virgins, drug-free people and other innocents
cons: Pro #1 and Pro #2 require touch until developed (NCN)
Cannot purify genetic anomalies (genetic disorders, superpowers etc) by touch, until developed (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers and MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provide immunity

name: Card Stack Abilities: Mask
overview: create a spirit mask for greater power access.
description: Normally when you access the abilities of a spirit, you can only use a small percent of your potential. The Mask ability allows you to draw out more of your powers. There are several mask levels. After the second level you could choose to become the Spirit you possess, and take on some of its personality. You can also merge your own spirit with the mask in order to make a more powerful form.
pros: Greater access to your powers.
Take on a spirit form while using the power
You can chnage your body shape depending on level of power and type of spirit.
cons: You may lose control when experiencing heavy emotions
People with the Card Stack Ability: Jester are not affected by your powers
Con 2 is only valid when they are of an equal of higher power level.

name: Song Reading
overview: perceive information about a subject by hearing their voice
description: With this ability, upon hearing a person's voice, one can tell many things about that person. Hearing their voice can reveal their innermost thoughts, their emotions, their intentions as well as whether they are telling the truth or not (it also renders one immune to song-based effects). And while it is not required, the ability works best if the subject actually sings.
pros: Perceive the inner workings of a song to find out the thoughts, feelings and motives behind them
Perceive the truth behind a person's voice
Song-based effects don't affect you
cons: Can only read subjects for as long as they vocalize (and it works best if they actually sing)
At the lower levels you can only hear thoughts OR emotions OR intentions OR truth
At the lower levels you can still be affected by song-based effects

name: Voodoo Doll Creation
overview: create a voodoo doll copy of a person or object.
description: This power lets you create a voodoo doll copy of a person or object that is an exact replica of what is copied. You can create a normal voodoo doll of a person or something like a dollhouse if you are coping a building. The dolls can be opened up and they will have realistic parts (like organs) inside. If a voodoo power is used the dolls can be opened up without the original object being ripped apart, unless that is what you want.
pros: Can create an exact replica voodoo doll of any object or person.
Can be paired with another voodoo power to increase its power.
Can be used to study an object without interacting with the object.
cons: Not much use if you don't have another voodoo power.
Can only create one doll per object. (unless origenal doll is destroyed)
If the doll is lost or stolen it is not much use.

name: Mahoujutsu: Angel's Shadow
overview: become a shadow.
description: One of the two paths of Mahoujutsu. Instead of selling your soul for immense power, you become the 'Shadow of an Angel. ' You keep your soul and gain power and defense, but not as much as if you became a demon.
pros: Boost of strength.
Boost of defense.
Keep soul.
cons: Not as strong as demonization.

name: Four Eyes: Scan
overview: scan an opponent to find out data about them
description: This power is gained by having the Four Eyes power and having only the two abnormal eyes open. The Four Eyes power slowly turns into this power. You can look at an opponent with all four eyes and find out something random about them. This happens magically and might be something even they are unaware of about themself. It takes around 1-2 seconds to get the information though. You can with a lot of training focus the information on what you consider useful.
pros: Can find out an opponent's weaknesses.
Can still use the Four Eyes powers.
This is a Four Eyes evolution.
cons: Must have Four Eyes power and have the two normal eyes closed while the other two eyes are open.
Data is random and might be useless. Ex: Has 100 fireflies in a jar.
Cannot get other Four Eyes evolutions.

name: Action Figure Shifting
overview: turn action figures into the people they are based on
description: With this power you can turn any action figure or doll into the person/character that they are based on. If the character has any special powers or abilities the action figure gains them as well. The action figures also grow to the normal height of the character. You are not able to control the figures but you can turn them back into inanimate objects whenever you want.
pros: You can turn action figures/dolls into the people or characters that they represent
You can turn them back whenever you want
cons: You cannot control the animated action figures

name: Transformers: Laserbeak
overview: have two flying laser shooting drones
description: With this power you can generate high powered laser guns on your wrists. The guns can also detach from your wrists and fly around and shoot lasers at your dissection. A side effect of this power makes you a fan of birds.
pros: You can generate flying laser shooting gun drones
cons: They can be destroyed
You are now a fan of birds

name: Super Cheats!!!
overview: hack any video game to do anything you wish!
description: You can kill your Sims by stabbing them, shoot the boss in Sonic with a laser, or even build a roller coaster that will destroy the world! The possibilities are as endless as your imagination, and your video game experience!
pros: You can control your video games!
You can win every time!
You can put things in video games (or take them out) for no apparent reason!
cons: You may get bored with video games
Your friends won't want to play Halo with you.
If you happen to lose all your lives in a video game, you lose this power temporarily

name: Maelstrom
overview: create violent whirlpool's of mass destruction
description: A maelstrom is a large and powerful whirlpool of tremendous destruction. It's basically a tornado but in the water that is in swift, circular motion creating a downward spiral. This ability you just focus your mind on the sea and maelstrom's occur.
pros: Power has very high destructive capabilities.
cons: Rely on vast amounts of water (sea) for power to work.

name: Superrevival
overview: regain superpowers
description: This power will only work if your abilities have been destroyed by the power Super Losers. You will regain all lost superpowers and keep new ones that have been collected!
pros: Recover superpowers
cons: Powers are gone until this superpower is acquired.

name: Laser Microphone Eyes
overview: see(hear) conversations from afar
description: A person with this power can see conversations from afar and literally hear what people are saying. They emit a near undetectable laser from their eyes which pick up the soundwaves nearby. The user then converts this into audio to hear things in the room. This can come in handy sometimes to get information.
pros: Can see conversations from afar
Does not require hearing capability---can have broken eardrums and still use it
cons: You are spying on people and invading privacy
People can use tinted/frosted windows

name: Quartz Prison
overview: trap enemies in a large quartz crystal
description: This ability allows you to trap your enemies within a large quartz crystal. After you touch an enemy, quartz will grow from the point of contact until it has engulfed thier body. Those trapped in the quartz are left in suspended animation until released.
pros: Trap enemies in quartz
Enemy is left in suspended animation
cons: Must touch your enemy for it to activate
Takes a few seconds for the target to be completly engulfed

name: The Five Newest Powers
overview: gain the five newest powers on the super power list
description: With this power you automatically have the five newest powers on the super power list. Your powers change whenever a new power is added to the list.
pros: You can get some pretty awesome powers
You have five powers
cons: Your powers are almost constantly in fluctuation

name: Money Tree V6
overview: create a tree that produces a lot of money
