description: The latin meaning of Arbitrium Ab Canor translates into Controls with Song. You are blessed with not only the abitily to sing beautifuly but the ability to control people with your song, melody, voice, etc.
pros: Easily Lure people with your voice.
You don't need to sing what you want them to do, you can just hum and think what you want them to do
It can be at any voice level and the form of song doesn't matter.
cons: Not exactly the greatest time and moment to use when you need to be quiet.
You can't control your soul mate.
You have to be careful of what your thinking when you're singing.

name: Lessen Others
overview: lessen others in some manner.
description: This powers works like the -less power but only affects other people and the effects are usually malevolent (can be used benevolently). Nose, spine, skin, life, mind. Any word with a -less and a negative effect is possible with this power. Add -less to future and a foe is going to die very soon. Penniless makes a foe lose all objects they own. Mind, Soul, Heart,etc. Lifeless (or Breathless) is instant death. Just find all the negative words ending in -less...
pros: Multiple ways to kill someone or strip them of something.
Can be used to achieve something good (e.g. use it on a ally's weakness)
You can mostly counter this power with the -Less power.
cons: This power doesn't provide a word for every situation.
This power has many counter powers.

name: Vampiric Superiority
overview: give orders to vampires and have the orders followed
description: A vampire with this power is of such a high level that other vampires automatically do what they're told by the vampire with this power. Due to the nature of this power, only a vampire or part-vampire can have this power. If two beings with this power try to give a command to the same being, the one who is more powerful gets their command followed first.
pros: You get servants who will follow your every command.
Works for vampires, dhampirs, and werepyres.
You're immune to the commands of someone else with this power, regardless of strength.
cons: Vampires are generally awake only in the night time.
Only works for the beings mentioned in the second pro.
You don't want to meet someone with this power who's more powerful.

name: Zombie Superiority
overview: give orders to zombies and have the orders followed
description: A zombie with this power is of such a high level that other zombies automatically do what they're told by the zombie with this power. Due to the nature of this power, only a zombie can have this power. If two beings with this power try to give a command to the same being, the one who is more powerful gets their command followed first.
pros: You get servants who will follow your every command.
Works for any type of zombie.
You're immune to the commands of someone else with this power, regardless of strength.
cons: Zombies are generally mindless creatures.
Only really helps if the zombie with this power is intelligent.
You don't want to meet someone with this power who's more powerful.

name: Blade Ankle Wings
overview: sprout wings that shoot sharp blades from your ankles
description: With this power you can sprout wings from your ankles. These wings enable you to fly like normal wings and you can shoot sharp blades out of them. These blades can cut through almost anything (stone, wood, metal flesh etc. ) and you have an unlimited amount of them.
pros: You can sprout wings from your feet
You can fly
You have an unlimited amount of sharp blades that you can shoot from the wings
cons: The blades can;t cut through everything just most things

name: Tactile Cellular Lag
overview: slow the body's processes on a molecular level via direct skin contact
description: With this ability, your touch will impede the human body's cellular processes. These processes include, but are not limited to, cell division and migration (wound healing and immune response) and metabolism (growth, digestion and the generation of energy). With practice and prolonged skin contact, users of this ability can halt the growth of cells completely and induce necrosis (the premature death of cells in living tissue) on a massive scale, effectively killing their target.
pros: You can tire foes easily by halting their metabolism and waiting for them to wear themselves out.
With practice and control, you can prevent those you touch from ageing for a short period.
With prolonged contact, you can prevent opponents with regenerative abilities from healing.
cons: You must make direct skin contact with the target.
People with little control over this ability can cause serious harm and even kill by accident.
You can only slow the body's processes, not speed them up to boost healing or growth.

name: Aerosol Generation
overview: generate aerosols in your vicinity.
description: With this power, you can generate any substance you want, provided they are in aerosol form. At first it must be from your body, but later can be at range. By default, the aerosols are at the temperature they come from; if emitted from your body they would be body temperature, while they'd be room temperature if emitted from the environment. However, the user may alter the temperature with experience and solids will always be heated to the point of becoming an aerosol.
pros: Infinite aerosol products.
Add a match and you can make a flamethrower.
Can even make aerosols of supernatural substances such as Normalization Fluid.
cons: Aerosols of, say, titanium may be slightly warmer than they normally are.
Chemically complex substances may change into other substances as an aerosol.
Aerosols cannot be controlled easily; they spread to fill a larger volume.

name: Irresistable Pick Up
overview: make people compulsively pick up anything you drop or throw
description: A person with this power can make anyone pick up anything they drop. This power is akin to the effect of the Golden Apples from Greek mythology that affected Atalanta. Anything you drop will induce people nearby to try and pick it up. This even overrides survival instinct as you can throw something off a cliff and people around you will jump and try to pick it up. This power will not affect those that do not see the object. If you throw multiple objects people will go toward the one closest.
pros: Instant distractions
Can prevent fragile things from being broken if picked up on time
Can get people's attention
cons: Power duration ends when the object thrown has been picked up
Cannot be turned off
Affects all people around you unless they cannot see the object thrown

name: Artkinesis
overview: create any artistic imagery with your mind
description: Say you want to fill an empty canvas with a beautiful sunset but you lack the talent and/or patience to do it. With artkinesis you don't even have to lift a brush. Just think of what you want to make on the canvas and it's there.
pros: Literally putting your mind onto paper
Profting from your art
Freeing your creativity
cons: May be seen as lazy in art community

name: Hallucinogen
overview: have hallucinations that become real
description: Your blood becomes filled with a rare hallucinogen that causes such powerful hallucinations that they don't STAY hallucinations. As such, you're a very powerful reality warper, but that's not necessarily a good thing, as you don't really have control over what happens. Luckily, you aren't in much danger as long as you don't do anything that might cause a 'bad trip,' like watching gruesome movies.
pros: Can do almost anything, as long as you hallucinate it happening.
Remember, your subconscious (the origins of the hallucinations) is influenced by your conscious mind
Your mind will probably adjust to this new state, as it's filled with mind-altering substances
cons: Two words: bad trip. A bad trip is where you start having hallucinations of horrific things.
You're going to go crazy. No doubt about it. Unless you have a will of iron and a powerful mind.
The hallucinations might not be helpful whatsoever, be uncontrollable, or permenantly alter you.

name: Reptilian Characteristics
overview: permanently share traits of reptiles
description: Due to your reptilian DNA, you possess large patches of hard green scales on your body, particularly your back and chest. Your canines possess a paralytic neurotoxin that can be released at will. You can dislocate your jaw, and taste the air like snakes. You can also sense air movements and vibrations, and see infra-red radiation. You possess small talons instead of your nails. Your skeleton is now made of many smaller bones, so your are more flexible, and have a larger muscle percentage.
pros: Slightly increased agility and strength with your claws can help a fight easily
Several extra senses
You're still warm-blooded, with all of its advantages
cons: With green scales and small claws, you'll look like a freak
Have to milk your poison or it will leak
Dislocating your jaw looks gross

name: Birds Eye View
overview: see behind every corner near you
description: You can see what is coming at every corner near you even in the near future. Unfortunately, you can't decide when to use it. It just kicks in when you need it.
pros: If people tried to jump you, you would know and go another way
If you wanted to hurt someone you would know when they are coming
You could avoid someone you didn't want to see
cons: You probably would never be surpised

name: Ash
overview: produce an ash with magical powers.
description: Whenever you burn something, it turns into an ash that can give people temporary powers. These are the powers: Controlled telescopic (long range) vision, one vision into the future that you can bring up at will, healing, super hearing, energy blasts, and super strength. When you have the powers, you have white eyes. The more ash you use, the longer your powers last. To use the ash, the user puts the ash into their eyes. This doesn't hurt.
pros: You can have many different powers
Can give others powers
cons: Someone could steal the ash
Powers are temporary
Future vision is one time use only. To use again, must use ash again.

name: Friendly Power Gifting
overview: give powers you have without losing them.
description: Have you wanted to make a super team with your friends but don't have a giving ability? Or maybe you have one but are afraid of losing the power yourself. Well look no further. We, here at Sahow Inc. have the Power that will solve your problem.
pros: You can happily give your friends powers.
You dont have to worry about losing powers when giving them away.
cons: You might not have any GOOD powers.
You might be a selfish jerkface

name: Death's Angel
overview: see the time of death for anyone
description: Whenever you look at someone you can see how much time they have left in their eyes.
pros: Have to look someone directly in the eyes
Can know the deaths of some people you dislike
Can prevent those deaths if you're powerful enough
cons: Can know when someone you love dies
Need to look directly in the eyes

name: Gift: Transformation
overview: be gifted at transforming
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at transforming than other beings. Thus their transformation powers are better than most other being's powers and it is harder to prevent their transformations. However, someone with this power can only recieve transformation powers, nothing else.
pros: Almost no one is as good transforming as someone with this power.
Transformation powers are boosted slightly.
Better disguises
cons: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the prevention aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only transformation powers now.

name: Feng Shui Master
overview: know the correct positition of things that will bring you luck
description:
With this power, the effects of feng shui become real and you now know how you should place objects so that it can benefit you or someone else. 

This power can also be used in battle. You can figure out the exact location where you take less damage or where attacks will fail to hit and also cause Rube-Goldberg reactions by hitting the right places.
pros: Have good luck
Have enemies trip on something you placed in a "convenient location"
Always find the exact spot where the opponent's attacks don't hit.
cons: You may not like how things look or the weird positions you would be in
If someone can prevent you from moving things around or moving yourself

name: Reincarnation 2: Soulstone
overview: survive as a gem-like object.
description: When you acquire this power, you grow an organ in your chest which, when you place a copy of your consciousness inside, it turns into a gem-like substance. You can leave it in you or you can cough it up and place it somewhere safe. However, someone with a mental ability can target you from anywhere as long as they are in range of this gem. You can only have one of these organs at a time. If someone touches it, you can use a telepathic ability on them.
pros: Survive in a gem-like object, able to absorb biomass to form a new body.
Holds a copy of all your powers -can use it restore lost powers.
Can use telepathic ability on those who touch it.
cons: Can only have one at a time.
Takes a week to grow to be ready to hold your consciousness.
You can only revive if either your body or the gem survives.

name: Existence Hostage Taker
overview: make reality around you vanish if you're killed or knocked unconscious.
description: This power is of solipsism. A sphere up to 1000 feet in radius surrounds you when you choose to activate this power. When made asleep or unconscious, everything you could see in the radius of your power will vanish from reality. If you are killed, the same thing happens. Using drugs or sleeping gas on yourself will also make things vanish. If you're erased from reality, this power still works.
pros: A foe's instant destruction power won't have any advantages against you.
An opponent will be forced to take you alive and conscious.
cons: If you can't be killed, made unconscious or put to sleep.
Someone with immutability or a power like immutability.

name: Myth Power: Amphitrite's Amity
overview: channel Amphitrite's command over the essence of the sighing, moaning wind and waves of the sea
description: Amphitrite, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the sighing, moaning sound of the ocean's wind and waves, as well as Queen of the Oceans and Seas. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well, survive underwater and glide on sea winds, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically manipulate water at will. Furthermore, one can psychically teleport to any shore or body of water, at will. One can even listen to the sea's rushing winds and waves to gain psychic insight, at will.
pros: Swim well, survive underwater and glide on sea winds (may be shared by touch)
Psychically manipulate water at will; psychically teleport to any shore or body of water, at will
Listen to the sea's rushing wind/waves to gain psychic insight on past, present and future, at will
cons: Cannot cast an illusion of rushing sea wind/waves to psychically calm subjects until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain physical power from listening to rushing sea winds/waves until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige provides immunity and allows disruption/negation (NCN)

name: X Tinction Reversal
overview: bring extinct species back into existence
description: With this power you can bring entire extinct species back into existence. When you use this power you just say the name of the species and then revive and then one hundred members of that species will appear wherever you want. You can use this power on as many species as you want.
pros: You can bring extinct species back to life
You can use this power on as many species as you want
cons: The animals you resurrect are not under your control

name: Power Of 10
overview: use any power you can think of as long as it involves the number 10 with restrictions on power usage
description: A person with this power can use any power as long as it involves the number 10. The only limit to this power is imagination and restrictions that involve the number 10. The user can only use this power 10 times a day. Each power usage last 10 seconds of real time. The user must have 10 written or worn on their body to use this power. The user cannot use the exact same power after using that power 10 times before. Clones cannot make more clones and has same "power counter" as when they were made
pros: Can use almost any power(as long as it involves the number 10 in application and usage)
A skilled user can use loopholes to their advantage
Has many practical applications
cons: Must involve the number 10
Restrictions involving the number 10
Must take notes etc and overuse of power leads to short power lifespan--practical wise

name: Decision Induced Life
overview: live the life you would have lived if you made other choices in life
description: To use this power, you must declare "What if I chose to" followed by a decision you wanted to make in the past and the exact moment that decision would have come into your mind. You will then be sent back in your former self at that same moment without any memories of your "previous" life and the fact that you just used your power, free to continue your life. These memories will only come back if you succeed to live to the moment you used your power, you can then choose to revert what you did.
pros: Change the things you regret in your life.
Try out slightly or completely different lifes.
Build your way to a more fulfilling life.
cons: It's not guaranteed that you will fulfill the decisions you made.
Your decisions can have unforeseen consequences.
If you become unconscious or die, the changes you made will remain.

name: Myth Power: Nyx's Night Shift
overview: channel Nyx's command over the essence of the dark of night and the nighttime sky
description: Nyx, in Greek myth, was the primeval goddess of night; nightfall and the nighttime sky. As such, channeling her gifts one with Night Vision to see better at nighttime. In addition, one can perceive any location in the world where it is nighttime, and the activities of any creatures in said locations. Furthermore, one can travel to and from any location where it is daytime, at will. One can even withstand shadow/darkness-based attacks and psychically disrupt light-based attacks at will.
pros: Gain Night Vision to see better at night
Psychically perceive any location where it is night (and creatures' activities in said locations)
Teleport self and others to any nighttime location; withstand dark powers, disrupt light powers
cons: Only generate 'dark of night' or Time Travel to future/past nighttimes at the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive communicate with, and compel nocturnal creatures until developed (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Ability Amplify
overview: enhance another person's abilities
description: Powers have limits. Pyrokinetics can only make so much fire, Speedsters can only move so fast. Ability Amplifiers can remove their, and other power's, limits for a short while.
pros: Become a VIP sidekick
Become an important team player
Get to watch some amazing things
cons: Only temporary
May never become real hero
Cannot enhance regular attributes

name: Mirror Your Enemy
overview: mirror your enemy.
description: A defensive power, using this you copy your opponents move at the exact time he makes them, making you as if you just his image in a mirror. This extends to powers, but you can use those powers until your Mirrored enemy does.
pros: Good defensive power.
cons: Sucks at offense.

name: Superman Hand
overview: have a single hand with the powers of Superman
description: The owner of this power has a hand that has all the powers of Superman - that can be used with a hand. For example, it is invulnerable, has superstrength, and can fly. Unfortunately the power is only contained in the user's hand. With only a single hand the user is still considerably powerful, able to crush coal into diamonds and otherwise defeat even superhumans with a single flick of a finger.
pros: Can fly at low speeds because hand drags you along
Can crush coal into diamonds
Finger poke of doom
cons: Only your hand has invulnerability
Does not come with super senses, heat vision, or superbreath
Can't choose which hand you get this power on

name: Energy Blend: Heated Beating
overview: produce a beam of thermo-sonic energy.
description: You have limited control over energy. When you activate this power, pointing at any target releases a red beam of thermo-sonic energy from your finger. Thermo-sonic energy is a mix of heat and sound, so it makes the molecules of the target move faster. Thus the target gains heat. This energy blend beam actually does hurt the target, because it's painful and if you point the beam at them long enough, they will evaporate, because their molecules will continue to move around due to heat.
pros: Make a beam out of your finger that heats up the target.
You decide how long the blast will be, and yes, you can use 2 or more fingers at once.
Good form of interrogation.
cons: Hurts them. Especially if they evaporate, because you can't go that hot without feeling any pain.
Unless you have advanced control over the power, you will regret pointing at anything.
Can't get them back to solid form after their molecules have been scattered.

name: City Of Heroes
overview: create a city of superpowered individuals.
description: Just imagine it. With just your imagination, you could physically create a city filled with superheroes. Give some of them ice powers, or make some of them invulnerable. Make some of them acrobatic, or give them magical powers. The city itself is yours to reshape, making it a sci-fi haven for anyone who visits!
pros: Entering a city of fantasy
Make your own superheroes
cons: The government may try to draft them
They won't have a normal life

name: Jack In The Head
overview: have your jester-shaped brain pop out of your head after singing "Pop! Goes the Weasel".
description: To activate this power, you must sing "Pop! Goes the Weasel". At a random moment during the song, the top of your head will suddenly open and your brain, which will be shaped and dressed like a jester, will pop out of it, still attached to your skull by a bundle of nerves and blood vessels shaped into a spring. You can also control your brain jester to make it move to some degree and grab things. As long as your brain is attached to your body, you'll survive.
pros: Freak people out by showing them your brain and making it move.
Just push your brain back into your skull and close the top of your head to deactivate this power.
You can make you brain grab things.
cons: The brain jester won't be able to go far from your head because of the "spring".
Obviously, your brain will be exposed to various dangers.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Christmas: Gift Manipulation
overview: manipulate gifts and everything inside it.
description: Manipulate gifts and anything inside it. Example: Your father was supposed to give you a teddy bear for Christmas, but you manipulated the gift and instead,inside the gift was a laser gun.
pros: Christmas is the best.
cons: You disappoint the giver

name: Uniquely Possessed
overview: be anyone you have want to be, once.
description: With this power, you can become anyone that you have ever wanted to be. You could even become the president, a famous person, or anyone else. The only problem is once you pick someone, then go to someone else, you can never be that first person again.
pros: You could become very popular.
You could see what someone was thinking.
cons: Once you leave being someone, you are risking of ever being able to go back to yourself again.
Once you pick someone, then pick someone else, you can never be that person again.
The exception for this is if you go back to yourself.

name: Dart Parasite
overview: fling darts at opponent and turn those darts into parasites.
description: Fling darts and the opponent's body and the ones that hit transform into a parasites that quickly go into the victims brain and eat it. Afterwards, the parasites emerge as scaled reptile/dog hybrids emerging from the stomach and growing to 7 feet in 5 seconds, becoming loyal familiars to the owner.
pros: Kill an enemy and get a nigh-vulvernerable pet
Familiars are nigh indestructible
If by some chance, the pet is killed, the owner can eat the heart to gain immortality
cons: The user does not have pin point accuracy so the percentage of actually hit target is slim
The darts must be darts made for the dart board game.
Darts are easy to dodge

name: Kunai Thunder
overview: fire a steel-tip spear filled with deadly electricity.
description: You can send out a rope with a tipped kunai at the end. It impales itself into the victim's chest and it shocks them, allowing you to pull them through the air towards you for a free hit while electrocuting them, as well as causing a lot of damage. The move could be upgraded so as to be used as a whip-like weapon to torture your opponents with it.
pros: You can toss a spear at the opponent, causing them to explode or reducing them to a pile of ashes.
cons: None.

name: Behind Blue Eyes
overview: make any statement you make become false when the power is activated.
description: People will trust that anything you say while using this power, is false. If you apply reverse psychology, you can get anything you want. Can be resisted and manipulated, especially by telepaths and people with a willpower ability.
pros: Fulfill or negate practically anything.
cons: People will think you are always wrong.
If you use it without focussing on what you are saying it will get you the opposite of what you are
Can be manipulated and resisted

name: Punctuality
overview: create timers.
description: The ability to set timers on things and beings with specific conditions. The conditions must be plausible, meaning that it has to be realistic. The length of time for the timer must be realistic as well, and not overly exaggerated. The condition could be that something will or wont happen in a specific amount of time. If the condition isn't met, the thing the timer is attached to will perish in the flames of time. You can't remove your timer once it has been set.
pros: Create a timer to constrict people's options.
If foes don't follow the conditions they would perish in the flames of time.
Helps you stay in control of a confrontation.
cons: The conditions and time periods must be realistic and unexagerated.
A foe could simply follow the conditions and be perfectly safe.
Unable to remove a timer once its been set, even to save yourself from not meeting the conditions.

name: Gift: Sound
overview: be gifted at the control of sound
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling sound than other beings. Thus their sound-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of sound from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve sound-based powers, nothing else.
pros: Almost no one has as good control over sound as someone with this power.
Sound-based powers are boosted slightly.
cons: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only sound-based powers now.

name: Native American Magic
overview: employ Native American Magic
description: Native American Magic was the form of magic used by the natives of america, up until Columbus came. They knew that everything in nature had a soul or spirit. They figured out how to converse directly with that spirit. This allowed them to control the paths of rivers, the rocks of mountians, and the branches of trees. They also could communicate through smoke, creating shapes and images out of the smoke.
pros: Conversing with spirits of nature around you.
EVERYTHING in nature has a spirit, even things like fire.
Controling smoke
cons: Just because you can talk to the spirits, doesn't mean you can control them.

name: Ball Listic
overview: bundle your body in any kind of element and launch forward into a ball.
description: You could have the ability to tuck into a cannonball, then bundle it into a fireball, an avalanching snowball, surrond yourself in electricity, change into a boulder, or turn into a spiked-metal ball and propel yourself at your opponents. The speed depends on the strength on how you use the move, you would aim your cannonball upwards to an aerial opponent, can hop back, then roll forward in a rainbow arc, and/or can use it to fly all over everywhere.
pros: Can do it Pinball-style with full force.
When you are with a muscle-bound ally, you can perform a Fastball Special.
cons: The ability's one external weakness is a well-timed jab or a projectile.

name: Hellrazor
overview: let out fire covered blades from your arms.
description: You can sprout out long retractable metallic blades from your arms that are covered in flames and span (at most) to seven feet, can raises the blades up which can slice and destroy most substance, shoot the blades straight forward flying through anything in its path, can attack with a lightning fast slash that are nearly impossible to see.
pros: Extremely effective against wood/plant and bug-type foes.
cons: Will not work underwater because the flames are put out.
Invulnerability
Metal/Fire Manipulators

name: Super Bite
overview: have a super bite
description: With this power you have a superhuman bite. When this power is used your teeth become sharper and poison tipped. You have the ability to your open your mouth wider than the average person. Your jaw also becomes stronger and it cannot be broken and if anybody tries to punch you in the jaw they will break their hand. You can turn this power on and off but if you turn it off all parts of it (sharp teeth, poison, wider mout, invincible jaw bone) are turned off you can't pick and choose.
pros: You have a super bite with sharp poison tipped teeth a wider mouth and an invincible jawbone
The poison cannot hurt you
You can turn this power on and off
cons: You can't pick and choose which parts of the power are turned off it's all or nothing

name: Myth Power: Proteus' Profession
overview: channel Proteus' command over the essence of elusive sea-change
description: Proteus (Proteos), in Greek myth, was the god of elusive sea-change; the sea's constantly changing nature. As such, channeling him allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically perceive any location in the depths of the sea, at will. Furthermore, one can attune to the sea for psychic insight, at will. One can even take on the consistency of water, at will, allowing one to assume the form of nearly any subject one desires.
pros: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically perceive any location in the sea, at will; attune to the sea for psychic insight
Gain Aqueous Shapeshifting (turn into water, and reform as nearly any living subject at will)
cons: Part 2 of Pro #2, and Pro #3 cannot be shared by touch until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 is limited to subjects of similar size/weight/mass until developed (NCN)
If grappled for thirty seconds, one can be compelled to tell psychic insights, until developed (NCN)

name: Super Repellant
overview: repel superhumans
description: With this power you can cause anybody with superpowers to stay away from you. You can pull off crimes without fear of being apprehended by superheroes or keep super powered villains out of your city. You can turn this power on and off.
pros: You can repel superhumans
cons: Does not work on aliens, wizards, robots or demigods

name: Ability S.: Tactile Projection
overview: create projectiles, auras, and fields based on the effects of one's tactile- based abilities.
description: This "Ability Skill" allows one to make their tactile abilities become long range. For example, somebody had to poison someone through physical contact. With this ability skill, they can shoot out a form of projectile to poison someone from long distances. He can make his tactile ability become an aura to affect things around or make it in to a huge energy field with the effect of his tactile ability.
pros: Will not need to worry about long distance opponents
Create projectiles, auras, and fields.
cons: Effects on projectiles are very short.

name: Bite The Bullet
overview: eat bullets of any gun and shoot them out of your palms
description: You can only shoot the amount of bullets that you consume. And if you eat all different kinds of bullets you can not control which kind of bullet will come out of your palm(if you only eat two kinds you can). You can shoot bullets at a unnatural speed if you concentrate. If you waste all of the bullets you consume you will be extremely tired and hungry.
pros: A defense at all times
Never need a gun (which you can lose at any time)
More comfortable than a gun
cons: Need to buy bullets
Makes you extremly hungry and tired if you used up all the bullets in your body
Can connect to emotions if not learned to control naturally

name: Pick Of Destiny
overview: play the guitar masterfully
description: Anyone who obtains the pick of destiny can play the Instantly become the best guitar player in the known universe. First seen in the movie "Tenacious D and the pick of Destiny"
pros: Play the guitar better than anyone ever.
cons: Satan will try to steal the pick.

name: Saprokinesis
overview: manipulate rot and putrefaction
description: One with this ability can psychically control putrefied matter and any other organic matter that festers with bacteria. This means one can control earwax, mucus, saliva, feces, urine, dead matter, moldy matter, fetid water, stale/polluted air and the like. At the higher levels, the user can even induce such foul conditions, making water bacterial and unsafe, making air (including breath) stifling and smelly, inducing rot and putrefaction in organic matter or even inducing bacterial infections.
pros: Anything foul, rotten or fungal can now be used as a weapon
Controlling it means you can also keep it from touching you
At the higher levels, induce or reverse rot, stagnation, pollution and bacterial infection
cons: Doesn't make the rot, sewage or disgusting/unsanitary/unclean matter smell any better
Can't REVERSE the rot unless the matter is still intact
Can't control dust or normal mud (only nasty, swampy mud)

name: Hyperpower Switch
overview: turn your own superpowers on or off.
description: With this ability, you can turn superpowers on or off. You can activate them, deactivate them, then reactivate your superpowers again. Useful for conserving the superpower's energy so it doesn't leak energy while not in use. It also comes with a scroll that you can summon at any time to see which powers are on and which ones are off. It doesn't work on this power because this superpower is always on and runs on the energy from the center of the earth.
pros: Turn your superpowers on or off and conserve their energy.
Comes with a scroll that tells you which powers are activated and deactivated.
This superpower runs on the power of the earth's core.
cons: This superpower is always active.

name: Time Recorder
overview: record damage so that it does not happen until a later date.
description: While the power is active small rings that look like clock faces appear around objects and people that undoes any damage such as physical, mental, and spiritual. The change is not permanent however because as soon as the power is turned off the damage returns in full force. This power causes the user to become exhausted if used for too long.
pros: Fixes any damage done to objects.
Records damage so that a person will not even have death will affect them.
Lasts for as long as the user has endurance.
cons: If power stops all damage returns instantly.
Cause user to become exhausted if used extensively
People would know if they would die when the power turns off.

name: Divine Immunity
overview: be immune from any divine or godly power, good or not.
description: This power will let you live however you please. You will continue to exist without being under divine or godly influence and control. If you were made by a god or goddess, you can continue to exist without them and they cannot exert any control over you (force you into an afterlife of their choosing or something). You are even immune to diseases started by godly entities. However, this does not change the fact that you cannot kill a god or creator without the appropriate powers.
pros: Free from divine influence.
Includes other deities than just the Mythpowers, such as the Nordic gods.
You can live your life as you please, no worries about karma, Judgment Day/Ragnarok etc.
cons: Demons are not included.
The gods might like you but can't help you.
Floods and other phenomena could still affect you indirectly.

name: Sparks
overview: make things highly flammable
description: Some of us have been camping and forgotten matches. I don't know how many of us are able to start fires by rubbing sticks together, but if you have this power, you can turn an ordinary stick into a highly flammable matchlike object - now you just have to find a ragged rock to strike it on.
pros: Make sticks, rocks, clothes, even people highly flammable!
Since you don't make fire, nobody will know it was you.
cons: You can't make fire, only make things inflammable.
Don't make yourself inflammable, because you'll catch on fire as soon as you scrape something fast.
High speed crashes.

name: Radio Connection
overview: connect your mind to the radio and listen to whatever is playing
description:
Connect your mind to the radio to listen to songs, change radio stations and listen to your favourite radio talk shows :) Songs are played in your mind, as if you had ear phones in. 
Stronger when you are near an actual Radio.
pros: Listen to songs anywhere
No need for earphones or physical radios
Listen to songs in class/work without getting in trouble
cons: Only you can hear the music
Signal will be very weak under large buildings (for example underground Carparks)
You may get no signal at all - for example The desert

name: Living Doll Creation
overview: create a living doll that can move and think on its own
description: The living doll can look like whatever you want it to look like as long as its basic shape is humanoid. It can be anywhere from the size of an ordinary doll to as big as a 2-metre-tall human. The doll will be able to move and think on its own without outside help and can be powered by a fuel cell, nuclear power, mana, etc whatever you wish for it to be powered by. Also, the living doll is always subject to the 3 Laws of Robotics and its first master will be its creator.
pros: You can create your own companion who can be your maid, butler, soldier, etc.
The living doll can be made of metal with gears (robot), with felt and stuffing (child's doll), etc.
You can sell the living dolls.
cons: If you sell the living doll it can now harm you if told to by its new master.
Your creation(s) might fall in love with you. May be a pro.
Note: You can add wings,horns, fangs, claws, pointed ears,etc as long as the basic body is humanoid.

name: Emesis Inducing
overview: make people vomit
description: With this power you can cause anybody to vomit whenever you want. You can even make them vomit multiple times in a row. Eventually they will have no food left in them and become sick therefore making them easier to defeat. Or you could just use this power to make people throw up on each other which is hilarious.
pros: You can make people vomit
You can make people sick
cons: You might accidentally step in the vomit

name: Myth Power: Graces' Groove
overview: channel the Charites' command over the essence of festivity and entertainment
description: These Charites (Kharites, Graces), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of parties and entertainment. As such, channeling Pandaisia (Banquets), one can summon food/drink (or teleport to anywhere with food/drink) at will. Channeling Paidia (Play, Amusement), one gains excellent gaming skill, and summon and animate toys at will. Channeling Pannychis (Pannykhis- All-Night Party or Festivity), one can teleport to any party, including all-night celebrations (raves, bonfires, sleepovers, etc) at will.
pros: Summon food and drink at will (or teleport to any location with food and drink at will)
Summon and animate toys/games (when developed, game characters) at will; become an awesome gamer
Teleport to any party, amusement park or any nighttime activities (raves, bonfires, etc) at will
cons: Cannot restore rotten/spoiled/stale food or drinks with a touch until the higher levels (NCN)
Only turn objects/subjects into toys (or toys into their real-life versions) at higher levels (NCN)
Only travel into video games (or to board game-based worlds) or the like at the higher levels (NCN)

name: Idiosyncratic Mimicry
overview: have the traits or become ones most prized possession.
description: This ability makes the user become the thing they have a strong connection to or have some traits of it. For example, the user's favorite thing was a hockey stick. This ability will make them have hockey sticks for limbs, become human-sized hockey stick, or become what the hockey stick is made of. If the possession is small, the user can disperse into that small object.
pros: Become your favorite possession
You can change in and out of it
Small objects: can disperse and reform
cons: You can only be one prized possession unless the connections are equal.

name: Negative Reincarnation
overview: project one's negative energy into a human like-being
description: Project negative energy with one's mind in it. The negative being is a dark purple color. When the negative being is out, one is protected by an impenetrable force-field and one's eyes turn the same color as the negative being. Since it is energy, it can fly and phase through objects. The negative being can't stay out of one's body too long or it'll dissolve into nano-particles and be reincarnated into a positive being. However, if the two merge together, they become unstable and will explode.
pros: Can fly
Can phase through objects
cons: Can't stay in negative being for a long time
Merging with positive equals explosion

name: Ossiokinesis (Osteokinesis)
overview: manipulate your bones
description: This ability lets you manipulate your bone structure. It also allows you to regrow bones you have lost or used.
pros: You can fix any broken bones.
You can create weapons out of bones.
cons: It hurts to have the bones come out.
They can break if they are too brittle or thin.

name: Cash Mine
overview: create Gold/Silver mines.
description:
Creates a Gold/Silver mine at the location specified, this gold respawns every
two hours. One Gold/Silver Deposite per two foot radius, can create an infinite amount,
Gold/Silver is allways exposed. Can destroy mines too, and have all Gold/Silver appear at your feet, can choose for them to respawn instantly.
pros: Wealth.
Infinite Gold/Silver.
Instant "Harvest".
cons: You have to sell it.
You have to explain infinite Gold/Silver.
You'll be used. (could be a pro. )

name: Slavery Immunity
overview: never be a slave of any being in existence
description: Someone with this power cannot be the slave of other beings of its kind, gods, demons, angels, animals, spirits, etc. Slave is defined by this power as being forced to work with no pay (being given food for work does not count as pay). If one is already a slave when they gain this power it does not activate until after they are freed.
pros: Freedom! Unlimited freedom!
cons: Already a slave? Have to wait until you're freed.
Can still be a servant.

name: Electric Net
overview: generate a net that shocks the person who is in it when they move
description: With this power you can generate a net of any size. Once the net covers a person they will be shocked whenever they move. This power cannot be used against someone else with this power. Only one net can be generated at a time.
pros: You can generate an electric net
cons: Only one net can be generated at a time

name: Artifact: Joculatrix Monachans
overview: summon a pair of shoes that allow you to run extremely fast.
description: When you say "Adeat", a pair of shoes appear on your feet. These shoes allow you to run extremely fast and enhance your agility.
pros: Can run on water.
Can run along walls.
Jumping power is increased.
cons: Limited combat use.

name: Space Umbrella
overview: divert falling objects away from your head
description: A person with this power has not need for an umbrella. Falling objects that would hit the person's head or body from the top are all diverted to the side. That includes downswinging swords an axes. Rain will fall around the person thus giving this power its namesake since a person with this power would have no need for an umbrella.
pros: No need for an umbrella
Falling objects fall around you and if the object is too big a hole is made to protect you
You can dive very far since the water on top of you is diverted to the side
cons: Things going straight at you or from the ground are not diverted
Things coming at an angle have a slight resistance to this power

name: Beginner's Luck
overview: succeed at anything the first time you do it
description: Have you ever done something really well the first time and somebody says "Oh! It's just beginner's luck"? Well, with this power, it really is. The first time you do anything, you will always surpass expectations and do better than thougth possible.
pros: You will always succeed at something the first time you try it
You could do really amazing/crazy things
Get a boost in skill, and go from there
cons: Only works once on each action
Can still suffer from side-effects, like a gunshot ricocheting

name: Pathfinding
overview: always know what your global position is.
description: Pathfinding is a unique ability that allows you to sense exactly where you are in the world. You can never get lost, and will always be able to find your way to a place, even if you've never been there before. All you have to do is think about your destination to be able to get there, or think about yourself to determine where you are in the world.
pros: You will never get lost.
You'll never need to use a GPS device ever again.
You can find your way through any maze or out of any building with ease.
cons: While you can find your way to your destination, getting there is all on you.
A telepath can easily throw off this power.

name: Batman Utility Belt
overview: have Batman's utility belt
description: With this power you have Batman's utility belt and all of its gadgets including batarangs, bat-lasso, bat-cuffs and other assorted bat themed weapons and gadgets. When you use this power the belt instantly appears around your waist and when it is taken off it disappears until you summon it again. You also are unable to use any kind of gun or firearm while wearing the belt.
pros: You have batman's utility belt and all of his gadgets
cons: You can't use guns when you're wearing the belt

name: Shadow Kinetic Blast
overview: indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to redirect it as a fiery blast.
description: The user can steal the potiential energy then merge it into a grayish kinetic blast. The objects and living things will be will sorched when in its range, especially those that can't move.
pros: Powerful energy blast
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
Immune to blast
cons: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Duplicator's Physical Boost
overview: multiply four of your physical traits by the number duplicates that you have.
description: The four physical traits are speed, strength, endurance and toughness. This power only affects one copy of you-the original. Duplicates,clones or copies. All work with this power. A Swarm of You power or something similar works with this power. Forced shapeshifting type powers work with this power also. The range of this power is Earth-planet in area. You can't receive a boost greater than by a factor of 10.
pros: Having a swarm shapeshifting power can make you very hard to defeat.
The Earth is a big place where enough of your duplicates could hide.
If you have a invulnerability power or invisibility or a teleport ability.
cons: This power doesn't work beyond a Earth-sizied area.
Your duplicates(clones,etc) can't get a physical boost even though they have this power.
You can't receive a boost greater than by a factor of 10

name: Artistic Outlet
overview: create art from touching a surface
description: The ability to create art from your thoughts simply by touching a surface. With this power the art of your wildest imagination can be placed on any surface simply by touching it.
pros: Make painting or drawing you can think of
cons: Not useful in a fight unless your enemy is ADD

name: Mystic Spinner
overview: make anything you throw spin just by thinking.
description: This power will allow you to make things that you throw spin. You can throw any throwing weapons at your opponent and make it spin just by thinking. The faster you spin it, the greater the force of the impact will be.
pros: Add more power to anything you throw.
cons: You need to have a great accuracy in order to hit your target when you throw something

name: Anti Solid Field
overview: never be touched ever by anything in the solid state
description: A person with this power cannot be touched by anything that is in the solid state. There is a field around their body preventing contact with solids. Thus bullets and conventional melee weapons are useless since it will never make direct contact to hurt you. However liquids, gasses, and energy will affect you. With practice the user can extend their field to repel solid objects.
pros: Bulletproof and Hitproof
Forces can still affect you so gravity will keep you down even when your feet are not on the ground
You can push back solid objects with practice.
cons: You can never high five or give a hug
You can only eat liquid food and you have to slurp it(no spoons)
People can use acid, flamethrowers, tasers, teargas to bypass your power.

name: Myth Power: Achlys' Access
overview: channel Achlys' command over the essence of sadness/misery, obscurity, the Eternal Night and poison
description: Achlys (Akhlys), in Greek myth, was the goddess of misery, obscurity, Eternal Night (a death-mist, preceding even Chaos, that clouds dying eyes) and poison. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive sadness, at will. In addition, one can absorb sadness to gain physical power, at will. One can also psychically produce a 'death-mist' which induces suspended animation, at will. One can even withstand, as well as psychically perceive and manipulate poison/venom/toxins, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive sadness, and absorb it to gain physical power, at will
Psychically produce a 'death-mist' which induces a trance of suspended animation, at will
Withstand, as well as psychically perceive and manipulate poison/venom/toxins, at will
cons: Pro #2 cannot be channeled into a touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot erase identities from subjects' minds, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Aniothability, Poison Immunity, Poison Neutralization, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Angelical Conquer
overview: have wings and control a type of crystal
description: You have a pair of huge wings that are colored to your liking. You also control any type of crystal, ex. Ruby, obsidian, emerald, etc. Also, your wings are retractable, but it takes a lot of effort to master flight.
pros: You pick the type of crystal and wing color
Wings are retractable
You can fly for a short time
cons: Once you pick a crystal you can't change it
You'll have an uncontrollable urge to wear a lot of jewelery
You might give your mom a heart attack

name: Blinding Acid Stare
overview: painfuly blind people by staring into their eyes and turning their eye fluids into acid.
description: This power is most active when angry. When you're angry but don't want to blind anyone, don't stare in their eyes. Wearing sunglasses makes this power have no effect. People wearing sunglasses are not affected by this power.
pros: Blind people.
Turn their eye fluids into acid.
Power is most active when you're angry.
cons: This power is not effective when wearing sunglasses.
People wearing sunglasses are not affacted by this power.
Have to stare at their eyes to work.

name: Plant Mimicry
overview: turn into a plant
description: You are able to turn into a plant that you you know of you also gain any skill which the plant has, e. G tree's allow you to have enhanced durability and strength. You are still able to move, walk and talk in your plant form. You will need sunlight in order to change, you are able to store some sunlight for night time.
pros: You turn into a plant
You can walk, talk and move in your plant form
You can absorb sunlight
cons: You need sunlight to change

name: Reality Anchoring
overview: prevent reality from being bent or warped within a certain radius.
description: With this ability one can prevent true reality from being changed within a radius. The radius of this ability is up to two hundred yards. If a time traveler were to go into the past and change the future, meanwhile in the future anything within the radius would not be affected. Keep in mind, one can not undo the changes outside of the radius. This ability is always on.
pros: Nothing can change within the radius.
Rendering any power that changes reality useless, unless out of the radius.
cons: The changes outside the radius.
One cannot undo changes.

name: Myth Power: Psyche's Smile
overview: channel Psyche's command over the essence of the spirit and the soul
description: Psyche (Psykhe), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the spirit and the soul. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive and communicate with spirits (as well as perceiving souls of the living) at will. In addition, one can see into the astral plane at will. One can also release and return his soul at will (Astral Projection). Furthermore, one can pass between the material and astral realms at will (Astraportation). One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and command lepidopterans.
pros: Psychically perceive, communicate with and channel spirits; perceive the souls of the living
Psychically perceive the astral plane, project one's consciousness to it or travel through it bodily
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and command butterflies and moths
cons: Cannot evict souls by touch (Astral Eviction) until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot absorb evicted spirits to gain knowledge, skills and abilities until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Thanatos' Embrace provide immunity (NCN)

name: Max Spider Power
overview: have all abilities of all species of spiders
description: you will have spiderman's power also adding Venom coming from your palm, Digestive Enzymes Coming from your mouth, Tarantula Hair Growing on your arm, Ability to dig as fast as a trap door spider.
pros: With your tarantula hair you can blind your enemies
With your digestive enzymes you can melt anything
With Your Venom you can paralyze or kill your enemies
cons: Weird Craving to eat flies
Wierd Craving to eat small mammals
You'll Ocassionally Blind

name: Adrenaline
overview: make yourself into an unstoppable killing machine and send others into a frenzy
description: Adrenaline is a very dangerous power. You can send others into a crazed frenzy and they would kill themselves if you wished them to be killed. You are nearly unstoppable with Adrenaline. Your eyes begin to glow a strange color and your senses highten. If you do not master this power quickly, it could be your death. If you use this power too often, you could become stuck in your Adrenaline mode. Your only instinct is to kill.
pros: You can make threats to kill people and actually carry the deed out.
You can send others into a frenzy.
You could rule the world.
cons: This power eats your soul a little bit every time you use it.
Turning it on and off as you please comes with a great amount of time and effort.
You can't think clearly. You don't know who you're killing until you manage to turn it off.

name: Blessing Of Dionysus
overview: have the blessing of Dionysus
description: Dionysus is the Greek god of wine. His blessing gives you powers over all that he rules. This means you can control grapevines and conjure drinks of all sorts. You can also cause people to go mad and insane. You can turn yourself and others into tigers, as they are Dionysus' sacred animals. Also, in your presence, grapevines will grow very rapidly.
pros: You can control grapevines and conjure drinks.
You can turn into a tiger and explore the jungle.
Insanity is now your greatest weapon
cons: Rapidly growing grapevines will usually give you away

name: Symptoms Spreader
overview: give anyone the symptoms only of any ailment that one has ever experienced
description: A person with this power can give anyone the symptoms of any disease that they have ever experienced. This power is not control over bacteria, viruses, etc. Instead, this power controls the human body to produce the desired symptoms. The user can produce any symptom caused by any outside contagion. In addition a skilled user can produce the symptoms of various diseases at the same time. The effect continues as long as the user is concentrating on their target(s).
pros: Give anyone fever, headache, sneezes, stomachaches etc.
Produces the symptoms only and bypasses immune system
Generally non-lethal and is non-contagious, so you can use it on yourself to fake illness
cons: Wears off over time based on the user's mental capacities
Can not be used to give people immunity

name: Sacrifice Inducement
overview: induce people into sacrificing their time, energy, materials, or their own lives for you or others.
description: This ability makes people sacrifices anything for you or other that you want. They will have no idea why they did it but it will give them an overwhelming sense of pride in what they did. They save you even if they are your worst enemy. No price is to big once you use this ability.
pros: Get people to save your life at the cost of their own.
Make them sacrifice other things to you or others.
cons: You wouldn't look at yourself in the mirror whenever someone sacrificed their lives because use them

name: Ability Skill:Effect Reduction
overview: reduce any ability that has a side effect to little to no effect.
description: It is what is said in the overview. You will barely feel the side effects of your abilities. This ability has a hidden effect as well. When you have an ability that gives side effects to someone else, those effects are also reduced.
pros: Will reduce effects of any kind caused by your own abilities.
Reduces side effects on other people.
Can choose which are reduced/negated and when.
cons: None.

name: One Hit Ko Punch
overview: kill anybody with one punch
description: With this power you grow a switch on the back of your neck, if you turn the switch on you able to kill anybody with one punch no matter how light the punch is. If you turn the switch off your punches only do normal damage. No matter what your punches won't hurt you though.
pros: You can kill anybody with just one punch if you want
Either way your punches won't hurt you
cons: Somebody might turn this power on without you realizing by flicking the switch on your neck

name: Power Hunger
overview: devour superhumans and gain their abilities by doing so.
description: Once you eat a full superhuman, you gain their sbilities. You want super strength, eat someone super strong. The problems with this power are you have no way of stopping once you start eating, you can't stop and you have an restless hunger for superhumans.
pros: Gain many abilities.
When doubled with Power Sensing and Digestion Adaptation makes this power deadly.
Superhumans will fear your voracious hunger.
cons: The hunger will make you continuosly want to eat more superhumans.
You eat bones and all so you should have a digestion adaptation along with this power.
Primal eating will occur. (No fork, no knife, no cooking, etc. )

name: Psychic Tattoos
overview: grant people psychic tattoos which affect their minds
description: By focusing on a person and picturing the tattoo, you can psychically create a tattoo on someone's skin, which affects their mind in different ways depending on the tattoo design. For example,a tattoo of fire would make them think they were bursting into flames, while tattoos of chains would make them think their arms are bound.
pros: Can control people's minds with the right tattoo
Can beat people in fights without the chance of accidentally killing them, as all damage is psychic
It is very difficult to block this attack without psychic powers
cons: It is easy for others to tell if you are using your powers, as tattoos are an obvious sign
It takes a few seconds to focus to use this power

name: Gamma Ray Bursts
overview: produce gamma-ray bursts
description: Gamma-ray bursts are intense flashes of gamma-rays that cause the nucleus of a cell to explode. The user can emit these intense rays from his body but the target has to be within medium distance for the gamma-rays to reach the target and to not disperse. Overuse of this ability poses a great physical strain on the body which can eventually result in muscle degeneration.
pros: Targeted limbs or whole bodies can be exploded at will
The waves can be fired at a 9m radius
Close-combat attacks will be unable to hit the user as the person coordinating the attacks will expl
cons: Waves can be reflected, refracted and diffracted. If wave is reflected back at user the will explode
Limited radius to fire waves
Overuse causes muscle degeneration and user can become crippled

name: Rough Skin
overview: have unnaturally high-friction skin that is harmful to the touch
description: Your skin gains an insane amount of friction, allowing you to "stick" to surfaces, as well as increasing the power of your hits due to your skin's roughness, easily scraping away enemy skin, or even stone. Your skin also becomes unnaturally durable and invulnerable to heat, making it possible to heat your body to high temperatures by rapidly rubbing it on something. You can control the level of friction to some degree, but can't turn it off completely.
pros: Can resist other forces (like gravity, or a punch) through friction on another object
Can cause damage through scraping or heat through your incredibly frictitious skin
Resistant to physical attacks and invulnerable to heat
cons: Skin may wear away anything it comes into contact with (including clothes)
Skin must come into direct contact with something to affect it
Your skin will always be rougher than that of a normal person

name: Army Of Anubis
overview: command the army of Anubis
description: (This power is cool but creepy) you have to sell your soul to Anubis to get this power. Anyone that kills you gets control of the army. You don't have a soul. Your life is increased. Your true master is Anubis
pros: Your the general
Make any army carer in fear
Sweat revenge
cons: You have to sell your soul to Anubis ( no con negation)
Anyone how kills you gets control of the army ( no con negation )
Anubis is your master

name: Inward Blades
overview: use the inward blades
description: This ability grants the user to cut their opponent from inside out by touching their body and saying extend.  The beginning of the blade is visible but it looks like a broken blade but the reason why it looks like that is because the rest of the blade is invisible
pros: Very unexpected
Good for stealth
cons: A maximum of three blades
Can cut yourself
Cannot cut things from the outside

name: Friendly Memory Deletion
overview: delete all the good memories someone associates with a specific person.
description: This power allows you to erase all of the positive memories someone has of another person. Good memories containing only the two of them are completely exorcized, while the person is deleted from any good memory that contains more people. The bad memories your victim has of this person are left completely intact.
pros: Alter someones perception of someone else.
Ruin someones reputation.
cons: If you want to compleatly ruin someones reputation, you have to get to most of their supporters.
The person you erace dosen't change, and has a chance to get back in the victims good graces.

name: Myth Power: Tapestry Of Fate
overview: channel the Moirae (Fates) and their command over the forces of destiny, the essence of fate
description: The Moirae (Moirai, Moerae, Moires, Fates), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of destiny and fate. As such, channeling Clotho (Klotho- Spinner of the Thread), one can psychically perceive and time-travel to a subject's birth date, by touch, at will. Channeling Lachesis (Lakhesis- Dispenser of Lots), one can psychically perceive a subject's lifespan and events from their life so far. Channeling Atropos (Atropus- Cutter of the Thread), one can perceive subjects' deaths and cause of death, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive and time-travel back to a person's birth date, by touch, at will
Psychically perceive a subject's lifespan, lived life events, death and cause of death
Psychically perceive passage of time (Chronopathy); gain Time Defiance and Unpredictability
cons: Cannot psychically bind foes in their metaphysical thread of fate, at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon divine shears, which cut/kill nearly anything, until developed (NCN)
Immortality, Time Defiance, probability/chance/luck based MythPowers, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Dinosaur Morphing
overview: become a real dinosaur.
description: With this power, you don't just look like a dinosaur, you can also become gigantic and have the powers of the dinosaur you want.
pros: Be any dinosaur you want
Super strong
cons: Uses energy
Big means clumsy

name: Fire Seeker
overview: see hidden messages of the future in fire.
description: You can look into fire and see a hidden message describing what will happen in the future. But it must be a real fire. Not like a fire on T. V., or pictures.
pros: You can tell what will happen to your best friend in 5 minutes.
You only see the message if you want to (so it's optional).
If you master this power, you might earn the ability to control fire.
cons: If you tell anyone what you've learned about the future, you lose the power.
Make sure you have self-control, because you don't want the fire to spread around.
You must never try to change the future to hurt someone (unless they're a villain).

name: Myth Power: Iapetus' Impetus
overview: channel Iapetos' command over the essence of mortality, the mortal life span and wounding
description: Iapetus (Iapetos), in Greek myth, was the Titan god of wounding and mortality (the mortal lifespan). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the extent of a subject's mortality (how long a person has lived, has left to live, etc) at will. In addition, one can afflict wounds on any subject, as well as amplify wounds, make them better (heal them), prevent healing, etc, at will. One can even psychically render mortals immortal, and render non-deity immortals mortal, by touch.
pros: Psychically perceive mortality (how long someone has lived/will live, vulnerability to harm, etc)
Afflict wounds, heal them, prevent them from healing, etc, at will
Render mortals immortal, render (non-deity) immortals mortal, etc, by touch
cons: Pro #2 requires touch (Pro #3 requires touch, and only works one at a time) until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain Eternal Youth or rapidly regenerate one's own wounds, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Oath of Ouranos and MythPowers based on Iapetos' children provide immunity (NCN)

name: The Eraser
overview: "erase" powers from super beings, done by touch.
description: An "eraser" can remove superpowers from any super being simply by touching them. The super being must submit to the "eraser" for this to be successful. Super powers removed by the "eraser" may or may not affect the "eraser", depending on the power being removed.
pros: Is extremely helpful to unintentionally evil super beings.
Can help in investigations of evil super beings.
Can save lives.
cons: Death can happen if the super being's power is very harmful.
Does not work if the super being won't submit to the "treatment".
"Erasers" are VERY hard to find.

name: Myth Power: Cydoimos' Confusion
overview: channel Cydoimos' command over the essence of confusion and misunderstanding
description: Cydoimos (Cydoimus, Kydoimos, Ceidomos, Keidomos, Ceidomus), in Greek myth, was the god of uproar, confusion and misunderstanding (especially in combat). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically induce and negate confusion, by touch, as well as withstand it. In addition, one can psychically encode language into (and decode language from) gibberish, at will. One can even psychically generate illusions of battle or rioting, which cause foes to mistake their allies for foes, at will.
pros: Psychically induce and negate confusion, by touch; withstand confusion/disorientation effects
Psychically encode language into (or decode language from) gibberish, to communicate privately
Psychically generate illusions of battle/rioting; make foes mistake their allies for enemies
cons: Part 1 of Pro #1 requires touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Eris' Enmity provides immunity (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Schultze Cell Mimicry
overview: have a keen sense of smell and shoot electricity or special signals when you smell something.
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. You have a very sharp nose and whenever you smell an odor, you can shoot either electricity or a special signal containing information about the smell. You can use these signals to make people smell what you smell by sending them through the area between their eyes. They can also be sent to Neuron Mimics from a short distance, only if they can receive them. You can't smell odors a normal person can't smell. If you're a female, this power becomes stronger when you ovulate.
pros: You can identify and perceive odors much more easily than a normal human being.
You can make people smell what you smell.
There are many things to smell so you can nearly shoot electricity whenever you want.
cons: You are very susceptible to strong, pungent smells.
You can't smell odors humans can't smell to begin with.

name: Genie
overview: grant reality-warping "wishes".
description: You're not stuck in a lamp, but you are bound to grant a person's wish. Just one wish and it can be almost anything, except to have infinite or more wishes or to become a reality-warping "genie". The good part is that you're technically an all-powerful demi-god. The downer is you're a servant demi-god that has to do what others tell you to do, unless they wish to free you from your bounding power and make you normal, and you can't make wishes for yourself. So be careful what you wish for ;D
pros: Be an all-powerful reality-warping demi-god.
cons: Bound to serve other people's wishes.
Can't make your own wishes.
Person has to say "I wish" and can only have one which does come with rules.

name: Improbable Staircase
overview: turn any staircase into an entrace to the Improbable Staircase
description: Any staircase can become your own entrance to the Improbable Staircase. The Improbable Staircase is a set of stairs that exsists nowhere and everywhere at the same time. By traveling on the staircase and exiting on certain "landings" you can travel to anywhere on earth or its adjacent dimensions at any point in time. Traveling the Improbable Staircase is dangerous as it requires concentration and if concentration is lost you may "fall" off and end up stuck somwhere you don't want to be.
pros: Effectivly a portal to anywhere or anytime
Doubles as a portal to other dimensions
Great for getaways
cons: Difficult to travel and reach your desired destination
You may end up in a bad place
Requires intense concentration

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Virtues
overview: become an angel of divine supervision.
description: The Virtues, also known as the Strongholds, are responsible for supervising heavenly bodies in order to ensure the cosmos remains in order. The Virtues are renowned for their powerful nature and astonishing might. These celestial beings appear as having a pair of diamond-studded wings, ceremonial robes, and ranging from six to seven feet in height.
pros: Imbue within your foes "natural order", bringing them to your side.
Skewer through targets with your diamond-studded wings.
Incinerate targets with raw cosmic energy.
cons: Virtues have no key weakness but are still vulnerable.

name: Superhero 5: Iron Man
overview: have the powers of the armored avenger, Iron Man.
description: With the armor of Iron Man, you have superhuman strength, durability, speed (in running/flight), and an array of weapons such as repulsor rays, the Uni-Beam, rockets, turrets, and flares. You are like a human tank.
pros: You have an armored suit that makes yuy stronger, fly faster, and more harder to hit.
You shoot lasers from the palm of your hands and chest.
You're like a tank.
cons: You need to recharge.
People will try to copy the technology used to make the armor.
In space, the armor will stop and freeze.

name: Myth Power: Demos' Demeanor
overview: channel Demos' command over the essence of people and the population
description: Demos (Demus), in Greek myth, was the god of the people and the population. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the entire population of the land one currently occupies, as well as various facts about the population, at will. In addition, one can psychically comprehend and communicate in all languages of subjects in that land. One can even psychically teleport to anywhere with people at will, as well as gaining physical power proportional to the number of subjects present.
pros: Psychically perceive the population (and population facts) of any land one currently occupies
Psychically comprehend and communicate in all languages of subjects in that land
Teleport self and others to anywhere with people; gain physical power in the presence of people
cons: Cannot tap into the entire population of one's current land for power until developed (NCN)
Cannot shapeshift into any citizen of one's current land until developed (NCN)
Shapeshifting, Omnilingualism powers, etc, only apply to humanoids (NCN)

name: Gene Knockout Punch
overview: delete or inactivate a given gene in a person via a punch to that person.
description: As there are quite a lot of genes in any punchable opponent, the gene to be inactivated or deleted must be called out before contact occurs. The effect can be specified by gene, trait, allele, or protein associated with the gene targeted for deactivation/deletion, e.g. "I'm gonna knock the lux (A) out of this Vibrio fischeri!" The default effect is that the given gene is deactivated, though as the example implies, deletion is possible by indicating destructive intent while "calling" the attack.
pros: Any mad scientist, doctor, or biologist worth their salt will be willing to hire you.
You can legitimately beat the disease out of your victi- experi- err... clients.
Insane savings on equipment while tinkering with the very building blocks of Life itself.
cons: You do actually have to punch the container of the targeted gene.
Not very relevant if you don't know the first thing about genetics.
If you don't know quite enough about genetics, you can easily mess something up... permanently.

name: Emotional Wreck
overview: make things happen depending on your mood
description: If you are angry, things around you explode. If you are tired, others get tired. When you are depressed or sad, people become wrecks and cry or become suicidal. If you are lonely, people will try to comfort and be around you. It takes years to gain control over this ability. Your aura is visible during one of these episodes.
pros: Are rarely lonely
People are afraid of angering you
cons: Takes a long time to gain control
Is dangerous to people around you
Your emotions are always obvious, making it difficult to lie

name: The Heart Of Rontu
overview: have superhuman knowledge of the wilderness
description:
In a mysterious Native American language, Rontu means "grey wolf with yellow eyes". Legend has it, that an Indian girl named Karana was stranded on an island. She made friends with a wolf and named him Rontu. When the wolf died, she buried him. She was rescued from the island, but when she was going to dig up the wolf, she saw a wolf with yellow eyes running from the scene. 
Using this power allows the user to know every aspect of the wilderness. The dangers, the prey, the predators, etc.
pros: Know everything about nature
cons: May have visions of a grey wolf with yellow eyes.

name: 0: Zero Hour
overview: surpass or extend temporal delays
description: One with this ability is very lucky. It allows the user to surpass or extend temporal delays. In other words, the user can cause shorten or lengthen the amount of time before an event takes place, as long as he knows it will happen. This makes waiting in line a breeze, and homework is no longer so much of a hassle.
pros: Shorten or lengthen the amount of time it will take until an event happens
Snap your fingers, the teacher suddenly decides homework is due two weeks from the actual due date
Snap fingers/nod/wave/think, and people just start walking out of line at the movie theater
cons: Can't reverse an event once it is happening or has already happened
Can't prolong the event indefinitely (the user must have a time-extension in mind)
The farther ahead in the future an event is, the harder it is to prolong or speed up

name: Lucky Winner
overview: win at every poker game
description: Say that you went Las Vegas and participated in a poker tournament; you could win at every hand and get a lot of money. You would do nothing illegal, so the owners of a casino couldn't prosecute you.
pros: Win every time.
cons: Doesn't effect slot machines
You would have to know the Card ranks e.g. Full House, Royal Flush etc

name: Rural Empathy
overview: become superhumanly durable, strong, and quick while away from civilization
description: Who doesn't love backwoods areas: the isolation, the friendly people, the banjos? A Rural Empath has another reason--away from civilized centers, development, and complex technology, they become superhumanly durable, strong, and quick. This lets them resist a direct shotgun blast, lift a tree, and outrun a car. Unfortunately, this strength logarithmically decreases as they approach cities or towns. They may also become physically ill at the approach of urbanization.
pros: Durable enough to resist a rocket blast
Strong enough to benchpress a redwood
Quick enough to outrun a car on the highway
cons: Powers quickly dissipate as user approaches cities or towns
Complex technology causes mild discomfort
Development and urbanization causes nausea

name: Universal Softener
overview: make anything super soft
description: With this power you can make even the hardest diamond as soft as a marshmallow.
