In practice this can be use to make bullets fired at you no more effective as being hit by very cheap water guns. Softened objects will be able to easily bend and can be shoved into tight containers. They can be effectively rendered as soft pillows. Objects turned soft are more durable than before since they can absorb impacts.
pros: Make your belongings soft so you can pack things faster. Also makes armor a lot more comfortable
Cushion an impact
Sleep on anything
cons: Not very powerful
You would want to hug everything

name: Chinese Zodiac Morphs
overview: change into the Chinese Zodiac animals
description: This is the ability to change into all Chinese Zodiac animals, from the simple small rat, to the allpowerful dragon! It's still like shape-shifting, but you can only change into twelve animals, including the dragon.
pros: Ram into things with the ox
Eat people if in snake form, except if your shorter than 16 feet
ALL POWERFUL DRAGON!!!!!
cons: Can only change into twelve animals
Only one thing can fly. Dragon.
If your snake form can swim, thats the only one that swims

name: Trap Door
overview: summon a rope out of the air which opens a trap door underneath your enemy
description: The trap door ability enables it's user to summon a rope wherever they may be. Once said rope is pulled, a trap door opens up underneath the target (or targets) of choice. Door drops target at a totally random location. This could be anywhere from the moon, to five feet away.
pros: Gets rid target almost instantaneously
Works both indoors and outdoors
Can be used on yourself as a method of escape, albeit a risky one.
cons: Could potentially deposit target on top of you
If used on yourself, could potentially deposit you in the middle of space.

name: Hyperflexible Spine
overview: have an extreme flexible spine
description: This superpower gives you an extremely flexible spine. The spine is more flexible because it is stretched out more. The stretched out spine, makes you at least 2 inches taller by default. You get good at limbo.
pros: Have an extremely flexible spine.
Be taller.
Be good at limbo.
cons: Only your spine is flexible...

name: Cremate
overview: turn a person to ash & dust
description: In order for the power to work, you have to stare at the person or people for a minute & focus. Your eye's iris will turn black pupil red. Their body will create a super flash of spontaneous combustion from the inside out in seconds. Soon your target will become paralyzed & crumble into ash.
pros: Cremate people instantly
cons: Have to focus & stare for a minute to work

name: Divination
overview: determine future events by using cards, crystal balls, etc.
description: Every culture has a Diviner. Divining is a form of Precognition that is dependent on a tool like tarot cards, reading fox tracks, tea leaves, and things like that. This is easier to access than Precognition, but  you need your chosen tool to use it.
pros: Predict the future with eerie accuracy
Easy to find tarot cards, tea leaves, etc.
Usually become very trusted in a community
cons: Need a tool to tell the future by
Bad fortunes
Being "Johnny Raincloud"

name: Absorptive Consumption
overview: eat anything like a garbage disposal
description: Eat anything, literally anything, and your body will turn that into nutrients, well considering on what you eat, it can also give you a boosted stat. Eat nails, get tougher skin and bones, etc. As an added bonus, your stomach acid is highly corrosive. Your body is only immune to being melted because of this power. If you were to throw up on the ground, a hole would form.
pros: Never go hungry
Vomit can be a projectile.
Immune to melting in your own vomit
cons: Your clothes aren't immune to melting, so you could end up running around naked in your own vomit.
If you touch anyone with that vomit, then they melt.

name: Ostracism (The Pariah Effect)
overview: cause a subject to flock toward or run away from any object of one's choosing
description: Also called the Pariah Effect, Ostracism is the ability to make subjects move (run/walk) towards or away from any subject of the user's choosing. One with this ability could keep enemies from getting too close, draw others to him as a shield from an attack, or the like. At the higher levels, the user could even do the same with concepts, controlling subjects' receptivity to (or rejection of) an idea.
pros: Make foes move away from you (you choose whether or not they walk or run)
Make foes congregate toward something that will cause them harm
Works on any species/system that is capable of autonomic movement
cons: At the lower levels, requires a touch
At the lower levels, doesn't work on non-living things, or things of a different species
Has to be directed at something (can't just control the subject's movement freely)

name: Lifespan Of A Black Hole
overview: extremely long natural lifespan.
description: You have a natural lifespan of roughly 66 quindecillion years. That's 66 followed by 49 zeros. This power only extends your lifespan. Other powers are needed to make yourself invulnerable or go without food,air or water. If you actually possess a power to absorb matter like a black hole then the lifespan of 66 quindecillion can be made longer by absorbing matter.
pros: Pass as a immortal.
Live a extremely long time.
Absorbing matter as if you were a black hole will give a even longer lifespan.
cons: You're not immortal. You're still aging.
Beyond 100 billion years you'll need a power to survive proton decay.

name: Superhuman Conversion
overview: convert any current version of a superhero/villan that you have the powers of to a different version
description: With this power you are able to convert the current version of any superhero or supervillain to a version that may be more appealing version towards you. This process may only be done one time per superhero or villain.
pros: Change into a more appealing version.
cons: You may only change it once.

name: The Armor Of Achilles
overview: wear an armor that is impenetrable
description: (This armor is legendary and it has a history to it) this armor was created by Hephaestus and given to  Achilles. As long as you wear the armor you can never be harmed by any weapon. This armor is rare to Find. You have to know your history
pros: You have an armor that is impenetrable
You have the coolest armor
You have an armor that was created by Hephaestus
cons: You not immune to aging
You are not that powerful
You remove the armor you die

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message1
overview: channel the Muses' command over the essence of knowledge, inspiration and art
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration. As such, channeling Calliope (Kalliope- Epic Poetry, Eloquence) allows one to psychically access knowledge of all epic works, at will. In addition, one can psychically travel into any epic story world, at will. One can also psychically summon objects and characters from epic story worlds, at will. One can even psychically perceive and communicate in nearly any language, at will
pros: Psychically access knowledge of epic story works, at will
Psychically travel into (and summon objects/characters from) epic story worlds, at will
Psychically perceive and communicate in nearly any language
cons: Cannot psychically disrupt creativity (or negate ideas), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive subject's ideas until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift may cause bossy attitude toward the user (NCN)

name: Summoning Tome
overview: call fourth random apparitons, various type of objects & weapons are summoned from Heck.
description: The oddest thing about this power because it's corresponded to the various types of objects and/or weapons summoned from the netherworld, Example - if you use a katana, a demonic samurai come out and slices an ememy. the second example is if you use a coin, a vere crazed Angeldevil comes appears and attacks an evildoer. Be warn to use this ability wisely.
pros: Might come in handy when you use small or large weapons.
cons: Use one object or a weapon at a time.

name: Power Self Negation
overview: protect your superhuman abilities from negation/mimicry/absorption by temporarily deactivating them
description: One with this ability has perhaps among the ultimate in superhuman ability protection. When a Power Negator, Power Mimic or Power Absorber uses his ability, your subconscious mind beats him to the punch, cancelling out any superhuman powers or physical features that you possess. Therefore, when the negator's powers reach you, they will bypass you as though you are a normal person. When the threat passes, you can elect to reactivate your powers and/or features at will.
pros: Protect your powers from being negated, mimicked or absorbed
Reactivate them at will (or wait for the threat to pass, and they reactivate subconsciously)
This power itself cannot be negated/mimicked/absorbed (works reflexively;hard to counter)
cons: Still rendered without powers for as long as the threat is present
If somebody IS fast enough to steal/mimic/negate your power before your ability activates
Can't cancel out superhuman features if you aren't human

name: Find Your True Love
overview: be guided toward your true love.
description: Somewhere in the world, there is this one person for whom you are destined. You are MADE for each other. You will find true happiness when you're finally together. This power gives you the power to know where he or she is at any moment.
pros: You will find true happiness! You will find true love! Your life will have a purpose!
And the MOST important thing: YOUR true love will find THEIR true love!
cons: There's nothing bad as long as there's LOVE!

name: Children Of The Sun
overview: control the Raw Power and Energy of Light
description: You are a creature of Good and gain your powers from the Sun. Whenever the Sun is up, you could create wings, weapons, or blast light from your fingertips. You can fly high in the sky and feel the amazing warmth of the Sun. You don't need to eat, you get all your nutrition from the Sun. Your enemies are the children of the Night.
pros: Feel and use the raw power of the sun
Experience the warmth of the sun while flying high in the sky
cons: You're screwed if your in the middle of a battle and the Sun go's down
The Children of the Night are powerful while you are a weak human

name: Prevention
overview: be immune to transformations into any kind or type of monster or creature.
description: This ability completely and utterly prevents you from ever becoming any and all kind and type of zombie, werewolf, and vampire, as well as also completely and utterly preventing you from becoming petrified, or mutating into a mindless and/or bloodthirsty monster or creature.
pros: Never worry about becoming a monster, vampire, werewolf, or zombie.
Complete & utter immunity to the effects of petrification.
Can instantly, perfectly, and permanently cure people with your blood who are monsters.
cons: Monsters, creatures, vampires, and werewolves might want to destroy you.

name: Children's Game
overview: change reality according to the rules of a basic game you are playing
description: With this ability, you and your opponent will play a children's game. You can change reality to make the game harder. You can also "create" other players. The players will look like your childhood friends and have their personalities. The loser will be in extreme pain and paralyzed, and the winner goes free. The games have no time or player limit. (EX: If playing hide n seek, you can change reality to make it so that players can hide in shadows, can fly, etc).
pros: If you're good at the game you are playing, you might win
cons: Chance the opponent will win

name: Chain Thunder
overview: grab the foe with a mystic HT chain, and then shock your foe completely.
description: You grab the opponent with a mystical high-tensile chain that will obey your mental commands, and then send violent thunderbolts through it to shock the foe. It is also capable of transforming into three weapons: it separates the links which then each morphs into shuriken-like blades, these then come back into normal links and change back into the chain, can be stiffened into a staff, and spin the chain at extreme speeds to create a saw that can cut anything.
pros: Can deal a great massive damage.
cons: Will not work against enemies with magnetism.

name: Brain Waves
overview: create brain waves that act as propulsion beams.
description: You can shoot sonic waves by using your brain.
pros: Handy in some cases...
cons: Can cause recoil.

name: Cerberus
overview: control the mythical threeheaded hellhound Cerberus
description: With this power you can summon the giant threeheaded hellhound Cerberus from the Underworld and have him under your complete control. You can make Cerberus fight for you, scare people for you, eat people for you or you can just ride on him and use his as a pet. When you're done with him, you can just send him back to the Underworld.
pros: You can summon and control Cerberus
When you're done with him you can send him back to the Underwolrd
cons: Hades might get pissed off at you and have you killed

name: Snap You're Gone V1
overview: send people to different countries by snapping
description: With this power you can send a person to different country by snapping you fingers saying the person's name and the name of the country you want to send them to. The person doesn't even have to be near you and you can send them back by saying the person's name and the country he/she was in originally. You cannot use this power on yourself or other people with this power. Likewise this power cannot be used on you at all.
pros: You can send people to different countries
You are immune to this power even if it is used by another person
cons: You cannot use this power on yourself
You do not choose where in the country the person appears

name: Mind Drain Grip
overview: erase a person's memory just by squeezing the top of their skull.
description: You have the power of neuralyzing your opponents by pressing one's fingers against their head to wipe the witnesses' memories of what they have seen and heard.
pros: You can drain your opponent's memory and store it into yours.
cons: Don't try to drain it too much cause your brain would grow to gigantic size.

name: Forced Power Usage
overview: make people use their powers
description: With this power you can cause any superhuman or magical being within a forty mile radios to use their powers/magical abilities. This can be useful if you see somebody in danger nearby but can't save them yourself you simply cause another superhuman to use their powers to save him/her. You could also cause people to reveal their secret identities by causing them to use their powers in public areas. Or if you're a villain you can cause heroes to destroy things and be shunned by the public.
pros: All of the pros are mentioned above
cons: You don't chose how the person uses their powers

name: Empathic Healing
overview: heal others by taking the wound/illness onto themselves.
description: A person with this ability can completely heal others from wounds and illnesses through skin contact, but by doing so, they transfer the wound or illness onto themselves.
pros: Can heal other people.
cons: Get the injury or wound they healed the other person from.
Painful.
If the injury is fatal, it could cause the user's death.

name: Myth Power: Arrows Of Eros
overview: channel Eros' command over the essence of sexuality and attraction
description: Eros, in Greek myth, was the god of sexual attraction and sexual affection. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive lust, love and affection, as well as a subject's sexual preference, their sexual capacity and their destined soul mate at will. In addition, one can psychically induce attraction (toward oneself or others) at will, and withstand love-based effects. Furthermore, one can generate wings at will. One can even summon (and gain skill in using) a bow and arrow at will.
pros: Psychically perceive lust/love/affection, subjects' sexual preference, sexual capacity and soul mate
Psychically induce sexual attraction (toward self or others) at will; withstand love-based effects
Generate wings at will to fly; summon (and gain skill with) a bow and arrow at will
cons: Cannot psychically imbue arrows with love-inducing powers, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain Superhuman Accuracy and Blindsight (Blind Sight or Blind Sense) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Oath of Ouranos, Aphrodisia, Train of Erotes, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Invincible War
overview: summon copies of the superhero Invincible.
description: Have you read Invincible #60? I have. With this ability, you can summon an army of Invincibles (good or bad) and make them do your bidding. Invincible is a teenaged Image Comics superhero. He can fly and has sworn to protect the Earth.
pros: Police the world
Make them do whatever you want
cons: Some of them might turn on you
An army of godlike teens could destroy the world if you're not careful

name: Super Smash Bros. Summon
overview: summon any fighter from any of the Super Smash Bros. Games
description: With this power you can summon any fighter from any of the Super Smash Bros. Games and they will be under your complete control
pros: You can summon powerful characters like Mr. Game and Watch or Bowser
Lots of characters to choose from
cons: You can only summon playable characters

name: Pain Resurgence
overview: bring back past injuries, diseases and bad memories.
description: Whenever you touch someone, all the injuries they once had reappear, all the diseases they once had relapse, and all their bad memories come back to their mind, even the long forgotten and repressed ones. This power is passive, so you need training and concentration if you want to turn it on and off at will. If the victim acquired an immunity against a disease, it doesn't matter. It just means they will heal faster from that disease after being infected again.
pros: Effectively hurt or even destroy anyone physically and mentally.
The more damage someone sustained in the past, the deadlier this power will be.
cons: You can end up being contaminated if your victim once had a contagious disease.
Your family, friends and lover will avoid touching you if you don't learn to turn off your power.

name: Egyptian Staff
overview: wield an egyptian magician's staff.
description: An egyptian magician's staff is his most valuable possesion. The tradition staff is about five feet long, pitch black, and covered with gold Egyptian symbols. The staff has many powers. Magic can be stored or collected within it. It also has morphing powers. It can be morphed into any animal(all of which obey the wielder)and also can shrink into an 8 inch black rod, so it can be stored more easily. The symbols have powers too. When the wielder presses and concentrates on them they become real
pros: Weilding a magical staff
It has many powers
It can morph into animals and shrink to be stored more easily
cons: Have to learn Egyptian to use the symbols

name: Inner Beauty Perception
overview: see people for who they truly are.
description: Just like Hal Larson, you can see people's inner beauty. If they have a good soul, they will appear beautiful/handsome to you. If they are ugly on the inside, it will show on the outside. Also, if someone's appearance has been altered through make-up or surgery, or because of an accident, you will see through that. As a result, you cannot be deceived by cloners, shape-shifters, invisibility, illusions when they affect someone's appearance, body modelers, and any appearance-altering powers.
pros: You can easily assess how likely a girl/guy will cheat on you or if she/he is a libertine.
You can measure how trustworthy someone is.
You can see through appearance-altering powers.
cons: You can switch this power off, but, after a while, it may be confusing as to whether it's off or on.
If you date someone based on how they look on the inside, doesn't it mean you've become shallow?

name: Power Suggestion
overview: suggest to people that they have a power, even if they do not have it.
description: This power lets you tell a person that they have a certain power and they will believe you and not question you. If they actually have the power then they will only use the powers you have suggested to them and forget or not notice the other powers they have. If they do not have the power you suggested then anything could happen based on what you suggested to them. Have to shock the person to get them out of the suggestion.
pros: Convince people that they only have the powers that you tell them.
They wont notice or use powers that you have not suggested to them.
Tell enemies they can fly when on a cliff.
cons: Mental powers, people with strong wills, or if they have some shock they could get out of this power
Have to be able to explain the power to the person.
Powers that are always active, or passive powers will still be used, but unnoticed by person.

name: Demon Blade
overview: summon a sword with mystic powers
description: You can summon a sword from the shadows that grants you a mystic power. The sword's form will express your dreams, the mystic power will match your personality and fighting style. The mystic power granted can be nearly anything: from flight to mind control passing by elemental manipulation. The sword can be summoned and sent back anytime, if separated you can call it back to your hand. The power given can be used even without the sword in hand but you must have summoned it once before.
pros: Have a sword anytime
Are granted a mystic power from the sword
Mystic powers can be used even without the sword in hand
cons: Can't tell what the power will be untill you fully summon the sword
The mystic power can be nearly anything, even a power you have never even thought of

name: Myth Power: Titanomachy Rematch
overview: channel the Titans, and their command over the essence of the primordial forces of nature
description: The Titans, in Greek myth, were gods older than the Olympians, presiding over various aspects of primordial nature and the human condition. As such, channeling them, one can release the Titans from Tartarus to do one's bidding; they automatically act favorably toward whoever released them. This means that they will not use their primal elemental powers to destroy the user or anything or anyone he holds dear. In addition, they'll be a threat to anyone or anything who tries to.
pros: Summon the Titans (superstrong, very powerful elemental giants)
They do your bidding; they like you and protect you (and defend your interests)
Can be unsummoned at will
cons: They won't always obey
They've been known to fear lightning (among their only weaknesses)
Only summon Titans not named in other MythPowers (no need to know names, but they won't be famous)

name: Symbiotic Suits: Space Suit
overview: be able to survive in space without anything but a SymbiSuit
description: The Symbiotic Space Suit, or Symbi Suit, is a living material that combines itself with you. It's a symbiote, so it does live on you, but it doesn't affect you negatively. You are able to see in different color spectrums. The suit sustains you by converting radiation into energy, so you do not need to breathe. To "take it off" you just think it, and it will go through your pores, and hide in your marrow. To move, you only need to think of moving in a certain direction, at any speed.
pros: You have a space suit at the ready, whenever
The temperatures of space don't bother you
You can control your speed, or even stop at a single thought
cons: Symbiote may grow a mind of it's own
You can't really take it off
Just because you can live in space doesn't mean that you can live on a random planet

name: Manual Control
overview: have no reflexes whatsoever
description: A person with this power has no reflexes whatsoever. While many may find this power useless and even detrimental, others can use this power to access their full physical potential. You are immune to flinching and have control of heartybeat and lung functions. In addition your body can move even when in great pain this includes moving even after hit with a low blow. In addition your body will always be able to access its 100% capacity since the reflexive limits are gone.
pros: You don't flinch
Can move even when in great pain
Can use your full 100% potential all the time
cons: No reflexes means that you cannot dodge reflexively
You must learn to actively dodge things that you cannot block
No reflexes? No autonomic functions...fool lie detectors.

name: Lion's Heart
overview: get the abilities of a lion because the user possesses a lion's heart
description: This person had his own heart removed and replaced with a lion's heart. Because of this, they have gained the strength of a lion, the speed of a lion, the sense of smell of a lion and the eyesight of a lion.
pros: Is as strong as a lion
Can easily chase and catch criminals
cons: Might get a craving for very raw meat

name: Majora's Masks
overview: conjure and use the masks from Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
description: This power alows you to magically have any of the 24 masks you would like(except Majora' mask) from the game The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask and use its power (if it has any).
pros: Magically conjure any of the 24 masks.
Use mask abilities such as transfromation and marching.
The masks look awesome!
cons: Certain masks have no point other than looking awesome.
Some effects last very short periods of time
Some undersireable effects (such as being loved by the undead)

name: Countdown Timer
overview: conjure a countdown that only the victim can see.
description: This power causes a red numbers to appear on someone's left hand which then starts counting down to zero. Only the victim can see the number and the number can be as large or as small as you choose. Nothing happens at the end of the countdown.
pros: Stress people out by making them think something terrible is going to happen.
Make people question the victim's sanity. Make the victim question their own sanity.
Use it as a warning or to keep time.
cons: It doesn't really do anything.
You can't predict how someone will react to it.
Do it too much and people will stop worrying about it.

name: Equivalent Warp Compensation
overview: get warps based on how often you've been warped before
description: Whenever you get "warped"(mind,body,soul,etc) you gain a warp that you can use on yourself. This means that you can turn into a desired form to fight whatever warped you(be it reality bender,mentalist,etc). Your warp can be anything from a huge elemental to just warping back into your previous form, however the warp must be equivalent to the warp done to you(no empowered stellar entity by being warped into sadness). This power also lets you build up your number of warps to shapeshift more often.
pros: Get many forms
Get many powers
Versatile.
cons: Lasts for a short period of time
You can only warp yourself and you only get warps if someone else warps you.
If your opponent just never warps you in the first place.

name: Oxymoronic Powers
overview: have any power based on an oxymoron
description: A person with this power has the ability to override reality at specific instances allowing them to do the impossible. The user literally has every power that deals with an oxymoron (i.d. contradictions). There is almost no limits to this power except the user's imagination.
pros: See the invisible
Do things accidentally----on purpose
Move the immovable
cons: Need to know what oxymoron is relevant for a situation
Sounds awesome but is more useless than it sounds

name: Ash Cloud
overview: turn into a cloud of ash
description: Turn into a cloud of ash and reform your body at will at any time and be able to move about freely in the form of the ash cloud
pros: Fit through tight spaces easly
Highly useful for stealth
Impervious to firearms and melee weapons both blunt and sharp
cons: Can be frozen by ice
Water can easy render you helpless

name: Color Hair Power
overview: have certain powers based on the color of your hair
description: With this power you can gain different powers based on the color of your hair. If you're blonde you will be able to glow in the dark. Red heads will be able to shoot flames from their hands. Brunettes will be able to control the weather.
pros: You can gain different powers based on the color of your hair
cons: If you have hair a different color then the ones mentioned here you get no powers

name: Ability Skill:Cursing/Blessing
overview: utlize abilities in the form of curse or blessing on someone else.
description: This new ability skill can give one the ability to use their other powers to curse or bless people. An example, would be if a pyrokinetic use this skill to curse someone to forever burn in flames or blesses someone to have a fire shield to appear everytime their are threatened.
pros: Bless/Curse people
cons: May require magical skills or decent training

name: Power Protection Filter
overview: prevent your powers from "protecting" you from beneficial things.
description: With this power, you can tell your powers to allow an "attack" to work on you. For instance, you can tell a telepathy-blocking power to allow telepathic communication while still blocking mind control and mind reading.
pros: Can now communicate telepathically even with Anti-Telepathy.
Allow a friend with Inverse Shapeshifting to alter your appearance even if you have Immutability.
Allow medication to work on you despite Chemical Invulnerability.
cons: Cannot make a power protect you from something it normally cannot.
Must be consciously set to do so; a person cannot heal you unless you tell your powers to allow it.
This power cannot be affected by Con Negation and similar powers.

name: Susanoo Manifestation
overview: create a gigantic, humanoid being that surrounds the user
description: Loosely Based on Susanoo(Naruto). This power allows the user to manifest a Giant-Humanoid around him. It possess no Life or Soul, but works on the feelings of the user. It is a sort of a guardian deity. Allows the user to move and fight. Susanoo can have one weapon which he likes the most. But, it can't be changed thereafter.
pros: Protects user from Physical attacks & Magic/superpower, based on user's ability to master it.
Attacks through a weapon which user once chose as his style
Acts as a force-field. Can allow others to be in it too
cons: It consumes the user's vital life force and stamina
Lasts only for small durations
Causes Headaches, fatigues & visual impairments after the use.

name: Esp Interference
overview: interfere with ESP.
description: With this power, one can interfere with extrasensory detection of events and objects. It has no effect on enhanced senses or information collected from another source (e. G. Via Telepathy or Technopathy). The effect is able to be applied to any object, event or concept.
pros: Keep secrets and enjoy privacy.
Can be applied to almost anything.
Difficult to counteract.
cons: There are ways of getting around this power, depending on what it is hiding.
This power provides no immunity to itself.
Does not protect against those physically viewing what is hidden.

name: Vampire's Bite
overview: drink someone's blood and gain their powers, abilities, and strengths.
description: The ability to bite someone, drink their blood, and inherit their powers, abilities, and anything else that person can do.
pros: Anyone you bite you have their powers.
Your powers are exponetional.
cons: You have to drink blood.
Unless you have a rengenerative healing factor (like wolverine) you might get AIDS or something
You need a hard bite.

name: Lie Inducing
overview: make people lie
description: This power is very simple. You can make anyone lie. When they lie they only notice what is coming out of their mouths and cannot do a thing to stop it(besides cutting off their tongue). In addition this power can be used consecutively forcing them to be unable to tell the truth as long as you are around. They can't even say that you are the one that is making them lie. However the limitation is that you can't control what they lie about--so they can mutter nonsense to attract attention.
pros: If you infiltrated a group and someone found out----make them lie
When they lie it does not show up on lie detector tests
Ostracize people by establishing them as liars
cons: You are making people lie

name: Red Light
overview: create a beam of red light that prevents the target from moving closer to you.
description: See overview
pros: Keep people at bay
Stop projectiles
Illuminate rooms
cons: Only the size of a flashlight beam.

name: I Am Iron Man
overview: turn into Iron Man
description: With this power you can turn into the invincible Iron Man to fight crime.
pros: You have a lot of weaponry
You have a lot of protection
Fame
cons: Metal Manipulators
Technopaths and Electricity Manipulators
You're not actually Tony Stark, so you're still broke...

name: Delete This Blessing
overview: be a double
description: double
pros: be
cons: superfluous

name: Legendary Ice Dragon
overview: cast spell to create an Ice-breathing flying dragon by imagination.
description: Summon spell through imagination creating a real Ice flying dragon that you can control to deflect psychic and physical attacks, send ice blast and provide transportation for 1 hour duration.
pros: Cool pet.
Turn enemies to block of ice
cons: Weak against fire.
Short playtime.

name: Shattering Form
overview: explodes into shards with great force
description: With this power, you harden your body and shatter it into razor-sharp cellular shards, one of which you regenerate from.
pros: You shatter with incredible force and power and amount of shards.
You will always regenerate instantly.
On rare occasion, if your regeneration shard shatters again, you will be cloned.
cons: If the shards dont penetrate, they will shatter again into less effective pieces.
You cannot control EXACTLY where the shards go and they can hit your allies.

name: Blank
overview: be completely forgotten by anyone
description: This is a passive ability, it can't be turned off, which makes it kinda sad. As soon as you leave someone's presence they will forget you and every moment that they associate with you. So you can shoplift with no consequence, but you'll never have a meaningful relationship. You can still be caught on tape, but people will forget the tape after seeing it. A person with this ability will develop one of three personalities: really clingy, completely insane, or apathetic. Usually in that order.
pros: Shoplift with no consequence
Do whatever you want. Who Cares!
This is a dream power for a lonely personality
cons: Never have a deep relationship
Always a stranger
Will likely develop a lot of mental disorders

name: Capgras Effect
overview: perceive twins, clones, replicates, copies, mimics, forgeries and counterfeits
description: This ability definitely has its uses. With it, you can naturally perceive when mimicry is taking place. Shapeshifters never escape your notice. Illusionists can be discovered. Twins are a cinch to tell apart. And replicates and clones are easily distinguished from the people that produced them. You can even detect voice impersonation, written forgeries and various other types of counterfeit.
pros: Easily tell identical twins apart; easily pick out a foe from his replicates/clones
Sense when a person is in shapeshifted form (or otherwise mimics someone else)
Recognize forgeries and counterfeits at a glance
cons: Mimicry is identified by the sense it is trying to deceive (must HEAR vocal mimicry to identify it)
Recognizing that a shapeshifter is transformed doesn't identify what his TRUE form is
Doesn't prevent you from being mimicked (just lets you know its happening)

name: Fangs
overview: grow fangs
description: With this power you can turn your teeth into super sharp fangs that can bite through almost anything including stone and metal. The you can turn as many of your teeth as you want into fangs and when you're done you can simply turn them back into normal teeth.
pros: You can turn your teeth into fangs that can cut through almost anything even metal and stone
cons: You might not like the taste of metal or stone

name: Other Negator
overview: negate things other than superpowers or magic.
description: This is a useful ability for someone with imagination. You could negate air flow in a room to stop your foe from getting oxygen or negate gravity to float. Your negations may be able to be undone by certain powers and you cant negate magic or superpowers. However, you can negate life or reality.
pros: Power with very diverse effects
Not too hard to learn
cons: Your negations don't last forever.
Your negations can be overcome by certain powers.

name: Child Creation
overview: create children based on two people.
description: With this ability all you have to do is touch 2 parents and you can create a viable offspring based on their DNA. The offspring will have the best traits of both parents and will not have any genetic defects if created from two parents who would not normally be able to breed together, such as parents of the same sex or different species. There is no pregnancy necessary, as the child appears fully formed in your arms.
pros: Grant children to people who would never be able to have them otherwise.
Save endangered species.
cons: You do not control exactly what traits the child gets.
You may be approched by some pretty weird people.
Both parents must be organic, living beings.

name: Elemental Move: Guraten
overview: create fissures in the ground with a finger
description: The literal translations is quake. This an earth manipulating technique which create fissures in any direction you point to ground with a finger. With this move you can trap enemies in the cracks and set off land mine and its power can be increased by adding more fingers to the ground. With enough practice this move can hit ground under sea levels.
pros: Good for long range battle.
Crush the beneath your enemies with a finger tip.
cons: Need the earth element.
Useless against enemies who fly.

name: Pain Delay
overview: delay pain damage or death
description: Allows you to delay harmful effects up to 5 minutes. Stabbed, cut, burned, explosions, and ect. Can all be delayed no matter what. Even a head stot wont bring you down. This ability will also slow down everything except yourself.
pros: Be able to have the last laugh.
Say those final words you want to get out.
Find medical attention BEFORE the effects kick in.
cons: Only lasts 5 minutes
Death is death it will happen now or later

name: Imprinting
overview: mentally write marks on surfaces
description: Writer's cramp no more! An Imprinter can 'write' by waving their hand over a surface and applying minimal concentration. This can be cursive, print, any color or size. Sign 30 contracts at a time, make indelible graffitti, copy signatures or create sketches from memory.
pros: Can be cursive, print, any color/size
Requires minimal concentration
Graffitti that cannot be washed away
cons: Must wave hand over surface
Not really useful outside of the office
Cannot 'unwrite' something without much greater effort

name: Dark Heart
overview: absorb evil.
description: First of all, credit to Ghost. His comment about me being cold-hearted actually made me think of adding this idea I made about a year ago for a short story. Dark Heart is an ability that allows people to absorb the dark nature and evil intentions of others. The closer they are to such people, the strong they get. Their endurance, power, and speed boosts near people who are evil. Not necessarily evil themselves.
pros: Absorb evil.
Strong when near, or fighting evil people.
cons: Only works near evil people.
Doesn't work on yourself.

name: Passive Aggression Deflection
overview: deflect passive-aggressive behavior forcing others to become direct and confrontational.
description: This ability allows one to deflect any passive-aggressive powers back toward the offender forcing them to confront problems and issues directly. It blanks their mind of evasive language and gestures, stopping their tongue, eye movement and body language only to move when their motivations are acknowledged either by their internal struggle or external confrontational forces. This force can't be deflected or ignored. It is activated by the passing over of one's face while wearing a glass ring.
pros: The ability to move forward in word and action
Minimizes internal stress
Keeps it real
cons: Too much Pent-up aggression released at once
Everyone starts arguing (adust strategies)
Ability to lie develops ( rare but possible)

name: Demolisher
overview: demolish building and structures just by looking at them
description: With this power you can cause any building or structure to explode just by looking at them. You can turn this power on and off so you're not constantly destroying buildings.
pros: You can destroy buildings or structures just by looking at them
You can turn this power on and off
cons: You might forget to turn the power off

name: Energy Sphere
overview: take the energy from someone & forge it into a sphere
description: Grab someone on the chest and take all of the power and forge it into a sphere! Eat it, throw it at someone or toss it back and forth in the yard!  Note: if it hits something it releases the energy, so if it gets eaten, the eater gets energy. If it hits someone, it kills them (unless they absorb it) and if you drop it, it explodes. And if the absorbee has a superpower, it gets stored in the sphere.
pros: Blow things up!
Get superpowers!
Everyone fears you!
cons: If you absorb, you kill the aborbee!
If somebody absorbs the sphere, bad things could happen!
Everyone fears you!

name: Interdimensional Sword Monster
overview: summon a special sword
description: This is similar to the arrow, hand, bolt etc. Monsters, except this isn't a ranged attack. When you command it, a special one-handed slightly-curved sword will materialise in your hands. This is the carved claw of a giant interdimensional monster, not like the small, spherical monsters. Anyone or anything you stab will be displaced to the dimension the monster came from, and they will not be harmed in any way. You can also pull them out at any time, with the same rules as the Hand Monster.
pros: Stab anything with the sword,and it will go to another dimension
The victim won't feel a thing (except maybe fear) and you can pull them out at any time.
Nothing like weilding a slightly-curved one-handed sword to make you feel AWESOME!
cons: Not good for killing or hurting.
If you use the sword to slow your fall, the object you stab will disappear.
Make the earth disappear... Not good at all.

name: Wind Up Punch (Flame)
overview: generate a flaming arm by spinning rapidly using the force of friction
description: A person with this power can generate flames on their arm via the use of friction whilst spinning their arm rapidly. In addition, the user is immune to their own flames. If skilled, the user can use the spinning arms to grab things to fling as fiery projectiles. Also, the user can use the arms as flails-like the other Wind-up powers. There is no recoil after it hits something and Newton's Third Law does not apply to it. However, targets will get blasted backward on fire if hit hard enough.
pros: You are immune to your own flames
You can grab stuff while spinning and throw as flaming projectiles if you are skilled
Fire punch enough said, also like the other wind-up punches it has no recoil and protects from NTL
cons: Fire is dangerous to other people
Cannot use if there is no oxygen

name: Divine Transformation
overview: transform someone based on how well they have treated others
description: When you use this power it transforms the target based on how well they have treated others. If the target has never been nice nothing will happen, but if they have always treated others with kindness then they will gain extreme beauty, powerful healing abilities, and angelic wings. Those who have been both kind and mean will get weaker versions of the previous powers dependant on how nice they have been.
pros: Can reward the kind and good.
The recipient will look like they are good now, if they didn't already.
cons: Not based on karma so even those who seem evil could be boosted.
Target may not be thankful.

name: Tailoring
overview: have extreme talent tailoring, or the art of making clothes.
description: With this ability you gain extreme talent in making/mending clothing, and as you make more clothes this skill advances to cranking out more clothing with less materials and less effort.
pros: Create your own clothes!
cons: Where are you going to find materials to make clothes?
Really not that great....
Nothing is really great about it except its good quality put into it.

name: Mode Swap
overview: switch ability from physical to mental or the other way around.
description: A good example of this ability would be like if you have the ability to turn into a giant monster. Well you will be able to change it around. Instead of turning into the monster, you can project a monster or make it happen in someone else's mind, who knows? All abilities are different when you switch them.
pros: If you have a lot of abilities, you'll be able to open a whole new world of abilities.
Gives you two ways to fight opponents.
cons: You'll never know what will come out when you switch the nature of your abilites.

name: Enhancement: Drain
overview: cause a blast power to drain energy from what it hits and give it to the user
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it causes the power to drain energy from what it hits and gives the drained energy to the user. This will only work on a power that fires off blasts of power. This power can only be attached to'one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: Regain power as a fight wears on.
Surprise a stronger opponent by lasting longer than they expect.
cons: Useless without another power.
Hitting the ground is the only thing that will not get you energy.

name: Silence Is Golden
overview: take away someone else's voice by making a simple hand gesture.
description: It's been said in dictionaries that silence is of great value. Some things are better left unsaid. Peace and quiet have immense value. Often the best choice is to say nothing. So, you have the ability to drain your enemies' voices, having a golden aura around you.
pros: If someone is extremely annoying, then you will be able to steal his or her voice.
Might be in use for combat.
cons: Your enemies won't able to tell the truth if you steal their voice.

name: Snap Flash
overview: snap and create a blinding flash.
description: You can snap and create a blinding flash so anyone near you will be instantly blinded or temporarily blinded. Up to you.
pros: You can blind bad guys.
You can screw up your friends' sight during a soccer game.
You can do anything you want with no consequences because what nobody sees won't hurt them.
cons: You might accidentally blind someone.
After a person is hit 20 times in a day, he or she will gain the power as well.
You can lose your power by trying to use it on too many people.

name: Purification Method
overview: be immune to addictives
description: The user possesses a recessive genetic anomaly that can uniquely sustain and harbor infected agents in their blood. The anomaly breaks down infected agents, such as viruses, diseases, poisons, intoxicants, medications, and drugs, much faster than the normal human body would. An outcome of that process generates raw energy and sugar, feeding it back into the user's system. This somehow augments the natural flow of adrenaline, enhancing the user's physical prowess by many-fold.
pros: Get stronger, faster, etc. , almost instantly.
Never have to worry about being drunk or high ever again.
cons: Tremendously large doses of something can slow or even stop the user.

name: Death God's Promise
overview: have anyone keep any promise they make with you
description: If anyone breaks their promise(s) with you they will be killed by a Death God with whom you have made a promise with. You are bound to the Death God by your promise for eternity. The promises can be anything from: 'I promise I will not call you derogatory names,' to 'I promise I will love only you'.
pros: Once a promise is made with you, it will be followed.
You can release people from their promises if you want to.
cons: If you break your promise to the death god, you will die even if you are immortal.
You are unable to use this power on other people with powers.

name: Blessing Of Xuan Wu
overview: gain all the power of a turtle and a snake, so long as you face north.
description: Xuan-Wu is one of the four Chinese celestial beasts and is alternatively known as the Black Tortoise or the Black Warrior of the North. He is often depicted with a snake for a tail. Thus, his blessing confers all the defense of a turtle as well as the speed, flexibility,and striking power of a snake for as long as you are facing the direction of north. In addition, you gain control over the element of water.
pros: The defense of a turtle.
The speed and deadliness of a snake.
Control over water in all of its states.
cons: You must be facing north for your powers to activate.

name: Death Elements
overview: summon and manipulate the elements in the form of Death.
description: With this ability, you are able to control the four elements but only the ones that are tinged with death. The user can summon and control grave-dirt/gravestones, cold air/wind, pyre flames and tears. You can rip the tears straight from people's eyes, make the surrounding air fearfully cold, ignite the undying flames and summon the dirt/stone that buries the dead.
pros: You can control the four elements in a creepy way.
Induce fear to most lifeforms.
Forcibly make people cry.
cons: You cannot just summon tears and cold air. You must have people (that have tears) and air to change.
Some people don't fear death and won't be intimidated by you.
Elemental manipulators have more variety over the elements thn you do (unless your in a cemetery. )

name: Vampiramorphosis
overview: change into: a bat, a wolf, or a dense black cloud. Only works at night.
description: Like Dracula, you are able to change your form into a large bat, a wolf or a thick, dark fog. This power can only be used during the night.
pros: As a bat you can fly
As a wolf you have great strength, speed and sensory perception
As a mist you can sneak by undetected
cons: It only works at night
Transformation takes a couple of minutes in which time you are vulnerable
You have a weakness to all things holy (ie relics, churches, holy water, etc)

name: No Heat
overview: shoot out cold fire
description: This fire is shot out from the user's hands. It is a fire that is very cold. If touched by it, the flames will infect the target if the target is a living one. The infection must be cured by burning the flesh off of the infected or the infected will become a dumb witted super strong zombie and the zombie can make others very cold.
pros: The fire only has whatever weakness water has.
Can't infect the user what so ever.
If others touch the fire, they become a zombie.
cons: The user can get a little chilly.
Can infect family, friends, ect.
Can't burn anybody or anything.

name: Adaptive Personality
overview: alter your personality depending on the situation
description: Capable of something, not capable of something--it's all in the personality. A person with Adaptive Personality is able to make chameleon-like shifts in their psychoemotional makeup depending what is most beneficial. If they need to work, they will become studious. If they need to clown, they will become goofy. If they need to fight, they will become vicious. If they need to love, they will become affectionate. The only weakness is an inability to associate with friends due to mood swings.
pros: Chameleon-like psychoemotional shifts
Always beneficial to the situation
Always conscienseless when it's necessary
cons: Inability to associate with normal people
May regret crazy actions later, when personality is more stable
Unable to maintain a normal personality

name: Elemental Target
overview: designate a person as target of every elemental power within a certain area.
description: The possessor of this power designated a "target person" that from that moment onwards will become the target of all the elemental powers (such as cryokinesis, pyrokinesis etc. ) within a certain area. If someone who has an elemental power and the "target" too are located in this area, and the possessor of the elemental power directs his/her power to someone or something, that power is automatically diverted to this "target person". The "target" stop being such only to the subject's liking.
pros: The subject can also choose him/herself as target;
The subject can defend his/her friends and him/herself damaging his/her foes.
cons: The subject can also choose him/herself as target;
The power only works with material elements (forces, waves phenomena etc. Are not aviable).

name: Communication Spy
overview: listen in on conversations via phone lines or waves
description: You can easedrop on phone conversations via mentally tuning into the phone lines or wave frequency. You'll be able to hear both ends of converation, even 3 way call. You can't see text messages or pictures though & you have to focus on the conversation you are hearing or you end up listening to someone else or to many conversations all at once.
pros: Listen in on phone conversations
Make a good communication spy
cons: Cannot see text, IM or picture messages
Have to focus on the conversation you are listening in on or end up listening to the wrong one
Could hear to many conversations all at once if you don't focus hard enough

name: Consume Radiation
overview: absorb and radiate radiations of all kinds
description: Your body is now a magnet for all kinds of radiation. You can absorb it form the surrounding area and store it in your body. The radiation does not affect you, but since you now radiate it at all times, you are a walking, cancer-causing, death-inducing, radiation monster.
pros: Remove radiation from an area
cons: Bring death to all you are near
You'll become a monstrosity.

name: The Paths Of Magic:The Magician
overview: have special talent as a magician.
description: The Path of the Magician, or the Path of the Word, is the third path of magic. Magicians use words to control their power. You see, space bends around everything, including vibrations in the air. Certain things happen when these distortions are energized with mana. Ancient mages developed a language that worked best with magic. This was the base for many ancient languages, such as Egyptian and Greek, which can also be used for magic. Latin is nearly identical to this language, so it works best.
pros: You have special talent as a magicain.
cons: You must learn another language.

name: Fake Skin
overview: create fake skins that alter the wearer.
description: A fake skin can be created that changes a persons body structure while it is worn. The fake skin can be designed so that it makes the wearer look like another human, or it can be the fake skin of an animal as long as the animal is of similar size and has same number of legs/arms. You will have the same body structure, except for voice, as what the fake skin is of for as long as it's worn. Multiple can be worn but body only takes attributes of the outermost fake skin.
pros: Perfect disguise (minus voice).
Can be used to mimic an animal.
Can wear multiple ones on top of each other, or give extras to friends.
cons: Voice isn't changed.
Can feel uncomfortable as body is compressed and changed by wearing the fake skin.
The fake skin can be forcibly pulled off returning you to normal.

name: Microwave Emission
overview: produce microwaves
description: We treat microwaves rather flippantly, but without that protective glass door...A Microwave Emitter knows this first-hand. They can generate as much radiation as 100 kitchen microwaves. This lets them melt plastic, boil liquids, make aluminum foil spark, cook TV dinners, etc. This is especially shocking when used on living creatures. This ability can result in an effect that you did not intend (making a person explode instead of just causing them pain) and takes energy.
pros: Versatile
Good for combat
Make aluminum foil spark
cons: Wide range of effects (boiling water--exploding people)
Takes some of your energy
Microwave-proof objects

name: Four Horsemen
overview: possess the powers of the four horsemen.
description: The ability to possess powers of the four horsemen.  Pestilence, War, Famine and Death. This Power only lets you to have all four powers at once. E.g Pestilence  - allows you to cause a disease on a enemy. War - become combative and immortal.  Famine - allows you to disinergrate living things. Death - allows you to become grim, one touch and someone'll go dead in an instant.
pros: You might not become a respectable hero when using this power.
cons: Don't let this power corrupt you.
You'll become extremely evil.

name: Transforming Dragon Master #3
overview: transform into any Dragon through use martial arts
description: As the pinnacle of the transforming masters of martial arts you have the power to become any dragon of any culture. Within the movements of your art you could transform your limbs or morph into full dragon form at will. You innately know each fight style when you begin practice or battle. Where it began with focus & style with #1 & #2, Dragon Master #3 is about determination to end a battle. Be forewarned, however. Dragons at their very heart are unsavory beasts.
pros: Dependant upon your moves & style you could be any dragon from any culture in the world
Breathe fire, scaled skin, extra strength, animal instincts, advanced sight, unrivaled fight skill
Dragon Master #3 forms can be combined with Dragon Master#1 and #2 forms
cons: Full dragon forms or neither friendly nor controllable
Each ending punch, kick or move is accompanied with violent fire whether you breathe it or not
Some dragons forms are inherently evil even if you have benevolent intentions

name: Shapeshifting Immunity
overview: be immune to shapeshifting
description: With this power you will be immune to any powers that could cause you or any part of your body to shapeshift.
pros: You are immune to forced shapeshifting
cons: Not much use in physical combat if your enemy does not have any forced shapeshifting powers

name: Life Force Drain
overview: drain the living daylight out of people you hate
description: You can Drain People 's life forces but only people you hate.The life force you drain can be used to create spirit minions with the same power as you.
pros: You Can Drain People's Life Force
You choose who to drain
You can Create SPirit minions that will do anything you want
cons: You'll feel weak when you create spirit minions
Your Powers Can Only work to the people you chose to hate
You'll Faint or Have Blackouts When The life force is not fully drained

name: Villian Mimicry
overview: copy and impersonate any villian inpecticular.
description: Imagine if you think an evildoer can outsmart you and get even tougher, you can take some payback advantage to the situation like you can copy/impersonate and mix some of powers of any Supervillian and you might even get the upper hand.
pros: 2 or a thousand wrongs might or might not miake a right.
cons: Must stare at the enemy to work.
Some superhero teams might not want to accept you when using this ability.

name: Grim Reap Yourself
overview: choose when you will die.
description: Think carefully if you decide to use this power. All future events that need to happen will happen-probable or improbable-to keep you alive until your death day. You can still be imprisoned or banished. This power could get you a life sentence in prison or banished to another universe. You could lose free will with this power if what you love in life contradicted with what would keep you alive. This power will try and take the safest route-instead of defeating Superman you just avoid him.
pros: Hopefully you'll live to be 90 years old and die in the arms of a playboy playmate.
Your worst enemies-the ones who can disintegrate you-can't. It's improbable.
cons: This power defies reality so foes who defy reality can kill you.
Someone could negate this power and kill you.
This power is meaningless if you couldn't die without it.

name: Body Split
overview: split your body parts from yourself.
description: With this power, you can separte yourself many times. You can also split them anyway you like, such as spilting your head in two, chopping your mid section, or spliting your arm into three. Each part can be controlled menatlly and you are able to use all of your senses through that part, e. I. You arm can smell, taste, see, and hear. You can also reaggrange yourselve in anyway you see fit.
pros: Never lose at Twister
Spy on any one without them knowing
Scare people with floating body parts
cons: You must have all of your parts together or you'll be stuck separated
Any part lost can not be repaired
All parts must return within a two hour time span

name: Tao Dial
overview: use it to transform into any of the eight humanoid warriors.
description: You could temporarily gain the ability to transform into eight humanoid warriors with elemental patterns of the ba gua. It is a unique power to morph into any of the eight half-human, half-animalistic warriors, so here are the examples: heavenly dragon, firey tiger, tidal shark, moon unicorn, earthly millipede, mountain elephant, thunder eel, and windy hawk.
pros: Can be of use for extreme heroism.
cons: Could be of use for dark villainy.

name: Poison Of The Demon Snake
overview: create and control a liquid poisonous substance, which causes deadly allergic reactions on anyone.
description: With this power you can create and control a green liquid substance, which causes anyone that touches it to suffer deadly allergic reactions. This "smart" toxin affects directly the most important parts of the body, destroying anyone from inside out. Once someone is affected by this power it's incurable by normal means. After generating the substance, you can't touch it too, because you are not immune to it. This ability is more recommended to villains.
pros: This is the ultimate poison, incurable and deadly.
You can control the liquid without having to touch it.
You can make the liquid substance appear anywhere, as long as this place is nearby you.
cons: You are not immune to your own power, which makes this ability really dangerous.
People with Liquid Control are able to control the substance too.
Won't work on invulnerable people and can be cured by healing powers.

name: Myth Power: Charon's Conscience
overview: channel Charon's command over the essence of spirits' entrance into the afterlife
description: Charon (Kharon), in Greek myth, was the ferryman of the dead into the afterlife. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with, summon, banish and ward off the spirits of the dead, at will. In addition, one can make physical contact with said spirits of the dead, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically teleport onto a ferry that travels to the Underworld, at will. One can even withstand  death/underworld/afterlife-based effects, as well as spiritual possession.
pros: Psychically perceive, communicate with, summon, banish, ward off spirits (ghosts) at will
Make physical contact with spirits; psychically teleport to a ferry to the underworld, at will
Withstand Death/underworld/afterlife-based effects (and Spiritual Possession)
cons: Pro #1 and Part 1 of Pro #2 do not apply to demons until developed (NCN)
Cannot perceive whether subjects are destined for Heaven or Hell, by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Hades Haunt and MythPower: Persephone's Poise bypass Pro #3 (NCN)

name: 1 For The Money
overview: make money rain from the sky
description: With this power you can make as much money as you want rain from the sky. You can only use this power once a day and as soon as you stop making it rain money you have to wait a whole 24 hours before using this power again.
pros: You can make money rain from the sky
cons: You can only use this power once a day

name: Cartoon Powers: Fourarms
overview: sprout two additional arms that have super strength
description: With this power you can sprout two additional arms (or the necessary amount to bring your up to four). The extra arms both (all) have super strength and are invincible. Unfortunately only your extra arms have super strength and invincibility you cannot transfer this to your original arms or any other part of your body.
pros: You get two additional super strong invincible arms and hands
cons: Only the extra arms and hands have super strength and invincibility

name: Template Swapping
overview: swap your collection of powers for someone else's.
description: The user of this ability is able to "mark" a superhuman by touch to make a template of their powers. They can mark as many as they want. Then, they can swap all other powers they own for one of the "marked" people's power collections. However, when unconscious, dead or negated, their entire collection reverts to normal.
pros: Get a lot of different powers.
If the "victim" gains a power, their template grows.
The "victim" is unharmed.
cons: You lose all your powers other than this one.
If the "victim" loses a power, their template shrinks.
If you fall unconscious, die or have this power negated, your entire collection reverts.

name: Myth Power: Nympholepsy
overview: channel the Nymphs and their command over the essence of natural landforms
description: The Nymphae (Nymphai, Nymphs), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of nature's various landforms. As such, channeling them allows one to gain entrancing supernatural beauty. In addition, one can attune oneself to, and thus survive in, any environment, at will. One can even psychically empathize with nature; psychically perceive and communicate with plants and animals, psychically induce subtle influences in nature to give combat advantage, nature responding to one's emotions, and the like.
pros: Gain entrancing supernatural beauty (snapped into peak physical condition)
Psychically adapt to survive in any climate at will
Psychically empathize with nature for various defensive and offensive effects
cons: Lifeline may become linked to natural land features like a tree (while the ability is active)
No Dryad Tree Form, Air/Wind Mimicry, or Water Mimicry until the higher levels(NCN)
Cannot use this ability to manipulate weather, or induce major weather/nature events (NCN)

name: Super Spikes
overview: shoot out very sharp spikes from the top of your hand.
description: That's pretty much it. Just shooting out spikes from your hand. Your spikes can go as far as 500 miles and are very fast. The spikes are very durable as well.
pros: Extremely fast
Stab enemies
They can go as far as 500 miles.
cons: May kill a loved one

name: Loophole Finder
overview: get out of any contract
description: With this power, you can find the loopholes of any contract, if there are any.
pros: Can get out of any contract
cons: Can only find loopholes for written contracts
There are no loopholes

name: Precognitive Whittling
overview: whittle the future
description: Whittling is when you carve shapes out of wood. With this power you can whittle the future. It does not matter if you can whittle or not; when you slip into a trance you are able to become a master whittler. You cannot whittle until you have a knife and a block of wood, so you will stay in that trance until you have finished the whittle. The range of the precognition is about an hour to a couple of years.
pros: You can whittle the future
You are a masterful whittler in the trance
cons: You do need to have a knife and some wood
You won't come out of the trance until you have whittled the event

name: Metabolism: Spiritual
overview: have a metabolism that also functions spiritualy.
description: This power is a useful one to have. It allows the user's metabolism to function on the spiritual level and with spiritual things. You can fight off spiritual illness, absorb spiritual energy, heal from spiritual wounds, etc. The user even has the ability to have the normal nutrients they take in produce spiritual energy and the spiritual energy they take in be used for normal metabolic processes. In addition any spiritual powers or abilities that the user posses are boosted by the metabolism.
pros: Have ANY spiritual powers or abilities boosted by metabolic processes.
Be capable of healing on the spiritual level and taking in spiritual energy.
Convert normal metabolic fuels into spiritual energy and vice versa.
cons: You might have to take in more nutrients to manage the physical and spiritual body.
You might never come across much spiritual energy to absorb.
Spiritual illneses have more affect on you.

name: Boom Bag
overview: wield the Boom Bag
description: The Boom Bag is a portable bag that works like a Hammer Space for grenades. Any type of grenade can be taken out from it's endless supply. The condition for the explosion can be chosen from a list.  E.g. timed, on hit, proximity, temperature, voice recognition, remote control etc. The type of explosion can also be chosen.  examples : fire, ice, local time freeze, stench, sleeping gas, power canceling field etc. They can only be activated/deactivated by who pulled the grenade out of the bag.
pros: Very versatile weapon if used wisely
The grenades you pulled out can be used even if you don't have the bag with you
Bada Bing Bada BOOOOOM!!!
cons: Your Boom Bag could be stolen
If your arms are weak, you can't throw the grenades very far

name: Gun Shift
overview: turn guns into any other kind of gun
description: With this power you can change any kind of gun into any other kind of gun and change any ammo into any other kind of ammo. It ever works with toy guns such a Nerf Guns or paintball guns. You cannot turn guns into fictional guns from TV, books, comics, or movies.
pros: You can change any kind of gun into any other kind of gun
You can change any kind of ammo into any other kind of ammo
You can use this power as many times as you want on a gun
cons: You cannot turns guns into fictional guns

name: Bubble Shield
overview: create a shield that is a bubble
description: This power creates an ordinary water/air bubble around the user. The bubble has a radius of one metre from the center of the user. If the user won't fit, then add one half of a metre to that and repeat until the user fits. The bubble can withstand up to ten pounds of force being used on it, but reforms after ten seconds.
pros: Bubble automatically reforms after ten seconds of being hit unless first con occurs.
Bubble can withstand most non-slashing and non-electrical attacks/powers.
cons: If the bubble is hit with an electrical attack or power, you can't form it for the next 24 hours.
Bubble is automatically destroyed if hit with an electrical attack/power.

name: Mimic Backlash
overview: inflict pain on people who try to mimic your powers.
description: With this power, you will be able to cause intense pain and discomfort in a person when they try to mimic or copy your powers. This does not work if they acquired the powers by other means.
pros: Cause pain to mimics
cons: Doesn't work on people who acquired the same powers by other means

name: Cold Night
overview: freeze the night by sleeping and decide when the sun will rise by waking up.
description: The ability to freeze the night when you are sleeping. The night will last as long as you're still sleeping. It will only end the moment you wake up. This ability is not permanent. You can activate this skill when you want to.
pros: You don't have to follow an alarm clock anymore
cons: Lots of things can happen by messing up with the time

name: Koldoken
overview: launch a projectile that would temporarily freeze the opponent.
description: Meaning freezing surge fist, a hadoken is the ice equivalent of a fireball, a frost/cold ball if you will. You can fire up to three of those (at the same time) towards the enemy and if it touches your enemy, he/she will be frozen for a while.
pros: Can be like Sub-Zero from MK.
cons: Fire type opponents would be immune to this.
Only lasts a small period of time.

name: Cerebral Spike
overview: turn your finger into a spike to plug into others' brains
description: At will you can turn your index finger into a sharp, hard spike, which when plunged into another's brain will allow you to absorb all their knowledge and memories. Stabbing another body part will not absorb anything.
pros: Can soon learn massive amounts of information
No need to interrogate your foes
You can use your spike as a weapon too
cons: Unless you have an excellent memory or write the info down, you will forget it
Others have to die for you to learn
Any forcefield or strong armour will block your spike

name: The Pathsof Magic:The Enchanter
overview: have special talent as an enchanter.
description: The Path of the Enchanter, or the Path of the Hand, is the last Path of Magic. Enchanters use magic to create objects with magical powers. One of the many properties of mana is that it can change the atomic properties of matter it flows through. If this is done in a controlled fashion, objects can be given new properties. One example is a sword that can absorb heat from something it stabs, causing it to freeze. This ability gives you special talent for enchantment.
pros: You can create objects of great magical power.
You have special talent for enchantment.
Objects can be given multiple abilities, but this is dangerous, as the properties can conflict.
cons: Items can be lost or stolen.
If an enchanted item is transmutated, it loses all magical abilities.
If the enchanted object is broken, it will release a destructive explosion of magical energy

name: Spider Mimicry
overview: transform into a spider-like hybrid
description: At will, you can turn into a spider-human hybrid and back. You remain the same size, but gain enlarged canines laced with a paralysing venom, four black-haired large spider-legs sprout from your back, small black hairs grow over parts of your body and your strength is enhanced. Your eyes turn shiny black and your movement-based vision is improved. Your extra legs are strong enough to support your body and throw a person. Using them, you can climb up walls
pros: Can climb up walls
Your intimidating appearance will end most fights before they start
cons: If made too angry, you may accidentally transform
You will appear frightening to others
You can't web-swing

name: Vulcanizing
overview: give anything the properties of rubber
description: Rubber is bouncy, stretchy, floats on water, and is nearly indestructible. With just a thought you can make anything like rubber. Vulcanize your arm and use it as a whip. Vulcanize the car you're about to crash. Vulcanize your feet and bounce around. Vulcanize your entire body and become indestructible. The world is rubbery with this ability.
pros: Vulcanizing anything and everything
Becoming rubbery
You can also devulcanize things
cons: If you Vulcanize rubber it becomes explosivly bouncy

name: Imagination Crusher
overview: destroy a person's imagination
description: This ability lets you destroy anything that someone is imagining. Imagined creatures, objects, and imagined realities are instantly destroyed via touch and touching another person directly destroys their imagination.
pros: Destroys Reality Warpers except for those that can erase your existence
Destroys things that require visualization such as projections of a Green Lantern Ring
As Einstein said "Imagination is more important than knowledge"
cons: Normal memorized actions are not negated
If the user is actually a figment of imagination this power will destroy them
Without gloves you can accidentally destroy people's imagination

name: Jewellery
overview: change anything into jewellery
description:
Change anything into jewellery. 
The new formed jewellery will maintain one feature from it's past form, for example:
a lamp into a ring - the ring lights up.
pros: Always impress the ladies
Have jewellery with useful features (glowing rings)
cons: You might run out of storage for your jewellery
You might get a bad feature (spikey necklace)

name: Bomber's Touch
overview: turn anything into a bomb.
description: When throwing items to other people, simply turn those into bombs and they shall learn their lesson of messing with you.
pros: Anything can turn to bombs, even people.
cons: Accidentally touching yourself while this power is active will turn you into a living bomb.

name: Trap Master
overview: create a trap in a selected area.
description: With this power you see the world as if on a grid. By selecting areas of the grid you can cause the area to be turned into a trap. The type of trap is typically random but you can direct the power to a certain type of trap, though it will not always turn out as you imagined. You can also direct the range of how deadly your trap is. You will not activate the trap but anyone else in the selected area will. The trap could be anything from a hidden turret to a disguised hole in the floor.
pros: Set traps for your enemies using only your mind.
You are immune to your own traps.
You can deactivate your traps in the same way as making them.
cons: Have to see the world in a grid all the time.
Your traps may not work as planned or hurt someone you wish to protect.
Foes have to come within the selected area for the trap to work.

name: Essence Mix
overview: mix the essence of two or more objects into a new essence
description: This ability is used in conjuction with Hollowing Essence. With this ability you may mix two or more essences stored or otherwise into a brand new essence which will be stored within you.
pros: Create a brand new essence
Get the best of two things into one essence
cons: Must havethe essence you want to mix nearby.

name: Paint Manipulation
overview: manipulate any paint or pigment (except chlorophyll or melanin)
description: A person with this power can manipulate paint. Not only can they use this for artistic purposes they can also use this to attack. For example they can control paintballs as a concussive attack as well as use paint similar to hydrokinesis. They can also literally rip the paint off walls to use. The paint can also be turned from solid to liquid state at the user's preference. In addition objects covered in paint are also able to be manipulated by moving the paint with the object.
pros: Can cheat at paintball deflecting all shot and making all shots "home in" on opponents
Paint the fence faster
Since most houses are painted you can literally rip off that paint to use it as a weapon
cons: Needs imagination to use
Needs paint to work

name: Cryonic Function
overview: function and move normally even at really cold temperatures.
description: When the body temeperature drop, you usually shiver, get hypothermia, nerve signals slow down, blood flow stops in some areas, skin contricts, and many more problems.
