With this ability, you can move and function normally even when body temperature drops too low. You don't even shiver when the temperature drops. Your body will still produce body heat to stay at 98. 6 F. The risks are that body temperature can lower quicker, frostbite can occur, feeling cold, and freezing solid kills you.
pros: No more numb extremities in the cold.
No more hypothermia.
No more shivering.
cons: Body tends to cool down faster.
Frostbite can occur and kill the frozen area.
Freezing solid will kill you.

name: Deathmatch Field
overview: create a "arena" that only the last person standing can leave
description: The user of this power pictures a place in their mind and designates it as an "arena". That area is then enclosed by a bright red "boundary". Any person who enters or is caught within the "boundary" is trapped inside of it until they are the last living person in the "arena". Anyone who goes "out of bounds" before this dies of massive internal hemorrhaging. The only other way to deactivate this power is with your death.
pros: Trap people inside the "arena".
Escape pursuers by traping them in an "arena".
Turn teams (heros and villains alike) against one another.
cons: You could trap youself in your own power if your not carefull.
You can only have one "arena" up at a time.
The "arena" doesn't force people to fight, mearly puts them in a situation where it is likely.

name: Plastic Demons And Spirits
overview: both control, mold and transfer demons and spirits into plastic objects.
description: With this ability you can mold any plastic thing into anything and then transfer almost any demons or spirits to make the molded objects come to life and improve the plastic by turning them into the element of the spirits or demons that posess them and if more then one spirit or demon is transfered to one object than said object will keep the first spirit or demon element.
pros: You can build an army of plastic demons and spirits.
You can transfer up to 16 spirits or demons into a transformed plastic object to boost its power.
You can help the envirement by collecting plastic.
cons: You can't transfer demons or spirits that posess the fire element.
Some of the spirits and demons might turn out useless or like destruction to much.
If you join a spirit and a demon in a transformed plastic object the object will self destruct.

name: Summon Ally
overview: summon an ally
description: You have the power to summon a magical orb right near your ally where ever she/he is. You don't need to know their location.   The ally can be a friend, a relative or anyone who's not an enemy.   That ally has the choice to touch the orb, or not.  And only the ally can see it.  The orb shows a view of the destination place.  (so they can see it's safe)  The moment the orb is touched that ally will then immediately appear at the place that was shown through the orb.
pros: Have your allies appear near you when needed
Summon your kidnapped relatives to a safe place
cons: When your ally can't even move enough to touch the orb
When your ally is sleeping and isn't aware of the orb
Friends that are constantly late for a meeting and keep demanding you help them.

name: Myth Power: Spondae Special
overview: channel the Spondae and their command over the essence of treaties, contracts and treaty libations
description: The Spondae (Spondai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of treaties, contractual agreements and drinking wine to seal deals. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically summon and fill out a scroll-like contract (with feather quill pen and ink well for signing) at will; a contract may bind subjects to a promise (with deadly results for failure to comply), grant wishes, etc. In addition, one may summon a glass of wine to negate inhibitions. One may even gain skill in handling contracts.
pros: Psychically summon a scroll/feather quill pen/ink well, and draw up contracts for wish granting, etc
Psychically summon a glass of inhibition-negating wine (making foes easier to trick and confuse)
Become a master at creating/exploiting loopholes; Tearing up contracts negates any deal
cons: Summoned wine is only irresistible (and useful to heal self/others) at the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Horkos' Pledge, MythPower: Styx Bond, etc provide immunity (NCN)
Wine/festivity-based MythPowers provide immunity to (and power from) this ability (NCN)

name: One Man Band
overview: mimic the sounds of any musical instrument
description: With this power you can mimic the sounds of any musical instrument with only your mouth. Unless you happen to have more than one mouth you can only mimic the sounds of one instrument at a time.
pros: You can mimic the sounds of any musical instrument
cons: You can only mimic one instrument at a time

name: Anthropomorphic Personifying
overview: create anthropomorphic personifications of anything.
description: An anthropomorphic personifications is the physical, thinking, living form of a concept or idea. For example; the Grim Reaper for death. With this power you can personify any idea you like. The personification has full influence over the thing it's the personification of, and its personality is influenced by the way the idea is perceived by humanity. For example, the personification of Google would follow the company motto of "don't be evil" and the company would act on its wishes unconsciously.
pros: Turn something unthinking into a living being that can be influenced.
Personifications are as hard to destroy as the ideas or concepts they represent.
Personifications are intimatly connected to what they represent, and can share information with you.
cons: The destruction of the personification will destroy what it represents as well.
The personification is not controled by you, and has its own feelings and opinions.

name: Hecation Ability
overview: have a genetic heratige that allows all abilities you possess to be magnified
description: It's an anchient family which passes from uncle to nephew,they are characterized by going through several "jumps" in their lives which cause their abilities to intensify and diversify. They always start out with a starter ability, the three that are alive right now started with, clairvoyence, precognition and empathy.
pros: They are very powerfull
They are unique
They are ususally taught by the uncle before them
cons: They always feel they are different
There abilities can get out of control
They have a dislike of themselves

name: Ability Augmentation
overview: expand upon pre-existing abilities
description: An Ability Augmenter can permanently enhance the abilities of others, granting new sub-abilities which branch off from their primary ability. A Telekinetic wouldn't be able to lift increased mass, but may be able to create telekinetic energy fields. A Speedster couldn't run any faster, but might be able to vibrate through walls, or make objects explode through vibration. Augmentation requires physical contact.
pros: Granting friends enhanced forms of their abilities
You have some influence over the augmentation
You can augment an ability more than once
cons: Requires physical contact
Being forced to augment the ability of an enemy
Augmenting an ability multiple times can make it unstable

name: Myth Power: Demeter's Touch
overview: channel Demeter's command over the essence of food, agriculture and the Eleusinian Mysteries
description: Demeter, in Greek myth, was the goddess of food, agriculture and the Eleusinian Mysteries. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically access cooking skill. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to any location with food, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically manipulate plants, at will. One can also psychically absorb sunlight and the earth's nutrients, to heal and gain physical power and sustenance, at will. One can even psychically perceive the Astral Realm, at will.
pros: Psychically access cooking skill; perceive and teleport to any location with food, at will
Psychically manipulate plants; psychically perceive the Astral Realm, at will
Psychically absorb sunlight and earth's nutrients to heal, gain physical power/sustenance, at will
cons: Cannot psychically absorb sunlight and earth's nutrients to grow in size, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based powers, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically bond with users of MythPower: Persephone's Poise, until developed (NCN)

name: Plant Growth
overview: make plants grow to maturity very quickly
description: Food shortages are the cause of many of the world's problems. A Plant Stimulator can make a field full of seedlings become adult plants in less than 10 seconds. If those plants are fruit-bearing, then those fruits become huge and very nutritious--apples the size of softballs, pumpkins the size of exercise balls, etc. This is not Plant Manipulation; the user cannot direct the growth of the plants. They also cannot make the plant wither back to its original state.
pros: Make whole crops of seedlings become adults in seconds
Fruits of these plants become huge and nutritious
Good for farming
cons: Cannot direct the growth
Cannot manipulate plants
Cannot reverse the process

name: Inescapable Judgment
overview: trap an enemy and kill him.
description: Usable by the Demon Transformation #3 Black Demon. Lasers shoot out of your wings (must have some), go around an enemy and close behind him (Explanation: take both your hands, hold the wrists together. Now, touch each finger of one hand with the opposite finger of the other hand (ring finger with ring finger, etc.) You are standing where the wrists meet, your palms are your wings, your fingers are the lasers and your enemy is in between) First, you fire an orb that will sap out all the power...
pros: ..of your enemy, then you follow up with a sword attack that finishes off your helpless opponent.
If the orb hits, your enemy is finished.
cons: Can be evaded by: teleporting out of the lasers, burrowing in the ground, turning into mist etc.
PS. 500 letters is SOO not enough for my descriptions.

name: Panontic Arch:Gray Abyss
overview: gain powers from the Gray Abyss dimension.
description: Gray Abyss - home of phasing monstrosities. The first ability is to turn into something inhumanly strong, fast and tough. You look like a creature that was left out of the Necronomicon. You can also use the phasing power but only in your hideous monster form. You are unaffected by the sight of yourself in monstrous form. While in monstrous form, seeing creatures like yourself has no affect on your sanity.
pros: Inhuman speed, strength and toughness.
The phasing power.
cons: You're not invulnerable.
Your monstrous form could shatter the minds of the weak-willed.
Heroes will easily mistake you for some sort of vile monster.

name: Enhancement: Triple
overview: triple the effects of a power by attaching this power to it
description: This is a support power. This power must be attached to another power at which point it triples the effects. This power is gained by using Enhancement: Double several times at which point it evolves into this power. Because of this anything that goes for Enhancement: Double goes for this power. Can only attach this power to one power at a time.
pros: Triple the effects. Triple Fireball!!!
Anything that goes for Enhancement: Double goes for this power. May be con for certain parts.
If used enough may quadruple.
cons: Some powers that are useful doubled might be useless tripled.
Useless without another power.
Must have had Enhancement: Double and then used it.

name: Story Teller
overview: observe any story.
description: Gives you ability to enter any story (lives of humans are also concidered their stories) and observe it. You are given unlimited powers while you are observing a story. You can help people or harm them, hovever there is a limit.
pros: You have ultimate/unlimited power.
You can change your favorite stories or help people you know.
cons: You take physical and mental damage each time you significantly affect the story.
Saving someone from death will cause you the most damage.

name: Sonic Scream
overview: scream at a super high volume.
description: You can make your voice incredibly loud.  Great for stunning people, getting people's attention, and being "that guy" on live concert albums.
pros: Shock and confuse people
Project your voice
Get people's attention
cons: You could damage people's hearing if you're not careful

name: Handful Hands
overview: create thousands of hands.
description: This ability allows you to create thousands of hands that will appear wherever you want them to appear. The movements of the hands follow the movement of your original hands. When one of your hands is destroyed, you won't be able to feel any pain.
pros: Makes tasks easier for you to do
cons: You decide...

name: Fog Shield
overview: create a thick fog.
description: Your hands shake and a cloud of fog appears in which you can hide and strike unseen. The fog also functions as a shield against incoming attacks.
pros: A great way to escape stronger enemies.
You can hit unseen and retake a defensive position when the fog clears.
No human is able to see you in this thick fog.
cons: Strong winds can blow away the fog and leave you defenseless.
Those with sonar and supersight will still be able to spot you.
It has no offensive possibilities.

name: Sense Balancer
overview: balance power between your senses
description: Imagine that everyone on the planet has 40 points for all of their senses: Sight, Hearing, Touch, and Smell/Taste. 10 points is the average for each sense. Well, with this ability you can freely add or subtract points to or from each sense. This can be done instantaneously. However, you can't add to the original total of 40. There's a ton of uses for this. Become an awesome sniper. See with sonar. Sense air pressure and predict the weather... Maybe. Make foodgasms EVEN BETTER!!
pros: Can adapt easily to most challenges
Predict the weather probably
FOOD..... GASM
cons: Mostly only good for spying
Leaves you open to certain attacks

name: Holy Power: The Reaper
overview: use the powers of The Reaper, the second Path of Light.
description: With this power you can "activate" the Reaper mode. You gain a powerful energy armor and the powers of the Reaper. While using the reaper, you get Super Strength Level Omega, Superhuman Senses and invulnerability. You also become able to use all the other Reaper ability's. To acquire the Reaper you need Six Paths of Light, and you must not send anyone to hell or heaven, you can only kill your enemies. Reapers are ill-considered by other enlightened's.
pros: Allows you to use all the next Godlike powers of The Reaper.
Makes you so strong that you are able to raise a "small" tectonic plaque.
Allows you to use the Reaper Scythe, who brings death to all the ones who deserve it.
cons: Hard to get, Reapers are considered black sheep's by the other enlightened.
Need Six Paths of Light.
Another Enlightened can kill you.

name: Frozen Reaver
overview: create a sword made of frozen souls
description: The Frozen Reaver it a move that allows the user to steal any number of souls and create a sword out of them. The sword can freeze enemies on contact and is very hard to destroy. The sword is grayish black and can have any style the user wishes to have (Japaneses, European etc). The size of the sword depends on the number of souls used: 1 soul makes a dagger, 10 and up make a sword that grows with the number of souls. In order to add more souls, the user must kill anything and trap the soul
pros: Very strong weapon
Freeze anything on contact
Hard to destroy
cons: Needs souls to make
Size and power depend on the number of souls used

name: Location, Location.....
overview: never be defeated at a decided location.
description: You are able to choose a location (no bigger than a city) that you are not able to be defeated at. You can be hit, but you are resistant to it or are healed or something.

cons: This isn't exactly immunity, so you can still die because of personal reasons (poison,burns,etc. )
You can still feel pain.
Just put one foot outside of location and you can be defeated.

name: Web Shot
overview: shoot spider webs.
description: The ability to shoot organic spider webs out of spinerets located in the hands, fingers, or wrists. Your body constantly makes new webs, so you never run out. The ability to make complex webs is imprinted in your DNA. Shoot sticky, dry, line, and ball webbing. You can even make web walls, boats, shields, parachutes, and sculptures.
pros: Swing from buildings.
Web annoying people's mouths shut.
Webs will dissolve after an hour (no evidence).
cons: You can slam into a building while swinging.
Webs conduct electricity.

name: Poison Spit
overview: spit poison
description: With this power you can spit poison up to forty feet the poison is deadly and instantly kills whatever living thing it touches
pros: You can kill people from up to forty feet away
cons: You need to have good aim

name: Myth Power: Smiting
overview: channel the wrath of the ancient Greek gods
description: Everyone knows that the Greek gods all had particular domains, but there was one thing they could ALL do: smite those who oppose them. If people thought they could surpass a god in something they presided over, they were turned into something, or driven mad, or their people were afflicted with plague, or died, or were struck by lightning, as Zeus was famous for. Channeling the divine wrath of the Olympians, you can do just the same, provided you don't disrespect the gods, yourself.
pros: Inflict divine wrath upon foes for defying the Greek gods
Choose any method of smiting you like (and be immune to other gods' smiting)
Choose between a person, a group or an entire nation
cons: Plague, famine, hunger, destruction, chaos, violence? That means a lot of clean-up
If you offend the gods in any way, you lose this power
If you offend the gods after you lose this power, YOU get smited

name: Enhancement: Permanence
overview: make the temporary effects of a power permanent
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the temporary effects of a power permanent. The permanence lasts until this Enhancement is taken off. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: Permanently enhanced strength, speed, dexterity, defense, etc.
Used on defensive powers, this will beat the sniper!!!
cons: Useless without another power.
Do you really want to make self-damaging powers permanent?
Makes bad effects permanent as well as good effects.

name: Good Clone Generator
overview: create good clones of criminals, super villains, bullies and other baddies
description: With this power you can generate "good" versions of criminals, super villains, bullies, monsters and other jerks. The clones are not under your control but are generally helpful and love to do good deeds. You cannot get rid of the clones once you generate them. This could even be useful if you're a villain. You can make a good version of yourself to make yourself look good to the public eye and you can discredit other villains and make them look bad (good) in front of bigger and badder villain.
pros: You can create good clones of evil/bad/mean people
They love to do good deeds
cons: They're not under your control
You can't unsummon them

name: Kaiser
overview: have the title of Kaiser and all that it entails.
description: This superpower instantly and automatically provides the title of Kaiser to those that acquire all of the superpowers of the Superpower List. Either naturally or through the superpower known as The Superpower List. Inaddition to this superpower also granting all the responsibilities that come with the title of Kaiser. Which are to protect the innocent, make strong the weak, mend the broken, and defeat the forces of evil.
pros: You have the title of Kaiser, meaning that you are extremely powerful.
You'll feel compelled to protect the innocent, make strong the weak, mend the broken, & defeat evil.
Instantly & automatically granted to those that have the superpower known as The Superpower List.
cons: Does not provide you any additional superhuman powers or abilities.
Having to fight and defeat the forces of evil time and again.

name: Error Immunity
overview: immune to any or all glitches and errors in a false reality.
description: This ability allows the user can be immune to all the flaws in a false reality.  In a video game , the user would not be frozen the world crashes. In a cartoon, the user will not be harmed by that reality's flaws.
pros: be immune to errors
cons: only works in false realities.

name: Energy Blend: Sonic Magnetism
overview: produce a beam of magneto-sonic energy.
description: When you activate this power, pointing at any target releases a purple beam of magneto-sonic energy from your finger. Magneto-sonic energy is a mix of magnetism and sound, so it magnetises the molecules of the target. The beam doesn't directly hurt the target, but any magnetically-affected objects will slam into them. And if the target produces any sound energy, the magnetic field's strength and range is increased. But the effect is only temporary, and will wear off over some time.
pros: Make a beam out of your finger that magnetises the target.
The magnetic field is increased by the amount of sound energy produced by the target.
The effects are only temporary.
cons: Will not hurt them directly, but any piece of magnetically-affected metal will be drawn to them.
Unless you have advanced control over the power, you will regret pointing at anything.
The effects are only temporary.

name: Piano Master
overview: be an expert at playing the piano
description: A person with this power is an expert at playing the piano/keyboard/organ. You can play any song and read music perfectly as well.

You can become a professional pianist
You can read music
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Human Spring
overview: define a reference position where your body will return to when it's moved away from it.
description: When you activate this power, your starting spatial position and body posture become your reference. A force will act upon your body to make it return to it as soon as you move or are moved away, as if elastic strings were connected between you and your reference. The further you are, the stronger the returning force. This power works down to the molecular level, wounds and fractures closing if they were inflicted after you activated your power. This power doesn't affect bodily functions.
pros: If you are moved from your original position, you will automatically return to it.
If you are falling, you can use this power to remain suspended in mid-air.
You have some form of accelerated regeneration.
cons: Your reference position can only be a position and posture you just adopted.
You will have an increasing difficulty to move by yourself the further you are from your reference.

name: Evolutionary Distortion
overview: change modern fauna and flora into a prehistoric chaos
description: Can change animals into prehistoric beasts and turn modern plants into a prehistoric environment. A lizard or bird world resemble dinosaurs, mammals would resemble their ice age cousins. The flora of a desert could turn into a jungle or forest.
pros: Can create new species that resemble prehistoric animals
Can be controlled as long as the person is alive
cons: Can mess up the modern ecosystem and can cause a new age of animals
The worst animals or plants would consume a city within a matter of months or days
If the user dies then they would consume the planet within months or years

name: Political Plumber
overview: fix any government.
description: Basically, with this ability you can make a complete overhaul of whatever country you happen to be in at the time. It will dismiss/dismantle it's government and replacing it with the perfect system which will eventually lead to the end of all of it's problems, creating the ultimate Utopian society within at least two and a half months.
pros: Help corrupt countries
End wars and civil unrest
cons: You'll erase cultures

name: Half Lycanthrope
overview: be half-human, half-lycanthrope
description: A being with this power has increased strength, speed, and healing speed. They also have a heightened sense of smell than a human's, though not as good as a wolf's. They can also transform into a wolf, but only two areas of the body can be transformed at a time. Each arm, each leg, the head, the upper body, and the lower body are different areas of the body for this power. Silver and other lycanthropic weaknesses affect half-lycanthropes as they would an ordinary human due to being part-human.
pros: The boosts occur both when transformed and when not transformed, but are better when transformed.
No lycanthropic weaknesses!
cons: The boosts to strength, speed, and healing rate vary and may not be any better than a human's.
Can still die by having the head cut off (Plus there are NO defensive boosts).

name: Third Person Perspective
overview: see yourself in a flying camera mode
description: This power basically allows the person using it to be able to see themselves in a third person flying camera that can change angles. This also allows you to slow down time to do slow motion moves (because slow-mo makes anything better). You can still control your body and mind completely and can go back to first person if you want to. If the camera hits an obstacle, it will automatically move to the nearest free space.
pros: Seeing yourself do awesome dance moves
Able to check yourself out
cons: Hard to coordinate at first
You also are slowed down by the slow motion
The camera is always fixated on you

name: Urban Legend Materialization
overview: make urban legends real and control certain factors of urban legends
description: With this power, you can make urban legends come true.  You also have limited control over the legend itself by materializing your interpretations of the urban legend. You can access any urban legend you know of from any place. Also, you can have the legend materialize to everyone or haunt specific people. An urban legend can be any rumor that a large group of people have heard of, another example would be the chain mail people send.
pros: You can scare people and do many other things
This power can work selectively and can be used on any urban legend
Materialize the urban legend to scare the creators of the original chain mail

Some legends can drive people insane
Legends have the same weaknesses as their description

name: Aura Entrapment
overview: cause someone's aura to constantly harden or turn to stone around them.
description: This ability can be used to turn your opponent's aura against them. When used, the aura of the target constantly harden and becomes stone, trapping the person. The entrapment can be removed by supressing the target's aura or by sheer strength of the one trapped. For instance, someone with super strength could smash the stone forming around them and would only be slowed down, not stopped.

Turn enemies' auras against them.

Sheer strength can overcome the stone.

name: Myth Power: Eurybia's Rule
overview: channel Eurybia's command over the essence of the sea's forces and naval/maritime supremacy
description: Eurybia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the sea's forces, which influence sailing and other marine pursuits. As such, channeling her allows one to breathe underwater, swim well and withstand pressure and friction from wind and water. In addition, one can pressurize ambient moisture at will, to blast at foes. One can even mimic water pressure; this allows a tactile form of Hydrokinesis, enhances attack impact with moisture from the air, or even allows one to crush things in one's bare hands.
pros: Breathe underwater, swim well, withstand pressure/friction/resistance from wind and water, etc
Pressurize water or ambient moisture in the air to produce powerful water jets at will
Water Pressure Mimicry (control water by touch, stand underwater as if on land, crush things, etc)

Pro #3 requires touch (NCN)

name: Multiple Choice Master
overview: always guess the correct answer in multiple choice or true/false
description: This power is a weak probability altering power that always makes the user get the correct answer when confronting a multiple choice situation. This is not limited to tests. This can also apply in real life when the user approaches a point where there are multiple choice such as a game show or a fork in the road. If in a battle situation you imagine the world as a quiz you can use this similar to prerecognition.

name: Lonely Island

description: With this power you can teleport people to an island where they are all alone and they can't escape from it and nobody can get to it unless you send them there. The island is a standard desert island its got palm tress, coconuts, crabs and one fresh water river surrounded by thorn bushes.

overview: channel Iaso's command over the essence of recovery from illness and injury
description: Iaso, in Greek myth, was the goddess of cures, remedies and modes of healing. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive and communicate with ill and injured subjects, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive what treatment an ailing subject needs, as well as how to administer it, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically summon medicines and medical instruments, at will. One can even enhance medicines' curative effects (or weaponize medicines or instruments) at will.
pros: Psychically perceive and communicate with ill and injured subjects, at will

name: Instant Moving

If the item was on a shelf/closet/bin/etc before you used the power it will be on a shelf/closet/bin/etc in the new location (if there is no shelf/closet/bin/etc in the new place or there are too many items to fit on the shelf/closet/bin/etc the item will appear on the floor). You can use this power as many times you want but it automatically moves every single thing you own.

If any super is told about you or learns about you in any way, they forget about you in seconds. This power is completely fool proof. If any power would allow a super to become aware of your existance, you are immune to that power. However, you can allow people to find you (like allies etc.)

Sneak by even the most observant super undetected!

Normal people are unaffected

overview: negate your powers and become mortal, but revive in select conditions.
description: With this power, you can deactivate all of your abilities and become mortal. However, you can choose to have your abilities reactivate under certain conditions, such as when the human race is threatened and you can reactivate them at will at any time. The power has access to all of your abilities; if you have super speed, it will process things as fast or faster than you would normally.

name: Sexy Scent

You can have fun with and manipulate people
Walk into a room and blast your sexy scent

name: Fog To Hell
overview: breath out a black fog where anyone inside it will vanish.

Killing Machine

name: Humanity One!
overview: harness the power of humanity.
description: The user basically copies every living human being's physical and mental prowess, adding it to his/her own body, and thus is granted the combined forces of humanity. This means that the user has become one of the most powerful humans on the face of the planet; having generated an infinite supply of abilities amongst an already vast repertoire. Superhuman strength, speed, empathy, telekinesis, electrical energy; any based on the human body is at the user's disposal.

name: Taste The Rainbow!
overview: touch an object or living thing and turn it into Skittles!

Can control it

name: Gigantic Swung Object

description: There is a large category of hand-held objects with a handle, such as baseball bats, flyswatters, hammers, handbags, whips, screwdrivers, swords, knives, tennis rackets, buckets, shovels, axes, mallets, clubs, etc. When the power user holds one by its handle and makes a swinging movement, the body of the object will suddenly gain mass and grow to enormous proportions while moving at the same speed as its original version would move. pros: Durable razor sharp claws
Claws secrete a paralyzing toxin
Immune to toxin
cons: Neurotoxin could cause coma & death
Can't control how much neurotoxin is injected

name: Aura Wrap
overview: take an enemy's aura and wrap it around a weapon while also intermingling another aura
description: The effect of doing that is that both auras allow the weapon itself to be around 10 times more harmful to your enemy, while also temporaily negating a regenerative factor that they have. Neither aura that you use, however, can be your own aura.
pros: You can use this power even with the power'No Aura'.
The stronger the auras are the better this power is.
cons: All the destructive power of this power is just stealing others' strength.

name: Pixel Beam
overview: shoot a beam from your eye that turns things into their bit form
description: Anyone hit by this beam turns into a digitized looking version of themselves with or without color.  Bits can be stored in game software, shoved into TV screens, and can be taken out later on.  User can undo the effect of the pixelation by closing his eye.  Pixelized things are flat and can fit through small cracks.  You can hit yourself with the beam by looking in a mirror or looking at your hand.  You can choose to pixelize parts of the body or the whole body.
pros: Can make anything retro
Can store things in game files then pull them out later from the screen
Can choose which pixelation to undo
cons: Pixelation has no real offensive capability on its own, doesn't even hurt to be pixelized
If you lose your eyes then you also lose this power

name: Myth Power: Hedone's Pleasure
overview: channel Hedone's command over the essence of sensual pleasure, enjoyment and delight
description: Hedone, in Greek myth, was the goddess of pleasure, enjoyment and delight (of a sensual, sexual nature). As such, channeling her allows one to perceive what pleases others. In addition, one may psychically induce pleasant sensations by touch, word or thought, as well as heighten or diminish said sensations. One may even cast a convincing illusion, in which the subject feels as though they only experience that which sexually pleases them (regardless of what is actually happening around/to them).
pros: Perceive what pleases others (be the perfect people pleaser or heartbreaker)
Induce and alter pleasant sensations (even to the point of euphoric stupor, or addiction)
Cast a "Rose-Colored Glasses" illusion on foes; they only see what they want to see
cons: Only telekinetically affect subjects with sexually-pleasing libido energy at the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot be used to induce love; only pleasure and sensual arousal (NCN)
MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Psyche's Smile provide immunity (NCN)

name: Projective Prosopagnosia
overview: cause others to have prosopagnosia.
description: Prosopagnosia is the condition in which someone is unable to cognitively recognize faces. With this ability, the facial recognition part of the brain can be switched off in someone else, so they can see your face or your friend's face and have no idea who it is they are looking at. They aren't blind or stupid, they just cannot recognize faces. However, similar to other prosopagnosics, they can recognize people from clothing or behaviours, such as a hat or a bounce in their step.
pros: You can make people not recognize you by your face
You can make people not recognize each other by their face
cons: You need to consciously turn prosopagnosia on and off. It won't automatically happen
They can recognize you by something, such as an outfit you are known for wearing or your behaviour

name: Language Powered Abilities
overview: gain powers through the knowledge of foreign languages.
description: Do you like foreign languages? Do you know a second language? If you answered yes to either of these questions, then this is the power for you. With this power, every foreign language you learn gives you a power of your choice when you reach conversational level and the better you are at it, the more powerful the power it corresponds to is. It works for the ones you already know and is linked to the one you consider your natural one. It isn't just true languages, as musical instruments work too.
pros: Cannot lose a power unless you forget the language which gave it to you.
Number of powers is only limited by the number of languages you can learn.
Works for any language, including artificial ones like Esperanto and Klingon.
cons: You still have to learn the languages normally to gain the benefits.
If you forget the language, you lose the power.
You cannot choose the omni powers.

name: T&S Disembodiment
overview: project parts of your body through time and space.
description: If you really want to reach out and touch someone, then you would instantly open gateways in space through which you can project your own body, allowing you to teleport parts of yourself to other locations.
pros: You can use it to annoy your opponent.
cons: If you die, your limbs will get lost forever, drifting between dimensions.

name: Least Desired Powers Mimicry
overview: access any of the 100 least desired powers on the Superpowerlist
description: A person with this power can access any of the least desired 100 powers in the superpowerlist and can choose which ability to activate at any time. Think that this power is useless? Guess again. The user also has the ability to use any of the powers in conjunction with each other making it possible to have deadly combinations you might not even imagine.
pros: Can decide when to use each power---it's not always active
Can find out combinations that make these oh-so-useless powers deadly
Can access more than one power at a time
cons: The list always changes so you need to keep track of what powers you have

name: Scythe Manipulation
overview: create and control scythes
description: A low-level user of this power can only create two scythes at any given time and control scythes within a 3 metre radius while a high-level user can create thousands of scythes and control scythes within a 100 metre radius. This power can only be gained by harvesting 100 fields of grain with a scythe and mastering the use of a scythe for fighting.
pros: This is not a power to laugh at.
Enemies will probably call someone with this power, "Death" due to the scythes.
cons: It might take some time to harvest all 100 fields and each field has to be at least 1 acre.
Who in the world will you get lessons from for 'scythe fighting'?

name: Rapid Prototyping
overview: quickly mock-up a working prototype of a design out of materials you have at hand.
description: After creating the initial design of an object, the next stage is often to prototype it. With this power you can quickly and skillfully mock-up a working prototype out of anything you have at hand. The finished creation will by definition be unfinished; like beta software it will need to be refined. Added to this, some designs are beyond the scope of reality: you couldn't create an LHC prototype out of cardboard and scissors. As a design aid or quick solution, though, this power is very useful.
pros: Be able to quickly and skillfully create prototypes for a whole range of products.
Ingenuity and modelling/design skills are included within this power.
It will be far quicker to get a design from paper to finished product.
cons: The prototypes will likely be a bit temperamental/rough-and-ready.
This power is somewhat limited by feasability or access to tools/materials.

name: Illusion Of Fire
overview: create the illusion that you're body is on fire
description: This power allows the user to create the illusion that the user's entire body is on fire. This illusion will cause others to think that you are a being of evil and will induce fear into them, perhaps even permanently traumatizing them. With concentration, the user may be able to generate the illusion of heat.
pros: Illusion that your entire body is on fire (doesn't burn or hurt you)
Induce fear into others, perhaps even permanently traumatizing them
May be able to generate the illusion of heat.
cons: It's just an illusion.
Takes concentration to make an illsuion of heat.

name: Wound Licking
overview: heal wounds by licking them
description: One with this ability gains a NICE little set of capabilities. First off, of course, he can heal wounds by licking them (cuts, bruises, broken bones, tumors, etc. ). However, his tongue and mouth are also adapted to the point that the user is incapable of getting sick by ingesting poisons/acid. Not to mention, if the user licks a subject who ISN'T wounded, the subject is jolted with a wicked biological backlash (foe's nerves fire off at the same time)
pros: Heal physical wounds
Ingesting acids/poisons won't harm you (and tastes are different, so nasty things don't taste bad)
If you lick sbjects who aren't wounded, they suffer backlash, temporarily paralyzing them
cons: Licking people is creepy
Some user's don't get different tastes (licking wounds tastes HORRIBLE)
Some user's don't become immune to acids/poisons (you can only heal)

name: Vice Grip
overview: create strong pressure around objects or person
description: You can control the pressure around an object or person. You'll be able to crush things with immense power.
pros: Crush objects mentally
cons: Takes a lot of concentration & to much power to crush super dense objects

name: Chains Of Dragonoid
overview: summon two huge chains that set everything on fire.
description: Ages ago in a galaxy not so far away, a dragonoid roamed our stars. Searching for someone who could be a match for it's powers. And it found someone. The chain master Slybound forged two unique chains that could control this monster. But eventually the dragonoid died and so the chains were enchanted to set everything on fire. Only the handles are fireproof the rest will ignite all. Beware the actual chains don't burn but whatever hits them will ignite.
pros: When mastered you could hit almost anyone from any angle.
Cold during the winter or on hoth? Just touch a nearby object to set it on fire.
Just give an enemy a smack of the ol' chain and he'll run for the nearest source of water.
cons: You have to master this weapon so beware of ricochet.
Two huge chains that only work when together, and they are heavy as hell.
It's not like you can put em on the ground. Or the ground will be set on fire. (If it wasn't clear)

name: Teleportation Immunity
overview: resist being teleported somewhere against your will
description: With this power you will never be teleported to somewhere against your will ever again. You can resist teleporting machines, teleporting powers and teleporting creatures. You can turn this power on and off so you can be teleported to places if you want to.
pros: You will never be teleported to anywhere if you don't want to be teleported
You can resist teleporting machines, powers and creatures
You can turn this power on and off
cons: Does not apply to teleporting to other dimensions or time periods

name: Bomb Detector
overview: detect bombs and other explosives
description: With this power you will instantly be alerted if there is a bomb within thirty yards of your location. You will also know what type of bomb it is and its exact location. This power does not give you the knowledge on how to disarm or get rid of a bomb.
pros: You will automatically be alerted if there is a bomb within thirty yards of yourself
You will know what kind of bomb it is and where it is
cons: You will not know how to disarm it
This power does not affect water ballons, paint grenades, toy bombs or nonlethal bomb like objects
This power will go off even if you're the one who placed the explosive

name: Zodiac: Taurus
overview: forcibly remove a power from a target's body
description: By drawing the sign of Taurus the Bull, you can forcibly remove a power from your target, but in exchange you also lose a power or powers equal in strength to the removed power. The power(s) you lose have to be equal to or greater than the removed power in terms of strength. If you do not have enough powers to fulfill the requirement then you age an amount corresponding to the amount of power left to be equaled.
pros: You can remove an enemy's Power of Imagination, permanently.
You get to choose what is lost for both sides.
cons: Removing Power of Imagination means you lose lots of weak or a few strong powers.
Becoming old from using this power.

name: Soul Music
overview: play the music of a person's soul.
description: With this ability, simply touch someone and music based on that person's soul will begin to play out of nowhere. The music can be upbeat or depressing, rigid or chaotic, beautiful or terrifying. Each person has a different type of song, and the song that plays will tell you everything you need to know about what type of person they are.
pros: Listen to people's character and avoid the bad ones.
Have a source of music on hand at all times.
Ply your power to make money.
cons: This could be seen as a massive invasion of privacy.
You may not like what you find out.

name: Clone Control
overview: control the minds, bodies, and actions of clones
description: Any clone you come upon you can control. You can control how old they appear, how they think, what they do, etc. You cannot however do things that change who they look like. Ex: no changing hair color, sex, face, height, etc.
pros: An enemy that uses an army of clones.
cons: Not that many clones in the world.

name: Crown Of Sand
overview: have a sand crown that allows you to shoot sand and control desert animals
description: With this power you have a brown crown with a sand colored gem. You can shoot sand out of the gem in powerful bursts that send your opponent flying. The crown also gives you control over animals who live in the desert such as camels and lizards and such.
pros: You can shoot sand
You can control desert animals
cons: The sand might get in your eyes

name: Area Of Pain
overview: create an area that cuases intense pain to those within its range
description: With this ability you will be able to create an area (size is dependent of strength of power) that causes pain to all who are within the area. Pain will stop once you exit the area. The pain that victims are sujected to is intense, but can be overcome through superhuman mental control.
pros: Submit your enemies to intense pain
Anyone within the area is affected
cons: Pain ends when you exit the area
Pain affects the user as well
Pain can be blocked by mental control

name: Femtosecond Laser Burst
overview: shoot one laser from your hand for every femtosecond in a second.
description: A femtosecond is 0. 000000000000001 of an second. You will put a hole in anything that is not is somehow invulerable to lasers or that doesn't reflect or absorb lasers. The burst has a range of 20 feet and needs a 5 minute recharge time between uses. If you use this power more than 10 times a day your 'laser' hand will suffer burn injury and be crippled for a day. Your laser burst can only be dodged by someone who can perceive time slowed down or is moving light speed or faster than light.
pros: A million times a billion lasers in one second.
An attack so fast almost no one can perceive it.
cons: It's short range.
Lasers can't hurt everyone and some people could actually dodge your attack.
Limited use.

name: The Twilight Zone
overview: gain access and control the twilight zone
description: The twilight zone is an alternate dimension. It is more widely known as the Bermuda Triangle or the Devil's Triangle. Having this power gives access to manipulation of that dimension, spectral fire, magnetism, time warps, spectral flares, UFO-like transport constructs. If the user does not have a strong will or control of the power, they might be dragged into it.
pros: You can use time warps to capture people
It can be used to recover the missing ships, planes and people that have gone missing
The wielder can reveal the true mysteries of the Bermuda Triangle
cons: If your will is not strong enough, the twilight zone may destroy you
The twilight zone is a very unknown topic, so there is not a lot of knowledge about it
It is a very dangerous power

name: Similtude Combiner
overview: combine all or some things into one thing.
description: Combine things into one, like making a drop of water from every lake in the world go into a giant water bottle made from plastic from around the world. You can't combine things that are different, like water with steel: Ground combines with ground, air with air, metal with metal, fire with fire, etc.
pros: You can be a big time inventor.
Takes only a second.
Handy for a quick get away
cons: Can't be used on enemies, as in you can't use them, but you can hurt them with something you made.
Can only be made from the same type of thing that is connected in some way.

name: Summon Durendal
overview: summon Durendal, the ancient stone blade of Air.
description: Durendal is known as Charlemagne's personal sword, but it is also one of the four ancient stone blades of power. Durendal is the sword of air. Its powers include controlling air and purifying anything it touches. It is indestructible and can combine with its twin Durendal to create new Ley Gates which act as portals to other Ley Gate locations around the world.
pros: Control air
Create Ley Gates
Purify anything
cons: Must be combined with Joyeuse to create Ley Gates.

name: Myth Power: Lesson Of The Litae
overview: channel the Litae, and their command over the essence of prayers and blessings
description: The Litai (Litai), in Greek myth, were the nine frail sister goddesses of prayers, repentance and blessings. As such, channeling them allows one to grant up to nine wishes a day, for oneself and/or others. These wishes may be for anything, so long as they do not directly endanger or harm anyone. In addition, one receives divine inspiration and enlightenment when one requires it. One even gains favor by good-aligned gods of the Greek pantheon and immunity to MythPowers based on evil-aligned gods.
pros: Grant nine benevolent wishes a day, for self and/or others
Receive divine inspiration and enlightenment
Favor with good-aligned gods of the Greek Pantheon; immunity to MythPowers of evil-aligned gods
cons: Only nine wishes or blessings a day. Not nine for you AND nine for others. Nine TOTAL in a day.
Wishes cannot be used to directly endanger or harm anyone
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provides immunity (NCN)

name: Crack Creation
overview: create cracks on contact and control them for various functions
description: A person with this power can create cracks on anything the touch. In addition they can control this crack(s) as long as they have not lost physical contact with that object. The crack can travel from one solid to another so you can make the crack follow people at will. By controlling the crack they can use it in creative ways. A skilled user can control how deep the crack is and how wide it is so they can used it to carve up solid blocks into any structure into art or weapons.
pros: Powerful and versatile
Can use to carve up anything into a desired structure
The crack can travel from one object to another--ie "The Crack from the Donald Duck Cartoon"
cons: Inevitable bad puns based on this power's name
Requires constant touch with the origin of the crack--ie easy to find you
Does not work on incorporeal things

name: Flower Explosion
overview: make flowers explode by looking at them.
description: Don't you just hate their colors? their sickening fragrances? the feelings of happiness girls display when they are offered flowers? Well, now you can make those flowers explode! Mwahahahahahaha!
pros: Get rid of people with Flower Walk.
Get rid of happy couples on St Valentine's Day.
Get rid of FLOWERS!!!
cons: None. Seriously, this power rocks!
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Planetary Mimicry
overview: gain the basic features and abilities of any planets, moons, or asteroids you come in contact with.
description: This allows you to transform your body into a humanoid version of the planet you want to touch. I'll give a good example: Earth. You can have a stream of water flowing through your body that you can use to blast stuff, strong mountains on your back, and you'll grow in size depending on what planet your copied. Finally, you can have your very own gravitational pull that you can control.
pros: You could be strong depending on what planet you mimic.
Have a gravitational pull that you can control.
You can grow in size depending on what planet you mimic.
cons: You can't do Suns, Stars, or Galaxies.

name: Artifact: Diarium Ejus
overview: read people's minds using a book.
description: Whenever you say "Adeat", it summons a book that can read someone's mind. The book automatically writes down anything they are saying and shows a picture that sums it all up.
pros: Seperating the book into smaller pieces that can read multiple people's minds.
cons: Must know the person's name.
When you start reading, you become unaware of your surroundings.
All thoughts are deleted when you make the book go away.

name: Evil Eyes
overview: have the evil eyes.
description: This is Where you literally have evil eyes. This Power is most kept dormant, due to the fact that when they are active, any and every person you look in the eyes will run away in fear. This is activated and deactivated every time you close your eyes for exactly 3 seconds, so you don't have to worry about waking up with your evil eyes.
pros: You can make your enemies run away in fear, no matter how strong or brave.
It puts no strain on your eyes, so you can use it forever.
cons: It doesn't work on animals, so you are vulnerable to tigers and other dangerous animals.
If someone isn't looking you in the eyes, you are still vulnerable.

name: Power Bluffing
overview: temporarily have any single power you want if you can convince an opponent.
description: This power temporarily becomes another power-any power you've heard of and understand-if you can bluff an opponent into believing you have that power. This temporary new power last only as long as you are near the opponent you fooled. If you fail to bluff an opponent for one temporary power you can try for another power. Any opponent who catches on to your bluff or knows of this power will stop it from working.
pros: Any power you heard of and understand can be yours for a short time.
cons: This power is useless if you can't keep it secret.
Opponents who know you are lying.
Only works on one opponent.

name: Toximaniacal Form
overview: transform into a state which grows and gains power from consuming toxic waste, gas, and pollution
description: With this ability, you can transform into a sludge which grows and gains power from toxins, gases, and pollutions. The sludge brakes down, and consumes with powerful enzymes, and it can break down anything it chooses while in contact. It can throw, release, or hurl its toxic pollution. It can also breathe a dangerous toxic gas which can make people unconscious, or even disintegrate them, depending on how strong the user has become.
pros: Grow and gain strength by consuming toxic waste, gas, and pollution.
You have a variety of sludge abilities, strengthening the larger you become.
You have enzymes which can disintegrate objects, becoming stronger as you enlarge.
cons: The enzymes can be suppressed, but cannot be completely be turned off at will.
You are vulnerable to fire and ice.
Once you revert to normal form, you lose all the effects of this ability.

name: Reversal
overview: reverse the user and the target in a power
description: Basically you use this power on another power and the positions of the one who is using the power and the one who is targeted by the user are switched. Ex. You're being chased by a pyrokinetic. You use this power on their pyrokinesis and voila! You are now the one controlling the fire and they're the one on the run. They still have pyrokinesis but you're the one controlling it.
pros: You can get a lot of laughs out of this one.
Getting someone to attack you with a power then hijacking that power with this power.
cons: The other person has to use their power on someone else in order for you to use this power.

name: Thought Piggy Back
overview: use the surrounding people's thoughts and memories as your own.
description: This power can't be turned off. At first, you will have difficulty knowing which thoughts and memories are yours. You will have to guess by which stay when you leave that group. The more you concentrate this ability, the more you can widen the effect range. Others with mental-based powers may see this as a huge invasion of privacy (which it is).
pros: Fit into any group.
See any attack coming a mile away.
Know everyone better then they know themselves.
cons: Nothing anyone ever tells you is news (by the time they say it, you already know ).
People may not want you to know their deep dark secrets or past.
Can't turn it off.

name: Dark Crosses Of Judgement
overview: create shadowy crosses that hurt people based on karma
description: With this power you can create shadowlike crosses. You can create as many of them at a time as you want, but you are not immune to their effect. Whenever someone touches one of the crosses, they get hurt based upon the damage they have done to others mentally, spiritually, and physically. The crosses will ONLY disappear when touched by a living, sentient being. Using this power does NOT affect your karmic balance in any way.
pros: Crosses can only be gotten rid of by touching them.
The crosses also count in damage dealt by previous lives that haven't been affected by this power.
cons: The crosses can affect you.
Someone who has never hurt others' lives. (like that'll happen)

name: Myth Power: Cratos' Workout
overview: channel Cratos' command over the essence of strength, power and sovereign rule
description: Cratos (Cratus, Kratos), in Greek myth, was the god of physical strength, muscular power, might and sovereign rule. As such, channeling him allows one to be instantly snapped into peak physical condition. In addition, one gains Superhuman Strength, Endurance (Durability) and Stamina. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel muscular and physically strong neutrals, at will. One can even withstand direct effects of Superhuman Strength, as well as psychic compulsion.
pros: Snapped into peak physical condition; Gain Superhuman Strength, Endurance and Stamina
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel muscular/strong neutrals
Withstand direct use of Superhuman Strength and psychic compulsion (shared by touch)
cons: Cannot mimic allies' strength at will (absorb foes' strength, by touch) until developed (NCN)
MythPowers based on Styx or Styx's Children (Cratos, Bia, Nike, Zelos) provide immunity
Power/strength/toughness-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Pillow Manipulation
overview: create and control pillows
description: You can have the pillow be any size and shape you want. You can only create the pillows in a 50 metre radius around you and can control pillows within 100 metres of you. You can only gain this power by sleeping 16 hours or more per day for 1 week. You must willingly choose to sleep all those hours and cannot be knocked out, have fainted or be in a coma.
pros: You can easily win any pillow fight.
cons: This is really only useful in a bedroom...

name: Human Reflector
overview: reflect electromagnetic radiations.
description: When activated, your entire body gets the property to reflect all electromagnetic radiations. You can therefore scatter and be protected from dangerous radiations, such as microwaves, ultraviolet radiations, gamma rays and X-rays. You even reflect visible light, which turns you into a "human mirror" but who can't be shattered. By reflecting radio waves, you could even disturb radio communications by causing interferences or serve as a relay.
pros: You don't have to worry about dangerous radiations when you use this power.
You can blind people by reflecting a source of light directly into their eyes.
You can mess with radio communications.
cons: You cannot discriminate the radiations, you reflect all of them when you use this power.
This power alone doesn't allow you to perceive electromagnetic waves other than visible light.
When you use this power, you don't turn invisible and you look weird.

name: Giant Summon
overview: summon a giant
description: With this power you can summon a super strong twenty feet tall giant. The giant is under your complete control and you can use him for as long as you like. When you're done using him, he disappears into a pocket dimension and waits there until you call on him again. You can only summon one giant at a time but if it dies you can summon another one.
pros: You can summon a super strong twenty foot tall giant
It is under your complete control
If one dies you can just summon another one
cons: It is not invincible

name: Q Power
overview: have the power of the Q, from Star Trek.
description: Q is a fictional character from Star Trek, he is omnipotent, and all powerful. It is the Q's duty, to keep balance and order in the cosmos. Any misuse of your power and the Q continuum will judge you, to see whether you should remain Q or be a disgusting human.
pros: Have all power and immortality.
Be sworn enemies with patrick stewart.
cons: Misuse of power can result in loss of power.
Must maintain order and balance in the universe, being a Q.

name: Instant Karma Booster
overview: boost your own or others' karma in a good or bad way.
description: To understand this power, you must see your life as a balance. On one side, all the good you've done and, on the other, all the bad you've done. This balance is known as Karma. When your good side outweighs your bad side, good things will happen to you. But sometimes evil is stronger, in that case the Instant Karma Booster is the power you want to have. It makes one of the sides of the balance max out and delete the other side. So, you can enjoy a great life or give others a bad life.
pros: You can be as evil as you wish to be, everytime bad things start to happen just boost your karma.
You can use this power on yourself and others as much as you wish.
Someone giving you a hard time? Negative karma boost and your problem will be solved soon.
cons: Boosting bad karma can cause the boosted one to die by extreme bad luck.
Santa has his own list and if you are evil, he'll know.
Karma is fragile, mess with someone's karma a bit too much and the power might consume you.

name: Theme Manager
overview: change the theme of any object, place, or person.
description: Change the theme of a target to your choosing. You can make objects more effective for what they are intended to do, places more interesting and useful, and even give superpowers that fall within the theme to people. Items, places and people are still essentially the same, but the theme added on to enhances them. The theme change will last as long as the user of this power can maintain the change or until they leave the area. You cannot put two different themes on the same thing. Limited range.
pros: Can be used to "upgrade" items.
Can change and add utilities to an area.
Great for costume parties and trying new powers.
cons: May need to be specific to get a desired outcome.
May not work on sentient things if they mentally resist.
If used to give superpowers, previous superpowers may be unavailable if they don't follow the theme.

name: Myself Power Tamer
overview: gain all of the powers made by Myself, without suffering any of their cons
description: This is the Myself Attribution Power; this power lets you gain all the powers you want, that Myself has made or will make. All 'Myself powers' that you gain (and any 'Myself Powers' that you already have) will have all their 'cons' taken away. You can choose which of the 'Myself Powers' to acquire and you can get them all instantly.
pros: Myself has made soom excellent powers.
Useful.
Negate people's powers.
cons: Myself didn't make every power on the site.
Myself didn't make many of the mainstream powers

name: Arcana: 4 The Emperor
overview: have absolute control of movement over your own body.
description: This power lets you move however you want with your body. You can keep moving when it would be physically impossible to do so, like if your leg was broken or if your muscles were destroyed. This power lets you continue moving even if your body has died, with few ill effects. You are immune to pain your body feels and can even move it if you normally wouldn't be able to unless physically, and heavily, restrained.
pros: Can do things that you shouldn't physically be able to do.
Keep mobile while injured, or even dead.
cons: Your mind (And soul) is stuck to your body, even if your body is totally destroyed.

name: Crab Shell Armor
