The blind spots follow their eye movements.
cons: You can't hide something in a blind spot. They just need to look away a little and they will see it.
If an eye is closed, that one won't be affected.
The further you are, the smaller the blind spots will be.

name: Hand Manipulation
overview: change the size and shape of your hands
description: Hands can expand, elongate, compress, sharpen and change shape. Increasing size also increases the sizes of muscles without increasing the mass thus granting pseudosuperstrength but only in the fingers. If you wear gloves they will also have the same properties.
pros: You can create hammers, wings, lances, swords, and other creative things
You can punch with big hands and pick up small things with a small hand
cons: Only your hands can be manipulated
If your hand had an injury making it big will only increase the size of the injury

name: Gift: Lights
overview: be gifted at the control of light
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling light than other beings. Thus their light-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of light from them. However, someone with this power can only receive light-based powers, nothing else.
pros: Almost no one has as good control over light as someone with this power.
Light-based powers are boosted slightly.
cons: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only light-based powers now.

name: Enhancement: Healing (M)
overview: change the effect of a power to healing minds
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. While attached, it changes the effect of the power to cause it to heal minds instead of the original effect. Can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: Easy to do mass healings with Omni-Directional Blast.
Destructive powers can now have a second use.
A cure for insanity!!!
cons: Useless without another power.
A fireball that heals might be a little odd.

name: Trick Arrows
overview: spawn trick arrows used in any media.
description: This power allows the user to spawn any arrows used in any media (television,comics, and movies).  These can also be arrows that you can think up, but they have to be logical.
pros: Spawn trick arrows!
cons: You have no bow, or quiver.
Must be logical if you create your own.

name: Swords Of Aging
overview: create swords made of light that rapidly age whatever they touch
description: The swords cause whatever they touch to age 1,000,000,000 times faster than normal for one second. However, they only age whatever is in a close range to what they touch. Ex. If your hand is touched, only that will age rapidly. The user of this power can only have five swords out at a time. Aging the mind or brain however does not bestow increased intelligence by the way.
pros: Age your enemies so that it's harder for them to move.
1,000,000,000 secs is approximately equal to 31 years, 8 months, 15 days 14 hours and 24 minutes.
Each cut makes it harder to dodge the next cut.
cons: Those with powers that prevent aging can fully negate this power's effects on those they can affect.

name: The Infinite Dollhouses Prison
overview: trap forever someone in an infinite series of dollhouses.
description: A study of the power infinitely regressed led to this power. It creates a universe that is a house missing one wall with a dollhouse in it that is the house with the dollhouse in it. The house the victim finds himself in is a dollhouse in a house ad infinitum in either direction. A victim will always have food and water. There is just enough light. The victim won't suffocate despite an infinite of them existing. This power can only be used once a day due to stresses on reality and yourself.
pros: Eternal imprisonment is always good.
cons: Only once a day.
Dimensional travelers or those who resist reality changes.
You can't be there to hear the infinite scream of your infinite victim.

name: Shattering Person
overview: shatter like glass.
description: This is an interesting power. If a truck were to hit you, intead you would shatter as soon it touched you. While shattered, you can reshape yourself. It sorta looks like liquid moving when you see it. You can also control your shatterability from china to plate glass. Also for some unkown reason, you will pass through glass. Your pieces can also teleport if they are somewhere else. You can also shatter certain parts of your body.
pros: You won't get hurt by blunt things
Broken bottle hand
Pass through glass
cons: Nothing

name: Stun Beam Vision
overview: stun enemies with your vision beam
description: The people with this power is able to stun people with this power. Unlike the other visions which can potentially hurt people or kill people, this power will only stun the enemy. This power works, by stunning the enemies' neural synapses. This power has an effective range of 500 feet.
pros: Stun enemies instead of killing them (Stun now, ask questions later)
Will not accidentally kill your enemies
Easy to take down enemies with little or no superpowers
cons: More powerful enemies might not be affected
The stun effect will wear off after time
Cannot hurt a person

name: Name Strength
overview: gain super strength whenever somebody says your full name
description: With this power you can have super strength whenever anybody on the same planet as you says your full name (i. E. Jonathan Robert Doe). After they say your name you have super strength for the next ten minutes. This power does not work if you say your own name of if you tell somebody to say your name.
pros: You can have super strength
cons: They have to say your whole name
You can't say it yourself or tell other people to say it for you
It's only ten minutes

name: Summon Sharke
overview: summon a temporal energy monster.
description: Sharke are 20 ft. long, fly, look like a snake/shark hybrid and have an average IQ. Sharke can eat whole or take a bite from any matter that won't last forever. In the extreme far future, all normal matter won't exist. The Hulk or adamantium could be eaten. Sharke can only be hurt, stopped or contained with psionic, temporal or magical powers. A sharke stays until you unsummon it. You can summon a new one every day, but after a day, any sharke will eat when you're not around.
pros: Invulnerability is useless against a sharke.
Have your sharke chew its way into an adamantium vault.
cons: If one sharke might be too much trouble to keep around more than a day.
Anyone with time control powers.
Any foes who could live forever.

name: Delete This Mastery
overview: combo
description: the same
pros: None.
cons: None.

name: Untamed
overview: be immune to and cancel the effects of tamer powers.
description: This power (also called Untameability or Untamer) allows the user to create a barrier between them and those who possess a Tamer power of them so as to prevent the "Taming" that allows others to have all the powers created by the user. In addition the user gains an automatic immunity to all powers mimicked through tamers, though this is ineffectual if the person possesses a hard copy of the power being used. At advanced levels the user can even put up barriers for others who have tamers of them.
pros: These barriers cannot be breached by Barrier Defiance.
Don't worry about Tamer powers gaining all abilities you made.
Acquired Total Immunity will not protect against this power even through having a hard copy.
cons: The barriers will not defend against anything else other than protection of powers you have made.
Not much use if there is not a "Tamer" of you.
Only at advanced levels can barriers be spread.

name: Rise Of The Manticore
overview: turn into a manticore
description: With this power you can turn into a manticore. A manticore is a monster with the body of a red lion, the head of a man albeit with three rows of sharp teeth and the tail of a scorpion which can shoot poison barbs which can wound a person but cannot kill them.
pros: You can turn into a manticore
You can shoot poison barbs from your tail
You have three rows of sharp teeth
cons: The barbs can only injure not kill

name: Myth Power: Horae (Growth1)
overview: channel the Horae and their command over the essence of plant growth and production
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of plant growth. As such, channeling Hegemone (Soil, Healthy Plant Growth) allows one to psychically perceive and manipulate soil, at will. In addition, one can psychically teleport to anywhere with soil, at will, as well as gain physical power by standing in soil. Furthermore, one can psychically prevent plant growth or manipulation, at will. One can even psychically summon plants through space-time, to help self/allies, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive, manipulate and teleport to any location with soil, at will
Gain physical power by standing in soil; Psychically prevent plant growth/manipulation
Psychically summon plants through space-time to help self/allies, at will
cons: Cannot psychically manipulate plants (Agrokinesis), other than summoning them for help (NCN)
Pro #3 does not allow one to perceive and communicate with plants until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demeter's Touch and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Trip Wire
overview: trip anyone you want just by thinking about it.
description: With this ability, you can trip anyone at any time. Someone walking just a little TOO gracefully? Is there a arrogant bastard at the party that just needs to go down? What about that cop that just pulled you over? Trip them all, with or without them knowing it was you. Just think about it, and you can make it happen.
pros: People watching
Tripping someone you really don't like
Getting pulled over and asking the cop to demonstrate the sobriety test for you
cons: Tripping tight rope performers

name: Eye Projector
overview: project thougths through eyes like a movie
description: This power only works with absolute concentration. It can be used as an illusion to fool enemys and it helps when having flashbacks that are a little blurry. You have to let this power recharge itself for 5 minutes after use.
pros: You can project maps and globes from your eyes
Using it as a decoy to trick enemys is a good strategy
Can be used like a flashlight
cons: This power can cause short term memory loss
Using this power takes away your field of vision while in use
This power doesn't work in direct sunlight

name: Constellation Animator
overview: bring constellations to life
description: With this power you can bring any constellation of stars to life it doesn't have to be a known constellation just any shape or figure you happen to see in the stars
pros: You can have some really cool things
cons: You could have some really lame things (like dippers in assorted sizes)

name: Snap You're Dead
overview: kill people every time you snap your fingers
description: With this power, every time you snap your fingers, anybody who hears it will drop dead. All their body systems immediately shut down, and their soul automatically leaves their body. Sometimes the person's death is irreversible, but if you develop this power, the reversibility of the person's death can be decided. You might even be able to decide who can hear it. Either way, though, you should be careful when you snap your fingers with this ability.
pros: Useful if surrounded by enemies
Immune to the effects yourself
Can sometimes be reversed by means like Resurrection, Revivification, Necromancy, etc.
cons: It happens whenever you snap (can also affect friends, too, if they're caught off guard)
Deafness and the powers Sound Absorption and Inaudibility negate this power
This power cannot be reversed by the user

name: Play Dead
overview: stop all body functions and restart them later.
description: Stop all body functions and start them later, giving you the genuine appearance of a dead person. Can move while doing this.
pros: Play dead to avoid bears.
Play dead to avoid villains.
Play dead to copy your dog.
cons: You might be tossed in an incinerator.

name: Panontic Arch: Baroth
overview: gain powers from the Baroth dimension.
description: The Baroth dimension of false heroes. You gain two powers. First, the power to deceive anyone using empathy, mind reading, prediction, past detection, lie detection, body language reading or an alignment detection power on you. Second, you gain the power to not suffer any super powered consequences if you break an oath, promise, deal or pledge. Someone with a prediction power or body reading ability has to see you for you to give him a false impression.
pros: Be evil as you want and be sensed as the nicest guy on the planet.
Be good as you want and fool a good-detecting super villain.
cons: Your 'goodness' or 'evilness' in some situations will be difficult to explain.
You still suffer non-superpowered consequences by breaking a promise.

name: Oath Of Light
overview: have true happiness and bestow it upon others, at a price.
description: This power allows you to have a mind at peace with itself, without stress or worry. It also allows you to know subconsiously how to fix a bad, tense, or awkward situation. You can also bestow a mind at peace upon others. However, there is a price. You cannot kill a living creature, or act self-servingly in any way. This means that doing things like walking over grass very awkward, as you would not physically be able to step on a bug.
pros: You will be truly happy.
People will automatically like you.
You will be safe from depression.
cons: You cannot act even remotely self-servingly.
You cannot kill, so there are many jobs you will be unable to do.
You won't be much good in a fight, unless you have extremely strong willpower.

name: Life Soundtrack
overview: have a soundtrack in your life that always fits.
description: Your life now have a soundtrack it goes wherever you go and it always fits the situation you're in, you can make also other people hear the soundtrack. However, you cannot stop hearing the soundtrack yourself.
pros: Soundtrack always fits.
It can help you focus on something.
It can raise your awesome level in eyes of your friends.
cons: You cannot turn it off, you don't hear it only when you sleep.
It can distract you sometimes.

name: Empathetic Olfaction
overview: psychically smell a person's emotions & thoughts
description: Ever go into a room after a fight & you can sense strong emotions you can almost cut it with a knife. Well, you can't with this power, but you CAN smell it. Emotions take on an indescribable smell & they surround the person much like an aura. Different emotions emit different smells from pleasant like happy to foul odors like sad or angry. So strong you can almost taste it & if strong enough you could decipher & read a thought possibly.
pros: Smell emotions & maybe be able to read some thoughts
cons: Has to be a very strong emotion smell to read thoughts but may not always work
Psychopaths are hard to smell

name: Induce Apathy
overview: make those around you cease to care about anything.
description: Makes anyone in your sightlines (as in you can see them or could see them if you turned around) and range (defined here as the range at which you can make out their facial features) feel apathetic to everything. For example, you could murder someone in front of a loved one and they wouldn't care. In fact, you could murder anyone around you and they would not fight back.
pros: Free to live your life as you like (criminally if you wish) unobstructed.
Avoid arguments and tricky social situations.
Undefeatable at any short-mid range form of combat.
cons: Impossible to have face-to-face social contact with people.
Any instance of you having sex is debatably rape.
Any long range weapons such as Sniper Rifles are just as effective on you as normal people.

name: Sensational Sound Burst
overview: let out a powerful concussion beam, or blast everytime you hear your favorite sound, word, or music.
description: This ability is great for all those music lovers out there. This power is enough to destroy 2 buildings if let loose for the first time. The "side effects" of the beams on your victims depend on what the sound, word, or music is and there also could be multiple side effects. It must genuinely be your favorite sound. No recordings.
pros: Use your favorite sound for power
cons: Must hear the sound to release it

name: Vampire's Kiss
overview: secrete an immensely druglike saliva
description: Your saliva is a potent drug that gives humans or humanoids extreme euphoria, intoxication, and lowered inhibitions. Absorption is near-instantaneous and can be delivered through skin contact or ingestion, but the lips provide the strongest path. Effects last roughly between thirty minutes to an hour, and a single drop dissolved in a glass of water is enough to induce effects. Those exposed to this drug develop a strong unconscious mental dependence which is attributed to you if you are present.
pros: You are immune to the effects of your own saliva.
Your saliva is a two-pronged attack - it functions both chemically and magically.
The effect is the same on all humans and susceptible humanoids. There are no physical side effects.
cons: You are immune to the effects of your own saliva.
Delivery must be physically administered, which may already be challenging outside of combat.
Spiritual humanoids receive the narcotic only magically, which means halved strength.

name: Myth Power: Acheilos' Action
overview: channel Acheilos' command over the essence of sharks
description: Acheilos (Akheilos, Acheilus, Achilos, Achilleus, Achilles), in Greek myth, was the god of sharks. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and command sharks at will. In addition, one can psychically mimic the features and abilities of a shark at will. Furthermore, one can transform oneself into any species of shark (or wereshark) at will (others by touch). One can even psychically teleport oneself and/or others to any location that is home to sharks at will.
pros: Psychically perceive, communicate, command and mimic sharks at will
Transform oneself into any species of shark (or wereshark) at will; others, by touch
Psychically teleport self/others to any location with sharks at will
cons: Part 2 of Pro #2 requires touch until developed (NCN)
Cannot astral-project a water-independent shark-spirit at will, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige and MythPower: Amphitrite's Amity provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Horae (Growth3)
overview: channel the Horae and their command over the essence of plant growth and production
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of plant growth. As such, channeling Thallo (Buds, Shoots, Blooming) allows one to psychically perceive reduce plants to harmless green buds/shoots/blooms, at will. In addition, one can cause plants to produce weaponized buds/shoots/blooms (explosive, poison, acid etc) at will. Furthermore, one can grow buds/shoots/blooms from one's body, at will. One can even psychically loosen inhibitions, causing emotions to 'bloom', by touch.
pros: Psychically reduce plants to harmless green buds/shoots/blooms, and at will
Psychically weaponize plants' buds/shoots/blooms, and produce buds from one's own body, at will
Psychically loosen inhibitions, causing emotions to heighten to 'full bloom', by touch
cons: Cannot psychically communicate and eavesdrop through flower blooms, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically cause buds to bloom into magical flowers (lotus, moly, etc) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demeter's Touch and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Sonic Screwdriver Creation
overview: create a sonic screwdriver.
description: The amazingly useful sonic screwdriver of the who-verse. You can create one a day. Open a electronic door,cut locks,control a elevator,charge a battery,unlock handcuffs,cut rope,crack ice,a makeshift flashlight and a 100+ more uses. Anyone can use them.
pros: One hundred plus uses including as a screwdriver.
Small and can be hidden.
One function is to store the consciousness of a person.
cons: Some uses are only useful in the who-verse.

name: Summerlands
overview: concentrate hard enough on something and make it appear, also to VISIT the Summerlands
description: Above
pros: You always have everything you need
You are able to get away from danger quickly
You are fearless
cons: Anyone can come with you
You can be easily discovered
You're too secretive

name: Thumbtack Grenade
overview: summon a grenade that sends out thumbtacks when exploding.
description: You have the ability to summon a grenade in your hand. You can either throw it, use it as a close-combat weapon, or strike the ground with it. However, when it comes in contact with any solid surface besides your own body or clothing, it will explode. But instead of causing a normal explosion, it will shoot thumbtacks in every direction, in all kinds of colors. You cannot control the colors of thumbtacks you have.
pros: Have a weapon anytime you need one.
Can use it to cause pain to your enemies.
There are roughly one million thumbtacks released during each explosion.
cons: They're only thumbtacks.
You could get hit by one.
You can't control what color thumbtacks fly out.

name: Quicklove
overview: make any girl you want fall for you without problem
description: Make any girl instantly fall in love with you without a problem. All you have to do is concentrate and make eye contact.
pros: Easily get a girl
Have no problem getting any girl you want instantly
Get the girl of your dreams without question
cons: It could end up hitting a girl you don't like

name: Infinitely Regressed
overview: temporarily trap someone in an infinite regression.
description: You have the ability to do the most difficult reality manipulation possible. You can temporarily trap someone in an infinite regression universe. You put the person in a white room holding a white box. Your victim opens the box. Inside is a tiny version of themself looking inside an open white box-it's the room they are standing in. If they shake the box they are holding, their room will move the same way.  The 'white box' universe can be escaped with reality altering or dimension travel powers.
pros: Imagine if your victim turns the box upside down.
Your power will freak out enemies.
cons: You break laws of the universe-you don't know what could happen when using your power.
Reality changers or universe jumpers.
It's only temporary. Just enough time to get out of sight of any pursuers.

name: Cyborg Transformation
overview: become any cyborg from any source(comics,tv,books,etc).
description: This power counts robots covered in flesh(The Terminator),a mechanical shell giving life support and/or mobility(i. E. A dalek,a cyberman or Darth Vader) or someone partly organic,partly mechanical(DC Cyborg, a borg or Darth Vader-again). If a borg you could assimilate others but be confused as you have no collective. Being Darth Vader gives you force powers. Technology powers will be your bane.
pros: You will assimilate others.
You will use the force.
A single dalek is very tough to defeat.
cons: Any cyborg will have aspecific weaknesses or at least a one weakness.
Technology powers will stop or control you.
Electromagnetic pulse powers.

name: Pyramidal Neuron Mimicry
overview: perceive information out of electricity and shoot electricity to send messages.
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. You can understand electrical signals (only if they are meant to carry information) or special signals used by Neuron Mimics. After analysing them, and if you decide to give an order or send some other information, you can encode it and send it by generating electricity or the signals Neuron Mimics use. The greatest strength of Neuron Mimics is the formation of communication networks between them. They can put their intelligence together and act like a giant brain.
pros: It is not required to have received a message to send one. You can spontaneously shoot electricity.
You can understand electrical signals, though it's not guaranted you'll understand the message.
By networking with Neuron Mimics, you can discuss at light speed without speaking or writing.
cons: You need help from Oligodendrocyte or Schwann Cell Mimics to send messages to other Neuron Mimics.
You need help from Astrocyte Mimics to receive messages from other Neuron Mimics.
If you're all alone, you won't be able to use this power's full strength.

name: Missile Stop
overview: prevent missiles from falling
description: With this power whenever you see a missile falling towards you or the area you're in you can freeze it in midair and keep it in the air until you want it to fall. Only you can cause the missiles you freeze to fall but you cannot cause missiles stopped by others with this power to fall. This power is useful if the world ever goes into nuclear apocalypse mode.
pros: You can stop missiles from falling
cons: You cannot unfreeze missiles stopped by other people with this power

name: Myth Power: Epimetheus' Idea
overview: channel Epimetheus' command over the essence of afterthought
description: Epimetheus (Epimetheos), in Greek myth, was the Titan god of afterthought, or retrospect reflection. As such, channeling him allows one to reduce and distract meticulous thought and concentration in others (making subjects less capable of formulating a coherent plan, and more likely to make terrible decisions). In addition, one may perceive a subject's past regrets by touch, word or thought. One may even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who are naturally flighty thinkers.
pros: Reduce and scatter otherwise meticulous thought (foes become unable to function effectively)
Psychically perceive a subject's past regrets by touch, word or thought
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally flighty thinkers
cons: People with mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory based MythPowers are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Iapetos' Scorn are immune to this ability
At the lower levels, this ability may affect one's personality

name: Snap You're A Monster
overview: turn people into mythical creatures, cryptids or other monsters
description: With this power you can turn anybody into a mythical creature, cryptid or monster just by snapping saying their name and the desired creature eg. "John Doe, Dragon". Once in creature form they are not under your control and might even attack you but you can change them back by snapping and reversing what you said earlier eg. "Dragon, John Doe". All damage sustained in creature mode transfers over to human mode.
pros: You can turn anybody into a mythical creature, cryptid or other monster by snapping
You can change them back
All damage sustained in creature mode transfers to human mode
cons: They are not under your control

name: Party Powers
overview: make confetti, lights, sounds, and even fireworks appear when a person uses their superpowers.
description: Lets you mark people so that whenever they turn their power on non-lethal fireworks, lights, sounds, and confetti will periodically be released from their body until the power is turned off. Useful for annoying people and finding the location of people when they turn their power on. Confetti disappears after 30 seconds and fireworks after they explode. This power lasts on target until it is magically removed by user or some other power. Effects grow stronger if power is left on longer. Parties!!
pros: Amusing to watch.
Drive superpowered foes insane.
Easily find invisible or hiding foes.
cons: Expect to be hated by the people you use this power on.
Only works on powers that can be turned on/off.
No offensive / defensive capabilities.

name: Pampered
overview: be pampered by everybody
description: Whenever this power is "activated", the user is automatically pampered by anyone and everyone they encounter. That's all there is to it. And because of the effect this power has on people, the user is immune to making enemies. And don't worry about getting tired of being pampered because that only happens in movies, how does someone get tired of being pampered, nobody does in real life!
pros: Everyone pampers you
Immune to making enemies
Most-likely won't get tired of being pampered
cons: Some people might get tired of being constantly pampered (if they're weird! )

name: Realistic Air Guitar
overview: make it sound like you're actually playing the guitar when you air guitar
description: With this power you can make it sound like your actually playing the guitar (with skill) whenever you air guitar. It doesn't even have look convincing the guitar sound will just come out of nowhere and automatically sound really good.
pros: Make all your friends thing you can play the guitar
Win any air band competition
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Nanite Biomechanicality
overview: have all of Generator Rex's powers
description: The overview says it all. With this power you have Generator Rex's(Rex)powers. Every time a new power is discovered by Rex, you get it. You can discover new machines. Sometimes you turn into Rex's EVO form. But you still keep your memory.
pros: Rex makes extremely powerful machines
You can discover machines.
Sometimes a control nanite activates and con 1 is inactive
cons: Rex's powers sometimes don't work when you get angry
In EVO form you lose control.

name: Beserker Rage
overview: go into a beserk state with enhanced attributes
description: Vikings did it. Indonesians called it 'running amok'. But it's really an ability called Beserker Rage, where a person can induce a state of enhanced strength, speed, agility, endurance, and ingenuity. However, this ability comes with a price: while in this state, the user's mind is in primal mode. They are only influenced by pain and rage, cannot remember anything, and are an equal threat to friend and foe.
pros: Escape is simple
You against 100 people
Multiple enhanced attributes
cons: Equal threat to friend + foe
Cannot remember what happens in beserk state
Rage wearing off in middle of fight

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Cherubim
overview: become an angel of protection.
description: Cherubim have been described as the most fearsom and intimidating angels in the hierarchy. The Cherub is said to have four faces: one of each a man, an ox, a lion, and an eagle. The ox is considered as the "true face". The Cherub also has four conjoined wings covered with eyes and the feet of an ox. Cherubim usually reign in strength and lightning-fast speed; buzzing about like lightning strikes.
pros: Strike fear into your enemies as they cower before your presence.
Your strength and power is second to none.
cons: May frighten loved ones.

name: Super Enhanced Pack
overview: have all the members of an enhanced pack get a power boost equal to the number of the group.
description: Like the Enhanced Pack Invulnerability power but the number of the group boosts any power or powers of any group member. The exception is strength powers.  Ex: 5 people in an enhanced pack. One has a running speed of 90 mph and one can fly 300 mph. The runner now runs 450 mph (unless friction is a problem) and the flier goes 1500 mph. Some powers might not benefit due to the fact they're as good as they get, boosting the power wouldn't make any sense or a power can't be modified.
pros: An enhanced pack with enhanced powers.
cons: Certain powers may not get the power boost.

name: Will Breaking: Deadlock
overview: induce inaction resulting from the opposition of two uncompromising wills.
description: This ability may prove to be useful when you are up against extremely powerful opponents who seem to resist all types of manipulative abilities. By projecting your will directly on your target grants you of some sort of limited control on them. This limited control stems from your willpower that dwells inside your target's mind which now coexists with their freewill. In effect you can cancel out their actions by thinking of something opposite that action. Thus your opponent is rendered inactive.
pros: Can also target manipulated objects making it extremely useful against telekinetic targets.
Can be used on yourself to eliminate the effects of spirit, mental, physical, psychic manipulations.
Can be used around you to disrupt psychic and precognitive abilities.
cons: Requires quick thinking and concentration.
You dont actually possess the control of your targets action; you only induce inaction.
No one completely wins in battles between two opposing free wills; it always ends with a draw.

name: Motivator
overview: motivate people to achieve common goals.
description: With this power you can incite a strong, burning passion in those around you. The feeling can only be described as a strong desire to accomplish something together. This power is always "on" and cannot be turned off, but with time and mastery, you can suppress it almost completely.

The blades' movement can be controlled so long as the blades are attached by hair to the head. One can have any number of blades so long as there is enough hair and can lengthen hair to extend the blades' range or to make bigger blade(s). Maximum range of blades while attached to hair is 100 m. Minimum length of blade is 1 cm. Blades will stay together for 3 hours after being detached from head.

In addition, one can convert an enemy's allies into his own allies, who link minds with one for as long as the power lasts. Furthermore, one can replicate self and allies (natural or converted) at will.

As such, channeling him allows one to gain skill in how to speak and act to trick and con others. In addition, one becomes highly agile and dexterous, gaining skill in stealth, sleight of hand, pickpocketing, picking locks, cracking safes and other sneaky pursuits. Channeling Megaera (Megaira, Megara- Grudge), one can psychically perceive and inflict curses on the jealous/envious and unfaithful, at will. description: This power makes it so that you can bestow a paradox upon someone. With just the flick of your finger, you can bestow an unsolvable paradox that tears through the fabric of space-time so your opponent will be shoved into a state of nonexistence. When in this state, they will still be alive, but the universe will not remember them, and they will not be able to communicate with anything or anyone in any way. Unfortunately, this power is irreversible and cannot be undone.
pros: Bestow a paradox upon your enemy.
The enemy will be shoved into a state of nonexistence.
cons: This power is irreversible.
The paradox may destroy the planet...... Just kidding.

name: Drunk Control
overview: control people when they are drunk
description: With this power you can make any drunk person your mind slave. All you have to do is make contact with a drunk person and you will be able to take control of him until he becomes sober.
pros: You can take over the minds of drunk people
cons: If you never see a drunk person in your life this power is useless
You loose control once they become sober

name: Punisphere
overview: trap & shock your enemy in a tiny orb.
description: You can lift up the opponent and trap them in a micro-electromagnetic dimension of your creation. Watch as your foe gets electrocuted several times inside; then you close your fist, crushing the dimensional orb which causes raw energy to give your foe the final large shock and dealing huge damage, probably killing them.
pros: Could give your enemy a squeezing shock.
cons: Some people are protected against trapping through their powers

name: Myth Power: Maidens' Maximum
overview: channel the Hyperborean Maidens and their command over the essence of archery
description: The Hyperborean Maidens, in Greek myth, were the goddesses of archery. As such, channeling Opsis (Opis, Oupis, Upis- Aim), one can aim with superhuman accuracy, and can psychically disrupt aim, by touch. Channeling Loxo (Trajectory), one can psychically manipulate airborne objects' trajectory. Channeling Hekaerge (Hecaerge, Arge- Distancing), one can psychically perceive space (objects' presence, distance, speed, velocity, momentum, etc), and psychically disrupt others' spatial sense, at will.
pros: Aim with Superhuman Accuracy, and psychically disrupt aim, by touch, at will
Psychically manipulate airborne objects' trajectory (Flight Manipulation) at will
Psychically perceive space, at will, and disrupt others' spatial sense, by touch, at will
cons: Cannot summon indestructible bow and quiver of infinite arrows, until developed (NCN)
Cannot withstand the effects of the cold (Cold Immunity), until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift and MythPower: Artemis' Gift provide immunity (NCN)

name: Blade Ankle Wings V2
overview: sprout wings that shoot sharp blades from your ankles
description: With this power you can sprout two wings from both of your ankles. The wings allow you to fly and also give you enhanced speed. The wings can also shoot our small silver blades that can pierce anything. The blades cannot be used against you.
pros: You can sprout wings from your feet
You have enhanced speed
You can shoot blades from the wings on your feet
cons: Nothing really

name: Delete This Cannon Punch
overview: glowingly fly forward with your fist and push them against the wall.
description: Your left hand will turn red. You'll then get the chance to lunge toward your opponent by driving your fist through them. After it's done, your left fist will let out some steam.
pros: This is just a regular flying power!
cons: None.

name: Primal Scream
overview: produce a scream that attacks the minds of the listeners
description: Imagine the worst migraine you've ever had. Then multiply it by 70. A person with Primal Scream can induce this head-splitting pain in others with a raw, high-pitched cry. This is not particularily loud--100 decibels--but it causes mental anguish far greater than its volume. Experienced users can push the volume up to 150 decibels, which causes physical damage as well. However, it is totally fueled by emotion and drains its user of energy.
pros: 70 times worse than a migrane
Gets stronger the more you use it
Effective crowd control
cons: Not particularily loud (100 dB)
Totally fueled by emotion
Drains user of energy

name: Arrow Creation
overview: create arrows at will
description: The arrows are created out of the air. The shafts are of any chosen wood (yew, hornbeam, etc), the arrowhead is made of any chosen stone or metal (iron, obsidian, etc), and the fletching can come from any kind of bird (geese, duck, etc).
pros: You can have arrows that are of a high quality whenever you want.
cons: You need to have a bow for this to be fully useful.

name: Power Ring Symbiosis
overview: permanently become an indestructable ring with all of your powers and force of will
description: Power Ring Symbiosis turns you into a ring that retains all of your powers and force of will. The wielder must, and is compelled to give thier powers to the ring in order to use it. The wielder cannot, nor wants to remove the ring and can use all of the power within it at will. The wielder belives that they are in control, but in actuality, they are acting out your thoughts, desires and will. When the wielder dies, the ring comes off and retains the powers of itself and all previous wielders.
pros: Live through another and gain power each time a new host emerges.
Never truly die.
Gain the knowledge of each wielder.
cons: You are a ring.
Nobody might put you on for quit a while.
Defenseless when not on a finger.

name: Rise Of The Legendary Pokemon
overview: turn into any legendary pokemon
description: With this power you can turn into any of the legendary Pokemon even ones that have not be officially released or discovered. In Pokemon mode you retain your intelligence level, personality and ability to speak. You can stay in Pokemon form for as long as you want. Also if you turn into Manaphy, find a Ditto and give birth to a Phione it will be under your control.
pros: You have over 40 powerful forms
You retain your intelligence level, personality and ability to speak
If you give birth to a Phione by turning into Manaphy and breeding it will be under your control
cons: You might be hunted by pokemon trainers
You might be hunted by pokemon collectors
The real legends might come after you

name: Induce Necrosis
overview: induce the disease necrosis (the death of living cells).
description: You're able to induce the disease through touch, saliva, blood and breath. You can infect someone's lungs through breath, pass it into water supplies by using blood or saliva and kill someone in a matter of seconds (as the cells multiply and infect other cells quickly) by touching them. You're also able to reverse the process in your body and others' and can target specific cells in a body (e.g. fat cells).
pros: Ultimate assassin.
Able to affect someone from a distance.
cons: Vulnerable to mundane ways of killing.
Cells die in air after a few minutes.

name: Black Cat's Dance
overview: cause another person bad luck by crossing his or her path.
description: This insidious power allows the user to alter probability, absorbing the good luck of another person and passing on any bad luck he or she possesses to that person as well. This means that the user will not only drain them of their good luck and leave them with their own bad luck, he or she will leave them with his or her bad luck as well. The possessor of this ability can use it consciously 12 times a week, but once a week it will be triggered unconsciously as well.
pros: Great way to boost your luck before hitting the casinos!
Good way of getting revenge, especially if your foe is lucky.
Good for a career in sports, medicine, or politics.
cons: You quickly get a reputation as a jinx or a "Jonah. "
The ability may affect friends and loved ones when it goes off unconsciously.
On Friday the 13th, the effect of this ability is reversed!

name: Arcana: 2 The High Priestess
overview: gain random knowledge.
description: This power gives Procedural Knowledge, or "How-To" knowledge. It gives you expert knowledge and muscle memory without you ever even so much as seeing something done. You could learn how to throw a curve ball or how to operate a machine gun. This ability will often give information that is useful, but not always for the current situation. The only real limits to this power are that you can't learn how to do the physically impossible or do something without the things required to do it.
pros: Can gain any kind of how-to knowledge.
Might gain the how-to knowledge of a martial art expert.
Can activate at will.
cons: Never gives you what you want to know.
Can't do something impossible, or directly gain superpowers.

name: Streaker
overview: cause people to streak.
description: Those with this power can cause people to streak, without anyone (except the user, people who can resist telepathy/mindcontrol/change to willpower) noticing anything wrong, with varying levels of control. Weak control can cause everyone around you to streak uncontrollably. Those with strong control can make only specific people streak, or make them only remove certain things, such as weapons, without them noticing. It is possible also to make people notice the streaker.
pros: Cause people to streak without anyone thinking its unnormal.
With strong control can make people not wear certain things, such as weapons.
Can streak yourself without worrying about breaking the law.
cons: With weak control you might see people streak that you did not wish to see.
May take a lot of will power to keep people from noticing the streaking.
If you lose control and people notice the streaking you may get into trouble.

name: Ultimate Sidekick
overview: emulate the power of any sidekick to any hero or villain from any published source
description: A person with this power has all the abilities and strengths of every sidekick in existence and can use multiple abilities simultaneously. However, they can only access these powers if they are the sidekick of a hero. In addition as a sidekick, they are not allowed to outperform the hero in popularity, doing so will make them lose their powers since they are no longer a sidekick.
pros: You have a lot of power, speed, and other capabilities
You are actually stronger than the hero/villain most of the time
cons: No matter how strong you are, you are still treated as the sidekick
If you try to be better than the hero in public view, you will lose your powers.
You need to find a hero/villain to be a sidekick of.

name: Son Of Re
overview: summon the Son of Re, a fiery, ancient, near-unstoppable warrior.
description: Summon the Son of Re at any time. He is an ancient, fiery warrior that is superstrong & absorbs heat. He is technically dead on our plane giving him zombie like attributes, very hard to kill. He carries a variety of weapons of which he can pull from the dimension he resides in. Flaming oversized swords, bow and arrows, axes, spears, and shields. All of which only you and he can utilize. He is always angry and hard to control. He is not your sidekick. You are his. Once summoned you belong to him.
pros: He becomes invincible after he absorbs a sufficient amount of heat & burns like a walking inferno
He lends you his weaponry (fireproof while holding them) & teaches you his warrior fighting skills
Immortal? If he dies, u rise from the ashes as a fiery phoenix for one hour or until he reintegrates
cons: When he absorbs 2 much heat forced to release by exploding fireball kills himself and u each time
Don't call him by his many names (Horus, Osiris, Amun, Atum, Apollo, Helios) or he will pimp-slap u
He is not ur friend, he will kill u, ur friends or family if u lie, cheat or steal in his presence

name: Magic Negation
overview: negate the magical abilities of others
description: With this ability, you become the very antithesis of magic; any magical effect is automatically negated in your presence; magic spells will fail, curses falter and fade away; magical traps vanish into thin air, and magical illusions are suppressed, to reveal the truth behind them. What's best, not only do you negate the magical enhancements of others, but magic that touches your body cannot affect you AT ALL.
pros: Negate magical spells and effects that have already been produced
Prevent magic from being used in the first place
Magic touches your body, it's negated (naturally immune to magic)
cons: Mages HATE you...
No magical enhancements
No magical assistance AT ALL...

name: Moon Blade 9th Lighting Yellow
overview: summon the 9th Moon Blade
description: Blade for controlling light and lightning. Looks like a golden blade with blue marks on the hild and bottom bart of the blade.
pros: Can summon lightning bolts.
Can control light in any variation such as making someone invisible by bending the light around them
Or by blinding someone with light or absence of it.
cons: Light manipulation has no effect on blind people and light illusions are cancelled by true-sight.

name: Spinekinesis
overview: create and have complete control over spines.
description: The ability to grow spines and have control over all spines. You can grow spines as weaponry or break opponents' spines with a thought. You can cause paralysis by blocking signals coming from the brain, or cure it if caused by the spine. If you have this power, your body can't be taken over by mind-controlling powers because you can replace the signals going to your muscles. In the same way, you can control how other people's bodies move, unless they have direct muscle control outside the spine.
pros: Spine-based offense / defense
Cause or cure paralysis
Can control signals going through the spine to control or prevent bodies from being controlled.
cons: May be painful if you decide to grow spines from your body.
Ineffective if people can control their body with other means besides signals through the spine.
Takes focus to grow spines that are not grown from your own body

name: Half Raiju
overview: be half-human, half-raiju
description: Someone with this power has claws and fangs as well as furry wolf,cat,monkey or weasel ears and a wolf-,cat-,monkey- or weasel-like tail. They will have higher strength,speed,and magical power especially for lightning magic. They can also transform into lightning at will and transform back into their normal forms. Use of the lightning form comes at a cost of extreme pain all over the body though. Also, as a Raiju is a servant of the gods a Half-Raiju only needs to bow down to gods and demi-gods
pros: You are far more powerful than most beings.
For the most part you don't have to do what others want you to do unless you want to.
Note: Raiju translates as 'Lightning Beast' but is often depicted as a wolf, weasel, cat or monkey.
cons: You have to do what gods and demigods order you to do.
The lightning form is a definite last resort.

name: Gargoylenesis
overview: transform oneself into a gargoyle made of stone
description: This ability allows you to transform oneself into a powerful gargoyle with skin of stone. You can fly (with wings), perform incredible feats of maneuverability in midair, change your skin shade to blend in with different types of stone, and rip boulders from the ground to hurl. However, you must be very focused and concentrated to become a gargoyle, and it does tax your energy quite a bit, although no extra energy is used once one has transformed.
pros: You can become a gargoyle with the powers of flight
You become very strong, fast and agile
Chameleon-like abilities
cons: Takes enormous amount of focus to become, cannot be rushed.
You are terrifying and may cause innocent civilians to run to their doom off the edges of buildings
Takes a fair amount of energy to activate

name: Human Bouncing Ball
overview: bounce upon impact.
description: Whenever you or a part of your body is hit by a blunt impact, you or your body part will bounce without suffering any internal damage. The same goes if you hit something. You will still be able to cause damages, but the recoil of your hits will make you spring away. You can't be hurt if you hit yourself. This power is always active, so you can't turn it off and you are forever immune to blunt impacts.
pros: You are immune to blunt damage.
If you fall to the ground, you will bounce in the air.
If you are punched, you can bounce against a wall and hit them back.
cons: Always active. So, be careful if you accidently or impulsively hit something.
You have little control over your bounces.

name: Freezing Skulls
overview: send icy skulls at your opponent, then freeze them solid.
description: You can grant youself by creating ice sculptured skulls and throw it at your enemies and you can throw up to nine, but. The worst thing you can do to them is those iced skulls actually bite and freeze them stiff that can give out to a new meaning of Bone Chilling.
pros: You'll be having fun with this ability when you give your opponents the chills.
cons: None.

name: Interbody Transfer
overview: teleport anything inside your body to someone else's body.
description: Ever had to empty your bladder, but you can't get to the bathroom, but you see someone else going in? You can teleport your urine into their bladder instead. Teleport your kidneys to a child in need. Teleport the spoiled food you just ate into someone else's stomach. Teleport that bullet you just took into your attacker's brain. But, you cannot take things from others, only send them. Just be careful what you send. The only limit is what's inside of you at the moment. Got cancer? Not anymore.
pros: Remove any offending objects from your own body
Never worry about diseases, viruses, or anything else invading your body
Can send away objects that are even partially in your body, but only the part that is inside of you
cons: The objects must go into someone else's body.
You must know about the object to purge it
To teleport dangerous things into people, they first have to be inside of your own body

name: Pokemon Maker
overview: create your own pokemon
description: You can make your own pokemon with ease.
pros: You have cool pokemon you can make
Be the envy of your peers
cons: Pokemon may suck
You might not be creative

name: Cursed Regeneration
overview: regenerate except the cells destroyed are replaced with indestructable cursed cells
description: A person with this power has been cursed to become a servant of some other being eventually. However in the mean time, they have the access to regenerative abilities that regrow their bodies to the ones desired by the one who granted the curse. The regrown body parts are indestructible and can give the user of this curse superstrength. However this curse can only be given by someone that dislikes you and they might send hoardes of soldiers to injure you more.
pros: Can regenerate from fatal injuries
The new cells are indestructable
Cursed muscle cells give you some degree of superstrength
cons: The person that cursed you must be someone that dislikes you.
Once your whole body becomes cursed you will become the eternal servant to whoever cursed you
The cursed cells prevent you from killing the person that cursed you

name: Sawtooth Fingerprint
overview: push small sawtooth blades from between the grooves of your fingers
description: With this ability you are a covert killer. You can push small sawtooth blades from beneath the skin in your fingers. These blades pop up from between the grooves of your fingerprint and are incredibly sharp. Slice, dice, cut, rip, and shred with your ten deadly digits.
pros: A weapon at your fingertips (litterally)
A covert and concealed power
Blades stay sharp
cons: Forgetting to retract the blades
Accidentally cutting yourself

name: Red Sun Beams
overview: shoot red sun radiation from your hands
description: With this power you can shoot red sun radiation from your hands. Red Sun Radiation can turn Kryptonians into normal humans. Depending on how much red sun radiation you shoot them with the longer they lose their powers for. The red sun radiation also burns non Kryptonians but doesn't make them lose their powers.
pros: You can turn Kryptonians into normal humans
You can burn non Kryptonians
cons: As long as they're near a yellow sun you cannot make the Kryptonians lose their powers permanently
It only burns non Kryptonians

name: Babushkian Cloning
overview: make smaller and smaller copies of yourself.
description: This power sort of lets you be like a russian nesting doll. You make one slightly smaller clone of yourself. That clone can make one clone slightly smaller than himself and so on and so on. The smallest clone of a clone can be no smaller than a nanomachine. If one clone in the clone chain is killed all the clones vanish. If a growth power is used on any of the clones,all the clones vanish. Using other copying powers on any of these clones also causes the chain of clones to vanish.
pros: A microscopic or smaller version of yourself could be useful.
A half-sized version of you could be helpful.
cons: It takes time to get the smallest version of yourself.
One clone dies,all the clones die.
You can't make these clones any bigger in size.

name: Masculinization
overview: cause someone to become more masculine
description: Someone affected by this power will become more masculine in both mind and body. They will start to act like how they think a proper guy acts. Their body will also bulk up and they will gain a fully masculine body (legs, abdomen, arms, etc). Females affected by this will still act feminine, but more tomboy-ish.
pros: They will be unaware that they are changing until pointed out.
cons: Can be reversed, but only by other powers.

name: Tournament Field
overview: create a battlefield area where only one person in a group of three can fight at a time
description: You can choose an area of 4 square kilometers in which people are allowed to enter with a group of no less than 3 beings. While in the area only one person can fight at a time. If someone tries to attack an enemy while a member of their group is fighting someone else, the whole group immediately gets a cruel and unusual punishment game. The game chosen is random every single time. Don't bother trying to avoid the punishment game, because that results in death for anyone who tries.
pros: Great to lure enemies into and hire mercenaries.
Telling allies the restrictions but not enemies or people who wander into the area.
Setting up cameras to watch the punishment games.
cons: Punishments affect friends as well as enemies.
Have to manually alter the terrain yourself, this power only designates the zone.
Con Negation and other alteration powers do not affect this power.

name: Enhancement: Mending
overview: make a power repair damaged objects when used
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it causes the power to repair objects and buildings when used. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: Repair your fortifications with Omni-Directional Blast.
Used in combination with either Enhancement: Healing and people will love you.
cons: Useless without another power.

name: Aura Of Purification
overview: purify others of evil by keeping them in one's aura
description: Anyone who stands in the aura of someone with this power will be purified of evil and become more inclined to do acts of good.
pros: Artifacts and places can also be purified by keeping them in your aura.
cons: Anything that leaves your aura can still become (more) evil.

name: Teleport To Master
overview: teleport to where one's master is located at
description: With this power you can teleport straight to wherever your master is whether it is 100 yards away or on the other side of the universe. Doesn't matter whether what kind of a master they are or whether or not you want them to be your master. Also works if you acknowledge them as your master but they don't acknowledge themself as your master.
pros: You can help your master whenever they need help.
You can make it to classes on time (teacher).
cons: You are unable to teleport back home.
You cannot teleport to other dimensions until the higher levels.

name: Percussive Awakening
overview: wake anyone by hitting them.
description: With this ability the user can awaken anyone, from any degree, or type of sleep by hitting them. This includes naps, to comas, to even eternal sleep, this counters superpowers and magic, that induce sleep. This power also creates thirty minutes of immunity to sleep related powers.
pros: Wake up a comatose friend.
Thirty minute immunity to sleep powers.
cons: Friends who make you hit yourself in your sleep.
You could accidently hit yourself.

name: Super Forget
overview: point at someone and make them forget what they were doing
description: With this power whenever you point at somebody they forget what they were doing when you pointed at them. So if your enemy is building a weapon of destruction or aiming a gun at your head or something you can just point at them and they will forget about it. You can do this as many times as you want to the same person or you can use it against a bunch of people by pointing at several different people.
pros: You can make people forget what they were doing by pointing at them
cons: Just because they forgot they were doing it doesn't mean they won't think of doing it again

name: Death Memory Sight
overview: see into the past of the dead
description: By making physical contact with the corpse, he or she will be able to tap into the memories and thoughts of the deceased's life, but only while in contact with the corpse.
pros: It will be easy was to find who murdered the deceased
An easy way to discover the secrets of the long dead
cons: Morbid thoughts and seeing the death of the body
Can cause slight insanity if you accept the dead's memories and personality too well.

name: Myth Power: Methe's Mirth
overview: channel Methe's command over the essence of drunken intoxication (drunkenness or inebriation)
description: Methe (Methyse, Methyne), in Greek myth, was the goddess of drunkenness. As such, channeling her allows one to withstand, as well as psychically manipulate drunkenness, at will. In addition, one can psychically elect to give in to the effects of drunkenness, at will, which improves both fighting and weapon skill. One can also psychically perceive subjects' drunken hallucinations, at will. One can even psychically realize said hallucinations, at will, so they affect foes as though they were real.
pros: Withstand, and psychically manipulate drunkenness, at will
Psychically elect to give in to effects of drunken, and it improves one's fighting and weapon skill
Psychically perceive and realize drunken hallucinations, so they can harm foes, at will
cons: Cannot psychically summon a chalice of instantly-intoxicating wine to drink, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically cause foes to automatically share one's drunken state, until developed (NCN)
Wine/festivity-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: 2 For The Show
overview: have tickets to any show
description: With this power you can have as many tickets as you need or any show. You can get the tickets for any row or seat you want. This power works for any play, movie, concert, sporting event, opera, ice show etc. Unless it's already sold out.
pros: You can have tickets to any show
cons: If the show is already sold out you cannot get tickets for it

name: Waifu Control
overview: control and manipulate love (romantic and platonic) for fictional people/places
description: Some people become obsessed with fictional worlds, or even fall in love with fictional characters. You can control that. You can make someone fall in/out of love with a character, change their soulmate to a character, make them desire a fictional world more than the real one (or solve that problem). You can even make characters and worlds respond in kind, 'desiring' a person, though you have less control. At maximum level, you can bridge between fiction and reality, if it's in the name of love.
pros: Make people fall in/out of love, make them content (even if the object of their love isn't real)
Play matchmaker: find out who loves/would love who, or MAKE them fall in love
Can eventually travel to and from fictional worlds, and force people and characters through
cons: Best with anime/anime-style, mid with other drawn/animation, worst with writing, and no live-action.
Bridging the gap is only at a really high level, and (NCN) can ONLY be done in the name of love.
Power may be sentient, and might try to play matchmaker with YOU.

name: Tattoo Artist
overview: give yourself and others tattoos with your mind
description: With this power you can cause yourself or others to suddenly have tattoos anywhere on their body. You can send people messages by causing words to appear on their body or frighten people by causing scary images to appear on them. Or you know you could break your brother out of prison by hiding the blueprints of a maximum security prison in tattoos on your body.
pros: You can cause tattoos to appear on yourself or others
You can cause the tattoos to disappear whenever you want
cons: Not much use in physical combat
If the person's body is already covered in tattoos this power has no affect on them

name: The Colt
overview: summon a gun from 'Supernatural' that can all most kill anything
description: (This gun is very wear ) this looks like the colt M1892. This gun can kill all most anything. This gun has Latin inscriptions on it, it says I fear no evil. This gun can't kill Lucifer or god. This gun is deadly in the wrong hands. Know your history.
pros: Can kill anything ( all most )
Looks cool
All shall fear you
cons: It breaks
You will loose it eventually
Needs bullets

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours06)
overview: channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Mesembria (Noon Hour, Midday), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when noon hits. One can also psychically project one's vision to anywhere beneath the midday sun, at will. One can even psychically generate noonday heat/light, 12x stronger, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate and gain physical power when noon hits
Psychically project vision anywhere beneath midday sun, project noonday heat/light (x12), at will
cons: Cannot psychically access 'high noon' peak condition, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to any location where it is midday, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically time travel to past/future noon times, until developed (NCN)

name: Chew Bubblegum And Kick Ass
overview: spit out gum accurately with different effects depending on what flavor it is
description: If you are chewing gum, once you spit it out, it will have a different effect. E. G. Juicy Fruit will create a stun effect to whoever you spit it on.
pros: More reasons to chew bubble gum
Nice tasting power
High accuracy
cons: You need material to use your powers
You might not like the flavor of the best acting powers
It will cost money to use the power

name: Guardian Helmet
overview: be bestowed powers by the Guardian Helmet
description: Once a user wears the Guardian helmet, the source of power and recognition for the intergalactic peace force known as the Guardian Corps,he or she will be granted its power which includes the ability to fly, survive in space, limited invulnerability, scanning abilities, database access to the Guardian's database and the ability to create hardlight constructs via the Guardian star that serves as the helmet's power souce
pros: Can take on most if not all powerhouses
Symbol of peace, justice
Highly versatile
cons: The star that powers the helmet must be charged once its power has been exhausted
Dislodging the helmet from the user will depower the user. Although this is near impossible to do.

name: Sign Language Magic
overview: the cast magical spells by casting the spell using sign langauge
description: Magic users can cast magical spells using sign language to sign out the spell they desire to cast
pros: Can cast extremely powerful spells to fight other magic users or non-magic users
Someone with these power can also talk to deaf people when they are not using their magic
cons: They first have to learn sign language to a high degree of proficiency
If the magical user's hand or hands were to be broken, they would not be able to sign spells
Might take a long time to spell cast if the spell is too long

name: Uncuttable Skin
overview: have skin that cannot be cut or stabbed by any bladed or remotely sharp object
description: A person with this power has skin that is uncuttable. No sharp or even remotely sharp weapon or object can cut his or her skin.
pros: Can go head to head with any criminal or open that loves to use bladed weapon.
Can fight crime.
cons: If the user is injured internally, operation will be almost impossible because scalpels cant be used
No other super human strength or abilities, unless the user trains themselves to combat crime
Injuries caused by kinetic force, lasers, or magic can hurt the user

name: Car Of Dacia
overview: posses a car that can travel through dimensions
description: (This car can travel through dimensions) this car looks like the dacia logan 2. The colour of the car is what you want it to be. The car uses nuclear energy.
pros: Travel through dimensions
Meet different peaple
You get to choose what colour you want for your car
cons: You cant time travel (no con negation)
This car uses nuclear energy (you've been warned )
If you lose the car you will be lost in the dimension forever

name: Quartz Tag
overview: tag an object or organism with quartz particles that can be tracked psychically
description: This ability allows the user to tag an object or organism, through direct contact, with small quartz particles. The particles are psychically linked to the user and can be tracked anywhere in the world. If the quartz particles make it into the blood of a living organism they can override the effects of personal psychic canceling abilities.
pros: Track any person or object
cons: Requires skin contact

name: Dream Database
overview: be able to page through all of a person's past dreams when you are in physical contact with them
description: With this power whenever you touch a person you can be able to see every single dream they've had (while sleeping) throughout their entire life. Even dreams they themselves can't recall having.
pros: You can see all of a person's dreams
cons: Not much use in physical combat
You might see something disturbing
Only works while touching the person

name: Tornado Spin
overview: spin incredibly fast like a mini tornado
description: Just like the Tasmanian Devil (Taz) from Looney Tunes, you can spin extremely fast, until you become like a miniature tornado. The speed and strength of the spin depends, and can get stronger with practice, but usually is strong enough to tear through obstacles, and deflect projectiles (even to tunnel into the ground). Spinning, no matter what speed, never makes you dizzy.
pros: Turn into a mini-tornado or a human drill
Tear through obstacles, deflect obstacles and drill through things
Never get dizzy, no matter how long or how fast you spin
cons: You're a destructive force if you cannot control yourself
Still get tired (can't spin forever)

name: The Whisperer
overview: whisper at things from long distances.
description: This power allows you to send your whispers to any location that you can think of. If you begin to speak louder than a whisper while using this power, this power will automatically reduce the loudness of your words. The resulting words are ten to twenty decibels. You can whisper to multiple locations at the same time.
pros: Can talk to people far away.
Can pretend to be someone's conscience.
Or pretend to be a ghost.
cons: If the target is at a loud location, the whisper might not be heard.
Only works one way, you can't hear them talk back.
Only sends your voice, no other sounds.

name: Ghost Writing
overview: turn into a ghost temporarily after writing
description: To harness this power, you have to choose a keyword; for example, "super". Every time you write the word "super" you turn into a ghost temporarily. In this state, you have the standard ghost powers (flying, intangibility, invisibility, etc. ) After thirty minutes, the power will wear off, and you will not be able to use this power for the rest of the day (unless you develop it). It's good to carry a pencil around if you have this power.
pros: You can transform into a ghostly state.
You can fly, phase, be invisible, etc.
cons: You might have to carry a pencil around in case you need the power
This can only be used once per day, until developed
Don't forget your keyword!

name: De Zombinizer
overview: transform zombies back to their normal selves.
description: If anyone or everybody is bitten and/or infected, the De-Zombinizer allows you to turn people back to their normal state just by releasing a lime mist with a gesture of your hand.
pros: Can cure any or everyone who's totally zombified.
cons: It won't work on long dead zombies risen from their graves.

name: Bioacoustic Disruption
overview: disrupt the ability to speak and/or hear
description: Bioacoustic Disruption is the psionic ability to disrupt mechanisms of communication within species. One with this ability could psionically disable a foe's ability to speak or to hear, making communication extremely difficult. This ability could be used to render a person deaf (so that he can't hear warnings or understand people who try to talk to him) or mute (so that they can still hear, but they cannot respond back to what they are being asked or told).
pros: Girlfriends don't seem like such a bother anymore
Boss doesn't seem like such a bother anymore
May even disrupt communication mechanisms within machines so they cannot be used to type on, etc.
cons: If you can't undo your power
If you can't control your power, it may backfire
If your boss's computer suddenly stops working, or responding to voice commands, you'll be blamed

name: Pokemon Taker
overview: take pokemon out of their card or game.
description: Take pokemon out of their card or game, the pokemon you take out are not limited to the moves they have in the game or card. It is limited to what TM and HM moves they can learn and what level they are.
pros: You can bring pokemon to life.
cons: They'll probably leave and steal things.
They could kill others.

name: Townsaver
overview: wield the sword of fury
description: Also called the sword of fury, Townsaver's power only activates if unarmed people are in danger. Townsaver then augments its strength and speed to the point that it could slay entire armies. While Townsaver is drawn, its user cannot die by any means regardless of injuries. Also, while its power is active, the user MUST help those in danger. It is impossible for them not to. After the fighting has stopped, all the strength and speed disappear, and if the person is badly wounded they will die.
pros: Super-strength, Speed, and Limited Invulnerability
Increased combat ability
Well balanced, super sharp sword, resistant to most damage
cons: Once the fighting is over, you go back to normal
You have to help people
The sword will use you as a human shield if necessary, and hurt you to protect people.

name: Power Food
overview: eat any food and convert the energy to use as a power.
description: Basically, when you ingest any food, this power can convert it into three things: healing, super-strength, or energy manipulation. This power only lasts for the specific day that you ate the food on. Oh and on rare occasions, if you ingest spicy food, you spit fire out of your mouth with heats reaching up to 2,000 degrees.
pros: Two things that I love: kicking butt and eating!
cons: Stomach ache if you eat a lot of food!
When your power finishes, you are highly fatigued.
The weight that you gain after eating all that food

name: Visible Music
overview: create a visible symphony line to block or attack
description: When you sing or use a musical instrument, you can see notes attacking or blocking the attacks of your enemies
pros: Create an impenetrable note barrier and protect people
You can put enemies to sleep by singing a lullaby
You can deafen your enemies
cons: Can easily damage your voice
Notes only last as long as you continue singing
Can cause lung problems

name: Reality Poisoning
overview: create and manipulate an energy that literally poisons reality.
description: This ability allows the user to create an energy that poisons reality. What do I mean by this? This energy cause everything within the reality it is in to become ill. Everything be in a dull single color, matter and energy become inert,and living creature will suffer energy loss. If kept up for a long period of time, the poisoning will be permanent, and reality will slowly die. The user can concentrate it to certain area.
pros: Weaken enemies
Take advantage of the disarray.
cons: Poisoning will be permanent, if used to long.
The user will also be affected if he spends in it to long.
Continual use will will also be deadly to user.

name: Figurine Army
overview: grow an army from little lead figurines
description: The power can cause a bunch of pre-made lead figures to grow into full sized humans (or whatever). Any simple non-mechanical tools the figures may possess also become real. The figures are loyal, able to think for themselves, know how to use any tool or weapon they possess, and otherwise know anything their master knows.
pros: Unlimited number of allies
Not limited to fighters - workmen, cooks, homework writers,...
Can always make more, so expendable
cons: Have to carry around large bag of figurines
No modern weapons or SF stuff.
You go down, they go down.

name: Atheism Powered Abilities
overview: become god-like through nonbelievers
description: This ability is very contradicting. On the one hand, you gain godlike powers through everyone who either questions their beliefs or those who don't believe in God at all. And on the other hand, you lose your god powers once people start believing in the higher-ups again. So to become even more powerful, you would need as many nonbelievers as you can.
pros: Through every 1000 nonbelievers, your already existing powers are 1.5 times more powerful
Being like a god would be awesome
With enough faithless, you can do anything you want
cons: Your very presence would make atheists believers again
Born again Christians
Would have to hide that you are a god from everyone.

name: Primal Rage
overview: induce uncontrollable rage in the people around you
description: Everyone has an animal in them. We just forget it. A person with Primal Rage subdues the conscious mind while simultaneously drawing our territorial animal out, causing the people around them to fight each other for space. Meaning? An instant fight to the death for 50 yards. This ability is totally voluntary and can be snapped off at any time. However, it makes your eyes glow red and targeting specific people is pretty difficult.
pros: Causes an instant fight to the death
Great distraction
Can be snapped on and off
cons: Makes eyes glow red
Targeting people difficult
50-yard range

name: Were Animal
overview: turn into the last animal you petted at night
description: At night after you pet a dog you turn in to a were-dog until sun-up. You can communicate with other animals of the same species, but follow instinctes of that animal
pros: Find out what it's like to be a animal
cons: Have to pet it

name: Spiritual Conjuration
overview: conjure up spirits from the dead or the living
description: When conjuring up dead spirits, you have to be near someone that is dead. When conjuring living spirits out of living people, you are in for a lifetime of servitude. The dead can turn on you, because their minds have been corrupted in the process of death.  Though it can be tiring, it's actually quite fun!
pros: The living spirits completely obey you no matter what
cons: The dead can sometimes turn on you
It is emotionally and mentally draining

name: Gorgon Eyes
overview: petrify enemies with an implanted eye
description: With this power, one or both of the user's eyes is replaced with the eyes of a Gorgon. Those who look into the eyes are turned into stone and the user can also shoot a beam from its eye that can turn things into stone.
pros: You can choose when to fire the beam of petrification
You do not have hair made of snakes
You can smash petrified people easily
cons: You cannot deactivate this power so you must wear an eyepatch on one or both of your eyes

name: Rave Light
overview: manipulate chemiluminescence. (glow-in-the-dark)
description: This ability gives the user the freedom to manipulate light that emits from glow-in-the-dark objects and form it into anything, but can only be done if it's dark or there is only little light present in the room.
