So the user must always carry a source of light (ex. Glow stick, etc.) to be able to use it, therefore the ability always ends up as a colorful display of shiny lights.
pros: Can be formed to be as soft as light or as hard as a rock.
It's versatility is it's strong point. Ex. Platforms, shields, projectiles etc. )
Very appealing to the eyes.
cons: Can only be used to it's climax if in a pitch black environment.
Needs a source of light to be used. Ex. Glow in the dark accessories , etc. )
Very weak or nothing at all in the daylight.

name: Oxidation Displacement
overview: steal oxygen from things on fire
description: What is fire? Fire is the rapid oxidation of a material through combustion. Meaning, it's a chemical reaction that adds oxygen to the molecules of the material. With this power, you can 'steal' the oxygen of any fire. Any fire within a 60 metre radius of you will form microscopic portals to your lungs. Just as the oxygen is about to join onto the molecule, it falls into the portal and goes into the lungs, meaning all you have to do is breath out.
pros: Steal oxygen from fires.
Fire lasts forever, because it can't quite change the material.
No need to breathe in (if you are near a fire).
cons: 60 metre radius.

name: Bio Metal Arm
overview: a bio metal virus in your arm
description: A bio metal virus has infected your arm. A razor sharp three pronged glaive can be formed from this arm that can be thrown as a weapon. The glaive will always come back to the infected arm as it is part of the living metal. Elemental attacks can be used simply by throwing the glaive in to an electrical power source or even in to fire. This will then allow the user to throw an electrical or flaming hot glaive at opponents.
pros: Diamond hard bio metal arm, virtualy indestructable
Deadly sharp bladed glaive
Use elemental attacks for twice the damage
cons: Bio metal virus will spread and eventualy cover the infecteds body
Energy sapping virus will need to be controled or it can kill the infected
Mental side effects from the infection spreading

name: Soothsayer
overview: see exactly when, where and how a person will die
description: When you touch anyone you will know when, where and how that person will die. Be death's enemy or audience.
pros: You can tell anyone how much time is left in their life
You could make loads of money
You could try to stop person's death or be a sicko and just watch
cons: Your power is always active, so to your intimacy will probably be depressing
If you help someone escape death, they will die another, more horrible way very soon after
Your death gets more difficult to see every time you see another's death

name: Anti Matter Breath
overview: exhale a beam of Anti-matter at will.
description: Depending on the amount of air that you choose to exhale, this power can dispose of everything within its reach. It can destroy an army that is the size of the entire army of China, the Persian Empire, and the Roman Empire combined; over 1,000-fold.
pros: In the most extreme case, when the whole world is your enemy, this comes in handy.
You posses a certain energy that makes you Immune to the Anti-Matter explosion.
cons: Think of all of your loved ones.
You also destroy a lot of the natural resources that you depend on to eat and drink.
Every being would want you to leave their planet. You would have a hard time making friends.

name: Phys Men Pulse
overview: combine your mind and body's power to discharge a psychic wave depending on one's mass.
description: "PhysMen" is a combination of the words 'physical' and 'mental', or 'mind' and 'body'. With this ability, you release a powerful two-part psychic pulse; the first part is released from the mind, and the second part is released from the body. The two combined can affect systems both mentally and physically; There is only one catch, when you use it both your mind and body will be weaken to the point that you would be tired if you were a regular person.
pros: Very powerful.
Affects mind and body.
Can elect to emit just "physical" or just "mental" or BOTH.
cons: You will get tired and weak.
Your power will depend on your body mass.

name: Holy Power: The Avenger
overview: use the powers of The Avenger, the first Path of Light.
description: With this power you can "activate" the Avenger mode. You gain a powerful energy armor and the powers of the Avenger. While using the avenger you get Invulnerability, Super Strength and Superhuman Senses and Super Speed. You also become able to use all the other Avenger ability's. To acquire the Avenger you need Six Paths of Light, and you need to send a dying innocent to heaven, and his killer to hell.
pros: Allows you to use all the next Godlike powers of The Avenger.
Makes you totally immune to external damage.
Allows you to use the Avenger Shield, who brings death to all the ones who are guilty.
cons: Hard to get.
Need Six Paths of Light.
Another Enlightened can kill you.

name: Fearless
overview: never feel fear at all in any situation
description: This ability makes you unable to feel any fear. There would be no fight or flight response. You would not feel any reason to avoid the dangerous situation, because you don't even fear death.
pros: Never feel fear ever again.
Never fear death.
Never have a fight or flight response.
cons: No apparent reason to escape danger.

name: Enhancement: Uncontrollable
overview: make a power uncontrollable but the user is immune to the power
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power uncontrollable but the user of the power is immune to the power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, it permanently enhances the power it is attached to.
pros: You're immune but your enemies aren't.
cons: Useless without another power.
Getting this power stolen might not be a good thing to do.

name: Ray Gun Re Animator
overview: conjure a ray gun that re-animates dead things
description: You can conjure out of thin air a 1950's style ray gun. This gun will re-animate anything dead. IQ loss is no problem, but lost limbs don't regrow. If a re-animate is 'killed' a second time just use the gun again on him or her. A third time, a fourth time, etc...the gun has no limit. You can only have one ray gun at a time. If it's stolen you can't unmake it. You can conjure a new ray gun if yours is destroyed. Any conjured ray gun will work on any re-animate. Your gun only works for you.
pros: No one can take control of your re-animation gun
It only works for you. If your the only one with this power then your re-animates are very loyal
Re-animate a re-animated person as many times as you need to.
cons: If gun is stolen.
Gun doesn't restore lost limbs

name: Self Storage
overview: store yourself in a hendheld object indefinitely
description: This may be one of the best melee powers ever. You can store yourself in any object that you can lift with one hand and reappear at any point on it. So if you have a long pole, you can disappear from one side and reappear on the other. You can hold a marble and throw it with yourself inside, allowing for easy travel. You can stay inside for as long as you like without aging, and see everything that happens outside of the object. However, if the object is destroyed, so are you.
pros: Awesome melee power
Semi-immortality
Great for spying
cons: Must be an inanimate object that you can lift with one hand, not good for weak people
Object cannot be destroyed

name: Music Synchronization
overview: do anything associated with a song, its artist, or video.
description: With this power you can do things associated with a song. For instance, the title of the song "Decode" would allow you to decode any code or password and/or do anything else associated in the lyrics. You can also transform into the artist if you know who sings the song. Also, you can do almost anything that was done in the music video (if there is one).
pros: If you have a CD of the song, you grow stronger.
If you have the song on your iPod or music player, then you grow stronger.
cons: You MUST know the name of the song, no matter what.
You CANNOT do anything EXTREME (like being God).

name: Past Life Transformation
overview: transform into your past lives
description: Everyone has past lives and with this power you can transform into them. Any talents or traits you may have had in a past life, you can have them now with this power by transforming into your past life.
pros: Your past lives could have been rich or famous
cons: Sometimes you have bad past lives

name: Cut Clone
overview: grow duplicates from severed limbs
description: Lets say you lose a finger. Not only will it grow back, but in about three days it will have grown a fully functioning clone of you! If you lose an arm or an entire lower half the wait time will decrease considerably. The more material and pain involved, the shorter the wait will be. Clones have all of your memories and skills and have a psychic connection to you.
pros: Might save you from a normally mortal wound
Nifty free clone!
cons: No help against bullets and the like
Still stand a good chance of dying if cleft completely in twain
Choosing between the pain or the wait

name: Weapon Soul
overview: completely transform into any one specific weapon.
description: The next step up from "becoming one with your weapon", this power allows you to convert your entire body into a fully functional weapon: i.e., a scythe, a sword, a pair of nunchucks or even a gun.  The type of weapon you turn into is largely based on your soul and/or your history - for instance, a ninja could turn into a variety of ninja weapons, while a cowboy-type would probably turn into a revolver.  The drawback, of course, is that you can't use yourself - you need a partner to wield you.
pros: Partial transformations allow for unique attack/defense options
Full transformation could possibly allow for hiding in plain sight, depending on your weapon type
As a soul-based ability, your powers grow as you grow as a person
cons: Of course, in full transformation, you need a partner to wield you, or you're useless
Sometimes partial transformations are awkward - imagine explaining your leg turning into a blade
If you are destroyed as a weapon, your soul is shattered, and you become unrevivifiably dead

name: The Evil Eye
overview: scare foes with a piercing stare
description: The Evil Eye is the power to intimidate foes with a mean look. One with this power (usually) has a normal-looking face; however, it is in the user's power to give a glare that is so menacing that it psychically evokes the panic or fear response in the brains of foes, so that they cower at the sight of him.
pros: Scare foes (even to the point of wetting themselves or fainting)
Very inconspicuous (the eyes might glow, but that's the only sign the power is being used)
Not permanently-activated (not everybody is scared by looking the user in the eye)
cons: Must make eye contact (or look at the foe at least); foes out of sight range are immune
People with the power fearlessness or aniothability are immune to this effect
Also called the "stink eye" which can get people to make fun of you.

name: Spawn: Greek Shelters
overview: spawn greek shelters based on their gods/goddesses.
description: You are able to spawn spacious,comfortable shelters where you can sleep and lounge.  Since they are based off the greek pantheon and the titans you gain special features for each cabin spawned.  Dionysus's cabin will have a big party room, Athena's will have a library, etc.  Each will have at least 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a large kitchen, and a book shelf with exclusive greek history of all the hero's, wars, and everything in between.
pros: Good if you are lost and want to rest.
Each is very spacious and comfortable.
cons: Somethings are just scary (Phobus's cabin)
Some may involve you do dangerous things (A sparing arena in Are's cabin)
They are not protected on the outside.

name: Fullmetal Alchemists:Envy
overview: gain the abilities of Envy.
description: By gaining the abilities of Envy one gains numerous benefits. The first is a great shapeshifting ability, you are able to shape shift into a real or fictional person as long as they way less. You also gain incredible speed and strength, no matter what form you are in.
pros: Transformation.
Speed and strength.
cons: If others become better than you, your envy shall get to the better of you.
Your eyes are your greatest weak spots.

name: Predator Creator
overview: make any living or nonliving object instantly become murderous
description: Your hands fire invisible beams that when they strike an object, makes them instantly evil and out to kill. This works for living things (like turning a giraffe into a superpredator by making grow sharp teeth), technology (like making a car suddenly drive itself, run people over), and even everyday objects (like pens would chase you bouncing with their springs, stab your vein, contract their ink reservoir, and inject you with toxic ink). You cannot mentally control them, they just want to kill.
pros: You can make multiple things predatory at once, and it doesn't wear off, unless you take their power
The most harmless looking objects can jump in peoples tracheas, choking them
Living things and machines can change themselves to become killers (grow teeth, horns, etc. )
cons: Non-living objects (besides machines) cannot change themselves, only stretch and contract to move
Because you don't have control of them, they can attack and harm you as well
Most things will be to easy to destroy (like predatory porcelain) and some things simply can't move.

name: Mime Control
overview: control mimic power users.
description: Worried of mimic power users? Transform yourself into a mime and fully control them by your body actions and gestures.
pros: You can use your other abilities while this is activated.
This cannot be copied or absorbed.
Make fun of others.
cons: Works only for mimic ability users.
Control only one person at a time.
Kick your victim, you'll be kick as well(unless you teleport,etc. To avoid)

name: Myth Power: Algos' Affliction
overview: channel Algos and the Algea's command over the essence of sadness, pain, misery, grief and suffering
description: Algos (Algus) and the Algea, in Greek myth, were the gods of pain, suffering, sorrow and distress. As such, channeling Achos (Physical Pain), one can psychically induce and manipulate physical pain at will. Channeling Lupe (Mental Pain) one can psychically induce and manipulate mental pain at will. Channeling Ania (Distress, Trouble), one can psychically perceive factors that annoy, bother, trouble or distress the foe, and psychically manipulate probability to bring about said factors at will.
pros: Psychically induce and manipulate physical pain at will
Psychically induce and manipulate mental pain (sadness, worry, regret, trauma, etc) at will
Psychically perceive, and bring about factors which distress and trouble the foe at will
cons: Cannot transfer pain or psychological trauma to/from self or others until developed (NCN)
Aniothability, Mental Immunity, etc provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Eris' Enmity and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Hecate's Hex
overview: channel Hekate's command over the essence of magic, witchcraft, spirits, necromancy and crossroads
description: Hecate (Hekate), in Greek myth, was the goddess of magic, witchcraft, spirits, necromancy and crossroads. As such, channeling her endows powerful magic; one can brew magic potions and charms (such as love charms, transmutation potions and magic remedies), hex foes, etc. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with ghosts/spirits and witches, as well as withstand magic/necromantic effects. Furthermore, one gains physical and magic power during the new moon, and at crossroads.
pros: Powerful magic at your disposal (hex/jinx/curse foes, assist allies, shapeshift, cast illusion, etc)
Psychically perceive and communicate with ghosts/spirits/undead and witches/necromancers/mages
Become more physically and magically powerful during the New Moon and/or at crossroads
cons: Cannot compel ghosts/spirits/undead, witches/mages or black dogs until the higher levels (NCN)
Until the higher levels, even immune to direct magical BENEFITS (NCN)
Disrespecting spirits (desecrate graves, etc), directly harming spirits or mages disrupts power use

name: Burning Blood
overview: have one's blood ignite in flames.
description: This power only works when the blood is outside of your body and is at the user's will. The blood will burn at the temperature of regular flames. You are immune to flames created with this power.
pros: If you're bleeding, it is bad for your enemies.
cons: You need to lose blood to use this power.

name: Scar Empowerment
overview: be empowered by the number of scars one has
description: The larger the number of scars you have the higher your physical strength, endurance, and speed are, as well as all other powers you have being boosted by 1% for each scar you have. In order to gain this power one person has to punch OR kick you 10,000 times at full force.
pros: Having this power, 'Blades of Pain', and 'Scarred'.
cons: An enemy with 'Scarred' can make this power useless.
Getting lots of scars will hurt and take time.

name: Glucokinesis
overview: manipulate sugar
description: Glucokinesis, also called Sucrokinesis, Saccharokinesis or Sugar Manipulation is the ability to manipulate sugar crystals. This includes moving it, moving substances containing it, forming it into crystalline constructs, changing it into various physical states, altering its presence in bodies (including within humans and plants) and the like. One could even whip it at foes with force enough to flay flesh, if enough is gathered.
pros: Sugar and anything sugary/sweet can now be used as a weapon
Flavor (sweeten) foods or remove excess sugar from foods (don't betray your diet)
Extract sugar from various sources (including from living organisms, and out of foods)
cons: Eating too much sugar can be unhealthy
Crystallokinesis, when developed, can overpower this ability
People with Sugar Rush are immune to this ability

name: Tripler Du Canon De Venin
overview: produce triple cannons that release powerful energy
description: Manifest a cannon, two for each arm and one for the back, charge energy and then fire a huge amount of power to cause huge damage
pros: Destroy any enemy in its path
Extremely fast power blasts
Can reduce a mountain to rubble
cons: Can't be used more than once a day
Huge consumption for amount of power used
Has to sleep for 24 hours after eating huge consumption

name: Neutrophil Granulocyte Mimicry
overview: be attracted to harmed friends, stick to/absorb foes and produce a foe-specific poisonous gas.
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers: an elastic body, the power to clone yourself while in combat mode and the power to distinguish friends from foes on a molecular level. You can detect hurt friends and enter combat mode as soon as you find them. In combat mode, you can stick to and absorb foes, killing them. You can absorb up to 25 foes, before you die. You can also produce a poisonous gas which only affects foes, paralysing them and slowly killing them.
pros: You can sense if a friend is hurt and locate them. It even works if you are already in combat mode.
When you touch a foe, your body will stick to theirs on a molecular level until you absorb them.
You enter combat mode as soon as you find your hurt friend in order to defend them.
cons: Once in combat mode, you're stuck in this mode.
If you absorb too many foes, you'll die.

name: Spiritual Converse
overview: see, hear and communicate with ALL spirits.
description: The gifted person can see, hear and communicate with ALL spirits (living and dead) from ALL forms of life. Spirits of deceased (both human, animal and plant), Spirits from nature, Spirits from the Elements, Angels, Demons, Gods, small spirits from All forms of energy, Spirits residing in flowers, trees, and anything living. The user can communicate both verbally and telepathically.
pros: The user is gifted to be the diplomat between the natural and the supernatural.
The user can negotiate with troublesome ghosts and malevolent spirits of natural disasters.
The person is never alone and can use the spirits as intuitive messengers, and protectors.
cons: Negotiations are not always 100%
The person has this uncontrollable ability to attract ALL spirits (good and bad).
Everything is making sounds. There is NO privacy or quiet time.

name: Snack Time!
overview: have a snack anytime!
description: With this ability, you can have a snack anytime. You can summon as many snacks as you want. Snacks disappear after 48 hours. You can't summon meals or drinks with this power. No exceptions.
pros: Have a snack whenever you want!
No limit to the amount of snacks!
Have a midnight snack!
cons: You can't summon meals.
You can't summon drinks.
No exceptions.

name: Acid Immunity
overview: be unaffected by acids of any kind and strength
description: No acid will ever hurt someone with this power.
pros: You can still digest food since the acid isn't hurting you.
Enemies with only powers having to do with acid.
cons: Bases can still hurt you.

name: Osmosis Manipulation
overview: control your osmosis and that of people around you
description: Osmosis is essential to the human body; we use it when we breathe, cells get nutrients with it, and we couldn't live without it. This process is now in your power! With this ability, you can take in substances through your skin like oxygen, water, etc. You can also mess around with other people's osmosis so their cells don't get enough oxygen.
pros: Take in more oxygen than your lungs normally do, drastically reducing the need to breathe.
Stop your enemies' cells from getting any nutrients, thereby destroying their major organs.
Change anything else in the world that requires osmosis.
cons: You are more susceptible to poison.
Your chances of getting sick increases when you use your power: skin is part of the immune system.
Swimming in salt water causes your blood pressure to skyrocket.

name: Ability Devolution
overview: turn other abilities to their low-level form.
description: This ability lowers the abilities of others down to their first state of development. This could make other abilities nearly worthless. A good example would be if someone could raise a tidal wave, then with this ability, it will reduce it into raising a small amount of water. Most of the time during this ability's effect, it could turn against the user of the other ability if not mastered.
pros: Weakens enemies ways of attacks.
Turns ability users' abilities against them.
cons: Might affect your other abilities.
Short- time effect.

name: Talent Granting
overview: imbue others with talents or special skills.
description: A talent is a group of aptitudes useful for some activity, or qualities that make someone who has them espically good at a certain thing. A talent granter can imbue someone with these qualities. They cannot, however, imbue anyone with qualities beyond normal human capabilities, such as intangibility or flight.
pros: Can grant anyone with a talent of your choice.
It is possible to grant yourself a talent, at the expense of losing this ability
cons: Contact is required
Can't grant super-human qualities
Can't grant more than one talent per person, but you can take a talent back.

name: Body Fat Manipulation
overview: manipulate body fat.
description: With this power, the user can use their own weight for multiple purposes. For example, one could make the fat on the front of their body become bulletproof or even use fat to enhance their strength. One of the many other applications of this power is to burn it rapidly, granting a massive energy boost (such as for powers) but it makes you lose your fat--a precious resource. The holder can store a limited amount of fat extra-dimensionally. With training, you can control your metabolism.
pros: To prepare for a fight, simply become obese.
You can steal fat from others.
Can give regenerative stem cells.
cons: If you can't gain weight easily, this is pointless.
There are some powers that prevent weight gain.
There are plenty of medical conditions which can cause weight loss.

name: Gift Of Ezechiel
overview: memorize every written text by eating it.
description:
It is said in the Bible that the prophet Ezechiel ate a scroll containing some divine prophecies: the scroll tasted like honey and after eating it he was able to report word by word everything was written there. 
Everyone who possess this power can eat every text (written on papery or another digestible support): in this way, the subject can learn by heart the text and repeat it word by word. Useful for students (XD).
pros: The subject is able to learn a big quantity of texts;
He also learns all the information contained in these texts;
He can bring back to memory every page or paragraph learned during his life by association of ideas.
cons: Not every support is digestible, and also eating too much paper is not so healthy.
The text must be totally readable;
The risk of "information indigestion" is high; if taken too much information at once you risk coma.

name: Myth Power: Horae (Growth4)
overview: channel the Horae and their command over the essence of plant growth and production
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of plant growth. As such, channeling Carpo (Karpo, Damia- Ripening, Ripe Fruit) allows one to psychically summon ripe fruit, at will, as well as ripening unripened fruit, by touch. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to any location with ripe fruit, at will. Furthermore, one can gain physical power by eating ripe fruit. One can even produce the aroma of ripe fruit, to attract and/or intoxicate subjects, at will.
pros: Psychically summon ripe fruit, and ripen unripe fruit, by touch, at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere with ripe fruit, at will
Gain physical power from eating ripe fruit; produce the aroma of ripe fruit to attract/intoxicate
cons: Cannot turn into an immovable, indestructible divine fruit tree, at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically turn normal fruit into magical fruit (Golden Apples, etc) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demeter's Touch and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Beautification Vision
overview: induce the current standard on any individual through sight.
description: With this ability, one merely has to look at an individual and they will immediately express the standard of beauty in that time and place for a person of their race and gender. For instance, all will become young and females will enjoy low body fat while males will experience enhanced muscle tone. Once transformed, they will revert back over time, but the effect can be reapplied. There will be no consequences before, during or after the transformation, nor after reverting.
pros: Can be applied to yourself by simply looking at any part of yourself.
Change others to boost self esteem or even financial reward.
If applied continuously, targets can enjoy eternal youth and immunity to any disfiguring illnesses.
cons: Restricted to the general standard of beauty, not your own.
Cannot bring back then dead (cannot restore someone to the beauty inherent in life).
Cannot cure diseases, only remove the visible signs of them.

name: Cat Tastrophe
overview: have all the powers of a feline.
description: This power will allow you to have extend-able claws, jump incredibly accurately and "fft!" at your enemy.
pros: Conceal your claws easily.
cons: You are easily frightened by Dogs.

name: Resurrection Sacrifice
overview: bring someone who died to life again by offering certain years of your lifespan
description: If you bring back to life one person, you will offer one year of your lifespan. Two persons, two years, etc.
pros: You can bring your lovers to life
cons: Your lifespan will be reduced
You can bring back one person each year
You will feel weak after using this power

name: Reverse Possession
overview: be able to possess ghosts.
description: Instead of allowing a ghost to possess YOU, YOU can possess a ghost. This ability allows you to climb into a ghost's form and gain control of its mind. You then have all the powers of a ghost and partial invulnerability. Note: This power is only to be used on friendly spirits. Evil spirits can override your control and destroy you. Friendly spirits tend to forgive and forget.
pros: You can possess a ghost.
You gain all of the ghost's powers.
In this state, you are partially invulnerable.
cons: If you do this on evil spirits... They'll destroy you.

name: Melanopsin Cell Mimicry
overview: stay awake when exposed to light, convert light into electricity and make people see what you see.
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. While exposed to light, especially a blue light, you can convert it into electricity, as well as special signals, and your body clock will remain stuck to wakefulness, keeping you alert and active no matter how much sleep you need. By sending the signals to someone's visual cortex (the back of the head in humans), you may make them see what you see, though it will be unconsciously, as well as keep them awake. Also, this power responds slowly to changes of lighting.
pros: You can electrocute someone when you're exposed to light.
The brighter and bluer the light, the more effective this power will be.
Feeling sleepy? Take a light therapy.
cons: When you go from darkness to light, this power needs time to activate.
When you go from light to darkness, this power needs time to deactivate.
You can make people see what you see, but they may not notice as it affects unconscious sight.

name: Emotional Body Color Change
overview: change your skin color depending on your emotion
description: With this power you can change your skin color depending on your emotion. You can turn this power on and off whenever you want. When you're angry you turn red, happy yellow, sad blue, lovestruck pink, confused purple, determined orange, excited green, scared white, brave gray. This is good if you want to be able to camouflage with something all you have to do is feel a certain emotion and you change colors. The stronger you feel the emotion the darker the color is. You can use this on others too
pros: You can change your color by feeling emotions
You can turn the power on and off
You can use it on others to see what they're feeling
cons: Not much use in combat

name: Instant Friends
overview: make anyone your friend.
description: You want to be friends with someone right, but they hate you, use this power, and presto! You got a new friend. It also works on celebrities too.
pros: Get friends quick.
Be able to go to more parties.
Meet celebrities.
cons: There is such as thing as too many friends
Friends may fight for your attention

name: Endless Passageway
overview: make the end of a passageway unreachable.
description: This power can affect any delimited area used for passage, such as corridors, roads, bridges, stairs, ladders, walkways or tunnels. You can make one end of any passageway unreachable. So, anyone who enters from the unaffected end will have the impression of advancing, but the other end will never get closer to them. Their only way out is to go back the way they came, unless you decide to switch your power to the other end.
pros: You can protect your secret hideout by affecting the passageways leading to it.
You can make a maze unexitable by affecting the very last corridor.
With practice, you can discriminate who should be stuck in the passageway and who may pass.
cons: They can still reach the other end if they step out of the boundaries of the passageway.

name: Like Spell
overview: cast a spell to make anyone like anyone else.
description: This ability allows you to cast a spell to make anyone like anyone else. You can also use the spell to make anyone like you. The duration of the spell depends on how much someone liked someone else before the spell. If someone hated someone else (or you), the spell only lasts 3 hours. If someone already liked someone, the spell lasts 3 months. The spell duration varies. Someone might like someone else (or you) even if the spell wears off. The effects wear off if you tell them about the spell.
pros: Make people like (not love) others.
Make friends more easily.
Even works on people who dislike others or you.
cons: Spell must remain a secret. Telling them about the spell breaks it.
Spell doesn't last as long on those who dislike the other person.
Someone might like you even if the spell wears off. Bad if you don't like them.

name: Bubbles Blast
overview: summon a large ammount of bubbles that burst into a impenetrable fog.
description: This power gives one the power to summon a large ammount of bubbles that have two effects when they burst. One they form an impenetrable fog around in the room the user is in, or the direct area of affect. Two, when the bubbles burst they cause the temperature in the direct area of affect to drop drastically.   This power is naturally weak against wind and fire attacks, and is purely deffensive in nature.
pros: Clouds your foe's line of sight.
Causes temp to drop drastically.
cons: Weak against Fire and Wind type attacks.
Purely a deffensive power.

name: Human Jack Hammer
overview: smash an object by rapidly jabbing or punching it
description: When you jab or punch an object it will be slowly smashed or worn down because your fist is super hard and it moves very fast.
pros: Can easily destroy an obstacle in your way.
cons: Bad if you jab a human.

name: Foe Cloning
overview: contol any a clone of anyone you defeat
description: When you defeat someone in battle you gain their shadow (a perfect likeness of him/her with all their powers). A few problems are: though you can collect any shadow, you can use only one at a time and you can't move while using it. If an enemy beats you you don't get their shadow, and magical people seem to be immune to it.
pros: Control anyone you ever fought
You will be in two places at once
Instant shadow switches
cons: If they beat you you'll NEVER get their shadow
Totally frozen in place while using
Most magic users are immune to having shadows stolen

name: Gift: Emotions
overview: be gifted at the control of emotions
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling emotions than other beings. Thus their emotion-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of emotions from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve emotion-based powers, nothing else.
pros: Almost no one has as good control over emotions as someone with this power.
Emotion-based powers are boosted slightly.
cons: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only emotion-based powers now.

name: Unison Raid
overview: combine two individuals and their powers into one body.
description: This last a relatively short amount of time, but allowes to increase overall power as well as utility of skills. 1st Person gains all the powers of the 2nd person, and the 2nd person, losing their body, follows the 1st as a ghost, untill Unison Raid is cancelled.
pros: Increases overall power.
Allows for the 1st person to use powers without having to worry about co-ordinating with a teammate.
Gives full understanding and mastery of powers for the duration.
cons: Having one fighter instead of two.
Takes up extra energy to maintain, versus fighting as two separate individuals.
Can't be used too often for fear of losing personality.

name: Sunstone
overview: use this jewel to enhance weapons
description: The sunstone looks like a multicolored jewel necklace with beads and magatama with limitles solar power. It can be combine with any weapon like the moon blade to enhance  its abilities,repair it if they both get damaged or destoryed, and can combine the weapon with your body.
pros: Enhances the moon blade abilities
Repair if damaged or destoryed
combine your weapon to your body

going super nova will over heat you and your weapon

name: Shadow Fire
overview: burn shadows
description: This power is a force to be reckoned with. By using this ability you induce damage upon your foe by attacking their shadow. This does not cause heat damage nor does it cause direct physical damage. It causes transferred damage. This power can only be wielded by people who have access to the shadow realm or who have absorbed it with power absorption. The stronger the level the more the damage.
pros: Indirect attack
If used in shadow realm it 2x the damage
Not actually fire
cons: To shadows its fire
Can affect user
Sucks if being used against you

name: Baton Of Absorption
overview: wield an attack-absorbing baton
description: This magic baton acts as a shield and weapon. When spun, it stores energy for a powerful blow. When the baton is hit by any form of energy while spinning, it absorbs the energy and transforms based on the energy. For example, if the baton absorbs fire energy, it turns red and the two crystal balls on both ends fill with fire and leaves a scorching mark when used on somebody.
pros: Excellent shield
Uses stored energy to attack enemies
Absorbs all kinds of energy
cons: Whatever you do, do NOT break the crystal balls storing the energy

name: Unicity
overview: resist being added on to or increased.
description: This ability allows you to resist being added on to or increased. This means that you cannot be increased in size, possessed, mind controlled, forcibly psychically linked, given powers forcibly , or other things which add on to the body, mind, powers, or spirit of the person. It also prevents foreign agents from growing in or on you and can allow you to prevent any transformation that causes you to increase in some way whether physical or not. As a side affect you cannot get cancer.
pros: Resist being given least wanted powers.
Cannot be possessed or mind controlled as it adds to the spirit or mind.
If you have powers to add on to yourself you are capable of doing so.
cons: Does not protect against other types of damage.
Still affected by powers that reduce you.
Does not protect you from being totally destroyed.

name: Fish Control
overview: control any species of fish
description: With this poer you have complete control over any species of fish, including sharks. If you're fighting underwater, you can have a shark or swordfish come and attack your enemy. You could also use this power to cheat in fishing competitions.
pros: You can control any species of fish
You can make sharks and swordfish attack your enemies
You can cheat in fishing competitions
cons: Has no use if you're not fighting in or at least near the water
Has no affect on sea mammals

name: Dissolvilcation
overview: shoot beams from your fingertips that cause your foe's head to explode and their bodies to melt.
description: Your fingers are glowing with a bright greenish aura and you shoot a beam at your opponent's head that causes it to explode into bloody pieces while their body will dissolve into a puddle of dark yellow or lime-ish goo.
pros: A kind of a weird fatality.
cons: Totally gross.

name: Hypno Dance (Entrancing Dance)
overview: dance in such a manner that any person watching is mesmerized.
description: Simply by dancing you can induce a trance in any person that is watching you. Clearly the person must be able to see, and must be looking at you when you begin your dance. Any interruptions before the full effect of your dance takes place will free the target unless he is foolish enough to stare at you again. That being said the skill makes excellent crowd control and through the use of video, like Youtube the possibilities are limitless. Once you stop dancing the effect fades in 20 minutes.
pros: You can compel men to do what you want.
Excellent crowd control
Get back at your ex
cons: Only works for fthe opposite sex
Victims must be able to see
Physically taxing

name: Vocal Powered Strength

description: A person with this power has superstrength but only when they are talking. The good thing is that their strength increase the louder that they speak. However the limitation of talking can be very troublesome especially if people know about this weakness. For example, if you are gagged you cannot use your superstrength. Also is someone uses gas or other corrosive it can hurt your lungs.
pros: Your voice gives you superstrength
The louder you speak the more powerful you get--there is no limit

Swallowing flies, getting hit with tear gas, having objects crammed down to shut you up

description: With this power you will know if their is a traitor or mole within your team or group. If a person is secretly revealing information or fighting for your enemies you will instantly know who it is and how they are interacting with the enemy. With practise, you can sense betrayal in other groups too.

No use if their is no traitor or mole

name: Half Tanuki

description: Powers that need a snap to activate can't have any effect on you.
pros: Snap power immunity
cons: None

name: Object Splitting
overview: split objects and form portals between the two halves
description: You can split any object in two by running your finger around it in a complete loop. It will split along the line you draw. If you have a hollow object, the two halves will act as if still connected. For instance, if you split a straw, you can put one half in a drink and drink remotely through the other half. In this way, you can remove your limbs and operate them from a distance. However, once the object is split, it cannot be rejoined. You could put some tape around it but it wouldn't be same.
pros: Split any object in two easily
Operate limbs remotely
Perpetual motion now possible
cons: Must be able to draw a complete, non-stop line around the object
Object can never be truly rejoined
Portals only available with hollow objects

name: King Of The Super Gators
overview: summon and control super powered alligators
description: With this power you can summon and control super powered alligators. The alligators can fly, breathe fire, have super strength, enhanced agility, sharp teeth and bulletproof skin. You can summon up to 20 super gators at a time and can unsummon them when you're done with them. The gators can stand on their two hind legs but cannot speak or write only communicating through growls and other animalistic sounds. The gators also have all of the abilities of a normal gator like breathing underwater.
pros: You can summon and control up to twenty super gators
If one dies you can just summon another one
You can unsummon them when you're done with them
cons: They cannot talk to you
You can't summon regular alligators or any kind of crocodile

name: Death Eater's Hunger
overview: transmute life energy into bite sized orbs of death.
description: Death Eaters being what they are, mock & sneer upon the very existence of life in this realm. For them, only death & decay, which are most often than not inevitable, are the only absolute truth that nature must eventually obey & submit to. Through this ability they are able to ultimately cast insult to life & to anyone who futilely attempt to keep it by inexplicably transforming that ability to live or its energy into the absolute existence of death in the form of dark viscous blob-orb of death.
pros: You do not simply end life; you distort, corrupt, & reverse its existence and function.
These death orbs can be consumed by a death eater or manipulated into other useful forms.
Very pleasing for anyone who thrives on the death of other's.

Immortality

name: Frictionless
overview: become frictionless
description: If you are being hold onto, you will easily be able to slide right out of their arms. You can also slide on the ground without stopping until you de-activate your power & produce friction again.

Slide for miles without stopping

name: Gigantization
overview: make objects or people larger in size
description: The opposite spectrum of shrinking. You can make things behemoth size--be it a person, building, animal, plant. They will grow to a max of 25,000 feet in height. Weight & mass all depends on what is growing. You use this power by touching whatever you want enlarged and it will increase size every second you touch. Living things might find it hard to breathe with increasing altitude & there's the whole "giant rampage" issue that could occur. The object retains its huge size for 12 hours.

The max height is 25,000 ft (almost the size of Everest)

pros: Could create something out of nothing.
Amplifies ability.

Only works on certain skills. If you do soul alchemy, you create weapons.

name: Blessing Of Qing Long
overview: become as strong as a dragon as long as you are facing east.
description: Qing-Long is one of the four Chinese celestial beasts and is alternatively known as the Azure Dragon of the East. When facing the direction east, you will be imbued with all the strength of a dragon, as well as control over the element of wood.
pros: Become as powerful as a dragon.
Control plants and the wind.
Always know which direction east is.

name: Slifer The Sky Dragon

Slifer the Sky Dragons strength is its weakness

name: Myth Power: Panope's Panoply
overview: channel Panope's command over the essence of the sea's broad panorama
description: Panope (Panopeia, Panopea) is the goddess of the vast view of the sea's horizon from a height, by which sailors spot land and oncoming storms. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to any location one can see the sea/ocean on the horizon, at will. One can even psychically transport a subject's soul, by touch, out to a random spot on the sea, where it remains until retrieved.
pros: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically teleport to anywhere one can see the sea/ocean on the horizon, at will
Psychically transport a subject's soul, by touch, to a random spot on the sea/ocean

name: Leaf Form
overview: turn your body into leaves.
description: With this power you can transform any part of your body into leaves, which you can then control freely. You can change your entire body into a pile of leaves and then move about freely as though sailing on the wind, reforming by bring the leaves back together. You can control what type of leaves you become, reform the parts of your body that the laves make up independent of your whole body, and heal yourself by applying real leaves to any wound to replace the part you lost.
pros: Heal yourself with leaves.
Change yourself into poison oak and fly around.
Midigate damage by transformin into leaves when struck.

name: Arceusforce: Insect
overview: channel the power of Arceus's Bug form.
description: The user of this ability can channel the power over the insect armies under the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Bug-type. The user's skin turns olive green, their irises turn pink and pupils turn green. Under their insectoid guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Bug-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Bug attacks such as Bug Bite, Spider Web, Pin Missile, Megahorn and more.

Generation and manipulation of silk and insectoid aura to perform Bug attacks.

name: Tunneling

description: Imagine a mole on steroids. On Java coffee. That is the effect that a Tunneler can achieve. By mentally displacing soil, they can burrow at speeds of up to 75 miles an hour and at depths of up to 2 miles below the surface. The user has a reduced need to breathe while under the surface and a heightened sense of touch (allowing them to "see" what is in their path). However, these bonuses only apply while Tunnelling.
pros: Speeds of up to 75 mph
Depths of up to 2 miles

name: Superpower Trap

Once you have decided on your victim, every nearby superpowered being will hear the tune to 'Pop Goes the Weasel' in their head. At a random moment, the tune will stop and a clown will quickly emerge from the container, grab the victim and pull them inside. It works even with small containers and they can't escape until it is opened.
pros: Fun and suspenseful way to capture a superpowered opponent, regardless of the origin of their power.
The clown has depowering effects on the victim. So, it can even capture intangible beings.
The tune can hint at who may have a superpower as only they can hear it.
cons: Only works if the designated victim has a superpower.
You don't know when the clown will emerge. So, the victim may have the time to flee.
Don't accidently designate yourself.

name: Queen/King Of The Bees
overview: have control of all types of bees
description: With this power you are the king or queen of the bees meaning they do whatever you say; not to mention, you can see what they see, hear what they think, and understand bee dancing and buzzing
pros: You can make the bees sting people  you don't like, and command them in other ways
You'll never get stung by bees again (and they'll defend you...even QUEEN bees obey you)
You get free honey (they let you reach into their hive without reacting)
cons: Does not work on hornets, wasps or yellow jackets
Might make them like you too much (follow you everywhere, etc.)

name: Myth Power: Aletheia's Absolute
overview: channel Aletheia's command over the essence of truth, honesty and sincerity
description: Aletheia (Alatheia, Alethea, Alathea, Alethea, Alethia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of truth, honesty and sincerity. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive lies, deception, dishonesty, untruth and insincerity at will. In addition, one can answer nearly any question they encounter with absolute truth. Furthermore, one can psychically force subjects to speak only truth, at will. One can even see through/negate illusions and shapeshifting, and restore lost memories, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive lies, deception (illusion, shapeshifting, etc), untruth and insincerity at will
Answer nearly any question with absolute truth; psychically force subjects to speak only truth
Psychically see past/prevent/negate illusion and shapeshifting and restore lost memories at will
cons: Kinda turns you into a stickler for the truth
If you tell a lie while using this power, it short-circuits temporarily (honesty is the best policy)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and law/order/justice based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: V.I.P. Access
overview: access to all events and venues, free of charge.
description: VIP Stands for "very important person". With this ability, the magic gate opens up for you at any event or place with restricted access. This includes waiting in line! Be it a bar, club, concert, or even a government facility, you will be treated as a special VIP guest and will be allowed in (including whoever you are with), free of charge or hassle. You and your friends will roll right in like a rockstar!
pros: Free access to concerts, bars, and clubs
People will see you as high status by the way you are being treated
Never wait in line at theme parks, movie theaters etc.
cons: You might be allowed in, but having spending money is another issue
You're treated like a VIP, but you're still held accountable for your actions (ie crimes)
You're on your own when it comes to workin the ladies in the VIP lounge

name: Earth Diving
overview: dive through the entire earth
description: Just dive toward the ground and you will break through the earth's crust, eventually coming out the other side. WTF, you say? Excellent question. This power gives you invulnerability, unstoppability, and increased lung capacity only to be used for this purpose. You're gonna need that last one, as this trip will take at least three hours at top speed. You come out on the opposite side, but can redirect to about 15 latitude points with concentration. This can also be used through water.
pros: Excellent escape technique
Easy Transportation
Become a one man oil pipline driller
cons: Takes FOREVER
Crazy Scary
May run out of breath

name: Induced Radioactivity
overview: generate harmful radiation
description:
A person with Induced Radioactivity can generate dangerous radiation in massive amounts for a variety of effects including:
*Radiation poisoning
*Radiation burns
*An EMP (Electromagnetic Pulse)
*Heating objects
*And finally, a dangerous atomic blast similar to an Atomic Bomb
pros: Extremely powerful
Can stop an army
Only limited by imagination and will
cons: Always emitting some radiation
No peaceful uses
Easy to fatally injure or kill

name: The Terrorizer
overview: transform into a horrifying being with dark various powers.
description: Imagine if you had the invisibility of Hawley Griffin, the vile methods of Mr. Edward Hyde, the vampirism of Count Dracula, and the immortality of Dorian Gray. With all of that, you can become a monster that'll strike fear into the hearts of good and evil alike. You can drain your opponent's blood, can spy on your enemies, could have brute intense strengh, and never die for a long time.
pros: Nothing good can come from this ability.
cons: Can accidently kill your family and friends.
Can forever become a vile lunatic.

name: Monkey King (Sun Wukong)
overview: become a legendary figure from Chinese mythology.
description: With this ability, you become the monkey king, Sun Wukong himself. In the story, Journey to the West the Monkey King was a master shapeshifter knowing over 72 different transformations. He was also a master martial artist with superb strength. His staff, known as Ruyi Jingu Bang was capable of reaching incredible lenghts. Sun can also fly upon a cloud for traveling. With this ability you are nearly invincible and immortal.
pros: The spells are quite powerful.
Use your cloud for short trips.
It is good to be immortal.
cons: The transformations are imperfect, your tail is still noticeable.
You are still prone to damage and can feel pain.
A habit to play pranks on others.

name: Objection!
overview: object to anything that annoys you.
description: You can object to anything you want at any time. Things that bother you, tick you off, make you sad, anything at all. But if you do, you won't be able to bring back the thing or person you objected to. So watch what you object to.
pros: You can object to anything you don't want to listen to.
If there is anything you don't like, you can object to it.
You can get rid of anything you want to.
cons: Certain things shouldn't be objected to.
Once you object you can't go back.
If you don't think about what you object, you may object the wrong thing so think before you object.

name: Mr.Sunshine
overview: be constantly surrounded by a warm glow of sunlight
description: This power assures that the user will always be bright and sunshiny, even if their mood and their actions reflect just the opposite. One with this ability is constantly surrounded by a warm glow that is reminiscent of sunlight, and can be used as such. In the user's presence, plants get nutrients and grow slightly faster (but never out of control); you cast a glow in the dark, can withstand being sunburned, can withstand intense cold, and (perhaps the best part) you can turn it on/off anytime.
pros: You constantly radiate warm and comforting sunshine (never too hot or too bright)
All the properties of sunlight (help plants grow, give off heat/light, resist temperature extremes)
When developed, can turn it off and on at will
cons: This power was changed from its original idea (hope the author doesn't mind)
Those who can absorb or manipulate solar energy tend to be a pain
Somtimes the heat, light and radiation you give off depends on your emotions (burn stuff by mistake)

name: Medusa Glare
overview: look at someone in the eye & paralyze them
description: Like the Greek mythical monster Medusa, you will be able to look at someone in the eyes & make them paralyze for a day. It only works if its eye to eye contact though.
pros: Paralyze people
cons: Only last for a day
Have to make eye contact

name: Avaritia
overview: create a vacuum that can suck up anything
description: This is a power that allows the user to create a powerful vacuum that can suck up anything. It's basically similar to a black hole. It's activated by using one's hands to create the vacuum(hole). Anything that is sucked into the hole can be used later on by the user, for example weapons or even people(as shields).
pros: Can suck up just about anything
Very powerful and hard to avoid
cons: Hard to control and may inadvertently suck up something not intended
Has a time limit, doesn't last forever
Its power and size depend on the overall strength and ability of the user

name: Mind Freak
overview: possess all the powers of master illusionist Criss Angel
description: Ever wondered how Criss Angel performs all his insane stunts? With this power, you can, too! This ability lets the user levitate, walk on water, make things disappear and reappear, and escape from impossible situations. You are still human, though, and can die.
pros: Levitate, disappear, and other cool powers
Escape from practically anything
Be awesome in general
cons: People will constantly be asking how you do it
You scare little kids

name: Space Vehicles
overview: transform into any kind of space vehicle
description: With this ability you can turn your body into any type of space vehicle real or fictional such as a Space Shuttle, Star Ship, UFO etc.
pros: You can travel through space
cons: You can only travel through space while in vehicle mode

name: Mind Eraser
overview: erase your own memories
description: The power to erase stuff in your mind--intense traumas, irrational fears, etc.
pros: Perfect for if you're watching a scary movie
Can erase your memories of clandestine activities
cons: Cannot restore lost memories on your own

name: Myth Power: Soter/Soteria Says
overview: channel Soter and Soteria's command over the essence of security, safety and deliverance from harm
description: Soter and Soteria, in Greek myth, were god and goddess counterparts (respectively) of safety, preservation and deliverance from harm. As such, males channel Soter; females channel Soteria. Doing so allows one to perceive impending danger for oneself and others. In addition, if one is in a dangerous situation, one may produce an aura about oneself and one's allies which prevents foes from thinking to do them harm. Similarly, dangers from inanimate objects are deflected off of this aura.
pros: Perceive impending danger
Produce an 'Aura of Safety' that keeps enemies from wanting to hurt you (and/or allies)
That same aura deflects harm from inanimate objects as well
cons: The 'Aura of Safety' often doesn't draw people to come rescue you until the higher levels
Cannot stop or reverse time to prevent or undo harm until the higher levels
Cannot perceive the actual CAUSE of impending danger until the higher levels

name: God Phone V4
overview: summon any of Gods and Goddesses from Norse Mythology
description: With this power you can summon any of the Gods or Goddesses from Norse Mythology. The deities are not under your control but they might want to help you if you have a good reason for summoning them. If you don't have a good enough reason however they will most likely destroy you. You cannot send them back unless they want to go back.
pros: You can summon any of the Norse Gods and Goddesses
You can summon as many of them as you want
They might help you
cons: They might kill you

name: Star Arranger
overview: arrange the stars in certain patterns
description: With this power you can arrange the stars into whatever shapes or patterns you want. You can write people's names in the stars, write messages, or make funny shapes in the stars. This is also a good way to distract your enemy while fighting at night.
pros: You can arrange the stars into any patterns you want
You can distract your enemies in fights
cons: If it's a cloudy night this power is useless

name: Tint V2
overview: make other people see the whole world in just one color
description: With this power you can cause other people to see the entire world as just one color. You can make one guy see the entire world as being blue and another person seeing it as red and so and so forth. You can undo the effects of this power whenever you want.
pros: You can cause anyone to see the entire world as one color
You can reverse the effects of this power
cons: You can't use this power on yourself

name: Human Battering Ram
overview: cause doors to open when you touch them with your head
description: With this power you can cause any door no matter how many locks it has on it to open just by touching your head to it. It only works with doors that swing inward (push doors) and not pull doors, revolving doors, sliding doors etc.
pros: You can open doors just by touching your head to them
cons: They have to be push doors

name: Jli Summon V2
overview: summon any member of Justice League International
description: With this power you can summon any member of the Justice League International. The hero doesn't have to currently be an active member of the team, they don't even have to be living in the current comic book timeline. Also when you summon one of them they under your complete control. Unfortunately if you want to use the mind control function you can only summon one of them. If you summon two or more you lose control over them.
pros: You can summon any member of the JLI
You can mind control up to one of them at a time
They don't have be an active or living member of the League
cons: You can only use the mind control function if you summon only one hero

name: Human Magnet
overview: be magnetized
description: This power allows you to become magnetized. You can attract or repel metal objects. This will become very useful if people are trying to shoot you. Although in it's early stages, this power is uncontrollable, but with time, you'll be able to master it.
pros: Repell bullets
Never have to reach for a fork or other utensil
Be able to pick up change
cons: Bad when in cutlery store
Bad in video cassete store
In early stages, uncontrollable

name: Human E.O.
overview: create electrical outlets from any part of your body
description: Ever wanted a portable electric plug? Well, now you have one. With this power, you can generate an electrical outlet from any part of your body to supply energy to your many devices. Electricity is infinite and comes from a special dimension. You can change the shape of the electrical outlet to fit any plug.
pros: Very convenient
No electricity bill
cons: Can only make an outlet as big as your body
Someone can kidnap you to use you as their infinite power source
If someone pours water on you then you will get shocked but only if you have an outlet on

name: Effect Latency
overview: add a delay to a superpower so it takes time to take effect.
description: With this power, you can add a delay to a superpower. So, it will take a moment to take effect after it has been activated. In the case of a power that is already in use or always active, variations that may occur during its usage will be delayed. It will even take some time to deactivate if its user wants to switch it off. If the power already has a delay, you can add more time to it, but you can't shorten it. You can assign a different time lag to different superpowers.
pros: You can affect anyone's abilities, even yours.
Delay a lethal superpower's activation so you can escape!
It's really annoying and frustrating when there's a lag all of a sudden.
cons: The delays are maintained even when you're not around, but at the cost of YOUR energy.
The longer the delay, the more energy it will suck from you to maintain itself.
Can delay the negation of a power, but only if this power's effect is not negated in the process.

name: Sleep Vampirism
overview: drain the benefits of sleep from another to use yourself.
description: With a touch, you can drain as many hours of rest from a person that you want to use yourself. You can 'store up' sleep, ensuring you are well rested for many long days if you have drained a great deal, eliminating the need for naps or rest. Can be subtle, taking just an hour or so from many targets, or take an entire day of sleep from someone. Limited to taking 24 hours per person between rest cycles.
pros: No need for caffeine
Always feel rested and at your best
Knock people out with a single touch
cons: Possibly get very bored with all your extra hours of productivity
Many people around you tired
Ineffective against anything that doesn't sleep

name: Single Man Army Corp (Smac)
overview: be as strong as an army corp via transformation from a special belt.
description: The person who has the special transformation belt, designed by the military, can transform into SMAC, the prime example of soldier and warrior. The belt gives the wearer super strength and invulnerability  The belt also has an uplink with an army satellite in orbit that can upgrade the transformation or divert power to other powers. For example, diverting power from super strength to invulnerability, making them more invulnerable but lest powerful in strength and flight.
pros: You are the ultimate soldier
You can take down most enemies
Can divert power to other sections to make you more suited to combat a certain situation.
cons: Once the power source runs out it, needs to recharge
Satelite link can be hampered by bad weather

name: Bat Suit
overview: put on a battle suit that has a bat theme
description: The person with this power, has the ability to put on this bat themed battle suit. The suit includes a kevlar utility harness and a gas powered magnetic grappling gun. The suit is made up of a hybrid kevlar material and has reinforced padding at the joins. This made the suit bulletproof as well as invulnerable to knife stabbings. And a cape that is made up of a light weight fabric called memory cloth. The memory cloth becomes rigid when a current is applied to it
pros: Good for fighting crime
Can survive in an urban hostile environment.
cons: No super powers whatsoever

name: The Dark Side Of The Force
overview: harness emotions such as anger, jealousy, fear, and hate for nearly infinite uses.
description: The Force is an energy field created by all living things, that surrounds and penetrates living beings and binds the galaxy together. Sith can harness its Dark Side to do nearly anything from telekinesis to shooting lightning to conquering the galaxy. The ability to connect with the Force is based upon the concentration of Midi-chlorians in your cells.
pros: You can choke people with your mind
Your eyes turn yellow
You rule over a vast army of clones and planet-destroying superweapons
cons: You don't get to choose what color lightsaber you have, because red is the only one ominous enough
Multiple of these will occur to you: mutilation, betrayal, defeat by a kid, and painful death
There's only 2 of you against the entire Jedi Order, and at one of you has to die in this movie

name: Body Part Substitution
overview: replace any part of your body with other organic parts.
description: This power allows you to replace any body part from libs, to eyes, even your internal organs. You can install multiple parts such as having two heats, four lungs, two sets of kidneys, etc. Any powers, or actions that were performed with that part, is also transferred to you. This can give you any number of powers, although restricted to that one part(if you take the finger from a fire manipulator, you can only use the power with that finger). You can also take the body parts of animals.
pros: Have more than one power
Not worry about if you lose an arm
cons: The parts all age at a faster rate
You can subcome to memories gained from said parts
Once damaged, that part can not be healed.

name: Surgical
overview: create surgical tools out of pure energy.
description: With this power the user can channel pure energy into the form of any surgical tool. The energy can be drawn from the surroundings or from the user. The energy can be reshaped into any surgical tool and will act as the tool does. More than one tool can be formed at a time. The energies can be used to create chemicals to be used in surgeries but the user can not control the chemicals once they are created.
pros: Create surgical tools and chemicals anywhere.
Save people's lives.
Use surgical tools to "operate" on your enemies.
cons: Need knowledge of how to perform surgery.
Can not control chemicals after they are produced.
Operations may not go as you wish.

name: Air Sight
overview: see air physically and sense objects in the air
description: If you face a opponent who is invisible, you will be able to use this power to see the air traveling around him. Sense any fast moving objects he throws at you and can be used to find people watching you.
pros: See the air as colors
Storms and hurricanes look cooler
cons: Useful only for defense not attack

name: Animal Enhancement
overview: enhance the abilities of animals.
description: With this ability, you can increase the natural abilities of any animal. This includes strength, speed, reflexes, and intelligence. The amount you can increase their abilities by depends on the mastery of the user. The average user can increase the abilities by x50. Their bodies will adapt accordingly to this change. (Ex: makes the brain larger if you boost intelligence, or the muscles larger if you boost strength. ) However, you can't reverse this ability, so grant this power carefully.
pros: Give an animal super-powered abilities.
The average user can multiply their natural abilities (strength, reflexes, intelligence, etc) by x50
Use this on your pets to give them a boost to their abilities.
cons: It's not a good idea to use this on untamed animals.
You may make an animal too reckless by enhancing their abilities.
Cannot use this on humans.

name: On Deadly Ground
overview: make the earth around you poisonous to the touch.
description: You have the ability to make rocks, soil and sand nerve-gas-deadly to the touch. The area can't be more than 100 feet by 100 feet. You can reverse the effect any time. You're immune to this power but not other poison and venom powers. The nerve gas effect works with a single grain of sand. You can use this power if you become a elemental or create them. This power doesn't work with processed earth materials.
pros: Your'e at the beach, in the woods or at the mountains.
A good power for a villain with an earth power .
A single poisonous grain of sand. That's all it takes.
cons: Someone who is immune to earth and/or poison powers
You're not near rocks, soil or sand.

name: Shear Thickening Cartilage
overview: have cartilage which increases in viscosity(resistance) with increased stress.
description: Cartilage is the soft, flexible material that connects bone and allows you to move. With this ability, your cartilage will increase in viscosity(resistance) as stress and strain increases. The greater the stress, the more the resistance becomes. You can turn this power off at any time. The setback of this is that if you put too much stress on your body, it will become much harder for you to move. It only makes cartilage nearly indestructable, not your bones. It's a non newtonian fluid!
pros: Have your cartilage increase in viscosity(resistance) with increased stress and strain.
Cartilage resist impact and pulling more.
It's a non newtonian fluid!
cons: Harder to move when power is on.
Must move slower or lift less when power is on.
Only useful in certain situations.

name: Awesome Masseur
overview: give the best massages in the world
description: With this power you give the best massages in the world. You can relax anybody and heal all back pains. In the middle of the fight you can give your enemy a massage (this might be tricky) and calm him down and then capture him.
pros: You are the best masseur in the world
You can relax almost anybody
You can heal all back pains
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Brass Fists
overview: turn your forearm to your fingter tips into brass
description: With this ability you can turn your forearms into metal brass causing massive dammge to whoever you punch. It's like brass knuckles except now it's your whole fists.
pros: Powerful punch
Unbreakable fists
Doesn't make your fists heavy
cons: Heavy at first
Can be worn down by amonia attacks

name: Empathy Switching
overview: absorb a person's empathic memory & project it to another person
description: Like in The Crow or Powder, you will be able to touch someone & absorb their empathic memories like feelings of pain & tragedy & inject it into someone else. So you have a person that is in pain & dying, you take their empathy & go put it into the one who caused it. Or if someone has depressed feelings, you take a cheerful person's emotional thoughts & give it to the sad one. You do feel a little bit of the empathy you absorb & can only absorb one at a time.
pros: Trade emotions between people
cons: You feel just some of the empathy you absorb but not as much as what you project
Can only take one empathy at a time

name: Ability Jump Start
overview: jump-start your abilities that have been cancelled.
description: This power is not cancellable as it would obviously defeat its purpose. It allows you to use any of your powers when they should be cancelled. It doesn't restore your lost abilities though. You can choose more than one power to jump-start. Once you are done with a power, you can release it, in which case it becomes cancellable again.
pros: You can use your powers against power negators.
This power cannot be cancelled.
cons: Useless if your powers aren't cancelled in the first place.
This power can still be removed/stolen.

name: This Will Hurt You More Than Me
overview: do more damage to the thing that hurts you
description: If someone/something harms you, you will do more damage and harm to them. Also enhances your damage for things like punches and other powers.
pros: Do more harm
Do more damage
People won't want to harm you.
cons: You can still be hurt
You can still die.
Do more harm.

name: Bubble Trapper
overview: trap people in indestructable bubbles.
description: With this power you can take anyone as your prisoner. Know someone you don't like, trap them in a bubble. Want to ground your kids, trap them in a bubble. Or if you're just bored, trap someone is a bubble.
pros: It is unbreakable, so not even other superpowers can break through it.
Great for prison cells.
Unlimited air.
cons: You have to give your prisoners food and such, it is only a bubble.
You can't change its size.

name: Humor Field
overview: emit an aura that cause people to laugh uncontrollably
description: With this power you release a aura that makes everyone laugh uncontrollably. However, it is only limited to 200 yards. It's strongest on april fools day.
pros: Finally funny
Causes foes to laugh as well
Strongest on April Fools Day
cons: Limited to 200 yards
Doesn't work on comedians
Doesn't defend your title

name: Dead Shed
overview: shed injuried or dead skin on yourself
description: If get cut, burnt, stabbed, shot etc. You would be able to peel that part of the flesh off yourself revealing perfectly healthy skin underneath. Like it never happened. Even if you die from your wounds, it takes awhile till you revive yourself & shed your dead body. This is not immortality or accelerated healing. You still feel pain & not immune to diseases & will die from them. Then you'll come back with healthy organs & bones. Its a healthy you inside a dead you.
pros: Shed dead tissue to reveal healthy ones
Your insides will eventually heal after death then you'll revive
cons: Not true immortality or accelerated healing
Still susceptible to illness
Still have to die in order to come back

name: Sword Of Damocles
overview: materialize a sword above the heads of enemies
description:
A person with this power can create the sword of damocles that hangs above people's heads and drops when ordered by the user. 

Only the target and the user can see the sword. 
The sword grows bigger the more fear is exerted but not vice-versa. 

This power can be spammed.
pros: Sword(s) always follows target and swords change direction to always hit the enemy
Can be spammed-tons of swords over a person or tons of swords over an army
With training, the Damocles sword can fall on other parts of the body or form a cage of swords
cons: Sword(s) is only as big as a person's fear
If the sword becomes too big it will fall regardless of the user's commands

name: Stampede
overview: summon a group of any animal to trample your enemies
description: You can summon any animal you want in great numbers. A worm hole opens up and releases the animals you are thinking of at the time. The worm hole opens behind you, giving you time to strike an epic pose. Also, a thought is subconsciously put in the animals' heads to run as fast as they can, avoiding you and aiming for your desired target. When they've done their job, they get taken back to their point of origin, not knowing it even happened.
pros: Can take out large groups of people
Makes for a good distraction
Useful for breaking out of cages, cells, and the like
cons: The animal must exist somewere in the world at the moment (No dinosaurs)
Not usable in small rooms, for obvious reasons
Can only summon one kind of animal at a time

name: Bullet Shrimp Mimicry
overview: have snaps with the power of the Bullet Shrimp
description: Bullet shrimps, when they snap their claws can create cavitation bubbles that create huge sound effects where struck and can be hotter than the sun as well as generate sonoluminescence.With this power your snaps create the same effect only larger because you are bigger and you have the secondary powers needed to not get affected by your own effects. Bullets can be used underwater and in air.
pros: Snap bullets
Even if you miss the shockwave is more than enough to knock out or kill your prey
cons: Too lethal to use all the time
If you don't know how to snap your fingers or are unable to do so

name: Selective Unfreezing
overview: selectivley unfeeze things when time is frozen
description: This power is completley useless if time isn't frozen. If somebody (you or another person) froze time, you would be unharmed and you could also make certain things work, like a car.
pros: Use items that couldn't function otherwise while frozen.
If you get this you will probably be able to freeze and unfreeze time by yourself.
Use this again if someone freezes your targeted item.
cons: Things can be re-frozen
Useless if time is not frozen
You might wanna be able to freeze time yourself

name: Song Of The Family
overview: have a beautiful singing voice when near members of your immediate family.
description: With this power, you will have a beautiful singing voice when a member of your immediate family (father, mother, sister, brother, wife, son, daughter) is in a hundred-foot radius of you. Also, when you sing while this power is in effect, only good things will happen to you, so if you sing while fighting an enemy and one of your immediate family members is near you, you will win the fight. Or, if you use this power while buying a lottery ticket, you will win the lottery.
