pros: You will have a beautiful singing voice when a member of your immediate family is near you.
Only good things can happen to you when you use this power.
cons: Your family members have to be near you.

name: Eight Virtues
overview: possess all Eight Virtues.
description: The ability to possess all Eight Virtues. Charity, Temperance, Chastity, Patience, Kindness, Diligence, Humility and Justice. This power lets you purify a soul and they will see the light to know what evil things they done. E.g Chastity - The person will embrace moral wholesomeness. Diligence - The Person will have a careful nature and total work ethics.
pros: Can cast all Eight Virtues onto anybody at once.
cons: Nothing bad about this power at all.

name: Exploding Limb Technique
overview: make objects explode when stricken by your limbs.
description: Ability to make objects explode when stricken by your limbs. When striking objects with your hands, feet, legs, knees, elbow, fingers and even your head it sends large amount of kinetic energy through the object in which causes rapid and violent explosion; all depending on how hard you can strike an object. The harder you hit the bigger the explosion. The technique can be used for defensive or offensive use, which takes training.
pros: Able to make objects explode and the ability heightens when in adrenaline rush.
Used as/or for self defense.
Can control the kinetic force either through thought or power of the mind.
cons: When in a emotional state of conflict it can be an unwanted accident waiting to happen.
Debris from explosion can harm you, well depending on what the debris consist of.
Needing extensive training/knowledge on knowing how to focus the energy and use it.

name: Last Man Alive
overview: temporarily become the last person/people on the planet.
description: You can freely enter or exit a parallel dimension where you are the only person(s) on the planet. Anything you do in this other dimension has no effect on the real world. You can bring things to and from this dimension, including bringing people into the dimension. People automatically return if you exit the dimension or die inside it. Wild animals still exist, but pets and anything sentient will not exist in the dimension. You will come back to the original world in the nearest safe spot.
pros: Alone in time.
Can explore areas you could not before.
Can bring things back from the dimension.
cons: Cars, planes, nuclear reactors, etc. will end up crashing without people.
Wild animals may attack.
Cannot trap people inside the dimension

name: Summon Mega Sharke
overview: summon a giant temporal energy monster.
description: If you want this power, you first need to have the Summon Sharke power. Stop reading now and see what that power is and come back to this power. This power summons a sharke with the same abilities and weaknesses as a normal sharke, but it is 60 feet long and able to gulp down an object the size of a tank or take trash dumpster-sized bites out of a bigger object. A mega-sharke, if left unsupervised, will eat the same as 6 normal sharke.
pros: Bigger is better!
They eat tanks in one gulp.
No one will mess with you-if you're crazy enough to keep a few mega-sharke with you.
cons: A 20-foot-long temporal monster is bad enough to have around-you want a 60-foot-long one?

name: Super Acute Hearing
overview: hear a pin drop from 1/2 mile away
description: Your hearing, at will, becomes so acute that you can hear specific conversations across a sports stadium. You can hear a cats footfalls from a block away.You can hear an owl flap his wings from 1/4 mile away. With mastery, allows you to pick up other frequencies too.
pros: You can hear what people are saying about you after you leave the room.
You can hear the tumblers on a safe drop into place.
You will hear people arrive at your door long before they ring the bell.
cons: You can hear what people are saying about you after you leave the room.
You might not like everything tht you hear.
Loud noises can become deafening!

name: Encore
overview: make anyone repeat the same thing over again by clapping your hands.
description: You could compel the foe to keep using only the same move by clapping your hands. You can even use it to call for a brief extra repetition done after the main performance is complete until your opponent gets tired.
pros: A great, but strange use for humiliation.
cons: It'll get much more annoying after a while.

name: Myth Power: Pallas' Passion
overview: channel Pallas command over the essence of warcraft and military campaigns
description: Pallas, in Greek myth, was the Titan god of warcraft; planning and executing combat and military campaigns. As such, channeling him allows one to become a master strategist, by thinking of problems in terms of military conflict. In addition, one can psychically perceive the plans and schemes of others in proximity. Furthermore, one gains skill in every weapon and fighting style in his physical and mental capability. One can even augment or disrupt stats (strength, etc) and physical superpowers.
pros: Become an expert strategist; psychically perceive plots/plans/schemes/strategies of those in radius
Gain skill in every weapon style and martial art (fighting style) in your physical/mental capacity
Augment/disrupt physical stats (strength, speed, reflexes, etc) and physical superpowers, by touch
cons: Cannot augment/disrupt combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction based MythPowers until developed
People with mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory based MythPowers are immune to this ability
People with Unpredictability and MythPower: Ares' Wrath are immune to this ability (no Con Negation)

name: Spam Frame
overview: repeat any action continuously through continous recycling of time frames
description: This ability allows you to have anything repeat itself for as much time as you want. The time that is surrounding anything you touch including you is being continuously copied until you cancel it. Since time is still passing outside you own touch your actions will still add up.
pros: Never run out of bullets, you can keep shooting as long as you are doing the same thing
Can have near infinite wealth or food. Eating 1 grain of rice repeatedly or continuous money deposit
cons: You can only repeat 1 specific action
Others can change their actions but you cannot until you stop

name: Super Squad: X Ray Heat Vision
overview: see through things (not clothes) and see heat.
description: See through things (again not clothes) and see heat. Owned by fictional superhero "Vision".
pros: See through walls.
See heat in complete darkness.
Can see through skin to see diseases.
cons: Can't see through clothes. (To some, it's bad. )
Can't see through mirrors.
The heat you see will be the heat your eyes are.

name: Space Suit
overview: create a space suit that gives the wearer space related powers.
description: The user can create and control a space suit that could be of various designs as long as it matches real world designs of space suits. The wearer of the space suit has access to outer space related powers. The wearer can survive in space indefinitely and can create mini planets, black holes, stars, meteors, and other objects found in outer space. The wearer can also control how gravity affects himself such as the strength and direction of the gravity on himself. Can be remade if original is lost
pros: Have personal space suit that lets you survive in space.
Can create mini versions of objects existing in outer space.
Wearer can control his personal gravity, controlling strenght and direction of gravity on himself.
cons: Have to be wearing the space suit.
If the suit is destroyed or lost then you lose access to the powers.
The objects created will be about the size of a human.

name: Dance!
overview: make people dance uncontrollably
description: With this power you can make anybody dance just by thinking of the person and saying "Dance! " after that the selected person will start dancing uncontrollably until you say "Stop! "
pros: You can make anybody dance
You can cause your enemies to start dancing during a fight
You can make them stop by saying "Stop"
cons: They can still attack you while dancing

name: Eagle Shifting/Attributes
overview: shift into an Eagle and have the attributes
description: The Haast Eagle was the most powerful Eagle ever in the world. This eagle standing was 6ft tall and its wingspan was the size of a small air plane(2. 7m). It had a powerful beak and talons and it was very fast even though it was big like all birds it had amazing vision.  These are the attributes of the Haast Eagle
pros: The user can shift into the actual versions of the Eagle or smaller ones
The user can have the attributes of a haast Eagle
cons: Opponents can see the user clearly in the air even if its the smaller version
The smaller version of the Eagle is 6ft wingspan 3ft height (yikes)

name: Myth Power: Eris' Enmity
overview: channel Eris and the Erites' command over the essence of strife, discord, enmity and social chaos
description: Eris, in Greek myth, was the goddesses of strife and discord; her dual good and bad forms were called the Erites. As such, channeling her allows one to summon Golden Apples of Discord, at will, for subjects to argue and/or fight over. In addition, one may gain physical power in the presence of natural strife. One may even split in two; one copy boosts allies' morale (getting them to feel motivated and competitive, which speeds their healing process); the other causes foes to turn on one another.
pros: Induce, amplify, reduce and negate strife at will; gain physical power from natural strife/discord
Summon Golden Apples of Discord (one at a time) to wreak havoc on foes (or to feed self/others)
Split into two copies; one heals and motivates allies; the other causes foes to turn on each other
cons: Subjects only follow compulsions inscribed on Golden Apples of Discord at the higher levels (NCN)
Subjects only become instigators by eating Golden Apples of Discord at the higher levels (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide power with this ability (NCN)

name: Thought Bubble Pop
overview: see the thought bubbles of others and pop them.
description: Ever heard the saying "an idea blowing up in their face"? That's the idea behind this power. You see people's thought bubbles which you can pop; the bigger the bubble, the bigger the explosion. It might splat into some primordial thought goop all over their faces or unleash the horrors contained within a random thought (such as a giant chicken); if the thought survives the popping of course.
pros: People who think a lot make HUGE explosions
The explosions do damage if great enough
Random thoughts are sometimes awesome if they survive the pop
cons: Bubbles are very very small for people who don't think much at all (obviously)
The "thought-goop" is just messy/nasty. Nothing else than that.
If a thought does survive the popping, some of them suck (giant chicken is arguably one of them)

name: Deathtrap Making
overview: touch any object and turn it into a fatal trap
description: It's self explanatory. When you touch any non-living object, it will flash a silver light, indicating it's been rigged. When another person uses it, it will kill them in some sort of way. For example, a laptop and a door. When a laptop is used, it will violently elecrocute the user to death. When a door is touched, it will powerfully swing open, crushing the user to the wall. Just don't use it on anything you use daily, like your toilet, or a comb.
pros: Create your own house of death
Strategically kill your enemies
Have fun creating creative ways to kill someone
cons: Touching yourself is a bad idea if you're in a relationship.

name: United We Stand
overview: gain super strength when you have friends near you
description: With this power you have super human strength parallel to that of the Incredible Hulk but only when you have at least one of your friends near you
pros: You have incredible strength
cons: You may be putting your friend in danger if you're fighting crime and need your super strength

name: Lich Transformation
overview: turn oneself into a lich when one dies
description: If you have this power you can turn yourself into a lich when you die. A lich (pronounced lik) is someone with power who didn't want to die. Because of this they do some ritual to prevent themselves from dying. They also retain intelligence and have increased magical power. This power takes out the ritual part that most lichs did, but your body has to die for this power to work and it has to be in one piece. You do retain your physical looks but your body will be slowly decaying.
pros: Your magical power increases.
You have intelligence unlike most zombies.
You don't have to do a long magical ritual.
cons: You're undead and you will generally be thought of as evil regardless of whether or not you are.
You have to die.
Your body has to be in one piece.

name: Swiss Army Saber
overview: use it to switch to different blades within it.
description: The swiss army saber is a multi-function pocket sword-hilt; it has an amount of various blades such as broadsword, kriss, katana, scimitar, machete, drakesword, and kirehashi. It is approximately 96 mm (4.6) long.
pros: Can definitely confuse your foes in combat.
cons: None.

name: Origami Manipulation
overview: manipulate origami
description: This strange ability has more uses than most would think. Origami is the anicent art of folding paper into different shapes. With this you can create and control all sorts of origami. So if you create a giant origami dragon, it will follow your mental orders. This ability also grants the power to become origami. When you do this, you will become a life size origami human. You then can become any number of origami shapes and creatures.
pros: Become origami.
Your can create origami weapons and creatures.
All of your creations are under your control
cons: A very strange ability

name: Aaimuzki
overview: gain cactus-like skin and the abilty to rapidly increase and decrease you muscle mass.
description: Based on a yokai, it gives you a cactus like appearance with needles you can throw and enlarge and retract, plus you can greatly increase and decrease your muscles, giving you heightened strength and size.
pros: Heightened strength.
Enlargement and projectile needles.
Rapid regeneration and cactus-like physiology.
cons: Huge appearance changes.
You lose your senses of smell and taste when activated.
Muscles arent high on the superhuman strength scale.

name: Disaster Glove
overview: summon the glove of disaster
description: When you think of the glove it will be placed on your hand. You will have control over all disasters, e.g. earthquakes, birdflu and other epidemics, meteor strikes etc. You will also know when actual disasters (not caused by you) will happen. The only side effect is that you're not immune to any of the disasters (even if caused by you).
pros: Control the element of Disaster
Cause destruction to your enemies
Make people fear you
cons: You could hurt yourself (not immune to effects)

name: Currency Switch
overview: change money from one currency to another currency
description: Euros, yen, dollars, dinars, pesos, seashells, gold-plated latinum, etc. You can change your money into any type of currency that you want whether it is a real currency or a fictional currency, even historical currency from ancient Hawaii or Sumeria. Exchange rate is based on value of the target currency in the original currency. Ex: An ancient coin that is worth say 100 dollars will be exchanged by this power at that rate. Ex: 1 yen is aproximately 1 US cent so that would be the exchange rate.
pros: Time travelers will always have the currency they need.
No fees and no banks required.
cons: No combat value.

name: Cryptobiosis Gold
overview: survive almost anything
description: Cryptobiosis is what some animals go into to survive tough conditions. All their internal mechanisms and organs stop working, leaving the animal 'dead' until the conditions are right for it to wake up. With this power, it is similar: When the conditions aren't right for normal life, your body stops working and becomes a gold statue. Your golden body is indestructible, and you will wake up when your body can survive. But the statue is stiff; you can't move. You are put in "suspended animation".
pros: Survive vacuum,pressure, lack of oxygen, too much/little heat and anything the environment has.
Cryptobiosis Gold form is indestructible.
Wake up when conditions are right, and you don't age.
cons: Can't breathe, think, talk or move when in this form.
When you wake up, your friends/relatives might be dead.
You only survive conditions, not things like poisons, bullets, falling etc.

name: Brain Scramble
overview: randomly switch the brains of people in an area
description: When this power is activated, an aura begins to begins to grow around you. When you choose to release it, everyone within this space, excluding you, will have their brain randomly switched to another body in the area. Basically, lots and lots of chaos. This is useful if a large group is after you. Even better if there are supers within the ranks, being that they will have to get used to new powers before they pursue you. It will have no effect if used on only one person.
pros: Can be used for escape or relaxation
Cannot be undone except by you
With practice, can be extended to cover the entire earth
cons: No control over where the brains go
Trading the brain of a supervillain into the body of a superhero
You are excluded: no switching into a better body

name: Blessing Of Iris
overview: have the Blessing Of Iris
description: Iris is the greek goddess of Rainbows. Her blessing allows you to gain many powers over rainbows and color. You can create and manipulate rainbows as a tangible force, and can use them to communicate. You can also use the essences of the colors. For example, the essence of red is fire. You will be able to camoflage, and manipulate color.
pros: Controling color and rainbows
Using the essences of color
Camoflage
cons: You can't always use rainbows to communicate

name: Hexting
overview: cast dark chaotic spells just by texting.
description: You are able to create and cast an incredible variety of spells by one simple strange thing, texting. However, Hexting is quite necessary for you to cast spells, but which extends to an ability to control the elements including fire, air, earth, liquid, ice, and also create strong invincible force field, transmutation, massive teleportation portals, and among other feats.
pros: Text "fired" to do some fire damage.
You can become a text wizard or witch.
cons: You will get caught.

name: Myth Power: Pontus/Thalassa Pov
overview: channel Pontus and Thalassa's command over the essence of the deep sea and the sea's surface
description: Pontus (Pontos), in Greek myth, was the god of the sea's depths; his wife, Thalassa, was the goddess of the sea's surface. As such, channeling Pontus allows one to swim well and survive underwater. In addition, one may mimic crushing deep-sea pressure with one's hands at will. Channeling Thalassa, one may stand/move on the surface of any body of water like solid ground. Channeling either allows one turn into a form composed of water, and project one's sight to any body of water at will.
pros: Swim well and survive underwater; mimic crushing deep-sea water pressure with one's hands at will
Stand/move on the surface of water like solid ground; immunity to effects of (any) dehydration
Turn into a form composed of water, and project one's sight to/within any body of water at will
cons: Only share Aquatic Adaptation, Deepwater Perception or Water Mimiby touch at the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot teleport self/others to sea bottom/surface or manipulate water by touch until developed (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Morati Spell
overview: destroy evil matter
description: Cast the spell by saying "Morati" (pronounced more-awe-tee"). This will destroy darkness, evil, banish demons, and destroy evil spells.
pros: Hasn't failed me yet
Banish demons
Destroy an opponent's darkness spell
cons: None

name: Dinosaur Control
overview: control dinosaurs.
description: You can fully control any dinosaur you want. But you have to find them first
pros: You can control dinosaurs
Paleontologists would seek you out if they can revive dinosaurs
cons: Dinosaurs don't exist anymore
Need other powers to get/summon/revive dinosaurs

name: Stupipathy.Telepathic Stupidity
overview: make anyone stupid or defenseless through telepathic influence
description: It is the ability to make anyone stupid or defenseless through telepathic influence. Once used by a psychic con-man to make a lot of money and earn a living.
pros: More than normal convincing power to average intelligence people
Near mind control ability through repeated practice
Can be used to oneself as an effective disguise
cons: Cannot be used in battle or life and death situations
Takes a lot of practice and creativity to be useful
Will not make you famous, only affects people at subliminal level

name: Expandable Mind
overview: expand one's mind into the astral plane.
description: This power enables a person to extend their mind into the psychic realm that is the Astral Plane. This allows them to handle and store much more information than normal. It can be used in unison with other powers, like telepathy, to flash memorize vast amounts of data. Also it could allow a clairvoyant to use multiple view points with less disorientation by reducing the mental load on the brain. The downside to this is that your extended mind is open to attacks on the astral plane.
pros: Allows for increased intelligence, memory and mental agility.
Can be used to temporarily store information to complex to normally process.
Works well with other psychic powers.
cons: Leaves one vulnerable to psychic attack on the astral plane.
Makes a very visible "Cloud" of psychic energy on the astral plane.

name: Myth Power: Phales' Philander
overview: channel Phales' command over the essence of the phallus, adultery, rape and pederasty
description: Phales, in Greek myth, was the god of the phallus (male sex organ), adultery, rape, pederasty and other male sexual indecency (like exposing genitalia). As such, channeling him allows one to assume the form of any male humanoid at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with males of any species (and compel females) at will. One may even psychically absorb power (including sexual virility) from males by a touch; this same touch induces sexual pleasure in females.
pros: Assume the form of anymale humanoid at will (regardless of one's true gender)
Psychically perceive and communicate with males (and compel females)
Touch males to absorb power (and enhance male attributes); touch females to induce sexual pleasure
cons: Cannot assume the form of male animals (besides humanoids) until developed (NCN)
Cannot use phallus as divining rod (locating/navigation, detecting lies, etc) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Bacchanalia and MythPower: Baubo's Burlesque provide immunity (NCN)

name: Tetris Shift
overview: turn people into tetris pieces
description: With this power you can turn people into pieces from tetris. You can turn them into any of the pieces but to play the game you're gonna have to throw the people in the air and hope they fall in the right place.
pros: You can turn people into tetris pieces
cons: You cannot play the actual game Tetris with them

name: Normalization Fluid
overview: "cure" superpowers
description: With this power you can inject a serum that "cures" any and all superpowers. In minimum dose this acts like a tranquilizer by causing your body to tense up and combat its own power. In maximum dose this eliminates any and all superpowers of a person. This power is treated as a cure and will never be perceived as a threat by any superpower sense or barrier. The body will not reject this fluid and powers that come in contact directly with the fluid when in the body are negated.
pros: The effects are permanent and powers cannot be regained
This power is never perceived as a threat by superpowers
You can help people who don't want their powers or take power away from supervillains
cons: You have to get within range to inject the fluid
It takes times to circulate within the body and it can be sucked out or slowed down from the heart
Does not take away inherent powers such as natural intelligence or natural training

name: Willpower: State Of Permanence
overview: render one's freewill unaffected by unnatural change.
description: You may not be aware of it but your freewill is the most important force that resides in you. Anything you choose to do or not to do is governed by your freewill. The excercise of freewill for a powerful ability user is important. If he plans to make use of his powers in this physical world his freewill must be free from any constraint. But freewill like any other forces that resides in us can be changed by other enities that dwell outside us. This ability blocks such changes enabling freewill.
pros: Let your freewill remain unchanged even if reality itself yields to such changes.
cons: No offensive use

name: Selective Recall
overview: have memories that are only available when the user decides to access it
description: A person with this power has the power to hide knowledge or memories from himself until a certain time period or until he says a certain code word. This power also allows someone to have more memory than an average person to cope with stored memories. When activated, this power has a sort of pseudoamnesia effect where the person has absolutely no idea what they are doing. However, they can still remember new bits of information while they are in the amnesiac state.
pros: You can hide the truth and lie without any repercussions
You make a great spy-I dont know anything and you would be half right
Forget painful memories unless you needed to recall it
cons: Sudden rush of old information can shock you, you may have switched sides previously, etc.
This only affects your memory so you will still look the same
If the code word is lost or you are killed before the time to recall is possible

name: Bullet Catching V2
overview: cause bullets to fly into your hand and be perfectly ok
description: With this power whenever you're shot at the bullet will instantly fly into your hand and since this power makes your hands impervious to bullets you'll be perfectly fine. However if you're holding something when someone takes a shot at you the bullet will probably destroy whatever you were holding.
pros: Your hands are impervious to bullets
Bullets instantly fly towards your hand when you're shot at
cons: If you're holding something when you're shot at the thing will probably be destroyed

name: Myth Power: Thanatos' Threat
overview: channel Thanatos' command over the essence of peaceful, painless, non-violent death
description: Thanatos (Thanatus), in Greek myth, was the god of peaceful, non-violent, painless death. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive painless death in one's range, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the undead (ghosts/spirits, zombies, etc) of those who died painlessly. Furthermore, by a paralyzing touch, one may induce simultaneous shutdown in all of a subject's organ systems. One can even withstand death/underworld/afterlife-based effects.
pros: Psychically perceive past, present and future non-violent death in one's range at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel undead who died non-violent deaths
Induce instantaneous (painless) death, by touch; withstand necromantic effects
cons: Cannot generate wings to fly until the higher levels
Cannot summon an indestructible scythe (similar to Thanatos' Scythe) until the higher levels (NCN)
Death/underworld/afterlife-based MythPowers (and Immortality) provide immunity (NCN)

name: False Cognition
overview: act under a hypnagogic trance in which no true cognition takes place
description: Also called Psychic Sleepwalking, Hypnagogic/Sleepwalker Automatism or (Psychic) Somnambulance, this ability allows you to undergo a hypnagogic trance, like a psychic autopilot command. This allows the conscious mind to rest, so your body can heal and recover, without having to stop for rest. In this trance, one can respond to one's environment as though still awake (though, whether the eyes are open or not depends on the user).
pros: Get sleep without having to stop (subconscious knows your needs/desires/routines and can direct you)
Immune to mental tampering in the trance state (no true cognition, just impulse and instinct)
If your eyes aren't open in the trance state, your power is often accompanied by a Spatial Sense
cons: If subconscious desires are harmful and take you somewhere you didn't want or need to go
If your eyes aren't open in this state, and you have no Spatial Sense
No dreaming in this state (though this can also be good as it protects you from dream manipulation)

name: Doomsday Energy
overview: harness the power of a doomsday device planted in your body
description: A person with this power has a doomsday device planted in their body. However, their body has adapted to slow down the activation of the device and harness energy contained within the device for superhuman feats. The doomsday device is like a parasite that attaches to a person's heart and nerves. The user is given the ability to either slow down the timer for the device or hasten it and gain power. If the user dies before the device activation, the device recalibrates and looks for another host.
pros: You can instantly vaporize anything you want-and I mean anything
You also gain enhanced strength and speed and the ability to travel and survive in a vaccuum
The timer is actually very long-about a zettayear and it recalibrates to a zettayear each time
cons: If you overuse this ability, you will blow up the universe(no joke)
Stopping the doomsday device will kill you-heart stops and doomsday device will recalibrate anyway
The allure of power-hastening the device gives the user access to more power and abilities

name: Holy Power: The Tormentor
overview: use the powers of The Tormentor, the third Path of Light.
description: With this power you can "activate" the Tormentor mode. You gain a powerful energy kimono and the powers of the Tormentor. While using the tormentor you get Hallucinization, Superhuman Senses and Super Speed Class Omega. You also become able to use all the other Tormentor ability's. To acquire the Tormentor you must send a killer that repented from his crimes to hell, even if he is good now.
pros: Allows you to use all the next Godlike powers of The Tormentor.
Makes you so fast that you become able to reach the light speed.
Allows you to use the Torment Claws, who brings punishment to all the ones who should suffer.
cons: Hard to get, Tormentors are considered black sheep's by the other enlightened.
Need Six Paths of Light.
Another Enlightened can kill you.

name: Amber Eyes
overview: trap people inside your eyes
description: Amber is a fossilized tree resin; some pieces of amber have prehistoric insect trapped inside the sticky sap. With this power, if you stare at someone for a long period of time, their body will be trapped inside your eyes like an insect in amber. They can be trapped there for as long as a month, and during that time, they cannot escape. You can trap a maximum of two people (one for each eye). This comes with a price; it will become slightly harder for you to see clearly.
pros: You can trap your enemies just by staring at them
You can keep them there for a maximum time of one month
They cannot escape their prison
cons: They may try uselessly to escape, causing minor eyestrain
You can ONLY keep them trapped for a month
While someone's trapped, your vision gets slightly less clear

name: Myth Power: Ctesios' Title
overview: channel Ctesios' command over the essence of the house, the home and property
description: Ctesios (Ctesius, Ktesios), in Greek myth, was the god of the house/home and property. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and teleport to one's home at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with members of one's household, as well as psychically compel visitors to one's home, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically fortify one's home as an invulnerable fortress, at will. One can even psychically summon and manipulate one's property, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive and teleport to one's home at will
Psychically perceive and communicate with household members, and compel visitors, at will
Psychically fortify one's home, at will; Psychically summon and manipulate one's property, at will
cons: Cannot apply Pro #1 and Pro #3 to allies and foes, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate one's home (or bend reality within it) at will, until developed (NCN)
Home/family/domestic-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Vocal Sfx
overview: create real effects based on the sounds you make with your mouth and voice.
description: A lot of sound effects can be reproduced with only the mouth and voice, sometimes the body. This power allows you to cause real effects when you produce them. For example, imitating an explosion SFX will cause one; a motorcycle SFX allows you to travel as if you were on a real one; a gunshot or machine gun SFX allows you to fire TK bullets; a ripping SFX can tear fabric. Keep in mind that you don't materialize things, you just make it seems like they are there and can act on their surrounding.
pros: This power is very flexible. You don't have to produce a perfect imitation of a SFX.
One SFX can be used for various effects. A metal impact can pound nails, deflect swords and more.
Since your power isn't "substantial", its effects can't be blocked by conventional means.
cons: You have to learn how to produce sound effects. Just saying "BOOM" or "SCRATCH" won't work.
Only sounds produced with your own body works. For example, recordings don't work.

name: Induced Temporal Pull
overview: perceive things that are not from this time and cause them to be pulled toward the time they left.
description: First, you can perceive the "chronon" particles that people and objects pile up in them during time travels. Second, you can "read" them to know when they come from or from which timeline they originate. Third, you can create a time pull, causing the particles and their host to be attracted to their origin, so, eventually, they will be tossed into their correct time. However, if they somehow manage to resist, their period or timeline will be pulled toward the current one, merging with it.
pros: Send time travellers back to when they come from.
Restore the timeline by sending misplaced objects and people to their correct time.
cons: It probably won't prevent the time travellers from coming back.
If they have the power to resist the time pull, their time will come to them. Very dangerous.

name: Quiescence
overview: internally produce a temporal silence and stillness
description: The user of this ability has a valuable power at his disposal. This ability allows the user to literally phase outside of the realms of time. During this time, the user doesn't have to eat, breathe or sleep, and he is incapable of physical contact with the physical world; he also becomes intangible. However, until the danger passes, the user is also rendered immobile.
pros: Cannot be touched by anything that is bound to the realms of space-time
Don't need to eat, sleep or breathe, and doesn't age (state of "temporal dormancy")
Total quiet for assistance in contemplation (remain aware of environment)
cons: Cannot move (stuck in whatever pose you take before ability activates)
Can still be touched by time-defiers, chronokinetics, and "nonexistents"
The user can use this ability at will, but it is SUBCONSCIOUSLY activated upon sensing danger

name: Arcana: 7 The Chariot
overview: passively telekinetically demolish any and all obstacles.
description: This power is difficult to control. It automatically attempts to destroy anything you view as an "obstacle". It'll smash walls, send people flying, and flatten cars. Anything that gets in your way is going to be at least damaged, if not destroyed outright. This power only works if you have a particular goal in mind, and something is getting in the way of it. Non-physical things that get in your way will make this power demolish things in the general area. The key to this power is control.
pros: At times, you can be about as easy to stop as the Juggernaut.
You can go from point A to point B and heaven help what gets in your way.
Gains power with emotions.
cons: Without control you'll LITERALLY leave a trail of destruction behind you.
A non-physical obstacle will make this power go berserk and destroy everything in the general area.

name: Hair Arrows
overview: fire one's hair off like arrows
description: The hair that is fired off will be stiff and straight. It will be fired off in a straight line from where it was on your head.
pros: Always have a way to defend yourself.
cons: Hair is only stiff when fired. May be a pro.
It will hurt to fire off your hair. Equivalent to getting the hair plucked from your head.

name: Reversed Fire
overview: make a fire grow fiercer when it should weaken.
description: To start a fire, you need an oxidizing agent (mainly oxygen), a combustible and an activation energy (usually heat). Remove any of these three components and the fire will weaken and die out. However, a reversed fire becomes more intense when it doesn't have enough of these, reaching its strongest peak when one is completely removed before suddenly dying out. While the fire will still disappear, it has the potential to start another one due to the intense flmaes and heat it produces.
pros: Extinction methods based solely on cooling down the heat won't work as the fire is self-sustained.
Other extinction methods may work, but they will usually make the fire stronger or start new ones.
Good if you have pyrokinetic powers AND a fireproof body.
cons: The reversed fire still needs fuel and oxygen, or it will die out.
As it grows stronger, the fire consumes fuel and oxygen more quickly.
Most of the time, a reversed fire grows uncontrollable, even more than normal fire.

name: Purple Flames
overview: create and control purple flames that are more harmful to those who are virtuous
description: These purple-colored flames can burn like normal flames, but will be more harmful to those who lead a virtuous life. Those who are pure evil most likely will not be harmed by these flames.
pros: The flames will probably creep your enemies out.
cons: The flames hurt those who are good more.
Users of this power will most likely be evil.

name: Radioactive Burn: Outbreak
overview: pass on the radioactive burn as a virus.
description: You must read "Radioactive Burn" to understand this ability. When active, you can pass the radioactive burn as a disease, therefore resulting in an epidemic. Those with the virus will gain the same abilities as the carrier, but less in power, strength, endurance, and intelligence. When the "burn" is passed on, the victim's flesh will bubble like tar and metamorphose into a monstrosity. The victim is incapable of reverting back to their original form and however obeys your commands.
pros: Create an army of superpowered monsters.
You are capable of acting as a vaccine for victims of the virus.
This ability works on any living organism, including plants and insects.
cons: None really.

name: Demon Summon
overview: summon demons from hell
description: This gives you the power to summon evil, twisted demons that will do anything no matter how big the sin because they're from hell. The more demons you summon and the worse the sins get the more evil, insane and twisted you become.
pros: Have demon slaves.
Will do anything you say.
Never turn on you.
cons: You become evil and twisted.
Could become insane.
5% of damage demons take, you absorb.

name: Equator
overview: equate anything to anything else, and everyone will simply assume it makes sense
description: With this power, any time that you compare two or more things, everyone around you will agree, even if it makes no sense at all. For example, you could say, "Sedimentary rocks are just like my lungs when I breathe in," and everyone would just nod in agreement. Or, say, your friend tells you their father just died, and you say, "I know how you feel, I dropped a nickel the other day," and they think you understand their plight perfectly.
pros: Everyone will believe you so long as you make a comparison.
No more arguments about your stupid metaphors or ridiculous allegories.
Imagine haggling with somebody about the value of things...
cons: Only works when comparing two or more things, no flat out lies.
Not all that useful against any opponents.
Anybody who can negate this power may inform people that you don't actually make sense.

name: Evil Impulse
overview: gather energy from evil and use it in an attack.
description: When the user places their hand against the victim's chest, they can suck out all the evil and release that in the form of an energy beam. Once mastered, you can amplify their evil until it becomes too much to handle. This will cause the victim to explode.
pros: You can easily defeat super villains.
Every living being has even a little bit of evil in them.
cons: This power recoils every time it is used.
You can accidentally use this power against yourself.

name: Blessing Of Hestia
overview: have the Blessing of Hestia
description: Hestia is the Greek goddess of home and family. A being with her blessing has many gifts. For one, they always have a home, temporary or permenant. Meaning they always will have someplace to stay, rest and eat. Also whenevery they're at home, any injuries they have will heal rapidly and they will start to regain their energy. And when at home, they can conjure food for themselves and visitors. The user can also induce loving family like feelings in anyone they have eye-contact with.
pros: Always having a home.
Healing and food conjuring
Good family-like feelings
cons: Can only conjure so much food.
Can't control where your homes will be(they will always be nearby, though)

name: Skill: Ultimate Feint Strike
overview: perform an ultimate feint attack
description: You will perform a feint strike with any weapon that your opponent will always go to block, making it easier to win fights
pros: You can always feint your opponent in a fight
It will make you a great fighter/soldier
cons: There really isn't one

name: Side Effect
overview: give anyone a side effect!
description: ever wanted to give some one a side effect you see on cans of stuff and that sort? now you can and you make up your own like explosive diarrhea!
pros: enemy:come on!..."ploop" yes!..."BOOM!"
you'll have a lot of fun
cons: can't make death a side effect  but still can make stuff like explosive diarrhea

name: Container Fill
overview: have any container you open be filled with what it was meant to hold.
description: With this power, any time you open a container, it is instantly filled with what it was meant to contain, no matter how many times it was previously emptied.  So, Gun Cabinets will always be filled with firearms, and picnic baskets always filled with food.
pros: Never go hungry or thirsty with lunch pails and water bottles.
Never run out of ammo
Always have everything you need
cons: Container must be closable and sealable (no cups or plates).
Might not get what you like (Gun cabinets might be filled with Muskets...)
Only works if you open the container

name: Shrinking
overview: shrink someone to centimeter sizes.
description: The power to shrink someone to tiny sizes, making them easy to fight or unseeable.
pros: You can shrink your enemies so they cannot keep up with you.
They are weaker in a fight.
cons: You can't see them.
Their powers still work to their limits so they can do anything they could before.

name: Tornado Fingers
overview: turn your fingers into mini tornados
description: Your fingers can become mini tornadoes when you start to twirl them. The tornadoes will be twirling in the direction that your fingers are pointed. The power can only be activated when you twirl that finger that you want to use to become a tornado.
pros: You can pick people up and spin them around when you point at them.
You can pull people or objects toward you when you want something.
You can float in the air when you point your fingers at the ground.
cons: You could get finger cramps if you use the power for a very long time.

name: Myth Power: Themis' Decree
overview: channel Themis' command over the essence of divine law and order
description: Themis, in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of divine law and order; traditions of good conduct, and other divine decrees, as passed down by the gods. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive the laws, customs and traditions of any land at will; in addition, one can sense defiance of said law (true crimes and immoral acts). Furthermore, one can compel subjects to do anything in their physical/mental capacity, as long as it is legal. One can even receive and bestow divine oracular insight.
pros: Perceive the essence of law and order (laws/customs/traditions) and defiances of law
Psychically compel people to do anything in mental/physical capacity, as long as it isn't illegal
Receive (at will) and bestow (by touch, word or thought) divine oracular revelations
cons: Cannot enhance or disrupt/negate law/order/justice based MythPowers until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot erase illegal/unlawful thoughts from others' minds by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provides immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Tychon's Hand
overview: channel Tychon's power over the forces opportunity, chance and accident
description: Tychon (Tykhon), in Greek myth, was the god of opportunity, chance and accident. As such, channeling him gifts one with the ability to perceive, manipulate and benefit from the same. This means one becomes a genius at calculating and understanding probability; one can tell when the "right time" is to make any move; one can tell when a decision is a good or bad idea; and if they allow their intuition to lead them, they will find fortune constantly.
pros: Your feelings can lead you to the right decisions making you seem almost psychic
Become a genius at stochastic sabotage (tossing a rock out a window leads to your foe's murder)
Tell if an idea is a good one or not
cons: Cannot apply powers from Pro #3 to oneself until the HIGHEST levels (no Con Negation)
People with probability/chance/luck based MythPowers and Unpredictability are immune to this ability
People with Luck Reversal can disrupt this ability, until it is developed

name: Human Bomb
overview: produce plastic explosives from your body
description: You can seep out of your body chemical compounds that make plastic explosives. Your body is can revert from normal to C4 by holding your breath. You regrow any plastic you cut off to make your explosion but only in C4 mode. So if you use a your whole arm, you have to hold your breath for that long till it grows back which could take a few minutes. Have to supply own firing pins & timer. If you are shot or contact with fire while as C4, huge explosion & unlikely you survive.
pros: Create bombs from your body
Can regrow limbs but only as C4 body
cons: Have to supply your own detonating devices
Have to hold breath in order to become plastic explosive & regrow parts of body used
If damaged while in C4 mode, you'll die as you make a huge explosion

name: Think Outside The Box
overview: materialize an invulnerable box that makes anyone inside it think of what's outside.
description: A person with this ability has the power of materializing a box that is impervious to physical damage and has a strange effect of making anyone inside it only think and perceive things which are not inside the box.
pros: The user is exempted from the effects of the box.
Telekinesis, Mind reading, Precognition, Perception Power and other Mind powers are also affected.
It comes in many different colors and sizes!
cons: When everybody else is outside the box.
If you are outside the box.
It is just a box.

name: Sleeper Moths
overview: release tiny moths that instantly put your opponents to sleep.
description: The oddest way to put people to sleep is by releasing a bunch of small magical moths. They even have unusual features that have sleeping power inside of them.
pros: A total good chance of sneaking around enemy headquaters while they are sleeping.
cons: None.

name: Instant Counting
overview: instantly know the number of jelly beans or other things you see
description: Also known as Number Sense, a person with this power can instantly tell the number of objects there are with just a short glance. In non-combat, you can win contests and impress people -- however this can be used to keep track of how many people there are facing you (so you don't let one get away). It's also useful in scouting missions.
pros: Always win Jelly Bean counting contests
Excellent recon
cons: None

name: Figure Inhabitation
overview: enter a statue or other representation of a person
description: When you wish to get away from someone, or appear someone you're not, you may enter a statue of a person. For example, say you are in a waxworks, you could enter one of the waxwork models and move around as that person. But, your own body will be left behind as a statue.
pros: Become a famous person, like Daniel Craig, and lap up the praise.
Hide from anyone, almost anywhere.
Works even with paintings
cons: Your body will be left behind as a staue, and could be taken away or broken
Must look human to work, no animals
Trying to enter half a waxwork or statue will result in death

name: Demonic Transformation
overview: transform into a demon
description: You can transform yourself and others into demons. The form's power and looks are based on how much damage to other people's life they have done directlly or indirectly. The demonic forms are different for each person and their nature will change to fit their form. Gender change is not possible.
pros: Can transform people into demons.
It's not karma-based so works on that healer who healed a killer on accident (might be con).
Demonic forms are all different.
cons: Transformation can be 'undone' by temporarily transforming back into their original form.
Doesn't work on demons or part demons since they are already demons.
Transformation is basically permanent.

name: Flaming Serpent
overview: fire a flaming projectile in a shape of a flying snake.
description: You can let out a 19-inch fiery flying snake from the palm of your hands that will burn and stun your opponent.
pros: Fire
cons: Water

name: Vampirism: Adrenal
overview: gain sustenance and power from the adrenaline of others
description: Also called Adrenal Absorption or Stamina Absorption, this is the ability to absorb the literal stamina (vigor or energy) of a subject, and convert it into sustenance and energy for one's own personal use; temporarily gain a boost of strength, temporarily gain a boost of speed, or go longer at your normal pace; even resist the urge to eat or sleep for a while (as such, this power is especially helpful on a hyper foe, or a foe with an adrenaline rush)
pros: Take away the stamina of your foe, making them temporarily VERY tired
Taking their stamina also delays having to eat or rest
Foes with Superhuman Stamina, Superhuman Speed, Superhuman Strength, Berserker Rage, etc.
cons: Doesn't absorb foes' life-force (only tires them, doesn't age them)
Sometimes it requires an actual bite like a true vampire
If you can't control it, friends and family won't want to be around you

name: You're Fireproof
overview: turn people fireproof
description: With this power you can turn people fireproof. They won't be able to become burned or feel hot from fire and they can even walk through it. Their clothes and other items however can still be burned. You cannot however make yourself fireproof.
pros: You can make people fireproof
cons: You cannot make yourself fireproof
You cannot make items fireproof

name: Vampire Control
overview: control vampires
description: With this power you can control vampires. You can make them fight battles for you or bite people and turn them into vampires to increase your army of mind controlled vampires.
pros: You can control vampires.
You can make them bite other people turning them into vampires to increase your vampire army.
cons: They can only fight at night or in dark places.
They can be defeated by garlic.

name: Shadow Immunity
overview: be immune to shadow-based powers affecting one directly
description: Powers that would directly affect your shadow will no longer affect it. EG. Shadow Obliteration or Shadow Manipulation if it is used on your shadow.
pros: You can't be erased from existence by Shadow Obliteration anymore.
cons: They can still affect shadows in the environment to indirectly affect you.

name: Myth Power: Panacea's Patience
overview: channel Panacea's command over the essence of cures, remedies, antidotes and panaceas
description: Panacea (Panaceia, Panakea, Panakeia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of cures, remedies, antidotes and panaceas. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive how to mix cures, remedies, antidotes and antivenin at will (ingredients, where to find them and how to prepare them). Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with the ill and injured. One can even psychically transfer healing abilities, by touch, to and from oneself and others, at will.
pros: Psychically access knowledge and skill in finding and preparing any cure/remedy/antidote/antivenin
Psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with those in need of healing
Psychically transfer regeneration/healing abilities to/from oneself/others, by touch
cons: Cannot cure harm (illness and injury) of  self at will (others by touch), until developed (NCN)
Cannot turn medicines to/from poisons and other dangerous substances, at will, until developed (NCN)
Medical/healing/restorative MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Ent Summon
overview: summon an army of Ents
description: With this power you can summon up to ten Ents. The Ents under your complete control and they are super smart, super strong and if they get angry enough even the sound of their voices will cause great destruction. You can have the Ents for as long as you want and then send them back when you're done with them.
pros: You can summon up to ten Ents
They are under your complete control
cons: They can be killed

name: Myth Power: Hesychia's Hush
overview: channel Hesychia's command over the essence of quiet, rest, silence and stillness
description: Hesychia (Hesykhia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of quiet, rest and tranquility. As such, channeling her allows one to calm subjects with a touch, a word or a thought; this even works on Berserker Rage, and similar angered/frenzied mental states. In addition, with prolonged contact, one can even lull a subject into peaceful sleep. The user may even manipulate probability to prevent any events that disrupt the user (or subjects) from restful ease, quiet relaxation and peaceful harmony.
pros: Induce calm and tranquility in any subject (including oneself); quell Berserker Rage, and the like
If contact is prolonged, subjects can even be lulled into peaceful slumber
Manipulate probability to prevent disruption of peace, tranquility and rest
cons: Cannot PREVENT Berserker Rage or other angry mental states until the higher levels (NCN)
Only psychically induce temporal/molecular stasis (stillness) in matter at the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Dike's Decision provides immunity (NCN)

name: Avenger Summon
overview: summon any character who's ever been a part of the Avengers
description: With this power you can summon any character that has been or currently is apart of the Avengers. This includes the comic books, the TV shows and the Avengers movie. The Avengers are not under your control but they may decide to help you depending on what you want them to help you with.
pros: You can summon any Avenger
They don't have to currently be an Avenger for you to summon them
cons: They have to be alive when you use this power
They are not under your control

name: Pearl Effect
overview: generate a pearl like substance from the skin.
description: Calcium carbonate is secreted from the skin and is fashioned to any form desired ex. (sword, shield, mimicry of other objects, etc). Can create layers of calcium carbonate to make you skin tougher.
pros: Denser than normal pearls.
Can be useful in different kinds of situations ex. (duplication of keys, etc.
If the user is creative, he/she can use this power to it's maximum potential.
cons: It breaks if to mush pressure is applied.
Secretion of calcium carbonate is not as fast as most abilities.
Gets heavy if to much layers are created.

name: Boulder Rain
overview: make giant boulders fall from the sky
description: With this power you can make giant boulders fall from the sky wherever or whenever you want. The boulders are roughly the size of a minivan and completely round in shape so once they hit the ground they start to roll causing more damage.
pros: You can cause giant boulders to fall from the sky wherever and whenever you want
The boulders are round so they will role once they hit the ground
cons: You might damage innocent people or things

name: Messy Minions
overview: create helpful sentient minions from ash, dirt, dust or soot.
description: You can create a number of useful organisms in any shape or form to do your bidding. They are fully aware and need no controlling but do require orders.
pros: You can have small tasks done without worrying about it.
You can spy on people without them realizing.
You can basically make your minions anywhere.
cons: They are made of dust or dirt, they don't stand well in a fight.
They can't speak, so keep questions to yes or no.
They are dirty.

name: Reincarnation Detection
overview: sense and repel reincarnation applying to your offspring.
description: When a parent-to-be has this power, they will sense the being to inhabit their child's body when developed. It starts even before conception. If they know of the soul to be born as their child, they are able to eject it and allow another to take its place. They share these senses with the other parent.
pros: Prevent someone with Reincarnation Determination inheriting your powers against you will.
Know the personality your child will have,
Your knowledge will be shared with your partner, whether they have powers or not.
cons: If you aren't familiar with the new being, they may take you by surprise.
Only works on biological children.
No use if you aren't interested in having children.

name: Car Chase
overview: match the speed of any car/truck that your are pursuing
description: With this power you will be able to go at the same exact speed of the car or truck that you are pursuing (providing that you yourself are in a car or a truck). You will only be able to match the speed the vehicle is currently moving at when you use the power not its potential speed. You don't even need gasoline in your car for this power to work.
pros: You will be able to match the speed of any car or truck that you chasing
You can come in second place in any competitive car race
No gasoline required
cons: Not much use in physical combat
You cannot use this power on bikes, planes, tanks, boats, helicopters, motorcycles, skates, scooters
You need to be in a car or truck for this power to work

name: Transformers: Omega Supreme
overview: cause a tank gun to sprout from your head
description: With this power you can cause a high powered tank gun to sprout from your head. When you use this power your entire head becomes metal as well. The gun can shoot any type of ammo you want and can move to any spot on your head. A side effect of this power causes you talk like Omega Supreme (Speech patterns: Omega Supreme).
pros: You can cause a tank gun to sprout from your head
Your entire head becomes metal (this does not hamper your breathing, sight, smelling or anything els
cons: You talk like Omega Supreme when you use this power

name: Thirteen Treasures: Mantle
overview: wear the Mantle of King Arthur
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. This mantle grants the bearer invisibility from all eyes, while still allowing the wearer to view all others.
pros: If you so wish, you can pretend to be Harry Potter.
cons: The books in the restricted section of Hogwarts will still scream when you open them.

name: Healer 5: Genetic Purification
overview: remove genetic disorders from unborn children and establish a link.
description: With this power, you project a field with a diameter of 25 kilometers around yourself. When an unborn child is within this range, all genetic disorders or at least the negative aspects are removed. As a side effect, you establish genetic-based telepathic link with them you can use for things like communication, spirit transference/reincarnation (with powers) and sharing senses. This power can be switched off at will and the range of the ability increases at one meter each year.
pros: Range of 25 kilometers, increase by one meter each year of possession. Can be turned off at will.
Instant and permanent.
You gain a telepathic link which can be used by other powers for even more purposes.
cons: You will need another power to cure genetic disorders in anyone else.
Limited range.
Unlike other healing powers, this cannot heal wounds or other ailments.

name: Ace In The Hole
overview: deliver one decisive blow.
description: This allows for the user to deliver a perfect strike against any opponent. The strike will bypass all of the enemies defenses and is essentially a one hit knockout.
pros: Thrown objects can count as the strike.
cons: Activates randomly 5 minutes into any fight
Can only be used in a fight.
Decisive blow can only be through the hands.

name: Attack Trailer
overview: leave behind a trail after you attack that hurts anything that comes into contact with it.
description: This power causes you to leave behind a glowing "trail" every time you attack, which follows the path of your attack perfectly and hangs in the air until dismissed by the user. Anything that touches the line will suffer the effect of the attack on whatever part of it touched the trail. For example, if you were to shoot a gun the bullets would leave behind grey trails following the path of the bullet. Were someone to touch one of these trails with their hand, they would be "shot" in the hand.
pros: Pin your enemies in.
Leaves traps hanging in the air.
Trails are all different colors so you can identify them.
cons: Someone with armor could pass through the trails unharmed depending on how you attacked.
You are not immune, touching the trails will hurt you as well.

name: "Delete This" Mimicry
overview: have all the "delete this" powers from the Superpower list
description: A person with this power has all the powers that say delete this in their title. Wait a minute if you have this power doesn't this power make it so you have this power? Infinite loop!!!
pros: Have a lot of powers
Can use multiple powers at once and can choose to not use the powers you don't like
cons: If the powers are actually deleted you lose them forever
Crazy ass drivers

name: Witch Species: Fair Folk
overview: have all of the powers of the fair folk
description: The fair folk could do many things including teleportation, creating illusions, and thousands of other magical abilities. Originally called faeries these beings are some or the most powerful, albeit odd looking witch species around
pros: You are probably the most powerful thing out there
You are the king (or queen) of practical jokes
You get to travel between this world and the true world of magic
cons: Your, oh about anywhere from three inches to about 3 feet tall

name: Glass Shard Golem
overview: become a golem made of fast moving, sharp glass shards
description: This ability allows you to become a human sized golem made entirely of quick moving glass shards. Because the glass that composes your body is in constant motion you cut and slice everything that touches you. You become a walking storm of destruction.
pros: Great for defense from most melee weapons
Great for hand to hand combat
You can change back to human at any time
cons: Cuts everything that touches you

name: Attachable Abilities
overview: equip items to your abilities in order to change their effects.
description: The user has the power attach items to the very essence of their abilities to change how they work. Example: If a person has the ability to shoot fire bullets, then the user attaches a cup to his ability's essence. The ability goes through the cup like a medium. The ability is alter to match the medium. Since a bullet is smaller than the hole of the cup, the ability changes. Thus, the fire bullet gets bigger to match the cups hole. Through the cup, the ability is converted into a fire cannon.
pros: Modify abilities
Make them have new effects
cons: Items may be attached for longer periods of time than needed
Items can make new effects unpredictable

name: Induce Migraine
overview: cause extremely painful migraines in an enemy.
description: The user is able to cause an extremely painful migraine in an enemy. Low level users can only induce the migraine to one enemy, but a high level user can induce extremely painful migraines to a room full of people. A powerful enough user can incapacitate an enemy with this power
pros: Good to stop either criminals or law enforcement
Can incapacitate an enemy
cons: Might not be able to effect someone that has strong mental blocking powers

name: Nightmare Fuel
overview: bring people's nightmares into reality
description: This ability allows the user to, in essence, place a mine in a person that will bring their nightmare to life the next time they have one. Individuals observing the subject with spy based powers are also affected.
pros: No contact necessary.
Can be used through spy based powers.
Lucid dreamers with this power can create their own monsters consciously.
cons: Only works once before having to be reapplied.
The user ALWAYS has the "mine" in them.
You have to wait and hope the afflicted has a nightmare.

name: Xl
overview: make anything into an extra large version of itself
description: With this power you can turn anything into a version of itself that is ten times larger than the original object. Anything, food, clothing, animals, even people (although this is probably not healthy). You cannot however reverse the effects of this power.
pros: Make things ten times larger
cons: Can't reverse the effects of this power

name: Summoning To Shapeshifting
overview: change a summoning power into a shapeshifting power.
description: With this power you can change any summoning power that you have in your arsenal into an ability to shape shift into whatever it was that you were able to summon.
pros: You can change your summoning powers into shape shifting powers.
cons: You cannot reverse the effects of this power.

name: Pantheon
overview: split yourself into several different beings each representing one aspect of your personality
description: With this power you can split yourself into several different people each representing one aspect of your personality. You can create as many extra people as you want but as you go on the personality aspects that they represent will become more obscure (oh the one that constantly picks his nose, the one known for having red hair, the one that watches Sherlock twenty four hours a day every day).
pros: You can split yourself into several different beings
You can reabsorb them whenever you want
cons: They're not under your control
The more you make the less obscure they get

name: Point Zero
overview: activate Point Zero.
description: Zero point is the lowest possible energy, sometimes referred to as vacuum energy. Once this is activated, an area surrounding your body, its size depending on the user, creates a void. Any energy or powers entering this field are nullified, and absorbed into the user's body. This field sucks the energy and life of even humans that pass into it. This is a last resort ability, and usually results in the user's death.
pros: Ultimate defense and offense.
Nothing can pass the field without dying.
cons: Causes the user to die.
Can't move while using it.

name: Fusion Dance!
overview: merge two bodies together into a single, superior entity.
description: A more universal fusion dance, of the sorts. Where two beings, of any race, shape and size, can align their energy signatures and combine them by performing a mode of body movements. The result of the dance is that of one individual, standing in an aura of electricity and force, whose level of power has been heightened several-fold, and who possesses mixed physical and mental traits of both fusees. Life across the multiverse would never see this coming.
pros: Create an awesome, super-cool name for the fusees; like, Matalex (Matt + Alex).
Become the most powerful being in existence with knowledge of martial arts.
Destroy anyone who threatens to destroy you or the Earth, or take over the Galaxy!
cons: Users must know how to and perform the dance without flaw.
The new body may be difficult to handle, and might harbor intolerable mannerisms.
The fusion lasts just about 30 minutes -- sucks!

name: Word Cracker
overview: understand, disrupt and cancel language-based superpowers and magic.
description: This power gives you strong knowledge of supernatural linguistics that you can apply to understand how a language-based supernatural effect works. You can then dismantle and rearrange it to produce a different effect, or destroy it. It works with any language. Written, oral or even sign. Human or non-human.
pros: You can counter any magical spell, word-based power, name-based power, number-based power,...
You can change the intended effect of these powers, though the results may be unexpected.
cons: Though you can understand how language-based powers work, you cannot use this power to copy one.
It may take time to fully decrypt and analyze a language-based effect, depending on its complexity.

name: Quartz Form
overview: turn into a mobile golem made of Quartz
description:
By activating this ability you transform into a golem made of quartz. This form gives you superstrength, increased endurance, and increased defense. Being made of quartz also gives you the added ability of being immune to any energy, beam or light based attack with the quartz deflecting and dissapating it. 

Even after being destroyed while in quartz form you can regenerate by all your pieces reforming.
pros: Increased Strength, Endurance and Defense
Immune to light based attacks
cons: Quartz is more brittle than you think
Being made of quartz doesn't exactly make you very threatening

name: Bane To The Piggy's Existence
overview: inhale objects and spit out the elements those objects are made of.
description: Have you ever wondered what something was made of? Well be glad you found this power! Bane to the Piggy's Existence is the ability to inhale anything (doesn't matter how big or small) and spit out everything it is comprised of in its original state. For example, if you inhale a table you will spit out a full grown tree and some metal! Now doesn't that make you want to huff and puff!
pros: Really helpful if you are in need of a specific material.
Since the objects shrink going in and coming out it doesn't matter how big your mouth is.
Also really useful for combat purposes. Inhale something on fire and you'll be spitting fireballs.
cons: Obviously, it doesn't work if your mouth is covered.

name: Quoth The Raven, Nevermore
overview: summon the otherworldly raven to your side
description: With this ability, you can summon to your side the Raven himself. A shadowy, spectral bird, he goes by Nevermore, and will only answer to that name. He can speak, and will happily carry out any task that you ask of him (in the bird's capability), including spying and revealing cryptic knowledge. He is immortal, and can return from being banished or "killed" at will, so once you summon him, he's there to stay (although, he doesn't eat, sleep or breathe, so he doesn't require much care).
pros: It can speak, and will gladly follow orders, including spying and giving cryptic knowledge
It can speak with other birds (AND read their minds and emotions) and rally them to fight
It is immortal (can regenerate, and return from death or banishment at will)
cons: He's a smart-alec, so sometimes he may choose not to answer, or answer sarcastically
He doesn't eat, or breathe, but he also doesn't sleep (and he won't leave unless HE wants to)
His knowledge is often cryptic (yes or no questions get you a croaking "NEVERMORE" as a response)

name: Enhancement: Flaming
overview: make a power's physical part surrounded with flames by attaching this power to it
description: This is a support and does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it makes the physical part of the power surrounded with flames. The fire will go out if it is separated from the power's physical part AND it has no fuel. If stolen, this power permanently effects the other power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
pros: Flaming powers. Flaming Hair Blades! Don't ask how that works.
You can change the heat of the flames with training.
This plus fire immunity equals RAMPAGE!!
cons: Useless without another power.
Enemy with fire immunity.
Might be useless flaming or might not want the power to be flaming.

name: Usurpation: Angel
overview: temporarily usurp all powers of a single angelic entity.
description:
This power allows you to temporarily usurp all powers of a single angelic entity, leaving it completely powerless in the process. Your appearance will change to reflect the angel whose powers you have usurped (i. E. : white wings, clothing or other symbolic changes). 
You gain their powers at exactly the same level of the original angel. Line of sight is required, otherwise you will gain the powers of a random angel who could be anywhere at the moment. You have no knowledge when Usurpation ends.
pros: Become an angel and use their divine abilities
Knowledge what you can and can't do with "your" powers
Angels won't mind you borrowing their powers to fight evil
cons: If you use the usurped powers for evil, angels might want to destroy you
Demons will see you as enemy, or try to recruit you as weapon against angels

name: Metallic Hair Alloy
overview: create a titanium metal from your hair
description: The user is able to create a heavy duty sturdy titanium metal from their hair. This is telekinetic, so no words or spells needed. Think it and you can do it. When used as a weapon, the hair forms to the place you want it the most, i.e. if you wanted a sword, the hair would curl around your arms and form a sword. Same thing with a gun that shoots metal bullets. Limitation: You cannot create massive things, such as buildings or houses. If you have any questions, contact me for better explanation.
pros: Guns have unlimited ammo since you have thousands of hairs per square inch on your head
The metal that is created is virtually indestructible
Can create a one-manned machine of any sort. Color depends on hair color
cons: If the hair gets wet, the titanium alloy rusts and becomes weak
If, for any reason, your hair breaks off or the metal is breaking, you lose your regular hair

name: Shadow Lugia
overview: transform at will into the 'shadow' form of Lugia with near-limitless power
description: At will, you can become the 'Shadow' form of the Pokemon Lugia. You can communicate with telepathy and also control other's perceptions of reality, implant/erase thoughts, and also read and control minds, all exactly like Matt Parkman. You also have extremely powerful regenerative capabilities, and can heal others regardless of injury or ailment severity. You also have hydrokinesis like Percy Jackson from 'The Lightning Thief', and vector telekinesis like Sylar from 'Heroes'.
pros: This is a very versatile, and cool, power to have!
Both your hydrokinesis, and the Lugia's song, can heal and strengthen both yourself and others
Your greatest weapon is your mind and despite being a Shadow Lugia, you are not evil!!
cons: Harnessing your powers will take time
Psychic static from your telepathy can give you headaches when learning to control the power

name: Sacrifice Adaption
overview: adapt to most things at the expense of a sacrifice
description: With this power you can adapt to most (not all) things. Like if you were hit with a flame, you would become fireproof, but that fireproof power would come at a cost. You could lose things ranging vaulable items to loved ones.
pros: Adapt.
You can choose to use this power, so if you can choose if the sacrifice is worth it.
You know the sacrifice beforehand.
cons: You are not able to adapt to everything (if you are at the HIGHEST LEVELS it may be possible)
Some adaptions may be useful, but require a very important sacrifice.

name: Drill Teeth
overview: turn your teeth into miniature drills
description: With this power, you can turn your teeth into miniature drills. The drills can drill through almost anything, except for teeth and other drills. You can turn any amount of your teeth into drills and turn them back whenever you want.
pros: You can turn your teeth into drills that can drill through almost anything.
You can turn any amount of your teeth into drills.
You can turn them back to normal teeth whenever you want.
cons: You can't drill through teeth or other drills.

name: Enhancement: Unblockable
overview: make a non-damaging power unblockable
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power ignore all barriers. This power can only be attached to powers that do no harm to the target. Ex: works on "Mind Reading" but not "Mind Control". This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced so long as the power does no harm to any being.
pros: Harmless powers unblockable.
Scanning powers don't have to worry about walls or barriers that are in the way
cons: Useless without another power.
Only usable on harmless powers.
Con negation and similar powers have no effect. No altering in RPs or discussions to get rid of cons

name: Quivering Palm
overview: send potentially fatal vibrations into another one's body.
description: When making a successful strike against a target, the user of this power can send vibrations into the targets body. Once the vibrations are in the targets body, the user can simply will the target to die at any point within a period of a few days. The target can resist the attack, but it is very unlikely. After a few days, or if the target resists your attempt to kill him, all current vibrations in the body would be gone. Can be used on multiple targets.
pros: If attack is succesful, you can instantly kill harder foes.
