Threaten people to do what you want during the period the vibrations are in their body.
Can be used repeatedly to refresh the vibrations in the target's body.
cons: Requires landing a succesful blow on opponent.
Vibrations only last a certain period of time.
Target can resist the killing attack if they are exceptionally skilled.

name: Evil Manipulation
overview: manipulate evil.
description: By manipulating evil you could force someone to do an evil deed,make him steal or kill for you,but once you turned him evil,you cant turn him back to normal.
pros: Make the president steal a nuclear bomb for you.
Make a serial killer strike again.
cons: You cant turn back the chosen person back to normal.
A strong willed person can resist.

name: Erythrocyte Mimicry
overview: absorb and release various gases, mainly oxygen (O2) and carbon dioxide.
description: This power is always active. It changes the chemical composition of your body so it automatically absorbs dioxygen and carbon dioxide. Your body can absorb up to 40 times its volume and can use the absorbed oxygen to breathe. Your skin also becomes red in the process. To release the absorbed gas from a part of your body, you must flex or press that area. However, your body can also absorb other substances more easily, such as carbon monoxide, nitric oxide, or cyanide to the detriment of oxygen.
pros: Your body can contain much more oxygen and carbon dioxide at the same time.
The absorbed oxygen acts as a personal oxygen tank.
You can contain a lot of gases!
cons: This power is always active. You can only turn it off through the use of other powers.
You could kill many people and animals by anoxia the first time this power is activated.
Carbon monoxide is nearly impossible to release and they take the place of oxygen.

name: Calcium Fist Breaker
overview: have someone's fist turn hollow and break when it's made out of normal bone.
description: If someone's skeletal system is made out of normal bone, they better not punch you. If they punch you, they're fist instantly becomes hollow and possibly break. If they are wearing brass knuckles, this power doesn't work. If they have a different skeletal structure or are using superpowers, it doesn't work.
pros: People's fist break/become hollow if they punch you.
They'll think twice about punching you.
cons: If a supersayan/superhuman punches you.
If someone does something else to hurt you.
If the person is wearing brass knuckles.

name: Ghost Of The Future
overview: summon a spirit to warn a person what dark and deadly fate awaits them.
description: The future spirit or the ghost of yet to come is a dark non-speaking grim reaper like being, it can teleport you in a form of a mist to the depressing horrible future to view somebody their darkest destiny.
pros: You'll be transported back to the present time & able to change your own life for the better
cons: Can see your own grave.
You might not like the future

name: Penance
overview: force others to relive their sins.
description: This power is used by Ghost Rider (Penance Stare) and Akuma (Raging Demon). With this ability, you can force criminals to feel the pain and anguish they have caused others. We all have sins to atone for, but if you have too many, then this ability will drag your soul down to hell!
pros: Help reform people if it's not too late for them
Takes the wrong that someone has done... And turns it against them!
cons: If a person empties their mind and soul, it won't work

name: Zonk Out
overview: sleep as much and as well as you want.
description: With this ability, you can control the quality and the amount of time you sleep. You control the sleep stages. Sleep as much as you want. Induce your own sleepiness. You can't induce lack of sleep or a poor sleep quality with this power.
pros: Sleep as much and as well as you want.
Get well rested.
Induce your own sleepiness.
cons: Sleeping more and/or better than usual. Get yelled at for sleeping a lot!
The more well rested you are, the more energy you have while awake.
Get too well rested, and you'll stay awake for 24+ hours with strong clean energy if power is off.

name: Inverse Shapeshifting
overview: turn anyone into your identical twin.
description: With normal shapeshifting, you can turn into other creatures or objects. With Inverse Shapeshifting, you can turn other people into your look-alikes. They will have their own memories and personality, but they will look exactly like you.
pros: You can confuse your enemies.
No quantitative limits: you can turn the entire mankind into your twins.
You can turn a more powerful enemy into your twin and make the chances equal.
cons: They will get back to their original shape after 24 hours.
They will have your biological structure, so they can have some of your superpowers.
Your face will be well-known, if you use this power a lot.

name: Charging Rhino
overview: have the Strength and Speed of a Rhino, and its invincibility
description: This ability can also proves to be handy while playing football
pros: You will be as invincible as a Rhino
You will be as fast as a rhino
You will be strong as a rhino
cons: You will occasionally be dumb as a log
You will be short tempered
You will be more agressive

name: Fate Switch
overview: switch fates with someone else
description: A person with this power has the ability to switch fates with someone else. For example if they are destined to die at a young age they can switch this fate to someone else. If your defeat is certain then you can switch this with someone else, then reality will warp to give you the advantage. Everytime you switch fate, the results of your last fate switch will start to crumble. If you made an empire then switched fates with a peasant your empire will start to crumble.
pros: Switch your death with someone else
If you're erased from existence then you can still switch with someone in existence before erasure
Can switch with an immortal to "defeat" the immortal
cons: If someone you switch with has a worser fate than you
You can still die of old age since that is a universal fate

name: Special Memory Manipulation
overview: forget any embarrassing situations you might have experienced.
description: With this superpower, you can instantly erase any embarrassing situation from your memory. For example, suppose you made a fool of yourself at a party and your mates keep reminding you about it. Well, now you won't have any idea what they're talking about. Ah, blissful ignorance.
pros: Forget all embarrassing moments.
Remain blissfully ignorant of your embarrassing mistakes.
Feel better about yourself.
cons: Once you erase a memory, you can't get it back.
You might not learn from your mistakes if you keep erasing them.
You might start to think you're perfect.

name: Coatl, The Ever Flowing River
overview: increase your productivity, the quality and profitability of your work, and enhance your appearance.
description: This power allows you to be very successful in what you're doing. You'll be more productive and the quality of your work will increase, as well as any profit you can get from it. To reflect your success, your skin will shed, revealing a more appealing appearance. Your inner self will also "shed" to reveal a more attractive personality. The best thing is people won't notice the change, they only feel something's different but won't know what, unless they are very observant.
pros: Hard work and determination is undoubtedly the road to success with the help of this power.
Your family, friends and acquaintances will still recognize you after you change your appearance.
Any project you undertake can become successful if you put your heart into it.
cons: Beware as it only works if you actually put effort into it: It doesn't reward laziness at all!
You can't control what appearance you will get after you shed your skin.
Using your other superpowers to help with your projects can be seen as laziness.

name: Excalibur And Avalon
overview: wield Excalibur and its sheath Avalon
description: Excalibur is the strongest sword given by the Lady of the Lake; with it you can cut through almost anything. Avalon, the sheath, lets you become invulnerable by healing all existing wounds through cellular regeneration and protecting against dimensional, magical, and physical attacks.  If the user acts unchivalrous then the effects will be negated  Both of these can be stolen, and cannot be used against each other(strongest spear/shield paradox)
pros: You have the best weapon combination short of divine weapons
You can lead armies and create your own kingdom
cons: You will die young betrayed by your most trusted knight
You must be chivalrous
Can be defeated by divine weapons

name: Bloodless
overview: live with a body that has no blood
description: Normally when at least 50% of the blood is drained from a body, the body dies. However, with this power you can live even if all the blood in your body is drained away. You'll survive with nutrients getting to each cell similar to how an Arctic fish gets nutrients to each cell or a fungus alternatively.
pros: Can survive with no blood in your body.
Used in conjunction with Blood Manipulation.
cons: When all the blood disappears from the body it will stop regenerating blood for the rest of life.

name: Sea Mammal Control
overview: control sea mammals
description: With this power, any type of sea mammal is at your control. This includes dolphins, whales, porpoises, manatees, walruses, seals, sea lions etc.
pros: You can control all sea mammals
cons: Most sea mammals are confined to the water so this power is only useful if fighting in the water
No applicable to other sea animals that are not mammals

name: Anti Magic Bullets
overview: create psionic bullets that destroy magic on impact and physically damage only magical creatures
description: This power allows the creation of psionic bullets that destroy any magic they come in contact with and physically harm magical beings. Magical artifacts are 'depowered' as are cursed beings. 10 bullets can be fired in a second for 10 sec with 1 min rest between each burst. If you try to extend the 10 sec limit, you cannot use this power for 1 week. The bullets can pierce through magical things, but dissipate a sec after firing. Bullet per second rate can be increased with hard training.
pros: Can take down the strongest magical opponent.
Can increase rate of fire.
Bullets can pierce to hit multiple targets.
cons: Only works on magic.
Bullets dissipate really quickly.
Hard to get targets to line up for the piercing effect.

name: Anvil, Safe And Piano Drop
overview: make anvils, safes and pianos fall from the sky
description: With this power you can cause anvils, safes and pianos to fall from the sky and onto your enemies, enemies' houses/bases, enemies' car or anything else that you want to drop an anvil, safe or piano on
pros: You can crush people/things
cons: What are you going to do with the anvils/safes/pianos after they crush things

name: Mini Me
overview: create a 2-inch chibi version of oneself
description: You can create a 2-inch chibi version of yourself that follows your orders but also has a slightly different personality than its creator. Ex. The Mini-Me could be more spunky, flirtatious, etc. The Mini-Me will be three heads tall, in other words its head is 1/3 of its total height and also looks cuter than its creator. You can communicate with the Mini-Me telepathically and also verbally. This power can only be gained by using Telepathy at the same time you use Astral Projection.
pros: Carry him/her around in your pocket as a companion.
Instant servant!
The Mini-Me likes anyone you like and hates anyone you hate.
cons: Only one way to gain this power.
The Mini-Me's strength is in proportion to how small it is in comparison to its creator.
You will know when you gain this power because you will faint.

name: Pleasantly Warm
overview: make a sunny weather
description: Is it raining? Not anymore! With this power, all you have to do is say the words "Pleasantly Warm" and it will become as warm as day. You can only make the weather warm and sunny. Nothing more.
pros: Rain,rain go away.
It's raining sunshine :)
Have a wonderul weather.
cons: You can only make the weather warm and sunny. Nothing more.
Might hate sunlight.
This can even be activated at night time. So vampires, you're screwed.

name: Energy Mimicry
overview: mimic the energy that is in one vicinity, whether being heat-related, magnetic, solar, or kinetic.
description: One with the ability of Energy Mimicry is capable of mimicking the energy in one's surroundings. They can also mimic other empowered humans' abilities by successfully replicating their energy. However, when one mimics the energy of an empowered human or a normal human they take their ability strength as well. So they are just as experienced as the user they mimic from.
pros: The advantage that one has in battle is immense since they can take their enemies' power
With training, one can wield all forms of energy.
One can also learn to master the natural elements
cons: Can only mimic nearby energies.
Can't master mimicked abilities from others past their proficiency.

name: Eye Beam Holes
overview: stare holes through objects
description: Ever wanted to make someone's head disappear? Just stare at them and concentrate. Turn 'em into swiss cheese. This can be done to any substance. You can control the hole's size, but its maximum diameter can only be as big as the distance you are from the object, and its maximum depth is half that distance. You can unmake a hole by staring at it again, so you can pass through walls and stop followers. This can be used for spying, though it is not as discreet as X-Ray Vision.
pros: Very Dangerous
Holes don't have to be permanent
Works on any substance
cons: Limit to size of holes
Only works if you can see the target
Not the best way to spy

name: Weapon Form
overview: turn people into weapons for 15 minutes
description: The power to turn people into weapons. They will only be changed into a weapon for 15 minutes. Pretty cool, huh?
pros: Super strong to counter bad guys in battle
Destroy disasters
cons: Lasts 15 minutes
Weapon type will fit character's personality

name: Friend Summon
overview: summon one's friends.
description: Basically, you can summon anyone whom you consider to be a friend to your location.
pros: Always have help when you need it.
cons: Might tick off your friends by constantly summoning them or summon them at the wrong time.
If you're the strongest and you're losing a fight, your friends won't make much of a difference.

name: Sleep Sight
overview: make people fall asleep by looking into a person's eyes.
description: With this super power, looking into a person's eyes will make them fall asleep for up to twelve hours. The effect can vary from two hours to twelve hours. When they wake up, they will not remember falling asleep. Also, the person will not be able to be waken up until your power wears off.
pros: You can cause people to fall asleep to get out of tight situations.
cons: You can't control exacly how long a person will fall asleep.

name: Myth Power: Leto's Grace
overview: channel Leto's command over the essence of motherhood, womanly demure, modesty and concealment
description: Leto, in Greek myth, was the goddess of motherhood, womanly demure, modesty and concealment. As such, channeling her allows one to turn imperceptible (invisible, intangible, inaudible, inodorous, etc) at will; one does not even leave behind traces of one's presence, such as fingerprints, footprints or the like. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with one's mother at will, as well as withstand any abilities she has. One even gains favor with subjects who have MythPowers.
pros: Turn imperceptible (invisible, etc) at will (may be shared by touch); impossible to track
Psychically perceive and communicate with one's mother at will; immune to her abilities
Favor with people who have MythPowers
cons: Cannot mimic/absorb mother's abilities until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift and MythPower: Artemis' Gift provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and other Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Death Perception
overview: see how someone will die within the next 24 hours
description: A person with this power has the ability to predict how someone will possibly die within the next 24 hours. For an assassin this is an useful ability since you know how to kill someone. For law enforcement or a bodyguard you can prevent people from dying by predicting how they can possibly die and preventing it. This ability is only activated when the user wills it and all scenarios seen can be avoided--can avoid fate but not death--in the end.
pros: You know how to kill someone, possibly even an immortal--gives you info how to kill
You know how to prevent someone from dying early
You can use this in direct combat to figure out people's weaknesses and attack them
cons: You will often have to save people if you want to check the power often
You cannot predict your own death
Trying to help may sometimes be the reason someone will die but not always

name: Demon Type Absorption
overview: absorb any living being for various uses
description: This power is demonic and will corrupt the soul. You can absorb livin beings into your body and then use their matter to create new beings that are under your control by ejecting some living mass from your body. You can also enhance the unseen parts of your body with the matter and transform parts of your body to be more demonic. You can also change height, weight, gender, anything except being less demonic.
pros: Can still absorb beings that died (this includes plants).
Can become really strong.
Can create living beings under your control.
cons: Cannot absorb matter that never lived.
Must become more demonic (may be pro for some people).
Soul corrupts.

name: Airborne Rage
overview: induce a state of destructive rage in the people around you
description: The possessor of this ability automatically secretes an odorless chemical that induces a homicidal rage in the people around him/her. The chemical also makes them identify the possessor of the ability as a friend, meaning they will never attack him/her. This ability also can be reversed, and will make everyone romantically love each other, no matter their orientation. The anger can be directed at a certain person or group, giving you a homicidal army that will also want to kill each other.
pros: Can create an army of crazy, murderous people
Can create of group of peace loving people in even the craziest of people.
Won't get attacked by the people around you.
cons: Won't be included in the lovefest
Hard to control/turn off

name: Mass Consumption
overview: increase size based on mass consumed
description: With this ability, your body grows by the amount of mass consumed. You can also use this ability to steal mass from other forms of life. You can compress your body to a normal size, however the more mass you take in, the more difficult it becomes. The amount of mass your body can take is limitless, so you can become three times your normal size, or even hundreds of times your normal size.
pros: You can make yourself look taller
cons: Becomes harder and harder to compress to a normal size as you gain mass

name: Potent Blood
overview: have blood that enhances the effects of what it is put into
description: Your blood is potent and can enhance what it is put into. Example: A potion that enhances your strength by a factor of 10 suddenly enhances by a factor of 20. It can be any type of liquid or solid that can be ingested for some kind of effect. You cannot enhance how much your blood enhances stuff nor can the potency be reduced.
pros: Your blood enhances potions that can make you stronger.
cons: Your blood can enhance poisoned potions.
Your blood will NOT mix with gases.

name: Myth Power: Techne's Teachings
overview: channel Techne's command over the essence of art, technology, technical skill and craftsmenship
description: Techne (Tekhne), in Greek myth, was the goddess of art, technology and craft. As such, channeling her allows one to access knowledge of any technical skill, at will (as well as withstand skill-based effects). In addition, one can enter a trance state, to relay psychic insights, artistically. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command machines (engine-run machines, electronic devices, etc). One can also psychically mimic electronic devices' thought processes, at will.
pros: Psychically access knowledge of any technical skill (and withstand negative skill-based effects)
Enter a trance state, to receive psychic insights, and relay them via artistic expression
Psychically perceive, communicate with, command and mimic thought processes of machines
cons: Cannot psychically gain/bestow/enhance/disrupt/negate magic powers until developed (NCN)
Cannot travel into technology (Cybernetic Projection) or art (Artistic Travel) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Hephaestus' Forge provides negation (NCN)

name: User Rank Power Boost
overview: boost the effectiveness of any of your powers by a number equal user rank squared
description: Basically what the overview says. The power boosting number affects any power with a measurable trait. If you're not one of the 10 most powerful users then this power  works as if you were 11th most powerful user. This power allows for multiple 11th most powerful users.
pros: Not one of 10 most powerful users? You get the best power boost.
There can be more than one 11th most powerful user.
A way to balance your powers against those of the top 10 users.
cons: None or not enough of your powers have measurable traits.

name: Mind Fi
overview: use Mind Server.
description: You now have the ability to emit a WiFi signal from your head. Any computer within a range of thirty feet can log on to the Internet via your brain waves. The signal is always good, and pretty fast. The only downside is the headaches that form after an hour or so.
pros: Create a WiFi signal.
Always have Internet connectability.
cons: Causes headaches.

name: Mantis Hookswords
overview: use the swords to fire off waves of energy.
description: Also known as the crescent blades, they are extremely durable and when you slash with them, they can fire off waves of fire & ice. They are very sharp so you can eviscerate your foes with great ease.
pros: One Ice blade
One Fire blade
Sharp and durable
cons: Can be stolen
You are not immune to your own blades

name: Myth Power: Jaws Of Charybdis
overview: channel Charybdis' command over the essence of whirlpools, maelstroms and the tides
description: Charybdis (Kharybdis), in Greek myth, was the goddess of whirlpools and the tides. As such, channeling her allows one to survive underwater and swim well. In addition, one can stir any source of water into a whirlpool (which may be used for Teleportation and the like) at will. Furthermore, one may inhale with the power of a whirlpool, and exhale with the force of a tornado (with the added option of unhinging one's jaws) at will. One can even spin rapidly like a miniature tornado at will.
pros: Swim well and survive underwater; stir water into whirlpools (may be used for Teleportation)
Vortex Inhalation (immense water/air intake); Gale Exhalation (even shoot pressurized water/air)
Spin rapidly, like a minature tornado, at will; Unhinge one's jaws at will
cons: Cannot stir ambient moisture into buzzsaw-like blades until th higher levels (NCN)
Cannot use whirlpools for Dimensional Travel or Time Travel until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot perceive (and gain physical power from) the flux of the tides until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Long Distance Sex
overview: make someone feel like they are physically having real sex with you at a distance
description: The ability to have sex with another person or partner in a different location, and yet it feels like real sex. They can feel, see, hear, taste, and smell you as if you were actually present in their location.
pros: You can have sex with anyone
No possible way to get pregnant
Could greatly improve the success of your long distance relationship
cons: Can't get pregnant from doing it
Person isn't actually there with you

name: Enhancement: Counter Attack
overview: make a power automatically counter-attack when the holder is attacked
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power automatically counter an attack to you when you're attacked. This power cannot be attached to overly powerful powers such as Power of Imagination, Self-Existence Manipulation (don't know what it would do for one thing), unavoidable attacks, etc. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: Putting this on a negation power might be a little overkill on superhumans.
Great for a surprise attack when enemies think you're guard is down.
Don't have to worry about countering anymore because any attack is automatically countered.
cons: Useless without another power.
The attack on you might be a joke set up by friends.
Can only have one of this power at a time.

name: The  Less Power
overview: reduce yourself in some way.
description: You have the ability to less-in yourself in some way. Ex. Shadowless or ageless; also death, time, fear, sound, emotion, color, life, power, change or sin; any trait that make sense with a -less added to it. You can't choose boundless or limitless and be omni-powerful. You can only reduce yourself in one trait but can change it at will. Becoming mindless, lifeless or powerless for example would require secondary powers to restore yourself.
pros: Become translucent and hard to see.
Live longer.
Protect yourself from shadow control powers.
cons: Secondary powers are required to recover certain traits.

name: Negative Neutral Blasts
overview: create powerful blasts of energy from your body when your powers are neutralized.
description: There are these machines/powers that take away superpowers called "neutralizers." Villains just love using these to make the hero "a normal person". Ironically this power only works if you have been neutralized; now you can create powerful blasts of energy to project at your enemy, fly or create a shield to protect yourself and others. All powers are neutralized, except this one; if this is your only power, nothing is neutralized.
pros: This power is made to activate if you have been neutralized
Send the blasts from your feet to fly
Stop the blasts a few feet from you to create a shield
cons: Only works if you have been neutralized
Sucks if this is your only power

name: Wind Up Punch (Kinetic)
overview: charge up your fists with kinetic energy by winding up
description: A person with this power has the ability to charge up kinetic energy in their fists by "winding up" their arms-spinning. Also, the user can store this energy for any time they want until they punch something. When they punch something, they transfer all the charged kinetic energy into the attack. The target will either get blasted away or have a gaping hole. The energy is transferred without Newton's Third Law, so there is no recoil and the user's arms do not break due to the opposing force.
pros: You can store unlimited amount of energy by winding up
Your arm does not break from the recoil or Newton's Third Law
You can combine this with superspeed to wind up faster or with multiple arms to get more hits
cons: It takes time to store energy
If you spin too fast, you might dislocate something
You only get one shot since it will most likely blast your target away or kill in one shot

name: Lock Shot
overview: summon and wield the LockShot.
description: The LockShot is the opposite of the KeyBlade. It is a fusion of a pistol and a pad lock. Like the KeyBlade it can take on many styles and can be used to cast a variety of magics. Unique to the LockShot is its ability to lock people's hearts turning them into Heartless controlled by the wielder. If destroyed the Heartless return to being normal people. The LockShot can not be wielded by anyone but its owner and will teleport back to its owner.
pros: Have the LockShot as a weapon with infinite ammo.
Allows magic use such as holy, cura, and firaga.
Has the option to turn those it shoots into Heartless.
cons: Will be seen as a villian if you turn people into Heartless.
The KeyBlade can undo the effects of the LockShot.
Those with strong will can become immune to becoming Heartless.

name: Taste No Evil
overview: be immune to tainted & poisonous foods while eating them.
description: You can enjoy eating the oddest foods and drinking things that aren't beverages, but you could sense spoiled snacks and spiked drinks by using your red-glowing taste buds and if it detects them you can devour them.
pros: You can't get poisoned and sick while trying to eat and drink anything else.
cons: Some people might try to see you as disgusting and weird.

name: Self Submersion Limits
overview: choose how deep the water is to you.
description: With this ability, you choose how deep the water is to you. You can choose to make the water 6 feet deep or 6 inches deep to you. This works because of a psionic invisible platform that is tangible only to you. You can turn the power off. If the power is on, you can't choose the psionic platform to be deeper than 6 feet or less than 1 inch deep.
pros: Choose how deep the water is to you.
The invisible psionic platform protects you from deeper water.
You can turn the power off.
cons: The psionic platform is only tangible to you.
You can't set the psionic invisible platform deeper than 6 feet or less than 1 inch deep.
You might not know if you have this superpower.

name: Myth Power: Nomos' Nomination
overview: channel Nomos' command over the essence of rules, law, ordinance and statutes
description: Nomos (Nomus), in Greek myth, was the god of rules, law, ordinances and statutes. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically inscribe rules on subjects; subjects will follow their inscribed rule without question, and act with hostility toward those who don't. In addition, one can psychically summon (and recall every word of) a book with every rule and/or law in existence, at will. Furthermore, one may point to a rule in the Rule Book, and perceive/teleport to any place said rule applies.
pros: Psychically inscribe rules on subjects that serve as psychic compulsions
Psychically summon a Rule Book with every rule/law in existence; check for rule/law loopholes, etc.
Point to a rule in the Rule Book and teleport self/others to anywhere said rule applies
cons: Rule-compulsions must not contradict one another, or both are negated (NCN)
Only inscribe subjects with one rule at a time until developed; no direct inscription of death (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Epiphron's Appeal
overview: channel Epiphron's command over the essence of prudence, carefulness and caution
description: Epiphron, in Greek myth, was the god of prudence, carefulness, shrewdness, thoughtfulness and caution. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive nearly any significant events in subjects' lives, so they can prepare for them. In addition, one's luck increases when one takes time to practice, prepare and plan ahead carefully. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive and communicate with careful, meticulous people at will. One may even psychically compel rash and reckless people.
pros: Psychically perceive especially significant events in the lives of others at will (by touch)
Gain better and better luck the longer one takes time to practice, prepare and plan ahead
Psychically perceive and communicate with cautious, prudent people; compel reckless people
cons: Cannot perceive especially significant events in one's own life until the higher levels (NCN)
Probability/chance/luck based-MythPowers and Unpredictability provide immunity (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: 3 Headed Dragon Summon V2
overview: summon a three headed dragon
description: With this power you can summon a three headed dragon. The dragon can fly, is invulnerable, has sharp teeth in all of its mouths and is super strong. One of the dragon's heads shoots fire, the second one shoot ice and the third one shoots out webbing. The dragon is under your complete control and you can unsummon it when you're done.
pros: You can summon a three headed dragon
It's under your complete control
cons: It can be killed
It might be attacked by the government for being a monster

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message4
overview: channel the Muses' command over the essence of knowledge, inspiration and art
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration. As such, channeling Euterpe (Lyric Poetry) allows one to psychically access knowledge of all lyrical works, at will. In addition, one can psychically generate and manipulate rhythm and tempo, by touch and/or proximity, at will. One can also psychically convert objects into other objects with rhyming names, at will. One can even psychically compel subjects, by rhyming, at will.
pros: Psychically access knowledge of lyrical works, at will
Psychically generate and manipulate rhythm/tempo, by touch or proximity, at will
Psychically convert objects into rhyming objects; compel subject, by rhyming, at will
cons: Cannot psychically disrupt creativity (or negate ideas), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive subject's ideas until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift may cause bossy attitude toward the user (NCN)

name: Cd Consciousness.
overview: put a copy of your consciousness on CD
description: Don't have many defensive powers? Have a major weakness? Afraid of death? Just want some extra protection? If you answered "yes" to any of these questions, this is the power for you. If the CD is put in an electronic device, you can enter and control that device. You can even burn yourself to make more CD's. Each CD also has a copy of your DNA from your touch. Uses the same process as Power Backup.
pros: Avoid death, unless all your CD's are destroyed.
This power automatically protects the CD from scratches.
Control electronics with the capacity to use CD's.
cons: If you can't get blank CD's.
If alive, you can only access electronics through a deep trance or sleep.
CD's can be destroyed.

name: Bacterial Communication
overview: control how bacteria and some cells communicate.
description: Bacteria produce chemicals they use to communicate. With this power you can generate these chemicals to employ a variety of effects. You can program the bacteria with your powers to empower you or give you back your lost powers. You can make them join together and infect something, glow, aid bodily functions or attack. You can use this to create new strains and you can also make the bacteria form a cluster the size of a small dog to use as a weapon.
pros: Versatile.
Heal yourself and others.
Make poisonous bacteria or ones that corrode things.
cons: Healing is limited.
Try telling your friends that your job is bossing around germs.
Creepy.

name: Quartz Bolts
overview: fire bolts of energy that turn anything into quartz.
description: This ability allows you to fire bolts of white energy that turns anything they strike into quartz crystal. Objects retain thier shape.
pros: Turn anything to quartz crystal
Objects retain shape
cons: Does not discriminate. If you hit it, it's quartz.
Hard to be percise

name: Blue Needles
overview: throw them at your opponents, causing their bodies to swell and explode.
description: You are able to rapidly throw a bunch of acupuncture needles at your opponent, and one more at their head. They then start to go a little further than skin-deep, your foe turns red and starts to feel intense pain. They'll be inflated and float on way up high. An explosion is heard as their blood, bones and organs rain down.
pros: May be able to throw one or two which stops your foe from moving.
Can use it for rapid firing,
cons: Kind of gross.

name: Enhancement: Unfindable
overview: make a power nigh impossible to scan for or find
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes it nearly impossible to scan for or find the attached power. It also makes itself 'invisible' to an outside searcher to help hide the other power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: Now you have a backup the enemy knows nothing about... Hee hee hee hee...
If this power is somehow stolen its last effect is really nice, highly unlikely though
cons: Useless without another power.
Mind readers don't have to bother searching, your memories will tell them.

name: Walk On Water
overview: walk on Water
description: The ability stand on bodies of water without sinking .
pros: Cross ponds and lakes without detouring for a bridge.
Keep your feet dry when you step on a puddle.
Chase Ducks and Geese.
cons: Unable to swim
Can't take a bath

name: The Walking Plague
overview: infect any living thing with any disease through physical contact.
description: Those with this power can infect any living thing with any disease simply by touching them. However, the power is always active and the user has little or no control over what diseases are used with each touch (though you can learn to gain some control).
pros: You can weaken enemies easily.
You can make enemies die painfully and slowly (if you enjoy watching others suffer).
You could discover new diseases (any disease meaning discovered and undiscovered).
cons: You can kill someone by accident (say you bump them by mistake and give them cancer).
You cannot turn off your power so you risk killing any creature you touch.
The diseases are chosen at random so you could try to kill someone and end up giving them a cold.

name: Medicated
overview: gain abilities from pills
description: With this power a drug's claim is taken literally. Pain relievers allow you to control your pain and the pain of others. Sleeping pills allow you to induce sleep. Allergy medicine allow you to make anyone allergic to whatever you choose, etc. Recreational drugs are mostly dangerous but have varying effects. All abilities last until the drug runs its course.
pros: The range of your powers is dependant on dosage
Multivitamins will enhance abilities gained from medications
Steroids, HGH and muscle builders will take you beyond any top athlete
cons: Medications must be in pill form and you still have to come up with the co-pay
Herbal medications have a 50 percent chance of being a placebo
You are at risk of every drug's side effect and you could always overmedicate.
tags: lucy in the sky with diamonds

name: Grave Re Animator
overview: dig a hole that will re-animate a dead thing.
description: This power is kind of like that graveyard in Pet Cemetery except better. You can dig a hole anywhere were there's sand or soil. Your re-animates aren't killers. Missing a body part? Throw a replacement limb or entire body in the grave and get a intact re-animate. You need at least the brain and spinal column of the dead thing to want to re-animate. You can't mix up species. A re-animate dies again just dig a new grave. These re-animates can heal.
pros: As long as you can dig a hole you can re-animate a dead person or animal.
If you know you're dying you can dig a hole for yourself.
Grave re-animates heal.
cons: You're not near sand or soil.
These re-animates might be mistaken for zombies...
You can't make minotaurs or centaurs.

name: Myth Power: Amechania's Aim
overview: channel Amechania's command over the essence of helplessness, powerlessness and weakness
description: Amechania (Amekhania), in Greek myth, was the goddess of weakness, helplessness, defenselessness, incompetence and incapability. As such, channeling her allows one to turn a subject entirely intangible, inaudible, etc by touch; others can touch the subject if they desire, but if he tries to touch anything, he phases through it. In addition, one can psychically weaken subjects by touch; the longer the contact, the physically weaker they get. One can even withstand any of the foe's abilities.
pros: Turn foe helplessly intangible (can be touched, but can't touch anything) and inaudible (can't talk)
Physically weaken subjects by touch (the longer the contact, the weaker they get)
None of the foe's powers directly work on the user (even powers like Superstrength)
cons: Can still be harmed indirectly by the foe; Pro #2's effects are only temporary (NCN)
Cannot transfer strength/stamina/durability from one subject to another until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Penia's Penalty and Ptocheia's Talent provide immunity (NCN)

name: Fourth Wall Creation
overview: create a fourth wall around any stage/set, trapping the actors in their parts.
description: If you hate poor acting, then this is the power for you! With fourth wall creation, you can litterally turn the old theater device into a barrier between the set and the audience. All you have to do is make a stage, give everyone scripts, and create the wall. BOOM! Everyone with a part becomes their character: with all the personality, memories, and abilities that come with it. While there is no physical wall, the "fourth wall" appears as a real wall to the actors in their minds.
pros: You can make acting more realistic and make tons of cash.
If you want, make your own dream world by getting your friends to do a play you wrote.
You're imune to the the power, so you won't get sucked in.
cons: Since the wall is not physical, the actors could fall off if they tried to walk through it.
No one will remember what happened behind the wall but you.
If you don't remember to turn the wall off, you'll have a bunch of crazy people.

name: Television Vision
overview: make any television character appear out of thin air.
description: With this awesome power, you can make any TV character appear out from the TV. 2D characters such as cartoons will still be 2D in our world. Also, the characters will be the size that they were in the TV. The TV has to remain on if you want your character to stay in our world. You can't actually take the character from the show, you can only make a duplicate of that character.
pros: You can interview Spongebob SquarePants.
Can be the television master.
Can have a tiny army and take over the world HAHAHA.
cons: The television has to remain on for however long you want your character to be in our world.
The characters are only going to be about six inches tall.
2D characters will still be 2D in our world.

name: Creepy Summoning
overview: summon tiny ghost-like creatures.
description: You can summon little 7 inch tall creatures that look like sheets with huge eyes (like black holes) that float 1 inch off the ground. If something goes in 1 of their eyes,it comes out the other. Their "sheets" can't be ripped or torn and they can emit "mist" from under them that acts like tentacles or shields. If someone looks under their "sheets" their mind & soul are stolen, making the creature more powerful,or allowing them to duplicate. They talk telepathically.
pros: Incapacitate ANYONE(even immortals:D)
They can't be ripped
Awesome servants and helpers
cons: They can still be incapacitated/destroyed
Are pretty weak until someone looks under them
Can only summon 1, they have to get minds and souls to duplicate

name: Kinesis Ii: The Healer
overview: remotely heal any living creature
description: Anyone, anything on the planet can be healed by you. All you need is to see them. Even if they are on TV, as long as you see them you could heal them in an instantaneous rush. You see them, you establish a empathetic link to them, feeling what they feel, you heal them in the blink of an eye.
pros: Heal people around the world from the comfort of your own home
You could walk through hospitals and heal everyone anonymously
You could heal yourself by looking at your own reflection
cons: Finding something to reflect yourself for your own healings
Someone may find out you're healing folks and then the "savior" talk will begin
Seeing someone hurt and not healing them will cause you pain until you heal them

name: The Power Of Pow!
overview: pull a punch and knock out anyone just by saying POW!
description: A kind of reality control. As long as you actually pull your punch some and just say POW! You will knock out an opponent regardless of what powers he or she possesses. Your opponent will stay unconscious long enough to be taken away by authorities if you the good guy or if your the bad guy you have enough time to put him or her in a fiendish death trap.
pros: Ignore invulnerability of any foe.
Knock unconscious that big green guy who always smashing things. You know who I mean.
Your likely very sneaky. See below.
cons: You probably don't go to a gym. Your a weakling.
Any way a opponent could shut your mouth or keep you quiet. Sound control is good.

name: Psychic Voodoo
overview: act as a living voodoo doll
description: Voodoo is a Cajun religion that places belief in folk magic, especially the infamous voodoo doll. A person with Psychic Voodoo can take the damage that they would have(fire, bullets, etc.) and give it to another person. While using this ability, the user takes no damage and has no pain. However, once the target dies, the link ceases.
pros: Payback
While using, effectively invunerable
Unlimited range
cons: Must know the person
When they die, the link dies too
Takes active concentration
tags: do that voodoo that you do

name: Dark Soul Keeper
overview: become the exact double of an dead evil individual
description: Anyone who has ever died that society has at least once outcasted as a sort of bad person--Hitler, Jack the Ripper, Atilla the Hun, Billy the Kid--you have the ability to mimic or become. You would be able to completely look like them and any thing they were capable of knowing or doing.
pros: Maybe you're evil
You would have the military genius of multiple people
Demons, Grim Reaper, etc. are also fair game
cons: Maybe you're good
Turning into Hitler on the street will cause massive panic

name: Psychopomp Interference
overview: perceive and interfere with the work of soul carriers.
description: Everytime someone is about to die, a strange formless creature appears and waits for the right moment to extract the soul of the deceased. Their true intents are still uncertain, but some people believe they guide souls to the afterlife and others say it is Death itself. While they are usually imperceptible to living beings, this power allows you to see them and actually affect them. So, you can prevent them from taking a new soul by fighting them away, albeit temporarily.
pros: Prevent someone's death.
Get a chance to prevent your own death.
cons: The dying person may continue to suffer horribly.
When the moment comes, you will realize you're about to die soon.

name: Claws Of Dust
overview: create claws out of dust
description: When you activate this power it gathers dust from the area around you. This takes around 3 seconds. The dust then hardens around your fingernails which takes 4 seconds. More dust can be used to make the claws denser or longer.
pros: Now you can use that dust instead of just vacuuming it up and throwing it away.
Can make the claws longer with more dust.
Dust is everywhere on most planets.
cons: Some dust can be poisonous (might be pro).
Takes time to form the claws.
Being in outer space.

name: Half Kitsune
overview: be half-human, half-kitsune
description: Someone with this power will have fox-like ears and tail(s). The more tails they have the more powerful they will be. Sometimes they won't have tails, instead their hair will naturally separate into 'ponytails' to signify the number of 'tails' they have. They will also have higher physical strength and speed. Their magical power will also be boosted for shapeshifting and fire magic.
pros: The more tails you have the less others will want to incur your wrath or fight you.
Rare versions of this power allow for control of Foxfire.
cons: Some people will make signs to ward you off. Ex: the holy cross.
You are weaker than a full Kitsune (unless you have 9 tails), but more powerful than normal humans.

name: Fate Of Socrates
overview: turn any liquid into hemlock
description: With this power you can turn any liquid into the poisonous hemlock. Whenever someone is about to take a drink turn it into hemlock. Whenever it rains you can turn some of it into hemlock. With a lot of practice you will be able to turn large bodies of liquids such as oceans, rain storms or even the human blood stream into poisonous hemlock.
pros: You can turn any liquid into hemlock
cons: You have to practice a lot before you can turn a large amount of something into hemlock

name: Ufo Creation
overview: pull random objects from the sky
description: A UFO is an unidentified flying object, and not necessarily just an alien spacecraft. With this power, you can summon any object that flies to help you, like a bird, a plane, a (well, yes, an alien spaceship), super-humans who can fly, you name it, you can summon it, if it can fly. But it's also a random ability: You don't know what your going to get when you summon something. That's where the 'unidentified' bit comes from. You don't know what it is until you get it.
pros: Need escape? A helicopter, alien spacecraft or plane may come to your aid!
Need to get somewhere? Plane, helicopter or GIANT BIRD!!! (What??? )
Need a form of attack? Army helicopter, alien spacecraft, fighter plane or GIANT BIRD!!!
cons: Object is random, so in some cases you might summon many objects before you find one that's useful.
There might be people inside the planes, helicopters etc.
Issues with alien spacecraft's tractor-beam, and maybe the GIANT BIRD trying to peck you.

name: Substance: Chemical Creator
overview: create molecules, chemical elements etc that the universe has never seen
description: With this power, you can create new chemicals. They can be atoms or mixtures, really any type of substance. It just needs to be totally unknown until you bring it to existence. You can also choose what traits or special abilities it might have. It might be a new element that's nigh indestructable or super malleable. It could be a compound that exerts antigravity, or warps time and space. It could be superconductive material, whatever, it just needs to be unknown and you can bring it to life!
pros: Combine any number of protons, neutrons and electrons to make a totally new element or compound.
You decide was properties or traits it can have, like one that is, for example, alive! ALIVE! HAHAHA
You can use the -ium, -ite, -ate etc suffixes all day.
cons: Once you have made it, this power will never allow you to make it again, as it is not new.
Without a power to control already known elements, this power could be rendered useless.
In order to name the elements, you might need to learn Latin

name: Transformers: Ironhide
overview: shoot liquid nitrogen from your hands
description: With this power you can shoot liquid nitrogen from your hands. The liquid nitrogen can melt through almost anything but it cannot hurt you or anyone else who has this power. A side effect of this power causes you to speak in a southern accent while you use this power.
pros: You can shoot liquid nitrogen from your hands
The liquid nitrogen cannot hurt you
cons: You cannot hurt other people who have this power with this power

name: The Cup Of Water
overview: create a 12 ounce cup of drinking water.
description: Imagine walking through a desert wishing you had something to drink, oh wait you have "The Cup of Water"! It's simple, it's practical, it's strange that few would have this I mean water is essential to life right? Just hold out your hand and instantly you can create a 12 ounce cup filled with drinking water, and by drinking I mean the good kind, so whether it's the desert or the sewers or wherever you have water. Oh and did I mention you get to keep the cup? That's right a free cup too!
pros: Endless supply of drinkable water with no waiting time between
Costs no energy on the person using the power
You get a free cup when you are done
cons: It's just water, nothing special
Not a lot of people can be affect by 12 ounce of water
Do you really need ANOTHER glass cup?

name: Myth Power: Thetis' Thought
overview: channel Thetis' command over the essence of the sea's buoyancy and the generation of fish
description: Thetis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the sea's buoyancy and the generation (spawning) of fish, as well as the Leader of the Nereids. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically manipulate water, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically manipulate matter's buoyancy in water, at will. One can even psychically perceive and communicate with fish, as well as users of aquatic MythPowers, at will.
pros: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically manipulate water, and matter's buoyancy in water, at will
Psychically perceive and communicate with fish and aquatic MythPower users, at will
cons: Cannot gain Aqueous Shapeshifting (turn into water, then another subject) until developed (NCN)
Cannot astral-project water-independent fish-spirits at will, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige provides immunity and allows disruption/negation (NCN)

name: Space Vehicles V2
overview: summon any type of space vehicle
description: With this power you can summon any kind of space vehicle. You can summon rocket ships, satellites, lunar rovers, space pods, UFOs etc. You also know how to operate any vehicle that you summon. When you're done you can unsummon the vehicle.
pros: You can summon any kind of space vehicle
You know how to operate the vehicle
You can unsummon them when you're done
cons: Just because you know how to operate a space vehicle doesn't mean you're ready to go into space

name: Rube Goldberg Machine Creation
overview: trigger Rube Goldberg-esque reactions to perform the tasks you want.
description: There are three requirements: you need to trigger the first action, there must be enough elements available and the reactions must be possible. If all these are met, you just need to think about a task and a chain of events will accomplish it. Living beings' reaction can be involved, such as someone opening a door to see what's happening, someone putting down an object in a convenient place when they stand up, or even a rat chewing on a rope that just so happens to connect a car to the ceiling.
pros: With experience, this power could even guide you to perform the first action perfectly.
Cause an incredible chain of reactions to perform even the simplest task without the need to set it.
Humans's, even animal's and plant's, reaction to what's happening can be elements of the chain.
cons: If some reactions are impossible, the chain will break.
Complex tasks are very difficult to realize, especially if there aren't enough elements.
Unless you have precise aim and calculated move, you may fail to trigger the chain.

name: 3rd Time's The Charm
overview: win at anything that doesn't have any prize except making one feel better
description: You will literally win at anything you do the third time you do it, unless there is more of a prize than just making you feel good about winning.
pros: You always win the third time you do something!
cons: You had to fail the first two times.
Doesn't guarantee future wins.

name: One Power Unrequirement
overview: use this superpower to eliminate the requirements of one superpower.
description: With this ability, you can use it to complete the requirements of one superpower instead of doing what the superpower requires. It only works with one superpower. No more sacrifices to use the one power you always wanted to use. Now you can freely use that one superpower. Cons of those powers may still apply. Be careful how you use this power. This power has no requirements.
pros: Eliminate the requirements of one superpower.
No more deadly sacrifices that may kill you.
You can now use that superpower.
cons: Cons of the other power may still apply.
If your superpowers do not require anything for you to use them.
Use responsibly.

name: Air Lock
overview: be immune to unnatural weather changes.
description: With this ability you are immune to weather changes caused unnaturally. So if it is a natural change if the sun is shining and it a beautiful day, you would be unaffected by that. But if another made the weather rainy, you would be immune to the rain and cold.
pros: Unaffected by weather changes.
cons: If someone makes it ran down money, you would be unaffected by that.
Weather usually isn't that much of a problem.......

name: Spirit Eater
overview: eat spirits and grow stronger
description: Whenever there is a spirit in a one hundred yard radius, your mouth will automatically open and the spirit will be sucked into it. The spirit will not be able to posses your body and you will gain all of the powers that the spirit had; but only when it was alive for twenty four hours. If the spirit did not have any powers when it was alive, you simply gain super strength and invulnerability for twenty four hours.
pros: You can gain the powers of spirits
You can gain super strength and invulnerability
You can never be possessed by spirits ever
cons: You only have the powers for 24 hours

name: The Balance
overview: heal anyone, but with a consequence
description: If you spot someone who is ill, injured and/or near death, you can miraculously heal them through touch and all their illnesses and injuries will disappear. However, there is a dire part to this power. As someone gets another chance at life, someone else in the vicinity will inexplicably die of something. You can heal that person too, bring them back to life, but again, someone else will die. You have a gift and a curse. It's a tease power of playing God. Order and balance must be set.
pros: Can instantly heal or bring someone back to life
cons: When you save someone, someone else will die

name: Superderm
overview: be immune to injuries caused by friction
description: With this ability, you will become immune to all injuries caused by friction. No more scrapes or friction burn. No more skateboard injuries. No more knee pads or elbow pads.
pros: Be immune to all friction induced injuries.
No more skateboard injuries.
No more knee pads or elbow pads.
cons: You are not indestructable.
Can still get hurt by physical attacks not involving friction.

name: Demon Lords
overview: have powers from each of the seven demon lords of Hell.
description: Call upon the seven demon lords for thier powers such as Leviathan-Sea Monster form, Beelzebub-Deadly Flies, Belphegor-Seducing Hypnotism, Mammon-Matter Magnetism, Asmodeus-Wind Gusting, Amon-Army of Souls Command and Lucifer-Great Demonic Strength.
pros: Having awesome POWERS!
cons: You will be EVIL!

name: Bioluminescence
overview: make the skin (and your blood) glow
description: The ability to make the skin grow, also when cut the blood of a person with this power glows.
pros: Great night vision
Skin doesn't break out
Able to create a visible path for others in the dark
cons: If person doesn't know how to control it they glow all the time in the dark
Powers don't work well in light

name: Holy Power: Field Of Fear
overview: create an hallucination, making your enemy think that he spent 100 years in hell, driving him crazy.
description: With this power you induce an hallucination on your enemy, making him think that he spent 100 years in hell, which is enough to drive anyone crazy, no matter how strong your enemy is. This power causes no physical damage and you can use it only on a maximum of three enemies per time. This power wastes almost no energy at all. People with Level Omega mind powers might be able to get protected from this power.
pros: Can drive your enemies crazy without even getting tired.
Can use it on three enemies at the same time.
Hard to defend.
cons: Causes no physical damage.
People with Level Omega mind powers are able to protected themselves from this power.
Only a Tormentor can use this power.

name: Con Negation
overview: negate cons
description: Is there a super awesome superpower you like, but with horrible cons? This could be the power for you. With this power, cons cease to exist. When one first gets this power, they randomly negate them. But with some hard work and training, one could have total control over this power.
pros: No
More
Cons
cons: Mary/Gary Sue-ish
Makes Everything Mary/Gary Sue-ish
You might not have any other powers.

name: Mon Moves
overview: use any move used by a Pokemon in real life
description: A person with this power can access a variety of abilities by imitating Pokemon attacks. If the user does not have the adequate body part, their body will shapeshift temporarily to use the attack. Temporarily transformed parts have the same type advantages, disadvantages and strength of the chosen pokemon. You have to declare the attack before it can be used. All of the attack's effects can do the same damage as seen in the video game or the TV show.
pros: You gain a lot of powers like telekinesis or energy balls or spewing fire.
Type advantages apply, but only when attacking
cons: If someone throws a pokeball at you, your power will subconsciously make it real
Type disadvantages apply when attacking as well

name: I Am Here!!!!!!!!!!!
overview: give anyone a magical presence
description: A magical presence is where a certain thing happens in your presence. For example,you could give someone a presence of Misfunction. Then whenever they are around things would go haywire. When you give someone a presence you can control how long it lasts but one month max. When you give a presence to yourself you can suppress it but its hard to do for a long time. Some common presences are the Presences of fortune,misfortune,peace,anger,fear & others. Once you give a presence you cannot take it.
pros: You can be specific (presence of exploding hot dogs)
Helpful in most situations
Gain multiple powers. Sorta.
cons: You cannot take a presence back once you give it
More specific presence take longer and are harder to do
If it is discovered people will abuse (if you dont already) your power.

name: N+
overview: have the powers of the ninja in N and N+
description: You don't look like him, but you can jump up to 10 feet in the air, run up walls, run faster than a missile, and you can't get hurt unless you would die from the injury.
pros: Agility
Immunity to injuries that would not cause death
Wall run
cons: When you die, you explode
Your lifespan is limited to 17 years after you get the power but can be raised by getting gold cubes

name: The Centipede's Dilemma
overview: permanently negate an opponent's power if they can't explain it to you.
description: Ask an opponent to tell you how a power they have works. If they try and fail, they power is gone. This power always works on other powers that control or manipulate complex things like matter, time, space, life, energy, etc. It won't work on something simple like super strength. How it works on anything in between depends on the IQ of your foe and the complexity of the power you want to negate. If your foe can or can't explain their power, your power will never work on them again either way.
pros: Can the Hulk explain why he can't be hurt?
"I can..." isn't an answer to how you control time and space.
cons: Geniuses.
You only get one shot with this power.
The simplest powers can often be the best ones-you can't negate those powers.

name: Triforce Of Courage
overview: use the triforce of courage
description: With this power you have the triforce of courage and with this you can summon the master sword and gain courage and if you lose your soul it goes back to you body but until you find the person or thing that almost took your soul you will stay in wolf-form.
pros: Fear nothing
Use the master sword
Never get your soul taken away
cons: Untill you find the thing that almost took your soul you stay a wolf

name: Power Level Progress Blocker
overview: prevent the level of a power from rising.
description: Having a superpower isn't enough, you have to learn how to use it, train it, develop techniques, etc. This power allows its user to block anyone in their vicinity from making any further progress with their superpower. In other words, their level of proficiency with their power can't rise and their power can't evolve in any way. This power affects all the powers of a user, and blocks any means to level up a power.
pros: It's frustrating for them to realize the efforts they just made to train a power were a waste.
Great against Ultimate Upgrader and, to a degree, Technique-based Power Creator.
cons: You need to stay in their vicinity to keep blocking their power level.
The time and effort they'll lose is ridiculous in comparison with the time needed to master a power.

name: Personal Power Deactivation
overview: turn off any power you have at will
description: This power is very rare and very heard to find. Imagine having powers that you don't want and you want to torn them  of permanently. You choose any power you have and it is deactivated.  This power is not immune to ability cancellation or any ability that is similar to it. This power does not protect or defend you in any way.
pros: Make your self feel better
You can cheat very easily (pro & con)
You can use this power as much as you want
cons: This power is nether offensive or defensive ( no con negation)
only the auther of the power can torn it back on (no con negation)
Only works on yourself

name: Prerecorded Precogition
overview: anticipate the responses to a recorded message
description: When you record a video for someone to see or hear in the future, you're only saying your message. You don't know how the person would respond or what they would say. But that would change if you have this power. When you start recording, your vision moves to when the recording will be played. You will speak and act out your message, but you will see and hear only the future. You will know the future guy's responses, and so you could change your message accordingly, conversation-style.
pros: Have a conversation with your great-great-great-great-great-great (GASP! ) -great grandchildren.
Doesn't even have to be far into the future, it just has to be in the future.
You could look through the recording's eyes and see what the future is like.
cons: People might think it's not a recording.
Others wanting to know about their great-great-great-great-great-great (GASP! ) -great grandchildren
Effectively useless in combat - More useful in a time capsule or something.

name: Twin Devils
overview: use them to stab & strike with a brutal & mystical force.
description: The twin devils are a pair of sais that are forged from mercury & scandium. They can manipulate and conjure darkness, as well as disperse mystical scarlet flaming energy in a form of a barrier. Further, they can send forth blasts of necrobolts which can only destroy any opponent that is evil. They will be sent  all the way to the underworld.
pros: Awesome sais
Darkness manipulation
cons: Only works on evil beings

name: Myth Power: Phoebe's Phenomenon
overview: channel Phoebe's command over the essence of bright intellect and prophecy
description: Phoebe (Phoibe), in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of bright intellect and prophecy. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the past, present and future. In addition, one can psychically manipulate subjects' extrasensory powers, by touch, at will. One can also psychically absorb ambient light to increase one's intelligence and extrasensory powers, at will. One can even psychically project the feeling of being blinded/burned by intense light into subjects' minds, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive past/present/future; manipulate subjects' extrasensory power, by touch, at will
Psychically absorb light to temporarily increase one's intelligence and extrasensory powers, at will
Psychically project sensation of being blinded/burned by intense light into subjects' minds, at will
cons: Cannot psychically project light to extend range for Part 2 of Pro #1, until developed (NCN)
Effects of Pro #2 and Part 2 of pro #1 only last while power is active (NCN)
MythPower: Leto's Grace, Apollo's Appeal and Artemis' Art provide immunity (NCN)

name: Hell Bent
overview: make people Hell Bent.
description: Have you ever heard the term Hell Bent on something? Well this power can motivate people to do things in you want them to do, and when you do it they won't stop until they die or succeed. This is what it means by being Hell Bent.
pros: Make people do your will.
They won't stop ever.
cons: They might die.

name: Gale Breath
overview: be full of a considerable amount of air.
description: With this power you become filled with an unending supply of air. The air causes your body to expand so that it becomes bloated, almost like a hot air balloon. Having this air means you will never need to breathe because you are filled with the supply of air. You can also blow out the air with considerable force. The air you blow out could be either hot or frosty.
pros: Have an unending supply of air.
Breathe gale winds.
Your body will not be hurt from containing the air.
cons: Your body becomes bloated containing the air.
You could be popped.
Accidentally releasing the air.

name: Vampire Immunity
overview: be unaffected by the direct actions of vampires towards one
description: Vampires' fangs can't pierce your skin nor can they control your mind. They also can't use guns or swords to kill you because they're the ones using them. Nothing they do directly to you by themselves will have any effect on you.
pros: Vampires can't steal your blood or turn you into one of them.
'Vampirism: Superpower' won't neutralize this power, but it will negate your other powers.
cons: Werewolves and zombies can still bite you and turn you into one of them.
Shadowulf1's Vampirism powers can still affect you.
Vampires can still hire mercenaries to kill you.

name: Surf's Up!
overview: create and control large tidal waves or Tsunami
description: Snap your finger and manipulate tidal waves, causing them to increase in size, decrease in size or otherwise change (including what direction they move in).
pros: Ride the waves with glory.
Make waves larger or smaller at will.
Even cause tsunamis.
cons: Creates tsunami when pissed off (unintentionally).
Must have presence of massive body of water.

name: Aura Of Corruption
overview: cause others to become (more) evil by keeping them in one's aura
description: Anyone who stands in the aura of someone with this power will be corrupted and become more inclined to do acts of evil. Cannot have both this power and 'Aura of Purification'.
pros: Artifacts and places can also be corrupted by keeping them in your aura.
cons: Anything that leaves your aura can still be purified.

name: Relationship Breakup
overview: sever the bonds between individuals.
description: Parents, friends, a girlfriend/boyfriend, a husband/wife, exes, a boss, colleagues, the doctor, the baker, the guy they bumped into on the street, the girl they met in the lift, a rival, a kidnapper or a bully. Whenever two people interact with each other, a bond is created. Someone with this power can see these bonds and cut them. When it happens, both of them will forget everything about each other after experiencing a short sentiment of grief or relief depending on their former relationship.
pros: Get rid of a rival in love or a family member by making them forget their love or their family ties.
Help someone forget their past as a victim or a former prison convict and move on.
Dissolve groups of people, such as allies, sport teams or gangs.
cons: Material traces, such as photographs, videos, phone numbers, or even common friends, still remain.
It doesn't prevent the two people from creating new bonds.
Doesn't work with animals and objects.

name: Death Touch
overview: bring upon near or full death upon a living entity through flesh contact.
description: This power is based on flesh to flesh contact. It begins to kill cells in the target rapidly. Depending on how long contact is held, the victim can be brought to a fatal state or be killed. It may be affected by the abilities of the opponent on how it may effect them and also may not work. Ex. Hand to sleeve of opponent has no effect. It will also not have any effect on something mechanical like a robot or machine.
pros: May lead to quick victory.
Can cripple an opponent temporarily or permanently.
Intimidating presence.
cons: Close range.
Interferes with social activities greatly.
Easy to misuse.

name: Submission Collar
overview: create a collar that strangles people if they don't obey you.
description: With this power, you can create a collar around anyone's neck and assign a task to them. If they refuse to carry on that task, the collar will strangle them until they either resume or die. Once it's been completed, the collar disappears. You can create as many collars as you want but only one task can be associated with one collar and only one collar can be given to one person. For this power to work, you also need to explain the basics of your ability if they don't know about it.
pros: Force anyone to do your bid, even your enemies.
If they already know about your power, you don't have to explain it and can activate it immediatly.
cons: If someone doesn't understand your power, it won't work on them.

name: Legends: Byakko.
overview: channel the power of the Tiger God.
description: With this power, the user conjures the mythical forces of the legendary Byakko (literally meaning; White Tiger). As such, they become engulfed with the creature's magnificent might; able to take the form of a tiger who harnesses superhuman strength, speed, senses, invulnerability, and control over the elements of wind and metal. The virtue of righteousness lives within, and the world is seen through clairvoyance. The user's abilities are doubled during the autumn season.
pros: The power can be activated at any given moment.
The user is the epitome of a tiger's (mythological) evolution.
cons: The user's power is dependent on the number of tigers still existing.
The user's power is multiplied by the statistical value (prowess) of lasting tigers.

name: Power Of The Fainting Goat
overview: cause living creatures to stiffen their muscles
description: Fainting goats are domestic goats that contract their muscles for roughly ten seconds when startled. With this power, you can invoke this response in any living creature by contracting all muscles related to movement, resulting in a total stiffening of the body. You can make duration from 1 second to 10 minutes. It's painless and doesn't inhibit breathing or cause any other negative effects to the body, and the victim stays conscious. The target will simply stiffen up and be totally immobile!
pros: Great for self defense or a good laugh
Fainting cats, dogs, people, cows, you name it
People won't want to mess with you
cons: Doesn't cause any damage if that's what you're going for
The victim is still totally conscious

name: Wayfinder
overview: wield the sword of wisdom.
description: Also called the sword of wisdom, Wayfinder possess the ability to lead you to wherever, or whatever, you want or need. Wayfinder will lead you intelligently, taking you through steps to get what you want. The main problem is that wayfinder does not lead you down the safest or quickest path, in fact it leads you down the longest and most dangerous path possible. Another lesser use of Wayfinder is to answer a question and to point to the answer. But beware, multiple paths will confuse it.
pros: Leads you where you want to go
Has a great sense of direction
Well balanced, super sharp sword, resistant to most damage
cons: Has a nasty sense of humor
Extremely dangerous paths to your goal
It can't multitask.

name: Myth Power: Hemera's Daybreak
overview: channel Hemera's command over the essence of daylight and the daytime sky
description: Hemera, in Greek myth, was the primeval goddess of daytime; daybreak and the daytime sky. As such, channeling her gifts one with Ultraviolet Vision to see better at day. In addition, one can perceive any location in the world where it is daytime, and the activities of any creatures in said locations. Furthermore, one can travel to and from any location where it is daytime, at will. One can even withstand light-based attacks and psychically disrupt shadow/darkness-based attacks at will.
pros: Gain Ultraviolet Vision to see better during the day
Psychically perceive any location where it is day (and creatures' activities in said locations)
Teleport self and others to any daytime location; withstand light powers, disrupt dark powers
cons: Only generate 'daylight' or Time Travel to future/past daytimes at the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel diurnal creatures until developed (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Hellhounds
overview: summon hounds from Hell
description: A hellhound is a dog from hell that can withstand far higher temperatures than most creatures. They also can harm any kind of bodiless spirit with nothing more than their bare paws and fangs.
pros: Powerful pets.
cons: The hellhounds you summon might decide to kill you.
You have to try to control the hellhounds by normal or supernatural methods.

name: Wolf Pack Eclipse
overview: become a twilight lycan
description: This power can only be obtain if have the mark of Skoll and Hati. When combing the two marks you can become even more stronger werewolf than before with the power of the sun and moon your power can grow during the day or night.
pros: Become the ulimate werewolf
Power over the sun and moon
Never lose power during the day or night
cons: Need the mark of Skoll
Need the mark of Hati
Gods will hunt you down

name: Myth Power: Mystis' Mission
overview: channel Mystis' command over the essence of members initiated into mysteries
description: Mystis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of initiates into mystery rites, like cults and secret societies. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically convert normal language into language only the user and chosen subjects can understand, at will. In addition, one can psychically establish a telepathic and/or empathic bond between the user and/or chosen subjects, at will. One can even psychically project a forcefield nearly impenetrable by anyone except the user and chosen subjects, at will.
pros: Convert normal spoken/written language into a language only the user/chosen subjects can understand
Psychically establish a telepathic and/or empathic link between user/chosen subjects
Psychically project a force field, nearly impenetrable by anyone except user/chosen subjects
cons: Pro #2 requires touch (and cannot develop into user-dominated hive-mind), until developed (NCN)
Cannot access arcane/occult knowledge to cast magic spells until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Bacchanalia and MythPower: Telete's Test provide immunity (NCN)

name: Tenocyte Mimicry
overview: create tough collagen bands.
