description: You can produce biological fibers compressed into very tough bands. These bands have some elastic properties but are still very resistant to traction forces. Also, you can easily stick either end to any kind of solid surfaces. Additionally, you can undergo mitosis, creating identical copies of yourself.
pros: You can create very resistant ropes.
You won't waste any time tying your rope or finding something to tie it to, you can just stick it.
You can duplicate yourself to outnumber an opponent.
cons: Your "ropes" can still be slashed.
Your "ropes" can conduct electrical current.
You can't reabsorb your clones.

name: Sarcasm Detection
overview: detect sarcasm in any form.
description: With this ability, the user can detect sarcasm, whether spoken, telepathic, written or otherwise. It manifests as knowledge, not a sense, when sarcasm is used.
pros: Detect sarcasm flawlessly.
Good for autistic people.
Very useful when on the internet.
cons: If you are good at picking up on sarcasm, this is next to useless.
Nearly useless if you do not understand the means of communication.
Very limited number of possible uses.

name: The Mixed Beast
overview: summon the mixed beast
description: This beast has the mouth of a lion the feet of a bear and the body is leopards body it has wings of an eagle and the tail of a scorpion. This beast came out of the worst parts of hell "the abyss".
pros: This beast is very powerful
The user can ride this beast
cons: The mixed beast is vulnerable towards light and abilities with light
The user can only ride the beast when it knows how to control it
You can only summon 3 at a time and this beast is very hard to use

name: Gamerverse: Reality Glitch
overview: create and utilise glitches in reality
description: With this power, you perceive the laws of nature as merely sophisticated programming for the universe. With this power, you can create glitches in the fabric of reality. When activating this power, you can voluntarily dump excess 'coding' into any physical space you can see immediately. It will form a random law for that place that might shove you forward or back, teleport you, increase impetus, move people, etc. But it is random, so they may actually hinder you. The possibilities are limitless!
pros: Create a glitch in a part of reality that you can see.
Only YOU can be affected by these glitches.
Glitches stay in that part of space for only a couple of hours.
cons: Can only create a glitch in the part of reality that you can actually see with your eyes.
Glitches are random, so they might hinder your efforts.
Glitches might also be completely useless at that current time.

name: Restaurant Transformation
overview: turn any occupied building into a restaurant.
description: With this power, when you open a buildings door to enter, you can choose to transform it into a restaurant. Everyone inside is changed to reflect this, becoming waiters, chefs, entertainers, and other diners as the building's interior changes to reflect the fact that it is now a restaurant.   The theme, menu, and quality of the restaurant is determined by the type of building you've transformed, and the building returns to normal when you leave so there's no need to pay.
pros: Feed mostly everyone in a large building.
Always have acess to a restaurant, eat at a different place every night.
Dine and dash all you want, everyone forgets the restaurant the instant you're out the door.
cons: People who enter after you are not effected by the restaurant transformation.
All the time spent being a restaurant is just wasted time for the inhabitants of the building.

name: Lambs Cross
overview: slash at places where the users blood has touched
description: This ability allows the user to control the iron in their blood or limited capabilities, allowing them to create cuts, gashes and slashes at any place which their blood has come into contact with. The user may also be able to sharpen their blood into blades an other tools however this blood must remain connected to a flowing source therefore the blades can only be made on ones body however the incisions can be made at any distance as long as there is a sample of the users blood.
pros: Blades and other tools can be fashioned out of the iron content within the blood
Cuts, gashes, slashes and incisions can be made at any distance as long as their is blood about
User can control flow of their blood and can therefore not be affected by any form of drug or toxin
cons: Slashes, cuts, gashes and incisions can only be used when blood is around
If the user loses too much blood they will die
Blades and tools must be kept connected to a flowing blood source

name: Universal Reset
overview: reset the universe to a near-perfect replica of its current state.
description: With this power, one can reset the universe with all events still occurring in the same way. The only changes are to reality itself; certain people are no longer required to maintain reality, while people who imbued the entire universe with their consciousness are now once again vulnerable to destruction and everybody is capable of nonexistence.
pros: Repair damage to reality.
Neutralize certain individuals without danger.
Reality is not damaged in the process.
cons: Certain powers such as Reality Anchoring interfere with the normal action of this power.
Only works in your current universe.
Does not protect against anything such as destruction of reality.

name: Taper
overview: have an unlimited amount of tape that comes out of nowhere
description: A person with this power has the ability to materialize any type of tape they have seen and can manipulate it. For example, you can use the tape as a chain when coming out of the air or change it into a lifeline before falling into a hole. You can also materialize it in front of a person's mouth to stop them from talking. You can only materialize about 2 inches per second but through practice you can materialize up to 100 ft per second. Also, you can later materialize constructs of tape.
pros: You have unlimited amounts of tape
Duct tape is very durable and electrical tape is electric proof
Needs practice before becoming useful
cons: No tape armor--how would you get it off?
Has all the weaknesses of the respective tape that you are using

name: Turbo Sense
overview: feel any vehicle you're driving as a part of yourself
description: When you're driving a vehicle, you will feel it as a part of your body. You will feel its size, its speed, its power. You will be able to react faster and to drive expertly. Your power is compatible with all sorts of vehicles: cars, planes, submarines, spaseships, etc.
pros: Brand new sense, unique experiences!
You can drive more skillfully
cons: Crashes will be painful, even if your human body doesn't get injured.
You may feel some kind of absence when you stop driving.

name: 300 Reapers
overview: command 300 reapers to your will
description: You would have the ability to summon up 300 reapers to your will and make them do what ever you want....Anything!And you can call them back at anytime.
pros: Army of reapers to back up your buds
Make them do yardwork
You can take X number out of 300
cons: The maximum is 300
They might turn on you if you are not nice to them

name: Superfly Sabre
overview: use it to slash through any material and slice your foes.
description: The Superfly Sabre is made of an amalgamation of crystal and steel empowered by a golden glow with internal power that can slice through anything and slash your enemies with it. The Sabre so powerful it can slay 20,000 super villains in a single slash.
pros: It is a very cool sword to have.
Can't be used by evil beings. It instantly vaporizes any crook who try to posess it.
cons: None.

name: Entomokinesis
overview: manipulate certain kinds of insects.
description: The power to manipulate various forms of insects, such as bees or ants.  This allows you to control the  actions from individual insects to entire swarms.
pros: Excellent for defense if you have a swarm of hornets or wasps with you.
Seldom will need to worry about solving infestation problems.
Won't need to worry about being attacked by insects you can control.
cons: Cannot control all forms small life, such as arachnids.
May sometimes unknowingly control the actions of insects.
Cannot actually summon insects to defend you.

name: Archivist
overview: have all the powers of the legendary Archivists.
description: Archivists are masters over archives and libraries. They have control over book, scrolls, and paper in which they can manipulate them with spells to form attacks. Archivists can also archive things by trapping an object inside of a book or scroll. Archives and Libraries can be summoned by the Archivist as well allowing access to knowledge, protection, and resources for the Archivists powers. Archivists can also hush others to prevent them from passing on the knowledge archived in their brain.
pros: Have access to the wide range of Archivist spells.
Can archive objects, people, places, etc inside of your books and scrolls.
Mental access to the knowledge in your own archives.
cons: Archivists tend to be physically weak.
Your weapons of choice are a quill and inkpot.
If you are unable to gain access to paper you are considerably weaker.

name: Dinosaur Revival
overview: revive fossils dinosuars.
description: Just by touching the fossil or bone (it doesn't matter how many you have), you can bring the whole dinosuar back to life!
pros: You can bring fossils to life.
cons: The dino may accidentally eat you if it gets hungry.

name: Looks To Kill
overview: look at someone and kill them
description: If you stare at someone for longer than 5 seconds they will drop dead, peacefully.
pros: If you hate someone, it's easy to eliminate them
People will never be mean to you.
You can kill ANYTHING!
cons: You can't have staring comps
People will only like you so you won't kill them
You can't stare at someone you like.

name: Idea Nulllifying
overview: the cancel out the ideas of others and possibly one's own self.
description: With this ability one can cancel the ideas of others and possibly one's own ideas. One can cancel out a foe's idea to attack, an idea to escape, etc. If this power is developed, one can cancel out his/her own ideas such as, should one flee from opposition. This ability cannot be turned off.
pros: Stop your oppenents from attacking.
Cancel ideas for foes to escape.
Gain automatic confidence.
cons: To cancel one's own ideas takes years to develop.
If a foe is extremely strong willed, this ability will not work
Cancelled out good ideas of others

name: Hereditary Memory
overview: pass your memories to your offspring.
description: With this ability your children will know what you know. Your memories will be passed down to your children , the youngest knowing the most.
pros: This skill is hereditary.
Your children will be the smartest.
Save time on education.
cons: Only effects males.
Share the same personality.
Sibling rivalry.

name: Liquid Rain
overview: turn rain into any liquid
description: With this power you can cause rain to turn into any liquid. You can only use this power on actual rain not just any water. This power works even if the rain is already on the ground as a puddle. You cannot turn the liquid back into rain water.
pros: You can turn rain into any liquid
cons: It only works on rain

name: Theme Music
overview: create music based on what you're doing.
description: With this power, you can turn context-specific theme music on and off whenever you want. Everyone around you can hear it, but you can control the volume. However, it all depends on what you're doing at the moment, and changes dynamically with you. Fighting your arch-nemesis? Just turn on your theme music and you'll get an epic, dramatic score that would make John Williams jealous! It responds to everything that happens. ex: gain the upper hand in a fight, and it builds to a crescendo.
pros: Adds drama, comedy, suspense, etc. to any situation you find yourself in.
Music responds to exactly what you do.
All music is original, and therefore not subject to copyright law.
cons: Can annoy others if you abuse the power.
Not smart to use it while sneaking up on somebody.
Can possibly distract the user.

name: Yellow Dog
overview: become fueled by your own negative emotions.
description: Fear, anger, hate, violence. Let it out. Yellow Dog finds you at your most disturbed focusing your bad feelings into your body. Guiding you, while leeching your base emotions, inciting you to frenzied violence against foes, granting you enhanced strength, speed, agility & reflexes. Your senses are that of 10 dogs. You are immortal while the Yellow Dog is with you. Injuries are transferred to the dog, because the Yellow Dog likes the pain. Fear, anger, hate, violence. Let it out.
pros: Negative emotions feed your abilities allowing you to let out a burst of emotion on a target before,
You beat the target senseless. The more mean, rude or cruel you are to a foe the more power you get
10x the speed, strength, reflexes, agility of a normal human. 10x a dog's senses.
cons: The Yellow Dog is metaphysical, psionic powers can effect it and it's weakened by magic
You will probably have to be around someone you hate to ignite your powers
Hard to be a hero with this power. Yellow Dog makes you do bad things to people

name: Rise Of The Cerberus
overview: with this power you can turn into the giant three headed hell hound Cerberus
description: With this power you can turn into Cerberus, the giant three headed hellhound that guarded the underworld, in order to fight crime
pros: Three heads are better than two which are better than one
You have strong teeth and a loud bark (and you're superstrong and superdurable)
You are pretty darn scary
cons: You can't fit into small places (about the size of an elephant)
You might be mistaken for the real hell hound and attacked

name: Bloodline Extreme
overview: pass along almost everything about oneself to another by way of blood
description: Can pass along one's power, knowledge, body form(shapeshift for this), etc through way of having another being consume one's blood. The only thing not passed along is your personality. The biggest possible cost is that the person has to drink an amount of blood equal to 52% of the blood in their body. The blood can be up to one week old.
pros: All your power and knowledge get passed along.
Recipient can masquerade as you at boring meetings.
Blood doesn't have to be fresh.
cons: You're most likely going to die unless it's a baby (50% of blood gone from body means death).
Vampires will love this.

name: Aftermath
overview: damage your foe when they land a hit on you.
description: When your foe lands a hit on you, a small bit of damage is given to your opponent.
pros: You don't have to hit your opponent to damage them.
cons: The damage given is so small, it isn't even useful.
Only damages opponent when hit with a physical attack.

name: Drug Mimicry
overview: mimic the properties of illegal or medicinal drug.
description: This ability can make the user become a liquid or gaseous drug. He be able to help heal people or give them the user's own brand of steriods. The user can give or take away side effects of the drugs that he gives out. He can heal himself and pump himself with steriods without feeling any side effects.
pros: Have a liquid or gaseous form
Heal yourself and others of illness, pump them with steriod, or other drug uses.
Can give or take away side effects
cons: Since you are chemicals, you are effected by temperature.
Just for a joke, People might do commercials about not taking you.

name: Ehecatl, The Sky Cycle
overview: embody Ehecatl, the wind God, who can create winds so powerful, they'll move the sky and hearts.
description: When activated, you change into Ehecatl's priest outfit with its noticeable red face and giant mouth. In this form, you can blow extremely powerful winds and tornadoes. Your winds are so strong that, if you direct them towards the sky, you can affect the paths of the sun, the moon and the clouds. However, the stronger the wind you blow, the more energy is needed. You can also blow a symbolic wind, being able to stir up people's emotion and magnifying their affection for their loved ones.
pros: You can magnify love and affection in people's hearts.
You can create powerful winds and tornadoes you can use to fly and travel.
Your winds are so powerful, they can move the sky.
cons: You look ridiculous whenever you activate this power.
Creating powerful winds is very tiring for your body.

name: Cartoon Power: Mario
overview: have five lives
description: With this power, you have the amount of lives Mario generally starts off with: five. Meaning that when you die, you instantly come back to life right where you died.
pros: You have five lives
cons: If you get shot by a criminal and you come back to life where you died you will just get shot again

name: Mystic Honey
overview: create and control honey with special properties.
description: You create mystic honey at any moment and move it with your mind. The mystic honey has special properties that can cause people who eat it to feel healthier and stronger. The mystic honey can also speed up the healing process of wounds that it touches. The mystic honey is capable of acting as a shield by stopping objects from passing through it. The mystic honey is also always great tasting no matter what you put it on.
pros: The honey can heal wounds and improve health.
Can be used offensively by creating weapons or honey-bolts.
Can be used defensively by creating barriers.
cons: While you can stop the honey from healing foes, they can still get stronger by eating it.
Objects created out of honey are not the strongest.
The healing properties of the honey take time.

name: Double Vision
overview: make your opponent see doubles
description: Have your opponent look you directly in the eye and he will see a complete double of whatever he is looking at. Like Naruto's Shadow Clone, with double vision, you can create a living clone that can hurt you even if it isn't the real one. But if the person decides to attack the wrong one, then it doesn't affect you.
pros: Can really confuse your enamy
Good if you are dealing in hand-to-hand combat
cons: There is always a fifty-fifty chance of your opponant hitting you

name: Jobber Aura
overview: make people want to lose to you
description: A person with this power can make anyone purposely lose to them in any activity once. When used the other person somehow wants to lose to you for some given reason and they will forget the reason after they lose. This will always work--however this can only work against someone in a given activity only once.
pros: Beat people way stronger than you
Impress your friends
cons: Can only work against anyone or anything once for a given activity

name: Artifact Of Light: Valkyria
overview: summon a bow named Valkyria.
description: The bow is a very strong weapon on its own, and it further magnifies its power by allowing the user to shoot part of his/her soul along with the light arrow. Upon agreement, even a whole person can be turned into a arrow and shot out of Valkyria, for increased power or for any other reasons. A soul fragment returns to the user after being shot out as well as anyone turned into an arrow can revert back to human form at will.
pros: Can fire arrows at an insane speed.
Has great power, and is the strongest light alligned bow.
Good against anyone, great against demons and other light fearing beings.
cons: You could, but is nearly impossible to use if you are a dark being such as a demon.
Firing speed and power will be greatly reduced for dark ebing users.

name: Delete This Comet Kick
overview: fly across anywhere while glowing and connect on your opponent with a kick.
description: Using this power, you can charge up your left leg and foot with a fiery glow. Your kicks can now target your enemie's torso and break through glass and bricks unharmed.
pros: This is just a regular flying power!
cons: None.

name: Instant Trip Wire
overview: create trip-wires and link them to any trap you can think of.
description: From the tips of your fingers, you can cast thin, nearly invisible wires that can be stuck to any surface and linked to any trap you can think of. For example, you could string one across a hallway and mentally place a cluster of shurikens on the adjacent wall (these will be invisible until triggered). When your target trips the wire, the shurikens will be launched at high speed into them. Wires are unlimited, one trap per wire, and traps can be literally anything you can think of.
pros: Wires are nearly invisible, like spider's web, while traps are completely invisible until triggered.
You can place any trap you can think of.
Wires are indestructible, but disappear after being triggered.
cons: You can trigger your own traps.
in the right light, wires can be seen.
If your target reacts quickly enough, they can potentially escape the traps.

name: Myth Power: Power Of Perses
overview: channel Perses' command over the forces of destruction, pillaging and savagery
description: Perses, in Greek myth, was the god of savagery, pillaging, destruction and laying of waste. As such, channeling him allows one to exaggerate the weak points within a structure, to the point it will tear, break, crumble, collapse or otherwise come apart. In addition, the user becomes physically empowered by destruction NOT caused by him. The user can even psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel those who are naturally vicious, ferocious, fierce, savage or destructive.
pros: Destroy inorganic matter with a touch, a word or a thought (causing it to come apart, or the like)
Gain physical power from destruction that is not cause by you
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel vicious/ferocious/savage people
cons: Cannot disintegrate or vaporize matter with a touch until the HIGHEST levels (no Con Negation)
Cannot REVERSE or UNDO damage (Mending) until the higher levels
People with combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction based MythPowers are empowered by this ability

name: Hellish Banishment
overview: send someone's mind or body to his/her hell on earth
description: A person with this power does not have the ability to send someone to hell but they have something very similar. Everyone likely has been to a place that was very hellish and would not ever want to go there again. Well now you can send them to that exact time/place courtesy of this power. If the place does not exist anymore or has changed instead their mind gets tricked into replaying that scene until the user decides not to. If people get used to the hell, they will be sent to the next hell.
pros: You can send someone's mind to relive his hell on earth
You can send a person to their least favorite place in the world
You can talk to the person while they are in their hell
cons: If someone's life is already living hell then you can't send them anywhere
People can get used to hell over time, but then they will be sent to their next hellish place
If someone does not have the concept of hell

name: Splitting Shield
overview: make a long range attack split in two and hit the areas to the sides of one
description: In essence, this power makes a physical attack split in two so that the original target of the attack is standing in between both halves of the attack which then proceed on to hit up to two objects that are behind the original target.
pros: You won't get hurt by long-range attacks.
Normal shields needed only for close range attacks now in battles.
cons: Two people might get hurt because of you.
You have to concentrate on using this power, so snipers will still get you if you don't expect them.

name: Planar Compaction
overview: compact several planes of reality onto each other.
description: Also called Plane Merging, this ability grants the user the power to compact the planes of reality together. When any action is performed in a compacted area it affects ALL of the compacted planes. Beings that are in a compacted area also appear on all merged planes so extraplanar entities can come through. In addition due to the different nature of the planes when they merge reality can warp randomly. If uncontrolled, the users very presence will create areas of merged planes.
pros: Catch enemies on a different plane.
There is a possibility to cause extra planar entities to come to a different plane.
Cause the different planes to warp the reality of one another.
cons: Reality warps are random and uncontrollable.
There is no telling what kind of extra planar entity will come through if ANY.
If someone is just plain in another dimension.

name: Myth Power: Elpis' Elevation
overview: channel Elpis' command over the essence of hope and expectation
description: Elpis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of hope. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive subjects' hopes, wishes and dreams, their likelihood and how to achieve them, at will. In addition, one can gain physical power and sustenance in the presence of hopeful subjects. One can also psychically cast illusions of subjects' hopes, wishes and dreams, at will. One can even psychically induce a powerful physical and/or mental backlash in subjects hoping for one's misfortune, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive subjects' hopes/wishes/dreams (likelihood, how to achieve them, etc), at will
Gain physical power and sustenance in the presence of optimists, at will
Psychically cast illusions of hopes, backlash foes' negative hopes as physical/mental pain, at will
cons: Cannot psychically backlash foes' negative hopes as matching misfortune, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel optimists, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Pandora's Box provides power from this ability (NCN)

name: Summoning Specialty
overview: summon something with a power that normally does something else
description: With this power whenever you use a power that doesn't normally summon something, you can instead choose to summon something based on the power's normal effect. Ex: 'Pyrokinesis' could summon a salamander, a phoenix, etc. 'Wolves to Werewolves' could summon wolves or werewolves.
pros: You now have another choice on how to use each individual power.
You can control what you summon if you want to.
cons: What you summon with a normally nonsummoning power is random.
Exception con 1: : "Rise of..." powers will summon what you would have transformed into.
Exception con 1: MythPowers: the channelled god.

name: I Can Hear You V2
overview: be able to hear any conversation that is about you
description: With this power you will automatically be able to listen to any conversation that is about or in reference to you. The people talking do not even have to mention your full name for you to be able to listen in. You can turn this power on and off.
pros: You will be able to listen in on any conversation that is about you
The speakers do not even have to mention your name
You can turn this power on and off
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Xianyang Theory
overview: know where your enemies are at all times
description: With this power you can know where any of your enemies are at all times. All you have to is say their name out loud and instantly you will know where they are. This power works for anybody you don't like anybody you've ever fought against or anybody who is competing against you.
pros: You can know where any of your enemies are at all times
cons: You have to speak their name out loud for it to work

name: Myth Power: Lethe's Legacy
overview: channel Lethe's command over the essence of forgetfulness, oblivion and the Underworld River Lethe
description: Lethe, in Greek myth, was the goddess of oblivion (forgetfulness and forgottenness) and Lethe, the Underworld River of Oblivion. As such, channeling her allows one to wipe memories with a touch, a word or a thought. In addition, one can withstand the same effects, unless one DESIRES to forget unwanted/unneeded experiences. Furthermore, one has access to an extradimensional Lethe Space; it contains the user's forgotten memories, as well as lost memories of his allies, and anyone else he touches.
pros: Psychically wipe memories with a touch, a word or a thought
Withstand mermory wiping and memory loss (natural or otherwise) unless one DESIRES to forget
Psychically access (and/or travel to) a Lethe Space, which contains lost/forgotten/wiped memories
cons: Only banish foes to the Underworld River Lethe by touch/word/thought when developed (NCN)
Once banished to the River Lethe, foes' memories are completely forgotten (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Flutter Jump
overview: flutter jump
description: With this power you can flutter jump. Meaning that when you jump you can stay in the air longer and propel yourself farther if you start flapping your arms around.
pros: You can flutter jump
cons: You look like an idiot when you flutter jump

name: App Power: Temple Run
overview: channel the power of the endless chase in Temple Run
description: This ability gives you the powers of the popular game Temple Run. With the power of the runner, you have unlimited stamina and enhanced agility. A convenient path will appear to take you wherever you need to go, even space. You can also summon temporary boosts such as shields or speed. Finally, you can summon Cuchanck, the guardian of the temple. This monster will pursue your enemies, forcing them to run or face the beast's wrath. If Cuchanck catches his quarry he will bring them to you.
pros: No need to eat or drink or sleep
You can run anywhere, be faster than a jet, protect yourself from any attack, or summon money
Cuchanck is virtually impossible to escape or defeat, so your target can only run
cons: Some super powers may allow people to escape Cuchanck
You can only sustain Cuchanck for a limited time, up to 12 hours. Boosts are even shorter
Can't run underwater or in space until higher levels

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Seraphim
overview: become the highest ranking angel in heaven.
description: The Seraphim, also known as "the burning ones", have six wings in total; two covering their faces, two covering their bodies (feet), and two with which they fly. As a Seraph, the light emanating from you is so bright that not even angelic beings or anything else can look upon you. Your primary abilities consist of utilizing pure light as your weapon.
pros: Ward off demonic armies and other forces of darkness.
Vanquish and repel foes with the power of light.
Strike down enemies with blinding light.
cons: You are still susceptible to harm and damage from higher demonic beings.

name: Ivory Axe
overview: use it to unleash a powerful swing & slice your enemies.
description: The ivory axe is a mystical materialistic weapon to be used for blunt damage and is nearly indestructible. Can Swirl it about 440 degrees around you, converting into a blunt force melee weapon or as a throwing weapon. It can also fire an energy blast of fire or ice. It could also manipulate magnetic fields, allowing the user to deflect incoming gunfire back at attackers.
pros: It is immune to evil acts if that means it can't crave blood.
It can cut through any substance.
cons: None.

name: Heat Mouth
overview: blow super hot air from your mouth
description: Everyone has heard about Supermans ice breath, but what about heat breath? Heat breath is different from fire because it is super heated air rather than flame. The temperature of the heat can range from average human temperatures to metal melting heats but does not harm the user because the heat only triggers once the breath leaves the user's mouth and is surrounded by oxygen. This power doesn't increase the user's lung capacity.
pros: Able to melt most metals known to man
Powerful and useful - can heat up water etc
You can fly by being your own hot air ballon
cons: Using on humans can cause them to smell horrible
Running out of breath high in the air being a hot air ballon

name: Old One Power: Cthulhu
overview: channel the power of the Great Old One Cthulhu
description: Cthulhu, the mightiest of the Old Gods slumbering on Earth. The green, squid-headed, dragon-winged reality-distorting sanity-shattering abomination grants you a portion of his power. With it, you have perfect control over dreams and tentacled sea creatures (squids and octopi). You can also sort of control people, by sending them dreams giving them an order, and then showing them the twisted geometry of Cthulhu's sunken city, horrifying them into obedience.
pros: Dream control powers for communication and control. And squids, whatever that's worth.
You will reincarnate as the first Star Spawn born after his awakening.
If the most horrifying possible armageddon comes to pass (Old Ones returning), you will be safe.
cons: If Cthulhu himself didn't grant this power, he gets angry. Dreams and afterlife are unending pain.
Overtime, you start to dislike the laws of reality more and more, and become extremely malevolent.
Any attempts at finding your alignment via unnatural means always turns up "Ultimate Evil. "

name: Myth Power: Honor Of The Ourea
overview: channel the Ourea and their command over the essence of mountains and mountain life
description: The Ourea, in Greek myth, were the gods and goddesses of mountains. As such, channeling them allows one to selectively perceive present and future weather conditions on any mountain throughout the Cosmos. One may also use this power to psychically perceive the layout of any mountain at will (including caves, tunnels, volcanic faults, etc within that mountain). In addition, one may teleport to any mountain at will, and one's attributes are enhanced as long as one is on (or inside of) a mountain.
pros: Knowledge of any mountain in existence (location, layout, present/future weather conditions, etc. )
Teleport to any mountain at will
Stats (strength, durability, reflexes, etc) are enhanced for as long as you are on a mountain
cons: Cannot alter a mountain's weather until the higher levels (NCN)
Not every mountain is habitable
Pro #3 gets weaker the further you are from the mountain peak (NCN)

name: Board Game Battle
overview: bring objects from board games.
description: With this power, the user may bring any object from any board game, eg. The tokens from Monopoly, or some Hungry Hungry Hippos.
pros: Can bring objects from board games
cons: Can only bring things from board games
Can't bring things from board games that the user hasn't played

name: Artifact Of Light: Angel's Eye
overview: summon Angel's Eye.
description: Angel's Eye looks like a crystal ball on a chain, with wings around it. Worn on the neck, it allows the user to use any skills that manifest in one's eyes, such as future sight or laser vision.
pros: Many different skills.
Protects the user's eyes from any harm such as blinding.
cons: Can only be summoned for so long, before disappearing for a recharge.

name: Myth Power: Graces' Grandeur
overview: channel the Charites' command over the essence of glory and reputation
description: These Charites (Kharites, Graces), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of fame, fortune and glory. As such, channeling Eupheme (Praise), one gains physical power from every compliment or word of praise/encouragement that one receives. Channeling Eucleia (Eukleia- Good Repute), one can psychically spread (or wipe subjects' minds of) rumor/scandal about self/others at will. Channeling Euthenia (Wealth, Prosperity), one can psychically transform property into their proper monetary value with a touch.
pros: Become physically more powerful (stronger, etc) with every compliment (even if they only think it)
Psychically spread (or wipe subjects' memories of) embarrassing rumors and scandals at will
Psychically exchange property for its monetary value (ie touch a car, instantly get thousands back)
cons: Cannot "trade reputations" with others by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Pheme's Feat provides immunity to Pro #2 (NCN)
MythPower: Plutos' Bounty and MythPower: Tryphe's Trifle make Pro #3 useless (NCN)

name: Paper Sharpening
overview: slice with a simple sheet of paper
description: This power enables you to sharpen and harden the edges of any sheet of paper, rendering it able to cut through any material. The paper remains sharp as long as you keep concentrating on it.
pros: Because it's been hardened, the paper can be used as a throwable weapon.
Anything made of paper becomes deadly in your hands.
cons: Beware of paper cuts!

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours01)
overview: channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Auge (Daybreak), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, wake up feeling rejuvenated and gain physical power at daybreak. One can psychically generate light from the eyes to see in the dark, at will. One can psychically teleport through darkness, as an entity of light, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate, wake up refreshed and gain physical power at daybreak
Psychically generate light from eyes to see in the dark, teleport through shadows as entity of light
cons: Cannot psychically induce wakefulness (allies) or drowsiness (foes), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to any location where it is daybreak, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically time travel to past/future daybreaks, until developed (NCN)

name: Steampunk Battle Armor
overview: equip your body with a Steampunk Battle Armor
description: The user is able to equip his or her body with a steampunk battle armor. This battle armor runs purely on highly compressed steam generated from a special type of coal that can generate heat for a good week. The armor is made up of an element that is a combination of brass and an unknown like element. However, the armor is not invulnerable.
pros: Has two shoulder mounted gatling gun when brought out of slot
Can fire hot compressed steam
Can fly due top steam power
cons: No match for powerhouses
Weaponry is a tad obsolete

name: Hellfire
overview: create and control a fire that burns the soul as well as the body
description: This flame has an orange-reddish color and burns the victim's soul while it is burning the body as well. This power can only be gained by way of full mastery of 'Ghostly Pyrokinesis'.
pros: Anyone killed by this power cannot be reincarnated because their soul has been destroyed.
cons: Do not burn yourself with this flame. EVER.

name: Swan Song
overview: use a subject's voice as a kill-switch
description: In legends, a swan is thought to be mute for its entire life, except right when it is about to die, when it emits a lovely song called the Swan Song. One with this ability imitates this effect on a foe. The user closes the subject's mouth and programs vital organs with a psionic "kill-switch" function linked to the voice. So the next time the subject speaks, the vital organs automatically shut down at the same time, causing the subject to die a fairly quick, but painful, and irreversible, death.
pros: Force a foe to be silent for the rest of his life, or DIE
Works on nearly any species (even non-divine immortals)
The effect can be undone at will
cons: Can only be undone by the actual one who uses it, and cannot be undone if the subject dies
Does not affect undead, extradimensional entities or divinities
Mimesis (Mime Power) or natural muteness renders the ability moot

name: Satisfaction Manipulation
overview: change the feeling of hunger or thirst in another being
description: You can emit an invisible beam that changes how much hunger or thirst the affected beings feel.  The effect fades away after some time.  Unless you reapply or remove it.
pros: Increase the thirst or hunger of the clients. More profit for the bar or restaurant.
Remove the hunger of predators that want you as a meal.
Make your guests appreciate your food even more.
cons: Your targets could overconsume when eating/drinking doesn't satisfy.

name: Thirteen Treasures: The Horn
overview: wield the horn of Bran Galed
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin, the demon-wizard. The horn will fill, on command with any drink desired.
pros: Rehydration station!
Get drunk with all your friends for free!
cons: If somebody takes control of your body, they could make you summon poison.

name: Iron Tiger Armor
overview: wear an near indestructible tiger themed armor
description: The person with this suit of armor will be able to fly, shoot focused laser beams, missiles as well as use the armor's advance H. U. D. Interface to hack into security systems, scan for life signs, give tactical suggestions as well as give a status report on armor's statuts and prevent the suit's system from being hacked into. The suit is colored black and yellow.
pros: Able to combat most threats
Cannot be hacked
cons: Susceptible to EMP blast
Replacement parts might be hard to come by

name: Toy Gun Affect
overview: turn anything into a harmless toy.
description: Simply point and fire (well not quite). Toy-gun Affect allows you to change an object, such as a gun like an AK-47 into the toy version of that same object, such as a squirt gun that resembles an AK-47, from a distance without having to actually touch the object (of course it has to be within vision). If used on a vehicle such as a car the passengers will be teleported automatically out of the vehicle before "toyification" of said vehicle. The toy state of the object only lasts one hour however.
pros: Make any weapon useless
Fun for the whole family XD
Can be used from a distance (that's why it's the Toy-GUN Affect) and not just if touched.
cons: Ineffective on people or animals
Only stays a toy for 1 hour before changing back
Not reversible (turning a toy such as a toy sword into a katana)

name: Card Wielder
overview: control cards
description: A Card Wielder has the ability to use cards as a weapon. He/she can levitate cards and shoot them at another enemy. There isn't a certain amount, pertaining to you shooting them out of your fist. They are used also to help you move around, if necessary. The cards also have a mind of their own, doing task that the Card Wielder has told them to do.
pros: Uses as a weapon
Doing task so the master has less work
Moving around advantages
cons: Not always loyal
Makes you weak after using too long
Not too strong

name: Reaper   Sickles
overview: use it to fire slashing projectiles.
description: The reaper sickles are totally razor sharp with chains linking between them, you can throw it at your foe and it will home in onto your opponent and it will spin around you, charge it and fire energy waves & dispense electric stun shocks from the blades. Can even grab the opponent and hit them onto the sickles which pull through them.
pros: Those have incredible range and last a longer time.
cons: None.

name: 32 Gb Memory
overview: have a 32 GB memory storage in the user's brain.
description: The user has a 32 GB memory chip in their head that can only be used to absorb knowledge that has to do with human history, scientific breakthroughs, government files, top secret government files, scientific files as well as military strategies. The user can't absorb knowledge that is deemed unnecessary to the survival of the human knowledge. The download is done with a special neural link headset that is linked to a computer, using the bluetooth or USB port.
pros: A living repository of human knowledge
A source of wisdom and information for other people
cons: Can't fight with this power
Ambiguous which cultural info is "necessary"

name: Bravery
overview: be truly brave
description: Bravery is not the absence of fear, but the acknowledgment and conquering of it. One with this power, after facing their fear and mentally conquering it, will truly conquer it. Say your worst fear is fire. You must first face it, then conquer it(saving someone from a fire, remaining calm alone in the middle of a fire, etc. Only then will you be able to control fire and be totally immune to its effects.
pros: Mastering fear
Finding true bravery
cons: Must first face your fear, and conquer it (which isn't always a bad thing, but is always difficult)

name: Parasol Knight
overview: use a selected parasol and wind manipulation to perform various actions.
description: A parasol is given to the recipient of this ability. It is virtually indestructible and doesn't flip inside out with strong winds. It grants the recipient the ability to manipulate the direction and strength of wind, and their own density to move with the parasol. The parasol is able to shoot energy beams from the tip. The power is dependent on the happiness level of the user.
pros: Control the wind to be able to move and dodge seemlessly with the wind, and even fly.
The parasol is virtually indestructible, and can also be used as a shield or a blunt weapon.
It's pretty sneaky, no one would think of a parasol as a weapon.
cons: The control of the wind is limited to a small perimeter around the user, typically not offensive.
The strength of the energy beams are completely dependent on happiness. No joy, no power.
The user and the parasol are connected. However, if it's lost, the powers are lost.

name: Craft Greater Semivif
overview: craft greater semivif servants.
description: You get craft material with this power by painlessly removing pieces of yourself by hand. Any lost pieces grow back in an hour. After this regrowth, you can start again. The semivif you make look like mannequins made of your guts and organs. They have your intelligence and are only affected by damage or powers if you are affected by damage or powers. You can have the invulnerability power and use this power. Any regeneration power will make the regrowth time for this power a second, not an hour.
pros: These semivif can't be affected by anything unless you are first.
This power works with invulnerability.
cons: If you're psionically stunned, all your semivif will be too.

name: Meteor Call
overview: call a meteor from space to come hurdling towards the earth.
description:
Its name says it all 'Meteor Call'
Summon a meteor from outer space like the asteroid belt and cause it to come hurdling towards the earth.
Also you can call as many meteors as you want.
pros: Can call as many meteors as you want.
Can cause the meteor to land on whoever you want.
cons: Might get crushed under the meteors weight.

name: Minus Splicer
overview: split anyone into male and female halves
description: You have the ability to separate one person you touched, causing them to be separated into two different beings (one's male and one's female).
pros: You might find a male or female counterpart attractive.
cons: You could find a male or female counterpart unattractive.

name: Ban Hammer
overview: summon the almighty BAN-HAMMER
description: When activated, the Ban-hammer will appear in your hand. It is able to perma-ban everyone it touches. You can perma-ban them from everything, even from using the bathroom.
pros: Ban anyone
Ban them from everything
cons: Might accidentally touch a loved one

name: Insect Symbiosis
overview: use insects that is stored inside the user's body
description: These insects are stored in the user's body and have a symbiotic relationship with the user. The user , houses the insects in exchange for the insects obeying the user's commands
pros: Can use insects for offense and defense
cons: The symbiosis relationship might become a parasitic one if the user becomes to weak
Insects are easily defeated by fire

name: Acidbase Conversion
overview: convert any object to either an acid or a base.
description: You can convert any object into an acid or a base on contact.
pros: Can make explosions
Can turn air into acid and target into base
Unlimited salt
cons: Useless at long range combat
Accidents could be fatal
Useless against guns

name: Astral Law: Gungnir's Point
overview: take out Odin's mythical spear Gungnir from the MantraPlane
description: The user is allowed to take out Gungnir, Odin's supreme spear. The spear generates a gauntlet of the hand on which it's held. It has the ability to fire gravitational beams that have the effect the user wants (e. G. The user can fire a gravotational beam that crushes the opponent to the ground using gravity or sends them up into the atmosphere where they die of lack of oxygen. The user can also fire small pods that have the same effects. Gungnir can also act as a compass for places or for energy
pros: One has probably the best compass in the world.
One can transfer the effects of hieghtened or lessens gravity onto the opponent
One can have a portable powerful weapon
cons: The gravitational effects wear of after some time
Since all of the user's mantra is on controlling Gungnir, the user is quite weak to physical attacks
Gungnir is a long range weapon and is not nearly as good in close range

name: Beauty's Scythe
overview: wield the scythe of beautiful death
description: Ever heard of how death is beautiful well this scythe lives to the name it grants the wielder incredible beauty and power. Though this scythe kills someone in a very beautiful way like the person will explode into flowers.
pros: Can great beauty
Death is immortal
Do become death itself
cons: Can only kill people who are meant to die
When all life dies so do you
Only the scythe's wielder get this power

name: Card Master
overview: choose what cards you get on card games
description: This is good for a gambler, you just think about what you want, then you get it, and a bonus is that you can master the art of cards, which includes card throwing, sleight of hand and other card tricks you know!
pros: You dont need a poker face
Good money-making ability
Works on cards you personally have made
cons: Doesnt work on fake cards other people have made
You can be blamed for cheating if you get the same card everytime

name: Blast From The Past
overview: relive 20 minutes of your past once each day.
description: With this ability, you can relive 20 minutes from your past once each day. You can't change the future with this ability--you can only experience 20 minutes of something you did. Whatever changes you make during your trip back will not become a reality after the 20 minutes is over.
pros: Experience something really enjoyable over and over.
Find out the truth about something that once happened.
You can do whatever you want for 20 minutes; they will be reverted after that!
cons: Don't use this to relive the worst 20 minutes of your life, unless you're masochistic.
You can't change the past with this power alone.
You can't travel to the future.

name: Eye Of Balor
overview: use the powerful eye of Balor
description: Balor was a giant in Celtic mythology with an eye that could kill anyone he looked at. When you receive this power, one of your eyes becomes infused with this mighty ability. Once gained, the eye of Balor becomes permanent and is always active. The eye gives you the strength, endurance and stamina of a 50-foot tall giant and the ability to turn any organism to ash by focusing your eye on it.
pros: Turn your enemies to ash
Superhuman strength, endurance and stamina
Works on any living person or animal big enough for you to see
cons: You will have to wear an eye patch or something to keep from accidentally killing things
The victim must be in your direct line of sight (you can't use it through opaque solids)
The farther away the organism is, the more concentration it takes

name: Lizard Tail Effect
overview: only have a part of your body affected by certain powers.
description: If you have this power and someone with TK tries to grab you, the only thing they're grabbing is a single hair on your head. If you're immortal and someone with Iapetos' Scorn tries to take away your immortality, all they'll affect in you is a single cell in your body. The same thing with powers that would erase you from reality or total destruction powers that directly target your body. You regrow any lost parts. Yes, a foe grabbing your arm and not letting go would cause you to lose your arm.
pros: Some powers only target a part of you which you can afford to lose.
Powers that use stickiness will trigger this power.
There are many powers that work like the ones mentioned in the description.
cons: You will need a power like teleportation if you're reduced to a human torso.

name: Leap Of Faith
overview: use others' powers if they trust you
description: With this power you can use anyone's power(s) for an hour. The catch is that they have to say "I trust you."  Also, that person can't use their power in that hour.
pros: No limit to the number of powers you can have
Can have any power
Takes the person's power for an hour (good for use on bad guys)
cons: Person with power must say "I trust you" (tricky for use on bad guys).
Leaves person powerless.
Very corny to say. (:

name: Myth Power: Eleos' Empathy
overview: channel Eleos' command over the essence of mercy, pity and compassion
description: Eleos (Eleus), in Greek myth, was the goddess of mercy, pity, compassion, empathy, sympathy and forgiveness. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive others' emotions, or show others one's own emotions (as the case calls for it) in order to show, or be shown, pity, compassion or mercy. In addition, one may perceive those who are naturally unmerciful, and harm them by a touch. One can even shapeshift into a cute and cuddly form that subjects find so cute that it is impossible to do harm to.
pros: Perceive the emotions of others, and show others one's own emotions (to gain, or better show, mercy)
Perceive the merciless/insensitive/unforgiving and harm them by a touch
Shapeshift into a form (of one's choosing) so cute/cuddly, people will defend/refuse to harm it
cons: Only perceive emotion to better show mercy; only project emotion to receive mercy (NCN)
Only heal subjects (or kill them painlessly as an act of mercy) by touch at the higher levels
MythPower: Anaideia's Anger provides immunity

name: Power Burning
overview: create a flame that can only burn other powers
description: Be careful with this as it can burn only powers and does not differentiate between an ally's power and an enemy's power. Also do not let it touch you if you have Superhuman Strength or another power like that as it will burn the power and hurt as though 100 spikes have pierced your skin. To gain this power you must have had your powers negated 1000 times within one week.
pros: Burn a curse to get permanently get rid of it.
It still will hurt if you touch the flame despite the fact that it won't burn the skin.
cons: Warning: Do NOT use on a magical item that you want to use.
Gaining this power is somewhat comical for your enemies until you gain it.
When destroying a magical weapon's power, the weapon itself will also be destroyed.

name: Quintesson Summon
overview: summon any Quintesson
description: With this power you can summon any Quintesson and have them be under your complete control. You can summon Quintesson scientists to create things for you or Quintesson Executioners to kill people for you etc. When you're done with them you can send them back.
pros: You can summon any Quintesson
They are under your complete control
cons: They can be killed

name: Hepatocyte Mimicry
overview: have all the equivalent abilities of liver cells, known as hepatocytes.
description: Hepatocytes Mimics really have a huge number of abilities. The main ones are the abilities to store sugar inside their body, to neutralize various toxic subtances, such as alcohol or drugs, to produce bile (a fat solvent), to create duplicates at a extremely rapid rate, to manipulate cholesterol and to regulate cholesterol levels in other people. They can also gain or give new abilities in the vicinity of other Cellular Mimics. For example, Thrombocyte Mimics will produce sticky ropes.
pros: You have a wide panel of abilities. Check other Cellular Mimic pages for more.
Your duplication ability is extremely fast, near instantaneous.
You can heal people and may give them new powers if they are Cellular Mimics.
cons: You can heal other people very effectively, but you can heal yourself only at a much slower rate.
A less cool ability is to convert ammonia into urea.

name: 2 For The Show V2
overview: project any episode from any TV show onto any flat surface
description: With this power you can project any episode from any TV show from your eyes onto any flat surface. All you have to do is say the name of the episode and the name of the TV show.
pros: You can project any episode from any TV show onto any flat surface
cons: Only works for TV show for movies please see Movie Projector

name: Minotaur Summon
overview: summon the minotaur
description: With this power you can summon the mighty minotaur from Greek Mythology. When you summon it the Minotaur is under your complete control and you can make it do whatever you want. The minotaur has super strength and has sharp horns which can be used to impale enemies.
pros: You can summon the minotaur
It is under your complete control
It is super strong and has long sharp horns which can be used to impale enemies
cons: The minotaur eats humans so feeding it could be a problem
There is only one so if it dies this power is useless

name: Cybear Summon
overview: summon Cybears
description: With this power you can summon as many Cybears as you want. The bears are under your complete control and have super strength and durability and they can shoot lasers from their eyes. You can unsumon them when you're done.
pros: You can summon an army of Cybears
They are under your complete control
You can unsummon them when you're done
cons: They can be destroyed

name: Anti Space Generation
overview: generate and propel Anti-Space parrticle spheres
description: Anti-Space, although similar to anti-matter, has different properties. Anti-Space atoms teleport any of it's atoms that contact any other types of atoms to a random point in space light-years away from itself.
pros: Powerful and deadly
Effective shield
cons: Can't make spheres to large for possibility of contact with yourself
Takes time to generate spheres

name: Math: Evil Negative Squared
overview: change a person from evil
description: When you negatively square a negative integer, the result is positive. So, -4 by -4 equals positive 16. With this power, the same rule applies, except negative is evil and positive is good. When facing an evil person, activating this power will bring forth an exact replica of this person. They will both look the same, act the same, and will both be the same amount of evil. Then they will merge in a blinding flash of light, and their alignment will change from evil to good. They are now positive.
pros: Change the alignment of an evil person to good.
They will feel happier, without feeling the urge to slaughter innocents
Maths is AWESOME!
cons: This is more a hero power. Sorry to disappoint the villains
It is largely irreversible.

name: Artifact: Tengu No Kakuremino
overview: summon a cloak that can let you travel to a different dimension.
description: When you say "Adeat", a cloak appears. This cloak allows you (and others) to travel to a different plane of reality. In this plane, is a house complete with a kitchen.
pros: Has camouflage so enemies don't notice it.
More than one person can enter.
You control who gets in and out.
cons: No combat purposes.

name: Outfit Conjuring
overview: create any outift you can think of
description: Did you ever want an outfit from the mall that was just to expensive.Well, with this power, you can create with with only the power of your mind. Not only can you conjure it on your body, but your friends body too.
pros: Create any outfit you want
Always a perfect fit
Make even the most exotic things
cons: You'll miss shopping at the mall

name: Opposite Personality
overview: change the personality of a person to the exact opposite.
description:
This ability you can change the personality of a person to be the exact and direct opposite.
E.g a shy and quiet person becomes talkative and loud.
However you can not change what they are feeling or emotion only their personality. You can't make an upset person happy.
pros: Give shy people a confidence boost.
Effect of ability can be reversed. (Just use it a second time. duh!)
cons: Behavioural changes in opposing personality can cause person to take devasting actions.

name: Memory Limit
overview: make a person only able to remember 3 things at a time
description: When this ability is activated, the person's memories of last week are wiped and the person is now only able to remember 3 new things at a time besides subconscious acts like breathing.   When the target wants to remember something new they will have to forget about the first thing they learned.   This power can be used on yourself and can be deactivated only by you.
pros: Your opponents will be severely limited in capacity
If you fill their head with irrelevant information you can mess with them
cons: Trying to explain something to a person you accidentally used this on
Notebooks or writing in hand

name: Mental Photo Editing
overview: take and edit photos with your brain
description: With this power you can take a picture every time you blink and then edit the photo in your mind. You can end captions, change the colors of things, photoshop things into the image, add speech bubbles, crop it, erase the redeye etc. You can then transfer the image to any computer you want. You can turn this power on and off so you don't take a picture every time you blink.
pros: You can take and edit photos with your brain
You can send the pictures to any computer in the world
cons: Not much use in physical combat
If you don't send the pictures to a computer eventually your brain will become cluttered

name: Trees To Ents And Vice Versa
overview: turn trees into Ents and Ents into trees
description: With this power you can turn trees into mythical tree monsters called Ents. The Ents are not under your control but may help you after much debilitating with the council. You can use this power on as many trees as you want and you can even turn Ents other than the ones you created into normal non monstrous trees.
pros: You can turn trees into Ents
You can turn Ents into trees
cons: The Ents are not under your control

name: Omnidroid Summon
overview: summon the Omnidroid
description: With this power you can summon the Omnidroid from The Incredibles. The Omnidroid is under your complete control and can shoot lasers, crush things, cut things in half, turn into a ball and run over things and more.
pros: You can summon the Omnidroid
It is under your complete control
cons: It can be destroyed (it's hard but it can be done)

name: Owl Mimicry
overview: mimic the skills of an owl
description: With this power you can mimic the skills of an owl. You have excellent night vision, you can fly, you can grow a sharp beak, you can turn your hands into talons and mice have automatically have a fear of you.
pros: You can mimic the skills of an owl
You can fly
Mice won't come near you
cons: You prefer to be up at night and sleep all day

name: Voice Swap
overview: trade voices with anyone else
description: With this power you can trade voices with any other person. Once you steal their voice you will sound exactly like them and they will sound exactly like you. You do not have to be near the person for this power to work. You will not gain their speaking mannerisms and if they know how to speak other languages you will not learn them by using this power. You will however gain their accent with their voice.
pros: You can trade voices with any other person
cons: You do not gain their speaking mannerisms or knowledge of other languages
You cannot switch other people's voices you can only switch your own with someone else's

name: Power Boomerang
overview: automatically have this ability come back to you if it is stolen or taken away.
description: This power is great against power stealers. If they steal it from you, it returns to you and... That's pretty much it. It does nothing else... No, really. It only gives you the power to have this power return to you if it is stolen or taken away. It can still be mimicked though... Or destroyed... Or willingly discarded if you want to get rid of it. Otherwise, there's nothing much you can do with it... B-but it cannot be stolen or tak-, oh wait, I already wrote that, didn't I?
pros: This power cannot be stolen or taken away from you! Yeah!
If someone mimics this power, they will end up with an unstealable power that does nothing!
If it's cancelled to prevent its return, it will return to you the second the cancellation stops.
cons: This power cannot be stolen or taken away from you and that's it.
It does nothing else.
It can still be mimicked, deleted, discarded, etc.

name: Super Squad: Extra Vision
overview: see cosmic and magic powers around you.
description: See cosmic powers, like that of the Silver Surfer, and magic, like that of Doctor Strange. Owned by fictional superhero "Vision".
pros: Can see cosmic and magic powers.
Can see if the cosmic or magic power is good or evil.
Can absorb it if it's a weak enough magic.
cons: It feels as if your eyes are in chlorine.
Blind to all other things.
You go blind for ten seconds after using it.

name: You're Heat Resistant
overview: make people heat resistant
description: With this power you can make people heat resistant (no snapping required). They will not get sun burns or be able to be hot even if they want to. They can still be burned by fire or lava however. You cannot make yourself heat resistant with this power.
pros: You can make others heat resistant
cons: You cannot make yourself heat resistant with this power
You cannot make them fireproof or lavaproof

name: Myth Power: Astrape's Assault
overview: channel Astrape's command over the essence of lightning
description: Astrape, in Greek myth, was the goddess of lightning. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive, generate and manipulate electricity at will. In addition, one can conduct electricity, as well as absorb electricity to gain physical power. Furthermore, one can look at lightning strikes to psychically divine past, present or future, at will. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who fear lightning, as well as teleport to the site of lightning strikes.
pros: Psychically perceive, generate, manipulate, conduct and absorb electricity
Watch lightning strikes to psychically divine the past, present and future
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel those who fear lightning
cons: Cannot assume a form of living electricity (Electrical Mimicry) until developed (NCN)
Cannot call lightning down from the sky until developed (NCN)
Electrokinesis, Electrical Immunity, MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and the like provide immunity (NCN)

name: Life Force Sacrifice
overview: donate some of your life force in order to amplify powers and talents.
description: With this power you are able to amplify your powers, but in order for them to experience greater power some of your life-force must be sacrificed, power is measured in 6 months (1/2 years), so this amount of time is subtracted from years to live.
pros: Powers are greatly amplified.
cons: If Immortal, you can not use this (No con negation)
You will die sooner.

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes5
overview: channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling Himeros (Himerus- Sexual Desire, Longing and Yearning), one can perceive and manipulate sexual desire (for reasons other than producing offspring) within others. In addition, one can direct the focus of a subject's sexual desire to anyone --or anyTHING-- one wants. One can even psychically compel (and do enhanced damage against) subjects when they naturally experience the sexual urge.
pros: Psychically perceive and manipulate a subject's desire to pleasure themselves sexually
Psychically direct a subject's affections to anyone --or anything-- one desires
Psychically compel (and do enhanced damage against) subjects naturally experiencing a sexual urge
cons: Cannot psychically gravitate or repulse attractive/attracted subjects until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Myth Power: Apolausis' Applause
overview: channel Apolausis' command over the essence of enjoyment, pleasure and delight
description: Apolausis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of pleasure, enjoyment and delight (in an entertainment/fun sense). As such, channeling her allows one to gain numerous entertainment skills. In addition, one can psychically entrance subjects, immobilizing them in awe of one's performances, at will. Furthermore,one can psychically induce pleasant, happy sensations, by touch. One can even psychically rewind time and memory, at will, by clapping, making subjects relive previous actions and experiences.
pros: Gain numerous entertainment skills (acrobatics, juggling, dancing, singing, stage magic, etc)
Psychically entrance subjects with one's performances; induce pleasant, happy sensations by touch
Induce a 'psychic encore' (reversal of time/memory) of a subject's experiences, by applauding them
cons: Cannot cast an illusion of (or gain physical power from) cheering/applause until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain power from others' natural smiles, laughs and happiness until developed (NCN)
Humor/entertainment-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Eater
overview: devour every person, weapon, place or thing related to Myth, Legends
description: There must be balance. As the Myth-Eater, you devour anything that relates to Myth, mythic gods, beasts, weapons even mythic cities. Eat titans, eat days of the week, months. You could eat time. Every myth, every pantheon, every legend. Each myth you eat gives you the strength, lifespan and power to eat the next mythic figure. Of course, a group of gods will team-up against you and you'll smile as you are surrounded knowing you will not hunger for a few millennia.
pros: Instinctively gain more power to transcend mythic foes.
None of the so-called gods can escape your hunger. When you arrive, it is their end
Your hunger is precognitive ensuring each thing you devour makes you stronger than the next
cons: You'll eat Cerberus, Fenrir, Laelaps, Teumessian Fox (all may be considered to be Ghostdogs)
In a mythic melee do not go against your instincts or it could be your undoing
Elder gods like Zeus & Odin have a propensity to whine quite a bit before they are devoured.

name: Strong Right Hand
overview: possess a super strong right hand
description: Your right hand and arm are indestructible and possess enough superhuman strength to shatter a concrete pillar with a good punch. Your strength will increase if you work out. This power extends only to your right shoulder, and the rest of you is completely mortal.
pros: Can win any fight if you start it with a good right hook
Can block attacks with your right arm
Your right-handed throw or swing will be great in sports
cons: The rest of you is as weak and vulnerable as anyone else is
Using your right arm extensively will leave you looking lop-sided, like swordsmen
If you use your full strength in a fight, you would kill a man

name: Jerk Healing
overview: heal people by being mean
description: You can heal injuries, but to do so, you must tell them to stop whining. Somebody has a papercut?--"Somebody call whine-one-one! "--and it's healed! Friend on the ground, nearly dead?--"Stop being a big wuss and get up"--kick 'em in the ribs a few times, and everything's good! Actually dead? "Just get up you lazy fat sonuvagun!" You can heal yourself by downplaying injuries ("It's merely a flesh wound!").
pros: Get to make fun of people and have them thank you
You and your loved ones can live forever
cons: Those who don't know what you're doing will think you're a pretty big jerk

name: Quantum Re Animation
overview: have a dead person be alive only if that person isn't being observed.
description: You can make re-animates that are sort of like the weeping angels of doctor who. As long as these re-animates aren't being watched they are fully alive and healed. They become strong enough to rip thru steel or rip someone from limb to limb. These re-animates move so fast as to appear to teleport. When 'dead' these re-animates must be reduced to less than a finger or when not being observed these re-animates will be intact and alive again.
pros: Who's going to suspect a dead body is a threat?
Quantum re-animates reconstitute from a little as a pinkie finger.
These re-animates are only alive when not being observed(pro/con).
cons: 360 degree vision, surveillance cameras or anything similar.
These re-animates are only dead when being observed(con/pro).
They can be destroyed in their stone form (but it's hard)

name: Resurrection In Killer
overview: come back to life in the body of the one who killed you
description: If someone kills you their soul is forced out of their body and yours is put into their body. You will keep all of your own powers but get none of theirs.
pros: You can never truly be killed.
cons: You can still die of old age.

name: Half Sea Serpent
overview: be half-human, half-sea serpent
description: Someone with this power has higher strength and speed than normal humans. That boost is doubled when they are in the water. They can 'breathe' water like a fish and are extremely good at swimming. They will also have finlike flaps of skin on their hands and feet, scaly skin, gills, and a scaly tail.
pros: The tail can be used as a weapon.
Hard for others to catch you in a race in the water.
cons: You're not as good on land as you are in the water.

name: Dendritic Cell Mimicry
overview: stick to/absorb a foe, assimilate their cells and make other Leukocyte Mimics go into combat mode.
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers (cf. Other Leukocyte Mimics to know which ones). In normal mode, you can stick to and absorb a foe into your body, killing them. Once you've absorbed one, you'll then enter combat mode in which you grow several arms and legs, gaining enhanced mobility, and assimilate the foe's cells into your skin. When you encounter a Leukocyte Mimic who recognizes the cells as a foe's, you can make them enter combat mode too, if they haven't yet.
pros: You can make T Cell and B Cell Mimics, who can't enter combat mode alone, enter it.
Enhanced mobility skills include enhanced running, climbing, jumping, swimming skills.
In normal mode, when you touch a foe, your body will stick to theirs on a molecular level.
cons: Once in combat mode, you're stuck in this mode, in which you can't absorb or stick to foes anymore.
As soon as you touch a foe's body, you'll get stuck to them until you manage to absorb them.
You'll automatically enter combat as soon as you absorb at least one foe.

name: Lonely God
overview: have godlike power along with complete loneliness
description: Once the user activates this power, two things will happen. 1) you will recieve godlike power (nearly unlimited). 2) everyone else on earth (mankind/animals and insects) will instantly disappear and you'll be all alone.
pros: Godlike power
Loopholes are still fair game
Some people like being alone
cons: Everyone else on earth (mankind, animals, insects) will instantly disappear and you'll be all alone

name: Myth Power: Pan's Prowess
overview: channel Pan's command over the essence of shepherds, flocks, wilderness, hunting and rustic music
description: Pan, in Greek myth, was the god of shepherds, flocks, pastures, wilderness, hunting and rustic music. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and compel plants and animals. In addition, one can gain a supernatural awareness of events in the immediate environment. Furthermore, one can produce the "Call of the Wild" by voice, or by the entrancing music of summoned panpipes. One's presence even evokes a fear in foes, similar to being lost in the woods.
pros: Commune with nature psychically (awareness of weather conditions, one's immediate environment)
Communicate with and control animals (and unleash animal nature in people)
Your presence can invoke fear reminiscent of being lost in the woods (they become panicked/nervous)
cons: Aniothability, Mental Immunity and the like provide immunity to Pro #2 and Pro #3
MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace provide immunity to the direct effects of Pro #2
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Living Music
overview: turn your cells into sound waves of classical music that makes you living music.
description: Your cells elongate and vibrate as classical music that you control. But you still liv and can go back.
pros: Amplify yourself to deafen and shatter glass.
Intangible.
Escape through incredibly tight spaces.
cons: You can be absorbed.
Limited to classical music.

name: Idiots To Geniuses
overview: turn stupid people into geniuses
description: With this power you can turn anybody you want into a genius, but it works best if the person has a low IQ (diminished by mental retardation, old age, infancy, etc.) to start.
pros: Help friends out
Help out the "mentally challenged"
Help out the elderly and little kids
cons: You can't use this power on yourself
Some say ignorance is bliss

name: A Swarm Of You
overview: become a swarm of tiny or smaller versions of yourself.
description: You start as a swarm of ant-sized versions of yourself. With time and practice you can become a swarm of femto-sized versions of yourself. Femto-sized versions of yourself are small enough to affect matter and energy processes on a sub-atomic level. This power doesn't give you a hive mind. Losing one part of your swarm reverts you to normal form.
pros: Affect matter or energy processes on a sub-atomic level(with time and practice).
At a small enough your swarm-self will be unaffected by some attacks.
cons: You're not a hive mind. You have to coordinate all yourselves somehow.
Lose one part of your swarm and revert to normal.

name: Blue/Purple Grenade
overview: throw a magic grenade with various effects
description: This power came from the dream of my brother.  Blue Grenade: You can throw it at somebody (including yourself) and anybody in the radius of the grenade will have blue metal skin and will be indestructible (similar to the Silver Surfer). When you jump and stomp you will have a flying board. Also you will be super fast. This super power is temporary.  Purple Grenade: Basically a magic grenade. (Its radius just hurts.)
pros: You can fly
You can go super fast
You are indestructable
cons: This can cause alot of destruction
If you use this on another person, they will not know how to use it (unless you use it on them alot)
If a villian is in the radius he will have both his and your powers

name: Mosquitos
overview: summon 1,000,000 mosquitos
