description: Fun fact: It would take about 1,000,000 mosquito bites to completely drain an average adult human of all of their blood. With this power you can summon up to 1,000,000 bloodthirsty mosquitoes that are under your complete control. You can use them to attack you enemies or just summon a couple to be a mild annoyance to your friends. The mosquitos will never bite you no matter what. If some of your mosquitos die they are replaced with new ones so that you can have up to 1,000,000 at all times.
pros: You can summon up to 1,000,000 mosquitos
They are under your complete control
They will never bite you
cons: Their buzzing can get annoting
They can't penetrate armor

name: Swimming Out Of Water
overview: float through the air as if in water
description: In a way it's like flying, except no wings. You have the same, light feeling that you do when underwater. You wont float off either because just like in water you can control where you go.
pros: Traveling is made easy
You are more flexable
Makes it harder for opponents to attack when up in the air
cons: You move slower
Dodging is harder

name: Jade Emerald Shades
overview: use the Jade Emerald Shades to see through disguises and look into the future.
description: With these you can look through any disguise, to see who is a demon or an alien, you could also get a glimpse into the future just by wearing the shades, if you see everything light purple: the future could be better, if you see everything orange: the future can be far worse.
pros: The future is so bright you gotta wear shades.
Weird looking sunglasses.
You can wear them at night.
cons: The future been bright for so long, it could look dark.
The enemy can see you.

name: The Trial
overview: have anyone take a trial of which the result affects their power levels
description: If the person succeeds at the trial they will have full use of all of their powers to the power's highest level, but if they fail the trial, then their powers will be locked at the current levels and never be able to become stronger. The trial for each person is based on who and what they are and thus is different for each person. Also, they cannot be disturbed while taking the trial (temporary invulnerability,) which takes place completely in the mind and thus they will not be physically harmed
pros: Allies could become much stronger.
Enemies could be locked at their current power levels.
Any given person can only take the trial once. May be a con if they fail.
cons: Enemies could become much stronger.
Allies could be locked at their current power levels.
Using this power on yourself is a risk.

name: Myth Power: Tryphe's Trifle
overview: channel Tryphe's command over the essence of luxury, extravagance and lavish lifestyle
description: Tryphe, in Greek myth, was the goddess of luxury, extravagance, and lavish living. As such, channeling her allows one to receive services, products or deals offered by any upscale establishment (country club, luxury hotel, etc) for free. In addition, one can psychically manipulate (and receive insight from) designer items. Furthermore, one can turn luxury items into similarly shaped weapons, tools and armor. One can even psychically perceive, locate and manipulate precious metals and stones.
pros: Full free access to luxury/upscale places and services; turn luxury items into weapons/tools/armor
Psychically manipulate (levitate, move, etc) and receive psychic insight from luxury items
Psychically perceive and manipulate precious metals/stones
cons: Only psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the rich/spoiled/greedy when developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically upgrade normal items into luxury items, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Money/economy/wealth-based MythPowers provide immunity/disruption/negation (NCN)

name: Completely Ungifted
overview: not be affected by any power.
description: This power makes you 100% unaffected by any power. Inversely, you can't have or use any power or object with power. This power transfers to the nearest person when you die, so there is always someone with this ability. If the person the power transfers to has a power, it is lost forever.
pros: Never affected by any power.
Ability transfers from person to person after death, so it's never lost.
Power is always active, and undectable.
cons: Can't use any power or object with power.
People might think you're useless.
You might not know you have the power until someone attempts to use a power on you.

name: 7 League Jump
overview: jump 7 leagues in one movement without much effort
description: In one jump you can go 7 leagues from your original position. It takes around a minute from initial push from the ground to landing on your feet. While landing your feet and legs become immune to all harm. There is no need for any item to use this power and you can choose whether or not to use this power. It is not automatic.
pros: You can escape quickly.
Calculate it correctly and you can kick someone in the face when landing and take no harm.
cons: The jump is always 7 leagues, no more, no less.
This con and the previous con are immune to alteration by other powers.
Can tire out quickly from the jumping.

name: Vampric Vendetta
overview: drain the life out of people you hate.
description: By concentrating intensely on a person you despise, you drain their vitality bit by bit until they waste away and die. However, as you drain life, you begin to take on their characteristics more and more, and if you drain them completely, these characteristics are ingrained into your personality.
pros: Destroy those who stand in your way.
Hold power over life and death literally at your whim.
cons: You will become everything you hate.
In doing so you will grow to hate yourself.
The compounded self-loathing will cause you to collapse into a godlike demon of all consuming hatred

name: I Can Hear You V3
overview: know when a someone is typing or writing something about you
description: With this power you will automatically know if someone is typing or writing something about you. You will know who the person is and what they are writing or typing. You cannot turn this power on and off.
pros: You will know when someone is typing or writing something about you
You will know what the person typed/wrote and who the person is
cons: You cannot turn this power on and off
You will not know who the person was writing or typing to

name: Collared
overview: make those that you put a collar onto become one's slaves.
description: Anyone on which the weilder of this power puts a collar, is their slave and the collar can only be taken off by the master or someone they completely and fully trust. This power can only be gained after making 1000 collars from raw materials (e.g. cow hide) by hand.
pros: Works on anyone who doesn't have Slavery Immunity or Mimic Slave.
You start off with 1000 collars when you gain this power.
cons: It will take a large amount of time to create 1000 collars.
How in the world are you going to get the raw materials for all those collars?

name: Shadow Life
overview: string your life to another person's shadow.
description: You have the ability to tie your life to a shadow. When the other person dies or object, so do you.
pros: Easier to live a long life.
cons: Harder to live a long life.

name: Enhancement: Electrifying
overview: make the physical part of a power surrounded by electricity by attaching this power to it
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it electrifies the power's physical part. This power requires no source of power to keep going. If stolen, it will permanently electrify the power it is attached to. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
pros: Shock your enemies. Electrifying Hair Blades!
No source of power required for the electricity.
cons: Useless without another power.
Power might be useless electrified or might not want power to be electrified.
One power at a time

name: Nasa Warehouse
overview: summon anything that NASA has created.
description: With this power you can summon anything that NASA has created, invented, or designed. You can control the size of the object that you summon so it does not have to be the same size as the one NASA made. You also gain knowledge of how the object was made and how to use it for as long as it is summoned. The knowledge is lost when the object is unsummoned. NASA does not lose the objects it makes when you summon, you summon a copy. You also have a mental catalog of everything you can summon.
pros: Summon anything NASA has created, invented, or designed.
Have knowledge of how the object is made, and how to use it.
Can control the size of the copy you are summoning as well.
cons: NASA will not like you stealing their ideas.
If NASA goes out of business.
Can only use what NASA has made.

name: Ape Shift
overview: go Ape-Shift and transform into a super-strong 10-foot, 4 ton gorilla
description: Any change in your emotions or the emotions of anyone you care about will cause you to go Ape-Shift, transforming into a giant Silverback. You will be larger than any other ape and about 100 times stronger, optimally. Your sight, smell, taste and hearing will be off the charts. You will keep your intelligence. Well, as much IQ as any bipolar 8000 lbs gorilla can have.
pros: When really frenzied, your already amazing strength doubles
All other non-human primates will look to you as their master & you can control them.
Leap and swing around any city like it is a concrete jungle.
cons: Highly emotional in Ape-Shift. Any sudden change in emotions make you lose your mind
In a fight, you will not know when to stop & nothing but you can calm your beserker rage
The urge to throw your own feces is irresistible, even when you are human

name: Demon Transf. #2 Black Dragon
overview: transform into a big dragon.
description: You transform into a big, black dragon. You have all the strength and powers of a dragon (fire breath etc. ). As an additional trait you have a fear aura (everyone looks at you and becomes VERY scared)
pros: Dragons are cool
Fear is cool
cons: You are just a scary dragon, not much to see

name: Monster Control
overview: control monsters
description: With this power you can control any monster as long as it exists
pros: You might be able to have an army of monsters
Can control their behaviors, and they like you (act like pets or guardians around you)
They won't want to scare you
cons: If you exist in a universe where no monsters exist, this power is useless
If you're a scaredy-cat, this power won't do you much good...

name: 300 Spartans
overview: appears 300 spartans instantly.
description: You can materialize 300 spartans from your back yard, your bathroom. You can be their leader and its fun.
pros: You are the leader.
They are your friends.
You can make them disappear or reappear.
cons: You have to feed them.
Take good care of them.

name: Tirer La Couverture
overview: see spells, curses or any other supernatural influences.
description: Supernatural influences, such as spells, curses or effects of a superpower, can appear to you as either strings of words or symbols, a representation of the one who cast them or that of an artifact, or any other clues that indicate what the user is dealing with. Without any knowledge of the supernatural, this ability is pretty much useless to identify or counter spells, curses or the like. However, it can hint you that something supernatural is at work.
pros: Allows you to see if something supernatural is at work, for example in cases of unexplained illness.
What you see are clues about what spell, curse or superpower is at work
cons: You can't really do anything if you don't know much about superpowers, curses or spells.

name: Haymaker
overview: deliver a highly powerful knockout punch
description: Haymaker is much similar to the fisticuff ability, but rather than delivering an endless combo of punches, haymaker delivers one superblow that can knock out any enemy with enough force to punch a wall and knock out the enemy standing on the other side. Overuse, however, can tear your own muscles or break your bones.
pros: Knocks out any opponent, even if they are made of metal or standing behind a wall.
cons: Can be avoided by a fast-moving enemy
Overuse can eventually tear your muscles and break your bones

name: Rise Of The Hydra
overview: turn into the legendary five headed hydra
description: With this power you can fight crime as the legendary super strong five headed hydra in order to fight crime
pros: Whenever someone cuts off one of your heads two more grow in it's place
Really big, strong reptile (superstrength, superendurance, strong tail, claws, fangs, etc)
cons: You'll be attacked as you look pretty dangerous

name: Cytotoxic T Cell Mimicry
overview: kill cells through touch (only cells of the same species as yours and only in combat mode).
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers: an elastic body, the power to clone yourself while in combat mode and the power to distinguish friends from foes on a molecular level. While cloning, you can decide if the new clone stays in combat mode or reverses to normal mode. In combat mode, you will cause a foe's cells to die by touching them, but only if the foe is of the same species as you. Note that, with this power alone, you cannot enter into combat mode by yourself.
pros: You can tell friends from foes on a molecular level, meaning you can't be fooled by shapeshifters.
You can kill or severely hurt a foe by touching their body.
Your elastic body makes you impervious to blows.
cons: You can only kill the cells you're touching and only those of the same species as yours.
You cannot enter combat mode by yourself with this power alone.
You can't return yourself to normal mode and your killing ability is always active in combat mode.

name: The Flaming Cage
overview: trap an enemy in a cage of fire.
description: Create small red orbs that will quickly surround someone and shot fire at each other and connect together to form and cage. This can work on groups of people and can be used as a good torturing method, mainly because fire can be shot from the orbs at the captive. If used underwater in stead of fire the orbs will release heat at very high temps(around 1000 degrease at times) and connect. The orbs can also trap moving targets on the run. The space in between the fire is 8 inches by 7 inches.
pros: The orbs may also burst into flames and chase down enemies.
If water is sprayed onto the flames the heat will take its place until the water is gone.
Orbs will burn almost anything that touches them.
cons: The larger the target the more orbs are needed and take about 3 seconds to create 5.
The space between the fire is small, but can still be passed through if one is quick enough
The orbs can be brooken by smashing them with about 3 tons of pressure.

name: Clean Oceans
overview: fight threats made to bodies of water
description: With this ability, you can instantly clean sections of any body of water (depends on size). You can keep the world oceans clean, counter pollution and overfishing, protect/restore coral reefs etc.
pros: Clean oceans
Healthy fisheries
Healthy reefs
cons: The bigger the body, the more you need to concentrate
Oceans are to big to do instantly, need a chopper to do it entirely

name: Hollow Mask
overview: grow a hollow mask on your face
description: This ability lets you grow a hollow mask on your face at any time by storing energy and moving your hand in front of your face. Your mask will appear however you want it to look. When you release your mask you get the ability of one of the arrancar from Bleach which is a permanent effect for the mask. So for example your mask would be called Hollow Mask- Luppi or Hollow Mask- Ulquiorra
pros: Become a half hollow
Increased strength, edurance, and speed
Can release your mask for increased stats and abilities
cons: Does not come with zanpakuto
Takes alot of energy to keep up
Must store energy before using

name: Usurpation: Magic
overview: temporarily usurp all powers of a single magic user.
description:
This power allows you to temporarily usurp the magical powers of a single magic user, leaving them completely powerless in the process. Clothing will change to reflect the person whose powers have been stripped for the moment. 

You gain their powers at exactly the same level of the original owner. Line of sight is required, otherwise you will gain the powers of a random mage who could be anywhere at the moment. You have no knowledge when Usurpation ends.
pros: Fighting magic users will become easy as you turn them powerless for the a while
Instant knowledge of what you can and can't do with "your " powers
cons: The more powerful the magic user, the shorter you keep their powers
Magic could also just mean that powers are magical in nature but do not allow to do "real magic"

name: 3rd Key Of Death
overview: summon a key that is able to raise dead animals.
description: This key is able to raise dead animals. They are at command, and since they remain undead, they can't be killed. The key turns into a door that releases selected animals - like if you wanted to bring back a lion, but not an elephant. They can be unsummoned, as if they were in quicksand they slowly sink into the earth.
pros: An undying army of animals.
cons: It is a small key, that can get lost or get destroyed.
Only animals.
No Con Negation or Inconvience Destroyer.

name: Wudang Totem
overview: instantaneously learn the ways of the Wudang Warrior.
description: The person with this totem is able to call upon the martial art skills of the animals that are inscribed on the totem, which is the tiger, the bat, the shark, the eagle and the fox. The ultimate form of this version is that the user will be able to change to the humanoid animal form of the animal that they are currently using. When you change to the humanoid animal form, you also gain that animal's natural ability.
pros: You know the ancient wudang martial arts.
You can transform into a humanoid animal form to give yourself more power to fight enemies.
cons: Can only use one martial art at a time.
The humanoid animal transformation can last only for an hour.

name: Imperious Interruptus
overview: hijack the conversation of subordinates
description: You can hijack the conversations of subordinates.  You can speak to one of the subordinates while you turn your back to the others.  Those others are not allowed to leave, nor to chime in.  Their only choice is to stand awkwardly waiting while forced to listen.
pros: You can spread your wisdom to your subordinates without delay
cons: You boss can use this power against you.

name: Condition Change: Water
overview: make a power work only when the user has visible water on their skin
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that the power only works when the user's skin is visibly wet. It doesn't matter where the skin is wet. This power is tactile.
pros: Just keep them from getting wet.
cons: Have to touch opponent and each touch only affects one power.
A hydrokinetic

name: Myth Power: Pledge Peitharchia
overview: channel Peitharchia's command over the essence of obedience, subservience and submission
description: Peitharchia, in Greek myth, was goddess of obedience to command, subservience and submission. As such, channeling her allows one to compel nearly any subject to do one's bidding. In addition, one can cause the requests and commands of others to effect a subject like psychic compulsions. Furthermore, the user is immune to compulsion of any kind, compulsions directed to do him harm are instantly negated, and the user may psychically perceive and communicate with those who are naturally obedient.
pros: Make foes subject to one's own will, and/or the will of others (and immune to compulsions of others)
Compulsions directed to do you harm automatically fail
Psychically perceive and communicate with those who are obedient by nature (servants, etc)
cons: Abilities which bestow Compulsion Immunity
Cannot pass on the Compulsion Immunity until the higher levels
Cannot induce pain in disobedient people (who disobey orders OR compulsions) until the higher levels

name: Brown Adipocyte Mimicry
overview: absorb fat and convert it into heat.
description: This power is always active. Your entire body is covered in a huge amount of tiny brown spots. As soon as you touch/consume fat, you'll absorb it in your body. You can absorb between twice and three times your body mass. However, it won't affect your build at all. In addition to storing a lot of fat, you also have an extremely high metabolic rate and can convert fat into a huge amount of heat. The conversion aspect of this power is amplified by cold external temperatures.
pros: The fat you absorb also acts as a thermal insulator, protecting you from extreme cold or heat.
You look tanned (well, from a distance).
You'll never worry about becoming fat.
cons: You can only generate heat as long your body contains fat.
Once you burn all the fat in your body, you'll be very vulnerable to external temperatures.
You'll become very heavy despite looking normal.

name: Myth Power: Ire Of The Arae
overview: channel the Arae and their command over the essence of curses and misfortune
description: The Arae (Arai), in Greek myth, were the fierce sister goddesses of curses, imprecations and misfortune. As such, channeling them allows one to grant up to nine wishes a day, for oneself and/or others. These wishes may be for anything, so long as they do not directly help or benefit anyone. In addition, one may receive knowledge of foes' innermost fears and weaknesses at will. One even gains favor by evil-aligned gods of the Greek pantheon and immunity to MythPowers based on good-aligned gods.
pros: Grant nine malevolent wishes a day, for self and/or others
Receive knowledge on the fears and weaknesses of foes
Favor with evil-aligned gods of the Greek Pantheon; immunity to MythPowers of good-aligned gods
cons: Only nine curses or afflictions a day. Not nine for you AND nine for others. Nine TOTAL in a day.
Wishes cannot be used to directly help or benefit anyone
MythPower: Eris' Enmity provides immunity

name: Transformation: Red Devil
overview: transform to the Red Devil
description: He or she who shouts the phrase ' Glory, glory to the Red Devil he who defends the weak against the ignorance'. The user transform into a red devil, defender of the weak as well as hunter of the evil. Has a trident made of near indestructible metal. The user changes back after reciting the phrase ' Return, return Red Devil, the weak has been defended and the evil has been vanquished'. This form's only weakness is magic
pros: Nearly indestructible
Has super strength
Can shoot flame bolts
cons: Transformation phrase might take to long to say out in times of emergency
Very easily defeated by powerful or skillful magic users

name: Flesh Melting
overview: melt people's flesh with your mind
description: With this power you can melt people's flesh with your mind. All you have to do is think of the person and say "Flesh melter supreme!" then that person's flesh will start to melt until you shout "Supreme melter of flesh!". You cannot be harmed by anybody who has this power and this power cannot be used on people who have this power.
pros: You can melt people's flesh
You can't be affected by this power
cons: You cannot affect people who have this power

name: Quick Flight
overview: increase the speed of air based vehicles
description: With this power you can make any airbased vehicle to move faster. You do not even have to be in the vehicle but you have to be looking at it. You cannot make vehicles go slower but you can return them to the rate at which they were moving before you used this power.
pros: You can make planes go faster
cons: You have to be looking at the vehicles to make them faster

name: Game God: Mmorpg
overview: simulate omnipotence on a game.
description: With this ability, the user can become basicly omnipotent within MMORPG games.  Allowing Item creation, instant leveling, character cloning, and monster summoning in-game. The user can achieve ANY effect desired, the listed are just options provided. In the real world, the user can only summon/control MMORPG related objects & beings.
pros: In-game Omnipotence.
Armies of NPCs in-game
Summoning God level objects in-game
cons: Game addiction.
No sense of reward for honest play.
You can get detected.

name: Summon Samurai
overview: summon an army of samurai
description: You can summon an army of samurai to fight for you. The samurai follow the codes of bushido and if they do break any of the codes they will commit ritual suicide.
pros: You are their feudal lord
They will kill anyone how dishonors you and they will do what want
cons: They hate ninjas
You have to follow bushido or the samurai will kill you

name: Myth Power: Alke's Alacrity
overview: channel Alke's command over the essence of battle strength and battle prowess
description: Alke (Alce), in Greek myth, was the goddess of battle strength (strength in the heat of combat) and battle prowess (fighting skill). As such, channeling her allows one to gain superhuman fighting skill and weapon skill. In addition, one can psychically gauge others' physical stats, fighting skill and weapon skill, at will. Furthermore, one can share one's own fighting and weapon skill with one's allies at will. One can even psychically reduce foes' fighting and weapon skill, by touch, at will.
pros: Gain superhuman fighting and weapon skill; gauge others' physical stats and fighting/weapon skill
Share one's own fighting and weapon skill with others
Psychically reduce foes' fighting and weapon skill, by touch, at will
cons: Pro #3 is not permanent until developed (NCN)
Cannot withstand or negate fear-based ability (including MythPowers) until developed (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide resistance until developed (NCN)

name: Want/Need Swapper
overview: swap a persons wants and needs.
description: This power gives the user the ability to swap someones wants for their needs. For example, someone wants a designer purse, but needs water to live. When these are swapped, they now need to the purse to survive, but only want water. If someone does not obtain something they need, they die a slow death as their body shuts down.
pros: Swap your enemies basic needs with their unattainable wants.
Swap a dying person need for medicine or surgery with an easily obtained want.
Replace your need to eat, drink, and rest with your hobbies.
cons: You will still want rest, food, sleep, or anything swapped in to a want.

name: 7 Flames Of Purgatory
overview: control the seven flames of Hell
description: Theyre based on the 7 deadly sins: Satan(Wrath)- blue flames that incinerate any and everything. Belphegor(Sloth)- nullifies other powers. Mammon(Greed)- twin headed beast that comes in the form of twin swords; one of hot blue flame and the other of cold yellow. Beelzebub(Gluttony)- colorless/invisible flame reaching pass 1500 degrees Celsius. Leviathan(Envy)- the silver flame of Hades removes heat in the area ,allowing him to create ice.
pros: Control of all 7 flames
Can use the flames for defense and offense
Can completely incinerate people
cons: Takes up a lot of energy
Most of the flames have a strong backlash
Can hurt yourself if used improperly

name: Super Missles
overview: create Super Missles that fire from your hands
description: You see a target, or targets, point your hand or hands at the targets, think of how many super missles and then that amount of super missles fires coming out of your hands. One super missle is powerful enough to hurt Superman, two missles double the power, three missles triple the power, etc.  You can create a gigantic missle that is as powerful as Thor's God Blast but it would also destroys a vast amount of the area. The super missles are the size of Baseball bats used in MLB.
pros: Can be Shoot underwater,on other planets, etc
Can fight Very powerful foes in the League of Darkseid, Mongul, Brainiac, Mephisto, Doctor Doom,etc
Something needs to fall you can use a super missle
cons: Shields Can Prevent Super Missles from Hitting the Target
Super Missles Can be changed Using Telekinesis or other power to hit you, someone else, car, etc
If the target teleports away from the missle then the missle hits whatever it touches first

name: Healer 7: Addiction Removal
overview: remove unwanted addictions and mimic desired ones.
description: With this power, the user creates a field 25 kilometers in radius which removes unwanted addictions in others. In addition, they can mimic the addictions of others within range they desire, such as exercise. The range expands by one meter each year and can be turned off at will.
pros: Cure addictions such as alcoholism and tobacco addiction.
Mimic desired addictions.
No relapse into addiction.
cons: Side effects are not cured.
Target needs to be willing to be cured.
If the target tries the substance again, they can become addicted once more.

name: Unwanted Effect Interception
overview: intercept unwanted effects.
description: With this ability, you can take on part of or all of an effect about to occur to someone as long as they do not want it. Underweight? Take some weight about to be gained over Christmas. Short? Take the effects of an unwanted growth spurt. This cannot grant you things such as superpowers or magic.
pros: Fix the majority of your problems.
Take upon the failure of things, such as the failure to reproduce.
You can control what you take on and others benefit from this power.
cons: You cannot gain things such as magic or superpowers.
This power may take a great deal of creativity.
This power cannot be modified by other powers.

name: Monetary Rewards
overview: have it rain money onto someone in responce to good deeds done.
description: This power allows you to "bless" someone so that, whenever they perform an act of selflessness and good will, that actions "value" in money will rain down on them from the sky. The money is that of whichever country they happen to be in at the time.
pros: Give someone an incentive to do good.
Give a reward to a down on their luck but honest person.
Get rich doing charity.
cons: It falls from the sky in plain view of anyone.
The good deeds must be genuine, The power will NOT activate if you're only doing it to get the money
Don't hand it out to too many people unless you want to crash the local economy.

name: Murderous Advice
overview: give advice that, while seemingly good at the time, will subtly lead that person to their death.
description: With this power you can give advice that, while seemingly benign or good at that moment, will put that person on a path to unavoidable death. The true ramifications of your advice might not be readily apparent after you give it, and you may have to advise a person many times to guide them toward their own demise, but they will assuredly die if they keep listening to you.
pros: The advise is always seems good in the context of the persons present situation.
Their chances of survivle will drop stedily to 0% if they keep following your advice.
There is basically no way to trace the victim's death back to you.
cons: While good in context, the victim does not have to follow your advice.
The chances that you will be able to kill someone with just one piece of advice are slim.
Killing someone like this could take a fairly long time.

name: Author Power Restriction.
overview: impose universal restrictions on powers you create.
description: Are people exploiting loopholes in powers you create and making themselves overpowered? With this power, one can set rules on your power use forbidding such things without editing the power. Be careful though; it affects you too.
pros: Close loopholes others are exploiting.
The only direct defense against this is Author Power Block.
If desired, you may undo restrictions placed upon your powers.
cons: Restrictions cannot have exceptions allowing you to escape the limitations you impose.
No use if you do not create powers.
People will likely find even more ways to get around your power restrictions.

name: Dive Compulsion
overview: compel any living thing in a body of water to swim toward the bottom
description: With this power you can let out a mental pulse that will compel anything in an area of water to dive to the bottom of it. How large the area is is left to the users discretion. Creatures will continue swimming toward the bottom regardless of temperature, pressure, or need for oxygen. Should the creature actually reach the bottom the compulsion is broken.
pros: Keep living things off of the waters surface.
Send anything attacking you underwater.
cons: Depending on how deep the water is, this will kill pretty much everything in the target area.

name: Chronological Event Reversal
overview: cause events to reverse themselves during the normal passage of time
description: With this power, a specific event occurs twice; once normally, and again only in reverse order. If this power were to be used on a bottle that had fallen off a building and shattered, the bottle would immediately reassemble itself and fly back to the ledge. This is not time reversal; time only goes in the one direction. However, this power makes a selected local event happen once naturally, and again as its reversed form, all during the natural passage of time.
pros: Reverse death, injury, accidents, fix things, reverse aging, etc.
Time flows normally; only, the affected event occurs twice.
No restrictions placed on object/event type.
cons: People could be made younger than they should be (think new-born baby or younger).
Unless you have experience with this power you SHOULD NOT use it on yourself.

name: Claymore :  Phoenix Fire
overview: possess clamore that can create and control a very hot flame
description: (This clamore can creat and controle a phoenix fire that can torn its victims to ash. ) the sword is made from chrome steel. This claymore is weakest in the cold.
pros: Torn your victims in to ash
Scare your victims to death
cons: You can only have one claymore (no con negation)
You are not immune from the fire (no con negation)
This clamore is weakest in the cold

name: Aquacanthropy
overview: become An Aquatic Werecreature
description: This power gives the user the ability to become an aquatic werecreature of their choice but the rule is that it must be done near water or in water while the moonlight is reflecting over the waves. Your transformation may differ depending on the tides.
pros: In were-seacreature form you're a faster swimmer.
Breathing underwater is easy.
You get a different transformation in correspondance to the tides.
cons: Can't do it out of water.
You can't become amphibious.
Only fish and the like, no whales or dolphins.

name: Umbrella Portals
overview: use umbrellas to create portals to jump from one place to another.
description: By opening an umbrella, and holding it over yourself, you can create a portal that would make you jump from one place to another where you have another umbrella that you have imbued already set, in another location. As you come out of the other umbrella it flies, and hovers up in the air, and kind of just pops you out, leaving the previous umbrella to fall to the ground in the other spot, and shut itself. No one can open, or move the umbrellas you have imbued.
pros: Once you've set your umbrellas in their places, no one else can move them or open them up.
Umbrella porting looks cool, and umbrellas are suave and stylish.
In a dire situation if you've set up escape umbrellas, you can flee a dangerous situation.
cons: You can only link umbrellas in pairs. To make more 'routes' you need to set up more pairs of umbrellas.
You have to set up the umbrellas in position. Meaning you need to travel to this location by physical means initially.
This power only works for you, you cannot port anyone else to go along for the ride.

name: Animated Techniques
overview: give crude life to one's techniques, skills, or natural talent.
description: This ability does not bring techniques, skills, or natural talent to actual life, but make them become physical and able to move by the user's will. They have no will or soul. They look like ethereal beings, not actual creature. The user can make his karate chop move in a remote controlled, long- range attack or cook's cutting technique into quick and precise air slices.
pros: Make any techniques, skills, or natural talent be physical and animated
Remote control with one's mind
cons: Could require a source to create crude life like one's own life energy.

name: Mood Change
overview: change someone's mood.
description: Change anyone's mood. For example, happy to sad.
pros: Love.
Sad to happy.
Angry to happy.
cons: Not real love.
Mad to happy will slowly make them lose their sanity.
Moods will be off.

name: Aniothability
overview: entirely resist all negative emotion
description: Aniothability is the superhuman inability to feel any negative emotion at all. This ability is not the same as having no emotion at all, and one with this ability is not overly chipper; they simply don't feel fear, nervousness, apprehension, doubt, anger, jealousy, embarrassment or the like. They cannot even have these feelings psychically imposed by means of emotion manipulation or the like. They can often still feel pain, however, of the physical sort (not betrayal or anger; like cuts, etc. )
pros: No irrational fear or worries
Calm minded at all times
Only experience positive emotions
cons: May annoy people if you can't relate to their pain
May be unable to perceive physical pain which can be very disadvantageous
May make people dislike you if you're always saying "what is pain? What is sad? Sounds unpleasant"

name: Transposition
overview: play any song you've heard
description: A person with Transposition is the hero of the band. Any song they've ever listened to, they can play. Everything from Mozart's Fifth to Ladies and Gentlemen, ska to rap, Blues Brothers to Rage Against the Machine. However, there are some limits. If you can't hit a high note, you'll have to take it down. And if you can't play an instrument, you'll have to learn. I recommend guitar or trumpet.
pros: Playing 'Ladies and Gentlemen' on an accordion
Playing the Blues Brothers album at a party
Listening to an amazing guitar solo and playing it perfectly
cons: Having to learn an instrument
Must hear song first
If you can't play it high, you can't play it high

name: X Zone
overview: banish your enemies into an empty dimension for eternity.
description: This ability to open a one-way portal into an empty dimension, which even someone with this power cannot escape. This dimension is a completely empty void.  No time, no space. The only thing your enemies can do in here is go insane. They are trapped in here for all eternity.
pros: Banish your enemies here for all eternity.
cons: If you somehow get trapped in the X-Zone, there is no escape.
Can not undo the x-zone.

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Rulers
overview: become an angel of both authority and power.
description: The Rulers, often known as the Principalities, tend to collaborate their duties with those of the Powers. The Rulers appear as pointed-eared humanoids with ruby-studded crowns, along with a pair of sable-coloured scalloped wings. The Rulers also carry winged scepters from which they draw most of their power. Their primary duties are said to carry out the orders given to them by the Dominions. Rulers also have been said to inspire art and science.
pros: Inspire brilliant ideas to many living things.
Draw immense power and strength from your scepter.
Annihilate multiple targets with a "heavenly beam" from your scepter.
cons: Rulers are still vulnerable to stronger angelic/demonic forces.

name: Gaze Aversion
overview: make all people in an area face away from you
description: Good for the person who doesn't like to draw attention, but at the same time not so good. This power will instantly face anyone nearby away from you so you can make a getaway. The effect is very disorienting, and anyone moving will continue in the same direction, adding to the confusion. Still, this ability can sometimes hurt more than help. If someone knows your power, then using it will make it even easier to find you.
pros: Quick Getaway
Lots of confusion
cons: May give away your position
Not many uses

name: Ventriloquist
overview: disguise your voice & make it appear to come from somewhere else
description: This power allows you to make your voice come from another direction. It also allows you to perfectly mimic someone else's voice after hearing them speak. Though this takes focus & might be hard on your vocal cords at times.
pros: Fool people with your voice
Imitate someone else's speech pattern
Great for a ventriloquism act
cons: Takes concentration
Your vocal cords may get tired

name: Solace Mancy
overview: absorb sadness and imbue hope.
description: You can see a subject's fading aura going through emotional crisis. Then you can help them out by instantly removing people's despair and misery, and giving your unconditional pure embrace or comforting touch.
pros: Totally free someone from depression and unwanted feelings.
Take away their pain and replace it with happiness
cons: Feel one's sorrow and pain.
It won't work by force.

name: Poison Detection
overview: detect poison through your senses.
description: With this power, you will be able to know when you're interacting with a poisonous substance. Poisons you are about to ingest will have an alarmingly bad taste to warn you. You will be able to smell any poisonous gases, even the odorless ones, like carbon monoxide. Dangerous radiations and colorless gases will have a color to you. You will be able to feel contact poisons through touch, even if the poison already attacked your nerves. The faintest gas leak will become audible to you.
pros: You will have a lot of clues to avoid poisoning.
You could save countless lives by warning people.
cons: You're still vulnerable to poison.
You could be overwhelmed by the huge amount of poisons present in big cities.

name: Sun Phoenix Cannon
overview: use the solar cannon.
description: Summon a gold cannon with wings on top (makes it look abit like a crossbow) on your right arm. While can be fired at any time, it is best to do so when the sun is present, because it greatly increases the effectiveness. Aside from the normal beam from the front end of the cannon, by placing your palm on top of it and calling out "scatter" muntiple secctions of the cannon's plating slide back and it fires multiple smaller lazers that home in on the enemy and attack from all sides.
pros: Great power when fired during the day.
Even more effective against anything darkness aligned (eg. Vampires, demons)
cons: Less power without the sun.
Rather big; quickly unsummon it, or learn to fight close combat with only your left arm.

name: Food Rain
overview: make any type of food fall from the sky
description: With this power you can cause as much of any type of food to fall from the sky one time per day. Though you can only use this power once a day, while you're using the power you can make several different types of food fall but once you stop using the power you have to wait 24 hours before using it again.
pros: You can make as much of any type of food fall from the sky
cons: Limited to once per day
Doesn't include condiments

name: My Name Is Legion..We Are Many
overview: absorb souls & replace them with yours controlling zombie-ish army
description: You are a soul devourer. You take the souls of others & replace their blank lifeless body with with part of your soul. Making more of you all mentally linked together & to you. Every soul you take gives you strength & extended life. So however many souls you have, thats how many lives you can live. If one of your slaves mortally dies, you can keep it alive like a zombie. Only way to die is shoot or whatever between eyes unless already died that way. But you all feel short agony of death.
pros: You draw strength & life from each soul you take
You control an army of bodies that can live beyond mortal death
cons: Your minions if zombied will die permanantly if shot between the eyes
Everyone feels the mortal death of of anyone
You have to give up a soul you converted to yours in order to zombify a body when dead

name: Scarred
overview: control the appearance of scars on a person's skin.
description: With this power you can control the appearance of scars on a person's skin. You can remove scars allowing you to return the skin to normal, or create scars allowing you to change the appearance of the skin. You can create any type of scar, of any pattern, on any section of skin with only a thought. This is an artistic power.
pros: Make a person hideous using the scars.
Give yourself an awesome scar.
Create scar tattoos.
cons: Would not have an awesome story to back up the scar.
Need some artistic skill.
No combat usage.

name: Healer 4: Lethargy Elimination
overview: energize lethargic people and gain stamina.
description: This ability restores the energy levels of lethargic people within range and provides equivalent amounts of energy for the user. However, lethargy will eventually return when people are out of range, since it only treats the symptoms, not the cause. The maximum range for this ability is 25 kilometers, but expands at a rate of 1 meter per year. You can turn this power off at will.
pros: Cure lethargy, of any kind.
Has a range of 25 kilometers.
You gain stamina as well.
cons: Cannot heal people outside the current radius.
Only treats symptoms; the cause is likely to remain.
Unlike other healing powers, it cannot wounds or other ailments.

name: Mode Lock
overview: lock anyone into their current form with a snap
description: Tired of fighting someone that can keep transforming. Well with this power you can stop their transformations and make them stay in any of their forms. Let's say that they were spying on you as a bug and you catch them. With a snap they permanently become a bug. Fighting a group that needs to transform to have powers. Snap! Now they can't transform.
pros: Lock shapeshifters in a harmless form
Keep yourself permanantly transformed into a stronger being
cons: Only good against shapeshifters and people that can change forms
Might lock someone in a good form----if they are enemies this is bad

name: Anger Augmented Shapeshifting
overview: change into different animals / forms based on your anger.
description: With this ability, you can shapeshift into any animal. However, it's harder to shift into more complex animals than it is simple ones unless you have enough anger. The strength of your forms also increases based on your anger.
pros: Also allows you to shapeshift into human forms.
If you have other shapeshifting abilities, it also increases their power the angrier you are.
cons: Doesn't become very strong until your anger rises.
The power itself doesn't include mythological / fictional entities.

name: Pocket Full Of Sunshine
overview: have a pocket full of solar rays (sunshine)
description: A pocket containing the sun's solar rays (sunshine). Can be used to light dark places or make pocket glow.
pros: Makes a good night light.
May surprise unsuspecting people.
Makes a slight hand warmer.
cons: Is not lethal in any form or way.

name: Flint Skin
overview: produce sparks by striking your skin against things
description: With this power, you have a thin layer of flint covering your whole body. You can strike your skin against yourself or other objects to make sparks. With concentration, you can force your skin to produce thick layers of flint, allowing for resistance to blunt force attacks. You can also break off pieces and use them as daggers or shuriken. Pretty lame, but hey, no more hassling with campfires!
pros: Removable weapons
Great for Camping! (*sob sob* I'm so lame)
cons: LAME
Mostly useless

name: Human Lantern
overview: generate light from the inside.
description: Light pours out of all your orifices (eyes, ears, mouth, wounds, and down-stairs areas) at any intensity you wish. At high enough intensities, your skin will glow (just like when you put a flashlight under your hand) and you will generate heat.  Not exactly the sneakiest power, but can dazzle and keep you warm.
pros: Your eyes are natural headlights.
Could potentially blind enemies.
Can't freeze to death.
cons: Mirrors and other reflective surfaces are your new nemesises.
Easily gives your position away when used.
You'd have a firefly-bum. (Firefly's a good alias, though... )

name: Hi My Name Is
overview: know everyone's name.
description: If you forget names easily, this is the power for you, like if you're about to go on a date and they call you and you forgot their name, you are screwed. OK, peace!
pros: You will always know people's name.
You will know every girl's name.
You will know every actor's or actress's name.
cons: You might say a random name during sex.
You might call a chinese dude Jackie Chan.
You might say a random name at a bar.

name: Summoning: Janus's Key
overview: use the Key of Janus.
description: Janus is the Roman god of doors and such. You can now summon his Key, which has the ability to unlock any door or chest that isn't enchanted. The key is easily recognizable by the fact it depicts two differing faces, the symbol most common with Janus.
pros: Unlocks chests and doors.
cons: Only works on non-magical items.

name: Mood Singing
overview: sing a note and change the mood of a person or in a room
description: Sing a note and change the mood of a person or in a room. Like as if you were to sing a bad note you make some one or a room filled with people sad. Or if you were to sing a happy note you can make people happy. You can sing a dramatic note you can make some one scared. The one rule you must follow you can not use this on yourself for any kind of reason.
pros: Great in battle
You can have fun with it
Ummm. Yay that's most it.
cons: Can not use it on yourself
Can't use to cause phsyical pain
Yay so that's it really

name: Ice 9
overview: produce Ice 9.
description: Ice nine is a type of ice that melts only at temperatures over 114. 4 degrees Fahrenheit. Should this ice come into contact with any liquid at all it acts as a seed crystal that cause that liquid to instantly freeze into Ice 9. You are immune to the freezing effects of Ice 9, but one misplaced shard could potentially end the world.
pros: Freeze anything and anyone into almost unmeltable ice.
cons: Do not let Ice 9 come into contact with the ocean.
It will end life on earth as we know it.

name: Myth Power: Harpocrates' Secret
overview: channel Harpocrates' command over the essence of silence and secrecy
description: Harpocrates (Harpokrates), in Greek myth, was the god of silence, secrets and secrecy. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive when people are hiding something, what it is, and (if it's a physical thing) WHERE it is. In addition, one's own mind is protected from the same intrusion; when subjects try to invade one's mind, all they hear is silence. Furthermore, one can psychically nullify ambient sound at will. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and command mute creatures.
pros: Perceive secrets of any kind (treasure chest, kidnapped person, embarassing thought, etc)
Mind/aura can't be read; Nullify ambient sound (move silently; withstand/disrupt sonic attacks)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and command mute/non-speaking/non-vocal creatures
cons: Cannot hide subjects' thoughts/emotions/memories/personality from them until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot SHARE one's Power Cloaking, Aura Cloaking or Mental Immunity until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Hesykhia's Hush provides immunity (NCN)

name: Power Murderer
overview: gain one's powers if you kill them.
description: If you kill others, you will gain their powers. This power is useless against people with no powers.  If you kill a person who has the same power as you, it will be given a boost.
pros: If you steal a power they can come back, but if you kill them they can't.
Easier with some killing abilities.
If you kill someone indirectly, you still get their powers.
cons: May be hard/dangerous to kill someone with powers.
Could feel guilty.

name: Claw Of Sickness
overview: transform one's hand into a claw that causes sickness with a touch
description: You can basically transform your hand into a 10 centimetre long set of claws. The claws look a sickly green. Upon scratching a person the claws will give them a random disease. It can be any disease from Chickenpox to Black Death. The disease will not travel outside of the victim(s) so as not to cause a pandemic.
pros: Get claws that cause sickness.
The disease in another person's body can't affect you if it was created by this power.
cons: Cannot create a true pandemic (The people get different diseases).
Scratching yourself and getting Black Death.

name: Dance Master
overview: dance like a master (Hip-Hop, Charlie Brown, slow, etc.)
description: Dance any way you want and be the best, without even breaking a sweat.
pros: No more getting served
Won't embarrass yourself
Crime fight and dance at same time
cons: Gangs will want to hurt you
Might lose friends due to jealousy

name: The Crown
overview: cause anyone to kneel down in one's presence
description: With this power alone you can cause anyone to kneel down to you. When kneeling they are prevented from doing anything else. If you have the powers, 'The Throne' and 'The Scepter' as well then you can control their minds instead of just forcing them to kneel.
pros: You can control almost anyone if you have all three powers.
cons: Forcing people to kneel isn't all that useful.

name: Rise Of The Landshark
overview: turn into a landshark
description: With this power you can turn into a landshark. A landshark is pretty much just a shark with legs and feet where their tail should be and arms and hands were their fins should be. As a landshark you have super strength and invulnerability along with super sharp teeth and the ability to breathe under water. As a landshark you are unable to speak unless you are under water.
pros: You can turn into a super strong landshark with super sharp teeth and can breathe under water
cons: You are not able to speak unless you are underwater

name: Power Health Chain
overview: have all of your powers status be affected by the status of the one designated power.
description: With this ability you can basically select one of your powers to make the base chain link. If that power get's copied all of your powers get's copied, if that power get's a strength boost all of your powers get a strength boost. This affect does not include status such as activation as in if you activate said power all of your powers do not activate at the same time as well unless you wish so.
pros: Upgrade all of your powers by upgrading the base chain link.
As long as the base chain is not negated none of your other powers can be negated.
cons: Obvious. If the base power gets negated all of your powers get negated.
If the base power becomes weakened all of your powers become weakened.
Only one power can be the base power.

name: Magic Diffusing Mist
overview: generate a mist in which magic is weakened
description: Any magic that enters the mist will have its effect be half as powerful for each second while in the mist and if it exits the mist for each second while it was in the mist it will take two seconds longer to regain full power. Anyone who breathes in the mist cannot use magic until they get the mist out of their body. You can generate the mist at any rate from 0 milliliters per second to 5 liters per second. You can only gain this power by being hit by 1000 harmful magic spells within 24 hours.
pros: 1 second in mist: 1/2 as powerful. 2 seconds: 1/4 as powerful. 3 seconds: 1/8 as powerful.
cons: You cannot hit yourself with your own spells to gain this power.
You cannot use any magic while using this power.

name: Liquid Sweat
overview: turn your sweat into any liquid
description: With this power you can turn your sweat into any kind of liquid. You can turn it into a drink so you can drink it or blood so you can make people think you're bleeding.
pros: You can turn your sweat into any liquid
cons: You have to be sweating for this power to work

name: Bio Sneeze
overview: sneeze out your own species of bacteria or virus
description: With this power you can sneeze out your own made up pathogen. You can control every thing about it from when your body gets rid of it to what symptoms you get from it.
pros: You can give your enemies embarrassing symptoms
You can give yourself symptoms that acutely help you
cons: You might not successfully give or get the germs/viruses

name: Top Chef
overview: know how to professionally prepare any meal within 10 minutes.
description: With this ability, you know every recipe for every meal in existence.  You'll know how to prepare it, exactly which ingredients you need, and you'll even be able to finish cooking within 10 minutes, no matter how many people you're cooking for or how complex the dish is.  You're just that friggin good.
pros: Cook whatever you want quickly
Be the next Food Network Star
The ladies love a man who can cook
cons: People might be embarrassed to cook for you
Paying for gourmet foods
Managing the hotel you'll probably want to open

name: Brain Washed
overview: summon a dark cloud of rain to brain wash subjects.
description: You can summon a dark cloud of rain to completely take away 100 years of knowledge from them so they are like infants.
pros: You an make foes have the mind of an infant
You can fight babies instead of real foes.
cons: It gets weird with an infant/man thing who you are trying to behead.

name: Fire Wolf
overview: turn inta a wolf that is on fire
description: To turn into a wolf that is on fire and it can spit out fire from its mouth.
pros: Your a burning wolf
Can breath in fire
It looks like a werwolf
cons: Doesn't like water
wind hits it your a regular wolf
Anything touch it, it will catch it on fire

name: Pit
overview: make pits appear anywhere
description: With this power you can cause a pit that is ten feet deep and ten feet wide to appear anywhere on the ground or floor. You can make them appear under an enemy or make one so you can hide in. You cannot get rid of the pits once you create them.
pros: You can make pits appear anywhere
cons: You can't get rid of the pits

name: Third Eye: Inner Eye
overview: utilize a third eye gained through meditation
description: Through long, hard meditation the owner of this power has gained an internal third eye. This eye grants the owner the power to have visions, clairvoyance, observation of chakra and auras, precognition, and out-of-body experiences. In order to maintain the eye, the holder has to meditate, although not as much.
pros: It is mental and cannot be seen unlike the third eye in the Third Eye power.
The eye gives multiple powers.
cons: Must meditate to gain the eye.
Have to meditate to maintain power.
Might not get the eye even for several years worth of meditation.

name: Fingernail Whip Blades
overview: turn one's fingernails into blades that are on the ends of threads
description: The blades are connected to the fingers by 1 millimetre-thick threads. The blades are sharp enough to cut through a cable of wires, and can take 10000 Newtons of force. Minimum size of the blades is 1 centimetre while maximum size of the blades is 5 centimetres. The threads can extend to be up to 500 metres long with minimum length being 2 centimetres. If the threads are destroyed, the blades immediately dissolve into raw minerals.
pros: The blades are extremely sharp which allows cutting of most materials.
Can fight long-range battles against close-range enemies without moving that much.
Don't need to gesture to move the blade.
cons: Accidently cutting yourself would be a really really horrible idea.
The blades can't take a large amount of force being put on them.
Blades and threads have the same weaknesses and hardness as fingernails.

name: Vision Displacement
overview: see with another part of your body
description: This power enables you to make your own eyes disappear, to create two new ones wherever you want on your body and to see with them. The new eyes do not damage the organs they appear into, are fully functional and have perfect eyesight regardless of where they appear. For example, they can appear on the back of the skull where there should be bones or in the palm of the hands even though the hands themselves aren't thick enough for eyeballs to fit. The eyes can appear on separate locations.
pros: Litterally keep an eye behind you.
Look into areas you couldn't reach before.
You don't need glasses or contact lenses for your new eyes.
cons: You will look creepy with your new eyes and your empty eye sockets.
You might need some time to get used to your new eyes' location.

name: Three Steps At A Time
overview: take stairs and ladders three steps at a time.
description: Most people take every step. Some people can take them two at a time. This power makes you one of the rare people who can take three steps at a time without fear of tripping and falling. It's active by default, so you will unconsciously climb or get down stairs or ladders three by three. To temporarily deactivate it, you just need to watch your step. However, it doesn't just work with stairs and ladders, it also affects you when you walk toward or from any kind of step, such as a high sidewalk.
pros: A quick and easy way to climb or get down stairs or ladders.
It's always active, so you don't have to think about activating it when you chase after someone.
cons: If the number of steps isn't a multiple of three, you can fall or trip at the end of the course.
This power also makes you take three steps when there's only one to take.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Legends: Anansi.
overview: channel the power of the Spider God.
description: With this power, the user conjures the mythical forces of the legendary Anansi (literally meaning "spider"). As such, they become engulfed with the creature's magnificent might. The user can transform into a human-sized spider, possessing immortality, eight very long legs, metal-rendering fangs, superhuman speed and enhanced strength, adhere to any surface, shape-shifting, as well as generate magically-imbued illusions.
pros: The power can be activated at any given moment.
The user becomes as powerful as Anansi himself.
The user is able to contend against the Gods with amazing powers!
cons: The user may lose to a stronger God.
The user may grow insane due to the power of the Spider God.
The user may draw unwanted attention.

name: Sing, Sing A Song
overview: make people start singing
description: With this power you can make people sing any song you want at any time even if they're asleep or they've never heard the song before in their life
pros: It's funny to make people sing ridiculous songs
Make your enemies break into song during a fight
Make your teacher break out into song in the middle of class
cons: As soon as they're done singing the song they return back to normal until you make them sing again

name: Mallet Quake
overview: slam a mallet to the ground, shaking everything in sight.
description: This power only works only when you are using a Mallet or a Sledgehammer to cause a Aftershock, Avalanche, Tremor, Fissure, Earthquake and whatever you wanna call it.
pros: You could even put this ability to good use when you are outnumbered.
cons: A small toolhammer is not acceptable.

name: Wereliger
overview: transform into a beast that's half-lion and half-tiger.
description: The curse of the wereliger. As such, your power is affected, but not entirely controlled by instincts. In your transformed state, you have increased strength, dexterity and agility, you also hold heightened senses and a healing factor, and last, you have razor-sharp claws and teeth. All of that and only you could be bitten or scratched by a radioactive Liger.
pros: Gain a new personality.
cons: You can only acquire these abilities by being bitten or scratched by a radioactive Liger.

name: Lightning Thumbs
overview: have nearly unbreakable thumbs that can move ten times faster than normal.
description: With this ability, you have nearly unbreakable thumbs that can move ten times faster than normal.
pros: You have faster thumbs that are more resistant.
cons: Only good for videogames.

name: Myth Power: Alala's Alarum
overview: channel Alala and her command over the essence of the call to arms (the battlecry or warcry)
description: Alala (Alale), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the battle-cry or war-cry, "Alala" or "Alale". As such, channeling her allows one to give a great, loud cry with three effects. Neutrals will be intimidated (often to the point of either fleeing or passing out); foes will become temporarily stunned for a few seconds; allies will have their stats, fighting skill and hostility will be amplified, and they will gain the ability to wield even their most mundane possessions like weapons of combat.
pros: Frighten neutral onlookers to make way for a battlefield anywhere you choose
Give allies a headstart in any fight
Turn allies into powerful warriors, who wield ordinary items like weapons of war
cons: Some may actually have to yell "ALALA" or "ALALE" to activate this ability, until developed
Headstart in a fight is only by a few seconds; cannot turn mundane objects into actual weapons (NCN)
MythPower: Ares' Wrath and MythPower: Eris' Enmity provide power with this ability (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Persephone's Poise
overview: channel Persephone's command over the essence of spring's bounty and the depths of the underworld
description: Persephone (Kore), in Greek myth, was the goddess of bountiful produce in the spring and summer, and withdrawal of produce in the fall and winter. She was also Queen of the Underworld, alongside Hades. As such, channeling her allows one to accelerate/reverse plant growth, and communicate with plants, at will. In addition, one can mimic the powers of plants (photosynthesis, producing roots, thorns, leaves, plant-based pheromones and toxins, etc) at will. One even gains many underworld benefits.
pros: Perceive, communicate with, grow, reverse growth of and mimic powers of plants; favored by nymphs
Withstand/disrupt all death-based, underworld-based or infernal powers (including MythPowers)
Offer a foe a pomegranate; the number of seeds eaten is the number of hours he will have bad luck
cons: People with MythPower: Zeus Power and MythPower: Demeter's Touch are immune to this ability
People with strong death-based, underworld-based or infernal MythPowers can resist Pro #3
People with probability/chance/luck based MythPowers and Unpredictability are immune to Pro #3

name: Personal Train Engine
overview: create your own train engine complete with a limited amount of track always under it.
description: You can create a train engine with 30 feet of track before it,under it and behind it. This track will always be there even when going 125 mph in the train engine. The train engine is powered by this power. If going over water or a open space a bridge will be under the track. Depth of the water or the open space is no problem. You do have to be on the ground to initially use this power. This power will cause temporary tunnels thru hills and mountains.
pros: The train engine doesn't need fuel.
You can travel 125 mph.
You can cross the ocean as long as you start on land.
cons: A train engine isn't that maneuverable.
To start, you need room for the 30 feet of track before and after the train engine.

name: Orange Light
overview: generate a thick orange field around you that greatly slows human thought.
description: You can make a 20 meter thick orange field that, when entered, greatly slows human thought, weakens reflexes and allows one to escape foes.
pros: Escape.
Stop plan making.
Covers large area.
cons: Will affect every one in area.

name: Roulette Wheel
overview: summon a roulette wheel that you can use to make magical bets.
description: With this power you can summon a roulette wheel that will levitate near you. You can then make a bet that something will happen and numbers on the roulette wheel will light up. The more extreme the bet, the less numbers will light up. You will then spin a ball that comes with the roulette wheel on the wheel and if the ball lands in one of the slots for the lit up numbers then what you bet will come true. If your bet wrong then something bad will happen to you similar to what you bet.
pros: Can summon it for use at any time.
Can bet that near anything would happen, and cause it to become true.
If you are lucky or have luck powers.
cons: If you have bad luck.
The more exteme a bet is the less likely that you will get what you want.
If you get the bet wrong then you will face consequences.

name: Specific Superstrength
overview: lift between 500 and 750 pounds exactly, no more no less
description: You can still lift what you would normally be able to lift, but also have the option to superhumanly lift objects between 500 and 750 lbs like they're styrofoam
pros: Impressive party trick
Throw small vehicles and boulders like they are nothing
If you obtain a weapon of the right weight and whatnot, you can wield it
cons: Anything less than 500 lbs is too heavy for you
If the object you are lifting loses weight, it may crush you

name: Toast
overview: turn bread into toast just by looking at it
description: With this power you can toast bread just by looking at it. You are unable to reverse the affects of this power but you can turn it on and off.
pros: You can toast bread with your eyes
You can turn this power on and off
cons: Not much use in physical combat
You cannot reverse the affects of this power

name: Living Tattoos
overview: make your tattoos come to life.
description: With living tattoo you can make your body art come to life, assuming you have tattoos of course. Have a lion defend you in combat, have an escape vehicle, or a weapon, etc. When you tattoos come to life you are momentarily in a coma-like state leaving you defenseless for that short while.
pros: Make your tattoos fight for you.
Have a an escape vehicle.
Create a weapon on hand.
cons: Must have tattoos.
Coma-like state.
Those ridiculous tattoos.

name: Soul Whisper
overview: talk to souls
description: With the Soul Whisper ability, you are able to talk to the souls of people around you and people from the past. When talking to a soul, you leave your body and your soul takes over, continuing on with your life. When in soul mode, you can talk to other souls and even convince them to leave their bodies causing their body to die. You can also ask other souls to do work for you. But beware, not all souls are good and some souls may try to harm you or trick you into danger.
pros: You can pretty much kill people
You can leave your body while it unconciously works
You can find information about that history assignment by talking to Abe Lincoln's soul
cons: As a soul, you are more vulnerable to dying in the real world, unless your soul is strong
Prolonged exposure in the soul world can be dangerous

name: Moon Blade 1st Form: Blood Red
overview: conjure a blade allowing blood manipulation.
description: Blade with a gold hilt, silver blade and a red jemstone set at the end of the hilt. To draw out say: "Moon Blade, First form Blood Red." Allows for blood manipulation abilities. Also, even a drop of blood on the red jem allows the sword to gain tremendous power against the owner of the blood.
pros: Can be used with other moon blades. (same power)
Almost unstoppable once it has been exposed to the blood of the enemy.
cons: Slightly less useful without enemy's blood.
Since it allows blood manupulation, the blood will most likely be yours, which will weaken you.

name: Nova Tiger Staff
overview: use it to strike enemies with a glowing essence.
description: The nova tiger staff is a powerful bo staff that has tiger stripes on it with larger spearheads at both ends, and with it you can illuminate yourself with a yellow-orange force and strike your opponent, could posess some special mind powers, allowing you to conjure up illusions and make others believe that something is happening, and extensively transform it into trichucks.
pros: Can use it to put a forcefield around yourself which causes projectiles to go through you.
Could use it to teleport back to you.
Can use it to gather up energy and shoot from the staff.
cons: Using this staff requires a great deal of advanced preparation and it drains you.
If it is used too long, then you'll become feral and your human memories will be erased.

name: Toy Model To Real Item
overview: turn model toys into the real thing
description: You can turn toy models into the real thing for 1 hr. The toy can be of any material and can be anything reasonable. E. G. Toy plane to actual plane, model of a girl to actual girl. The 'item' will work just as if it was made normally.
pros: Can always have a friend if you have the right model.
Can travel the world for free.
cons: Transformation of objects lasts for only one hour.
If you don't have the right model(s).

name: Pearly Whites Of Doom
overview: have glowing/destructive teeth
description: If you have this power, you will find a natural but translucent coating on your teeth that is connected to your nervous system. It destroys leftover food and bacteria and absorbs light every time you open your mouth. You can control this coating and make it release the light it absorbed. You can also control the way in which it's released, and how much. It could be mere radiance to help you see in the dark, or a full blast of photons in the form of a 'laser'.
pros: Naturally clean teeth which emit light when you want them to!
Brighten a dark room, or blow it to bits.
Surprise your dentist!
cons: This light runs out the more you use it, so you have to recharge it sometimes.
People might get digusted that you won't clean your teeth (even if you don't have to).
Accidents do happen...

name: Thirteen Treasures: Whetstone
overview: use the whetstone of Tudwal Gludwyd
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. If a brave man would sharpen his sword on this whetstone, it would surely kill any man from which it drew blood.
pros: Arm your friends with deadly swords.
Make any blade deadly.
cons: Hard work.
Anybody can use the whetstone.
Won't work if you aren't brave.

name: Taming Sari Keris
overview: use the mystical Taming Sari Keris
description: The user with this mystical keris is granted both super human strength as well as durability. This keris can only be used by a person pure of heart as well as brave. However, to use the keris effectively, the user must be trained extensively in the art of silat first
pros: Superhuman strength and durability
Can fight most threats
cons: User without having physical contact with the keris will not have its power bestowed on them
Does not grant you martial arts skill to use the keris effectively

name: Warning
overview: cause warnings to appear on objects listing their potential dangers
description: With this power you can cause written warnings to appear on any object. The warnings will list every possible danger the object could pose to the power user. If their are too many potential dangers the list scrolls automatically at a slowish pace (like the opening crawl for Star Wars movies but less epic).
pros: You can know all of the potential dangers of any object
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Myth Power: Graces' Graces
overview: channel the Charites' command over the essence of grace, elegance and charm
description: These Charites (Kharites, Graces), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of charm, elegance, grace and beauty. As such, channeling Aglaia (Adornment), one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those wearing flashy or fancy clothes, jewelry or accessories. Channeling Thalia (Thaleia- Good Cheer), one can induce and amplify positive emotion by touch (and withstand negative emotion). Channeling Euphrosyne (Mirth), one can generate sparkles and illusions to entertain or mesmerize foes.
pros: Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel those with a flashy wardrobe
Induce/amplify good emotions by a touch; immune to bad emotions
Cast entertaining illusions; generate mesmerizing sparkles
cons: Cannot gain Hypnotic Charm or Laughter Inducing (by touch) until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Said by Pseudologoi provide immunity to Part 1 of Pro #3 (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provides immunity (NCN)

name: Piece Of Eden: The Staff
overview: use a staff that can create powerful illusions.
description: The Staff has the ability to create powerful illusions. It can also be used as a weapon.
pros: Has a blade at the bottom that can be used in a fight.
cons: Can be destroyed and if it is, it causes a HUGE explosion.
Enemies can use it.

name: Giganto
overview: bulk up really fast or bulk down really fast.
description: You will be able to become strong and really big in seconds, or become weak and small again. So stay big.
pros: Being very very strong
Looking really good
Super scary
cons: Roid rage

name: Unknown Immortality
overview: live forever in obscurity
description: No one will know you. No one will know your name, your face, or your opinions. Not even your family and friends. People will forget that you ever existed. In exchange for this, you will be made immortal (barring accidents). With this power, you can spend eternity living like a ghost, staying and taking whatever you want, but no person will ever speak to you or acknowledge your presence.
pros: Live forever.
Stay wherever and take whatever you like.
No one will ever acknowledge you.
cons: No one will EVER acknowledge you.

name: Full Metal Alchemists: Pride
overview: have the abilities of the sin, pride.
description: Prides abilities are very useful.  First, you become an umbrakinetic.  Anything that encounters your shadow you will be able to devour/slice through it.  You can exist in two forms, your original human form and a shadowy form, you can exist in the shadowy form, but when the shadow is gone you will need to go to the other form.  You gain all knowledge and abilities of those who you devour.
pros: You can control darkness.
You exist in two forms.
You gain all knowledge and abilities of who you devour.
cons: There needs to be a light source for a shadow to exist.
You attempt things that are out of the ordinary, with pride in yourself.

name: Enhancement: Widen
overview: widen the sphere of influence of another power.
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it multiplies the size of the power's sphere of influence (the area the power affects) by 2 and a half. Ex: 100-meter radius becomes 250-meter radius. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: Sphere of influence is really important for some powers.
cons: Useless without another power.
Has no effect on powers that affect only the user as a 0 meter/inch radius times anything is still 0

name: Raindrop Shield
overview: create raindrop-shaped shields on one's forearms
