description: The raindrop-shaped shields have a radius of double your arm length and the point extends another 15 centimetres from the center. The shields have a design based on the mind, soul, and body of the user and can take damage based on the user's willpower. The shields can also have up to ten small handheld objects stored between them and the arms.
pros: Unique design for each individual being.
Small amount of storage space.
cons: If you have no willpower.
NO tanks, planes, androids, etc. There is not enough space in the storage area.

name: Summon Mini Sharke
overview: summon a tiny temporal energy monster
description: Mini-sharke are 7 inches long, can fly, and look like a eel/baby shark mix. Mini-sharke can take tiny little bites out of any matter that won't last forever, Wolverine's claws or Superman for example. Mini-sharke make up for their tiny size by being of genius IQ and possessing invisibility. They only thing that will hurt, stop or contain them are psionic, temporal or magical powers. A mini-sharke stays until you unsummon it. You can summon a new one every day. Mini-sharke can go unsupervised.
pros: A extremely smart,small,flying and invisible spy.
You have no reason to unsummon them. They're house pets.
They can turn invisible and attack as a swarm.
cons: You may become a mini-sharke collector.
You give them cute names.
If your not smart enough--will you understand what they're saying?

name: Human Garden
overview: grow from your body any object put into your body.
description: With this power, you can become a human garden for anything that is put into your body. Whatever food you eat can start to grow out of your back, without taking any energy from you. This power works on objects that are not food as well, such as putting a blade in your mouth and then having blades sprout from your back. If you have part of an animal or person inside you, you can regrow their body but not their mind.
pros: Have as much food as you need by regrowing what you eat.
Works on items that are not food, such as blades.
Can stop growing things at any point and detatch them from your body.
cons: May be awkward to have many things growing from your body.
Speed of growth varies between people so you might be stuck with growing things incredibly slow.
Can only grow things that have recently been put into your body.

name: One Last Time
overview: automatically use a power at the last moment before death.
description: You can pair this with another power, the power paired with this one will active one moment before your death.
pros: It's automatic.
You pick the power.
cons: If your about to die, why would you need to use a power.

name: Myth Power: Corymbos' Course
overview: channel Corymbos' command over the essence of the ivy plant, used to crown mystery initiates
description: Corymbos (Corymbus, Korymbos), in Greek myth, was the god of the ivy plant, which crowned ancient Greek mystery initiates' heads. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically summon a crown of ivy to one's head, at will, to withstand compulsions, magic and reality bending, at will. In addition, one can psychically summon crowns to subjects' heads, by touch, to dominate them, at will. One can even psychically launch ivy berries from crowns, and detonate them with power like bombs, at will.
pros: Psychically summon an ivy crown to one's head, to withstand compulsions, magic and reality bending
Psychically crown subjects with ivy to dominate their minds, by touch, at will
Psychically launch ivy-crown berries, explode them like bombs; ivy crowns near impossible to remove
cons: If crowns are unremoved, user's sleep/unconsciousness/death put the crowned in a coma (NCN)
Pro #2 cannot bypass mental defenses until developed (NCN)
Eleusinian cult-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Frost Bite
overview: make someones hand freeze.
description: With this ability you can control a persons hand temperature to way below zero and weaken them because they wont be able to use their hands.
pros: Opponent cant use hands
You can get a good hit
cons: You cant use it on their legs
You have to touch their hands

name: Moon Blade 7th: Lost Violet
overview: create a moon blade that manipulates emotions.
description: The moon blade allows you to: 1) Show someone your emotions (can also be a multiple of your emotions, such as 2x the happiness you have). 2) Multiply their emotion (or reduce it). 3) Create additional emotions
pros: You can inflict extreme sadness or laziness on a person, which kills them almost instantly
Makes them unable to do anything.
cons: Must touch the person with the blade.
Useless on anything without feelings (zombies are a good example)

name: Jawbreaker
overview: inexplicably break anyone's jaw at any given time.
description: So long as the person is within seeing range, you can snap your fingers and break the person's lower jaw. You don't have to punch them, and it won't do anything other than break the person's jaw.
pros: Quick incapacitation technique without killing them
No contact needed
Shuts people up fast
cons: Control may or may not be an issue
Person can make a lot of noise afterwords, not exactly stealthy

name: Description Reduction
overview: reduce any ability to what can be understood from its overview, and only its overview.
description: You know the overview? That sentence sitting between the title and the description? This power can affect any ability so its description is reduced only to what's in the overview, losing everything else! No more title, full description, pros and cons, tags, creator name, possessors' names (excluding the name of the one on whom you use this power), statistics and comment section. The affected ability is reduced to what can be understood and interpreted from the overview alone.
pros: Has the potential to greatly improve any ability since limitations are usually lost in the process.
Used correctly, it is a great counter to Power Sacrifice (Hey, it says you're the only possessor! )
Same thing against Author Power Mimicry (Hey, it doesn't say you created this power! )
cons: A lot of details can be lost during the process, possibly resulting in a vastly different power.
Nothing can be added to the description.
Some overviews are badly written or open to interpretation.

name: Tune Of Sadness
overview: play music that makes everyone sad.
description:
You are able to make an instrument appear out of nowhere and play music on it that makes everyone sad. This effect is globally, so if you play all beings become sad. 
You don't need to be able to play the actual instrument.
pros: Make everyone understand the way you feel.
Nobody is able to move or act while you play.
You don't need to drag an instrument around everywhere you go.
cons: Deaf or people who ear plugs are immune.
If everyone is sad, who will cheer you up?
The effect ends once you seize to play.

name: Moon Blade 6th:Crystal Diamond
overview: create a Moon Blade made of diamond.
description: The Moon Blade is transparent but can still be seen. Made of unbreakable diamond. The main use is that if you focus any type of laser-like power (or other powers) on it, you can make the blade act like a prism and reflect the power all around you, without harming you.
pros: With training, it's possible to focus power reflection on a specific target.
Great for using that laser vision on a crowd of people at the same time.
Unbreakable, and can cut nearly all things.
cons: Before you learn to focus the rays, you better not use it while allies are near you.
Aside from reflection, has no special powers.

name: Farslayer
overview: wield the sword of vengeance
description: Farslayer, unlike many other Swords, is quite direct in function. It requires you to think of a person you want killed and then swing the sword above your head three times, thinking of their name. Farslayer then flies through the air, leaving a trail often confused with a rainbow or a comet. It ignores all obstacles, all barriers, and any protections. Once it hits the person, they will almost always die. And the sword will remain there, possibly to be used by their mourning relatives.
pros: Lets you kill virtually anyone, even gods and immortals.
Ignores all barriers.
Well balanced, super sharp sword resistant to most damage
cons: Can be used against you.
Once it leaves your hand, there's no going back
Can only kill from a distance

name: Soul Eating Breath
overview: erode life energy and strengthen yourself with your breath
description: You breathe a black cloud acting as a spiritual acid, partially dissolving the soul of any living thing it touches and channeling the energy back to you, boosting you physically and spiritually. Eventually, it will completely devour the soul of the target. The cloud is steerable to a certain extent, and its speed and area depend largely on the power and skill of the user. The most proficient users of this ability have been known to wipe planets clean of all life, even bacteria, in an hour.
pros: Will kill anything with enough use
Bestows massive amounts of energy
Nearly unblockable (the cloud is made of an antilife solution)
cons: Ineffective against nonliving targets
The cloud is a bit difficult to control, and will affect anyone it touches
Excessive movement will break the link and negate the ability

name: Myth Power: Calocagathia's Call
overview: channel Calocagathia's command over the essence of goodness, nobility, honor and prestige
description: Calocagathia (Kalokagathia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of nobility and goodness. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive and alter others' noble qualities (chivalry, charity, honor, loyalty, devotion to just causes, etc). In addition, one may withstand compulsions they see as morally wrong.  Furthermore, one may psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those of noble lineage (aristocrats, heirs/heiresses, etc). One may even become a literal knight in shining armor at will.
pros: Perceive and manipulate others' noble qualities at will; withstand immoral compulsions
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those descended from prestige (noble pedigree)
Turn into a literal knight in shining armor at will (indestructible armor/weapons, immortal horse)
cons: Effects of Pro #1 and Pro #2 last only until power's use is up (NCN)
Mental Immunity/Perspicuity provide immunity to Pro #1 and Pro #2 (NCN)
Sin/injustice/corruption-based MythPowers and MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provide immunity (NCN)

name: Panontic Arch: Nameless
overview: gain powers from the nameless dimension.
description: Nameless dimension. Prison of beings and things that should not be named. The first power is to let one out into this world for just a second. Everyone within 500 feet of you not possessing a supernatural power or the Living Memory power will be gone. Not a single atom will remain. You can also imprison someone in this dimension by touch. Anyone possessing a supernatural power can't be affected.
pros: Entire SWAT team surrounding you. No problem.
Some resurrection powers require at least a single atom to work.
The panontic is supernatural. You are immune to these powers.
cons: Supernatural would also include: myth power, demonic, infernal, holy.
Magical, cthulhu mythos, angelic, unholy, undead beings and werebeings (e.g. werewolf)
Any other power described as supernatural in nature not mentioned here.

name: Vampirism
overview: have all the traditional abilities (and weaknesses) of a vampire
description: With this ability, you gain superior strength, speed, durability, stamina, senses, reflexes, agility, accuracy, dexterity, and basically immortality. You can turn into a bat, a wolf, a red mist, or (at the higher level) even the form of another human. In addition, you gain the power Hypnotism, and as your power develops, you may be able to fly. The only shortcoming is that, with all the traditional powers of a vampire, you also get all the traditional weaknesses.
pros: Enhanced attributes and can shapeshift to assume various different forms
Immortal (longevity, regeneration, poison/disease/hanging/guns/drowing/electrocution can't kill you)
Powers of Hypnotism (including Hypnotic Charm), power to command canines, and Shapeshifting
cons: You are extremely vulnerable to sunlight (if you haven't had blood in about three days)
Allergy to garlic, holy symbols, stakes and silver
Can't cross rivers, no reflection, and no shadow (until powers develop, bound to coffin)

name: Black Hole Whips
overview: wield symbiotic black hole whips
description: You're a master of black hole whips (dark energy/dark matter whips). Use them on your enemies as regular whips or synchronize various black holes to become near undefeatable. Wrap yourself in them & you are immune to the vacuum of space & even black hole effects. They can be used to swing around large areas
pros: They absorb or bend light, allowing you to blend in with shadows or become invisible
You are their host so no one can lift them but you (density shifting)
cons: You are still normal
It will take a while to learn to use a whip and study theoretical quantum physics
You might end up destroying Earth and this solar system

name: Myth Power: Horae (Seasons3)
overview: channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the four seasons
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the four seasons; winter, spring, summer and fall. As such, channeling Theros (Therus- Summer) allows one to psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth summer weather at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere where it is naturally summer. Furthermore, one can withstand heat. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of summer at will.
pros: Psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth summer weather at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere it is naturally summer; withstand heat
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of summer
cons: Cannot psychically Time Travel to future/past summers until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate time during NATURAL summer until developed (NCN)
Olympian MythPowers and elemental MythPowers related to heat/summer provide immunity (NCN)

name: Forced Standing
overview: force people to stand.
description: Isn't it a pain in the ass when you have to stand all day long? Well, now you can FORCE people to endure this misery! Or, you can use this for entertainment! Just think of the possibilities... Disrupting class, bathrooms, a unique form of torture, and get this: at the next football game you can choreograph and execute the PERFECT wave! How can you go wrong? Not to mention the fun you would have at church...
pros: Disrupting prayer
Easily get revenge on someone while they're dropping a deuce
Endless hours of fun
cons: You will be known as The Great Bringer of Discomfort

name: Brick Creation
overview: create blocks of any material with your mind.
description: Like the little guys from Blockland, you can create colored bricks that are of the material of your imagination. Up to 128 thousand of these bricks can be created on one world.
pros: Create any kind of material in the shape of a brick.
You can trap people in these bricks.
You can make a house at no cost.
cons: Limited to 128 thousand on one world.
The whole block will be demolished from the hit of a hammer, as long as it's not a support block.
You can only create them from a limted distance.

name: Dehydration
overview: suck the water out of an object
description: A Dehydrator may look normal, but you need to be wary around them. They can drain an object of its water content--wood, Kool-Aid, living things, etc.--leaving it dry and brittle. This water is then metabolized. This ability comes with an incredible thirst, as a result of the body quickly clearing water from its system. It is also difficult to stop using this ability once you have started without draining something first.
pros: Kill easily
Re-powder Kool-Aid
Affect anything with water content
cons: Comes with an incredible thirst
Hard to stop after starting without draining something
Cannot affect things with menial water content

name: Brain Freeze
overview: give people brain freeze
description: A person with this power has the power to give people an ice-cream headache. They can control the length of the brain freeze and can trick people into thinking that they ate something cold.
pros: Hurts people from afar
Makes them incapable of attacking properly
Non-lethal
cons: Non-lethal

name: Delete This Giga X Ray Assault
overview: completely break all of your opponent's bones.
description: True to its name, it is an ability of a sequence that lets you look through your foe's body with an X-Ray vision. Then, you rush to your enemy, breaking off both their arms and legs, karate chopping their spine, but before launching the pile driver, you go in mid-air, breaking their ribcage, and the impact upon landing shatters their skull. Now that's gotta hurt.
pros: It's extremely useful when your foe is dizzy.
cons: a fight combo is not a power

name: Prophet
overview: talk to your patron deity
description: With this power you can talk to God (whatever that means to you) and directly ask him/her/them anything you want; To gain insight into the past, the future and other vital information, to gain favors like healings and miracles, etc.; This power has no time limit and you can use it multiple times
pros: You can talk to the god you worship
He might help you in battle if you become his friend
He might grant your requests
cons: He might not want to talk to you
He might not grant any of your requests (a god can't be manipulated like an element)
He might want to smite you if you're corrupt (unless you worship an evil god)

name: Bases Control
overview: control bases (the opposite of acids)
description: With this power, you can spew bases out of your hands and also change the PH level of your skin and blood. The big benefit of this power is a lot of villains have power over acids. Well, with power over bases, you can balance that acid to a PH level of 7 making it water. Also, since bases are just as strong as acids, it has offensive potential too.
pros: You can balance villains who have acidic powers
Everyone will assume you have powers over acids when really it is bases
Since acids and bases are equal in strength, you can still fight other villains
cons: There are not a lot of superhero names for someone who controls bases
You cannot really kill an acidic villain, just make his powers useless
If you cannot control it, you will melt through everything like you are acidic

name: Illusion Vision
overview: see through illusions
description: You can see trough illusions! It's like the x-ray vision on illusions! Just don't use it during magic shows.
pros: If your enemy's power is to make illusions, they're screwed
You don't run into mirage water in the desert
Be a show off at the desert
cons: Magic shows won't be fun if you use it
If you can make illusions and your enemy has this power, you're screwed
It's not fun to see through every illusion

name: Kissing In The Rain
overview: kiss someone and make them experience different feelings and emotions.
description: With this power, you can kiss someone and make them feel certain ways. For instance, if someone is feeling sad, you can kiss them and make them feel happy. Not only can you make them experience emotions, you can also control their physical feelings. For instance, if someone is tired, you can kiss them to give them energy.
pros: You can kiss someone anywhere on their body (hand, cheek, lips, etc. )
If the person wanted the kiss, accepted it, or was happy to get it, the power works even better.
cons: If you're unable to kiss someone, the power won't work.
If the person didn't want the kiss or didn't accept it, the effect wears off faster or can be broken

name: External Superpower Activation
overview: activate your own power by having someone else fulfil all the conditions needed to use it.
description: This is the counterpart of Forced Superpower Activation. Instead of activating someone else's power by fulfilling the conditions to use it, you can activate one of your own powers while someone else fulfils the required conditions. This can be tricky to use if there's a very short time frame when the conditions are reunited. For example, if the condition is saying "Adeat", you must already be using this power on them before they say it, not while they say it, not after.
pros: If you are put in a position where you can't activate your power, someone can activate it for you.
If you'll never be able to fulfil the conditions yourself, like being pregnant as a man.
If the effects normally manifest on your body, they will still manifest on your body, not theirs.
cons: In some cases, this person can use your power as they want, possibly against you, like telekinesis.
If the conditions must be maintained to keep your power active, you will be depending on them.
Tricky if there's a very short period of time when all the conditions are reunited.

name: Songspeak
overview: communicate psychically with others through song
description: One with this ability can communicate psychically with others through song. They need only sing or hum a note, and the musical sound conveys the message without need for lyrics (similarly, music from others conveys a message to the user). In addition, the user may use this ability to mimic (and resist) Hypnotic Song, Psychic Song, Dread Song, Siren Song, or the like, based on what is needed. Furthermore, the ability results in a beautiful, tireless singing voice.
pros: Communicate in a way that's even more discreet than telepathy or empathy
Mimic (and resist) any song-based ability
Awesome singing voice
cons: Doesn't allow you to otherwise manipulate sound
No sonic attacks unless they sound song-like (no just outright compulsions)
Deaf people

name: Blessing Of Heimdallr
overview: be blessed by the Norse God Heimdallr
description: The user, once blessed by the Norse God Heimdallr, is granted a golden suit of armor, a golden great sword , a mystical horn and limited powers of the God Heimdall
pros: Limited Precognition
Enhanced Eyesight and Hearing ( Not super )
Can summon allies with mystical horn
cons: Can't fly
Armor and great sword reduces speed

name: Thunder Skulls
overview: fire skull like projectiles which will shock the opponent.
description: You can fire a skull of light yellow electrical energy at your opponent; it zaps and knocks them farther back, as well as having increased damage.
pros: It maybe one of the oddest projectiles ever to be on the SPL.
Works well against water-type foes.
cons: Will not have an effect on wood, plastic and rock type opponents.

name: 1 For The Money V2
overview: turn one thing into its monetary value a day
description: With this power you can turn one object into the exact amount of money you or the person who most recently bought it for. You can only use this power once a day.
pros: You can turn objects into their monetary value
cons: You can only use this power once a day

name: Summoning: Symbiotic Parasite
overview: summon a Symbiotic Parasite.
description: Symbiotic Parasite, a cruel uncaring demonic creature that latches onto people. Once summoned, it will latch onto the user, using the user's body to survive. The person whom it attaches to gains incredible powers for the cost of hosting the parasitic demon.
pros: Incredible power.
cons: Saps your energy at times.

name: Demon Doppleganger
overview: trade places with your Demon Doppleganger
description: Everyone has a demon doppleganger, most are sealed away. Some are good, some are bad.
pros: Gain demonic powers
More resilient
cons: Demons are both good and bad
Might be stuck in demon form depending on the demon

name: Concretakinesis
overview: mentally move concrete with your mind.
description: The power to mentally move concrete with your mind, allowing you to destroy concrete, use it as a shield, and make concrete mud slides.
pros: Destroy concrete.
Make shields out of concrete.
Good protection.
cons: Slower than most -kinesis.

name: Business Tycoon
overview: do extraordinary well at business management.
description: This ability you do exceedingly well, at managing business and companies. Always shooting straight to the top of the corporate ladder. Whatever your business is about. You get all the clients and become extraordinarily wealthy.
pros: Always excell in business 100% of the time.
Choices you make end up making you more money.
cons: Business management may not be one of your interests.

name: Information Inaccessibility
overview: unconditionally withhold information by burning the paper it was written on.
description: The user has the power to unconditionally withhold information by writing that information on paper, and then burning that paper afterwards. The information has to be something personal (like your name or a current position) or something that 'affects' you personally (like the name of your friend). After the informaton is burned away, any attempt to access/recover/distribute/comprehend/store it will ultimately be futile. The effects cannot be undone, even if this ability is nullified.
pros: Your opponent will never know where you are, even if you two are face to face.
Even if you say every information out loud, no one will receive nor comprehend that information.
The effects of this ability is irreversible; thus, it cannot be nullified.
cons: Only the user of this ability is unaffected. Everyone else (your family, friends, allies) is not
Irreversible

name: Rollout
overview: curl into a ball, and roll/tumble at high speeds
description: Also called Rolling or Tumbling, is the ability to curl into a ball and roll at high speeds. This can be used to tumble into foes and bowl them over, to smash through subjects like a living wrecking ball, deflect projectiles hurled at the user, or just for very quick, efficient travel. It can even be used to ricochet off walls or bounce around an area at will. Rolling is almost always at a very high speed, just like Sonic the Hedgehog.
pros: Very efficient travel (at high speed, and the back is very flexible so rolling doesn't hurt)
Good to bowl foes over with the same power as Unstoppability, but only while rolling
Superhumans try to throw you? You're very bouncy, you'll just ricochet off the walls
cons: Doesn't increase strength unless you are rolling
Doesn't increase speed unless you are rolling
Increases durability, but still hurts if you roll over surfaces like concrete roads with rocks

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes7
overview: channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling Pothos (Pothus- Passionate Longing, Desire and Yearning for the Unattainable), one can perceive the identity of a subject's dream lover, and summon a copy of that being to life. It can be altered completely to suit the user/subject's whims and falls instantly in love with the user/subject. One can even travel to and from a fictional universe where a fictional dream lover lives, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive the identity of a subject's dream lover
Psychically summon a copy of a subject's dream lover to life (create, edit and delete them) at will
Teleport self/others to and from a fictional universe where a dream lover lives, at will
cons: Knowledge/Skills/Powers/Abilities bestowed on a dream lover must grow in power over time (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Blob Transform
overview: transform into a blob
description: Similar to blob mimicry, but different (and better). You can transform into a blob with something of a "cell membrane" (you can change and hold shape). You are blue and indestructible, and have a single eye. (your brain is combined with your cells that make up you). You can switch between your normal self and blob at any time.
pros: Indestructible
Can eat things (anything)
You can see and hold shape
cons: People can go through you
You have no muscle mass

name: Set Fire To The Rain.
overview: turn rain into fireballs.
description: If you say "Set fire to the rain," the rain will turn to fire, it will be massively destructive but no worries, you are immune to the fire.
pros: Easily wipe out a village.
Immune.
You can turn the fire back to normal.
cons: Very destructive.
Cannot work without rain.

name: Floor Removal
overview: pull the floor out like a rug
description: This ability allows you to grab the floor and to pull it out. Once released, the floor will quickly come back into place. If there's a room under the floor, you can also open a passage to it. If your enemy or a bystander is standing on the floor, you can literally pull the floor out from under them to make them fall.
pros: Make your enemies trip.
Easily open an access to the room beneath the floor.
cons: Useless against flying enemies.
Works only on the floor

name: Laser Fingers
overview: shoot lasers from fingertips for pointing purposes only
description: Each finger may emit a highly accurate laser beam that can reach approximately 7 meters away to any target. The lasers can go through gloves and pockets, but are not lethal in anyway shape or form.
pros: Point extremly accurately
Blind enemies by suprise
Lasers can change colors (may cause seizures)
cons: Lasers don't burn, pierce, or harm enemies
Does no damage to the eyes
Fingers may overheat

name: Daydream Recovery
overview: recover your ability to daydream that has been crushed by certain people.
description: You can remember past daydreams. You can daydream again. You can also make it much harder for people to interrupt your daydreams (unless you want them to). Your brain puts together what it learns during daydreaming as a side effect. Your brain exercises it's complex problem solving skills during the daydream. You might become more emphathetic. A daydream might be a stronger form of imagination.
pros: Recover your ability to daydream.
Remember past daydreams
Daydreaming has similar benefits to sleeping.
cons: Might not recover imagination.
If you daydream excessively, it becomes disruptive to your life.

name: Babel
overview: cause a contagious linguistic nightmare.
description: What if you could confuse everyone you speak with to the point that they could no longer speak or understand coherent words? With this power, you could drive people nuts. Say one indistinguishable word to a person and you will cause that person to never be understood when they speak, write or communicate in any way. Each person they speak to will fall prey to your power. The only cure to your confusing bedlam is getting the victim near an open flame. What if you could confuse the entire world?
pros: You only need to speak one garbled word to begin confusing people
You could ruin an opponent's ability to think clearly and his team's communication
You are the only one who can understand the confused message your victims are trying to speak
cons: Being near any open flame ruins your effect and returns your victim's thoughts and speech to normal
No one will ever be able to accurately recount anything you say again
Your confusing babble could ruin communications across the globe

name: Summon Fractal Crystalloid
overview: once a day summon a self-replicating crystalline being.
description: A fractal crystalloid is fractal in nature, that is should one be damaged any pieces that come off will grow into new crystalloids. This cycle will keep repeating itself unless certain powers are used. Powers of total destruction, reality erasing, entrapping powers, powers that somehow freeze objects, matter control, matter manipulation, powers that control earth or crystals. Crystalloids have no minds of their own, are 6 feet tall, strong as an olympic weightlifter and look like icy skeletons.
pros: Servant-warriors that opponents will avoid damaging.
Crystalloids have no minds-mind control powers are useless.
You want an army? All you do is smash one into a thousand pieces.
cons: If some takes control of this power and turns your crystalloids against you.
Any powers that exploit a crystalloid's weaknesses.
Crystalloids can't act on their own.

name: Anti Virtual  Reality
overview: make virtual reality-based powers ineffective 100 metres around oneself
description: All powers based on virtual reality have no effect on the area 100 metres around you whenever this power is activated. This power considers any fake world on an internet server to be virtual reality as well as any power that inputs digital information into the real world.
pros: Completely counters Digitalization, Matriculation, etc.
cons: Only helps against virtual reality-based powers.

name: Author's Genius
overview: have a secondary mind whose capabilities increase exponentially.
description: This power grants the user a fully functioning yet inherently loyal mind inside your own. While it cannot use your superpowers directly, it will serve it's master in any way. It begins with the same level of intelligence, memory and creativity as its masters', but increase exponentially when a power the user added to the superpower list is acquired.
pros: If you create a lot of popular powers, this mind will be extremely intelligent and creative.
Completely loyal and obedient; in spite of intelligence, it will do whatever you want it to.
Memory increases as well.
cons: Cannot effect the outside world.
Cannot stop you if you fall under the influence of another.
Cannot use your powers, although it will be telepathically shielded if you are.

name: Myth Power: Dione's Dynamic
overview: channel Dione's command over the essence of moisture, moist soil and the oak tree
description: Dione, in Greek myth, was the goddess of moisture, moist soil and oak trees. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate and manipulate moisture in the air (humidity, steam, mist, fog) at will. In addition, one can imbue moisture into, or absorb moisture from matter, by touch. Furthermore, one can psychically absorb nutrients from soil (especially if moist), to heal and gain physical power, at will. One can even psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere with oak trees, at will
pros: Psychically generate and manipulate moisture in the air; imbue (or absorb) moisture at will
Absorb nutrients from soil to heal and gain physical power, at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to any location with oak trees, at will
cons: Cannot trap subjects' souls within oak trees (immobilizing foes), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot turn into an immovable, indestructible divine oak tree, at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot turn into a divine mist, a dove or a flock of doves, at will, until developed (NCN)

name: Life Drain Backlash
overview: produce a backlash effect whenever you suffer a severe loss of stamina
description: Should the user of this power ever run a marathon, have his life-force absorbed, or otherwise exert too much energy, the consequences can be dire. When the user feels exhausted, even mentally, his body gives off a psychic version of an EMP that basically causes a foe's nerves to fire off at once. This temporarily disables their foe so they can recuperate and catch their breath.
pros: Life-force absorbers are no match for you
Vampires are hurting themselves by trying to drink your blood (and dehydration harms dehydrators)
If you get too tired, your power goes off to give you a headstart or a leg-up
cons: If you get really tired during sex
If you feel mental strain during a test
Never run a marathon, if you don't plan on being discovered

name: Coinspinner
overview: wield the sword of chance.
description: Also called the sword of chance, Coinspinner is one of the 12 swords of power. As its name implies, it is lucky, if a bit of a gamble. Even without being drawn Coinspinner endows its user with superhuman good luck, it seems as if it is impossible for them to go wrong. But Coinspinner is the most intelligent of the swords. And the most unpredictable. Coinspinner will often leave its owner without warning vanishing, and leaving a storm of bad luck in its place.
pros: Superhuman Good Luck
Somewhat intelligent
Well balanced, super sharp sword resistant to most damage
cons: Unpredictable
Has a nasty habit of disappearing at the moment you need it most.
Leaves bad luck behind.

name: Super Alloy Shapeshifting
overview: turn your body into a super-alloy while retaining organic properties
description: Just like colossus, but a lot cooler and more durable. You can withstand temperature extremes and you have immunity to most physical attacks. You can change in any alloy you want, even adamantium and vibranium.
pros: Withstand temperature extremes and most physical attacks
Can withstand almost anything like acids, bullets, TNT, etc.
Super-strength, superhuman endurance
cons: Physical protection only
Can be hurt by super super strength

name: Flight Of The Bumblebee
overview: access abilities pertaining to bee species
description: This ability can pack quite a sting (pun intended). It allows the user to mimic all the abilities of any given bee species. The user may turn into a bee or a SWARM of bees at will. He can size-shift to a small size at will (without turning into a bee), sprout bee wings without size-shifting, turn into a HUMAN-sized bee, and the droning of his wings can produce four effects: 1) normal flight, 2) disorientation, 3)pacification (inducing drowsiness), 4)sonic blasts.
pros: Mimic bee abilities (venom, itch-inducing touch, flight, communicate with/command bees)
Bee wings produce 4 different effects the user can control
Mix bee effects (Human-sized bee, Human with bee wings, Human with stinger, etc. )
cons: While size-shifted, you can be smushed
You can turn into a hive of bees, but you can't replicate yourself in NORMAL form, or at NORMAL size
May form a hive-mind with others who have this ability (if they get in range)

name: Chaos Dice
overview: roll dice to randomly kill someone.
description: You can conjure 6 sided dice that you can roll. If the roll is one, the person you have picked will not die but will be painfully hurt. If you roll a six, your victim's inner organs and body explode in chaos as your victim feels the worst feeling of pain possible to feel by a human.
pros: Can be painful and deadly
cons: You could roll a one

name: Dodge
overview: dodge any attack or action towards you.
description: This power will allow to move out of the way of some sort of attack. However, you must be aware of the attack in order to dodge it. For example, if someone hits you from behind or catches you off guard, they will most likely succeed.
pros: Great in combat situations.
Applies to mental and physical attacks.
Can lead to good counter moves.
cons: Have to be aware of the attack.
Has to be realistically dodged (tight corners can be a problem)

name: Old One Power: Yog Sothoth
overview: channel the power of the Outer God Yog-Sothoth
description: Yog-Sothoth is immensely powerful, as he is the master of time and space (and some magic). He can open gates from and to any place (including other realms) and any time. The opening of the gates is so great a task that he keeps an eye on your use, refusing to open gates for reasons he disagrees with. He also uses you to further his goals often, usually allowing him direct access to the universe so he can feast. As you are useful, you gain eternal youth and immortality, at least to aging.
pros: Mastery of time, space, and dimension! The benefits of these powers can't begin to be listed here!
As he needs people on the inside to gain access to this universe, he is much more willing to talk.
If he sees fit, he might teach you some of the powerful mythos magic. You're immortal, too.
cons: Unless it's necessary for survival, gathering power, or useful for him, no time travel for you.
The Mythos magic he might teach you drains the stability of the mind of the user and local reality.
His goals are usually "curry favor with the other Old Ones" and "enter reality to cause horror. "

name: Epidermal Chroma Control
overview: control the color of your own skin at will.
description: With this power, you can completely control the color of your skin. You can be white, black, purple, or whatever. Options are only limited to the visible light spectrum. However, you cannot alter the texture of your skin, but your skin doesn't have to be a solid color, and you could even create patterns of color on your skin. Your internal colors (including eyeballs) will not change, nor will your hair color.
pros: Can provide some degree of camouflage
Never have to put on coloring makeup again
Can have new tattoos everyday
cons: Not that useful for hiding unless naked and bald
Strong emotions may trigger unintentional changes
People may want to touch and poke your skin whenever it is a non-normal color

name: Sneaky Superpower Snatcher
overview: have this power come back if it is stolen right after it steals some power from the thief.
description: An upgraded version of Power Boomerang. Not only will this power return to you if it is stolen or taken away, but it will also steal some of the thief's powers. Otherwise, it still does nothing and it still is vulnerable to mimicry, destruction, cancellation, etc. But, it still is much better than Power Boomerang, right?
pros: This power cannot be stolen or taken away from you! Yeah!
It also steals powers from the thief if they steal this power!
If it's cancelled to prevent its return, it will return to you the second the cancellation stops.
cons: What if the thief also has this power and what if you accidentally steal it from them?
It does nothing if it's not stolen or taken away.
It can still be mimicked, deleted or discarded.

name: Yes Man
overview: have good luck when saying yes.
description: Every time you say the word yes you get good luck.  Talking to your boss,in a important event,just keep saying yes and you will surely have good luck.
pros: Always have good luck.
cons: Saying another word will give you bad-luck.
Passive ability.

name: Title Theme Tune
overview: have a catchy tune about you play whenever you have to do something tense or just awesome.
description: The tune will be only about you! Let's say WHD has this power. He just heard a person in distress. As he runs to rescue them, his theme tune plays: "Double-you!... Aitch!... Dee!... WHD!!!..." Let's say Vespert has it and really needs to go to the toilet but they are all occupied, so he has to wait: "*drum rolls* Ves-PERT! *drum rolls* Ves-PERT!". name: X Men Summon
overview: summon any member of the X-Men
description: With this power you can summon any character who has ever been a member of the X-Men even if they're no longer a member anymore
pros: You can summon powerful heroes to help you
cons: They don't have to help you

name: Extraterrestrial Psychic Link
overview: psychically communicate with one specific alien in the whole universe.
description: When this power manifests, a psychic link between you and a random alien will be established. From then on, you will be able to exchange telepathically (thoughts), empathically (emotions), sensorily (senses) and mnemonically (memories) with that alien. Unless special conditions arise, you will never be able to change to another alien 'correspondent'. The reason why that specific alien was chosen is because he/she/it(?) has this power as well.
pros: You or the alien can turn this power off, but you won't change correspondent when you turn it on.
You can obtain valuable information about alien technology, culture and knowledge.
You will psychically understand each other and can become friends or more.
cons: You most likely will never meet your new friend in person. And you cannot change your correspondent.
People can think you're crazy if you tell them you're in communication with an alien.
You may be psychically invaded by the alien, meaning it may take over your body.

name: Skeleton Key
overview: unlock anything with your bare hands
description: Your fingers are the exact size, shape, and thinness to unlock anything you come across. The only thing you have to do is put your finger in the lock and turn.
pros: Never worry about locking your keys in a room.
Help the attractive damsel in distress who locked her keys in her car.
Pretty much unlock anything.
cons: Horrifyingly mangled and hideous hands.
Hands so useless they can't do anything (pick things up, turn door knobs, hitchhike, etc.)
Combination locks baffle you.

name: Bard
overview: have the musical powers of a Bard.
description: Bards are musical warriors that can enchant others with their songs. A bard can play any instrument expertly and the songs they play can have the effect of buffing themselves and their friends or hindering their enemies. A bard's melodies can unite a group so that their strengths act in harmony. Advanced Bards can even use their melodies to mesmerize their foes and alter their minds.
pros: Use songs to strengthen and bolster allies.
Use songs to weaken or dishearten foes.
Advanced Bards can mesmerize others.
cons: Requires an instrument.
Have to play songs to effect others.
If the song is stopped or isn't heard, the effect wears off.

name: Full Metal Alchemist: Freezer
overview: have the abilities of Freezer.
description: Have the abilities of Freezer, which includes using alchemy to control the boiling and freezing of water, and causing the molecules to form in a specific shape. "Boiling and Freezing are both elements of water. "-Freezer.
pros: The abilities of Freezer.
cons: In some places water is not usable.
You have to watch Full Metal Alchemist to understand the full effect.

name: Invincible Ears
overview: have invincible ears
description: With this power your ears are invincible meaning they cannot be cut off, you cannot go deaf, you cannot get an ear infection, your hearing is always perfect, you can't be affected by the bang part of flashbang grenades, nothing can hurt your ears, your ears cannot feel cold or heat unless you want them to.
pros: Your ears are invincible
cons: Only your ears are invincible

name: Interdimensional Arrow Monster
overview: fire a small monster using a special bow
description: You need to read the power "Interdimensional Hand Monster" to understand this power. This is a similar power, but instead, it involves the sport archery. When you activate this ability, a bow will materialise in your hands. You start by pulling the string back and aiming as if you were launching an arrow. You will be shooting nothing, but when you release, a red spherical monster slips into our dimension. It will take the target into another dimension, with the same rules as the Hand Monster.
pros: Fire a small monster at a target by firing nothing.
The monster will pull the target into the dimesion it came from.
Get awesome archery skills. "How are you so good with archery? ", and you say "Ah, it's nothing! "
cons: Unlike an arrow, this monster will bounce if it hits a wall. What if it bounces back at you?
Monster is small, so gigantic targets may not be an option.
Bad if you dislike the colour (color) red

name: Gravitational Stabilization
overview: make your current universe act normally despite creation/destruction of matter or energy.
description: When you are able to create and or destroy matter or energy, you have to be wary of disrupting the gravitational constant and thus killing the universe. This power bestows upon you a form of telekinesis as strong as the universe is large. Unfortunately, you cannot use it in any way other than subconsciously making the universe behave normally, as if nothing had changed. This power cannot be modified by other powers.
pros: Create or destroy matter or energy without destroying the universe.
Takes no effort; it even does the adjustments automatically. You may even forget about the power.
You also compensate for those who do not have this power.
cons: Cannot use this telekinesis for anything else. You cannot even modify it with other powers.
Does not help if you change the gravitational pull of the body you stand on.
If you die or lose this power without reversing your work, the universe will suffer.

name: Claymore : The Storm
overview: posses a claymore that can only create storms
description: This gives you a set of claymores; this claymore looks like the Scottish broad sword and is made of iron. It can create storms, but beware, for it attracts lightning
pros: Create a storm of your making
Looks like the Scottish broad sword
cons: You can only have one claymore (no con negation )
You are not immune to the storm
What ever you do, do not lose the claymore

name: Helmet Hair
overview: turn your hair into a helmet
description: With this power you can turn your hair (only the stuff on your head) into a helmet. The helmet is completely indestructible and you can turn it back into hair whenever you want.
pros: You can turn your hair into a helmet
The more hair you have the larger your helmet
cons: You can really only protect the top of your head

name: Surface Compulsion
overview: compel any living creature in an area of water to rise to the surface.
description: With this power you can let out a mental pulse that will compel anything in an area of water to rise to the surface of it. How large the area is is left to the users discretion. Creatures will remain at the surface of the water for as long as the user wills.
pros: Find people trying to hide underwater.
Scoop up sea life with a net when they surface.
Send anything attacking you underwater to the surface.
cons: You'll probably end up killing deepwater life that can't hendel the change in pressure.
You have no control over them once they reach the surface, you can only tell them to come up.

name: Nail Bullets
overview: fire your fingernails like bullets.
description: With this power you can fire off your fingernails from your hand with the force and speed of a bullet. The nails grow back as soon as as you've fired every nail on one hand, quickly and painlessly.
pros: A concealed weapon with unlimited ammo is on hand at all times.
Your nails will always grow back healthy.
cons: They're fingernails, so don't expect deep penetration.

name: The Shyamalan Effect
overview: affect probability to force a huge random twist in a situation.
description: Oh what a beautiful day..... Why is my house on the moon?! What a twist! This power allows you to manipulate one's own or someone else's probability so that whatever they do next will turn out to be a "twist" like in a movie. When the killer is going after them, it might turn out that he just wants to kill that awful nail biting habit of theirs. What a twist! You can't control what kind of twist happens though. It can be good, bad or just plain weird.
pros: Make your enemies really confused.
Maybe you like M. Night Shyamalan movies so much that you can make your life like one.
cons: You can't control what kind of twist it will be. It can be for the best or for the worst.
Maybe you hate M. Night Shyamalan movies and stupid, unexplainable twists.

name: H&V Control
overview: control heroes and villains
description: There are 3 rules: 1. You can only control one target at a time; 2. While controling, your body will be left unconscious; 3. You can only control your target for 5 minutes.
pros: Able to have different powers
Able to have different powers
Able to have different powers
cons: Your original body goes into an unconscious state
You only have a limited amount of time in a body
After you leave the target's body, the target becomes conscious

name: Firework Vision
overview: shoot fireworks from your eyes
description: You are able to generate a blast of fireworks from your eyes. The blast can be any colour and you can control how strong it is. You are unable to control when the blast explodes.
pros: You are an immediate party hit
It can be very useful
You can control the colour and how strong it is
cons: You cannot control when the blast explodes

name: Contained Blood
overview: not have your blood leave your blood vessels.
description: This power prevents your blood from leaving your body or, more precisely, your blood vessels. You could have a very bad cut or lose a limb, but at least you won't bleed. You can't even get bumps or hematomas. Since your blood doesn't leak from the blood vessels, it also coagulates more easily. However, it doesn't prevent things like poison or dirt from entering your body through your wounds.

Great against mosquitoes, vampires and other blood suckers.
Never get internal bleedings, bumps, hematomas or black eyes.
cons: You can't donate your blood.
You can't take blood tests.
Doesn't prevent your blood from being contaminated.

name: Flip A Destiny
overview: decide your destiny by flipping a coin.
description: With this power, you can decide your destiny by tossing a coin. In order to use it, you must first ask something to the coin, then flip it. If it is heads you will get what you desired, if not, you will get the opposite. This is also useful during combat. If you are outnumbered or cannot beat an enemy, just flip the coin. You will not only win but also defeat your enemies once and for all. But you may also fail at flipping the coin. Then you will not only die, but also burn in hell forever.
pros: You can get all you want.
Can win any battle.
Is a matter of luck
cons: You can lose all you have.
Can lose any battle.
Is a matter of luck.

name: Deaf Ray
overview: shoot an invisible beam that makes someone deaf for 1-2 minutes
description:
With this power you can shoot a "deaf ray" from you finger tips that switches a person's normal hearing with sounds that do not make them suspicious. 

They will not know that they have been hit unless someone starts to talk to them.
pros: Can use it on others so you can talk freely without them knowing what you said
Can use it on yourself to study better
cons: Deafness only lasts 2 minutes
Reading Lips
Using it at the wrong time

name: Reincarnation 1: Genetic
overview: reincarnate as your descendants.
description: With this power, you have a genetic anomaly compos, which is passed on to your descendants. These genes have this power. This trait is autorecessive (look it up) Children born with two of these genes turn into "backup" bodies upon death -complete with your exact DNA, including powers. Children born with one copy will be carriers, able to produce backups and more carriers, but not otherwise affected. If they inherit neither, they are normal humans.
pros: Be very hard to kill with enough backups.
Easy to use.
If negated, the genes are passed on until the suppression is over, when they regain their powers.

name: Anatomical Automatism
overview: control the parts of your body after they have been severed
description: A katana is the best thing that could happen to an Anotomical Automator. When a part of their body gets seperated from them, they control it as if it was still attached. This means that severed hands and arms can still scurry around, severed legs can still kick, and even spilled blood will crawl around. This also comes with the ability to reattach the limbs easily. However, it still hurts and the body cannot automatically detach body parts.

Can reattach the parts easily
Can even control spilled blood

name: Glowing Items
overview: make things glow

pros: You can easily find things
It's fun to watch things light up when you think about them

name: Shootingism

name: Aura Changer

Pretty.
Fool Aura-Readers.

name: Myth Power: Pheme's Feat
overview: channel Pheme's command over the forces of rumor, gossip, fame and reputation
description: Pheme (Ossa), in Greek myth, was the goddess of rumor, gossip and fame. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive any rumors that are circulating, as well as the truth behind them. In addition, any gossip one speaks will be taken as truth, and those who hear it will feel compelled to spread it to others, before also forgetting who first told them. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel gossipmongers (those who love to hear and tell gossip).

With this power, you can know all these paradoxes and more, including things that don't have to do with time but are just paradoxes. With this power, you also get a bonus of knowing the effects of time travel that don't contain paradoxes, i.e. preventing someone from killing your friend may make it so your friend turns evil and takes over the world someday.

name: Dark Powers: Depression
overview: summon humanoid creatures that absorb the energy of everyone around them and redirect it to you.
description: You can summon the Depressions, small humanoid monsters that are able to slowly steal the energy of everyone around them and transfer it to you. They are very fast, but cannot walk like a normal person: they walk crouching, like monkeys. They are mindless but follow all your orders without question. Very useful as soldiers, since they are always many and they have claws that are more dangerous than any sword. This power turns you evil.
pros: You have an army of loyal minions that follow all your orders.
The Depressions will slowly restore your energy, if there is at least one person nearby them.

name: Rise Of The Robot Scorpion

pros: You can turn into a giant scorpion.
You have lots of weapons.
You can fly and burrow under ground.

name: Black Beetle Scarab
overview: have a black beetle armor form around the user with the use of the scarab

Besides that, the black beetle armor is totally invulnerable to every form of fire. The armor has only limited invulnerability to physical attacks
pros: The symbiotic nature of the armor helps the user in times of need

name: Wing Arms

The wings are retractable.

You can't carry stuff with your arms while you're flying.

name: Innocence Weapons
overview: summon and use exorcist weapons from D. Grayman

The weapons can only be used for good purposes and will not work for those who are evil. Demons defeated by the weapons will be purified. Can only use one of the Innocence Weapons at a time.

Very strong for those who are good and going against evil.
You automatically know how to use the Innocence weapon upon summoning.

Does not work for those that are evil
Can only use ones from the show.

name: Balls Of Fire

Make Tiger Woods look like a kitten.  Make Michael Jordan feel like a midget.  With that dirty mind of yours, you may even be thinking of less-than-PG uses for this ability.  Hey, anything goes as long as it's a sport and it involves balls, you dirty minded bastard.  Great balls of fire!

name: Myth Power: Olympus Invocation

name: Zero's Scroll: Dark Light
overview: use Dark Light.

Because this combines to conflicting elements, light and dark, it is extremely volatile. Instead of exploding, it implodes. When use on someone it will be absorbed into the targets body, and the said body will implode on itself.

Great for offense.

name: Opposite Stimuli Effect
overview: react to a stimulus in an opposite way.
description: There are many types of stimuli in the world, like the most common stimulus, gravity. With this ability, instead of being grounded by gravity, you'll float, and with training, you'll fly. Now let's say the stimulus was aimed directly at you, like a heat ray. Well, you'll feel cold and, if it keeps up, the effects will neutralize each other.

Able to neutralize stimuli if it is directed at you.

name: Enhancement: Speed

name: Serpent Supreme

They don't even have to know how to whistle, though, after you use this power on them, they will remember how to do it later. name: Eosinophil Granulocyte Mimicry
