name: Pokemon Trainer
overview: actually have any pokemon ever created in one pokeball
description: Tired of playing pokemon for hours while constantly watching the girls next door, yelling at the t.v saying ''WHY CANT I BE HUGH!?'' Well, with this power you can have an army of pokemon at your disposal
pros: You dont have to fight
If one pokemon fails try another
Be the envy of all pokenerds
cons: Can only have one pokemon at one time

name: Bodily Malfunctions
overview: induce loss of bodily functions in a person
description: This power makes a person lose their bodily functions, meaning they crap & piss themselves til you leave. You secrete & release an aerial chemical pheromone that attacks anyone else's neural inhibitor that controls their bodily functions, making them urinate & defecate uncontrollably.
pros: Can be used as a distraction/escape power, making people go #1 & 2
cons: It's a toilet joke superpower
The mess

name: Flower Walk
overview: create flowers or plants wherever you walk.
description: With every step you take flowers or plants grow in your footsteps. You can control which plant or flower grows if you concentrate but if you don't concentrate the flower will just depend on you mood or thoughts.
pros: You hungry? Just concentrate on a fruit or vegetable and walk.
Plants and flowers grow instantly.
The plants and flowers survive and grow in any weather or condition.
cons: Can't make up plants; they have to be real.
Looks kind of strange when flowers grow out of the sidewalk.

name: Arcana: 9 The Hermit
overview: send out thought-forms to collect information.
description: This ability allows you to form imperceptible (Invisible, Intangible, etc) thought-forms from your own mental energies. These thought-forms have the exact same senses as you do and can float speedily through the air to wherever you send them. However, these thought-forms can only obey simple orders and will dissipate once they use up all of the energy you gave them. They are unable to physically affect anything around them and can only relay information to you by merging with your mind again.
pros: Allows you to keep track of important people, items, or places.
Offers some of the benefits of astral projection without many of the risks.
With efficient use of energy, you can have a virtual army of invisible spys.
cons: Thought-forms have no intelligence to speak of and blindly follow only simple orders.
They can be detected and destroyed by psychic means.
Unless they return to you, you gain no information.

name: Sibling Power
overview: have strengthened shared powers when near a sibling
description: You and your siblings possess super strength, super speed, invulnerability, healing and flight, as well as an invisible aura. When you are in a sibling's aura's range, your power's increase in ratio to your proximity. When standing next to your sibling you can withstand a nuclear blast and lift mountains, but if you are a mile away you are barely superhuman. At all times you have a telepathic connection with siblings, which either of you can block at will.
pros: When nearby you and your siblings have phenomenal power
Could be a great crimefighting duo
Playing ball games while flying would be cool
cons: Have to be near your sibling to use your powers
If you hate your sibling, then superpowers will only worsen the situation
If a sibling dies, you must be near their body or ashes to use your powers

name: The Power Of Flowers
overview: generate flowers that calm and pacify others
description: You can generate flowers (types of flowers may vary) that have a calming, pacifying effect on others. Some affected individuals may also become more affectionate and tolerant of others. The effects generally last an hour on average. The power may manifest in two ways: 1) a spray of flowers from the hands or 2) rapidly growing a bed of flowers under the target.
pros: A non-lethal, non-violent ability
Good for calming rioting individuals or crowds
cons: Allergies
You may be called a hippie

name: Battle Leather
overview: grow a durable hide
description: You can grow a durable hide, as hard as steel, as light as silk, and it can be shed at will. The leather doesn't disappear once shed, either--it can be crafted into other armor or objects.
pros: Light, easy to use defence
Items can be crafted from the shed hide
You can grow it on other people if you are touching them
cons: Hide takes up nutrients fron your body
Enemies finding and using the hide against you

name: Shapeshift: Kitten
overview: transform into an adorable little kitten
description: Who hasn't wanted to change into a fuzzy little thing at some point in their lives? Well, now you can.
pros: If you're a guy, you know what girls do with little kittens, right? Right? =]
You still think like yourself when in kitten form.
Legally get high on catnip.
cons: You can't really fight. At all.
You can't speak with your kitten mouth either.
Heaven help you if the animal pound catches you.

name: War Zone
overview: create a zone that intensifies fighting.
description: Creates a zone that causes war and fighting to be more likely to happen and intensifies them. People in the zone become more agitated to the point where they go insane with rage if inside the zone to long. People become stronger the longer the field is in place and aspects of the environment become more dangerous. Healing affects also weaken over time. Effects are quickly removed if the zone is left.
pros: Cause a fight when you need one.
Put on an enemy camp and destroy them from within.
Good to use against opponents that rely on their brains.
cons: May go into a rage yourself.
If you start a war and are on losing side.
Has no use except to start fights.

name: Holy Power: Redemption
overview: chose if a defeated enemy deserves heaven or hell, and allows you to use other Holy Powers.
description: With this ability, when you defeat someone, you can chose if your defeated enemy deserves heaven or hell. If this person is "forgiven", she will be sent to Heaven. If this person is "punished", she will be sent to Hell. This ability also allows you to use other Holy Powers. This power is Hero only.
pros: You can chose if our enemy deserves forgiveness or punishment.
Makes you able to learn all Holy Powers.
cons: You need to be a good person to be able to use this power.

name: Orbis Sensualium Pictus
overview: look up any information about the supernatural.
description: Whenever you say "Adeat", a book appears that can give you detailed information about anything supernatural (magic, demons, angels, etc. ).
pros: Comes with a broom that can be used for magic and flying.
cons: Information is constantly being updated so something might get deleted.
Searching for the exact information you want may take a while.

name: Keep Moving Or Else
overview: cause people to die if they stop moving
description: This power allows you to put a curse on anybody which causes them to die if they stop moving. You cannot remove the curse from the person and you can curse as many people as you want.
pros: You can cause people to die if they stop moving
You can curse as many people as you want
cons: You cannot remove the curse

name: Soul Re Creator
overview: turn souls into bodies while their soul slowly grows back.
description: You can turn a soul into a body, equal or less than the souls old body's weight, their body/soul slowly grows back, for someone small, less than 2 months, for a heavier person, a little longer than 4 years.
pros: For giving them back their bodies they are loyal to you.
cons: How likely is it you will find a wandering soul?
It takes a while to grow back their body from their soul.

name: Bottleneck Effect
overview: limit the flow of fluids through an opening or a conduit.
description: With this ability, you can decrease the dimension of an opening or a conduit which is made to allow passage for a fluid or through which a fluid is currently flowing. This includes biological openings and conduits, like the veins, the trachea, the mouth, and such. You cannot decrease it completely as fluid must still be allowed to flow if it's possible. So, you cannot close it. This power requires active concentration to maintain the effect.
pros: Limit container leaks.
Strangle your enemies from a distance.
Fluids include liquids and gas.
cons: Cannot close the opening or conduit completely.
Requires active concentration.

name: Panontic Arch:Thend
overview: gain powers from the Thend dimension.
description: Thend, the home of the sharke. You have no 24-hour limit on the use of panontic arch powers. Anything you can touch you can choose to age 100 billion years in a second -- just like sharke do when one bites something or someone.
pros: A deadly time power.
No time limit on panontic arch powers.
cons: Some things literally last forever.

name: Superhuman Insanity
overview: be so insane that it serves as an advantage
description: Joker, Hannibal Lector, and all mad scientists all have this trademark ability. They cannot be convinced  or dissuaded by ordinary means and can always come up with a convoluted scheme.This power also renders the user immune to fear based power-they are so insane that nothing scares them.
pros: You are not afraid of anything
You can come up with things that no rational person would have considered
You are immune to mind control
cons: Sanity has its advantages--social interaction, etc.
You will be placed in the mental ward or isolate yourself from society

name: Pull/Push
overview: make people pull things when they want to push them and vice versa
description: With this power you cause the commands for pull and push to be reversed in a person's mind. When they want to pull something they will push it and when they want to push something they will pull it. This can be useful if someone is trying to take something away from you you can cause them to actually push it towards you. Or if someone is trying to push something hazardous towards you can make them pull it towards them. It works on telekinesis and robots as well.
pros: You can make people push things when they try to pull them and vice versa
You can really screw with someone when they try to open a door
cons: Your enemy can figure out what you're trying to do and simply do the opposite action

overview: become the greatest MI6 agent ever
description: With this ability, you get to become James Bond. Packaged with this ability, you get a license to kill and cool gadgets, like a laser pen or jet-propelled pants. You talk with a very cool British (or Scottish) accent and get all the fine honeys who hear your voice. Anything James Bond has done in movies or books, you are able to do it as well.
pros: British or Scottish accent!
Wicked gadgets to help out with fights or escapes
You see a girl you want to bed? Well, now you can have her!
cons: Too arrogant at times.
Always get captured the first time going against a master villian
Can sometimes depend on gadgets too much

name: Beatlemania
overview: make women and girls do whatever you wish (if you don't mind screaming).
description: Women and girls will flock to you as if you were the most attractive, talented person on Earth. They will scream and follow you everywhere you go. If you happen to have a British accent or a musical talent, the power becomes even more effective.
pros: These women would die for you. They'll do almost anything you ask of them.
It's a great confidence booster!
cons: Females can get very hostile. Really, be forewarned.
You have virtually no privacy. Even while at home, they'll be outside waiting for you.
Your hand may cramp from the amount of autographs you'll have to sign.

name: Omnizord
overview: summon ten mythical creatures to combine them into the complete ultimate weapon.
description: The Omnizord is the combination of the ten mythical zords: salamander, serpent, mandragora, golem, chickidemon, manticore, griffin, thunderbird, unicorn, and a black dog. This combination would be the first to demonstrate a rare ability, that of transformation within its combined state. The first stage of combination of the Omnizord was a tank-like vehicle, then after forming the tank mode, you and nine others could initiate transformation into the Omnizord's battle mode.
pros: Can use it to fight very large evildoers.
cons: It can only work when you have 9 friends with you while summoning them.

name: Hollywoodoo
overview: have the abilities of the hero starred in the latest American superhero-movie.
description: You always have the superpowers of the hero who is starred in the latest Hollywood blockbuster. If they release another Spiderman-sequel, you get Spiderman's abilities, if they release Wolverine 2, you will be immortal and unbreakable, and so on.
pros: New combination of powers about every month!
cons: Pray that they won't release Hancock 2.

name: Power Separator
overview: separate powers.
description: With this power, you can separate your own powers. For example, a power to create and manipulate water could be separated into a power to create water and a power to manipulate water.
pros: Nothing, it gives you the same power except as smaller powers.
cons: Doesn't help you.

name: Critter Instinct
overview: be like an animal
description: Your body is sort of like the animal you most resemble and you have all the same mannerisms. You don't turn into the animal, but you have the same instincts.
pros: If you're like a wolf, your vocal chords allow you to do a pretty wicked creepy howl.
Cat people can have night vision
cons: It's uncontrollable: you never know which instinctive behavior is going to pop up next.
Froglike people inherit the amphibian's preferred diet...

name: Exploder
overview: explode when you are hit
description: No one will ever want to hit you. You will explode with any concussive trauma & subsequently reintegrate anywhere you want within the blast zone. Ram into structures, vehicles, whatever. Here's a personal favorite: jump off a building and see what kind of crater you'll make.
pros: Hits, punches will cause a small reactive explosion roughly 5 times the force of the hit
Large hits, hit by moving vehicles or hit by the superstrong causes exponentially massive explosions
Explode and reintegrate wherever you want within the blast zone
cons: No more pats on the back, high-fives or the like. Slicing and energy weapons pose a threat
Accidentally bumping into things, tripping and walking through crowds are precarious adventures
When you reintegrate you are buck-naked to the world & slightly disoriented
tags: blowing up like you thought i would

name: Carbonylkinesis
overview: manipulate carbon monoxide.
description: Carbon monoxide is a colourless, odourless, and tasteless gas that can be lethal when inhaled. The gas can affect the user, but being able to control it they can keep it away from themselves.
pros: Can speed up the process, force the gas into the victims blood.
It can't be detected by the victim, but the user can see it in a different colour.
The death can appear to be accidental.
cons: The user must be very careful not to use it in a confined space, or inhale it.
It is harder to control, the more people the user is effecting.
It cannot be created nor destroyed, so it has to be gathered from the environment.

name: Perfect Zombie
overview: revive as a zombie with your sanity intact and you do not need to eat brains
description: A person with this power can revive as a zombie. But not just any type of zombie. You get to retain your intelligence and sentience as a human and you do not need to eat brains or do any sort of ritual. You just revive with increased strength lack of pain receptors and unlimited stamina with no need to sleep. Also you don't rot either. You can move as fast at I am Legend Zombies. However you can still be "killed" by a headshot or be burned to death.
pros: All the normal zombie powers like unlimited stamina, can't get killed by normal wounds
Don't have to eat brains and you don't rot over time and you don't smell either
Retains brain power---as in you can still think like a normal person
cons: You are already dead and your skin is pale
Can still be burned or shot in the head
No regenerative factor---your cells are dead--so you need to sew up your body the hard way

name: Axe Of Pine
overview: summon a huge pine tree shaped like a rasor sharp axe.
description: When the holidays are coming near you want to fight your enemies in a fitting theme. With this ability anything wooden in your hands can be turned into a 7-foot long Christmas-tree-shaped axe capable of chopping enemies to bits. Also, you don't need super strength to use this weapon, but anyone else trying to use your axe WILL (it'll be extremely heavy to them). Note: Around Christmas your tree-axe is decorated.  (delete the following: This is not meant as a joke. )
pros: This axe is just as strong as any other axe.
No need to drag heavy objects with you.
It's flammable, so you can wield a flaming axe
cons: Avoid using it on a necessary item (can't be reversed)
When lighting the tree-axe on fire, might burn your hands

overview: reduce nearly anything to 0
description: Also called the Cypher Effect, or the Nonentity Effect, one with this power can reduce nearly anything in all of existence to zero. When matter is reduced to 0, it is shifted into a metaphysical plane of existence in which matter is only imagination. It can have no effect on the real world, other than being seen by those with this ability, and those with ESP. Matter affected by this power cannot be otherwise affected at all (even by the user) until shifted back into existence.
pros: Makes all physical and energy attacks ineffective
Protect fragile objects and valuables; release affected things at will or keep them cyphered forever
Living things don't to eat, drink, sleep, breathe, etc while cyphered
cons: Can't cypher intangible concepts (emotions, imagination, thought, etc. ); psychic attacks still work
Injury, age, hunger, thirst and other bodily process only cyphered when the SUBJECT is cyphered
Cannot cypher self (to escape age, harm or bodily needs) until the higer levels (no Con Negation)

name: Myth Power: Priapus' Pride
overview: channel Priapus' command over the essence of vegetable gardens and fertility
description: Priapus (Priapos), in Greek myth, was the god of vegetable gardens and the fertility of animals associated with agriculture. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and manipulate vegetables, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command sheep, goats and bees at will. Furthermore, one gains physical power from eating vegetables and other garden-grown produce. Power use may cause involuntary erections.
pros: Psychically perceive, communicate with and manipulate plants that yield vegetables
Psychically perceive, communicate with and command sheep, goats, bees and other garden animals
Enhanced stats from eating vegetables; immune to MythPower: Aphrodisia and MythPower: Bacchanalia
cons: Cannot root subjects to the ground (sprouting various vegetables) by touch until the higher levels
People with MythPower: Aphrodisia and MythPower: Bacchanalia are immune to this ability
People with plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Delete This Rapid Eruption
overview: do multiple powerful kicks to the opponent that sends him/her flying.
description: You will strike and break the bones of your opponents several times then end it with lifting them up with a powerful uppercut kick that'll send them flying far upwards.
pros: a fight combo is not a power
cons: None.

name: Holy Power: Seismic Wave
overview: divide the land with the Reaper Scythe, shooting the energy of a level 9 earthquake on your enemy.
description: With this power you can divide the land with your Reaper Scythe and shoot the seismic energy of a level 9 earthquake against your target, shattering his bones and destroying everything around him. This attack is very powerful, but slow and dangerous.
pros: Cause massive destruction.
This power has a great field of range.
Even if you miss, the attack will probably destroy the ground under your enemy and overwhelm him.
cons: This power is slow and dangerous.
Only Reapers can use this power.

name: Thematic Power Boosting
overview: boost the effectiveness of a group of powers related by theme.
description: The rules. You must actually have acquired the powers. You can only one thematic power boost at a time. A multi-theme power only gives one theme but of your choice. As long as you have one power in a group that can be boosted it doesn't matter if the others can't be. 1 out of 10 powers becomes 10 times more effective. A theme can subject(time,fire,telekinesis,etc) or the name of a power series(i. E. Mythpowers). It can't be both.
pros: If all your powers are the same theme or mostly the same theme.
If all or most of your powers can be boosted.
cons: None of your powers are theme related.
All your powers are from mimicry or theft.

name: Organization
overview: be organized.
description: To be organized you can find a folder,find pencils,etc.  While you are organized, it doesn't exactly mean you are neat.
pros: Organized.
cons: Doesn't exactly mean you are neat.

name: Bladed Whip Tail
overview: have a tail that can act like a whip with a blade on its end
description: The tail is 1 metre long and 2-5 centimetres thick dependant on where it is measured. The tail can be controlled at will as it is a part of your body. The bladed end is as sharp as a 4-body katana and if it is cut off will take 3(blade only)-4(whole tail) days to grow back. The look and composition of the tail and blade vary for each being with this power.
pros: Weapon that can protect you whenever you need it.
cons: Really hard to hide.
Can't lengthen the tail so that it can hit long-ranged enemies.

name: Synoviocyte Mimicry
overview: give water the property to become more viscous when subjected to pressure, among other properties.
description: By consuming sugar, you can produce and secrete a substance which, when mixed with water, gives it various properties depending on pressure. Under normal pressure, the affected water acts like a lubricant. Under high pressure, it becomes very viscous, being able to absorb shock. Under negative pressure, gases which were dissolved are released as bubbles, which produce high-frequency cracking sounds by collapsing when the pressure returns to normal. Otherwise, you can also undergo mitosis.
pros: Duplicate yourself to outnumber your enemies.
Make puddles of water very slippery.
Affected bodies of water become harder to swim in the more you move.
cons: Bellyflopping into a suddenly viscous liquid is very harmful, sometimes deadly.
It takes time for a big body of water to be entirely affected by your power.

name: Planet Hopper
overview: look at any picture of planets and teleport there with a thought
description: Might suffocate into a unstable planet, stars, blackholes, you never know
pros: If Earth is destroyed, Mars is within 1 second away
Can take multiple people at once
Too fun
cons: Teleport into a blackhole
Burn by a planet that's too close to a Star
Teleport onto a inhabitable planet, not having. Oxygen etc..
tags: basically but your not a planet devour

name: Weapon Control:Armored Assault
overview: summon an Armored group to aid in combat
description: This weapon control grants the ability to create an armored detachment out of nothing. The type and ammount depends on knowledge of what you are doing(someone with expeirience or military knowledge as opposed to a total noob) and training.
pros: Can create armored onslaughts
Good combo with other WC powers
cons: You must have seen what you are making
May not always work
Crew comes seperately

name: Miracle: Cross Bear
overview: take away someone's willpower when they hit you
description:
With this power people that hit you will lose their willpower to hurt you the more that they hit you. 

The more willpower/hatred a person puts into a punch the more drained of willpower the other person will be.
pros: No one wants to ever finish you off, unless they do so in one hit
You can hit back when the other person has no more willpower
If you are a masochist then you will get over the main con of this power
cons: You still get hit and it will hurt
Will only work on the thing inflicting the pain-does not target the puppetmaster

name: Blades Of Pain
overview: create dark blades from one's scars
description: Basically, anytime one gets a wound it turns into a scar from which one can create a shadowy blade. The size of the blade depends on the size of the scar. However, one can still die from a losing their heart or being beheaded. This power can only be gained in one way: by being cut 10000 times in one day and surviving throughout all of the cuts.
pros: Really powerful if used correctly.
Not truly immortality, but close enough.
cons: Extremely dangerous to try to gain.
People will be scared of the one with this power.
You'll end up with lots of scars with this power.

name: Zigzagging Projectile
overview: cause things you throw to have a random zigzagging trajectory.
description: Whenever you throw something while having this power activated, the projectile will adopt a totally random and ever-changing zigzagging trajectory, effectively convering more space than a normal trajectory, while still moving at the same speed and in the direction it was thrown. Since it's unpredictable, it's very difficult to dodge -- it's very difficult to aim precisely too!
pros: Covers more space than a normal trajectory and therefore has a higher chance of hitting the target.
Very difficult to predict and to dodge.
You're a nightmare if you have a machine-gun
cons: The smaller the target, the more difficult it is to aim precisely and hit with this power.

name: Myth Power: Laelaps' Pursuit
overview: channel the superhuman chasing prowess of the mythical dog Laelaps
description: Laelaps (Lailaps), in Greek myth, was a magical dog who was fated always catch any pursued target, regardless of their speed. As such, channeling him allows one to move with speed that adapts to outdo any any subject that one pursues; likewise, one's reflexes, friction/wind resistance, etc adapt to handle changes in speed. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command dogs at will. One can even turn into any breed of dog, or mimic the abilities of a dog at will.
pros: Adapt speed, reflexes and wind/friction resistance to catch any target
Psychically perceive, communicate with and command dogs
Turn into any breed of dog, or mimic the abilities of a dog at will
cons: Every hear of the tale of Laelaps and the Teumessian Fox? Look it up.
Speed/athletics/competition-based MythPowers provide immunity
MythPower: Artemis' Gift and other animal-based MythPowers (may provide immunity and/or control)

name: Myo Virus
overview: infect life forms with a virus that makes them grow and become stronger the longer it festers.
description: With this ability, you can infect people, plants, and animals with the Myo Virus. This causes them to grow, and become stronger until the user de-activates the Virus at will. Life forms with this Virus become increasingly aggressive the longer this virus festers. A life form can grow to a height of 1,000 feet before its heart stops, or dies. Once deactivated, they return to normal size and strength.
pros: Infect people, plants, animals, or yourself with this virus.
As the subject becomes larger, they will become stronger.
Can increase or decrease the speed of the Virus' effect.
cons: Once the target exceeds 1000 feet, their heart fails, or they die.
Targets become increasingly aggressive as the Virus festers.
You can't deactivate the Virus unless you can see the infected target.

name: Snap You're An Animal
overview: turn people into animals
description: With this power, you can turn anybody into any animal by snapping, saying their name and the desired animal. For instance, "John Doe, Elephant". The person will then turn into the desired animal but is not under your control. You can turn the person back by snapping and reversing the phrase you said earlier. From the previous example, "Elephant, John Doe". All damages sustained in animal mode transfer over to human mode.
pros: You can turn anybody into an animal.
All damages sustained in animal mode transfer over to human mode.
cons: The animal is not under your control
If you do not know how to snap or are mute, this power is useless

name: Enhancement: Multi Planar
overview: allow a power to spread out its effects over multiple planes of existence
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it allows the power to spread out its effects over multiple planes of existence. This in turn also decreases the level of power on any one plane of power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: Now you can hit those pesky enemies who are on a different plane of existence.
Affects all planes of existence at the same time.
cons: Usseless without another power.
Effects are spread out evenly in all the planes.

name: Relative Alteration
overview: alter or replace negative and positive energy.
description: This is the power to change or replace negative or positive energies. With it, you could control gravity by increasing or decreasing it. You can also replace positive space with negative space (AKA teleporting). You can also switch something's attributes with its opposite, like switching fire and water to make fire wet and water burn. You can only change what you touch though, or the area around you with things like gravity.
pros: Not a very specific power so you can do a bunch of things with it
Can do almost whatever you can imagine.
Changing something can be permanent
cons: You need contact with whatever you are altering/replacing
Changing something can be permanent

name: Variables
overview: modify the variables of objects.
description: This ability allows you to view and modify the variables - the invisible properties that define how an object exists in the universe - of anything. The possibilities are endless. Modify the AGE variable to change the age of an object or the COLOUR variable to change its colour. You can also change your own variables. If you are ill, increase your HEALTH variable, or if you need some extra strength, increase your STRENGTH variable.
pros: You can be immortal by manipulating your AGE variable.
You can increase your SKILL variable to increase your skill in other activities.
You can increase your intelligence, strength, speed - anything really.
cons: Overuse of this power will tire you without the proper training.
Changing variables you do not understand can have terrible consequences.
Changing the wrong variable could kill you.

name: Mind Blower
overview: cause others to think everything you say is profound
description: Tired of people not listening to you? Is your voice lost in the sea of opinions and ramblings of your friends and acquaintences? Do people not take you seriously? A Mind Blower has all of these issues handled with ease. Everything you say will be seen as deeply profound and insightful. You will capture the attention of anyone and everyone within earshot, and they will be eager to listen to you. Even casually saying "let's blow this popsicle stand" will arouse deep fascination and interest.
pros: Never be ignored or seen as boring
Captivate audiences, friends, family
Gain respect and admiration
cons: You cannot shut this power off. It's active at all times.
Goofing around will still be seen as profound

name: Beauty Stealing
overview: steal the beauty of another human
description: With this power you can become attractive by simply touching the person that you envy because of their beauty. By doing this you will replace your appearance with theirs and their appearance with yours.
pros: Improving your appearance
Feeling good about yourself
Making the person you envy suffer from your appearance
cons: It is not your true beauty
People will know about the switch in appearances
More of a villian's power rather than a hero's power

name: Terrain Moving Man
overview: shrink a terrain feature and relocate it.
description: Focus on a terrain feature, at the same time it will shrink and be pulled in into your closed fist. You can put it back where it was or you have an hour to release it somewhere else. You can't move a terrain feature that goes length-wise beyond the horizon of the Earth. You could move a small enough town with this power and anything in it. You take air and climate with the feature you're moving. If someone with immutability was on a mountain you wanted to move, their power would stop this power.
pros: Move small mountains, seas, lakes and good-sized chucks of rainforest.
Less focus and quicker to use than terrain manipulation.
You can hold a shrunk town in your hand. How many powers let you do that?
cons: Can't affect oceans or mountain ranges.
Someone with immutability or a power like immutability.
Radical environmentalists may try and kill you.

name: A Life For A Life
overview: give life to a dead or dying person in exchange for someone else's death

The instrument does not manifest itself in the physical realm but instead exists only in your mental realm.

Power seals based on original use.

name: Myth Power: Dew's Duty
overview: channel Herse, Pandrosos, Aglauros and the Drosoi's command over the essence of dew
description: The Drosoi, in Greek myth, were the gods and goddesses of dew. As such, channeling Herse (Erse, Ersa- Dew) and the Drosoi (Dews) allows one to psychically teleport to anywhere there is dew, at will. Channeling Pandrosos (Pandrosus- All-Dewy) allows one to psychically generate dew; anything it falls on can be heavily weighted down, at will. Channeling Aglauros (Aglaurus- Bright; Agraulos, Agraulus- Field-Dwelling) allows one to psychically observe an area, through the dewdrops covering said area.

As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can also psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions). One can even psychically generate forty-nine replicates, at will.

In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically receive insight from a year in the past or the future. One can also psychically age and de-age matter by a year, by touch, at will. One can even psychically perceive and grant subjects' (physically possible) New Years' resolutions, at will.

One can even psychically take subjects for allies and lovers, by touch, as long as they are the allies or loved ones of one's foes (reversing subjects' alliances).
pros: Gain superhuman skill in misleading and manipulating others
Cast illusions to deceive the senses (natural senses, ESP, etc); withstand illusion/hallucination
Befriend allies and charm lovers, by touch, as long as they are allies/lovers of one's foes
cons: Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel deceivers/frauds until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain the power of Crocodile Tears and (eventually) Mirage Inducing until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Aletheia's Absolute and MythPower: Eris' Enmity provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Limos' Longing
overview: channel Limos' command over the essence of hunger and starvation
description: Limos (Limus), in Greek myth, was the goddess of hunger and starvation. As such, channeling her allows one to accelerate metabolic processing of food, in self and others (productively, it can help maintain healthy weight; offensively, it can cause foes to rapidly starve to death, unless they eat constantly). In addition, one can induce or negate hunger at will (and sense and alter a person's appetite). Furthermore, one can totally withstand the need to eat and drink; it is impossible to starve.
pros: Cause foe to starve, and help self and allies maintain healthy weight
Induce or negate hunger (or hunger pangs) at will; sense and alter what a person is hungry for
Freedom from hunger or thirst; inability to starve, or suffer from malnutrition
cons: Cannot cast illusions of what a person is hungry for until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot share hunger and thirst immunity by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
Agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Miquiztli, The Introspector
overview: make people have an external and objective point of view of their own actions.
description: When activated, you'll change into a moving, talking skeleton. This allows you to sense when someone is neglecting their priorities or when they are turning a blind eye on their situation, and to make people have an objective point of view of themselves, meaning that they will see and judge themselves as if they were an external observer. They still retain their personal view and opinion of themselves, but it can, and most likely will, clash with the more honest and objective view you give them.
pros: You can help them see what's wrong with them, improve their behavior and redefine their priorities.
You can use it on yourself if you need to think about a personal problem.
If someone is acting very obnoxiously, you can put them in their place by making them realize it.
cons: Truth hurts, especially true when it comes from ourselves.
It's rarely easy and flattering seeing ourselves for what we truly are.
As long as you activate this power, you'll look like a skeleton.

name: Random Teleportation
overview: make teleportors teleport to random coordinates.
description: Basically you use this on a teleportor and he'll go to a set of random coordinates within the range of his power when he teleports. This power starts by affecting a teleportor's first two teleports. With practice and mental focus you can make this ten teleports. If someone's teleportation power prevents teleporting into solid matter then this power can't make that happen.
pros: A teleportor that can teleport in solid matter will be afraid to teleport.
A good secondary power to Teleportation Manipulation.
cons: Only affects the first ten teleports of the victim.
Affecting more than two teleports of a victim requires practice and effort.

name: Ology Power: Alienologist
overview: know many facts about alien species
description: Ever wanted to be like Alpha "Allen" Gray from Alienology? Now you can! You will know almost everything about loads of alien species, from stance with the Intergalactic council, weaponry, technology level, political system & biology but you will not understand the languages.
pros: Know lots of facts about aliens, before you've even met them
cons: Cannot control aliens
If aliens do not have universal translator, you cannot communicate

name: Excalibulg
overview: wield Excalibulg (the fusion of Gae Bulg and Excalibur)
description: With this power, you wield an extremely powerful club that can smash and pierce through anything like butter, spraying tons of blood everywhere.   This weapon is also very heavy.   You can also resurrect anyone that you have killed this way, by reversing time afterwards then restoring everyone's memories.
pros: Very very dangerous weapon
You can kill someone first and then resurrect them to heal them
If you kill yourself with Excalibulg, you can choose to resurrect yourself
cons: Blood and guts
Need to be very strong to use

name: Perfect Pitch
overview: sing or hum any note possible perfectly
description: You can literally sing any musical note. This can be as high or low as you want. There are no limitations except that you still have the same lung capacity. You cannot hold notes for as long as you want.
pros: Have a infinite range of notes to sing
Find the brown noise
Win American Idol & become the best singer in the world!
cons: The brown noise might work on yourself
Really high and low notes can't be heard by humans
Singing so high that it is low, will create a black hole that will swallow the universe

name: Acherontia Atropos
overview: hold about 40 mutated butterflies in your skin and to have a mental link with them.
description: The skin of the holder of this power is developed so that it can accommodate from 30 to 40 butterflies inside it. These butterflies are bigger than normal, they have a strength and a high regenerative factor, and can depart for several kilometers from their "nest". When butterflies rest, the skin of the subject seems simply decorated with their wings; when they are active the skin appears normal. The subject can control these butterflies and perceive what's happening around them.
pros: The butterflies are more longevous, more resistant to cold and hunger and more strong than normal;
The subject has a mental link with them and he/she can keep in contact with them at long distances.
cons: The metabolism of butterflies depends on the host organism's one;
No offensive skills.

name: Dark Powers: Schizofrenia
overview: summon wolf like creatures that drive your enemies crazy before killing them.
description: With this power you can summon Schizofrenia, a pack of terrible monster wolves. These creatures look like really creepy wolves with stitched mouths. But when they start to show their true form, it's revealed that they are truly demons. When fully transformed, the creatures are able to talk like a really mean person, making their target unable to think, without the wolves hearing them. When the enemy is unable to resist, they kill him slowly. This power naturally turns you evil.
pros: You can kill someone in a terrible way.
You can fully control The Pack, and only you and your target can see the Schizofrenia.
The wolves can read the target's mind, and they know how to hurt him/her.
cons: The wolves are not hallucinations, your target can kill them if he is realizes this.
You can summon another wolf if one dies, but killing you would make them all disappear.
This power slowly turns you evil, and you become addicted to using it.

name: Children Of The Moon
overview: transform into a werewolf every time the moon is up
description: You are transformed into a werewolf every time the moon is up. You gain your power from the moon and the fuller the moon is, the more wolf you become ... the darker the moon is, the more human you become. Every full moon you turn full wolf, every new moon you don't morph. Your fangs and teeth are sharp and lethal, you are also fast and posses incredible strength.
pros: Transform into a beast or incredible strength each night
Own the forest while hunting for prey
cons: Your screwed if your in the middle of a battle and the moon go's down
There is only one night in a lunar cycle that you get to stay human

name: Myth Power: Prophasis' Plea
overview: channel Prophasis' command over the essence of excuse, apology and asking forgiveness
description: Prophasis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of excuses, apology and pleading forgiveness. As such, channeling her allows one to make up nearly any excuse, and those who hear it will believe it. In addition, one can perceive the truth behind the excuses of others and make false excuses (which often pertain to personal misfortune) come true, until the subject apologizes. One with this ability may even withstand compulsions and probability/reality manipulation as long as one has a good excuse.
pros: Make up any excuse, and subjects will believe it (unless they can see otherwise)
Perceive the truth behind the excuses of others (untrue excuses can be made true)
With a good excuse, withstand compulsions, magic and reality/probability/chance/luck manipulation
cons: ESPECIALLY vulnerable to MythPower: Epimetheus' Idea
People with MythPower: Prometheus' Plan are immune to this ability
People with probability/chance/luck based MythPowers and Unpredictability are immune to this ability

name: Rise Of The Alternate Legends
overview: turn into alternate forms of Legendary Pokemon
description: With this power you can turn into alternate or different versions of Legendary Pokemon. You can turn into Primal Dialga, Shadow Lugia, Baby Lugia (aka Silver), Shiny versions of legendaries, the Golden Ho-oh from the first episode of the anime, Green Gem Deoxys and the monster Groudon from Jirachi: Wish Maker. In Pokemon form you retain your personality, intelligence and ability to speak.
pros: You can turn into powerful forms
You retain your personality, intelligence and ability to speak
cons: You cannot turn into the normal forms of the Legendaries

name: Groundhog's Day
overview: relive the same day for one week.
description: You must live the same day for one week. You have no control over this power. Example: "1" July 1st equals "7" July 1st's You do not age more than the typical day. You cannot die until the 7th day. The 7th day carries over to the next actual day (Example: July 1st 7th day carries over to July 2nd 1st day)
pros: 7 times longer life
Correct mistakes
Avoid death
cons: Miserable day is multiplied by 7
May lose track of days
Possible frustration

name: Myth Power: Effect Of Eos
overview: channel Eos' command over the essence of the dawn
description: Eos, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the dawn. As such, channeling her allows one to rewind or fast-forward time to the dawn of any day (the current day or any other one desires). One can also psychically perceive and communicate with anyone who is awake at that time, as well as project his sight to anywhere the light of dawn touches. Furthermore, one is gifted with the ability to generate wings for flight, stand on clouds, withstand atmospheric conditions and generate/glide on wind at will.
pros: Rewind or fast-forward time to the dawn of any day of one's choice
Project sight to anywhere dawn's light touches; perceive and communicate with anyone awake at dawn
Generate/manipulate/glide on winds, stand on clouds, winged flight
cons: Cannot disrupt or repel effects of MythPower: Nyx's Night Shift until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Help from Helios and MythPower: Salute to Selene provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Hyperion's Watch and MythPower: Theia's Light provide immunity (NCN)

name: Time Merge
overview: combine two or three decades.
description: It might sound extremely strange. You can have the ability to combine different decades, like if you want to merge the 1970's, 1980's and 1990's, it'll be a difficult culture clash, but mixing in between the 1960's and the 2000s, it'll be total Heck.
pros: Everything and everyone around you might become new.
You can also create an "amalgamation" of two or three timelines you've seen from each decades.
cons: Everything and everyone might become twisted
No one from each timeline will understand each other.

name: Crazy Legs
overview: do any dance perfectly.
description: You can dance any dance you want to dance, perfectly as soon as you want to dance it, without breaking a sweat.
pros: Win dance contests.
Show off.
Look awesome at dance parties.
cons: Can't exactly attack anyone with it.
Can't exactly defend yourself with it.

name: Zodiac: Lunar: Tiger
overview: use the powers of the lunar calender's Tiger
description: You draw upon the power of the Tiger. You can transform into a tiger, talk with tigers, and move around jungles, forests, and the like wihout making a sound in order to kill your target. This does not help with sneak attacks unless they are to kill.
pros: Full moon gives full power.
Can move around any normally noisy environment without making a sound in order to kill.
cons: New moon gives no power.
Can only use if born in a year of the tiger. 1926, 1938, 1950, 1962, 1974, 1986, 1998, 2010, etc.
More of an assassination power.

name: Vampirism: Empathic
overview: gain sustenance and power from the emotions of others
description: Also called Empathic Absorption or Emotion Absorption, this is the ability to absorb energy from emotions (which sometimes relieves people of their emotions), or to simply become stronger in the presence of intense emotion; sometimes, the user become stronger only in the presence of a certain emotion, such as love or doubt, or anger, or bravery, or the like (as such, this power is especially effective on empaths and others who give off powerful empathic emanations)
pros: Drain your foes' emotions, making your foe temporarily emotionally numb
Draining their emotions also builds your physical stats and your resistance to empathic powers
Foes with empathic (emotion-related) abilities have nearly no effect
cons: Can still have emotions READ when this power is in use (though it also drains empathic perception)
Sometimes it requires and actual bite like a vampire
If you can't control it, friends and family won't want to be around you

name: Psionic Fruit Ripening
overview: ripen fruit and vegetables with your mind.
description: Ripen unripe fruits and vegetables to make them ripe, or take already ripe fruits and vegetables and ripen them until they ferment.
pros: If the store only has green banannas, no worries.
If you want an orange off the tree, but it hasn't fully ripened, no worries.
If you want to ferment something, no worries.
cons: Accidentally overripening fruit or vegetables.
If you hate fruits and vegetables, I guess it wouldn't do you much good.
Friends and family will always be wanting you to ripen things for them.

name: Tattoo Imprisonment
overview: turn people into tattoos on one's skin
description: You can use this power on someone by touching them. The people who you turn into tattoos can interact with each other and any other tattoos you have. They can also affect your body with their powers but if you die, they will be trapped forever on your skin.
pros: This power can reverse itself.
cons: You can now be harmed by your own tattoos.

name: Batman Vehicles V2
overview: summon any vehicle from Batman
description: With this power you can summon any vehicle that Batman has used. You can summon any kind of Batmobile, Batwing, Bat Boat, Batcycle, Bat Pod, etc. This power also gives you the knowledge of how to operate the vehicles.
pros: You can summon any Batman vehicle.
You know how to operate the vehicle.
You can unsummon them when you're done.
cons: The vehicles can be destroyed.

name: Myth Power: Iris' Illumination
overview: channel Iris' command over the essence of color and the rainbow
description: Iris, in Greek myth, was the goddess of color and the rainbow, as well as the Messenger of the Gods. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive the entire color spectrum (including focusing in on certain colors) at will. In addition, one can absorb color from matter, by touch, and re-release it at will (to re-color matter or as bolts/blasts of light). Furthermore, one can use rainbows to walk on or teleport, as well as fly. One even gains immunity to effects based on colors from the rainbow.
pros: Psychically perceive the entire color spectrum (including focusing in on certain colors) at will
Absorb color from matter, by touch, at will (recolor matter, Camouflage, release colorful blasts)
Use rainbows to walk on, or for teleportation; fly (wings optional); gain Rainbow Immunity
cons: Only change color of matter without a touch (or manipulate colored light) at the higher levels (NC
Cannot manipulate matter of same color as one's clothes until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Hera's Habit and MythPower: Thaumas' Theme provide immunity (NCN)

name: Go Back Home
overview: go back to your home sweet home!
description: The power to go go back too your home sweet home.
pros: If you are bored in a car its perfect!
cons: Use it wisely!

name: Good/Evil Seperation
overview: divide a person in two, separating their good and evil sides.
description:
This ability causes other people to divide into two people that look exactly like them. However, one person has all the good traits, while the other person has all the evil and bad traits. It divides the good and evil qualities of that person.
On top of the separation. The good and evil traits are defined by the original (whole person's) moral perception of good and evil, what they think of being essentially the "worst" and "best" attributes of themselves.
pros: You create a purely good person.
cons: You create a purely evil person.
The morality of good and evil is based on your subject's perception of morality, and not your own.

name: Ability Sponsors
overview: allow others to use their ability through you.
description: This is a superpower-based ability. If you know someone with a superpower (the sponsor), then they can decide to let you use it. Their power is then passed onto you for as long as the sponsor lets you. If the sponsor can only use their power so often because it drains their energy or something, when their power is passed on, it will still drain the sponsor's energy and not the receiver's. This ability could be extremely powerful if the wielder has lots of superpowered allies.
pros: Can be extremely powerful.
Does not require proximity.
Does not require energy from the receiver.
cons: Relies on sponsors.
Drains sponsors' energy.

name: Power Hobbling
overview: give any power a crippling drawback
description: Tired of seeing power with no cost? With this ability you can apply a thematically appropriate weakness to any power. Invulnerability? They lose their sense of touch. Fire powers? Now they must constantly eat or "go out". Animal form? They lose themselves in it. However, any flaw you inflict will also be placed on you for exactly one week. So be careful about who you curse.
pros: Make people regret they ever had power in the first place.
cons: Any flaw you place is put back on you for one week.
You will likely become hated among those with powers.
The flaw you place might not keep the recipient from hurting you

name: Trousers Of Doom
overview: store anything in your pockets
description: He who has this power can store anything in his pockets forevermore, regardless of size or shape. First, he must chant, "Picky picky pockets," and then name the object he wishes to store. There is only one catch: absolutely NOTHING that enters the pockets can ever come back out.
pros: Put people in a permanent time-out.
Who needs jail when nothing can escape your pockets?
cons: You can't take anything back out.
Never, EVER say "Picky picky pockets, the universe," because you'll be trapped in the void.

name: Enchantress
overview: make anyone fall in love with you.
description: This ability allows any female to enchant and entice their victims into falling in love with them.  Someone poor at using this ability might not even know they have it, but anyone whom they feel they love would love them back.  Anyone whom is decent at weilding this ability would have anyone whom they come in contact with fall for them, and lastly, a master would be able to pick and chose.  This ability works on contact for anyone competent; a touch of the hand could do it.
pros: Anyone you love would love you back.
So deep into love that they will do anything you ask of them.
cons: Never know if they love you for you.
They could get hurt; if you love them you do not want that.

name: Holy Power: Hands Of Energy
overview: create a huge amount of energy in the Torment Claws and use it for different battle purposes.
description: With this power, you can use the Torment Claws to create a huge quantity of energy. You can use it for different purposes: you can use it with your Omega level superspeed, running and destroying everything behind you with the energy; or create a huge explosion by concentrating the energy and releasing it. You can also use the energy to make the Torment Claws more powerful, destroying everything you touch with them, or give it the power to create waves of destructive energy.
pros: You can create pure energy from the Torment Claws, and use it for many purposes.
You can create an infinite amount of energy with your claws.
You can use it to restore the energy of your allies.
cons: If the energy creation get out of control, you are going to kill yourself.
Only Tormentors can use this power.

name: Hall Of Fear
overview: use the Hall of Fear.
description: The Hall of Fear is an illusion power. It forces the victim's mind into a dark hall illuminated by torches. There they are confronted by their worst fears. If they lose to them, they fall into insanity. If they beat their fears, you are forced into the Hall and have to face your fears.
pros: Forces people to fight worst fears.
Drives people insane.
cons: You might be driven to insanity.

name: Piece Of Eden: The Apple
overview: use an apple that can control people and create illusions.
description: The Apple can give you the ability to create illusions and control people's minds. As long as it is in your possession, you can use this power.
pros: You can carry it in your pocket or bag and still use its power.
cons: It must be in YOUR possession.
Enemies can use it if they take it from you.
Can be destroyed. And if it is, it will cause a HUGE explosion.

name: Reality's A Musical
overview: summon a piano that can bend a space of reality to your will.
description: Are you a talented musician that just can't seem to get your career started? Well, now you don't need to! With this power, you can call a keyboard to you that will form with a strap around your neck. You determine what each chord, cadence, and note does to a specific amount of space, determined by you power level. Once you determine this, you may not change it.
pros: You can control reality by playing the piano.
It may work on a smaller scale if you can't play actually.
You can add theme music to a space of reality to determine what happens.
cons: It's somewhat heavy.
You can't change the settings you put on it.
It takes a few minutes to fully summon it.

name: Sparta Kick
overview: make a giant hole and kick someone/something down it.
description: With this superpower you can spawn a infinite hole into the ground and kick something down it.
pros: Effective killing.
A cool rubbish bin
cons: You have to say 'THIS IS SPARTA!!! "
You would say it by accident.

name: Get Cooking
overview: cook anything in the world and make it good.
description: You can cook anything in the world! Like, you just throw anything in the oven and set the time, and it's really good!
pros: Never throw away anything ever again
Never hungry!
Costs less paying for food
cons: Sometimes it won't cook
Can't cook stuff older than a month

name: Hive Mind
overview: share a mind with several others
description: Hive Mind is very easy to overlook, but do so at your peril. People in a Hive Mind share a mind--they are one mind with several bodies. Therefore, anything one person in a Hive Mind knows, the whole Hive Mind knows. It also knows where each of its members is. Finally, the Mind can flood all of itself into a single member, giving them telepathy and hypnosis.  This leaves the other members comatose. There is no individuality in a Hive Mind, and when one member dies, it almost kills the others.
pros: Can be as many as 20 people
Know what your Hivemates know
Can flood all of it into one member, giving them psychic powers
cons: No individuality in a Hive Mind
When one dies, the others almost die too
"Flooding" leaves the others comatose

name: Poison Dart Strike V3 Monsters
overview: shoot poison darts from your hands
description: With this power you can shoot poison darts from your hands but they only effect monsters (werewolves, vampires, Bigfoot, zombies, dragons etc. ) the darts paralyze the victim for up to twenty minutes
pros: While the monster is paralyzed you can easily slay it or save somebody from it
cons: After the twenty minutes the monster will probably kill you

name: Narcotic Emission
overview: generate a powerful drug from your skin
description: A person with Narcotic Emission is a walking drug factory. At will, they can release a powerful heroin-like narcotic liquid from their skin. Upon contact with another person, this liquid is quickly assimilated. Its effects are euphoria, a reducing of physical pain, and apathy. The subject must touch the drug in order to feel its effects, and some may experience mental addiction. Narcotic Emitters are immune to their own drug.
pros: Help the terminally ill feel better
Make some money
Aids in fights (distract foes with how good they are feeling)
cons: Subject may experience mental addiction
Subject must touch drug to feel effects
Immune to your own drug

name: Rotating Wrists
overview: have wrists that can rotate around the axis of your arm.
description: You can make your wrists turn all the way around the axis defined by the length of your arms. It won't hurt at all and you can make them turn either clockwise or counterclockwise.
pros: You can now open or close screw caps without stopping and grabbing the cap at a different point.
You can now turn keys in their lock in a single continuous movement.
You can now do the helicopter spin with a bo staff or any stick without releasing it.
cons: If you don't stop the wrist rotation in the normal position, your hand will look funny.
Sadly, you can't rotate your pinky fingers with this power alone... (Quick! Use Con Negation!)
You can sort of slap someone by rotating your wrist.
tags: was edited as it was not really a superpower

name: Disaster Zone
overview: passively cause bad luck to everyone else
description: Wherever they go, people with this ability cause mayhem. Cars wreck, weapons misfire, things blow up, and people trip. This power is completely passive and requires no concentration. It also is unfortunately always active and can not be turned off. It does not affect you but it does affect everyone else within a 300 ft (91.44 meters) radius. Any "good luck" powers will provide protection from this ability. With practice you can learn to focus on one person, but you will still cause bad luck.
pros: Doesn't affect you
Gives you "virtual" good luck by making everyone else's worse
Can work on many people
cons: Can't be turned off
Can cause bad luck to friends
Not many people will want to be near you

name: Alien Detector
overview: know if somebody is an alien
description: With this power, you will automatically know if a person is an alien just by looking at them. If the person is an alien their skin will look bright red to you. You cannot turn this power off, so let's say one of your friends is an alien, their skin will always look bright red to you, which can get annoying.
pros: You will know if there is an alien near you.
cons: You cannot turn this power off.
If you're color blind, this power might not work for you.
If you're blind, this power will not work for you at all.

name: White Adipocyte Mimicry
overview: absorb fat, duplicate yourself when you're fat enough and make people feel sated.
description: This power is always active. As soon as you consume fat, you'll absorb it in your body. You can absorb up to four times your original body mass, becoming more obese. When you consume at least twice your body mass, you can undergo mitosis, duplicating yourself into two identical individuals and cutting your fat supply in half between your two selves. Also, as you slim, the skin will readjust so you won't have any excess. Additionally, you have the power to inhibit your or other people's appetite.
pros: The fatter you are, the more resistant to extreme temperatures and damages you become.
You have a great control over your fat intake as you can order your own body to feel full.
You can divide yourself into two, slimming in the process without any excess skin.
cons: If being thin is important to you, you'll never use the full potential of this ability.
People can be very cruel and discriminating with obese people.
You cannot easily lose the weight you gained.

name: Family
overview: know when a member of your immediate family is in trouble.
description: With this power, you automatically know when a member of your immediate family (father, mother, sister, brother, wife, son, daughter) is in trouble. This power also gives you the exact location and nature of the danger, so you get over there and try to help them. Unfortunately, this power can never be turned off and you're alerted whenever your little brother trips over a rock or your daughter was stung by a bee and other minor forms of danger.
pros: You know whenever a member of your immediate family is in any kind of danger.
cons: You're alerted for even the smallest things.

name: Legendary Weapon: Gungnir
overview: summon and wield the legendary weapon of the Norse God Odin
description: This allows the user to summon and wield the legendary weapon Gungnir. This weapon belongs to the King of the Norse Gods, Odin. It's incredibly powerful and can pierce through just about anything. Also, its special ability is that it's a spear that never misses its target. It can't be stopped once in midair. Truly a fearsome weapon.
pros: Very powerful weapon that can pierce through just about anything
Never misses its target
Can't be stopped in midair, except by the user
cons: Hard to control such a powerful weapon (takes a lot of energy to wield and control)
Getting the weapon is very difficult and chances are Odin won't just give it up

name: Odd Change
overview: unwillingly change your form depending on who you meet.
description: You see, these changes can only be stop if you are physically alone. It is not bad because this ability is made for one thing, combat. You'll need to fight different opponents with different form. Each form has a different face and each form is based on one of the three characteristics of a fighter: speed, strength, or agility.
pros: Able to protect your identity.
Gain different fighting styles.
cons: You have to be physically alone to stop it.
No one will see your true form.

name: Enhancement: Spinning
overview: make a power's projectiles spin by attaching this power to it
description: This is a support. It is useless without another power. When attached to another power it makes the projectiles spin which in turn gives the projectiles a piercing effect. This means that they are not slowed down when going through an object. If stolen, this power permanently affects the power it is attached to. It can only be attached to one power at a time.
pros: Spinning projectiles. Spinning Fireballs!
Hit an enemy when they think they are safe.
Having this and an aiming power.
cons: Useless without another power.
Still have a bad sense of aim if your's wasn't good in the first place.
Still need to know where to fire.

name: Flight Of The Lemmings
overview: force a group of objects to copy the actions of one member of said group.
description: Ever heard the story of how a group of lemmings will run off a cliff to their deaths without hesiatation, while following the group? This is the same concept. If you force a member of a group does something, all of the others do it as well, even with inanimate objects. One enemy get's scared, all of them get scared. you pickpocket one person, you pickpocket them all. You always decide when the effect takes place.
pros: Seduce/mesmerise/enlist/control large groups of people at once.
You can decide if when the effect takes place
You are not affected by this power yourself.
cons: Be careful of who's included in a group when you initiate a response for obvious reasons.

name: Alpha Cell Mimicry
overview: produce and inject glucagon, as well as trigger new abilities in Hepatocyte and Adipocyte Mimics.
description: This Mimicry belongs to the islets of Langerhans. You can produce glucagon, a hormone which raises the level of blood sugar in the body. You can inject a dose in anyone through touch, forcing their body to produce more sugar. You can also use it on other Cell Mimics from a distance. Hepatocyte Mimics will be forced to release their stored sugar but will be able to create more from various substances, like milk, fat, muscles,... Adipocyte Mimics will convert and release their fat as fatty acid.
pros: You can help people suffering from hypoglycemia.
When you're in need of sugar, you can use the glucagon on yourself.
You can give Hepatocyte and Adipocyte Mimics (both white and brown) new powers.
cons: It only works on humans and other species with a genome similar to human's, such as mice.
After a while, the body of those injected with glucagon can counteract its effects.
You can only undergo mitosis when united with all the other Mimics of the islets of Langerhans.

name: Spawn: Greek Pavilion
overview: spawn a greek pavilion.
description: This power spawns a delicious greek eatery, it is very spacious able to seat up to 400 quests.  You are served by satyrs, the food always replinishes. You are also given goblets that can create any kind of drink, like bright red lemonade, or hot chocolate with marshmallows,etc.
pros: Spawn a pavilion that makes great foods.
If your lost and need food.
Your own personal restaurant!
cons: The satyrs are somewhat slow and tend to eat some food you get until power develops.
People might think it is an actual restaurant and walk in.

name: Fancy Nail
overview: cut anything with your nails.
description: You can lengthen and shorten your nails at will. These nails can cut anything - fire, water, air, flesh, diamonds, etc. - anything.
pros: Can cut fire and thus escape burning buildings
Instant self-defense
cons: If you don't control it, you could slice yourself in half
Cutting cheese causes many unfortunate puns

name: Empathic Linking
overview: connect two persons together empathically
description: This power links two people together empathically, meaning they feel what the other is feeling in terms of emotions. You can choose to connect their lives as well; if one person is hurt or dies, the other one is hurt or dies as well.
pros: Make people understand each other by placing them in their shoes
You can tell is someone is lying
You can use it on anyone you like
cons: You may not like what you find out.
Both targets could die

name: Dragon Wand
overview: gain supernatural powers & abilities from a Chinese sceptre
description: The Dragon Wand is an unnatural and mystical artifact. It is a two and a half-foot long steel wand with an Emerald Dragon's head on top with dark red eyes. it can grant you great powers, primarily used for casting spells--enhancing, multiplying, gathering, focusing and redirecting mystical energies, etc. It only works when you say them in Chinese and/or Japanese.
pros: The Dragon Wand has been shown to only to destroy dark magical creatures or objects.
Vast potential
cons: You may only cast spells when you say them in Chinese and/or Japanese.

name: Benevorous
overview: feed off the goodness of a foe and become better physically.
description: You get a boost to stamina,strength and speed depending on the level of goodness in a foe. It starts with 50%(someone almost a anti-hero,but not quite) to a perfect angel of a person who gives you a 100 times boost to your physical traits. This power a has a 300 foot radius. The power automatically scans for the best goodness to feed off of when facing multiple foes. Foes need not have actual powers,the perfect cop could give you a boost to your physical traits.
pros: Turn a foe's goodness to your gain.
A almost anti-hero can still give you a slight boost to your physical traits.
The goodness you feed off of can come from a superpowerless but goodhearted person.
cons: A amoral person is fighting you.
Someone evil like yourself is fighting you.
A good guy is attacking you beyond the 300 radius.

name: Gustance Deduction
overview: determine details of something by taste
description: A person with this power is able to figure out vast amounts of information by tasting something. They analyze the exact tastes of the components that went into the tasted object. This lets one figure out the composition of their food as well as give them the ability to simulate the flavor of any food in their mind by combining the tastes of said ingredients in their mind. However, there are cons - you have to have tasted something before in your life to determine what ingredient it is.
pros: Figure out the composition of your food - what type of meat etc
Become a very good food critiquer
Become an excellent experimental chef
cons: Figuring out there was poison in something
You might not want to taste everything
You need to have a reference to figure out the exact taste

name: Food Control
overview: control food and make them fight for you
description: With this power you can summon a food army. They will fight for you and do whatever you tell them to do. Plus if your hungry you can it.
pros: Having an army that will fight 4 you
If you are hungry you can eat the army
cons: If you eat to much you might throw up
They can plan a revolt

name: Con Generation
overview: cause a very bad situation to happen to a superpowered being when they use their superpowers.
description: Some people think highly about their ability, but the worst thing that could happen to them is coming across someone with this power. The user can cause a bad plausible situation to happen to a superpowered being, related to the use of their superpowers. Even though someone claims there are no cons to their superpower, either because they don't want/know/believe them to have one, there usually is a worst-case scenario that might happen to them that could make them regret they used their power.
pros: You're immune to this power. Sort of. (See con 1. )
Don't believe it when the description of an ability says there are no cons.
Cause them to regret having powers or even hurt/kill them by backfiring their powers on them.
cons: It's rare but it can happen that the generated situation could affect the user in some ways.
The situation must be plausible -- well, in a world where superpowers exist, anything is possible.
A fully-mastered Con Negation power.

name: Naruto
overview: turn into or have the powers of Naruto from the anime "Naruto".
description: This power allows you to either have the abilities of, transform into, or partially transform into, Naruto, from the series,"Naruto".
pros: Can have all of his amazing powers.
Can do all of his jutsus.
Can do all of his jumping and running and fighting skills.
cons: Opponents can still beat you if they are more skilled.
Can only do what Naruto can do plus your own skills.
Can only transform yourself.

name: Temporary Speed Boost
overview: boost one's movement speed at a cost
description: You can multiply your speed by a constant of 5 for 1 minute, but all your leg muscles are damaged beyond what short term rest will cure. You signal your muscles for the speed increase by tapping one foot against the other foot.
pros: Chances are an enemy won't be able to stop your speed during that one minute.
Your bones' conditions are unchanged by this power.
cons: Healing and regeneration powers will not speed up the time needed to recuperate.
You heal the damage caused by this power at the average rate for someone your age and fitness would.
Average time to recuperate from this power is one month.

name: Enhancement: Potent
overview: increase the potency of a power by attaching this power to it
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it increases the potency or power of the power. Maximum increase in power is 200%. If this power is stolen, then the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This power can be attached to only one power at a time.
pros: Power is stronger.
The power can do more damage.
Works for physical, mental, magical, etc.
cons: Useless without another power.
Might not want a power to be stronger in a hostage situation if you are a good guy.
Maximum increase in power is 200%.

name: Uncanny Faith
overview: do things through prayer.
description: The ability to move a mountain or do anything else that seems impossible to man, but possible to God. You pray for whatever you want to happen and if your faith is strong enough, it will happen.
pros: You can do anything.
You go to heaven.
You have a close relationship to god.
cons: People will hate you.
People will try to kill you.
People will think you're the messiah.

name: Protective Ability Acquisition
overview: be protected by abilities
description: Temporarily gains all abilities necessary to eradicate a person or thing that is putting the user in danger. The amount of abilities gained to protect the user are limitless. The user has full control and understanding of the abilities gained; however, once the danger has been eradicated, the user becomes completely powerless. This ability becomes triggered if the user becomes naturally ill, if the user is being attacked etc.
pros: You are virtually invincible.
cons: If you aren't in danger you are completely powerless.

name: Template: Glory Angel.
overview: channel the power of a special seraphim.
description: A demented, immortal seraphim, stolen from grace. The user is able to take the form of man, but also that of an angel, whose six large wings spread feathers of glistening white. But, beneath that facade, there is deceiving; the user is composed of worms, through and through. A fever of mysterious power capable of independent movement, communication, and complete biological manipulation. The user is accompanied by unlimited strength, speed, invulnerability, and an immense regenerative factor.
pros: A unique physiology allows total command over themselves.
The user can "absorb" other invertebrates inside/within themselves.
There is no limit to how big, small, or wide the user can be.
cons: The user may lose to a stronger being.
The user is susceptible to magic and psionic influence.
The user may draw unwanted attention.

name: Blob Mimicry
overview: turn into an evergrowing/consuming gelatinous blob
description: Like the old monster movie, you can turn into a liquid/plasma form that grows bigger every time you consume something. Almost nothing can stop you, from electricity to explosions to freezing to fire to nukes. You adapt quickly & continue to grow, but you can't form any shapes like a fist or hammer. You just look like a giant amoeba. You consume matter by breaking it down with strong acid chemical enzymes. You can return to normal after everything you ate is dissolved.
pros: Be a giant consuming blob & continue to grow
Nearly invulnerable, adapting quickly
Can return to human again
cons: Can't take complex shapes
Can't return back to normal till everything you ate is dissolved
May be hunted by the military & angry mobs

name: Yokai: Tengu
overview: undergo a transformation into a Japanese monster or spirit.
description: The tengu, translated as "heavenly dogs". They appear as avian humanoids with red or blue skin with either a long nose or beak. The tengu are usually depicted as carrying hauchiwa (fans made of feathers) which stir up great winds. Tengu are also portrayed as expert samurai and yamabushi.
pros: Master swordsman.
Stir up deadly tornadoes.
cons: Still susceptible to damage.

name: Know Demons
overview: know when a demon is near
description: With this power you will know when a demon is nearby. The location of the demon must be within 10 kilometres. You will know how powerful the demon is, what type of demon it is, what powers it has, what it looks/sounds/smells like, and what it eats. This information pops into your head and disappears when the demon is out of range.
pros: You know when a demon is nearby.
Knowing where a succubus/incubus is to avoid her/him.
If you can counter the demon's powers and fight it on even terms(do this only if strong enough).
