Channeling Mneme (Memory), one can psychically record and replay any audio, as well as recalling lyrics to any song they hear, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive physical and mental (ie logical and strategic) flaws and errors, at will
Psychically access Perfect Pitch, generate music notes to manipulate matter (ie F for Fire), at will
Psychically recall/remember any song lyrics one hears, record/play any audio one hears, at will
cons: Cannot psychically practice (no physical strain, gain skills faster), until develop (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to any location where music is playing, until developed (NCN)
Sonic/music/song-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Photo Op
overview: take a picture anywhere without a camera.
description: Ever forgotten your camera at the worst time? Like when your new child has just been born? Anniversary? Birthday? Just need a picture to remember the moment? With this power all you have to do is make a rectangle with your fore-fingers and thumbs and say 'click! ' The picture will be stored in your subconsciousness until you decide to print it by slowly sliding one hand over the other, developing and printing it perfectly just as it should be.
pros: Portable camera with no extra weight on your person.
Can be set to color or black and white with a thought.
Infinite space and battery
cons: No flash or zoom.
Must have still hands.
Only standard photo size.

name: The Keyblade
overview: wield and use a keyblade
description: Just like Sora from Kingdom Hearts, you too can wield a keyblade. As long as you have a strong heart, the keyblade will remain with you. You can unlock any door, unlock any chest; you can also lock things up.
pros: Able to unlock and lock anything with the keyblade
cons: Keyblade will find another master, if your heart becomes weak

name: Card Immunity
overview: be immune to cards and card-based powers
description: Any power that has to do with cards won't affect you. This includes both negative and benificial effects.
pros: No more getting paper cuts from cards!
cons: For some versions this power applies only to cards OR card-based powers.

name: The Phonebooth
overview: interact with characters in a movie/on TV using a phone.
description: Imagine you're watching something on TV, and you want to warn the main character about a scheme, or confuse her with a red herring. Where would the plot spiral off to? How would it conclude? What would become of the main characters? Pick up any phone while watching TV, dial the character's name, and these scenarios need be speculation no more. Uses any phone near the character, mobile or otherwise (or even cartoon, if it's an animated film. Conversation with Pumbaa anyone?).
pros: A lot of fun, as you can send the plot spinning wildly off.
Can have a conversation with your favourite characters.
Non-permanent changes. Each viewing will be normal until you call in.
cons: Could ruin the suspense if you warned the character of a plot twist.
Would REALLY annoy/confuse people in the cinema!

name: Twilight Power:Tactile Telepathy
overview: read ALL thoughts.
description: Can see all the thoughts someone has ever had upon physical contact with them. The longer the contact, the more the user is able to see others' thoughts, and memories.
pros: Read every thought someones ever had.
cons: Requires physical contact.
You may need bodyguards.

name: Thirteen Treasures: White Hilt
overview: wield White-hilt, the sword of Rhydderch the Generous
description: One of the 13 treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. When drawn from its scabbard by a well born man, or a man of royal blood, this sword will burst into flames from the hilt to the tip.
pros: Evil Princes, Queens or Kings will not be able to wield this sword.
cons: You can only wield this sword if you are low-born.
If you are able to wield this sword, it will not be on fire.

name: Summon Clarent
overview: summon Clarent, the ancient stone blade of Fire.
description: Carent is known as the blade that killed King Arthur, but few know that it is Excalibur's twin. With this power, you can summon Clarent and use its many powers. Clarent can shoot fire, burn any creature cut with it and absorb the most painful memories of anything killed with it, then transfer those memories to its user. It is also indestructible and can fuse with Excalibur to create new Ley Gates which are used as portals to other Ley Gate locations around the world.
pros: Control of Fire
Can create Ley Gates
The Sword is indestructible.
cons: Absorb the most painful memories of killed enemies.
The sword is evil and may corrupt you.

name: Enhancement: Reflecting
overview: make a power unalterable by reflecting alterations sent by others
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the other power reflect alterations done to it back to the alterer to affect their powers. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This power CANNOT affect other enhancements.
pros: Karma will annoy your enemies.
The power this is attached to is 'unalterable'.
Ran out of room in cons: this power affects all alterations, good and bad.
cons: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.
Cannot be used on other enhancements. This cannot be negated by Con Negation.

name: Twilight Bracelet
overview: have the Twilight Bracelet, and its powers from the DotHack// series.
description: The Twilight Bracelet has many different abilities. Data Drain sends a beam from the bracelet that rewrites the opponent's data, making them weaker, and extracts the excess data as a virus core. Drain Arc lets you do this on multiple targets. Gate hacking lets you use the virus cores to open a gate and travel to a different area in space. Continued use of the bracelet causes infection, with strong side effects, but the infection disappears after periods when the bracelet is not used.
pros: Data Drain foes to make them significantly weaker, and gain their virus cores.
Data Drain can remove things like Immorality and Invulnerability,as well as other significant powers
Gate Hacking allows travel to areas that are usually restricted.
cons: Data Drain can be resisted by strong foes. (Can be countered by causing Protect Break)
High levels of infection can cause a person to reduce in level, enter a coma, or even die.
Data Drain, when used on others that are weak, can leave them in a coma.

name: Meibomian Gland Cell Mimicry

name: Passive Clothing Empowerment
overview: extend your abilities to your clothing.
description: This ability allows the user to extend the effects of their abilities, particularly physical ones, to the items they wear. If you are immune to fire, so will your clothing. If you are bulletproof, your jacket will not get holes in it when fired at. The clothing, however, does not gain any powers or enhance your abilities in any way. The clothing has the same weaknesses as the one providing it with powers. The empowerment is instantaneous but fades just as quickly when clothing is removed.
pros: Never accidentally destroy your clothing through use of powers again.
No longer need special equipment.
Some clothing may improve power use; clothing can now absorb sunlight for you, for instance.
cons: The clothes do not gain any other power/s.
You are not additionally empowered in any way by your clothing.
Clothing is only empowered while actually worn.

name: Myth Power: Neaera's Need
overview: channel Neaera's command over the essence of the rising of the sun and the moon
description: Neaera (Neaira, Perseis, Perse), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the sun and moon's risings. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically manipulate sunlight when the sun is out, and moonlight when the moon is out, at will. In addition, one can psychically absorb sunlight and moonlight to gain physical power and sustenance, at will. One can also psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can even psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions).
pros: Psychically manipulate sunlight when sun is out, moonlight when moon is out, at will
Psychically absorb sunlight and moonlight to gain physical power, as well as sustenance, at will
Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions
cons: Cannot psychically teleport to any location the sun/moon is rising, at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically time-travel to past/future sunrises/moonrises, at will, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Helios' Help and Selene's Salute provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Usefulness Removal
overview: remove the actual usefulness any weapons, powers, technology, etc
description: This ability can make anything useless and pointless by removing all uses that a target has. By removing their usefulness, the victim will be just phase through thing. Since they are now useless, it is basically nothing but a waste of space. They do not even have a physical use. The user can only use this ability on one thing at a time.
pros: Remove any or all uses from anything
Superpowers are affected as well
cons: The effects are only temporary.
The user can only use this ability on one thing at a time.

name: Jacket Fusion
overview: become a jacket that, when worn, conveys all of your powers, skills, and traits to the wearer.
description: With this power you can freely transform into a jacket that, when worn by someone else, gives them access to all of your powers and skills in addition to combining your strength, speed, intelligence, and endurance.   You are aware of everything that is happening while you are a jacket and can transform back at any time you wish, sliding off the wearer automatically.
pros: Pool your strength with an ally.
Enhance someone who you know is better than you for the task at hand.
Share your strength with someone you know is weaker.
cons: You are trusting yourself completely to another person.
In a fight, because you are covering someone else, you will be taking hits first.

name: Arceusforce: Icicle
overview: channel the power of Arceus's Ice form.
description: The user of this ability can channel the cold heart of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Ice-type. The user's skin turns light blue, their irises turn white. Under their frigid guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of an Ice-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Ice attacks such as Ice Beam, Aurora Beam, Icicle Spear, Blizzard and more.
pros: The user can resist other ice-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of ice, cold and aurora for Ice attacks
cons: The user is weak to fire, supernatural combat, mineral and metal-based attacks.
This power may be too powerful for the user. May need to be unlocked from the default form.
Ice is probably the weakest defensive type.

name: Default Form
overview: see a person's default/normal/true form and then make them return to it.
description: With this power you can see a person's default or normal form. If the person is a shapeshifter you have the ability to see their normal form, if they're in disguise you can see what they look like normally, if they're hidden behind a hologram or mirage you can see through it. If a person is an extension or puppet of a third party force you can see that person. You can turn this power on and off. You can also cause a person to revert to their normal or default form.
pros: You can cause a person to revert to their normal form.
You can tell if a person is a shapeshifter.
If someone is being possessed by something you can see that thing.
cons: Not good to use at costume parties.
Not much use in physical combat.

name: Ability To Manipulate Pimples
overview: manipulate pimples so you can give yourself pimples to look older than you are
description: Control pimples to make your enemies ugly or remove them to give your allies flawless skin... You can cover yourself with indestructable pimples to use as armor.
pros: Make a popular guy ugly
Indestructable armor
Never suffer puberty
cons: U look freaky and ugly while wearing armor
People will always bug you about their pimples

name: Midas' Touch Revamped
overview: Turn what you touch into gold at the expense of your own blood.
description: No, this is not your run-of-the-mill Midas' Touch, who'd want that? with this power, if you choose to do so, you can turn anything you touch into gold. Upon activation, an equivalent amount in mass of gold created is consumed from your own blood.
pros: Gold, man. Gold.
You can turn anything into gold, even organic matter, so it may be lethal.
Easily concealable.
cons: Must be in direct contact with the matter to be transformed.
Loss of blood might be dangerous if done in large quantities.
It is lethal, so accidents might happen.

name: Media Mastery (Sodenio)
overview: be skilled in media-related tasks
description: You know all and can do all media-related tasks, including filming, artistry, directing, producing, management, being a spoeksperson etc.
pros: Can make movies easy and fast
Can film great shots
Can be great in all artist related things
cons: Can make any ones pictures bad or ugly
Can make films, bad or good
Can control the outcome of TV shows

name: Summoning: Amaterasu
overview: summon Amaterasu.
description: Amaterasu, the Sun Goddess. Her power is now yours. She can use a flame that will never extinguish until those she targets are burned to ashes.
pros: Flames.
Powerful flame attacks.
cons: Same as all Summons.

name: Televangelism
overview: get money from people by saying "The Lord wants you to give me money! "
description: Simply point to person and say, "The Lord wants you to give me money! " They will then give you all that they have, and go get more if you want them to.
pros: You have an unlimited supply of money as long as there are Christians around.
It's not CrackTart.
cons: Not much use in combat.
Well, it's not CrackTart...

name: The Unforgiving Fist
overview: punch anyone you want once every day with no consequences.
description: Ever have the urge to punch someone?  Why hold back?  With this ability, each day you can punch ANYONE you want.  As long as you can walk up to them, you can punch them and you have all to gain from it.  No retaliation.  Just pure venting in one of our most primitive and satisfying ways!  Start punching today!
pros: Road rage at stopped traffic lights
When you feel you deserved a C, not an F
The TPS reports can wait
cons: Too much punching, too little negotiating
Becoming an angry, punching, hairy gorilla (at least figuratively)
Occasionally, you might feel guilty for punching someone.

name: Cloning Bite
overview: clone yourself by biting a living being and having your clones emerge from the bite wound.
description: Typically possessed by some insects and some arachnids, one with this ability must bite a living host. After a period of incubation, a dozen duplicates will emerge from each bite wound. If the duplicates are extracted before they are fully formed, they will die and won't be replaced. Humans and big animals are not usually meant to have this power as they need be able to open a wound with their teeth and find a big enough host to bring their clones to term. It won't work if the host is too small.
pros: Fast and creepy way to reproduce yourself.
Since the human population is increasing, it's very easy to find a host.
The duplicates will be at the same metamorphosis stage as you when you bit the host.
cons: Since the duplicates are identical to you, you all have the same weaknesses, especially pesticides.
You could disturb the balance of an ecosystem.
If you're a big animal, there won't be many situations where this power will be useable.

name: Myth Power: Notion Of The Nesoi
overview: channel the Nesoi and their command over the essence of islands and island life
description: The Nesoi, in Greek myth, were the goddesses of islands. As such, channeling them allows one to selectively perceive present and future weather conditions and natural phenomena on any island throughout the Cosmos. One may also use this power to sense the layout of any island at will (including any supposedly hidden features, such as treasure and magical landmarks). In addition, one may teleport to any island at will, and one's attributes are enhanced as long as one is on an island
pros: Knowledge of any island in existence (location, layout, present/future weather conditions, etc. )
Teleport to any island at will
Stats (strength, durability, reflexes, etc. ) are enhanced for as long as you are on an island
cons: Cannot alter an island's weather until the higher levels
Not every island is habitable
At the lower levels, stat enhancement gets weaker the further you are from the center of an island

name: Cat's Eyes
overview: see through the eyes of a cat, any cat.
description: You can tap into the network of feline minds and see what they see. Can also see things that cats have seen by looking at the particular cat in the eye.
pros: Can solve crimes by looking in the eyes of feline "witnesses".
Can observe other people/events without being physically there.
cons: Can only see things within the cat's vision range.
Empathic feedback: if the cat you're looking through gets hurt, you get hurt too.

name: Superhuman Olfaction
overview: possess an incredible sense of smell
description: In comparison to other animals, humans are blind. A person with Superhuman Olfaction can enjoy a whole new spectrum of experience. Their sense of smell is as a scenthound's; 6 million times human strength. As such, they can track an object coonhound-style, draw minute details from scents, find food from miles away, and actually sort of smell the chemical mix that is fear. However, they are more sensitive to incapacitating smells, like sulfur or drying tar.
pros: 6 million times normal strength
Determine tiny details from a single whiff of the scene
Find food or track foes
cons: May rely a bit too much on smell and not on other senses
Sensitive to unpleasant smells
Explaining to others how you know that the A-1 sauce is generic brand

name: Star Reclassification
overview: change a star's spectral class without harm to life on any planets.
description: With this power you could make the sun an O class star(a blue super-giant) or the lowest class, an M red dwarf. The planets automatically change orbit, so life on Earth is always safe. Life adapts to the new light spectrum. Plants survive under the new sunlight. All animals may just see infrared (if living under a red dwarf). The new sun, if a normally unstable star, is perfectly stable under this power.
pros: Make a day on Earth last hundreds of hours or more.
Make a year last thousands of years or more.
A summer that last years.
cons: Imagine winter that last a 100 years...
Sunlight fearing creatures will be a big problem when there's weeks of nighttime.

name: Zerg Mutation
overview: make animals mutate in the same way as the Zerg.
description: The Zerg are the masters of biological warfare. With this power you can make any animal mutate and infect in the same way the Zerg do and have control over their hive mind. You can mutate any animal to make it fly, swim, tunnel or even mutate them into a form of hive building. The mutated animals can even produce acidic chemicals within their bodies. The mutation occurs rapidly and the animals can be mutated several times. Larva can be produced so you only need one of an animal to create an army
pros: Zerg army.
Can be used on any animal.
Hive mind lets you know everything your mutations know.
cons: Can only be used on one species and can not be changed.
If you lose control over the hive mind they will most likely turn on you.
May take time to spawn and mutate your army to be large enough to take on other superpowers.

name: Luminescence
overview: emit bright light
description: Luminescents can emit large amounts of pure white light- maximum around 100,000,000,000 candles' worth. This is enough to blind almost anything permanently and can almost be seen from space. It can be used as a beacon or offensive weapon.
pros: Homing signal extraordinaire
Blinding foes
Strobe light at concerts
cons: May blind things you didn't want to blind
Really, really obvious
Cannot make other colors

name: Herbology
overview: employ the art of herbology
description: Herbology is the art of using and caring for magical plants. Anyone with this ability will have full knowledge of all sorts of magical plants and herbs. Also, they will possess a sort of magical green thumb. Whenever they plant a magical seed of any kind, it will grow faster than normal, growing to full size in a fourth of the time. The user can use these herbs for many things, suchs as breathing underwater, healing, or fire-starting.
pros: Will have full knowedge of herbology (what they need to grow, where they can be found,etc. )
Other powers can be gained
cons: Very hard to find magical plants
Caring for hundreds of herbs and plants

name: Holy Power: Soul Reap
overview: remove the souls of everyone around you by spinning the Reaper Scythe
description: With this power you can remove the soul of everyone around you by spinning the reaper scythe above your head. With this power you can easily save yourself when surrounded by enemies. This power is very useful because it doesn't wastes too much energy, but you might hurt innocents.
pros: Perfect for escaping when surrounded by enemies.
Kill everyone around you in seconds.
Doesn't wastes too much energy.
cons: You might hurt innocents.
Reaper only.

name: Moon Manipulation
overview: control the moon.
description: Moon Manipulators get great advantages with this power. With it they control it's distances; making it farther away or extremly close. Control the ocean tides, affect the rocks, and even control the moon's gravity.
pros: Have a great view at night by making a full moon.
Make tidal waves for offense by pulling the moon closer.
Make night come faster.
cons: Moving it too much will knock it out of orbit.
Changing the axis and creating dangerous climate.
If it's destroyed you have no power over it anymore.

name: The Sneaker Sneaked
overview: sneak up on someone who is sneaking up on you.
description: The passive part of the power makes you aware of anyone who is sneaking up on you. You then have the choice to use the active part of the power, which is to sneak up on that person. It can happen in two ways. If they lost sight of you at that moment, you will be teleported in their blind spot, allowing you to sneak up on them. If they were watching you, your doppelganger takes your place while you are teleported and sneak up on them. You can decide if you want to appear far from or near them.
pros: Noone can ever sneak up on you by surprise.
It's creepy to follow someone from afar and they are suddenly right behind your back.
You are guaranteed to appear somewhere they can't see you, usually behind them.
cons: If you use this power to sneak up on a sneaker and they also use it to sneak up on you.
If you don't have the means to attack or defend yourself, it could be dangerous to sneak up on them.

name: Self Absorption
overview: absorb yourself.
description: Ever need a quick escape from the universe? With this power, you can absorb your own body, in the same way that a matter absorber would absorb other things, until there is nothing left. The effect would be similar to travelling into a black hole and you may come out in the other side of the universe, a completely different universe, or even a non-universe, like limbo. You could end up being 2 dimensional, 12 dimensional, 0 dimensional, or even -3 dimensional! Infinity's the limit.
pros: Escape from the universe quickly.
Can make it look like you are eating yourself.
cons: Completely unpredictable.
Not necessarily voluntary.
Absolutely mind-boggling. Will probably end up going insane.

name: Trap Realm
overview: trap the most powerful evil inside a prison realm forever.
description: You are a fighter for good and you have been fighting this evil creature possibly a demon, yet no matter what you do you'll never defeat him, but he's about to destroy all you know. Ah but you have this one time use power. You can trap him in a prison realm forever. No possible escape. Garenteed! However in order to trap him you must go in with him to lock the gate from the inside.
pros: Trap a nearly all powerful evil in a prison for all time.
Your name will live on to inspire heroes for generations.
Your world and all you care about will be saved from that particular Great Evil being.
cons: All your powers are taken away when you shut the gates of this prison realm.
You can't get out because there is no escape for anyone. Not even you.
This Evil being will punish you forever because you put him there there's noone else to hurt.

name: Summon Shroudthought
overview: summon an anti-telepathic half-alive thing.
description: Kyst has given shroudthoughts the appearance of blood soaked six-foot tall rag dolls. Shroudthought or just shrouds have the anti-telepathic power. They will target for death anyone with psionic powers first, you can't command them otherwise. A shroud won't even consider killing you if you don't have any psionic powers. Shrouds have the strength to rip apart man as if he were wet tissue paper. They can run 50 mph. They have standard kystian invulnerability. Shrouds are sneaky and clever.
pros: An anti-psionic flesh-ripping monster.
You are safe if you don't have any psionic powers.
cons: A monster that will kill if you say the wrong thing-only if you are psionic.

name: Myth Power: Arete's Excellence
overview: channel Arete's command over the essence of virtue, excellence and valor
description: Arete, in Greek myth, was the goddess of excellence, virtue, honor, valor (bravery and courage) and prestige. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive subjects' morals, as well as the extent of their valor, at will. In addition, one can gain physical power from feeling fear, worry and doubt. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel experts; those considered the best at what they do (fighters, singers, scientists, artists, politicians, athletes, etc).
pros: Psychically perceive subjects' morals, and the extent of their valor (bravery/courage)
Gain physical power when one feels fear, worry or doubt (natural or projected)
Perceive, communicate with and compel those who are talented/experts/role models in their field
cons: Pro #2 does not completely PREVENT the feeling of fear/dread/doubt until developed (NCN)
Pro #2 only uses one's own fear; No enhanced damage against dishonorable foes until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain enhancement of one's natural skills until developed (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Comos' Charisma
overview: channel Comos' command over the essence of revelry, merrymaking and festivity
description: Comos (Comus, Komos), in Greek myth, was the god of revelry, celebration, merrymaking and festivity. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the dates/customs of any holiday/special event, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive communicate with and compel anyone born on the day of power use, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically induce an overwhelming urge to party, by touch. One can even psychically summon gifts, and weaponized party decorations, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive the dates/customs of any holiday/special event (even birthdays, etc) at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born on day of power use
Psychically induce overwhelming urge to party; summon random gifts and weaponized party favors
cons: Cannot withstand fatigue and negative drinking/drug effects (shared by touch), until developed (NCN)
Cannot teleport/time travel to parties (and gain physical power at parties) until developed (NCN)
Cannot banish party crashers to the Underworld until developed (NCN)

name: Civilian Zone
overview: create a zone that promotes commonness.
description: Creates a zone that promotes commonness. Advantages and disadvantages would be removed and the total power level of everyone inside would be divided equally. While inside the zone a person with no powers would be evenly matched with superman. For things, such as competitions, advantages given by superpowers, or from other means, would be lost or given to everyone within the competition.
pros: Make it impossible for people to become overpowered.
Make competitions based on skill only.
Increase the power of weaker individuals.
cons: Lose any advantages you would have with superpowers inside the zone.
Unable to become stronger or better than others while within the zone.
Could lose against foes you could normally beat effortlessly.

name: Human Fire Extinguisher
overview: shoot fire retardant foam from your hands
description: With this power, you can be like a human fire extinguisher (hence the name) and shoot fire retardant foam from your hands. The foam comes out rather quickly and with a lot of force, so it can also be used to injure enemies or push them away or into walls.
pros: You can put out fires
You can injure your enemies
You never run out of foam
cons: It doesn't hurt that much

name: Time To Duel!
overview: summon monsters, use traps and spells from the Yugioh card game and they are real!
description: You'll be able to summon Yugioh Monsters, like the cards from the game!   You'll have infinite lifepoints when using your powers against someone without the same powers, so you'll be able to take a bullet!   when dueling, you'll have real cards happen before you while your opponent will have the basic cards...
pros: You'll be like Akiza from Yugioh 5Ds
You'll be the envy of other duelists
You can summon Obelisk the Tormentor!!!!!!!!
cons: You won't have a duel challenge unless you meet someone else with the same power
You might accidentally kill someone
You need to draw the cards you want to use

name: Painsmith
overview: create weapons from the bones of dead beings that have power based on the pain felt at death
description: You can take bones from a dead body or bodies and fuse them together to create a weapon made of bone. The weapon will have magical power based on the amount of physical pain the being(s) felt when they died. The sharpness of the weapon, if it is a bladed one, is based on the mental pain and anguish felt at death. The weapon will also have an independent mind of its own and in order to use the weapon, one must pass the weapon's test (test differs for each weapon).
pros: Beings tormented physically and mentally until they died yield up powerful weapons. May be a con.
Enemies may not pass the test needed to use one of the weapons.
As the creator of the weapon, you are the only one who does not need to pass the test to use it.
cons: Beings who died happily in their sleep of old age will not yield up powerful weapons.
Seems like more of an evil power.
Friends may not be able to pass the weapon's test to use it.

name: Synesthesia
overview: have mildly crosswired senses
description: Synesthesia is a great gift. It allows the user to perceive sound as color. This lets them easily discern musical key, or see differing pitches as color, or even different timbres as different colors. This ability can prove a bit vexing if the user is asked to identify a red object while listening to a blue pitch, or if a sound is so loud it makes them go blind.
pros: Easily identify key
Adds an extra dimension to perception of music
Really fun to have
cons: Being blinded by sound
Considered a bit strange
Arguing with other synesthetes over perceived colors

name: Half Mummy
overview: be half-human, half-mummy
description: Someone with this power will have boosted physical strength and speed. They will also have bandages at various parts of their body that they can control and they will have an attractive appearance. They will also have boosted magical power for cursing other people and controlling sand. Also, they will be half-living and half-undead with a healing rate that is 3/4s that of a normal human's healing rate and they can never become dehydrated.
pros: People won't want to make you angry at them.
Best terrain to fight in is a desert. May be a con.
cons: People might be scared of you. May be pro.

name: Arcana: 10 The Wheel Of Change
overview: cause things and people around you to be in constant flux.
description: A person with this power is the bane of reliability. This power creates a aura around a person that cause everything to flux and change. Superpowers may become stronger or weaker, or change function entirely. People may become happy, sad, excited, scared, all emotions and thoughts in flux. Probability is warped as the unlikely becomes likely and vice versa. The only one immune it the person with this power themselves. This power is difficult to shut off- if it can be at all.
pros: Send your enemies into chaos.
Win money in Vegas.
cons: Power also affects allies.
May empower enemies
Totally random

name: Power Backup
overview: store copies of your powers on CD
description: This power lets you burn to CD any power you have(including this one). All you do is hold a CD between your palms for 20 minutes and you've got a backup power. Make multiple copies of any power. A lost power(including this one) can be restored in 2 minutes by holding the CD between your hands. These CDs only work for you. Someone else with this power could detect them if he was 10 feet or closer. Your CDs can't be affected by any power-altering power. You can use rewritable CDs.
pros: Make multiple copies and hide them anywhere you might go
Carry them with you
These power CD's work even if badly scratched.
cons: You break the last copy of a power and you've just lost that power
You keep them all in one location and someone finds your stash
If you can't afford to buy blank CD's.

name: Condition Change: Life
overview: make a power work only when the user is saving someone's life
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that it works only when the user is saving another's life. This power is tactile.
pros: It will also replace Condition Change: Unneeded, if Unneeded was already on the power being altered.
Now the opponent has to help others.
cons: Condition Change: Unneeded will replace this power, if this power was on the affected power first.

name: Lava Rain
overview: cause lava to rain from the sky
description: With this power you can cause scolding hot molten lava to fall from the sky wherever and whenever you want. The lava can burn through almost anything and once the lava hits the ground you cannot make it disappear.
pros: You can make scolding hot molten lava to fall from the sky
The lava can burn through almost anything
cons: You might harm innocent people
Once the lava hits the ground you cannot make it disappear

name: Myth Power: Arke's Arcana
overview: channel Arke's command over the essence of color, the rainbow's arch and the lost second rainbow
description: Arke (Arce) in Greek myth, was the goddess of color, the rainbow's arching shape and the lost second rainbow, as well as the Messenger of the Titans. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive the entire color spectrum (including focusing in on certain colors) at will. In addition, one can arc colored light into a boomerang, or a bow for light arrows. Furthermore, one can use rainbows to walk on or teleport, as well as fly. One can even withstand effects based on the colors of the rainbow.
pros: Psychically perceive the entire color spectrum (including focusing in on certain colors) at will
Bend colored light into an arc (rainbow) shape, to use as a boomerang or a bow to shoot light arrows
Use rainbows to walk on, or for teleportation; fly (wings optional); gain Rainbow Immunity
cons: Cannot psychically bend structures into a rainbow-arc shape until developed (NCN)
Cannot manipulate matter of the same color as one's clothes until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Titanomachy Rematch and MythPower: Thaumas' Theme provide immunity (NCN)

name: Puppet Alive
overview: cause puppets to come to life
description: With this power you can bring puppets to life by pointing at them and saying "Rise Puppet! " then the puppet will come to life and be under your complete control. Since puppets generally don't have legs the puppets will be able to levitate and float around. You can use this power on as many puppets as you want but you can't turn them back to normal.
pros: You can have an army of puppet minions
You can have as many as you want
cons: It only works on puppets
You have to say the spell

name: Myth Power: Oxylus' Option
overview: channel Oxylus' command over the essence of mountain forests
description: Oxylus (Oxylos), in Greek myth, was the god of mountain forests. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically generate and manipulate plants indigenous to mountains at will. In addition, one may cast the illusion of being high on a mountain top at will. Furthermore, one gains adaptation to survive on any mountain (enhanced toughness, cold immunity, adapted respiration, etc), which may be shared by touch. One can even teleport (self or others) to or from any mountain in the Cosmos at will.
pros: Generate and manipulate mountain plants and trees at will; cast illusions of being on a mountaintop
Teleport to/survive on mountains (enhanced toughness and respiration, cold/wind immunity, etc)
Share Montane Adaptation (adaptation to survive mountain conditions) by a touch
cons: Cannot turn subjects into trees indigenous to mountains with a touch until the higher levels (NCN)
People with agrokinetic MythPowers are immune to being turned into mountain trees
People with MythPower: Honor of the Ourea can resist being teleported to a mountain

name: Acid Generation
overview: generate acid.
description: This ability can be manifested through touch or as a spray.
pros: You would be able to secrete an acid-like sweat from the pores of your body.
You could metabolize the acid into corrosive projectile beams and shoot them from your hands.
You would be able to form acidic brass knuckles to augment your punching power.
cons: You would still be harmed by your own acidic projections.
It is possible to unintentionally harm someone.
People would want to stay away from you.

name: Zoading
overview: speed up computer loadings.
description: This ability allows you to speed up computer loadings just by thinking, including downloads. This ability will work on any computer. Using the skill too much causes headache.
pros: You don't have to wait for that loading to finish
Speed up your download time
cons: Causes headache if overused

name: Sickage Bender
overview: turn anyone you want sick
description: You are able to make anyone sick with any cause but you are only able to make 1 person sick every 10 minutes and your able to make them be sick in any way you want
pros: You can give security guards a disease to get through gate a security guard is guarding
cons: The time limit isn't the best so you have to use your power wisely

name: Myth Power: Penia's Penalty
overview: channel Penia's command over the essence of poverty, penury and the poor
description: Penia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of poverty, penury and neediness. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive how much money anybody has on them at any given time, at will. In addition, one can compel subjects to give away all of their money and valuable possessions to any person or organization that one desires. One can even compel foes to destroy their valuable items at will. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with, and compel the poor and the homeless at will.
pros: Perceive how much money subjects have; perceive, communicate with and compel the poor/homeless
Compel subjects to give away their valuables at will (to you, friends, charity or the like)
Compel subjects to destroy their valuables at will
cons: If people ever learn about your power, they'll likely expect you to help end poverty
People with MythPower: Plutos' Bounty are immune to this ability
People with MythPowers based on Penia's sisters are immune to this ability (and vice versa)

name: Army Of The Living Dead
overview: control zombies
description: You will be able to bring back the deceased as zombies under your control.
pros: Have an army of walking corpses
cons: Your army will rot & decompose
The smell of death

name: Pizza Maker
overview: create pizza out of thin air
description: You can create pizza out of thin air. In battle, you can have a slice of pizza whenever you want.
pros: Tasty pizza whenever you want
cons: You can't control the toppings

name: Demon Weapon Forging
overview: create mystic weapons from the fangs, claws, and/or scales of demons
description: The weapons are created by first combining the fang, claw, or scale with metal, then turning the resulting combination into a weapon by way of the arts of the blacksmith. The weapon has powers based on those of the demon from which the fang, claw, or scale came from. Fangs tend to give offensive powers, claws tend to give agility-based powers,and scales tend to give defensive powers. However, all of the fangs, claws and scales have to come from the same demon for any individual weapon.
pros: Can create extremely powerful weapons.
Different demons give different powers to the weapons so it is good to experiment.
Demons might pay you to make them weapons if they feel they need or want one.
cons: The number of powers is random but always at least one and no more than 5.

name: Chimpanzee Mimicry
overview: mimic the skills of a chimpanzee
description: With this power you gain all of the skills of a chimpanzee including enhanced agility and climbing skills, the ability to walk a tight rope flawlessly, opposable feet and the ability to hold up to 300 pounds in one hand.
pros: You have all of the skills of a chimpanzee
cons: You can't actually turn into a chimpanzee with this power

name: Myth Power: Paregoron's Paragon
overview: channel Paregoron's command over the essence of consolation, soothing words and coaxing
description: Paregoron (Paregoros), in Greek myth, was the goddess of consolation, soothing words and coaxing words of encouragement. As such, channeling her allows one to intuitively discern how to speak to others in order to soothe, console and encourage them. In addition, one's touch amplifies the soothing effect. Furthermore, coaxing and encouraging others multiplies the effect of nearly any effort they put forth. One can even gain the same benefits when one receives words of encouragement from others.
pros: Psychically intuit how to speak to others to console/soothe/encourage them (amplified by a touch)
Coaxing and encouraging others amplifies the result of any effort they put forth
Receiving words of encouragement from others amplifies the result of any effort the user puts forth
cons: Soothing words ease pain, and encouraging words speed healing only at the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot use soothing words to calm rage/trance-like mental states until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot use encouraging words to induce rage/trance-like mental states until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Old One Power: Nyarlathotep
overview: channel the power of the Outer God Nyarlathotep
description: Messenger of the Outer Gods, Nyarlathotep. While Nyarlathotep incarnates in various avatars known as "masks" to do the bidding of the other Outer Gods, you are limited to one body, but do gain his many forms. Many are useful for combat, but the more powerful your new shape, the more uncontrollable the destruction. You also gain his mastery of telepathic communication, though no mind-reading, and a genius mind geared towards long-reaching and complicated plans of manipulation.
pros: Telepathy, limited shapeshifting (limited to 999 forms), and the brain power to use it.
Nyarlathotep also has plans and pawns EVERYWHERE, who will act favorably towards you.
If manipulation doesn't work, the shapeshifting can blast someone's sanity, and packs a punch.
cons: Your descent into sadism and hatred is inevitable. There is no arguing or avoiding it.
On the best of days, Nyarlathotep considers you a valuable pawn. On the worst, an obstruction.
Unless they directly oppose you, other Old One Powers users can command you.

name: Decepticon Summon
overview: summon any of the Decepticons
description: With this power you can summon any Decepticon or Predacon from any continuity in order to help you commit crimes. You can summon as many as you want but keep in mind they're not under your control and will probably kill you first and ask questions later but on the off chance that they help you some of them are extremely powerful (Unicron, Galvatron) though some of them aren't that powerful (Cybertron Thundercracker, Lazerbeak)
pros: You can summon any Decepticon/Predacon
Some of them are extremely powerful
cons: They might kill you
If you're a hero they definitely will not help you

name: Coupon Authenticity
overview: make expired or fake coupons real and useable.
description: The ability to make other people believe that your expired or fake coupons are real and be able to use them to acquire things. Extremely unrealistic coupons may get noticed unless you attempt to persuade that they are real. People with psychic powers may be immune to this power. After you use the coupon, it might be hard to explain how you got whatever you used the coupon for.
pros: Really good deals.
Trick people into giving you their stuff.
Those "free kiss" coupons.
cons: If it's extremely unrealistic, it might get noticed.
Psychics are immune to this trick.
Explaining how you got so much stuff.

name: The Trollforce Master
overview: control the force behind trolling and Schadenfreude
description: This force can be used in two major ways. The first is for actual trolling. Besides being granted major manipulation and computer skills, the trollforce can be used to read minds and control computers. But it can also be used to create 'epic' real life 'trolls'. Though its preferred form is in standard psychic (particularly telepathic) powers and trickster magic. The catch is that it must be recharged through actual trolling if you use it for non-trolling.
pros: Become a legend wherever you go, for bringing devestation through manipulation
Have the powers of Professor X and Mr. Mxyzptlk, particularly if you're just wreaking havoc
Manipulative and computer skills for free! The manipulation/computer powers are recharged easily
cons: While the lighter effects may only require browsing the internet and enjoying the works of others,
The really dramatic stuff requires you to pull very epic (and hurtful) trolls
People will hate (and possibly even fear) you if you can't hide the way you charge your powers

name: Power Bait And Switch
overview: choose what power is copied or stolen from you.
description: With this power, you become aware when someone is going to steal, copy or duplicate one of your powers. You then have the ability to pick what power they get. If your only choice was this power or gravity manipulation, you could choose this power. Or if you had one of the worst top ten powers, you could choose that power. The power duplicator or power thief has no idea what you've done until they try to use their newly acquired power.
pros: The worst superpowers are actually useful to you.
Save your best powers from theft or duplication.
cons: If you don't have enough powers.
If you don't have the ability to copy powers yourself.

name: Snap....There Goes Your Career
overview: snap your fingers and end the career of any celebrity you want
description: If you want to end a celebrity's career, and stop their fame and fortune, snap your fingers and it will all go to hell for that person. If they have any ounce of fame or star power, they can be affected by this power; doesn't work if that person is already a washed up has-been.
pros: You can end the career's of horrible celebrities
The better celebrities could get a chance a fame
You could get a chance at fame
cons: You might end the career of an influential person
That person might commit suicide without fame
Doesn't work if their career already sucks...

name: Ars Goetia: Bael's Fury
overview: harness the demonic king's monstrous form.
description: The goetic demon king Bael is described as a chimera of a man, cat, and toad. The user is capable of transforming into this abomination along with immense strength and command over endless demonic hordes at their disposal.
pros: Crush and swipe multiple targets.
A demonic king of hell. Can't get any better than this.
Prehensile tongue and cat/toad attributes.
cons: Your monstrous appearance will frighten others and alert them to attack you.

name: Myth Power: Ecomene's Example
overview: channel Ecomene's command over the essence of the inhabited world
description: Ecomene (Oikoumene, Oecomene, Oecoumene, Ecoumene), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the inhabited world. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive anywhere on the planet inhabited by sentient subjects. In addition, one can psychically teleport anywhere on the planet inhabited by sentient subjects. One can even psychically tap into the collective unconscious (mental reserve of knowledge, thoughts, emotions, dreams, memories and raw psychic power) of the inhabited world at will.
pros: Psychically perceive anywhere on the planet inhabited by sentient beings
Psychically teleport self/others anywhere on the planet inhabited by sentient beings
Psychically tap into the collective unconscious (psychic reservoir) of the inhabited world at will
cons: Places for Pro #1 and Pro #2 require at least one sentient being at the target destination (NCN)
Pro #3 only allows enhancement of any psychic abilities one ALREADY possesses until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demos' Demeanor, etc provides immunity (NCN)

name: Hunger Empowerment
overview: gain powers from being hungry
description: With this power, breakfast is overrated. If you are hungry, you can gain super powers, like super strength, super speed, higher and farther jumping capacity, and super resilient skin. It also gives you a maddened psychology, doing anything for food. This power wears off if you eat anything.
pros: No breakfast, you carry a piano while running a marathon jumping 1 metre into the air while doing it
Doesn't matter how hungry you are, you still get the amount of powers.
Easily reversible with food, and you can trick your maddened self into doing stuff for food.
cons: Maddened state, unpredictable.
Cannot stop you from dying of hunger.
You can easily be turned into a hunger slave.

name: Red Rain
overview: create red-colored raindrops that dissolve everything
description: You are able to create a burning crimson rainstorm that affects all things everywhere and can hit several times before disappearing.
pros: No one is invulnerable to it, especally like golems and androids.
cons: If it gets out of control, it'll try to dissolve everyone, even you might get burned by it.

name: Real World
overview: negate all super powers
description: Whoever has this power basically creates a field around the planet that they are currently inhabiting which makes all of those inside of it lose the ability to use super powers, and forget that super powers were ever anything more than fiction.
pros: No evil super powered idiots running amuck
If you become aware of your powers you can shorten the field to only affect a certain area
cons: No super powers.... For anyone........ Ever.
You have no idea that you have this power unless someone far enough away from you sends a message.

name: Increased Acrobatic Skill
overview: perform feats that would make any acrobat, freerunner, or traceur jealous
description: Basically you will be the best urban ninja ever. Other freerunners will be jealous and you will give the circus people a big middle finger. It ranges from jumping high or long distances, increased speed to make the jump, and massive upper body strength.
pros: Good for escaping
Getting up buildings will be a breeze
Falling will be easier, just swing on something
cons: Basically just for escaping
A good way to get to the fight but then just look dumb jumping around your enemy
Not strong or abnormally fast unless the purpose is for basically getting somewhere quicker

name: Transformers: Astrotrain
overview: summon and control the Astroforce
description: With this power you are able to summon and control a sentient version of Astrotrain's Astroforce, an army of drones that resemble trains. A side effect of this power allows you to turn your skin gray.
pros: You can summon the Astroforce
You can turn your skin gray
cons: The Astroforce isn't really that smart and are more likely to crash into each other than anything

name: Con Activation
overview: reactivate negated cons.
description: With this ability, you can essentially negate Con Negation within 100 meters of you. All powers entering the area must now be restricted by their downsides and any person must suffer the consequences of normal power use. Since this does not negate, power protection powers offer little, if any, protection. It can be easily turned on and off at will.
pros: Stop heavily overpowered power combinations such as Bursts of Invinicibility + Con Negation.
Even affects powers entering the area, such as a Farslayer-based attack.
Easily turned on and off.
cons: Affects you too; you had better have some other ways of dealing with the cons up your sleeve.
Limited range, at least without other powers. Naturally, this is vulnerable to Radius Distortion.
Is only effective against Con Negated powers.

name: Porcelain Secretion
overview: secrete fast-harden porcelain from every pore of your body
description: You have the ability to secrete a unique variety of porcelain from any area of your body with pores. This porcelain is secreted as a liquid but hardens almost instantly on contact with air. It is heatproof and strong enough to withstand moderate impacts, as well as incredibly light-weight.
pros: Cutting weapons will just encounter and shatter a barrier of porcelain instead of cutting you.
Fire powers will have little to no effect on you.
Doesn't slow you down much.
cons: If you secrete it from jointed areas of your body, your movement will be impeded.
It's not completely indestructible, and once it shatters you have to secrete more.
Squeezing porcelain out of your pores is fairly painful.

name: Bond
overview: bond with somebody.
description: A bond connects two people. When the two bonded people are together, they gain incredible powers. Random for every one of them.
pros: Great tag team.
Great power.
cons: If one of the bonded die, the others die too.

name: Panontic Arch:Panhydri
overview: gain powers the Panhydri dimension.
description: Panhydri,the entirely liquid dimension. You gain immunity to water pressure and dehydration. Your body acts as a sponge. You can soak up anything liquid. Your body acts a conduit to the panhydri dimension. You feel no effects of any liquid you soak up. Poisons,acids,liquid nitrogen won't affect you. You could absorb a liquid being by touch. You could in theory absorb the oceans of the world.
pros: Immunity to liquid based attacks.
You can absorb water elemental types.
cons: While you can explore the deepest areas of the ocean,you still need oxygen.

name: Weapon: Sword Of Tristain
overview: wield the sword that was used by Tristain
description: With this sword, the user can heal themselves from any injury as long as they are fighting for love.   Poisons and anything that does continuous damage are only delayed, not permanently healed
pros: Almost invincible, except against poisons and the like
Sharp enough to slay dragons
cons: If you are not fighting for love, then the effect is negated and the sword can break
Not a divine class or magic class weapon

name: Musical Brawl
overview: fight within a rythem of a song the user is listening to.
description: Depending on the song itself the power can temporarily increase or decrease the fighters strength, speed, and reactions. The ability is very useful for fighters trained in hand-to-hand combat.
pros: Movements can be unpredictable
Possible chance of increased atributes within the duration of the song
Can enjoy music in a fight
cons: Enemies can predict movements if they know of the song.
Power can not be active without music
Some music can effect the user in a negative way

name: Additional Pylons
overview: summon an unlimited number of Protoss Pylons.
description: Summon a floating pylon to any location that powers or fuels anything within its radius. The size of the pylon can be changed, but the radius of the power changes equal to the size. Larger pylons take more focus and control to summon. Pylon colors can be changed, but this has no effect on what it does. Pylons can be destroyed or unsummoned. Pylons cannot be summoned if another object is in the way.
pros: Free energy or fuel.
Color and size can be controlled.
Unlimited amount.
cons: Can be destroyed or unsummoned.
Radius of power is limited by the size of the pylon.
Will always need additional pylons to power new areas.

name: Crodo: Ban Hammer
overview: wield a ban hammer.
description: Once the user of this hammer hits the selected target,it will be banned from earth either sending them to heaven or hell.
pros: Ban someone from earth.
cons: Easy to dodge.

name: Two Headed Dragon Summon
overview: summon a two headed dragon
description: With this power you can summon a two headed dragon that is under your complete control. The dragon has a quirk though (aside from the two head thing) one of it's heads breathes fire while the other one breathes ice. The dragon can also fly, is super strong and has extremely sharp teeth in both of its mouths.
pros: You can summon a two headed dragon.
One of its heads breathes fire while the other breathes ice.
It can fly is super strong and has really sharp teeth in both of its mouths.
cons: You can only summon one so if it dies you loose this power.

name: Cyborg Summon
overview: summon an army of cyborgs
description: With this power you can summon an army of cyborgs. There are hundreds of different kinds of cyborgs, each of them being half of a different machine. Such as half car half human cyborgs, half television half human cyborgs etc. You can summon up to ten of each kind of cyborg and they are all under your control. Each cyborg as has super strength, invulnerability and heat vision. When you're done with them you can send them back to wherever they came from.
pros: You can summon an army of cyborgs
You can have up to ten of each kind of cyborg
cons: The cyborgs might be reprogrammed
The cyborgs might be destroyed

name: Transformers: Bumblebee
overview: cause a stinging sensation when you punch someone
description: With this power whenever you punch someone it will feel like they are being stung by something. You can turn this power on and off. A side effect of this power is that children often think that you are cool.
pros: You can cause a stinging sensation when you punch someone
cons: The sting isn't enough to defeat an enemy

name: Shakespearean Wordsmith
overview: recall any quote from the complete works of Shakespeare and to derive power from them.
description: This infinitely useful power can make you seem clever and well-learned by quoting the works of Shakespeare (where such a quote relates to the unfolding situation). With each quote, whether by you or any other conversational participant, you (and any powers you may have) become stronger. Perfect for those moments when, as you lay dying, your Arch-Nemesis unwittingly quotes the second act of 'The Taming of the Shrew'. Boom.
pros: Shakespearean idioms have become so integrated in culture that holding a conversation requires them.
Makes one appear better educated and seem more well-read.
Invariably increases the epicness of any moment by up to 500%. Guaranteed.
cons: Irrelevant quotes do not provide the same power boost as those pertaining to the situation.
Intellectually-challenged Arch-Enemies may not appreciate or understand your superior wit.
Those people who thought you were a bit weird before are going to be completely convinced of it now.

name: Chaneled Form: Sword
overview: channel a touch-type power into the form of a sword
description: Normally a touch-type power(Ex: Death Touch) does not extend beyond the what you touch. However with this power, you can channel that power into the form of a sword. The sword is the length of a standard European shortsword and when it hits the target it does not cut, but instead goes through the target and the power's effect activates.
pros: Don't have to touch the target anymore.
cons: Only 'tactile' or 'touch-type' powers.
Still a pretty small range.

name: Baka
overview: make anyone absolutely stupid or foolish for an hour
description: Baka translates as stupid or foolish. This power works in a 100 metre radius and stupid or foolish is randomly chosen by the power itself. The effect lasts for 1 hour.
pros: You get to choose the target.
This power is great for a prank during a test.
cons: The power chooses stupidity or foolishness.

name: Phone Fingers
overview: call anyone just by holding your fingers in the shape of a phone.
description: All you need to do is make like you're holding a phone using your thumb and pinky finger, think of whoever you want to call, and boom, their phone will ring.  You can have a full conversation with perfect reception, and worldwide coverage. No dropped calls and no battery to worry about! When someone calls you, your fingers will ring--unless of course you have them on vibrate or silent mode. And to top it off, you can change your number to whatever you want (as long as it isn't already taken).
pros: Emergency calls during common situations like avalanches, meteor storms and stampedes of goats
Prank calling Santa Clause and Paris Hilton
Drunk dialing
cons: You never have the excuse of "I couldn't find my phone"
You might look funny talking into your hand
Drunk dialing

name: Darkcalibur
overview: possess the Darkcalibur sword. It fires a powerful dark beam to damage your enemies.
description: With this power, you can possess Darkcalibur. Perhaps one of most disturbing powers, Darkcalibur is a very large, black-grayish silver sword in the stone attributed with evil magical powers or associated with the dark arts.  Thrust it and a dark, nocturnal beam comes out to damage your enemies.
pros: None to be exact.
cons: It can only be used by Evildoers.

name: Summon Kruai
overview: summon a hate-based weaponsmaster Kystian.
description: Kruai are 6 and a half feet tall. They look like scaly monkeys. Kruai can shape their hatred of non-kystians into solid melee weapons of emotional energy. Impenetrable forcefield, anti-telepathy and psionic armor will block the attack. Someone who can absorb emotions will temporarily disrupt this power. The weapon will otherwise ignore armor and normal forcefields cutting through any solid foe. Kruai can lift 10 tons and run 40 mph. Kruai are summoned with regular weapons.
pros: The melee weapons can be anything. Whip, katana, pole arm,etc.
Kruai can use two weapons at the same time.
Kruai are summoned with weapons to deal with foes immune to its special ability.
cons: Emotion-based powers can manipulate the weapons

name: Liquoromancy
overview: see the know the future by pouring shots.
description: This way of the seeing the future was first thought of by someone only known as WHD. This is how the power works. The number of shots you pour determines how many questions you can get a yes or no answer to and how many days you can see in the future. You have to down all the shots in rapid succession or you get no questions answered. Cheap or bad liquor reduces the chances to get a correct answer. Good moonshine or a aged liquor will give best chances to get a correct answer.
pros: One question and one day into the future for each shot of liquor.
If you can't get drunk.
You can get your hands on some good moonshine or aged liquor.
cons: You can't/won't drink liquor.
You're underaged.

name: Price Negotiator
overview: barter and haggle with anyone with guaranteed success
description: With this power, you can negotiate the price of anything. While you might not get 50% off, you will always be successful at lowering the price to some degree. This works even at the grocery line, where the art of bartering has been lost completely. Sometimes you even get lucky and end up with 99% off!
pros: Get great deals on things you purchase
Black Friday deals are even cheaper
Save hundreds or potentially thousands of dollars
cons: At the store, you might be "that guy"
No guarantees that your discount will be significant

name: Celtic Invocation: Nemetona
overview: utilise the power of Nemetona, the Celtic goddess of sacred places.
description: By invoking the power of Nemetona, the invoker may detect and locate places of power and sacredness, such as ley lines, sacred groves and springs, menhirs, etc. The invoker may also be able to create a sacred space, such as a circle of standing stones. Any invocations done within a sacred place created by the invoker can be strengthened or weakened, and the invoker may also strengthen or weaken the strength of natural sacred places. They can also allow or bar entry into such places.
pros: Nothing can best you in a sacred space.
A hastily drawn circle can end up being a stronghold in your hands.
Find some important historic places without any effort.
cons: Not much use offensively, or if not near a sacred space.
The creation of the sacred spaces are only available to the more powerful invokers.
Other users of Celtic Invocation: Nemetona, or those with the ability to pass through/destroy wards.

name: Myth Power: Ceraunobolia Strike
overview: channel Ceraunobolia's command over the essence of the thunderbolt
description: Ceraunobolia (Keraunobolia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the thunderbolt (simultaneous lightning flash and thunder crash). As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate electricity at will, which simultaneously amplifies all ambient sound. In addition, one can absorb natural sound and electricity to gain physical power. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with, and compel those who are afraid of thunder and lightning, and teleport to the site of thunderbolt strikes
pros: Psychically generate electricity, simultaneously amplifying all ambient sound into a sonic boom
Absorb sound and electricity to gain physical power at will; teleport to thunderbolt sites
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who fear thunder and lightning
cons: Pro #1 does not automatically home in to strike only foes until developed (NCN)
Cannot cause sounds to automatically produce accompanying electricity until developed (NCN)
Electrokinesis, Electrical Immunity, MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and the like provide immunity

name: Myth Power: Memento Moros
overview: channel Moros' command over the essence of depression and impending doom and destruction
description: Moros (Morus, Olethros, Olethrus), in Greek myth, was the god of doom, destructive forces and depression. As such, channeling him allows one to to perceive details of a subject's past/present/future death, at will (this may be shared by touch). In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with doomsayers, pessimists, and those fated to die soon. Furthermore, one can cause matter to wither and decay, by touch, at will. One can even withstand death/underworld/afterlife-based effects.
pros: Psychically perceive details of a subject's past/present/future death by touch (shared by touch)
Psychically perceive and communicate with doomsayers, pessimists and those fated to die soon
Wither/decay matter by touch; withstand Death/underworld/afterlife-based MythPowers
cons: Cannot project 'Doom Bolts' (matter-withering psychic energy) until the higher levels (NCN)
Only send foes through time to their fated time/place of death by touch at the higher levels (NCN)
Unpredictability and Death/underworld/afterlife-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Enhancement: Sleeping
overview: make a power cause sleepiness in addition to other effects
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power put whatever it hits into a sleeping state for 2 hours. Computers will shut off if hit. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: Put what you hit to sleep.
Duration of sleep can be lengthened.
cons: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.
Affects allies too.

name: Enhancement: Unbreakable
overview: make a power's connection(s) unbreakable
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the connections the power it is attached to unbreakable. This will only work for a power if the connection being made does NOT harm either side of the connection. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: No one can break the telepathic communication connections you make anymore!
cons: Useless without another power.
Does not help connections that drain, leech, or otherwise hurt one/both side(s) of the connection.

name: Rainbow Immunity
overview: withstand anything colored with one or more colors of the rainbow
description: This ability allows one to resist any subject, object, projectile or attack colored with one or more colors of the rainbow. Green Lantern's green energy attacks, Kryptonite of any color, Cyclops' red optic blasts, Psylocke's purple (violet) telekinetic energy, Hellion's green telekinetic energy, etc. Even red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet colored SKIN reduces the effect of a foe's attacks. In addition, It doesn't disrupt, reduce or otherwise affect one's own color-based power.
pros: Immune to any effects pertaining to rainbow colors
Even SKIN colored with one or more rainbow colors reduces effects of a foe's attacks
Often doesn't negatively affect your own color based powers
cons: At the lower levels, it might affect one's own color based powers
If it's permanently active (never wear clothes or touch items with colors from the rainbow)
Doesn't work on White Light, or any other non-rainbow colors

name: Chemical Reanimator
overview: reanimate someone with a glowing green liquid.
description: This power gives you retractable needles from your hands that can inject a glowing green liquid into a dying or dead person. There can be no brain damage. The reanimated will lose 10% of their IQ for each hour after their death. There can be a loss of basic civilized behavior -- even if you inject a dying person -- that causes loss of feeling guilt or lack of conscience. You could make someone zombie-like in behavior. These reanimated won't decay, age or heal.
pros: A way to help someone cheat death. A horrible way, but still cheating death.
You can use this power on yourself if you're that desperate not to die.
cons: You actually use this power on yourself.

name: Dr. Octagonapus
overview: summon a tentacle man that shoots lasers at people
description: Make Dr. Octagonapus come to your location and fire his laser at your enemy, instantly annihilating them
pros: Your enemies are instantly destroyed.
cons: You may get caught in the attack as well

name: Superpower Dispersal
overview: scatter the abilities of a superpowered being, leaving them with only one.
description: This power only works on beings with multiple superpowers, including mimicked and stolen ones, and some of the ones which give multiple abilities. When used, they will lose all their powers save for a random one and the lost ones are given to the closest powerless beings, one ability each. The downside is you can only have one ability as well, including this one, but if you somehow acquire another one, there would be a chance that you lose this power due to the dispersion that will take place.
pros: In the case of some powers with multiple aspects, they will be split into atomic powers.
Great against the ones with a lot of abilities, power thieves and power duplicators.
cons: You can only have one power, including this one. That pretty much means you only have this power.
Doesn't work on someone with Power Safety.

name: Opposite Sex Mirrors
overview: see your reflection in your opposite sex
description: These special mirrors let you see how you would look in your opposite sex! Even your clothes & other accessories are gender-bended in the reflection! However, your real gender hasn't actually changed.

Play the fun game of how clothes, shoes, & more will look in the reflections!
cons: If you break these special mirrors, it's 14 years bad luck! (7 for each gender)
Androgynous things will still look exactly the same in the reflections... Boring!

name: Cat Speak
overview: know the cat laugage
description: You can talk in, and understand the language of cats

Ask cats info

You cannot speak dog

name: Transformer
overview: have a flying car that can change into something small
description: You have a car that can Turboboost. Useful to fight bad guys and solve crimes. Can change into something small, so you can carry it with you in your pocket.
pros: Flying/jumping car
Can be changed into something small
cons: Just two abilities, nothing more

name: Evolving Swarm
overview: create a microbe that evolves
description: You can create a microbe that evolves so quickly it's descendants will evolve to human complexity in 3 months it's relatives will respect you as a god but will evolve to be able to hate you if it is good for it. Can create multiple evolving swarms if one hates you. They can copy any biological mechanism they get DNA from powers traits tricks to solving problems.

cons: They may grow to hate you.
Thay can replicate any power from DNA if it's biological including this one.

name: Summoning: Thanatos
overview: summon Thanatos.
description: You can now summon the power of Thanatos, the god of death. He resembles a small child, and his personality is innocent. But don't let this fool you, he has the power to freeze anything to death.
pros: Freeze things.
cons: Might lose control.

name: Soul Incasement
overview: release a cage made of a random person's soul so powerful only another soul attack can escape
description: You can create a cage made from a random person's soul encasing your victim. As a side effect, the cage slowly closes in on them, not harming their body, but crushing their soul.

A random person dies from the soul exchange, so although there are many, it may kill a loved one

name: Taste Warp
overview: change the tastes of any food
description: With this power you can change the taste of any food this is good for making the disgusting food you're eating taste like pizza or something or to make the delicious food your enemies are eating taste like something gross
pros: The pros are listed above
cons: No use in combat

name: Gift: Stone
overview: be gifted at rock-based powers
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at using rock-based powers than other beings. Thus their rock- and stone-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of stone from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve rock-based powers, nothing else.

Rock-based powers are boosted slightly.
cons: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only rock-based powers now.

name: Snow Cat
overview: transform in to a Snow Cat at will.
description: Snow cats are white cats that are 3 to 4 feet tall, they  have the abilities of a normal cat and can make the temperature drop below zero.
pros: You can make it freeze
You look very cute and cuddly
cons: It takes about two hours to go back to being human.
They want to photograph you for lolcat pictures

name: Blessing Of Zhu Que
overview: have the power of a bird when facing south.
description: Is one of the four Chinese celestial beasts according to the Taoist five-elemental system,and is alternatively knows as the Vermilion Bird of the South. With it's blessings you will gain the ability to fly and be imbued with supernatural grace for as long as you are facing the direction south. The blessing will also grant you control of the element of fire.
pros: Flight.
Grace.
Fire powers.
cons: You must be facing south for your powers to activate.
Zhu-Que is not a pheonix, and you do not have the ability to resurrect after death.

name: Bob Omb Summon
overview: summon an army of Bob-ombs
description: With this power you can summon an unlimited amount of Bob-ombs from the Mario series. They are under your complete control and you can also control when they explode or prevent them from exploding. You can unsummon them when you're done.
pros: You can summon an army of Bob-ombs
They are under your complete control
You can control when they explode
cons: You can be hurt by the explosions

name: Nitric Acid Vision
overview: shoot Nitric Acid from your eyes
description: It is similar to Heat Vision. You can use the highly corrosive strong mineral acid that shoots from your eyes. Before you shoot the Nitric Acid Vision your eyes are all Red Orange with no visible pupils, how high the tempature and the size is determined by you.

A power that makes you very powerful
120 Yards Away for how far you can Fire It

If a foe can absorb nitric acid, or acids then the foe could use your own power on you
If a Foe Covered your eyes while you were using it, a explosion would happen

name: Millenium Fists
overview: endlessly fire off dozens of punches to knock out your opponent.
description: It doesn't matter if you're far or close, your arms and hands will flash and then you'll be able to throw a million punches to break through barriers, dizzy your opponent, and put them to sleep.
pros: Might be great for Boxing, Wrestling, and Mixed Martial Arts
cons: You can get cramps in your arms

name: Myth Power: Ate's Attitude
overview: channel Ate's command over the essence of evil, mischief, ruin and delusion
description: Ate, in Greek myth, was the goddess of evil, mischief, ruin and delusion (infatuation, blind folly, naivete, rash choices, etc). As such, channeling her allows one to psychically induce false comfort, by touch. In addition, one can psychically act as a subject's conscience, by touch, word or thought; subjects will follow any naive or unwise suggestion one gives. One can even psychically take on one other deceptive ability (Shapeshifting, Illusion Casting, etc) to cause mischief with, at will.
pros: Induce false comfort by touch (subjects will trust you)
Act as a subject's conscience by touch, word or thought; they will take any detrimental suggestions
Take on one other mischievous, deceptive ability (Vocal Mimicry, Ventriloquism, Invisibility, etc)
