MythPower: Eris' Enmity and MythPower: Thrasos' Thrill provide immunity (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Super Losers
overview: eliminate other superpowers
description: This power will only work for people on the superpower list. Simply by interacting with another person's profile, you will eliminate all of their current powers. This power will only work on a user once and if they gain new superpowers afterward, they cannot be eliminated. If a user has an ability-canceling power, this power will not work, unless you have an ability-canceling-canceler power. A person can revive their superpowers with a soon-to-be created superpower Superrevival. Until then, bye!
pros: Eliminate others' superpowers
Unaffected by your own superpower
Really cool
cons: Superpowers are revivable.
Really annoying

name: Stormsong (Storm Song)
overview: produce a song which invokes changes to the weather
description: This ability is the power to induce stormy weather or just unpleasant weather conditions around a foe (or a group of foes, or an area) by singing a song. This song is not a song of the user's choosing, but is innately known by the user; and once he/she produces it, the skies will darken, winds will whip up, rain will pour or any other desired weather effect for the user's pleasure. The user can even make a storm cell follow one particular person, or the like.
pros: Start storms around foes (bestows foe with a great voice)
Increase or stop current storms at will
Make them follow foes around

If your power can only start storms and not stop them (and can't make them worse/better)
Only cause storms native to the environment (sandstorms in the desert, hurricanes in Florida, etc. )

name: Myth Power: Harpies' Harassment
overview: channel the Harpyiae and their command over the essence of destructive storm winds
description: The Harpyiae (Harpyiai, Harpies), named Aello, Ocypete (Okypete), Celaeno (Kelaeno) and Podarge (Podarke, Podarce), in Greek myth, were the sister goddesses of powerful storm winds which snatch things away into the unknown. As such, channeling them allows one to generate, manipulate and resist tornado/hurricane-force winds at will. In addition, one may touch an object, attuning it to the winds, so the winds only retrieve/affect things one desires. One may even sprout powerful wings at will.
pros: Generate, manipulate and withstand powerful storm winds (like tornadoes, hurricanes and typhoons)
Attune objects or subjects to the wind, so only desired things are picked up by the winds
Sprout superstrong, powerful wings for flight, or for combat
cons: Cannot calm storm winds, only direct them (NCN)
Cannot generate winds, unless they are storm-force (NCN)
Strongest when used in groups of three or four; power cannot be shared until higher levels (NCN)

name: Spicy Flames
overview: generate flames from consuming spicy foods.
description: Ever felt that you breathed fire after eating something spicy, well now you will! After consuming something spicy, you'll begin to breathe flames from your mouth. The size and temperature of the flames depend on the spiciness of the food eaten, the duration of the power depends on the amount of food eaten. In addition, your mouth and nearby body parts (Head, Neck) are fireproof
pros: Easy to activate and attack with.
If controlled, functional and practical outside of battle
Good party trick
cons: Involuntary, once you eat something remotely spicy, you will start breathing fire
You might not like spicy food
Might hurt close friends and family if not careful

name: Taboo
overview: trap a person within a special gourd if he or she says their most frequent word
description: The user of this power is able to trap their enemies in a special gourd if their enemies says their most frequent word or phrase once they are hit by a special golden rope attached on the user's arm . Enemies who figure out this power and remain silent, meaning they do not talk , will also be dragged into the gourd after 5 minutes . An enemy will be able to escape if he or she changes their frequent word to another word
pros: Most people dont know what their frequent word is
Can trap the people in the gourd indefinitely
cons: Hard to touch people with the golden rope
People who know their favorite and think before they speak may be able to escape

name: Myth Power: Meiboia's Measure
overview: channel Meiboia's command over the essence of bees
description: Meiboia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of bees. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and command bees at will. In addition, one can psychically mimic the features and abilities of a bee at will. Furthermore, one can generate sonic force, or hypnotic influence, from one's wings, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically convert liquids into edible honey, by touch. One can even psychically convert neutrals into a user-dominated hive mind, by touch, at will.
pros: Perceive, communicate with, command and mimic powers of bees
Generate sonic or hypnotic effects from one's wings, convert liquids into honey (by touch), at will
Psychically assimilate neutrals into a user-dominated hive-mind, by touch, at will

name: Summon Pack Of Flickerspawn
overview: summon a pack of half-alive things
description: Flickerspawn are from the Kyst dimension. There are six flickerspawn in a pack. A flickerspawn looks like a skeletal human remolded into a wolfish shape. A pack will see you as its master, but will attack anyone else unless commanded not to. Flickerspawn are as smart as dolphins and have a limited teleport ability with a 20-foot range. They are as strong as five normal men. They can be damaged or killed, but to hurt or kill one you have to hurt or kill each member of the pack simultaneously.
pros: Six in one summoning.
A teleport ability useful in combat.
Understand any command a dolphin would.
cons: Can't understand what a dolphin wouldn't understand.
They're not bipedal, you still need help to carry loot from a robbery.

name: Communicate With Dogs
overview: speak to dogs and hear what they are saying
description: With this power you can speak to and be fully understood by canines. Also, you can comprehend exactly what a dog is saying. That means you can carry on a conversation with a dog or you will understand what the dog behind the fence is yelling(barking)about!
pros: You will know which well Timmy is in.
You will know which food your pet likes best.
You can explain why chasing cars is a bad idea.

Your weavings are three times as strong as a normal one would be and they are more comfortable and durable. You can form a rope hammock in less than two minutes or a pillow in thirty seconds. You can knit or manipulate thread as well as with needles so weavings are done immenseley fast.
pros: Description cant be shortened and pros cant be negated.
Usefull.
cons: Power sacrifice can affect this.

name: Surprise Caller
overview: intercept the call of anyone in the world who's just dialed and is waiting for someone to pick up.
description: You need to have a phone next to you to use this power. When you activate it, if anyone in the world is dialing another and nobody's picked up yet or if they've been put on hold, the phone next to you will intercept the call and ring. If you pick up, you'll be talking to the caller. You can't control which call the phone will intercept though. And it only works on calls which haven't been picked up yet or which have been put on hold.

Answer in stead of the intended recipient.
A new form of prank call. Instead of calling strangers, they call you!

The call can still be traced to you.

You will not directly turn into the object that you eat, but gain some of its characteristics. So if you somehow are able to eat a house, you would be able to open up your body and have dollhouse-like rooms inside you. You can only take on the characteristics of one thing at a time and can choose when the power activates.

Works on nonfood items as well.
Effect lasts for as long as you wish.

" Then you gain super strength, if they say "hey Speedy Gonzales! " Then you gain super speed, etc. It is not just verbal bullying either, if they chase you you gain super speed,etc.

Verbal or Physical

You can do this as many times and anywhere you want as long as it's on a road/highway/street/bridge. You can't make the forks go back into the ground so be careful where you use this power. If you have super strength or a bulldozer or something it is possible to remove the fork from the ground and throw it away somewhere.

You can make the fork either metal or plastic

As such, channeling Hymenaios (Hymenaeus, Hymen- Marriage, the Wedding Ceremony and the Wedding Song), one can sense if a subject is destined to be married, to whom, and many other facts about people's marriages. Hit any part of the pody,
Give the person a Nut shot.

If someone time travels while inside the volume, not only will they appear at its core, but they won't be able to travel outside the volume's period of existence.

You can trap time travellers inside a time period.

name: Small
overview: manipulate the attributes of small in yourself without bodily change
description: With this ability you can do many things with the attributes of small. You can be very dificult to notice even if you're standing in front of someone. All this is possible with you being the same size as you normally are.

name: Darthon!

description: By saying the words "Your party..." you are able to alter reality in an adventure, like if you said "Your party has just approched a fire", a fire will appear in front of you. To continue an adventure you can say something like, "My skin repels fire."

name: Rise Of The Cerberus V2

pros: You can turn into Cerberus
You can open a portal to and from Hell
You can breathe fire

name: Invisible Zombies
overview: create invisible zombies
description: What's more dangerous than a zombie horde? Why, an invisible zombie horde, of course. This power lets the user summon hordes of invisible zombies. The zombies are under the command of the user. Anyone bitten will also become an invisible zombie. The typical zombie weaknesses apply, but they are harder to deal with because they are invisible. If the user dies they go berserk.

Your enemies never know if they killed all the zombies or not
The zombies obey the user of this power

If you die the invisible zombies will coninue rampaging

overview: manipulate energy in the form of a geometric locus

When used for offence, two straight lines of energy, two two-dimensional circles that can be manipulated through the air, and a crashing of circles which would result in a large explosion due to the intersecting of lines.

no one would suspect this
Tron would be easy

you must be exact in your geometrical calculations
look before you shoot

overview: shoot a beam of light that instantly puts clothes on anyone or anything.

Great for pranks.
No more ill-dressed people, homeless people or streakers.

May get odd looks.

name: Serath Blades

The chains can be twisted together to make it a double bladed staff: Moon Glaive.
pros: No ammo required.
Good range and accuracy.
Powerful.

name: Vacuum
overview: suck all the gas from an area and store it in your bones
description: Air is everywhere. A person with Vacuum can change that. They can drain all the air from an area and cause an implosion--but not by breathing in. Instead, they drain it into their bones via their hands. This lets them store it indefinitely. Then they can release it explosively in a single burst when they please. However, one with this ability must be careful--cracking a bone while it has gas in it causes an uncontrolled explosion that usually wrecks the surrounding tissue as it leaves.
pros: Draining gas causes an implosion
Can explosively release gas you've stored

cons: Limit to how much gas you can store

Who's going to suspect an elderly man or woman of being a danger?

name: Omac Summon

These OMACs however are purely robot and not humans they will hunt down and destroy any person you want and you're not limited to just superhumans. The OMACs have all of the powers they have in comics including laser shooting, flight, super strength etc. When you're done you can just send them back to wherever they came from.
pros: You can summon up to twelve OMACs
They will hunt down and destroy anybody you want them to

name: Robot Detector

Counter enemy use of Information Enchantment.

name: Witch Species: Straga

description: The straga were the mortal enemies of the benandanti, they could leave their bodies and enter the bodies of other animals, they could infect someone through touch causing their body to decay rapidly, they could also negate almost all non-physical abilities, (like mind-reading and things like that).

You can also force Hepatocyte, Myocyte and Adipocyte Mimics to store sugar (as fat for the third one), and stop Adipocyte Mimics from using their fat and Hepatocyte Mimics from releasing their sugar, but giving the latter the power to release sugar as fatty acid.

name: Rooster

Your overall form will be mostly human though. Feet can grab things like hands and with the wings you can glide for short distances, fall great height safely
pros: Super Sonic shock waves, annoy the neighbors every morning and controling the power.
Wings and legs help you run really fast, Glide and fall far without injury
Great balance and feet can be used like extra hands,Spurs on your feet act like peircing weapons.
cons: You look like a chicken/man!
People think you may be tasty when fried and smothered in Bull's Eye.
Feathers are itchy.

name: Neck Elongater
overview: elongate your's and others' necks
description: With this power you can make your own neck or the necks of others longer or shorter. You can cause your enemies' necks to extend up to the sky where they will either die of lack of oxygen if fighting outisde or hit their head on the ceiling if fighting indoors. You can make your own neck longer in order to see over people or to reach things on high places.
pros: You can make your own or others' necks longer or shorter
Hurt your enemies
See over people or reach things in high places
cons: You will look weird with a long neck

name: Zephyr
overview: cause rough harsh winds, to be calm and gentle.
description: This is a real peaceful ability. When the winds a rough, harsh, cruel and dangerous. Those who possess the zephyr ability can calm the wind becoming nice, gentle breeze's
pros: Cause rough winds to be gentle.
Can save lives in certain situations.
cons: Not an ability used for combat.

name: Smoke Bubbles
overview: fire a stream of greyish black bubbles which traps & chokes the opponent if they get caught in it.
description: This may be the weirdest ability yet. You can use this power when you're blowing a stream of silver/violet blue/blackish grey bubbles. If it's silver, it blows out concentrated acid, if it's violet/blue, it puts the opponent to sleep, and if it's blackish grey, it could even choke your enemy to death for a few seconds or minutes.
pros: You can even burp.
You can sneak your way into enemy hideouts using the silver one.
cons: You might have to swollow some water, juices, soft drinks or even coffee for this ability to work.

name: Cipactli, The Primitive Earth
overview: embody Cipactli, the creature from which the Earth was created.
description: When activated, you transform into a gigantic, magnificent reptilian creature, part fish, part crocodile, part toad, with a saber-toothed mouth on each joint. While in this form, you can bless a land with fertility. You can also pull gigantic mouths made of rock out of the earth to devour an entire piece of land or sea. When closed, the mouths will form into hills, mountains or islands. Beware as creating those mouths sucks an huge amount of your energy.
pros: You can create new pieces of land.
You can fertilize the earth on which you stand.
You can destroy a area you're not happy with.
cons: You look quite ugly every time you use this power.
Using the destructive aspect of this power can severely tire your body.

name: Eye Shields
overview: summon invisible shields that protect your eyes.
description: With this superpower, you can create invisible psionic shields that protect your eyes. They protect your eyes from things like dust, acid, toxic fumes, water, pencils, and rocks. The shields can withstand up to 50 pounds of pressure and allow oxygen to pass through. If the eye sheilds are hit with more than 50 pounds of force, the shields will disappear. You can summon the eye sheilds again. The power can be turned off. Does not protect eyes from blinding light.
pros: Protect your eyes from dust and toxic gases and other things.
Sheilds let in oxygen.
Can be turned off.
cons: Limit of 50 pounds.
Does not protect your eyes from blinding light.

name: Hatred
overview: be fueled by your anger to settle a score.
description: Say you were stabbed in the back by your best friend and then he stole your wife and plotted to kill you, only when he tried to kill you, you activated this power. It would instantly give you so much strength and resistance to injury that would get Hollywood directors begging you to star in their horror flicks. You will die if you're not careful and don't treat your wounds immediately afterward. It's not really a power, more like a honed skill. Anyone with the will can pull it off.
pros: Damage resistant
Strong
Terrifying to enemies. (why won't you die!? D: )
cons: Can die, just takes a long time.
Treat your wounds or suffer for it.
Not really a super power, anyone can do it if they wanted to.

name: Dog Shift
overview: change into a dog
description: This power changes you into a dog. The type of dog you change into will determine on your personality. Ex. If you're a tough cop with an angry attitude, German Shepard. If you're a sissy, a poodle. If you're a cute little baby, a puppy! However, you will have animal urges. You can switch to dog form any time you want, but you may be so happy in it you'll never want to change back. (I have nothing against cats or poodles.)
pros: Sniff around for fun
Run really fast
cons: Doggy urges
Avoid cars
Bad news for cats

name: Mutation: Spike Shell
overview: mutate to have a shell with spikes on the back
description: This mutation causes a shell with spines to form on your back. This increases your defensive capabilities significantly. Mutations increase spike and shell strength, as well as size.
pros: Increases offense and defense
Includes both.
cons: Increases weight

name: Ghost Of The Past
overview: summon a sprit to let a person to view his/her past.
description: The past ghost is a white-robed, androgynous figure of indeterminate age, with a head of blazing light reminiscent of a candle flame. This spirit grabs your hand, takes you far back into the past to show you what you were like, have been missing in your live and what you should never should do wrong.
pros: You and your past ghost see others and they cannot see you.
It could redeem a person
cons: You cannot even talk to others while you are with the past spirit.

name: Mummy Spawn
overview: make mummies appear out of nowhere
description: With this power you can make angry brain eating mummies appear out of nowhere.
pros: They want to eat enemy brains
They will not attack you
cons: They might attack your allies

name: Jli Summon
overview: summon any member of Justice League International
description: With this power you can summon any member of the Justice League International. You can summon them at any time, but they are not under your control. So if you're a villain, they probably won't want to help you. When you're done with them, you can send them back to their home universe.
pros: You can summon any member of the JLI
You can send them back to their home universe when you're done with them
cons: If you're a villain they won't want to help you

name: Thermovariance
overview: raise blood temperature
description: If you have thermovariance, no one can get close to you. If they do, you raise their blood temperature.
pros: No one can touch you.
You are free from bondage (burning ropes and chains).
If you don't like someone, you don't have to get your hands dirty.
cons: You can be reckless.
You can't touch your best friends or family.
You can destroy thousands.

name: Four Eyes
overview: have four eyes
description: You have four eyes. Two eyes are in the normal spots and the other two are in the same spots on the opposite sides of the body. Ex. Back of hands, shoulders, elbows, etc. When the eyes are open you can see auras and your eyesight is improved so that you can see up to 1000m away.
pros: Not as obvious as an eye on the forehead (hopefully).
Can see auras and have improved eyesight.
Eyes could become more powerful in time.
cons: Leaves easily-seen bumps where the eyes were.
Eyesight and aura seeing only when all the eyes are open.
Eyes have no use in a fight.

name: Exclusive Uniqueness
overview: have only one of you in the whole universe.
description: For reasons still unknown, the universe cannot acknowledge more than one of you, meaning that no one who intentionally looks like you can ever exist. So, any clone, shapeshifted version, doppelganger, look-alike of you disappears the moment they are created. The copies must have been created with the purpose of copying the user. If it was accidental or a coincidence, nothing happens. Same thing if you copy someone or something else's appearance, unless someone then tries to copy your new look.
pros: Protection against shapeshifters and cloners.
Don't worry about impersonators.
A combo with Inverse Shapeshifting would be deadly.
cons: Only works if your appearance is copied.
If you are split into copies of you (in which case the original you disappears), you cease to exist.

name: Exorcist
overview: create a dimesional portal from the chest & summon demons
description: With this ability, your chest will open a hellish dimensional portal & summon impish demonic creatures into our world. They will do your bidding. They are strong, fast & clever. They become weak when around sacreligious  icons or take too much damage causing them to disappear in a cloud of brimstone dust. When your power is not in use, your strength is somewhat increased.
pros: Summon demonic minions
Imps are strong, fast & clever
Minor increase in strength
cons: The creatures become weak & die when around holy powers
The creatures become weak & die when taking too much damage

name: Myth Power: Penthus' Penance
overview: channel Penthus' command over the essence of depression, grief, mourning and lamentation
description: Penthus (Penthos), in Greek myth, was the god of grief (grieving), mourning, and lamentation (crying). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and remind subjects of past traumas, sorrows and regrets, at will. In addition, one can psychically suppress traumas, sorrows, grief and regrets of self and others at will. Furthermore, one can psychically induce uncontrollable crying, at will. One can even psychically teleport to the site of any intense psychological trauma, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive and remind subjects of past traumas/sorrows/regrets of others at will
Psychically uncontrollable crying by a touch, a word or a thought
Psychically teleport to the site of any intense trauma, at will
cons: Cannot perceive, communicate with and compel unhappy/depressed/crying people until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 works best when combined with the perception-based part of Pro #1
Aniothability or sadness/grief/misery-based abilities provide immunity (NCN)

name: Ductal Cell Mimicry
overview: shoot bicarbonate, a chemical subtance which counters both acids and bases.
description: You can grow flesh appendages from anywhere on your body to shoot bicarbonate and retract them when you don't need them anymore. Bicarbonate is a chemical substance which can either act as an acid or as a base in chemical reactions. The strong point of bicarbonate is its ability to dampen the acidity of acids and the basicity of bases. Additionally, you can create clones of yourself with the same powers.
pros: You can put a lid on the dangerous abilities of Parietal Cell Mimics and Gastric Chief Cell Mimics.
Duplicate yourself to outnumber a foe.
Become immune to any acid-based and base-based attacks.
cons: If you shoot less bicarbonate than the quantity of acid or base, you can be overpowered.

name: The Heroes Curse
overview: always be a hero.
description: From the beginning to the end of your life, you will always be a hero. Whenever someone or something around you is in trouble, you will have to help them. At the end of your life, you must pass on The Heroes Curse to another. Life must always have a hero.
pros: You will lead an incredible, adventurous life.
You will be a part of a long line of heroes.
You must, when you die, pass on The Heroes Curse
cons: Always being a hero
You will always be getting sucked into some sort of adventure
Heroes usually die a dramatic, painful, yet heroic death

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Angels
overview: become the lowest ranking angel in the Angelic Hierarchy.
description: The Angel, also recognized as the Malakhim, is the most common celestial being in the Angelic Hierarchy. The Angels are the ones most concerned with the affairs of living things. Within the category of angels, they have many functions as there are many different types. The Angels are mainly sent as messengers to mankind. Angels have been perceived as humans with a pair of white feathered wings.
pros: Utilize pure light as offense and defense.
Take off to the skies at magnificent speeds.
cons: Limited amount of abilities.
Lowest order of angels in the hierarchy.

name: Superhuman Killing Intent
overview: have unnatural urgency to kill as well as easily gaining the physical capacity to do so
description: A person with this power has unnatural urgencies to kill and just seeing anyone can make them want to kill them even whey they know it is wrong. However if the user is strong willed they can focus this power for positive purposes. For example if they focus this on sports such as MMA and Boxing they can become unnaturally skilled, though it might be dangerous if things get out of hand. This power can override mind-control and mind-reading and the user can also sense the killing intent of others.
pros: This ability lets you have the ability to learn deadly ways to kill people very fast
You can also sense when other people want to kill-it takes one to know one
If you have strong willpower you can focus this curse for positive purposes
cons: If you don't have a strong will you might be tempted to kill people
You might find that you are hiding weapons on your person even when you don't think you are
You might have to stay in an asylum or chain yourself to prevent your desire to kill

name: Consumptive Psychometry
overview: know the past events that have occured to something by eating it
description: Anything that you eat, you will know the past events that have occurred to it (prior to it being eaten). When developed, you can learn something's past by just licking or biting it.
pros: Forensics will be a lot easier, but it is definitely disgusting to eat a corpse.
Find out how hot dogs are REALLY made
Find out the Colonel's secret recipe and have the KFC food chain at your mercy
cons: Sharp, pointy, foods will still hurt.
Eating a hamburger will give you knowledge of the lives of a cow and wheat from their perspective.

name: Collared Restraint
overview: put restraints on oneself and others that are attached to collars
description: A restraint can be put on only if you have prior approval. The restraint will lower each power of the person it is on, to 1/10 of the original levels or to the point in which the person can control the power, whichever one is lower. The 'key' to take off the restraint differs for each person and is based on their personality. They will know what it is and the appearance of the restraint also differs for each person (and is based on their personality).
pros: Keeps your powers at a level in which you can use them.
Allies can now control powers that were uncontrollable.
cons: No chance of restraining your enemies' power since they most likely won't give approval.
Affects all powers not just unstable ones.
The restraint will not change how much power you can use even if you become stronger.

name: Epic Stare
overview: epicly stare.
description: With this ability you can stare epicly at anyone. Enhances your popularity and your bad @$$ness.
pros: Epic Stare!
cons: None what so ever. It's the Epic Stare.

name: Enhancement: Untouchable
overview: have a superpower be untouchable.
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the other power "untouchable". This, in effect, makes the other power unstealable, unmimicable, and unalterable. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. Unlike the other enhancements, you can only have one Enhancement: Untouchable at a time.
pros: One of your powers is unstealable.
One of your powers is unalterable.
One of your powers is unmimicable.
cons: If attached to a power, will take a while before you are able to change the power it's attached to.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.
Can only have one at a time.

name: Adaptative Compatibility
overview: be a universal blood/organ donor and receiver.
description: On the one hand, when you donate your blood or one of your organs, the blood group and tissue type systems of the blood/graft change to match those of the receiver. On the other hand, when you receive someone else's blood or organ, its blood group and tissue type systems are changed to match yours. In the case you receive a contaminated blood or organ, such as a cancerous or an HIV positive one, they will only heal if your immunity system has what it takes to fight the disease.
pros: If someone is in need of an organ transplant, you can be their savior.
If you're in need of an organ transplant, anyone else's organ can do.
Saves time from most of the compatibility tests.
cons: Beware of risky organ transplants and blood transfusions.
If you donate an organ, you won't get a new one, with a few exceptions.

name: Body Blubber
overview: make your body bend and bind ,however long

No pain when stretching

Probably might loose control if too long

name: End Dream
overview: stop any nightmare
description: Has this ever happened to you? You're having a terrible nightmare, and you want to wake up, but it's just not happening? Well with this power you can instantly end any nightmare. You can also end dreams.
pros: Can end any nightmare (immunity to dream manipulation)
Can end any dream (wake up on time for work and the like; also works on daydreams)
If your power develops, can also end others' dreams
cons: Sometime your power develops so you can only end OTHER people's dreams
Not quite the same as Lucid Dreaming (can't change dreams other than ENDING them)

name: Moon Creation/Destruction
overview: make extra moons for a planet and destroy the new ones if need be.
description: This power lets you make extra moons for a planet. These moons have a stable orbit and won't crash into a planet being orbited. These moons will add extra hours to the day of a planet. These extra moons can be any type of moon(e. G. The ice-covered one around Jupiter). You can destroy these extra moons any time you choose. Extra moons won't be bigger than existing ones.
pros: Extra days to the calendar could mean extra holidays.
Extra resources in earth's orbit.
cons: Extra days means extra work days.
The tides will be altered in unknown ways.

name: Enhancement: Giant
overview: increase the size of the power's physical effect by attaching this power to it
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it increases the physical size of the power's effects. Size increase maximum is 1000%. E.g. Toy Models to Real Items - A giant car. If stolen, the power this power is attached to permanently gains this powers effects, and this power is given to the thief. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
pros: Bigger powers means harder to avoid. Giant Fireball!
Limit isn't that bad. Lot of stuff you can make bigger.
Use on the cash multiplying power and you could get a giant stack of money.
cons: Bigger isn't always better and this power only affects size, not potency or number of.
Power may be useless bigger or you may not want a power to be bigger (Timemaster70's kystians).
Useless by itself.

name: Biological Manipulation
overview: manipulate the aspects of living organisms.
description: With this, you can manipulate cells and DNA. You can heal injuries of any extent, cure diseases of any kind no matter how severe, change any physical deformation, change the actual genetic structure of living organisms, create clones, accelerate child growth, etc. A beginner can only affect through touch, but an advanced user can project beams. These beams you usually warp the air, making the beams partially visible. People may be enraged that you're using God's power.
pros: Be a famous doctor
Can take away superpowers
People might worship you as a God
cons: People might go into a rage by your presence
Can only take away superpowers embedded in the genes
Must know what you are doing

name: Meal Pass
overview: order food at restaurants for free.
description: With this ability, you never have to pay for food prepared for you at any restaurant in the world.  Be it the McD's drive-thru or the finest restaurant in the world, anything you order will be free of charge!
pros: Eat for free for life
Take your friends out for dinner
Fine dining whenever you want
cons: Having to go to the gym more often
People might want to take advantage of you

name: Lego Manipulation
overview: control, generate and absorb Lego pieces
description: With this you can make a fortress of Lego pieces and even create armour for yourself, for the joints of the armour you can manipulate the Legos to be more moveable and more flexible. You can also expel lego pieces as projectiles for attacking enemies and create boulders of solid Lego and throw it for a better chance of taking out more enemies at once.
pros: It will give you enhanced durability and strength
Your attacks will be more deadly and powerful
With a constant build-up of Legos, you will not grow tired

Creating boulders or other big projectiles will take away some energy

name: Drill Palm
overview: make drills come out of your palms
description: When used, a mini drill will come out of the middle of your palm and you can use it to kill or drill up a wall... I don't know any other uses but you can think up some ideas.
pros: Hand drill.
Can be used any way you wish.
cons: Sometimes you cannot control when it comes in and out.

name: Tickle Spot Detector
overview: discover the opponent's ticklish spot and concentrate the force of 100 people tickling that area.
description:
The tickle power is cut off if the opponent manages to strike back at the superhero. 
The opponent is able to control whether he can be rendered helpless or not; its all based on his own effort. 
The tickle power can go through any clothing and also directed at anywhere in the body.
pros: You can render that opponent helpless, until they pass out.
You can get a good reputation by defeating the opponent with a simple move.
You get a good metaphysical experience.
cons: You are vulnerable to repels.
You cannot move while inflicting the tickle attack.
It takes a short while to detect the tickle areas.

name: Dance Baaybe! Dance Defense
overview: be unconditionally protected against attack, assault, ambush, being hunted unless your enemy dances.
description: This is a defensive ability which unconditionally protects you from having any superpowered battle with anyone by means of simple escape, and all other sorts of super defenses, like invulnerability or teleportation. Unless the one who wishes to challenge you dances with their heels behind their neck, their forehead touching their buttocks, both their knees touching both of their elbows, and sticking their tongue out while singing their nation's national anthem, you cannot be attacked or harmed.
pros: It is an ability that protects you as long as the enemy does not comply with the conditions.
You gain various abilities, like invulnerability, nonexistence, immortality and such to protect you.
You get a lot of fun out of this.
cons: If your enemy manages to pull the stunt off.
If your enemy has 'Dance of Death', then you are in big trouble.

name: Myth Power: Angelia's Angle
overview: channel Angelia's command over the essence of news, messages, announcements and declarations
description: Angelia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of news, tidings, messages, declarations and announcements. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive whenever good or bad news arises (for oneself or those to whom one is connected; loved ones, enemies, etc). In addition, one may psychically communicate with others, over long distances, as though the sender and intended recipient were right next to one another; one can also withstand Telepathy. One may even sprout wings and fly at will.
pros: Psychically perceive whenever news arises pertaining to self, loved ones, allies and foes
Psychically communicate with intended subjects, as though in person (Telepresence), at will
Withstand Telepathy; sprout wings and fly at will
cons: Bad news (duh); cannot keep psychically prevent subjects from relaying news until developed (NCN)
Wings do not gain Superhuman Strength until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Hermes' Hustle provides immunity (NCN)

name: Animal Power Gifting
overview: temparly give animals super powers no matter were they are
description: This power may sound silly but think of it like this: If your pet got lost in the woods, wouldn't you be worried that they might die out there? Well, with this power you can give them super powers once you realize that they are lost. You can give them powers and when they come back, you can take the powers away.
pros: You don't have to worry as much about your pets.
Your dog can defend you better.
Your pet will be number one.
cons: You can't use this power on humans or your self.

name: Myth Power: Eupraxia's Practice
overview: channel Eupraxia's command over the essence of good deeds and success
description: Eupraxia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of success, especially that which results from good deeds. As such, channeling her allows one to gain increased fortune by doing good deeds (regardless of one's morals or one's attitude while doing the good deed). In addition, one can do enhanced damage to any foe who has done fewer good deeds than they have in the last 24 hours. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and gain good fortune in the presence of those who wish for his success.
pros: Gain increased fortune (luck) by doing good deeds
Enhance damage done to foes by doing more good deeds than they do in a 24-hr period
Psychically perceive, communicate with and gain good luck around subjects who wish for your success
cons: Cannot psychically perceive or communicate with the successful until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive how to bring about (or prevent) success until the higher levels (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Ghost Of Bats
overview: be a psionic vampire
description: Everyone has potential psionic abilities. The Ghost of Bats can sink their teeth into any sentient being and drain psionic power. If a person already displays their power, telepathy, telekinesis, pyrokinesis etc. You rob them of their power. Stolen abilities last longer but potential psionic energy taste better.
pros: Potentially gain a host of psionic, psychic abilities
Stealth; exist between the astral & physical plane, intangibility & phasing may be possible
Every psychic meal taste different & gives you an addictive rush so you never get bored

You will never eat normal food again; you only eat potential or existing mental power
In a few hours stolen mental abilities begins to fade & you begin to hunger for more graymatter

name: String Mimicry
overview: transform your body into strings
description: This power allows a person to convert their body mass into strings. Strings can be stretched from the body, the strength of each string is as strong as the original person, and a person can purposefully transform only part of his/her body into strings. Strings can be as hard as diamond if the density is compressed. Strings can transfer sound and you can attach an "eye" to the tip to spy on people. The transformation is near instantaneous so you can create a string Kevlar suit on impact.
pros: Versatile power
Near instantaneous
You can control the change as well as compress strings to harden them
cons: String volume can only be as much as your body
You must train to make the strings stronger and more dexterous
Spread attacks like fire and electricity

name: Regain Power
overview: regain up to ten lost powers
description: With this power you can regain 10 powers that you lost one way or another. The powers are regained with the same number of uses as when you lost them and minimal power as well as skill. Minimal power and skill meaning you're as weak and horrible at using the power. The uses part means that if the power had 10 uses and you used it 7 times before you lost it, then you regain it with 3 uses.
pros: Regain 10 lost powers!
cons: Same number of uses as when the power was lost.
Limit of 10 powers.

name: Channelled Form: Bow And Arrow
overview: channel a tactile power into the form of a bow and arrow
description: Normally a touch-type power(Ex: Death Touch) does not extend beyond what you touch. However with this power, you can channel that power into the form of a bow and arrow. The bow is the size of a standard European longbow and when the arrow hits the target it does not pierce, but instead goes through the target and the power's effect activates.
pros: Can give tactile powers a slightly longer range.
The arrows are fletched.

Nothing other than a bow and arrow.

name: Pros Negation

With enough practice you can negate the pros of abilities.
cons: Still stupid, because without practice you can take away the pros of your own powers.
Like normal Negation, people can defend themselves against this.

name: Myth Power: Metis' Method
overview: channel Metis' command over the essence of wisdom and wise counsel (good advice)
description: Metis, in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of wisdom, wise counsel and prudence. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically access superhuman wisdom, at will, as well as withstand effects which reduce one's wise judgment. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with those one considers wise (or their spirit, if they've died), at will. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive the future. One can even psychically compel subjects to do anything considered wise, at will.
pros: Psychically access superhuman wisdom, at will; withstand effects that can reduce one's wise judgment
Psychically perceive and communicate with anyone one considers wise (if dead, contact their spirit)
Psychically perceive the future; psyhically compel subjects to do wise things, at will

name: Gift: Animals

description: Basically, someone with this power is better at using animal-based powers than other beings. Thus their animal-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of animals from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve animal-based powers, nothing else.

Animal-based powers are boosted slightly.

Won't get stuck in other form

name: Speech To Sign
overview: change powers you need word to activate to powers you need sign language to activate
description: With this power you can change powers that require some sort of spell or phrase to activate into powers that you can use sign language to activate. All you have to do is say the name of the power in sign language. The power can no longer be activated by speaking once you use this power on it.
pros: If you're unable to speak this power opens up several new power opportunities for you
cons: Once you use this power on another power the power can no longer be activated through speech

name: Condition Change: Chant
overview: make a power work only when the user chants a short phrase
description: By touching another superpowered being you automatically make one power require a specific phrase to be spoken in order to be used. The affected being will always know the required phrase to use their power. The phrase is always chosen randomly. Ex: 'Let me heal you,' for an auto-death power.
pros: They have to chant the phrase every time they want to use the power.
If the phrase is "I am stupid, now kill me"!
You now know when they're going to use their power.
cons: You have to touch them and it only affects one power at a time.
If the phrase is something like, "I am your ultimate enemy," or "You will now die"!
Con Negation and other alteration powers do not affect this power.

name: Trash Into Trees
overview: turn trash into trees.
description: With this, you can help the environment and hit people all at the same time! You would be the new Mother Nature.
pros: No one can hate you for helping the environment.
Eight master weapon abilities come with the power.
Power becomes stronger the more you train and use it.
cons: Have to carry stinky trash with you.
Most powerful in a landfill where no one will battle you.
Might hurt somebody or destroy a building if not well trained.

name: To Fyuron To Biographicon
overview: summon a collection of books that can be used to copy anybody you've met.
description: When you say "Adeat", a bookmark and a collection of books that have biographies of anybody you've ever met appear. When you place the bookmark inside a book and slide it out, you can become a clone of the person the book belongs too. You can also completely become a person (thoughts, emotions, memories, personality, etc. ) for a full 10 minutes.
pros: Can copy the person's powers when you transform into them.
cons: You can only be a person who's stronger than you for a few minutes.
If you ever completely become a person, you can never become them again.

name: Chuck Norris
overview: have the power of Chuck Norris
description: Chuck Norris is known to the world as the strongest human evar. He has a power level of over 9000 which means that he and google are the 2nd most powerful things in the world. The only thing he cannot defeat is a ninja. We proved this in a googlefight that was broadcast all around the world.
pros: You're Chuck Norris
You're Chuck Norris
You're Chuck Norris
cons: You cannot beat a ninja

name: Invinciblity Oil
overview: douse yourself in oil to gain superhuman strength.
description: You can get tough and slippery by oiling yourself up and gain vast superhuman strength, speed, agility, reflexes, stamina, and durability. When you are dry, you still maintain a slippery body and the same movesets, but when you apply some oil you receive many advantages such as sliding further on the ground, and your application of oil makes you glow for a short amount of time.
pros: Bad guys will slip off of you.
cons: You'll be vulnerable to fire when using it.

name: Blood Sugar Control
overview: control others' blood sugar levels
description: With this power you can raise or lower the blood sugar level of other people at whichever speed you want. When you stop using your power, the subject's level stays at the level you put it, unless sugar/medicine etc. is consumed by them. Maintaining your power will cause high blood sugar (hyperglycemia) and severe dehydration in your target, or deprivation of glucose/low blood sugar (hypoglycemia).
pros: By lowering an enemy's blood sugar very quickly, you can make them faint or suffer anxiety attacks
By raising an enemy's blood sugar very quickly you can cause blurred vision and extreme fatigue
By maintaining extreme sugar levels, you can put others in comas or kill them
cons: Medicine such as insulin can temporarily reverse your power's effects
You may be asked by lazy and forgetful diabetics to medicate them
People may treat your power as lame, until you make them faint or kill them

name: Enhancement: Quintuple
overview: quintuple the effects of a power by attaching this power to it
description: This is a support. This power does nothing until attached to another power and quintuples that powers effects. This power is gained by using Enhancement: Quadruple multiple times after which it changes into this power. Anything that goes for Enhancement: Quadruple goes for this power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
pros: Quintuple the effects of a power. Quintiple Fireballs!!!!!
What goes for Enhancement: Quadruple goes for this power. May be a con for some parts.
This is the highest of the multiplicative enhancements. (I'm lazy).
cons: Useless without another power.
What was useful quadrupled may not be useful quintupled.
Must have Enhancement: Quadruple and use it.

name: Eye Glue
overview: "glue" someone's eyes to one point
description: A person with this power can "glue" someone's eyes to only look at a fixed point which can be moved. For example, if someone was looking at a crate and you used this power, they would be unable to turn around and look at anything else besides the crate. If the crate is moved, the person is forced/dragged to move so that their eyes continue to stare at it. If something tries to go between the field of vision between the target and object, the target will fly/be dragged to look at the said object.
pros: Useful for practical jokes
Surprisingly useful for combat
Can also be used on yourself, so you can go after a flying object by being dragged along
cons: The person can still move as long as they continue to look at the" glued" point
You need to have a lot of imagination to make this useful

name: Gates Of Heck
overview: open a fiery portal then banish an evildoer to the underworld
description: You may use this power to your advantage, but only when villains are in the agony of defeat or are dizzy. You can open a big fiery hole, and then uppercut, push, punch, or kick them into the devil's playground.
pros: You don't have to kill any villain if they commit violent crimes
cons: This power only works on Evildoers.

name: Zombie Maker
overview: make someone into a zombie and control them.
description: When you have this power you can change someone into a zombie by touch and fully control them. Those zombies are strong and hard to kill, but when killed, they can't recover.
pros: Can make a zombie army.
Can fully control it.
Those zombies have the skills of the person from who they are made.
cons: You must touch the person.
You can only control the zombies that you made
When you change someone into a zombie you can't change them back.

name: Twinkle Smile
overview: have your teeth sparkle whenever you smile.
description: No matter how dirty your teeth really are or how well you brush them, you can make people believe they are pearly white just by smiling and letting them glint. It doesn't have to be illuminated. Your teeth will even release flashes of light in total darkness.
pros: If people see your teeth glitter, they will definitely think they are clean!
You look awesome!
cons: It only works if you are smiling.
It's not a steady nor a constant source of light.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Delete This Tantrum Kick
overview: launch a flurry of kicks with rapid force.
description: Patada de berrinche (Tantrum Kick) in which you strike the opponent rapidly with multiple kicks to the face & torso which move faster than the eye can see. If you continue to strike them repeatly then they'll get K'oed to the ground.
pros: a fight combo is not a power
cons: a fight combo is not a power

name: Myth Power: Amphilogia's Ambush
overview: channel Amphilogia and the Amphilogiae's command over the essence of dispute and disagreement
description: Amphilogia (Amphillogia) and the Amphilogiae (Amphilogiai, Amphillogiae, Amphillogiai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of dispute, debate controversy and other unclear words. As such, channeling them allows one to gain skill in using clever double-speak to outwit subjects. In addition, any statement one disagrees with may be converted into a psionic blast that may be turned back on whoever said it. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally argumentative people.
pros: Gain skill in using clever double-speak to confuse and outwit subjects, and win arguments
Any subject one disagrees with may be turned into a psionic blast to harm the subject who spoke it
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally controversial and argumentative people
cons: Cannot make a subject forget their point in an argument, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot use Pro #2 to harm anyone other than the controversial speaker, until developed (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Usurpation: Inheritor
overview: temporarily usurp all powers of a single being which are genetically inherited in one way or another
description:
This power allows you to temporarily usurp the powers of a single being whose power are genetic in nature, leaving them completely powerless in the process. Clothing will change to reflect the person whose powers have been stripped for the moment. 

You gain their powers at exactly the same level of the original owner. Line of sight is required, otherwise you will gain the powers of a random being who could be anywhere at the moment. You have no knowledge when Usurpation ends.
pros: Surprise your opponent(s) with new powers
Knowledge what you can and can't do with "your " powers
cons: If no Inheritor is in sight, the target is chosen at random
Random inheritor powers might be useless in your current situation

name: Odor Sight
overview: see different smells and odors, using your eyes.
description: All odors left behind can be "seen," allowing you to track down an object. No odors have the same color, and the color fades away when the odor fades away. Once you've mastered identifying smells, you can easily track down a certain something, like pie.
pros: Allows to see odors human noses can't detect
Excellent for tracking
cons: May clutter field of vision

name: Gift: Auras
overview: be gifted at the control of auras
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling auras than other beings. Thus their aura-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of auras from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve aura-based powers, nothing else.
pros: Almost no one has as good control over auras as someone with this power.
Aura-based powers are boosted slightly.
cons: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only aura-based powers now.

name: Verity Song
overview: give superpowers to other people by making them listen to a song.
description: The subject induces another person in a state of trance. During this trance, the holder of the power make him/her listen to a song: the person who undergoes this treatment takes a superpower, which depend on the text and the meaning of the song, but also the affinity for the song of who receive the power in this way. In other words, the subject associates a song to a person and in this way he/she give a power. This power will be activated whenever the person who acquired it listen to the song.
pros: You also have the ability to understand what could be the receiving's favourite song.
The most appreciated is the song, the most powerful will be the received power.
cons: The power is not aviable on yourself.
The song that activate the received power must be listened entirely.

name: Kiss Of Fate
overview: sadistically give your enemies a kiss that will cause fear & pain.
description: You would blow a kiss and an amazing giant red glowing bright heart that would seek out towards your opponent, thus causes them to feel all of the sins and fears that they have inflicted upon others, causing severe damage.
pros: The kiss can cause your foes to go into an unmovable shock.
cons: Only works on evildoers.
Can only be used by women.

name: Electrified Hair
overview: run an electrical current through one's hair to electrocute whatever it touches
description: The electrical current will always be just high enough to electrocute whatever the hair touches and when using this power the user's hair will become yellow in color. The user of this power is the only one immune to the electricity.
pros: Being able to manipulate your hair would be a good idea.
cons: Very obvious that this power is in use.

name: 5 Stone Pillars
overview: cause five stone pillars to appear and anything surrounded by the pillars can have its powers sealed
description: First, you'll punch the ground after which 5 pillars will erupt from the ground in a circle with a 5 metre radius. The centre of the circle can be anywhere within 10 metres of the user. Anyone or anything within the area that the pillars surrounds can have the powers sealed away.
pros: Enemies inside the circle can be depowered, unless they have powers that prevent sealing.
cons: Can't use this if you have no fists.
The pillars disappear after 2 seconds.
Enemies who can move extremely quickly.

name: Snap You Pulled A Muscle
overview: cause people to pull their muscles by snapping
description: With this power you can make people pull their muscles by snapping and saying the muscle you want to be pulled. You don't have to say the scientific name for the muscle just shouting out "leg muscle" will do. The person will then be in pain and the pull will last as long as it takes for a normal pulled muscle to heal.
pros: You can cause people to pull their own muscles
cons: You have to be able to snap and say the name of the muscle

name: Transformers: Shockwave
overview: think through every situation logically
description: With this power you are able to contemplate every situation and scenario logically, when making decisions you are not affected by emotions or personal bias but only by what makes the most logical sense. An unfortunate side effect of this power is that if you use it too much you start to actually lose your emotions.
pros: You are able to think through every situation logically
cons: Not much use in physical combat
You may start to lose your emotions

name: Tranform Into Dinosaur Hybrid
overview: transform into Raptor Hybrid Creature
description: All traits grow to the size of the Utah Raptor body. Four sets of eyes #1 rattlesnake eyes for thermal vision #2 Cat eyes for night vision #3 Fly eyes for motion detection #4 Human eyes. Body, head, and skin of a Utah raptor. Tail of a stegosaurus. With human arms and hands. Keeping your own brain and consciousness while in this form. Maintain form indefinitely, could lead to savageness and loss of humanity.
pros: Able to use weapon's.
Fantastic eye sight.
Incredible speed, power, resilience
cons: Freakish looking
Incredibly painful tranformation
Loss of humanity

name: Bio Ink Tattoos
overview: touch someone and tattoo their true nature in symbolic form at whim
description: By touching any individual (super or not) the super can inject biologically produced ink into the receivers skin. This ink then takes the shape of: 1. The true nature of the receiver in whatever symbolic form works best or 2. Whatever the super chooses to mark the receiver with. The ink will fade as the body absorbs it over time. However, it will last for a long time before fading.
pros: Useful to mark targets/allies/etc
Could be used with magic to grant temporary boons
Really adds to the flare of any superhero/villan story
cons: Not very useful to attack or defend with unless used with another power
Not permanent because of it's natural ink basis
Has to be used by touching the receiver. That means getting close

name: Photon Based Physiology
overview: have a functioning body based around the usage of light.
description: This changes your body to allow you to utilize light in your biological processes. Specifically, you gain the ability to convert light into energy for your body through photosynthesis, in addition to your normal ways for getting energy, like eating (as such, your entire body is tinged green from chloroplasts, particularly your hair). In addition, your nervous system no longer uses electrons; now, it utilizes photons, allowing it to work much, much faster and more efficiently than before.
pros: Can use photosynthesis to continuously gain energy and stamina in a sunny environment
Reflexes and thought speed are pushed to extremes no electrical nervous system could hope to achieve
You glow in the dark due to all the light running through your body
cons: Hard to hide in the dark
Extreme thinking speed can cause extreme impatience
Odd coloration may ostracize you from your peers

name: Dark Element: Dark Water
overview: create and manipulate dark water.
description: Dark water is one of the four Dark Elements, more evil versions of the four classical elements. Dark water, unlike water, is black and very sluggish moving like molasses or lava. When stepped into, it is hard to escape as this element is similar to quicksand. A large body of it will suck you down slowly and it is extremely hard to swim through. One who can use this power can create dark water out of water and manipulate dark water. They can even swim through it like it was regular water.
pros: Create and manipulate the dark waters.
Trap and drown your enemies in large bodies or even waves of dark water.
You may swim through dark water like it was regular water.
cons: Dark water is slow so it won't "chase" foes quickly and won't turn into waves that quickly.
In order to form dark water, you have to create it from an existing water source.
This power is very dark and can't be used for much good. Can't transmute entire oceans into this.

name: Claymore : Gold
overview: possess a claymore that can torn things to gold
description: (This claymore can torn things into gold ) the blade is made from Crown gold. The hilt is made from Damascus steel. This claymore can turn almost anything to gold except planets.
pros: You are Midas without the physical contact part ( pro + con )
Turn your enemys ito gold
cons: You can only have one claymore ( no con negation )
This claymore makes you hungry for gold
Any power that controls metal

name: Pointy Palm
overview: have claws that reside in the palms of your hands
description: These are different from other claws because you actually have sheaths for them in the palms of your hands, right at the bases of your fingers. They are each five inches long and curved, and they retract easily and effortlessly into your hands. They are made of super dense bone so they don't break easily and they are incredibly sharp.
pros: Hang on to stuff. Very useful if you're falling off a building.
Slapping people across the face.
No bloody mess! No mutant healing factor required!
cons: You can see the openings in the palms or your hands.
Making a fist could become difficult/annoying/painful if you accidentally stab yourself.
You'll probably destroy a lot of pens until you get your claws under control.

name: Myth Power: Ececheiria's Ace
overview: channel Ececheria's command over the essence of armistice, truce and cessation of hostility
description: Ececheiria (Echecheria, Ekhekheiria, Ekekheria), in Greek myth, was the goddess of armistice, truce (compromise) and cessation of hostilities. As such, channeling her allows one to instantly perceive fights, arguments or battles going on in the immediate area. In addition, one may immediately perceive a compromise that the conflicting parties will agree upon to stop fighting/arguing/warring. Furthermore, one may perceive any breakers of the truce, and inflict one random curse on them at will.
pros: Perceive impending fights, arguments, disputes, feuds or wars
Perceive the perfect compromise to keep both sides happy
If either side reneges on the bargain/deal, they may be afflicted with a curse of the user's choice
cons: Once a punishment is chosen, it's the same for every truce-breaker until next power use
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Eris' Enmity provides immunity (NCN)

name: Reaper Claw: Final Stage
overview: completely obliterate your opponent
description: Unlike reaper claw 1&2 which have different abilities reaper claw: final stage only has one and that ability is total oblivion. When you activated reaper claw: final stage azrael the angel of death will appear and merge with you arm. I'll explain this part in the pros&cons and describe the merging in a comment. The attack is simple when it connects the opponent his body/soul/ and aura are completely destroyed and no power from neither heaven nor hell or earth can bring him/her back ever.
pros: There are no good qualities to this power
It is a somewhat dark technique
And should only be used as a last resort
cons: Unlike stage 1&2 there is no risk of injury however if overused your arm will die
To use this stage you must first master 1st and 2nd stage which will impress and befriend azreal
I listed this as a con because i don't know if befriending him is a good thing

name: Mini Mud Monsters
overview: make small humanoids out of mud
description: With some sticks & twigs & rocks & main ingredient: mud. You make a stick figure with rock as skull & a stone heart. Then cover in mud, zap it with some of your life force & it will come alive controlled by you. It'll take & form a monstrous appearance at action figure size. They will do your bidding until they "die" either by drying up or become to liquidy. They can put themselves back to gather though if damaged, but can't become bigger or combine with each other. You age when creating.
pros: Have muddy homunculi under your control
They become more monster like after they become alive
They can reform themselves & heal if damaged
cons: Can die by drying up or dissolving
Every creation you bring alive, drains some your life force

name: Hell's Helping Hand
overview: summon a firey hand from hell
description: To summon you must be a fire power master.  When you summon it any movement from your hands make "hells helping hand" do the same. The hand comes from Hell and is made of dead demons and magma. This power can go on and off any time.
pros: Destroy enemies instantly
Does what your hands command it
Very powerful
cons: Enemy must be within a 30 foot range to hit.
Not very effective on powerful people possessing holy aka light powers.
Comes out any time if your rage is very high

name: Miracle: Duplication Of Loaves
overview: induce people to share more often
description: With this power you can't really duplicate loaves but you can encourage people to share more often so it looks like everyone has more. Against someone who feeds on negative emotions exposure to this ability hurts--akin to healing zombies.
pros: Help a Scrooge donate
"Sharing is Caring"
Hurts people who rely on negative emotions to win
cons: No offensive capability (except hurting those who require negative emotions)

name: Ashes Ashes
overview: turn people into a pile of ashes
description: With this power you can turn people into piles of ashes just by looking at them and saying "Ashes Ashes". Once they're a pile of ashes you cannot turn them back to human form and they pretty much die.
pros: You can turn your enemies into piles of ashes
cons: You cannot turn them back
If you're mute this power has no effect

name: Movie For A Day
overview: have your life mimic a movie for an indeterminate amount of times.
description: While not quite a day, this unorthodox power allows you to have your life mimic a movie; what genre it will be depends on the overall moment that it activates; if you're fighting someone will become a action movie, if you're swooning over someone a romantic film, if you're joking around or goofing off a comedy. However, this will only happen at any time for an indeterminate amount of time (i. E. Time in movies ranges from a week to years)
pros: Have your life mimic a Action, Adventure, Comedy, etc.
Get to experience things as a protagonist; usually gets the girl
For a while almost everything will be interesting
cons: Not being able to control when the power activates.
The centre of any good film is conflict and drama.
Having your life mimic a horror movie (i. E. Activates while you're feeling scared, threatened)

name: Myth Power: Poros' Provision
overview: channel Poros command over the essence of expediency, contrivance and provision
description: Poros, in Greek myth, was the god of expediency, the tactics taken to provide for self and loved ones. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive the needs and desires of one's loved ones (family and friends). In addition, one can psychically perceive the steps to take which will allow one to most efficiently achieve the means to provide what one's loved ones want. This includes the most efficient way to commit crimes without leaving evidence or getting caught.
pros: Perceive the wants and desires of loved ones
Perceive the most efficient way to go about obtaining the desires of self, loved ones and allies
If one wants something only possible by crime, perceive how to efficiently get away with it
cons: Planning efficiency grows with practice; no widescale planning until higher levels (no Con Negation)
People with MythPower: Penia's Penalty are immune to this ability
People with justice/law/morals-based MythPowers can still sense your crimes

name: Osteoclast Mimicry
overview: melt/digest bone tissue through direct touch, absorbing its minerals, such as calcium.
description: When your skin is in contact with a bone, it releases an acid which destroys its organic part. The skin then absorbs the dissolved minerals, such as calcium and phosphate, which you can either secrete or store inside your body. Note that you must be directly touching a bone to melt it. It won't work if you try using this power through the skin or a piece of clothing. Also, be careful of Osteoblast Mimics, as they can have control over your power.
pros: You can eat and digest bones for their calcium and other minerals.
If you have a Phasing ability, you can destroy bones through skins and clothes.
This ability can be strengthened by Osteoblast Mimics.
cons: You can use it on your own skeleton, but it's really not recommended unless you can reform it.
You have to directly touch a bone to melt it.
This ability can be weakened by Osteoblast Mimics.

name: Red Rhabdomyocyte Mimicry
overview: contract your body heightwise and be extremely good at endurance exercises.
description: Also called Red Skeletal Myocyte Mimicry. As a type of Myocyte Mimic, you have the power to contract your body heightwise: your body and limbs become much shorter and fatter. In your case, you need to use fat and oxygen to do so, or be in the presence of an Adipocyte Mimic (fat provider) and an Erythrocyte Mimic (oxygen provider). Electricity can force you to use this power. Your contraction speed is slow and your contraction strength is low, but your body is very slow to fatigue.
pros: By contracting your body, you can pull yourself up or be short enough to enter through low passages.
Your body is very slow to fatigue, so you can excell at any endurance exercises.
If you find a way to lock your feet in place, you can pull things down by grabbing them.
cons: Once contracted, you'll stay that way until you find a way to stretch yourself.
You need to have access to a source of oxygen and a source of fat to contract your body.
You body is slow to contract and not very powerful.

name: Serpent Supreme Summon
overview: summon a serpent supreme
description: With this power you can summon a Serpent Supreme. A serpent supreme is a snake that is about the size of an elephant, has green, nearly impenetrable skin. It has a long red forked tongue and two rows of sharp teeth. The only thing a serpent supreme can eat, however, are humans. If it eats anything else, it will die and you will lose this power. You can unsummon the snake whenever you want.
pros: You can summon a serpent supreme and it is under your complete control
It is nearly invincible
You can unsummon it
cons: You only get one
It only eats people if you feed it anything else it will die and you will lose this power

name: Laser Blood
overview: bleed lasers
description: Your blood is made of light. If you are cut it will pour out perpendicular to your skin. These lasers are very powerful and can ignite things and send people flying. When it hits your tissue it will be reabsorbed directly into your blood stream, making internal bleeding no longer a problem. You also have increased stamina due to the fact that your blood charges through you at the speed of freakin' light. The problem is, when you lose blood, you lose it pretty fast.
pros: Awesome Weapon
Increased Stamina
Blood regenerates quickly
cons: May be reluctant to use your power
Cannot be turned off
Pitiful band-aids cannot contain your mighty boo-boos

name: Myth Power: Rhea's Nurture
overview: channel Rhea's command over the essence of flow, fertility and generation (reproduction)
description: Rhea, in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of flow, fertility and generation. As such, channeling her allows one to induce and manipulate fertility in soil, plants, animals and people (to make a sterile man virile, make a barren woman fertile, fertilize soil, etc). In addition, one can perceive his generations (if he will have children; their genetic traits, thoughts, emotions, etc). One can even manipulate flow (that of blood, water, mother's milk, energy, etc; at the higher levels, even time).
pros: Induce, amplify, reduce, and negate fertility at will; immune to Olympian MythPowers
Perceive one's past/future generations (location, genetic traits, thoughts, emotions, etc)
Manipulate flow of wind, water, milk, blood, energy, etc; at higher level, even time; gain Longevity
cons: Cannot share Longevity, or gain/bestow Immortality until the highest levels (no Con Negation)
Also perceive barrenness/infertility/sterility, future/past adoptions, abortions and miscarriages
People with MythPower: Kronos' Craft are immune to this ability (and it doesn't allow time travel)

name: Alligator/Crocodile Summon
overview: summon and control alligators and crocodiles
description: With this power you can summon and control alligators and crocodiles in order to fight or commit crime. The reptiles are under your complete control and can do anything a normal croc/gator could do. They have powerful jaws and extremely sharp teeth. They can jump far distances and breathe underwater.
pros: You can summon alligators and crocodiles
The animals will be under your complete control
There's no time limit
cons: They are not super powered crocs/gators

name: Burning Hair
overview: cause one's hair to light on fire without actually burning
description: Your hair will be at such a high temperature when you use this power that the air around it will ignite. You are immune to heat and flames created or caused by this power. Your hair also turns red when using this power.
pros: Enemies will not want to touch your hair.
cons: Your clothes will still burn so you'll be naked if you use this power and your hair is too long.
Very obvious when in use.

name: Myth Power: Potter's Potential1
overview: channel the Ceramic Daemons' command over the essence of pottery and ceramics
description: The Ceramic Daemons (Potter's Daemons, Daimones Keramikoi, Daemones Ceramicoi), in Greek myth, were the gods who plagued the craftsman and potter. As such, channeling Asbetos (Asbetus- Burn) allows one to turn foes into clay statues by touch; as they are petrified, they will feel an agonizing burning, like they are being fired in a kiln. In addition, one is can withstand the same effects (heat, fire and petrifaction). Furthermore, one can negate others' heat/fire/petrifaction immunity by touch.
pros: Turn foes into clay statues by touch; as they turn, they will feel like they are being burned alive
Totally withstand the effects of heat, fire and petrifcation
Negate the heat, fire and petrifaction immunity of others by touch
cons: Cannot burn others without petrifying them until the higher levels
Cannot heal others' burn wounds, or prevent/reverse petrifaction until the higher levels (NCN)
People with earth/fire-based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Negated Superman
overview: have powers with strength equal to the number of powers you have lost
description: You gain flight, durability, speed, and strength enhancements whenever a power you have gained is negated, stolen, or lost. The amount of durability, speed, and strength exponentially increases for every power, plus one. If you can lift 5 pounds and lose three powers it would be 5 to the 4th exponent, so you could lift 625 pounds. It is plus one so that when you lose only one power this power is still squared in power.
pros: Gain flight, durability, speed, and strength.
Will not be left superpowerless.
Grows exponentially equal to number of powers lost.
cons: Only works when you lose powers (requires you have multiple abilities besides this one).
If you regain powers this power weakens.
Foes will simply learn to not negate your powers.

name: Ice Cream
overview: create ice cream and shoot it at people
description: With this ability you can just focus and make ice cream in the palm of your hands or in a different location. This power is limited to 3 tons every day, but still, you can totally bury someone in a mass of ice cream. This power also includes some freezing properties. You can summon any flavor ice cream you want, as long as you have tasted it before.
pros: Freezing properties
Any flavor; you can also make money of this power
You can shoot it at people or summon it on top of them
cons: Limited to 3 tons a day
You can't make it disappear, you'll have to eat it if you want it gone
People wll ask you for ice cream all the time

name: Sacrifice!
overview: warp reality with a sacrifice.
description: An evil twist to reality warping; to warp reality, you have to kill an animal. Different animals give you different amounts of power, with humans giving the most. The more drastic the change, the more valuable the animal has to be. Only one change at a time, but if you kill a human, you could do anything. However, if you hurt yourself, you can also bend reality, as it gives you a huge boost.
pros: Warp reality to your will.
Serial killers will love this power.
Could sacrifice your enemy.
cons: Need to kill.
Only one reality warp at a time.
Doesn't come with an offensive power.

name: Delete This Lightning Hammer
overview: charge your foot with electricity then jump up into the air and bring it down to crush your foe.
description: You could even charge up your right leg with static electricity and jump all the way in the air and then descend it onto the opponent and they will have a major concussion.
pros: Your foe could have a maximum headache.
cons: Not a very good idea to miss your attack on the enemy.

name: Hyperventilation
overview: make others breathe really quickly on demand
