In addition, one can project a powerful prehensile tongue for assistance, at will. Furthermore, one can have as much food and drink as desired, at will. One can also withstand food-based illness and unhealthy food-based weight gain. One can even psychically receive taste sensations, at will.

name: Zodiac: Pisces

cons: The power is always random...

name: Instantly Zombies Once Dead
overview: cause people to become zombies that are under your control as soon as they die
description: With this power you can put a curse on a living person which makes them become zombies that are under your control as soon as they die. You can put this curse on up to ten people after that you lose this power. If the person you curse is immortal it has no effect on them unless you can find a way to negate their immortality. Once they are zombies they act as normal zombies (they have a desire for brains, their limbs can come off easily, they can't be killed etc. )

name: Internal Organ Intangibility
overview: make internal organs phase through objects
description: This power allows your organs to pass through objects, such as the skin, however the skin does not possess this ability. The user can apply this power to specific organs. This way you could remove your intestines and strangle someone with them, or throw your stomach in someone's face. You could detach your organs and use your skin as a parachute. There are tons of awesome, totally disgusting things you can do. Attacks can be avoided much like normal phasing, but the skin still takes damage.

Skin still takes damage

name: Healer 1: Seizure Negation
overview: block and end seizures within a certain radius around you.

The absorbed electricity can be used for the possessor's own purposes. If you have additional electricity-manipulating powers, this provides another source of power to use. It can be deactivated if so desired. The longer you have this power, the greater the range (1 meter each year).

name: Ghost Annihilating Soags
overview: summon beings made of anti-ectoplasm.
description: Saogs are anti-matter versions of ghosts but can interact with normal non-ectoplasmic matter without harm. It's contact with ectoplasm that that causes saogs to explode. This contact also causes the ectoplasmic being to explode at the same time. Just like matter and anti-matter.

name: Bug Pathy
overview: communicate with insects.
description: One could be the king of the insect world with this power. You could talk to insects and insects could talk to you. You might request them to help you in a battle but they have different personalities and some may say "U not the boss of me." But one could only talk to INSECTS not to arachnids or crustaceans.

name: Methanogenesis
overview: breathe in Carbon Dioxide and exhale methane
description: A form of anaerobic respiration, the possessor of this ability is able to survive in oxygen-poor environments by using carbon dioxide as the electron acceptor in cellular respiration rather than oxygen. While not as efficient as aerobic respiration, it will allow the person to survive. As aerobic respiration has carbon dioxide as its byproduct, methanogenesis' byproduct is methane gas. Might also breathe in side-products and/or smells.

Good for survival in enclosed spaces, e.g. sealed in by your foe
Collect the methane for fuel

name: Crazy Hair
overview: control your hair color, length, volume, and style to exactly how you want it.
description: Never have a bad hair day again.  Losing a little bit up top?  Not any more!  Take control of that bed head, 100% of the time.

overview: send the opponent to the edge with an Icy Hurricane Kick.

name: Usurpation: Upgrade
overview: be skilled with your "Usurpation" powers.
description: This power gives you several "upgrades" to your Usurpation power(s): Usually you need either line of sight or have to gain powers at random. With this power, however, you can choose to usurp the powers of a being whose power you have usurped before. Usurpation will last longer and will steadily increase the more experience you have gained, you will also know when Usurpation will end. Finally, you also gain the power to usurp more than one being's powers.

Duration of "Usurpation" is increased and you will know when it will end
Multi-Usurpation will become available
cons: Completely useless without any Usurpation powers

name: Razor Skin
overview: possess a denticled skin
description: Denticles are the tooth-like structures on a shark's skin. When rubbed toward the tail, they are perfectly smooth; when stroked upwards, they act as sandpaper. A person with Razor Skin also has these, but in much greater density. So when they are "rubbed the wrong way", they can strip flesh to the bone and smooth steel. Unfortunately, this ability cannot be turned off. The denticles face downwards; if they are stroked downwards, there is no effect.

Can flay flesh easily
Razor punches

name: Knuckle Bump Explosion
overview: create explosions by doing a knuckle-bump with another person.
description: This power is very simple and easy to use. Simply knuckle-bump with another human and an explosion will occur at the point of impact. The size and force of the blast depends on how much focus the user has and how much energy they exert. The user is always shielded from the explosion, and if they concentrate they can shield the other person as well.

Epic fist bumps

May accidentally kill your friends

name: Summoning: Avatar Of Zeus
overview: summon Avatar of Zeus.
description: In Greek mythology, Zeus was king of the gods, in command of electricity. Using this, you can summon a small portion of his power in the form of an avatar. A large humanoid beast made of pure energy and cackling with electricity will follow your command.

name: Never End The Superpower List
overview: make it so the Superpower List never ends

name: 4 To Go
overview: cause people to want to go somewhere
description: With this people you can make people have an overwhelming urge to go anywhere you want. You can make them fall off a cliff, make them walk into a containment cell, make them come to you, if they have a car then you can make them drive you somewhere. You can do all of this and more just by saying the person's first and last name and the place you want them to go.

name: Odour Whisperer
overview: see, interact and speak with odours
description: With this power, you see odours as if they were ghosts. They appear as coloured, gaseous spirits to you, clear as day. How good the smell is dictates the mental alignment of the odour; good smells are benevolent and handsome/beautiful, the bad smells are ghastly and twisted figures, and evil/bad. They will tell you how they were created, and they can attach themselves to you so that you can bring them along with you. Some may be your friend for life, or your worst nightmare.

name: Acultomancy
overview: divine information through needles
description: Acultomancy can tell the future, and other things, through small pointy pieces of metal. It specializes in the question "Where". Acultomancers put(or hold) needles on a flat surface. After thinking about what they want to find, the needles will spin and point in the direction of the thing. Compasses are used often for convenience. Acultomancers can find almost anything, and often have an inborn sense of direction. Better Acultomancers can find things faster, or more easily.
pros: Never lose your keys again!
Make use of a compass.

name: Myth Power: Cacia's Corruption
overview: channel Cacia's command over the essence of vice, sinfulness and corruption
description: Cacia (Kakia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of sin, vice, immorality, weak morals and corruption. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive sinful thoughts and acts (including what sin affects a subject most) at will. In addition, one can psychically cast illusions pertaining to which of the Seven Deadly Sins affects a subject most. One can even psychically replicate oneself six times, at will, for a total of seven bodies (each representing one of the Seven Deadly Sins).

They become dinosaurs completely, with nothing remaining of their pre-dinosaur mind. Creatures will only become dinosaurs that are within their size range. frees you from any constraints

name: "I Like Trains!"
overview: cause trains to crash into things when you say "I like trains"
description: With this power you can cause trains to appear out of nowhere when you say "I like trains" the trains will usually crash into something near you but they will never hit you or anybody/thing that your are touching.
pros: You can make trains appear
The trains can't hit your or anything you're touching
cons: You might accidentally hit an innocent person

name: "Speak Humans!" V3
overview: give humans the ability to speak any alien language
description: With this power you can give humans the ability to speak alien languages by pointing at a person and saying "Speak Humans" Then saying the name of the planet/alien species that you want them to know the language of. The person will then know how to speak that language for the rest of their life.
pros: You can give humans the ability to speak to aliens
cons: Not much use in physical combat
You can't use this power on yourself

name: Vertical Manipulation
overview: control all things that go in a near or perfect vertical line; their speed, how high they go, etc.
description: This ability doesn't control anything that is flying because they are usually in a horzontal line. This ability manipulates things that go straight up or straight down. The user can increase or decrease the speed of the object that is rising or falling. The user can't force things to go up or down(like Gravity M. ), they have to do it themselves. The user can even put that up object in midair. The user can also give the object or person a certain height in air before they will immediately stop.
pros: The user is also able to reverse the direction of the object.
Stop things in midair
Give things a certain height before they immediately fall.
cons: This doesn't control flying things.
It doesn't force things to go up or down like Gravity Manipulation does.

name: Author's Block
overview: make one of your superpowers immune to its author.
description: With this power, you can protect your powers from powers like Author's Power Manipulation, Author's Negation and Author's Immunity. It does not, however, stop Author Power Mimicry from ensuring that the creator has it, nor does it stop the author form gaining other benefits such as those from Author's Genius.
pros: Bypass a power's author's inherent defenses, including preventing their control over it.
Even the playing field a bit.
Stop an overpowered author-unique combination.
cons: If your opponent didn't create the power, this power is useless.
This power cannot have it's cons negated.
This power cannot affect itself.

name: Summon Chiron
overview: summon the wise centaur Chiron
description: With this power you are able to summon the wise Centaur and teacher of heroes, Chiron. While Chiron is not under your control if you are a hero or want to be a hero he will probably help you and train you and maybe even help you battle. You can unsummon him whenever you want.
pros: You can summon Chiron
He'll probably help you out
cons: He can die
You'll probably have to hide him from the public eye

name: Primeval Nail
overview: cut anything apart with your finger and toe nails.
description: You posses the primeval nails, the template on which all lesser nails are based. The grow quickly, straight,and sharp enough to rend anything they touch into ribbons. So keen are their edges that, were one to try, they could even split an atom.
pros: Your finger and toenails are sharp enough to slice anything apart.
cons: Must be handled with care, there is a chance you could cut anything you grasp.
Must be clipped daily to arrest their rapid growth.
Power can not be "switched off. "

name: Super Moderator
overview: instantly approve or reject a superpower correctly at first glance
description: Correct spelling and grammar errors, check for any rule/guideline violations, and approve or disapprove instantly just by looking at it.
pros: Might be good if you are a moderator
Never unfair, always right
cons: Only bad if you like taking the time to review a superpower

name: Gate: 80 Portals
overview: create portals to other places in the cage of rods of light
description: In order to get this power you must have Gate: 40 Rods of Light. When this power is activated the rods must be in a cagelike formation around people. The portals will appear in the area enclosed by the rods for 1 millisecond. The areas that the people are sent to by the portals are always random. They can possibly be sent back into the cage.
pros: Get rid of captured enemies quickly.
cons: Must have Gate: 40 Rods of Light. Con Negation has no effect on this.
Areas will always be random.

name: Self Turning Pages
overview: have the book you're reading stay open and have its pages automatically turn.
description: How nice would it be to read a book in your bed while keeping your arms warm under your blanket. This power allows just that. You still have to open the book yourself when you want to start reading it. But then, you don't need to touch the book anymore, except to hold it of course. Just read normally. As soon as you want to turn a page, it will turn automatically. When you take a short break before resuming your reading, the book will stay open.
pros: You don't need to move at all to read a book.
The pages can be turned in both directions.
It even works on flip books!
cons: It doesn't work on electronic books.
You still need to hold the book if you don't have a stable surface to put it on.
You can't operate pull tabs or any special mechanisms that are found in pop-up books.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Enhancement: Explosion Creating
overview: have a power create an explosion on 'impact' by attaching this power to it
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it allows a power to cause explosions upon impact with something else. Ex. Telepathy-another mind, physically-affecting power-something physical. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
pros: Explosion causing powers!
Mental and physical explosions can both be caused.
cons: Useless without another power.
Might not want a power to cause explosions. Ex. Hostage situation if good guy.
Explosion happens upon impact.

name: Exodus Gem
overview: use it to completely and utterly destroy entire timelines from beginning to end.
description: It's been described as the most devastating gem. As such, it has the ability to annihilate timelines, eliminate any target you choose at will, and it's powerful enough to destroy entire universes if the bearer is of sufficient intellect and power.
pros: None.
cons: Once you use it, there won't be any chance of bring back what you destroyed.

name: Photovideo Reproduction
overview: have photos and videos of you become you.
description: If you choose to use this power then ten minutes after a picture of you is taken,it will become you. A cellphone would burst apart releasing a another you. A photo will expand into a full-sized version of you. A video recording requires 10 minutes of continuous play. A DVD could hold a dormant version of you for yourself or someone else to play. Youtube videos work for this power.
pros: Practically every cellphone can take pictures.
Make DVD copies of yourself.
Upload yourself to Youtube.
cons: Anyone that knows this power will avoid taking your picture or recording you.
Videos or DVDs take ten continuous minutes of play.
Useless if you travel back too far in time.

name: Condition Change: Super
overview: make a power work only when used on those with powers
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to work only when used on those with powers. Cannot be used on a power already affected by Condition Change: Ordinary. This power is tactile.
pros: Now those with powers can't affect innocent civilians with the affected power.
cons: Have to touch opponent and each touch only affects one power.
Opponents with multiple powers.

name: Half Basilisk
overview: be half-human, half-basilisk
description: Someone with this power will have gray, scaly skin as well as fangs and a forked tongue. Anyone who looks into their eyes will be paralyzed until someone gets an antidote into the victim's mouth. The antidote will always be juice from the Mandragora. Also, if someone with this power bites someone, they will inject a deadly poison from their fangs. The poison is as deadly as a king cobra's venom. Someone with this power will also have higher strength, speed, and dexterity than most humans.
pros: Your poison has only a few antidotes and is extremely dangerous. Also a con.
cons: Most of the time you can't let anyone look directly into your eyes.

name: Claymore: Ability Absorption
overview: posses a claymore that can steal powers by striking them
description: This gives you a set of claymores; anyone who is struck by the sword will lose every single power that they have, unless they have power protection. The claymore looks like the cold steel Italian long sword.
pros: You can absorb all of there powers by striking them
Anyone who gets close to this sword will die
Arthur Petrelli version but without physical contact
cons: dont touch your friends with this sword
You live by the sword you will die by the sword
you can only have one claymore (no con negation)

name: Red Shift
overview: jump to and from a timeline where the Soviet Union won the Cold War.
description: What if America had collapsed instead of the Soviet Union? With this power you can shift to and from a timeline where this is a reality, along with anyone you care to bring with you. Different
pros: Escape danger by shifting to another reality.
Shift your enemies to another reality.
Make money by smuggling items across dimensional lines.
cons: The world could be very different.
You may exist on the red side of the timeline.

name: Complete Stupidity!
overview: randomly use any superpower imaginable!... Once.
description: The user of said ability can use a completely random power at will. However, they have absolutely no choice of what power they receive. It could range from the ability to fly, to shape-shift, etc.  The power that has been received can only be used once. However, though there is a very small chance of getting the same power twice, it is completely possible.  Mutations that can be caused by this power are only temporary, and will vanish when a new random power is received.
pros: Could potentially be a great help in combat.
The opponent will never be able to anticipate your next move!
Can be well hidden.
cons: The random power might be completely useless!
It might randomly destroy the world.
May cause self harm.

name: Moon Blade 8th: Shark Gray
overview: summon a blade of destruction.
description: This blade looks like it's made from gray shadow. Any magical thing hit by the blade is destroyed. For example, another magical sword, a magic armour or a transformation. They will be destroyed forever, even if they have the ability to repair themselves.
pros: Can destroy anything magical.
Good to make the enemy completely powerless and then watch them suffer.
cons: Careful not to hit yourself.
Doesn't work on stuff like laser vision, unless you hit their eyes (but they'd be dead then)
Has no actual offensive/defensive abilities (the enemy may have a normal sword+super strength)

name: Wood Mimicry
overview: turn your tissues into wood at will
description: Trees are some of the most sturdy living things; some live 500 years and stand 200 feet tall. Wood Mimics can take on some of their characteristics. At will, their internal organs and tissues become wood while their skin turns to bark, their feet turn into root-like things, their blood becomes sap, and their strength is multiplied 20 times. When they are in tree-mode, however, they are vunerable to fire, have a slower thought process, and are not as agile.
pros: Thick bark-skin, wood innards, sap-blood
Root-feet that can be locked in for immobility
Strength multiplied by 20 times
cons: Vunerable to fire
Slower thought process
Not as agile

name: Claw   It Came From The Sky
overview: make a giant claw crane come from the sky and take something away.
description: Ever been in a conversation where the other person wouldn't stop talking? If you had this power a long time ago, you could've fixed that! You know those machines where you operate a claw to pick up stuff and put it in a slot? With this power, a giant one comes along when you want to and picks up any object you want to, be it a teacher, your boss, your enemy, or yes, that person that won't stop talking. You don't know where they are taken, but the claw will cause them no harm.
pros: Giant claw will appear to pick up anything you want.
Giant claw won't harm the object/person.
The claw will never be linked to you, so no one will know it was you!
cons: You can't make it take anything to a specific location, it will only take it to a random destination
The local psychologist will be busy with all the witnesses who think they are crazy.
Every year, it comes form you to put $2 in a slot. No cash? You'll owe it next year.

name: Induced "Pop! Goes The Weasel"
overview: make someone sing "Pop! Goes the Weasel", even if they don't know the lyrics.
description: Just as the overview puts it. When you use this power on someone, that person will sing "Pop! Goes the Weasel". It works even if they don't know the lyrics of the song or even if they don't know how to sing it. You can't however make a mute sing with this power alone. The targeted person will sing as long as you don't release your attention on them and you can make more than one person sing this song.
pros: Force someone with the Jack-In-The-Head power to expose their weakness.
Force someone without the Jack-In-The-Head power to be exposed to ridicule.
cons: You can't force people to sing another song with this power alone.
tags: was edited as it was not really a superpower

name: Drunken Master
overview: control anyone when you are drunk.
description: Everyone will do as you tell them to. Except you have to be drunk, not just slightly intoxicated but really drunk. This might have a certain influence on your commands, but hey the party never stops till your out of booze. Feeble minds will admire you like a god. Strong minds might put up a fight though.
pros: Cops trying to arrest you? Just tell em to run 500 miles.
You can get any guy/girl even when they don't like you.
cons: You're not immune to major hangovers.
When you're sober, the effects stop: everyone will know you influenced them.
Commands must be (physically) possible

name: Bulletproof Hair
overview: have no bullet of the kind can pierce your hair
description: No bullet of the kind can pierce your hair.
pros: Your new or old hair style is untouched
cons: Might not easily be able to comb your hair

name: Glow Enhancer
overview: charge any matter of weapons, cause them to glow in a powerful instant.
description: This ability doesn't explode when throwing an object like Gambit does, if you use a Sword, Sai, Warhammer, or any kind of weapon to be charged powerfully, but if you use a belt, whip, rope, or a chain and wraps it around someone, this power causes to go into an electric shock.
pros: You might even use a Mace, Nunchuks, Bow & Arrow, Sledgehammer, or any kinds to glow powerfully.
cons: This power doesen't explode when throwing an object.

name: Human Thesaurus
overview: know the synonyms and antonyms of each word
description: With this power you are like a human thesaurus you know up to three synonyms and three antonyms of every word in every language on your home planet.
pros: You're like a human thesaurus
cons: No use in physical combat

name: Limb Multipliy
overview: mulitiply your arm(s) or leg(s) as many times as you want
description: With this superpower you can multiply your arms or legs to any number, such as 6 arms, and have a stronger punch.  Same with the legs.
pros: Can hit enemies with more arms or legs
cons: Multiplying your arms and legs 100 times probably isn't smart

name: Octopus Arms
overview: grow octopus-like tentacles from your body
description: With this power you can generate four octopus-like tentacles from your body (and turn your four original limbs into tentacles as well); these tentacles give you the ability to grab things, squeeze people with them, stick to surfaces using the suckers or do more things at once with your extra hands.
pros: Can climb walls
Can tie people up
Can multitask more easily
cons: Your enemies might tie you up with your tentacles
You can only use the suckers to stick to SMOOTH surfaces
Doesn't allow you to breathe underwater

name: Hailraiser
overview: call fourth a long lasting hailstorm.
description: You can create a deadly hailstorm that affects all things everywhere, can even send down shards of barraging hail that fall down both horizontally & diagonally.
pros: The attack lasts for a prolonged period of time.
As you would expect this power is devastating to opponents caught in it.
cons: It will not affect fire/magma type enemies.

name: Poison Dart Strike V1 Mortals
overview: shoot poison darts from your hands
description: With this power you can shoot poison darts from your hands but they can only hurt mortals (i. E. Normal people with no super human abilities) these poison darts will paralyze the victim for about twenty minutes
pros: You can paralyze people for up to twenty minutes while you attack them or rob them
cons: Only works for twenty minutes though you can shoot them with numerous darts at a time
Doesn't work on people with super powers

name: Touch From Hell
overview: set anything ablaze just by touching them.
description: Anything that come contact with the user's palm will be set ablaze, even if the object touched is something that shouldn't burn, such as seawater. Only the user's limbs are unaffected by this.
pros: Touch anything you hate and watch them burn.
Has some entertainment value.
cons: Everyone will panick with you around.
Anything that's set ablaze is irreversible.
No touching yourself (rubbing your tummy)

name: Game Physics: Mario
overview: mimic Mario's physics.
description: By mimicking Mario, you will have a hard head, 3 lives and mushrooms as power-ups.
pros: A Hard Head.
3 lives.
Powerups
cons: 3 lives only.
Turtles and muffins kill you.

name: Myth Power: Palaemon's Playtime
overview: channel Palaemon's command over the essence of safe ports and harbors
description: Palaemon (Palaimon), in Greek myth, was the god of ports and harbors. As such, channeling him allows one to swim well and survive underwater. In addition, one can teleport to any body of water at will. Furthermore, if one falls or is thrown, one is teleported on impact into an extradimensional 'Harbor Space' at will. One can also step into the Harbor Space at one location, and step out of it at another location, at will. One can even psychically perceive impending dangers (storms, etc) at will.
pros: Swim well and survive underwater
Travel into customizable 'Harbor Space', and use it for shelter/storage/capture or Teleportation
Psychically perceive impending dangers (attackers, poison, storms, etc) at will
cons: Cannot psychically access boating/sailing/fishing knowledge until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain favor with sea creatures or turn vehicles into boats, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Automatic favor with sea creatures (mythical or not) means they LOVE you

name: Barbed Wire
overview: turn normal wire into barbed wire
description: With this power you can turn any kind of wire into barbed wire. Including electrical wire, trip wires etc. This power also works in revers so you can turn your new barbed wire back and turn normal barbed wire into normal wire.
pros: You can turn any kind of wire into barbed wire
You can turn any kind of barbed wire into normal wire
cons: You can only make barbs appear on wires

name: Macrophage Mimicry
overview: stick to/absorb foes, assimilate their cells and make other Leukocyte Mimics go into combat mode.
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers (cf. Other Leukocyte Mimics to know which ones). You enter combat mode as soon as you encounter a foe (or any kind of human-sized obstacles). In this mode, you can stick to them and absorb them into your body, destroying them. In the case of living foes, you'll assimilate their cells into your skin. When you encounter a Leukocyte Mimic who recognizes them as their foe's, you can make them enter combat mode too, if they haven't yet.
pros: Unlike Dendritic Cell Mimic, you can still stick to and absorb foes while in combat mode.
Your body will stick to foes on a molecular level, making it hard for them to get away from you.
You can make T Cell and B Cell Mimics, who can't enter combat mode alone, enter it.
cons: As soon as you touch a foe's body, you'll get stuck to them until you manage to absorb them.
Unlike Dendritic Cell Mimic, you don't gain any abilities that enhance your mobility.
Once you're in combat mode, you're stuck in this mode.

name: Sedation And Murder
overview: seduce victims to be  safe around you and then shut off their brain functions, therefore killing the
description: With this ability, you can seduce victims into a sleepy state and then have the choice to murder them by removing all brain functions. The ability also has control over limited emotions, such as love, hate, or a neutral friendship.
pros: force a person you have a crush on to love you
kill any enemy, no matter how much stronger
fix a screwed up relationship
cons: the ability could backfire and kill you
you could unconciously kill a loved one

name: Forced Transformation Use
overview: use forms one was forced to become
description: Don't you hate those powers that force you to become something else? Well now you can use those forms you have been forced to take on as though they were originally transformations you were able to naturally use. You can also as a side effect of this power use your original form.
pros: Being transformed against your will can now help you gain new identities.
You can still use your original form for ID purposes.
The gained forms will never age or change looks from what the other people intended them to be like.
cons: No use if you have shapeshifting, immutability, and a few other powers.
Only works if you're transformed against your will.

name: Zombification
overview: convert living subjects into zombies by touch
description: Also called Zombification Inducing, Zombifying, Zombie Conversion or Living-Undead Conversion is the ability to convert the living into undead, via physical contact. With a touch, the subjects soul is ejected; the body rapidly undergoes decomposition, to the degree of the user's choosing. The mind is reduced to the lowest possible intelligence required to function, and linked to the mind of the user. When the process is finished, the soul returns and the subject is a zombie.
pros: Convert foes into zombies (often reversible)
They obey your every command, and cannot even be PSYCHICALLY compelled to harm you
If returned to normal, they have no recollection of being zombified
cons: Zombification only works with a touch (or a bite from one who was zombified)
At the lower levels it may be uncontrollable (either it can't be turned off or can't be reversed)
Only allows communication with (and domination of) those zombified with THIS power

name: Fire Flower
overview: turn normal flowers into flowers that spew fire.
description: These flowers are able to spew fire, similar to a flamethrower, but these are shorter and spew more fire.
pros: This fire burns through most things.
cons: The fire doesn't burn through everything.
This power is negated if close to someone with Water Flower.

name: Phone Head
overview: call people in your head
description: Those who own this power can call people's phones by 1.) thinking of their number and 2.) talking to them with their thoughts. The user of this power needs good thought control, or they might say what they didn't mean to or call the wrong number.
pros: Have a conversation in your head with people (now that sounds funny)!
You don't look like you're just talking to yourself all the time.
Call people in the middle of that boring math class!
cons: Still need phone numbers and can't text people.
You could end up with that song "867-5309" by Tommy Tutone stuck in your head.
Wandering thoughts. If you're a guy, you should probably call hot girls on a regular phone.

name: Myth Power: Prowess Of Palioxis
overview: channel Palioxis' command over the essence of retreat and backrush
description: Palioxis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of retreat and fleeing pursuit. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive the location, number and identity of any foe pursuing him, and avoid them with instincts like a prey animal. In addition, one may surpass the speed of any pursuer. At the higher levels, one may even cause a pursuer to slow down, as well as communicate with, and transform into, any animal considered a prey animal.
pros: Perceive the location, identity and number of one's pursuers
Gain prey instinct (even when the power is otherwise not in use)
Slow down pursuers and transform into a prey animal at the higher bands
cons: Some prey animals are also considered predatory animals (may get confusing)
Cannot COMPEL prey animals until the higher bands
People with MythPower: Laelaps' Pursuit  are immune to this ability

name: Myth Power: Dike's Decision
overview: channel Dike's command over the essence of justice, fair judgment and rights established by law
description: Dike (Dice, Dikaiosyne, Dikaeosyne, Dicaeosyne), in Greek myth, was the goddess of justice, fairness and rights established by law. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically subjects' guilt/innocence in criminal situations, based on the law, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive a subject's chance of being a repeat-offender, by touch; if over fifty percent, the subject can be banished to an extradimensional prison. One can even summon an indestructible weapon at will.
pros: Psychically perceive subjects' guilt or innocence of crimes, at will
Psychically perceive criminals' chances of repeat-offense; banish high-risk criminals
Psychically summon a powerful, indestructible sword and/or club (can only harm criminals) at will
cons: Cannot perceive past/future crimes (just ones in progress) until developed (NCN)
The definition of a crime shifts according to jurisdiction of one's location (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Harmonia's Heart
overview: channel Harmonia's command over the essence of harmony, agreement and unanimity (oneness of mind)
description: Harmonia (Homonoia, Hermione), in Greek myth, was the goddess of harmony, agreement and unanimity. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically induce harmony between any two or more subjects (quelling arguments, getting subjects to work together, etc), at will. In addition, one can psychically compel neutral subjects to agree with nearly anything one says, at will. One can even psychically attune oneself to the auras of others, to mimic their voices, appearances and skills, etc, at will.
pros: Psychically induce agreement, harmony and cooperation/teamwork, at will
Psychically compel neutrals to agree with nearly anything one says, at will
Psychically attune oneself to the auras of others to mimic their traits, at will
cons: Cannot use harmonic resonance to break matter apart, by touch or proximity, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia and MythPower: Ares' Wrath allow one to withstand (and disrupt) this ability
MythPower: Eris' Enmity and MythPower: Nerve of the Neikea provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Zelos' Rivalry
overview: channel Zelos' command over the essence of rivalry, emulation, jealousy and zealotry
description: Zelos, in Greek myth, was the god of zeal, emulation, rivalry and envy, especially in matters of competition. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive the location, thoughts and emotions of anyone he is jealous/envious of, as well as anyone who is jealous/envious of him (like rivals). In addition, one can perceive a foe's strategic weakness in competition. Furthermore, the more dedicated one is to a cause, the easier it is to catch on to skills pertaining to that cause (sports, etc).
pros: Psychically perceive location/thoughts/emotions of rivals/enemies/admirers/haters
Psychically perceive a foe's strategic weakness (adapt your style to outdo them)
The more dedicated you are to a cause, the easier it is to catch onto skills related to that cause
cons: Success Auto-Training only works with PRACTICE (and does not apply to superpowers; no Con Negation)
People with MythPower: Philote's Affection are immune to this ability
People with MythPowers based on Styx or Styx's Children (Cratos, Bia, Nike, Zelos) are immune

name: Dark Powers: Book Of Corruption
overview: summon the book of corruption, which can corrupt the soul of anyone with its words.
description: With this power you can summon the book of corruption. It teaches most of the Dark Powers, including the ones with Summon, Transform, Curse and Awakening type powers. This book also gives it's user the power of corrupting the souls of people who hear you talking it's Real Name, which cant be write in any human language. There are only 13 of those books in the entire multiverse. This book is for villains only.
pros: Gives you access to all the other Dark Powers.
Gives you a bonus power of corrupting the souls of people who hear you talking it's Real Name.
cons: This power is really rare, you probably would be the only person in the multiverse with this power.
This book corrupts your soul too, turning you evil.

name: Human Energy Container
overview: build up and contain so much energy you blow up if this power no longer takes effect.
description: As long as this power is active, any energy that your body absorbs or wastes is gathered in your stomach area. If a threshold is reached, your body has the potential to blow up if all this energy is released at once. Fortunately for you, this power prevents that by containing it, but that is true as long as you keep it active. So, you're a real human bomb, and the trigger is turning this power off. Oh, and a normal body doesn't usually survive its own explosion.
pros: You're the nightmare of every power negators/stealers. And they're yours too!
If you have or one has an appropriate power, you or they could tap into your energy reserve.
If you have an appropriate power, you could explode at least twice!
cons: Once you explode, you'll need to gather energy to blow up again. That is, if you're still alive!
You'll usually die when you explode.
You'll usually explode when you die.

name: Myth Power: Momos' Mockery
overview: channel Momos' command over the essence of criticism, blame and mockery
description: Momos (Momus), in Greek myth, was the god of mockery, blame, ridicule, scorn, complaint and harsh criticism. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive flaws, weaknesses and shortcomings of any kind. In addition, one gains a superhuman ranting ability in which one reveals the foes' deepest, innermost thoughts, feelings and secrets aloud, without even knowing it. One can even psychically cause matter to take damage, by mocking flaws in its physical or chemical structure, at will.
pros: Psychically perceive flaws, weaknesses and shortcomings of any kind
Superhuman ranting ability that subconsciously reveals foe's innermost secrets
Psychically cause matter to literally break down by mocking it physical and structure
cons: Cannot do physical/mental pain or damage to living things with insults until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia provides immunity
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity

name: Vampire Tracker
overview: know if someone's a vampire when they're near you
description: With this power, you can know if there is a vampire near you and you know which person near you is a vampire.
pros: If you're a vampire hunter, you know who to slay
cons: You can't turn this power off

name: 1st Law Of Kyst: Existence
overview: manifest the kyst law of existence around yourself.
description: "No changes can be made to the metaphysical state of anything. " A sphere half a mile in diameter surrounds you. As such, channeling him allows one to gain skill in said pursuits. In addition, one can psychically perceive and manipulate various medicinal herbs, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command bees and sheep. One can even psychically generate soothing breezes, at will.

Psychically perceive and manipulate herbs (Agrokinesis); generate soothing breezes (Aerokinesis)

name: Panontic Arch: Ithuari

A link to the panontic arch anywhere you go.

name: Lost Smoke Monster

description: You can turn into a flying cloud of smoke at will. You can manifest yourself as people who have died. Your smoke form can grab multiple people and kill them with a large amount of strength. You can "scan" people's minds to see their past. You cannot leave the island or fly across oceans. name: The Savior's Ears
overview: hear and locate cries for help
description: Whenever someone in danger is crying for help, you will hear them if they are within a certain radius from you. That radius depends on your power level; the more powerful you are, the longer the radius. Also, the closer they are from you, the more accurately you will be able to locate them. Moreover, if they are people you know, you can know their identities as well. However, whether or not you will be able to save them is totally up to you.

If you're worried about your loved ones being in danger, you can know for sure.

name: Atlas Syndrome

description: This ability is a curse to the bearer and a blessing to those around them. In mythology Atlas was forced to carry the weight of the sky on his own. With this power the user instantly takes on the direct burdens, physical or otherwise, of those near them. In order to cope with these burdens the user adapts in a manner that will allow them to cope with, but not eliminate the problem. In addition, any actual physical burden where the afflicted is stuck will trap the user once they take it on.

Free your friends and allies of any burdens that would hold them back.

Fun, and creepy!

Kill your enemies ruthlessly.
cons: You could drown in your sleep if you can't control it
If this is involuntary, could make for very awkward social situations

name: Snap You're A Vehicle
overview: turn people into vehicles by snapping
description: With this power you can turn people into vehicles by snapping and saying the person's name and the desired vehicle Ex: "John Doe, Motorcycle" The person loses all sentience when in vehicle form but you can turn them back by snapping and saying what you said before in reverse Ex: "Motorcycle, John Doe". All damage sustained in vehicle mode transfers to human mode so its an easy way to defeat powerful enemies just tun them into vehicles and crash them a couple of times before turning the back.
pros: You can anybody into any vehicle.
Once in vehicle mode they lose all sentience so you can ride them or use them to attack people.
All damage sustained in vehicle mode transfers to human mode.
cons: If they get destroyed in vehicle mode they die.

name: Celtic Invocation: Cailleach
overview: invoke the power of the Cailleach, the Gaelic goddess of winter and destruction.
description: Those with the invocation can, by tapping a fist, staff or other object against the ground three times, summon a storm common to the winter in the area. According to the climate, it may be a monsoon, a hurricane, a blizzard or a thunderstorm. The invoker may also be able to freeze objects, to call ice and frost by chanting, and to lay curses upon people or objects. These curses may cause instant death, illness, misfortune, pain, or any other negative, destructive effect.
pros: One of the most destructive invocations. The invoker will become winter personified in person.
The invoker's powers are stronger in late autumn to early spring.
Highly respected among the Invokers and people whose powers involve cold and destruction.
cons: The invoker's powers are weaker from early spring to late autumn.
Those who have power over heat, light and fire.
The storms affect all people, including friends and family.

name: Myth Power: Astra Planeta4
overview: channel the Astra Planeta and their command over the essence of the planets
description: The Astra Planeta (Astra, Asteres) in Greek myth, were the gods of the five Wandering Stars (Planets). As such, channeling Phaethon (Phaithon, Phaiton, Dios, Dion- Planet Jupiter) allows one to fly, as well as gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Jupiter. In addition, one can psychically generate an aura mimicking Jovian weather and air conditions, at will. One even gains favor with Jupiter's patron, Zeus, to resist and benefit from his domains (sky and weather, fate, royal power, etc).
pros: Gain flight; gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Jupiter (physical change voluntary)
Psychically generate an aura mimicking Jovian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will
Gain favor with Jupiter's patron god, Zeus; resist and benefit from his domains
cons: Cannot teleport self to Jupiter at will (others by touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate Jupiter-patterned forcefield (or project Pro #2 onto others) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Planet Eater
overview: gain powers by eating planets
description: With this power you become a giant, big enough to eat planets and every time you eat a planet you get a new power this is more of a Super Villain power than a Super Hero power
pros: Gain new powers by just eating (planets)
cons: Kills billions of people unless it's an uninhabited planet
Dwarf planets (like Pluto) don't work
Eventually you'll run out of planets and have to travel to a different galaxy

name: The Kyst Dimension
overview: banish someone to the Kyst dimension.
description: The Kyst dimension is where the norr, slitskins and other half-alive things like them come from. This power manifests as a 100-foot-radius ring of green-black primordial ooze that surrounds you and moves with you as if it were your shadow. If you're pushed to the ground, the ooze will flow around you. Anyone making contact with the ooze will instantly become enveloped and banished to the Kyst dimension. If they can't escape, they face hordes of half-alives that won't stop until they're dead.
pros: Banishment to an ultra-nightmarish world.
Your own ooze can't affect you.
cons: Anyone who flies.
Dimensional travelers.
Someone with a phasing power.

name: Racist Reversal
overview: turn people into the race that they are most racist against.
description: With this power you create a constant aura that turns people into the race that they are most racist against. It affects anyone in your range of sight even if you can not directly see them. If the people around you are not racist or are racist against their own race then nothing happens. People could change races multiple times if their racism changes to a different race.
pros: Cure to racism.
People can experience being a new race.
Teach them that everyone is equal by making them like those they are racist against.
cons: Always active.
Permanent.
May affect yourself.

name: Soquidkinesis
overview: mentally manipulate and control soquids.
description: A soquid is a state of matter between a solid and a liquid. This ability allows you to control soquids with your mind. You can control magma (but not lava), slushies, peanut butter, semi-melted glass, honey, a Wendy's Frosty, and anything else that is a soquid. A soquid shares properties of both solids and liquids. 50% solid, 50% liquid. You can only move magma at less than 1 mph. You can only control soquids. If the soquid magma solidifies (and it will), you can't control it.
pros: You can mentally control soquids.
You have complete control over soquids.
Control slushies, peanut butter, semi-melted glass, and magma (not lava).
cons: Can only control soquids. Lava is a liquid.
People who can manipulate solids and/or liquids can still slightly manipulate soquids.

name: Mermaid Friend
overview: summon mermaids.
description: Mermaids love to party and sing, so it's great anytime  you feel like having fun.
pros: Having someone to hangout with all the time.
cons: You have to be in or near water for it to work.

name: Suicidal Immunity
overview: be unable to take your own life
description: With this power you will be unable to kill yourself. No matter what you do to yourself (shoot yourself, hang yourself, jump off a cliff etc. ) you will come out completely unscathed. This power even applies if you pay someone to kill you.
pros: You are unable to cause yourself to die
cons: If you're suicidal (which of course is not a good thing to be) this power is not the one for you

name: Sh33
overview: make and use it to survive without water forever.
description: With this superpower, you know how to make SH33. You make it and when injected(or drank), can allow you to survive without water for a day. Just one dose a day and you'll never need water again. It has to be kept at a constant 40 degrees fahrenheit or below. Above 40 F, it decomposes into SH46, causing extreme thirst and temporarily increased need for water(more than normal) when used. SH33 has a distinct green-yellow glow that glows in the dark. When it glows less and becomes yellow.
pros: Make SH33 and survive without water.
Each dose lasts 24 hours.
A dose a day and you'll never need water again.
cons: It must be kept at a constant 40 F or it'll decompose into SH46.
SH46 causes extreme thirst.
Someone might want to sabatage the SH33 project and hide it from the public.

name: Myth Power: Enyo's Laugh
overview: channel Enyo's command over the essence of violence and bloodshed
description: Enyo, in Greek myth, was the goddess of violence and bloodshed. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive violence and bloodshed in one's proximity at will. In addition, one gains physical power from inflicting pain and injury on others; the more blood drawn, or pain inflicted, the better. One can also transfer wounds from one's own body to others' bodies, by touch, word or thought. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel particularly violent people.
pros: Psychically perceive violence and bloodshed at will (when developed, extends into past and future)
Gain physical power from inflicting harm; transfer one's wounds onto others by touch word or thought
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel particularly violent people
cons: Cannot induce violent behavior in neutrals by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Eirene's Elegance provides immunity (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide power from this ability (NCN)

name: Condition Change: Festival
overview: make a power work only when there is a festival somewhere in the world
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation for a power so that it only works when there is a festival ocurring in the world. It doesn't matter where the festival is, what is being celebrated, or who is celebrating. This power is tactile.
pros: You can most likely predict when your enemy can use their powers.
cons: Have to touch and each touch affects only one power.
There are probably lots of esoteric festivals in this world alone.

name: Melanocyte Mimicry
overview: produce melanin.
description: You can produce sacks of melanin inside your body that migrate toward your hands. There are two types of melanin that you will produce: a dark brown/black one (harmlessly absorbs UV rays and converts them into heat) and a yellow-redish one (changes when exposed to UV rays and may damage the DNA if it does). Your body synthesizes the same ratio of the two types, which depends on your skin, hair and eye color. You can also undergo mitosis when a Keratinocyte Mimic near you is undergoing mitosis.
pros: Use the dark melanin to protect yourself or others from UV radiations.
You can duplicate yourself in the presence of Keratinocyte Mimics who are undergoing mitosis.
You can pierce the sacks to spray the melanin on you or others.
cons: You can only duplicate yourself when Keratinocyte Mimics duplicate themselves as well.
Keratinocyte Mimics can influence the ratio between the two melanin types you produce.
You must produce DNA-damaging melanin when using this ability if the ratio forces you to.

name: Road Rage
overview: force any car (or cars) out of your way at any given time.  Includes rush hour!
description: With this ability, you can cause any car that's PISSIN YOU OFF to get the hell out of the way.  They will magically be forced to move out of your way, and, if you want, you can give them the finger while doing it.  Basically, this will satisfy any road rage you might have.
pros: Get place faster
You're never late because of traffic
Rush hour is a fun time
cons: You might force an ambulance to wait

name: Myth Power: Anaideia's Anger
overview: channel Anaideia's command over the essence of disrespect, ruthlessness and unforgiveness
description: Anaideia (Anaidea, Anaidia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of disrespect, mercilessness, shamelessness and unforgiveness. As such, channeling her allows one to speak and act nearly however one likes; people will not retaliate, no matter how rude, hurtful, vulgar, profane, obscene or disrespectful. In addition, one when holding a grudge, going against a foe one does not respect or when one's foe is down (pleading for mercy). One can even psychically compel subjects by talking to them rudely.
pros: Do nearly whatever you like (even if it breaks the law), and nobody will retaliate
Gain physical power when holding a grudge, fighting a foe one doesn't respect, or when he is down
Psychically compel subjects by talking to them rudely (yelling, insults, cursing, etc)
cons: Cannot get away with physical abuse, rape or murder until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Eleos' Empathy allows one to withstand and negate this ability (NCN)
Law/order/justice based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Sentinel
overview: grow an eye on any part of your body.
description: You can grow an eye on any part of your body in several seconds, and than remove it with your thoughts. You can always know, what is behind you. Or above you. Or under you.
pros: Seeing everything around you
Recognize your enemy before the attack
Quite fun to show eyes on your sole or your elbow to your friends.
cons: Too conspicouos, anyone can see that your not an avarage human being.
Having clothes over the part of your body where you want the eye to be

name: Spore Releaser
overview: shoot spores from yourself which turn into any type of fungi imaginable.
description: With this superpower, you can shoot spores from any part of your body. These spores turn into any fungi of your choosing. The fungi doesn't have to be real, but you have to have a clear image of it in your head. Be warned, as this power can randomly activate with strong emotions. If used too much in a 1-hour time period, the user's energy will be severely taxed. Also, this power works best in damp, dark places.
pros: Neverending supply of mushrooms equals never-ending supply of food. (donut mushroom! )
You can make the fungi ANYTHING you want.
Endless supply of fungi-weaponry.
cons: It's emotionally triggered.
You will dry out if you stay in the sun too long.
If you're not careful, you could accidentally pulverise an ally with an avalanch of fungi.

name: Uv Stick Grenade
overview: use it to emit bright explosions to you foes.
description: The UV Stick Grenade consists of an explosive flashlight head, on top of a hollow lead handle. A pull cord runs from the detonator inside the head to a porcelain ball that is held in place by a detachable screw cap on the base of the handle. They are designed to stun normal opponents and disintegrate vampires.
pros: It would blind the enemy for five seconds
It desintegrates a vampire in an instant.
cons: None

name: Tick
overview: become a tick and steal the powers of all you bite.
description: You turn into a tick. You climb onto someone with powers, bite them and with each drop of blood you drink you gain one of their powers. If you bite a person with only one super power you basically just get stronger within the restrictions of the power you've stolen.
pros: You can take any power you can get.
Not many people will even notice you're on them.
It doesnt take much blood to steal a power.
cons: You have to become a tick first, then try to get on them.
If someone sees you in tick form they can kill you with one good foot squashing.
Unless you're a vampire, who likes to drink blood. Yuck!

name: Bird Caller
overview: be able to imitate any bird call perfectly
description: With this power you can mimic any bird call perfectly. So perfectly that birds and cats might start running/flying towards you thinking your a bird.
pros: You can attract birds and cats
You can mimic any bird call perfectly
cons: Not much use in physical combat
You might be allergic to cats or birds

name: Marks Of Master And Servant
overview: create an explosion in an area that turns everyone into a master or a servant
description: The master will be marked with 'M's on their palms and the servant(s) will be marked with 'S's. The biggest significance though is that the servant(s) must each take into their body at least 1 drop of blood a day from their master or die. The master can order around the servant(s) for that reason. In order to get rid of this curse the servant must willingly do 500 things for their master without doing them in order to free themself of the curse.
pros: Possibilty of turning your enemies into the servants of your allies.
50% chance of being marked as a servant or a master. Exceptions in cons.
Chance of being marked as either a servant or master can only be changed by the cons.
cons: This power will not make those with Slavery Immunity into servants. Con 1 is negated only by con 2.
The user of this power is automatically marked as a servant if caught in the explosion.
Possibility of turning your allies into the servants of your enemies.

name: "Speak Humans!" V2
overview: give humans the ability to speak any animal language
description: With this power you can give humans the ability to speak to animals. They will be able to speak to any fish, bird, mammal, reptile, insect, amphibian etc. And understand what the animals are saying as well.
pros: You can give humans the ability to speak to animals
cons: You can't use this power on yourself

name: Infernal Demons
overview: release demons and spirits if they offer you something
description: Demons and spirits can contact you from the underworld, another plane of existence or wherever they come from. In return for releasing them, they will offer you something as a reward. You can accept or reject the offer, or you may make an counter-offer. You'll have a gut feeling where and when they will spawn. No traces/evidence will be left to implicate you for the spawning of the creatures, they will not remember you set them free. You yourself can also choose to not remember this.
pros: No evidence to implicate you, even you can forget if you want to; despite memory powers
Creatures come in different shapes and forms (hands, animals, human-like) and have their own powers
You can choose when you want to hear offers, so you don't hear them all the time.
cons: They have to obey the agreement, but after fullfillment, they don't disappear
Each demon has it's own personality and attitude. They might turn on you if you're not careful.
They can be destroyed or exorcised

name: Hot Tub Effect
overview: create a stream of bubbles or churning warm water when fingers placed in water.
description: Never take a cold bath again! You could immeidatley turn any pool into a hot tub, and make any water so unbearably hot and bubbly that it scalds the foe!
pros: Hot tubs! No more cold water!
Bubbles!
Boil a foe alive!
cons: Nice relaxing tub can become a horrible bubbly mess!
Boiling yourself alive.

name: Myth Power: Geras' Guard
overview: channel Geras' command over the essence of old age, the old and geriatric conditions
description: Geras, in Greek myth, was the god of old age, its associated conditions and the elderly (old). As such, channeling him to allows one to age, and yet never suffer or die from old age or geriatric conditions. In addition, one can psychically age subjects (physically and/or mentally), at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with anyone older than middle age (senior citizens, etc), at will.  One can even psychically generate a forcefield that works on the elderly (old).
pros: Gain Graceful Aging (never die of old age or associated geriatric conditions)
Psychically age subjects (mentally and/or physically), at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and generate a forcefield against the old, at will
cons: Cannot psychically trade bodies/minds with the old, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically convert one's old age into physical power, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Hebe's Hedge and other time/age-based powers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Enhancement: Perverted
overview: make a power more evil than normal
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power more effective at healing evil beings and harming pure-hearted beings. This power cannot be attached to powers that are good in origin. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: Pure-hearted enemies.
100% evil allies.
Objects are affected also if the attached-to power could affect them originally.
cons: Useless without another power.
Evil enemies.
Pure-hearted allies.

name: No Aura
overview: have no aura
description: Normally a living being has an energy field that they give off. This is known as an aura. Most beings can only suppress or hide their aura with concentration. However, like Kanna from 'Inuyasha' (her powers are based on emptiness and she carries a mirror that has powers of its own) you have no aura.
pros: People cannot track you by aura since you have don't have one.
Aura manipulators will not like you.
NOTE: It is because Kanna is based on emptiness that she has no aura. You don't have to be like her.
cons: Largest irregularity a living being can have.
Can't have a beneficial aura.
Might become similar to Kanna. Might be a pro as she has a few nice powers.

name: The Chocolate Touch
overview: turn anything into chocolate just by touching it
description: Similar to King Midas's Mida Touch but instead of turning things gold, you turn them into chocolate. Also unlike the Midas Touch, you can reverse the effects of this power, but you cannot turn it off. For instance, if you hug your mom she automatically turns to chocolate, but you can quickly turn her back so it doesn't matter.
pros: You can turn anything into chocolate.
You can reverse the effects of this power
cons: You can't turn this power off
If you're allergic to chocolate this is bad

name: Infinity Sword: Sulk
overview: use Sulk.
description: The Infinity Sword is one sword that can transform into an unknown amount of different other swords, each with unique abilities and appearances. Sulk appears to be a regular steel claymore, but has the ability to feed off negative emotions. Whenever near people who are sad, angry or such, the user grows stronger.
pros: Gain power near negative emotions.
cons: Only uses negative emotions.

name: Puppet Power
overview: turn people into puppet versions of themselves
description: With this power you can turn people into puppet versions of themselves and control them
pros: Turn your enemies into puppets so they can't cause any more harm
cons: Once you turn a person into a puppet you can't turn them back

name: Enhancement: Duration
overview: increase the duration of time that a power works
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power's duration 50% longer than normal. This includes ALL durations: usage and cooldown times. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: Can surprise opponent by using a power longer than they thought you could.
Con: some powers are just plain useless even with longer durations
Con: Powers you don't want to have longer durations, such as a power used to curse, used on oneself.
cons: Useless without another power.
Will not affect powers in which the duration it works is important to how it works (May be a pro).
Only helps on powers with limits on how long they can be used.

name: Clairgustance
overview: psychically taste anything.
description: Just by concentrating a moment, you can taste the rainbow or anything else to which you set your mind. This power draws the essence of the substance out of the spiritual or ethereal realms straight to your taste buds!
pros: Find that the world is delicious.
Make dieting far easier.
Science
cons: Bad tastes

name: Temporary Nylon Ligaments
overview: temporarily make your ligaments as strong as nylon.
description: Ligaments are a type of tissue that connects bones to other bones. With this ability, you can temporarily turn your ligaments as strong as nylon. You can turn this ability off at any time. You can't be pulled apart too easily. Your bones can still break. This power only last for 5 hours or less. When this power is activated, your ligaments do not stretch and you can't move as much.
pros: Temporarily have ligaments as strong as nylon.
Can't be pulled apart as easily.
Power can be turned off at any time.
cons: Can't move as much because power prevents ligaments from stretching.
Power last for 5 hours or less.
Your bones can still break.

name: Lymph Manipulation
overview: manipulate lymph at the cellular level
description: A person with this power can control lymph at the cellular level. This means that they can control the immune system of anything as well as use it like blood manipulation. With this power you can cure many diseases as well as cause symptoms of disease. In addition you can also trigger or stop allergies in people.
pros: Can use to cure people from edema and stop allergies
Can also cause edema and allergies including anaphylactic shock
Can use similar to blood manipulation
cons: Lymph is less common than blood ie less to manipulate
Need to study how lymph works

name: Independant Action
overview: have your summoned minions persist after your death.
description: This is less of a power for you, and more a power for anything you summon with magic. With this power any creature you summon will persist in this realm for up to three days after you have been killed. More if they can find another source of Mana to draw from.
pros: Have your minions stick around after you die.
Have them put your plans into action or take revenge on your killer.
They may find a way to revive you.
cons: You will be dead.
This power could make certain beings harder to controll.

name: Song Stealer
overview: remove any musical piece from history and transfer it into your memory
description: This power allows you to remove any musical piece in existence from reality past and present. For example, if you removed Beethoven's 3rd Symphony, it would be as if he had never composed the song. The entire song, both in performed and written form, would then be transferred into your memory in its entirety. A byproduct of this superpower is that you will be able to play or sing stolen songs perfectly. However, you would play or sing any other songs only as you normally would.
pros: Become known as a master musician (if you're not worried about stealing others' music)
Get rid of the songs you hate
A vicious counter to any musically-based superpower
cons: You can't directly return any stolen songs to history (you can still play/reveal the melodies)
The songs you hate that you get rid of will be stuck in your mind forever
You might accidentally change a major part of history by removing important songs

name: Transformation: V
overview: transform into the vigilante V
description: The person who has acquired the Guy Fawkes mask is able to transform into the vigilante V. When the person becomes V, he or she gains Olympic level reflexes, increased strength, incredible mental capacity and not to mention experience and knowledge of former "V's"
pros: Olympic level strength, reflexes
Has knowledge on every field of study
cons: He or she does not necesarily fight for the good or bad.

name: Pain?
overview: know if someone is in pain
description: With this power you have the ability to know if the person you're talking to is in emotional or physical pain and you also know exactly how to help them. You also know what to do to worsen their pain if you decide to be a jerk.
pros: You know if someone is in pain
You know how to help them
You know what to do to make their pain worse
cons: You have to be talking to the person to know if they're in pain or not

name: Pokethulhupower: Pokenomicon
overview: know all pokethulhu via a special book
description: Ever played pokethuhlu? It's a parody of the pokemon anf cthulhu rpgs. With this power you get a pokenomicon, with all the pokethulhu in (fanmade and official)
pros: Know all pokethulhu
cons: As a magic book, it can be destroyed by supremely powerful weapons
Need shining Dodecahedrons to capture them (d12 dice will do)

overview: turn into a Spartan Warrior
description: With this power you can turn yourself into a Spartan Warrior. You have enhanced strength, stamina, durability and fighting skills. You can also summon Spartan armor and weapons.
pros: You can turn yourself into a Spartan Warrior
cons: You can still be killed

name: Chihuahua Summoner
overview: summon assassin Chihuahua's
description: Summon 3 Super evolved assassin Chihuahua's that upon death disappear and can be re summoned after a 12 hour recharge period. These Chihuahua's are the same size but speak English, and are trained with knives and small arms. They have paws that morph into hand with three fingers and one thumb. They are good assassins because after a kill they can trot out without raising suspicion. They obey your commands even if they are not happy about it or give you some sarcastic remark.
pros: Cute killers
Die but return in 12 hours
Obedient-ish
cons: Small
Not good for general fighting
All assinations must be suprise attacks.

name: Summon Snickerdoodles
overview: summon snickerdoodles.
description: Ability to summon the best tasting snickerdoodles.
pros: Snickerdoodles taste good.
cons: THERE IS NOTHING BAD WITH SNICKERDOODLES.

name: Anubis Shift
overview: shape shift into Anubis at will
description: With this power you can shape shift into Anubis at will. You can speak Egyptian and understand Egyptian. You don't get his powers, memories or skills. You will be worshiped as long as you are in this form, though you'll smell of corpses. Lastly, dogs will like you.
pros: You speak and understand Egyptian
Dogs like you
Scare people to death
cons: You don't have his powers
You don't have his memories
You don't have his skills

name: Arcana 12: The Hanged Man
overview: sacrifice memories for knowledge.
description: You may use this power to gain knowledge. You simply need to state a question and your power will supply you with the information required. Information gained by this power is always true, thorough and useful. However, using this power permanently removes one or more of your memories. The more obscure or valuable the information, the more precious or large the memory taken will be. If you regain the lost memory, you lose the knowledge gained, even if the information was stored or written down.
pros: You can gain knowledge of almost anything.
This power is nigh-impossible to trick or block.
cons: The harder the knowledge would have been to obtain, the greater the memory loss.
You may forget why you sought to obtain the information.

name: Arcana 15: The Devil
overview: cause people to act on their innermost urges.
description: With this power, you can cut down to the deepest part of a persons personality and cause them to indulge in whatever their most basic desire is. They will attempt to do whatever that is as much as possible until this power runs its course. Of course, their deepest desire may not be negative. A charitable person may end up giving away everything they own, but the urge is always complete and overwhelming. This power can spread from person to person whenever someone affected speaks to anyone.
pros: Reduce small towns to utter chaos as people abandon their responsibilities.
Easily access forbidden areas.
Discover people's innermost secrets and desires.
cons: You may end up unleashing to much chaos.
Some desires may end up negatively impacting you, such as somone who deeply desires violence.
Emotional manipulation powers can cancel or redirect this effect.

name: Fragmentation!
overview: make any gang or group not know each other, forget their last idea, and break apart
description: Does it suck living in a crappy neighborhood? With fragmentation, that's a thing of the past. You can use this superpower to dismantle any group or gang as long as their within a 20 mile radius. They will forget that the group existed and then forget that they were going to beat up people "for fun". Then they would just be individuals. Corrupt cops as well? Make the bad cops forget that they were part of the police force, and break apart from the rest of the police force. New groups might form.
pros: Break up any group within a 20 mile radius.
They'll forget their evil goals.
Disorganize the bad people and make neighborhoods safer.
cons: Superpower might be used for evil.
Have to be in a 20 mile radius.
New groups might form.

name: Claymore : Sand
overview: posses a claymore that can only contral sand
description: (This claymore is fun ) the blade is made from Hiduminium. You can only control sand. You have to be near sand.
pros: You are sandman with a claymore
Barry people in sand
You can make a sand castle
cons: You can only have one claymore (no con negation)
Any power that uses water
Any power that uses fire

name: The Big Squeeze
overview: grab anyone's ass without permission.
description: Anywhere, anytime, as long as you can get within grabbing distance, you can grab any ass.  Nobody will try to stop you and there will be no negative consequences--just cheek in hand.  As an added bonus, the person whose butt you're squeezing will be happier as a result.
pros: The beach
Making people happier
Everyone wins!
cons: Don't get too frisky--you're only covered for the squeeze

name: Prayer To The Dragon, Dagiozzi
overview: summon the holy guardian from the depths.
description: You have to enter a state of perfect peace (not Heaven!) as you pray. It goes like this: "Aumento, dea del mare, Aumento, drago della giustizia, La mia lingua ti chiama. Benedizioni tuo elargire indegni, Abbiamo bisogno di forza tua, Ci protegga, Esiliatore del male. " What's lame is that you have to pronounce it in native Italian.
pros: Dagiozzi is a sea goddess. What's not cool about that?
She will follow almost every bidding, but your intentions must be pure.
She can swim, fly, walk, and is 35 feet tall. And you can ride on her. Wee!
cons: If you're not Italian.
She's a goddess, so pervert her and die!
It has a duration of one day, and a cooldown of two, so don't get into any trouble for two days.

name: Pheromone Detection
overview: detect pheromones of all animals.
description: Pheromones are produced by animals (mainly insects) and plants to communicate between them. Even humans produce some. There are alarm pheromones, food trail pheromones, sex pheromones... It is considered the sixth sense of animals.
pros: Allows you to discover a large amount of informations about an animal just by smelling it.
Detect the presence of animals.
cons: Humans produce less pheromones than other animals.
You need to smell to discover informations.

name: Summon Kekig
overview: summon a Kystian designed to fight the intangible
description: Kekigs look like a six foot tall fusion a chimpanzee and wolverine. They do have sharp teeth and claws. They are summoned with weapons and armor. Kekigs can see astral and invisible beings. Kekigs need armor because they have the ability to grab phased, intangible or ghostly beings as if those beings were solid. Kekigs lose invulnerability while holding onto someone. Kekigs can run 35 mph and lift 5 tons.
pros: Your foe with the phasing power is in for a nasty surprise.
The armor a kekig wears offers really great protection against conventional weaponry
cons: Armor or not, invulnerability is temporarily lost when fighting the intangible

name: Greater Kystian Morph #5
overview: become a unsummonable giant hummingbird kystian.
description: A zyl, a giant hummingbird-like kystian with a 50-foot wingspan. You can fly at mach 10. You can hover in place and choose to generate a 300-mph fire storm with a radius of 300 feet. You can just generate 300-mph winds if you choose to do that. The fire storm has a temperature of 1500 degrees. You have slow-motion vision.
pros: You fly at mach 10.
You can choose to create a 300-mph fire storm around your body.
cons: A giant form that you can't use everywhere.

name: Diary Of A Madman
overview: have a person's diary/journal entries appear in this book of yours
description: You have a never-ending book that contains the entries of any people you choose. This book can be used to know what others are thinking, but it comes with a serious price (dramatic pause) YOUR SANITY! (Dun, Dun, Dum! ) If you have too many people in the book, their thoughts start to haunt your mind and you lose track of who you are, thus driving you to insanity.
pros: Track what certain people are doing.
You can give the book to someone you know would abuse this (MuaHaHa! )
If it fills up, the book automatically makes 10-20 more pages
cons: Lose you sanity, and sense of self

name: Rise Of The Skeleton Archer
overview: turn into a skeleton archer
description: With this power you can turn into a Skeleton Archer. A Skeleton Archer is a ten foot tall skeleton with a bow and an unlimited amount of arrows to go with it. The Skeleton Archer's weakness in that it burns when it is in the light so you can only use this power in dark places or at night.
pros: All of the pros are mentioned above
cons: All of the cons are mentioned above

name: Word Power
overview: enhance another power you possess depending on its value in Scrabble.
description: This ability is passive. If an ability is a phrase, it will depend on the letter count of the longest word in the power's name (but only ones that count in Scrabble) multiplied by the number of letters in the power name.
