The power's scrabble value times the number of letters in the power's name divided by the number of words in the power is equal to the boost given. Try it.
pros: You don't need to be good at math to have this.
If you have a powerful move that has a long name, it's better.
cons: You can't use this on others.
The boost will last for a day and have a cooldown of another.

name: Vouivre Hair
overview: have a serpentine creature on the back of your head, disguised as your hair
description: You permanently have an extremely long, flying, razor-toothed and fire-breathing serpentine creature attached to the back of your head. While resting, it is disguised as very long uncuttable hair, but if it feels threatened, it will instantly morph back into the dragon-like creature to attack and defend itself--and you--on the same occasion. While it will never attack you, you still need to tame it if you want to have some control over it.
pros: Excellent defense and attack mechanism
You can fly on its back
It will never attack you.
cons: If untamed, it won't differentiate friends from foes.
If it is too violent, it can injure your neck, or worse, break it.
You are stuck with very long hair for the rest of your life.

name: Immortal Urn
overview: become immortal if your heart is placed into the urn.
description: It is unclear where the urn came from, but what is known is that of one's heart is placed inside he or she will be immortal as long as their hear is inside. After that time, any injury will heal instantly and only ash will spill from the wounds. Person remains the same age they were when the heart was placed inside. Person can travel as far away from the urn as they want which makes hiding it easier to hide the urn.
pros: You're immortal as long as your heart is inside.
Urn can be hidden and you can go anywhere.
No pain when injured and healing is quick.
cons: You have no added strength or speed so there's that. You will look as pale as a dead person.
Your body, excactly as it was when you become immortal so if you're fat, thin, whatever you're stuck
If someone find your urn, they can enslave you if they want, until you get it back. Or they kill you

name: Bunny God
overview: control every bunny on Earth
description: Bunny God gives you the power to control every bunny on Earth, including toys and dead ones. Only bunbun my toy bunny can withstand the effects and override your power for he is the true bunny god and maintains balance and order in the bunny universe.
pros: Make your toy bunny come to life
Win bunny competitions by getting your bunny to hop over the hurdles
cons: Not complete control

name: Frostbite
overview: give a bite that makes someone freeze
description: This power gives one the ability to bite someone and cause them to freeze.
pros: Can freeze people
Can instantly freeze them or slowly take your time
Their reaction time is slower
cons: No love bites
Watch out for who you are biting.
You might freeze yourself if you bite yourself (e.g. tongue).

name: Depreciating Touch
overview: make everything you touch less valuable.
description: This ability gives you the power to lower the value of anything you can touch. It works regardless of which place of business you use it in on any item displayed for sale. While the quality and durability of the item will be unaffected, to others it will appear to be in some intangible way subpar and of defective quality. The longer you are in contact with an object, the less valuable it becomes.
pros: Get insane deals on anything you could possibly want.
Resturants usually just throw out defective food, so you can eat for free!
The longer you occupy a house or apartment, the lower your rent becomes.
cons: You will never have a profitable garage sale.
Carrying around physical money will be a pointless exercise in futility (Digital money is fine)
You will realize the satisfaction of owning expensive things is nothing more than a hollow sham.

name: Forced Snake Head Hands
overview: turn other people's hands into snake heads and have complete control over the snake heads
description: With this power you can turn other people's hands into snake heads. The snakes have indestructible skin, sharp fangs and a poison tipped tongue. The snakes are also under your control so you can turn your enemy's hands into snake heads and then cause the snakes to bite your enemy, poisoning and eventually killing him. Additionally only you can turn the snakes back into hands.
pros: You can turn other people's hands into snake heads
You have complete control over the snake heads
Only you can turn the heads back into hands
cons: You cannot turn your own hands into snake heads

name: Name Dropping
overview: boost your other powers when someone says its name
description: Whenever someone names your superpower (besides you, of course) that power gets stronger! So, if you had super strength, you would get much stronger every time someone said 'super strength. '
pros: Major boosts to powers you already have.
Effects itself, making it double its own powers, thus doubling gains again.
Boost is temporary (see con 1)
cons: Involuntary, so if you had something that fed on your lifeforce it could get dangerous.
Requires other powers to be useful.
Boost is temporary

name: Ally Shift V2
overview: turn into any of your friends
description: With this power you can turn into any of your friends and if they have any you get all of their powers. You also retain all of your intelligence and personality. You can stay in ally mode for as long as you want.
pros: You can turn into any of your friends
You retain your intelligence level and personality
You can stay in ally mode for as long as you want
cons: You can only turn into people who are your friends

name: Mace Hand(S)
overview: turn your left hand and if you have enough practice your right hand into maces
description: With this power you can turn your hands into maces. You start off by only being able to turn your left hand into a mace but if you train a lot you will eventually be able to turn your right hand into one too
pros: You can turn your hands into maces
cons: If you're not a lefty the training process can be hard and annoying

name: Being: Blood Warrior
overview: transform into a blood warrior
description: Blood warriors are excepetional warriors made by Hades, they are Omni-creatures capable of becoming more and more powerful by every victim they absorb gaining all statistics and abilities then adding it to their own, having 2 blades for hands and 2 blades on their elbow,they can be fearsome opponents,however although being very intellectual they also absorb the sickness or disorder and even personality creating another split personality,this may cause insanity in the worst degree
pros: Become an Omni-Creature
Very smart
cons: May be absorbed by the transformation itself making you insane
Also absorb's sickness,disorders,personality etc.

name: Defense Action Detection
overview: sense when one of your powers is being used defensively,
description: A user of this power knows when one of their powers is being used defensively. Something hits their forcefield? They know where it was, what it was and how powerful it was. If invulnerable, they'll get all sorts of knowledge about bullets hitting them. If you are the "creator" of a group's defense, you will sense when they are taking damage.
pros: Using Pack Invulnerability (of your own creation), you can sense when an ally is attacked.
Get detailed information about threats being stopped by your powers, including their effectiveness.
Works for all powers used defensively.
cons: Provides no defense itself.
Useless without other powers.
You need to learn how to use the acquired information effectively.

name: Jewelakinesis
overview: make jewels come out of your mouth
description: Jewelakinesis is a pretty simple power.All you have to do is talk and soon your mouth will be filled with jewels. The size and value will depend on what you say. The more advanced the word, the the more valuable the jewel,and the louder the word, the bigger the jewel.
pros: Can have any jewel come out of your mouth
Instant money and wealth
"Superfragilisticexpialidocoius" wll get your college tuition
cons: Not a good idea to eat while talking
Also not a good idea to talk in front a large crowd of people
Will have to carry pencil and paper with you at all times

name: Demonic Contract
overview: make a contract with a demon when one is dying
description: When you are dying, you can summon a demon and sign a contract with them. The contract can have any terms either side wants but must be agreed on by both sides. The only conditions that cannot be changed are that you will be revived with your body at the prime of your life and that the demon will travel with you at all times. You cannot get god-like powers from this nor can the demon. You have five minutes to write up the contract and if neither side can agree, you die by aging rapidly.
pros: Can make whatever terms you want.
Revived from the brink of death at your body's best condition and have a 'bodyguard'.
Can get a load of powers.
cons: Both you and the demon must agree to the terms of the contract.
Must be dying in order to use and doesn't work with old age.
Have a time limit of five minutes to write up contract and sign it or you die.

name: Lyricopath
overview: memorize the lyrics of any song you hear
description: You can memorize the entire lyrics of a song after hearing it only once. After you've memorized a lyrics you never forget it. However, this does not make you sing better or more in tune. You just know all the words to every song you've ever heard. Unfortunately you can't forget songs.
pros: Know the words to all your favorite songs
Impress people with your ability to memorize lyrics
Sing along to any song
cons: You could hear a stupid song and you have to remember it forever
Some songs are annoying
You can't delete song lyrics from your head

name: A Gun That Shoots Guns
overview: own a gun that shoots other guns
description: You are given a gun that, instead of shooting bullets, materializes other guns out of thin air and launches them at several hundred mph. The type of gun it "shoots" is random, ranging from a tiny pistol to even a rocket launcher. The speed of guns launched range from 100-1000mph. The gun does not need ammunition, but the ones that it launches don't come with ammunition either. The gun itself must look like an actual firearm of your choice. There is no changing its appearance once you do.
pros: Sometimes the guns launched have bayonets at the end
Very hard to trace murders back to you
Very intimidating weapon , if your lucky the weapon that it launches survives impact for you to use
cons: If you shoot a large pile of guns and somehow drop it there it would be hard to find
If you miss your enemy, and he has ammunition, he can shoot one of the guns back at you
He could also charge at you with a bayoneted gun, if you miss and a gun lands close to him

name: Myth Power: Ganymedes' Gain
overview: channel Ganymedes' command over the essence of rain, the rain-cloud and homosexuality
description: Ganymedes (Ganymede), in Greek myth, was the god of rain, the rain cloud and (somewhat) homosexuality, as well as Cupbearer of the Gods. As such, channeling him allows one to induce, amplify, reduce, suppress or prevent rainfall at will. In addition, one can stand on clouds as if standing on solid ground. Furthermore, one can coalesce ambient moisture into a small cloud, on which one may stand and fly. One may even induce, amplify, reduce, redirect and negate homosexual affection/urges by touch.
pros: Induce, amplify, reduce, suppress or prevent rainfall at will; when developed, manipulate rainwater
Stand on clouds as though solid ground; form a cloud on which one can stand and ride
Induce, amplify, reduce, negate and withstand homosexuality (homosexual urges or affections) at will
cons: Cannot teleport self/others to rainy areas at will until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot perceive, communicate with, share senses with or compel homosexuals until the higher levels
Love/affection-based MythPowers provide immunity; may attract those with MythPower: Zeus' Zenith

name: Acid Breath
overview: melt thing with your breath
description: With this power you can melt anything with your breath
pros: Can make passageways by melting through walls
Can melt enemies
cons: Whenever you breathe through your mouth you melt things

name: Enhancement: Ghost Harming
overview: make a power harm ghosts instead of living beings
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power harm only ghosts and other astral beings. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: Can get rid of those pesky ghosts.
cons: Useless without another power.
Only allows harming ghosts.

name: Myth Power: Phrike's Fright
overview: channel Phrike's command over the essence of horror and shivering
description: Phrike, in Greek myth, was the goddess of horror and shivering, shuddering, trembling fear. As such, channeling her gifts one with a presence like a ghost's, which lowers the temperature in radius, and sends chills (of fear AND cold) up a subject's spine; the effect is amplified by touch. In addition, one can cast illusions to make oneself seem more frightening (taking on a demonic voice, monstrous facial features, etc) at will. One can even entirely withstand the effects of fear and cold.
pros: One has a cold, disturbing, ghost-like presence and touch (also makes ghosts less likely to attack)
Cast an illusion to make oneself sound or appear more scary/frightening
Withstand the effects of cold and fear; share Cold Immunity and Fear Immunity by touch
cons: Only summon, communicate with and compel horror story monsters/demons/killers at higher levels (NCN)
Only teleport self/others to and from a fictional horror universe at the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Phobos' Fear, MythPower: Deimos' Dread and the like provide immunity (NCN)

name: Cinderblock Fists
overview: turn your fists into cinderblocks
description: With this power you can turn your fists into cinderblocks and back whenever you want.
pros: You can turn your fists into cinderblocks
cons: Any damage sustained in cinderblock mode is transferred over to hand mode

name: Angry Birds
overview: have an unlimited amout of any kind of Angry Bird to launch at people
description: With this power you have an unlimited amount of evey kind of angry bird from the game Angry Birds, and its various spinoffs. When you use this power a small one way portal opens up and shoots out as many of any kind of angry bird as you want. After the birds are launched from the portal, a remote with different buttons (one for each kind of angry bird) appears in your hand and pushing the button will activate the birds' special power (speed, exploding, multiplying). you can send them back later.
pros: You have an unlimited amount of angry birds
You can keep them for as long as you want
You can send them back later
cons: The portal only works on angry birds so you cannot go through it
Only works on angry birds from the games and spinoffs, not any bird that is angry
The birds can be killed

name: Myth Power: Pistis' Promise
overview: channel Pistis' command over the essence of faith, trust and belief
description: Pistis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of faith, trust and belief. As such, channeling her allows one to say nearly anything to nearly anyone and be believed; even when subjects know (or discover) one is lying, one will never lose the trust of those subjects. In addition, belief in oneself and one's allies will allow oneself and one's allies to work at peak physical and mental capacity. One can even psychically deal pain and/or injury, by touch, to those who lose (or do not have) one's trust.
pros: Say nearly anything to nearly anyone, and be believed; never lose others' trust when caught lying
Believing in self/others allows self/others to work at peak physical/mental capacity
Psychically deal pain and/or injury, by touch, to those who lose (or do not have) one's trust
cons: Some people are not trusting; others are not trustworthy
Cannot harm subjects, by touch, who verbalize beliefs different from one's own until developed (NCN)
Cannot use one's faith for reality/probability-defying stunts until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Virus: Virobacteriosis
overview: release a virus that causes symptoms of every disease to pop up randomly
description: The user of this ability is gifted indeed. The virus released is properly called Virobacteriosis-itis Syndrome Disorder, and when it is released, no living thing may resist it. Combined with animal viruses, plant viruses and synthetic viruses (including the Legacy virus, for those of you familiar with X-men), it causes the afflicted to randomly display symptoms of every disease present on that planet. The effects last for typically a week, although, as the power develops, it goes up to a month.
pros: Release a virus that transcends species
Make foes suffer symptoms of every disease known to man
Release and alleviate the virus at will
cons: Computers aren't living, so they just glitch up, and become really susceptible to malware/viruses
Plants don't display emotion, so emotional disorders just make them change color
Aliens may die from this virus (immune system not as effective against earth diseases/viruses)

name: 1000 Needles
overview: shoot 1000 deadly needles from your back to your enemies.
description:
With this ability you can shoot exactly 1000 needles at once from your back towards your enemies.
These needles are poisonous and deadly.
The needles aren't homing and can only shoot 1000 at any one time. The bonus is there s not pain felt by use of this ability.
pros: Needles are poisonous and instantly kill enemies.
Needles shoot out all at once and consecutively.
You feel no pain when using this ability.
cons: Can only shoot from your back.
Can only shoot 1000 needles at any one time.
Needles are not homing.

name: Toy Soldier Affect
overview: turn anyone into a harmless toy
description: This power is much similar to the Toy-gun Affect, except instead of turning weapons into toys you can turn people or animals into toys. The power lasts for one hour, and while the person is a toy, you can hear them talking in your thoughts. However, you have to touch the person (with your hands, not touching them by spitting on them) in order to turn them into a toy.
pros: Turn anyone into a toy.
Also fun for the whole family XD
cons: You have to touch them in order for it to work, and not with something like your spit.
Only stays as a toy for 1 hour before changing back
You could get a major headache from hearing all the 'toyified' people talking at once

name: Summon Darana
overview: summon an battle-designed Kystian.
description: Darana look like 15 foot tall hybrids of rhinos and armadillos. A darana can lift 500 tons. A darana is summoned with a weapon that might or might not be dangerous to you if fired near you. A darana can run 20 mph and has a below average IQ. Its claws will go through admantinium like it was paper.
pros: A darana can lift 500 tons.
It can rip/dig/tunnel through through practically any material.
cons: A darana could be armed with a weapon that could hurt you indirectly.
Below average IQ

name: Myth Power: Underworld Assault1
overview: channel the hellacious power of the Greek Myth Underworld's first level, Erebus
description: The Underworld, in Greek myth, was composed of three levels. The first was Erebus. As such, channeling the realm of Erebus, one can banish foes to a world of blinding darkness. Inhabitants include superhuman shadow beings that can only die in the light. However, all light in Erebus is overtaken by infernal shadow, so foes are subject to unnamed terrors, concealed by the gloom. In addition, one may open a portal at will, so this darkness, and its inhabitants, can be brought to the mortal realm.
pros: Banish foes to a realm of blinding darkness, impenetrable by mortal light
It is inhabited by shadow beings, indestructible by anything but light
Generate a portal to unleash shadow beings and darkness from Erebus (like fog) into the mortal realm
cons: Cannot free spirits of the dead from Erebus; Divine Essence penetrates Erebus Dark (no Con Negation)
People with death/underworld/necromantic based MythPowers are immune to this ability
People with law, order and justice based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Albino Control V2
overview: control albino animals and give them powers
description: With this power you can control all white animals. You can also give them enhanced agility, strength and the power to fly.
pros: You can control albino animals
You can give them powers
cons: If their are no albino animals near you it might take them a while to get to you
They cna only fly if they are birds

name: Focus Trade
overview: trade attention spans with people
description: Someone with this power can effectively switch attention spans with someone else. For example, if the user has ADD and switches with someone else, the other person will focus less and have the symptoms of ADD. This can be similar to giving someone a coffee break. If you are tired and switch attention spans with someone else, then you can concentrate on your work for a little longer as long as the person with whom you swapped is still awake.
pros: You can pay attention longer
You can make people pay less attention by swapping their attention spans
You don't need coffee
cons: You will be hated for taking away other people's focus
Trading attention spans does not give you more physical strength or more physical stamina
You still need to sleep or else your brain will overwork itself

name: Gift: Food
overview: be gifted at food-based powers
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at using food-based powers than other beings. Thus their food-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of food from them. However, someone with this power can only receive food-based powers, nothing else.
pros: Almost no one has as good control over food as someone with this power.
Food-based powers are boosted slightly.
cons: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only food-based powers now.

name: Venom Spirit
overview: control a venomous spirit.
description: You can control the venom spirit from every part of your body for instant, if you want to poison something trhough your breath a black and green light will come out of your mouth and poison whatever you want.  You can also set the spirit free for some time but you might not be able to control him.
pros: You can poison every single byological thing that existes.
The venom spirit will protect you even in your sleep or when something unnexpected attacks you.
Drinking poison will boost the spirit power.
cons: You'll only get some control of this spirit after you reach 16 years old.
Before you can control him he will free himself and attack whatever he wants to.
Even when you reach 16 it's unlikly that you'll control him when you temporarly free him.

name: Always Thinking V2
overview: constantly think about a problem until you discover the solution
description: With this power, whenever you are given a question or problem you will constantly be working on it in your mind until you come to a solution or are given a new question.
pros: You will constantly be thinking about a problem until you reach an answer
You cannot get distracted
cons: Not much use in physical combat
You are not able to think about anything else until you come to a solution

name: Super Massage
overview: massage bones back into place
description: Why worry about out-of-place joints, with this ability, you could pop bones without a lot of pressure. All you would do is rub the joint and it would pop itself. Wow, what an ability to have in case one your joints go out of place.  At least you be safe.
pros: Paying less for hospital bills.
Never needing a chiropractor.
Able to heal yourself.
cons: An invasion of your privacy.
People bothering you about all their ailments.
Being unable have alone time.

name: The Barrier Before Gods
overview: peek at anything addressed to gods and stop it.
description: Whenever you want, you can act like a passage for anything that is addressed to a deity by humans. You will know what it is and the choice is entirely yours to let it through or not. Once it's through, you cannot take it back though. Basically, you can prevent prayers from reaching gods or interrupt someone before they channel a god's power or before they summon one.
pros: Prevent prayers from reaching gods.
Prevent someone from summoning a god.
Prevent someone from channeling the powers of a god.
cons: You need to activate this power to know when someone is trying to contact a god.
If you let it through, it's too late to come back on your decision.

name: Gender Switch
overview: switch between genders
description: This ability allows you to change from boy to girl, and vice versa. Ever wonder why(If you already) your not popular, then maybe you'd be popular if you were the opposite gender of your own. Maybe.
pros: You may be popular.
Wonder what you would look like as a girl/boy.
cons: You may be disapointed with your other form.
You may be disturbed by your other body.
You may not like being popular

name: Death Replay
overview: have a person who died before, die again instantly
description: A person with this power can send anyone who died back to their point of death to die again then transport them back dead. The effect is instantaneous, the target is dead on both times and no change to the time frame has occured. The transported corpse is in the same condition as when they were facing you so their items will still be there. People who have died before they became immortal can be killed by this power since it kills them when they were mortal, thus this works on zombies as well.
pros: People who come back to life will die again
This can work on undead as well zombies will die the way they were killed and come back dead
You can set it to work indefinitely to kill people that can instantly resurrect
cons: The person had to be dead before
This cannot stop those with immortality unless they died before being immortal

name: Stubborn Mind Curse
overview: make anyone's mind so inflexible, they can't understand a speech or text if there's a mistake.
description: You can alter anyone's mind to make it so rigid they can't understand any speech or sentence if there's a grammatical or orthographical mistake in it. Their mind just can't do the gymnastics to interpret the mistake and read the correct word or just figure out the gist. They also can't read upside down or backwards. The upside is they will never make any mistakes when they write or speak.
pros: Corntray to the rscheearch, it deos mttaer to tehm in waht oredr the ltteers in a wrod are.
They can't make head or tail of "10 items or less" and similar anomalies.
They would have so much trouble with SMS language.
cons: Too bad George W. Bush isn't the president anymore. It would have been so troublesome.
They would become spelling bee champions.

name: Shiver Point
overview: cause people to shiver uncontrollably
description: With this power you can cause people to shiver uncontrollably just by pointing at them. The person will continue to shiver as long as you point at them and will not be able to stop until you stop pointing at them.
pros: You can cause people to shiver by pointing at them
cons: They stop shivering when you stop pointing

name: Sand Sculptor
overview: be a master sand sculptor
description: With this power you have amazing skills at sculpting things out of sand. This power includes but is not limited to creating sand castles and fortresses and whatnot.
pros: You are amazing at creating things out of sand
You can use this power to win money from sand castle building competitions
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Sixth Amendment
overview: get justice
description: Whenever any crimes pertaining to you, i.e. you committed the crime, or someone you know did it, or you were robbed or something, your version of justice will be immediately set into action.
pros: If you are right
cons: If you are wrong

name: Crodo: Gravity Coil
overview: weild a gravity coil.
description: Gravity coil's are items that make you jump higher; just put your arm through it and the effect activates.
pros: Jump higher.
cons: The weapon has the ability,not you.

name: Bustance
overview: cause something to grow so massively that it busts
description: 1. You have to actually be able to see what you are busting.  2. The process may take a while depending on the size of the object.  3. Try not to bust yourself.
pros: You can destroy anything in your way
Can cause things to bust for fun
Your own fireworks!
cons: Takes a while so you might get beat up if using it during battle
You cannot deflate what you've inflated
You can't just inflate an object when you use the powers. It goes until it busts

name: Condition Change: Pain
overview: make a power require pain in order to work
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation so that the power can only be used when the user feels pain of any kind. The amount of pain affects how much power can be used. This power is tactile.
pros: Watch your opponent cutting themself and laugh.
cons: Fighting a masochist.
You have to touch them.
Emotional pain counts for this power.

name: Myth Power: Underworld Assault3
overview: channel the hellacious power of the Greek Myth Underworld's third level, Tartarus
description: The Underworld, in Greek myth, was composed of three levels. The third was Tartarus. As such, channeling the realm of Tartarus, one can banish foes to a world of storms and chaos. The storms are unruly, and vastly worse than in the mortal world. The landscape is inhabited by the worst of criminals... Including the Titans themselves. However, a still worse fate awaits. Should one ever be chased into the right area, they may well be caught up into a monster's grasp, tossed into an unending abyss.
pros: Banish foes to a realm of stormy chaos, where weather is more intense than normal
It is inhabited by criminals of all kinds, including various evil spirits and the Titans
Good chance the foe will end up tossed into a bottomless pit, doomed to fall for eternity
cons: Cannot free spirits of the dead from Tartarus (no Con Negation)
People with death/underworld/necromantic based MythPowers are immune to this ability
People with law, order and justice based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Likeability
overview: like anything you want
description: You know that stinky smell that comes from your neighbor? With this power, you can decide (permanently) that you like it, to the point that you are crazy about it. This also works in a reverse fashion, allowing you to decide (again permanently) that you don't like something.
pros: Have no hates and grudges
Helps with self control
cons: If you accidentally activate it, you may find that you are crazy about drugs or other bad things

name: Meat Eatingu
overview: have a faster healing rate after eating meat
description: After eating meat your healing rate will speed up but only enough that the meat you ate heals an area equal to what it fills. Ex: Eat a chicken leg and you can heal wounds equal to that chicken leg's size or eat a human's leg and you can regenerate your own leg.
pros: You can regenerate from horrible wounds.
Mortal wounds aren't so bad anymore.
cons: People will think you're evil if you go cannibalistic.

name: Enhancement: Extra Loud
overview: make a sound-based power louder by attaching this power to it
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it increases the volume of sound for the power. Maximum increase is 400%. This enhancement only works for powers that control or use sound. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This can only be attached to one power at a time.
pros: Deafen your enemies.
Make yourself heard all the time with the right powers.
cons: Useless witout another power.
Might not want a power to be really loud.
Sound-based powers only.

name: Idiot Minion Field
overview: turn all evil human minions/henchpersons into klutzy morons.
description: This power turns minions or henchpersons into klutzy morons. The radius is one mile. A sniper henchman won't be able shoot you as he'll forget the gun safety is on. Henchmen with guns will shoot themselves in the feet. Sneak into a foe's lair and just keep telling each henchman or minion that sees you,"I'm the janitor" or "I'm your boss disguised as my worst enemy. "
pros: The mile radius of the power should cover most villain bases.
A power that makes henchmen forget to check if the gun safety is on.
cons: Some villains have non-human minions.
Klutzy and dumb people get lucky and kill someone by mistake.

name: Weapon Strike: Firestorm Ops
overview: summon a Missile strike.
description: If you have seen Transformers 2, you saw the missile strike "Operation Firestorm" (right before Megatron killed Sam). With this power you can summon that strike shot. It's power can wipe out a Toys r us shop, and have enough missiles to wipe the parking lot.
pros: Missile strike
Toys r us's are big,
cons: Full effect is only achieved if you use all of your missiles
Collateral damage

name: Myth Power: Matton's Menu
overview: channel Matton's command over the essence of kneading bread, baking and eating
description: Matton (Daites, Daiton, Daton), in Greek myth, was the god of kneading bread, baking and eating. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and summon breads at will, as well as gaining skill in baking. In addition, one can superheat matter by touch; this same touch can also turn matter into bread; combined, the effects turn matter into baked bread. Furthermore, one can gain physical power from eating food (healthy is better). One can even knead matter like bread dough, by touch.
pros: Psychically perceive and summon bread at will; gain skill in baking (bread, pastries, etc)
Superheat matter (or turn it to bread) by touch; combined, turn matter into baked bread
Gain physical power from eating; knead matter like bread dough in one's hands, by touch
cons: Cannot eat infinitely until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the hungry until the higher levels (NCN)
Agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Guitar Shock
overview: shoot lightning bolts out of any guitar
description: With this power you can fight crime while bringing music to the world. All you have to do is, point you guitar at your target and say "Shock." A lightning bolt will shoot out of your guitar at the target.
pros: Can fight crime while playing your guitar
cons: It happens whenever you say the word shock and you're holding a guitar
Only works with a guitar (violins and banjos will not work)

name: Eye Orbs
overview: create giant protective orbs from ones eye.
description: Imagine an eyeball, nerves and all. Now Imagine that eye 2 to 1000 times larger, & translucent. Pretty creepy huh? This power allows you to do just that. You can take out your eyeball, use this power and you have a giant eye shield. Or an eye bowling ball that you can manipulate by moving your other eye.
pros: If you have the 1000 Eyes power
Can create giant eyeball shield
Can float by standing in it
cons: Not many offensive capabilities.
Unless you have other eye related superpowers
Look creepy missing an eye

name: Enhancement: Sharp
overview: make a power physically sharper by attaching this power
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it makes the physical part of the power as sharp as the highest quality katana. An ordinary katana by the way can cut through a medieval European suit of armor really easily. If stolen this power permanently affects the power it is attached to, and  this power is given to the ability thief. Can only be attached to one power at a time.
pros: Sharper powers. Sharp Hair Blades!
A katana can cut through a lot.
Still have power if stolen, kind of.
cons: Useless without another power.
Useful only for powers with edges.
One power at a time.

name: Television Precognition
overview: know when a new episode of a series will air on TV
description: This ability allows you to know when a new episode of a series will come out even before the TV network announces it. This works for any TV series, in any country, in any language. All you have to do is concentrate on your chosen TV series and your power does the rest. It's also quite precise. You get the year, date and even time it will air.
pros: You never have to wonder when your fave series will be on
You have a TV guide in your head
You will know in advance if a show is cancelled
cons: You have to know the full name of the series
You can only concentrate on one at a time

name: The Monkey's Paw
overview: turn into the monkey's paw
description: When you use this power, you turn into a monkey's paw, and just the paw. You can then feel your way around but you can't smell, see or taste; only feel and hear. As the monkey's paw, you automatically make any wish you hear come true!
pros: Hiding is easier.
Record your wishes and make them come true!
cons: Must grant other people's wishes.

name: Myth Power: Fertility Force2
overview: channel Priapus' companions' command over the essence of fertility
description: The phallic companions of Priapus, in Greek myth, were the gods of fertility. As such, channeling Conisalus (Conisalos, Konisalos, Gigon- sexual vigor; perspiration during intercourse), one can psychically increase one's own stamina, as long as one's mind is concentrated on sexual thoughts. In addition, one can psychically convert foes' exerted effort into sexual pleasure, to distract them from functioning, by touch. One can even psychically absorb superhuman powers through intercourse, at will.
pros: Psychically increase one's stamina by concentrating on sexual thoughts
Psychically convert foes' exerted effort into sexual pleasure (distract them), by touch
Psychically absorb superhuman abilities though sexual intercourse, at will
cons: Pro #1 does not also increase strength and durability, until developed (NCN)
Pro #2 requires touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot just MIMIC powers via sexual intercourse (Pro #3 leaves lover helpless) until developed (NCN)

name: God Phone V5
overview: summon any of the ancient Chinese Gods and Goddesses
description: With this power you can summon any of the ancient Chinese Gods and Goddesses. They are not under your control but if you have a good enough reason for calling them they may help you, if not they'll probably destroy you. You can only send them back if they want to be sent back.
pros: You can summon any of the Chinese Gods and Goddesses
They might help you if you have a good enough reason for summoning them
cons: They might destroy you
They might not help you
They are not under your control

name: Tooth Bullets
overview: shoot your teeth out of your mouth.
description: With this power you can shoot your teeth out of your mouth at high speed, as though they were fired from a gun. They can be shot individually, or all at once like a shotgun blast. Shooting teeth is not painful, and a perfectly new tooth grows back almost immediately.
pros: Shoot out cavities to be replaced with new teeth.
Have a weapon you can carry anywhere, with effectivly unlimited ammo.
cons: Make sure to smile wide when you shoot so the teeth don't shred your lips.
If you don't take care of your bullets they become weaker.

name: Snowcat
overview: transform into a snowcat.
description: A snowcat is a enclosed-cab, truck-sized, fully tracked vehicle designed to move on snow. It's treads are designed to move across soft ground such as snow or peat bog easily. The cap is very well heated and warm. They are usually filled with a plow on the front because they're commonly used for maintaining ski trails.   While in snowcat form, your front windshield acts as your eyes (good because they're designed to not ice up) and your numbed to the cold. You also don't need gasoline to run.
pros: Turn into a big vehicle.
Shelter people from the cold with your heated interior.
Easily cross snow.
cons: Not the fasted vehicles, snowcats.

name: Arcana 13: Death
overview: take an early death.
description: At any point in time, you may die. Upon your death, you become an intangible, invisible spirit creature and maintain all of your normal powers. At any time following your death, you may chose to return to a physical life. Your new body is any age of your choosing. However, your new body is always slightly different from your old one, with variations in appearance, ethnicity and even gender. You may also suffer from mental changes, though you maintain your basic personality.
pros: You can avoid attacks by simply dying.
Death is mostly an inconvience for you.
You can spy on or enter contained areas as a spirit.
cons: While in spirit form, abilities and attacks that affect spirits or souls will affect you.
Using this ability often can result in extreme changes in physical form and personality.
You may have difficulty with psychopomps and other creatures of death.

name: Fickle Genie
overview: summon a genie that will grant 3 wishes out of 1000.
description: This power allows the user to summon a genie that will grant the user three of their wishes. However, you will not be able to simply make three wishes. You will need to make 1000 different wishes of the genie, of which it will choose three at random to grant.   Anyone you allow may use the genie, but only one person may use the genie at once. You can not have 1000 different people each make one individual wish. Likewise, you can not cheat by wishing for different increments of one thing.
pros: The genie is all powerful, and will always grant three of your wishes.
cons: Long start up time. You must repeat 1000 wishes to the genie for every three it grants.
Some people may not have that many wishes.
Every wish must be different.

name: Vampire Ring
overview: call for a ring that turns you into a vampire and summon vampires to you
description: The ring possesses people. The first person who puts on the ring turns into a vampire. They can never take it off. They are given the powers of immortality, bringing other vampires to them and controlling them, shape-shifting, super strength and gaining power when they drink blood. However, it makes the wearer completely insane.
pros: Control other vampires
Immortality
Shape-shifting
cons: Go completely insane
Can never take it off

name: Forced Crocodiling
overview: force someone to use their native language when they speak.
description: This power requires you to concentrate on someone to use this power on them. Someone affected by this power will only be able to speak in their native language. If they have more than one native language, they will use a random one among the ones they know. Don't underestimate this power's might! It is common to have someone use another language when they want to tell something secret to someone when other people are watching.
pros: Expose secrets when people are using an other language than their native one to tell secrets.
Make someone's in-laws believe they're talking behind their back when they use their mother tongue.
Offend Esperantists by having one of their own "crocodile" during an esperantist convention.
cons: Not much use if the targeted person only knows their native language.
Not much use if the targeted person uses their native language everytime.
Not much use if the targeted person doesn't want to speak.
tags: was edited as it was not really a superpower

name: Enhancement:  Light
overview: make a super power's creations feel lighter
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power's creations feel lightier. This is accomplished by decreasing the general effects of gravity. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is enhanced permanently.
pros: Less effort to move something your power creates.
cons: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.
Weaker hits if you throw the creation.

name: Folie A Deux
overview: share your mental disorders with anyone who probes your mind.
description: This power doesn't protect you from mind readers, but they sure would take a huge risk violating your mind, especially if you have a severe mental illness. Every time someone pokes into your brain for too long, this power kicks in and uses the opening they made into your psyche to alter theirs, reproducing every mental disorder you have. It works even better if they struggle to make sense of your mind. This power won't work if your mental illness is healed or negated by another power.
pros: You can make mind readers crazy, stressed, depressed, delusional, paranoid, etc.
The longer they take to read your mind, the more likely this power will suceed.
cons: You need to suffer from a mental illness yourself.
You can't affect someone who sporadically reads your mind.
Only mental disorders recognized by the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM).

name: Red Paper Clip
overview: detect and create a chain of trades within a fairly large radius
description: A person with this power can instinctively sense what people need and what they have within a fairly large radius. After activating this power you focus on an object you want then a map will form in your head to conduct the trades. In addition the trades would be mutually beneficial so you don't need to feel guilty about it. For example, you can trade a laser pointer to a rich man who desperately needs it for a meeting and get a huge cash reward. Then it turns out that pen made him more money.
pros: Go from something unwanted to something amazing.
Become rich.
Fairly large radius with which to apply this power---can cover most large cities.
cons: The objects you trade for can get stolen.
Making a mistake can get you something of lesser value.
Does not account for travelling expenses.

name: Compendium O Useless Knowledge
overview: know every useless fact in the universe.
description: You simply know every random fact in the universe. The speed of glacier degradation in the arctic, the mating call of the African Water Buffalo, how to speak a language so old that no remnants of it are available in modern history, and so much more. But none of it is worth anything in present day life.
pros: You just KNOW random facts.
The knowledge is automatic, and requires no activation
Finally, you know what the word "floccinaucinihilipilification' means!
cons: You don't know any useful facts, just useless ones.
Knowing the innermost thoughts of the creepy cat lady down the street
Knowing what slugs think about being sprinkled with salt, isn't very useful in a fight

name: The Never Blink
overview: control when people blink
description: Torture your enemies by preventing them from blinking as long as you want. Watch their eyes water and become dry as they beg you for mercy! You can't blink either without breaking the effecting.
pros: Cause severe eye damage to your enemies
Bring the strongest to their knees
cons: Have to stare into the eyes of the victim

name: Delete This Volcano Uppercut
overview: rise up in the air and deliver an uppercut with an illusion of magma flowing through it.
description: It is a special maneuver, performed by you, that lifts your opponents up with a powerful awesome blow with an illusion of magma around your fist.
pros: It doesn't burn them, but rather knocks them out hard.
cons: a fight combo is not a power

name: Condition Change: Body
overview: make a power require being used on one's own body in order to work
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that it can only be used on the user's physical body. The arms, legs, tail, wings, and head(s) are not defined by this power as part of the body. This power will not affect a power already affected by another Condition Change that requires a different body part. This power is tactile.
pros: Now all you have to do is avoid getting hit with anything from the body.
cons: Have to touch the opponent and each touch affects only one power.
An opponent with multiple powers.

name: Demonic Weaponry: Namazu
overview: possess a piece of armor with geokinetic attributes
description: Namazu in myth was a giant catfish who could summon earthquakes. You now possess Namazu's arm guard, one made of metal and scales, with a catfish emblem on it. While wearing these you command the earth, and can even summon earthquakes.
pros: Command earth
Summon earthquakes
cons: Hard to control
Will devour your soul if overused

name: Alien Control V2
overview: control aliens no matter where they are in the universe
description: With this power you can have complete control over aliens no matter how far away they are from Earth. You can cause them to come to you but if they are very far away from you it will take them a very long time to get to you so you're better off taking control of aliens that are close to you.
pros: You can take control over all aliens
cons: If they're far away it will take them a long time to get to you

name: Monotissue Morph
overview: turn your entire body into one type of tissue or one part of your body.
description: You remain bipedal but can become all heart muscle, skin, eyeballs,etc. You can still see and hear. You're all eyes(360 degree sight),all lung and you can't be strangled. Solid heart muscle and you have extra toughness. Of course each form has a weakness. Blinded easier,you can't hold your breathe against gases and a giant heart is going to be easier to hear.
pros: Each tissue-morph or organ-morph will have a unique advantage.
cons: Each form has a unique weakness.

name: 5 Faces Of Darkness V2
overview: turn into a Quintesson from the Shattered Glass Universe
description: With this power you can turn into a Shattered Glass Quintesson, you can change your form at will, can summon all kinds of alien technologies. You can also make peace with any alien species.
pros: You can turn into a Shattered Glass Quintesson
You can change your form at will
You can make peace with any alien species
cons: You can't turn into positive universe Quintessons

name: Zeakinesis
overview: mentally manipulate grains
description: One with this ability has full control over gains, such as, cereal, caryopsis, grasses. One with this ability only, but does not have full, Plant Manipulation; being that one only controls a certain type(s). One would have a huge advantage in areas such as wheat fields, but other than that, one has little use of this power.
pros: Control a whole field, which can be miles.
Grains are abundant
cons: Being in an area not having grains.
Not Plant Manipulation.

name: Green Man
overview: change anything into an eco-friendly alternative.
description: You are the ultimate ecologist. When you touch something, you will be able to change it in some way that makes it eco-friendly! You can change a gasoline powered car into an electrically powered car, or an oil drilling plant into a wind farm! This ability works especially well on things that harm the environment, but it does apply to anything you can touch.
pros: You can help save the world!
And cut down on gas prices!
cons: Not much use in combat
Must be able to touch your target

name: Attach!
overview: attach two things that were separated.
description: In order to use this power you must point out to the two objects you want to attach and say ATTACH! After doing this, the objects will fly one to each other. If one of the objects cannot move, only the other will.  While flying, the objects cannot be stopped, once they are united they cannot be separated unless you say so or with extreme strength.
pros: You can attach people or living beings.
You can move anything regardless of size or weight.
You can also attach yourself to anything.
cons: Attaches can only be made in pairs.
Attached objects are not unseparable.
Need to point and south in order to use the power.

name: Panontic Arch: Xichia
overview: gain powers from the Xichia dimension.
description: Xichia, the dimension of cosmic killers. The first power is to keep dead anyone you killed directly. Shot, stabbed, laser eye blast, etc. Bullets count. Grenades and bombs don't. Death traps don't count either. A death caused by this power can't be undone or reversed. Divine beings and those who have a power to come back to life are unaffected by this power. The second power is to come back to life if killed unless you were killed by someone with the first power.
pros: A power to revive yourself from the dead.
Non-divine foes and those who can't come back to life will avoid you.
If you were a divine being and had an already existing resurrection ability.
cons: The first part of this power cancels out the second part.

name: Full Metal Alchemist: Alphonse
overview: have the abilities of Alphonse in Full Metal Alchemist.
description: The ability to be bound to an object, such as controlling a TV by giving up your body to inhabit the TV. One with mastery of this ability could create bodies and have control over them.
pros: Take over an object.
cons: One body at a time.
Like Alphonse you could lose your body.
Only with mastery you can create bodies.

name: Intelligent Super Panda Summon
overview: summon a super smart panda who want to become a superhero
description: With this power you can summon a super smart panda who wants to become a superhero. In addition to being super smart the panda has super strength, really sharp claws and teeth, can eat though almost anything and enhanced agility. The panda is not under your control but if you're a good guy he will help you because he wants to be a superhero. However if somebody calls the panda a bear or a panda bear the panda will go berserk and try to kill them. Also if the panda dies you lose this power.
pros: You can summon a super smart superhero wannabe panda
He has some other cool skills
He'll help you if you're a good guy
cons: If somebody calls him a bear he will go berserk and try to kill them
If he dies you lose this power unless you figure out how to bring him back to life
You cannot unsummon him

name: Myth Power: Astra Planeta2
overview: channel the Astra Planeta and their command over the essence of the planets
description: The Astra Planeta (Astra, Asteres) in Greek myth, were the gods of the five Wandering Stars (Planets). As such, channeling Phosphoros (Eosphoros, Hesperos, Aphrodition - Planet Venus) allows one to fly, as well as gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Venus. In addition, one can psychically generate an aura mimicking Venusian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will. One even gains favor with Venus' patron, Aphrodite, to resist and benefit from her domains (love, charm, beauty, etc).
pros: Gain flight; gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Venus (physical change voluntary)
Psychically generate an aura mimicking Venusian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will
Gain favor with Venus' patron goddess, Aphrodite; resist and benefit from her domains
cons: Cannot teleport self to Venus at will (others by touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate Venus-patterned forcefield (or project Pro #2 onto others) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia and sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Four Eyes: Aura Changer
overview: absorb auras through all of one's eyes and transform into the aura's source
description: This power is gained by using the aura seeing part of the Four Eyes power. The Four Eyes power will slowly turn into this power. Whenever you have all of your eyes immersed in an aura, you absorb a tiny bit. This allows you to transform into that person at will. You can mix and match parts, but you cannot use superhuman powers or memories that they have.
pros: Can transform and mix and match at will.
You can still use the other Four Eyes powers.
This is an evolved form of Four Eyes.
cons: Must have Four Eyes power and use the aura seeing most of the time.
Must have all four eyes in the aura.
You cannot get the other Four Eyes evolutions anymore.

name: G1 Trypticon's Transformation
overview: turn into a city
description: With this power, you can turn into a city just like the giant Decepticon Citybot Trypticon. In city mode, you act like a normal city, albeit a smaller one that you can use as a storage for your things or a hideout for your allies and friends. You can still speak in city mode and you have a defense mode, meaning you can have lasers sprout out of every building and giant walls rise up from the ground. Note: when you turn back to human mode, the items you were storing vanish until you turn back.
pros: You can store stuff or help your allies hide in your city mode
You can shoot lasers from your buildings
You can still speak to the people and see what is going on in your city mode
cons: You cannot turn back to human mode if you're in defense mode
You can't turn back when you have people inside you

name: Summon Slitskin
overview: summon a half-alive wormlike thing.
description: A slitskin looks like a 30-foot-long earthworm made from twisted flesh. Slitskins instinctively hate anything not half-alive. A slitskin lacks any intelligence. You can only unsummon it. Slitskins are strong enough to break through 20-foot thick concrete walls. Nothing will hurt them. A slitskin's skin is constantly splitting open and sealing itself. The only way to kill one is to stop the healing (it falls apart). Stopping the splitting will unsummon it.
pros: A good power for a desperate situation.
The threat of using this power may be enough to win.
cons: You're in a situation bad enough to have to use this power.

name: Cement
overview: glue people to the ground with cement
description: With this power you can project balls of cement that explode upon impact at your enemies feet. This will glue them to the ground or any other surfaces
pros: Glue your enemies to any surface
cons: The cement is not invincible and can be broken

name: Emergency Weapons Lender
overview: summon the kystian weapon trader in an emergency.
description: In an emergency, the kystian weapon trader will lend you one weapon for everyone on your side in a fight. The weapons won't require ammo and will be idiot-proof to use. The weapons will vanish back to Kyst when they are no longer needed. The weapons will also vanish if any of them fall into the hands of your foes. A long drawn out fight will trigger one of the kyst emergency powers.
pros: Need to arm 100 henchmen with blaster rifles? No problem.
You summon the weapon trader, Kyst doesn't.
cons: If there's a disagreement over the definition of emergency.

name: Summon Femt Cloud
overview: summon a mistlike cloud of femtoscopic kystians.
description: Femts. Look like teenage sisters of nans. Femts are a million times smaller nans and a cloud numbers in the octillions. Femts can take matter apart but can also make AB matter. AB matter has properties a million times stronger than normal matter. Heat conductivity is actually more than a million. AB matter is unaffected by temperatures high as 10 billion degrees. Tensile strength and material hardness would be a million times stronger. A femt cloud moves at 5 mph.
pros: A exotic matter battle suit could be build for you.
This power is the closest thing to actual femtotechnology.
cons: Femts have the same weakness as nans and pyks.

name: Bugger Armada
overview: summon the Buggers from the Ender's Game series
description: SPOILERS for anyone who has not read the book: With this power you can summon the Buggers from Ender's Game. You can summon as many as you want, but you have to summon a Hive Queen first, as the Buggers operate on a hive mind and are controlled by the Hive Queen (which is under your control). You can summon and unsummon them as you please.
pros: You can summon the Buggers
They are under your control
cons: They can be killed
They're apparently pretty scary

name: Unillamas
overview: summon giant one horned llamas
description: With this power you can summon up to 30 Unillamas. Unillamas are basically giant llamas that have one horn on their heads. They have enhanced speed and strength and the horn can pierce almost any material. The Unillams also have super spit that can blind people if it hits them in the eye. The Unillamas are under your complete control and you can unsummon them whenever you want.
pros: You can summon up to 30 Unillamas that are under your complete control
They are super strong and fast and their horn can pierce through almost anything
Their super spit can blind people
cons: They can be killed
They eat a lot

name: Oxygen Store : Iron Smash
overview: tranfer iron into a part of the body.
description: Special breathing puts oxygen into sacs in the cells of your body, to store for later. This is important, because the next part of the power will stop them from getting some of the oxygen they need. The haemoglobin in your blood gives up its iron, and sends it to whatever body part you want. The part of the body turns grey and heavy. You may have an iron fist, able to smash most objects or bad guys. And every special breath you do, you gain 1 hour of no-breathing.
pros: Every time you breathe in to fill the sacs, you gain an extra hour of holding your breath.
Iron fist, iron foot, iron chest, iron head, etc.
Reversible, so your body return to normal after the oxygen reserves have been used up.
cons: Your body part isn't made of iron, it's just iron mixed in with it. It's still partially vulnerable.
No full iron body, requires too much iron.
Normal breathing won't fill the sacs to full potential; It's a breathing that needs concentration.

name: Blindness
overview: cause blindness
description: You will be able make people go blind for a month. The only thing is you have to look at them in the eye for the power to work.
pros: Make your enemies go blind for a month
cons: Only lasts for a month
Have to have eye to eye contact
Have to be careful not blind your allies

name: Victor Frankenstein Knowledge
overview: have access to all the knowledge of Victor Frankenstein.
description: Victor Frankenstein is the legendary scientist that brought to life what would be known as Frankenstein's monster. You gain his masterful knowledge of science, particularly in chemistry and anatomy. Along with his vast knowledge you gain an understanding of the secret of animation. You can create life from corpses or parts of corpses by running any electrical current through the corpse.
pros: Knowledge of chemistry and anatomy.
Gain the secret of animation.
Bring corpses to life.
cons: Need corpses and eletrical currents to create life.
The animated corpses may not be friendly.
You may appear to be evil and this power could lead to your downfall.

name: Zippers
overview: "zip up" and "unzip" people and objects
description: With this power, simply picture that something has a zipper on it, grab the tab, and pull. When you do, the object or person will "zip up" or "unzip" as if they were really cloth being held together by a zipper. Kill and destroy by unzipping. Heal and repair by zipping things up.
pros: "Unzip" enemies or obstacles blocking your path.
Fix what's broken by "zipping up" wounds, cracks, and breaks.
Make a door anywhere you like.
cons: You must physically grasp the visualized zipper to "zip" anything.

name: Candy Beam
overview: fire a beam that turns people and objects into candy.
description: Like the infamous Majin Buu, you can fire a beam that turns anything or anyone on the recieving end into a delicious sugary treat of your choosing. It is sometimes reversable in case you hit someone with it by mistake. Also this power doesn't necessarily need to come with a pink antenna on your head, instead you can fire the beam from your eyes or hands. The beam will still be pink though.
pros: Eat your enemies!
Candy you like whenever you want
cons: Candy is bad for you in large quantities
Beam can be deflected or reflected back at you
Don't take on Majin Buu (or Uub) with this power alone, you'll lose!

name: Chau Mackuho
overview: transform into a hideous and powerful monster.
description: When someone chants "the lament demon surrounds us all," the user slowly turns into a monstrous creature of unknown power. Stage 1. The users eyes turn dark violet and strange symbols appear all over his or her body. Stage 2. The user grows taller, gets fangs and the whole body turns rock solid and black purple. Stage 3. The user gets more rugged and buffed, becomes insane and looks more monstrous. Stage 4. Unknown
pros: You become better at everything.
Normal strength goes up ten fold
You become unstoppable and are not affected by emotions.
cons: You become more insane day after day.
You lose control over your body/sentience at stage 3
Becomes unstoppable and are not affected by emotions

name: Transformers: Thundercracker
overview: summon the Solo Mission Jet Plane
description: With this power you can summon Action Master Thundercracker's Solo Mission Jet Plane (yes that's really what it's called). The SMJP (nope still sounds stupid) is small plane that can shrink down ans turn into an indestructible armor exo-suit. In plane mode it can travel at incredibly high speeds and withstand enormous G-forces dues to its flexible duraflex metal coating. A side effect of this power is that whenever you jump you cause a thunder clap.
pros: You can summon the Solo Mission Jet Plane (as seen on TV)
It can turn into an indestructible battle armor
Something about flexible duraflex
cons: It has a stupid name

name: Rolling Stone
overview: become a boulder when you tumble.
description: When you tumble, you turn into a boulder of twice your size with appropriate weight. While you are a boulder you are immune to damage that would not destroy a boulder, feel no pain, but at the same time can not move on your own. Like a real rock, you must rely on outside force if you wish to keep rolling after your initial tumble. You can change back at any point.
pros: Become a boulder and roll at things.
You become a rock, so there's no need to eat, breath, drink, or feel pain while in boulder form.
Despite not having any means to, you still comprehend things going on around you in boulder form.
cons: You're a rock, so you can't move on your own after the initial rolling force of the tumble.
You must be able to tumble to use this power.

name: Piercing Elbows
overview: have extremely sharp elbows.
description: This power gives the user elbows which are as sharp and as hard as diamod. They can be used to pierce almost all armour and could be very useful, both offensively and defensively.
pros: Pierce armour.
Pierce jugular veins.
Block attacks.
cons: Awkward.
Giving a friend a friendly nudge could be fatal.

name: Melody Rhapsody
overview: cause people to sing instead of talk.
description: With this ability you can cause people to sing what they are feeling, thinking or are talking.
pros: Amusing entertainment.
cons: Some people probably shouldn't sing at all.

name: The Last Laugh
overview: unleash a lethal mind altering laughing gas that causes the opponent to explode like a balloon.
description: You can use it by releasing a light-greenish puffball projectile at your opponent's mouth and they'll start to laugh endlessly. The effect of it is when they laugh hard they'll expand like a huge balloon before exploding into pieces. The second effect is your opponent will soon go totally irreversibly mad. You also say this quote after finishing your enemy "He/She who laughs last, laughs dead".
pros: Can put your serious opponent into an severe laugher.
cons: None.

name: Summon Agony One
overview: summon a pain inducing kystian.
description: Agony Ones look like bipedal hyenas. While in Kyst Agony Ones record every second of agony of a fallen foe of Kyst. Agony Ones can play back this recorded agony onto other beings. Agony Ones have finite memory of recorded agony so at some point you will have to unsummon it so it can record new material. Agony Ones can lift 5 tons and run 45 mph, they have a IQ of 200.
pros: Your foes won't go to Kyst, let an Agony One do the next best thing.
Agony Ones can run down the fastest normal human.
Agony Ones can lift trucks and throw trucks.
cons: Anyone immune to the effects of pain
Finite pain inducing ability; have to return to Kyst to recharge

name: 2nd Key Of Death
overview: summon a second key of death.
description: The first key controls half of mankind, while this controls the other half. The keys have different ways of killing though; with this, their skin, muscle, and bone disintegrate rapidly, even their soul begins to disappear. Then, that body and the soul are re-created in the underworld.
pros: Good if you are a lazy murderer.
cons: It is a very small key, that you can lose.
Might have the wrong key for the killing someone.

name: Quick Drive
overview: make cars go faster
description: With this power you can cause cars to go faster this is very useful if you're participating in a car race to make your car drive faster than the others or when you're in traffic to cause all of the cars in front of you to go faster
pros: Clear traffic
Win races
cons: Might cause car crashes if you cause cars to go too fast

name: Poison Water
overview: make any water one touches poisonous to the next person it touches
description: The water will be as deadly as a wandering spider's poison. The poison effect will last for 24 hours or until the living being the water touched is dead, whichever comes first.
pros: You can always have a poison ready.
You are always immune to the poison effect.
cons: You cannot use atmospheric water (humidity) for this power.

name: Myth Power: Acratos' Action
overview: channel Acratos' command over the essence of making and drinking unmixed wine, and incontinence
description: Acratos (Acratus, Akratos, Acratopotes, Akratopotes), in Greek myth, was the god of unmixed wine and incontinence (lack of self control, with drinking). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically summon undiluted wine, at will. In addition, one can psychically manipulate wine at will. Furthermore, one can psychically empower wine, by touch, to draw subjects like a beacon, and psychically compel anyone who drinks it. One can even withstand wine intoxication (and share immunity by touch).
pros: Psychically summon unmixed wine at will; psychically manipulate unmixed wine at will
Psychically empower undiluted wine, by touch, to attract subjects; compel anyone who drinks it
Withstand intoxication by ANY wine, mixed or not, which may be shared by touch
cons: None of the above applies to beer, or any other liqueur/liquor; ONLY wine (NCN)
Cannot disrupt urinary/bowel function (induce incontinence in foes' bladders/bowels) by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Bacchanalia allows one to withstand (and disrupt) this ability (NCN)

name: Mr. Bubbles
overview: create thought bubbles over people's heads.
description: With this ability, you can create large, opaque thought bubbles over people's heads, just like you see in the comics. Everyone can see the bubbles, except the person whose head they are over. You can only create one bubble at a time, but they can say anything you want. All you have to do is think about what you want the bubble to say. No one else will know who is doing it or suspect that it's you.
pros: Entertainment factor.
Instant pick-me-up if you're having a bad day.
Blackmail.
cons: You could be caught if you concentrate too hard.
Thought bubbles may accidentally state your OWN thoughts.
Lack of sleep from doing this all the time.

name: Parazoan Shot
overview: shoot a sponge substance from your hands
description: It shoots sponge so you can bounce on it or land on it for safety
pros: FUN
Safety
Bouncey
cons: Might miss target

name: Summon Nylda
overview: summon a poisonous-gas-using kystian.
description: Nylda look like a 40-foot-long mix of praying mantis, millipede and horseshoe crab. They have ultrasonic hearing, an ability to produce a large cloud of deadly hydrogen cyanide, slow motion vision (it can see a hummingbird's wings in slow motion), a lightning-fast arm strike/grab and cuprumo-kinesis (manipulation of copper). It can build up to a speed of 90 mph. It has average intelligence and can pull 600 tons. It isn't made to use weapons, but it could carry things for you.
pros: A hydrogen cyanide attack.
A lightning-fast arm strike.
It can drag 600 tons.
cons: It can't use weapons.
You need space if you're not going to unsummon it.

name: Power Transfering
overview: transfer power(energy) from some of your superpowers to other superpowers you own.
description: Ever get stuck in a situation where some superpowers you have have more power, but the superpower you need to use is too weak. With this superpower, you can transfer some or most of the energy from other powers you own to other powers. For example, let's say your hydrokinesis and technopathy is strong, but your superspeed is too weak for you to save someone far away in time. You could remove some of the energy from technopathy and hydrokinesis to make your superspeed more powerful.
pros: Transfer energy from some superpowers to other superpowers.
You can strengthen other superpowers.
It is temporary, so other powers aren't inherently changed
cons: The superpowers you use to power other powers temporarily become weaker.
You can't use this to get rid of unwanted superpowers. It only makes them weaker.

name: Statue Pose
overview: become a statue by striking a pose
description: This power is useful for evasion. Strike a pose and at your will instantly turn your body into a stone statue. The level of detail in this form is reduced, like the removal eyelashes and smoother skin and hair, to look more convincing and unrecognisable. The catch is you cannot move or use other powers and the longer you remain as a statue the harder it is to reverse. Remain in this form for a few hours and it becomes permanent leaving you alive as an unmovable statue until you are destroyed.
pros: Very convincing
Excellent for evasive strategies
Works with your will so you can strike poses without transforming by accident
cons: Cannot move or use other powers while in affect, leaving you vulnerable
Remain a statue too long and transformation becomes permanent
Being stuck as a statue means you remain alive until you are destroyed

name: Superacid Rain
overview: summon superacid rain that corrodes everything and everyone in a minute
description: You can summon superacid rain from the sky that destroys everything and everybody. You can control the degree and the duration of the rain, and you can control in what area it hits the surface - you can limit it to hit one object or enemy.
pros: Destruction from the sky
Destroys buildings, too - almost nowhere to hide
cons: It doesn't look so cute when you use it
Bad effect on the environment

name: Snap Win V1
overview: cause any team to win a sporting event
description: With this power you have complet control over who wins a sporting event. There are two ways that you can make a team win, either say the sport, the opposing team and the team you want to win and then snap ("Basketball, Jazz, Knicks") or if you're watching the game either live or on TV you can just say the name of the team you want to win and then snap.
pros: You choose who wins sporting events
Works for any sports (even the Olympics)
You can make money by placing bets on the team you choose to win
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Name Killer
overview: instantly kill people who know your birth name
description: The moment anyone knows your birth name they drop dead. You can kill people by simply stating "We haven't introduced ourselves, I'm. " They can hear your name be said, but the moment they know of your existence as well, they become dead. It is pretty simple actually, and works with all languages including brail, sign language, and extraterrestrial (but you have to learn them first). You like to wear sunglasses, be mysterious, and are "bad" at public speaking. You are completely unknown to gov't.
pros: All your enemies must avoid learning about you, and unknown to all governments
You can kill entire populations by saying your birth name on television/internet (Its not Ian)
It happens to be a very embarrasing name, so this ability prevents humiliation
cons: Your weakness are many, including windowless/soundproof jail cells and blind/deaf people
It only works on sentient beings that are capable of understanding names and existance
You can never have close friends without having to be called by your annoying nicknames

name: Rose Poison
overview: manipulate roses with poisonous thorns
description: This ability allows the user to manipulate the growth of roses with different kinds of deadly poisons and effects, and, with practice, may be able to heal yourself or the person you wish to heal with roses. You can choose when the person will die when the poison is in their blood.
pros: the poison effects can't hurt you.
able to heal yourself or anyone.
kill a person in an Instant or slow death. your choice.
cons: Can't hurt the innocent or the ability will be reduced by half until the next full moon

name: Alcohol Muscles
overview: gain super strength through alchohol
description: The more alcohol you drink the stronger you get. Strength begins with the first drink 1 and ends when you sober up. Works with any alchohol.
pros: Impress the ladies
The power source is in your liver, so no liver damage
cons: Still get drunk, and hungover
Alcohol could still make you fat

name: Ghost Of The Present
overview: summon a spirit to let anyone know what is going on in the present time.
description: The present ghost is a gentle jolly giant with dark brown curls, wears a fur-lined green robe and on his head a holly wreath set with shining icicles, carries a large torch made to resemble a cornucopia, appears accompanied by a great feast, has the power to change his size to fit into any space and also wears a scabbard with no sword in it which represents peace on Earth. The spirit can transport a person by swirling his torch around to let them see who they have hurt most.
pros: You and your present spirit see all those around you and all of them cannot see you.
cons: The present spirit will only exist on earth year during a holiday.
The ghost reveals to you that he has 2 vile children chained under his robe named ignorance & want.
The spirit warns you to beware forcreating want & need

name: Vehicle Alive
overview: bring vehicles to life
description: With this power you can make any vehicle come to life by pointing at it and saying "Live! " The vehicle will then come to life and gain the ability to move on its own, think, see, hear, feel, speak and smell. Though the vehicle will not gain a face or any other human like features. You are not able to remove the life from the vehicle; you must completely destroy it to get rid of it.
pros: You can bring vehicles to life
cons: You can't "kill" the vehicle unless you completely destroy it

name: Effervescence
