overview: produce numerous "bubbly" effects
description: This ability is quite a whimsical one to have. It allows the user to do numerous things pertaining to bubbles. It allows the user to make liquids bubble at will with/without heating them (which can cause numerous problems with a foe's blood circulation), it allows the user to generate and manipulate bubbles of breathable air (underwater, or anywhere else that has air and moisture), as well as assuming a form composed of bubbles, similar to Water Mimicry.
pros: Everyone loves bubbles
Generate/control bubbles, cause liquids to bubble (with OR without heating it)
Assume a bubbly form that can reconstitute if any of the bubbles pop
cons: Superhero alias sucks (Bubbles, Bubble Buddy, Bubblebutt, et. al)
Vulnerable to Hydrokinesis
Strong winds are not your friend

name: Rpg Vision
overview: shoot two rocket propelled greanades from your eyes.
description: With this you can shoot two rocket-propelled grenades from your eyes at a time.
pros: Long ranged destruction.
cons: The explosion is massive so it requires complete control.
As accurate as your normal accuracy (better have Superhuman Accuracy, or...)

name: Common Sense Detection
overview: detect common sense.
description: Ever wondered how ironic it is that "common sense" is rare? With this power, you can detect the amount of common sense a person has, who has it, what conclusions it has brought them to, who needs it and how it is currently being used. The maximum range is 100 kilometers for most functions, but you will need physical contact to see past uses of common sense.
pros: Prevent Darwin Award-type activity in friends.
May be useful if you lack common sense.
Could provide useful information on complete strangers.
cons: Need physical contact for some functions.
Range of all non-contact functions limited to 100 kilometers.
Limited usefulness.

name: Spermatozoon Mimicry
overview: have a tail that allows you to fly and swim.
description: This power is always active and only useable by a male. You'll have a very long and powerful tail you can use it to fly in the air. It's also very effective to swim underwater. Your body depends entirely on the nutrients present inside you, so you won't need to breathe while submerged. However, using your tail requires a lot of nutrients and you'll die if you run out of it, so you must feed yourself very frequently. Also, this power prevents you from being seen as a foe by other Cellular Mimics.
pros: You have a very powerful tail which you can swim and fly with.
While underwater, you won't need to breathe.
To fill up on nutrients, you can eat (slow method) or inject yourself with nutrients (instantaneous)
cons: Useless if you are a female.
Unless this power is cancelled, you can't get rid of your tail.
You depend on nutrients to live. If you run out, you must be injected with nutrients or you'll die.

name: Stereo
overview: have a floating boom box follow you around and play any song you want
description: With this power you have a floating boom box follow you around and play any song you want all you have to do is think of the song you want it to play. You can also you use the boom box as a recording device to record things and then have it play it later. The boom box is always one foot behind you and floats seven feet off of the ground. You cannot make the boom box disappear but you can make it stop playing music.
pros: You have a floating boom box that play any song you want
You can use it to record things
cons: You can't make it disappear
It is always a foot behind you and seven feet off of the ground

name: Natural Killer Cell Mimicry
overview: kill cells through touch, but only those of friends who are infected/controlled by a foe.
description: As a Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers. You can also recognize friends who are being controlled by another party or infected by an illness. When you do, you spontaneously go into combat mode, where you will destroy that friend's cells through touch and feel the urge to do so. Fortunately, because of this power's potency, you also have the power to inhibit your own killing power, as long as you resist your own urges, as well as other Natural Killer Cell Mimics' killing power.
pros: None of your friends are going to be controlled (for long)!
You can tell if a friend is being controlled (unless they are controlled by another friend).
You can inhibit other Naturel Killer Cell Mimics' killing power (friends of foes).
cons: You feel the urge to kill your friends if you find out that they are being controlled or are ill.
You can duplicate yourself to outnumber your own friends.
You need to fight against your own urges to avoid killing your own friends.

name: Transformers: Ratchet
overview: be able to summon a one box component
description: With this power you can summon a one box component similar to the one Ratchet uses occasionally. The box has wheels and can be controlled remotely through your brain. It comes equipped with a high powered gun, an operating table and plenty of medical supplies. A side effect of this power is that you become an expert in medicine.
pros: You can summon a one box component
You know a great deal about medicine
cons: If the component is destroyed you need to Wait an hour before you can summon a new one

name: Crocodile Tears
overview: feign sadness or distress and gain power from the sympathy felt toward you
description: One with this ability is a very dangerous person indeed. By activating this ability, they will begin to cry (or otherwise display distress, depending on which their mind determines will be more believable). When others come up to the user, feeling sorry for him, his power builds up within. And if the subject gets within radius, the user's power is capped off and sends him into a berserker rage to attack that person.
pros: Your tears or other show of distress is convincing
Your power builds up the more people feel sympathy for you
This power is released in the form of a powerful berserker rage that pwns enemies
cons: If nobody cares about your troubles
If the power isn't accompanied by the berserker rage part
Fool me once, shame on you, fool me twice, shame on me.

name: Which Ever Way The Winds Blows
overview: let random chance control what you do and nothing else.
description: You can use any object or objects to choose what you'll do. A coin, cards, dice, a random number generator. Anything else that works. Every time you do this you'll be be immune to any control powers that affect behavior, body, mind, spirit, soul or powers for a day for each time you make a decision this way. If you refuse to go with random chance, you lose a day of immunity. Any lost object can be easily replaced or made(e. G. Homemade dice), your power just works through it.
pros: Immunity to control powers.
You can buy, make or steal whatever object(s) you to make the power work.
cons: Some things shouldn't be left to random chance.
If you can't agreed with what random chance chose for you, lose a day of immunity.

name: Spawn: Roman Shelters
overview: spawn a roman shelter based on their pantheon
description: You are able to spawn spacious, comfortable shelters based on their pantheon.  Each will have different features for each deity it was based on.  Bacchus's will have a party room, Minerva's will have a library,etc.  Each will have at least 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a kitchen, a bookshelf with exclusive knowledge of Roman gods, heroes, adventures and everything in between.
pros: If you get lost at night and you want rest.
Very comfortable and spacious.
cons: Somethings are just scary (Timor's cabin)
Some will force you to do dangerous things (fighting arena in Mar's cabin)
They are not protected on the outside.

name: Baby Talk
overview: psychically communicate with babies
description: Also called Baby Communication, Infantile Communication, Baby Omnilingualism, Infantile Omnilingualism or Babyspeak, this is the psychic ability to communicate with and understand babies, and for them to understand YOU. One with this ability can easily translate all the hiccups, burbles, gurgles, coos, whines, cries and giggles of a baby (regardless of species), and can also speak this language (or speak their normal voice, and empathically translate it into signals the baby can understand)
pros: Understand babies
They understand you
If power develops, you can exert mental control to COMMAND babies
cons: Sometimes only extends to babies of YOUR race
Sometimes takes a while to learn baby language of another species
Baby minds are less developed so it may harm them if your influence over them is TOO strong

name: Moon Teleportation
overview: teleport to any planet's moon
description: With this power you can teleport to any planet's moon. The moon doesn't have to be in solar system but it has to be in your universe. This power does not allow you to breathe in space so getting a power that allows you to might be helpful.
pros: You can teleport to any planet's moon
The moon can be in a different solar system
cons: The moon has to be in your universe
This power does not allow you breathe in space

name: Heat Meals
overview: heat meals with your hands
description: Someone with this ability would be able to heat any meal with his hands. This includes things requiring a toaster, oven, or microwave to prepare. It's perfect for someone in a hurry.
pros: Heat/microwave any meal with just your hands
Perfect for anyone in a hurry
cons: Pretty much useless in other situations
Works only on food

name: Night Time
overview: make the sun set whenever you want it to
description: With this power you control when the sun sets making the day longer or shorter
pros: Make the sun set whenever you want
Make the sun STAY down as long as you want
When the sun sets, the moon automatically rises
cons: Can only be used to make the sun go down or stay down (can't make it rise)
If you make the sun stay down on ONE side of the earth, it scorches ANOTHER side of the earth
Doesn't control time

name: Third Eye.
overview: have a third eye and better eyesight
description: The third eye is on the forehead. Eyesight is improved to be able to see up to one mile away and see things moving at less than 680 meters per second. The sight bonus lasts only while the third eye is open.
pros: Can see better.
Get a third eye.
Third eye could possibly become better.
cons: Third eye is very obvious.
People will be scared of you.
Eyesight only lasts while third eye is open and if you lose it your eyesight is normal.

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Dominions
overview: become an angel from the Second Sphere.
description: The Dominions, also known as Hashmallim, regulate the duties of lower-ranking angels. They also preside over nations. Their appearance is described as a divinely beautiful humans with a pair of feathered wings. The Dominions may also be described as wielding orbs of light which are fastened to their swords or scepters.
pros: Preside over nations and countries ensuring righteous order.
Regulate laws and the tasks of subordinate angels.
Use orbs of light as a means of offense and defense.
cons: Rarely making yourself visible to humans.

name: Zombie: Summon 10 Zombies
overview: summon up to 10 zombies per day.
description: With this power, you can summon an army of zombies. You can summon up to 10 zombies per day. When they bite/scratch someone, their victim is infected and you get another zombie!
pros: If they have a leathal blow they will still do what's commanded
When they bite/scratch someone, hell! You got another zombie!
Zombies rock
cons: They stink
They're ugly
They rot

name: Simultaneous Speech
overview: simultaneously say what someone else says.
description: You have to activate your power while concentrating on a precise person. As long as you keep your concentration, every time that person says something, you will say the exact same thing with your own voice. You will also copy that person's volume, speech rate, pitch, accent and verbal tics as long as they are within your limits of competence. You can use your power wherever that person might be.
pros: If you're a bad singer, you can gain experience by copying a good singer.
Discover what anyone is talking about behind your back.
Get private or confidential information by choosing the right person.
cons: You can only copy one person at a time.
If that person is having a conversation, what you say will hardly make sense.
You will look funny talking nonsense to yourself.

name: 4 D Movies V2
overview: cause people to feel things that characters feel in movies
description: With this power you can place a curse on someone that causes them to feel the exact same things a character in a movie feels. All you have to do is the same the name of the movie, character and the person you're cursing. Then you have to play the movie and whenever the character feels something the person will as well. If the character dies in the movie the person dies as well.
pros: You can place a curse on people that allows them to feel the same things as movie characters
cons: You are not immune to this power so people can use it on you

name: Cartoon Power: G1 Cliffjumper
overview: make giant guns appear out of nowhere
description: With this power you can make giant powerful gun come out of nowhere like Cliffjumper was somehow able to do in the old G1 Transformers cartoons
pros: You always have a giant gun
cons: They're heavy
You can't make the giant guns disappear

name: Forced World Hopping
overview: force an enemy to travel through every world that they can possibly imagine
description: You can basically force an enemy to bounce though every world they have ever imagined. This means supernatural, oddball worlds(Ex. Soccer and football combined is the only sport), etc. This will continue until they run out of possible worlds. Daydreamed worlds count for this power as do ones seen in actual dreams while sleeping. They can only get out of a world by finding a tiny 20 centimeter tall oni and catching him.
pros: Trap an enemy for a long period of time.
If the world has a storyline the enemy has to go through that storyline before escaping.
cons: Only helps with imaginative enemies.
Dimension-traveling enemies can still escape.
Can't alter power in any way to make it more powerful.

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes3
overview: channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling Hedylogos (Hedylogus- Flattery, Sweet-Talk, Compliments and Wooing) allows one to compel subjects by sweet-talking them; complimenting them and offering them flattery. In addition, one's breath will always sound, smell and taste intoxicatingly sweet. One can even cause a foe's mouth to continually generate sugar, by touch; if he stops talking, his throat will fill with sugar, choking him.
pros: Psychically compel subjects by offering flattery, compliments and sweet talk; withstand compulsion
One's breath sounds/smells/tastes intoxicatingly sweet (if desired, subjects can become addicted)
Induce Oral Sugar Generation in foes by touch; if foe stops talking, they risk choking
cons: Cannot use flattery to raise a foe's blood sugar until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Countdown Clock
overview: have a large clock follow you that counts down to the second you die
description: With this power you can have a clock that only you can see follow you around. The clock is counting down until the second you die so when you use this power you can figure out when you're going to die and how much time you have left.
pros: You have a clock that pretty much tells you when you're going to die
cons: Sometimes knowing when you're going to die is not a good thing
You can't unsummon the clock

name: Monster In Your Closet
overview: make any monster from Monsters Inc appear in anybody's closet
description: With this power you can make any monster from the movie Monsters Inc appear in any closet in the planet that you're on when you use the power. The monsters are not under your control and are free to do whatever they want, scare, befriend, freak out, play bowling etc. You also don't control when they go back to their world as they can do it whenever they want just by walking back into the closet that they came though.
pros: You can make any monster from Monsters Inc appear in any closet on the planet that you're on
cons: The monsters are not under your control

name: Snap Your Head Explodes
overview: make people's heads explode when you snap
description: With this power you can make people's heads explode by snapping, thinking about them and saying "Head Explosion! " then no matter where the person is or what he is doing his head will explode. If you are near the person you cannot be hurt by the explosion. There is no way to reverse the affects of this power.

You are immune to the explosion
cons: There is no way to reverse this power
You have to be able to snap and say "Head Explosion"

name: Freezing Hair
overview: cause one's hair to freeze what it touches
description: The temperature of anything touhing your hair will decrease to below the freezing point of water and your hair will turn blue while using this power. You are immune to the cold created by this power.
pros: Enemies will never want to grab your hair.
cons: Very obvious when you're using this power.

name: Fullmetal Alchemists:Lust
overview: gain the abilities of Lust.
description: By gaining the abilities of Lust you become a symbol of beauty, and sexuality. As the saying goes, don't judge a book by its cover, you become highly intelligent, and easily deceive others. Your fingers can extend to the point of, well, there is no length limit, but your fingers can pierce anything.

Highly Intelligent.
Deceive others.

You expect everyone's love to come to you, being very lustful.

cons: You can only give a person one allergy
You can't cure them of their allergies

name: Theatre Character Summon

description: With this power you can summon any character from any play that you've seen. The character you summon will look exactly like the actor that plays them but will act like the character that they're playing. The characters are not under you control and they can be unsummoned whenever you like.

They look like the actor that plays them so you may be able to use that to your advantage somehow
cons: They're not under your control
Only plays that you've seen

name: Panontic Arch:Ergi
overview: gain powers the Ergi dimension.
description: Ergi,the universe of raw energies where matter can't exist. You're immune to temperatures high as 11 billion degrees. Energy attacks can't hurt you. You can disrupt the strong nuclear force in a object by touch. Cold/ice attacks will do extra damage to you. Freezing temperatures for you will start at 60 degrees.

Immune to energy attacks.
You can disrupt the strong nuclear force by touch.
cons: Cold and ice attacks hurt you more.
You freeze at 60 degrees or less.

name: Enhancement: Anti Immunity
overview: be immune to the defenses provided by a power
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it gives immunity to the defenses provided by that power to another being. Ex: Indirect Total Immunity, Impact Shield, Author's Immunity, etc. You can only have one copy of this power at a time. The other power cannot have other Enhancements attached. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
pros: Don't have to deal with annoying immunity or shield powers.
Con: Cannot be shared with other people not even with Enhancement Sharing.
Con: Have to have the defensive power yourself.
cons: Useless without another power.
Cannot be used on a power that was acquired using another power. Ex: Acquired using Ability Theft.
Con Negation and other alteration powers have no effect on this power.

name: Myth Power: Ker's Curse
overview: channel Ker and the Keres' command over the essence of painful, cruel and violent death
description: Ker (Cer) and the Keres (Ceres), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of painful, cruel and violent death. As such, channeling them allows one to perceive violent death in one's range, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the undead (ghosts/spirits, zombies, etc) of those who died violently. Furthermore, one can perceive and mimic, by a paralyzing touch, foes' most feared mode of death. One can even withstand death/underworld/afterlife-based effects.
pros: Psychically perceive past, present and future violent death in one's range at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel undead who died violent deaths
Perceive and mimic, by touch, foe's most feared mode of violent death; withstand necromantic effects

Death/underworld/afterlife-based MythPowers (and Immortality) provide immunity (NCN)

name: Know Nothing

win smart comps

cons: Meddling with the past can have disastrous effects on the present

name: Myth Power: Horae (Seasons4)
overview: channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the four seasons
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the four seasons; winter, spring, summer and fall. As such, channeling Phthinophoron (Autumn/Fall) allows one to psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth autumn weather at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere where it is naturally autumn. Furthermore, one can withstand wind. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of autumn at will.
pros: Psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth autumn/fall weather at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere it is naturally autumn; withstand wind
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of autumn

Cannot psychically manipulate time during NATURAL autumn until developed (NCN)
Olympian MythPowers and elemental MythPowers related to wind/autumn provide immunity (NCN)

name: Summoning: Nekomata
overview: summon a Nekomata.
description: Nekomata, meaning Forked Cat. It is a cat with two tails, but other than that appears to be a normal cat. It has the power to raise the dead if it walks over a corpse. They are tricky creatures to use, because even master summoners can't stop their whimsical nature. They are great companions, however, if you can befriend them.
pros: Raise the dead.
Useful companion
cons: Hard to master.
Incredibly hard to impose your will upon.

name: Bug Enlarger
overview: make bugs giant sized
description: With this power you can make bugs as big as you want and when you make them bigger they're under your control. Depending on what types of bugs you enlarge you can have soldiers that: fly, can jump long distances, are super strong, can walk on walls etc.
pros: You can have an army of giant mind controlled bugs
You can take over the world with your giant bug army
cons: No spiders
The bugs can be killed

name: Myth Power: Fertility Force1
overview: channel Priapus' companions' command over the essence of fertility
description: The phallic companions of Priapus, in Greek myth, were the gods of fertility. As such, channeling Tychon (Tykhon- sexual fortune; fertility, virility, sexual endowment), one gains favor with the plant and animal kingdoms; they will not attack/harm the user (even by compulsion), in exchange for enhancing their fertility. In addition, one can psychically perceive the right thing to say, to charm neutrals into doing one's bidding, at will. One can even psychically weaponize phallic items, at will.

Psychically perceive the right thing to say to charm neutrals into doing one's bidding (Lucky Charm)
Psychically weaponize phallic items (ie enlarge and empower a baseball bat) at will

name: Bloons Tower Defense Summon
overview: summon any tower from the Bloons Tower Defense series of games.
description: Using this power, you can summon any of the towers from any of the Bloons Tower Defense series of games. You cannot, however, summon any of the Bloons. The towers are 3D, and throw real objects at any target. You have complete control over the actions of the towers. However, you cannot upgrade the towers. You also cannot summon the Road Spikes, Monkey Glue, or Pineapples.

Can use the towers to defend yourself and your friends.
Complete control over the towers.

You cannot summon any of the upgraded towers.
The bomb towers have a bigger explosion than you think.

name: Snap You're Sticky
overview: make things sticky
description: WIth this power you can make anything sticky by snapping with one hand and pointing at it with the other. The thing will then become sticky and stick to anything that touches it until you snap and point at it again.

cons: You have to snap and point at the object

name: Act Your Age
overview: physically change age depending on mood
description: Ever wanted to relive your glory days? Need to get cranky, hunker down and get some work done? Or do you just wanna crap your pants and have someone take care of you? This power covers all of that. If you feel serious and sophisticated, you go to your 30's. Feel like partying? Teens. In a nurturing, parenting mood? 40's or 50's. Lazy? Toddler/Senior Citizen, your choice. The change is instant and the results are always satisfactory.

People will never be confused about how you feel
Basically Immortality

Getting cranky will make you an old geezer, make your hip hurt, and make you even crankier
Drunk people tend to act like 5-year olds, and drunk 5-year olds tend to die of alcohol poisoning

Have Witch best friend

This power is always on when you are alive and is off when you die. If for some reason you were to become alive again, this power reactivates itself. This is an unstealable superpower. If you sprout dragon wings you can shoot fire from the wings. Bird wings allow you to fly normally, bat wings make you grow fangs etc.

You can make the wings disappear if you want

description: With this power whenever you use this power to fly every member of your species will disappear until you stop flying with this power. People only disappear when you fly using this power. If you fly using any other power or by external means (airplane, jetpack, dragon, giant bird etc. ) nobody will disappear.

Easily make clean get aways by flying and making your pursuers disappear until you land far away

overview: channel Boule's command over the essence of the council
description: Boule, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the council; a group of people who help make decisions in society. As such, channeling her allows one to summon nearly anybody one chooses, as astral-projection copies, to offer advice and information, at will. In addition, to avoid potential harm, or to avoid exposing one's ability, one may move into an extradimensional 'Council Space', at will. One may even step into the Council Space at one location, and step out of it at another location, at will.

Travel into a customizable 'Council Space' to avoid danger, or avoid exposing one's ability

As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can psychically negate altered mental states (unconsciousness etc), by touch, or proximity (psychically generating sunlight), at will. Furthermore, one can withstand them. One can even psychically project a sonic rooster crow, at will.

Heat or cold may be used by appropriate secondary powers such as Heat Eater directly.

Protect yourself from temperature extremes.

Their hive mind is somewhat stupid. The venom of a diamondizer triggers a limited carbon manipulation effect. It causes a living carbon-based life form to become a lump of diamond. This effect is permanent. A average person running can outrun a diamondizer. These kystians have infrared vision and sonar.

name: Gastric Chief Cell Mimicry
overview: shoot gastric digestive enzymes.
description: You can grow flesh appendages from anywhere on your body to shoot enzymes and retract them when you don't need them anymore. Enzymes are catalysts, i.e. each one greatly enhances a specific chemical reaction. Yours can increase the action of acids over proteins and lipids. So, the mix of acid and your enzymes greatly increases the acid's property to break down most organic compounds. Unfortunately, your enzymes alone can't do anything on their own. And you are not immune to the effects of acid.

You can increase the deadliness of Parietal Cell Mimicry.
Dissolve and digest any kind of organic thing.

You could, for instance, block a side effect causing hair loss, but allow it to remove body hair. You could also allow a medication make you lose or gain weight without impediment.

Shoot spines

As such, channeling him allows one to perceive, by touch or thought, any promise that a subject has made or received, and whether that promise was kept (including one's own promises). In addition, one can perceive lies. One can even afflict liars and oath-breakers with misfortunes associated with the promise they broke, or the lie they told, until the offense is either avenged or forgiven.

name: Condition Change: Angry
overview: make a power require the user being angry in order to activate
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation so that the power can only be used when the user is angry. Cannot be used on a power that has already been affected by a Condition Change that requires a different mood. This power is tactile.

Use this power on an opponent with no emotions for the best results.
This will be fun to watch.

name: Leather Jacket
overview: create stylish leather jackets instantly

Always look good
Can start you own buisness selling jackets and make millions without having to buy the materials
cons: If leather jackets ever go out of style the power is useless (like that will ever happen)

name: Enhancement: Corrupting
overview: make a power corrupt what it hits in addition to its other effects
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, the other makes those whom it affects evil. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.

cons: Useless without another power.

name: Vehicle Rain
overview: make vehicles fall from the sky
description: With this power you can cause up to ten different vehicles fall from the sky everyday. It can be any kind of vehicle you want including space ships, boats, bikes, planes, cars, trucks etc. As long as they exist in the real world. You can cause the vehicles to fall anywhere so you cause trucks or submarines to fall on your enemies or cause a sports car to fall on top of your old jalopy and have a sweet new ride. You cannot make the new vehicles disappear.

name: Rise Of The Super Gator
overview: turn into a super gator
description: With this power you can turn into a super gator. In gator form you can fly, breathe fire, you have super strength, super sharp teeth and bullet proof scales. You can stay in gator form as long as you want and you retain your intelligence, personality and ability to speak.

name: Myth Power: Ceraon's Cup
overview: channel Ceraon's command over the essence of mixing wine and drinking
description: Ceraon (Keraon), in Greek myth, was the god of mixing wine and drinking. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and summon drinks at will, as well as gaining skill in mixing drinks. In addition, one can turn harmful liquids (acids, poisons, etc) into harmless drinks, or turn drinks into harmful liquids, medical remedies, etc, by touch. Furthermore, one can gain physical power from drinking beverages (healthy is better). One can even psychically manipulate beverages, at will.

name: Summoning: Wraith
overview: summon a Wraith.
description: A Wraith is a ghost, who as a human held an incredible amount of rage and hatred. A Wraith is a malevolent spirit who will steal the life of anyone you hate. However, if the Wraith can't steal the life of the one you hate, it will come back and steal your life instead.

name: Delete This Iple Scissors Kick

People won't want to mess with you

Make a rotten fruit edible once again.

name: Koolaid Creation
overview: create any flavor of Koolaid imaginable.

name: Halitosis
overview: increase or decrease the freshness of someone's breath

Go buy as many tic-tacs as you possibly can!! " Oh, they can do whatever they want to freshen it, but it will eventually go back to the level at which you set it. This also works vice versa, it also works on you. So ruin someone's reputation, and seduce people with your sexy breath. For you are THE GOD OF FRESHNESS!

Ruin Reputations!

With this ability, your rap ability will change from hysterical to incomparable. Ex: If you usually make 5 word rhymes, you can now rhyme like this.. 

I've Spit the Table of Elements Yes I mean every single Component,
Sent back the Competition and I have a need for Opponents,

Easily diss your friends.

name: For Someone's Honor
overview: gain power from obedience to others.
description: This ability turns you into what is for all intents and purposes a slave. However, servitude empowers you with strength, speed, regeneration, and an immunity to mind attacks and mental detection while you fulfill your master's command. Your oath of loyalty can only be given if you truly want to, so choose carefully. Once sworn, the only way to break the bond is either the master's death or your death (immortality and other powers can change this. )
pros: Physical power and nigh indestructibility.
Mental fortitude and inability to be sensed via mind powers.
You know what you're fighting for at all times.
cons: You have to have a master for this ability to work.
Your master has to give you a command, and you have to fulfil it.
Your master (or mistress) can tell you to do anything, and you're forced to obey.

name: Myth Power: Dioskouroi Deluxe
overview: channel the Dioskouroi and their command over the essence of athletics, travel and guests
description: The Dioskouroi (Dioscouroi, Dioskoroi, Dioscoroi), in Greek myth, were gods of athletics, travel, sailing and guests. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically access peak physical condition, as well as sports, horsemanship and sailing skill. In addition, one can psychically perceive directions to any location, at will. One can also psychically teleport to previously visited locations, at will. One can even psychically perceive and communicate the language of nearby subjects, at will.

Psychically perceive directions to any location, teleport to previously-visited locations, at will
Psychically perceive and communicate in the language of subjects in proximity (Xenoglossy), at will

overview: shoot tar from any part of your body
description: With this power you can shoot scolding hot tar from any part of your body. With the tar you can burn people, cause people to become stuck to places, you can blind them by shooting tar into their eyes, you can cause them to stop breathing by shooting tar into their mouth and nose or you could make streets or pavement.

cons: The jetpacks can be destroyed
The jetpacks can be stolen

name: Divine Form: Anubis
overview: temporarily channel the spirit of Anubis into your body
description: A priest of Anubis can allow the spirit of Anubis to take over his body temporarily granting him incredible powers. They can also change their own people into Jackal headed creatures, which have often been confused for were-wolves.

Disgust everyone by eating rotten-looking apple marmalade and acting like it's delicious.

Then, you use your free arm to either push their arm, and particularly its radius bone, against the face of the opponent to cause pain. Then, you lock their arms up into the air (as in a full nelson hold). You next hook the opponent's near leg and throw yourselves forward, driving the opponent face first into the ground.

name: Grappling Hook Limbs

description: A rav looks like red-feathered harpy. She has the ability to mimic any sound-based powers. She of course must hear the power and be 200 feet or closer to the person using it. Ravs make permanent copies of powers. If you unsummon a rav with copied powers you can summon the same rav later(99% chance). A rav can carry 300 lbs in her claws. She can fly 30 mph.

name: Myth Power: Alastor's Alliance
overview: channel Alastor's command over the essence of blood feuds
description: Alastor, in Greek myth, was the god of blood feuds, as well as inflictor of divine vengeance upon younger generations, for the sins of their fathers. As such, this ability allows one to perceive one's foe's paternal bloodline. For every criminal, villain or other ne'er-do-well they have in their paternal bloodline, one curse or plague may be inflicted on them (and if you are their rival, the power increases). In addition, simply having this ability absolves one's bloodline of any past misdeeds.

They can only create a certain amount of puppets at a time, and these puppets act with some degree of free will. This person has access to the puppets minds and powers at any time.

The hand can also shoot bolts of lightning, and that can be use for many purposes.

Kyst can't provide water or food. You need all the kyst powers to make this power work. The con power won't work on this power.

If you don't own this power and you don't want it but you won the straw duel, you get it anyhow.

Totally withstand any powers made by you

Con #1 can only be negated by the power Birhright Thief (NCN)
Cannot separate powers from their owners as pseudo-sentient energy beings until developed (NCN)

name: Thirteen Treasures: Halter
overview: use the halter of Clydno Eiddyn
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. When tied to the end of one's bed, any horse appearing in one's dream will appear tied to the halter.
pros: Summon shadow horses, cyborg horses, giant horses, kelpies, carnivorous dino-horses, and many more!
cons: The halter could be stolen while you slept, rendering your equine dreams useless.

name: Magic Chuck
overview: summon Chuck Norris from a card
description: Summon Chuck Norris from a magical Yu-Gi-Oh card and win automatically.

cons: Lose the card, fail at life.
Anyone can use the card

name: Epidemic
overview: give diseases to living things.
description: It is the ability to make people sick by exhaling viruses or bacteria which cause deseases. You may make it as bad as a cold or as serious as Cancer. Also you can control the range. More gas exhaled, wider range. But you can't give diseases which have a more complicated way of being obtained. Such as AIDS which is from "having fun in bed." You could also give them diseases by stimulating cells such as in cancer but a lot more concentration is needed.
pros: You can kill opponents with diseases and watch them suffer.
You can control the seriousness
You can control range

STDs can't be transmitted through breathing or touching but by ya know

name: Inside Jokes
overview: understand all inside jokes
description: Think about it: a situation can be awkward when someone pulls out an inside joke and nobody else gets it. EXCEPT YOU! If you have this power, all inside jokes are laid open to your understanding.
pros: Don't have to sit there and wait while the other person has to explain the joke to you
cons: Maybe that's a joke you really didn't want to understand.

name: God's Magnifying Glass
overview: wield a giant magnifying glass
description: This weapon is well-rounded in magic and strength. It can see things from great lengths. When small, it is used to deal out powerful light attacks in sunlight, and use dark magic in moonlight. When it is struck, it glows red for a brief second, and then turns giant and seeks out the person who angered it. When the person is found, it hovers over the enemy and seals the enemy in a dome. The enemy is left there, until the suns rays burn the enemy to death. It has a reverse effect in the moonlight.
pros: Wield a magic based weapon
Have a giant minion at times
Better then any pair of binoculars you will ever get
cons: Don't drop it, just don't.

name: Rotating Body Parts
overview: spin your limbs/extremities at any speed
description: You can spin your head, neck, arms, hands, torso, legs and feet at any speed, from slow to super fast.
pros: Spinning your head to look out for enemies behind you.
Drilling Punches!
Flight by holding out your arms then rotating your torso super-fast while your head is stabilized.
cons: You could get dizzy if you move to fast.
Recomended to wear armor if you want to use a drilling punch.
Little control over Pro number three.

name: Gift Of The New Year
overview: absorb sickness and injuries, taking them unto yourself until the new year.
description: You have the ability to take onto yourself any affliction, be it an injury or a disease and free another (living) person from it. This disease or injury persists until the stroke of midnight on New Years. At that point, any injury or disease you have is removed.
pros: Bring miracles, especially on New Years day.
Christmas gift of awesome
Its hard to die from someone else's disease.
cons: It can kill you if it adds up to enough.
Crippling injuries suck
You get sick, the common cold is the least of your problems.

name: Zodiac: Lunar: Cat
overview: use the powers of the lunar calender's Cat
description: You draw upon the power of the Cat. You can transform into a cat, talk with cats, and move around without anyone visually seeing you. You have to keep moving for this to keep working.
pros: Full moon gives full power.
Can avoid being seen in an enemy's hideout.
The cat is in the Vietnamese Lunar Zodiac but the rabbit is in its spot in the Chinese Lunar Zodiac.
cons: New moon gives no power.
Can only use if born in a year of the Cat. 1927, 1939, 1951, 1963, 1975, 1987, 1999, 2011, etc.
Not really combat-oriented.

name: Snap You're Deaf
overview: make people deaf
description: With this power you can cause people to lose their ability to hear by snapping your fingers, thinking of the person you want to become deaf and saying "Snap you're deaf! " The person then loses their hearing permanently. You cannot restore the person's ability to hear without other powers.
pros: You can cause people to lose their hearing permanently
cons: You cannot restore the person's hearing without other powers.

name: Shibito
overview: be an immortal, Semi-intelligent undead.
description: You are a Shibito, and red water flows in your veins. The water is regenerative, so you cannot die no matter how much damage you sustain. Even if you "die" you will get back up in a matter of minutes. In addition, you see even the most hellish world bathed in a beautiful white light and so are constantly happy. So happy that you want to share it with everyone around you, even if you have to cut them open to let the red water in. Other than that you are, while deranged, still intelligent.
pros: You are practically indestructable.
You are still mostly intelligent, unlike normal zombies.
You are constantly happy.
cons: You become deranged, and will kill any non-shibito you see.
You look like a zombie, and over time will mutate into something worse.
You will be attracted to repetative tasks, and you will be less intelligent.

name: God Phone V8
overview: summon any on the Inca gods and goddesses
description: With this power you can summon any of the gods and goddesses of the Inca tribe of Native Americans. They are not under your control but they may help you if you're lucky. You cannot unsummon them unless they want to be sent back.
pros: You can summon any of the Inca gods and goddesses
They may help you
cons: They probably won't help you
They can only be sent back if they want to be sent back

name: Explosive Fingernails
overview: shoot explosive fingernails from the tip of your hand.
description: With this ability you can shoot explosive fingernails from any hand,though when shooting from your right hand,the fingernails tend to be weaker than the ones on your left hand.
pros: Always have a weapon that you can keep with you at airports.
They look normal until you shoot them
cons: They might explode before you shoot them.
They tend to be redder than the average fingernail

name: Shark Skin
overview: transform your skin to that of shark's skin
description: With this ability, your skin takes on the properties of shark's skin. It will be tough and leathery, giving you increased durability. It will also have the feel of sand paper, being covered by dermal denticles. These denticles assist in protecting you from damage and parasites. They also assist in your fluid dynamics, reducing water turbulence, thereby increasing your swimming abilities. The denticles can scrape someone else's skin. This transformation may be temporary or permanent.
pros: Increased swimming ablity
Added protection
cons: May interfere with intimacy with others, esp. If a permanent transformation

name: Ugly Vanity
overview: create the illusion that someone appears really ugly or really beautiful
description: By touch, you can create an illusionary cloud around a person that makes them appear really ugly or very beautiful to other people. This power wears off though in a day.

Spell wears off in a day

overview: manipulate people's sexuality

pros: There would always be a guy/girl for you
cons: You are forcing them to change sexuality

name: Hell's Candy Maker
overview: create candy demons.
description: Demonic hard sweets,fudge,toffee,licorice,chocolate and any other candies. Any demonic candies you create will walk,talk and bite. Licorice demons might be able to strangle. Demonic jaw breakers could be miniature juggernauts. Marshmallow and nougat demons will be sticky. This power can be combined with the hell's baker power. Soft candy demons are exorcised like baked good demons but a gobstopper demon will be tougher to exorcise than that.
pros: Create jaw breaker juggernauts.
Create a horde of marshmallow demons to stick to a foe.
This power combines with the hell's baker power.
cons: Some candy demons are tougher than baked good demons.
You're better than someone with just the hell's baker power.

name: Musical Bones
overview: make sounds and music with your bones.
description: With this skill you can make sound just by moving your bones. These sounds are amplified by the flesh, blood and skin, resulting in powerful sound blasts.   The more bones you move at the same time, the higher the power, so when you are dancing you become a unstoppable machine of destruction.
pros: You can hit your foes with tremendous power.
No need to shout to activate the power.
You will never get bored.
cons: Others may find your power ridiculous.
Useless in the vacuum of space.
Need to move to release the power.

name: Jodo Shinshu: 3 Poisons
overview: control 3 Buddhist mental poisons and their symbols
description: The three Buddist mental poisons are greed, ignorance, and wrath. This power makes you a master of the Jodo Shinshu (Buddhism sect) and thus, of the poisons. Their symbols are chicken for ignorance, pig for greed, and snake for wrath. This power allows full and total control of the poisons, but only one at a time. A user of this power can get rid of these poisons from a person or corrupt them with the poisons.
pros: Can make a person completely kind and gentle to all those they meet.
You also have three species of animals you can control.
Certain healing/mental/will powers can counteract this power.
cons: Can make a person completely evil and uncaring towards other humans.
Can only control one poison & animal species at a time.
Con Negation and other alteration powers do not affect this power.

name: Spirits Into Demon(S)
overview: turn bodiless spirits into demons
description: The more spirits you put into one demon, the stronger it is. However, the strength increase is such that a demon formed from 100 spirits can beat 2 demons, one with 99 spirits the other with 1 spirit, with power to spare. That will not change, even though the purer the spirits sacrificed, the weaker the demon will be; the more corrupted the spirits, the stronger the demon. The demons will have traditional demonic powers but as the power levels rise, the traditional weaknesses go down in number.
pros: A demon formed from 100.000 spirits might be pretty much unstoppable.
A demon formed from several spirits that are pure evil could be hard to stop.
Some of the demons will have powers that are not traditional demonic powers. Rare and may be a con.
cons: Just because you created the demon, doesn't mean it will listen to you.
People might be scared of this power.

name: Byte Bite
overview: be a computer vampire.
description: With this ability one can copy/drain anything on a computer/phone/gaming device/etc. by biting it. You can also use this on wires, memory cards, or data related items.
pros: Be the best hacker or music/movie pirate ever!
Doesn't have to be a computer, could be a phone/memory card/etc.
No blue screen of death!
cons: Might get a virus, you'll need to copy norton.

name: Yelling Point
overview: make people yell
description: With this power you can make people start yelling uncontrollably as long as your pointing at the person. As soon as you stop pointing at the person they will return to speaking at whatever volume they were speaking at before you pointed at them. This is useful if people are whispering secrets to each other; you can just point at them and they will start yelling whatever secrets they were saying for everybody to hear.

You can cause people to shout out their secrets
cons: Once you stop pointing at them they stop yelling
Your arm might get tired
It happens whenever you point at someone

name: "Tap Dance!" V2
overview: be surrounded by an unbreakable force field when your tap dance
description: With this power whenever you start tap dancing you are surrounded by an unbreakable forcefield. So now whenever you're about to be attacked or are being attacked just start tap dancing and you're good. This power does not give you the knowledge of how to tap dance.
pros: Whenever you tap dance you're surrounded by an unbreakable forcefield
cons: You don't necessarily know how to tap dance with this power

name: Immortal Infant
overview: be unable to be killed as an infant.
description: If a person has this power, they will not be able to be killed, provided they are an infant. This can be extended to infant children as well, whether or not they inherit this power. This power is even resistant to being blocked; only high-end power negation powers can block it like Normalization Fluid and Power Sacrifice. It even applies to a unborn children.
pros: Never die as an infant and protect infant relatives.
Still grow older, so there is no curse of immortality.
Due to the nature of this ability, regeneration will keep you in god health.

If you do not have/care for children, this is only useful once.
Abortions would be impossible (may be a pro for some).

name: Talent Of Woodcraft

description: This power gives you natural skill in woodcraft. You can carve wood easily into weapons, traps, or other things. If you are lost in the woods, then you can easily make five wooden spears in two minutes or a bow in one. You have a natural sense of what wood is strong and how to get it. You never get splinters and your hands won't turn coarse from working. You can even make a shelter from wood with youre bare hands and can smooth it by gently rubbing it.
pros: Description cant be shortened and pros cant be negated.
Works great with a lost in the woods scenario.
cons: Power sacrifice works on this.

When the power is activated, ridiculously awesome music will begin to play wherever you are standing, and every one will mistake you for the guy who's supposed to save the world!

You can easily take authority over any situation
The ladies will love ya!

The effect only lasts as long as you maintain the pose.
You might have to use the bathroom eventually.

Its powers are vast and mostly unknown, but it's best understood and most powerful ability is to drink and control essences. Whenever this sword stabs a living thing, it absorbs its essence. This causes the wielder to become stronger. The wielder can also channel the absorbed essence in different ways. The essence appears as a energy-like smoke or dust.
pros: Manipulating essences and learning more of the sword's powers
Becoming stronger
Can use essences in many ways

The sword can be stolen

name: "I Like Trains!" V2

You know how to operate them

Be prepared for fights.

Highly restricted uses.

The power is also extensible to other snacks as well, including but not limited to: potato chips, pizza slices, and chicken wings. It is able to be targeted to specific people, but will usually happen on "autopilot" even if not purposely being called upon. A blessing and a curse - it's the way of the hero.

You have the ability to consistently annoy all around you at will
People will stop trying to share your fries

You have green skin

The cookie has a magical force imbued that keeps it from breaking, it would take a force equal to that which blessed it to even crack the shield. The shield is also able to negate attacks.

name: Oil Secretion

Would have to wash oil off your skin after use

name: Weapon: Caladbolg
overview: wield Caladbolg

Since this sword always destroys cities when unsealed it is best not to use it unless needed

Only protects you physically.

overview: summon Tortegulous when in danger.
description: To summon Tortegulous is to summon destruction. Tortegulous is the giant demon Turtle which once ruled.  If you wish to summon him, beware, he may go out of control. But your enemies will run in fear. You can only summon him twice a day; or risk exhausting your power completely.

Does not work on the guardians aside from Ganthet

overview: grow the greatest mustach in existence not held by the omnipotent.
description: You can change the style, length, color, and texture of the mustach at will, and control it's actions telepathically. Ultimate slaves.

name: Gizmo

Say a fire extingusher, with this power you can turn it into a jetpack, a nuclear explosion, or even a small military tank.

Super strength
