They vanish when not needed. You get command of one brigade if a division or more is called up. If this somehow isn't enough, Kyst will trigger emergency power #4 if you have it.
pros: 1,000,000 kystians. As much help as Kyst will supply outside of Itself.
cons: You need Kyst to use emergency power #4.

name: Triscuit Power
overview: turn things into Triscuits.
description: With this power, simply point to an object and shout "Triscuit! " and, in a puff of smoke, where the object used to be, there's a steaming pile of Triscuits. You can use this on living and non-living objects/beings alike. The number of Triscuits in the stack depends on the number of molecules in the object. And if you're a villain, you can also cause destruction by changing important structural elements into Triscuits, thereby knocking everything else down.
pros: Turn your worst enemies into Triscuits.
Good snack while on the road.
The number of Triscuits is equal to the number of molecules in the object.
cons: You might use this power accidentally.
You cannot poison your Triscuits.

name: Drunk Shot
overview: shoot a rifle or pistol with better accuracy and speed while drunk than you can sober.
description: With this ability you can shoot faster and more accurately even make trick shots and impossible shots while being drunk than you could sober.
pros: Become the one of the greatest gun slingers of all time.
cons: Will only last as long as your drunk.

name: Microsoft Manager
overview: control anyone on microsoft at the time
description: Cannot control any other computer operating systems.
pros: Lots of people use microsoft
cons: If the system goes down, so do you

name: Bad Guy Be Gone
overview: turn bad guys into superheroes.
description: With a magical pen, you erase the badness of the bad guys and draw in super powers to make them superheroes.
pros: Anyone can be a superhero
No more bad guys
cons: Super heroes wouldn't be so unique

name: Calli, The Trusted House
overview: close off people from outside and foreign influence.
description: This power can be manifested in various ways. You can create a sealed house made of adobe bricks all around the targeted people. If they are in a house, you can reinforce the walls and fill any opening with adobe clay. These are spiritual manifestation of your will, so it's impervious to supernatural ways of violation, like teleportation. You can also create a "house" around people's mind and heart, reinforcing their trust in people they really know, while magnifying their distrust in others.
pros: Protect yourself or others with supernatural adobe houses.
Your houses are immune to supernatural ways of violation.
Your houses are unmovable too.
cons: Not even you can violate the houses you created, except maybe by removing them.
If you create a house around you to protect yourself, you won't be able to move very far.
It's very dark in your houses since there are no windows either.

name: Artifact: Ensis Exorcizans
overview: summon a sword or a fan that can get rid of demons or magic.
description: Whenever you say "Adeat", a giant sword or fan will appear. These things can cancel magical spells, seals, and curses. They can also send demons back to where they came from.
pros: The sword is lethal to magical creatures.
The sword is strong enough to cut boulders.
The fan can be used to hit people without killing or seriously hurting them.
cons: The chances of you getting the sword or the fan is RANDOM.
The sword is extremely heavy.
The fan barely hurts anyone physically.

name: Failkintectis
overview: mind waste others to fail and possibly cause you to fail also as a side affect.
description: Started back in 25 AD when King Fail'los was slayed by his own minnions and then anyone who visits the kingdom becomes over raged with fail and can control others thus the city was burnt to the ground in a matter of hours but the statue of the King still stands! only one King of Fail still roams the realm of earth his name is Sir Dude Of Puppets otherwise known as Dudepuppet.
pros: For Causing Humor
For Making Freinds
For Distractions
cons: Can Cause rage not being able to do something.
Can Cause desire to eat.
Can Cause FAIL!

name: Condition Change: Kiss
overview: make a power work only after the user has kissed their target
description: You can make a power work only after the user has kissed the intended target. The kiss has to be on the cheek or lips so kissing themself will not work. The kiss also has to be an actual kiss, so no blowing a kiss to use the power. This power is tactile and can never be turned off.
pros: Watching someone have to kiss their archenemy.
If this power affects a power that only affects the user they can never use the power again.
The results of using this power are highly amusing.
cons: You have to touch the person for this power to work.
They only need to kiss once to use the power as many times as they want.
Accidently using this on a friend.

name: 4th Law Of Kyst: Kyst Absolute
overview: manifest the Kyst Law of Kyst Absolute around yourself.
description: "The Kyst dimension is self-aware and godlike and won't allow the divine powers of others to work. " This power only goes an inch around your body. This power stops powers of a divine/infernal/mythical nature from directly affecting you. You still would be hurt if caught in the blast of a hellish fireball. Zeus's lightning bolt could indirectly zap you with electricity. An angel could still pick you up and drop you from the sky. A divine wind could push you around.
pros: Immunity to direct effects of infernal/divine/mythic powers.
cons: You still die if caught in the blast of an infernal nuke-like fireball.
Power negation or reality anchoring.

name: Hygiene Transformation
overview: transform to any hygienic object or substance.
description: You can change into any object or substance that belongs to the hygiene family, such as baths, toilets, soaps, water, etc. It can be useful sometimes if you want to scare people when they are in your bathroom or in public restrooms.
pros: Scare people when they are in the restrooms.
Hide from danger.
Or simply have fun!
cons: People can poop on/inside you.
They could use you.
People or animal could chase you if you smell too bad or too good!
tags: water...anything that is in the Hygiene family .

name: Key  Of  Adam
overview: open Mephisto's Codex
description: The Key of Adam is a mystical item that has been lost for thousands of years.  It was hidden by the three angels of the highest court.  Their help is needed to find the key.  With the Key of Adam, you can either open Mephisto's Codex or destroy it by breaking the key off in the lock.
pros: With the key you will never get locked out again
As long as your mission it to destroy the codex you will be considered a holy crusader
While Destroying the codex will not kill or hurt satan but it will set him back by hundreds of years
cons: If you use the codex for any reason you will be damned
As long as your mission is to destroy the codex you will be a target for demonic Assassination
If you open the codex life as we know it will end

name: Zodiac: Virgo
overview: make an enemy fear the loss of mental virginity
description: By making the sign of Virgo the Virgin in the air you can make an enemy run screaming from anything that goes against their idea of a perfect world, for as long as up to two days.
pros: Just yell at your enemy until you find something that goes against what they believe.
Might be amusing to keep doing this for a long period of time.
cons: Only lasts two days.
Have to make the sign of Virgo.

name: Mimicking Pose
overview: make anyone do your signature poses for 5 min.
description: Yeah, think of them posing. It must be poses that you can do and anyone will do those poses. If you do them in the air, they stay in the air for 5 min.
pros: You can make anyone do your poses.
cons: This effect lasts for 5 min.

name: Hueco Mundo
overview: create a world of soul eating hollows.
description: The hollows are lost souls that devour other souls to increase their power. With this power, you can create your own hollow world and let these creatures slug it out. Command hollows of different ranks (normal, gillian, adjuchas, vasto lordes) and make them visible to normal people. As long as you have this ability, they should not run amok.
pros: Summon powerful spirits to aid you in battle
Become the king of a world
cons: If you lose this ability, the hollows will start eating humans
Cannibalizing each other to become stronger

name: Dantes Rage
overview: summon the 1/2 dragon 1/2 human Derrick Dante (Fumetsu Ryuu... Immortal dragon)
description: When Dante's scroll is in your possession you may call on him. He does not like being call on so his rage explodes when this happens you can redirect the enormous power into a blast to annihilate your enemy or to create something of perfection if you redirect it with a form of magic transforming this rage into anything your heart desires. But it better be worth it because he remembers who has wielded his scroll. Recommended
pros: Almost unbeatable
Can turn into a beautiful creation such as life
Huge amounts of power (absorbing not recommended)
cons: Dante will find you
If it falls into the wrong hands things will go to hell

name: Summon Harubi
overview: summon a gorilla-elephant centauroid kystian. See description.
description: Harubi aren't a human and horse hybrid but a gorilla and elephant hybrid. Harubi stand 14 feet tall. They appear with some sort of 18 to 24 foot long melee weapon and two handheld weapons. Harubi can lift 350 tons but pull 500 tons. They can run as fast as an elephant and have as average IQ. Harubi have the ability to copy memories of anyone who gets 100 feet away or closer.
pros: Harubi can lift 350 tons and pull 500 tons.
Can copy memories and learn possibly important things for you.
cons: A 14-foot-tall gorilla-elephant centauroid creature takes up room.
Especially if you summon 19 of them.

name: Myth Power: Thrasos' Thrill
overview: channel Thrasos' command over the essence of carelessness, recklessness and rash action
description: Thrasos (Thrasus), in Greek myth, was the god of rush, carelessness, recklessness and rashness. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically disrupt perception of probability, luck, fate, chance, the past or the future by touch. In addition, one's luck increases when one acts erratically, recklessly and without careful forethought. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive and communicate with rash and reckless people at will. One may even psychically compel careful, meticulous people.
pros: Prevent psychic perception of luck/fortune/chance/probability/fate/destiny, the past or the future
Gain better and better luck the more rash, erratic, reckless and spontaneous one acts
Psychically perceive and communicate with reckless people; compel cautious, prudent people
cons: You are encouraged to rash, spontaneous action (the make of this power is a prude)
Probability/chance/luck based-MythPowers and Unpredictability provide immunity (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Vehicon Summon
overview: summon any Vehicon
description: With this power you can summon any Vehicon from the Transformers series. The Vehicons are under your complete control but you cannot make them disappear. You can summon as many Vehicons as you want at a time.
pros: You can summon any Vehicon
They are under your complete control
You can summon as many as you want
cons: You cannot make them disappear

name: Random Dimension Travel
overview: make dimension travelers go to random dimensions rather than ones of their choice.
description: Dimension travelers afflicted by this power 'think' they're going to a dimension(timeline,plane,alternate universe) of their choice but it's totally random chance where they end up. Dimension travelers that use portals(doors,etc) get a preview of this other random place. With practice you can affect someone with the Personal Realm power if he has a dimension travel power that uses portals(doors,etc). The effects of this power are temporary.
pros: With practice keep someone out of his or her Personal Realm.
You might get lucky and a enemy dies in the random world he goes to.
cons: Dimension travelers using portals can avoid deadly random worlds.
The effects of this power wear off and need renewing.

name: Glitter Skin
overview: grow reflective glitter-like scales on your body
description: This power manifests as a kind of bizarre eczema or psoriasis. Your skin flakes and scales, but the bits of skin resemble tiny metallic and highly reflective flakes, like glitter. The glitter covers your body and is constantly regeneting any lost pieces. Your skin becomed highly reflective and collected glitter may be thrown at opponents' faces for distration, and potential temporarly blinding. There are two kinds: 1) Permanant Glitter Skin and 2) Manifesting Glitter Skin at will.
pros: Reflects light and energy-based attacks
Thrown glitter can be distracting and irritating if got in mouth or eyes
Glitter party at any time!
cons: The glitter never completely washes away - always some left
Significant other may think you have a stripper's body glitter on you
Leaves behind a trail of glitter where ever you go

name: Mooning Manipulation
overview: manipulate people to moon other people.
description:
Mooning Manipulation is the ability to moon* other people by manipulating someone to moon.   

*Mooning is the act of displaying one's bare buttocks by removing clothing, e.g., by lowering the backside of one's trousers and underpants, usually bending over.
pros: Simply watching people moon.
Make fun of someone.
Humiliate someone.
cons: People could be mad at you.
You could go blind by doing it to fat people.

name: Reversed Gas
overview: make gases move against air currents.
description: When released in the atmosphere, a gas is dispersed and eventually follows the same direction as the flow of air. Reversing it makes it follow the air currents in the opposite direction. This property remains active as long as the gas is inside the ambient air and isn't too dispersed in the area it is released. A reversed gas still tends to rise or sink in the air based on its density in the same way as its normal version.
pros: You can make exhaust ventilation systems useless against poisonous gases as they will be kept in.
It is useless and sometimes harmful to blow on reversed gases as they will invade the lungs.
Reversed gases can follow ventilation systems to the source.
cons: It doesn't work on the ambient air of an area, nor on solid particles in suspension.
It doesn't work if the gas is so dispersed it is considered a part of the ambient air on a area.
Be careful not to accidentally breathe in gases you shouldn't breathe.

name: Demonic Weaponry: Gore
overview: use Gore.
description: Gore is a double edged long sword made of pure steel, and a red oak hilt. When bathed in blood the blade will glow a dark red, but that's not all that makes Gore special. It drinks the blood it baths it, and the more blood it drinks, the stronger the user becomes. But with every drop of blood it drinks, the user comes closer to becoming a demon.
pros: Use Gore.
More you kill, stronger you become.
cons: Risk of turning into a Demon.
Only works with blood.

name: Greater Kystian Morph #1
overview: become a unsummonable kystian.
description: The thathan from Kyst: Emergency Power #4, a 130-foot-tall bipedal dinosaur-like creature. You can lift 7000 tons, smash, crush or go through just about anything you want to. If you want a weapon, you'll need to make one that will be big enough for your new form. This power leaves you unconscious when deactivated.
pros: Be a 130-foot-tall monster with a gun (if you made one).
You can lift 1,400,000 lbs.
cons: You'll need an ally you can trust when you revert to human form.

name: Fruit Juicer
overview: change the inside of a fruit into juice while leaving the skin untouched.
description: By concentrating on a fruit, you can liquefy its pulp while it's still inside the skin. And that's it! Just cut or pierce the skin and enjoy a refreshing fruit juice full of vitamins! Also, the nice thing is only the meat of the fruit will be juiced, not the seeds, nor the occasional bugs.
pros: A juiced fruit offer less resistance to opening attempts.
Exposed to the air, fruit juices quickly lose lots of vitamins. Well, you won't have that problem.
Botanically speaking, tomatoes are fruits, so affectable by your power!
cons: It doesn't work on vegetables.
Don't quaff it if the fruit has seeds.
tags: was edited as it was just a unimaginative combination of two unrelated powers

name: Unicron Summon
overview: summon Unicron
description: With this power you can summon Unicron from the Transformers Universe into your own. Once he is here however you cannot send him back unless he wants to go back. He is also not under your control but he is susceptible to mind control or robot controlling powers. If you do somehow get him to be under your control you can have him eat enemy planets or cause him to make his various minions and worshipers to fight your battles for you.
pros: You can summon Unicron.
He is susceptible to mind controlling and robot controlling powers.
cons: He is not under your control.
You cannot send him back unless he wants to be sent back.

name: Meat Eater
overview: mimic an animal's call when you eat its meat
description: With this power you will be able to mimic the sounds an animal makes after eating its meat. By using the animal's call you can attract the attention of other members of the species and possibly befriends them.
pros: You can mimic an animal's call by eating its meat
cons: Not much use in physical combat
This is not a power for vegetarians

name: Wide Load
overview: make cars and trucks wider
description: With this power you can make cars and trucks wider. You can make them as wide as you want so that they take up the whole road or become to big to be on the road.
pros: You can make cars and trucks wider
You can prevent cars from passing your car in a race
You can make criminal's get away cars to wide to fit on the road
cons: You cannot reverse the effects of this power
Only works on cars and trucks

name: Malinalli, The Disease Carrier
overview: alternatively cause periods of devastating epidemic and periods of rejuvenation.
description: This power has two phases. They alternate each time you activate it and last for 13 days before you can turn them off. During the first one, your hair will become withered grass and you will contaminate everyone near you with a contageous disease which exacerbates the worst aspects of one's emotions, personality, physical condition,... During the other, your hair will become green grass and everyone who has been contaminated will become completely healthy and receive a huge boost of vitality.
pros: Depending on the point of view, your power can be seen as a purge of the weak elements.
You can heal any disease, that is if the person can survive the first phase of your power.
Give a huge power boost to your allies during the 2nd phase, but they need to survive the 1st one.
cons: You need to wait for thirteen days before you can turn each phase off.
If you made enemies during the 1st phase, they could get the means to kill you during the 2nd one.
The disease of the 1st phase doesn't kill directly, but it easily triggers wars and conflicts.

name: Laugh Track Conjuring
overview: summon a laugh/boo/shock/etc. track to where you are
description: It goes quite simply: Whenever you feel the need to use those old sitcom laugh/boo/gasp/etc. tracks, you simply summon the track by thinking of it during the current situation. You can choose how long, loud, and in what form. For example: you want a laugh track for 5 seconds with a loud tone and have one of those old ladies say "I don't get it!" in the background.
pros: Boost your ego to unimaginable size
Cause some hilarious moments
You won't feel lonely ever again
cons: Others could hear it, so it may be a disturbance
Bad idea to use near the mentally insane
May warrant you a punch in the face if you try to make a laugh track towards the physically superior

name: Type I Pneumocyte Mimicry
overview: create an oxygen-rich area in front of you and a carbon-dioxide-rich area behind you.
description: This power is always active. Your body is very big, wide and extremely flat. It's also entirely covered by microscopic pores. These actively filter gases at will, letting only oxygen pass in front of you and carbon dioxide behind you. You are also immune to hyperoxia. However, certains gases (some very toxic) can break through and collect in front of you, such as carbon monoxide, nitric oxide, cyanide or sulfur monoxide. It also works with dissolved gases; you can extract them out of water.
pros: You can make the area in front of you extremely rich in oxygen, which you can breathe.
You can create bubbles of dioxygen out of water.
Oxygen is very toxic to living beings in high concentration. Luckily, you're immune to hyperoxia.
cons: Some dangerous gases can collect in front of you when you attempt to collect oxygen.
Your appearance is very strange.
By depriving water of oxygen, you can kill animals inside.

name: Tsar Bomba
overview: unleash the king of all bombs
description: (This ability should not be used at all except if you have no choice) you have to choose where you want to drop it, this bomb has 57,000,000 Tunes of TNT. It was so powerful that it was completely impractical, know your history
pros: You have the most powerful weapon ever constructed by mankind
Total destruction bomb
Has fallout of 1000 square kilometers (pro & con)
cons: People will think that you are a terrorist
No one will survive not even you
The last thing people will see is everything and everyone die

name: Joke Neutralization
overview: negate any power that is based on jokes or is a joke
description: Some jokes just aren't good and when combined with superpowers they become even worse. Well, now you don't have to bother with the powers anymore. Just get this power and you can negate any power that is based on jokes. You are also immune to them if they cannot be negated.
pros: This includes powers having to do with jokesters, jesters, clowns, etc. You get the idea.
Immunity to joke-based powers.
NOTE: This power technically is a joke, but does not treat itself as so.
cons: Doesn't help with any non-joke powers.
Doesn't help with corny jokes or puns that are not affected by powers.
Does NOT help with pranks.

name: Jello World
overview: give anyone or anything in your vicinity the properties of jello
description: A person with this power can give anything within their vicinity the properties of jello. This includes the wobbliness and the lack of rigidity. A person with this power can also use this on people but it is very squicky. For example this would cause the person affected to collapse due to lack of support however they would still be able to survive due to the jello cusioning their brain and organs. Getting away from that 2 meter radius restores the person affected from the jelloification.
pros: Easy to defeat jello-ified enemies
Easier to eat your food
Can swim through jello-ified walls
cons: Kind of squicky when you apply this in combat
Does not change the color of objects affected
Effects only work in a 2 meter radius from user

name: Fairy Tale Disbelief
overview: not be affected by the supernatural if you do not believe it exists
description: A person with this power must be a skeptic or else this power is useless. This power gives the user immunity to the supernatural because they do not believe that it exists. As such they would be immune to spell and some of the more spectacular powers like pyrokinesis or telekinesis. They might think that the pyrokinetics is using some sort of light show-the fire becomes lights and the telekinesis becomes a trick with strings when used on them.
pros: Immune to magic if you don't believe it is real
Immune to some of the more spectacular superpowers if they don't look remotely believable
Because of this the user has no need to dabble into supernatural affairs
cons: You might not take people with superpowers seriously
Some of the more believable powers in this list are immune to this power
This power warps abilities into more believable counterparts which might be just as dangerous

name: Smell Warp
overview: change the scent of things
description: WIth this power you can change the way things smell. Make camel poop smell like roses and vice versa. Make your breath smell "minty fresh", make yourself "smell like a man" without even using Old Spice etc. You can change the scent of anything as many times as you want.
pros: You can change the smell of anything
cons: Not much use in physical combat unless you make everything around the enemy smell bad so he retreats

name: Communicate With Monsters
overview: talk to monsters in their own language
description: With this power you can talk to all kinds of monsters and understand what they're saying. This power does not give you control over monsters but you might be able to strike a deal with them or gain their trust by speaking they're language.
pros: You can communicate with monsters
cons: This power does not allow you to control monsters
The monsters will probably just eat/kill you before you even get a chance to speak

name: Snap You're Tardy
overview: cause someone to always be tardy
description: With this power you can cause someone to be tardy no matter what they do. You can use this power on as many people as you want but you cannot reverse the effects of this power.
pros: You can make someone always be tardy
cons: You cannot reverse the effects of this power

name: Summon Norr
overview: summon a half-alive thing.
description: A norr is 8 feet tall and looks like a marionette made of medical waste. They are strong enough to rip open a bank vault and nothing hurts them. They hate anything not half-alive like they are. Including you-a norr will use any loophole in a command you give it to kill you, or, if not you, anybody else. Norr can only be killed by taking away the hate they feel or by making them forget what they hate. Powers that affect the living, the dead or the undead won't work on them.
pros: A strong and invulnerable helper (?)
Only killed by emotion draining or memory loss.
cons: They will use loopholes in commands to kill you.
If you're not smart enough. Reread con #1.

name: ""Mechanical Grammar Errors""
overview: never have a mechanical grammar error again!
description: Have you ever been typing and you spelled it wrong? Not anymore! With this power you will have a perfect spelling, like a dictionary!
pros: No more mechanical grammar errors!
cons: Not really useful with spell check.......
Only has effect when on a computer,laptop,etc.
No defense or combat use.......

name: Half Yukionna
overview: be half-human, half-yukionna
description: You gain from this power boosted magical capabilities however the boost is far higher for snow- or ice-based magic than anything else. Also, your body is capable of withstanding temperatures well below the freezing point of water. The highest cost of this power though is decreased physical strength and speed.
pros: Very few beings can overcome you in a battle of snow magic.
You could survive in the Arctic regions.
cons: You're physically weak and slow.
Can only be gained by females especially since Yukionna translates as "Snow Girl".

name: Bee Keeper
overview: control a hoard of angry bumble-bees.
description: This power allows you to BEE able to control and angry hoard of bees. They live inside your honey-comb-shaped pores.
pros: Easily overwhelm your enemies!
cons: Honey-comb pores are itchy.
The constant buzzing in your head gets annoying.

name: High Fructose Mutation
overview: be Stretch Armstrong.
description: Due to diets based entirely on high fructose corn syrup, mutants have appeared with cell cytoplasm and blood plasma consisting entirely of gooey corn syrup. These mutants can stretch to ridiculous lengths in their pursuit of justice/vengeance. Sharp objects are known to be lethal since they have no more platelets, just sugary goo. Low temperatures decrease their stretching ability, and high temperatures increase likelihood of overstretching, again being quite lethal.
pros: Make leaps and bounds like no other!
Save cats, put ladder companies out of business.
Experimental cannibals will love you.
cons: Advanced form of hemophilia.
No holidays in exotic locales.
Totally sterile.

name: Slime
overview: have the characteristics of a slime.
description: A Slime is a squishy, jello type creature that moves at a slow pace. They are impervious to any physical attack. It can suck vast amounts of air into itself becoming a giant and divide into smaller slimes. Solid materials tend to dissolve when made contact with a slime. Also if you fall from a giant distance the slime will splatter and then reform.
pros: Impervious to physical attacks.
If falling from a high distance, then splattering on the ground, you will reform.
If someone attacks you they will dissolve into you.
cons: Other superpowers like mind attacks will harm you.

name: Delete This Deadly Grip Snap
overview: nerve pinch your opponent, then finish them with a Double Knee Breaker.
description: You could render your foe unconscious by pressure pointing your victim's neck with all four fingers opposing the thumb on both hands. You then grab them by the shoulders and stand on their knees, snapping them backwards. Finally, you flip back with a kick and send the opponent rolling backwards until their knees snap back into place.
pros: a fight combo is not a power
cons: a fight combo is not a power

name: Hobokinesis
overview: control hobos with one's mind.
description: You can control hobos with your mind. Example of uses: slavery, armies, or just for entertainment.
pros: Controlling hobos.
Formation of possible armies; slavery uses; entertainment purposes.
cons: Uncleanliness
Hobos frequently self-defecate.

name: Rabid Wrath
overview: inflict rabies on someone
description: Rabies is a disease that is transmitted by animal bites and is Very Very VERY deadly if not treated directly after the bite. This power allows you to inflict a very powerful and fast-acting rabies virus onto someone, and to cure someone of rabies. You can also infect animals with rabies as well. Since rabies is a VERY deadly disease if not treated, this should be a last resort.
pros: You can inflict a powerful, fast-acting rabies virus on an enemy.
You can also cure someone who has rabies
You can infect animals as well
cons: Rabies can be VERY VERY VERY Deadly
Use with caution
This can be a last resort

name: Giant Robot Head Summon
overview: summon the heads of giant robots
description: With this power you can cause the head of any robot over 9 feet tall to appear in your hand. This is useful if you're in a fight with a giant robot, you can just cause its head to appear in your hands, thereby decapitating the robot and possibly killing it. It's also useful if you collect giant robot heads. You also gain the strength necessary to hold the giant robot head. You retain the strength until you put the robot head down.
pros: You can cause the head of any robot over 9 feet tall to appear in your hand
Easily win fights against giant robots with heads
Complete your giant robot head collection
cons: Doesn't work against robots under 9 feet tall
Doesn't work against giant robots who don't have heads
The giant robot might not need its head to continue functioning

name: Rise Of The Zords
overview: turn into any of the Power Ranger zords
description: With this power you can turn into of the Power Rangers Zords. You are unable to turn into the Megazords with this power but if you can find a bunch of other people with this power you can form them together.
pros: You can turn into any of the power rangers zords
cons: You can't turn into Megazords

name: Parasitic Negotiation
overview: strike deals with parasites
description: With this power, you can communicate with human parasites; head lice, tics, fleas etc. You also gain good diplomatic skills with this power. Instead of killing the parasites, you can strike deals with them. You may ask them to take less blood, or slow breeding down, in return for you not killing them. It also works with not-really parasitic creatures, like mosquitoes. You can make the air around you as forbidden air-space, in return for not swatting them. You can regulate tape worms as well!
pros: Have friendly parasites living on/in your body. HARMONY WITH HEAD LICE!
Communicate with parasites on other people as well.
Generate mosquito-free zones.
cons: You have to promise something in return, and if you break it, they go back to their nasty selves.
People might try to kill them, despite your protesting.
Human parasites only.

name: Color Identifier
overview: see the name of a color by touching the t shirt, car, etc by touching it with your hands
description: You have the great option of knowing what the exact color is of a car, shoes, T-shirt, etc. You want to know the color of something, then touch it with one of your hands or both hands and you'll find out at the blink of an eye what the exact color is. You won't just know that something is crimson, but also the variation or different shade, such as Harvard crimson.
pros: You can know your buying the car of the exact color you want
It's a passive power so people can't get hurt compared to if you have optic blasts
Its something you can control so playing basketball, and other things won't be inconvenient
cons: For something involving multiple colors you have to touch the item repeatedly to know all colors
Not a visible physical power so you can't use it to end a argument of what color something is
You could cheat if something involves answering a question of what color is this car, t shirt, etc

name: Seeing Gibberish
overview: cause others to view any written words as gibberish
description: With this ability you can cause others to view any wrriten words as an unreadable mess or in other words, gibberish. Affected people will not be able to read anything.
pros: Confuse enemies
cons: Affected have a hard time writing

name: Condition Change: Forests
overview: make a power work only when the user is in a forest
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to work only when the user is in a forest. Cannot be used on a power already affected by a Condition Change requiring another type of terrain. This power is tactile.
pros: Just make sure you don't fight anywhere near forests.
cons: Have to touch the opponent and each touch only affects one power.

name: Religious Power Boost
overview: boost religion-based powers based on your own faith.
description: With this power, your powers get boosted depending on how strongly you believe in a religion. If you are religious at all, this will give a boost; if agnostic, you'll get a slight boost and for atheists there is no boost.
pros: If religious, your religion-based powers are boosted.
You can further your faith's cause with your amplified powers.
You can even follow any religion and get a boost.
cons: If atheist, your religion-based powers are the same (not boosted).
No powers can eliminate the con of this superpower.
If you have no religion-based superpowers.

name: Vomiting Bulbs
overview: vomit light bulbs that give you information about people
description: While thinking about someone, you can vomit a light bulb with their name on it. The light bulb will remain lit as long as this person is alive, its colour will vary according to their situation. You will also know where that person is, and even communicate with them. If the light bulb is broken, you will lose all contact. You can eat the light bulb after use to store it. While holding the light bulb, that person will not be able to harm you. You can vomit any numbers of light bulbs.
pros: You can know where is anyone.
While holding a light bulb that person cannot harm you.
Can talk to anyone no matter how far they are.
cons: Have to vomit and eat light bulbs.
You only can make one light bulb for each person.
Light bulbs only work while you hold them.

name: Zord Summon
overview: summon any of the Power Ranger Zords
description: With this power you can summon any Power Ranger Zord from any of the shows or movies. The Zords are under your complete control and you can summon as many as you want. You can also summon whole teams of Zords and make them form Megazords to fight for you. Once your done with them you can just send them back to wherever they came from.
pros: You can summon Zords
The Zords are under your complete control
You can make them form Megazords
cons: They can be destroyed

name: Rat Control/Mutation
overview: control and mutate any species of rat
description: With this power you can control and mutate any species of rat. When you mutate it, it becomes six feet tall gains super strength, sharper teeth and it can spit poison it can also launch its claw at people like some sort of projectile and have new claws grow in right after. Its tail also becomes super sharp and the rat can use it as a sword. When you're done with the rat you can just unmutate it and send it away.
pros: You can control and mutate any species of rat
When you're done you can unmutate the rat and send it away
cons: Only works for rats not mice or any other rodent

name: Call Of Cthulhu
overview: call Cthulhu from any phone
description: With this power, all you need do is pick up a phone and say "Call Cthulhu" into the receiver. Within seconds, the Great Old One will pick up the phone, and you can talk to him. He will respond to you and act as if you might have been an old friend of his from school.
pros: You get to talk to Cthulhu
I'm sure Cthulhu knows a lot more than you do, and he might share that knowledge if you're nice
If you're really nice, and Cthulhu is in a good mood, he might just unleash his hell on your enemies
cons: Cthulhu might be busy, and he probably doesn't like being interrupted
You may go insane from the knowledge he bestows upon you
You probably shouldn't make jokes at his expense

name: U.C.S.
overview: uncontrollably and continuously shapeshift into different human forms.
description: This power is more of a curse because it's shapeshifting with two twists. 1/You cannot control which form you transform into but they will only be human forms. And 2/You shapeshift every few seconds from the moment that you are born and so on even after you die (if you do die. ) This is great for being a spy or thief however no one will know or love you. You're new bodies may have different skin color, eye color, hair color, voice tone, biological age, gender and various other qualities.
pros: Be the best spy since your fingerprints/features will continuously change.
Become immortal since you will keep shifting to another form that could be younger.
Regenerate from any physical injuries. (Not while something like a bullet is stuck inside of you)
cons: You can never be loved, known or remembered (Since you can't control the power. )
You might turn into a 115 year old and die.
If you are completely obliterated, you're dead since no one can survive that.

name: Double Double Speak Speak
overview: make people say every word twice
description: With this power you can cause people to repeat every single word they say. This isn't real useful except for that it annoys the speaker and anyone listening to them talk. You can undo this.
pros: You can make people repeat every single word they say
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Kiss Me Deadly
overview: poison anything in your path, by kissing or touching whatever they came into contact with.
description: You can gain the ability to poison people through a kiss, you can even poison your weapons by breathing on them.
pros: You could even exhale a poisonous mist at your foe, which kills them.
cons: It can only work for females.

name: Demon Fury
overview: have the power of a 2nd form tailed beast from naruto
description: Super speed, strength, stamina, acrobatics, and pain. You get covered in energy. Good news is, it's hard to break through, bad news it hurts like a b! #$%@. People will fear you and you get healed by this energy. It also shortens your lifespan because of it's healing factor. This energy actually burns your skin so if you didn't have that healing factor you'd look like a burn victim from the Chicago fire. Also ghostly unbreakable bones float over you.
pros: Super strong and super fast
Super agile and don't get tire easily
Heals
cons: Burns you
Shortens your lifespan
Control is difficult when you use it at high levels.

name: Multiple Personality
overview: have a party, but in your head!
description: Are you bored? Have a fun conversation with Frank, the grumpy old man in your head who refers to you as a whippersnapper. Or maybe Ferdinand, the former Chancellor of the Prussian Empire, to discuss the pros and cons of your newest stock portfolio.
pros: Never lonely
Have skills and knowledge of your other self
cons: Posible to get commited to an asylum
You talk to your self

name: Fist Scanner V2
overview: know the exact measurements of any object just by pointing your fist at it
description: With this power you can know the heigh, length and width of something just by pointing your fist at it.
pros: You can know the exact measurements of something just by pointing your fist at it
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Rise Of The Mummy
overview: turn into a mind controlling mummy
description: With this power you can turn into the mummy from Wizards of Waverly Place in order to fight crime. This means you can turn people into your minions and trap them in hieroglyphs
pros: You can control any number of people
You can store them in hieroglyphs when you're not using them
cons: You have a strong addiction to cookie dough ice cream
If your gauze gets unwrapped you automatically turn back into your human form and lose this power

name: Myth Power: Eusebia's Sapience
overview: channel Eusebia's command over the essence of piety, duty and filial respect
description: Eusebia (Eusebeia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of piety, duty and filial respect. As such, channeling her allows one to strengthen one's connection to deities of one's same moral alignment for as long as the power is in use. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who honestly believe in, love and respect divinity (regardless of mental defenses). One can even psychically inflict harm on those who honestly hate, deny or mock/disrespect divinity, by touch.
pros: Psychically strengthen connection to deities of similar moral alignment, regardless of pantheon
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel pious people/people of faith
Psychically inflict pain/injury on atheists, agnostics, and the irreligious at will
cons: When active, cannot use MythPower: Dyssebia's Defiance or other anti-divine abilities (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and heal loved ones until the higher levels (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Summon Kystian Guns Trader
overview: summon a half-alive weapon dealer.
description: The Kyst dimension keeps all the weapons of any fallen foes who dared try and invade it. The corpse-like weapon merchant you summon with this power will trade you one in exchange for a thinking non-kystian being. As for the weapons, think of the Men in Black movies or the Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy books, but Star Wars or Star Trek will work too. A weapon will be explained and if it needs ammo of some kind you will be given enough. Your trade could be a thinking clone of someone.
pros: High-speed nucleoannihilator pistol. It annihilates-good enough.
The assault ultraeliminator. It eliminates-do you need to know more?
A variable gravitic exploder. It explodes using gravity. Enough said.
cons: A one for one trade.

name: Summon Yuru
overview: summon a dimension-warping kystian.
description: Yuru look like badly out of focus humanoids. They seem to warp and distort space wherever they stand. Yuru can send someone to Kyst by sight or touch. This can affect someone visible in this universe but partly existing in another universe, e.g. the astral plane. Yuru are summoned with weapons. Two pistols, a melee weapon and a rifle. If the weapons are lost somehow, yuru are still strong enough to lift 20 tons. Yuru see perfectly well despite what they look like.
pros: Dimensional banishment, energy weapons and inhuman strength.
Foes that have never encountered them will think gaze-based powers are useless.
Give a yuru the power to see the invisible.
cons: Reality anchoring or some other power that someone will think of.

name: Creepy Clone
overview: clone an evil clone of yourself
description: You can clone an evil version of yourself and let the clone do your chorus/work for you. You can decide if and which of your powers the clone posesses.
pros: You have your very own clone living your life and you can do whatever you want to do!
You can grant the clone powers and take them away from the clone.
Only 1 clone at any given time.
cons: The clone is evil.
The clone may turn people against you.
The clone may have an obsession to rule the world.

name: Sunproof Skin
overview: not get sunburned
description: No longer with this power would you have to put on sunscreen, and wait 20 minutes before going to the pool, beach, etc. You don't have to worry about getting sunburned, and you can save money since you don't have to buy sunscreen.
pros: No having to put on sunscreen before going to beach, pool, etc
Your skin can't get sunburned from the sun
Unless as a gift or present for someone else you don't have to buy sunscreen anymore
cons: You can still get skin diseases
You are still vulnerable to sweating, heatstrokes, and other problems scorching days can produce

name: Golf Cart
overview: summon golf carts.
description: You can summon golf carts of any model, size,etc.
pros: Its a way of transportation.
cons: Golf carts really aren't that fast........

name: Enhancement: Radioactive
overview: make a power act radioactive by attaching this power to it
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power act like it is radioactive. E. G. Physical-based powers give off radiation that only you are immune to, and mental powers feel like they are giving off radioactive 'particles'. Potency is set at beta radiation. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This can only be attached to one power at a time.
pros: Makes mind-based powers act like they are radioactive.
You are immune to the 'radiation' this power gives off.
Potency is at a good level.
cons: Useless without another power.
Can still be damaged by other radiation.
Might not want a power to be radioactive.

name: Herbology: Immemor Arbor
overview: summon an Immemor Arbor
description: While the Immemor Arbor may be beautiful, its fruits are bittersweet. It looks to be a normal tree, with thorned blue flowers sprouting from the branches. The tree gets its name from the toxin within the flowers. The toxin grants its victims temporary superhuman strength, speed, agility, and reflexes, it also causes total memory loss. The toxin begins to kill after the superhuman abilities wear off.
pros: The toxin can be separated into a poison, a superhuman serum, and a memory loss potion.
The flowers and their toxins can be very valuable.
The other parts of the tree (the bark, wood, leaves) all have their own properties.
cons: This ability can be hard to discover without herbology, let alone use it properly.

name: Summon Carnallure
overview: summon a shapeshifting half-alive thing.
description: Carnallures are cousins of the norrs. If you die or they hurt you, they're unsummoned. They grudgingly accept they can't harm or kill you. Everyone else is fair game. Their favorite killing method is to look like a good looking human to lure a victim to his/her slow and painful death. A carnallure's real form is a 6-foot tall column of quivering flesh-like substance. Nothing will hurt them. They are strong as four normal men. Seeing them shape change is the only way to kill them.
pros: A majority (?) of people are safe from them.
They won't hurt or kill you.
A shapeshifting (if somewhat Hannibal Lecter like) helper.
cons: You've summoned a shapeshifting serial killer to this world.

name: Mimic Slave
overview: obey and not to want to harm or kill the person from whom you duplicated this superpower.
description: This power can only be active if you copied it. If the person from whom you copied it gives you an order, you will be forced to obey them. This power also prevents you from having any bad feelings, intentions or opinion about that person. You only take orders from the person from whom you directly copied it, not the one from whom that person copied it, if that's the case. It works as long as they don't lose their power. If you obtained it in any ways other than duplication, nothing happens.
pros: If you obtained this power in any other way, you don't have to obey anyone.
You can command anyone who copies this power from you, even if you already have a master yourself.
If your master loses their ability, they will also lose their power on you.
cons: If they recover it (not through copy nor by stealing someone else's), they can control you again.
You should not copy this ability and it's useless if noone duplicates it from you.
This power can still be stolen, deleted, cancelled, etc.

name: Poison Dart Strike V4 Spirits
overview: shoot poison darts from your hands
description: With this power you can shoot poison darts from your hands but they can only hurt spirits (ghosts, angels, demons etc. ) these poison darts will paralyze the victim for about twenty minutes after they pass through them but after twenty minutes the spirit will probably seek vengeance on you.
pros: You can paralyze spirits for up to twenty minutes
cons: As soon as the spirit is free they will most likely kill you

name: Obelisk The Tormentor
overview: turn into Obelisk the Tormentor from Yu-Gi-Oh
description: This power is something you should cherish, you have great power but at risk you have to bind your very soul to the god. You have all of his powers and memories
pros: Your strength is four thousand times stronger when you are in this form
You are the Epitome of all evil
You are immortal in this form
cons: You are not a god you just look like him
You look scary and evil
You have to pray to Obelisk the Tormentor

name: Delete This Ocd
overview: be obsessed over details
description: not a superpower
pros: Have OCD
It makes it easier to make friends.
cons: You worry too much

name: Apoco Blast
overview: destroy any world in a single, concentrated blast
description: This is a very serious and powerful attack that involves the utmost concentration, willpower, and inner strengh to unleash. What happens is that you take in energy from the universe around you, add in your own plus your strengh and willpower, and unleash an apocolyptic blast of pure energy that destroy a world of any size. The one deadly backdraw is that the person who used it is also eliminated with the blast.
pros: Completely destroys a planet.
cons: Destroys the user completely

name: Cheap Summoner
overview: summon half of an object.
description: The ability to instantly summon half of any object to your general location. Once half is summoned, you cannot simply summon the other half because you would only end up with half of the remaining half or a forth of the original. You cannot unsummon an object to return it to its original structure. You are able to choose which half is summoned.
pros: Some is better than none.
Cutting things in half.
If you have twice what you need of something, you can summon the half you need.
cons: Don't summon living things. They dont like being cut in half.
Summoning unstable items can have bad side effects.
Would need two of everything for this power to be useful.

name: Summoning: Recall
overview: recall any summons.
description: Can send summons back to where they were summoned from, or return people from certain places that you summoned then to.
pros: Can return summons, or people.
Easy to use.
cons: No use in actual combat.

name: Old One Power: Zalgo
overview: channel the power of the (Old One? ) Zalgo
description: Zalgo is the god of and source of a force that we have no name for save Zalgo, created by the interaction of the hivemind called "Anonymous" with the forces of the Old Ones. Zalgo's force causes corruption, mutation, insanity, hatred, violence, and death. Fully unrestrained, it would cause the apocalypse. You can control this force and use it to achieve virtually any effect of corruption. While Zalgo is presently sealed from this universe, you can contact him. He is very intelligent.
pros: You can control (very loosely) the beasts that result from life + Zalgo force.
The Zalgo force works on inanimate objects too. A building might have impossible architecture.
Zalgo himself can be contacted, may provide useful advice, and protect you from his apocalypse.
cons: The force cannot move through walls, believe it or not. It can move through openings, though.
There is essentially no beneficial use of your power, except selectively killing evil.
Zalgo will be in your head, trying to get you to help break down the wall keeping him out of reality

name: Glutton's Jaw
overview: consume almost anything with one bite.
description: With this power you can consume anything with one bite by morphing your jaw to any size you can manage. This power also has the side effect of applying pressure to whatever you eat while it is in your digestive system so that you do not explode from eating something too large. Most people with this power could only eat things up to the size of an airplane.
pros: Eat things you could not before.
Consume things before they can harm you.
Great party trick.
cons: Without other powers, only eating the size of an airplane is obtainable.
You may not be able to digest the things that you eat.
Using the bathroom after eating something the size of an airplane.

name: Myth Power: Telete's Test
overview: channel Telete's command over the essence of mystic initiation
description: Telete, in Greek myth, was the goddess of initiation into mystery rites, such as cults and secret societies. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the locations of meeting places for cults and secret societies. In addition, one may psychically perceive, communicate and compel members of secret societies and cults. Furthermore, one may inscribe arcane symbols on matter by touch; only the user, and subjects chosen by him, may interact with inscribed objects or subjects.
pros: Psychically perceive the locatons of meeting places for cults and secret societies
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel secret society/cult members
Inscribe matter with cryptic symbols; only the user and chosen subjects can sense/interact with them
cons: Only encode speech/writing into a special language for user and chosen subjects at the higher levels
Cannot decipher arcane/occult language to cast arcane/occult spells until the higher levels (NCN)
People with MythPower: Bacchanalia are immune to this ability

name: Fovea Displacement
overview: change the position of your foveae.
description: A fovea (plural foveae) is a small area inside each eye responsible for sharp central vision. Usually, when you look at something, you can pick out its details only if it's in the center of your visual field. Otherwise, it's just a blur. This power allows you to shift your two foveae so you can pick out details of things that you're not directly looking at. However, a human fovea is usually deprived of rod cells, so this power is useless in a situation where there's not enough light.
pros: Freak out people by being aware of your surrounding without moving your eyes or your head.
cons: You can see something if it's in your visual field.
This power is useless in dim lights.

name: Head Needles
overview: shoot needles out of your head
description: Shoot needles out of your head. They are poisonous.
pros: Deadly assassination
Thin hard-to-see needles
cons: Could look weird
May hurt your head
Could hit yourself

name: Celeb Shift V2
overview: turn into any celebrity who ever lived
description: With this power you can turn into any famous person who ever lived. You can get into parties, get free stuff, make celebrities look bad, scare people by turning into dead celebrities etc. You can stay in celebrity mode for as long as you want.
pros: You can turn into any celebrity dead or alive
cons: People might realize that you're not the real deal

name: Avatar Summon V2
overview: summon any character from the Legend of Korra the animated series
description: (If you like the Legend of Korra the animated series then this power is for you) with this power you  Can summon any of the sixty one characters that is from the series. You can only summon one character at a time. Know your history

pros: You can five extra gun barrels to pop out of any normal gun
Each of the extra guns can hold up to six bullets

name: Playing Possum
overview: stop heart and actually seem dead.
description: This power allows you to stop your heart and make you skin cold just like a real corpse. You will look and feel dead, then reawaken at will.
pros: Can pretend to be dead if someone is trying to kill you.
Can wake up anytime you want.
cons: Can only stay dead for a maxium of four hours.
If harmed during fake death, then you will stay dead.

name: Imaginary Friendship
overview: turn someone else's imagination into reality.
description: This power binds you to someone (You can't choose who) and allows you to see anything they imagine and make it real. However, the subject's mind has a noticeable affect on yours. If they're childish or immature, so are you, etc. Only the subject can see you, unless they want someone else to see you as well. The power runs out when the subject dies (and then you die) or decides to let you go (in which case you are free, and retain the power, only not bound to a single individual)
pros: A close friendship with whoever you're bound to.
Because of the effect on your mentality, anything they imagine is fun for you to create
If you're manipulative enough, you could get the subject to imagine whatever you want
cons: Potential death
Having to be bound to one person, unable to interact with anyone else, unless the person wills it
You're basically a slave

name: Living Sponge
overview: suck up any liquid just by touching it like sponge.
description: You will be able suck up any liquid like a sponge. However, your skin will not have holes like a real sponge.
pros: Can clean up a mess easily.
cons: Have a limited ability to suck up free liquids (none contained within other things)
Cannot swim or will became to heavy to move (if you can't control it).
Will swell up if to much liquid.

name: Rise Of The Talking Monkey
overview: turn into a talking monkey
description: With this power you can turn into a super smart talking monkey in order to fight crime
pros: You're super smart in this form
You're a monkey!
cons: You might get put in a zoo

name: Delete This Ultra Backbreaker
overview: lift your foe up in the air, fly up then slam their backs with your knees.
description: You could grab your opponent lifting them in mid-air, flying upwards, hooking both hands around the opponent's back then taunt your enemy and break them in half, shattering their spine using both knees.
pros: Your foe might not able to walk again.
cons: None.

name: Snap You're Lonely
overview: make people lonely
description: With this power whenever you snap and say "Lonely (insert person's name)" that person will instantly be overwhelmed by a feeling of loneliness. Additionally people will stop talking to and hanging out with that person. You can reverse the affects of this power by saying "(insert person's name) lonely. "
pros: You can make people lonely
You can use this power on yourself if you want people to stop talking to you
You can reverse the affects of this power
cons: You can't just make a person feel lonely or just make people stop talking to a person

name: Mutant Frog Summon
overview: summon mutant frogs
description: With this power you can summon mutant frogs that are seven feet tall, have horns and can shoot lasers from their eyes. The mutant frogs also have very powerful legs and they can jump long distances. They are under your complete control and when you're done with them you can send them to a pocket dimension where they will wait until you need them again. You can only summon three mutant frogs at a time but if one dies you can promptly summon another one to take its place.
pros: You can summon mutant frogs
You have complete control over the frogs
The frogs are seven feet tall and can shoot lasers
cons: The frogs are not invincible
You can only summon three of them at a time

name: Myth Power: Kraipale's Credit
overview: channel Kraipale's command over the essence of the hangover and other consequences of overindulgence
description: Kraipale (Craipale), in Greek myth, was the goddess of crapulence; the consequences of overindulgence (eating or drinking too much, etc). As such, channeling her allows one to induce, amplify, reduce or negate hangover and stomachache, by touch. In addition, one can eat and drink infinitely if one desires (never getting full, and passing on feelings of stomachache, drunkenness and hangover to foes). One can even mimic hangover symptoms (headache, nausea, etc) to use as superpowers at will.
pros: Induce, amplify, reduce and negate hangover/stomachache by touch
Eat infinitely, if desired; never get full, pass stomacheache/drunkenness/hangover onto foe
Mimic hangover symptoms to use as superpowers (headache=psionic blast, etc)

Cannot summon a chalice of healthy Hangover-Free wine to drink until the higher levels (NCN)
Wine/festivity-based MythPowers provide immunity

name: Axis
overview: always have the earth's axis beneath you
description: With this power, you basically are the axis of the earth. Wherever you go on the planet, the earth will spin beneath you. This grants you tremendous power to reshape the earth. Moving to the equator will cause the earth's climate to constantly shift throughout the year. Moving to the exact top or bottom of the earth will do away with seasons altogether. Anyone with this ability will likely be exiled to the north or south pole.
pros: You can live in any climate you choose so long as you plan ahead
Does not affect the earth's gravity or rotation, so no spiraling into the sun
EPIC!!!
cons: Being Exiled
Takes a while to kick in
If there are two people with this ability at different places, the earth will rip apart

name: Card Stacker
overview: stack cards by using hand gestures and voice commands.
description: This ability allows you stack cards by using hand gestures and voice commands. You activate this ability by saying the words, "Card Stacker, activate". You use hand gestues to levitate cards and stack them anywhere. Cards also stack when you move your hand in the desired direction and say, "Cards, stack". When you say, "Cards, return" the cards will stack on your open hand. You have to own the cards or have permission to use them. Only useful for card stacking. Stack them as high as you want.
pros: Stack cards easily with hand gestures and voice commands.
Makes magic tricks cooler.
Stack cards as high as you want.

As such, channeling Enestos (Enestus- Present), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically receive insights from the present, at will. One can also psychically pause subjects' perception of the present, by touch, word or thought. One can also psychically summon past and/or future targets to the present, at will.

Psychically preceive updates about the present, freeze subjects' senses in the present moment
Psychically summon past/future targets to the present, at will

Cannot psychically remove ability to plan for/negate visions of the future, until developed (NCN)

So, they could tear the corner of a sachet and the tear will be very close to open the bag, but it won't. They could pull on the tab of a beverage can and the tab will break. They could pull off the seal of a bottle top and a portion of it will stay in their hand. They could open a zipper bag and the slider will either get stuck or break.

As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with animals that are hunted in one's vicinity (for food, sport, etc). In addition, one can psychically summon nets, of various sizes and types (razor, electrified, butterfly, fish etc) at will. you are invulnerable to starvation, dehydration, asphyxiation and aging.
