Beer with high alcoholic content increases the chances of a correct answer.
pros: A thirst quenching way to see the future.
The POOF! Beer power will let make the best beer possible.
cons: You don't have a power to avoid getting drunk.
You're underage.
You've given up drinking.

name: Cheerleading
overview: make someone happy just by applauding or cheering.
description: With the clap of your hands, you can make any specific individual feel good. If a little girl was crying, you could applaud her and erase the sadness from her mind. Cheering is another method of doing this. This power will only work if the specific individual hears the applause or cheer.
pros: You can spread happiness.
Erase sadness, grief, pain, etc.
cons: Only works if the individual HEARS the applause or cheer.
Sometimes sadness can be a good thing.

name: Fluffy Bunny
overview: change into a fluffy, hot pink bunny whenever you want.
description: You just scream "Super fluffy bunny power! " and whap! You're the hot pink bunny of your dreams. Of course, you're still the same size of a regular bunny, but you can shoot hot pink lasers out of your eyes.
pros: You can run really fast as a bunny
You can spy on people
cons: If you accidentally scream "Super hot pink bunny power! " during school.

name: Pollution Port
overview: teleport to any polluted area
description: Pollution is everywhere in the air, in the forms of gas, smoke, and smog. Any polluted area can be a potential teleportation area for you. This power allows you to teleport to any area with polluted air; this can be used to escape enemies, or to teleport to clean up the environment. Plus, you are immune to the effects of the pollution when you teleport. However, you can only teleport to areas of high AIR pollution; which applies to most large cities and towns.
pros: Teleport anywhere that there is high air pollution
You are immune to the effects of pollution
Escape from enemies or clean the environment... The choice is yours
cons: You can only teleport to areas of high AIR pollution
If pollution is eradicated, then the power will be useless

name: Jelly Bean
overview: turn anything or anyone (including self) into a jelly bean of any flavor
description: The ability to turn anything or anyone (including yourself) into a jelly bean of any flavor and any size.
pros: Have a jelly bean!
Cool to show off
Can do this to enemies, then eat them!
cons: Someone can eat you.
You might get stuck that way

name: Stitchpunks
overview: transfer your soul into a Stitchpunk.
description: This power lets you shoot your soul out (which is green) and put it into a Stitchpunk (a sack puppet). You are currently dead while you have your soul out. But you can transfer your soul back into your body. This will help through getting into hard to reach areas or do other fun stuff. But you will still get hurt as a Stitchpunk but it won't be painful. Just your body will be damaged.
pros: Get to hard to reach places
Work out with a pencil
Won't feel pain
cons: You're dead with your soul out
You can still get hurt

name: Squid Powers
overview: do everything a squid can do.
description: After being bitten by a radioactive squid, you have gained several considerable abilities. You can breathe underwater, turn your arms into extendable tentacles, shoot ink from your wrists, and even shapeshift into a squid.
pros: You can swim for as long as you want.
The ink-shooting will help you escape deadly situations.
cons: You will seem slightly ridiculous.

name: Zodiac: Lunar: Ox
overview: use the powers of the lunar calender's ox
description: You draw upon the power of the ox. You can transform into an ox, talk with oxen, and carry an infinite amount of weight. The superstrength aspect only applies to carrying. NO throwing, punching, kicking, etc.
pros: Full moon gives full power.
"You can have anything you can carry. " "No problem! " *Picks up house and walks away*
cons: New moon gives no power.
Can only use if born in a year of the ox. 1913, 1925, 1937, 1949, 1961, 1973, 1985, 1997, 2009, etc.
Can only carry infinite weight. NO throwing.

name: Flicker
overview: make lights flicker
description: With this power you can cause any light bulb to start flickering. This is useful if you want to bother someone or distract the teacher during class or just for fun.
pros: You can make lights flicker
cons: Not much use in physical combat

name: Multi Headed Swung Object
overview: make the body of hand-held objects with handles duplicate when swung.
description: There is a large category of hand-held objects with a handle, such as hammers, whips, swords, knives, tennis rackets, shovels, axes, mallets, etc. When the power user holds one by its handle and makes a swinging movement, the body of the object will suddenly multiply while moving at the same speed as its original version would move. For example, swinging a sword will create a sword with multiple blades coming out of a single hilt. When the swinging motion stops, the object becomes normal again.
pros: Have a sword? Why go for the kill when you can go for the overkill with this power?
You can control in which directions the object will be duplicated.
cons: If the object is a container, its contents won't multiply, only the container does.
The body of the object is only duplicated during the swing.
The duplicated parts remain attached to the handle.

name: Forced Suicidal Immunity
overview: make others unable to kill themselves
description: With this power you can cause other people to be unable to kill themselves. No matter what that person will do to themselves they will not be able to die, it even applies if the person pays someone else to kill them. You cannot reverse the effects of this power.
pros: You can make people immune to suicide
cons: You cannot reverse the effects of this power

name: Forced Kenny Mc Cormick Morph
overview: turn someone into Kenny McCormick from South Park
description: You have the ability to change someone into Kenny and watch them be killed in under thirty minutes. Your victim is stripped of any powers that would ensure his survival. Nothing he does will save himself. Mice will carry off any remains after your victim's horrible death. Once you kenny-morph someone you have to wait until the first Kenny is dead before using your power again.
pros: Watch an enemy run around in panic as he knows he's doing to die.
cons: You can make only one Kenny at a time.
You don't know when a Kenny will get killed.

name: Myth Power: Dyssebia's Defiance
overview: channel Dyssebia's command over the essence of irreligious impiety and godlessness
description: Dyssebia (Dyssebeia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of impiety, disrespect for deities/divinities and atheism. As such, channeling her allows one to prevent deities from contacting oneself for as long as the power is in use. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who honestly hate, deny or mock/disrespect divinity (regardless of mental defenses). One can even psychically inflict harm on those who honestly believe in, love and respect divinity, by touch.
pros: Psychically prevent contact with any deities, regardless of moral alignment or pantheon
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel atheists, agnostics, and the irreligious
Psychically inflict pain/injury on pious people/people of faith
cons: When active, cannot use MythPower: Eusebia's Sapience or other divine abilities (NCN)
Cannot disrupt others' connection to the divine by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
Sin/injustice/corruption-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Spinning Trigger Toy
overview: create a spinning trigger toy out of thin air.
description: Create a small device with a bulb, trigger and a small cylinder attatched to the bottom. When you pull the trigger, the bulb opens at a fast speed into petals releasing a vortex stored at its center that has the sucking force of a black hole. Anything sucked into it's center, including living things, are condensed into a marble. Once in marble form you can alter its form and personality by adding or removing traits. Release the sphere by pulling on the trigger once and concentrating.
pros: Trap your enemies
Suck up attacks before they have a chance to harm you and then return them to your enemy.
Merge spheres to create powerful creations under your complete control
cons: After the toy manifests itself it can be stolen.
You can only hold a limited amount of spheres inside the capsule at a time
Alterations do not always turn out the way you intended.

name: Evil Mind
overview: have an evil mind that is to horrible to manipulate.
description: This power is only for villains. Whenever a person tries to manipulate your knowledge, emotion or willpower (this includes telepathy and empathy), they are then forced to look at your mind which will send them continuous terrible nightmares. You will gain amazing evil thoughts all of the time and be immune to fear inducers. Sometimes will project into a death stare and/or an uneasy aura if it's powerful enough.
pros: Perspicuity with a terrifying twist.
You could be an extremely good evil mastermind.
People will feel uneasy around you.
cons: You can't completely project the fear like a Psychic Intimidator or Fear Inducer.
This power is only for a villain.
Fear Immunity, Emotionlessness, etc.

name: Myth Power: Eurynome's Range
overview: channel Eurynome's command over the essence of pastures and meadows
description: Eurynome, in Greek myth, was the goddess of pastures and meadows (especially water-meadows). As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive and teleport to any meadow or pasture, at will. In addition, one can psychically instill an overwhelming fear of wide open spaces at will. Furthermore one can psychically manipulate the ground of any meadow or pasture, at will. One can even psychically manipulate the grass of any meadow or pasture, at will, so that the blades become razor sharp.
pros: Psychically perceive and teleport self/others to any meadow or pasture, at will
Psychically instill an overwhelming fear of wide open spaces (ie meadows and pastures)
Psychically manipulate the ground and sharpen the grass of any meadow or pasture, at will
cons: Cannot heal self and gain physical power while within a meadow or pasture, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive and communicate with snakes until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Ocean/Tethys Power and MythPower: Kronos' Craft provide immunity (NCN)

name: Nail Summon
overview: summon any non-aligned Transformer
description: In the lexicon of the Transformers the word NAIL stands for Non-Aligned Indigenous Life-forms which pretty much just means any Transformer who is not affiliated with either the Autobots or Decepticons. This power allows you to summon any NAIL from any Transformers continuity however you cannot control them (for controlling see Transformers Summon and Ctrl, yes I make a lot of Transformers related powers) You can unsummon the NAILs whenever you want.
pros: You can summon any of the NAILs from any Transformer continuity
There is a NAIL named Hipotank how cool of a name is that
cons: You cannot control them
They might step on you (just for fun)

name: Lampokinesis
overview: lamp shade plot elements with your mind.
description: Whenever you find that the suspension of disbelief is just about broken, you can use this power to bring the absurdity of something like, gee I don't know, superpowers, into perspective.  In order to have this power, you must exist in the real world, since having it in super hero land can sometimes come off as needlessly skeptical and stops the story altogether.   Examples include the one time I thought it was pretty weird that I said this won't work in real life. That seems out of place.
pros: Reassure everyone that real life is boring.
Bring the audience back into the story.
Point out that superpowers aren't supposed to be real.
cons: A major buzz-kill.
Makes world-building and creativity futile.
It doesn't stop the lamp shaded thing from existing.

name: Delete This Nasty Spike
overview: kick your opponent in the back of their head, uppercut them in the groin, then knee them in the jaw.
description: You can start off by using a super roundhouse axe kick at the back of your opponent's skull, crouch down and send a powerfully charged uppercut to your enemy's groin, but this can only work on male heroes or villains, and finish it with a massive knee to your foe's jaw to send them flying.
pros: a fight combo is not a power
cons: a fight combo is not a power

name: Pulmentikinesis
overview: manipulate any broth, stew or soup, regardless of make or flavour.
description: From the latin meaning 'vegetable stew', Pulmentikinesis allows the user to fully control any soup-like substance. This can mean anything from the motion, temperature or shape to even the parsley content, and is limited only by the degree of control the user has, and their imagination. The further away from the initial state the soup is taken, however, be it density, velocity or whatever, the more energy it takes to use, and the more tired the user becomes.
pros: Ever seen the 'parting of the soup' scene in Bruce Almighty? That's now you, my friend!
With a lot of effort, superheated or chilled soup could be possible, or even ultra-dense!
Combined with other powers (like Campbell's Blessing or Soupification), you've got a winner.
cons: As with a lot of powers, to become really useful requires a lot of energy and practice.
It's still only soup, and so you wouldn't look as cool as someone with Pyrokinesis...
Eventually you'll get chucked out of the Soup kitchen. It's inevitable.

name: Backsliding
overview: slide around the ground on your back!
description: Ever get stuck in a massive crowd, unable to move? Worry no longer! With this ability, just hop on the ground, and start sliding at walking speed! Become unstoppable! However, normal friction rate occurs and it will hurt quite a bit. But why let that get you down! WARNING: DO NOT KNOCK OVER PEOPLE WITH HIGH HEELS ON, OTHERWISE YOU WON'T BE DOING MUCH SLIDING ANYMORE.
pros: Get places faster than you would walking.
Trip people you don't like over.
Impress your friends!
cons: You are vunerable to 'steppings on'.
The back of your shirt will be gone.
So will multiple layers of back-skin.

name: Brain Eater
overview: gain powers when you eat brains
description: With this power you get a new, random power whenever you eat a brain.
pros: New power.
You'll be nicknamed Sylar.
cons: Unless you happen to be a zombie brains aren't going to taste very good
You're going to have to kill someone in order to eat their brain
Power is random.

name: Disco Ambiance
overview: create a 'discotheque' atmosphere with a mirrored disco ball above.
description: You can be anywhere at all and still be able to boogie! Anytime you want, dim lights, loud, lousy music and spotlights on a mirrored disco ball floating above. Plus, you get the ability to dance and force everyone around you to participate.
pros: Control your surroundings
Get some 'funky' exercise
Watch your friends and enemies 'get down'
cons: It's Disco
Obligatory 'fever' comes with it - afterwards
It only lasts as long as you're 'feelin' groovy'

name: Tik Tok
overview: never deal with hangovers, never have to pay for drinks at clubs, and have the party never stop
description: With this superpower, you have all of the mighty abilities of Ke$ha from the song Tik Tok. In order to activate this power, all you have to do is listen to Tik Toc once before you go to bed and for the next 24 hours you will be granted the powers of Tik Tok.
pros: Wake up in the morning feeling like P Diddy
You never have to pay for drinks at the club
You never have to deal with hangovers!
cons: Can't go for guys that dont look like Mick Jagger
Boys will try to touch your junk
Police may shut you down

name: Angry Birds V2
overview: summon any amount of any kind of Space Angry Bird
description: With this power you have an unlimited amount of every kind of space angry bird from the game Angry Birds Space. When you use this power a small one way portal opens up and shoots out as many of any kind of space angry bird as you want. After the birds are launched from the portal, a remote with different buttons (one for each kind of space angry bird) appears in your hand and pushing the button will activate the birds' special power (freezing, multiplying etc). You can send them back later
pros: You can summon any of the space Angry Birds
cons: The birds can be killed

name: Glow
overview: glow in the dark
description: When calling for help, and you don't have the right supplies with you, glow in the dark would be the best power to have. You can use it to scare your town, or light up a dark room. It can be activated or de-activated whenever you want.
pros: Great for parties
Scares away robbers
Good for calling for help
cons: Makes you easier to find in the dark
May be too bright
People might think your an alien

name: Salt Hands
overview: generate salt
description: With this power, you can create salt on your hands, and rub said salt into your enemies eyes and wounds, making their injuries sting like crazy.
pros: Sting your enemies via rubbing salt into their wounds
Blind them temporarily
cons: Make sure you don't use it then grasp your own cuts

name: Paintballs To Bullets
overview: turn paintballs into bullets
description: With this power you can turn paintballs into any kind of bullet. This is useful if you're being attacked and all you have is a paintball gun you can simply shoot at the attacker and turn the paintballs into bullets as they soar through the air. You cannot turn the bullets back into paintballs with this power.
pros: You can turn paintballs into bullets
cons: You can't turn the bullets back into paintballs

name: Taco Taste
overview: make everything and anything taste like tacos!
description: Makes anything taste like the best food ever. Tacos.
pros: Makes things taste like tacos.
Funny pranks!
Still taste other foods!
cons: Nothing wrong!
Awesome power!
Rocks!

name: Karate Zebra
overview: summon a martial arts master Zebra
description: Whenever you're in danger with this power you can summon a karate fighting zebra who is a master in every form of martial arts
pros: You have your own personal body guard
You have your own personal zebra
You might learn one or two thing from him
cons: He might not be able to save you from all of your problems

name: Freak Out
overview: freak out on someone
description:
This ability is an instant cast ability that frees the user from their own boundaries allowing them to release their emotions upon their target with ease and control. 

Freak Out causes an instant explosion of emotion that confuses the target and usually causes them to run away and wonder what exactly they did or said to trigger such a sharp reaction.
pros: Gets you out of just about any situation
Freak Out is instant cast, so it doesn't take any prep time
Doesn't require any thinking
cons: You don't really know what the target's reaction to your freak out will be
People might think differently about you after you use Freak Out
Innocent bystanders might be affected by your Freak Out

name: Filipino Cuisine Creation
overview: create a delicious Filipino cuisine at the user's will.
description: With this ability, the user will be able to create a Filipino cuisine at will. This cuisine includes steaming hot rice, and lumpia. You may not have another Filipino cuisine until you have finished your first.
pros: Experience the quality of the Filipino cuisine.
cons: You must finish your first before you may have another.
You can't deny serving your uncle a cuisine.

name: Amitiels' Atlas
overview: find the Key of Adam
description: Amitiel's Atlas is in reality a map on which the location to the Key of Adam can be found. The map was written by Amitiel, the Angel of Truth, and one of the three angels of the highest court. Only Amitiel's Atlas can lead you to the Key of Adam. However, there are two problems. The first being that the map is written in angelic script, a language that far predates the human species and is thus indecipherable to man. Secondly, the map currently resides deep within the Vatican vault.
pros: With the map you can find the Key of Adam
Aside from finding the key of adam Amitiels' atlas will show you the location of what ever you want
To hold Amitiels atlas is to have the angel Amitiels blessing
cons: Amitiels Atlas Is illegible to humans
To acquire Amitiels Atlas, one must break into the Vatican or have someone on the inside

name: Rise Of The Real Steel Robots
overview: turn into any of the robot from the film Real Steel
description: With this power you can turn into any of the fighting robots in the movie Real Steel. Depending on which one you turn into you can have a variety of cool powers. You also retain all of your intelligence and fighting skills while in bot form and you do not need anybody to control you. If you are destroyed in robot form you cannot revert to human mode and are dead.
pros: You can turn into any robot from Real Steel
You can get some pretty cool powers
You retain all of your intelligence and fighting skills in bot form
cons: All damage sustained in robot mode transfers over to human mode

name: Summon Zalt
overview: summon a limited dimension-hopping kystian.
description: Zalts look like ants reshaped into humanoids. Zalts carry weapons. A zalt has the power to travel between Kyst and the dimension that its summoner is in. Zalts can't be unsummoned, even if you lose this power. A zalt can't be banished to another dimension. A zalt will stay, even if you're killed, but it will go comatose. Zalts can help you in a fight by going to Kyst and bringing back things that could aid you or by taking you to Kyst if a fight is going bad.
pros: A zalt is here to stay-unless erased from reality.
"Return to Kyst and find something so you can't be erased from reality. "
cons: Your zalt might not find anything to avoid being erased from reality.
You can't fake your death if your zalt has been captured.

name: Candying
overview: remove water from an object and replace it with sugar.
description: Candied fruit are produced by putting fruits in heated sugar syrup, until they are saturated with sugar. This process can take several months. With this ability, not only can you do it at will and without waiting, but you also can do it to living things (the human body is composed of approximatively 60% of water), which actually makes this superpower kind of deadly.
pros: Allows you to kill your foes by dehydration.
Candied fruits AT WILL!
cons: You have to touch the object.
You can't just harm your foes, you can only kill them.

name: Potpourri
overview: make anything smell nice
description: With this ability you can make anything or anyone smell delicious. Cover up any bad scent and create a more relaxing enviorment.
pros: Make a nice smelling enviorment
Never have to take a shower
cons: Pretty useless most of the time.

name: Immortal Urn (Master's Urn)
overview: have an immortal slave by placing a damaged brain into the urn.
description: This is quite literally the sister urn of the original Immortal Urn, You find a person who's been recently injured beyond current medical healing capabilities. You put the braindead person's brain in the Master's Urn. Then just like with the first urn you have an immortal, unlike the other this person has no soul contained inside. You have the body, not the person who once lived inside. They serve without thought and without question. Only the owner controls the slave body.
pros: Immortal Slave, serves without question.
The soul has moved so you're not morally currupt.
Only the owner of the Urn controls the slave
cons: They serve without thought, meaning the slave is completely mindless, be specific
The slave responds only to voice commands and sometimes you may be unable to speak.
It can annoying telling a mindless body every sinle move to make.

name: Lego Minfig Shift
overview: turn people into Lego Minfig versions of themselves
description: With this power you can turn people into Lego Minifig versions of themselves. The will shrink down to the size of an average Minifig but they will still be alive and be able to move around and talk and whatnot. Even if you take them apart they will not die and their bodies will be able to move while their head can still talk and see and hear and smell and burp and stuff.
pros: You can turn people into Lego Mini Figure versions of themselves
cons: It's hard to kill them in mini figure mode

name: Induced Boredom
overview: make anyone within 5 miles of you extremely bored.
description: The overview kind of states it all so il just say it again. The ability to make anyone within 5 miles of you extremely bored. No matter what fun/happy thing they're doing, it will be extremely boring to them.
pros: I don't know
Im thinking...
Oh! Good way to get back at someone!
cons: Most people won't like you for this.
It's automatic, you can't turn t off
You yourself will forever be bored.

name: Stuffed Animalinator
overview: turn animals into stuffed animals/beanie babies
description: With this power you can turn any animal into a stuffed animal/beanie baby version of it. You can use this power on as many animals as you want buy you cannot reverse the effects of this power.

You can use this power as many times as you want
cons: You cannot revers the effects of this power

name: Rice Manipulation
overview: manipulate and transform into rice!
description: Imagine Sandman, but instead of sand, you're made of rice! With this power, you can heal using rice, have a "rice sense", and basically use your imagination to do anything as long as you have enough rice. Rice sword! Rice grenades! Rice!

Sense everything around you that has rice in it.
Never go hungry.

Third world countries.
You'd probably need to carry some rice with you due to it not being everywhere.

name: Greater Kystian Morph #7
overview: become the biggest land-bound unsummonable kystian.
description: The uba. A perfect fusion of elephant, rhino, whale and sauropod dinosaur. You're 400 feet long, your tail is 80 feet of that. Your trunk is 80 feet long. Your tusks are 120 feet long. Your horn is 30 feet long. You stand 80 feet high at the shoulder. You can temporarily stand upright. You weigh 2100 tons. You possess a limited geokinesis that lets you strengthen the earth under you. You're strong enough to pull 16000 tons. You can emit sonar and hear subsonically.
pros: Be a giant rampaging monster. As fast as a real rampaging elephant.
You can strengthen the earth under yourself.
You have a giant prehensile limb, tusks and horn.
cons: You are only as fast as a real rampaging elephant.
There will be locations where you can't become this kystian.

name: Summon Hira
overview: summon a half-alive thing linked to the Kyst flow of time.
description: The Kyst dimension can slow down or speed up its flow of time. It links with hira that you summon to this dimension. Hira can speed up so fast that the effect is like the Supertime power. Hira are immune to any damage, except that done by someone possessing a time-based power. A hira looks like a sexless translucent human. Hira are as strong as four normal humans. You have to watch what you command them to do.
pros: A kystian that can strike at any foes before they have a chance to blink.
The first con below could be eliminated with the right powers.
cons: A man of normal strength with a time-based power could easily destroy one.
They will find ways to act against you, unless you have the right powers.

name: The Phantom Tollbooth
overview: summon the Phantom Tollbooth and use it to go to the Kingdom
description: With this power you can summon the Phantom Tollbooth and use it to travel to the Kingdom of Knowledge. You can keep the tollbooth for as long as you want and send it away when you're done with it. Once you send it away however you cannot bring it back and you lose this power. Alternatively if this power is stolen from you somehow the tollbooth disappears as well.
pros: You can send yourself and others into the Kingdom of Knowledge
You can keep the tollbooth for as long as you want
cons: Once you unsummon the Tollbooth you can never bring it back
If this power is stolen from you, you lose the tollbooth as well

name: Gate: Singularity
overview: open a singularity in a cage of darkness for a split second
description: You must have Gate: 40 Rods of Darkness in order to get this power. When this power is activated the rods 'unroll' into flat 'plates' and form a cube around the target area, then in a split second a singularity forms and disappears absorbing everything in the area and spitting it out somewhere else. If the cage is destroyed, you will most likely be absorbed also as the cage protects everything outside of it from being absorbed.
pros: Cage protects all outside of it.
Only one area is damaged.
cons: Must have gate: 40 rods of darkness to get this power. Unaffected by Con Negation.
Someone destroying the cage when the singularity forms.

name: Phantom Pirate

pros: Scare your enermies silly
Command a army of dead pirates
cons: You will be seen as a freak and your loved ones will be scared of you

name: Think Mouthless
overview: cause people's mouths to disappear just by thinking about it
description: Have you ever thought about how people would look without their mouths? Well now whenever you think about that the mouthless person you were thinking about will actually lose their mouth as in their mouth will disappear from their face. This power does not cause a large gaping hole to appear on the person's face rather their is skin where the person's mouth used to be. The person cannot talk and has to breathe through his/her nose and you cannot bring their mouth back.

cons: You cannot bring their mouth back

name: Muppet Power Beauregard 2011
overview: survive without food or water for up to 12 years
description: With this power you can survive without food or water for up to 12 years, without losing any strength or stamina. However the longer you use this power, the dumber you get; until you stop using it. Once you stop using the power, you slowly gain your intelligence back until you regain it fully; after not using the power for the same amount of time you used the power in the first place.

You don't lose any strength or stamina

name: Mother's Lullaby
overview: become a child again
description: Has your mother ever sung a special lullaby to you as a child with this ability if you sing it you'll turn back into a child.
pros: Enternal youth
Be a child
Immortality
cons: If your mother never sung a lullaby to you
You lose your powers
Starting school again!

name: Myth Power: Polemos' Pull
overview: channel Polemos' command over the essence of civil war and civil battle
description: Polemos (Polemus), in Greek myth, was the god of civil war and civil battle (war and battle between two parts of the same nation). As such, channeling him allows one to perceive past, present and future civil war at will. pros: Battle noise drowns out conversation (and sound-based effects) and distracts concentration
Battle noise may be used to enrage all neutrals in radius (until they can no longer hear it)
Produce a rushing, thrashing, whirling Battle-Noise Sound Cloud to literally fight foes
cons: Cannot use Battle-Noise Sound Cloud to stand or ride/fly on until the higher levels (NCN)
Sonic Immunity, Sonic Absorption and/or Protected Hearing provide immunity (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide power with this ability (NCN)

name: Condition Change: Blood
overview: make a power also require drunk blood in order to activate the power
description: This power allows the user to change the condition(s) of activation so that the power also requires the user to drink the blood of who they are affecting with the power. This power is also tactile.
pros: Now your opponent has to drink the blood of what they want to affect.
If what the person wants to affect has no blood.
cons: Have to touch the target.

name: Rise Of The Two Headed Monster
overview: turn into a monster with two heads
description: With this power you turn into a seven foot tall black hairy monster with two heads in order to fight crime
pros: Two heads are better than one
You're really intimidating
You can jump high enough to dunk on a ten foot tall basket ball hoop
cons: You will definitely be attacked because you look evil

name: Lactokinesis
overview: control milk.
description: You control any type of milk, which means you can make it levitate, coagulate it to make cheese, fermentate it to make yoghurt...
pros: Free ice cream!
Expel the milk from woman's breasts in the street AT WILL!
cons: You can't create milk, just control it.
Pretty useless, huh?

name: Condition Change: 6th Sense
overview: make a power work only on what the user can feel with their sixth sense
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that it works only on what the user is able to feel with their sixth sense. This power is tactile.
pros: Opponents with barely any sixth sense.
cons: Have to touch opponent and each touch affects only one power.
Opponents who have a really good sixth sense.
Will not work on those with no sixth sense.

name: Frankenstein
overview: harvest other people's organs  into your own body.
description: Pieced together from other body parts and organs like a Frankenstein creature, you can absorb other people's organs into your own body. This extends your life and gives you complete health. Also makes you stronger. Almost immortal.
pros: Near immortality.
Increased strength.
cons: You have kill and harvest other people's organs.

name: Acne Remover
overview: cure people of acne
description: With this power you can cure yourself and others of acne, no creams or other types of medication required. All you have to do is point at the person or yourself and say "Acne be gone" and all the person's pimples and zits disappear. The person can however get acne again, but a person with this power can never get acne again once they cure it.
pros: You can get rid of your own or other people's acne
You can never get acne again if you have this power
cons: You have to point at them and say "Acne be gone"
If the person you cure doesn't get this power they can still get acne again

name: Summoning: Asylum
overview: summon the Fortress Asylum.
description: My personal creation, Asylum. Asylum was a fortress in Hell, containing the souls of the insane. It resembles a modern day insane asylum, but it is surrounded by giant obsidian walls. Using this summon doesn't summon the Fortress to you, but rather summons those you target to the Asylum, where they will stay until the die or you recall them. This only works on evil people.
pros: Can send people to the Asylum.
Only works on evil people.
cons: Only works on evil people.
Extremely hard to use.

name: Defender Of Comedy
overview: always have a tomato on hand for when someone tells a bad joke
description: When someone tells a bad joke a tomato appears in your hand, which you may then chuck at the offending joker. This tomato will always find its mark (the face) even if it is physically impossible for it to do so. After being hit by the tomato, the jokester is inexplicably hilarious for the following twenty-four hours and anything they do will inspire raucous laughters.
pros: Make bad comedians funny.
Drive someone to madness by making everyone laugh at them.
Make yourself hilarious for a day.
cons: The victim may go out and commit a crime during their funny period.
The tomato will only appear when someone tells an unfunny joke.

name: Delete This Redemption Day
overview: submit your opponent in mid-air then switch to piledrive them.
description: This power involves you hooking each of your opponent's legs in one of their arms and draping the opponent over mid-air, at this point you would hook the arms of the opponent with their legs securing the hold. As this move involves the use of it airborne, the quickly switch to the variation of a belly-to-belly piledriver, you can hold the opponent upside down in a belly-to-belly position, then falls to a kneeling position. As the enemy falls, the opponent's head is driven into the ground.
pros: This can be one day used in future pro wrestling.
cons: a fight combo is not a power

name: Condition Change: Sad
overview: make a power work only when the user is sad
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation so that the power can only be used when the user is sad. Cannot be used on a power that has already been affected by a Condition Change that requires a different mood. This power is tactile.
pros: Now your opponent has to be sad in order to use their power.
cons: It's horrible watching people crying, which is what the target will probably end up doing.
Have to touch the target of this power.

name: Condition Change: Deserts
overview: make a power work only when the user is in a desert
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to work only when the user is in a desert. Cannot be used on a power already affected by a Condition Change requiring another type of terrain. This power is tactile.
pros: Just make sure you don't fight anywhere near deserts.
cons: Have to touch opponent and each touch only affects one power.

name: Technical Pacifist Curse
overview: not be able to kill anyone
description: A person with this power is unable to kill anyone ever, indirectly or directly. However, they are still able to hurt people. This person could also be the ultimate sadist because they know that they really can't kill anyone in the end. This power is a form of reality manipulation.
pros: You can now use all of those dangerous powers without killing anyone
You now can use 100% of your power without fear of endangering someone
cons: You can't kill anyone
You can become insane and keep beating up someone because they just won't die
If someone cancels this power and you kill someone

name: Kyst: Emergency Power #4
overview: have Kyst call the big guns for support.
description: This emergency power like all emergency powers works independently or with the other emergency powers. Kyst will call for the big guns. 40-foot long ultra tech guns carried by bipedal dinosaur-like kystians who stand 130-feet tall called thathans. The weapons have a direct range of 5 miles and indirect range of 40 miles. A hit will leave a crater a mile wide and half a mile deep. Kyst can call a fireteam (4), a squad (8) or a platoon (25) of them. Any thathan will disappear when not needed.
pros: Destroy armies.
Giant monsters with giant guns.
cons: You can't command even one of them.
Kyst will need space to use this power.

name: Limited Magic
overview: unleash 20 of the most powerful spells, after which you explode
description: As the title suggests, your power is limited by twenty uses. Once you use all of these you will blow up rivaling the explosion of the Atomic Bomb. You can do anything: create planets, make yourself a god, or just do something simple like killing a human being. You may only use your power once a day.
pros: You can do anything
cons: Your death resulting in a massive explosion

name: Detach Head
overview: detach your head from your body and keep it alive
description: This ability allows you to detach your head and keep it alive. Reattachment is also possible if it is returned to the neck within 24 hours.
pros: Place your head in a strategic location for surveillance
Head and body stay alive (even if cut off forcefully)
Always have a "Headless Horseman" costume at the ready for Halloween
cons: Your head cannot be reattached after 24 hours
Head can still be damaged by smashing, bullets, etc.

name: Virus: Fungamonus
overview: release a quite embarrassing, disgusting virus
description: The user of this ability will most surely be hated. The proper name of this virus is Fungamonus Sudorificus Flatulens Cloaca-Emesis, and it is not at all pleasant one to have. Carriers lose all control of their bodily functions, including farting, burping, sneezing, sweating, bowel movements, vomiting and release of odor in the body. The afflicted, as one can imagine, become social pariahs AT LEAST for the duration of their illness.
pros: Release a virus that disrupts perfectly-normal body functions
Afflict foes with bad gas, irritable bowel syndrome, lactose intolerance, explosive diarrhea, etc.
VERY embarrassing (affects only people you want it to, and render allies immune)
cons: The clean-up is horrendous (use this power from far away to avoid being blamed)
If people know YOU'RE the one with the ability, you're gonna get it
If people are already sick, people won't notice much of a difference

name: Make A Kystian
overview: make a kystian of your own.
description: You get 300 lbs of material every time you use this power. You can't use the power again until you use the material or it is destroyed or it is lost. You can make one or as many kystians as you can. Make them too small and get kystians with a hive IQ. You'll have to balance speed and strength. No superkystian. You can give your creatures sub-powers based on your powers. There is a maximum of 5 powers. There are off limit powers. Your creatures can walk,slither,swim or/and fly.
pros: Make a really good creature and Kyst will mass produce it.
Any appearance is possible. Off limit power have no affect on appearance.
cons: Off limit powers include are mythic,holy,unholy,time travel,time reversal.
Elemental body powers and cartoon based powers are off limits.
Any other powers that might be questionable for a kystian creature to have.

name: Chibification
overview: change people into chibis
description: A chibi is a human four inches tall that dies after four years with this power you can change people into chibis and do whatever you want with them!
pros: Chibis
cons: Permanent

name: Delete This The Rabbit Hole
overview: put your opponent in a spinning piledriver and then turn into a vortex to slam them.
description: You could hold your opponent them upside down by the waist, then leap into the air in a sitting position with the opponent's head between your legs and set them up for a spinning piledriver, but once activated you'll glow & turn into a ball which dissolves into a vortex and slam the opponent head hard into the ground that causes massive damage.
pros: a fight combo is not a power
cons: a fight combo is not a power

name: Cheesy Demons
overview: create cheesy demons.
description: Create any sort of demon possessed cheese. Cheddar,limburger,etc. Cheese demons remain demons if reduced to crumbs. They just become more demons. Hard cheese demons can actually hurt someone or at least knock them unconscious. Fondue demons will be able to burn someone. Some cheese demons like vieux boulogne demons will be detectable by their smell before being seen. Cheese demons can't be mass exorcised.
pros: Hard cheese demons can possibly knock someone unconscious.
Fondue demons can burn someone.
A demon wheel of cheese becomes hundreds of little demons if reduced to pieces.
cons: Someone who summons mice and rats.
Smelly cheese demons will give themselves away.

name: Lawn Gnome Power
overview: turn people into lawn gnomes
description: With this power you can turn people into lawn gnome versions of themselves. When they are a lawn gnome they cannot do anything at all and (depending on how good looking the person is) they can make good lawn decorations.
pros: You can turn enemies into lawn gnomes to make them less dangerous
cons: If you ever decide to turn them back that person will probably be angry at you

name: G Cell Mimicry
overview: produce and inject gastrin, and mentally activate the powers of some Cellular Mimics.
description: You can produce gastrin, a hormone which stimulates digestion. You can inject a dose in anyone through touch, forcing their body to begin digestion, even when they haven't eaten anything yet. In addition to this aspect, you can mentally activate the shooting power of Parietal Cell and Gastric Chief Cell Mimics and mentally control their aim. You can also enhance the secretion ability of Pancreatic Acinar Cell Mimics.
pros: Forcing someone to digest on an empty stomach can cause severe ulcers.
Kill a Parietal Cell Mimic with their own hydrochloric acid.
Take control of foes', or even allies', Parietal Cell or Gastric Chief Cell Mimicry.
cons: Parietal Cell Mimics could create new appendages to attack you with acid.
You are not immune to the effects of your targets' secretions.

name: Condition Change: Darkness
overview: make a power work only when its user is in the shadows
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that the power only works when the user is in the shadows. At least 25% of the body must be in shadows. Will not affect a power already affected by Condition Change: Light. This power is tactile.
pros: Just need to keep your opponent's body completely in light.
Fighting during the day.
cons: Must touch opponent and each touch affects one power.
Shadow controllers

name: B Cell Mimicry
overview: produce and release airborne Y-shaped objects that strongly stick to foes and hinder their moves.
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers: an elastic body, the power to clone yourself while in combat mode and the power to distinguish friends from foes on a molecular level. While cloning, you can decide if the new clone stays in combat mode or reverses to normal mode. In combat mode, you will keep creating floating Y-shaped objects that strongly stick to foes. When stuck to a foe, they will attract other friend Leukocyte Mimics and will boost their killing powers.
pros: You can tell friends from foes on a molecular level, meaning you can't be fooled by shapeshifters.
You can tag foes by sticking Ys to them. It will attract friends with a Leukocyte-Mimicry power.
In the presence of a friend Hepatocyte Mimic, the Ys will bore holes in a foe's body.
cons: You cannot enter combat mode by yourself with this power alone.
You can't return yourself to normal mode and your ability remains active in combat mode.
If you don't have a friend Leukocyte Mimic or Hepatocyte Mimic, you can't kill a foe.

name: Acid Breath V2
overview: breathe corrosive acid
description: With this power you can breathe corrosive acid from your nose. Whenever your breathe out through your nose you will melt anything near your nose. You cannot be hurt by your nose acid.
pros: You can breathe acid out through your nose
cons: You melt things whenever you breathe out through your nose
Breathing from your mouth does nothing acidwise

name: Zombie Ninja Summon
overview: summon three zombie ninjas
description: With this power you can summon zombies with all of the skills and abilities of your average stereotypical ninja. Enhanced senses and agility, a black belt in several forms of karate, being able to wield swords, nun-chucks and ninja stars with ease and being able to move without making any noise. They're also undead so they have a craving for brains, smell horrible and can't be killed. The three ninja zombies are under your complete control and you can unsummon them whenever you want.
pros: You can summon three zombie ninjas
They have all of the attributes of a zombie and a ninja
They are under your complete control
cons: They smell bad
Sometimes they fall apart

name: Suction Cups
overview: create suction cups all over your body
description: With this power you can create suction cups all over your body whenever you want. The suction cups give you the ability to stick to anything for up to sixty minutes unless you replace the suction cup.
pros: You can generate suction cups all over your body
You can stick to stuff
cons: You can only use a suction cup for up to an hour before it looses its stickiness

name: Hockey Scythe
overview: turn hockey sticks into scythes
description: With this power you can turn any hockey stick into a scythe. All you have to do it be holding a hockey stick and say "Scythe! ". You cannot reverse the affects of this power.
pros: You can turn hockey sticks into scythes
cons: You cannot reverse the affects of this power

name: Bird Species Shift
overview: change the species of birds
description: With this power you can change the species of birds. You change a canary into a hawk, a cardinal into an eagle. You can change the species of a single bird as many times as you want and you can also use this power on as many birds as you want.
pros: You can change the species of any kind of bird
You can change the species of a single bird as many times as you want
You can change the species of as many birds as you want
cons: The birds are not under your control
It only works on birds

name: Rise Of Gossamer
overview: turn into Gossamer
description: With this power you can turn into Gossamer. Gossamer is a giant red furry monster with sharp claws and tennis shoes on his feet. In this form you are super strong, are always warm due to your fur and have super sharp claws and big feet for stepping on your enemies. You retain your intelligence, personality but not your ability to speak in this form.
pros: You can turn into Gossamer
You have super strength, fur, sharp claws and big feet
cons: You cannot talk

name: Thirteen Treasures: The Coat
overview: wear the coat of Padarn Red-Coat
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. This coat will fit any brave man who should choose to put it on. Cowards attempting to wear this coat will either find it ridiculously large or painfully small.
pros: You'll be able to find out whether you are a coward by trying this coat on.
Toasty warm.
Lovely shade of red.
cons: The coat not fitting would hurt your pride.
It's basically just a regular coat.

name: Myth Power: Phocus' Focus
overview: channel Phocus' command over the essence of seals
description: Phocus (Phocos, Phokos), in Greek myth, was the god of seals. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and command seals at will. In addition, one can psychically mimic the features and abilities of a seal at will. Furthermore, one can transform oneself into any species of seal (or wereseal, or selkie) at will (others by touch), among other phocine abilities. One can even psychically teleport oneself and/or others to any location that is home to seals at will.
pros: Psychically perceive, communicate, command and mimic seals at will
Transform oneself into any species of seal (or wereseal or selkie) at will; others, by touch
Psychically teleport self/others to any location with seals, cast illusion of seal barking, at will
cons: Part 2 of Pro #2 requires touch until developed (NCN)
Cannot astral-project a water-independent seal-spirit at will, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige and MythPower: Amphitrite's Amity provide immunity (NCN)

name: Open Pet Tank
overview: keep a pet while it's in the wild
description: When you acquire this power, a special glass tank appears in front of you. This tank has the ability to inter-dimensionally share an object with two places: The outside world and inside the tank. Say you have a lizard that is really hard to look after. When you put the lizard in this tank, it will be both inside the tank and in the wild. The lizard will eat, drink and be in the wild while you can watch over it. You can pick it up, and the glass will serve as a shield against predators.
pros: Follow the pet in the wild in 3rd person perspective.
It can get whatever it needs.
You can interact with the pet, and the glass appears to momentarily protect it in the wild
cons: If you pick it up, it may think "WHAT JUST HAPPENED?!!! Where am I? "
Not much owner-pet bonding can happen unless you pick it up and interact with it a lot.
Bad if something disrupts the inter-dimensional displacement.

name: Skeptic Vibe
overview: give off a vibe that makes the supernatural avoid you.
description: You give off a vibe that makes the supernatural (psychics, ghosts, cryptids, aliens, witches, faith healers) extremely uncomfortable, to the point where anything supernatural avoids you and the area you're in.
pros: Never have to worry about supernatural threats.
Drive off the supernatural with your mere presence.
cons: You will never encounter anything supernatural.

name: Birds To Airplanes
overview: turn birds into airplanes
description: With this power you can turn any type of bird into any type of airplane but you cannot turn that airplane back into a bird
pros: You can have a lot of airplanes
cons: You can't do much with the airplanes unless you are a pilot or you can get your hands on one
You might accidentally make a certain type of bird endangered or even extinct

name: Obsessive Compulsive
overview: make someone obsess over something or some act for a length of time.
description: If you are attacked by an enemy, this ability is a great defense. Instead of hurting this person their attack bonuses back on them making them obsessed over a thing or action, even a personal trait long enough for you get away or capture them, example making a person count every breath they take and trying repeat the same number every minute or something.
pros: Great defence mechanism. Distraction helps you gets past enemy and capture suspects.
Make people look like fools in battle. Free House cleaning. Perfect cooking everytime.
cons: You could find yourself spending too time tormenting people.
You could get a victims killed if battling in large numbers.
You could make someone become obsessed for the rest of their life.

name: Strength Of Joy
overview: impose your will on reality through happiness.
description: With this power, you gain a low level of reality manipulation.- the control over reality through your thoughts. However, this ability is tied directly to the happiness of you and others around you. If people around you are extremely happy, your power will be very high, and you'll be capable of great feats. However, if you or many others around you are depressed, not only will your speed, strength, Etc. Be lower, your other powers will lose their strength also.
pros: When happy, you are very powerful.
If you are a naturally happy person, you will be extremely strong.
If you are social/surround yourself with friends, you will also be strong.
cons: When sad, you will be drastically weaker.
Once your sadness reaches a certain level. Your life will be in danger.

name: Loaded
overview: know how much ammo any weapon has just by looking at it
description: With this power you can know exactly how much ammo any given weapon has just by looking at it.
pros: You can know how much ammo a weapon has just by looking at it
cons: Not much use in physical combat if you're not fighting someone with a gun
You need to be able to see the weapon

name: Rip Van Winkle
overview: go into suspended animation for a century
description: Like Washington Irving's character, you will go into a deep hibernation for century. You will have a protective force field around you & all your fuctions will slow down. Meaning you won't need to breath much or need nutrition & all other involuntary functions will be taken care of. But most of all, you won't age. When 100 years have passed, you will awaken without atrophy.
pros: Be able to live 100 years without aging
Be protected by a force field
All bodily functions & needs will be taken care of
cons: Your family & friends will probably not be alive 100 years from now
You missed out on what happend for 100 years since you went into hibernation

name: The Spiller
overview: spill any liquid that has been placed in a container.
description: With this power, you can spill any liquid that's been placed in some type of container. Be it a coffee mug, semi-truck, or your neighbor's toilet, all that's required is a thought... And *sploosh*. While it seems limiting at first, there are TONS of possibilities awaiting the owner of this power. Co-worker not cooperating? Coffee burns! Drunk guy hitting on your girl? Party foul! And if you play your cards right, you might just become the next fast food lawsuit jackpot winner.
pros: Eliminate drunk ass-bandits and annoying co-workers
Never get shut out playing beer pong. They'll be too drunk to notice their cup spilled by itself!
Might be fun while giving blood.
cons: While showing off, you might spill pecious beverages such as beer or liquid uranium
You're useless with no contained liquids nearby
Doesn't work on organic containers like people or kittens

name: Zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz
overview: turn snoring into holographic imitative words.
description: If you have to sleep next to someone who snores loudly, you can turn their snoring into holographic imitative words like 'Zzzzzzz' (or 'Kkhhh', if you have to sleep next to Donald Duck). They will be silent and fun to watch.
pros: No more sleepless nights beside a snoring partner.
Surely the last power on the list.
Fun to watch.
cons: Other unpleasant noises can still keep you awake.

name: Yoko Factor
overview: bring up nasty secrets among groups of friends, effectively breaking them up.
description: When you are dealing with a group of people, such as friends, allies, teammates, family,... , you are able to spill out the secrets they are keeping from the others. You know exactly what to say to affect them and how to say it to upset them, either in a sadisticly calm way or even a charmingly nasty way. The biggest risk is that they turn their anger against you, but at least the damage has been done as they won't easily trust each other from now on.
pros: You can disband whole groups of people.
You can learn other people's embarrassing secrets.
cons: People could forgive themselves, in which case your intervention reinforced their bonds.
People could beat you to stop you from revealing any more secrets.

name: Take Out Menu
overview: order any food that you have eaten before for the same price.
description: You have a magic take-out menu that allows you to order any cooked food that you have eaten before. To order the food, you must pay the cheapest amount that has been paid for the food for you to eat in the past (ingredients if it was made at home). The food can only be eaten by the one who ordered it and only one meal can be ordered at any one time.
pros: Any food you want at any time.
Possibility of free food.
Food cannot be stolen.
cons: Have to pay to get better food.
Cannot feed those who are hungry around you.
May become fat.

name: Holy Power: Shield Grenade
overview: focus a massive amount of chaotic energy on the Avenger Shield and throw it, causing an explosion.
description: With this power you can focus a massive amount of chaos energy on your shield and then throw the shield on your target, causing it to create a gigantic explosion of pure destruction, destroying everything and everyone in great distance. This ability is really, really powerful but it is as dangerous as strong. You might kill a lot of people if you use this power on the wrong place, so be careful. Only an Avenger can use this power.
pros: Cause a lot of destruction.
You can easily destroy a whole army of enemies using this power.
You can use this power from a safe distance by throwing the shield on enemies that are far away.
cons: You might hurt a lot of innocent people.
Wastes a lot of energy, and takes a few second to get all the Chaos Energy required for this attack.

name: Maximum Fart
overview: inadvertently let out a massive sonic feedback Flatulence.
description: This power is able to generate huge amounts of sonic energy by farting. This 'gassy' new ability has a variety of uses. You can use it to fly, create concussive or disintegrating energy blasts, create force-fields, shatter certain materials by using different wavelengths of sound, or cause your enemies to become disoriented, nauseous, or even unconscious. You can even use your own stomach-wind to let you move very fast.
pros: This might cause your opponents to faint or vomit.
cons: If you get near a campfire, an inferno, or a wildfire it'll destroy everything within city blocks.

name: Meat Vision
overview: create meat upon will.
description: Create meat whenever you want! Feed the poor! Make a meat mobile! Do what ever you want, You the god of meat.
pros: Feed the power
Meat weapontry
Meat Mobile
cons: Rotten Meat
Tired of meat
Vegatarians family and friends

name: Diabolus Ex Machina
overview: solve any tragedy while creating another tragedy that is much bigger
description: With this power you have the evil twin of the Deus Ex Machina power. Truly the Devil in the Machine everything will become much worse for everyone else and if not careful you.   This power activates either when you shout Diabolus Ex Machina or when you die.   This will cause an unnatural phenomenon to happen that will make everything worse(or worse in comparison according to you).  When you die unnaturally, ultimate bad luck occurs and the universe ends in a big bang.
pros: Everyone wants to keep you alive
Everyone gets hit with this ability
Bad look may be twisted good luck
cons: This power makes everything worse
Everyone else will hate you
Crazy cultists will try to kill you

name: Garden Master
overview: have full knowledge of how to make and maintain a garden of any plants/style one wants
description: Zen gardens, vegetable gardens, flower garden, etc. Someone with this power can have any kind of garden they want and maintain that garden perfectly without any help because this power gives them full knowledge of how to do so.
pros: You can have the most beautiful garden on the block!
Grow all your own vegetables and spend less money on groceries.
cons: Only gives knowledge, no control like Mythpower: Demeter's Touch or something similar

name: Kyst: Emergency Power #5
overview: have Kyst call for up to 1000 big guns.
description: Vanthu -- bipeds that look like offspring of a whale and a elephant. Kyst will send for up to a thousand (space permitting). Weapons could be energy, hyperkinetic or reality negating. Damage will be direct rapid-fire with a range of 15 to 20 miles. Kyst will give you one vanthu to command. This vanthu will have the best weapon.
pros: You get one to command.
Yours will have the best weapon.
This adds to Emergency Power #4
cons: This is an emergency power, vanthu vanish when not needed.

name: Quintesson Robot Summon
overview: summon any robot from Quintessa
description: With this power you can summon any Quintesson robot (Sharkticons, Allicons, Overcharge) from any Transformers continuity. Though due to them being evil drones, they may need some reprogramming before they'll listen to you. When you're done with them, you can just send them back to whatever Universe they came from.
pros: You can summon as many Quintesson robots as you want
They are very powerful
Once you're done with them you can just send them back to whatever universe they came from
cons: You might need to reprogram them before they'll work for you
They might get distracted and eat a car instead of what you told them to do

name: Dantes Scroll
overview: gods from many religions came together to find a way to stop Derrick Dante
description: Derrick Dante has caused many troubles for many gods. Absorbing many avatars powers. Every time he grows stronger. So the gods developed a scroll that could summon Dante at anytime in case one of the gods were in trouble. He does not like being summoned however his level of "avatar" kills is so great the gods needed a way to keep him in check. This has worked so far but only time will tell if they made the right choice.
pros: Having Dante at your beckon call
