overview: emulate or resurrect a dead musician
description: With this power you can resurrect, summon the spirit of, or emulate (play with the same skill of) any dead musician of your choice. S/he will only remain alive for a short while.
pros: You can drum like The Rev, or write like Mozart
You can learn to become as good as any musician of your choice
You can interview/meet your musical hero
cons: The ghosts might leave you, or hurt you
The ghost might turn out to be a jerk
The person you're trying to resurrect has to remain dead

name: Rise Of The Shamir
overview: turn into the mythical shamir
description: With this power you can turn into the mythical Shamir worm a tiny worm that can eat through stone and metal
pros: You can eat through stone and metal
You are small so you can hide in small places or crawl though door cracks
cons: You can't really do much in a one on one fight

name: Condition Change: Cities
overview: make a power work only when the user is in a city
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to work only when the user is in a city. Cannot be used on a power already affected by a Condition Change requiring another type of terrain. This power is tactile.
pros: Just make sure you don't fight anywhere near cities.
cons: Have to touch opponent and each touch only affects one power.

name: Condition Change: Hair
overview: require a power being used on one's own hair in order to work
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that it can only be used on one's own hair. This power will not affect a power already affected by another Condition Change that requires a different body part. This power is tactile.
pros: Now just avoid your opponent's hair.
cons: Have to touch opponent and each touch affects only one power.
An opponent with multiple powers.

name: Sugar Beets
overview: can generate sugar beets out of thin air
description: Can generate sugar beets wenever you want. You leave a trail of sugar cane wearever you go. Can strip sugar cane/sugar beets of their sugar using your mind. Can cause grass to turn into sugar cane
pros: Infinite sugar for free
Help farmers
Can help the eco movment by creating more plants
cons: No real fighting capability

name: Stale, Mate
overview: turn anything stale
description: A person with this power can turn anything stale. For example, they can make food, air and water stale. Of course, this would make your enemies very paranoid when eating. But, this is not it. The user can turn ANYTHING stale, even people's thought processes. Essentially, you can force people to only think of stale ideas, using this power.
pros: Suffocate people with stale air
Turn your enemies' food stale
Even turn people's ideas (thought processes) stale
cons: Can only be used for evil purposes, except when making cheese or other stuff
Even if a person's thought processes are stale, they can still think of ways to hurt you

name: Delete This Now
overview: see anything in 3D
description: A person with this power can see anything in 3-d. See movies in 3D and see what you draw in 3d.
pros: Can see holograms of anything you draw
Don't need to pay extra for 3D
cons: No offensive purposes or defensive

name: Crodo: Vacuum Ball
overview: wield a vacuum ball.
description: Vacuum balls suck up any kind of dirt near them.  Anything it sucks up comes out on another universe.
pros: Cleaning will be a breeze.
cons: You don't control what it sucks up.

name: Myth Power: Pompe's Procession
overview: channel Pompe's command over the essence of religious procession
description: Pompe, in Greek myth, was the goddess of religious procession and ceremony. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically access the customs and traditions of every religion, religious sect and cult in existence. In addition, one may perceive the religious beliefs of others at will. Furthermore, one may psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with those who share one's religious/spiritual views. One may even do physical and mental harm, by a touch, to those who do not.
pros: Psychically access all knowledge of existing religions, religious sects and cults
Psychically perceive others' religious views at will; harm those with differing religious views
Psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with those with similar religious views
cons: Cannot compel subjects with similar religious views until the higher levels
The closer a foe's religious views are to the user's, the less harm can be done by touch (NCN)
People with law/order/justice based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Unforgettable Voice
overview: make whatever you say unforgettable
description: A person with this power can make whatever they say unforgettable. Whenever anyone else listens to the user's voice they will never forget what you said. This also works if the voice is spread through electronic media including microphones, recording devices, and through the internet.
pros: Can be used to become a great public speaker or singer
Useful to study with
Your insults hurt a lot since no one can forget them
cons: Cannot turn off--so be careful what you say
Does not improve the quality of your voice

name: Pose Mastery
overview: always be posing.
description: With this power you gain complete mastery of the pose, with the ability to seamlessly transition from one pose to the next without breaking stride such that even the most mundane tasks, such as walking your dog, become overdramatic and fabulous.
pros: Everything you do is now overdramatic.
You'll stand out in any picture you're in.
cons: Everything you do is now overdramatic.
You'll stand out in any picture you're in.

name: Needy Zombie
overview: summon emotionally insecure zombies
description: They won't eat your brains, but they won't leave you alone. Summon zombies who really need a friend then have them swarm your enemy.
pros: Typical Zombie powers
cons: If you don't leave the area, they may want to be your friend

name: Zodiac: Libra
overview: make damage of any kind equal on both sides
description: By drawing the sign of Libra the Scales in the air, you can make all damage on both sides equal out for two hours. This only works on damage done during those two hours. This power will NOT outright kill them if you die of blood loss because that requires open wounds. Any other death it will try to affect them the same way.
pros: Having Bloodless and Pain to Itchiness when using this power.
They won't want to hurt you.
cons: You won't want to hurt your opponent(s) while this is in effect.

name: Useless
overview: have the most useless power in existence.
description: This power does absolutely nothing. It is not affected by any other power, and cannot be copied, or negated by any other individual other than the one who possesses it. It basically doesn't exist other than being a power. Although it can be affected by upgrade type powers, or powers that increase your power depending on how many powers you have.
pros: No Power Mimicry (mimics who try copying this power will receive a power "blank space"
No Power Absorption (absorbers who try copying this power will receive a power "blank space")
No power alteration (negation does nothing, because technically, it does nothing anyway)
cons: It does absolutely nothing, besides giving you the indication of being superhuman to power sensors

name: Condition Change: Swamps
overview: make a power work only when the user is in a swamp
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to work only when the user is in a swamp. Cannot be used on a power already affected by a Condition Change requiring another type of terrain. This power is tactile.
pros: Just make sure you don't fight anywhere near swamps.
cons: Have to touch opponent and each touch only affects one power.

name: 9 Element Masters' Seal
overview: seal away any being/object so long as eight element masters are assisting one
description: The nine elements are fire, water, earth, wind, ice, lightning, metal, wood, and sound. All the elements have to have someone who has mastered them in order for this power to work and one person can only stand in for one element at most.
pros: You can stand in for one of the elements (only ONE).
cons: You need to have everyone and it should be hard to get all eight people.

name: Drunk People Language
overview: understand and fluently speak drunk people language without being drunk.
description: You can understand slurred speech and any nonsense drunk people shout. You can also speak the same way drunk people do, without needing to get drunk or act drunk, though it doesn't mean drunk people will understand you. Similarly, understanding them doesn't mean they will cooperate or answer your questions.
pros: Help lost drunk people.
If you can act, you can actually convince people you are drunk.
Make fun of policemen when they make you blow in a breathalyzer.
cons: Drunk people won't understand you.
Sober people won't understand you.
tags: was edited as it was not really a superpower

name: Yawning Point
overview: make people yawn when you point at them
description: With this power you can make people yawn by pointing at them. I happens whenever you point at someone and they don't stop yawning until you stop pointing at them.
pros: You can make people yawn
cons: Not much use in physical combat
They stop yawning when you stop pointing at them

name: "Jell O" Demons
overview: create demons from anything the company "Jell-o" makes
description: Anything made by the company "Jell-o"(like "Jell-o" jell-o, or "Jell-o" pudding) you can turn into evil demons who obey your every command. You can also summon "Jell-o" demons out of nowhere. Your demons can envelope anything, to kill someone, to save someone, to carry something, etc. Your demons' essence is trapped inside of their gooey body, so they can't be exorcised (or popssess someone). The only way to kill or get rid of them is to completely obliterate them, or for you to unsummon them
pros: Giant, tasty, evil minions
If anyone else tries to eat the Jellos, the eater will instantly die
cons: They can't possess someone
They can't go through forcefields

name: Myth Power: Phthonos' Theory
overview: channel Phthonos' command over the essence of jealousy, envy and resentment
description: Phthonos (Phthonus), in Greek myth, was the god of jealousy, envy and resentment, especially in matters of love. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive the thoughts, emotions, actions and locations of enemies and loved ones (relatives/friend/allies) at will. In addition, one can perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel those who are naturally envious, jealous and possessive. One may even mimic the superhuman abilities/skills/capabilities of rivals when in radius of them.
pros: Perceive the thoughts, emotions, actions and locations of loved ones and enemies at will
Perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel the envious, jealous and possessive
Mimic the powers and skills of rivals at will
cons: Mimicry of powers/abilities/skills/talents lasts only an hour after leaving rival's presence (NCN)
People with MythPower: Nike's Knowledge and MythPower: Zeus' Zenith are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Nemesis Indignation and MythPower: Aphrodisia are immune to this ability

name: Tele Apathy
overview: not care from far away.
description:
Tele-Apathic people couldn't care less about you or your problems. While many people display versions of this power in their everyday lives, Tele-Apathics (or "Shmanners" for convenience) have a super-humanly extended range. 

Famous shmanners include Peter Petrelli, who, despite having time travel, didn't care enough to stop time whenever attacked. Also D. L. Hawkins, a phaser who doesn't mind being shot point blank from the front.
pros: It's a lot less stressful than other powers
cons: You could die
Whoops, I mean you will die

name: Telephone Telepathy
overview: be heard all of the time by everyone
description: People hear you all the time where ever you are in a kind of telepathic transmission. Even people on the other side of the world can hear you.
pros: Your Girlfriend won't need to be jealous
People will know you are alive
Everybody can be your alibi if you would be accused for a crime
cons: No personal integrity
The world will hear you when you're sick
Sometimes it can be embarrasing

name: Guitar Hero
overview: shoot lightning out of your guitar head
description: Electric energy builds up in your hands and enters your guitar pick. When you strum with the guitar pick, it releases that energy into the strings, and travels up the strings until it exits through the headstock. You can use the energy to power up electronics or to shock your opponents.
pros: The better at playing the guitar you are, the stronger the electric force will be
Your guitar also works as a conductor, absorbing electricity and amplifying your own
cons: The worse at playing the guitar you are, the weaker the electric force will be
The electricity will backfire if you attempt to shock someone who is better at playing the guitar

name: Billymayskinesis
overview: spontaneously channel the spirit of Billy Mays
description: Hi, Billy Mays here with Billymayskinesis with this power you can do anything I can, sell anything to anyone, grow a beard, and so much more! For just two easy payments of $19.99 this power can be yours.
pros: Sell anything to anyone!
Grow a beard instantly
So much more!
cons: Constantly yelling
Hi, Billy Mays here!
Randomly creeping people out with your "power"

name: T Helper Cell Mimicry
overview: attract other Leukocyte Mimics and make them go into combat mode.
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers (cf. Other Leukocyte Mimics to know which ones). While cloning, you can decide if the new clone stays in combat mode or reverses to normal mode. When you encounter a foe, you spontaneously go into combat mode. In combat mode, you can attract other Leukocyte Mimics, as well as activate those who recognize the same foe as you and boost the powers of Macrophage Mimics.
pros: You can make T Cell and B Cell Mimics, who can't enter combat mode alone, enter it.
When you recognize a foe, you can directly enter combat mode and attract other Leukocyte Mimics.
You can clone yourself to outnumber a foe.
cons: You may attract foes with a Leukocyte-Mimicry power.
Once in combat mode, you're stuck in this mode.
If you don't have any friend Leukocyte Mimics, you'll have trouble destroying a foe.

name: Delete This Torture Typhoon
overview: put your opponent in a backbreaker rack, then go for a twirling finishing DDT.
description: You can place your opponent face-up across your own shoulders before hooking the head with one hand and a leg with the other. You then pull down on both ends to flex the opponent's back, lift the opponent up in a fireman's carry across your shoulders, throw the opponent's legs out in front of them to spin them out while they simultaneously fall backwards, driving their head into the ground in style of a DDT.
pros: Your foe will be in a whirlwind of pain.
cons: None.

name: Myth Power: Talas' Tale
overview: channel Talas' command over the essence of unfortunate love and unfortunate relationships
description: Talas, in Greek myth, was the goddess of unfortunate love (breakups, heartbreak, etc). As such, channeling her allows one to summon, by touch, a subject's 'Heart Object'. In addition, one may use it to perceive a subject's soulmate, and various negative aspects of their love life. Furthermore, one can manipulate it by touch to affect relationships at will (tearing it in two breaks up two lovers, and breaks single subjects' hearts; smashing it to the ground kills a subject, or their lover).
pros: Psychically summon a subject's Heart Object (a heart shaped object composed of love energy) by touch
Use it to perceive a subject's true love/soulmate (and various negative aspects of one's love life)
Manipulate a subject's Heart Object to manipulate love, life and relationships
cons: Heart Object capabilities do not apply to FRIENDSHIPS until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities (or not being sentient) provide immunity

name: Myth Power: Chloris' Claim
overview: channel Chloris' command over the essence of flowers
description: Chloris (Khloris), in Greek myth, was the goddess of flowers. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically manipulate flowers and flowering plants, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel subjects wearing flowers or flower patterns, at will. One can also mimic the powers of flowering plants (photosynthesis, producing roots, thorns, leaves, flower-based pheromones and toxins, etc) at will. One even gains favor with (thus, total immunity to) the winds.
pros: Psychically manipulate flowers/flower plants; perceive, communicate with and compel flower-wearers
Psychically mimic the abilities of flowers (roses, belladonna, wolfsbane, nightshade, etc), at will
Gain favor with (immunity to the negative effects of) the winds
cons: Cannot use flower-blooms as two-way communications systems or viewing portals, until developed (NCN)
Until developed, may cause one's breath to produce fragrant flower petals
MythPower: Demeter's Touch, Persephone's Poise and Gaia's Gift provide immunity (NCN)

name: Summon Nitra
overview: summon a limited existing kystian.
description: A nitra is a upright monster that looks like the offspring of pterodactyl and a sea anemone. It can fly 10 mph,run 30 mph and is strong enough to cut through titanium. It has long talons on the end of its wings/arms. It has the ability to only exist for its summoner and a sentient target of attack. It can't affect or be affected in any way by other beings or creatures when in that state. If its summoner is rendered unconscious a nitra dies instantly if in that state.
pros: A kystian that can literally only exist to kill.
You can make this kystian undetectable to its target. Invisible,silent,etc.
The target of a nitra is the only being that can affect it with or without powers.
cons: If you're made unconscious any nitras you have could die.
A nitra can only go after one target in its limited existence state.

name: Babality
overview: turn anyone into a baby
description: Step 1.  Raise your fist high in the air.  Step 2.   Watch and cackle maniacally (or smile heroically) as your opponent is instantaneously transformed into a helpless, crying baby.
pros: Turn Darth Vader into a cute, huggable little baby!
Enemy baby ninjas have sucky aim with shurikens.
No more getting your butt kicked just because someone else is bigger or older than you.
cons: You could end up getting stuck with the kid.
You have to raise your fist in the air, a difficult feat if your arms are tied to your torso.
You'll get bored if all your archnemeses are a bunch of babies who can't try to take over the world.

name: Myth Power: Trochilus' Trend
overview: channel Trochilus' command over the essence of the mill-wheel and the grinding millstone
description: Trochilus (Trochilos, Trokhilos), in Greek myth, was the god of the watermill's mill-wheel, used to drive the millstone that grinds grain or corn husks into flour. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and manipulate flour, and any plant that is used to make flour. In addition, one can psychically perceive and manipulate any mechanism considered to be a wheel. Furthermore, one may even produce a psionic millstone grinding effect on anything within one's vision range at will.
pros: Psychically perceive and manipulate flour; perceive, communicate and control flour-yielding plants
Psychically perceive and manipulate any wheel (transportation, steering, mill, bike, car, toy, etc)
Produce a psionic millstone grinding effect to crush or grind nearly anything one can see
cons: Only produce a mill effect on bodies of water to produce electricity at the higher levels (NCN)
Pro #3 ALWAYS requires seeing target; cannot be used on humans/animals until the higher levels (NCN)
People with plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Fwoosh
overview: make the ultimate Fwoosh sound effect.
description: Have you ever been doing something and you just thought, 'How much funner would this be if I could make a Fwoosh sound while I did it? ' Well, with this power, you can make a Fwoosh sound whenever you do anything, without faking it. You can Fwoosh when you do paperwork, when you eat, even when you slap someone.
pros: Make a Fwoosh sound effect at will.
cons: None.

name: Thirteen Treasures: The Knife
overview: wield the knife of Llawfrodedd the Horseman
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. This knife will multiply into enough knives to be used by 24 men.
pros: Many knives!
Arm your friends!
cons: Not enough knives for 25 men.

name: The Candy Man
overview: make it rain candy
description: With this power, you can make it rain candy of any and every kind. You can change the size of the candy and you can change the taste of the candy.
pros: Children will like you
Your every child's friend
Never go hungry again
cons: Toothaches
Children will beg you for candy
Parents

name: Myth Power: Hecateros' Hoedown
overview: channel Hecateros' command over the essence of the rustic dance
description: Hecateros (Hecaterus, Hekateros), in Greek myth, was the god of the rustic 'hekateris' dance. As such, channeling him allows one to move one's hands at Superhuman Speed, and with Superhuman Reflexes, at will. In addition, one can psychically access skill in 'combat dancing', at will. One can also psychically produce music, which compels subjects to perform a perfectly-coordinated dance routine, at will. One can even psychically launch foes literally into orbit, with a kick to the rump, at will.
pros: Move one's hands at Superhuman Speed and with Superhuman Reflexes, at will
Psychically access combative dancing skill; produce a song, which compels subjects to dance, at will
Psychically launch foes into orbit, with a kick to the butt, at will
cons: Cannot psychically manipulate subjects' hands, at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically amplify power of self/allies by joining hands, until developed (NCN)
Humor/entertainment-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Jack Bauer Power
overview: gain the powers of Jack Bauer for 24 hours
description: When using Jack Bauer Power, you will gain the abilities of Jack Bauer. This means you will become an expert in fire arms, close range combat, strategic thinking and being a badass. In addition, you have the ability to call in SWAT teams and have phone calls with the president whenever you want.
pros: You're an expert in fire arms, close range combat and strategic thinking
Talking with the president is pretty cool
You're an expert at torture
cons: Everyone with any kind of authority over you will suddenly become really annoying
You will probably spend most of your time having to kill terrorists
No bathroom breaks

name: Greater Kystian Morph #4
overview: become a 5-mile-long unsummonable kystian.
description: The aqusho. A five-mile-long anthropomorphic snake. You use telekinetic flight. It takes time to build up to your full speed of 60000 mph but takes lesser time to slow down. You can lift 1.4 million tons. You have telescopic vision times 1000 magnification, can sense electrical fields in a 500-mile radius and see in total darkness. When you first change, you first gain TK flight, then morph into a human-sized aqusho growing into your full size in 5 minutes.
pros: Smash up the planet or a fleet of starships ( the main reason why Kyst made the aqusho).
Escape from prison (yes, using this power to do so is overkill but it is fun).
You can lift 2,800,000,000 pounds.
cons: Annoying heroes with the right powers might stop you from changing and having fun.

name: Brain Spikes
overview: grow brain horns.
description: This power lets you grow many spike or horn from your head at any moment. You can grow as many as you want at a time. The horns are unbreakable. The horns can also hold electric charges. They can be used for many different things. You can help or hurt people with this power. You will be a superhero or villain, so have fun.
pros: Hurt people.
Look cool and bad.
Make a lot of money.
cons: Hurt people.
Superhero chance low.
They weigh a lot.

name: Flower Mimicry (Flower Form)
overview: become a flower.
description: You can become a flower whenever you want to. This form can last as long as you want, and happens almost instantly. And you are very convincing as a flower.
pros: You can hide easily.
You are pretty.
cons: As a flower, you can't talk or move, and you can be controlled by Agrokinesis
You might get trampled (you ARE just a flower)
Bugs always trying to pollinate you...

name: Jump 2: Powerless.
overview: jump to a reality where powers are impossible.
description: Annoyed with super powers? With this ability, you can move to a reality where all powers cease to function. This includes object-based powers. However, you leave an "anchor" in your last universe, which will enable you to return at will to the place, age and reality you left.
pros: Upon return, you are the same age, power level, etc as when you left.
If you aren't the one entering this world, you will still be able to return.
Good prison for enemies.
cons: You lose your powers too.
Lasting effects from powers are erased (could be a pro).
If you were too dependent on your powers, you would be a sitting duck.

name: The Oronox Elixir
overview: summon a bottle of Oronox
description: Oronox is a liquid that can give a person immortality or permanent death. Drinking this bottle is a gamble, if you were to drink it and it gave you permanent death, you will die, and can never be reincarnated. Few get lucky and are rewarded with immortality. Being good-hearted raises the chance of awarding you immortality. Being rich and greedy raises the chance of you being punished with death.
pros: Chance of being immortal
cons: Chance of being punished with permanent death.

name: Werewolf Summon
overview: summon werewolves
description: With this power you can summon werewolves and if you're lucky they'll help you do things. But they'll probably just eat you unless you also have werewolf control.
pros: You can summon werewolves
cons: They mitght eat you

name: Eye Popper
overview: blow up people's eyes
description: You simply take off all your clothes. They will be so amazed at how underdeveloped you are their eyes will burst.
pros: Run around naked, all the time!
cons: Never gonna get laid, ever!

name: Rise Of The Nornorajus
overview: turn into a Nornorajus
description: With this power you can turn into a Nornorajus, a small,cute looking creature that when angered goes berserk. It has sharp claws and teeth and is super agile and strong. It can climb almost any surface at enhanced speed. When you are angered while in Nornorajus mode you lose control over yourself and become a savage beast attacking anything that moves.
pros: You can cause enemies to let their guard down with your cuteness
You have sharp claws and teeth, super strength, super agility and enhanced climbing abilities
cons: If you get angry you lose control over yourself
You are unable to talk in Nornorajus mode

name: Bigfoot Control
overview: control Bigfoot
description: With this power you have complete control of the elusive cryptid, Bigfoot
pros: You can make him fight for you
You can bring him in for show and tell
You can use him to reach things for you that are in high places
cons: He might not be near you when using this power so it will take awhile for him to get to you

name: Mascot Conjuring
overview: conjure mascots of a corporate or sports variety.
description: Think of a mascot and it will appear before as a unaging flesh and blood being. It won't need food or water. It might have powers(e. G. Kool Aid Man, Lucky the Leprechaun). It will do its best to help you. You can unconjure it anytime. Mascots you conjure can be conjured by other people with this power.. Your jolly green giant could fight another jolly green giant. You can conjure a new mascot every day until you run out of mascots to conjure.
pros: Jolly green giant, Lucky the Leprechaun, Tony the Tiger, Chester Cheeto.
Conjured mascots don't need food or water.
Conjured mascots are immortal.
cons: Pillsbury doughboy, helping hand, geicko gecko, keebler elves, Snap, Crackle and Pop.
Eventually you'll run out of good mascots to conjure.

name: Tarentule (Tarantula)
overview: produce venomous web
description: If you're a tarantula hybrid, you can produce a web substance that slowly kills your prey
pros: You don't have to do a lot
A meal that doesn't fight back
And you can torture it as it slowly dies
cons: You're screwed if it can suddenly burst from your web
You can't hang from web substance
You as vulnerable to it as your victim

name: Zzzzz Xylophone
overview: summon a xylophone that can put others to sleep.
description: With this power you can summon a xylophone. One touch and anyone who hears it falls asleep.
pros: Put people to sleep.
cons: You could fall asleep.
No drumsticks.

name: Hollower
overview: make things hollow
description: With this power you can make anything hollow. Just point at the object and say "Hollow" and the object will instantly be hollowed out. You cannot use this power on living beings.
pros: You can make things hollow
cons: You cannot use this power on living beings

name: Baseball Bat Arms
overview: turn your arms into baseball bats
description: With this power you can turn your arms into baseball bats. You can do it with both arms and you can choose between metal and wood or you have one wooden bat arm and one metal bat arm at the same time. You can keep your arms in bat mode for as long as you want, but if one of the bats are cut off or broken in half, your arm is cut off or broken in half so be careful.
pros: You can turn your arms into either metal or wooden baseball bats
You can keep them in bat mode for as long as you want
cons: All damage sustained in bat mode transfers over to arm mode

name: Srs Bsns
overview: make somebody complete serious for a whole twenty four hours
description: With this person you can make anybody remain complete serious for up to twenty four hours. The person will not be able to laugh, tell a joke or make fun of anything.
pros: You can make people complete serious for up to twenty four hours
cons: Not much use in physical combat unless you're fighting the Joker or something

name: Max Hair
overview: cause your hair to grow longer
description: With this power you can cause your hair to grow as long as you want. You cannot make the hair become shorter again with this power.
pros: You can make your hair to grow longer
cons: You can't make it grow shorter

name: Kirby's Cellphone
overview: have Kirby's cellphone
description: With this power you can have Kirby's cellphone from Kirby and the Amazing Mirror. The phone allows you to summon four Kirby clones, green, red, yellow and Shadow Kirby. You can use the phone whenever you want. You cannot unsummon the Kirby's but eventually they will wander off and disappear on their own.
pros: You can have Kirby's cellphone
You can summon four Kirby clones
cons: The clones are not under your control
They're not very useful if there are no Kirby enemies around for them to inhale
Sometimes they'll wander off even when you still need them

As such, channeling her allows one to psychically access knowledge of every legal wrestling move in existence, at will. In addition, one can withstand damage from any attacks except wrestling moves. One can also psychically trap foes, by touch, in a divine 'wrestling space', where combatants' strength is equal. One can even psychically access triple the foe's strength, for the duration of a three-count, if pinned.

The plants are nourished with your bodies fluids and nutrients, but at the same time share their photosynthesis gained energy with you (mitigating the downside of sharing your nutrients), and the root structures may actually make your body more resilient to damage.

description: A burning red-orange aura glows around your right arm, that gives you the opportunity to put your foe in a powerbomb position and lift them up in a inverted powerbomb. You move your arm from around the opponent's neck, grabbing hold of their throat that'll cause them to be instantly burn, finally lift them high into the air slam the opponent down to the ground back first.
pros: a fight combo is not a power
cons: a fight combo is not a power

name: Pigsy Channelling
overview: become an immortal half-man half-pig monster
description: You'll transformed into an immortal half-man half-pig monster, Pigsy's weapon of choice is the muck-rake that can split stones and mountains, you are also capable of 36 transformations (as compared to Sun Wukong's 72), and can travel on clouds, but not as fast as Wukong. However, you can fight underwater.
pros: Diverse and interesting abilities
cons: You'll be forever tempted by gluttony and greed.
You'll become a womanizer.

name: G1 Megatron's Transformation
overview: turn into a gun
description: With this power, you can turn into a gun for others to use much like Megatron from Generation 1.
pros: Your allies can use you as a weapon
cons: You enemies might use you against your allies

name: Big O
overview: summon the "Big O" at will.
description: Summon a mech named "Big O" by yelling it into a watch you have (has to be the Big O watch). This mech is very powerful, very tall, moderately defensive and VERY slow and heavy. The Big O has a punch that when it hits it explodes the enemy. It also has two beams, one tiny one that comes from its head and a huge one that comes from its chest but it can only be used once.
pros: Only one on Earth with a mech.
Big O beam + Big O punch
Has hooks to help it up if it falls.
cons: Probably the worst mech ever
Slow
Need the watch to summon it.

name: Grue Control
overview: control grues
description: Allows you to control grues, and make them do whatever you want. Grues CANNOT be used in any bright light. Also allows you to fuse grues.
pros: Controlling Grues
Fusing Grues to make Uber-Grues
What else do you need?
cons: Useless on most of the planet during the day.
Lose control and you die.
Eurgs will target you.

name: Keep Eating Or Else
overview: cause people to die if they stop eating
description: With this power you can put a curse on up to ten people that causes them to die if they stop eating. There are some rules though, you can only use this power on someone while they're eating, it only works if they know they're cursed and the aforementioned ten person at a time limit.
pros: You can cause people to die if they stop eating
cons: You can only use this power on up to ten people
You can only use this power on someone while they're eating
The curse only kicks in once the person knows they are cursed

name: Fart Control
overview: control how bad your farts smell and where they move.
description: Make your enemy smell your horrible, horrible farts.
pros: Can make your friends smell your farts.
Farts are good crime fighting material.
Can fart in class and no one will know!
cons: If you fart when you're asleep.
Horrible to get used to when you just start having the power.
If you make a big enough fart, you will turn into that fart and never be human again!

name: Acne Gifter
overview: give people acne
description: With this power you can give people incurable acne. No matter how much medication or cream they use the acne that you give them will never go away. Not even you can remove the victims new acne.
pros: You can give people incurable acne
cons: You can't even cure this new acne so be careful who you use it on

name: Crayon Fingers
overview: turn your fingers into crayons
description: With this power you can turn your fingers into crayons. You can make the crayons any color or brand you want.
pros: You can turn your fingers into crayons
You can change the color and or brand of the crayons
cons: If the crayons break your fingers are broken
It's kinda hard to draw this way

name: A Wish List Of Kystians Summon
overview: summon exactly what you'll think you'll need for kystians.
description: Conquering the world, a nation or just a small country? You can use this power to summon the exact number of kystians you think you'll need. Two drawbacks however. If Kyst makes a new kystian you just have to have half a million of, then you need to unsummon your entire previous wish list. If you don't want any of the newer models but did lose 500000 of the kystians you have, you have to unsummon what's left of your wish list and summon again the same wish list.
pros: Rule the world or just a small nation.
Summon what and how many kystians you think you'll need.
Regular summoning and emergency powers still work.
cons: You can't rule the world if you send away your army occupying it.
Situations change; what you think you need now could change later.
Newer kystians. If you don't change your wish list, you can only have 19 of them.

name: Agettractiveness
overview: attract old people and animals, especially some foxy 70-year-old cougars and fine old Hugh Hefners.
description: It applies to any living species. You may find yourself followed by tortoises on the regular, but worry not. I hear they're mostly harmless.
pros: An army of sages!
Fine old women and men ;)
Hot cookies baked for you, daily!
cons: Wrinkly.... Things.
Saggy..... Ballooons.
You might cry because old things tend to die, so you best become a heartless jerk

name: Rise Of The Merlion
overview: turn into a merlion
description: With this power you can turn into a merlion, a monstrous create that has the head the lion and lower body of a fish/mermaid. In this form you can breathe underwater and have powerful jaws and teeth as well as a deafening roar.
pros: You can breathe under water
You have powerful jaws and teeth
You have a deafening roar
cons: You cannot breathe on land

name: Cat Breed Shift
overview: turn one breed of cat into another
description: With this power you can change the breed of a cat. You can turn a siamese cat into a persian cat and so on and so forth. You can change the breed of an individual cat as many time as you want.
pros: You can change the breed of any house cat
cons: You cannot change a house cat into a wild cat
This power has not effects on wild/jungle cats

name: 2 Heads Are Better Than One
overview: grow a second head
description: With this power you can grow a second head. As soon as you grow the second head both of your heads become super smart and you can solve almost any problem. You can only be in two head form for a period of 2 hours though and after that time the second head disappears and you go back to having your normal amount of intelligence.
pros: You can become super smart
You can scare people with your second head
cons: After 2 hours the second head disappears and you go back to your normal IQ level
You cannot revert to 1 head mode before the 2 hours are up do not use this power right before a date

name: Muppet Power Beaker's Talents
overview: have all of the talents of Beaker
description: Over the years the Muppet Beaker has been shown to have a variety of talents, from being mostly fire proof to beat boxing to making funny videos to shrinking Jack Black's head all the way down to being an assistant stage hand and dj. With this power you will be able to harness all of these abilities and skills. A side effect of this power is that hair turns bright red.
pros: You can beat box, be fireproof, play the guitar, make funny videos, shrink peoples heads, be a dj...
Your hair is bright red
cons: Your hair turns bright red and cannot be turned any other color even with dye or some sort of power

name: Rise Of The 3 Head Vampiric Sheep
overview: turn into a 3 headed vampiric sheep
description: With this power you can turn into a three headed vampiric sheep. You have all of the attributes of a normal vampiric sheep except for the three head part. One of the heads is a normal vampiric sheep head, the second head is a vampiric sheepacron robot head that shoots rockets from its nose and the third head is a super vampiric sheep head which breathes fire.
pros: You can turn into a 3 head vampiric sheep
You can shoot rockets from your nose
You can breathe fire
cons: You crave human flesh

name: Dog Breed Shift V2
overview: change wild dogs into domestic house dogs
description: With this power you can change any kind of wild dog into a domestic house dog. The affects of this power are irreversible.
pros: You can turn any wild dog into a domestic house dog
cons: The affects of this power are irreversible

name: App Power: Facebook
overview: psychically perceive the world through a Facebook-like system
description: With this power, you can view a person's psyche like a Facebook page. You can see their thoughts, their history, their likes, their relationships, etc. You can see where people are and what they're doing. You can communicate by mentally messaging others. With pokes you can influence people's behavior. You can also receive mental notifications. These notifications can alert you if someone is in trouble or if a crime is being committed. They can also serve as a danger sense to alert you to threats
pros: Mental pokes allow you to influence or control people
Learn everything about your enemies and stay informed on the status of your friends
Personal danger sense to help you in combat
cons: People with very strong wills can resist your pokes if they know what you're doing
You might learn things you didn't want to know
It can take practice to learn how to find what you need out of the billions of people on Earth

name: Procrastination
overview: wait.
description: You can wait like no one else.
pros: You have a large amount of patience.
You always seem to be the clincher, right on time, when needed.
You keep your cool in tight situations.
cons: You don't take initiatives.
Not a go-getter.
Hard to trust.

name: Spl User Summon
overview: summon any SPL user to your location.
description: By saying "Superpower List" followed by the screen name of an SPL user (the screen name used on the main site, not the forums), you can summon the person(s) behind said user name to your close vicinity. Saying "Release" followed by the screen name of a summoned user allows you to unsummon them and return them back to the exact location they were summoned from. You can only summon an SPL user if they are really far from you.
pros: Murder the top user of the SPL (currently Vespert, but some day WHD), so they stop acquiring powers.
Meet and hang out with the SPL users you get along with.
Get in touch with users who left the SPL a long time ago.
cons: Some screen names are unpronounceable and others are homophones, in which case the summon is random.
You may summon really creepy guys/girls, or even a group of people behind a single username.
It works with deceased users, but, well... You better have a solid heart and mind.

name: Muppet Power Lew Zealand's Fish
overview: have an unlimited supply of boomerang fish
description: With this power you have an unlimited amount of Lew Zealand's boomerang fish in a floating bucket that follows you around wherever you go. The fish can be used to throw at enemies, throw at the light switch when you're in bed and realize you forgot to turn off the light, or even for eating. The fish will always come back to you (even when you eat them though in a different more excretion related way). You also cannot make the floating bucket of fish go away.
pros: You have an unlimited supply of boomerang fish
The fish always come back to you
The fish can be used for a variety of things
cons: You cannot make the bucket go away

name: Zombie
overview: be a zombie.
description: This ability allows you to be a zombie. That means you are very strong and fast and you have increased attributes. But you must eat meat and you can lose some parts of body when you're a zombie for a long time.
pros: Increased attributes and high regeneration.
Dont feel PAIN.
No aging.
cons: Must eat meat.
You can lose some parts of body when you're zombie longer.
Can be killed just by Electricity or Fire.

name: Bob The Dinosaur
overview: summon a vegetarian dinosaur who gives wedgies
description: Exactly as it sounds. He gives wedgies to people you don't like, provided you ask nicely.
pros: Extremely funny to see someone getting a wedgie from a dinosaur
cons: When asked about his actions, Bob will tell people you told him to do it.
You might get sued.

name: Advanced Lyric Annoyance
overview: work lyrics to a currently playing song into conversation before they're mentioned in the song.
description: Whenever a song starts playing on the radio, you can immediately know the words coming up soon, they work them into your conversation.  Then when your tack is realized, it annoys the heck out of the people or person you're speaking with.
pros: You get some great "sour-face" reactions.
The stunned effect allows you to escape or turn the tables on your foe.
You get to know many great songs!
cons: There has to be music playing.
It works best only at the beggining of songs
It really annoying....

name: Acid Tears
overview: secrete nitric acid tears on command.
description: Secrete nitric acid tears when needed, good for burning through metal and items affected by acid.
pros: You are immune to the effects of your own acid tears.
cons: If upset, crying could prove bad results.

name: Lard
overview: control lard and use as a weapon of mass destruction
description:
The power to extract and control lard.
Much like a personal blobpet made out of lard uner your control. Only  your imagination sets limits for the wonders of this superpower!
pros: good crowd control
everyone will fear the master of lard
no limit to the power of the mighty lard
cons: Sticky
smells bad
takes a lot of space when it grows

name: Delete This Dunk Master
overview: dunk a basketball
description: The a dunk ability to dunk a baskeball. It cannot be used in situations where you are not dunking a basketball  so how is this a superpower?
pros: Can finally dunk, even if your short
Good if your arch-nemesis challenges you to a pick up game
Can show off in front of chicks
cons: Is useless outside of basketball
Doesn't make you shoot any better

name: Pwn Noobz
overview: pwn Noobz, Nubz, Newbiez, etc.
description: As soon as you see a Noob, you will point at them with your finger and their head will explode with blood and gore, and you will scream out "Boom Head-Shot! "
pros: Auto Kill a Noob
cons: Your mom's a Noob
You may be a noob

name: Snailishness
overview: be like a snail
description: With this power you can become like a snail at will. You lie down on your stomach and curl your legs up so that your feet rest on your shoulder blades. Then you bring your hands back into fists which you hold to either side of your head, with index fingers pointing out. In this mode, not only can you slide across the ground (at about one foot per second) but your legs become indestructible. However, you won't leave a slimy trail. It is notable that wherever you look, your fingers will point.
pros: Impress your friends with your awesome display of flexibility
Indestructible legs while in use
You can be like a snail
cons: Has very, very few practical applications
People will make fun of your lame power
Why would you want to be like a snail anyway?

name: Rise Of The Gorg
overview: turn into a gorg at will
description: With this power you can turn into a super strong, Fraggle-hating Gorg
pros: You are super strong
You live for hundreds of years (possibly forever)
cons: If you don't use your special cream you will vanish
People might not take you seriously thinking that you're just some crazy guy dressed as a muppet
They'll take you even less serious for your deep-seeded hatred for Fraggles...

name: Fart Factory
overview: fart on command: anytime, anyplace.
description: With this power, you can fart anytime you wish. The gaseous mix is rapidly formed in your colon, and then dispersed into the air behind you. The magnitude of the blast depends on how much you strain, and how long you charge your colon with gas. All unused natural gas compiles itself into your appendix, which is actually a very small portal to another universe, so there's no need to worry about it exploding. In fact, you could really put anything into your appendix, so long as it fits through.
pros: Never fart if you don't want to
Fun with drunks!
Become the World Farting Champion (after you establish the contest and find sponsors)
cons: Basically useless for combat
People may not want to hang around you
May have an aneurysm when trying to release an apocalyptic blast

name: Dwarf Planet Eater
overview: gain new powers when you eat dwarf planets
description: With this power you get a new power every time you eat a dwarf planet, like Pluto. You'd have to be able to breathe in space and some type of speed power would probably help
pros: You get a new power whenever you eat a dwarf planet
cons: Eventually you'll run out of dwarf planets
This power does not allow you breathe in space
You'll probably end up killing the people who inhabit these dwarf planets

name: Oz Teleportation
overview: teleport yourself and others to Oz
description: With this power you can teleport yourself and other into Oz whenever you want. When you're fighting bad guys you can simply teleport them all to Oz and let hem deal with it. Or you could go there and claim you're a wizard with some card tricks and special effects.
pros: You can go to Oz
The people of Oz are gullible so you can trick them into letting you become the new wizard
cons: They might not believe you're a wizard

name: Think Mouthless V2
overview: cause animal's mouths to disappear
description: With this power you can cause the mouths of animals to disappear. The animal will no longer be able to emit sounds or bite you. This is good if your breaking into a house (or enemy base) and there's a guard dog. You can simply cause the dog's mouth to disappear so the dog can't bark and alert the owners or bite you. You cannot cause the animal's mouth to reappear.
pros: You can make animal's mouths disappear
cons: You can't bring the mouths back

name: Ology Power: Dragonologist
overview: know everything about all dragon species
description: Ever wanted to be like Dr. Ernest Drake from the Dragonology books? Well, you're gonna be a lot more than him! You'll know everything about every dragon that ever lived.
pros: You will become a famous figure in the secret & ancient order of Dragonologists
Dragons may be more friendly to you compared to a normal human
cons: People might not believe in dragons & think you are crazy

name: Xylem Removal
overview: permanently remove xylem from plants
description: Xylem are specialized tunnels in a plant that move water from the roots to the shoots and leaves. Removing the xylem will hinder the plant's ability to photosynthesize and its ability to cool down by way of evaporation.
pros: Good counter against plant manipulators.
cons: Takes a long time for the effects of this to be felt.

name: Furplize
overview: turn a persons skin furry and purple.
description: Touch anyone's skin to turn their skin into very fuzzy and purple skin. Naturally this can not be reversed until you or any other person who owns this power, say "defurplize".
pros: Turn all who wish to be a furry, into one (although maybe not the furry of their choice)
Make your enemies go insane and make them even madder when they discover it's unshaveable.
Another reason to do the happy dance!
cons: Useless for people who lack hands.
You might want to avoid your family if you have this power.
If you prefer not to be furple, you can never touch yourself again.

name: Mouche (Housefly)
overview: dodge instantly once you see it with your fly eyes
description: By using your fly eyes, you can detect any enemy coming from behind you and then dodge accordingly
pros: Never be caught be surprised
Move really fast
Incredibly fast in flight.
cons: Have to be a fly hybrid
Once you're caught, you're helpless
Poor offensive capabilities

name: A Sexual Reproduction
overview: reproduce a-sexually, by yourself.
description:
This ability you reproduce in the same way as a cell.
You divide into two. Of course once you do you will be gone and you will have two offspring resulting with the exact same DNA structure as your own. So basically you divide into two of you. Which then divide into four then eight then sixteen and so on.
pros: So many of you running around the world.
cons: Misout on the joys of reproducing with a partner.

name: T Shirt Cannon Hands
overview: turn your hands into T-Shirt Cannons
description: With this power you can morph your arms into T-Shirt cannons like the ones they have at baseball games and other sporting events. You can make the T-Shirts have any image or say anything you want on them just by thinking about it and you can change the size of the shirt as well before you launch it at people. The cannon can only shoot T-Shirts and can't be loaded with anything else. When you're done you can just change your hands back to normal.
pros: You can turn your hands into T-Shirt Cannons
You can make the shirts have any design and be any size you want them to be
You can have a T-Shirt whenever you want
cons: All damage sustained in T-Shirt cannon mode transfers over to normal arm mode
You can't load anything else into the cannon besides T-Shirts

name: Muppet Power Gonzo's Creativity
overview: have Gonzo the Great's creativity
description: With this power you have all of Gonzo's creativity and weird ideas for death defying stunts. The power also gives you the ability to create these crazy stunts and no matter how insane it is you will survive. Another side effect of this power is that you have a strange attraction to chickens.
pros: You have all of Gonzo's creativity
You can recreate any of his stunts
You cannot be hurt while doing one of his stunts
cons: You only have invulnerability while doing a Gonzo stunt
You have a strange attraction to chickens

name: Ultimate Vampire Feeder
overview: produce anything an attacking vampire needs without harm.
description: This power will produce an infinite supply of any sustenance targeted by a vampire without harm to your personal supply or yourself. For instance, if a superpower vampire attacked you, your powers would remain and they would have an unlimited supply of food. This works with any form of vampirism. This power even seals puncture wounds and repairs other vampire-related damage to your body and blocks pain during feeding and possible transformation.
pros: Won't get drained of blood (or anything else targeted by a vampire).
If you become a vampire, you can choose not to feed; you can supply yourself.
Helpful to any vampire allies.
cons: May get captured by a group of vampires as an easy food source.
Useless if you do not encounter vampires.
Do not experience any positive effects of vampire feeding, unless this power is switched off.

name: Snap Everything Is Oatmeal
overview: turn anything into oatmeal
description: With this power you can turn absolutely anything into oatmeal. You can turn an enemy's weapons or getaway vehicle into oatmeal so they can't harm you or escape. You can turn a person's organs or blood into oatmeal to kill them. You can turn the lock or door to a room you're being held captive in into oatmeal for a quick escape. If you're stranded on an island somewhere you can turn the sand into oatmeal so you'll survive. The possibilities are endless!
pros: You can absolutely anything into oatmeal
Some examples of why this is useful are listed above
cons: If you're allergic to oatmeal this power is not very good for you

name: Greek To Japanese
overview: turn anything Greek, Japanese.
description: With this power you are able to turn Eos into Uzume, and Aelous into  Kami-no-Kaze and many more.
pros: Anything Greek to Japanese.
cons: It is basically the same thing.
You may not encounter many Greek things in your life.
The effect can not be reversed.

name: Anti Cat Lady
overview: stop people obsessed about cats.
description: With this power, you can stop that crazy lady down the street from being obsessed with cats. Therefore, you don't have them peeing all over your house and stuff. Does not work on any other animal/thing.
pros: Stop that annoying meowing
Actually be able to get to know them
Helps with allergies
cons: They'll need something else to fill the void
More mice around
The cats have to go somewhere...

name: Zodiac: Lunar: Goat
overview: use the power of the lunar calender's Goat
description: You draw upon the power of the Goat. You can transform into a goat, talk with goats, and digest anything in your stomach. This does not mean you can chew the stuff, or get it down your throat.
pros: Full moon gives full power.
Can use anything for nutrients.
cons: New moon gives no power.
Can only use if born in a year of the Goat. 1919, 1931, 1943, 1955, 1967, 1979, 1991, 2003, etc.
May not be able to swallow what you stuff in your mouth.

name: Cone Head
overview: turn people's heads into traffic cones
description: With this power you can turn people's heads into traffic cones this power can be used to make people stop talking and it can be really funny watching people run around with a traffic cone for a head
pros: People can't speak if they're head is a traffic cone
It can be funny
cons: You can't turn their head's back to normal so be careful

name: Ketchup Transformer
overview: turn anything into ketchup
description: Turn anything into ketchup!
pros: Turn anything into ketchup!
cons: You can only make 10,000 gallons of ketchup per day

name: Myth Power: Triptolemus' Trial
overview: channel Triptolemos' command over the essence of farming, sowing grain seeds, and making flour
description: Triptolemus (Triptolemos), in Greek myth, was the god of farming, and making flour. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and manipulate flour, as well as flour-yielding plants and other farm-crop plants. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel/command farmers, farm animals and beasts of burden. Furthermore, one can drain, by a touch, any nutrition and physical power (including enhanced stats) that others derive from farm grown foods.
pros: Psychically perceive and manipulate flour, flour-yielding plants and other farm-crop plants
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel/command farmers, farm animals and beasts of burden
Drain, by touch, nutrition and power that others gain from farm-grown foods (plant AND animal)
cons: Flour is not that common (have to keep it on hand)
Cannot turn subjects into farm animals by touch until the higher levels (no Con Negation)
People with agricultural, economic or cooking/food-based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: An Amazon Is You!
overview: become an amazon
description: You feel your muscles growing. You suddenly become much taller. You are now a superstrong young woman... An amazon!
pros: Men might be attracted to you
Super strength
cons: If you are a man you change gender.
Last for a day and night maximum
Men may not want to date you

name: Half Zombie
overview: be a half-human, half-zombie
description: Someone who holds this power is half-human, half-zombie. This means that the being has increased strength and speed, along with still being able to heal naturally. However, their healing rate suffers because they are partially undead and is at 50% of an ordinary human's. Someone with this power is also immune to further zombification because of already being part zombie.
pros: You're still a living being, so you can heal.
Your body won't rot unlike a full zombie's.
You have no need to eat brains in order to survive, since you still have your own mind.
cons: You still have pain receptors.
This power is kind of paradoxical.
People will treat you like you're evil even if you're good.

name: Beanie Babykinesis
overview: control Beanie Babies.
description: The power to animate and manipulate Beanie Babies. You can control more than one at a time and simply need to animate them and instruct them with your mind.
pros: The beanies hurt.
You can buy more.
They're really hard to destroy.
cons: Cost money.
You need room for all those Beanie Babies.
Chance that 5-year-olds may rule the world who may declare war if another doesn't share their M&Ms.

name: Acid Sweat V2
overview: make other people sweat
description: With this power you can turn other people's sweat into corrosive acid. The sweat will melt their skin and anything their sweat touches. You are able to the acid back into sweat. You can't use this power on yourself.
pros: You can turn other people's sweat into acid
cons: You cannot use this power on yourself

name: Thirteen Treasures: Skirt
overview: wear the mantle of Tegau Eufron
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. This mantle will be ankle length on faithful women, but will shorten in length as the woman becomes more and more faithless.
pros: Give it to your girlfriend, find out whether she is faithful!
Wear it to prove to your boyfriend that you're faithful!
Keep your ankles warm in Old English fashionable style!
cons: It doesn't look very nice. You'll have to cheat on your boyfriend to make your skirt look nicer.
You might find out you're being cheated on.

name: Myth Power: Potter's Potential2
overview: channel the Ceramic Daemons' command over the essence of pottery and ceramics
description: The Ceramic Daemons (Potter's Daemons, Daimones Keramikoi, Daemones Ceramicoi), in Greek myth, were the gods who plagued the craftsman and potter. As such, channeling Sabactes (Sabaktes- Smash, Crash) allows one to turn foes into clay statues by touch; as soon as they finish petrifying, they will crack and shatter. In addition, one is can withstand the same effects (petrifaction and powers that break up the body). Furthermore, one can negate others' petrifaction/separation immunity by touch.
pros: Turn foes into clay statues by touch; after they turn, they shatter into little (irreparable) pieces
Totally withstand the effects of petrifaction and separation type powers (vaporization, etc)
Negate the petrifaction and separation immunity of others by touch
cons: Cannot shatter non-petrified stone structures (or manipulate broken pieces) until the higher levels
Cannot mend broken subjects, or prevent/reverse petrifaction until the higher levels (NCN)
People with earth-based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Conditioner Breath
overview: breathe hair conditioner
description: If Shampoo Breath can be on here, then we're gonna need Conditioner Breath. Disclaimer: I know, I got this idea from someone else's power, but it felt right. I mean really, breathing conditioner!
pros: If you have a friend with Shampoo Breath, you'll both save a ton of money.
Conditioner is arguably even more slippery than shampoo.
cons: It does not make suds like shampoo does.
If you and your shampoo-breathing friend somehow get into a fight, no more free shampoo for you!

name: Stripes To Spots
overview: change stripes into spots
description: With this power you can turn stripes into spots. You can make spotted tigers and zebras, you can change your striped shirt into a spotted shirt and so on and so forth.
pros: You change stripes into spots
